name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.KIso.bijective_stalkMap
statement:
theorem KIso.bijective_stalkMap {A B : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} (e : KIso A B) (a : A) :
    Function.Bijective (e.hom.1.stalkMap a).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : IsIso (LocallyRingedSpace.forgetToSheafedSpace.map e.hom.1) := inferInstance
  have h₂ : IsIso (SheafedSpace.forgetToPresheafedSpace.map
      (LocallyRingedSpace.forgetToSheafedSpace.map e.hom.1)) := inferInstance
  have h₃ : IsIso e.hom.1.toShHom.hom := h₂
  have h₄ : IsIso (e.hom.1.stalkMap a) := inferInstanceAs (IsIso (e.hom.1.toShHom.hom.stalkMap a))
  exact (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp h₄

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.bijective_stalkMap_ofRestrict
statement:
theorem bijective_stalkMap_ofRestrict (X : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K) (U : Opens X)
    (x : X.restrictOpen U) : Function.Bijective ((ofRestrict X U).1.stalkMap x).hom
proof:
:=
  (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp (KLocallyRingedSpace.isIso_ofRestrict_stalkMap X U x)

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.isIso_stalkMap_restrictTo
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkMap_restrictTo {A B : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} (g : A ⟶ B) (U : Opens A)
    (U' : Opens B) (h : ∀ a ∈ U, Hom.toFun g a ∈ U') (a : A.restrictOpen U)
    (hg : IsIso (g.1.stalkMap ((ofRestrict A U).1.base a))) :
    IsIso ((Hom.restrictTo g U U' h).1.stalkMap a)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {φ ψ : A.restrictOpen U ⟶ B}, φ = ψ →
      IsIso (ψ.1.stalkMap a) → IsIso (φ.1.stalkMap a) := by
    rintro φ ψ rfl hψ
    exact hψ
  have h₂ : IsIso ((ofRestrict A U ≫ g).1.stalkMap a) := by
    rw [Hom.comp_val, LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp]
    exact IsIso.comp_isIso' hg (KLocallyRingedSpace.isIso_ofRestrict_stalkMap A U a)
  have h₁ := key (Hom.restrictTo_comp_ofRestrict g U U' h) h₂
  rw [Hom.comp_val, LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp] at h₁
  exact @IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (KLocallyRingedSpace.isIso_ofRestrict_stalkMap B U' _) h₁

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.bijective_stalkMap_restrictTo
statement:
theorem bijective_stalkMap_restrictTo {A B : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} (g : A ⟶ B) (U : Opens A)
    (U' : Opens B) (h : ∀ a ∈ U, Hom.toFun g a ∈ U') (a : A.restrictOpen U)
    (hg : Function.Bijective (g.1.stalkMap ((ofRestrict A U).1.base a)).hom) :
    Function.Bijective ((Hom.restrictTo g U U' h).1.stalkMap a).hom
proof:
:=
  (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp (isIso_stalkMap_restrictTo g U U' h a
    ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mpr hg))

name: CategoryTheory.uniq_of_conj
statement:
theorem uniq_of_conj {A A' B B' Z : C} (πA : A ⟶ Z) (πA' : A' ⟶ Z) (πB : B ⟶ Z) (πB' : B' ⟶ Z)
    (a : A ≅ A') (b : B ≅ B') (ha : a.hom ≫ πA' = πA) (hb : b.hom ≫ πB' = πB)
    (huniq : ∀ s s' : A' ⟶ B', IsIso s → IsIso s' → s ≫ πB' = πA' → s' ≫ πB' = πA' → s = s')
    (s s' : A ⟶ B) (hs : IsIso s) (hs' : IsIso s') (hc : s ≫ πB = πA) (hc' : s' ≫ πB = πA) :
    s = s'
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ t : A ⟶ B, t ≫ πB = πA → (a.inv ≫ t ≫ b.hom) ≫ πB' = πA' := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hb, ht, ← ha, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have h := huniq (a.inv ≫ s ≫ b.hom) (a.inv ≫ s' ≫ b.hom)
    (@IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Iso.isIso_inv a)
      (@IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hs (Iso.isIso_hom b)))
    (@IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Iso.isIso_inv a)
      (@IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hs' (Iso.isIso_hom b)))
    (key s hc) (key s' hc')
  exact (Iso.cancel_iso_hom_right _ _ b).mp ((Iso.cancel_iso_inv_left a _ _).mp h)

name: CategoryTheory.over_of_conj_inv_hom
statement:
theorem over_of_conj_inv_hom {A A' B B' Z : C} (a : A ≅ A') (b : B ≅ B') (pA : A ⟶ Z)
    (pA' : A' ⟶ Z) (pB : B ⟶ Z) (pB' : B' ⟶ Z) (ha : a.inv ≫ pA = pA') (hb : b.hom ≫ pB' = pB)
    (s : A ⟶ B) (hs : pA = s ≫ pB) : pA' = (a.inv ≫ s ≫ b.hom) ≫ pB'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hb, ← hs, ha]

name: CategoryTheory.conj_conj_inv
statement:
theorem conj_conj_inv {A A' B B' : C} (a : A ≅ A') (b : B ≅ B') (f : A ⟶ B) :
    a.hom ≫ (a.inv ≫ f ≫ b.hom) ≫ b.inv = f
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.over_comp₃
statement:
theorem over_comp₃ {A B C' D YA YB YC YD Z : C} (e : A ⟶ B) (t : B ⟶ C') (f : C' ⟶ D)
    (ofA : A ⟶ YA) (ofB : B ⟶ YB) (ofC : C' ⟶ YC) (ofD : D ⟶ YD) (pA : YA ⟶ Z) (pB : YB ⟶ Z)
    (pC : YC ⟶ Z) (pD : YD ⟶ Z) (he : ofA ≫ pA = (e ≫ ofB) ≫ pB)
    (ht : ofB ≫ pB = (t ≫ ofC) ≫ pC) (hf : ofC ≫ pC = (f ≫ ofD) ≫ pD) :
    ofA ≫ pA = ((e ≫ t ≫ f) ≫ ofD) ≫ pD
proof:
:= by
  rw [he, Category.assoc, ht, Category.assoc, hf]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: CategoryTheory.over_inv_of_over
statement:
theorem over_inv_of_over {A A' Y Y' Z : C} (α : A ⟶ A') [IsIso α] (ofR : A ⟶ Y) (ofR' : A' ⟶ Y')
    (p : Y ⟶ Z) (p' : Y' ⟶ Z) (h : ofR ≫ p = (α ≫ ofR') ≫ p') :
    ofR' ≫ p' = (inv α ≫ ofR) ≫ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, h, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: CategoryTheory.conj_over_eq
statement:
theorem conj_over_eq {A A' B B' Y Y' Z : C} (a : A ⟶ A') (s : A' ⟶ B') (b : B' ⟶ B) (ofA : A ⟶ Y)
    (ofA' : A' ⟶ Y) (ofB : B ⟶ Y') (ofB' : B' ⟶ Y') (p : Y ⟶ Z) (p' : Y' ⟶ Z)
    (ha : a ≫ ofA' = ofA) (hb : b ≫ ofB = ofB') (hs : ofA' ≫ p = (s ≫ ofB') ≫ p') :
    (a ≫ s ≫ b) ≫ ofB ≫ p' = ofA ≫ p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc b, hb, ← Category.assoc s, ← hs, ← Category.assoc, ha]

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.exists_iso_restrictOpen_restrictOpen_comap
statement:
theorem exists_iso_restrictOpen_restrictOpen_comap {A Z : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} (g : A ⟶ Z)
    (U : Opens A) (U' : Opens Z) (h : ∀ a ∈ U, Hom.toFun g a ∈ U') (O : Opens Z)
    (hOU : ∀ a, Hom.toFun g a ∈ O → a ∈ U) :
    ∃ e : (A.restrictOpen U).restrictOpen
          (Opens.comap ⟨Hom.toFun (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U'),
            Hom.continuous_toFun (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U')⟩ O) ⟶
        A.restrictOpen (Opens.comap ⟨Hom.toFun g, Hom.continuous_toFun g⟩ O),
      IsIso e ∧ ofRestrict _ _ ≫ (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U') =
        (e ≫ ofRestrict _ _) ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : ∀ a : A.restrictOpen U,
      Hom.toFun (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U') a = Hom.toFun g a.1 := fun a =>
    Hom.toFun_restrictTo g U U' h a
  have hinst : AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion
      (ofRestrict (A.restrictOpen U)
        (Opens.comap ⟨Hom.toFun (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U'),
          Hom.continuous_toFun (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U')⟩ O) ≫
        ofRestrict A U).1 :=
    inferInstanceAs (AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion
      ((ofRestrict (A.restrictOpen U) _).1 ≫ (ofRestrict A U).1))
  have hrange : range (Hom.toFun (ofRestrict (A.restrictOpen U)
        (Opens.comap ⟨Hom.toFun (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U'),
          Hom.continuous_toFun (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U')⟩ O) ≫
        ofRestrict A U)) =
      range (Hom.toFun (ofRestrict A (Opens.comap ⟨Hom.toFun g, Hom.continuous_toFun g⟩ O))) := by
    rw [range_toFun_ofRestrict]
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
      change Hom.toFun g v.1.1 ∈ O
      rw [← hπ]
      exact v.2
    · intro ha
      refine ⟨Subtype.mk (Subtype.mk a (hOU a ha)) ?_, rfl⟩
      change Hom.toFun (Hom.restrictTo g U U' h ≫ ofRestrict Z U') (Subtype.mk a (hOU a ha)) ∈
        (O : Set Z)
      exact Set.mem_of_eq_of_mem (hπ (Subtype.mk a (hOU a ha))) ha
  refine ⟨(isoOfRangeEq _ _ hrange).hom, Iso.isIso_hom _, ?_⟩
  rw [isoOfRangeEq_hom_comp, Category.assoc, Hom.restrictTo_comp_ofRestrict g U U' h]

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.mem_imageOpens
statement:
theorem mem_imageOpens {X : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} {V : Opens X} {T : Opens (X.restrictOpen V)}
    {x : X} : x ∈ imageOpens V T ↔ ∃ hx : x ∈ V, (⟨x, hx⟩ : V) ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ Set.range (Hom.toFun (ofRestrict (X.restrictOpen V) T ≫ ofRestrict X V)) ↔ _
  rw [Hom.range_toFun_comp, range_toFun_ofRestrict]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y.2, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hT⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hT, rfl⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.imageOpens_map_eq
statement:
theorem imageOpens_map_eq (X : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K) {V T : Opens X} (h : T ≤ V) :
    imageOpens V ((Opens.map (ofRestrict X V).1.base).obj T) = T
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
  rw [mem_imageOpens]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hT⟩
    exact hT
  · intro hT
    exact ⟨h hT, hT⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_kIso'
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_kIso' {A B : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} (e : KIso A B) (a : A)
    (h : IsRegularLocalRing (A.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk a)) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (B.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk (e.hom.1.base a))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_restrictOpen
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_restrictOpen (X : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K) (U : Opens X)
    (x : X.restrictOpen U) (h : IsRegularLocalRing (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x.1)) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((X.restrictOpen U).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:=
  @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ h _ _
    (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictStalkIso (Opens.isOpenEmbedding U)
      x).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

name: AnalyticSpace.span_germ_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem span_germ_le_maximalIdeal (z : localModel K n G f) :
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j)) ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact germ_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_cosupport G f z j)

name: AnalyticSpace.smul_toCotangent_eq
statement:
theorem smul_toCotangent_eq (q : Kn.{u} K n)
    (a : (structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q)
    (g : maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q)) :
    a • (maximalIdeal _).toCotangent g =
      Manifold.eval K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n) q a • (maximalIdeal _).toCotangent g
proof:
:= by
  have hm : a - algebraMap K _ (Manifold.eval K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n) q a) ∈ maximalIdeal _ :=
    (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval (Kn.{u} K n) _).mpr
      (by rw [map_sub, algebraMap_stalk_eq, eval_const, sub_self])
  have h0 := Ideal.Cotangent.smul_eq_zero_of_mem hm ((maximalIdeal _).toCotangent g)
  rw [sub_smul, sub_eq_zero] at h0
  rw [h0, algebraMap_smul]

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_span_eq_of_isRegularLocalRing_stalk
statement:
theorem exists_span_eq_of_isRegularLocalRing_stalk (z : localModel K n G f)
    (hreg : IsRegularLocalRing ((localModel K n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    ∃ (c : ℕ) (h : Fin c → (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1),
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j)) =
        Ideal.span (Set.range h) ∧
      LinearIndependent K (fun j => dlin K n z.1.1 (h j)) ∧
      (c : WithBot ℕ∞) +
        ringKrullDim ((localModel K n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z) =
          ((n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have := isRegularLocalRing_stalk_affine K n z.1.1
  have : IsRegularLocalRing ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1 ⧸
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j))) :=
    @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ hreg _ _ (stalkEquivQuotientF z)
  obtain ⟨m, c, x, hcm, hm, hx, hI, hdimI⟩ :=
    exists_regularSystemOfParameters_of_quotient_and_ringKrullDim
      (Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j)))
  have hmn : m = n := by
    have := hm.trans (ringKrullDim_stalk_affine K n z.1.1)
    exact_mod_cast this
  subst hmn
  refine ⟨c, fun j => x (Fin.castLE hcm j), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hI]
    congr 1
    ext s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨j.val, hj⟩, by simp⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Fin.castLE hcm j, j.2, rfl⟩
  · have hmem : ∀ j, x (Fin.castLE hcm j) ∈ maximalIdeal _ := fun j =>
      x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq x hx _
    exact (exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_extending_iff K _ z.1.1 _ hmem).mp
      ⟨x, Fin.castLEEmb hcm, hx, hm, fun _ => rfl⟩
  · rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (stalkEquivQuotientF z), add_comm]
    exact hdimI.trans (ringKrullDim_stalk_affine K _ z.1.1)

name: AnalyticSpace.toCotangent_mem_span_of_mem_span
statement:
theorem toCotangent_mem_span_of_mem_span (q : Kn.{u} K n) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (g : ι → (structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q)
    (hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q))
    {s : (structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q}
    (hs : s ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q))
    (h : s ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range g)) :
    (maximalIdeal _).toCotangent ⟨s, hs⟩ ∈
      Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => (maximalIdeal _).toCotangent ⟨g i, hg i⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp h
  have hsum : (⟨s, hs⟩ : maximalIdeal _) = ∑ i, a i • (⟨g i, hg i⟩ : maximalIdeal _) := by
    ext
    simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact ha.symm
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, smul_toCotangent_eq]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: AnalyticSpace.cotangentClass_eq_toCotangent
statement:
theorem cotangentClass_eq_toCotangent (q : Kn.{u} K n)
    {s : (structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q}
    (hs : s ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q)) :
    cotangentClass (Kn.{u} K n) q s = (maximalIdeal _).toCotangent ⟨s, hs⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold cotangentClass
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (by
    simp only
    rw [(mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval (Kn.{u} K n) s).mp hs, map_zero, sub_zero])

name: AnalyticSpace.linearIndependent_dlin_iff_toCotangent
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_dlin_iff_toCotangent (q : Kn.{u} K n) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (h : ι → (structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q)
    (hm : ∀ i, h i ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk q)) :
    LinearIndependent K (fun i => dlin K n q (h i)) ↔
      LinearIndependent K (fun i => (maximalIdeal _).toCotangent ⟨h i, hm i⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have := (linearIndependent_cotangentClass_iff_linearPart (Kn.{u} K n) ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift
    (chartAt (Kn.{u} K n) q) (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas q) (mem_chart_source _ q) h).symm
  simp only [cotangentClass_eq_toCotangent q (hm _)] at this
  exact this

name: AnalyticSpace.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_iff_jacobian
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_iff_jacobian (z : localModel K n G f) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((localModel K n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z) ↔
      ∃ (c : ℕ) (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin k),
        (c : WithBot ℕ∞) +
            ringKrullDim ((localModel K n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z) =
          ((n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        LinearIndependent K (fun j => dlin K n z.1.1
          ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hreg
    obtain ⟨c, h, hgen, hind, hcount⟩ := exists_span_eq_of_isRegularLocalRing_stalk G f z hreg
    
    have hmh : ∀ j, h j ∈ maximalIdeal _ := fun j =>
      (span_germ_le_maximalIdeal z) (hgen ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    have hmf : ∀ i, (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f i) ∈
        maximalIdeal _ := germ_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_cosupport G f z
    let vh : Fin c →
        CotangentSpace ((structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk z.1.1) :=
      fun j => (maximalIdeal _).toCotangent ⟨h j, hmh j⟩
    let vf : Fin k →
        CotangentSpace ((structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.stalk z.1.1) :=
      fun i => (maximalIdeal _).toCotangent ⟨_, hmf i⟩
    have hvh : LinearIndependent K vh :=
      (linearIndependent_dlin_iff_toCotangent z.1.1 h hmh).mp hind
    
    have hspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range vf) = Submodule.span K (Set.range vh) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · rw [Submodule.span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact toCotangent_mem_span_of_mem_span z.1.1 h hmh (hmf i)
          (hgen ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      · rw [Submodule.span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
        exact toCotangent_mem_span_of_mem_span z.1.1 _ hmf (hmh j)
          (hgen.symm ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    
    have hfin : Module.finrank K (Submodule.span K (Set.range vf)) = c := by
      rw [hspan, finrank_span_eq_card hvh, Fintype.card_fin]
    obtain ⟨t, htsub, htspan, htli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent K (Set.range vf)
    have htfin : t.Finite := (Set.finite_range vf).subset htsub
    let _ := htfin.fintype
    have htcard : Fintype.card t = c := by
      rw [← Set.toFinset_card, ← finrank_span_set_eq_card htli, htspan, hfin]
    let e : Fin c ≃ t := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq htcard).symm
    have hidx : ∀ u : t, ∃ i, vf i = u.1 := fun u => htsub u.2
    choose idx hidx using hidx
    refine ⟨c, ⟨fun j => idx (e j), fun j j' hjj' => ?_⟩, hcount, ?_⟩
    · exact e.injective (Subtype.ext
        ((hidx (e j)).symm.trans ((congrArg vf hjj').trans (hidx (e j')))))
    change LinearIndependent K fun j => dlin K n z.1.1
      ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (idx (e j))))
    refine (linearIndependent_dlin_iff_toCotangent z.1.1 _ (fun j => hmf (idx (e j)))).mpr ?_
    have key : LinearIndependent K (Subtype.val ∘ e) := htli.comp e e.injective
    convert key using 1
    funext j
    exact hidx (e j)
  · rintro ⟨c, σ, hcount, hind⟩
    have := isRegularLocalRing_stalk_affine K n z.1.1
    have hm : ∀ j, (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j)) ∈
        maximalIdeal _ := fun j => germ_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_cosupport G f z (σ j)
    have hJ := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_range_and_ringKrullDim K n z.1.1
      (fun j => (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j))) hm hind
    have hregJ : IsRegularLocalRing ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1 ⧸
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j)))) := hJ.1
    have hdimJ : ringKrullDim ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1 ⧸
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j)))) +
        (c : WithBot ℕ∞) = ((n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := hJ.2
    have hJI : Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j))) ≤
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j)) :=
      Ideal.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨σ j, rfl⟩)
    have hne : (Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j))).map
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j))))) ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro htop
      have h1 : (1 : _ ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j)))) ∈
          (Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
            (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j))).map
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
      obtain ⟨s, hsI, hs1⟩ :=
        (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp h1
      have hs : s - 1 ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f (σ j))) :=
        Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp (hs1.trans (map_one _).symm)
      have h1I : (1 : (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1) ∈
          Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
            (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j)) := by
        simpa using Ideal.sub_mem _ hsI (hJI hs)
      exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top
        ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr (span_germ_le_maximalIdeal z h1I))
    have hle := IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hne
    have hdimX : ringKrullDim ((localModel K n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z) =
        ((n - c : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      WithBot.eq_natCast_sub_of_add_natCast_eq (by rwa [add_comm] at hcount)
    have hdimJ' := WithBot.eq_natCast_sub_of_add_natCast_eq hdimJ
    have hq := (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE hJI)).trans
      (((ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (stalkEquivQuotientF z)).symm.trans hdimX).trans hdimJ'.symm)
    have hbot := eq_bot_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_eq hle hq
    have e := (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLE hJI).symm.trans
      ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hbot).trans (RingEquiv.quotientBot _))
    have hregI := IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e.symm
    exact @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ hregI _ _ (stalkEquivQuotientF z).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_chart_extending_affine
statement:
theorem exists_chart_extending_affine {c : ℕ} (z : Fin c → Kn.{u} K n → K) (q : Kn.{u} K n)
    (hz : ∀ i, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) 𝓘(K) ω (z i) q) (hz0 : ∀ i, z i q = 0)
    (hind : HasIndependentDifferentialsAt (Kn.{u} K n) z q) :
    ∃ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)) (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n),
      e ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) ω (Kn.{u} K n) ∧ q ∈ e.source ∧ e q = 0 ∧
      ∀ y ∈ e.source, ∀ i, z i y = (e y).down (σ i)
proof:
:=
  exists_chart_extending ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift z q hz hz0 hind

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_cosupport
statement:
theorem germ_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_cosupport (z : localModel K n G f) (j : Fin k) :
    (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, isUnit_germ_affine_iff K n G z.1 (f j),
    not_not]
  exact (mem_cosupport_modelIdeal_iff K n G f z.1).mp z.2 j

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_modelChartData
statement:
theorem exists_modelChartData (z : localModel K n G f) {c : ℕ}
    (h : Fin c → (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G z.1.1 z.1.2 (f i)) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range h))
    (hind : LinearIndependent K (fun i => dlin K n z.1.1 (h i))) :
    Nonempty (ModelChartData G f z c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hqG : z.1.1 ∈ G := z.1.2
  
  choose U' hqU' s' hs' using fun i =>
    (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.exists_germ_eq (h i)
  let U : Opens (Kn.{u} K n) := G ⊓ ⨅ i, U' i
  have hqU : z.1.1 ∈ U := Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hqG, mem_iInf_opens.mpr hqU'⟩
  have hUG : U ≤ G := inf_le_left
  have hUU' : ∀ i, U ≤ U' i := fun i => inf_le_right.trans (iInf_le _ i)
  let hs : Fin c → AnalyticFun K n U := fun i =>
    (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hUU' i)).op (s' i)
  have hhs : ∀ i, (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U z.1.1 hqU (hs i) = h i :=
    fun i => (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ (homOfLE (hUU' i)) z.1.1 hqU (s' i)).trans (hs' i)
  let fU : Fin k → AnalyticFun K n U := fun j =>
    (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUG).op (f j)
  have hfU : ∀ (j : Fin k) y (hy : y ∈ U),
      (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U y hy (fU j) =
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G y (hUG hy) (f j) :=
    fun j y hy => TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ y hy (f j)
  
  have hm : ∀ i, h i ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z.1.1) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : h i ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range h) := Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← hgen] at h1
    refine (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) h1
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact germ_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_cosupport G f z j
  have hz0 : ∀ i, extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) (hs i) z.1.1 = 0 := fun i => by
    rw [extendSection_of_mem K (Kn.{u} K n) (hs i) hqU]
    have := (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval (Kn.{u} K n) (h i)).mp (hm i)
    rw [← hhs i] at this
    exact (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) 𝓘(K) ω (Kn.{u} K n) K U z.1.1 hqU
      (hs i)).symm.trans this
  have hz : ∀ i, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) 𝓘(K) ω (extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) (hs i)) z.1.1 :=
    fun i => (contMDiffOn_extendSection (hs i)).contMDiffAt (U.isOpen.mem_nhds hqU)
  have hind' : HasIndependentDifferentialsAt (Kn.{u} K n)
      (fun i => extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) (hs i)) z.1.1 := by
    rw [← linearIndependent_dlin_germ_iff_hasIndependentDifferentialsAt K n U hs z.1.1 hqU]
    simpa only [hhs] using hind
  obtain ⟨e, σ, he, hqe, -, hcoord⟩ := exists_chart_extending_affine K n _ z.1.1 hz hz0 hind'
  
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U z.1.1 hqU (fU j)) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U z.1.1 hqU (hs i)) := by
    simp only [hfU, hhs]
    exact hgen
  have hf_mem : ∀ j, ∃ (W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)) (_ : z.1.1 ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U), ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W),
      (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U y (hWU hy) (fU j) ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U y (hWU hy) (hs i)) :=
    fun j => exists_forall_germ_mem_span (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf hqU (fU j) hs
      (hspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  have hs_mem : ∀ i, ∃ (W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)) (_ : z.1.1 ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U), ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W),
      (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U y (hWU hy) (hs i) ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
          (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U y (hWU hy) (fU j)) :=
    fun i => exists_forall_germ_mem_span (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf hqU (hs i) fU
      (hspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  choose W₁ hqW₁ hW₁U hW₁ using hf_mem
  choose W₂ hqW₂ hW₂U hW₂ using hs_mem
  let eS : Opens (Kn.{u} K n) := ⟨e.source, e.open_source⟩
  let W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n) := U ⊓ (⨅ j, W₁ j) ⊓ (⨅ i, W₂ i) ⊓ eS
  have hqW : z.1.1 ∈ W := Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨Opens.mem_inf.mpr
    ⟨hqU, mem_iInf_opens.mpr hqW₁⟩, mem_iInf_opens.mpr hqW₂⟩, hqe⟩
  have hWU : W ≤ U := inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
  have hWW₁ : ∀ j, W ≤ W₁ j := fun j =>
    inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_right.trans (iInf_le _ j)))
  have hWW₂ : ∀ i, W ≤ W₂ i := fun i => inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_right.trans (iInf_le _ i))
  have hWe : (W : Set (Kn.{u} K n)) ⊆ e.source := fun y hy => (inf_le_right : W ≤ eS) hy
  refine ⟨⟨U, hUG, hs, e, he, σ, W, hqW, hWU, hWe, hcoord, fun y hy => ?_⟩⟩
  have hyU : y ∈ U := hWU hy
  have : Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G y (hUG hyU) (f j)) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U y hyU (fU j)) := by
    simp only [hfU]
  rw [this]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact hW₁ j y (hWW₁ j hy)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hW₂ i y (hWW₂ i hy)

name: AnalyticSpace.ModelChartData.eval_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eval_eq_zero_iff {y : Kn.{u} K n} (hy : y ∈ D.W) :
    (∀ j, (f j).eval ⟨y, D.hU (D.hWU hy)⟩ = 0) ↔ ∀ i, (D.e y).down (D.σ i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hyU : y ∈ D.U := D.hWU hy
  have hyG : y ∈ G := D.hU hyU
  have h1 : ∀ j, (f j).eval ⟨y, hyG⟩ = 0 ↔
      (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G y hyG (f j) ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk y) := fun j =>
    ((not_congr (isUnit_germ_affine_iff K n G ⟨y, hyG⟩ (f j))).trans not_not).symm.trans
      (by rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff])
  have h2 : ∀ i, (D.hs i).eval ⟨y, hyU⟩ = 0 ↔
      (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ D.U y hyU (D.hs i) ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk y) := fun i =>
    ((not_congr (isUnit_germ_affine_iff K n D.U ⟨y, hyU⟩ (D.hs i))).trans not_not).symm.trans
      (by rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff])
  have key : (∀ j, (f j).eval ⟨y, hyG⟩ = 0) ↔ ∀ i, (D.hs i).eval ⟨y, hyU⟩ = 0 := by
    simp only [h1, h2]
    constructor
    · intro hf i
      have : (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ D.U y hyU (D.hs i) ∈
          Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
            (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ D.U y hyU (D.hs i)) :=
        Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
      rw [← D.hideal y hy] at this
      exact (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact hf j)) this
    · intro hh j
      have : (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G y hyG (f j) ∈
          Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
            (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ G y (D.hU (D.hWU hy)) (f j)) :=
        Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
      rw [D.hideal y hy] at this
      exact (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hh i)) this
  rw [key]
  refine forall_congr' fun i => ?_
  rw [← D.hcoord y (D.hWe hy) i, extendSection_of_mem K (Kn.{u} K n) (D.hs i) hyU]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.ModelChartData.hasIndependentDifferentialsAt
statement:
theorem hasIndependentDifferentialsAt {y : Kn.{u} K n} (hy : y ∈ D.e.source) :
    HasIndependentDifferentialsAt (Kn.{u} K n)
      (fun i => extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) (D.hs i)) y
proof:
:= by
  have h := (isAdaptedChart_zeroSet' (ψ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift) D.he D.σ
    ).hasIndependentDifferentialsAt hy
  unfold HasIndependentDifferentialsAt at h ⊢
  have : (fun i => mderivFun (Kn.{u} K n) (extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) (D.hs i)) y) =
      fun i => mderivFun (Kn.{u} K n)
        (fun x => (ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift : Kn.{u} K n ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) (D.e x) (D.σ i))
        y := by
    funext i
    unfold mderivFun
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
    filter_upwards [D.e.open_source.mem_nhds hy] with x hx
    exact D.hcoord x hx i
  rw [this]
  exact h

name: Manifold.mem_relationSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_relationSubmodule_iff (F : Fin q → Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ U)
    (a : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) :
    a ∈ relationSubmodule 𝒪 F y hy ↔ ∀ i, ∑ j, 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y hy (F i j) * a j = 0
proof:
:=
  mem_relKer_iff _ a

name: Manifold.relationSubmodule_res
statement:
theorem relationSubmodule_res {V : Opens X} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (F : Fin q → Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ V) :
    relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun i j => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (F i j)) y hy =
      relationSubmodule 𝒪 F y (hVU hy)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [mem_relationSubmodule_iff, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: Manifold.HasLocalGeneratorsOn.mono
statement:
theorem HasLocalGeneratorsOn.mono
    {M : ∀ y : X, y ∈ U → Submodule (𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) (Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y)}
    (h : HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p M) {V : Opens X} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 V p fun y hy => M y (hVU hy)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWU, hxW, k, r, hr⟩ := h x (hVU hx)
  refine ⟨W ⊓ V, inf_le_right, ⟨hxW, hx⟩, k,
    fun l j => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ≤ W)).op (r l j), fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have : (fun l => fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ (W ⊓ V) y hy
      (𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ≤ W)).op (r l j))) =
      fun l => fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ W y hy.1 (r l j) := by
    funext l j
    exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  rw [this]
  exact hr y hy.1

name: Manifold.hasLocalGeneratorsOn_of_forall_exists
statement:
theorem hasLocalGeneratorsOn_of_forall_exists
    {M : ∀ y : X, y ∈ U → Submodule (𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) (Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y)}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ (V : Opens X) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧
      HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 V p fun y hy => M y (hVU hy)) :
    HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p M
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, hV⟩ := h x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, k, r, hr⟩ := hV x hxV
  exact ⟨W, hWV.trans hVU, hxW, k, r, hr⟩

name: Manifold.HasLocalGeneratorsOn.congr
statement:
theorem HasLocalGeneratorsOn.congr
    {M N : ∀ y : X, y ∈ U → Submodule (𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) (Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y)}
    (h : HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p M) (hMN : ∀ y hy, M y hy = N y hy) :
    HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p N
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k, r, hr⟩ := h x hx
  exact ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k, r, fun y hy => (hMN y (hVU hy)).symm.trans (hr y hy)⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isCoherent_top_iff
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.isCoherent_top_iff :
    (⊤ : IdealSheaf 𝒪).IsCoherent ↔ ∀ J : IdealSheaf 𝒪, J.IsCoherent
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h J U p g _ => h U p g fun j => ?_, fun h => h ⊤⟩
  rw [IdealSheaf.carrier_top]
  exact Submodule.mem_top

name: Manifold.IsCoherent.isCoherent_top
statement: theorem IsCoherent.isCoherent_top (h : IsCoherent 𝒪) : (⊤ : IdealSheaf 𝒪).IsCoherent
proof:
:=
  fun U p g _ => h U p 1 fun _ => g

name: Manifold.relKer_of_isEmpty
statement: theorem relKer_of_isEmpty {p q : ℕ} [IsEmpty (Fin q)] (F : Fin q → Fin p → R) : relKer F = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [mem_relKer_iff, Submodule.mem_top, iff_true]
  exact fun i => isEmptyElim i

name: Manifold.span_range_single_one_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_range_single_one_eq_top (p : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range fun l : Fin p => (Pi.single l (1 : R) : Fin p → R)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := (Pi.basisFun R (Fin p)).span_eq
  have hr : Set.range (Pi.basisFun R (Fin p)) =
      Set.range fun l : Fin p => (Pi.single l (1 : R) : Fin p → R) := by
    ext v; simp [Pi.basisFun_apply]
  rwa [hr] at this

name: Manifold.sum_mul_sum_swap
statement:
theorem sum_mul_sum_swap {p k : ℕ} (f : Fin p → R) (g : Fin k → Fin p → R) (c : Fin k → R) :
    ∑ j, f j * ∑ l, c l * g l j = ∑ l, (∑ j, f j * g l j) * c l
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

name: Manifold.sum_mul_sum_swap'
statement:
theorem sum_mul_sum_swap' {p k : ℕ} (f : Fin p → R) (g : Fin k → Fin p → R) (c : Fin k → R) :
    ∑ j, f j * ∑ l, c l * g l j = ∑ l, c l * ∑ j, f j * g l j
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

name: Manifold.relKer_succ_eq_span
statement:
theorem relKer_succ_eq_span {p q k m : ℕ} (F : Fin (q + 1) → Fin p → R) (A : Fin k → Fin p → R)
    (B : Fin m → Fin k → R)
    (hA : relKer (fun i => F i.succ) = Submodule.span R (Set.range A))
    (hB : relKer (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun l => ∑ j, F 0 j * A l j) = Submodule.span R (Set.range B)) :
    relKer F = Submodule.span R (Set.range fun i => fun j => ∑ l, B i l * A l j)
proof:
:= by
  have hArel : ∀ (l : Fin k) (i : Fin q), ∑ j, F i.succ j * A l j = 0 := by
    intro l i
    have : A l ∈ relKer (fun i => F i.succ) := by
      rw [hA]; exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_relKer_iff _ _).1 this i
  have hBrel : ∀ i, ∑ l, (∑ j, F 0 j * A l j) * B i l = 0 := by
    intro i
    have : B i ∈ relKer (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun l => ∑ j, F 0 j * A l j) := by
      rw [hB]; exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_relKer_iff _ _).1 this 0
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro a ha
    rw [mem_relKer_iff] at ha
    have ha' : a ∈ relKer (fun i => F i.succ) := by
      rw [mem_relKer_iff]; exact fun i => ha i.succ
    rw [hA, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at ha'
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ha'
    have hc0 : c ∈ relKer (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun l => ∑ j, F 0 j * A l j) := by
      rw [mem_relKer_iff]
      intro _
      have h0 := ha 0
      rw [← hc] at h0
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h0
      calc ∑ l, (∑ j, F 0 j * A l j) * c l = ∑ j, F 0 j * ∑ l, c l * A l j :=
            (sum_mul_sum_swap _ _ _).symm
        _ = 0 := h0
    rw [hB, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hc0
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hc0
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
    rw [← hc]
    funext j
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have : ∀ l, c l = ∑ i, d i * B i l := by
      intro l
      have := congrFun hd l
      simpa [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this.symm
    simp only [this, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_relKer_iff]
    intro r
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun r' => ?_) r
    · calc ∑ j, F 0 j * ∑ l, B i l * A l j = ∑ l, (∑ j, F 0 j * A l j) * B i l :=
            sum_mul_sum_swap _ _ _
        _ = 0 := hBrel i
    · calc ∑ j, F r'.succ j * ∑ l, B i l * A l j = ∑ l, B i l * ∑ j, F r'.succ j * A l j :=
            sum_mul_sum_swap' _ _ _
        _ = 0 := by simp only [hArel, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: Manifold.isCoherent_of_isCoherent_top
statement: theorem isCoherent_of_isCoherent_top (h : (⊤ : IdealSheaf 𝒪).IsCoherent) : IsCoherent 𝒪
proof:
:= by
  intro U p q F
  induction q generalizing U p with
  | zero =>
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨U, le_rfl, hx, p, fun l j => if l = j then 1 else 0, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [relationSubmodule, relKer_of_isEmpty]
    have : (fun l => fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y hy
        (if l = j then (1 : 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)) else 0)) =
        fun l : Fin p => (Pi.single l (1 : 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) := by
      funext l j
      by_cases hlj : l = j
      · subst hlj; simp
      · simp [hlj, Ne.symm hlj]
    rw [this, span_range_single_one_eq_top]
  | succ q ih =>
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k, A, hA⟩ := ih U p (fun i => F i.succ) x hx
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, m, B, hB⟩ :=
      h V k (fun l => ∑ j, 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (F 0 j) * A l j)
        (fun _ => by rw [IdealSheaf.carrier_top]; exact Submodule.mem_top) x hxV
    refine ⟨W, hWV.trans hVU, hxW, m,
      fun i j => ∑ l, B i l * 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (A l j), fun y hy => ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [relationSubmodule]
    have hC : (fun i => fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ W y hy
        (∑ l, B i l * 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (A l j))) =
        fun i => fun j => ∑ l,
          𝒪.presheaf.germ W y hy (B i l) * 𝒪.presheaf.germ V y (hWV hy) (A l j) := by
      funext i j
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    rw [hC]
    apply relKer_succ_eq_span
    · have := hA y (hWV hy)
      dsimp only at this
      rw [relationSubmodule] at this
      exact this
    · have := hB y hy
      dsimp only at this
      rw [relationSubmodule] at this
      convert this using 3
      funext l
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: Manifold.isCoherent_iff_forall_isCoherent_idealSheaf
statement:
theorem isCoherent_iff_forall_isCoherent_idealSheaf :
    IsCoherent 𝒪 ↔ ∀ J : IdealSheaf 𝒪, J.IsCoherent
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => IdealSheaf.isCoherent_top_iff.1 h.isCoherent_top,
    fun h => isCoherent_of_isCoherent_top (h ⊤)⟩

name: Manifold.mem_idealRow_iff
statement: theorem mem_idealRow_iff (I : Ideal R) (a : Fin 1 → R) : a ∈ idealRow I ↔ a 0 ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealRow, Submodule.mem_comap]
  rfl

name: Manifold.hasLocalGenerators_iff_hasLocalGeneratorsOn_top
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_iff_hasLocalGeneratorsOn_top (I : ∀ x : X, Ideal (𝒪.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators I ↔ HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 ⊤ 1 fun x _ => idealRow (I x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x _
    obtain ⟨U, hxU, k, f, hf⟩ := h.exists_fin x
    refine ⟨U, le_top, hxU, k, fun l _ => f l, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    ext a
    rw [mem_idealRow_iff, hf y hy, Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun,
      Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨c, funext fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i, Finset.sum_apply]
      simpa using hc
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      have := congrFun hc 0
      simpa [Finset.sum_apply] using this
  · intro h x
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k, r, hr⟩ := h x trivial
    refine ⟨V, hxV, Fin k, inferInstance, fun l => r l 0, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    ext s
    have h1 : s ∈ I y ↔ (fun _ : Fin 1 => s) ∈ idealRow (I y) :=
      (mem_idealRow_iff (I y) fun _ => s).symm
    have h2 : idealRow (I y) = Submodule.span _
        (Set.range fun l j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ V y hy (r l j)) := hr y hy
    rw [h1, h2, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun, Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      have := congrFun hc 0
      simpa [Finset.sum_apply] using this
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨c, funext fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i, Finset.sum_apply]
      simpa using hc

name: Manifold.sum_elim_finSumFinEquiv_mul
statement:
theorem sum_elim_finSumFinEquiv_mul (φ : A →+* B) {k₁ k₂ : ℕ} (u : Fin k₁ → A) (v : Fin k₂ → A)
    (a : Fin (k₁ + k₂) → B) :
    ∑ x, φ (Sum.elim u v (finSumFinEquiv.symm x)) * a x =
      ∑ i, φ (u i) * a (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i)) +
        ∑ j, φ (v j) * a (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finSumFinEquiv (fun x => φ (Sum.elim u v (finSumFinEquiv.symm x)) * a x)]
  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]

name: AnalyticSpace.isCoherent_analyticSpaceOfOpen
statement:
theorem isCoherent_analyticSpaceOfOpen (n : ℕ) (G : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)) :
    IsCoherent (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪
proof:
:=
  KLocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_restrictOpen (affine K n) (oka_coherent n) G

name: AnalyticSpace.isCoherent_localModel
proof:
:=
  QuotientSpace.isCoherent_quotientSpace _ (modelIdeal K n G f) (isCoherent_analyticSpaceOfOpen n G)

name: AnalyticSpace.isCoherent_analyticSpace
statement:
theorem isCoherent_analyticSpace (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K) :
    IsCoherent X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪
proof:
:= by
  refine KLocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_of_forall_restrictOpen X.toKLocallyRingedSpace fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, n, k, G, f, W, ⟨e⟩⟩ := X.locallyModel x
  exact ⟨U, hxU, KLocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_of_kIso e
    (KLocallyRingedSpace.isCoherent_restrictOpen _ (isCoherent_localModel n G f) W)⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.isCoherent_idealSheaf
statement:
theorem isCoherent_idealSheaf (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K) (J : IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪) :
    J.IsCoherent
proof:
:=
  isCoherent_iff_forall_isCoherent_idealSheaf.mp (isCoherent_analyticSpace X) J

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGenerators_inf
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_inf (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K)
    (E F : IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪)
      fun x : X => E.stalkIdeal x ⊓ F.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨U₁, haU₁, k₁, e, -, he⟩ := E.exists_generators a
  obtain ⟨U₂, haU₂, k₂, f, -, hf⟩ := F.exists_generators a
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U, U = U₁ ⊓ U₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUU₁ : U ≤ U₁ := hU ▸ inf_le_left
  have hUU₂ : U ≤ U₂ := hU ▸ inf_le_right
  have haU : a ∈ U := by
    rw [hU, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf]
    exact ⟨haU₁, haU₂⟩
  obtain ⟨row, hrow⟩ : ∃ row : Fin (k₁ + k₂) → X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U),
      row = fun x => Sum.elim
        (fun i => X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUU₁).op (e i))
        (fun j => X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUU₂).op (f j))
        (finSumFinEquiv.symm x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, haV, k, R, hR⟩ :=
    isCoherent_analyticSpace X U (k₁ + k₂) 1 (fun _ : Fin 1 => row) a haU
  have hVU₁ : V ≤ U₁ := hVU.trans hUU₁
  have hVU₂ : V ≤ U₂ := hVU.trans hUU₂
  refine ⟨V, haV, Fin k, inferInstance, fun n => ∑ i, R n (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i)) *
    X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU₁).op (e i), fun b hb => ?_⟩
  
  have hge : ∀ i, X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U b (hVU hb)
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUU₁).op (e i)) =
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₁ b (hVU₁ hb) (e i) := fun i =>
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  have hgf : ∀ j, X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U b (hVU hb)
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUU₂).op (f j)) =
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₂ b (hVU₂ hb) (f j) := fun j =>
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  have hrel : ∀ v : Fin (k₁ + k₂) → X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.stalk b,
      v ∈ relationSubmodule X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => row) b (hVU hb) ↔
        ∑ i, v (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i)) *
            X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₁ b (hVU₁ hb) (e i) +
          ∑ j, v (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr j)) *
            X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₂ b (hVU₂ hb) (f j) = 0 := by
    intro v
    rw [mem_relationSubmodule_row_iff]
    subst hrow
    rw [sum_elim_finSumFinEquiv_mul (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U b (hVU hb)).hom]
    simp only [hge, hgf, mul_comm _ (v _)]
  have hRw : relationSubmodule X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => row) b (hVU hb) =
      Submodule.span _ (Set.range fun n x =>
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ V b hb (R n x)) := hR b hb
  have hgen : ∀ n, X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ V b hb
      (∑ i, R n (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i)) *
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU₁).op (e i)) =
      ∑ i, X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ V b hb (R n (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i))) *
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₁ b (hVU₁ hb) (e i) := fun n => by
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    rw [Submodule.mem_inf] at hs
    obtain ⟨hsE, hsF⟩ := hs
    rw [he b (hVU₁ hb), Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hsE
    rw [hf b (hVU₂ hb), Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hsF
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hsE
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hsF
    have hw : (fun x => Sum.elim c (fun j => -d j) (finSumFinEquiv.symm x)) ∈
        relationSubmodule X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => row) b (hVU hb) := by
      rw [hrel]
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, neg_mul,
        Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      rw [hc, hd, add_neg_cancel]
    rw [hRw, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hw
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := hw
    have hci : ∀ i, c i = ∑ n, lam n *
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ V b hb (R n (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i))) := by
      intro i
      have := congrFun hlam (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i))
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        Sum.elim_inl] at this
      exact this.symm
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
    refine ⟨lam, ?_⟩
    simp only [hgen]
    rw [← hc]
    simp only [hci, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  · intro hs
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hs
    obtain ⟨lam, rfl⟩ := hs
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun n _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_inf, hgen n]
    constructor
    · rw [he b (hVU₁ hb)]
      exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · have hRn : (fun x => X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ V b hb (R n x)) ∈
          relationSubmodule X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => row) b (hVU hb) := by
        rw [hRw]
        exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨n, rfl⟩
      rw [hrel] at hRn
      rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hRn, hf b (hVU₂ hb)]
      exact neg_mem_iff.mpr
        (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩))

name: AnalyticSpace.coe_convAt
statement:
theorem coe_convAt (q : Kn.{u} K n) (s : (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk q) :
    ((taylorAffine K n q s : Analytic.Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) = taylorAt K n q s
proof: := rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.eventually_evalSeries_convAt_germ
statement:
theorem eventually_evalSeries_convAt_germ (p : Kn.{u} K n) {U : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (F : (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K),
      evalSeries ((taylorAffine K n p ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U p hp F) :
        Analytic.Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) y' =
        extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) F (ULift.up (p.down + y'))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (isTaylorHom_taylorHom (Kn.{u} K n) ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift
    (chartAt (Kn.{u} K n) p) (mem_chart_source _ p) (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas p)).2 U hp F
  have hc : Continuous fun y' : Fin n → K => p.down + y' := continuous_const.add continuous_id
  have ht : Tendsto (fun y' : Fin n → K => p.down + y') (𝓝 0) (𝓝 p.down) :=
    hc.tendsto' 0 p.down (add_zero _)
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually h1] with y' hy'
  rw [coe_convAt]
  change extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) F (ULift.up (p.down + y')) = _ at hy'
  rw [hy', taylorAt_apply]
  change evalSeries _ y' = evalSeries _ (p.down + y' - p.down)
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.span_range_modelGens
statement:
theorem span_range_modelGens (z : localModel K n G f) :
    Ideal.span (Set.range (modelGens G f z)) = modelIdealAt G f z
proof:
:= by
  unfold modelIdealAt modelGens
  rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.eventually_forall_evalSeries_modelGens_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_forall_evalSeries_modelGens_eq_zero_iff (z : localModel K n G f) :
    ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K),
      ((∀ j, evalSeries (modelGens G f z j : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) y' = 0) ↔
        ∀ j, extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) (f j) (ULift.up (z.1.1.down + y')) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K), ∀ j,
      evalSeries (modelGens G f z j : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) y' =
        extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) (f j) (ULift.up (z.1.1.down + y')) :=
    eventually_all.mpr fun j => eventually_evalSeries_convAt_germ z.1.1 z.1.2 (f j)
  filter_upwards [h] with y' hy'
  simp only [hy']

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_cosupport_modelIdeal_iff_extendSection
statement:
theorem mem_cosupport_modelIdeal_iff_extendSection (x : analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G) :
    x ∈ (modelIdeal K n G f).support ↔
      ∀ j, extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) (f j) (x.1 : Kn.{u} K n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_cosupport_modelIdeal_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun j => ?_
  rw [extendSection_of_mem (M := Kn.{u} K n) K (Kn.{u} K n) (f j) (x := (x.1 : Kn.{u} K n)) x.2]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_restrictOpen_iff
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_restrictOpen_iff (X : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K) (U : Opens X)
    (x : X.restrictOpen U) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((X.restrictOpen U).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x) ↔
      IsRegularLocalRing (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x.1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ h _ _
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictStalkIso (Opens.isOpenEmbedding U)
        x).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  · exact isRegularLocalRing_stalk_restrictOpen X U x

name: AnalyticSpace.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_kIso_iff
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_kIso_iff {A B : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} (e : KIso A B) (a : A) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (B.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk (e.hom.1.base a)) ↔
      IsRegularLocalRing (A.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ h _ _
      (asIso (e.hom.1.stalkMap a)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  · exact isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_kIso' e a

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_reg_iff_localModel
proof:
:= by
  change IsRegularLocalRing (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk y) ↔ _
  rw [← isRegularLocalRing_stalk_restrictOpen_iff X.toKLocallyRingedSpace U ⟨y, hy⟩,
    ← isRegularLocalRing_stalk_kIso_iff e ⟨y, hy⟩,
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk_restrictOpen_iff]

name: AnalyticSpace.coeff_single_convEmbed_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem coeff_single_convEmbed_of_not_mem_range (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (T : Analytic.Conv ℂ d)
    {i : Fin n}
    (hi : i ∉ Set.range e) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single i 1) (convEmbed ℂ e T : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_convEmbed]
  apply coeff_rename_eq_zero
  rintro ⟨μ, hμ⟩
  have hmem : i ∈ (Finsupp.mapDomain e μ).support := by
    rw [hμ]
    simp
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_support_of_injective e.injective] at hmem
  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  exact hi ⟨k, hk⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.constantCoeff_convEmbed
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_convEmbed (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (T : Analytic.Conv ℂ d) :
    constantCoeff (convEmbed ℂ e T : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) =
      constantCoeff (T : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_convEmbed, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  have : (0 : Fin n →₀ ℕ) = Finsupp.embDomain e 0 := by simp
  rw [this, coeff_embDomain_rename]

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_maximalIdeal_stalk_iff_convAt
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_stalk_iff_convAt (q : Kn.{0} ℂ n)
    (s : (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk q) :
    s ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk q) ↔
      constantCoeff ((taylorAffine ℂ n q s : Analytic.Conv ℂ n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal,
    mem_nonunits_iff, mem_nonunits_iff, MulEquiv.isUnit_map]

name: AnalyticSpace.dlin_eq_coeff_convAt
statement:
theorem dlin_eq_coeff_convAt (q : Kn.{0} ℂ n)
    (s : (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk q) (i : Fin n) :
    dlin ℂ n q s i =
      coeff (Finsupp.single i 1) ((taylorAffine ℂ n q s : Analytic.Conv ℂ n) : MvPowerSeries
          (Fin n) ℂ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_graphIdeal
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_graphIdeal (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (T : Fin n → Analytic.Conv ℂ d)
    (hT0 : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range e → constantCoeff (T j : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) ℂ) = 0) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Analytic.Conv ℂ n ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j :
        {j : Fin n // j ∉ Set.range e} =>
      convX ℂ j - convEmbed ℂ e (T j)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : Kn.{0} ℂ n := ULift.up 0
  let ι := {j : Fin n // j ∉ Set.range e}
  let ε : Fin (Fintype.card ι) ≃ ι := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  let g : ι → Analytic.Conv ℂ n := fun j => convX ℂ j - convEmbed ℂ e (T j)
  let h : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk q :=
    fun a => (taylorAffine ℂ n q).symm (g (ε a))
  have hcoe : ∀ a, ((taylorAffine ℂ n q (h a) : Analytic.Conv ℂ n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) =
      X (ε a).1 - rename e (T (ε a) : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) ℂ) := by
    intro a
    simp only [h, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, g, Subalgebra.coe_sub, coe_convX, coe_convEmbed]
  have hm : ∀ a,
      h a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk q) := by
    intro a
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal_stalk_iff_convAt, hcoe, map_sub, constantCoeff_X, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero,
      ← coe_convEmbed, constantCoeff_convEmbed, hT0 _ (ε a).2]
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℂ fun a => dlin ℂ n q (h a) := by
    let proj : (Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] (ι → ℂ) :=
      { toFun := fun v i => v i.1, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
    refine LinearIndependent.of_comp proj ?_
    have hcomp : (⇑proj ∘ fun a => dlin ℂ n q (h a)) = ⇑(Pi.basisFun ℂ ι) ∘ ⇑ε := by
      funext a i
      change dlin ℂ n q (h a) i.1 = (Pi.basisFun ℂ ι) (ε a) i
      rw [dlin_eq_coeff_convAt, hcoe, map_sub, ← coe_convEmbed,
        coeff_single_convEmbed_of_not_mem_range e _ i.2, sub_zero, coeff_X, Pi.basisFun_apply]
      by_cases hia : i = ε a
      · subst hia
        simp
      · have hne : Finsupp.single (i : Fin n) 1 ≠ Finsupp.single ((ε a : ι) : Fin n) 1 := by
          intro h'
          exact hia (Subtype.ext (Finsupp.single_left_injective one_ne_zero h'))
        rw [ite_eq_right hne, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hia]
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (Pi.basisFun ℂ ι).linearIndependent.comp ε ε.injective
  obtain ⟨hreg, -⟩ := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_range_and_ringKrullDim ℂ n q h hm hli
  have hJ :
      Ideal.span (Set.range g) = Ideal.map (taylorAffine ℂ n q) (Ideal.span (Set.range h)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    congr 1
    have : (⇑(taylorAffine ℂ n q) ∘ h) = g ∘ ε := by
      funext a
      simp [h]
    rw [this, ε.surjective.range_comp]
  exact @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ hreg _ _
    (Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ (taylorAffine ℂ n q) hJ)

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_reg_iff_isRegularLocalRing_quotient
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_reg_iff_localModel e hy]
  constructor
  · intro h

  · intro h

name: AnalyticSpace.isReduced_stalk_restrictOpen_iff
statement:
theorem isReduced_stalk_restrictOpen_iff (X : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K) (U : Opens X)
    (x : X.restrictOpen U) :
    _root_.IsReduced ((X.restrictOpen U).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x) ↔
      _root_.IsReduced (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x.1)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.restrictStalkIso (Opens.isOpenEmbedding U)
    x).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact @isReduced_of_injective _ _ _ _ _ _ _ φ.symm φ.symm.injective h
  · intro h
    exact @isReduced_of_injective _ _ _ _ _ _ _ φ φ.injective h

name: AnalyticSpace.isReduced_stalk_of_kIso
statement:
theorem isReduced_stalk_of_kIso {A B : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} (e : KIso A B) (a : A)
    (h : _root_.IsReduced (A.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk a)) :
    _root_.IsReduced (B.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk (e.hom.1.base a))
proof:
:= by
  let φ := (asIso (e.hom.1.stalkMap a)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  exact @isReduced_of_injective _ _ _ _ _ _ _ φ φ.injective h

name: AnalyticSpace.isRadical_modelIdealAt_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem isRadical_modelIdealAt_of_isReduced {X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K} (hX : X.IsReduced)
    {U : Opens X} {W : Opens (localModel K n G f)}
    (e : KIso (X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen U) ((localModel K n G f).restrictOpen W))
    {y : X} (hy : y ∈ U) : (modelIdealAt G f (e.hom.1.base ⟨y, hy⟩).1).IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced]
  have h2 : _root_.IsReduced ((X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen
      U).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk
      ⟨y, hy⟩) :=
    (isReduced_stalk_restrictOpen_iff X.toKLocallyRingedSpace U ⟨y, hy⟩).mpr (hX y)
  have h3 := isReduced_stalk_of_kIso e ⟨y, hy⟩ h2
  set z : localModel K n G f := (e.hom.1.base ⟨y, hy⟩).1 with hz
  have h4 : _root_.IsReduced ((localModel K n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    (isReduced_stalk_restrictOpen_iff (localModel K n G f) W _).mp h3
  let φ := stalkEquivQuotientModelIdealAt z
  exact @isReduced_of_injective _ _ _ _ _ _ _ φ.symm φ.symm.injective h4

name: AnalyticSpace.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_comap_iff
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_comap_iff (σ : Analytic.Conv K n ≃ₐ[K] Analytic.Conv K n)
    (J : Ideal (Analytic.Conv K n)) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Analytic.Conv K n ⧸ Ideal.comap σ J) ↔ IsRegularLocalRing
        (Analytic.Conv K n ⧸ J)
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : J = Ideal.map (σ.toRingEquiv : Analytic.Conv K n →+* Analytic.Conv K n)
      (Ideal.comap σ J) := by
    have h := Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective (σ.toRingEquiv : Analytic.Conv K n →+* Analytic.Conv K
        n)
      σ.surjective J
    exact h.symm
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ h _ _ (Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ σ.toRingEquiv hmap)
  · intro h
    exact @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ h _ _
      (Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ σ.toRingEquiv hmap).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.eventually_exists_localModel_pt
statement:
theorem eventually_exists_localModel_pt (z : localModel K n G f) :
    ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K),
      (∀ j, evalSeries (modelGens G f z j : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) y' = 0) →
        ∃ z' : localModel K n G f, z'.1.1 = ULift.up (z.1.1.down + y')
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun y' : Fin n → K => (ULift.up (z.1.1.down + y') : Kn.{u} K n) :=
    (ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift : Kn.{u} K n ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)).symm.continuous.comp
      (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have hG : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K), (ULift.up (z.1.1.down + y') : Kn.{u} K n) ∈ G := by
    have : Tendsto (fun y' : Fin n → K => (ULift.up (z.1.1.down + y') : Kn.{u} K n)) (𝓝 0)
        (𝓝 z.1.1) := hc.tendsto' 0 z.1.1 (ULift.ext (add_zero _))
    exact this.eventually (G.isOpen.mem_nhds z.1.2)
  filter_upwards [hG, eventually_forall_evalSeries_modelGens_eq_zero_iff G f z] with y' hyG hiff
  intro h0
  refine ⟨⟨⟨ULift.up (z.1.1.down + y'), hyG⟩, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  exact (mem_cosupport_modelIdeal_iff_extendSection G f ⟨_, hyG⟩).mpr (hiff.mp h0)

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_mem_nhds_of_mem_nhds_localModel_restrict
proof:
:= by
  let g : (localModel K n G f).restrictOpen W → Kn.{u} K n := fun z' => z'.1.1.1
  have hind : Topology.IsInducing g :=
    Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal.comp (Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal.comp
      Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal)
  let w : (localModel K n G f).restrictOpen W := ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hN' : N ∈ Filter.comap g (𝓝 (g w)) := by
    rw [← hind.nhds_eq_comap w]
    exact hN
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hsub⟩ := Filter.mem_comap.mp hN'
  exact ⟨O, hO, fun z' hz' hzO => hsub hzO⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_mem_nhds_of_mem_opens_localModel
proof:
:= by
  let g : localModel K n G f → Kn.{u} K n := fun z' => z'.1.1
  have hind : Topology.IsInducing g :=
    Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal.comp Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal
  have hW : (W : Set (localModel K n G f)) ∈ 𝓝 z := W.isOpen.mem_nhds hz
  have hW' : (W : Set (localModel K n G f)) ∈ Filter.comap g (𝓝 (g z)) := by
    rw [← hind.nhds_eq_comap z]
    exact hW
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hsub⟩ := Filter.mem_comap.mp hW'
  exact ⟨O, hO, fun z' hzO => hsub hzO⟩

name: Analytic.mul_mem_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem mul_mem_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_forall_mem {I P : Ideal (Conv ℂ n)} (hI : I.IsRadical)
    (hP : P ∈ I.minimalPrimes) {h₀ : Conv ℂ n} (hh₀ : ∀ Q ∈ I.minimalPrimes, Q ≠ P → h₀ ∈ Q)
    {F : Conv ℂ n} (hF : F ∈ P) : F * h₀ ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hI.radical, ← Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes, Ideal.mem_sInf]
  intro Q hQ
  by_cases hQP : Q = P
  · subst hQP
    exact Q.mul_mem_right _ hF
  · exact Q.mul_mem_left _ (hh₀ Q hQ hQP)

name: Analytic.exists_mem_forall_minimalPrimes_ne_of_mem_minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hPp : P.IsPrime := hP.1.1
  have hfin := Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing (Conv ℂ n) I
  set s : Finset (Ideal (Conv ℂ n)) := hfin.toFinset.erase P with hs
  by_contra hcon
  have hle : s.inf id ≤ P := by
    intro h₀ hh₀
    by_contra hnot
    apply hcon
    refine ⟨h₀, fun Q hQ hQP => ?_, hnot⟩
    have hQs : Q ∈ s := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hQP, hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hQ⟩
    exact (Finset.inf_le hQs : s.inf id ≤ id Q) hh₀
  obtain ⟨Q, hQs, hQP⟩ := hPp.inf_le'.mp hle
  have hQmin : Q ∈ I.minimalPrimes := hfin.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hQs)
  have hne : Q ≠ P := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hQs
  exact hne (le_antisymm hQP (hP.2 hQmin.1 hQP))

name: AnalyticSpace.LocallyRingedSpace.hom_ext_of_cover
statement:
theorem LocallyRingedSpace.hom_ext_of_cover {X Y : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (f g : X ⟶ Y)
    {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Opens X) (hU : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (h : ∀ i, X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding ≫ f = X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding ≫ g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  have hb : f.base = g.base := by
    ext x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hU x
    have := congrArg (fun φ : X.restrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding ⟶ Y => φ.base ⟨x, hi⟩) (h i)
    exact this
  obtain ⟨⟨fb, fc⟩, fp⟩ := f
  obtain ⟨⟨gb, gc⟩, gp⟩ := g
  obtain rfl : fb = gb := hb
  have key : ∀ x, (⟨⟨fb, fc⟩, fp⟩ : X ⟶ Y).stalkMap x = (⟨⟨fb, gc⟩, gp⟩ : X ⟶ Y).stalkMap x := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hU x
    have h1 : HEq ((X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding ≫ (⟨⟨fb, fc⟩, fp⟩ : X ⟶ Y)).stalkMap ⟨x, hi⟩)
        ((X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding ≫ (⟨⟨fb, gc⟩, gp⟩ : X ⟶ Y)).stalkMap ⟨x, hi⟩) := by
      rw [h i]
    have h2 := eq_of_heq h1
    have e₁ := LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp (X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding)
      (⟨⟨fb, fc⟩, fp⟩ : X ⟶ Y) ⟨x, hi⟩
    have e₂ := LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp (X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding)
      (⟨⟨fb, gc⟩, gp⟩ : X ⟶ Y) ⟨x, hi⟩
    have h3 := e₁.symm.trans (h2.trans e₂)
    have hoi : LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion (X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding) :=
      LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.ofRestrict X (U i).isOpenEmbedding
    have : IsIso ((X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap ⟨x, hi⟩) :=
      LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.stalk_iso (X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding) ⟨x, hi⟩
    exact (cancel_mono ((X.ofRestrict (U i).isOpenEmbedding).stalkMap ⟨x, hi⟩)).mp h3
  have h3 : (⟨fb, fc⟩ : X.toSheafedSpace ⟶ Y.toSheafedSpace) = ⟨fb, gc⟩ :=
    SheafedSpace.hom_stalk_ext _ _ rfl fun x => by
      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl, Category.id_comp]
      exact key x
  have hc : fc = gc := by
    have := congrArg (fun φ : X.toSheafedSpace ⟶ Y.toSheafedSpace => φ.hom) h3
    exact eq_of_heq (PresheafedSpace.Hom.mk.inj this).2
  subst hc
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.germ_top_pullbackΓ
statement:
theorem germ_top_pullbackΓ {A B : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K} (l : A ⟶ B)
    (τ : LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.obj (op B.toLocallyRingedSpace)) (x : A) :
    A.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial (l.pullbackΓ τ) =
      l.1.stalkMap x (B.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ ⊤ (l.1.base x) trivial τ)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply l.1.1 ⊤ x trivial τ
  change A.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial
    ((LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.map l.1.op).hom τ) = _
  rw [LocallyRingedSpace.Γ_map_op]
  change A.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ ((Opens.map l.1.1.base).obj ⊤) x trivial
    (l.1.1.c.app (op ⊤) τ) = _
  erw [← hA]
  rfl
