  congr_arg (fun f => f ξ) (mapHom_stalkMap_comp_evalHom φ J' J h z')

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.map_base_apply
statement: theorem map_base_apply (z' : support X' J') : ((map φ J' J h).base z').1 = φ.base z'.1
proof: := rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.map_comp_ι
statement: theorem map_comp_ι : map φ J' J h ≫ ι X J = ι X' J' ≫ φ
proof:
:= by
  apply LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.ext'
  refine PresheafedSpace.ext _ _ rfl ?_
  refine NatTrans.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun a => Subtype.ext (funext fun z' => ?_))
  change fiberMap φ J' J h z'.1 (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X.presheaf.germ (unop U) _ _ a)) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X'.presheaf.germ ((Opens.map φ.base).obj (unop U)) z'.1.1 _ (φ.c.app U a))
  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (stalkMap_germ_apply'' φ (unop U) z'.1.1 _ a)

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.quotientMap_val
statement: theorem quotientMap_val : (quotientMap ψ J' J h).1 = QuotientSpace.map ψ.1 J' J h
proof: := rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.hasLocalGenerators_comap
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_comap :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := X'.𝒪)
      fun z' => (stalkIdeal X J (φ.base z')).map (φ.stalkMap z').hom
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨U, haU, k, f, -, hgen⟩ := J.exists_generators (φ.base a)
  refine ⟨(Opens.map φ.base).obj U, haU, Fin k, inferInstance, fun i => φ.c.app (op U) (f i),
    fun b hb => ?_⟩
  have hg : stalkIdeal X J (φ.base b) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => X.presheaf.germ U (φ.base b) hb (f i)) := hgen (φ.base b) hb
  change (stalkIdeal X J (φ.base b)).map (φ.stalkMap b).hom =
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
      X'.presheaf.germ ((Opens.map φ.base).obj U) b hb (φ.c.app (op U) (f i)))
  rw [hg, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  exact congrArg Ideal.span
    (congrArg Set.range (funext fun i => stalkMap_germ_apply'' φ U b hb (f i)))

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_comap
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_comap (z' : X') :
    (comap φ J).stalkIdeal z' = (stalkIdeal X J (φ.base z')).map (φ.stalkMap z').hom
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ _ z'

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.compat_comap
statement: theorem compat_comap : Compat φ (comap φ J) J
proof: := fun z' => (stalkIdeal_comap φ J z').ge

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.cosupport_comap
statement: theorem cosupport_comap : (comap φ J).support = φ.base ⁻¹' J.support
proof:
:= by
  ext z'
  rw [IdealSheaf.mem_support, Set.mem_preimage, IdealSheaf.mem_support, stalkIdeal_comap]
  exact not_congr (Ideal.map_eq_top_iff_of_isLocalHom _ _)

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.fiberMap_comap_bijective
statement:
theorem fiberMap_comap_bijective (z' : support X' (comap φ J)) [IsIso (φ.stalkMap z'.1)] :
    Function.Bijective (fiberMap φ (comap φ J) J (compat_comap φ J) z')
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Function.Bijective (φ.stalkMap z'.1).hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (φ.stalkMap z'.1)).mp inferInstance
  refine ⟨Ideal.quotientMap_injective' ?_, Ideal.quotientMap_surjective hb.2⟩
  change (stalkIdeal X' (comap φ J) z'.1).comap (φ.stalkMap z'.1).hom ≤ _
  rw [show stalkIdeal X' (comap φ J) z'.1 = (stalkIdeal X J (φ.base z'.1)).map (φ.stalkMap z'.1).hom
    from stalkIdeal_comap φ J z'.1]
  exact (Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hb).le

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.isIso_map_stalkMap_of_bijective
statement:
theorem isIso_map_stalkMap_of_bijective {X' X : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (φ : X' ⟶ X)
    (J' : IdealSheaf X'.𝒪) (J : IdealSheaf X.𝒪) (h : Compat φ J' J) (z' : support X' J')
    (hf : Function.Bijective (fiberMap φ J' J h z')) : IsIso ((map φ J' J h).stalkMap z')
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  have hsq := evalHom_mapHom_stalkMap φ J' J h z'
  have h1 : Function.Bijective (evalHom X' J' z').hom :=
    ⟨evalHom_injective _ _ _, evalHom_surjective _ _ _⟩
  have h2 : Function.Bijective (evalHom X J ((mapHom φ J' J h).base z')).hom :=
    ⟨evalHom_injective _ _ _, evalHom_surjective _ _ _⟩
  constructor
  · intro ξ₁ ξ₂ e
    have e1 : fiberMap φ J' J h z' (evalHom X J _ ξ₁) = fiberMap φ J' J h z' (evalHom X J _ ξ₂) :=
      (hsq ξ₁).symm.trans ((congrArg (evalHom X' J' z') e).trans (hsq ξ₂))
    exact h2.1 (hf.1 e1)
  · intro η
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf.2 (evalHom X' J' z' η)
    obtain ⟨ξ, rfl⟩ := h2.2 x
    exact ⟨ξ, h1.1 ((hsq ξ).trans hx)⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.isIso_map_stalkMap
statement:
theorem isIso_map_stalkMap (z' : support X' (comap φ J)) [IsIso (φ.stalkMap z'.1)] :
    IsIso ((map φ (comap φ J) J (compat_comap φ J)).stalkMap z')
proof:
:=
  isIso_map_stalkMap_of_bijective φ _ _ _ z' (fiberMap_comap_bijective φ J z')

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.isOpenEmbedding_mapBase_comap
statement:
theorem isOpenEmbedding_mapBase_comap (hφ : IsOpenEmbedding φ.base) :
    IsOpenEmbedding (mapBase φ (comap φ J) J (compat_comap φ J))
proof:
:= by
  have e : (mapBase φ (comap φ J) J (compat_comap φ J) : support X' (comap φ J) → support X J) =
      J.support.restrictPreimage φ.base ∘ Homeomorph.setCongr (cosupport_comap φ J) := by
    funext z'
    rfl
  rw [e]
  exact (Set.restrictPreimage_isOpenEmbedding _ hφ).comp (Homeomorph.setCongr _).isOpenEmbedding

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.isOpenImmersion_map_comap
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_map_comap (hφ : IsOpenEmbedding φ.base) [∀ z', IsIso (φ.stalkMap z')] :
    LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion (map φ (comap φ J) J (compat_comap φ J))
proof:
:=
  have : ∀ z' : support X' (comap φ J),
      IsIso ((map φ (comap φ J) J (compat_comap φ J)).stalkMap z') :=
    fun z' => isIso_map_stalkMap φ J z'
  LocallyRingedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.of_stalk_iso _ (isOpenEmbedding_mapBase_comap φ J hφ)

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.comap_comp
statement:
theorem comap_comp {X'' : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}} (φ' : X'' ⟶ X') :
    comap (φ' ≫ φ) J = comap φ' (comap φ J)
proof:
:= by
  apply IdealSheaf.ext
  intro z
  rw [stalkIdeal_comap, stalkIdeal_comap]
  change _ = ((stalkIdeal X' (comap φ J) (φ'.base z)).map (φ'.stalkMap z).hom)
  rw [show stalkIdeal X' (comap φ J) (φ'.base z) =
      (stalkIdeal X J (φ.base (φ'.base z))).map (φ.stalkMap (φ'.base z)).hom from
    stalkIdeal_comap φ J (φ'.base z)]
  rw [Ideal.map_map, LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.range_quotientMap_ofRestrict
statement:
theorem range_quotientMap_ofRestrict :
    Set.range (Hom.toFun (quotientMap (X.ofRestrict U) (restrictIdeal X J U) J
        (QuotientSpace.compat_comap _ _))) =
      Set.range (Hom.toFun (ofRestrict (X.quotient J) (quotientOpens X J U)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_toFun_ofRestrict]
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z', rfl⟩
    exact z'.1.2
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨⟨⟨z.1, hz⟩, ?_⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
    change (⟨z.1, hz⟩ : X.restrictOpen U) ∈ (QuotientSpace.comap (X.ofRestrict U).1 J).support
    rw [QuotientSpace.cosupport_comap]
    exact z.2

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.range_quotientMap_kIso
statement:
theorem range_quotientMap_kIso :
    Set.range (Hom.toFun
        (quotientMap e.hom (transportIdeal e J) J (QuotientSpace.compat_comap _ _))) =
      Set.range (Hom.toFun (𝟙 (X.quotient J)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hom.toFun_id, Set.range_id]
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro z
  refine ⟨⟨(KIso.homeomorph e).symm z.1, ?_⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  · change (KIso.homeomorph e).symm z.1 ∈ (QuotientSpace.comap e.hom.1 J).support
    rw [QuotientSpace.cosupport_comap]
    change e.hom.1.base ((KIso.homeomorph e).symm z.1) ∈ J.support
    have : e.hom.1.base ((KIso.homeomorph e).symm z.1) = z.1 :=
      (KIso.homeomorph e).apply_symm_apply z.1
    rw [this]
    exact z.2
  · exact (KIso.homeomorph e).apply_symm_apply z.1

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.ker_stalkMap_ι
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_ι (z : support X J) :
    RingHom.ker ((ι X J).stalkMap z).hom = stalkIdeal X J z.1
proof:
:= by
  ext σ
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← evalHom_stalkMap X J z σ]
  constructor
  · intro h0
    have h1 : (ιHom X J).stalkMap z σ = 0 := h0
    rw [h1, map_zero]
  · intro h0
    exact evalHom_injective X J z (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.exists_opens_eq_preimage
statement: theorem exists_opens_eq_preimage (V : Opens (support X J)) : ∃ O : Opens X, V = preimage X J O
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hV⟩ := isOpen_induced_iff.mp V.2
  exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, Opens.ext hV.symm⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.liftStalk_of_mem
statement:
theorem liftStalk_of_mem {x : X} (h : x ∈ J.support) :
    liftStalk X J J' x =
      (stalkIdeal (quotientSpace X J) J' ⟨x, h⟩).comap ((ι X J).stalkMap ⟨x, h⟩).hom
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left h

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.liftStalk_of_notMem
statement: theorem liftStalk_of_notMem {x : X} (h : x ∉ J.support) : liftStalk X J J' x = ⊤
proof: := dite_eq_right h

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.stalkMap_ι_germ
statement:
theorem stalkMap_ι_germ (W : Opens X) (z : support X J) (hz : z.1 ∈ W) (a : X.presheaf.obj (op W)) :
    ((ι X J).stalkMap z).hom (X.presheaf.germ W z.1 hz a) =
      (presheafCommRing X J).germ (preimage X J W) z hz (classFamily X J W a)
proof:
:=
  PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply (ι X J).toShHom.hom W z hz a

name: AnalyticSpace.isNonsingular_restrictOpen
statement:
theorem isNonsingular_restrictOpen {X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K} (hX : X.IsNonsingular)
    (U : Opens X) : (AnalyticSpace.restrictOpen X U).IsNonsingular
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNonsingular_iff] at hX ⊢
  intro x
  exact (isRegularLocalRing_stalk_restrictOpen_iff X.toKLocallyRingedSpace U x).mpr (hX x.1)

name: AnalyticSpace.dense_preimage_toFun_ofRestrict
statement:
theorem dense_preimage_toFun_ofRestrict (X : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K) (U : Opens X) {D : Set X}
    (hD : Dense D) : Dense (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (ofRestrict X U) ⁻¹' D)
proof:
:=
  hD.preimage U.isOpen.isOpenMap_subtype_val

name: AnalyticSpace.eq_zero_of_pullbackΓ_ofRestrict_eq_zero_of_dense_analyticSpaceOfOpen
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_pullbackΓ_ofRestrict_eq_zero_of_dense_analyticSpaceOfOpen
    (O : Opens (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G)) (hO : Dense (O : Set (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G)))
    (t : LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.obj (op (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G).toLocallyRingedSpace))
    (ht : (ofRestrict (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G) O).pullbackΓ t = 0) : t = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  let G' : Opens (TopCat.of (Kn.{u} K n)) :=
    (Opens.isOpenEmbedding (X := TopCat.of (Kn.{u} K n)) G).functor.obj ⊤
  let t' : (Manifold.structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.obj (op G') := t
  
  let O₂ : Opens (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G) := (Opens.isOpenEmbedding O).isOpenMap.functor.obj
    ((Opens.map (ofRestrict (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G) O).1.base).obj ⊤)
  have hres : (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.map
      ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding O).isOpenMap.adjunction.counit.app ⊤).op t = 0 := ht
  
  have hval : ∀ q : G', q.1 ∈ Subtype.val '' (O : Set (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G)) → t' q = 0 := by
    rintro q ⟨o, ho, hoq⟩
    have hoO₂ : o ∈ O₂ := ⟨⟨o, ho⟩, trivial, rfl⟩
    have hg0 : (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ ⊤ o trivial t =
        0 := by
      have := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply
        (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf
        ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding O).isOpenMap.adjunction.counit.app ⊤) o hoO₂ t
      rw [hres, map_zero] at this
      exact this.symm
    
    have hg1 : (Manifold.structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.germ G' o.1
        ⟨o, trivial, rfl⟩ t' = 0 := by
      have h := PresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso_hom_eq_germ (affine K n).toPresheafedSpace
        (Opens.isOpenEmbedding (X := TopCat.of (Kn.{u} K n)) G) ⊤ o trivial
      have h' : (PresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso (affine K n).toPresheafedSpace
          (Opens.isOpenEmbedding (X := TopCat.of (Kn.{u} K n)) G) o).hom
            ((analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ ⊤ o trivial t) =
          (Manifold.structureSheaf K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n)).presheaf.germ G' o.1
            ⟨o, trivial, rfl⟩ t' :=
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h t
      rw [hg0] at h'
      exact h'.symm.trans (map_zero _)
    
    have h2 := congrArg (Manifold.stalkToGerm 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) ω (Kn.{u} K n) o.1) hg1
    rw [map_zero] at h2
    erw [Manifold.stalkToGerm_germ] at h2
    have h3 : Manifold.extendBy0 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) ω (Kn.{u} K n) t' o.1 = 0 :=
      (Filter.Germ.coe_eq.mp (h2.trans (Filter.Germ.coe_zero).symm)).eq_of_nhds
    rw [Manifold.extendBy0_of_mem 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) ω (Kn.{u} K n) t'
      (⟨o, trivial, rfl⟩ : o.1 ∈ G')] at h3
    have hq : (⟨o.1, (⟨o, trivial, rfl⟩ : o.1 ∈ G')⟩ : G') = q := Subtype.ext hoq
    rw [← hq]
    exact h3
  
  have hdense : (Set.univ : Set G') ⊆
      closure {q : G' | q.1 ∈ Subtype.val '' (O : Set (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G))} := by
    intro q _
    obtain ⟨g, -, hgq⟩ : q.1 ∈ Subtype.val '' (Set.univ : Set (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G)) := q.2
    have hg : g ∈ closure (O : Set (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G)) := hO g
    have h1 : q.1 ∈ closure (Subtype.val '' (O : Set (analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G))) := by
      rw [← hgq]
      exact map_mem_closure continuous_subtype_val hg fun _ h => Set.mem_image_of_mem _ h
    rw [IsInducing.subtypeVal.closure_eq_preimage_closure_image]
    refine Set.mem_preimage.mpr (closure_mono ?_ h1)
    rintro _ ⟨o, ho, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨o.1, ⟨o, trivial, rfl⟩⟩, ⟨o, ho, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  
  have hcm : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) 𝓘(K) ω (fun q : G' => t' q) := t'.2
  have hcont : Continuous (fun q : G' => t' q) := hcm.continuous
  have heq : Set.EqOn (fun q : G' => t' q) (fun _ => (0 : K)) Set.univ :=
    Set.EqOn.of_subset_closure (fun q hq => hval q hq) hcont.continuousOn continuousOn_const
      (Set.subset_univ _) hdense
  change t' = 0
  exact Subtype.ext (funext fun q => heq (Set.mem_univ q))

name: AnalyticSpace.eq_zero_of_pullbackΓ_ofRestrict_eq_zero_of_dense
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_pullbackΓ_ofRestrict_eq_zero_of_dense {Z : AnalyticSpace.{u} K}
    (hZ : Z.IsNonsingular) (D : Opens Z) (hD : Dense (D : Set Z))
    (s : LocallyRingedSpace.Γ.obj (op Z.toLocallyRingedSpace))
    (hs : (ofRestrict Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace D).pullbackΓ s = 0) : s = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.sheaf ⊤ _ _ fun a _ => ?_
  
  have ha : a ∈ regularLocus Z := by rw [hZ]; exact Set.mem_univ a
  obtain ⟨d, -, V, haV, G', ⟨e⟩⟩ := (isRegular_stalk_iff_exists_manifold_nhd Z a).mp ha
  
  set f : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d G' ⟶ Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace := e.inv ≫ ofRestrict _ V with hf
  set p : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen V := ⟨a, haV⟩ with hp
  set m : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d G' := KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun e.hom p with hm
  have hinvm : KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun e.inv m = p := by
    have h : KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (e.hom ≫ e.inv) p = p := by
      rw [e.hom_inv_id]; rfl
    rw [KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun_comp] at h
    exact h
  have hfm : KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun f m = a := by
    rw [hf, KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun_comp, Function.comp_apply, hinvm]
    rfl
  have hopen : IsOpenMap (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun f) := by
    rw [hf, KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun_comp]
    have hinv : KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun e.inv = ⇑(KIso.homeomorph e.symm) :=
      funext fun q => (KIso.homeomorph_apply e.symm q).symm
    rw [hinv]
    exact V.isOpen.isOpenMap_subtype_val.comp (KIso.homeomorph e.symm).isOpenMap
  
  set O : Opens (analyticSpaceOfOpen K d G') := (Opens.map f.1.base).obj D with hO
  have hOd : Dense (O : Set (analyticSpaceOfOpen K d G')) := hD.preimage hopen
  have ht : (ofRestrict (analyticSpaceOfOpen K d G') O).pullbackΓ (f.pullbackΓ s) = 0 := by
    rw [← KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.pullbackΓ_comp]
    have hsq : ofRestrict (analyticSpaceOfOpen K d G') O ≫ f =
        KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.restrictTo f O D (fun _ h => h) ≫
          ofRestrict Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace D :=
      (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.restrictTo_comp_ofRestrict f O D _).symm
    rw [hsq, KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.pullbackΓ_comp, hs, map_zero]
  have ht0 := eq_zero_of_pullbackΓ_ofRestrict_eq_zero_of_dense_analyticSpaceOfOpen G' O hOd
    (f.pullbackΓ s) ht
  
  
  have hgerm := germ_top_pullbackΓ f s m
  have hinj : Function.Injective (f.1.stalkMap m).hom :=
    ((bijective_stalkMap_iff_of_comp_eq e.inv f hf.symm m).mp
      (bijective_stalkMap_of_isIso e.inv m)).injective
  have hz : f.1.stalkMap m (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ ⊤ (f.1.base m) trivial s) =
      f.1.stalkMap m 0 := by
    rw [← hgerm, ht0]
    exact (map_zero _).trans (map_zero _).symm
  have := hinj hz
  change Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ ⊤ (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun f m) trivial s =
    0 at this
  rw [hfm] at this
  exact this.trans (map_zero _).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.hom_ext_of_dense_affine
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_dense_affine {Z : AnalyticSpace.{u} K} (hZ : Z.IsNonsingular) (D : Opens Z)
    (hD : Dense (D : Set Z)) {m : ℕ} (g₁ g₂ : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ affine K m)
    (h : ofRestrict Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace D ≫ g₁ = ofRestrict Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace D ≫ g₂) :
    g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext_of_coord Z g₁ g₂ fun j => ?_
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_pullbackΓ_ofRestrict_eq_zero_of_dense hZ D hD _ ?_
  have e₁ : (ofRestrict Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace D).pullbackΓ (g₁.pullbackΓ (coordSection K m j)) =
      (ofRestrict Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace D ≫ g₁).pullbackΓ (coordSection K m j) :=
    (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.pullbackΓ_comp _ _ _).symm
  have e₂ : (ofRestrict Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace D).pullbackΓ (g₂.pullbackΓ (coordSection K m j)) =
      (ofRestrict Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace D ≫ g₂).pullbackΓ (coordSection K m j) :=
    (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.pullbackΓ_comp _ _ _).symm
  rw [map_sub, e₁, e₂, h, sub_self]

name: AnalyticSpace.hom_ext_of_dense
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_dense {A Y : AnalyticSpace.{u} K} (hA : A.IsNonsingular) (D : Opens A)
    (hD : Dense (D : Set A)) (h₁ h₂ : A ⟶ Y)
    (h : ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace D ≫ h₁ = ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace D ≫ h₂) :
    h₁ = h₂
proof:
:= by
  
  have hb : ∀ a : A, KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun h₁ a = KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun h₂ a := by
    have hcont₁ : Continuous (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun h₁) :=
      KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.continuous_toFun h₁
    have hcont₂ : Continuous (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun h₂) :=
      KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.continuous_toFun h₂
    have heq : Set.EqOn (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun h₁) (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun h₂)
        (D : Set A) := fun a ha => by
      have := congrArg (fun φ => KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun φ (⟨a, ha⟩ : D)) h
      exact this
    exact fun a => (heq.of_subset_closure hcont₁.continuousOn hcont₂.continuousOn
      (Set.subset_univ _) fun x _ => hD x) (Set.mem_univ a)
  
  have hloc : ∀ a : A, ∃ W : Opens A, a ∈ W ∧
      ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₁ = ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₂ := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨U, hyU, m, k, G, f, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
      Y.exists_kIso_localModel (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun h₁ a)
    
    set W : Opens A := (Opens.map h₁.1.base).obj U ⊓ (Opens.map h₂.1.base).obj U with hWdef
    have haW : a ∈ W :=
      ⟨hyU, by change KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun h₂ a ∈ U; rw [← hb a]; exact hyU⟩
    refine ⟨W, haW, ?_⟩
    
    have hl₁ : ∀ w : A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W,
        KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₁) w ∈ U :=
      fun w => w.2.1
    have hl₂ : ∀ w : A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W,
        KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₂) w ∈ U :=
      fun w => w.2.2
    set l₁ := KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.liftRestrict (ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₁) U
      hl₁ with hl₁def
    set l₂ := KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.liftRestrict (ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₂) U
      hl₂ with hl₂def
    have hl₁c := KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.liftRestrict_comp_ofRestrict
      (ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₁) U hl₁
    have hl₂c := KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.liftRestrict_comp_ofRestrict
      (ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₂) U hl₂
    
    set D' : Opens (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W) :=
      (Opens.map (ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W).1.base).obj D with hD'
    have hD'd : Dense (D' : Set (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W)) :=
      dense_preimage_toFun_ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W hD
    have hr : ∀ p : (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W).restrictOpen D',
        KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (ofRestrict (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W) D' ≫
          ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W) p ∈ D := fun p => p.2
    have hfac := KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.liftRestrict_comp_ofRestrict
      (ofRestrict (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W) D' ≫
        ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W) D hr
    have hagree : ofRestrict (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W) D' ≫ l₁ =
        ofRestrict (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W) D' ≫ l₂ := by
      apply KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.ext_of_comp_ofRestrict
      have e1 : ofRestrict (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W) D' ≫
            ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₁ =
          ofRestrict (A.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen W) D' ≫
            ofRestrict A.toKLocallyRingedSpace W ≫ h₂ := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, ← hfac, Category.assoc, h, ← Category.assoc, hfac, Category.assoc]
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hl₁c, hl₂c]
      exact e1
    
    have hZ : (A.restrictOpen W).IsNonsingular := isNonsingular_restrictOpen hA W
    have hκ : l₁ ≫ e.hom ≫ localModel.ι K m G f = l₂ ≫ e.hom ≫ localModel.ι K m G f :=
      hom_ext_of_dense_affine hZ D' hD'd _ _ (by
        have := congrArg (fun φ => φ ≫ e.hom ≫ localModel.ι K m G f) hagree
        exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (this.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)))
    have hl : l₁ = l₂ := by
      have := eq_of_comp_localModel_ι_eq G f (l₁ ≫ e.hom) (l₂ ≫ e.hom)
        (by rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc]; exact hκ)
      exact (cancel_mono e.hom).mp this
    rw [← hl₁c, ← hl₂c]
    exact congrArg (fun φ => φ ≫ ofRestrict Y.toKLocallyRingedSpace U) hl
  choose W hW using hloc
  exact hom_ext_of_cover h₁ h₂ W (fun a => ⟨a, (hW a).1⟩) fun a => (hW a).2

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGenerators_colon_idealSheaf
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_colon_idealSheaf (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K)
    (J I : IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪)
      fun x : X => Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal x))
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨U₁, haU₁, l, h, -, hh⟩ := I.exists_generators a
  obtain ⟨U₂, haU₂, m, f, -, hf⟩ := J.exists_generators a
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U, U = U₁ ⊓ U₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUU₁ : U ≤ U₁ := hU ▸ inf_le_left
  have hUU₂ : U ≤ U₂ := hU ▸ inf_le_right
  have haU : a ∈ U := by
    rw [hU, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf]
    exact ⟨haU₁, haU₂⟩
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : Fin l → Fin 1 → X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U),
      A = fun j _ => X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUU₁).op (h j) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : Fin m → X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U),
      g = fun i => -X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUU₂).op (f i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, haV, k, R, hR⟩ :=
    isCoherent_analyticSpace X U (1 + l * m) l (augMat A g) a haU
  have hVU₁ : V ≤ U₁ := hVU.trans hUU₁
  have hVU₂ : V ≤ U₂ := hVU.trans hUU₂
  refine ⟨V, haV, Fin k, inferInstance, fun n => R n (augCol 1 l m (Sum.inl 0)), fun b hb => ?_⟩
  
  have hgA : ∀ j (t : Fin 1), X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U b (hVU hb) (A j t) =
      X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₁ b (hVU₁ hb) (h j) := fun j t => by
    subst hA
    exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  have hgg : ∀ i, X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U b (hVU hb) (g i) =
      -X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₂ b (hVU₂ hb) (f i) := fun i => by
    subst hg
    rw [map_neg, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  
  have hrel : ∀ v : Fin (1 + l * m) → X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.stalk b,
      v ∈ relationSubmodule X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪 (augMat A g) b (hVU hb) ↔ ∀ j,
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₁ b (hVU₁ hb) (h j) * v (augCol 1 l m (Sum.inl 0)) -
          ∑ i, X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₂ b (hVU₂ hb) (f i) *
            v (augCol 1 l m (Sum.inr (j, i))) = 0 := by
    intro v
    rw [mem_relationSubmodule_iff]
    refine forall_congr' fun j => ?_
    rw [sum_map_augMat_mul (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U b (hVU hb)).hom A g v j,
      Fin.sum_univ_one, hgA]
    simp only [hgg, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hRw : relationSubmodule X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪 (augMat A g) b (hVU hb) =
      Submodule.span _ (Set.range fun n c =>
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ V b hb (R n c)) := hR b hb
  
  ext r
  dsimp only
  rw [hh b (hVU₁ hb), hf b (hVU₂ hb), Ideal.colon_span, Submodule.mem_colon,
    Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
  constructor
  · intro hr
    have hc : ∀ j, ∃ c : Fin m → X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.stalk b,
        ∑ i, c i * X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₂ b (hVU₂ hb) (f i) =
          X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U₁ b (hVU₁ hb) (h j) * r := fun j => by
      have := hr _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at this
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := this
      exact ⟨c, by rw [hc, mul_comm]⟩
    choose c hc using hc
    have hv : augVec (fun _ : Fin 1 => r) c ∈
        relationSubmodule X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪 (augMat A g) b (hVU hb) := by
      rw [hrel]
      intro j
      simp only [augVec_inl, augVec_inr]
      rw [sub_eq_zero, ← hc j]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
    rw [hRw, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hv
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := hv
    refine ⟨lam, ?_⟩
    have := congrFun hlam (augCol 1 l m (Sum.inl 0))
    simpa only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, augVec_inl] using this
  · rintro ⟨lam, rfl⟩ s ⟨j, rfl⟩
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun n _ => ?_
    rw [mul_assoc]
    refine Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_
    have hRn : (fun x => X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ V b hb (R n x)) ∈
        relationSubmodule X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪 (augMat A g) b (hVU hb) := by
      rw [hRw]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [hrel] at hRn
    have h1 := sub_eq_zero.mp (hRn j)
    rw [mul_comm, h1]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp_ofManifoldHom_apply
statement:
theorem stalkMap_comp_ofManifoldHom_apply {π : M' → M} (hπ : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, E) ω π)
    (g : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ ofManifold K E M') (z : Z)
    (t : (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk (π (g.1.base z))) :
    ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom t =
      (g.1.stalkMap z).hom (germMap π hπ (g.1.base z) t)
proof:
:= by
  change ((g.1 ≫ (ofManifoldHom π hπ).1).stalkMap z).hom t = _
  have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom t)
    (LocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_comp g.1 (ofManifoldHom π hπ).1 z)
  refine e.trans ?_
  change (g.1.stalkMap z).hom (((ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap (g.1.base z)).hom t) = _
  rw [stalkMap_ofManifoldHom_eq_germMap]

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_apply_coord_congr
statement:
theorem stalkMap_apply_coord_congr {F₁ F₂ : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ ofManifold K E M}
    (hF : F₁ = F₂) {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M) (z : Z)
    (h₁ : F₁.1.base z ∈ φ.source) (h₂ : F₂.1.base z ∈ φ.source) (j : Fin n) :
    (F₁.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ φ hφ h₁ j) = (F₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ φ hφ h₂ j)
proof:
:= by
  subst hF
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.base_comp_eq
statement:
theorem base_comp_eq {π : M' → M} (hπ : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, E) ω π)
    {g₁ g₂ : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ ofManifold K E M'}
    (h₂ : g₂ ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ = g₁ ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ) (z : Z) :
    π (g₂.1.base z) = π (g₁.1.base z)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun F : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ ofManifold K E M => F.1.base z) h₂

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_eq_of_coord
statement:
theorem stalkMap_eq_of_coord {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M' E}
    (hΦ : Φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M') (g : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ ofManifold K E M')
    (z : Z) (hp : g.1.base z ∈ Φ.source) {y : M'} (e : g.1.base z = y) (hy : y ∈ Φ.source)
    (β : (ofManifold K E M').toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk y ⟶
      Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z) [hβ : IsLocalHom β.hom]
    (hc : ∀ c : K, β.hom (const K E M' y c) = constAt Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace z c)
    (hz : ∀ j, β.hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ hy j) = (g.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ hp j)) :
    g.1.stalkMap z =
      ((ofManifold K E M').toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq e)).hom ≫
        β
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  change g.1.stalkMap z =
    (ofManifold K E M').toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_refl _) ≫ β
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl, Category.id_comp]
  have := AnalyticSpace.isNoetherianRing_stalk Z z
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext
    (ringHom_ext_of_coord' ψ hΦ hp (g.1.stalkMap z).hom β.hom (g.1.prop z) hβ ?_ ?_)
  · intro c
    exact (g.algebraMap_stalk z c).trans (hc c).symm
  · intro j
    exact (hz j).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_coord_sub_constAt_mem
statement:
theorem stalkMap_coord_sub_constAt_mem {X : KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K}
    {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M' E} (hΦ : Φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M')
    (g : X ⟶ ofManifold K E M') {x : X} (hp : g.1.base x ∈ Φ.source) (j : Fin n) :
    (g.1.stalkMap x).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ hp j) - constAt X x (ψ (Φ (g.1.base x)) j) ∈
      maximalIdeal (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : coord E ψ Φ hΦ hp j - const K E M' (g.1.base x) (ψ (Φ (g.1.base x)) j) ∈
      maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K E M').presheaf.stalk (g.1.base x)) :=
    (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E _).mpr (by rw [map_sub, eval_coord, eval_const, sub_self])
  have hloc : IsLocalHom (g.1.stalkMap x).hom := g.1.prop x
  rw [show constAt X x (ψ (Φ (g.1.base x)) j) =
    (g.1.stalkMap x).hom (const K E M' (g.1.base x) (ψ (Φ (g.1.base x)) j)) from
    (g.algebraMap_stalk x _).symm, ← map_sub]
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hm ⊢
  exact fun hu => hm (isUnit_of_map_unit _ _ hu)

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.eq_of_sub_constAt_mem
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := Ideal.sub_mem _ hb ha
  rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_left, ← map_sub] at h3
  by_contra hne
  exact ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp h3) (isUnit_constAt _ x (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.mul_sub_constAt_mem
proof:
:= by
  have : s * t - constAt X x (a * b) =
      (s - constAt X x a) * t + constAt X x a * (t - constAt X x b) := by
    rw [map_mul]; ring
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ha) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hb)

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.base_eq_of_coord
statement:
theorem base_eq_of_coord {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M' E} (hΦ : Φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M')
    (g₁ g₂ : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ ofManifold K E M') {z : Z} (hp₁ : g₁.1.base z ∈ Φ.source)
    (hp₂ : g₂.1.base z ∈ Φ.source)
    (hz : ∀ j, (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ hp₂ j) =
      (g₁.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ hp₁ j)) :
    g₁.1.base z = g₂.1.base z
proof:
:= by
  have hval : ∀ j, ψ (Φ (g₁.1.base z)) j = ψ (Φ (g₂.1.base z)) j := by
    intro j
    have h2 := stalkMap_coord_sub_constAt_mem (ψ := ψ) hΦ g₂ hp₂ j
    rw [hz j] at h2
    exact eq_of_sub_constAt_mem (stalkMap_coord_sub_constAt_mem (ψ := ψ) hΦ g₁ hp₁ j) h2
  exact Φ.injOn hp₁ hp₂ (ψ.injective (funext hval))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.hom_ext_of_coord_chart
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_coord_chart (g₁ g₂ : Z.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ ofManifold K E M')
    (h : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M' E) (hΦ : Φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M')
      (hp₁ : g₁.1.base z ∈ Φ.source) (hp₂ : g₂.1.base z ∈ Φ.source),
      ∀ j, (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ hp₂ j) =
        (g₁.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ hp₁ j)) : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ z, g₁.1.base z = g₂.1.base z := fun z => by
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ, hp₁, hp₂, hz⟩ := h z
    exact base_eq_of_coord hΦ g₁ g₂ hp₁ hp₂ hz
  apply Hom.ext
  apply LocallyRingedSpace.Hom.ext'
  refine congrArg (fun f => f.hom) (SheafedSpace.hom_stalk_ext g₁.1.toShHom g₂.1.toShHom
    (TopCat.ext fun z => hb z) fun z => ?_)
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ, hp₁, hp₂, hz⟩ := h z
  exact stalkMap_eq_of_coord hΦ g₁ z hp₁ (hb z) hp₂ (g₂.1.stalkMap z)
    (fun c => g₂.algebraMap_stalk z c) hz

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.pullback_coord_self
statement:
theorem pullback_coord_self :
    ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom
        (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ i)) =
      (g.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp (σ i))
proof:
:=
  (stalkMap_comp_ofManifoldHom_apply hπ g z _).trans
    (congrArg _ (hΦ.germMap_coord_self hπ hφ hp))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.pullback_coord_of_ne
statement:
theorem pullback_coord_of_ne {k : Fin c} (hk : k ≠ i) :
    ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom
        (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ k)) =
      (g.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp (σ i)) *
        (g.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp (σ k))
proof:
:=
  (stalkMap_comp_ofManifoldHom_apply hπ g z _).trans
    ((congrArg _ (hΦ.germMap_coord_of_ne hπ hφ hp hk)).trans (map_mul _ _ _))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.pullback_coord_off
statement:
theorem pullback_coord_off {j : Fin n} (hj : ∀ k, σ k ≠ j) :
    ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom
        (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) j) =
      (g.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp j)
proof:
:=
  (stalkMap_comp_ofManifoldHom_apply hπ g z _).trans
    (congrArg _ (hΦ.germMap_coord_off hπ hφ hp hj))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.stalkIdeal_comap_comp_eq_span
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_comap_comp_eq_span {D : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf K E M)}
    (hspan : D.stalkIdeal ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.base z) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun k => coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ k))) :
    (QuotientSpace.comap (g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1 D).stalkIdeal z =
      Ideal.span
        {((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom
          (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ i))}
proof:
:= by
  refine (QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_comap (X := (ofManifold K E M).toLocallyRingedSpace)
    (g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1 D z).trans ?_
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (hspan.le.trans (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)))
    (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    change ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom
        (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ k)) ∈
      Ideal.span
        {((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ i))}
    by_cases hk : k = i
    · subst hk
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    · rw [pullback_coord_of_ne hπ hφ hΦ g hp hk, ← pullback_coord_self hπ hφ hΦ g hp]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  · rintro _ rfl
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hspan.ge (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.mem_nonZeroDivisors_pullback_coord
statement:
theorem mem_nonZeroDivisors_pullback_coord {D : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf K E M)}
    (hspan : D.stalkIdeal ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.base z) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun k => coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ k)))
    (hinv : ∃ a ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z),
      (QuotientSpace.comap (g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1 D).stalkIdeal z = Ideal.span {a}) :
    ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ i)) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors (Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hspan'⟩ := hinv
  rw [stalkIdeal_comap_comp_eq_span hπ hφ hΦ g hp hspan] at hspan'
  obtain ⟨_, u, hu, hb⟩ := Algebra.exists_unit_mul_eq_of_span_range_eq_span_singleton
    (fun _ : Unit => ((g ≫ ofManifoldHom π hπ).1.stalkMap z).hom
      (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) (σ i))) a ha
    (by rw [Set.range_const]; exact hspan')
  rw [hb]
  exact Submonoid.mul_mem _ hu.mem_nonZeroDivisors ha

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.stalkMap_coord_eq_of_mem_source
proof:
:= by
  have hnzd := mem_nonZeroDivisors_pullback_coord h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₁ hp₁ hspan (hinv z)
  rw [pullback_coord_self h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₁ hp₁] at hnzd
  have hi : (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp₂ (σ i)) =
      (g₁.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp₁ (σ i)) :=
    (pullback_coord_self h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₂ hp₂).symm.trans
      ((stalkMap_apply_coord_congr h₂ hφ z (hΦ.source_subset hp₂) (hΦ.source_subset hp₁)
        (σ i)).trans (pullback_coord_self h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₁ hp₁))
  by_cases hj : ∃ k, σ k = j
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hj
    by_cases hk : k = i
    · subst hk
      exact hi
    · have e := (pullback_coord_of_ne h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₂ hp₂ hk).symm.trans
        ((stalkMap_apply_coord_congr h₂ hφ z (hΦ.source_subset hp₂) (hΦ.source_subset hp₁)
          (σ k)).trans (pullback_coord_of_ne h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₁ hp₁ hk))
      rw [hi] at e
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp
        ((mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp hnzd).1 _ (by rw [mul_sub, e, sub_self]))
  · push Not at hj
    exact (pullback_coord_off h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₂ hp₂ hj).symm.trans
      ((stalkMap_apply_coord_congr h₂ hφ z (hΦ.source_subset hp₂) (hΦ.source_subset hp₁)
        j).trans (pullback_coord_off h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₁ hp₁ hj))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.mem_source_of_lift
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M := hφa.1
  have hπ₂ := base_comp_eq h.contMDiff h₂ z
  obtain ⟨k, Φk, hΦk, hp₂⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφa (g₂.1.base z : M')
    (Set.mem_of_eq_of_mem hπ₂ (hΦ.source_subset hp₁))
  by_cases hk : k = i
  · exact IsBlowUp.mem_source_of_same_index (M' := M') hY h (hk ▸ hΦk) hΦ hp₂
  have hspan : D.stalkIdeal ((g₁ ≫ ofManifoldHom π h.contMDiff).1.base z) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun k => coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp₁) (σ k)) :=
    hD.2 φ σ hφa _ (hΦ.source_subset hp₁) hzY
  have hnzd := mem_nonZeroDivisors_pullback_coord h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₁ hp₁ hspan (hinv z)
  have e1 : ((g₁ ≫ ofManifoldHom π h.contMDiff).1.stalkMap z).hom
      (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp₁) (σ i)) =
      (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φk hΦk.mem_maximalAtlas hp₂ (σ k)) *
        (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φk hΦk.mem_maximalAtlas hp₂ (σ i)) :=
    (stalkMap_apply_coord_congr h₂.symm hφ z (hΦ.source_subset hp₁) (hΦk.source_subset hp₂)
      (σ i)).trans (pullback_coord_of_ne h.contMDiff hφ hΦk g₂ hp₂ (Ne.symm hk))
  have e2 : (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φk hΦk.mem_maximalAtlas hp₂ (σ k)) =
      ((g₁ ≫ ofManifoldHom π h.contMDiff).1.stalkMap z).hom
        (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp₁) (σ i)) *
        (g₁.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp₁ (σ k)) :=
    (pullback_coord_self h.contMDiff hφ hΦk g₂ hp₂).symm.trans
      ((stalkMap_apply_coord_congr h₂ hφ z (hΦk.source_subset hp₂) (hΦ.source_subset hp₁)
        (σ k)).trans ((pullback_coord_of_ne h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₁ hp₁ hk).trans
          (congrArg (· * _) (pullback_coord_self h.contMDiff hφ hΦ g₁ hp₁).symm)))
  have hC : IsUnit ((g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φk hΦk.mem_maximalAtlas hp₂ (σ i))) := by
    suffices hCB : (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φk hΦk.mem_maximalAtlas hp₂ (σ i)) *
        (g₁.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp₁ (σ k)) = 1 from
      ⟨⟨_, _, hCB, by rw [mul_comm]; exact hCB⟩, rfl⟩
    have e3 : ((g₁ ≫ ofManifoldHom π h.contMDiff).1.stalkMap z).hom
        (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp₁) (σ i)) *
        ((g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φk hΦk.mem_maximalAtlas hp₂ (σ i)) *
          (g₁.1.stalkMap z).hom (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp₁ (σ k)) - 1) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one, mul_left_comm, mul_comm, ← e2, ← e1, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp hnzd).1 _ e3)
  have hloc : IsLocalHom (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom := g₂.1.prop z
  have hu : IsUnit (coord E ψ Φk hΦk.mem_maximalAtlas hp₂ (σ i)) :=
    isUnit_of_map_unit (g₂.1.stalkMap z).hom _ hC
  refine IsBlowUp.mem_source_of_coord_ne_zero (M' := M') hY h hΦk hΦ hp₂
    fun h0 => ?_
  refine (mem_nonunits_iff.mp ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp ?_)) hu
  rw [mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval, eval_coord]
  exact h0

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.lift_unique_of_comp_eq
statement: theorem lift_unique_of_comp_eq [IsManifold 𝓘(K, E) ω M] : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext_of_coord_chart (ψ := ψ) g₁ g₂ fun z => ?_
  by_cases hzY : π (g₁.1.base z) ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, haφ, hφa⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart _ hzY
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hp₁⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφa (g₁.1.base z : M') haφ
    have hp₂ := mem_source_of_lift hY h hD g₁ g₂ hinv h₂ hφa hΦ hp₁ hzY
    exact ⟨Φ, hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas, hp₁, hp₂,
      stalkMap_coord_eq_of_mem_source h g₁ g₂ hinv h₂ hφa.1 hΦ hp₁ hp₂
        (hD.2 φ σ hφa _ (hΦ.source_subset hp₁) hzY)⟩
  · obtain ⟨Φ₀, hp₀, hΦ₀⟩ :=
      (h.isLocalDiffeomorphOn_compl ⟨g₁.1.base z, hzY⟩).exists_partialDiffeomorph
    have hp₀ : g₁.1.base z ∈ Φ₀.source := hp₀
    have hπ₂ := base_comp_eq h.contMDiff h₂ z
    have hb : g₁.1.base z = g₂.1.base z := by
      have h₂' : g₂.1.base z ∈ π ⁻¹' Yᶜ := by
        change π (g₂.1.base z) ∉ Y
        rw [hπ₂]
        exact hzY
      exact h.bijOn_compl.injOn hzY h₂' hπ₂.symm
    have hφ : chartAt E (π (g₁.1.base z)) ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M :=
      IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas _
    have hπp₁ : π (g₁.1.base z) ∈ (chartAt E (π (g₁.1.base z))).source := mem_chart_source E _
    have hp₀' : g₂.1.base z ∈ Φ₀.source := hb ▸ hp₀
    have hπp₂ : π (g₂.1.base z) ∈ (chartAt E (π (g₁.1.base z))).source := hπ₂ ▸ hπp₁
    have hp₁' : g₁.1.base z ∈ (transportChart Φ₀.symm (chartAt E (π (g₁.1.base z)))).source :=
      ⟨hp₀, by
        change Φ₀ (g₁.1.base z) ∈ (chartAt E (π (g₁.1.base z))).source
        rw [← hΦ₀ hp₀]; exact hπp₁⟩
    have hp₂' : g₂.1.base z ∈ (transportChart Φ₀.symm (chartAt E (π (g₁.1.base z)))).source :=
      ⟨hp₀', by
        change Φ₀ (g₂.1.base z) ∈ (chartAt E (π (g₁.1.base z))).source
        rw [← hΦ₀ hp₀']; exact hπp₂⟩
    refine ⟨transportChart Φ₀.symm _, transportChart_mem_maximalAtlas Φ₀.symm hφ, hp₁', hp₂',
      fun j => ?_⟩
    rw [← germMap_coord_transportChart h.contMDiff hφ Φ₀ hΦ₀ hp₀' hπp₂ j,
      ← germMap_coord_transportChart h.contMDiff hφ Φ₀ hΦ₀ hp₀ hπp₁ j,
      ← stalkMap_comp_ofManifoldHom_apply h.contMDiff g₂ z,
      ← stalkMap_comp_ofManifoldHom_apply h.contMDiff g₁ z]
    exact stalkMap_apply_coord_congr h₂ hφ z hπp₂ hπp₁ j

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_iInf_opens
statement:
theorem mem_iInf_opens {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {V : ι → Opens α}
    {x : α} : x ∈ ⨅ i, V i ↔ ∀ i, x ∈ V i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_iInf, Set.mem_iInter]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_forall_germ_mem_span
statement:
theorem exists_forall_germ_mem_span {U : Opens X} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (s : F.obj (op U)) {c : ℕ}
    (h : Fin c → F.obj (op U))
    (hs : F.germ U x hx s ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => F.germ U x hx (h i))) :
    ∃ (W : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U), ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W),
      F.germ U y (hWU hy) s ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => F.germ U y (hWU hy) (h i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp hs
  
  choose V hxV t ht using fun i => F.exists_germ_eq (a i)
  
  let V₀ : Opens X := U ⊓ ⨅ i, V i
  have hxV₀ : x ∈ V₀ := Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hx, mem_iInf_opens.mpr hxV⟩
  have hV₀U : V₀ ≤ U := inf_le_left
  have hV₀V : ∀ i, V₀ ≤ V i := fun i => inf_le_right.trans (iInf_le _ i)
  
  let σ : F.obj (op V₀) := ∑ i, F.map (homOfLE (hV₀V i)).op (t i) * F.map (homOfLE hV₀U).op (h i)
  have hσ : F.germ V₀ x hxV₀ σ = F.germ U x hx s := by
    rw [← ha]
    simp only [σ, map_sum, map_mul, F.germ_res_apply, ht]
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iW, iV₀, hW⟩ := F.germ_eq x hx hxV₀ s σ hσ.symm
  refine ⟨W, hxW, leOfHom iW, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have hyV₀ : y ∈ V₀ := leOfHom iV₀ hy
  have : F.germ U y (leOfHom iW hy) s = F.germ V₀ y hyV₀ σ := by
    rw [← F.germ_res_apply iW y hy s, hW, F.germ_res_apply]
  rw [this]
  simp only [σ, map_sum, map_mul, F.germ_res_apply]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_forall_germ_mem_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_forall_germ_mem_stalkIdeal {U : Opens X} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (s : 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)) (hs : 𝒪.presheaf.germ U x hx s ∈ J.stalkIdeal x) :
    ∃ (W : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U), ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W),
      𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hWU hy) s ∈ J.stalkIdeal y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, g, hg, hgs⟩ := J.mem_stalkIdeal_iff.mp hs
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iU, iV, hW⟩ := 𝒪.presheaf.germ_eq x hx hxV s g hgs.symm
  refine ⟨W, hxW, leOfHom iU, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  rw [← 𝒪.presheaf.germ_res_apply iU y hy s, hW]
  exact J.germ_mem_stalkIdeal hy (J.res_mem iV g hg)

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_stalkIdeal_eq_span_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem exists_stalkIdeal_eq_span_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span {U : Opens X} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U)
    {k : ℕ} (g : Fin k → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hg : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U),
      J.stalkIdeal y = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y hy (g i)))
    {c : ℕ} (h : Fin c → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hJ : J.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U x hx (h i))) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ V) (i : V ⟶ U), ∀ y (hy : y ∈ V),
      J.stalkIdeal y =
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ V y hy (𝒪.presheaf.map i.op (h j)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hh : ∀ i, ∃ (W : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U), ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W),
      𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hWU hy) (h i) ∈ J.stalkIdeal y := fun i =>
    exists_forall_germ_mem_stalkIdeal 𝒪 J hx (h i) (hJ ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  choose W hxW hWU hW using hh
  
  have hgg : ∀ j, ∃ (W : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U), ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W),
      𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hWU hy) (g j) ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hWU hy) (h i)) := fun j =>
    exists_forall_germ_mem_span 𝒪.presheaf hx (g j) h (hJ ▸ hg x hx ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  choose W' hxW' hW'U hW' using hgg
  let V : Opens X := U ⊓ (⨅ i, W i) ⊓ ⨅ j, W' j
  have hxV : x ∈ V := Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hx, mem_iInf_opens.mpr hxW⟩,
    mem_iInf_opens.mpr hxW'⟩
  have hVU : V ≤ U := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hVW : ∀ i, V ≤ W i := fun i => inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_right.trans (iInf_le _ i))
  have hVW' : ∀ j, V ≤ W' j := fun j => inf_le_right.trans (iInf_le _ j)
  refine ⟨V, hxV, homOfLE hVU, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  simp only [𝒪.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [hg y (hVU hy), Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact hW' j y (hVW' j hy)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hW i y (hVW i hy)

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_mem_maximalIdeal_affine_iff
statement:
theorem germ_mem_maximalIdeal_affine_iff {K : Type} [RCLike K] (U : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)) (x : U)
    (g : AnalyticFun K n U) :
    (affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U x.1 x.2 g ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((affine K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x.1) ↔
      g.eval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, isUnit_germ_affine_iff, not_not]

name: AnalyticSpace.vanishingStalkIdeal_eq_radical_span_affine
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set θ : (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk q →+* Analytic.Conv ℂ n :=
    (taylorAffine.{u} ℂ n q).toRingHom with hθ
  have hθb : Function.Bijective θ := (taylorAffine.{u} ℂ n q).bijective
  set gm : Fin k → (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk q := fun i =>
    (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U q hq (h i) with hgm
  set S : Finset (Analytic.Conv ℂ n) := Finset.univ.image fun i => θ (gm i) with hS
  have hSJ : Ideal.span (S : Set (Analytic.Conv ℂ n)) = Ideal.map θ (Ideal.span (Set.range gm)) :=
      by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, hS, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  
  let pt : (Fin n → ℂ) → Kn.{u} ℂ n := fun x => ULift.up (q.down + x)
  have hpt : Continuous pt :=
    (ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift : Kn.{u} ℂ n ≃L[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ)).symm.continuous.comp
      (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have hpt0 : Tendsto pt (𝓝 0) (𝓝 q) := hpt.tendsto' 0 q (ULift.ext (add_zero _))
  
  
  have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), ∃ hx : pt x ∈ U, (x ∈ zeroSet S ↔ pt x ∈ D) := by
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), ∀ i,
        evalSeries (θ (gm i) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x =
          extendSection ℂ (Kn.{u} ℂ n) (h i) (ULift.up (q.down + x)) :=
      eventually_all.mpr fun i => eventually_evalSeries_convAt_germ q hq (h i)
    filter_upwards [h1, hpt0.eventually (U.isOpen.mem_nhds hq)] with x hx hxU
    have hval : ∀ i, evalSeries (θ (gm i) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x =
        (h i).eval ⟨pt x, hxU⟩ := by
      intro i
      rw [hx i, extendSection_of_mem (M := Kn.{u} ℂ n) ℂ (Kn.{u} ℂ n) (h i) hxU]
      rfl
    refine ⟨hxU, ?_⟩
    rw [hD (pt x) hxU, mem_zeroSet_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hz i
      rw [← hval i]
      exact hz _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i))
    · rintro hm g hg
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hg
      rw [hval i]
      exact hm i
  
  have hkey : ∀ s, s ∈ vanishingStalkIdeal (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace D q ↔
      VanishesOn S (θ s) := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨V, hqV, g, rfl⟩ := (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), ∃ hx : pt x ∈ V,
        evalSeries (θ ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ V q hqV g) :
          MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x = AnalyticFun.eval g ⟨pt x, hx⟩ := by
      have h2' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ),
          evalSeries (θ ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ V q hqV g) :
            MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x = extendSection ℂ (Kn.{u} ℂ n) g (ULift.up (q.down + x)) :=
        eventually_evalSeries_convAt_germ q hqV g
      filter_upwards [h2', hpt0.eventually (V.isOpen.mem_nhds hqV)] with x hx hxV
      refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
      rw [hx, extendSection_of_mem (M := Kn.{u} ℂ n) ℂ (Kn.{u} ℂ n) g hxV]
      rfl
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨V', hqV', g', hg', hvan⟩
      obtain ⟨W, hqW, iV', iV, hW⟩ :=
        (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ_eq q hqV' hqV _ _ hg'
      change ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), x ∈ zeroSet S →
        evalSeries (θ ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ V q hqV g) :
          MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x = 0
      filter_upwards [hev, h2, hpt0.eventually (W.isOpen.mem_nhds hqW)] with x hx1 hx2 hxW hz
      obtain ⟨hxU, hzD⟩ := hx1
      obtain ⟨hxV, hval⟩ := hx2
      rw [hval]
      have hmem := hvan (pt x) (iV'.le hxW) (hzD.mp hz)
      have heq : (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ V (pt x) hxV g =
          (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ V' (pt x) (iV'.le hxW) g' := by
        rw [← (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ_res_apply iV (pt x) hxW g, ← hW,
          (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ_res_apply iV' (pt x) hxW g']
      rw [← heq, germ_mem_maximalIdeal_affine_iff V ⟨pt x, hxV⟩ g] at hmem
      exact hmem
    · intro hvan
      have hvan' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), x ∈ zeroSet S →
          evalSeries (θ ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ V q hqV g) :
            MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x = 0 := hvan
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hNo, h0N⟩ := eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hvan'.and (hev.and h2))
      have hsub : Continuous fun b : Kn.{u} ℂ n => b.down - q.down :=
        (ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift : Kn.{u} ℂ n ≃L[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ)).continuous.sub
          continuous_const
      let V₀ : Opens (Kn.{u} ℂ n) := V ⊓ ⟨(fun b : Kn.{u} ℂ n => b.down - q.down) ⁻¹' N,
        hNo.preimage hsub⟩
      have hqV₀ : q ∈ V₀ := ⟨hqV, by change q.down - q.down ∈ N; rw [sub_self]; exact h0N⟩
      refine ⟨V₀, hqV₀, (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op g,
        (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE inf_le_left) q hqV₀ g,
        fun b hb hbD => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨x, hxN, rfl⟩ : ∃ x ∈ N, pt x = b :=
        ⟨b.down - q.down, hb.2, ULift.ext (add_sub_cancel _ _)⟩
      obtain ⟨hz0, ⟨hxU, hzD⟩, ⟨hxV, hval⟩⟩ := hN x hxN
      rw [(affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE inf_le_left) (pt x)
        hb g, germ_mem_maximalIdeal_affine_iff V ⟨pt x, hb.1⟩ g]
      have : AnalyticFun.eval g ⟨pt x, hxV⟩ = 0 := by rw [← hval]; exact hz0 (hzD.mpr hbD)
      exact this
  
  have hI : vanishingStalkIdeal (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace D q =
      Ideal.comap θ (vanishingIdeal (Ideal.span (S : Set (Analytic.Conv ℂ n)))) := by
    ext s
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff rfl]
    exact hkey s
  have hker : RingHom.ker θ ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range gm) := by
    rw [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot θ).mp hθb.1]
    exact bot_le
  rw [hI, vanishingIdeal_eq_radical, hSJ, ← Ideal.map_radical_of_surjective hθb.2 hker,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective θ hθb]

name: AnalyticSpace.isUnit_map_iff_of_bijective
statement:
theorem isUnit_map_iff_of_bijective {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Bijective f) (x : R) : IsUnit (f x) ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.map f⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hf.2 (u⁻¹ : Sˣ)
  refine isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨y, hf.1 ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_one, hy, ← hu]
  exact u.mul_inv

name: AnalyticSpace.vanishingStalkIdeal_cosupport_eq_radical_analyticSpaceOfOpen
statement:
theorem vanishingStalkIdeal_cosupport_eq_radical_analyticSpaceOfOpen (G : Opens (Kn.{u} ℂ n))
    (J : IdealSheaf (analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪)
    (q : analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G) :
    vanishingStalkIdeal (analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G).toLocallyRingedSpace J.support q =
      (J.stalkIdeal q).radical
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U', hqU', k, f, -, hgen⟩ := J.exists_generators q
  have hoe := Opens.isOpenEmbedding (X := (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) G
  have hbij : ∀ b, Function.Bijective
      (((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict hoe).stalkMap b).hom := fun b =>
    haveI := LocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict_stalkMap_isIso (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace hoe b
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
  have hind : IsInducing ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict hoe).base := hoe.isInducing
  have hmemU : ∀ b : analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G, b ∈ U' → b.1 ∈ hoe.functor.obj U' :=
    fun b hb => ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  have hqU : q.1 ∈ hoe.functor.obj U' := hmemU q hqU'
  
  have hgerm : ∀ (b : analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G) (hb : b ∈ U')
      (s : (analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.obj (op U')),
      ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict hoe).stalkMap b
        ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ (hoe.functor.obj U') b.1 (hmemU b hb) s) =
        (analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U' b hb s := fun b hb s =>
    (congrArg (fun ψ : (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk b.1 ⟶
        ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.restrict hoe).presheaf.stalk b =>
      ψ ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ (hoe.functor.obj U') b.1 (hmemU b hb) s))
      (LocallyRingedSpace.restrictStalkIso_inv_eq_ofRestrict (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace hoe
        b)).symm.trans
      (LocallyRingedSpace.restrictStalkIso_inv_eq_germ_apply (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace hoe
        U' b hb s)
  
  have hD : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ hoe.functor.obj U'), b ∈ Subtype.val '' J.support ↔
      ∀ i, AnalyticFun.eval (f i) ⟨b, hb⟩ = 0 := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ : ∃ b' : analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G, b' ∈ U' ∧ b'.1 = b := hb
    have : IsLocalRing ((analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.stalk b') :=
      inferInstanceAs
        (IsLocalRing ((analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk b'))
    have hunit : ∀ i, IsUnit ((analyticSpaceOfOpen ℂ n G).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ U'
        b' hb' (f i)) ↔ AnalyticFun.eval (f i) ⟨b'.1, hmemU b' hb'⟩ ≠ 0 := by
      intro i
      rw [← hgerm b' hb' (f i)]
      exact (isUnit_map_iff_of_bijective _ (hbij b') _).trans
        (isUnit_germ_affine_iff ℂ n (hoe.functor.obj U') ⟨b'.1, hmemU b' hb'⟩ (f i))
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩ i
      obtain rfl : c = b' := Subtype.ext hcb
      have hne : J.stalkIdeal c ≠ ⊤ := hc
      rw [hgen c hb', ne_eq, Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit] at hne
      by_contra h0
      exact hne ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, (hunit i).mpr h0⟩
    · intro h0
      refine ⟨b', ?_, rfl⟩
      change J.stalkIdeal b' ≠ ⊤
      rw [hgen b' hb', ne_eq, Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit]
      rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hu⟩
      exact (hunit i).mp hu (h0 i)
  have hNS := vanishingStalkIdeal_eq_radical_span_affine q.1 hqU f hD
  have hpre : ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict hoe).base ⁻¹'
      (Subtype.val '' J.support) = J.support := by
    ext b
    exact ⟨fun ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩ => (Subtype.ext hcb : c = b) ▸ hc, fun hb => ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩
  have hV2 := vanishingStalkIdeal_preimage_eq_map ((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict hoe)
    hind (fun b => (hbij b).2) (D := Subtype.val '' J.support)
    (fun _ ⟨c, _, hcb⟩ => ⟨c, hcb⟩) q
  rw [hpre] at hV2
  have hker : RingHom.ker (((affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict hoe).stalkMap q).hom ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
        (affine ℂ n).toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.germ (hoe.functor.obj U') q.1 hqU (f i)) := by
    rw [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp (hbij q).1]
    exact bot_le
  refine hV2.trans ((congrArg _ hNS).trans
    ((Ideal.map_radical_of_surjective (hbij q).2 hker).trans (congrArg Ideal.radical ?_)))
  exact (Ideal.map_span _ _).trans ((congrArg Ideal.span ((Set.range_comp _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg Set.range (funext fun i => hgerm q hqU' (f i))))).trans (hgen q hqU').symm)

name: AnalyticSpace.vanishingStalkIdeal_cosupport_eq_radical_quotient
statement:
theorem vanishingStalkIdeal_cosupport_eq_radical_quotient (Y : LocallyRingedSpace.{u})
    (I : IdealSheaf Y.𝒪) (J' : IdealSheaf (QuotientSpace.quotientSpace Y I).𝒪)
    (z : QuotientSpace.quotientSpace Y I)
    (hY : vanishingStalkIdeal Y (QuotientSpace.liftIdeal Y I J').support z.1 =
      ((QuotientSpace.liftIdeal Y I J').stalkIdeal z.1).radical) :
    vanishingStalkIdeal (QuotientSpace.quotientSpace Y I) J'.support z =
      (J'.stalkIdeal z).radical
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : ∀ z, Function.Surjective ((QuotientSpace.ι Y I).stalkMap z).hom := fun z =>
    QuotientSpace.stalkMap_surjective Y I z
  have hind : IsInducing (QuotientSpace.ι Y I).base := IsInducing.subtypeVal
  have hpre : (QuotientSpace.ι Y I).base ⁻¹' (Subtype.val '' J'.support) = J'.support := by
    ext b
    exact ⟨fun ⟨c, hc, hcb⟩ => (Subtype.ext hcb : c = b) ▸ hc, fun hb => ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩
  have hcos : Subtype.val '' J'.support = (QuotientSpace.liftIdeal Y I J').support := by
    rw [QuotientSpace.cosupport_eq_preimage_cosupport_liftIdeal, Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range,
      Subtype.range_coe]
    refine Set.inter_eq_left.mpr fun x hx => ?_
    by_contra hxI
    exact hx ((QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_liftIdeal Y I J' x).trans
      (QuotientSpace.liftStalk_of_notMem Y I J' hxI))
  have hV2 := vanishingStalkIdeal_preimage_eq_map (QuotientSpace.ι Y I) hind hsurj
    (D := Subtype.val '' J'.support) (fun _ ⟨c, _, hcb⟩ => ⟨c, hcb⟩) z
  rw [hpre, hcos] at hV2
  have hlift : (QuotientSpace.liftIdeal Y I J').stalkIdeal z.1 =
      Ideal.comap ((QuotientSpace.ι Y I).stalkMap z).hom (J'.stalkIdeal z) :=
    (QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_liftIdeal Y I J' z.1).trans
      (QuotientSpace.liftStalk_of_mem Y I J' z.2)
  refine hV2.trans ((congrArg _ (hY.trans (congrArg Ideal.radical hlift))).trans ?_)
  exact (Ideal.map_radical_of_surjective (hsurj z) (Ideal.ker_le_comap _)).trans
    (congrArg Ideal.radical (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ (hsurj z) _))

name: AnalyticSpace.vanishingStalkIdeal_cosupport_eq_radical
statement:
theorem vanishingStalkIdeal_cosupport_eq_radical (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} ℂ)
    (J : IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪) (y : X) :
    vanishingStalkIdeal X.toLocallyRingedSpace J.support y = (J.stalkIdeal y).radical
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hyU, n, k, G, f, ⟨e⟩⟩ := AnalyticSpace.exists_kIso_localModel X y
  obtain ⟨φ₁, hφ₁⟩ : ∃ φ₁ : (X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen U).toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶
      X.toLocallyRingedSpace, φ₁ = (KLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict X.toKLocallyRingedSpace U).1 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨φ₂, hφ₂⟩ : ∃ φ₂ : (localModel ℂ n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶
      (X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen U).toLocallyRingedSpace, φ₂ = e.inv.1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ : ∃ y' : X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen U, φ₁.base y' = y := by
    refine ⟨⟨y, hyU⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hφ₁]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : ∃ z : localModel ℂ n G f, φ₂.base z = y' := by
    refine ⟨e.hom.1.base y', ?_⟩
    rw [hφ₂]
    exact congrArg (fun g : X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen U ⟶
      X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen U => g.1.base y') e.hom_inv_id
  obtain ⟨J₁, hJ₁⟩ : ∃ J₁ :
      IdealSheaf (X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen U).toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪,
      J₁ = QuotientSpace.comap φ₁ J := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J₂, hJ₂⟩ : ∃ J₂ : IdealSheaf (localModel ℂ n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪,
      J₂ = QuotientSpace.comap φ₂ J₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hiso₁ : ∀ b, IsIso (φ₁.stalkMap b) := by
    rw [hφ₁]
    intro b
    exact LocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict_stalkMap_isIso X.toLocallyRingedSpace
      (Opens.isOpenEmbedding (X := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) U) b
  have hb₁ : ∀ b, Function.Bijective (φ₁.stalkMap b).hom := fun b =>
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
  have hiso₂ : ∀ b, IsIso (φ₂.stalkMap b) := by
    rw [hφ₂]
    intro b
    have : IsIso e.inv.1 := KLocallyRingedSpace.KIso.isIso_hom_val e.symm
    have : IsIso e.inv.1.toShHom.hom := SheafedSpace.is_presheafedSpace_iso e.inv.1.toShHom
    exact PresheafedSpace.stalkMap.isIso e.inv.1.toShHom.hom _
  have hb₂ : ∀ b, Function.Bijective (φ₂.stalkMap b).hom := fun b =>
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _
  have hind₁ : IsInducing φ₁.base := by
    rw [hφ₁]
    exact (Opens.isOpenEmbedding (X := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) U).isInducing
  have hind₂ : IsInducing φ₂.base := by
    rw [hφ₂]
    exact (KLocallyRingedSpace.KIso.homeomorph e.symm).isInducing
  have hsurj₂ : Function.Surjective φ₂.base := by
    rw [hφ₂]
    exact (KLocallyRingedSpace.KIso.homeomorph e.symm).surjective
  have hbase₁ : ∀ b, φ₁.base b = b.1 := by
    rw [hφ₁]
    intro b
    rfl
  
  have hlm : vanishingStalkIdeal (localModel ℂ n G f).toLocallyRingedSpace J₂.support z =
      (J₂.stalkIdeal z).radical :=
    vanishingStalkIdeal_cosupport_eq_radical_quotient _ _ J₂ z
      (vanishingStalkIdeal_cosupport_eq_radical_analyticSpaceOfOpen G _ z.1)
  
  have hXU : vanishingStalkIdeal (X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen U).toLocallyRingedSpace
      J₁.support (φ₂.base z) = (J₁.stalkIdeal (φ₂.base z)).radical := by
    apply ideal_map_injective_of_bijective _ (hb₂ z)
    have hker : RingHom.ker (φ₂.stalkMap z).hom ≤ J₁.stalkIdeal (φ₂.base z) := by
      rw [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp (hb₂ z).1]
      exact bot_le
    have h1 : Ideal.map (φ₂.stalkMap z).hom (J₁.stalkIdeal (φ₂.base z)) = J₂.stalkIdeal z := by
      rw [hJ₂]
      exact (QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_comap φ₂ J₁ z).symm
    have h2 : φ₂.base ⁻¹' J₁.support = J₂.support := by
      rw [hJ₂, QuotientSpace.cosupport_comap]
    refine ((vanishingStalkIdeal_preimage_eq_map φ₂ hind₂ (fun b => (hb₂ b).2)
      (D := J₁.support) (fun b _ => hsurj₂ b) z).symm.trans ?_).trans
      ((Ideal.map_radical_of_surjective (hb₂ z).2 hker).trans (congrArg Ideal.radical h1)).symm
    rw [h2]
    exact hlm
  
  apply ideal_map_injective_of_bijective _ (hb₁ (φ₂.base z))
  have hker : RingHom.ker (φ₁.stalkMap (φ₂.base z)).hom ≤
      J.stalkIdeal (φ₁.base (φ₂.base z)) := by
    rw [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp (hb₁ _).1]
    exact bot_le
  have h1 : Ideal.map (φ₁.stalkMap (φ₂.base z)).hom (J.stalkIdeal (φ₁.base (φ₂.base z))) =
      J₁.stalkIdeal (φ₂.base z) := by
    rw [hJ₁]
    exact (QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_comap φ₁ J (φ₂.base z)).symm
  have hU : (U : Set X) ∈ 𝓝 (φ₁.base (φ₂.base z)) := by
    rw [hbase₁]
    exact U.isOpen.mem_nhds (φ₂.base z).2
  have h2 : φ₁.base ⁻¹' (J.support ∩ (U : Set X)) = J₁.support := by
    rw [hJ₁, QuotientSpace.cosupport_comap]
    ext b
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_inter_iff, hbase₁]
    exact ⟨fun hb => hb.1, fun hb => ⟨hb, b.2⟩⟩
  have h3 := vanishingStalkIdeal_preimage_eq_map φ₁ hind₁ (fun b => (hb₁ b).2)
    (D := J.support ∩ (U : Set X)) (fun b hb => ⟨⟨b, hb.2⟩, hbase₁ _⟩) (φ₂.base z)
  rw [h2, vanishingStalkIdeal_inter_of_mem_nhds J.support hU] at h3
  exact h3.symm.trans (hXU.trans
    ((Ideal.map_radical_of_surjective (hb₁ _).2 hker).trans (congrArg Ideal.radical h1)).symm)

name: AnalyticSpace.IsSncAtIdeals.congr_ideals
statement: theorem congr_ideals {I J : ι → Ideal R} (hIJ : I = J) (h : IsSncAtIdeals I) : IsSncAtIdeals J
proof:
:=
  hIJ ▸ h

name: AnalyticSpace.IsSncAtIdeals.map_ne_top_iff_of_bijective
statement:
theorem map_ne_top_iff_of_bijective {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (g : R →+* S)
    (hg : Function.Bijective g) (I : Ideal R) : I.map g ≠ ⊤ ↔ I ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  not_congr ⟨fun h => by
    rw [← Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective g hg (I := I), h, Ideal.comap_top],
    fun h => by rw [h, Ideal.map_top]⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.IsSncAtIdeals.map_ringHom_of_bijective
statement:
theorem map_ringHom_of_bijective {I : ι → Ideal R} (g : R →+* S)
    (hg : Function.Bijective g) (h : IsSncAtIdeals I) :
    IsSncAtIdeals fun j => (I j).map g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, z, ⟨hz, hn⟩, c, hc, hcz⟩ := h
  let e : {j // (I j).map g ≠ ⊤} → {j // I j ≠ ⊤} :=
    fun j => ⟨j.1, (map_ne_top_iff_of_bijective g hg _).mp j.2⟩
  refine ⟨n, g ∘ z, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun j => c (e j),
    fun j₁ j₂ h => Subtype.ext (show (e j₁).1 = (e j₂).1 from congrArg Subtype.val (hc h)),
    fun j => ?_⟩
  · rw [Set.range_comp, ← Ideal.map_span, hz, IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective g hg.2]
  · rw [hn, ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.ofBijective g hg)]
  · change (I j.1).map g = _
    rw [hcz (e j), Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.IsSncAtIdeals.of_map_isIso
proof:
:= by
  have := instS
  have := hg
  refine (h.map_ringHom_of_bijective (CategoryTheory.inv g).hom
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _)).congr_ideals (funext fun j => ?_)
  change ((I j).map g.hom).map (CategoryTheory.inv g).hom = I j
  rw [Ideal.map_map, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id, CommRingCat.hom_id, Ideal.map_id]

name: AnalyticSpace.ClosedSubspace.isSncFamily_iff_isSncAtIdeals
statement:
theorem isSncFamily_iff_isSncAtIdeals {ι : Type u} (H : ι → ClosedSubspace X) :
    IsSncFamily H ↔ LocallyFinite (fun j => (H j).support) ∧
      ∀ x : X, IsSncAtIdeals fun j => (H j).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.ClosedSubspace.support_comap_eq_preimage
statement:
theorem support_comap_eq_preimage (f : Y ⟶ X) (D : ClosedSubspace X) :
    IdealSheaf.support (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 D) =
      ⇑f ⁻¹' D.support
proof:
:=
  QuotientSpace.cosupport_comap f.1 D

name: AnalyticSpace.ClosedSubspace.isSncFamily_comap_of_isIso
statement:
theorem isSncFamily_comap_of_isIso {ι : Type u} (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : IsIso f)
    {H : ι → ClosedSubspace X} (h : IsSncFamily H) :
    IsSncFamily fun j => (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 (H j) : ClosedSubspace Y)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIso f := hf
  have : @IsIso (KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K) _ Y.toKLocallyRingedSpace X.toKLocallyRingedSpace f :=
    AnalyticSpace.isIso_toKLocallyRingedSpace_of_isIso f
  rw [isSncFamily_iff_isSncAtIdeals] at h ⊢
  refine ⟨?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · have hsupp : (fun j => IdealSheaf.support (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 (H j))) =
        fun j => ⇑f ⁻¹' (H j).support :=
      funext fun j => support_comap_eq_preimage f (H j)
    rw [hsupp]
    exact h.1.preimage_continuous (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.continuous_toFun f)
  · have hb := KLocallyRingedSpace.bijective_stalkMap_of_isIso
      (f : Y.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ X.toKLocallyRingedSpace) y
    refine ((h.2 (f y)).map_ringHom_of_bijective _ hb).congr_ideals
      (funext fun j => ?_)
    exact (QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_comap f.1 (H j) y).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.ClosedSubspace.isSncBoundary_comap_of_isIso
statement:
theorem isSncBoundary_comap_of_isIso (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : IsIso f)
    {E : ClosedSubspace X} (h : E.IsSncBoundary) :
    ClosedSubspace.IsSncBoundary (X := Y) (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 E)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIso f := hf
  have : @IsIso (KLocallyRingedSpace.{u} K) _ Y.toKLocallyRingedSpace X.toKLocallyRingedSpace f :=
    AnalyticSpace.isIso_toKLocallyRingedSpace_of_isIso f
  obtain ⟨ι, H, hlf, hx⟩ := h
  refine ⟨ι, fun j => QuotientSpace.comap f.1 (H j), ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · have hsupp : (fun j => IdealSheaf.support (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 (H j))) =
        fun j => ⇑f ⁻¹' (H j).support :=
      funext fun j => support_comap_eq_preimage f (H j)
    rw [hsupp]
    exact hlf.preimage_continuous (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.continuous_toFun f)
  · obtain ⟨n, z, ⟨hz, hn⟩, ⟨c, s, hc, hrange, hcz, hE⟩, -⟩ := hx (f.1.base y)
    have hb := KLocallyRingedSpace.bijective_stalkMap_of_isIso
      (A := Y.toKLocallyRingedSpace) (B := X.toKLocallyRingedSpace) f y
    have hmem : ∀ j, y ∈ IdealSheaf.support (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 (H j)) ↔
        f.1.base y ∈ (H j).support := fun j => by
      rw [support_comap_eq_preimage]; exact Iff.rfl
    let e : {j // y ∈ IdealSheaf.support (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 (H j))} →
        {j // f.1.base y ∈ (H j).support} := fun j => ⟨j.1, (hmem j.1).mp j.2⟩
    have he : Function.Surjective e := fun j' => ⟨⟨j'.1, (hmem j'.1).mpr j'.2⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨n, (f.1.stalkMap y).hom ∘ z, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨fun j => c (e j), s,
      fun j₁ j₂ h => Subtype.ext (show (e j₁).1 = (e j₂).1 from congrArg Subtype.val (hc h)),
      ?_, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩, fun _ => ⟨∅, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [Set.range_comp, ← Ideal.map_span, hz,
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective _ hb.2]
    · rw [hn, ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb)]
    · rw [show (fun j => c (e j)) = c ∘ e from rfl, he.range_comp, hrange]
    · have hj := hcz (e j)
      change (H j.1).stalkIdeal (f.1.base y) = _ at hj
      have hcm := QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_comap f.1 (H j.1) y
      change (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 (H j.1)).stalkIdeal y =
        Ideal.map (f.1.stalkMap y).hom ((H j.1).stalkIdeal (f.1.base y)) at hcm
      change (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 (H j.1)).stalkIdeal y = _
      rw [hcm, hj]
      exact (Ideal.map_span _ _).trans (congrArg Ideal.span Set.image_singleton)
    · have hcm := QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_comap f.1 E y
      change (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 E).stalkIdeal y =
        Ideal.map (f.1.stalkMap y).hom (E.stalkIdeal (f.1.base y)) at hcm
      change (QuotientSpace.comap f.1 E).stalkIdeal y = _
      rw [hcm, hE]
      exact (Ideal.map_span _ _).trans (congrArg Ideal.span (Set.image_singleton.trans
        (congrArg (fun t => ({t} : Set _)) (map_prod _ _ _))))
    · rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_bot, Finset.coe_empty, Set.image_empty, Ideal.span_empty]
      rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.ClosedSubspace.isSncFamily_of_openCover
statement:
theorem isSncFamily_of_openCover {ι : Type u} {ι' : Type*} (U : ι' → Opens X)
    (hU : (⋃ i, (U i : Set X)) = Set.univ) (H : ι → ClosedSubspace X)
    (h : ∀ i, IsSncFamily fun j =>
      (QuotientSpace.comap (KLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict X.toKLocallyRingedSpace (U i)).1 (H j) :
        ClosedSubspace (X.restrictOpen (U i)))) :
    IsSncFamily H
proof:
:= by
  have hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i := fun x =>
    Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hU.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ x)
  rw [isSncFamily_iff_isSncAtIdeals]
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, hx⟩ := hcov x
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hfin⟩ := (h i).1 (⟨x, hx⟩ : X.restrictOpen (U i))
    refine ⟨Subtype.val '' t, ?_, hfin.subset fun j ⟨y, hy, hyt⟩ => ?_⟩
    · have := (Opens.isOpenEmbedding (U i)).map_nhds_eq ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact this ▸ Filter.image_mem_map ht
    · obtain ⟨y', hy't, rfl⟩ := hyt
      refine ⟨y', ?_, hy't⟩
      change y' ∈ (QuotientSpace.comap
        (KLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict X.toKLocallyRingedSpace (U i)).1 (H j)).support
      rw [QuotientSpace.cosupport_comap]
      exact hy
  · obtain ⟨i, hx⟩ := hcov x
    obtain ⟨n, z, ⟨hz, hn⟩, c, hc, hcz⟩ := (h i).2 (⟨x, hx⟩ : X.restrictOpen (U i))
    have instS : IsLocalRing
        ((X.restrictOpen (U i)).presheaf.stalk (⟨x, hx⟩ : X.restrictOpen (U i))) :=
      (X.restrictOpen (U i)).toLocallyRingedSpace.isLocalRing _
    have hpt : @IsSncAtIdeals _ _ instS _ (fun j =>
        (QuotientSpace.comap (KLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict X.toKLocallyRingedSpace (U i)).1
          (H j) : ClosedSubspace (X.restrictOpen (U i))).stalkIdeal
            (⟨x, hx⟩ : X.restrictOpen (U i))) :=
      ⟨n, z, ⟨hz, hn⟩, c, hc, hcz⟩
    refine IsSncAtIdeals.of_map_isIso instS
      ((KLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict X.toKLocallyRingedSpace (U i)).1.stalkMap
        (⟨x, hx⟩ : X.restrictOpen (U i)))
      (KLocallyRingedSpace.isIso_ofRestrict_stalkMap X.toKLocallyRingedSpace (U i)
        (⟨x, hx⟩ : X.restrictOpen (U i))) ?_
    exact Eq.mp (congrArg (@IsSncAtIdeals _ _ instS _)
      (funext fun j => QuotientSpace.stalkIdeal_comap
        (KLocallyRingedSpace.ofRestrict X.toKLocallyRingedSpace (U i)).1 (H j)
        (⟨x, hx⟩ : X.restrictOpen (U i)))) hpt

name: AnalyticSpace.stratumKIso_inv_base_apply
statement:
theorem stratumKIso_inv_base_apply (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K) (hX : X.IsNonsingular) (d : ℕ)
    (q : stratumRestrict X hX d) : (stratumKIso X hX d).inv.1.base q = q
proof:
:= by
  have h := KIso.hom_base_inv_base (stratumKIso X hX d) q
  rwa [show (stratumKIso X hX d).hom = stratumHom X hX d from rfl, stratumHom_base_apply] at h

name: AnalyticSpace.stratumKIso_inv_toFun_apply
statement:
theorem stratumKIso_inv_toFun_apply (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K) (hX : X.IsNonsingular) (d : ℕ)
    (q : stratumRestrict X hX d) :
    KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (stratumKIso X hX d).inv q = q
proof:
:=
  stratumKIso_inv_base_apply X hX d q

name: AnalyticSpace.hom_ext_toFun_of_isNonsingular_of_manifold
statement:
theorem hom_ext_toFun_of_isNonsingular_of_manifold {d : ℕ} {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M]
    [ChartedSpace (Fin d → K) M] [IsManifold 𝓘(K, Fin d → K) ω M] {Y : AnalyticSpace.{u} K}
    (hY : Y.IsNonsingular) (F G : ofManifold K (Fin d → K) M ⟶ Y.toKLocallyRingedSpace)
    (h : ∀ y, KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun F y = KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun G y) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  
  refine KLocallyRingedSpace.hom_ext_of_cover F G
    (fun d' : ℕ => (Opens.map F.1.base).obj (dimOpens Y hY d')) (fun y => ?_) (fun d' => ?_)
  · have hy : KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun F y ∈ ⋃ d' : ℕ, dimSet Y d' := by
      rw [iUnion_dimSet_eq_univ Y hY]
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    exact ⟨d', hd'⟩
  
  have hmF : ∀ a ∈ (Opens.map F.1.base).obj (dimOpens Y hY d'),
      KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun F a ∈ dimOpens Y hY d' := fun a ha => ha
  have hmG : ∀ a ∈ (Opens.map F.1.base).obj (dimOpens Y hY d'),
      KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun G a ∈ dimOpens Y hY d' := fun a ha => by
    rw [← h a]
    exact ha
  generalize hP : (Opens.map F.1.base).obj (dimOpens Y hY d') = P at hmF hmG ⊢
  rw [← Hom.restrictTo_comp_ofRestrict F P (dimOpens Y hY d') hmF,
    ← Hom.restrictTo_comp_ofRestrict G P (dimOpens Y hY d') hmG]
  congr 1
  
  rw [← cancel_mono (stratumKIso Y hY d').inv,
    ← cancel_epi (ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := Fin d → K) (M := M) P).inv]
  refine hom_ext_baseFun (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl K (Fin d → K))
    (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl K (Fin d' → K)) _ _ (funext fun p => ?_)
  change KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (stratumKIso Y hY d').inv
      (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (Hom.restrictTo F P (dimOpens Y hY d') hmF)
        (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun
          (ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := Fin d → K) (M := M) P).inv p)) =
    KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (stratumKIso Y hY d').inv
      (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (Hom.restrictTo G P (dimOpens Y hY d') hmG)
        (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun
          (ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := Fin d → K) (M := M) P).inv p))
  rw [stratumKIso_inv_toFun_apply, stratumKIso_inv_toFun_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (Hom.toFun_restrictTo F P (dimOpens Y hY d') hmF _).trans
    ((h _).trans (Hom.toFun_restrictTo G P (dimOpens Y hY d') hmG _).symm)

name: AnalyticSpace.hom_ext_toFun_of_isNonsingular
statement:
theorem hom_ext_toFun_of_isNonsingular {X Y : AnalyticSpace.{u} K} (hX : X.IsNonsingular)
    (hY : Y.IsNonsingular) (f g : X ⟶ Y) (h : ∀ x, Hom.toFun f x = Hom.toFun g x) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  
  refine KLocallyRingedSpace.hom_ext_of_cover
    (f : X.toKLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ Y.toKLocallyRingedSpace) g (fun d : ℕ => dimOpens X hX d)
    (fun x => ?_) (fun d => ?_)
  · have hx : x ∈ ⋃ d : ℕ, dimSet X d := by
      rw [iUnion_dimSet_eq_univ X hX]
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact ⟨d, hd⟩
  
  rw [← cancel_epi (stratumKIso X hX d).hom]
  refine hom_ext_toFun_of_isNonsingular_of_manifold hY _ _ (fun y => ?_)
  exact h _

name: Analytic.eventually_eventually_add_of_eventually
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h.eventually_nhds] with x' hx'
  have hc : Continuous fun y' : Fin n → ℂ => x' + y' := continuous_const.add continuous_id
  exact (hc.tendsto' 0 x' (add_zero _)).eventually hx'

name: AnalyticSpace.span_modelGensFinset
statement:
theorem span_modelGensFinset (z : localModel ℂ n G f) :
    Ideal.span ((modelGensFinset G f z : Finset (Analytic.Conv ℂ n)) : Set (Analytic.Conv ℂ n)) =
      modelIdealAt G f z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold modelGensFinset
  rw [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, span_range_modelGens]

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_zeroSet_modelGensFinset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_zeroSet_modelGensFinset_iff (z : localModel ℂ n G f) (y' : Fin n → ℂ) :
    y' ∈ zeroSet (modelGensFinset G f z) ↔
      ∀ j, evalSeries (modelGens G f z j : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) y' = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold modelGensFinset
  simp only [mem_zeroSet_iff, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro h j
    exact h _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rintro h _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact h j

name: AnalyticSpace.eventually_regular_pt_of_minimalPrime
statement:
theorem eventually_regular_pt_of_minimalPrime
    (h17a : ∀ {n : ℕ} (P : Ideal (Analytic.Conv ℂ n)) [P.IsPrime], P ≠ ⊥ →
      ∃ (d : ℕ) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (L : (Fin n → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ)),
        Function.Injective (normMap ℂ P e L) ∧
        RingHom.Finite (A := Analytic.Conv ℂ d) (B := Analytic.Conv ℂ n ⧸ P)
          (normMap ℂ P e L : Analytic.Conv ℂ d →+* Analytic.Conv ℂ n ⧸ P) ∧
        ∃ (i₀ : Fin n) (_ : i₀ ∉ Set.range e) (Q : Polynomial (Analytic.Conv ℂ d))
            (A : Analytic.Conv ℂ d),
          Q.Monic ∧ Irreducible Q ∧ A ≠ 0 ∧
          (Q.map (convEmbed ℂ e).toRingHom).eval (convX ℂ i₀) ∈ Ideal.comap (substEquiv L) P ∧
          ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range e → ∃ B : Polynomial (Analytic.Conv ℂ d),
            convEmbed ℂ e A * convX ℂ i - (B.map (convEmbed ℂ e).toRingHom).eval (convX ℂ i₀) ∈
              Ideal.comap (substEquiv L) P)
    (h17c : ∀ {n : ℕ} (P : Ideal (Analytic.Conv ℂ n)) [P.IsPrime] {d : ℕ} (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n)
