name: Derivation.eq_localization_of_algebraMap
statement:
theorem eq_localization_of_algebraMap (D' : Derivation k (Localization M) (Localization M))
    (h : ∀ a, D' (algebraMap A (Localization M) a) = algebraMap A (Localization M) (D a)) :
    D' = D.localization M
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine Localization.induction_on x fun ⟨a, s⟩ => ?_
  have hs : Localization.mk (1 : A) s * algebraMap A (Localization M) (s : A) = 1 := by
    rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul, one_mul, mul_one,
      Localization.mk_self]
  have h1 : D' (Localization.mk 1 s) =
      -(Localization.mk 1 s) ^ 2 • algebraMap A (Localization M) (D s) := by
    rw [D'.leibniz_of_mul_eq_one hs, h]
  have hx : Localization.mk a s = algebraMap A (Localization M) a * Localization.mk 1 s := by
    rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
  have hD' : D' (Localization.mk a s) =
      algebraMap A (Localization M) a • (-(Localization.mk 1 s) ^ 2 •
        algebraMap A (Localization M) (D s)) +
        Localization.mk 1 s • algebraMap A (Localization M) (D a) := by
    rw [hx, D'.leibniz, h1, h]
  rw [hD', localization_mk]
  simp only [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, smul_eq_mul, pow_two, Localization.mk_mul,
    Localization.neg_mk, Localization.add_mk]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  push_cast
  ring

name: Derivation.zero_localization
statement: theorem zero_localization : (0 : Derivation k A A).localization M = 0
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Derivation.eq_localization_of_algebraMap
  intro a
  simp

name: Derivation.localization_comm
statement:
theorem localization_comm (D₁ D₂ : Derivation k A A) (h : ∀ a, D₁ (D₂ a) = D₂ (D₁ a))
    (z : Localization M) :
    D₁.localization M (D₂.localization M z) = D₂.localization M (D₁.localization M z)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : ⁅D₁.localization M, D₂.localization M⁆ = (0 : Derivation k A A).localization M := by
    apply Derivation.eq_localization_of_algebraMap
    intro a
    rw [Derivation.commutator_apply, Derivation.localization_algebraMap,
      Derivation.localization_algebraMap, Derivation.localization_algebraMap,
      Derivation.localization_algebraMap, h a, sub_self, Derivation.zero_apply, map_zero]
  have hz := congrArg (fun D : Derivation k (Localization M) (Localization M) => D z) hcomm
  rw [zero_localization] at hz
  simpa [Derivation.commutator_apply, sub_eq_zero] using hz

name: Ideal.colon_coe_span_singleton_pow
statement:
theorem colon_coe_span_singleton_pow (A : Ideal R) (u : R) (k : ℕ) :
    A.colon (SetLike.coe (Ideal.span {u} ^ k)) = A.colon {u ^ k}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Submodule.colon_span]

name: Ideal.colon_singleton_pow_mono
statement:
theorem colon_singleton_pow_mono (A : Ideal R) (u : R) {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) :
    A.colon {u ^ s} ≤ A.colon {u ^ t}
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hst
  rw [pow_add, ← mul_assoc]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hx

name: Ideal.span_pow_mul_colon_of_le
statement:
theorem span_pow_mul_colon_of_le (A : Ideal R) (u : R) (a : ℕ) (hA : A ≤ Ideal.span {u ^ a}) :
    Ideal.span {u ^ a} * A.colon {u ^ a} = A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff]
    intro x hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul] at hx
    rwa [mul_comm]
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hA hx)
    have hg : g ∈ A.colon {u ^ a} := Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr (by rwa [smul_eq_mul])
    have hcomm : g * u ^ a = u ^ a * g := mul_comm _ _
    rw [hcomm]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) hg

name: Ideal.colon_span_pow_mul_self
statement:
theorem colon_span_pow_mul_self (C : Ideal R) {u : R} (hu : u ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (Ideal.span {u ^ k} * C).colon {u ^ k} = C
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩
    have hx : x = z := mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero k hu) (by rw [hzx, mul_comm])
    rwa [hx]
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, hx, mul_comm _ _⟩

name: Ideal.colon_mul_pow_add
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← span_pow_mul_colon_of_le A u a hA, ← span_pow_mul_colon_of_le B u b hB]
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, ← pow_add]
  exact colon_span_pow_mul_self _ hu _

name: Ideal.colon_pow_pow_mul
statement:
theorem colon_pow_pow_mul (A : Ideal R) {u : R} (hu : u ≠ 0) (k s : ℕ)
    (hA : A ≤ Ideal.span {u ^ k}) :
    (A ^ s).colon {u ^ (k * s)} = A.colon {u ^ k} ^ s
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← span_pow_mul_colon_of_le A u k hA]
  rw [mul_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, ← pow_mul]
  exact colon_span_pow_mul_self _ hu _

name: Ideal.colon_sup_pow
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← span_pow_mul_colon_of_le A u k hA, ← span_pow_mul_colon_of_le B u k hB]
  rw [← Ideal.mul_sup]
  exact colon_span_pow_mul_self _ hu _

name: IsLocalRing.colon_span_singleton_pow_eq_top_of_ord_le
statement:
theorem colon_span_singleton_pow_eq_top_of_ord_le
    (hmul : ∀ f g : R, ordElem (f * g) =
      ordElem f + ordElem g)
    {u : R} (hu : u ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) {J : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hle : J ≤ Ideal.span {u} ^ m)
    (hord : ord J ≤ m) : J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u} ^ m) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at hle ⊢
  
  have hJ : J = Ideal.span {u ^ m} * J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u ^ m}) := by
    rw [Submodule.colon_span]
    exact (Ideal.span_pow_mul_colon_of_le J u m hle).symm
  have hordJ : ord J =
      ordElem (u ^ m) + ord (J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u ^ m})) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hJ]
    exact ord_span_singleton_mul_of_ordElem_mul hmul _ _
  have hm_le : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ordElem (u ^ m) := by
    rw [ordElem_pow_of_ordElem_mul hmul]
    calc (m : ℕ∞) = (m : ℕ∞) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ (m : ℕ∞) * ordElem u :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (one_le_ordElem_iff.mpr hu) zero_le
  have h0 : ord (J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u ^ m})) = 0 := by
    have h1 : (m : ℕ∞) + ord (J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u ^ m})) ≤ (m : ℕ∞) + 0 := by
      rw [add_zero]
      calc (m : ℕ∞) + ord (J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u ^ m}))
          ≤ ordElem (u ^ m) + ord (J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u ^ m})) :=
            add_le_add hm_le le_rfl
        _ = ord J := hordJ.symm
        _ ≤ m := hord
    exact le_antisymm ((WithTop.add_le_add_iff_left (ENat.natCast_ne_top m)).mp h1) bot_le
  exact ord_eq_zero_iff.mp h0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.val_fromZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem val_fromZeroRingHom (f : 𝒜 0) :
    (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 x f).val = algebraMap A (Localization x) f
proof:
:= by
  change (HomogeneousLocalization.mk _).val = _
  rw [val_mk]
  exact Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.valRingHom_apply
statement: theorem valRingHom_apply (y : HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x) : valRingHom 𝒜 x y = y.val
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.X_mem_one
statement: theorem X_mem_one (i : σ) : (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ homogeneousSubmodule σ R 1
proof:
:=
  (mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mpr (isHomogeneous_X R i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.X_mem_one_smul
statement: theorem X_mem_one_smul (i : σ) : (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ homogeneousSubmodule σ R (1 • 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]; exact X_mem_one R i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.algebraMap_away_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_away_apply (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) f) r =
      fromZeroRingHom _ _ (algebraMap R (homogeneousSubmodule σ R 0) r)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.val_algebraMap_away
statement:
theorem val_algebraMap_away (r : R) :
    (algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) f) r).val =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ R) (Localization (Submonoid.powers f)) (C r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraMap_away_apply, val_fromZeroRingHom]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.f_mem_one
statement: theorem f_mem_one : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule σ R 1
proof: := hf ▸ X_mem_one R j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.val_mkX
statement: theorem val_mkX (i : σ) : (mkX R j f hf i).val = Localization.mk (X i) (fpow R f 1)
proof:
:=
  Away.val_mk _ _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.mkX_self
statement: theorem mkX_self : mkX R j f hf j = 1
proof:
:= by
  subst hf
  apply val_injective
  rw [val_mkX, val_one]
  have : fpow R (X j) 1 = ⟨X j, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ := Subtype.ext (pow_one _)
  rw [this]
  exact Localization.mk_self
    (⟨X j, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X j : MvPolynomial σ R))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.dehomogenize_X_self
statement: theorem dehomogenize_X_self : dehomogenize R j (X j) = 1
proof: := by simp [dehomogenize]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.dehomogenize_X_of_ne
statement: theorem dehomogenize_X_of_ne {i : σ} (h : i ≠ j) : dehomogenize R j (X i) = X ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [dehomogenize, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.eval₂_mul_right_of_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem eval₂_mul_right_of_isHomogeneous {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (g : σ → S)
    (u : S) {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {m : ℕ} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous m) :
    eval₂ φ (fun i => g i * u) p = u ^ m * eval₂ φ g p
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval₂_eq, eval₂_eq, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd => ?_
  have hdeg : ∑ i ∈ d.support, d i = m := by
    have h := hp (mem_support_iff.mp hd)
    rw [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum] at h
    simpa using h
  simp_rw [mul_pow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, hdeg]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.aeval_mkX_of_mem
statement:
theorem aeval_mkX_of_mem {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {m : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule σ R m) :
    aeval (mkX R j f hf) p = Away.mk _ (f_mem_one R j f hf) m p (by simpa using hp)
proof:
:= by
  subst hf
  apply val_injective
  rw [Away.val_mk, aeval_def, ← valRingHom_apply, eval₂_comp_left]
  have h1 : (valRingHom (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (Submonoid.powers (X j))).comp
      (algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (X j))) =
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ R) (Localization (Submonoid.powers (X j)))).comp C :=
    RingHom.ext fun r => val_algebraMap_away R (X j) r
  have h2 : (valRingHom (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (Submonoid.powers (X j)) ∘ mkX R j (X j) rfl) =
      fun i => algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ R) (Localization (Submonoid.powers (X j))) (X i) *
        Localization.mk 1 (fpow R (X j) 1) := by
    funext i
    rw [Function.comp_apply, valRingHom_apply, val_mkX, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap,
      Localization.mk_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [h1, h2]
  refine (eval₂_mul_right_of_isHomogeneous R _ (fun i => algebraMap _ _ (X i)) _
    ((mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mp hp)).trans ?_
  set L := Localization (Submonoid.powers (X j : MvPolynomial σ R)) with hL
  have h3 : eval₂ ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ R) L).comp (C : R →+* MvPolynomial σ R))
      (fun i => algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ R) L (X i : MvPolynomial σ R)) p =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ R) L p := by
    rw [show (fun i => algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ R) L (X i : MvPolynomial σ R)) =
      ⇑(algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ R) L) ∘ X from rfl, ← eval₂_comp_left, eval₂_eta]
  rw [h3, Localization.mk_pow, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul, one_pow,
    one_mul, mul_one]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.dehomAux_dehomogenize
statement:
theorem dehomAux_dehomogenize (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    dehomAux R j f hf (dehomogenize R j p) = aeval (mkX R j f hf) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [dehomAux, dehomogenize, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, comp_aeval]
  congr 2
  funext i
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; rw [map_one, mkX_self]
  · rw [aeval_X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.dehomAux_surjective
statement: theorem dehomAux_surjective : Function.Surjective (dehomAux R j f hf)
proof:
:= fun z => by
  obtain ⟨m, p, hp, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective _ (f_mem_one R j f hf) z
  exact ⟨dehomogenize R j p, by
    rw [dehomAux_dehomogenize, aeval_mkX_of_mem R j f hf (by simpa using hp)]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isUnit_dehomogenize
statement: theorem isUnit_dehomogenize : IsUnit (dehomogenize R j f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf, dehomogenize_X_self]; exact isUnit_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.dehomLoc_val_dehomAux
statement:
theorem dehomLoc_val_dehomAux (q : MvPolynomial {i : σ // i ≠ j} R) :
    dehomLoc R j f hf (dehomAux R j f hf q).val = q
proof:
:= by
  subst hf
  have : (dehomLoc R j (X j) rfl).comp
      ((valRingHom (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (Submonoid.powers (X j))).comp
        (dehomAux R j (X j) rfl).toRingHom) = RingHom.id _ := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, RingHom.id_apply]
      rw [dehomAux, aeval_C, valRingHom_apply, val_algebraMap_away, dehomLoc,
        IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
      simp [dehomogenize]
    · intro i
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, RingHom.id_apply]
      rw [dehomAux, aeval_X, valRingHom_apply, val_mkX, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, dehomLoc,
        IsLocalization.Away.lift, IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec]
      simp [dehomogenize_X_of_ne R j i.2, dehomogenize_X_self]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.dehomAux_injective
statement: theorem dehomAux_injective : Function.Injective (dehomAux R j f hf)
proof:
:= fun a b h => by
  have ha := dehomLoc_val_dehomAux R j f hf a
  rw [h, dehomLoc_val_dehomAux] at ha
  exact ha.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.dehom_apply
statement:
theorem dehom_apply (q : MvPolynomial {i : σ // i ≠ j} R) :
    dehom R j f hf q = dehomAux R j f hf q
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.gradedMap_apply
statement:
theorem gradedMap_apply (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    gradedMap R S p = MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R S) p
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.gradedMap_X
statement: theorem gradedMap_X (i : σ) : gradedMap R S (X i) = X i
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradedMap_apply, map_X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayMap_dehomAux
statement:
theorem awayMap_dehomAux (q : MvPolynomial {i : σ // i ≠ j} R) :
    Away.map (gradedMap R S) (X j) (dehomAux R j (X j) rfl q) =
      dehomAux S j (gradedMap R S (X j)) (gradedMap_X R S j)
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R S) q)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Away.map (gradedMap R S) (X j)).comp (dehomAux R j (X j) rfl).toRingHom =
      (dehomAux S j (gradedMap R S (X j)) (gradedMap_X R S j)).toRingHom.comp
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R S)) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, map_C]
      rw [dehomAux, dehomAux, aeval_C, aeval_C, algebraMap_away_apply, algebraMap_away_apply,
        Away.map_fromZeroRingHom]
      congr 1
      ext
      simp [gradedMap_apply]
    · intro i
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, map_X]
      rw [dehomAux, dehomAux, aeval_X, aeval_X]
      apply val_injective
      rw [mkX, Away.map_mk, Away.val_mk, val_mkX]
      congr 1
      exact gradedMap_X R S i.1
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.tensorEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_tmul (s : S) (z : Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (X j)) :
    tensorEquiv R j S (s ⊗ₜ z) = algebraMap S _ s * Away.map (gradedMap R S) (X j) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := (dehom R j (X j) rfl).surjective z
  rw [tensorEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_refl, id_eq, MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv_tmul,
    Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, AlgEquiv.commutes, dehom_apply, dehom_apply, awayMap_dehomAux]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isPushout_away
statement:
theorem isPushout_away :
    CategoryTheory.IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (X j))))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ S) (gradedMap R S (X j)))))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map (gradedMap R S) (X j)))
proof:
:=
  (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct R S (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (X j))).of_iso
    (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _) (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _) (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _)
    (tensorEquiv R j S).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso (by simp) (by simp)
    (by ext s; simp [tensorEquiv_tmul]) (by ext z; simp [tensorEquiv_tmul])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.irrelevant_le_span_range_X
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_span_range_X :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule σ R)).toIdeal ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ R))
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le]
  intro i hi p hp
  change p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ R))
  rw [← Set.image_univ, MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image]
  intro m hm
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := fun h0 => by
    have h := (mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mp hp (mem_support_iff.mp hm)
    rw [h0, map_zero] at h
    exact hi.ne h
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hm0
  exact ⟨k, Set.mem_univ k, hk⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι_projToSpec
statement:
theorem awayι_projToSpec (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule σ R 1) :
    Proj.awayι _ f hf one_pos ≫ projToSpec σ R =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) f)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [projToSpec, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule σ S) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (homogeneousSubmodule σ R)).map (gradedMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toIdeal_le_toIdeal_iff, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map]
  refine (irrelevant_le_span_range_X σ S).trans (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  rw [← gradedMap_X R S k]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ one_pos (X_mem_one R k))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projMap_projToSpec
statement:
theorem projMap_projToSpec :
    projMap σ R S ≫ projToSpec σ R =
      projToSpec σ S ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  rw [projMap, projToSpec, projToSpec, map_toSpecZero_assoc, Category.assoc,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r => Subtype.ext ?_)
  simp [gradedMap_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isPullback_awayι_projMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_awayι_projMap (j : σ) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map (gradedMap R S) (X j))))
      (Proj.awayι _ (gradedMap R S (X j)) ((gradedMap R S).map_mem (X_mem_one R j)) one_pos)
      (Proj.awayι _ (X j) (X_mem_one R j) one_pos) (projMap σ R S)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _
    (Proj.awayι_comp_map (gradedMap R S) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap σ R S) one_pos (X j)
      (X_mem_one R j))
    (by rw [Proj.opensRange_awayι, Proj.opensRange_awayι, projMap, Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isPullback_Spec_away
statement:
theorem isPullback_Spec_away (j : σ) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap S (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ S) (gradedMap R S (X j))))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map (gradedMap R S) (X j))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Away (homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (X j)))))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _ (isPushout_away R j S)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isPullback_projMap_aux
proof:
:= by
  have hchart := (isPullback_awayι_projMap σ R S j).flip
  let e := hab.isoIsPullback _ _ hchart
  have he₁ : e.hom ≫ Proj.awayι _ (gradedMap R S (X j))
      ((gradedMap R S).map_mem (X_mem_one R j)) one_pos = a :=
    hab.isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ hchart
  have he₂ : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map (gradedMap R S) (X j))) = b :=
    hab.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ hchart
  refine (isPullback_Spec_away σ R S j).of_iso' e (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_
    ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, ← awayι_projToSpec σ S (gradedMap R S (X j))
      ((gradedMap R S).map_mem (X_mem_one R j)), ← Category.assoc, he₁]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, he₂]
  · simp
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, awayι_projToSpec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isPullback_projMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_projMap :
    IsPullback (projToSpec σ S) (projMap σ R S) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
      (projToSpec σ R)
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover (projMap σ R S) (projToSpec σ S) (projToSpec σ R)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) (standardCover σ R).openCover fun j =>
      (isPullback_projMap_aux σ R S j (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _)).flip).flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projBaseChangeIso_hom_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem projBaseChangeIso_hom_fst :
    (projBaseChangeIso σ R S).hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = projToSpec σ S
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_projMap σ R S).isoPullback_hom_fst

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projBaseChangeIso_hom_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem projBaseChangeIso_hom_snd :
    (projBaseChangeIso σ R S).hom ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = projMap σ R S
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_projMap σ R S).isoPullback_hom_snd

name: IsLocalRing.derivation_mem_pow
statement:
theorem derivation_mem_pow (δ : Derivation k A A) (J : Ideal A) (N : ℕ) {f : A}
    (hf : f ∈ J ^ (N + 1)) : δ f ∈ J ^ N
proof:
:= by
  induction N generalizing f with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [pow_succ'] at hf
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf (fun a ha b hb => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
    · rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hb)
      rw [pow_succ']
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha (ih hb)
    · rw [map_add]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy

name: IsLocalRing.span_image_derivation_pow_le
statement:
theorem span_image_derivation_pow_le (δ : Derivation k A A) (J : Ideal A) (N : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span (δ '' (J ^ (N + 1) : Ideal A)) ≤ J ^ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  exact derivation_mem_pow δ J N hf

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_le
statement:
theorem le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_le {r m : ℕ} (h : r < m) :
    I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ m ↔ c.Dpow r I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ (m - r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_ord_iff, ← le_ord_iff]
  exact c.le_ord_iff_le_ord_Dpow I h

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_le_maximalIdeal {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ m ↔ c.Dpow (m - 1) I ≤ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_le I (Nat.sub_lt hm one_pos),
    show m - (m - 1) = 1 by omega, pow_one]

name: IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_iff_ne_top
statement:
theorem _root_.IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_iff_ne_top {J : Ideal R} :
    J ≤ maximalIdeal R ↔ J ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h htop => (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top (top_le_iff.mp (htop ▸ h)),
    fun h => le_maximalIdeal h⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_ne_top
statement:
theorem le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_ne_top {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ m ↔ c.Dpow (m - 1) I ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_le_maximalIdeal I hm, le_maximalIdeal_iff_ne_top]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_ord_iff_Dpow_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem le_ord_iff_Dpow_le_maximalIdeal {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I ↔ c.Dpow (m - 1) I ≤ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_ord_iff]
  exact c.le_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_Dpow_le_maximalIdeal I hm

name: Derivation.exists_retraction_mapBaseChange
statement:
theorem exists_retraction_mapBaseChange [Algebra.FormallySmooth A B] :
    ∃ r : Ω[B⁄k] →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄k], r ∘ₗ mapBaseChange k A B = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (mapBaseChange k A B) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (Algebra.H1Cotangent.exact_δ_mapBaseChange k A B x).mp hx
    rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, map_zero]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (map k A B B) := map_surjective k A B
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (map k A B B) LinearMap.id hsurj
  have h01 := ((exact_mapBaseChange_map k A B).split_tfae hinj hsurj).out 1 2
  exact h01.mp ⟨s, hs⟩

name: Derivation.exists_extension_of_formallySmooth
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_formallySmooth [Algebra.FormallySmooth A B] (δ : Derivation k A A) :
    ∃ δ' : Derivation k B B, ∀ a : A, δ' (algebraMap A B a) = algebraMap A B (δ a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_retraction_mapBaseChange (k := k) (A := A) (B := B)
  let ℓ : B ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄k] →ₗ[B] B :=
    ((Algebra.linearMap A B).compDer δ).liftKaehlerDifferential.liftBaseChange B
  refine ⟨linearMapEquivDerivation k B (ℓ ∘ₗ r), fun a => ?_⟩
  have h1 : linearMapEquivDerivation k B (ℓ ∘ₗ r) (algebraMap A B a) =
      ℓ (r (D k B (algebraMap A B a))) := rfl
  have h2 : D k B (algebraMap A B a) = mapBaseChange k A B (1 ⊗ₜ D k A a) := by
    rw [mapBaseChange_tmul, one_smul, map_D]
  have h3 : r (mapBaseChange k A B (1 ⊗ₜ D k A a)) = 1 ⊗ₜ D k A a := by
    simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun hr (1 ⊗ₜ D k A a)
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  simp [ℓ, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D]

name: Derivation.mem_span_range_compDer_of_projective
statement:
theorem mem_span_range_compDer_of_projective [Module.Finite A (Ω[A⁄k])]
    [Module.Projective A (Ω[A⁄k])] (d : Derivation k A B) :
    d ∈ Submodule.span B
      (Set.range fun δ : Derivation k A A => (Algebra.linearMap A B).compDer δ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, g, s, -, -, hgs⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective A (Ω[A⁄k])
  set ℓ : Ω[A⁄k] →ₗ[A] B := d.liftKaehlerDifferential with hℓ
  let der : Fin n → Derivation k A A := fun i =>
    linearMapEquivDerivation k A (LinearMap.proj i ∘ₗ s)
  have key : d = ∑ i, ℓ (g (Pi.single i 1)) • (Algebra.linearMap A B).compDer (der i) := by
    ext a
    have h1 : d a = ℓ (D k A a) := (d.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D a).symm
    have h2 : D k A a = g (s (D k A a)) := by
      rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hgs, LinearMap.id_apply]
    have h3 : s (D k A a) = ∑ i, s (D k A a) i • Pi.single i (1 : A) := by
      have := ((Pi.basisFun A (Fin n)).sum_repr (s (D k A a))).symm
      simpa only [Pi.basisFun_repr, Pi.basisFun_apply] using this
    have hL : d a = ∑ i, ℓ (g (Pi.single i 1)) * algebraMap A B (s (D k A a) i) := by
      rw [h1]
      conv_lhs => rw [h2, h3]
      rw [map_sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [LinearMap.map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
    have hc : (⇑(∑ i, ℓ (g (Pi.single i 1)) • (Algebra.linearMap A B).compDer (der i)) : A → B) =
        ∑ i, ⇑(ℓ (g (Pi.single i 1)) • (Algebra.linearMap A B).compDer (der i)) :=
      map_sum Derivation.coeFnAddMonoidHom _ _
    rw [hL, hc, Finset.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rfl
  rw [key]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨der i, rfl⟩)

name: Ideal.map_derivative_le_of_forall_exists_extension
statement:
theorem map_derivative_le_of_forall_exists_extension
    (h : ∀ δ : Derivation k A A, ∃ δ' : Derivation k B B,
      ∀ a : A, δ' (algebraMap A B a) = algebraMap A B (δ a))
    (J : Ideal A) :
    (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B) ≤ derivative k (J.map (algebraMap A B))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  refine derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun f hf => Ideal.mem_comap.mpr
    (le_derivative _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)), fun δ f hf => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨δ', hδ'⟩ := h δ
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← hδ' f]
  exact derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ' (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)

name: Ideal.map_derivative_le_derivative_map_of_formallySmooth
statement:
theorem map_derivative_le_derivative_map_of_formallySmooth [Algebra.FormallySmooth A B]
    (J : Ideal A) :
    (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B) ≤ derivative k (J.map (algebraMap A B))
proof:
:=
  map_derivative_le_of_forall_exists_extension
    (fun δ => δ.exists_extension_of_formallySmooth (B := B)) J

name: Ideal.derivative_map_le_of_forall_mem_span
statement:
theorem derivative_map_le_of_forall_mem_span
    (h : ∀ d : Derivation k A B, d ∈ Submodule.span B
      (Set.range fun δ : Derivation k A A => (Algebra.linearMap A B).compDer δ))
    (J : Ideal A) :
    derivative k (J.map (algebraMap A B)) ≤ (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  refine derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨Ideal.map_mono (le_derivative J), fun δ' x hx => ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ f ∈ J, δ' (algebraMap A B f) ∈ (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B) := by
    intro f hf
    have hspan : ∀ d ∈ Submodule.span B
        (Set.range fun δ : Derivation k A A => (Algebra.linearMap A B).compDer δ),
        d f ∈ (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B) := by
      intro d hd
      induction hd using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem d hd =>
        obtain ⟨δ, rfl⟩ := hd
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ hf)
      | zero => simp
      | add d₁ d₂ _ _ h1 h2 => rw [Derivation.add_apply]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ h1 h2
      | smul b d _ hd => rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hd
    exact hspan _ (h (δ'.compAlgebraMap A))
  change x ∈ Ideal.span (algebraMap A B '' (J : Set A)) at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact key f hf
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul b x hx' hx =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx)
      (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.map_mono (le_derivative J) hx'))

name: Ideal.derivative_map_le_map_derivative_of_projective
statement:
theorem derivative_map_le_map_derivative_of_projective [Module.Finite A (Ω[A⁄k])]
    [Module.Projective A (Ω[A⁄k])] (J : Ideal A) :
    derivative k (J.map (algebraMap A B)) ≤ (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B)
proof:
:=
  derivative_map_le_of_forall_mem_span (fun d => d.mem_span_range_compDer_of_projective) J

name: Ideal.derivative_map_of_formallySmooth
statement:
theorem derivative_map_of_formallySmooth [Algebra.FormallySmooth A B]
    [Module.Finite A (Ω[A⁄k])] [Module.Projective A (Ω[A⁄k])] (J : Ideal A) :
    derivative k (J.map (algebraMap A B)) = (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (derivative_map_le_map_derivative_of_projective J)
    (map_derivative_le_derivative_map_of_formallySmooth J)

name: Ideal.derivative_map_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem derivative_map_mvPolynomial {σ : Type*} [Module.Finite A (Ω[A⁄k])]
    [Module.Projective A (Ω[A⁄k])] (J : Ideal A) :
    derivative k (J.map (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial σ A))) =
      (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial σ A))
proof:
:=
  derivative_map_of_formallySmooth J

name: Ideal.le_derivative
statement: theorem le_derivative (J : Ideal A) : J ≤ derivative k J
proof:
:=
  le_sup_left

name: Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_derivative
statement:
theorem derivation_apply_mem_derivative (δ : Derivation k A A) {J : Ideal A} {f : A}
    (hf : f ∈ J) : δ f ∈ derivative k J
proof:
:=
  le_sup_right (a := J) (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem δ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩))

name: Ideal.derivative_le_iff
statement:
theorem derivative_le_iff {J K : Ideal A} :
    derivative k J ≤ K ↔ J ≤ K ∧ ∀ δ : Derivation k A A, ∀ f ∈ J, δ f ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [derivative, sup_le_iff, iSup_le_iff, Ideal.span_le]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨h1, fun δ f hf => h2 δ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨h1, fun δ => ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact h2 δ f hf

name: Ideal.derivative_mono
statement: theorem derivative_mono {J K : Ideal A} (h : J ≤ K) : derivative k J ≤ derivative k K
proof:
:=
  derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨h.trans (le_derivative K),
    fun δ _f hf => derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ (h hf)⟩

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem derivativeIter_zero (J : Ideal A) : derivativeIter k 0 J = J
proof: := rfl

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem derivativeIter_succ (r : ℕ) (J : Ideal A) :
    derivativeIter k (r + 1) J = derivative k (derivativeIter k r J)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_succ'
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_succ' (r : ℕ) (J : Ideal A) :
    derivativeIter k (r + 1) J = derivativeIter k r (derivative k J)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply _ _ _

name: Ideal.le_derivativeIter
statement: theorem le_derivativeIter (r : ℕ) (J : Ideal A) : J ≤ derivativeIter k r J
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [derivativeIter_succ]; exact ih.trans (le_derivative _)

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_mono
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_mono (r : ℕ) {J K : Ideal A} (h : J ≤ K) :
    derivativeIter k r J ≤ derivativeIter k r K
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ r ih => rw [derivativeIter_succ, derivativeIter_succ]; exact derivative_mono ih

name: Ideal.derivative_le_pow
statement:
theorem derivative_le_pow {J N : Ideal A} {a : ℕ} (h : J ≤ N ^ (a + 1)) :
    derivative k J ≤ N ^ a
proof:
:=
  derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨h.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ a)),
    fun δ _f hf => IsLocalRing.derivation_mem_pow δ N a (h hf)⟩

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_le_pow
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_le_pow {J N : Ideal A} {a r : ℕ} (h : J ≤ N ^ (a + r)) :
    derivativeIter k r J ≤ N ^ a
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing a with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [derivativeIter_succ]
    exact derivative_le_pow (ih (a := a + 1) (by rw [add_right_comm]; exact h))

name: Ideal.derivative_iSup
statement:
theorem derivative_iSup {ι : Sort*} (J : ι → Ideal A) :
    derivative k (⨆ i, J i) = ⨆ i, derivative k (J i)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨iSup_le fun i =>
      (le_derivative (J i)).trans (le_iSup (fun i => derivative k (J i)) i), fun δ f hf => ?_⟩)
    (iSup_le fun i => derivative_mono (le_iSup J i))
  induction hf using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem i f hf => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i (derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ hf)
  | zero => simp
  | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg

name: Ideal.derivative_sup
statement:
theorem derivative_sup (J K : Ideal A) :
    derivative k (J ⊔ K) = derivative k J ⊔ derivative k K
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨sup_le_sup (le_derivative J) (le_derivative K), ?_⟩)
    (sup_le (derivative_mono le_sup_left) (derivative_mono le_sup_right))
  intro δ f hf
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hf
  rw [map_add]
  exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ ha))
    (Ideal.mem_sup_right (derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ hb))

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_derivativeIter
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_derivativeIter (r s : ℕ) (J : Ideal A) :
    derivativeIter k r (derivativeIter k s J) = derivativeIter k (r + s) J
proof:
:=
  (Function.iterate_add_apply _ _ _ _).symm

name: Ideal.derivative_mul_le
statement:
theorem derivative_mul_le (J K : Ideal A) :
    derivative k (J * K) ≤ derivative k J * K ⊔ J * derivative k K
proof:
:= by
  refine derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨le_sup_left.trans' (Ideal.mul_mono (le_derivative J) le_rfl), ?_⟩
  intro δ f hf
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf (fun a ha b hb => ?_) (fun f g hf hg => ?_)
  · rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _
      (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha (derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ hb)))
      (Ideal.mem_sup_left
        (mul_comm b _ ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_mul (derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ ha) hb))
  · rw [map_add]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_mul_le
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_mul_le (r : ℕ) (J K : Ideal A) :
    derivativeIter k r (J * K) ≤
      ⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), derivativeIter k i J * derivativeIter k (r - i) K
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact le_iSup₂_of_le 0 (Finset.mem_range.mpr Nat.zero_lt_one) le_rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [derivativeIter_succ]
    calc derivative k (derivativeIter k r (J * K))
        ≤ derivative k (⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
            derivativeIter k i J * derivativeIter k (r - i) K) := derivative_mono ih
      _ = ⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
            derivative k (derivativeIter k i J * derivativeIter k (r - i) K) := by
          rw [derivative_iSup]
          exact iSup_congr fun i => derivative_iSup _
      _ ≤ ⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1 + 1),
            derivativeIter k i J * derivativeIter k (r + 1 - i) K := by
          refine iSup₂_le fun i hi => ?_
          have hi' : i ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          refine (derivative_mul_le _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
          · rw [← derivativeIter_succ, show r - i = r + 1 - (i + 1) by omega]
            exact le_iSup₂_of_le (i + 1) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) le_rfl
          · rw [← derivativeIter_succ, show r - i + 1 = r + 1 - i by omega]
            exact le_iSup₂_of_le i (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) le_rfl

name: Ideal.derivative_span_eq_of_span
statement:
theorem derivative_span_eq_of_span {ι : Type*} (der : ι → Derivation k A A)
    (h : ∀ δ : Derivation k A A, δ ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range der)) (S : Set A) :
    derivative k (Ideal.span S) = Ideal.span (S ∪ ⋃ i, der i '' S)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (derivative_le_iff.mpr
    ⟨Ideal.span_mono Set.subset_union_left, fun δ f hf => ?_⟩) ?_
  · have hδS : ∀ s ∈ S, δ s ∈ Ideal.span (S ∪ ⋃ i, der i '' S) := by
      intro s hs
      induction h δ using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem δ' hδ' =>
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hδ'
        exact Ideal.subset_span (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩⟩))
      | zero => simp
      | add δ₁ δ₂ _ _ h1 h2 => rw [Derivation.add_apply]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ h1 h2
      | smul a δ' _ h' => rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h'
    induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem s hs => exact hδS s hs
    | zero => simp
    | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg
    | smul a f hf' hf =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hf)
        (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.span_mono Set.subset_union_left hf'))
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x (hx | hx)
    · exact le_derivative _ (Ideal.subset_span hx)
    · obtain ⟨i, s, hs, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact derivation_apply_mem_derivative (der i) (Ideal.subset_span hs)

name: Ideal.derivation_mem_span_range_dualBasis
statement:
theorem derivation_mem_span_range_dualBasis {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι A (Ω[A⁄k])) (δ : Derivation k A A) :
    δ ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range fun i => linearMapEquivDerivation k A (b.coord i))
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  set L := linearMapEquivDerivation k A (M := A) with hL
  have hφ : L.symm δ = ∑ i, (L.symm δ) (b i) • b.coord i := by
    refine b.ext fun j => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun x _ hx => by rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hx, mul_zero])
      (fun h => (h (Finset.mem_univ j)).elim), Finsupp.single_eq_same, mul_one]
  have hδ : δ = ∑ i, (L.symm δ) (b i) • L (b.coord i) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← L.apply_symm_apply δ, hφ]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [LinearEquiv.map_smul]
  rw [hδ]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: Ideal.derivative_eq_D
statement:
theorem derivative_eq_D (hk : c.IsLinearOver k) (hs : c.SpansDerivations k) (J : Ideal R) :
    derivative k J = c.D J
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨c.le_D J, fun δ f hf => ?_⟩)
    (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨le_derivative J, fun i g hg => ?_⟩)
  · rw [hs δ f]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.pderiv_mem_D hf i)
  · exact derivation_apply_mem_derivative (c.pderivOver hk i) hg

name: Ideal.D_le_derivative
statement: theorem D_le_derivative (hk : c.IsLinearOver k) (J : Ideal R) : c.D J ≤ derivative k J
proof:
:=
  c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨le_derivative J, fun i _g hg =>
    derivation_apply_mem_derivative (c.pderivOver hk i) hg⟩

name: Ideal.Dpow_le_derivativeIter
statement:
theorem Dpow_le_derivativeIter (hk : c.IsLinearOver k) (r : ℕ) (J : Ideal R) :
    c.Dpow r J ≤ derivativeIter k r J
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [RegularCoords.Dpow_succ, derivativeIter_succ]
    exact (c.D_mono ih).trans (D_le_derivative c hk _)

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_eq_Dpow
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_eq_Dpow (hk : c.IsLinearOver k) (hs : c.SpansDerivations k) (r : ℕ)
    (J : Ideal R) : derivativeIter k r J = c.Dpow r J
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [derivativeIter_succ, ih, RegularCoords.Dpow_succ, derivative_eq_D c hk hs]

name: Derivation.localizationAlgEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem localizationAlgEquiv_algebraMap (a : A) :
    localizationAlgEquiv k (B := B) M (algebraMap A (Localization M) a) = algebraMap A B a
proof:
:=
  (IsLocalization.algEquiv M (Localization M) B).commutes a

name: Derivation.localizationAlgEquiv_symm_algebraMap
statement:
theorem localizationAlgEquiv_symm_algebraMap (a : A) :
    (localizationAlgEquiv k (B := B) M).symm (algebraMap A B a) =
      algebraMap A (Localization M) a
proof:
:=
  (IsLocalization.algEquiv M (Localization M) B).symm.commutes a

name: Derivation.extendToLocalization_apply
statement:
theorem extendToLocalization_apply (D : Derivation k A A) (b : B) :
    D.extendToLocalization M b =
      localizationAlgEquiv k (B := B) M
        (D.localization M ((localizationAlgEquiv k (B := B) M).symm b))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Derivation.extendToLocalization_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendToLocalization_algebraMap (D : Derivation k A A) (a : A) :
    D.extendToLocalization M (algebraMap A B a) = algebraMap A B (D a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendToLocalization_apply, localizationAlgEquiv_symm_algebraMap, localization_algebraMap,
    localizationAlgEquiv_algebraMap]

name: Ideal.derivative_map_le
statement:
theorem derivative_map_le (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M B] (J : Ideal A) :
    (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B) ≤ derivative k (J.map (algebraMap A B))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  refine derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun f hf => Ideal.mem_comap.mpr
    (le_derivative _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)), fun δ f hf => ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← δ.extendToLocalization_algebraMap M]
  exact derivation_apply_mem_derivative _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)

name: Ideal.exists_derivation_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_derivation_smul_eq (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M B]
    [Module.FinitePresentation A (Ω[A⁄k])] (δ' : Derivation k B B) :
    ∃ (δ : Derivation k A A) (s : M), ∀ a : A,
      algebraMap A B (δ a) = algebraMap A B s * δ' (algebraMap A B a)
proof:
:= by
  let d : Derivation k A B := δ'.compAlgebraMap A
  obtain ⟨h, s, hs⟩ := Module.FinitePresentation.exists_lift_of_isLocalizedModule M
    (Algebra.linearMap A B) d.liftKaehlerDifferential
  refine ⟨linearMapEquivDerivation k A h, s, fun a => ?_⟩
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hs (D k A a)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Algebra.linearMap_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    Derivation.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D, Submonoid.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def] at h1
  have h2 : (linearMapEquivDerivation k A h) a = h (D k A a) := rfl
  rw [h2, h1]
  simp [d]

name: Ideal.derivative_map
statement:
theorem derivative_map (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M B]
    [Module.FinitePresentation A (Ω[A⁄k])] (J : Ideal A) :
    derivative k (J.map (algebraMap A B)) = (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨Ideal.map_mono (le_derivative J), fun δ' x hx => ?_⟩)
    (derivative_map_le M J)
  obtain ⟨δ, s, hδ⟩ := exists_derivation_smul_eq (k := k) (B := B) M δ'
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap A B s) := IsLocalization.map_units B s
  have key : ∀ f ∈ J, δ' (algebraMap A B f) ∈ (derivative k J).map (algebraMap A B) := by
    intro f hf
    have : δ' (algebraMap A B f) = hu.unit⁻¹ * algebraMap A B (δ f) := by
      rw [hδ f, ← mul_assoc, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (derivation_apply_mem_derivative δ hf))
  change x ∈ Ideal.span (algebraMap A B '' (J : Set A)) at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact key f hf
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul b x hx' hx =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx)
      (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.map_mono (le_derivative J) hx'))

name: Derivation.conjAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem conjAlgEquiv_apply (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (δ : Derivation k A A) (b : B) :
    δ.conjAlgEquiv e b = e (δ (e.symm b))
proof: := rfl

name: Ideal.derivative_map_algEquiv
statement:
theorem derivative_map_algEquiv (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (J : Ideal A) :
    derivative k (J.map e) = (derivative k J).map e
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [derivative_le_iff]
    refine ⟨Ideal.map_mono (le_derivative J), fun δ g hg => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective e e.surjective).mp hg
    have h : δ (e f) = e ((δ.conjAlgEquiv e.symm) f) := by
      simp [Derivation.conjAlgEquiv_apply]
    rw [h]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (derivation_apply_mem_derivative _ hf)
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, derivative_le_iff]
    refine ⟨fun f hf => Ideal.mem_comap.mpr (le_derivative _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)),
      fun δ f hf => ?_⟩
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
    have h : e (δ f) = (δ.conjAlgEquiv e) (e f) := by
      simp [Derivation.conjAlgEquiv_apply]
    rw [h]
    exact derivation_apply_mem_derivative _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_map_algEquiv
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_map_algEquiv (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (r : ℕ) (J : Ideal A) :
    derivativeIter k r (J.map e) = (derivativeIter k r J).map e
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    have h1 : derivativeIter k (r + 1) (J.map e) = derivative k (derivativeIter k r (J.map e)) :=
      Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _
    have h2 : derivativeIter k (r + 1) J = derivative k (derivativeIter k r J) :=
      Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _
    rw [h1, h2, ih, derivative_map_algEquiv]

name: eq_of_specializes_of_isGenericPoint
statement:
theorem eq_of_specializes_of_isGenericPoint [T0Space X] {S : Set X} {ξ x : X}
    (hξ : IsGenericPoint ξ S) (hx : x ∈ S) (h : x ⤳ ξ) : x = ξ
proof:
:=
  (h.antisymm (hξ.specializes hx)).eq

name: notMem_closure_singleton_of_mem_genericPoints
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  rw [Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff] at hg hη
  have hle : closure {η} ⊆ closure {g} :=
    (isClosed_closure.closure_subset_iff).mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem)
  have heq : closure {η} = closure {g} := hη.eq_of_le hg.1 hle
  have hg' : g ∈ closure {η} := by rw [heq]; exact subset_closure rfl
  exact hne ((specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hmem).antisymm
    (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hg')).eq

name: mem_genericPoints_of_mem_genericPoints_preimage
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_of_mem_genericPoints_preimage [T0Space X] [QuasiSober X] [T0Space Y]
    [QuasiSober Y] [NoetherianSpace Y] {f : Y → X} (hf : Continuous f) (ho : IsOpenMap f)
    (Z : Closeds X) {η' : Y} (hη' : η' ∈ (Z.preimage hf).genericPoints) :
    f η' ∈ Z.genericPoints
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hη'Z : f η' ∈ Z := hη'.1
  
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξZ, hξ⟩ := Closeds.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes Z hη'Z
  suffices hcl : f η' = ξ by rw [hcl]; exact hξZ
  
  let C : Closeds X := ⟨closure {ξ}, isClosed_closure⟩
  have hCZ : (C : Set X) ⊆ Z :=
    Z.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hξZ.1)
  have hξC : IsGenericPoint ξ (C : Set X) := isGenericPoint_closure
  let W : Closeds Y := C.preimage hf
  have hη'W : η' ∈ W := by
    change f η' ∈ closure {ξ}
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hξ
  
  have hη'gW : η' ∈ W.genericPoints := by
    rw [Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff] at hη' ⊢
    refine ⟨⟨W.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hη'W),
      isIrreducible_singleton.closure⟩, fun T hT hle => ?_⟩
    exact hη'.2 ⟨hT.1.trans fun y hy => hCZ hy, hT.2⟩ hle
  
  have hfin : W.genericPoints.Finite := Closeds.genericPoints_finite W
  let O : Set Y := (⋃ g ∈ hfin.toFinset.erase η', closure {g})ᶜ
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    apply isOpen_compl_iff.mpr
    exact Set.Finite.isClosed_biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun g _ => isClosed_closure
  have hη'O : η' ∈ O := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hη'g⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hmem
    obtain ⟨hne, hgW⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hg
    exact notMem_closure_singleton_of_mem_genericPoints W (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp hgW) hη'gW hne
      hη'g
  have hOW : ∀ w ∈ W, w ∈ O → w ∈ closure {η'} := by
    intro w hw hwO
    obtain ⟨g, hgW, hgw⟩ := Closeds.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes W hw
    by_cases hg : g = η'
    · exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (hg ▸ hgw)
    · exfalso
      exact hwO (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨g, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hg, hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hgW⟩,
        specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hgw⟩)
  
  have hξO : ξ ∈ f '' O := (hξC.mem_open_set_iff (ho O hO)).mpr
    ⟨f η', hξ.mem_closure, ⟨η', hη'O, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨o, hoO, hoξ⟩ := hξO
  have hoW : o ∈ W := by
    change f o ∈ closure {ξ}
    rw [hoξ]; exact subset_closure rfl
  have hη'o : η' ⤳ o := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr (hOW o hoW hoO)
  have h1 : f η' ⤳ ξ := hoξ ▸ hη'o.map hf
  exact eq_of_specializes_of_isGenericPoint hξC (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hξ) h1

name: exists_mem_genericPoints_preimage_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem exists_mem_genericPoints_preimage_of_mem_genericPoints [T0Space X] [QuasiSober X]
    [T0Space Y] [QuasiSober Y] {f : Y → X} (hf : Continuous f) (hs : Function.Surjective f)
    (Z : Closeds X) {η : X} (hη : η ∈ Z.genericPoints) :
    ∃ η' ∈ (Z.preimage hf).genericPoints, f η' = η
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hs η
  have hyZ : y ∈ Z.preimage hf := hη.1
  obtain ⟨η', hη'W, hη'y⟩ := Closeds.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes (Z.preimage hf) hyZ
  refine ⟨η', hη'W, ?_⟩
  have hη'Z : f η' ∈ Z := hη'W.1
  rw [Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff] at hη
  have hgen : IsGenericPoint (f y) (closure {f y}) := isGenericPoint_closure
  have hmax : closure {f y} = closure {f η'} := by
    refine hη.eq_of_le ⟨Z.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hη'Z),
      isIrreducible_singleton.closure⟩ ?_
    exact isClosed_closure.closure_subset_iff.mpr
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (hη'y.map hf)))
  have hmem : f η' ∈ closure {f y} := by rw [hmax]; exact subset_closure rfl
  exact ((hη'y.map hf).antisymm (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hmem)).eq

name: exists_isClosed_singleton_mem_specializes
statement:
theorem exists_isClosed_singleton_mem_specializes [JacobsonSpace X] {S : Set X} (hS : IsClosed S)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ S) : ∃ p, IsClosed {p} ∧ p ∈ S ∧ x ⤳ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpc⟩ := nonempty_inter_closedPoints (Z := closure {x})
    ⟨x, subset_closure rfl⟩ ⟨Set.univ, closure {x}, isOpen_univ, isClosed_closure,
      (Set.univ_inter _).symm⟩
  exact ⟨p, hpc, (hS.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx)) hp,
    specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hp⟩

name: subset_iUnion_of_isOpen_of_closedPoints
statement:
theorem subset_iUnion_of_isOpen_of_closedPoints [JacobsonSpace X] {S : Set X} (hS : IsClosed S)
    (O : {p : X // IsClosed {p} ∧ p ∈ S} → Set X) (hO : ∀ p, IsOpen (O p))
    (hpO : ∀ p, p.1 ∈ O p) : S ⊆ ⋃ p, O p
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, hpc, hpS, hxp⟩ := exists_isClosed_singleton_mem_specializes hS hx
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨p, hpc, hpS⟩, hxp.mem_open (hO _) (hpO _)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.mem_smoothLocus_iff_isRegularAt
statement:
theorem Scheme.mem_smoothLocus_iff_isRegularAt [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X) : x ∈ f.smoothLocus ↔ X.IsRegularAt x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Scheme.isRegularAt_of_mem_smoothLocus f, fun hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hxU, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra U
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := f.finiteType_sectionsAlgebra hU
  rw [Scheme.isRegularAt_iff_isRegularLocalRing_localization hU hxU] at hx
  rw [f.mem_smoothLocus_iff_isSmoothAt hU hxU]
  exact Algebra.IsSmoothAt.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_perfectField (k := k)
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.smooth_iff_isRegular
statement:
theorem Scheme.smooth_iff_isRegular [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] : Smooth f ↔ IsRegular X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.smoothLocus_eq_top_iff, isRegular_iff, eq_top_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x
    exact (Scheme.mem_smoothLocus_iff_isRegularAt f x).mp
      (IsConcreteLE.le_iff.mp h (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top x))
  · intro h
    exact IsConcreteLE.le_iff.mpr fun x _ => (Scheme.mem_smoothLocus_iff_isRegularAt f x).mpr (h x)

name: IsRegularLocalRing.linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_span_eq {m : ℕ} (z : Fin m → R)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range z) = maximalIdeal R)
    (hdim : (m : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨z i, hz i⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Submodule.span R (Set.range fun i => (⟨z i, hz i⟩ : maximalIdeal R)) = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (maximalIdeal R).injective_subtype
    rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_subtype_top, ← Set.range_comp]
    exact hspan
  have hspanκ : Submodule.span (ResidueField R)
      (Set.range fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨z i, hz i⟩) = ⊤ := by
    have := (CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff (R := R)
      (s := Set.range fun i => (⟨z i, hz i⟩ : maximalIdeal R))).mpr hsub
    rwa [← Set.range_comp] at this
  have hfin : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = m := by
    have h1 : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
      IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
    rw [← hdim] at h1
    have h2 : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = m := by exact_mod_cast h1
    rw [← h2]
    exact (IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace R).symm
  exact linearIndependent_of_top_le_span_of_card_eq_finrank hspanκ.ge
    (by rw [Fintype.card_fin, hfin])

name: IsRegularLocalRing.card_eq_of_span_range_eq
statement:
theorem card_eq_of_span_range_eq {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (f : ι → R) (g : κ → R)
    (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hg : ∀ j, g j ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hfl : LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨f i, hf i⟩)
    (hgl : LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) fun j => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨g j, hg j⟩)
    (heq : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = Ideal.span (Set.range g)) :
    Fintype.card ι = Fintype.card κ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hd₁⟩ := quotient_span_range_of_linearIndependent f hf hfl
  obtain ⟨hreg₂, hd₂⟩ := quotient_span_range_of_linearIndependent g hg hgl
  rw [heq] at hd₁
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ, (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range g)) :=
    ⟨_, hreg₂.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, (m : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
    ⟨_, IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal⟩
  rw [← hd, ← hm] at hd₁ hd₂
  have h1 : d + Fintype.card ι = m := by exact_mod_cast hd₁
  have h2 : d + Fintype.card κ = m := by exact_mod_cast hd₂
  omega

name: Localization.localRingHom_surjective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem localRingHom_surjective_of_surjective (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Function.Surjective (localRingHom (𝔮.comap φ) 𝔮 φ rfl)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨⟨y, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective 𝔮.primeCompl z
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hφ y
  obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ := hφ (s : S)
  have hs'Q : s' ∈ (𝔮.comap φ).primeCompl := by
    change s' ∉ 𝔮.comap φ
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, hs']
    exact s.2
  refine ⟨IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.comap φ)) y' ⟨s', hs'Q⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [localRingHom_mk']
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext hs'

name: Localization.ker_localRingHom_of_surjective
statement:
theorem ker_localRingHom_of_surjective (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    RingHom.ker (localRingHom (𝔮.comap φ) 𝔮 φ rfl) =
      (RingHom.ker φ).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.comap φ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (𝔮.comap φ).primeCompl x
    dsimp only at hx ⊢
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, localRingHom_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ht0⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ := hφ t
    have ht' : t' ∈ (𝔮.comap φ).primeCompl := by
      change t' ∉ 𝔮.comap φ
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
      exact ht
    have hmem : t' * a ∈ RingHom.ker φ := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_mul]
      exact ht0
    have hx' : IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.comap φ)) a s =
        algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.comap φ)) (t' * a) *
          IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.comap φ)) (1 : A) (⟨t', ht'⟩ * s) := by
      rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq]
      simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hx']
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hmem)
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro a ha
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, localRingHom_to_map, RingHom.mem_ker.mp ha, map_zero]

name: Localization.bijective_residueField_map_localRingHom_of_surjective
statement:
theorem bijective_residueField_map_localRingHom_of_surjective (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) :
    letI
proof:
:= isLocalHom_localRingHom (I := 𝔮.comap φ) 𝔮 φ rfl
    Function.Bijective (ResidueField.map (localRingHom (𝔮.comap φ) 𝔮 φ rfl)) := by
  have := isLocalHom_localRingHom (I := 𝔮.comap φ) 𝔮 φ rfl
  refine ⟨(ResidueField.map _).injective, fun z => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective z
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := localRingHom_surjective_of_surjective φ 𝔮 hφ w
  exact ⟨residue _ v, ResidueField.map_residue _ v⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isRegularAt_of_mem_smoothLocus
statement:
theorem Scheme.isRegularAt_of_mem_smoothLocus (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ f.smoothLocus) : X.IsRegularAt x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hxU, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra U
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := f.finiteType_sectionsAlgebra hU
  have : Algebra.IsSmoothAt k (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal :=
    (f.mem_smoothLocus_iff_isSmoothAt hU hxU).mp hx
  rw [Scheme.isRegularAt_iff_isRegularLocalRing_localization hU hxU]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (x : X) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen V) (_ : x ∈ V),
      letI
proof:
:= f.sectionsAlgebra V
      Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n k Γ(X, V) := by
  obtain ⟨U', hU', V, hV, hxV, e, hstd⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (n := n) (f := f) x
  have hU'top : U' = ⊤ := by
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro y
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (α := PrimeSpectrum k) y (f x)]
    exact e hxV
  subst hU'top
  refine ⟨V, hV, hxV, ?_⟩
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra V
  have := (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_respectsIso (n := n)).2
    (f.appLE ⊤ V e).hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv hstd
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_residueField_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_residueField_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
    [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (x : X) :
    letI
proof:
:= f.stalkAlgebra x
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) +
      ((Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x))) : ℕ∞) :
        WithBot ℕ∞) = n := by
  let := f.stalkAlgebra x
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hstd⟩ := f.exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n x
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra V
  let := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have := f.isScalarTower_sectionsAlgebra_stalk V hxV
  set 𝔮 := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal
  let e : Localization.AtPrime 𝔮 ≃ₐ[k] X.presheaf.stalk x :=
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv 𝔮.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
      (X.presheaf.stalk x)).restrictScalars k
  rw [← ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv,
    ← (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapAlgEquiv e).trdeg_eq]
  exact Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.ringKrullDim_localization_add_trdeg_residueField
    (k := k) n 𝔮

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_isClosed [PerfectField k]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] {x : X}
    (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hstd⟩ := f.exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n x
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra V
  let := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  set 𝔮 := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal
  have : 𝔮.IsMaximal := hV.primeIdealOf_isMaximal_of_isClosed ⟨x, hxV⟩ hx
  rw [← ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (IsLocalization.algEquiv 𝔮.primeCompl
    (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (X.presheaf.stalk x)).toRingEquiv]
  exact Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.ringKrullDim_localization_of_isMaximal
    (k := k) n 𝔮

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isRegularAt_iff_isRegularLocalRing_localization
statement:
theorem isRegularAt_iff_isRegularLocalRing_localization {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    X.IsRegularAt x ↔
      IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  let := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩

    (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
  exact ⟨fun h => haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) := h

name: IsRegularLocalRing.quotient_span_range_of_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem quotient_span_range_of_linearIndependent {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → R)
    (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hli : LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨f i, hf i⟩) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) ∧
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) + Fintype.card ι = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set I := Ideal.span (Set.range f) with hI
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hf i)
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
  have : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  have : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  
  have hmax : maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) = (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
    refine (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal ?_).symm
    refine (Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R)).resolve_left fun h => ?_
    have := Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (maximalIdeal R)
    rw [h, Ideal.comap_top, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker, sup_eq_left.mpr hIle] at this
    exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top this.symm
  
  set b := Module.Basis.sumExtend hli with hb
  have hfin := Module.Finite.finite_basis b
  have : Finite (Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli) :=
    Finite.of_injective (Sum.inr : Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli → ι ⊕ _) Sum.inr_injective
  have hb_inl : ∀ i, b (Sum.inl i) = (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨f i, hf i⟩ := fun i => by
    rw [hb]
    unfold Module.Basis.sumExtend
    rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.extend_apply_self]
    rfl
  choose y hy using fun j : Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli =>
    (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_surjective (b (Sum.inr j))
  let g : ι ⊕ Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli → maximalIdeal R := Sum.elim (fun i => ⟨f i, hf i⟩) y
  have hg : ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ∘ g) = b := by
    funext s
    rcases s with i | j
    · exact (hb_inl i).symm
    · exact hy j
  
  have hspan : Submodule.span R (Set.range g) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff, ← Set.range_comp, hg]
    exact b.span_eq
  have hm : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range fun s => ((g s : maximalIdeal R) : R)) := by
    have := congrArg (Submodule.map (maximalIdeal R).subtype) hspan
    rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype, ← Set.range_comp] at this
    exact this.symm
  
  have hmbar : maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => Ideal.Quotient.mk I (y j : R)) := by
    have hm' := congrArg (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) hm
    rw [hmax, hm', Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
      rcases s with i | j
      · have hfi : f i ∈ I := Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)
        change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (f i) ∈ _
        rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hfi]
        exact zero_mem _
      · change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (y j : R) ∈ _
        exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j)
    · refine Ideal.span_mono ?_
      rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Sum.inr j, rfl⟩
  
  have h1 : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)).spanFinrank ≤ Nat.card (Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli) := by
    rw [hmbar]
    refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_range _)).trans ?_
    rw [← Set.image_univ]
    exact (Set.ncard_image_le Set.finite_univ).trans (by rw [Set.ncard_univ])
  
  have hdimR : ringKrullDim R =
      ((Fintype.card ι + Nat.card (Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli) : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal,
      spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace, Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis b,
      Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  
  have h2 : ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) + Fintype.card ι := by
    have hs : ((Finset.univ.image f : Finset R) : Set R) ⊆ Ring.jacobson R := by
      rw [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, ← Ideal.jacobson_bot,
        IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hf i
    have := ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_card (Finset.univ.image f) hs
    rw [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, ← hI] at this
    refine this.trans ?_
    gcongr
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_image_le.trans Finset.card_univ.le
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ, ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) = d := by
    have hne_top : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) ≠ ⊤ := ringKrullDim_ne_top
    have hne_bot : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) ≠ ⊥ :=
      ((WithBot.bot_lt_coe (0 : ℕ∞)).trans_le ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial).ne'
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp hne_bot
    have he_top : e ≠ ⊤ := fun h => hne_top (by rw [← he, h]; rfl)
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp he_top
    exact ⟨d, by rw [← he]; rfl⟩
  have hcardJ : Nat.card (Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli) ≤ d := by
    have := h2
    rw [hdimR, hd] at this
    have : Fintype.card ι + Nat.card (Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli) ≤ d + Fintype.card ι := by
      exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le (R ⧸ I)
      (by rw [hd]; exact_mod_cast h1.trans hcardJ)
  refine ⟨hreg, ?_⟩
  have hsp : ((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = d := by
    rw [hreg.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal, hd]
  have hsp' : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)).spanFinrank = d := by exact_mod_cast hsp
  have hdJ : d = Nat.card (Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hli) := le_antisymm (hsp' ▸ h1) hcardJ
  rw [hd, hdimR, hdJ]
  norm_cast
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.algebraMap_stalkAlgebra
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.algebraMap_stalkAlgebra (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X) :
    letI
proof:
:= f.stalkAlgebra x
    algebraMap k (X.presheaf.stalk x) = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.app ⊤ ≫
      X.presheaf.germ (f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) x (show f x ∈ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) from trivial)).hom :=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.germ_comp_algebraMap_sectionsAlgebra
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.germ_comp_algebraMap_sectionsAlgebra (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (U : X.Opens)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    letI
proof:
:= f.sectionsAlgebra U
    letI := f.stalkAlgebra x
    (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom.comp (algebraMap k Γ(X, U)) =
      algebraMap k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.algebraMap_sectionsAlgebra, Scheme.Hom.algebraMap_stalkAlgebra,
    ← CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  congr 1
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (f.app ⊤ ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op) ≫
    X.presheaf.germ U x hx = _
  rw [Category.assoc, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isScalarTower_sectionsAlgebra_stalk
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.isScalarTower_sectionsAlgebra_stalk (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (U : X.Opens)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    letI
proof:
:= f.sectionsAlgebra U
    letI := f.stalkAlgebra x
    letI := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
    IsScalarTower k Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
  letI := f.sectionsAlgebra U
  letI := f.stalkAlgebra x
  letI := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (f.germ_comp_algebraMap_sectionsAlgebra U hx).symm

name: Algebra.rank_kaehlerDifferential_eq_trdeg_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem rank_kaehlerDifferential_eq_trdeg_of_isSeparable {s : Set K}
    (hs : IsTranscendenceBasis k ((↑) : s → K))
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k s) K] :
    Module.rank K Ω[K⁄k] = Algebra.trdeg k K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := Algebra.adjoin k s with hA
  set F := IntermediateField.adjoin k s with hF
  
  have hrange : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range ((↑) : s → K)) = A := by rw [Subtype.range_coe]
  let e : MvPolynomial s k ≃ₐ[k] A := hs.1.aevalEquiv.trans (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ hrange)
  let : Algebra (MvPolynomial s k) A := e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial s k) A :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (e.commutes x).symm
  have : IsLocalization (⊥ : Submonoid (MvPolynomial s k)) (MvPolynomial s k) :=
    IsLocalization.of_le_isUnit bot_le
  have : IsLocalization (⊥ : Submonoid (MvPolynomial s k)) A :=
    IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_algEquiv (⊥ : Submonoid (MvPolynomial s k))
      (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId (MvPolynomial s k) A) e.bijective)
  have : Algebra.FormallyEtale (MvPolynomial s k) A :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization (Rₘ := A) ⊥
  
  let bA : Module.Basis s A Ω[A⁄k] :=
    ((mvPolynomialBasis k s).baseChange A).map
      (tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k (MvPolynomial s k) A)
  let bF : Module.Basis s F Ω[F⁄k] :=
    bA.ofIsLocalizedModule F (nonZeroDivisors A) (map k k A F)
  have : Algebra.FormallyEtale F K := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable F K
  let bK : Module.Basis s K Ω[K⁄k] :=
    (bF.baseChange K).map (tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k F K)
  rw [← bK.mk_eq_rank'', hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus_iff_exists_smooth
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus_iff_exists_smooth (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    {x : X} : x ∈ f.smoothLocus ↔ ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ Smooth (U.ι ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hVU, hxV, H⟩ := exists_smooth_of_formallySmooth_stalk f x hx
    refine ⟨V, hxV, ?_⟩
    have : IsAffine U := hU
    have : IsAffine V := hV
    have hres : Smooth (f.resLE U V hVU) := by
      rw [HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @Smooth)]
      exact (RingHom.Smooth.propertyIsLocal.respectsIso.arrow_mk_iso_iff
        (arrowResLEAppIso f U V hVU)).mpr H
    have := MorphismProperty.comp_mem @Smooth _ _ hres (inferInstance : Smooth U.ι)
    rwa [Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι] at this
  · rintro ⟨U, hxU, hU⟩
    have h : (U.ι ≫ f).smoothLocus = ⊤ := (U.ι ≫ f).smoothLocus_eq_top
    have : (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U) ∈ U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ f.smoothLocus := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_smoothLocus_eq, h]; trivial
    exact this

statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus_iff_isSmoothAt (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    letI
proof:
:= f.sectionsAlgebra U
    x ∈ f.smoothLocus ↔ Algebra.IsSmoothAt k (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal := by
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra U
  let := (f.appLE ⊤ U le_top).hom.toAlgebra
  rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus, formallySmooth_stalkMap_iff ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top _) U hU le_top hx]
  change Algebra.FormallySmooth Γ(Spec (.of k), ⊤) (Localization.AtPrime _) ↔
    Algebra.FormallySmooth k (Localization.AtPrime _)
  rw [← RingHom.formallySmooth_algebraMap, ← RingHom.formallySmooth_algebraMap,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k Γ(X, U) (Localization.AtPrime _),
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq Γ(Spec (.of k), ⊤) Γ(X, U) (Localization.AtPrime _)]
  exact (RingHom.FormallySmooth.comp_ringEquiv_iff _
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).symm
