name: Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime
statement:
theorem IsStandardSmooth.isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime [Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k S]
    (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsPrime] : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι, σ, _, _, ⟨P⟩⟩ := ‹Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k S›.out
  let : Fintype σ := Fintype.ofFinite σ
  
  set A := P.Ring with hA
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A S) := P.algebraMap_surjective
  set Q : Ideal A := 𝔮.comap (algebraMap A S) with hQ
  have : Q.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  have : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
    MvPolynomial.isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime (k := k) (ι := ι) Q
  
  set φ : Localization.AtPrime Q →+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮 :=
    Localization.localRingHom Q 𝔮 (algebraMap A S) rfl with hφ
  have hφsurj : Function.Surjective φ := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨⟨y, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective 𝔮.primeCompl z
    dsimp only
    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hsurj y
    obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ := hsurj (s : S)
    have hs'Q : s' ∈ Q.primeCompl := by
      change s' ∉ Q
      rw [hQ, Ideal.mem_comap, hs']
      exact s.2
    refine ⟨IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime Q) y' ⟨s', hs'Q⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hφ, Localization.localRingHom_mk']
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext hs'
  
  set f : σ → Localization.AtPrime Q :=
    fun j => algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q) (P.relation j) with hf_def
  have hrel : ∀ j, algebraMap A S (P.relation j) = 0 := fun j =>
    (RingHom.mem_ker).mp (P.relation_mem_ker j)
  have hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span (Set.range f) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective Q.primeCompl x
      dsimp only at hx ⊢
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, hφ, Localization.localRingHom_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hx
      obtain ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ht0⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ := hsurj t
      have ht' : t' ∈ Q.primeCompl := by
        change t' ∉ Q
        rw [hQ, Ideal.mem_comap]
        exact ht
      have hmem : t' * a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range P.relation) := by
        rw [P.span_range_relation_eq_ker]
        change t' * a ∈ RingHom.ker (algebraMap A S)
        rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_mul]
        exact ht0
      have hx' : IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime Q) a s =
          algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q) (t' * a) *
            IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime Q) (1 : A) (⟨t', ht'⟩ * s) := by
        rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq]
        simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [hx']
      refine Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_
      have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q)) hmem
      rwa [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at this
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      change φ (f j) = 0
      rw [hf_def, hφ, Localization.localRingHom_to_map, hrel, map_zero]
  
  have hf : ∀ j, f j ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q) := fun j => by
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, hf_def,
      IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (Localization.AtPrime Q) Q]
    change ¬ P.relation j ∉ Q
    rw [not_not, hQ, Ideal.mem_comap, hrel]
    exact zero_mem _
  
  set κ := Q.ResidueField with hκ
  set bκ := residueFieldTensorMvPolynomialLocalizationBasis (k := k) (ι := ι) Q with hbκ
  let π : (κ ⊗[Localization.AtPrime Q] Ω[Localization.AtPrime Q⁄k]) →ₗ[κ] (σ → κ) :=
    LinearMap.pi fun j => Finsupp.lapply (P.map j) ∘ₗ bκ.repr.toLinearMap
  let M : Matrix σ σ κ :=
    fun j i => algebraMap A κ (MvPolynomial.pderiv (P.map i) (P.relation j))
  have hπ : ∀ j, π (1 ⊗ₜ D k (Localization.AtPrime Q) (f j)) = M.row j := fun j => by
    funext i
    simp only [π, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      Finsupp.lapply_apply, M, hf_def]
    exact residueFieldTensorMvPolynomialLocalizationBasis_repr_tmul_D (k := k) (ι := ι) Q
      (P.relation j) (P.map i)
  have hM : IsUnit M := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]
    have hMeq : M = (P.jacobiMatrix.map (algebraMap A κ)).transpose := by
      ext j i
      simp [M, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.map_apply,
        PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobiMatrix_apply]
    rw [hMeq, Matrix.det_transpose, ← RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, ← RingHom.map_det,
      isUnit_iff_ne_zero, Ne, Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero]
    intro hdet
    have hunit := P.jacobian_isUnit
    rw [PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobian_eq_jacobiMatrix_det] at hunit
    exact ‹𝔮.IsPrime›.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hdet) hunit)
  have hli' : LinearIndependent κ fun j =>
      (1 : κ) ⊗ₜ[Localization.AtPrime Q] D k (Localization.AtPrime Q) (f j) := by
    refine LinearIndependent.of_comp π ?_
    have := Matrix.linearIndependent_row_iff_isUnit.mpr hM
    convert this using 1
    funext j
    exact hπ j
  
  have hli : LinearIndependent κ fun j =>
      (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)).toCotangent ⟨f j, hf j⟩ := by
    refine LinearIndependent.of_comp (cotangentSpaceToTensor k (Localization.AtPrime Q)) ?_
    convert hli' using 1
    funext j
    exact cotangentSpaceToTensor_toCotangent k (Localization.AtPrime Q) ⟨f j, hf j⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hreg, -⟩ := IsRegularLocalRing.quotient_span_range_of_linearIndependent f hf hli
  rw [← hker] at hreg
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hφsurj)

name: Algebra.IsSmoothAt.isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem IsSmoothAt.isRegularLocalRing [Algebra.FiniteType k S] (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsPrime]
    [Algebra.IsSmoothAt k 𝔮] : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hsm⟩ := IsSmoothAt.exists_notMem_isStandardSmooth_of_finiteType (k := k) 𝔮
  set T := Localization.Away g with hT
  set 𝔮' : Ideal T := 𝔮.map (algebraMap S T) with h𝔮'
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submonoid.powers g : Set S) (𝔮 : Set S) :=
    (Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime g).mpr hg
  have : 𝔮'.IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers g) T 𝔮 ‹_› hdisj
  have hcomap : 𝔮'.comap (algebraMap S T) = 𝔮 :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers g) T ‹𝔮.IsPrime› hdisj
  have hcompl : (𝔮'.comap (algebraMap S T)).primeCompl = 𝔮.primeCompl :=
    Submonoid.ext fun x => by
      change x ∉ 𝔮'.comap (algebraMap S T) ↔ x ∉ 𝔮
      rw [hcomap]
  have hloc : IsLocalization 𝔮.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮') := by
    have := IsLocalization.isLocalization_atPrime_localization_atPrime (Submonoid.powers g) 𝔮'
    rwa [IsLocalization.AtPrime, hcompl] at this
  have : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮') :=
    IsStandardSmooth.isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime (k := k) 𝔮'
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv 𝔮.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮')
      (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)).toRingEquiv

statement: theorem singIdeal_eq_top_iff_isRegular (X : Scheme.{u}) : X.singIdeal = ⊤ ↔ IsRegular X

:= by
  rw [isRegular_iff_singularLocus_eq_empty]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hsupp := congrArg (fun I : X.IdealSheafData => (I.support : Set X)) h
    simp only [coe_support_singIdeal, IdealSheafData.support_top, Closeds.coe_bot] at hsupp

  · intro h

      apply Closeds.ext
      rw [Closeds.coe_mk, h, closure_empty, Closeds.coe_bot]
    rw [singIdeal_eq_vanishingIdeal_closure_singularLocus, hZ]
    exact IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal_bot

name: KaehlerDifferential.mvPolynomialBasis_repr_D_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mvPolynomialBasis_repr_D]
  have h : (Finsupp.lapply i : (σ →₀ MvPolynomial σ R) →ₗ[MvPolynomial σ R]
      MvPolynomial σ R).compDer
        (mkDerivation R fun j => Finsupp.single j (1 : MvPolynomial σ R)) = pderiv i := by
    refine derivation_ext fun j => ?_
    change (Finsupp.lapply i : (σ →₀ MvPolynomial σ R) →ₗ[MvPolynomial σ R] MvPolynomial σ R)
        (mkDerivation R (fun j => Finsupp.single j (1 : MvPolynomial σ R)) (X j)) =
      pderiv i (X j)
    rw [mkDerivation_X, Finsupp.lapply_apply, pderiv_X, Finsupp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  exact Derivation.congr_fun h x

          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (Localization.AtPrime Q) x)) i =

name: KaehlerDifferential.residueFieldTensorMvPolynomialLocalizationBasis_apply

@[simp]
theorem residueFieldTensorMvPolynomialLocalizationBasis_apply (i : ι) :

      1 ⊗ₜ D k (Localization.AtPrime Q)
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (Localization.AtPrime Q) (X i))

name: KaehlerDifferential.residueFieldTensorMvPolynomialLocalizationBasis_repr_tmul_D
statement:
theorem residueFieldTensorMvPolynomialLocalizationBasis_repr_tmul_D (x : MvPolynomial ι k)
    (i : ι) :
    (residueFieldTensorMvPolynomialLocalizationBasis Q).repr
        (1 ⊗ₜ D k (Localization.AtPrime Q)
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (Localization.AtPrime Q) x)) i =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) Q.ResidueField (pderiv i x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [residueFieldTensorMvPolynomialLocalizationBasis, Module.Basis.baseChange_repr_tmul,
    mvPolynomialLocalizationBasis_repr_D, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]

:=

name: Ideal.cotangentEquivOfEq_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]

name: KaehlerDifferential.injective_kerCotangentToTensor_residueField_of_formallySmooth
statement:
theorem injective_kerCotangentToTensor_residueField_of_formallySmooth
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth k (ResidueField R)] :
    Function.Injective (kerCotangentToTensor k R (ResidueField R))
proof:
:= by
  set φ : R →ₐ[k] ResidueField R := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R (ResidueField R) with hφ
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective φ := residue_surjective
  have hsq : RingHom.ker φ.kerSquareLift ^ 2 = ⊥ :=
    (congrArg (· ^ 2) (AlgHom.ker_kerSquareLift φ)).trans (Ideal.cotangentIdeal_square _)
  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective φ.kerSquareLift := fun x => by
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj x
    exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ y, φ.kerSquareLift_mk y⟩
  set e := Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hsurj' with he
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Algebra.FormallySmooth.comp_surjective k (ResidueField R) _ hsq e.symm.toAlgHom
  have hsec : φ.kerSquareLift.comp g = AlgHom.id k (ResidueField R) := by
    ext x
    have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (RingHom.ker φ.kerSquareLift) (g x) = e.symm x :=
      AlgHom.congr_fun hg x
    have h2 : e (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (RingHom.ker φ.kerSquareLift) (g x)) =
        φ.kerSquareLift (g x) :=
      Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk hsurj' (g x)
    simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq]
    rw [← h2, h1, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ :=
    (retractionKerCotangentToTensorEquivSection (R := k) (P := R) (S := ResidueField R) hsurj).symm
      ⟨g, hsec⟩
  exact Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := l) fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun hl x

name: KaehlerDifferential.finrank_residueField_tensor_kaehlerDifferential
statement:
theorem finrank_residueField_tensor_kaehlerDifferential [Algebra.EssFiniteType k R]
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth k (ResidueField R)] :
    Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (ResidueField R ⊗[R] Ω[R⁄k]) =
      Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) +

proof:

    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (mapBaseChange_residueField_surjective k R), finrank_top,
    add_comm, (exact_cotangentSpaceToTensor_mapBaseChange k R).linearMap_ker_eq,
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (injective_cotangentSpaceToTensor k R)]

name: Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.ringKrullDim_localization_add_finrank_kaehlerDifferential_residueField
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_localization_add_finrank_kaehlerDifferential_residueField [PerfectField k]
    (n : ℕ) [Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n k S] (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsPrime] :
    ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) +
      (Module.finrank 𝔮.ResidueField Ω[𝔮.ResidueField⁄k] : WithBot ℕ∞) = n
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k S :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth n (R := k)
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime (k := k) 𝔮
  have hdim : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) =
      (Module.finrank 𝔮.ResidueField (CotangentSpace (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← hreg.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal, spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace]
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k S (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k 𝔮.ResidueField := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k S 𝔮.ResidueField
  have : Algebra.FormallySmooth k 𝔮.ResidueField := Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_perfectField
  have hcount :=
    _root_.KaehlerDifferential.finrank_residueField_tensor_kaehlerDifferential k
      (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
  have hn : Module.finrank 𝔮.ResidueField
      (𝔮.ResidueField ⊗[Localization.AtPrime 𝔮] Ω[Localization.AtPrime 𝔮⁄k]) = n := by
    have : Algebra.FormallyEtale S (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) :=
      Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization (Rₘ := Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) 𝔮.primeCompl
    let e₁ := tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k S (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
    let e₂ := TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.congr
      (LinearEquiv.refl 𝔮.ResidueField 𝔮.ResidueField) e₁
    let e₃ := TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange S (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
      𝔮.ResidueField 𝔮.ResidueField Ω[S⁄k]
    rw [(e₂.symm.trans e₃).finrank_eq]
    exact
      Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.finrank_residueField_tensor_kaehlerDifferential
        n 𝔮
  rw [hdim, ← Nat.cast_add, ← hcount, hn]

name: Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.ringKrullDim_localization_add_trdeg_residueField
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_localization_add_trdeg_residueField [PerfectField k] (n : ℕ)
    [Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n k S] (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsPrime] :
    ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) +
      ((Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k 𝔮.ResidueField) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ringKrullDim_localization_add_finrank_kaehlerDifferential_residueField (k := k) n 𝔮]
  congr 1
  have : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k S :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth n (R := k)
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k S := Algebra.FiniteType.of_finitePresentation
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k 𝔮.ResidueField := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k S 𝔮.ResidueField
  rw [← Algebra.rank_kaehlerDifferential_eq_trdeg_of_perfectField k 𝔮.ResidueField,
    ← Module.finrank_eq_rank, Cardinal.toENat_nat]
  norm_cast

name: Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.ringKrullDim_localization_of_isMaximal
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_localization_of_isMaximal [PerfectField k] (n : ℕ)
    [Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n k S] (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsMaximal] :
    ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) = n
proof:
:= by
  have h := ringKrullDim_localization_add_finrank_kaehlerDifferential_residueField (k := k) n 𝔮
  have : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k S :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth n (R := k)
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k S := Algebra.FiniteType.of_finitePresentation
  let : Field (S ⧸ 𝔮) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔮
  have : Module.Finite k (S ⧸ 𝔮) := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing k (S ⧸ 𝔮)
  have : Module.Finite k 𝔮.ResidueField :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (S ⧸ 𝔮) 𝔮.ResidueField).toLinearMap
      (Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField 𝔮).surjective
  have : Subsingleton Ω[𝔮.ResidueField⁄k] :=
    Algebra.subsingleton_kaehlerDifferential_of_isSeparable k 𝔮.ResidueField
  rwa [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at h

name: Algebra.FormallySmooth.residueField_of_bijective
statement:
theorem FormallySmooth.residueField_of_bijective
    (hbij : Function.Bijective (ResidueField.map (algebraMap P L)))
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth k (ResidueField L)] : Algebra.FormallySmooth k (ResidueField P)
proof:
:=
  Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_equiv (residueFieldAlgEquivOfBijective hbij).symm

name: Algebra.linearIndependent_tmul_of_bijective_residueField_map
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_tmul_of_bijective_residueField_map
    (hbij : Function.Bijective (ResidueField.map (algebraMap P L))) {ι : Type*} (v : ι → Ω[P⁄k])
    (hv : LinearIndependent (ResidueField P) fun i => (1 : ResidueField P) ⊗ₜ[P] v i) :
    LinearIndependent (ResidueField L) fun i => (1 : ResidueField L) ⊗ₜ[P] v i
proof:
:= by
  set e := RingEquiv.ofBijective (ResidueField.map (algebraMap P L)) hbij with he
  have hemap : ∀ p : P, e (algebraMap P (ResidueField P) p) = algebraMap P (ResidueField L) p :=
    fun p => by
      change ResidueField.map (algebraMap P L) (algebraMap P (ResidueField P) p) =
        algebraMap P (ResidueField L) p
      rw [ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, ResidueField.map_residue,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P L (ResidueField L), ResidueField.algebraMap_eq]
  let eₗ : ResidueField P →ₗ[P] ResidueField L :=
    { toFun := e
      map_add' := map_add e
      map_smul' := fun p a => by
        simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
        rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, hemap] }
  let E : ResidueField P ≃ₗ[P] ResidueField L := LinearEquiv.ofBijective eₗ hbij
  let Φ : ResidueField P ⊗[P] Ω[P⁄k] ≃ₗ[P] ResidueField L ⊗[P] Ω[P⁄k] := E.rTensor Ω[P⁄k]
  have hΦ : ∀ (r : ResidueField L) (m : ResidueField P ⊗[P] Ω[P⁄k]),
      Φ (e.symm r • m) = r • Φ m := by
    intro r m
    induction m using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a w =>
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      change E (e.symm r • a) ⊗ₜ[P] w = r • (E a ⊗ₜ[P] w)
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      congr 1
      change e (e.symm r * a) = r * e a
      rw [map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    | add m₁ m₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [smul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add, smul_add]
  have this : LinearIndependent (ResidueField L)
      (Φ.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom ∘ fun i => (1 : ResidueField P) ⊗ₜ[P] v i) :=
    hv.map_of_injective_injective (fun r => e.symm r) Φ.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom
      (fun r hr => e.symm.injective (hr.trans (map_zero _).symm))
      (fun m hm => Φ.injective (hm.trans (map_zero _).symm)) hΦ
  have hfun : (Φ.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom ∘ fun i => (1 : ResidueField P) ⊗ₜ[P] v i) =
      fun i => (1 : ResidueField L) ⊗ₜ[P] v i := by
    funext i
    change E 1 ⊗ₜ[P] v i = (1 : ResidueField L) ⊗ₜ[P] v i
    congr 1
    exact map_one e
  rwa [hfun] at this

name: Algebra.IsSmoothAt.of_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem IsSmoothAt.of_isRegularLocalRing [Algebra.FiniteType k S] (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsPrime]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)] [Algebra.FormallySmooth k 𝔮.ResidueField] :
    Algebra.IsSmoothAt k 𝔮
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, φ, hφ⟩ := Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''.mp ‹Algebra.FiniteType k S›
  set Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin N) k) := 𝔮.comap φ.toRingHom with hQ
  set P := Localization.AtPrime Q with hP
  set L := Localization.AtPrime 𝔮 with hL
  set g : P →+* L := Localization.localRingHom Q 𝔮 φ.toRingHom rfl with hg
  let _ : Algebra P L := g.toAlgebra
  have hgalg : algebraMap P L = g := RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra g
  have hcomm : ∀ c : k, g (algebraMap k P c) = algebraMap k L c := fun c => by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (MvPolynomial (Fin N) k) P, hg,
      Localization.localRingHom_to_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k S L]
    congr 1
    exact φ.commutes c
  have : IsScalarTower k P L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by rw [hgalg, hcomm]
  have hloc : IsLocalHom (algebraMap P L) := by
    rw [hgalg]
    exact Localization.isLocalHom_localRingHom (I := Q) 𝔮 φ.toRingHom rfl
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap P L) := by
    rw [hgalg]
    exact Localization.localRingHom_surjective_of_surjective φ.toRingHom 𝔮 hφ
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (ResidueField.map (algebraMap P L)) :=
    Localization.bijective_residueField_map_localRingHom_of_surjective φ.toRingHom 𝔮 hφ
  have hker : (RingHom.ker (algebraMap P L)).FG := MvPolynomial.fg_of_localization_atPrime Q _
  have : Algebra.FormallySmooth k P := MvPolynomial.formallySmooth_localization_atPrime Q
  have : Module.Free P Ω[P⁄k] := MvPolynomial.free_kaehlerDifferential_localization_atPrime Q
  have : Module.Finite P Ω[P⁄k] := MvPolynomial.finite_kaehlerDifferential_localization_atPrime Q
  change Algebra.FormallySmooth k L
  rw [Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_injective_cotangentComplexBaseChange_residueField P hsurj hker]
  
  set K := RingHom.ker (algebraMap P L) with hKdef
  have : IsRegularLocalRing P := MvPolynomial.isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime Q
  have : IsRegularLocalRing (P ⧸ K) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj).symm
  obtain ⟨n, c, x, hcn, hnP, hx, hK⟩ :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_eq_span_image_lt K
  have hxK : ∀ j : Fin c, x (Fin.castLE hcn j) ∈ K := fun j => by
    rw [hK]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨Fin.castLE hcn j, j.isLt, rfl⟩
  let v : Fin c → K := fun j => ⟨x (Fin.castLE hcn j), hxK j⟩
  have hrange :
      Set.range (fun j : Fin c => x (Fin.castLE hcn j)) = x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < c} := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Fin.castLE hcn j, j.isLt, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨j.val, hj⟩, congrArg x (Fin.ext rfl)⟩
  
  have hvspan : Submodule.span P (Set.range v) = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective K.injective_subtype
    rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype, ← Set.range_comp]
    have hcomp : Set.range (K.subtype ∘ v) = Set.range fun j : Fin c => x (Fin.castLE hcn j) := rfl
    rw [hcomp, hrange]
    exact hK.symm
  have hTspan : Submodule.span (ResidueField L)
      (Set.range fun j => (1 : ResidueField L) ⊗ₜ[P] v j) = ⊤ := by
    have := congrArg (Submodule.baseChange (ResidueField L)) hvspan
    rw [Submodule.baseChange_span, Submodule.baseChange_top, ← Set.range_comp] at this
    exact this
  
  set F := cotangentComplexBaseChange k L P (ResidueField L) with hF
  have hFv : ∀ j, F ((1 : ResidueField L) ⊗ₜ[P] v j) =
      (1 : ResidueField L) ⊗ₜ[P] D k P (x (Fin.castLE hcn j)) := fun j => by
    rw [hF, cotangentComplexBaseChange_tmul, one_smul, kerToTensor_apply]
  
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_basis_cotangentSpace_of_span_eq x hx hnP
  have hliP : LinearIndependent (ResidueField P) fun j : Fin c =>
      (maximalIdeal P).toCotangent
        ⟨x (Fin.castLE hcn j), x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq x hx _⟩ := by
    have := b.linearIndependent.comp (Fin.castLE hcn) (Fin.castLE_injective hcn)
    convert this using 1
    funext j
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hb]
  have : Algebra.FormallySmooth k (ResidueField P) := FormallySmooth.residueField_of_bijective hbij
  have hliP' : LinearIndependent (ResidueField P) fun j : Fin c =>
      (1 : ResidueField P) ⊗ₜ[P] D k P (x (Fin.castLE hcn j)) := by
    have this : LinearIndependent (ResidueField P) (cotangentSpaceToTensor k P ∘ fun j : Fin c =>
        (maximalIdeal P).toCotangent
          ⟨x (Fin.castLE hcn j), x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq x hx _⟩) :=
      hliP.map' (cotangentSpaceToTensor k P)
        (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (injective_cotangentSpaceToTensor k P))
    have hfun : (cotangentSpaceToTensor k P ∘ fun j : Fin c =>
        (maximalIdeal P).toCotangent
          ⟨x (Fin.castLE hcn j), x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq x hx _⟩) =
        fun j : Fin c => (1 : ResidueField P) ⊗ₜ[P] D k P (x (Fin.castLE hcn j)) := by
      funext j
      rw [Function.comp_apply, cotangentSpaceToTensor_toCotangent]
    rwa [hfun] at this
  have hliL := linearIndependent_tmul_of_bijective_residueField_map hbij _ hliP'
  
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero F).mpr fun w hw => ?_
  have hwT : w ∈ Submodule.span (ResidueField L)
      (Set.range fun j => (1 : ResidueField L) ⊗ₜ[P] v j) := by
    rw [hTspan]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun (ResidueField L)).mp hwT
  have h0 : ∑ j, a j • ((1 : ResidueField L) ⊗ₜ[P] D k P (x (Fin.castLE hcn j))) = 0 := by
    rw [← hw, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, hFv]
  have ha : ∀ j, a j = 0 := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hliL a h0
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => by rw [ha j, zero_smul]

name: Algebra.IsSmoothAt.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_perfectField
statement:
theorem IsSmoothAt.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_perfectField [PerfectField k] [Algebra.FiniteType k S]
    (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsPrime] [IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)] :
    Algebra.IsSmoothAt k 𝔮
proof:
:=
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k 𝔮.ResidueField := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k S _
  IsSmoothAt.of_isRegularLocalRing 𝔮

name: SymmetricAlgebra.ι_mem_grading_one
statement: theorem ι_mem_grading_one (x : M) : ι R M x ∈ grading R M 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [grading, pow_one] using LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x

name: SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_grading_zero
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_grading_zero (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r ∈ grading R M 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [grading, pow_zero]
  exact Submodule.algebraMap_mem r

name: SymmetricAlgebra.ringHom_ext
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun a =>
    SymmetricAlgebra.induction (R := R) (M := M) (motive := fun a => F a = G a) h₁ h₂
    (fun a b ha hb => ?_) (fun a b ha hb => ?_) a
  · rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb]
  · rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.liftₛₗ_ι
statement:
theorem liftₛₗ_ι {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (ψ : R →+* T) (g : M →+ T)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (x : M), g (r • x) = ψ r * g x) (x : M) : liftₛₗ ψ g hg (ι R M x) = g x
proof:
:= by
  let := ψ.toAlgebra
  exact lift_ι_apply _ x

name: SymmetricAlgebra.liftₛₗ_algebraMap
statement:
theorem liftₛₗ_algebraMap {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (ψ : R →+* T) (g : M →+ T)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (x : M), g (r • x) = ψ r * g x) (r : R) :
    liftₛₗ ψ g hg (algebraMap R _ r) = ψ r
proof:
:= by
  let := ψ.toAlgebra
  exact AlgHom.commutes _ r

name: SymmetricAlgebra.gradedMap_ι
statement:
theorem gradedMap_ι (φ : R →+* S) (f : M →ₛₗ[φ] N) (x : M) :
    gradedMap φ f (ι R M x) = ι S N (f x)
proof:
:= by
  let := algebraOfRingHom (N := N) φ
  exact lift_ι_apply (ιₛₗ φ f) x

name: SymmetricAlgebra.gradedMap_algebraMap
statement:
theorem gradedMap_algebraMap (φ : R →+* S) (f : M →ₛₗ[φ] N) (r : R) :
    gradedMap φ f (algebraMap R _ r) = algebraMap S _ (φ r)
proof:
:= by
  let := algebraOfRingHom (N := N) φ
  exact AlgHom.commutes (lift (ιₛₗ φ f)) r

name: SymmetricAlgebra.val_toAway
statement:
theorem val_toAway (e : SymmetricAlgebra R M) (r : R) :
    (toAway e r).val = Localization.mk (algebraMap R _ r) 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SymmetricAlgebra.e_mem_grading_one
statement: theorem e_mem_grading_one : e ∈ grading R M 1
proof: := he ▸ ι_mem_grading_one x₀

name: SymmetricAlgebra.val_frac
statement:
theorem val_frac (x : M) :
    (frac e x₀ he x).val = Localization.mk (ι R M x) ⟨e, Submonoid.mem_powers e⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [frac, Away.val_mk]
  exact congrArg (Localization.mk _) (Subtype.ext (pow_one e))

name: SymmetricAlgebra.dehom_ι
statement: theorem dehom_ι (x : M) : dehom e x₀ he (ι R M x) = frac e x₀ he x
proof:
:=
  liftₛₗ_ι _ _ _ x

name: SymmetricAlgebra.dehom_algebraMap
statement: theorem dehom_algebraMap (r : R) : dehom e x₀ he (algebraMap R _ r) = toAway e r
proof:
:=
  liftₛₗ_algebraMap _ _ _ r

name: SymmetricAlgebra.dehom_e
statement: theorem dehom_e : dehom e x₀ he e = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (congrArg (dehom e x₀ he) he.symm).trans ?_
  rw [dehom_ι]
  refine val_injective _ ?_
  rw [val_frac, val_one, ← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
    Localization.r_iff_exists]
  exact ⟨1, by simp [he]⟩

name: SymmetricAlgebra.val_dehom_of_mem
statement:
theorem val_dehom_of_mem {n : ℕ} {a : SymmetricAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ grading R M n) :
    (dehom e x₀ he a).val =
      Localization.mk a ⟨e ^ n, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers e) n⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [dehom_algebraMap, val_toAway]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (pow_zero e).symm
  | add x y i hx hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [map_add, val_add, ihx, ihy, Localization.add_mk_self]
  | mem_mul m hm i a ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hm
    rw [map_mul, val_mul, ih, dehom_ι, val_frac, Localization.mk_mul]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (pow_succ' e i).symm

name: SymmetricAlgebra.dehom_surjective
statement: theorem dehom_surjective : Function.Surjective (dehom e x₀ he)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective (grading R M) (e_mem_grading_one e x₀ he) z
  have ha' : a ∈ grading R M n := by simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using ha
  exact ⟨a, val_injective _ (by rw [val_dehom_of_mem e x₀ he ha', Away.val_mk])⟩

name: SymmetricAlgebra.away_ringHom_ext
proof:
:= by
  have : F.comp (dehom e x₀ he) = G.comp (dehom e x₀ he) :=
    ringHom_ext (fun r => by simpa [dehom_algebraMap] using h₁ r) h₂
  ext z
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := dehom_surjective e x₀ he z
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this a

name: SymmetricAlgebra.awayLift_mk_of_eq_one
statement:
theorem awayLift_mk_of_eq_one {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (L : SymmetricAlgebra R M →+* T)
    (hu : L e = 1) (hunit : IsUnit (L e)) (a : SymmetricAlgebra R M) (s : Submonoid.powers e) :
    Localization.awayLift L e hunit (Localization.mk a s) = L a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, n, rfl⟩ := s
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk']
  exact (IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec _ _ _ _).mpr (by simp [map_pow, hu])

name: SymmetricAlgebra.awayLift_dehom
statement:
theorem awayLift_dehom {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (ψ : R →+* T) (g : M →+ T)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (x : M), g (r • x) = ψ r * g x) (h₀ : g x₀ = 1) (a : SymmetricAlgebra R M) :
    awayLift e x₀ he ψ g hg h₀ (dehom e x₀ he a) = liftₛₗ ψ g hg a
proof:
:= by
  have hu : liftₛₗ ψ g hg e = 1 := by rw [← he, liftₛₗ_ι, h₀]
  refine RingHom.congr_fun (ringHom_ext (F := (awayLift e x₀ he ψ g hg h₀).comp (dehom e x₀ he))
    (G := liftₛₗ ψ g hg) (fun r => ?_) (fun x => ?_)) a
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, awayLift, dehom_algebraMap, algebraMap_apply, val_toAway]
    exact awayLift_mk_of_eq_one e _ hu _ _ _
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, awayLift, dehom_ι, algebraMap_apply, val_frac]
    exact awayLift_mk_of_eq_one e _ hu _ _ _

name: SymmetricAlgebra.awayLift_toAway
statement:
theorem awayLift_toAway {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (ψ : R →+* T) (g : M →+ T)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (x : M), g (r • x) = ψ r * g x) (h₀ : g x₀ = 1) (r : R) :
    awayLift e x₀ he ψ g hg h₀ (toAway e r) = ψ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dehom_algebraMap e x₀ he, awayLift_dehom, liftₛₗ_algebraMap]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.awayLift_frac
statement:
theorem awayLift_frac {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (ψ : R →+* T) (g : M →+ T)
    (hg : ∀ (r : R) (x : M), g (r • x) = ψ r * g x) (h₀ : g x₀ = 1) (x : M) :
    awayLift e x₀ he ψ g hg h₀ (dehom e x₀ he (ι R M x)) = g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayLift_dehom, liftₛₗ_ι]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.awayMap_toAway
statement:
theorem awayMap_toAway (r : R) :
    Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x₀) (toAway (ι R M x₀) r) =
      toAway (gradedMap φ f (ι R M x₀)) (φ r)
proof:
:= by
  change HomogeneousLocalization.map (gradedMap φ f) _
      (HomogeneousLocalization.mk ⟨0, algebraMap R (grading R M 0) r, 1, one_mem _⟩) =
    HomogeneousLocalization.mk ⟨0, algebraMap S (grading S N 0) (φ r), 1, one_mem _⟩
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.ext_iff_val, val_mk, val_mk]
  congr 1
  · exact gradedMap_algebraMap φ f r
  · exact Subtype.ext (map_one _)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.awayMap_frac
statement:
theorem awayMap_frac (x : M) :
    Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x₀) (frac (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl x) =
      frac (gradedMap φ f (ι R M x₀)) (f x₀) (gradedMap_ι φ f x₀).symm (f x)
proof:
:= by
  refine val_injective _ ?_
  rw [val_frac, frac, Away.map_mk, Away.val_mk]
  congr 1
  · exact gradedMap_ι φ f x
  · exact Subtype.ext (pow_one _)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.awayMap_dehom
statement:
theorem awayMap_dehom (a : SymmetricAlgebra R M) :
    Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x₀) (dehom (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl a) =
      dehom (gradedMap φ f (ι R M x₀)) (f x₀) (gradedMap_ι φ f x₀).symm (gradedMap φ f a)
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.congr_fun (ringHom_ext
    (F := (Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x₀)).comp (dehom (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl))
    (G := (dehom (gradedMap φ f (ι R M x₀)) (f x₀) (gradedMap_ι φ f x₀).symm).comp
      (gradedMap φ f).toRingHom) (fun r => ?_) (fun x => ?_)) a
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, dehom_algebraMap, awayMap_toAway]
    rw [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, gradedMap_algebraMap, dehom_algebraMap]
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, dehom_ι, awayMap_frac]
    rw [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, gradedMap_ι φ f x, dehom_ι]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.isPushout_away
statement:
theorem isPushout_away (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    (hext : ∀ (T : Type u) [AddCommGroup T] [Module S T] (g : M →ₛₗ[φ] T),
      ∃ g' : N →ₗ[S] T, ∀ x, g' (f x) = g x) :
    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (ι R M x₀)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (gradedMap φ f (ι R M x₀))))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x₀)))
proof:
:= by
  set e' := gradedMap φ f (ι R M x₀)
  have he' : ι S N (f x₀) = e' := (gradedMap_ι φ f x₀).symm
  have hsq : CommRingCat.ofHom φ ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway e') =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (ι R M x₀)) ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x₀)) := by
    refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r => ?_)
    exact (awayMap_toAway φ f x₀ r).symm
  
  let gR (s : Limits.PushoutCocone (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (ι R M x₀)))) :
      letI := s.inl.hom.toModule
      M →ₛₗ[φ] s.pt :=
    letI := s.inl.hom.toModule
    { toFun := fun x => s.inr.hom (dehom (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl (ι R M x))
      map_add' := fun x y => by rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        rw [LinearMap.map_smul, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_mul, dehom_algebraMap]
        change _ = s.inl.hom (φ r) * _
        congr 1
        exact (congrArg (fun h => h.hom r) s.condition).symm }
  let gN (s : Limits.PushoutCocone (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (ι R M x₀)))) :
      letI := s.inl.hom.toModule
      N →ₗ[S] s.pt :=
    letI := s.inl.hom.toModule
    Classical.choose (hext s.pt (gR s))
  have hgN (s : Limits.PushoutCocone (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (ι R M x₀)))) (x : M) :
      gN s (f x) = s.inr.hom (dehom (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl (ι R M x)) :=
    letI := s.inl.hom.toModule
    Classical.choose_spec (hext s.pt (gR s)) x
  have hsmul (s : Limits.PushoutCocone (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (ι R M x₀)))) (c : S) (n : N) :
      (gN s).toAddMonoidHom (c • n) = s.inl.hom c * (gN s).toAddMonoidHom n :=
    letI := s.inl.hom.toModule
    (gN s).map_smul c n
  have h₀ (s : Limits.PushoutCocone (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (ι R M x₀)))) : (gN s).toAddMonoidHom (f x₀) = 1 := by
    change gN s (f x₀) = 1
    rw [hgN, dehom_e, map_one]
  let desc (s : Limits.PushoutCocone (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway (ι R M x₀)))) :
      CommRingCat.of (Away (grading S N) e') ⟶ s.pt :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom (awayLift e' (f x₀) he' s.inl.hom (gN s).toAddMonoidHom
      (hsmul s) (h₀ s))
  refine IsPushout.of_isColimit (Limits.PushoutCocone.IsColimit.mk hsq desc
    (fun s => ?_) (fun s => ?_) (fun s m hl hr => ?_))
  · ext c
    exact awayLift_toAway e' (f x₀) he' _ _ (hsmul s) (h₀ s) c
  · refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (away_ringHom_ext (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl (fun r => ?_) (fun x => ?_))
    · change desc s (Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x₀) (toAway (ι R M x₀) r)) =
        s.inr.hom (toAway (ι R M x₀) r)
      rw [awayMap_toAway]
      change awayLift e' (f x₀) he' _ _ (hsmul s) (h₀ s) (toAway e' (φ r)) = _
      rw [awayLift_toAway]
      exact congrArg (fun h => h.hom r) s.condition
    · change desc s (Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x₀) (dehom (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl (ι R M x))) =
        s.inr.hom (dehom (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl (ι R M x))
      rw [awayMap_dehom, gradedMap_ι φ f x]
      change awayLift e' (f x₀) he' _ _ (hsmul s) (h₀ s)
        (dehom e' (f x₀) he' (ι S N (f x))) = _
      rw [awayLift_frac]
      exact hgN s x
  · refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (away_ringHom_ext e' (f x₀) he' (fun c => ?_) (fun n => ?_))
    · change m.hom (toAway e' c) = desc s (toAway e' c)
      rw [show desc s (toAway e' c) = s.inl.hom c from
        awayLift_toAway e' (f x₀) he' _ _ (hsmul s) (h₀ s) c]
      exact congrArg (fun h => h.hom c) hl
    · change m.hom (dehom e' (f x₀) he' (ι S N n)) = desc s (dehom e' (f x₀) he' (ι S N n))
      rw [show desc s (dehom e' (f x₀) he' (ι S N n)) = gN s n from
        awayLift_frac e' (f x₀) he' _ _ (hsmul s) (h₀ s) n]
      have hn : n ∈ Submodule.span S (Set.range f) := hspan ▸ Submodule.mem_top
      induction hn using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem n hn =>
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hn
        rw [hgN, ← gradedMap_ι, ← awayMap_dehom]
        exact congrArg (fun h => h.hom (dehom (ι R M x₀) x₀ rfl (ι R M x))) hr
      | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      | add n n' _ _ hn hn' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hn, hn', map_add]
      | smul c n _ hn =>
        change _ = (gN s).toAddMonoidHom (c • n)
        rw [hsmul, LinearMap.map_smul, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_mul, dehom_algebraMap, hn]
        congr 1
        exact congrArg (fun h => h.hom c) hl

name: SymmetricAlgebra.gradedι_apply
statement:
theorem gradedι_apply (m : M) :
    gradedι R M m = DirectSum.of (fun i : ℕ => grading R M i) 1
      ⟨ι R M m, by simpa only [grading, pow_one] using LinearMap.mem_range_self _ m⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMap_bijective_gradingZero
statement:
theorem algebraMap_bijective_gradingZero :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (grading R M 0))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun r s h => algebraMap_inj (M := M) r s |>.mp (congrArg Subtype.val h), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  rw [grading, pow_zero, Submodule.mem_one] at hx
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨r, rfl⟩

name: SymmetricAlgebra.gradedLift_apply
statement:
theorem gradedLift_apply (g : M →ₗ[R] A) (hg : ∀ x, g x ∈ 𝒜 1) (a : SymmetricAlgebra R M) :
    gradedLift 𝒜 g hg a = lift g a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Algebra.surjective_map_self
statement: theorem surjective_map_self : Function.Surjective (KaehlerDifferential.map k A S S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, ← top_le_iff, ← KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation A S,
    Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨KaehlerDifferential.D k S s, by simp [KaehlerDifferential.map_D]⟩

name: Algebra.formallyUnramified_of_surjective_mapBaseChange
statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_of_surjective_mapBaseChange
    (h : Function.Surjective (mapBaseChange k A S)) : Algebra.FormallyUnramified A S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun w => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := surjective_map_self k A S w
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h u
  exact (KaehlerDifferential.exact_mapBaseChange_map k A S).apply_apply_eq_zero t

name: Algebra.formallySmooth_of_bijective_mapBaseChange
statement:
theorem formallySmooth_of_bijective_mapBaseChange [Algebra.FormallySmooth k S]
    (h : Function.Bijective (mapBaseChange k A S)) : Algebra.FormallySmooth A S
proof:
:= by
  have hunr := formallyUnramified_of_surjective_mapBaseChange k A S h.2
  refine ⟨Module.Projective.of_free, subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_⟩
  have h1 := Algebra.H1Cotangent.exact_map_δ k A S
  have h2 := Algebra.H1Cotangent.exact_δ_mapBaseChange k A S
  have hδ : Algebra.H1Cotangent.δ k A S x = 0 :=
    h.1 (by rw [map_zero]; exact h2.apply_apply_eq_zero x)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (h1 x).mp hδ
  rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, map_zero]

name: Algebra.etale_of_bijective_mapBaseChange
statement:
theorem etale_of_bijective_mapBaseChange [Algebra.FormallySmooth k S]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation k S] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (h : Function.Bijective (mapBaseChange k A S)) : Algebra.Etale A S where
  formallyEtale
proof:
:= by
    have := formallyUnramified_of_surjective_mapBaseChange k A S h.2
    have := formallySmooth_of_bijective_mapBaseChange k A S h
    exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_formallyUnramified_and_formallySmooth
  finitePresentation := Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_restrict_scalars_finitePresentation k A S

name: Algebra.etale_aeval_of_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem etale_aeval_of_span_eq_top [Nontrivial S] [Algebra.FormallySmooth k S]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation k S] [Module.Free S Ω[S⁄k]] [Module.Finite S Ω[S⁄k]]
    (hrank : Module.finrank S Ω[S⁄k] = n)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range fun i => D k S (v i)) = ⊤) :
    (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) v).toRingHom.Etale
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) S :=
    (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) v).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) S :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      change algebraMap k S c = (MvPolynomial.aeval v) (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) c)
      rw [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
  change Algebra.Etale (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) S
  set A := MvPolynomial (Fin n) k
  
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin n) S (S ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄k]) :=
    (KaehlerDifferential.mvPolynomialBasis k (Fin n)).baseChange S
  have hb : ∀ i, mapBaseChange k A S (b i) = D k S (v i) := by
    intro i
    rw [Module.Basis.baseChange_apply, KaehlerDifferential.mvPolynomialBasis_apply,
      mapBaseChange_tmul, one_smul, KaehlerDifferential.map_D]
    exact congrArg (D k S) (MvPolynomial.aeval_X v i)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (mapBaseChange k A S) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, ← top_le_iff, ← hspan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b i, hb i⟩
  have hfin : Module.Finite S (S ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄k]) := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  have hrk : Module.finrank S (S ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄k]) = n := by
    rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (mapBaseChange k A S) :=
    OrzechProperty.bijective_of_surjective_of_finrank_le _ hsurj (by rw [hrk, hrank])
  exact etale_of_bijective_mapBaseChange k A S hbij

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.map_liftRelation
statement:
theorem map_liftRelation (r : σ) :
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R' R) (liftRelation hφ P r) = P.relation r
proof:
:=
  Function.surjInv_eq (MvPolynomial.map_surjective (algebraMap R' R) hφ) _

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.isUnit_jacobian_ambientPre
statement: theorem isUnit_jacobian_ambientPre : IsUnit (ambientPre hφ P).jacobian
proof:
:= by
  unfold ambientPre
  rw [PreSubmersivePresentation.comp_jacobian_eq_jacobian_smul_jacobian,
    PreSubmersivePresentation.localizationAway_jacobian]
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap (LiftedQuot hφ P) (Ambient hφ P) (liftedJac hφ P)) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (liftedJac hφ P)
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  exact hu.mul hu

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.isStandardSmooth_ambient
statement: theorem isStandardSmooth_ambient [Finite ι] : IsStandardSmooth R' (Ambient hφ P)

:=

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.liftedBase_relation
statement: theorem liftedBase_relation (r : σ) : (liftedBase hφ P).relation r = P.relation r
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftedBase
  rw [Presentation.baseChange_relation]
  exact map_liftRelation hφ P r

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.liftedBase_ker
statement: theorem liftedBase_ker : (liftedBase hφ P).ker = P.ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (liftedBase hφ P).span_range_relation_eq_ker, ← P.span_range_relation_eq_ker]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_range, liftedBase_relation]

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.dimension_ambientPre
statement: theorem dimension_ambientPre [Finite ι] : (ambientPre hφ P).dimension = P.dimension
proof:

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_ambient

theorem isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_ambient [Finite ι] :

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_mk
statement:
theorem baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_mk (q : MvPolynomial ι R') :
    baseChangeEquiv hφ P (1 ⊗ₜ[R'] (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι R') (LiftedQuot hφ P) q)) =
      aeval P.val (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R' R) q)
proof:
:= by
  have hval : (liftedBase hφ P).val =
      ⇑(Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R') (A := R) (B := LiftedQuot hφ P)) ∘
        (liftedPre hφ P).val := by
    funext i
    rfl
  have hcomp : aeval (⇑(Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R') (A := R)
      (B := LiftedQuot hφ P)) ∘ (liftedPre hφ P).val) q =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (aeval (liftedPre hφ P).val q) := by
    induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C r =>
      simp only [MvPolynomial.aeval_C, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul]
    | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
    | mul_X p i hp =>
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, hp, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, map_mul]
      rfl
  have h1 : (liftedBase hφ P).quotientEquiv
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R' R) q)) =
      1 ⊗ₜ[R'] (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι R') (LiftedQuot hφ P) q) := by
    rw [Presentation.quotientEquiv_mk, Generators.algebraMap_apply, hval,
      MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap, hcomp, ← Generators.algebraMap_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
    rfl
  unfold baseChangeEquiv
  simp only [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.restrictScalars_apply]
  rw [← h1, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk,
    Presentation.quotientEquiv_mk, Generators.algebraMap_apply]

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_liftedJac
statement:
theorem baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_liftedJac :
    baseChangeEquiv hφ P (1 ⊗ₜ[R'] liftedJac hφ P) = P.jacobian
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Fintype σ := Fintype.ofFinite σ
  have key := baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_mk hφ P (liftedPre hφ P).jacobiMatrix.det
  unfold liftedJac
  rw [PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobian_eq_jacobiMatrix_det]
  refine key.trans ?_
  rw [P.jacobian_eq_jacobiMatrix_det, Generators.algebraMap_apply]
  congr 1
  rw [RingHom.map_det]
  refine congrArg Matrix.det (Matrix.ext fun i j => ?_)
  rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply, PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobiMatrix_apply,
    PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobiMatrix_apply, ← MvPolynomial.pderiv_map]
  change pderiv (P.map i) (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R' R) (liftRelation hφ P j)) =
    pderiv (P.map i) (P.relation j)
  rw [map_liftRelation]

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.liftedToS_apply
statement:
theorem liftedToS_apply (t : LiftedQuot hφ P) :
    liftedToS hφ P t = baseChangeEquiv hφ P (1 ⊗ₜ[R'] t)
proof: := rfl

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.liftedToS_algebraMap
statement:
theorem liftedToS_algebraMap (r : R') :
    liftedToS hφ P (algebraMap R' (LiftedQuot hφ P) r) = algebraMap R' S r
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftedToS, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes]

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.isPushout_liftedQuot
statement:
theorem isPushout_liftedQuot :
    CategoryTheory.IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R' R))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R' (LiftedQuot hφ P)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)) (CommRingCat.ofHom (liftedToS hφ P).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (LiftedQuot hφ P) S := (liftedToS hφ P).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower R' (LiftedQuot hφ P) S :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => (liftedToS_algebraMap hφ P r).symm
  have h : Algebra.IsPushout R' R (LiftedQuot hφ P) S :=
    Algebra.IsPushout.of_equiv (S' := R ⊗[R'] LiftedQuot hφ P) (baseChangeEquiv hφ P)
      (RingHom.ext fun t => by
        simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
        rfl)
  exact CommRingCat.isPushout_iff_isPushout.mpr h

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.liftedToS_surjective
statement: theorem liftedToS_surjective : Function.Surjective (liftedToS hφ P)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (baseChangeEquiv hφ P).surjective s
  suffices h : ∃ t, (1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R'] t = x by
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul r t =>
    obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ := hφ r
    refine ⟨r' • t, ?_⟩
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨t₁, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨t₂, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨t₁ + t₂, by rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add]⟩

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.isUnit_liftedToS_liftedJac
statement: theorem isUnit_liftedToS_liftedJac : IsUnit (liftedToS hφ P (liftedJac hφ P))
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftedToS_apply, baseChangeEquiv_one_tmul_liftedJac]
  exact P.jacobian_isUnit

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.ambientToS_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ambientToS_comp_algebraMap :
    (ambientToS hφ P).comp (algebraMap (LiftedQuot hφ P) (Ambient hφ P)) =
      (liftedToS hφ P).toRingHom
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp _ _

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.ambientToS_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ambientToS_algebraMap (t : LiftedQuot hφ P) :
    ambientToS hφ P (algebraMap (LiftedQuot hφ P) (Ambient hφ P) t) = liftedToS hφ P t
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq _ _ _

name: Algebra.StandardSmoothLift.ambientToS_surjective
statement: theorem ambientToS_surjective : Function.Surjective (ambientToS hφ P)
proof:
:= fun s => by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := liftedToS_surjective hφ P s
  exact ⟨algebraMap _ _ t, ambientToS_algebraMap hφ P t⟩

name: Algebra.map_image_range_D
statement:
theorem map_image_range_D {ι : Type*} (v : ι → S) :
    KaehlerDifferential.map k k S T '' (Set.range fun i => D k S (v i)) =
      Set.range fun i => D k T (algebraMap S T (v i))
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i, by rw [KaehlerDifferential.map_D]⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, by rw [KaehlerDifferential.map_D]⟩

name: Algebra.exists_smul_mem_span_of_localized
proof:
:= by
  set P := Submodule.span S (Set.range fun i => D k S (v i)) with hPdef
  have hP : P.localized' T M (KaehlerDifferential.map k k S T) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hPdef, Submodule.localized'_span, map_image_range_D, h]
  have hmem : KaehlerDifferential.map k k S T ω ∈
      P.localized' T M (KaehlerDifferential.map k k S T) := hP ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  rw [Submodule.mem_localized'] at hmem
  obtain ⟨m, hm, s, hs⟩ := hmem
  rw [← IsLocalizedModule.mk'_one M (KaehlerDifferential.map k k S T) ω,
    IsLocalizedModule.mk'_eq_mk'_iff] at hs
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨c.1 * s.1, M.mul_mem c.2 s.2, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_smul]
  change c.1 • s.1 • ω ∈ P
  rw [← Submonoid.smul_def, ← Submonoid.smul_def, hc, one_smul]
  exact P.smul_mem _ hm

name: Algebra.exists_mem_forall_smul_mem_span
statement:
theorem exists_mem_forall_smul_mem_span (M : Submonoid S) [IsLocalization M T]
    [Module.Finite S Ω[S⁄k]] {ι : Type*} (v : ι → S)
    (h : Submodule.span T (Set.range fun i => D k T (algebraMap S T (v i))) = ⊤) :
    ∃ s ∈ M, ∀ ω : Ω[S⁄k], s • ω ∈ Submodule.span S (Set.range fun i => D k S (v i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Submodule.span S (Set.range fun i => D k S (v i))
  obtain ⟨m, g, hg⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := S) (M := Ω[S⁄k])
  have key : ∀ j : Fin m, ∃ s ∈ M, s • g j ∈ P := fun j =>
    exists_smul_mem_span_of_localized M v h (g j)
  choose sf hsM hsP using key
  refine ⟨∏ j, sf j, M.prod_mem fun j _ => hsM j, fun ω => ?_⟩
  have hω : ω ∈ Submodule.span S (Set.range g) := hg ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hω using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem ω hω =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hω
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ sf (Finset.mem_univ j), mul_comm, mul_smul]
    exact P.smul_mem _ (hsP j)
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact P.zero_mem
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [smul_add]; exact P.add_mem ha hb
  | smul r a _ ha => rw [smul_comm]; exact P.smul_mem r ha

name: Algebra.span_eq_top_of_forall_smul_mem
statement:
theorem span_eq_top_of_forall_smul_mem {S' : Type u} [CommRing S'] [Algebra k S'] [Algebra S S']
    [IsScalarTower k S S'] (M : Submonoid S) [IsLocalization M S'] {ι : Type*} (v : ι → S)
    {s : S} (hs : s ∈ M)
    (h : ∀ ω : Ω[S⁄k], s • ω ∈ Submodule.span S (Set.range fun i => D k S (v i))) :
    Submodule.span S' (Set.range fun i => D k S' (algebraMap S S' (v i))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set P := Submodule.span S (Set.range fun i => D k S (v i)) with hPdef
  have hP : P.localized' S' M (KaehlerDifferential.map k k S S') = ⊤ := by
    rw [_root_.eq_top_iff]
    rintro w -
    obtain ⟨⟨ω, t⟩, hw⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.mk'_surjective M (KaehlerDifferential.map k k S S') w
    rw [Submodule.mem_localized']
    refine ⟨(⟨s, hs⟩ : M) • ω, ?_, ⟨s, hs⟩ * t, ?_⟩
    · rw [Submonoid.smul_def]
      exact h ω
    · rw [IsLocalizedModule.mk'_cancel_left]
      exact hw
  rwa [hPdef, Submodule.localized'_span, map_image_range_D] at hP

name: Algebra.finite_kaehlerDifferential_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem finite_kaehlerDifferential_of_isLocalization (M : Submonoid S) [IsLocalization M T]
    [Module.Finite S Ω[S⁄k]] : Module.Finite T Ω[T⁄k]
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.equiv (IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange M T (KaehlerDifferential.map k k S T)).equiv

name: Algebra.span_eq_top_of_basis_tensor
statement:
theorem span_eq_top_of_basis_tensor [IsLocalRing T] [Module.Finite T Ω[T⁄k]] {ι : Type*}
    (v : ι → S)
    (b : Module.Basis ι (IsLocalRing.ResidueField T) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField T ⊗[T] Ω[T⁄k]))
    (hb : ∀ i, b i = 1 ⊗ₜ D k T (algebraMap S T (v i))) :
    Submodule.span T (Set.range fun i => D k T (algebraMap S T (v i))) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  IsLocalRing.span_eq_top_of_tmul_eq_basis _ b fun i => (hb i).symm

name: IsLocalRing.x_mem_chartCenter
statement: theorem x_mem_chartCenter {i : Fin n} (hi : i ≤ r) : x i ∈ chartCenter x r
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.chartCenter_le_iff
statement: theorem chartCenter_le_iff {I : Ideal R} : chartCenter x r ≤ I ↔ ∀ i, i ≤ r → x i ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartCenter, Ideal.span_le, Set.image_subset_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi => h hi, fun h i hi => h i hi⟩

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR
statement:
theorem algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR {i : Fin n} (hi : i < r) :
    algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x i) = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) * chartYR x r i
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hy : ((chartYR x r i : chartRing x r) : Localization.Away (x r)) =
      Localization.mk (x i) ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ := by
    rw [coe_chartYROf]
    exact chartYOf_of_lt x r (x r) hi
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, hy, mk_eq_algebraMap_mul_invX, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
    Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, mul_left_comm, algebraMap_mul_invX, mul_one]

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_x_mem_span_of_le
statement:
theorem algebraMap_x_mem_span_of_le {i : Fin n} (hi : i ≤ r) :
    algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x i) ∈ Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)}
proof:
:= by
  rcases hi.lt_or_eq with hlt | rfl
  · rw [algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR x r hlt, mul_comm]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _

name: IsLocalRing.chartCenter_le_comap_span
statement:
theorem chartCenter_le_comap_span :
    chartCenter x r ≤
      (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)}).comap (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))
proof:
:=
  (chartCenter_le_iff x r).mpr fun _ hi => Ideal.mem_comap.mpr (algebraMap_x_mem_span_of_le x r hi)

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_mem_span_pow_of_mem_chartCenter_pow
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_comap.mp
    (Ideal.le_comap_pow (f := algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) m
      (Ideal.pow_right_mono (chartCenter_le_comap_span x r) m hf))

name: IsLocalRing.exists_algebraMap_pow_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_algebraMap_pow_mul_eq {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m) :
    ∃ g : chartRing x r,
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * g = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f
proof:
:= by
  have h := algebraMap_mem_span_pow_of_mem_chartCenter_pow x r hf
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h
  exact ⟨g, by rw [mul_comm]; exact hg⟩

name: IsLocalRing.map_chartCenter
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (chartCenter_le_comap_span x r)) ?_
  rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (x_mem_chartCenter x r le_rfl)

name: IsLocalRing.coe_transformElem
statement:
theorem coe_transformElem {m : ℕ} (f : R) (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m) :
    (transformElem x r f hf : Localization.Away (x r)) =
      Localization.mk f ⟨x r ^ m, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers _) m⟩
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.map_chartDlog_le_logDerivative
statement:
theorem map_chartDlog_le_logDerivative (χ : chartRing c.x r →+* S)
    (δ : Fin n → Derivation k S S)
    (hδ : ∀ (j : Fin n) (g : chartRing c.x r), χ (c.chartDerivRing r j g) = δ j (χ g))
    (h : Fin n) (hpres : ∀ j, j ≠ h → (δ j).PreservesIdeal (Ideal.span {χ (chartYR c.x r h)}))
    (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    Ideal.map χ (c.chartDlog r h K) ≤
      Ideal.logDerivative k (Ideal.span {χ (chartYR c.x r h)}) (Ideal.map χ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  unfold chartDlog
  refine sup_le (sup_le ?_ (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)) (iSup_le fun j => iSup_le fun hj =>
    Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · exact Ideal.le_comap_map.trans (Ideal.comap_mono (Ideal.le_logDerivative (k := k) _ _))
  · rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, map_mul, hδ]
    have hpres_h : (χ (chartYR c.x r h) • δ h).PreservesIdeal
        (Ideal.span {χ (chartYR c.x r h)}) := by
      rw [Derivation.preservesIdeal_span_singleton_iff, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    have := Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_logDerivative hpres_h (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem χ hg)
    simpa only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  · rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, hδ]
    exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_logDerivative (hpres j hj) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem χ hg)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.map_chartDlogpow_le_logDerivativeIter
statement:
theorem map_chartDlogpow_le_logDerivativeIter (χ : chartRing c.x r →+* S)
    (δ : Fin n → Derivation k S S)
    (hδ : ∀ (j : Fin n) (g : chartRing c.x r), χ (c.chartDerivRing r j g) = δ j (χ g))
    (h : Fin n) (hpres : ∀ j, j ≠ h → (δ j).PreservesIdeal (Ideal.span {χ (chartYR c.x r h)}))
    (j : ℕ) (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    Ideal.map χ (c.chartDlogpow r h j K) ≤
      Ideal.logDerivativeIter k (Ideal.span {χ (chartYR c.x r h)}) j (Ideal.map χ K)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [chartDlogpow_succ, Ideal.logDerivativeIter_succ]
    exact (map_chartDlog_le_logDerivative c r χ δ hδ h hpres _).trans
      (Ideal.logDerivative_mono (k := k) ih)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.derivative_map_le_map_chartD_of_span
statement:
theorem derivative_map_le_map_chartD_of_span (χ : chartRing c.x r →+* S)
    (δ : Fin n → Derivation k S S)
    (hδ : ∀ (j : Fin n) (g : chartRing c.x r), χ (c.chartDerivRing r j g) = δ j (χ g))
    (hspan : ∀ (D : Derivation k S S) (f : S), ∃ a : Fin n → S, D f = ∑ j, a j * δ j f)
    (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    Ideal.derivative k (Ideal.map χ K) ≤ Ideal.map χ (c.chartD r K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.derivative_le_iff]
  refine ⟨Ideal.map_mono (c.le_chartD r K), fun D f hf => ?_⟩
  have hf' : f ∈ Ideal.span (χ '' (K : Set (chartRing c.x r))) := hf
  clear hf
  induction hf' using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hspan D (χ g)
    rw [ha]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_
    rw [← hδ]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem χ (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartD r hg j)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul a x hx hDx =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hDx)
      (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.map_mono (c.le_chartD r K) hx))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.derivativeIter_map_le_map_iterate_chartD_of_span
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_map_le_map_iterate_chartD_of_span (χ : chartRing c.x r →+* S)
    (δ : Fin n → Derivation k S S)
    (hδ : ∀ (j : Fin n) (g : chartRing c.x r), χ (c.chartDerivRing r j g) = δ j (χ g))
    (hspan : ∀ (D : Derivation k S S) (f : S), ∃ a : Fin n → S, D f = ∑ j, a j * δ j f) (s : ℕ)
    (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    Ideal.derivativeIter k s (Ideal.map χ K) ≤ Ideal.map χ ((c.chartD r)^[s] K)
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [Ideal.derivativeIter_succ, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact (Ideal.derivative_mono ih).trans (derivative_map_le_map_chartD_of_span c r χ δ hδ hspan _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.x_smul_pderivOver_preservesIdeal
statement:
theorem x_smul_pderivOver_preservesIdeal (i : Fin n) :
    (c.x i • c.pderivOver hk i).PreservesIdeal (Ideal.span {c.x h})
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  have := (c.mem_logDerE.mp (c.x_smul_pderiv_mem_logDerE {h} i)).2 h (Finset.mem_singleton_self h)
    f hf
  simpa only [Derivation.smul_apply, pderivOver_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderivOver_preservesIdeal_of_ne
statement:
theorem pderivOver_preservesIdeal_of_ne {j : Fin n} (hj : j ≠ h) :
    (c.pderivOver hk j).PreservesIdeal (Ideal.span {c.x h})
proof:
:= fun f hf => by
  rw [pderivOver_apply]
  exact c.pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne' h hj hf

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.eq_sum_smul_pderivOver
statement:
theorem eq_sum_smul_pderivOver (δ : Derivation k R R) :
    δ = ∑ i, δ (c.x i) • c.pderivOver hk i
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [hs δ f, derivation_sum_apply]
  simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, pderivOver_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.preserving_span_x_eq
statement:
theorem preserving_span_x_eq :
    Derivation.preserving k (Ideal.span {c.x h}) =
      Submodule.span R
        ({c.x h • c.pderivOver hk h} ∪ (fun j => c.pderivOver hk j) '' {j | j ≠ h})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · intro δ hδ
    rw [Derivation.mem_preserving] at hδ
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hδ (c.x h) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))
    rw [c.eq_sum_smul_pderivOver hk hs δ, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ h)]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => ?_)
    · rw [← hb, ← smul_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl rfl))
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨j, Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj, rfl⟩))
  · rintro δ (rfl | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩)
    · exact c.x_smul_pderivOver_preservesIdeal hk h h
    · exact c.pderivOver_preservesIdeal_of_ne hk h hj

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.logDerivative_eq_Dlog
statement:
theorem logDerivative_eq_Dlog (I : Ideal R) :
    Ideal.logDerivative k (Ideal.span {c.x h}) I = c.Dlog h I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.logDerivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨c.le_DlogE _ I, fun δ hδ f hf => ?_⟩)
    ((c.Dlog_le_iff h).mpr ⟨Ideal.le_logDerivative _ I, fun f hf => ?_, fun j hj f hf => ?_⟩)
  · rw [hs δ f]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases hi : i = h
    · subst hi
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
        Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hδ (c.x i) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))
      rw [← hb, mul_assoc]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE (Finset.mem_singleton_self i) hf)
    · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
        (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE (fun e => hi (Finset.mem_singleton.mp e)) hf)
  · have := Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_logDerivative
      (c.x_smul_pderivOver_preservesIdeal hk h h) hf
    simpa only [Derivation.smul_apply, pderivOver_apply, smul_eq_mul] using this
  · exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_logDerivative (c.pderivOver_preservesIdeal_of_ne hk h hj) hf

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.logDerivativeIter_eq_Dlogpow
statement:
theorem logDerivativeIter_eq_Dlogpow (s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    Ideal.logDerivativeIter k (Ideal.span {c.x h}) s I = c.Dlogpow h s I
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [Ideal.logDerivativeIter_succ, ih, Dlogpow_succ, c.logDerivative_eq_Dlog hk hs h]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_chartDlog
statement: theorem le_chartDlog (h : Fin n) (J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) : J ≤ c.chartDlog r h J
proof:
:=
  le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartYR_mul_chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog
statement:
theorem chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog {h j : Fin n} (hj : j ≠ h) {J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)}
    {z : chartRing c.x r} (hz : z ∈ J) : c.chartDerivRing r j z ∈ c.chartDlog r h J
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem j (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem hj
    (Ideal.subset_span ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩)))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlog_le_iff
statement:
theorem chartDlog_le_iff (h : Fin n) {J K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)} :
    c.chartDlog r h J ≤ K ↔
      J ≤ K ∧ (∀ z ∈ J, chartYR c.x r h * c.chartDerivRing r h z ∈ K) ∧
        ∀ j, j ≠ h → ∀ z ∈ J, c.chartDerivRing r j z ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hle
    exact ⟨(c.le_chartDlog r h J).trans hle,
      fun _ hz => hle (c.chartYR_mul_chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r h hz),
      fun _ hj _ hz => hle (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r hj hz)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    refine sup_le (sup_le h1 (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_))
      (iSup_le fun j => iSup_le fun hj => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact h2 z hz
    · rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact h3 j hj z hz

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlog_mono
statement:
theorem chartDlog_mono (h : Fin n) {J K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)} (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    c.chartDlog r h J ≤ c.chartDlog r h K
proof:
:=
  (c.chartDlog_le_iff r h).mpr ⟨hJK.trans (c.le_chartDlog r h K),
    fun _ hz => c.chartYR_mul_chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r h (hJK hz),
    fun _ hj _ hz => c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r hj (hJK hz)⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlog_le_chartD
statement:
theorem chartDlog_le_chartD (h : Fin n) (J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlog r h J ≤ c.chartD r J
proof:
:=
  (c.chartDlog_le_iff r h).mpr ⟨c.le_chartD r J,
    fun _ hz => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartD r hz h),
    fun j _ _ hz => c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartD r hz j⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlogpow_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartDlogpow_zero (h : Fin n) (J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlogpow r h 0 J = J
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlogpow_succ
statement:
theorem chartDlogpow_succ (h : Fin n) (j : ℕ) (J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlogpow r h (j + 1) J = c.chartDlog r h (c.chartDlogpow r h j J)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlogpow_mono
statement:
theorem chartDlogpow_mono (h : Fin n) (j : ℕ) {J K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)} (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    c.chartDlogpow r h j J ≤ c.chartDlogpow r h j K
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact hJK
  | succ j ih => rw [chartDlogpow_succ, chartDlogpow_succ]; exact c.chartDlog_mono r h ih

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_le_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem Dpow_le_chartCenter_pow {I : Ideal R} {m j : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + j)) :
    c.Dpow j I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction j generalizing m with
  | zero => exact hI
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ]
    exact c.D_le_chartCenter_pow r (ih (by rwa [show m + 1 + j = m + (j + 1) by omega]))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_le_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_le_chartCenter_pow (h : Fin n) {I : Ideal R} {m j : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + j)) : c.Dlogpow h j I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ m
proof:
:=
  (c.Dlogpow_le_Dpow h j I).trans (c.Dpow_le_chartCenter_pow r hI)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlog_le_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem Dlog_le_chartCenter_pow (h : Fin n) {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1)) : c.Dlog h I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ m
proof:
:=
  (c.DlogE_le_D _ I).trans (c.D_le_chartCenter_pow r hI)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_transformPreimage
statement:
theorem mem_transformPreimage {m : ℕ} {K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)} {g : R} :
    g ∈ c.transformPreimage r m K ↔
      ∃ hg : g ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m, transformElem c.x r g hg ∈ K
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transformIdeal_le_of_le_transformPreimage
proof:
:= by
  rw [transformIdeal_eq_span_range_transformElem _ _ hJ]
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨_, hgK⟩ := (c.mem_transformPreimage r).mp (hle hg)
  exact hgK

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transform_Dlog_le_chartDlog
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ∀ (f : R) (hf : f ∈ I),
      transformElem c.x r f (hI hf) ∈ transformIdeal c.x r I (m + 1) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [transformIdeal_eq_span_range_transformElem _ _ hI]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩
  refine c.transformIdeal_le_of_le_transformPreimage r (c.Dlog_le_chartCenter_pow r h hI) ?_
  refine (c.Dlog_le_iff h).mpr ⟨fun f hf => (c.mem_transformPreimage r).mpr
      ⟨Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ m) (hI hf), ?_⟩,
    fun f hf => (c.mem_transformPreimage r).mpr
      ⟨Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (by simpa using c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r (hI hf) h), ?_⟩,
    fun j hj f hf => (c.mem_transformPreimage r).mpr
      ⟨by simpa using c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r (hI hf) j, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [c.transformElem_succ r (hI hf)]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.le_chartDlog r h _ (hT f hf))
  · rw [c.transform_x_pderiv r hh (hI hf), mul_assoc]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.chartYR_mul_chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r h (hT f hf))
  · rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hjr | hjr | hjr
    · rw [c.transform_pderiv_lt r hjr (hI hf)]
      exact c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r hj (hT f hf)
    · subst hjr
      rw [c.transform_pderiv_eq j (hI hf)]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.sub_mem _ ?_ ?_) ?_
      · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog j hj (hT f hf))
      · refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
        by_cases hi : i = h
        · rw [hi]
          exact c.chartYR_mul_chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog j h (hT f hf)
        · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog j hi (hT f hf))
      · exact nsmul_mem (c.le_chartDlog j h _ (hT f hf)) _
    · rw [c.transform_pderiv_gt r hjr (hI hf)]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r hj (hT f hf))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transform_Dlogpow_le_chartDlogpow
statement:
theorem transform_Dlogpow_le_chartDlogpow {h : Fin n} (hh : h < r) {I : Ideal R} {m j : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + j)) :
    transformIdeal c.x r (c.Dlogpow h j I) m ≤
      c.chartDlogpow r h j (transformIdeal c.x r I (m + j))
proof:
:= by
  induction j generalizing m with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    have hI' : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1 + j) := by
      rwa [show m + 1 + j = m + (j + 1) by omega]
    rw [Dlogpow_succ, chartDlogpow_succ]
    refine (c.transform_Dlog_le_chartDlog r hh (c.Dlogpow_le_chartCenter_pow r h hI')).trans
      (c.chartDlog_mono r h ?_)
    rw [show m + (j + 1) = m + 1 + j by omega]
    exact ih hI'

name: Derivation.mem_span_sup_span_image
statement:
theorem mem_span_sup_span_image (δ : Derivation k A A) (S : Set A) {z : A}
    (hz : z ∈ Ideal.span S) : δ z ∈ Ideal.span S ⊔ Ideal.span (δ '' S)
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem s hs => exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | smul a b hb hδb =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hδb) (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hb))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartD_mono
statement: theorem chartD_mono {J K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)} (hJK : J ≤ K) : c.chartD r J ≤ c.chartD r K
proof:
:=
  sup_le_sup hJK (iSup_mono fun _ => Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono hJK))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartD_span_le
statement:
theorem chartD_span_le (W : Set (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartD r (Ideal.span W) ≤ Ideal.span (W ∪ ⋃ i, c.chartDerivRing r i '' W)
proof:
:= by
  refine sup_le (Ideal.span_mono Set.subset_union_left) (iSup_le fun i => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  have hle : Ideal.span W ⊔ Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r i '' W) ≤
      Ideal.span (W ∪ ⋃ i, c.chartDerivRing r i '' W) :=
    sup_le (Ideal.span_mono Set.subset_union_left) (Ideal.span_mono
      (Set.subset_union_of_subset_right
        (Set.subset_iUnion (fun i => c.chartDerivRing r i '' W) i) W))
  exact hle ((c.chartDerivRing r i).mem_span_sup_span_image W hz)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartWords_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem chartWords_zero (G : Set (chartRing c.x r)) : c.chartWords r G 0 = G
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartWords_succ
statement:
theorem chartWords_succ (G : Set (chartRing c.x r)) (s : ℕ) :
    c.chartWords r G (s + 1) =
      c.chartWords r G s ∪ ⋃ i, c.chartDerivRing r i '' c.chartWords r G s
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterate_chartD_span_le
statement:
theorem iterate_chartD_span_le (G : Set (chartRing c.x r)) (s : ℕ) :
    (c.chartD r)^[s] (Ideal.span G) ≤ Ideal.span (c.chartWords r G s)
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', chartWords_succ]
    exact (c.chartD_mono r ih).trans (c.chartD_span_le r _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlog_sup_le
statement:
theorem chartDlog_sup_le (h : Fin n) (A B : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlog r h (A ⊔ B) ≤ c.chartDlog r h A ⊔ c.chartDlog r h B
proof:
:= by
  refine (c.chartDlog_le_iff r h).mpr
    ⟨sup_le_sup (c.le_chartDlog r h A) (c.le_chartDlog r h B), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
    rw [map_add, mul_add]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.chartYR_mul_chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r h ha))
      (Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.chartYR_mul_chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r h hb))
  · intro j hj z hz
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r hj ha))
      (Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r hj hb))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlogpow_sup_le
statement:
theorem chartDlogpow_sup_le (h : Fin n) (t : ℕ) (A B : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlogpow r h t (A ⊔ B) ≤ c.chartDlogpow r h t A ⊔ c.chartDlogpow r h t B
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [chartDlogpow_succ, chartDlogpow_succ, chartDlogpow_succ]
    exact (c.chartDlog_mono r h ih).trans (c.chartDlog_sup_le r h _ _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlogpow_le_succ
statement:
theorem chartDlogpow_le_succ (h : Fin n) (t : ℕ) (A : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlogpow r h t A ≤ c.chartDlogpow r h (t + 1) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartDlogpow_succ]
  exact c.le_chartDlog r h _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlog_eq_span
statement:
theorem chartDlog_eq_span (h : Fin n) (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlog r h K = Ideal.span (c.chartDlogGen r h K)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chartDlog, chartDlogGen, Ideal.span_union, Ideal.span_iUnion, Ideal.span_eq]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_image_chartDlog_le
statement:
theorem span_image_chartDlog_le (h : Fin n) (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r h '' (c.chartDlog r h K : Set (chartRing c.x r))) ≤
      c.chartDlog r h K ⊔
        c.chartDlog r h (Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r h '' (K : Set (chartRing c.x r))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  have hz' : z ∈ Ideal.span (c.chartDlogGen r h K) := by
    rw [← c.chartDlog_eq_span r h]
    exact hz
  have hle : Ideal.span (c.chartDlogGen r h K) ⊔
      Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r h '' c.chartDlogGen r h K) ≤
        c.chartDlog r h K ⊔
          c.chartDlog r h (Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r h '' (K : Set (chartRing c.x r)))) := by
    refine sup_le ((le_of_eq (c.chartDlog_eq_span r h K).symm).trans le_sup_left)
      (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    rcases hg with (hg | ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩) | hg
    · 
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.le_chartDlog r h _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩))
    · 
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.chartDerivRing_chartYR r, ite_eq_left rfl,
        mul_one]
      refine Ideal.mem_sup_right (add_mem (c.chartYR_mul_chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r h ?_)
        (c.le_chartDlog r h _ ?_)) <;> exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    · 
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hg
      obtain ⟨j, hj, k, hk, rfl⟩ := hg
      rw [c.chartDerivRing_comm r h j]
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_right
        (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r hj (Ideal.subset_span ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩))
  exact hle ((c.chartDerivRing r h).mem_span_sup_span_image _ hz')

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_image_chartDlogpow_le
statement:
theorem span_image_chartDlogpow_le (h : Fin n) (t : ℕ) (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r h '' (c.chartDlogpow r h t K : Set (chartRing c.x r))) ≤
      c.chartDlogpow r h t K ⊔
        c.chartDlogpow r h t
          (Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r h '' (K : Set (chartRing c.x r))))
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact le_sup_right
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [chartDlogpow_succ]
    refine (c.span_image_chartDlog_le r h _).trans (sup_le le_sup_left ?_)
    exact ((c.chartDlog_mono r h ih).trans (c.chartDlog_sup_le r h _ _)).trans
      (sup_le le_sup_left le_sup_right)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_image_pivotDerivs_le
statement:
theorem span_image_pivotDerivs_le (h : Fin n) (G : Set (chartRing c.x r)) (j : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r h '' (c.pivotDerivs r h G j : Set (chartRing c.x r))) ≤
      c.pivotDerivs r h G j ⊔ c.pivotDerivs r h G (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  have hle : c.pivotDerivs r h G j ⊔
      Ideal.span (c.chartDerivRing r h '' ((⇑(c.chartDerivRing r h))^[j] '' G)) ≤
        c.pivotDerivs r h G j ⊔ c.pivotDerivs r h G (j + 1) := by
    refine sup_le le_sup_left (le_sup_of_le_right (Ideal.span_mono ?_))
    rw [← Set.image_comp]
    rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g, hg, Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _⟩
  exact hle ((c.chartDerivRing r h).mem_span_sup_span_image _ hz)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iSup_chartDlogpow_le_succ
statement:
theorem iSup_chartDlogpow_le_succ (h : Fin n) (A : ℕ → Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) (s : ℕ) :
    (⨆ j ≤ s, c.chartDlogpow r h (s - j) (A j)) ≤
      ⨆ j ≤ s + 1, c.chartDlogpow r h (s + 1 - j) (A j)
proof:
:= by
  refine iSup₂_mono' fun j hj => ⟨j, hj.trans (Nat.le_succ s), ?_⟩
  rw [show s + 1 - j = s - j + 1 by omega]
  exact c.chartDlogpow_le_succ r h _ _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartWords_subset_iSup
statement:
theorem chartWords_subset_iSup (h : Fin n) (G : Set (chartRing c.x r)) (s : ℕ) :
    ∀ z ∈ c.chartWords r G s,
      z ∈ ⨆ j ≤ s, c.chartDlogpow r h (s - j) (c.pivotDerivs r h G j)
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero =>
    intro z hz
    have hmem : z ∈ c.pivotDerivs r h G 0 := Ideal.subset_span ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    have hle : c.pivotDerivs r h G 0 ≤
        ⨆ j ≤ 0, c.chartDlogpow r h (0 - j) (c.pivotDerivs r h G j) :=
      le_iSup₂_of_le 0 le_rfl le_rfl
    exact hle hmem
  | succ s ih =>
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · exact c.iSup_chartDlogpow_le_succ r h _ s (ih z hz)
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
