    obtain ⟨i, w, hw, rfl⟩ := hz
    
    have hsup : (⨆ j ≤ s, c.chartDlogpow r h (s - j) (c.pivotDerivs r h G j)) =
        Ideal.span (⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : j ≤ s),
          (c.chartDlogpow r h (s - j) (c.pivotDerivs r h G j) : Set (chartRing c.x r))) := by
      simp only [Ideal.span_iUnion, Ideal.span_eq]
    have hw' : w ∈ Ideal.span (⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : j ≤ s),
        (c.chartDlogpow r h (s - j) (c.pivotDerivs r h G j) : Set (chartRing c.x r))) :=
      hsup ▸ ih w hw
    refine (sup_le (hsup.symm.le.trans (c.iSup_chartDlogpow_le_succ r h _ s)) ?_)
      ((c.chartDerivRing r i).mem_span_sup_span_image _ hw')
    rw [Set.image_iUnion₂]
    simp only [Ideal.span_iUnion]
    refine iSup₂_le fun j hj => ?_
    by_cases hi : i = h
    · 
      rw [hi]
      refine (c.span_image_chartDlogpow_le r h _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
      · refine le_iSup₂_of_le j (hj.trans (Nat.le_succ s)) ?_
        rw [show s + 1 - j = s - j + 1 by omega]
        exact c.chartDlogpow_le_succ r h _ _
      · refine ((c.chartDlogpow_mono r h _ (c.span_image_pivotDerivs_le r h G j)).trans
          (c.chartDlogpow_sup_le r h _ _ _)).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
        · refine le_iSup₂_of_le j (hj.trans (Nat.le_succ s)) ?_
          rw [show s + 1 - j = s - j + 1 by omega]
          exact c.chartDlogpow_le_succ r h _ _
        · refine le_iSup₂_of_le (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hj) ?_
          rw [show s + 1 - (j + 1) = s - j by omega]
    · 
      refine le_iSup₂_of_le j (hj.trans (Nat.le_succ s)) ?_
      rw [show s + 1 - j = s - j + 1 by omega, chartDlogpow_succ, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartDlog r hi hz

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterate_chartD_transformIdeal_le
statement:
theorem iterate_chartD_transformIdeal_le {h : Fin n} (hh : h < r) {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) {s : ℕ} (hs : s ≤ m) :
    (c.chartD r)^[s] (transformIdeal c.x r I m) ≤
      ⨆ j ≤ s, c.chartDlogpow r h (s - j) (transformIdeal c.x r (c.Dpow j I) (m - j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [transformIdeal_eq_span_range_transformElem c.x r hI]
  refine (c.iterate_chartD_span_le r _ s).trans
    ((Ideal.span_le.mpr fun z hz => c.chartWords_subset_iSup r h _ s z hz).trans ?_)
  refine iSup₂_mono fun j hj => c.chartDlogpow_mono r h _ ?_
  rw [pivotDerivs, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact c.iterate_chartDerivRing_transformElem_mem r hh hI (hj.trans hs) hf

name: Derivation.quotientLinear_mk
statement:
theorem quotientLinear_mk (hJ : ∀ f ∈ J, D f ∈ J) (f : R) :
    D.quotientLinear J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J f) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (D f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quotientLinear, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, ← Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk,
    Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv_symm_mk]
  rfl

name: Derivation.quotientOfMapLE_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientOfMapLE_mk (hJ : ∀ f ∈ J, D f ∈ J) (f : R) :
    D.quotientOfMapLE J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J f) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (D f)
proof:
:=
  D.quotientLinear_mk J hJ f

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne
statement:
theorem pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne {j : Fin (k + 1)} (hj : j ≠ i₀) {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ span {c.x i₀}) : c.pderiv j f ∈ span {c.x i₀}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := mem_span_singleton.mp hf
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x, ite_eq_right hj, mul_zero, add_zero]
  exact mem_span_singleton.mpr (dvd_mul_right _ _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.quotientPderiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientPderiv_mk (j : Fin k) (f : R) :
    c.quotientPderiv i₀ j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) f) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) (c.pderiv (i₀.succAbove j) f)
proof:
:=
  Derivation.quotientOfMapLE_mk _ _ _ f

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.shiftPerm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftPerm_zero : shiftPerm i₀ 0 = i₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftPerm]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.shiftPerm_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftPerm_succ (j : Fin k) : shiftPerm i₀ j.succ = i₀.succAbove j
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftPerm]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_x_shiftPerm
statement: theorem span_x_shiftPerm : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range (c.x ∘ shiftPerm i₀))
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.span_x, (shiftPerm i₀).surjective.range_comp]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_image_lt_one
statement:
theorem span_image_lt_one :
    span ((c.x ∘ shiftPerm i₀) '' {j : Fin (k + 1) | j.val < 1}) = span {c.x i₀}
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {j : Fin (k + 1) | j.val < 1} = {0} := by
    ext j
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero]
    omega
  rw [hset, Set.image_singleton, Function.comp_apply, shiftPerm_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.ringKrullDim_quotient_span_x_add_one
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_span_x_add_one :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {c.x i₀}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  have h := ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_lt (c.x ∘ shiftPerm i₀) (c.span_x_shiftPerm i₀) c.card
    (i := 1) (by omega)
  rw [c.span_image_lt_one i₀, Nat.cast_one] at h
  exact h

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.withBot_eq_natCast_of_add_one_eq
statement:
theorem withBot_eq_natCast_of_add_one_eq {d : WithBot ℕ∞} {m : ℕ}
    (h : d + 1 = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) : d = (m : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  induction d using WithBot.recBotCoe with
  | bot =>
    rw [WithBot.bot_add, ← WithBot.coe_natCast] at h
    exact (WithBot.bot_ne_coe h).elim
  | coe e =>
    rw [← WithBot.coe_one, ← WithBot.coe_add, ← WithBot.coe_natCast, WithBot.coe_inj] at h
    induction e using ENat.recTopCoe with
    | top =>
      rw [top_add] at h
      exact absurd h.symm (ENat.natCast_ne_top _)
    | coe a =>
      have ha : a = m := by
        have h' : a + 1 = m + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
        omega
      subst ha
      exact WithBot.coe_natCast a

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.card_quotient_span_x
statement: theorem card_quotient_span_x : (k : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {c.x i₀})
proof:
:=
  (withBot_eq_natCast_of_add_one_eq
    ((c.ringKrullDim_quotient_span_x_add_one i₀).trans c.card.symm)).symm

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.maximalIdeal_quotient_span_x
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_quotient_span_x :
    maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {c.x i₀}) =
      span (Set.range fun j : Fin k =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) (c.x (i₀.succAbove j)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_maximalIdeal_quotient_span_image_lt (c.x ∘ shiftPerm i₀) (c.span_x_shiftPerm i₀) 1
  rw [c.span_image_lt_one i₀] at h
  rw [maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map, h]
  refine congrArg span (Set.ext fun g => ?_)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      subst h0
      simp at hj
    obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succ_eq.mpr hj0
    exact ⟨j', by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨j', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨j'.succ, by simp, by simp⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.quotientCoords_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientCoords_x (j : Fin k) :
    (c.quotientCoords i₀).x j = Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) (c.x (i₀.succAbove j))
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.quotientCoords_pderiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientCoords_pderiv (j : Fin k) :
    (c.quotientCoords i₀).pderiv j = c.quotientPderiv i₀ j
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.quotientCoords_pderiv_mk
statement:
theorem quotientCoords_pderiv_mk (j : Fin k) (f : R) :
    (c.quotientCoords i₀).pderiv j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) f) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) (c.pderiv (i₀.succAbove j) f)
proof:
:=
  c.quotientPderiv_mk i₀ j f

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_algebraMap_transformElem_le
statement:
theorem ordElem_algebraMap_transformElem_le (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing x r)) [𝔮.IsPrime]
    (h𝔮 : maximalIdeal R ≤ 𝔮.comap (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))) {m : ℕ} {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m) (hord : ordElem f = m) :
    ordElem (algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (transformElem x r f hf)) ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, heC, heX⟩ := exists_quotient_map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv x hx hn r
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hdeg, β, hβ⟩ := exists_transformElem_eq_chartPresentation x hx r hf hord
  
  let ψ : chartRing x r →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) (ResidueField R) :=
    e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)
  have hψ_surj : Function.Surjective ψ := e.surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hψ_apply : ∀ g, ψ g = e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ g) := fun g => rfl
  have hker : RingHom.ker ψ = (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) := by
    ext g
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, hψ_apply, map_eq_zero_iff e e.injective, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have hJ𝔮 : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) ≤ 𝔮 :=
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr h𝔮
  have hker𝔮 : RingHom.ker ψ ≤ 𝔮 := by
    rw [hker]
    exact hJ𝔮
  
  have hprime : (𝔮.map ψ).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hψ_surj hker𝔮
  have hcomap : 𝔮 = (𝔮.map ψ).comap ψ := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hψ_surj, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      sup_eq_left.mpr hker𝔮]
  
  have hPC : ∀ a : R, chartPresentation x r (C a) = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a := fun a =>
    (chartPresentation x r).commutes a
  have hPX : ∀ i : Fin r, chartPresentation x r (X i) = chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) :=
    fun i => MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ i
  have hψQ : ψ (transformElem x r f hf) = MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q := by
    rw [hQ]
    have h : ψ.comp (chartPresentation x r).toRingHom = MvPolynomial.map (residue R) := by
      refine ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
      · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, hPC a, map_C,
          hψ_apply]
        exact heC a
      · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, hPX i, map_X,
          hψ_apply]
        exact heX i
    have h' := RingHom.congr_fun h Q
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom] at h'
    exact h'
  have hP0 : MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := congrArg (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff · β) h0
    rw [coeff_map, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] at h1
    exact hβ (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h1)
  have hsub : (MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q).support ⊆ Q.support :=
    support_map_subset (residue R) Q
  have hPdeg' : (MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q).totalDegree ≤ Q.totalDegree := by
    unfold MvPolynomial.totalDegree
    exact Finset.sup_mono hsub
  have hPdeg : (MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q).totalDegree ≤ m := hPdeg'.trans hdeg
  
  have := hprime
  let Ψ : Localization.AtPrime 𝔮 →+* Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.map ψ) :=
    Localization.localRingHom 𝔮 (𝔮.map ψ) ψ hcomap
  have : IsLocalHom Ψ := Localization.isLocalHom_localRingHom 𝔮 (𝔮.map ψ) ψ hcomap
  have h1 : ordElem (algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (transformElem x r f hf))
      ≤ ordElem (Ψ (algebraMap _ _ (transformElem x r f hf))) := ordElem_le_ordElem_map Ψ _
  have h2 : Ψ (algebraMap _ _ (transformElem x r f hf)) =
      algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.map ψ)) (MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q) := by
    rw [← hψQ]
    exact Localization.localRingHom_to_map 𝔮 (𝔮.map ψ) ψ hcomap _
  have h3 : ordElem (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.map ψ)) (MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q))
      ≤ ((MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q).totalDegree : ℕ∞) :=
    ordElem_algebraMap_le_totalDegree _ hP0
  refine h1.trans ?_
  rw [h2]
  exact h3.trans (by exact_mod_cast hPdeg)

name: IsLocalRing.ord_map_transformIdeal_le_of_le_comap
statement:
theorem ord_map_transformIdeal_le_of_le_comap (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing x r)) [𝔮.IsPrime]
    (h𝔮 : maximalIdeal R ≤ 𝔮.comap (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))) {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m) (hord : ord I = m) :
    ord ((transformIdeal x r I m).map (algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮))) ≤
      m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hfI, hf⟩ := exists_mem_ordElem_eq_of_ord_eq hord
  refine le_trans ?_ (ordElem_algebraMap_transformElem_le x hx hn r 𝔮 h𝔮 (hI hfI) hf)
  rw [← ord_span_singleton]
  exact ord_anti (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
    (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (transformElem_mem_transformIdeal x r hfI (hI hfI)))))

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_le_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_le_of_isIntegral (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.IsIntegral) :
    ringKrullDim B ≤ ringKrullDim A
proof:
:= by
  let _ := f.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := ⟨hf⟩
  refine Order.krullDim_le_of_strictMono (PrimeSpectrum.comap f) ?_
  intro p q hpq
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal] at hpq ⊢
  exact Ideal.IsIntegral.under_lt_under (R := A) hpq

name: IsLocalRing.exists_comap_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_comap_eq_of_le (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.IsIntegral) (P : PrimeSpectrum A)
    (Q₀ : Ideal B) (hle : Ideal.comap f Q₀ ≤ P.asIdeal) :
    ∃ Q : PrimeSpectrum B, Q₀ ≤ Q.asIdeal ∧ PrimeSpectrum.comap f Q = P
proof:
:= by
  let _ := f.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := ⟨hf⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ₀, hQprime, hQ⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral (S := B) P.asIdeal Q₀ hle
  exact ⟨⟨Q, hQprime⟩, hQ₀, PrimeSpectrum.ext hQ⟩

name: IsLocalRing.exists_ltSeries_comap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ltSeries_comap_eq (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.IsIntegral) (hinj : Function.Injective f)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ l : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum A), ∀ hl : l.length = n,
      ∃ (m : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum B)) (hm : m.length = n),
        ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
          PrimeSpectrum.comap f (m (Fin.cast (by rw [hm]) i)) = l (Fin.cast (by rw [hl]) i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨Q, -, hQ⟩ := exists_comap_eq_of_le f hf l.head ⊥ (by
      rw [Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective f hinj]
      exact bot_le)
    refine ⟨RelSeries.singleton _ Q, rfl, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hi : i = 0 := Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp i.2)
    subst hi
    exact hQ
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l hl
    have hl0 : l.length ≠ 0 := by omega
    obtain ⟨m', hm', hcomap⟩ := ih l.eraseLast (by simp [RelSeries.eraseLast_length, hl])
    have hlast : PrimeSpectrum.comap f m'.last = l.eraseLast.last := by
      have := hcomap (Fin.last n)
      simpa [RelSeries.last, Fin.last, hm', RelSeries.eraseLast_length, hl] using this
    have hlt : l.eraseLast.last < l.last := l.eraseLast_last_rel_last hl0
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ₀, hQ⟩ := exists_comap_eq_of_le f hf l.last m'.last.asIdeal (by
      rw [← PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, hlast]
      exact hlt.le)
    have hQlt : m'.last < Q := by
      rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal]
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne hQ₀ fun heq => ?_
      have h1 : PrimeSpectrum.comap f m'.last = PrimeSpectrum.comap f Q := by
        ext1; simp only [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, heq]
      rw [hlast, hQ] at h1
      exact hlt.ne h1
    subst hm'
    refine ⟨m'.snoc Q hQlt, by simp, fun i => ?_⟩
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [show (Fin.last (m'.length + 1) : Fin (m'.snoc Q hQlt).length.succ) =
          Fin.last (m'.snoc Q hQlt).length from rfl]
      erw [RelSeries.last_snoc']
      rw [hQ]
      change l (Fin.last l.length) = l _
      congr 1
      ext
      rw [Fin.val_last]
      exact hl
    · erw [RelSeries.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (hcomap j).trans rfl

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegral_of_injective
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegral_of_injective (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.IsIntegral)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) : ringKrullDim B = ringKrullDim A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (ringKrullDim_le_of_isIntegral f hf) ?_
  unfold ringKrullDim Order.krullDim
  refine iSup_le fun l => ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm, -⟩ := exists_ltSeries_comap_eq f hf hinj l.length l rfl
  rw [← hm]
  exact le_iSup (fun p : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum B) => (p.length : WithBot ℕ∞)) m

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_eq_of_finite_of_injective
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_eq_of_finite_of_injective (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.Finite)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) : ringKrullDim B = ringKrullDim A
proof:
:=
  ringKrullDim_eq_of_isIntegral_of_injective f hf.to_isIntegral hinj

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_le_of_finite
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_le_of_finite (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.Finite) :
    ringKrullDim B ≤ ringKrullDim A
proof:
:=
  ringKrullDim_le_of_isIntegral f hf.to_isIntegral

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_krullDim_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_krullDim_zeroLocus (I : Ideal R) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) = Order.krullDim (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (I : Set R))
proof:
:=
  Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (Ideal.primeSpectrumQuotientOrderIsoZeroLocus I)

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_radical
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_radical (I : Ideal R) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I.radical) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_krullDim_zeroLocus, ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_krullDim_zeroLocus]
  exact Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (Set.orderIsoOfEq _ _ (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_radical I))

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_quotient_of_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_quotient_of_le {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
  ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.factor h) (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective h)

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_iSup_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_iSup_minimalPrimes (I : Ideal R) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) = ⨆ P ∈ I.minimalPrimes, ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_krullDim_zeroLocus]
    unfold Order.krullDim
    refine iSup_le fun l => ?_
    
    have hI : I ≤ (l.head : PrimeSpectrum R).asIdeal := by
      have := (l.head).2
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus] at this
      exact this
    have : ((l.head : PrimeSpectrum R).asIdeal).IsPrime := (l.head : PrimeSpectrum R).2
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPle⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hI
    
    have hsub : ∀ i, (l i : PrimeSpectrum R) ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (P : Set R) := by
      intro i
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus]
      refine hPle.trans ?_
      have hmono : l.head ≤ l i := l.head_le i
      exact hmono
    let m : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (P : Set R)) :=
      { length := l.length
        toFun := fun i => ⟨(l i : PrimeSpectrum R), hsub i⟩
        step := fun i => l.step i }
    calc ((l.length : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = m.length := rfl
      _ ≤ Order.krullDim (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (P : Set R)) :=
          Order.LTSeries.length_le_krullDim m
      _ = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) := (ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_krullDim_zeroLocus P).symm
      _ ≤ ⨆ P ∈ I.minimalPrimes, ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) :=
          le_iSup₂ (f := fun P _ => ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P)) P hP
  · refine iSup₂_le fun P hP => ?_
    exact ringKrullDim_quotient_le_quotient_of_le hP.1.2

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_zero_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_zero_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical [IsLocalRing R] (J : Ideal R)
    (hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ≤ J.radical) : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (R ⧸ J) := by
    rw [Ideal.krullDimLE_zero_quotient_iff_forall_minimalPrimes_isMaximal]
    intro P hP
    have hPprime : P.IsPrime := hP.1.1
    have hle : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ≤ P := hm.trans (hPprime.radical_le_iff.mpr hP.1.2)
    rw [le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hPprime.ne_top) hle]
    exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _
  have h := Ring.krullDimLE_iff.mp this
  simpa using h

name: IsLocalRing.map_quotientMk_le_jacobson_of_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem map_quotientMk_le_jacobson_of_le_maximalIdeal [IsLocalRing R] (I B : Ideal R)
    (hBm : B ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) B ≤ Ring.jacobson (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_sInf fun M hM => ?_
  have hc : (Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) M).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective (H := ⟨hM⟩) _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hc]
  exact hBm

name: IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_map_span_range_le
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_map_span_range_le {d : ℕ} (I : Ideal R) (g : Fin d → R) :
    (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (Ideal.span (Set.range g))).spanFinrank ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_range _)).trans ?_
  rw [← Set.image_univ, ← Finset.coe_univ, ← Finset.coe_image, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical_sup
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical_sup [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {d : ℕ} (I : Ideal R)
    (s : Fin d → R) (hs : ∀ j, s j ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ≤ (I ⊔ Ideal.span (Set.range s)).radical) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hBm : Ideal.span (Set.range s) ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact hs j
  have h0 := ringKrullDim_quotient_le_zero_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical _ hm
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank _
    (map_quotientMk_le_jacobson_of_le_maximalIdeal I _ hBm)
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup I _)] at hdim
  have hrank := spanFinrank_map_span_range_le I s
  have hcast : ((Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (Ideal.span (Set.range s))).spanFinrank :
      WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← WithBot.coe_natCast, ← WithBot.coe_natCast]
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (Nat.cast_le.mpr hrank)
  refine hdim.trans ?_
  refine (add_le_add h0 hcast).trans ?_
  rw [zero_add]

name: IsLocalRing.formallySmooth_rat_of_field
statement:
theorem formallySmooth_rat_of_field (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] :
    Algebra.FormallySmooth ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  have : FaithfulSMul ℚ K :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective ℚ K).mpr (algebraMap ℚ K).injective
  have : CharZero K := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap ℚ K).injective
  obtain ⟨ι, v, hv⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' ℚ K
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range v)) K := hv.isAlgebraic_field
  have : CharZero (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range v)) :=
    (algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range v)) K).charZero
  exact Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_algebraicIndependent_of_isSeparable hv.1

name: IsLocalRing.sub_algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem sub_algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal [Algebra (ResidueField R) R̂]
    (hι : IsCoefficientAlgebra R) (y : R̂) :
    y - algebraMap (ResidueField R) R̂ ((residueFieldEquiv R).symm (residue R̂ y)) ∈
      maximalIdeal R̂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  change residue R̂ y =
    residue R̂ (algebraMap (ResidueField R) R̂ ((residueFieldEquiv R).symm (residue R̂ y)))
  rw [hι, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: IsLocalRing.exists_coefficientField
statement:
theorem exists_coefficientField :
    ∃ σ : ResidueField R →+* R̂, ∀ k, residue R̂ (σ k) = residueFieldEquiv R k
proof:
:= by
  have := formallySmooth_rat_of_field (ResidueField R)
  let f : ResidueField R →ₐ[ℚ] R̂ ⧸ maximalIdeal R̂ :=
    { toRingHom := (residueFieldEquiv R : ResidueField R →+* ResidueField R̂)
      commutes' := fun q => RingHom.map_rat_algebraMap _ q }
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Algebra.FormallySmooth.exists_mkₐ_comp_eq_of_isAdicComplete
    (R := ℚ) (A := ResidueField R) (S := R̂) (I := maximalIdeal R̂) f
  refine ⟨g.toRingHom, fun k => ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => φ k) hg
  exact h

name: IsLocalRing.residue_coefficientField
statement:
theorem residue_coefficientField (k : ResidueField R) :
    residue R̂ (coefficientField R k) = residueFieldEquiv R k
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_coefficientField R) k

name: IsLocalRing.sub_coefficientField_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem sub_coefficientField_mem_maximalIdeal (y : R̂) :
    y - coefficientField R ((residueFieldEquiv R).symm (residue R̂ y)) ∈ maximalIdeal R̂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  change residue R̂ y = residue R̂ (coefficientField R ((residueFieldEquiv R).symm (residue R̂ y)))
  rw [residue_coefficientField, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Derivation.blowupLift_preservesIdeal_map
statement:
theorem blowupLift_preservesIdeal_map (hδ : δ.PreservesIdeal J) :
    (δ.blowupLift x r).PreservesIdeal (J.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)))
proof:
:= by
  have hδ' : (x r • δ).PreservesIdeal J := (Derivation.preserving k J).smul_mem (x r) hδ
  exact hδ'.map_of_forall (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) _ fun a => by
    rw [blowupLift_algebraMap, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: Derivation.blowupLift_pow_algebraMap_mem
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  | succ i =>
    rw [Derivation.leibniz_pow, Nat.add_sub_cancel, blowupLift_algebraMap, map_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
    exact nsmul_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)) _

name: Derivation.blowupLift_preservesIdeal_saturation
statement:
theorem blowupLift_preservesIdeal_saturation (hδ : δ.PreservesIdeal J) :
    (δ.blowupLift x r).PreservesIdeal (⨆ i : ℕ, (J.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).colon
      ((Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ i : Ideal (chartRing x r)) :
        Set (chartRing x r)))
proof:
:= by
  have hJR := blowupLift_preservesIdeal_map x r δ J hδ
  have hmono : Monotone fun i : ℕ => (J.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).colon
      ((Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ i : Ideal (chartRing x r)) :
        Set (chartRing x r)) :=
    fun i j hij => Submodule.colon_mono le_rfl (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hij)
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ hmono.directed_le).mp hz
  refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i (Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun w hw => ?_)
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at hw
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hw
  have hzy : z * algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ i ∈
      J.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) := by
    have := Submodule.mem_colon.mp hi (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ i)
      (by rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rwa [smul_eq_mul] at this
  have hD := hJR _ hzy
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hD
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (blowupLift_pow_algebraMap_mem x r δ i)
  have h1 : z * δ.blowupLift x r (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ i) ∈
      J.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) := by
    rw [← hc', mul_left_comm]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hzy
  have h2 := (Ideal.add_mem_iff_right _ h1).mp hD
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (by rwa [mul_comm] at h2)

name: Derivation.transformIdeal_logDerivative_le
statement:
theorem transformIdeal_logDerivative_le {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    transformIdeal x r (Ideal.logDerivative k J I) m ≤
      Ideal.logDerivative k
        (⨆ i : ℕ, (J.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).colon
          ((Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ i : Ideal (chartRing x r)) :
            Set (chartRing x r)))
        (transformIdeal x r I (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hD : Ideal.logDerivative k J I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m :=
    (Ideal.logDerivative_le_derivative J I).trans (Ideal.derivative_le_pow hI)
  
  have key : (Ideal.logDerivative k J I).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) ≤
      Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m} *
        Ideal.logDerivative k
          (⨆ i : ℕ, (J.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).colon
            ((Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ i : Ideal (chartRing x r)) :
              Set (chartRing x r)))
          (transformIdeal x r I (m + 1)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    refine Ideal.logDerivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun f hf => ?_, fun δ hδ f hf => ?_⟩
    · rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r f (hI hf), pow_succ, mul_assoc]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) (Ideal.le_logDerivative _ _
        (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (transformElem_mem_transformIdeal x r hf (hI hf))))
    · rw [Ideal.mem_comap,
        ← algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r (δ f) (derivation_mem_pow δ _ m (hI hf)),
        transformElem_derivation x r δ (hI hf)]
      refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) (Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ ?_)
      · exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_logDerivative
          (blowupLift_preservesIdeal_saturation x r δ J hδ)
          (transformElem_mem_transformIdeal x r hf (hI hf))
      · rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
        exact Ideal.le_logDerivative _ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
          (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (transformElem_mem_transformIdeal x r hf (hI hf))))
  intro z hz
  have h1 : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * z ∈
      Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m} *
        Ideal.logDerivative k
          (⨆ i : ℕ, (J.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).colon
            ((Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ i : Ideal (chartRing x r)) :
              Set (chartRing x r)))
          (transformIdeal x r I (m + 1)) := by
    apply key
    rw [← span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hD, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mpr ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mp h1
  rwa [← algebraMap_pow_mul_right_injective x r m hwz]

name: IsLocalRing.algHom_ext_of_residue_eq
statement:
theorem algHom_ext_of_residue_eq {k A B : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B] [Algebra.FormallyUnramified k A] [IsLocalRing B]
    [IsHausdorff (maximalIdeal B) B] (σ₁ σ₂ : A →ₐ[k] B)
    (h : ∀ a, residue B (σ₁ a) = residue B (σ₂ a)) : σ₁ = σ₂
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a, σ₁ a - σ₂ a ∈ maximalIdeal B ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro a; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro a
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · rw [zero_add, pow_one]
        exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp (h a)
      · set J : Ideal B := maximalIdeal B ^ (n + 1) with hJ
        set I : Ideal (B ⧸ J) := (maximalIdeal B ^ n).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) with hI
        have hI2 : I ^ 2 = ⊥ := by
          rw [hI, ← Ideal.map_pow, ← pow_mul]
          exact Ideal.map_mk_eq_bot_of_le (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega))
        have hinj := Algebra.FormallyUnramified.comp_injective (R := k) (A := A) I hI2
        have e : (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I).comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k J).comp σ₁) =
            (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I).comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k J).comp σ₂) := by
          refine AlgHom.ext fun b => ?_
          simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk]
          rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← map_sub]
          exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (ih b)
        have e' := AlgHom.congr_fun (hinj e) a
        simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] at e'
        exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp e'
  refine AlgHom.ext fun a => ?_
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine IsHausdorff.haus ‹IsHausdorff (maximalIdeal B) B› _ fun m => ?_
  rw [SModEq.zero, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  exact key m a

name: Ideal.mul_ne_top_iff
statement:
theorem Ideal.mul_ne_top_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I J : Ideal R) :
    I * J ≠ ⊤ ↔ I ≠ ⊤ ∨ J ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    rw [not_or, not_not, not_not] at hc
    exact h (by rw [hc.1, hc.2, Ideal.top_mul])
  · rintro (hI | hJ) heq
    · have h1 : I * J ≤ I := Ideal.mul_le_left
      rw [heq] at h1
      exact hI (top_le_iff.mp h1)
    · have h1 : I * J ≤ J := Ideal.mul_le_right
      rw [heq] at h1
      exact hJ (top_le_iff.mp h1)

name: IsLocalRing.prod_dvd_of_prime_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem prod_dvd_of_prime_of_not_dvd (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (f i))
    (hnd : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → ¬ f i ∣ f j) {z : R} (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ∣ z) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, f i ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing z with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s has ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert has]
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hz a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have ht : ∀ j ∈ s, f j ∣ t := by
      intro j hj
      have hja : j ≠ a := fun h => has (h ▸ hj)
      have hdvd : f j ∣ f a * t := hz j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      rcases (hp j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)).dvd_or_dvd hdvd with h | h
      · exact absurd h (hnd j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) hja)
      · exact h
    exact mul_dvd_mul_left (f a) (ih (fun i hi => hp i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
      (fun i hi j hj hij => hnd i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) hij)
      ht)

name: IsLocalRing.minimalPrimes_span_prod
proof:
:= by
  have hPp : P.IsPrime := hP.1.1
  have hmem : ∏ i ∈ s, p i ∈ P := hP.1.2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hpi⟩ := Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff.mp hmem
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
  have hprime : (Ideal.span {p i}).IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (hp i hi).ne_zero).mpr (hp i hi)
  have hle : Ideal.span {∏ i ∈ s, p i} ≤ Ideal.span {p i} :=
    Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem p hi)
  have hP' : Minimal (fun q : Ideal R => q.IsPrime ∧ Ideal.span {∏ i ∈ s, p i} ≤ q) P := hP
  exact hP'.eq_of_ge ⟨hprime, hle⟩ ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).mpr hpi)

name: IsLocalRing.mem_minimalPrimes_span_prod
statement:
theorem mem_minimalPrimes_span_prod {s : Finset ι} {p : ι → R} (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (p i))
    (hnd : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → ¬ p i ∣ p j) {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) :
    Ideal.span {p j} ∈ (Ideal.span {∏ i ∈ s, p i}).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  change Minimal (fun q : Ideal R => q.IsPrime ∧ Ideal.span {∏ i ∈ s, p i} ≤ q) (Ideal.span {p j})
  refine ⟨⟨(Ideal.span_singleton_prime (hp j hj).ne_zero).mpr (hp j hj),
    Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem p hj)⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro P ⟨hP, hle⟩ hPj
  have hmem : ∏ i ∈ s, p i ∈ P := hle (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hpk⟩ := Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff.mp hmem
  have hkj : Ideal.span {p k} ≤ Ideal.span {p j} :=
    ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).mpr hpk).trans hPj
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · subst hjk
    exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).mpr hpk
  · exact absurd (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mp hkj) (hnd j hj k hk hjk)

name: IsLocalRing.isRadical_span_prod
statement:
theorem isRadical_span_prod {s : Finset ι} {p : ι → R} (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (p i))
    (hnd : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → ¬ p i ∣ p j) :
    (Ideal.span {∏ i ∈ s, p i}).IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp hr
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hm ⊢
  exact prod_dvd_of_prime_of_not_dvd s p hp hnd fun i hi =>
    (hp i hi).dvd_of_dvd_pow ((Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem p hi).trans hm)

name: IsLocalRing.exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast
statement:
theorem exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [FiniteRingKrullDim R] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim R = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp (ringKrullDim_ne_bot (R := R))
  have ha' : a ≠ ⊤ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact ringKrullDim_ne_top (R := R) ha.symm
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp ha'
  exact ⟨n, by rw [← ha, ← hn]; rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.isLocalRing_quotient_of_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_quotient_of_le_maximalIdeal {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI)
  exact IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map (I : Ideal R) [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I)] :
    maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) = (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
proof:
:=
  (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).symm

name: IsLocalRing.exists_span_insert_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_span_insert_eq_maximalIdeal {x : R} (mem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (nmem : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    ∃ t : Finset R, (t : Set R) ⊆ maximalIdeal R ∧ t.card + 1 = (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ∧
      maximalIdeal R = span (insert x (t : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hspan⟩ :=
    Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank (maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  have hspan : span (s : Set R) = maximalIdeal R := hspan
  have hs : (s : Set R) ⊆ maximalIdeal R := hspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span
  obtain ⟨f, -, hf⟩ :=
    Submodule.mem_span_finset.mp (show x ∈ span (s : Set R) from hspan ▸ mem)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hf
  have : ∃ i ∈ s, f i ∉ maximalIdeal R := by
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    apply nmem
    rw [← hf, pow_two]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i hi => Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hall i hi) (hs hi)
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, hu⟩ := this
  rw [IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal] at hu
  refine ⟨s.erase i₀, fun y hy => hs (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hy)),
    (Finset.card_erase_add_one hi₀).trans hcard, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [← hspan, Ideal.span_le]
    intro i hi
    by_cases h : i = i₀
    · subst h
      have hsum : f i * i + ∑ j ∈ s.erase i, f j * j = x := by
        rw [← hf]; exact Finset.add_sum_erase s (fun j => f j * j) hi
      have hx' : x ∈ span (insert x ((s.erase i : Finset R) : Set R)) :=
        Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      have hsum' : ∑ j ∈ s.erase i, f j * j ∈ span (insert x ((s.erase i : Finset R) : Set R)) :=
        Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j hj =>
          Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
            (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hj)))
      have hfi : f i * i = x - ∑ j ∈ s.erase i, f j * j := eq_sub_of_add_eq hsum
      have : f i * i ∈ span (insert x ((s.erase i : Finset R) : Set R)) := by
        rw [hfi]; exact Ideal.sub_mem _ hx' hsum'
      exact (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem _ hu).mp this
    · exact Ideal.subset_span
        (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨h, hi⟩)))
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro y (rfl | hy)
    · exact mem
    · exact hs (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)))

name: IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_quotient_add_one_le
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_quotient_add_one_le {x : R} (mem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (nmem : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ span {x})] :
    (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 ≤ (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, -, hcard, hspan⟩ := exists_span_insert_eq_maximalIdeal mem nmem
  rw [← hcard, maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map, hspan, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_insert_eq,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x), Ideal.span_insert_zero]
  refine Nat.add_le_add_right ?_ 1
  calc (span ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {x})) '' (t : Set R))).spanFinrank
      ≤ ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {x})) '' (t : Set R)).ncard :=
        Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (t.finite_toSet.image _)
    _ ≤ (t : Set R).ncard := Set.ncard_image_le t.finite_toSet
    _ = t.card := Set.ncard_coe_finset t

name: IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_quotient_add_one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, htcard, htspan⟩ :=
    Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank
      (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x})).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  have htspan : span (t : Set (R ⧸ span {x})) = maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x}) := htspan
  set mk := Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {x}) with hmk
  set t' : Set R := Function.surjInv Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective '' (t : Set (R ⧸ span {x}))
    with ht'
  have himg : mk '' t' = t := by
    rw [ht', ← Set.image_comp, Function.comp_surjInv, Set.image_id]
  have ht'fin : t'.Finite := t.finite_toSet.image _
  have hspan : maximalIdeal R = span (insert x t') := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro y hy
      have hy' : mk y ∈ span (mk '' t') := by
        rw [himg, htspan, maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map]
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hy
      rw [← Ideal.map_span, Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective] at hy'
      obtain ⟨y', hy'mem, hyy'⟩ := hy'
      have hsub : y - y' ∈ span {x} := Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp hyy'.symm
      rw [Ideal.span_insert, show y = (y - y') + y' by ring]
      exact Submodule.add_mem_sup hsub hy'mem
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro y (rfl | hy)
      · exact hx
      · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hy
        have hmkq : mk (Function.surjInv Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q) = q :=
          Function.surjInv_eq _ _
        by_contra hnot
        have hu : IsUnit (Function.surjInv Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q) :=
          IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hnot
        have hqm : q ∈ maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x}) := htspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span hq
        exact IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr (hmkq ▸ hu.map mk) hqm
  rw [hspan]
  calc (span (insert x t')).spanFinrank
      ≤ (insert x t').ncard := Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (ht'fin.insert x)
    _ ≤ t'.ncard + 1 := Set.ncard_insert_le x t'
    _ ≤ (t : Set (R ⧸ span {x})).ncard + 1 :=
        Nat.add_le_add_right (Set.ncard_image_le t.finite_toSet) 1
    _ = t.card + 1 := by rw [Set.ncard_coe_finset]
    _ = (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 := by rw [htcard]

name: IsLocalRing.exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq_notMem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq_notMem_minimalPrimes [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (h : 0 < ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ x ∈ maximalIdeal R, x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 ∧ ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, x ∉ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : (minimalPrimes R).Finite := minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing (R := R)
  set S : Finset (Ideal R) := insert (maximalIdeal R ^ 2) hfin.toFinset with hS
  have hprime : ∀ i ∈ S, i ≠ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 → i ≠ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 → i.IsPrime := by
    intro i hi hne _
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with h' | h'
    · exact absurd h' hne
    · exact IsMinimalPrime.isPrime (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp h')
  have hnot : ¬ ((maximalIdeal R : Set R) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ (S : Set (Ideal R)), (i : Set R)) := by
    rw [Ideal.subset_union_prime (maximalIdeal R ^ 2) (maximalIdeal R ^ 2) hprime]
    rintro ⟨i, hi, hle⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi'
    · exact lt_irrefl _
        ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_sq_lt_of_ringKrullDim_ne_zero h.ne').trans_le hle)
    · have hmin : i ∈ minimalPrimes R := hfin.mem_toFinset.mp hi'
      have hip : i.IsPrime := IsMinimalPrime.isPrime hmin
      have heq : i = maximalIdeal R := le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hip.ne_top) hle
      rw [heq] at hmin
      have h0 : (maximalIdeal R).height = 0 := Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff.mpr hmin
      have : ringKrullDim R = 0 := by
        rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, h0]; rfl
      exact h.ne' this
  rw [Set.not_subset] at hnot
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxU⟩ := hnot
  refine ⟨x, hx, fun hx2 => hxU ?_, fun p hp hxp => hxU ?_⟩
  · exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) hx2
  · exact Set.mem_biUnion
      (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hp))) hxp

name: IsRegularLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ span {x}) :=
    isLocalRing_quotient_of_le_maximalIdeal ((span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr mem)
  have hsf := spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_quotient_add_one_le mem nmem
  have hreg : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
  have hle : ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {x}) + 1 := by
    refine (ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank (span {x}) ?_).trans
      (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
    · rw [IsLocalRing.ringJacobson_eq_maximalIdeal R]
      exact (span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr mem
    · have h1 : (span {x}).spanFinrank ≤ 1 :=
        (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_singleton x)).trans_eq
          (Set.ncard_singleton x)
      exact_mod_cast h1
  have hQle : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {x}) ≤
      ((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x})).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal _
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (R ⧸ span {x})
  rw [hm] at hle hQle
  rw [← hreg] at hle
  have h1 : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ≤ m + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hle
  have h2 : m ≤ (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x})).spanFinrank := by exact_mod_cast hQle
  have h3 : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x})).spanFinrank = m := by omega
  refine ⟨IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le _ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hm, h3]
  · rw [hm, ← hreg]
    have : m + 1 = (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this

name: IsLocalRing.isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing_of_ringKrullDim_eq
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing_of_ringKrullDim_eq (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R], ringKrullDim R = n → IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro R _ _ h
    have h0 : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = 0 := by
      have := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
      rw [h] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hbot : maximalIdeal R = ⊥ :=
      (Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot (maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing).mp h0
    have : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := hbot ▸ (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).isPrime
    exact IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime R
  | succ n ih =>
    intro R _ _ h
    have hpos : 0 < ringKrullDim R := by
      rw [h]; exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
    obtain ⟨x, mem, nmem, hmin⟩ :=
      exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq_notMem_minimalPrimes hpos
    obtain ⟨hQ, hdim⟩ := IsRegularLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton mem nmem
    have := hQ
    have hQn : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {x}) = n := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (R ⧸ span {x})
      rw [hm, h] at hdim
      have : m + 1 = n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hdim
      rw [hm, Nat.succ_inj.mp this]
    have hdom : IsDomain (R ⧸ span {x}) := ih _ hQn
    have hprime : (span {x}).IsPrime := (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp hdom
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPle⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := ⊥) (J := span {x}) bot_le
    have hPprime : P.IsPrime := IsMinimalPrime.isPrime hP
    have hxP : x ∉ P := hmin P hP
    have hle : P ≤ span {x} • P := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := mem_span_singleton'.mp (hPle hy)
      have hz : z ∈ P := (hPprime.mem_or_mem hy).resolve_right hxP
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul (mem_span_singleton_self x) hz
    have hjac : span {x} ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥ :=
      ((span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr mem).trans (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _)
    have hPbot : P = ⊥ :=
      Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (span {x}) P P.fg_of_isNoetherianRing hle hjac
    have : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := hPbot ▸ hPprime
    exact IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime R

name: IsLocalRing.isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] :
    IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast R
  exact isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing_of_ringKrullDim_eq n R hn

name: IsRegularLocalRing.of_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem _root_.IsRegularLocalRing.of_quotient_span_singleton [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (reg : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors R)
    (hq : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ span {x})) :
    IsRegularLocalRing R ∧ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {x}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  have hdim :=
    ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors reg hx
  refine ⟨?_, hdim⟩
  have := hq
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  have h1 := spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_quotient_add_one hx
  have h2 : ((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x})).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {x}) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R ⧸ span {x})
  calc ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞)
      ≤ (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast h1
    _ = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {x}) + 1 := by push_cast; rw [h2]
    _ = ringKrullDim R := hdim

name: IsLocalRing.prod_pow_mem_pow_sum
statement:
theorem prod_pow_mem_pow_sum {B : Type*} [CommRing B] {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → B)
    (k : ι → ℕ) (J : Ideal B) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ J) : ∏ i ∈ s, a i ^ k i ∈ J ^ (∑ i ∈ s, k i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert j s hj ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hj, Finset.sum_insert hj, pow_add]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (ha j) _) ih

name: IsLocalRing.comap_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem comap_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    (e : A ≃+* B) : (maximalIdeal B).comap (e : A →+* B) = maximalIdeal A
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal,
    mem_nonunits_iff, mem_nonunits_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h hx
    exact h (hx.map e)
  · intro h hx
    apply h
    have := hx.map e.symm
    rwa [RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this

name: Ideal.map_eq_of_map_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.map_eq_of_map_le (e : A ≃+* A) (J : Ideal A) (h : J.map (e : A →+* A) ≤ J) :
    J.map (e : A →+* A) = J
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : J ≤ J.comap (e : A →+* A) := Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp h
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, ((e ^ (n + 1) : A ≃+* A) : A →+* A) =
      (e : A →+* A).comp ((e ^ n : A ≃+* A) : A →+* A) := fun n => by
    ext x
    rw [pow_succ']
    rfl
  let S : ℕ →o Ideal A :=
    ⟨fun n => J.comap ((e ^ n : A ≃+* A) : A →+* A), monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => by
      rw [hpow, ← Ideal.comap_comap]
      exact Ideal.comap_mono h1⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr inferInstance S
  have hNN := hN (N + 1) (Nat.le_succ N)
  change J.comap _ = J.comap _ at hNN
  rw [hpow, ← Ideal.comap_comap] at hNN
  have hJ : J = J.comap (e : A →+* A) :=
    Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective ((e ^ N : A ≃+* A) : A →+* A) (e ^ N).surjective hNN
  conv_lhs => rw [hJ]
  exact Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective (e : A →+* A) e.surjective J

name: IsLocalRing.adicCompletion_isLinearOver
statement: theorem adicCompletion_isLinearOver : c.adicCompletion.IsLinearOver k
proof:
:= fun i a =>
  adicCompletion_algebraMap_eq_zero (c.pderiv i) (hk i) a

name: IsLocalRing.adicCompletion_pderiv_coefficientField
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_pderiv_coefficientField [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (ResidueField R)] (i : Fin d)
    (a : ResidueField R) : c.adicCompletion.pderiv i (σ a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let δ : Derivation k R̂ R̂ := c.adicCompletion.pderivOver (adicCompletion_isLinearOver c hk) i
  have hP0 : Polynomial.aeval (σ a) (minpoly k a) = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, minpoly.aeval, map_zero]
  have h1 := δ.map_aeval (minpoly k a) (σ a)
  rw [hP0, map_zero] at h1
  have hne : Polynomial.aeval a (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly k a)) ≠ 0 :=
    (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable k a).aeval_derivative_ne_zero (minpoly.aeval k a)
  have hu : IsUnit (Polynomial.aeval (σ a) (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly k a))) := by
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply]
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne).map σ
  have h2 : Polynomial.aeval (σ a) (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly k a)) * δ (σ a) = 0 := by
    rw [← smul_eq_mul]
    exact h1.symm
  exact (hu.mul_right_eq_zero).mp h2

name: IsLocalRing.cohenAlgEquivCoords_pderiv
statement:
theorem cohenAlgEquivCoords_pderiv [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (ResidueField R)] (i : Fin d)
    (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R)) :
    cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ (pderiv (R := ResidueField R) i F) =
      c.adicCompletion.pderiv i (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ F)
proof:
:= by
  set Φ := cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ with hΦ
  have hC : ∀ a, Φ (C a) = σ a := cohenAlgEquivOver_C σ hσ c.x c.span_x c.card
  have hX : ∀ j, Φ (X j) = algebraMap R R̂ (c.x j) := cohenAlgEquivOver_X σ hσ c.x c.span_x c.card
  have hkill : ∀ a, c.adicCompletion.pderiv i (σ a) = 0 :=
    adicCompletion_pderiv_coefficientField c hk σ i
  have hsymmC : ∀ a, Φ.symm (σ a) = C a := fun a => by rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, hC]
  
  let δ : Derivation (ResidueField R) (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R))
      (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R)) :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := fun F => Φ.symm (c.adicCompletion.pderiv i (Φ F))
          map_add' := fun F G => by rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]
          map_smul' := fun a F => by
            simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
            rw [smul_eq_C_mul, map_mul, hC, Derivation.leibniz, hkill, smul_zero, add_zero,
              smul_eq_mul, map_mul, hsymmC, smul_eq_C_mul] }
      map_one_eq_zero' := by
        simp only [LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
        rw [map_one, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, map_zero]
      leibniz' := fun F G => by
        simp only [LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
        rw [map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, map_add, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, map_mul,
          AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] }
  have hδX : ∀ j, δ (X j) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := fun j => by
    have h1 : c.adicCompletion.pderiv i (algebraMap R R̂ (c.x j)) = if i = j then 1 else 0 :=
      c.adicCompletion_pderiv_x i j
    change Φ.symm (c.adicCompletion.pderiv i (Φ (X j))) = _
    rw [hX, h1]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hspans := mvPowerSeries_spansDerivations (ResidueField R) d δ F
  have hδF : δ F = pderiv (R := ResidueField R) i F := by
    rw [hspans]
    simp only [RegularCoords.mvPowerSeries, Derivation.restrictScalars_apply, hδX, ite_mul, one_mul,
      zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  have : Φ.symm (c.adicCompletion.pderiv i (Φ F)) = pderiv (R := ResidueField R) i F := hδF
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq] at this
  exact this.symm

name: IsLocalRing.D_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords
statement:
theorem D_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (ResidueField R)]
    (J : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R))) :
    ((RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries (ResidueField R) d).D J).map
        (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ) =
      c.adicCompletion.D (J.map (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ))
proof:
:= by
  set Φ := cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ with hΦ
  have hJ : J = Ideal.span (J : Set (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R))) :=
    (Ideal.span_eq J).symm
  conv_lhs => rw [hJ, RegularCoords.D_span]
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map, RegularCoords.D_span, Set.image_union, Set.image_iUnion]
  congr 2
  refine Set.iUnion_congr fun i => ?_
  rw [Set.image_image, Set.image_image]
  congr 1
  funext f
  exact cohenAlgEquivCoords_pderiv c hk σ hσ i f

name: IsLocalRing.Dpow_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords
statement:
theorem Dpow_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (ResidueField R)] (r : ℕ)
    (J : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R))) :
    ((RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries (ResidueField R) d).Dpow r J).map
        (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ) =
      c.adicCompletion.Dpow r (J.map (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ))
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [RegularCoords.Dpow_succ, RegularCoords.Dpow_succ, D_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords c hk, ih]

name: IsLocalRing.MC_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords
statement:
theorem MC_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (ResidueField R)]
    (J : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R))) (m : ℕ) :
    ((RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries (ResidueField R) d).MC J m).map
        (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ) =
      c.adicCompletion.MC (J.map (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ)) m
proof:
:=
  Dpow_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords c hk σ hσ (m - 1) J

name: IsLocalRing.isMCInvariant_comap_cohenAlgEquivCoords
statement:
theorem isMCInvariant_comap_cohenAlgEquivCoords [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (ResidueField R)]
    (Î : Ideal R̂) (m : ℕ) (h : c.adicCompletion.IsMCInvariant Î m) :
    (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries (ResidueField R) d).IsMCInvariant
      (Î.comap (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ)) m
proof:
:= by
  set Φ := cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ with hΦ
  set J := Î.comap Φ with hJ
  have hJΦ : J.map Φ = Î := Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective Φ Φ.surjective Î
  change _ * _ ≤ J
  refine Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp ?_
  rw [Ideal.map_mul, MC_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords c hk, D_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords c hk, hJΦ]
  exact h

name: IsLocalRing.isInvariantOnePlus_comap_cohenAlgEquivCoords
statement:
theorem isInvariantOnePlus_comap_cohenAlgEquivCoords [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (ResidueField R)]
    (Î : Ideal R̂) (m : ℕ) (h : c.adicCompletion.IsMCInvariant Î m)
    (hB : c.adicCompletion.MC Î m ≤ maximalIdeal R̂) :
    IsInvariantOnePlus (Î.comap (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ))
      ((c.adicCompletion.MC Î m).comap (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ))
proof:
:= by
  set Φ := cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ with hΦ
  set J := Î.comap Φ with hJ
  have hJΦ : J.map Φ = Î := Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective Φ Φ.surjective Î
  have hMC : (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries (ResidueField R) d).MC J m =
      (c.adicCompletion.MC Î m).comap Φ := by
    rw [← hJΦ, ← MC_map_cohenAlgEquivCoords c hk σ hσ J m,
      Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective Φ Φ.bijective]
  have hB' : (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries (ResidueField R) d).MC J m ≤
      maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R)) := by
    rw [hMC, ← comap_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv Φ.toRingEquiv]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono hB
  rw [← hMC]
  exact (isMCInvariant_iff_isInvariantOnePlus J m hB').mp
    (isMCInvariant_comap_cohenAlgEquivCoords c hk σ hσ Î m h)

name: IsLocalRing.map_comap_cohenAlgEquivCoords_eq_of_isOnePlus
statement:
theorem map_comap_cohenAlgEquivCoords_eq_of_isOnePlus [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (ResidueField R)]
    (Î : Ideal R̂) (m : ℕ) (h : c.adicCompletion.IsMCInvariant Î m)
    (hB : c.adicCompletion.MC Î m ≤ maximalIdeal R̂)
    (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R) ≃ₐ[ResidueField R]
      MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R))
    (hg : IsOnePlus ((c.adicCompletion.MC Î m).comap (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ)) g) :
    (Î.comap (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ)).map (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R) →+*
      MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R)) = Î.comap (cohenAlgEquivCoords c σ hσ)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.map_eq_of_map_le g.toRingEquiv _
    (isInvariantOnePlus_comap_cohenAlgEquivCoords c hk σ hσ Î m h hB g hg)

name: IsLocalRing.x_mem_coordIdeal
statement: theorem x_mem_coordIdeal {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ S) : x i ∈ coordIdeal x S
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.derivation_apply_mem_pow_of_mem_pow_succ
statement:
theorem derivation_apply_mem_pow_of_mem_pow_succ (D : Derivation k R R) (J : Ideal R) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ {f : R}, f ∈ J ^ (m + 1) → D f ∈ J ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => intro f _; simp
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f hf
    rw [pow_succ] at hf
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf (fun g hg h hh => ?_) (fun a b ha hb => ?_)
    · rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hg) ?_
      rw [pow_succ']
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hh (ih hg)
    · rw [map_add]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ ha hb

name: IsLocalRing.iterD_nil
statement: theorem iterD_nil (f : R) : iterD pd [] f = f
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.iterD_cons
statement: theorem iterD_cons (i : ι) (l : List ι) (f : R) : iterD pd (i :: l) f = pd i (iterD pd l f)
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.iterD_append_singleton
statement:
theorem iterD_append_singleton (l : List ι) (i : ι) (f : R) :
    iterD pd (l ++ [i]) f = iterD pd l (pd i f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold iterD
  rw [List.foldr_append]
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.iterD_mem_pow
statement:
theorem iterD_mem_pow (J : Ideal R) (l : List ι) :
    ∀ {p : ℕ} {f : R}, f ∈ J ^ (p + l.length) → iterD pd l f ∈ J ^ p
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro p f hf; rw [iterD_nil]; simpa using hf
  | cons i l ih =>
    intro p f hf
    rw [iterD_cons]
    refine derivation_apply_mem_pow_of_mem_pow_succ (pd i) J p (ih ?_)
    rw [List.length_cons, ← add_assoc, add_right_comm] at hf
    exact hf

name: IsLocalRing.eulerS_add
statement: theorem eulerS_add (f g : R) : eulerS x pd S (f + g) = eulerS x pd S f + eulerS x pd S g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eulerS, map_add, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: IsLocalRing.eulerS_mul
statement:
theorem eulerS_mul (f g : R) :
    eulerS x pd S (f * g) = f * eulerS x pd S g + g * eulerS x pd S f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eulerS, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1 <;> exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: IsLocalRing.eulerS_mem
statement: theorem eulerS_mem (f : R) : eulerS x pd S f ∈ coordIdeal x S
proof:
:=
  Submodule.sum_mem _ fun _ hi => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (x_mem_coordIdeal x S hi)

name: IsLocalRing.eulerS_x
statement: theorem eulerS_x {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ S) : eulerS x pd S (x j) = x j
proof:
:= by
  unfold eulerS
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun i hi hij => by rw [hx i hi j hj, ite_eq_right hij, mul_zero])
    (fun h => (h hj).elim), hx j hj j hj, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]

name: IsLocalRing.eulerS_sub_self_mem_sq
statement:
theorem eulerS_sub_self_mem_sq {h : R} (hh : h ∈ coordIdeal x S) :
    eulerS x pd S h - h ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun h _ => eulerS x pd S h - h ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ 2)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hh
  · rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    rw [eulerS_x x pd S hx hj, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  · simp [eulerS]
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    have : eulerS x pd S (a + b) - (a + b) = (eulerS x pd S a - a) + (eulerS x pd S b - b) := by
      rw [eulerS_add]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ ha hb
  · intro c a ha' ha
    rw [smul_eq_mul, eulerS_mul]
    have : c * eulerS x pd S a + a * eulerS x pd S c - c * a =
        c * (eulerS x pd S a - a) + a * eulerS x pd S c := by ring
    rw [this, pow_two]
    refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (by rwa [← pow_two])) ?_
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha' (eulerS_mem x pd S c)

name: IsLocalRing.eulerS_sub_nsmul_mem
statement:
theorem eulerS_sub_nsmul_mem {a : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) {f : R} (hf : f ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ a) :
    eulerS x pd S f - (a : R) * f ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ (a + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction a, ha using Nat.le_induction generalizing f with
  | base =>
    rw [pow_one] at hf
    simpa using eulerS_sub_self_mem_sq x pd S hx hf
  | succ a _ ih =>
    rw [pow_succ] at hf
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf (fun g hg h hh => ?_) (fun u v hu hv => ?_)
    · rw [eulerS_mul]
      have : g * eulerS x pd S h + h * eulerS x pd S g - ((a + 1 : ℕ) : R) * (g * h) =
          g * (eulerS x pd S h - h) + h * (eulerS x pd S g - (a : R) * g) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [this]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [show a + 1 + 1 = a + 2 by ring, pow_add]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hg (eulerS_sub_self_mem_sq x pd S hx hh)
      · rw [pow_succ']
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hh (ih hg)
    · rw [eulerS_add]
      convert Ideal.add_mem _ hu hv using 1
      ring

name: IsLocalRing.mem_pow_succ_of_forall_pderiv_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hE : eulerS x pd S f ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ (a + 1) := by
    unfold eulerS
    rw [pow_succ']
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => Ideal.mul_mem_mul (x_mem_coordIdeal x S hi) (hd i hi)
  have h1 : (a : R) * f ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ (a + 1) := by
    have := Ideal.sub_mem _ hE (eulerS_sub_nsmul_mem x pd S hx ha hf)
    simpa using this
  have hu : IsUnit ((a : R)) := by
    have : (a : R) = algebraMap k R (a : k) := by simp
    rw [this]
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))).map (algebraMap k R)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
  have : f = ↑u⁻¹ * ((a : R) * f) := by rw [← hu, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h1

name: IsLocalRing.mem_coordIdeal_pow_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coordIdeal_pow_iff (p : ℕ) (f : R) :
    f ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ p ↔
      ∀ l : List ι, (∀ i ∈ l, i ∈ S) → l.length < p → iterD pd l f ∈ coordIdeal x S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf l _ hl
    have : f ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ (1 + l.length) := Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hf
    simpa using iterD_mem_pow pd (coordIdeal x S) l this
  · induction p generalizing f with
    | zero => intro _; simp
    | succ p ih =>
      intro hl
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p with hp | hp
      · subst hp
        have := hl [] (by simp) (by simp)
        rw [iterD_nil] at this
        simpa using this
      · have hf : f ∈ coordIdeal x S ^ p :=
          ih f fun l hlS hlen => hl l hlS (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hlen)
        refine mem_pow_succ_of_forall_pderiv_mem x pd S hx hp hf fun i hi => ?_
        refine ih (pd i f) fun l hlS hlen => ?_
        rw [← iterD_append_singleton]
        refine hl (l ++ [i]) ?_ ?_
        · intro j hj
          rcases List.mem_append.mp hj with hj | hj
          · exact hlS j hj
          · rw [List.mem_singleton.mp hj]; exact hi
        · rw [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]; omega

name: Derivation.blowupLift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem blowupLift_algebraMap (a : R) :
    δ.blowupLift x r (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a) =
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r * δ a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_blowupLift, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
    Derivation.localization_algebraMap, map_mul]

name: Derivation.blowupLift_exc
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowupLift_algebraMap, map_mul]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: Derivation.transformElem_derivation
statement:
theorem transformElem_derivation {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    transformElem x r (δ f) (derivation_mem_pow δ _ m hf) =
      δ.blowupLift x r (transformElem x r f hf) +
        (m + 1) • (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (δ (x r)) * transformElem x r f hf)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
  
  have hg := congrArg (fun z : chartRing x r => (z : Localization.Away (x r)))
    (algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r f hf)
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap] at hg
  
  have hδ := congrArg (δ.localization (Submonoid.powers (x r))) hg
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.leibniz_pow, Derivation.localization_algebraMap,
    Derivation.localization_algebraMap, Nat.add_sub_cancel, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
    nsmul_eq_mul] at hδ
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_add,
    nsmul_eq_mul, SubringClass.coe_natCast, coe_blowupLift]
  rw [← hδ]
  ring

name: Derivation.transformIdeal_derivative_le
statement:
theorem transformIdeal_derivative_le {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    transformIdeal x r (Ideal.derivative k I) m ≤
      Ideal.derivative k (transformIdeal x r I (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hD : Ideal.derivative k I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m := Ideal.derivative_le_pow hI
  
  have key : (Ideal.derivative k I).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) ≤
      Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m} *
        Ideal.derivative k (transformIdeal x r I (m + 1)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    refine Ideal.derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun f hf => ?_, fun δ f hf => ?_⟩
    · rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r f (hI hf), pow_succ, mul_assoc]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) (Ideal.le_derivative _
        (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (transformElem_mem_transformIdeal x r hf (hI hf))))
    · rw [Ideal.mem_comap,
        ← algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r (δ f) (derivation_mem_pow δ _ m (hI hf)),
        transformElem_derivation x r δ (hI hf)]
      refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) (Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ ?_)
      · exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_derivative _
          (transformElem_mem_transformIdeal x r hf (hI hf))
      · rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
        exact Ideal.le_derivative _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
          (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (transformElem_mem_transformIdeal x r hf (hI hf))))
  intro z hz
  have h1 : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * z ∈
      Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m} *
        Ideal.derivative k (transformIdeal x r I (m + 1)) := by
    apply key
    rw [← span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hD, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mpr ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mp h1
  rwa [← algebraMap_pow_mul_right_injective x r m hwz]

name: Derivation.awayBlowUpLift_apply
statement:
theorem awayBlowUpLift_apply (z : Localization.Away (x r)) :
    δ.awayBlowUpLift x r z =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) *
        δ.localization (Submonoid.powers (x r)) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayBlowUpLift, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: Derivation.awayBlowUpLift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayBlowUpLift_algebraMap (a : R) :
    δ.awayBlowUpLift x r (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) a) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r * δ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayBlowUpLift_apply, Derivation.localization_algebraMap, map_mul]

name: Derivation.awayBlowUpLift_chartY
statement:
theorem awayBlowUpLift_chartY {j : Fin n} (hj : j < r) :
    δ.awayBlowUpLift x r (chartY x r j) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (δ (x j)) -
        chartY x r j * algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (δ (x r))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (δ.localization (Submonoid.powers (x r)))
    (AlgebraicGeometry.chartY_mul_algebraMap x r hj)
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.localization_algebraMap, Derivation.localization_algebraMap,
    smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  rw [awayBlowUpLift_apply]
  linear_combination h

name: Derivation.awayBlowUpLift_mem
statement: theorem awayBlowUpLift_mem : ∀ z ∈ chartRing x r, δ.awayBlowUpLift x r z ∈ chartRing x r
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun z _ => δ.awayBlowUpLift x r z ∈ chartRing x r) ?_ ?_
    ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    have : δ.awayBlowUpLift x r (chartY x r j) ∈ chartRing x r := by
      rw [awayBlowUpLift_chartY x r δ hj]
      exact Subalgebra.sub_mem _ (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _)
        (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (chartY_mem x r j) (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _))
    rwa [show chartY x r j = Localization.mk (x j) ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers (x r)⟩ from
      chartYOf_of_lt x r (x r) hj] at this
  · intro a
    rw [awayBlowUpLift_algebraMap]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    rw [map_add]
    exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ ha hb
  · intro a b hab hbb ha hb
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hab hb) (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hbb ha)

name: Derivation.coe_blowupLift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_blowupLift (z : chartRing x r) :
    (δ.blowupLift x r z : Localization.Away (x r)) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) *
        δ.localization (Submonoid.powers (x r)) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowupLift, Derivation.coe_restrictSubalgebra_apply, awayBlowUpLift_apply]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.IsDBalanced.eq_top_of_ord_lt
statement:
theorem IsDBalanced.eq_top_of_ord_lt {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (h : c.IsDBalanced I m) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hord : ord I < m) : I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ord I ≤ ((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (ne_top_of_lt hord)
    rw [← ha] at hord ⊢
    have ham : a < m := by exact_mod_cast hord
    exact_mod_cast (show a ≤ m - 1 by omega)
  have := h (m - 1) (by omega)
  rw [c.Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le hle, Ideal.top_pow, Nat.sub_sub_self hm, pow_one] at this
  exact top_le_iff.mp this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.IsDBalanced.ord_eq_zero_or_le
statement:
theorem IsDBalanced.ord_eq_zero_or_le {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (h : c.IsDBalanced I m) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ord I = 0 ∨ (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hle : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I
  · exact Or.inr hle
  · exact Or.inl (ord_eq_zero_iff.mpr (h.eq_top_of_ord_lt hm (not_le.mp hle)))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.IsDBalanced.ord_eq_zero_or_eq
statement:
theorem IsDBalanced.ord_eq_zero_or_eq {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (h : c.IsDBalanced I m) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hle : ord I ≤ m) : ord I = 0 ∨ ord I = m
proof:
:=
  (h.ord_eq_zero_or_le hm).imp id fun h' => le_antisymm hle h'

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.IsDBalanced.le_ord_iff_one_le
statement:
theorem IsDBalanced.le_ord_iff_one_le {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (h : c.IsDBalanced I m) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I ↔ 1 ≤ ord I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h' => le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hm) h', fun h1 => ?_⟩
  rcases h.ord_eq_zero_or_le hm with h0 | hle
  · rw [h0] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by simp)
  · exact hle

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.IsDBalanced.map
statement:
theorem IsDBalanced.map {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsRegularLocalRing R'] [Algebra ℚ R']
    {n' : ℕ} (c' : RegularCoords R' n') (φ : R →+* R') (e : Fin n' → Fin n)
    (hφ : ∀ j f, c'.pderiv j (φ f) = φ (c.pderiv (e j) f)) {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (h : c.IsDBalanced I m) : c'.IsDBalanced (I.map φ) m
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  calc c'.Dpow i (I.map φ) ^ m
      ≤ ((c.Dpow i I).map φ) ^ m := Ideal.pow_right_mono (c.Dpow_map_le c' φ e hφ i I) m
    _ = (c.Dpow i I ^ m).map φ := by rw [Ideal.map_pow]
    _ ≤ (I ^ (m - i)).map φ := Ideal.map_mono (h i hi)
    _ = (I.map φ) ^ (m - i) := by rw [Ideal.map_pow]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isDBalanced_span_singleton_x_pow
statement:
theorem isDBalanced_span_singleton_x_pow (i : Fin n) (m : ℕ) :
    c.IsDBalanced (Ideal.span {c.x i ^ m}) m
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [c.Dpow_span_singleton_x_pow i hk.le, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
    ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm (m - k) m]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.not_isDBalanced_span_singleton_x_mul_x
statement:
theorem not_isDBalanced_span_singleton_x_mul_x {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h : c.x i ^ 2 ∉ Ideal.span {c.x i * c.x j}) :
    ¬ c.IsDBalanced (Ideal.span {c.x i * c.x j}) 2
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  have h1 := hb 1 one_lt_two
  rw [Dpow_one, c.D_span_singleton_x_mul_x hij] at h1
  apply h
  have hx : c.x i ^ 2 ∈ Ideal.span {c.x i, c.x j} ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq, sq]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)) (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
  simpa using h1 hx

name: IsLocalRing.X_sq_notMem_span_X_mul_X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro h
  have hdvd : (MvPowerSeries.X j : MvPowerSeries σ K) ∣ MvPowerSeries.X i ^ 2 :=
    (dvd_mul_left _ _).trans (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp h)
  rw [MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff] at hdvd
  have := hdvd (Finsupp.single i 2) (by simp [hij])
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_left rfl] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: IsLocalRing.aeval_mem_pow_of_degree_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [P.as_sum, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun α hα => ?_
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial]
  refine Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (hP α hα) ?_)
  simp only [Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.degree_apply]
  exact prod_pow_mem_pow_sum _ a α J ha

name: IsLocalRing.aeval_eq_of_coeff_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← Ideal.mem_bot, ← hJ]
  refine aeval_mem_pow_of_degree_le ha fun α hα => ?_
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  exact (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hα) (by rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sub, h α hlt, sub_self])

name: IsLocalRing.eq_of_pow_zero
statement: theorem eq_of_pow_zero {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (I : Ideal S) (a b : S ⧸ I ^ 0) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
  refine Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr ?_
  rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
  exact Submodule.mem_top

name: IsLocalRing.eq_of_forall_mk_pow_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_forall_mk_pow_eq {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (I : Ideal S) [IsHausdorff I S]
    {a b : S} (h : ∀ n, Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) a = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine IsHausdorff.haus' (I := I) (a - b) fun n => ?_
  rw [SModEq.zero, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp (h n)

name: IsLocalRing.levelVar_mem
statement:
theorem levelVar_mem (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ maximalIdeal R) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin d) :
    levelVar R x n i ∈ (maximalIdeal R̂).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal R̂ ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_
  rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hx i)

name: IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_pow_eq_bot
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_pow_eq_bot (n : ℕ) :
    ((maximalIdeal R̂).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal R̂ ^ n))) ^ n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.map_pow (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal R̂ ^ n)) (maximalIdeal R̂) n,
    Ideal.map_quotient_self]

name: IsLocalRing.levelEval_apply
statement:
theorem levelEval_apply (n : ℕ) (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R)) :
    levelEval R x hx n F = MvPolynomial.aeval (levelVar R x n) (truncTotal n F)
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.factorₐ_comp_levelVar
statement:
theorem factorₐ_comp_levelVar {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n) :
    (fun i => Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ (ResidueField R) (I := maximalIdeal R̂ ^ n)
      (J := maximalIdeal R̂ ^ m) (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hle) (levelVar R x n i)) =
      levelVar R x m
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  unfold levelVar
  exact Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk (S := maximalIdeal R̂ ^ n) (T := maximalIdeal R̂ ^ m)
    (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hle) _

name: IsLocalRing.levelEval_compat
statement:
theorem levelEval_compat {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ (ResidueField R) (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hle)).comp
      (levelEval R x hx n) = levelEval R x hx m
proof:
:= by
  ext1 F
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, levelEval_apply, levelEval_apply, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply,
    factorₐ_comp_levelVar R x hle]
  exact aeval_eq_of_coeff_eq (levelVar_mem R x hx m) (map_maximalIdeal_pow_eq_bot R m)
    fun α hα => by rw [coeff_truncTotal _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hα hle), coeff_truncTotal _ hα]

name: IsLocalRing.mk_cohenMap
statement:
theorem mk_cohenMap (n : ℕ) (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R)) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal R̂ ^ n) (cohenMap R x hx F) = levelEval R x hx n F
proof:
:=
  IsAdicComplete.mk_liftAlgHom (maximalIdeal R̂) (levelEval R x hx)
    (fun hle => levelEval_compat R x hx hle) n F

name: IsLocalRing.cohenMap_C
statement:
theorem cohenMap_C (k : ResidueField R) :
    cohenMap R x hx (C k) = algebraMap (ResidueField R) R̂ k
proof:
:= by
  change cohenMap R x hx
    (algebraMap (ResidueField R) (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R)) k) = _
  rw [AlgHom.commutes]

name: IsLocalRing.cohenMap_X
statement: theorem cohenMap_X (i : Fin d) : cohenMap R x hx (X i) = algebraMap R R̂ (x i)
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_forall_mk_pow_eq (maximalIdeal R̂) fun n => ?_
  rw [mk_cohenMap, levelEval_apply]
  change _ = levelVar R x n i
  rw [← MvPolynomial.aeval_X (R := ResidueField R) (levelVar R x n) i]
  exact aeval_eq_of_coeff_eq (levelVar_mem R x hx n) (map_maximalIdeal_pow_eq_bot R n)
    fun α hα => by rw [coeff_truncTotal _ hα, ← MvPolynomial.coe_X, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe]

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_residueField_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_residueField_apply (k : ResidueField R) :
    algebraMap (ResidueField R) R̂ k = coefficientField R k
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.isCoefficientAlgebra_coefficientAlgebra
statement: theorem isCoefficientAlgebra_coefficientAlgebra : IsCoefficientAlgebra R
proof:
:=
  residue_coefficientField R

name: IsLocalRing.cohenMap_C_coefficientField
statement:
