theorem cohenMap_C_coefficientField {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → R) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (k : ResidueField R) : cohenMap R x hx (C k) = coefficientField R k
proof:
:=
  cohenMap_C R x hx k

name: IsLocalRing.isLocalHom_algebraMap_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem isLocalHom_algebraMap_adicCompletion {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A))
proof:
:= by
  have := isLocalRing_adicCompletion (R := A)
  refine ⟨fun a ha => ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  have hm : a ∈ maximalIdeal A := (mem_maximalIdeal a).mpr (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr h)
  have hm' : algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) a ∈
      maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) := by
    rw [maximalIdeal_adicCompletion]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hm
  exact mem_nonunits_iff.mp ((mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hm') ha

name: IsLocalRing.ordFaithful_algebraMap_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem ordFaithful_algebraMap_adicCompletion {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocalRing_adicCompletion (R := A)
    OrdFaithful (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) := by
  have := isLocalRing_adicCompletion (R := A)
  intro k
  rw [maximalIdeal_adicCompletion, ← Ideal.map_pow, comap_map_adicCompletion]

name: IsLocalRing.ordFaithful_chartLocalHom
statement:
theorem ordFaithful_chartLocalHom [IsNoetherianRing S]
    (hbij : Function.Bijective
      (haveI := isLocalHom_chartLocalHom x r χ hχ; completionMap (chartLocalHom x r χ hχ))) :
    OrdFaithful (chartLocalHom x r χ hχ)
proof:
:= by
  have := isLocalHom_chartLocalHom x r χ hχ
  have := isLocalRing_adicCompletion (R := Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))
  have := isLocalRing_adicCompletion (R := S)
  have := isLocalHom_algebraMap_adicCompletion (A := S)
  have hg : OrdFaithful (completionMap (chartLocalHom x r χ hχ)) :=
    (OrdFaithful.of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hbij)).congr (RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl)
  have hcomp := (ordFaithful_algebraMap_adicCompletion
    (A := Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))).comp hg
  have heq : (completionMap (chartLocalHom x r χ hχ)).comp
      (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)) _) =
      (algebraMap S (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S)).comp (chartLocalHom x r χ hχ) := by
    ext z
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [completionMap_algebraMap]
  exact OrdFaithful.of_comp (hcomp.congr heq)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.map_chartD_le_derivative
statement:
theorem map_chartD_le_derivative (χ : chartRing c.x r →+* S) (δ : Fin n → Derivation k S S)
    (hδ : ∀ (j : Fin n) (g : chartRing c.x r), χ (c.chartDerivRing r j g) = δ j (χ g))
    (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    Ideal.map χ (c.chartD r K) ≤ Ideal.derivative k (Ideal.map χ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  unfold chartD
  refine sup_le ?_ (iSup_le fun j => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · exact Ideal.le_comap_map.trans (Ideal.comap_mono (Ideal.le_derivative _))
  · rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, hδ]
    exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_derivative (δ j) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem χ hg)

name: IsLocalRing.exists_chartRing_hom_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_chartRing_hom_of_mul_eq (ρ : R →+* S) {w : S} (hw : w ≠ 0) (v : Fin n → S)
    (hρr : ρ (x r) = w) (hρj : ∀ j, j < r → ρ (x j) = w * v j) :
    ∃ χ : chartRing x r →+* S, (∀ s, χ (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) s) = ρ s) ∧
      (∀ j, j < r → χ (chartYR x r j) = v j) ∧ χ (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)) = w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := FractionRing S
  let ι : S →+* L := algebraMap S L
  have hι : Function.Injective ι := IsFractionRing.injective S L
  have hunit : ∀ y : Submonoid.powers (x r), IsUnit ((ι.comp ρ) y) := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff _ _).mp hy
    change IsUnit (ι (ρ (x r ^ k)))
    rw [map_pow, hρr, map_pow]
    refine (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ?_).pow k
    exact (IsFractionRing.to_map_eq_zero_iff (K := L)).not.mpr hw
  let Λ : Localization.Away (x r) →+* L := IsLocalization.lift hunit
  have hΛalg : ∀ s, Λ (algebraMap _ _ s) = ι (ρ s) := fun s => IsLocalization.lift_eq hunit s
  have hΛmk : ∀ j, j < r →
      Λ (Localization.mk (x j) ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩) = ι (v j) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec]
    change ι (ρ (x j)) = ι (ρ (x r)) * _
    rw [hρj j hj, hρr, map_mul]
  have hrange : ∀ s : chartRing x r, ∃ b, ι b = Λ (s : Localization.Away (x r)) := by
    intro s
    have hs : (s : Localization.Away (x r)) ∈ Algebra.adjoin R
        ((fun j : Fin n => Localization.mk (x j) ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers (x r)⟩) ''
          {j | j < r}) := s.2
    refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun z _ => ∃ b, ι b = Λ z) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hs
    · rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, (hΛmk j hj).symm⟩
    · intro r'
      exact ⟨_, (hΛalg r').symm⟩
    · rintro a b _ _ ⟨a', ha'⟩ ⟨b', hb'⟩
      exact ⟨a' + b', by rw [map_add, ha', hb', map_add]⟩
    · rintro a b _ _ ⟨a', ha'⟩ ⟨b', hb'⟩
      exact ⟨a' * b', by rw [map_mul, ha', hb', map_mul]⟩
  choose χ₀ hχ₀ using hrange
  let χ : chartRing x r →+* S :=
    { toFun := χ₀
      map_one' := hι (by rw [hχ₀, OneMemClass.coe_one, map_one, map_one])
      map_mul' := fun a b => hι (by rw [hχ₀, MulMemClass.coe_mul, map_mul, map_mul, hχ₀, hχ₀])
      map_zero' := hι (by rw [hχ₀, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, map_zero, map_zero])
      map_add' := fun a b => hι (by rw [hχ₀, AddMemClass.coe_add, map_add, map_add, hχ₀, hχ₀]) }
  have hχ : ∀ (z : chartRing x r) b, χ z = b ↔ Λ (z : Localization.Away (x r)) = ι b := by
    intro z b
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rw [← hz]
      exact (hχ₀ z).symm
    · intro hz
      exact hι ((hχ₀ z).trans hz)
  refine ⟨χ, fun s => (hχ _ _).mpr ?_, fun j hj => (hχ _ _).mpr ?_, (hχ _ _).mpr ?_⟩
  · rw [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, hΛalg]
  · rw [chartYR, coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_of_lt _ _ _ hj]
    exact hΛmk j hj
  · rw [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, hΛalg, hρr]

name: IsLocalRing.comap_maximalIdeal_eq_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem comap_maximalIdeal_eq_chartOrigin (hY : ∀ j, j < r → χ (chartYR x r j) ∈ maximalIdeal S)
    (hX : ∀ i, χ (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x i)) ∈ maximalIdeal S) :
    (maximalIdeal S).comap χ = chartOrigin x r
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine (chartOrigin_isMaximal x r hx hn).eq_of_le ?_ ?_
  · intro htop
    have h1 : (1 : chartRing x r) ∈ (maximalIdeal S).comap χ := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, map_one] at h1
    exact (Ideal.ne_top_iff_one _).mp (maximalIdeal.isMaximal S).ne_top h1
  · rw [chartOrigin, chartOriginOf, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap]
    by_cases hi : i < r
    · exact hY i hi
    · have hyi : chartYROf x r (x r) i = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x i) :=
        Subtype.ext (by
          rw [coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_of_not_lt x r (x r) hi, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap])
      rw [hyi]
      exact hX i

name: IsLocalRing.isUnit_of_mem_primeCompl_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_mem_primeCompl_chartOrigin (y : (chartOrigin x r).primeCompl) :
    IsUnit (χ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← notMem_maximalIdeal]
  intro hy
  have hmem : (y : chartRing x r) ∈ (maximalIdeal S).comap χ := Ideal.mem_comap.mpr hy
  rw [hχ] at hmem
  exact y.2 hmem

name: IsLocalRing.chartLocalHom_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartLocalHom_algebraMap (z : chartRing x r) :
    chartLocalHom x r χ hχ (algebraMap _ _ z) = χ z
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.lift_eq _ z

name: IsLocalRing.isLocalHom_chartLocalHom
statement: theorem isLocalHom_chartLocalHom : IsLocalHom (chartLocalHom x r χ hχ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a ha => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨s, t⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (chartOrigin x r).primeCompl a
  rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff]
  have hs : IsUnit (χ s) := by
    have := (IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec (S := Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))
      (hg := isUnit_of_mem_primeCompl_chartOrigin x r χ hχ) s _ t).mp rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (isUnit_of_mem_primeCompl_chartOrigin x r χ hχ t).mul ha
  intro hs'
  rw [← hχ, SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap] at hs'
  exact (notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr hs) hs'

name: IsLocalRing.flat_comp_algebraMap_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem flat_comp_algebraMap_adicCompletion
    (hbij : Function.Bijective
      (haveI := isLocalHom_chartLocalHom x r χ hχ; completionMap (chartLocalHom x r χ hχ))) :
    ((algebraMap S (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S)).comp χ).Flat
proof:
:= by
  have := isLocalHom_chartLocalHom x r χ hχ
  have h1 : (algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))).Flat :=
    RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr (IsLocalization.flat _ (chartOrigin x r).primeCompl)
  have h2 : (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))
      (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)))
        (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)))).Flat :=
    RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr inferInstance
  have h3 := RingHom.Flat.of_bijective hbij
  have heq : (algebraMap S (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S)).comp χ =
      (completionMap (chartLocalHom x r χ hχ)).comp
        ((algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)) _).comp
          (algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)))) := by
    ext z
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [completionMap_algebraMap, chartLocalHom_algebraMap]
  rw [heq]
  exact (h1.comp h2).comp h3

name: IsLocalRing.exists_pow_mul_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mul_eq_algebraMap (g : chartRing x r) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ) (c : R),
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ M * g = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := g
  have key : ∃ (M : ℕ) (c : R), algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) ^ M * g =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) c := by
    refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (hx := hg) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨1, x i, ?_⟩
      dsimp only
      rw [pow_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply]
      exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec' (Localization.Away (x r)) (x i)
        ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers (x r)⟩
    · intro c
      exact ⟨0, c, by rw [pow_zero, one_mul]⟩
    · rintro z₁ z₂ - - ⟨M₁, c₁, h₁⟩ ⟨M₂, c₂, h₂⟩
      refine ⟨M₁ + M₂, x r ^ M₂ * c₁ + x r ^ M₁ * c₂, ?_⟩
      rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, ← h₁, ← h₂]
      ring
    · rintro z₁ z₂ - - ⟨M₁, c₁, h₁⟩ ⟨M₂, c₂, h₂⟩
      refine ⟨M₁ + M₂, c₁ * c₂, ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, ← h₁, ← h₂]
      ring
  obtain ⟨M, c, h⟩ := key
  exact ⟨M, c, Subtype.ext (by simpa using h)⟩

name: IsLocalRing.IsTransformOf.zero
statement: theorem IsTransformOf.zero : IsTransformOf x r I 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, 0, I.zero_mem, by simp⟩

name: IsLocalRing.IsTransformOf.add
statement:
theorem IsTransformOf.add {g₁ g₂ : chartRing x r} (h₁ : IsTransformOf x r I g₁)
    (h₂ : IsTransformOf x r I g₂) : IsTransformOf x r I (g₁ + g₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M₁, f₁, hf₁, e₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨M₂, f₂, hf₂, e₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨M₁ + M₂, x r ^ M₂ * f₁ + x r ^ M₁ * f₂,
    I.add_mem (I.mul_mem_left _ hf₁) (I.mul_mem_left _ hf₂), ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, ← e₁, ← e₂]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.IsTransformOf.mul
statement:
theorem IsTransformOf.mul (a : chartRing x r) {g : chartRing x r} (h : IsTransformOf x r I g) :
    IsTransformOf x r I (a * g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, f, hf, e⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨M', c, e'⟩ := exists_pow_mul_eq_algebraMap x r a
  refine ⟨M' + M, c * f, I.mul_mem_left _ hf, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, ← e, ← e']
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.IsTransformOf.of_pow_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, f, hf, e⟩ := h
  exact ⟨M + k, f, hf, by rw [pow_add, mul_assoc]; exact e⟩

name: IsLocalRing.mem_transformsIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_transformsIdeal {g : chartRing x r} :
    g ∈ transformsIdeal x r I ↔ IsTransformOf x r I g
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: IsLocalRing.map_le_transformsIdeal
statement:
theorem map_le_transformsIdeal :
    I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) ≤ transformsIdeal x r I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr fun f hf => ⟨0, f, hf, by rw [pow_zero, one_mul]⟩

name: IsLocalRing.transformsIdeal_eq_iSup_transformIdeal
statement:
theorem transformsIdeal_eq_iSup_transformIdeal :
    transformsIdeal x r I = ⨆ m : ℕ, transformIdeal x r I m
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun g hg => ?_) (iSup_le fun m => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · obtain ⟨M, f, hf, e⟩ := hg
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem M (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, e⟩)
  · rintro g ⟨f, hf, e⟩
    exact ⟨m, f, hf, e⟩

name: IsLocalRing.iSup_colon_pow_map_eq_transformsIdeal
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_map_eq_transformsIdeal :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, Submodule.colon (I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)))
      (SetLike.coe (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ k))) =
      transformsIdeal x r I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun k g hg => ?_) fun g hg => ?_
  · refine IsTransformOf.of_pow_mul x r I (k := k) (map_le_transformsIdeal x r I ?_)
    have := Submodule.mem_colon.mp hg (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ k)
      (by rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at this
    exact this
  · obtain ⟨M, f, hf, e⟩ := hg
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem M (Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun p hp => ?_)
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hp
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hp
    rw [smul_eq_mul, show g * (b * algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ M) =
      b * (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ M * g) by ring, e]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ b (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)

name: IsLocalRing.iSup_colon_pow_singleton_map_eq_transformsIdeal
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_singleton_map_eq_transformsIdeal :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, (I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).colon
      {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ k}) = transformsIdeal x r I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_colon_pow_map_eq_transformsIdeal]
  simp_rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Submodule.colon_span]

name: IsLocalRing.iSup_colon_pow_map_eq_iSup_transformIdeal
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_map_eq_iSup_transformIdeal :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, Submodule.colon (I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)))
      (SetLike.coe (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ k))) =
      ⨆ m : ℕ, transformIdeal x r I m
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup_colon_pow_map_eq_transformsIdeal, transformsIdeal_eq_iSup_transformIdeal]

name: IsLocalRing.prod_pow_add
statement:
theorem prod_pow_add (α β : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    ∏ j, x j ^ (α + β) j = (∏ j, x j ^ α j) * ∏ j, x j ^ β j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: IsLocalRing.prod_pow_single
statement: theorem prod_pow_single (i : Fin n) : ∏ j, x j ^ (Finsupp.single i 1) j = x i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i (fun j _ hj => by rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hj, pow_zero])
    (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h)]
  rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, pow_one]

name: IsLocalRing.span_image_pow_eq_span_monomials
statement:
theorem span_image_pow_eq_span_monomials (s : Set (Fin n)) (m : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span (x '' s) ^ m =
      Ideal.span {z : R | ∃ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (α.degree = m ∧ ∀ i, i ∉ s → α i = 0) ∧
        z = ∏ i, x i ^ α i}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
    have h1 : ∃ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, (α.degree = 0 ∧ ∀ i, i ∉ s → α i = 0) ∧
        (1 : R) = ∏ i, x i ^ α i := ⟨0, ⟨by simp, fun _ _ => rfl⟩, by simp⟩
    exact ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr (Ideal.subset_span h1)).symm
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, Ideal.span_mul_span]
    refine le_antisymm (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨a, ⟨α, ⟨hα, hs⟩, rfl⟩, b, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨α + Finsupp.single i 1, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [map_add, hα, Finsupp.degree_single]
      · intro j hj
        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, hs j hj, Finsupp.single_apply,
          ite_eq_right (fun h : i = j => hj (h ▸ hi))]
        rfl
      · rw [prod_pow_add, prod_pow_single]
    · rintro _ ⟨α, ⟨hα, hs⟩, rfl⟩
      have hne : α ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        simp at hα
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hne
      have hi0 : α i ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi
      have his : i ∈ s := by
        by_contra h
        exact hi0 (hs i h)
      have hi1 : 1 ≤ α i := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi0
      have hle : Finsupp.single i 1 ≤ α := Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr hi1
      have hsplit : α = (α - Finsupp.single i 1 : Fin n →₀ ℕ) + Finsupp.single i 1 :=
        (tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle).symm
      have hdeg : (α - Finsupp.single i 1 : Fin n →₀ ℕ).degree = m := by
        have := congrArg Finsupp.degree hsplit
        rw [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single, hα] at this
        omega
      have hs' : ∀ j, j ∉ s → (α - Finsupp.single i 1 : Fin n →₀ ℕ) j = 0 := fun j hj => by
        rw [Finsupp.tsub_apply, hs j hj, Nat.zero_sub]
      have hprod : ∏ j, x j ^ α j =
          (∏ j, x j ^ (α - Finsupp.single i 1 : Fin n →₀ ℕ) j) * x i := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
        rw [prod_pow_add, prod_pow_single]
      rw [hprod]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mul_mem_mul ⟨_, ⟨hdeg, hs'⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨i, his, rfl⟩)

name: IsLocalRing.span_range_pow_eq_span_monomials
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.image_univ, span_image_pow_eq_span_monomials]
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp

name: IsLocalRing.exists_sum_monomials_of_mem_span
statement:
theorem exists_sum_monomials_of_mem_span {p : (Fin n →₀ ℕ) → Prop} {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ Ideal.span {z : R | ∃ α : Fin n →₀ ℕ, p α ∧ z = ∏ i, x i ^ α i}) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Fin n →₀ ℕ)) (c : (Fin n →₀ ℕ) → R),
      (∀ α ∈ S, p α) ∧ f = ∑ α ∈ S, c α * ∏ i, x i ^ α i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hf
  · rintro _ ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨{α}, fun _ => 1, by simpa using hα, by simp⟩
  · exact ⟨∅, fun _ => 0, by simp, by simp⟩
  · rintro f g - - ⟨S, c, hS, rfl⟩ ⟨T, d, hT, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨S ∪ T, fun α => (if α ∈ S then c α else 0) + (if α ∈ T then d α else 0), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro α hα
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hα with h | h
      · exact hS α h
      · exact hT α h
    · simp only [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      · rw [← Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left
          (f := fun α => (if α ∈ S then c α else 0) * ∏ i, x i ^ α i)
          (fun α _ hα => by simp [hα])]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun α hα => by simp [hα]
      · rw [← Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right
          (f := fun α => (if α ∈ T then d α else 0) * ∏ i, x i ^ α i)
          (fun α _ hα => by simp [hα])]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun α hα => by simp [hα]
  · rintro a f - ⟨S, c, hS, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨S, fun α => a * c α, hS, by simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]⟩

name: IsLocalRing.exists_coeff_notMem_of_ordElem_eq
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_not] at hcon
  have hmem : f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ (m + 1) := by
    rw [hfeq]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun α hα => ?_
    rw [pow_succ']
    refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hcon α hα) ?_
    rw [hx, span_range_pow_eq_span_monomials]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨α, hS α hα, rfl⟩
  have := mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem.mp hmem
  rw [hf] at this
  exact absurd this (by exact_mod_cast Nat.not_succ_le_self m)

name: IsLocalRing.exists_sum_monomials_unit_coeff
statement:
theorem exists_sum_monomials_unit_coeff (f : R) (m : ℕ) (hf : ordElem f = m) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Fin n →₀ ℕ)) (c : (Fin n →₀ ℕ) → R),
      (∀ α ∈ S, α.degree = m) ∧ f = ∑ α ∈ S, c α * ∏ i, x i ^ α i ∧
        ∃ α ∈ S, c α ∉ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  have hfm : f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ m := mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem.mpr (by rw [hf])
  rw [hx, span_range_pow_eq_span_monomials] at hfm
  obtain ⟨S, c, hS, rfl⟩ := exists_sum_monomials_of_mem_span x hfm
  exact ⟨S, c, hS, rfl, exists_coeff_notMem_of_ordElem_eq x hx hS rfl hf⟩

name: IsLocalRing.exists_sum_monomials_unit_coeff_of_mem_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem exists_sum_monomials_unit_coeff_of_mem_chartCenter_pow (r : Fin n) {f : R} {m : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m) (hord : ordElem f = m) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Fin n →₀ ℕ)) (c : (Fin n →₀ ℕ) → R),
      (∀ α ∈ S, α.degree = m ∧ ∀ i, r < i → α i = 0) ∧
        f = ∑ α ∈ S, c α * ∏ i, x i ^ α i ∧ ∃ α ∈ S, c α ∉ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartCenter, span_image_pow_eq_span_monomials] at hf
  obtain ⟨S, c, hS, rfl⟩ := exists_sum_monomials_of_mem_span x hf
  exact ⟨S, c, fun α hα => ⟨(hS α hα).1, fun i hi => (hS α hα).2 i (not_le.mpr hi)⟩, rfl,
    exists_coeff_notMem_of_ordElem_eq x hx (fun α hα => (hS α hα).1) rfl hord⟩

name: IsLocalRing.exists_leading_form
statement:
theorem exists_leading_form (f : R) (m : ℕ) (hf : ordElem f = m) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Fin n →₀ ℕ)) (c : (Fin n →₀ ℕ) → R) (g : R),
      (∀ α ∈ S, α.degree = m) ∧ f = ∑ α ∈ S, c α * ∏ i, x i ^ α i + g ∧
        g ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ (m + 1) ∧ ∃ α ∈ S, c α ∉ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, c, hS, hfeq, hunit⟩ := exists_sum_monomials_unit_coeff x hx f m hf
  exact ⟨S, c, 0, hS, by rw [add_zero]; exact hfeq, zero_mem _, hunit⟩

name: IsLocalRing.exists_castLE_eq_of_ne
statement: theorem exists_castLE_eq_of_ne {j : Fin n} (hj : j ≠ r) : ∃ i : Fin r, Fin.castLE r.2.le i = j
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : j.val < r.val := by
    have := j.2
    have hne : j.val ≠ r.val := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h)
    omega
  exact ⟨⟨j.val, hlt⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.chartRelations_sup_span_C_eq_map_C_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem chartRelations_sup_span_C_eq_map_C_maximalIdeal :
    chartRelations x r ⊔ Ideal.span {C (x r)} =
      (maximalIdeal R).map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx, Ideal.map_span]
  refine le_antisymm (sup_le (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨x r, ⟨r, rfl⟩, rfl⟩))
      (Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, ⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
  · rintro _ rfl
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨x r, ⟨r, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    by_cases hj : j = r
    · subst hj
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := exists_castLE_eq_of_ne r hr hj
      have h1 : C (x r) * X i ∈ chartRelations x r ⊔ Ideal.span {C (x r)} :=
        Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl))
      have h2 : C (x r) * X i - C (x (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)) ∈
          chartRelations x r ⊔ Ideal.span {C (x r)} :=
        Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      have := Ideal.sub_mem _ h1 h2
      rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this

name: IsLocalRing.exists_quotient_map_ringEquiv_of_sup_eq_map
statement:
theorem exists_quotient_map_ringEquiv_of_sup_eq_map (P : Ideal R)
    (L : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r) R))
    (hsup : RingHom.ker (chartPresentation x r) ⊔ L = P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R)) :
    ∃ e : (chartRing x r ⧸ L.map (chartPresentation x r).toRingHom) ≃+*
        MvPolynomial (Fin r) (R ⧸ P),
      (∀ a : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a)) =
          MvPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk P a)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin r, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i))) =
          MvPolynomial.X i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set J : Ideal (chartRing x r) := L.map (chartPresentation x r).toRingHom with hJ
  set K : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r) R) := RingHom.ker (chartPresentation x r) with hK
  let e₁ : (MvPolynomial (Fin r) R ⧸ K) ≃ₐ[R] chartRing x r :=
    Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (chartPresentation_surjective x r)
  have he₁ : ∀ p, e₁ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K p) = chartPresentation x r p := fun p =>
    Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk _ p
  have hPC : ∀ a : R, chartPresentation x r (C a) = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a := fun a =>
    (chartPresentation x r).commutes a
  have hPX : ∀ i : Fin r, chartPresentation x r (X i) = chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) :=
    fun i => MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ i
  have h1 : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R,
      e₁.symm.toRingEquiv (chartPresentation x r p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K p := fun p => by
    change e₁.symm (chartPresentation x r p) = _
    rw [← he₁, e₁.symm_apply_apply]
  have hJ' : L.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk K) =
      J.map (e₁.symm.toRingEquiv : chartRing x r →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R ⧸ K) := by
    rw [hJ, Ideal.map_map]
    congr 1
    exact RingHom.ext fun p => (h1 p).symm
  
  
  
  let φ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R ⧸ P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R) →+*
      MvPolynomial (Fin r) (R ⧸ P) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift _ (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (C.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk P)) X)
      fun _ ha => MvPolynomial.eval₂_C_mk_eq_zero ha
  let ψ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) (R ⧸ P) →+*
      MvPolynomial (Fin r) R ⧸ P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R) :=
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Ideal.Quotient.lift P ((Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp C)
      fun _ hi => MvPolynomial.quotient_map_C_eq_zero hi) fun i => Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)
  have hφψ : φ.comp ψ = RingHom.id _ := RingHom.ext fun p =>
    MvPolynomial.quotientEquivQuotientMvPolynomial_rightInverse (σ := Fin r) P p
  have hψφ : ψ.comp φ = RingHom.id _ := RingHom.ext fun p =>
    MvPolynomial.quotientEquivQuotientMvPolynomial_leftInverse (σ := Fin r) P p
  let e₅ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R ⧸ P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R) ≃+*
      MvPolynomial (Fin r) (R ⧸ P) := RingEquiv.ofRingHom φ ψ hφψ hψφ
  have h5C : ∀ a : R,
      e₅ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R)) (C a)) =
        C (Ideal.Quotient.mk P a) := fun a =>
    (Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk (P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R))
      (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (C.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk P)) X)
      (fun _ ha => MvPolynomial.eval₂_C_mk_eq_zero ha)).trans (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C _ _ _)
  have h5X : ∀ i : Fin r,
      e₅ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R)) (X i)) =
        X i := fun i =>
    (Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk (P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R))
      (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (C.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk P)) X)
      (fun _ ha => MvPolynomial.eval₂_C_mk_eq_zero ha)).trans (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' _ _ _)
  let e₄ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R ⧸ (K ⊔ L) ≃+*
      MvPolynomial (Fin r) R ⧸ P.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R) :=
    Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hsup
  have h4 : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R, e₄ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p :=
    fun p => Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk hsup p
  refine ⟨((Ideal.quotientEquiv J _ e₁.symm.toRingEquiv hJ').trans
    (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup K (L))).trans (e₄.trans e₅),
    fun a => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.trans_apply,
      Ideal.quotientEquiv_mk, ← hPC, h1]
    change e₅ (e₄ (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup K _
      (DoubleQuot.quotQuotMk K (L) (C a)))) = _
    rw [DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup_quotQuotMk, h4]
    exact h5C a
  · rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.trans_apply,
      Ideal.quotientEquiv_mk, ← hPX, h1]
    change e₅ (e₄ (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup K _
      (DoubleQuot.quotQuotMk K (L) (X i)))) = _
    rw [DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup_quotQuotMk, h4]
    exact h5X i

name: IsLocalRing.exists_quotient_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_quotient_map_ringEquiv (L : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin r) R))
    (hsup : RingHom.ker (chartPresentation x r) ⊔ L =
      (maximalIdeal R).map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R)) :
    ∃ e : (chartRing x r ⧸ L.map (chartPresentation x r).toRingHom) ≃+*
        MvPolynomial (Fin r) (ResidueField R),
      (∀ a : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a)) =
          MvPolynomial.C (residue R a)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin r, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i))) =
          MvPolynomial.X i
proof:
:=
  exists_quotient_map_ringEquiv_of_sup_eq_map x r (maximalIdeal R) L hsup

name: IsLocalRing.exists_quotient_map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_quotient_map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv :
    ∃ e : (chartRing x r ⧸ (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))) ≃+*
        MvPolynomial (Fin r) (ResidueField R),
      (∀ a : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a)) =
          MvPolynomial.C (residue R a)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin r, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i))) =
          MvPolynomial.X i
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) =
      ((maximalIdeal R).map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R)).map
        (chartPresentation x r).toRingHom := by
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    congr 1
    exact RingHom.ext fun a => ((chartPresentation x r).commutes a).symm
  rw [hL]
  refine exists_quotient_map_ringEquiv x r _ ?_
  rw [ker_chartPresentation x r hx hn, sup_eq_right]
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  refine Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_))
    (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_)
  · rw [hx]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨r, rfl⟩
  · rw [hx]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.exists_quotient_span_algebraMap_x_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_quotient_span_algebraMap_x_ringEquiv :
    ∃ e : (chartRing x r ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)}) ≃+*
        MvPolynomial (Fin r) (ResidueField R),
      (∀ a : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a)) =
          MvPolynomial.C (residue R a)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin r, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i))) =
          MvPolynomial.X i
proof:
:= by
  have hL : Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} =
      (Ideal.span {C (x r)}).map (chartPresentation x r).toRingHom := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    congr 2
    exact ((chartPresentation x r).commutes (x r)).symm
  rw [hL]
  refine exists_quotient_map_ringEquiv x r _ ?_
  rw [ker_chartPresentation x r hx hn]
  exact chartRelations_sup_span_C_eq_map_C_maximalIdeal x hx r hr

name: IsLocalRing.chartRelations_sup_span_C_eq_map_C_chartCenter
statement:
theorem chartRelations_sup_span_C_eq_map_C_chartCenter :
    chartRelations x r ⊔ Ideal.span {C (x r)} =
      (chartCenter x r).map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartCenter, Ideal.map_span]
  refine le_antisymm (sup_le (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine Ideal.sub_mem _
      (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨x r, ⟨r, by simp, rfl⟩, rfl⟩))
      (Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, ⟨Fin.castLE r.2.le i, ?_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
    change Fin.castLE r.2.le i ≤ r
    exact Fin.le_def.mpr i.2.le
  · rintro _ rfl
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨x r, ⟨r, by simp, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have hj' : j ≤ r := hj
    by_cases hjr : j = r
    · subst hjr
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    · have hlt : j.val < r.val := lt_of_le_of_ne hj' (fun h => hjr (Fin.ext h))
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i : Fin r, Fin.castLE r.2.le i = j := ⟨⟨j.val, hlt⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩
      have h1 : C (x r) * X i ∈ chartRelations x r ⊔ Ideal.span {C (x r)} :=
        Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl))
      have h2 : C (x r) * X i - C (x (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)) ∈
          chartRelations x r ⊔ Ideal.span {C (x r)} :=
        Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      have := Ideal.sub_mem _ h1 h2
      rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this

name: IsLocalRing.exists_quotient_span_algebraMap_x_ringEquiv_chartCenter
statement:
theorem exists_quotient_span_algebraMap_x_ringEquiv_chartCenter :
    ∃ e : (chartRing x r ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)}) ≃+*
        MvPolynomial (Fin r) (R ⧸ chartCenter x r),
      (∀ a : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a)) =
          MvPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartCenter x r) a)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin r, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i))) =
          MvPolynomial.X i
proof:
:= by
  have hL : Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} =
      (Ideal.span {C (x r)}).map (chartPresentation x r).toRingHom := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    congr 2
    exact ((chartPresentation x r).commutes (x r)).symm
  rw [hL]
  refine exists_quotient_map_ringEquiv_of_sup_eq_map x r _ _ ?_
  rw [ker_chartPresentation x r hx hn]
  exact chartRelations_sup_span_C_eq_map_C_chartCenter x r

name: IsLocalRing.isPrime_span_algebraMap_x_of_chartCenter
statement:
theorem isPrime_span_algebraMap_x_of_chartCenter :
    (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)}).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, -, -⟩ := exists_quotient_span_algebraMap_x_ringEquiv_chartCenter x hx hn r
  have := isPrime_chartCenter x hx hn r
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp (MulEquiv.isDomain _ e.toMulEquiv)

name: IsLocalRing.comap_span_algebraMap_x_eq_chartCenter
statement:
theorem comap_span_algebraMap_x_eq_chartCenter :
    (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)}).comap (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) =
      chartCenter x r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, -⟩ := exists_quotient_span_algebraMap_x_ringEquiv_chartCenter x hx hn r
  ext a
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← e.map_eq_zero_iff, he,
    ← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem (I := chartCenter x r)]
  exact ⟨fun h => by rwa [← MvPolynomial.C_0, MvPolynomial.C_inj] at h,
    fun h => by rw [h, MvPolynomial.C_0]⟩

name: IsLocalRing.isPrime_span_algebraMap_x
statement:
theorem isPrime_span_algebraMap_x :
    (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)}).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, -, -⟩ := exists_quotient_span_algebraMap_x_ringEquiv x hx hn r hr
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp (MulEquiv.isDomain _ e.toMulEquiv)

name: IsLocalRing.restrictExp_apply
statement:
theorem restrictExp_apply (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin r) :
    restrictExp r α i = α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrictExp]

name: IsLocalRing.not_lt_of_succ_eq
statement: theorem not_lt_of_succ_eq (hr : r.val + 1 = n) (i : Fin n) : ¬ r < i
proof:
:= fun h => by
  rw [Fin.lt_def] at h
  have := i.2
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.prod_eq_prod_castLE_of_forall_gt
statement:
theorem prod_eq_prod_castLE_of_forall_gt {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (g : Fin n → M)
    (hg : ∀ i, r < i → g i = 1) :
    ∏ j, g j = ∏ i : Fin (r.val + 1), g (Fin.castLE r.2 i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ∏ i : Fin (r.val + 1), g (Fin.castLE r.2 i) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.map (Fin.castLEEmb r.2), g j :=
    (Finset.prod_map Finset.univ (Fin.castLEEmb r.2) g).symm
  rw [h]
  refine (Finset.prod_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) fun j _ hj => hg j ?_).symm
  by_contra h
  apply hj
  rw [Finset.mem_map]
  refine ⟨⟨j.val, ?_⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext rfl⟩
  have := Fin.le_def.mp (not_lt.mp h)
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.sum_eq_sum_castLE_of_forall_gt
statement:
theorem sum_eq_sum_castLE_of_forall_gt {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (g : Fin n → M)
    (hg : ∀ i, r < i → g i = 0) :
    ∑ j, g j = ∑ i : Fin (r.val + 1), g (Fin.castLE r.2 i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ∑ i : Fin (r.val + 1), g (Fin.castLE r.2 i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.map (Fin.castLEEmb r.2), g j :=
    (Finset.sum_map Finset.univ (Fin.castLEEmb r.2) g).symm
  rw [h]
  refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) fun j _ hj => hg j ?_).symm
  by_contra h
  apply hj
  rw [Finset.mem_map]
  refine ⟨⟨j.val, ?_⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext rfl⟩
  have := Fin.le_def.mp (not_lt.mp h)
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.degree_eq_apply_add_sum'
statement:
theorem degree_eq_apply_add_sum' (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (hα : ∀ i, r < i → α i = 0) :
    α.degree = α r + ∑ i : Fin r, α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, sum_eq_sum_castLE_of_forall_gt r α hα, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc,
    add_comm]
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg α (Fin.ext rfl))
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => congrArg α (Fin.ext rfl))

name: IsLocalRing.eq_of_restrictExp_eq'
statement:
theorem eq_of_restrictExp_eq' {α β : Fin n →₀ ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hα : α.degree = m) (hβ : β.degree = m)
    (hα' : ∀ i, r < i → α i = 0) (hβ' : ∀ i, r < i → β i = 0)
    (h : restrictExp r α = restrictExp r β) : α = β
proof:
:= by
  have hrest : ∀ i : Fin r, α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) = β (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) := fun i => by
    have := congrArg (fun γ : Fin r →₀ ℕ => γ i) h
    simpa [restrictExp_apply] using this
  ext j
  by_cases hjr : j = r
  · rw [hjr]
    have h1 := degree_eq_apply_add_sum' r α hα'
    have h2 := degree_eq_apply_add_sum' r β hβ'
    rw [hα] at h1
    rw [hβ] at h2
    have h3 : ∑ i : Fin r, α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) = ∑ i : Fin r, β (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hrest i
    omega
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hjr with hj | hj
    · have hj' : j = Fin.castLE r.2.le ⟨j.val, Fin.lt_def.mp hj⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hj']
      exact hrest _
    · rw [hα' j hj, hβ' j hj]

name: IsLocalRing.prod_algebraMap_pow_eq'
statement:
theorem prod_algebraMap_pow_eq' (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) (hα : ∀ i, r < i → α i = 0) :
    ∏ j, algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x j) ^ α j =
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ α.degree *
        ∏ i : Fin r, chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) ^ α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [prod_eq_prod_castLE_of_forall_gt r (fun j => algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x j) ^ α j)
    (fun i hi => by rw [hα i hi, pow_zero]), Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  have e2 : Fin.castLE r.2 (Fin.last r.val) = r := Fin.ext rfl
  have hL : ∏ i : Fin r.val,
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x (Fin.castLE r.2 (Fin.castSucc i))) ^
        α (Fin.castLE r.2 (Fin.castSucc i)) =
      ∏ i : Fin r, algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) *
        chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) ^ α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) := by
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have e1 : Fin.castLE r.2 (Fin.castSucc i) = Fin.castLE r.2.le i := Fin.ext rfl
    have hlt : Fin.castLE r.2.le i < r := by
      rw [Fin.lt_def]
      exact i.2
    rw [e1, algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR x r hlt, mul_pow]
  rw [hL, e2, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum,
    degree_eq_apply_add_sum' r α hα, pow_add]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.univ_erase_eq_map_castLEEmb
statement:
theorem univ_erase_eq_map_castLEEmb :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).erase r =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)).map (Fin.castLEEmb r.2.le)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Finset.mem_map, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := exists_castLE_eq_of_ne r hr hj
    exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.castLEEmb_apply, Fin.val_castLE] at this
    have := i.2
    omega

name: IsLocalRing.degree_eq_apply_add_sum
statement:
theorem degree_eq_apply_add_sum (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    α.degree = α r + ∑ i : Fin r, α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)
proof:
:=
  degree_eq_apply_add_sum' r α fun i hi => absurd hi (not_lt_of_succ_eq r hr i)

name: IsLocalRing.eq_of_restrictExp_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_restrictExp_eq {α β : Fin n →₀ ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hα : α.degree = m) (hβ : β.degree = m)
    (h : restrictExp r α = restrictExp r β) : α = β
proof:
:=
  eq_of_restrictExp_eq' r hα hβ (fun i hi => absurd hi (not_lt_of_succ_eq r hr i))
    (fun i hi => absurd hi (not_lt_of_succ_eq r hr i)) h

name: IsLocalRing.prod_algebraMap_pow_eq
statement:
theorem prod_algebraMap_pow_eq (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    ∏ j, algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x j) ^ α j =
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ α.degree *
        ∏ i : Fin r, chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) ^ α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)
proof:
:=
  prod_algebraMap_pow_eq' x r α fun i hi => absurd hi (not_lt_of_succ_eq r hr i)

name: IsLocalRing.chartCenter_eq_span_range_of_succ_eq
statement:
theorem chartCenter_eq_span_range_of_succ_eq (hr : r.val + 1 = n) :
    chartCenter x r = Ideal.span (Set.range x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartCenter, ← Set.image_univ]
  congr 2
  ext i
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  exact not_lt.mp (not_lt_of_succ_eq r hr i)

name: IsLocalRing.exists_transformElem_eq_chartPresentation
statement:
theorem exists_transformElem_eq_chartPresentation {f : R} {m : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    (hord : ordElem f = m) :
    ∃ Q : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R, transformElem x r f hf = chartPresentation x r Q ∧
      Q.totalDegree ≤ m ∧ ∃ β, Q.coeff β ∉ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, c, hS, hfeq, α₀, hα₀S, hc⟩ :=
    exists_sum_monomials_unit_coeff_of_mem_chartCenter_pow x hx r hf hord
  refine ⟨∑ α ∈ S, monomial (restrictExp r α) (c α), ?_, ?_, restrictExp r α₀, ?_⟩
  · symm
    apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
    rw [hfeq, map_sum, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun α hα => ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_prod]
    simp only [map_pow]
    rw [prod_algebraMap_pow_eq' x r α (hS α hα).2, (hS α hα).1]
    simp only [chartPresentation, aeval_monomial]
    rw [Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun i => pow_zero _)]
    simp only [restrictExp_apply]
    ring
  · refine (totalDegree_finsetSum _ _).trans (Finset.sup_le fun α hα => ?_)
    refine (totalDegree_monomial_le _ _).trans ?_
    have h1 := degree_eq_apply_add_sum' r α (hS α hα).2
    rw [(hS α hα).1] at h1
    have hsum : ((restrictExp r α).sum fun _ => id) = ∑ i : Fin r, α (Fin.castLE r.2.le i) := by
      rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => rfl)]
      simp only [restrictExp_apply, id]
    omega
  · rw [coeff_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single α₀]
    · rwa [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left rfl]
    · intro α hα hne
      rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right]
      exact fun h => hne (eq_of_restrictExp_eq' r (hS α hα).1 (hS α₀ hα₀S).1 (hS α hα).2
        (hS α₀ hα₀S).2 h)
    · intro h
      exact absurd hα₀S h

name: IsLocalRing.exists_algebraMap_eq_pow_mul_chartPresentation
statement:
theorem exists_algebraMap_eq_pow_mul_chartPresentation (f : R) (m : ℕ) (hf : ordElem f = m) :
    ∃ Q : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R,
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f =
          algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * chartPresentation x r Q ∧
        ∃ β, Q.coeff β ∉ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m := by
    rw [chartCenter_eq_span_range_of_succ_eq x r hr, ← hx]
    exact mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem.mpr (by rw [hf])
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, -, β, hβ⟩ := exists_transformElem_eq_chartPresentation x hx r hmem hf
  exact ⟨Q, by rw [← hQ, algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem], β, hβ⟩

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_notMem_span_pow_succ
statement:
theorem algebraMap_notMem_span_pow_succ (f : R) (m : ℕ) (hf : ordElem f = m) :
    algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f ∉ Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, β, hβ⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_pow_mul_chartPresentation x hx r hr f m hf
  obtain ⟨e, heC, heX⟩ := exists_quotient_span_algebraMap_x_ringEquiv x hx hn r hr
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at hmem
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
  have hPQ : chartPresentation x r Q = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) * h := by
    apply algebraMap_pow_mul_right_injective x r m
    change algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * chartPresentation x r Q =
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) * h)
    rw [← hQ, ← hh, pow_succ]
    ring
  have hmk : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)})
      (chartPresentation x r Q) = 0 := by
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, hPQ]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have hcomp : (e : (chartRing x r ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)}) →+*
      MvPolynomial (Fin r) (ResidueField R)).comp
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp (chartPresentation x r : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R →+* _)) =
      MvPolynomial.map (residue R) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      change e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartPresentation x r (C a))) =
        MvPolynomial.map (residue R) (C a)
      rw [show chartPresentation x r (C a) = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a from
        MvPolynomial.aeval_C _ a, MvPolynomial.map_C]
      exact heC a
    · intro i
      change e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartPresentation x r (X i))) =
        MvPolynomial.map (residue R) (X i)
      rw [MvPolynomial.map_X, show chartPresentation x r (X i) = chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)
        from MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ i]
      exact heX i
  have h0 : MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (fun ψ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin r) (ResidueField R) =>
      ψ Q) hcomp
    change e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (chartPresentation x r Q)) = MvPolynomial.map (residue R) Q
      at this
    rw [hmk, map_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  have := congrArg (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff · β) h0
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
    IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff] at this
  exact hβ this

name: IsLocalRing.ordAlong_span_algebraMap_x_map
statement:
theorem ordAlong_span_algebraMap_x_map (I : Ideal R) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isPrime_span_algebraMap_x x hx hn r hr
    ordAlong (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)})
        (I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))) = ord I := by
  classical
  have hP := isPrime_span_algebraMap_x x hx hn r hr
  set P : Ideal (chartRing x r) := Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} with hPdef
  have hmC : maximalIdeal R = chartCenter x r := by
    rw [hx, chartCenter]
    congr 1
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨i, ?_, rfl⟩
      change i.val ≤ r.val
      have := i.2
      omega
    · rintro ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hmap : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) = P := by
    rw [hmC]
    exact map_chartCenter x r
  have hmax : maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P) = P.map (algebraMap _ _) :=
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal P (Localization.AtPrime P)).symm
  rcases eq_or_ne (ord I) ⊤ with htop | hne
  · rw [htop, ord_eq_top_iff.mp htop, Ideal.map_bot]
    unfold ordAlong
    rw [Ideal.map_bot]
    exact ord_bot
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hne
    rw [ENat.some_eq_natCast] at hm
    rw [← hm]
    unfold ordAlong
    apply le_antisymm
    · obtain ⟨f, hfI, hfm⟩ := exists_mem_ordElem_eq_of_ord_eq hm.symm
      have hmem : algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime P) (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f) ∈
          (I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).map (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime P)) :=
        Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hfI)
      refine le_trans ((ord_eq_iInf _).le.trans (iInf₂_le _ hmem)) ?_
      by_contra hlt
      have hle : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤
          ordElem (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime P) (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f)) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_succ]
        exact Order.add_one_le_of_lt (not_le.mp hlt)
      have hmem' := mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem.mpr hle
      rw [hmax, ← Ideal.map_pow,
        IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P)] at hmem'
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨s, hs⟩⟩, hys⟩ := hmem'
      rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P)] at hys
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hys
      dsimp only at ht hy hs
      have hne0 : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ≠ 0 := fun h =>
        x_ne_zero_of_span_eq x hx hn r
          ((algebraMap_chartRing_injective x r hx hn) (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
      have hprime : Prime (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)) :=
        (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hne0).mp hP
      rw [hPdef, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hy
      have hdvd : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ (m + 1) ∣
          ((t : chartRing x r) * s) * algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f := by
        have : ((t : chartRing x r) * s) * algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f = t * y := by
          rw [← ht]
          ring
        rw [this]
        exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hy _
      have hts : ¬ algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ∣ (t : chartRing x r) * s := by
        intro h
        have hmemP : (t : chartRing x r) * s ∈ P := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr h
        rcases hP.mem_or_mem hmemP with h1 | h1
        · exact (t.2 : (t : chartRing x r) ∉ P) h1
        · exact (hs : s ∉ P) h1
      have hfin := hprime.pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_left _ hts hdvd
      exact algebraMap_notMem_span_pow_succ x hx hn r hr f m hfm
        (by rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hfin)
    · refine le_ord_iff.mpr ?_
      have h1 : I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ m := le_ord_iff.mp hm.le
      calc (I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).map (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime P))
          ≤ ((maximalIdeal R ^ m).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).map
              (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime P)) := Ideal.map_mono (Ideal.map_mono h1)
        _ = maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P) ^ m := by
          rw [Ideal.map_pow, hmap, Ideal.map_pow, hmax]

name: MvPowerSeries.pderiv_pderiv_comm
statement:
theorem pderiv_pderiv_comm (i j : σ) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    pderiv (R := R) i (pderiv (R := R) j f) = pderiv (R := R) j (pderiv (R := R) i f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext n
  simp only [coeff_pderiv, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  rw [add_right_comm n (Finsupp.single j 1) (Finsupp.single i 1)]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h; ring
  · simp only [h, Ne.symm h, ite_false, add_zero]; ring

name: MvPowerSeries.exists_eq_sum_X_mul
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sum_X_mul (s : Finset σ) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R)
    (hf : ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, (∀ i ∈ s, m i = 0) → coeff m f = 0) :
    ∃ g : σ → MvPowerSeries σ R, f = ∑ i ∈ s, X i * g i ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ d, coeff d (g i) ≠ 0 → coeff (d + Finsupp.single i 1) f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing f with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨0, ?_, by simp⟩
    ext m
    simpa using hf m (by simp)
  | insert a t hat ih =>
    set ga : MvPowerSeries σ R := fun d => coeff (d + Finsupp.single a 1) f with hga
    have hXga : ∀ m, coeff m (X a * ga) = if 1 ≤ m a then coeff m f else 0 := by
      intro m
      rw [X_def, coeff_monomial_mul]
      by_cases h : 1 ≤ m a
      · rw [ite_eq_left (Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr h), ite_eq_left h, one_mul]
        change coeff (m - Finsupp.single a 1 + Finsupp.single a 1) f = coeff m f
        rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le (Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr h)]
      · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h' => h (Finsupp.single_le_iff.mp h')), ite_eq_right h]
    set φ₁ : MvPowerSeries σ R := fun m => if m a = 0 then coeff m f else 0 with hφ₁
    have hφ₁c : ∀ m, coeff m φ₁ = if m a = 0 then coeff m f else 0 := fun m => rfl
    have hsplit : f = φ₁ + X a * ga := by
      ext m
      rw [map_add, hXga, hφ₁c]
      by_cases h : m a = 0
      · simp [h]
      · simp [h, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h]
    have hφ₁' : ∀ m : σ →₀ ℕ, (∀ i ∈ t, m i = 0) → coeff m φ₁ = 0 := by
      intro m hm
      rw [hφ₁c]
      by_cases h : m a = 0
      · rw [ite_eq_left h]
        exact hf m fun i hi => by
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
          · exact h
          · exact hm i hi
      · exact ite_eq_right h
    obtain ⟨g', hg', hsupp⟩ := ih φ₁ hφ₁'
    refine ⟨Function.update g' a ga, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.sum_insert hat, Function.update_self, hsplit, hg', add_comm]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => by
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi hat)]
    · intro i hi d hd
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
      · rwa [Function.update_self] at hd
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi hat)] at hd
        intro h0
        apply hsupp i hi d hd
        rw [hφ₁c]
        split_ifs <;> simp [h0]

name: MvPowerSeries.mem_span_range_X_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_span_range_X_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero [Finite σ] {f : MvPowerSeries σ R}
    (hf : constantCoeff f = 0) : f ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPowerSeries σ R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype σ
  obtain ⟨g, hg, -⟩ := exists_eq_sum_X_mul Finset.univ f fun m hm => by
    have : m = 0 := Finsupp.ext fun i => hm i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [this, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hf]
  rw [hg]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: MvPowerSeries.mem_span_range_X_pow_iff_le_order
statement:
theorem mem_span_range_X_pow_iff_le_order [Finite σ] (k : ℕ) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) :
    f ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPowerSeries σ R)) ^ k ↔ (k : ℕ∞) ≤ f.order
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing f with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    constructor
    · intro hf
      rw [pow_succ] at hf
      refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf (fun r hr s hs => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
      · have h1 : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ s.order := by
          rw [one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero]
          have : Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPowerSeries σ R)) ≤
              RingHom.ker (constantCoeff (σ := σ) (R := R)) :=
            Ideal.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; simp [RingHom.mem_ker])
          exact this hs
        calc ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) = (k : ℕ∞) + 1 := by push_cast; rfl
          _ ≤ r.order + s.order := add_le_add ((ih r).mp hr) h1
          _ ≤ (r * s).order := le_order_mul
      · exact le_trans (le_min hx hy) min_order_le_add
    · intro hf
      have hc : constantCoeff f = 0 := by
        rw [← one_le_order_iff_constCoeff_eq_zero]
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)) hf
      cases nonempty_fintype σ
      obtain ⟨g, hg, hsupp⟩ := exists_eq_sum_X_mul Finset.univ f fun m hm => by
        have : m = 0 := Finsupp.ext fun i => hm i (Finset.mem_univ i)
        rw [this, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hc]
      have hgi : ∀ i, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ (g i).order := by
        intro i
        apply le_order
        intro d hd
        by_contra hne
        have h1 := order_le (hsupp i (Finset.mem_univ i) d hne)
        rw [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single] at h1
        have h2 : (f.order : ℕ∞) ≤ (d.degree : ℕ∞) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
        have h3 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (d.degree : ℕ∞) + 1 := hf.trans h2
        have h4 : (d.degree : ℕ∞) < (k : ℕ∞) := hd
        have h5 : (k : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ (d.degree : ℕ∞) + 1 := by push_cast at h3; exact h3
        exact absurd (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right ENat.one_ne_top |>.mp h5) (not_le.mpr h4)
      rw [hg, pow_succ']
      exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
        Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩) ((ih (g i)).mpr (hgi i))

name: MvPowerSeries.maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_X
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_X (σ : Type*) [Finite σ] (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries σ K) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPowerSeries σ K))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun f hf => ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · apply mem_span_range_X_of_constantCoeff_eq_zero
    by_contra h
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal f).mp hf
      (isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h))
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, isUnit_iff_constantCoeff,
      constantCoeff_X]
    exact not_isUnit_zero

name: MvPowerSeries.ordElem_eq_order
statement:
theorem ordElem_eq_order {σ : Type*} [Finite σ] {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : MvPowerSeries σ K) :
    IsLocalRing.ordElem f = f.order
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_ <;> rw [← ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le] <;> intro r hr
  · rwa [← IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem, maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_X,
      mem_span_range_X_pow_iff_le_order] at hr
  · rwa [← IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem, maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_X,
      mem_span_range_X_pow_iff_le_order]

name: IsLocalRing.isNoetherianRing_chartRing
statement: theorem isNoetherianRing_chartRing : IsNoetherianRing (chartRing x r)
proof:
:=
  isNoetherianRing_of_surjective (MvPolynomial (Fin r) R) (chartRing x r)
    (chartPresentation x r).toRingHom (chartPresentation_surjective x r)

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_localization_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_localization_chartOrigin [(chartOrigin x r).IsPrime] :
    maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
        algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)) (chartYR x r i))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal).symm.trans ?_
  change Ideal.map _ (Ideal.span (Set.range (chartYR x r))) = _
  rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_chartOrigin_le
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_chartOrigin_le [(chartOrigin x r).IsPrime] :
    (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))).spanFinrank ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximalIdeal_localization_chartOrigin x r]
  refine le_trans (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_range _)) ?_
  rw [← Set.image_univ]
  exact le_trans (Set.ncard_image_le Set.finite_univ)
    (by rw [Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin])

name: IsLocalRing.swapLast_last
statement: theorem swapLast_last : swapLast x r (lastIdx r) = x r
proof:
:= by
  simp [swapLast]

name: IsLocalRing.span_range_swapLast
statement:
theorem span_range_swapLast (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) :
    maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range (swapLast x r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx, swapLast, (Equiv.swap _ _).surjective.range_comp]

name: IsLocalRing.swapPrime_isPrime
statement:
theorem swapPrime_isPrime (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (j : ℕ) : (swapPrime x r j).IsPrime
proof:
:=
  isPrime_span_image_lt (swapLast x r) (span_range_swapLast x r hx) hn j

name: IsLocalRing.swapPrime_mono
statement: theorem swapPrime_mono {j j' : ℕ} (h : j ≤ j') : swapPrime x r j ≤ swapPrime x r j'
proof:
:=
  Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun _ hi => lt_of_lt_of_le hi h)

name: IsLocalRing.x_notMem_swapPrime
statement:
theorem x_notMem_swapPrime (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n - 1) : x r ∉ swapPrime x r j
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := swapPrime_mono x r hj h
  rw [← swapLast_last x r] at h1
  exact notMem_span_image_lt (swapLast x r) (span_range_swapLast x r hx) hn
    (i := n - 1) (by have := r.2; omega) h1

name: IsLocalRing.swapLast_mem_swapPrime_succ
statement:
theorem swapLast_mem_swapPrime_succ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) :
    swapLast x r ⟨j, hj⟩ ∈ swapPrime x r (j + 1)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, Nat.lt_succ_self _, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.swapLast_notMem_swapPrime
statement:
theorem swapLast_notMem_swapPrime (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) :
    swapLast x r ⟨j, hj⟩ ∉ swapPrime x r j
proof:
:=
  notMem_span_image_lt (swapLast x r) (span_range_swapLast x r hx) hn hj

name: IsLocalRing.disjoint_powers_swapPrime
statement:
theorem disjoint_powers_swapPrime (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n - 1) :
    Disjoint (Submonoid.powers (x r) : Set R) (swapPrime x r j : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro y ⟨k, rfl⟩ hy
  exact x_notMem_swapPrime x r hx hn hj
    ((swapPrime_isPrime x r hx hn j).mem_of_pow_mem k hy)

name: IsLocalRing.chartPrime_isPrime
statement:
theorem chartPrime_isPrime (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n - 1) :
    (chartPrime x r j).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  have := IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers (x r))
    (Localization.Away (x r)) (swapPrime x r j) (swapPrime_isPrime x r hx hn j)
    (disjoint_powers_swapPrime x r hx hn hj)
  exact Ideal.IsPrime.comap _

name: IsLocalRing.chartPrime_mono
statement: theorem chartPrime_mono {j j' : ℕ} (h : j ≤ j') : chartPrime x r j ≤ chartPrime x r j'
proof:
:=
  Ideal.comap_mono (Ideal.map_mono (swapPrime_mono x r h))

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_mem_chartPrime_iff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_chartPrime_iff (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n - 1) (a : R) :
    algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a ∈ chartPrime x r j ↔ a ∈ swapPrime x r j
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartPrime, Ideal.mem_comap]
  change a ∈ Ideal.under R ((swapPrime x r j).map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)))) ↔ _
  rw [IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers (x r))
    (Localization.Away (x r)) (swapPrime_isPrime x r hx hn j)
    (disjoint_powers_swapPrime x r hx hn hj)]

name: IsLocalRing.chartPrime_lt_succ
statement:
theorem chartPrime_lt_succ (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 ≤ n - 1) :
    chartPrime x r j < chartPrime x r (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (chartPrime_mono x r (Nat.le_succ j)) fun heq => ?_
  have hjn : j < n := by omega
  have hmem : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (swapLast x r ⟨j, hjn⟩) ∈ chartPrime x r (j + 1) :=
    (algebraMap_mem_chartPrime_iff x r hx hn hj _).mpr (swapLast_mem_swapPrime_succ x r j hjn)
  rw [← heq, algebraMap_mem_chartPrime_iff x r hx hn (by omega)] at hmem
  exact swapLast_notMem_swapPrime x r hx hn j hjn hmem

name: IsLocalRing.chartPrime_le_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem chartPrime_le_chartOrigin (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    chartPrime x r (n - 1) ≤ chartOrigin x r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z hz
  set x' := swapLast x r with hx'def
  have hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x') := span_range_swapLast x r hx
  set Q : Ideal R := swapPrime x r (n - 1) with hQ
  have hQle : Q ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [hx']
    exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_subset_range _ _)
  have hS : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Q) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt x' hx' hn (n - 1)
  set S := R ⧸ Q with hSdef
  let F := FractionRing S
  let g : R →+* F := (algebraMap S F).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap S F) := IsFractionRing.injective S F
  have hg : IsUnit (g (x r)) := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    apply x_notMem_swapPrime x r hx hn le_rfl
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact hinj (by rw [map_zero]; exact h0)
  let ψ : Localization.Away (x r) →+* F := IsLocalization.Away.lift (x r) hg
  have hψ : ∀ a, ψ (algebraMap R _ a) = g a := fun a => IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (x r) hg a
  have hmk : ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x i) ∈ maximalIdeal S := fun i => by
    rw [maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq x hx i)
  have hmemQ : ∀ i, i ≠ r → x i ∈ Q := by
    intro i hi
    refine Ideal.subset_span
      ⟨Equiv.swap r (lastIdx r) i, ?_, congrArg x (Equiv.swap_apply_self _ _ _)⟩
    have hne : Equiv.swap r (lastIdx r) i ≠ lastIdx r := by
      intro h
      apply hi
      have := congrArg (Equiv.swap r (lastIdx r)) h
      rwa [Equiv.swap_apply_self, Equiv.swap_apply_right] at this
    have h2 := (Equiv.swap r (lastIdx r) i).2
    have h3 : (Equiv.swap r (lastIdx r) i).val ≠ n - 1 := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
    change (Equiv.swap r (lastIdx r) i).val < n - 1
    omega
  have hy : ∀ i, ψ (chartY x r i) ∈ algebraMap S F '' (maximalIdeal S : Set S) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i < r
    · rw [chartY_of_lt x r hi, map_mul, hψ]
      have : g (x i) = 0 := by
        change algebraMap S F (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x i)) = 0
        rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hmemQ i hi.ne), map_zero]
      rw [this, zero_mul]
      exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, map_zero _⟩
    · rw [chartY_eq_algebraMap_of_not_lt x r hi, hψ]
      exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x i), hmk i, rfl⟩
  have hR' : ∀ w ∈ chartRing x r, ψ w ∈ Set.range (algebraMap S F) := by
    intro w hw
    refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun w _ => ψ w ∈ Set.range (algebraMap S F))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hw
    · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      have hi' : i < r := hi
      obtain ⟨s, -, hs⟩ := hy i
      rw [chartY_eq_mk_of_lt x r hi'] at hs
      exact ⟨s, hs⟩
    · intro a
      exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk Q a, (hψ a).symm⟩
    · rintro w v _ _ ⟨s, hs⟩ ⟨t, ht⟩
      exact ⟨s + t, by rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht]⟩
    · rintro w v _ _ ⟨s, hs⟩ ⟨t, ht⟩
      exact ⟨s * t, by rw [map_mul, map_mul, hs, ht]⟩
  have hM : ∀ w ∈ chartOrigin x r,
      ψ (w : Localization.Away (x r)) ∈ algebraMap S F '' (maximalIdeal S : Set S) := by
    intro w hw
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun (w : chartRing x r) _ =>
        ψ (w : Localization.Away (x r)) ∈ algebraMap S F '' (maximalIdeal S : Set S))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hw
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hy i
    · exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, by rw [Subalgebra.coe_zero, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
    · rintro w v _ _ ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩
      exact ⟨s + t, add_mem hs ht, by rw [map_add, Subalgebra.coe_add, map_add, hs', ht']⟩
    · rintro b w _ ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hR' b b.2
      exact ⟨t * s, Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hs,
        by rw [map_mul, smul_eq_mul, Subalgebra.coe_mul, map_mul, ht, hs']⟩
  
  have hz0 : ψ (z : Localization.Away (x r)) = 0 := by
    have hz' : (z : Localization.Away (x r)) ∈ Q.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r))) := hz
    rw [IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers (x r))] at hz'
    obtain ⟨⟨q, s⟩, hqs⟩ := hz'
    dsimp only at hqs
    have h1 := congrArg ψ hqs
    rw [map_mul, hψ, hψ] at h1
    have hq0 : g q = 0 := by
      change algebraMap S F (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q q) = 0
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr q.2, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.2
    have hsu : IsUnit (g s) := by
      rw [show (s : R) = x r ^ k from hk.symm, map_pow]
      exact hg.pow k
    rw [hq0] at h1
    exact (hsu.mul_left_eq_zero).mp h1
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_algebraMap_sub_mem_chartOriginOf x r (x r) z
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩ := hM _ ha
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_sub, map_sub, hz0, zero_sub, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, hψ] at ht'
  have hta : Ideal.Quotient.mk Q a = -t := by
    apply hinj
    rw [map_neg, ht', neg_neg]
    rfl
  have hmem : a ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk Q a ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
      rw [hta]; exact neg_mem ht
    rw [maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map, ← Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker,
      sup_eq_left.mpr hQle] at h1
    exact h1
  have h2 : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a ∈ chartOrigin x r :=
    maximalIdeal_le_comap_chartOrigin x r hx hmem
  have : z = (z - algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a) + algebraMap R (chartRing x r) a := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact add_mem ha h2

name: IsLocalRing.chartPrime_lt_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem chartPrime_lt_chartOrigin (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    chartPrime x r (n - 1) < chartOrigin x r
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (chartPrime_le_chartOrigin x r hx hn) fun heq => ?_
  have := algebraMap_x_mem_chartOrigin x r r
  rw [← heq, algebraMap_mem_chartPrime_iff x r hx hn le_rfl] at this
  exact x_notMem_swapPrime x r hx hn le_rfl this

name: IsLocalRing.chartChain_isPrime
statement:
theorem chartChain_isPrime (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (i : ℕ) : (chartChain x r i).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartChain
  split_ifs with h
  · exact chartPrime_isPrime x r hx hn (by omega)
  · exact (chartOrigin_isMaximal x r hx hn).isPrime

name: IsLocalRing.chartChain_lt_succ
statement:
theorem chartChain_lt_succ (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) :
    chartChain x r i < chartChain x r (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartChain
  rw [ite_eq_left hi]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact chartPrime_lt_succ x r hx hn (by omega)
  · have : i = n - 1 := by omega
    subst this
    exact chartPrime_lt_chartOrigin x r hx hn

name: IsLocalRing.natCast_le_height_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem natCast_le_height_chartOrigin (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (chartOrigin x r).height
proof:
:= by
  have hP := (chartOrigin_isMaximal x r hx hn).isPrime
  let chain : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum (chartRing x r)) := LTSeries.mk n
    (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => ⟨chartChain x r i, chartChain_isPrime x r hx hn i⟩)
    (Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr fun i => by
      rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal]
      exact chartChain_lt_succ x r hx hn i.2)
  have hlast : chain.last ≤ ⟨chartOrigin x r, hP⟩ := by
    change (⟨chartChain x r (Fin.last n : ℕ), _⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (chartRing x r)) ≤ _
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_le_asIdeal]
    change chartChain x r n ≤ chartOrigin x r
    unfold chartChain
    rw [ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl n)]
  have h := Order.length_le_height hlast
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight ⟨_, hP⟩]
  exact h

name: IsLocalRing.natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_chartOrigin
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    [(chartOrigin x r).IsPrime] :
    (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height (chartOrigin x r)
    (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)), ← WithBot.coe_natCast, WithBot.coe_le_coe]
  exact natCast_le_height_chartOrigin x r hx hn

name: IsLocalRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_localization_chartOrigin
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    [(chartOrigin x r).IsPrime] : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))
proof:
:= by
  have := isNoetherianRing_chartRing x r
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r))
    (le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr (spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_chartOrigin_le x r))
      (natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_chartOrigin x r hx hn))

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_localization_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_localization_chartOrigin
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    [(chartOrigin x r).IsPrime] : ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x r)) = n
proof:
:= by
  have := isRegularLocalRing_localization_chartOrigin x r hx hn
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_chartOrigin x r hx hn)
  rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal]
  exact Nat.cast_le.mpr (spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_chartOrigin_le x r)

name: IsLocalRing.ord_span_singleton
statement: theorem ord_span_singleton (f : R) : ord (Ideal.span {f}) = ordElem f
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_le_ordElem_map
statement:
theorem ordElem_le_ordElem_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    [IsLocalHom φ] (f : R) : ordElem f ≤ ordElem (φ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ord_span_singleton, ← ord_span_singleton]
  have := ord_le_ord_map φ (Ideal.span {f})
  rwa [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at this

name: IsLocalRing.order_coe_le_totalDegree
statement:
theorem order_coe_le_totalDegree {L : Type*} [Field L] {Q : MvPolynomial σ L} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    MvPowerSeries.order (Q : MvPowerSeries σ L) ≤ Q.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (mt support_eq_empty.mp hQ)
  refine (MvPowerSeries.order_le (d := s) ?_).trans ?_
  · rw [coeff_coe]
    exact mem_support_iff.mp hs
  · exact_mod_cast (le_totalDegree hs)

name: IsLocalRing.totalDegree_finset_prod_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_finset_prod_le {L : Type*} [CommSemiring L] {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (g : ι → MvPolynomial σ L) : (∏ i ∈ s, g i).totalDegree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (g i).totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact (totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ih _)

name: IsLocalRing.totalDegree_eval₂Hom_add_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_eval₂Hom_add_le {L : Type*} [Field L] (φ : K →+* L) (a : σ → L)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    (eval₂Hom (C.comp φ) (fun i => C (a i) + X i) P).totalDegree ≤ P.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 : ∀ i, (C (a i) + X i : MvPolynomial σ L).totalDegree ≤ 1 := fun i =>
    (totalDegree_add _ _).trans (max_le (by simp) (by rw [totalDegree_X]))
  rw [coe_eval₂Hom, eval₂_eq]
  refine (totalDegree_finsetSum _ _).trans (Finset.sup_le fun d hd => ?_)
  refine (totalDegree_mul _ _).trans ?_
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, totalDegree_C, zero_add]
  refine (totalDegree_finset_prod_le _ _).trans ?_
  have h2 : ∑ i ∈ d.support, ((C (a i) + X i : MvPolynomial σ L) ^ d i).totalDegree ≤
      ∑ i ∈ d.support, d i :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => (totalDegree_pow _ _).trans
      ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (h1 i)).trans (mul_one _).le)
  have h3 : ∑ i ∈ d.support, d i ≤ P.totalDegree := le_totalDegree hd
  exact h2.trans h3

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_algebraMap_le_totalDegree
statement:
theorem ordElem_algebraMap_le_totalDegree (𝔮 : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)) [𝔮.IsPrime]
    {P : MvPolynomial σ K} (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    ordElem (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) P) ≤ P.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let A := MvPolynomial σ K ⧸ 𝔮
  let L := FractionRing A
  let ι : A →+* L := algebraMap A L
  have hι : Function.Injective ι := IsFractionRing.injective A L
  let φ : K →+* L := ι.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮).comp C)
  let a : σ → L := fun i => ι (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮 (X i))
  
  let ψ₀ : MvPolynomial σ K →+* MvPolynomial σ L := eval₂Hom (C.comp φ) fun i => C (a i) + X i
  let ψ : MvPolynomial σ K →+* MvPowerSeries σ L :=
    (MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom).comp ψ₀
  
  have hconst : ∀ p, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (ψ p) = ι (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮 p) := by
    have h : (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := σ) (R := L)).comp ψ =
        ι.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔮) := by
      refine ringHom_ext (fun c => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
      · simp [ψ, ψ₀, φ]
      · simp [ψ, ψ₀, a]
    exact fun p => congrArg (fun g : MvPolynomial σ K →+* L => g p) h
  have hψ_unit : ∀ s : 𝔮.primeCompl, IsUnit (ψ s) := fun s => by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, hconst, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, ← map_zero ι,
      hι.eq_iff, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact s.2
  
  let Ψ : Localization.AtPrime 𝔮 →+* MvPowerSeries σ L := IsLocalization.lift hψ_unit
  have hΨ : ∀ p, Ψ (algebraMap _ _ p) = ψ p := fun p => IsLocalization.lift_eq hψ_unit p
  have : IsLocalHom Ψ := by
    refine ⟨fun z hz => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨p, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective 𝔮.primeCompl z
    rw [IsLocalization.lift_mk' hψ_unit] at hz
    have hp : IsUnit (ψ p) := (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hz)
    rw [MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, hconst, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, ← map_zero ι,
      hι.eq_iff, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hp
    exact (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) 𝔮 p s).mpr hp
  
  have hψ₀ : ψ₀ P ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    
    have hinv : (eval₂Hom C fun i => X i - C (a i) : MvPolynomial σ L →+* MvPolynomial σ L).comp
        ψ₀ = MvPolynomial.map φ := by
      refine ringHom_ext (fun c => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
      · simp [ψ₀]
      · simp [ψ₀]
    have h1 :=
      congrArg (eval₂Hom C fun i => X i - C (a i) : MvPolynomial σ L →+* MvPolynomial σ L) h0
    rw [map_zero, ← RingHom.comp_apply, hinv] at h1
    exact hP (map_injective φ φ.injective (h1.trans (map_zero (MvPolynomial.map φ)).symm))
  calc ordElem (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) P)
      ≤ ordElem (Ψ (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ K) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) P)) :=
        ordElem_le_ordElem_map Ψ _
    _ = MvPowerSeries.order (ψ₀ P : MvPowerSeries σ L) := by
        rw [hΨ, MvPowerSeries.ordElem_eq_order]
        rfl
    _ ≤ (ψ₀ P).totalDegree := order_coe_le_totalDegree hψ₀
    _ ≤ P.totalDegree := by exact_mod_cast totalDegree_eval₂Hom_add_le φ a P

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_pow_mul_right_injective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_pow_mul_right_injective (m : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective fun g : chartRing x r => algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * g
proof:
:= by
  intro g g' h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) ^ m) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_pow_isUnit (S := Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) m
  apply hu.mul_left_cancel
  have h' := congrArg (fun z : chartRing x r => (z : Localization.Away (x r))) h
  simpa only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap] using h'

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem
statement:
theorem algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem {m : ℕ} (f : R) (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m) :
    algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * transformElem x r f hf =
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
    coe_transformElem, Localization.mk_eq_mk', ← map_pow]
  exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec' (S := Localization.Away (x r)) (M := Submonoid.powers (x r)) _ _

name: IsLocalRing.eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    {g : chartRing x r}
    (h : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * g = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f) :
    g = transformElem x r f hf
proof:
:=
  algebraMap_pow_mul_right_injective x r m
    (h.trans (algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r f hf).symm)

name: IsLocalRing.transformElem_mem_transformIdeal
statement:
theorem transformElem_mem_transformIdeal {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hfI : f ∈ I)
    (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m) : transformElem x r f hf ∈ transformIdeal x r I m
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hfI, algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r f hf⟩

name: IsLocalRing.span_pow_mul_transformIdeal
statement:
theorem span_pow_mul_transformIdeal {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m) :
    Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ m * transformIdeal x r I m =
      I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_le_iff]
    intro g hg
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun g _ =>
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ m * g ∈ I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
    · rintro g ⟨f, hf, hfg⟩
      rw [hfg]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf
    · rw [mul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · intro a b _ _ ha hb
      rw [mul_add]
      exact add_mem ha hb
    · intro c a _ ha
      rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ha
  · refine Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr fun f hf => ?_
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r f (hI hf)]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) m)
      (transformElem_mem_transformIdeal x r hf (hI hf))

name: IsLocalRing.eq_of_span_pow_mul_eq
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {J J' : Ideal (chartRing x r)},
      Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ m * J ≤
        Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ m * J' → J ≤ J' := by
    intro J J' hle g hg
    have hmem :=
      hle (Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) m) hg)
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul] at hmem
    obtain ⟨g', hg', hgg'⟩ := hmem
    rw [← algebraMap_pow_mul_right_injective x r m hgg']
    exact hg'
  exact le_antisymm (key h.le) (key h.ge)

name: IsLocalRing.eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq
statement:
