theorem eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    {J : Ideal (chartRing x r)}
    (hJ : Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} ^ m * J =
      I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))) : J = transformIdeal x r I m
proof:
:=
  eq_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r (hJ.trans (span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hI).symm)

name: IsLocalRing.transformIdeal_eq_span_range_transformElem
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro g ⟨f, hf, hfg⟩
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, (eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq x r (hI hf) hfg).symm⟩
  · rintro g ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem x r f (hI hf)⟩

name: IsLocalRing.transformElem_mul
statement:
theorem transformElem_mul {m m' : ℕ} {f g : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    (hg : g ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m') (hfg : f * g ∈ chartCenter x r ^ (m + m')) :
    transformElem x r (f * g) hfg = transformElem x r f hf * transformElem x r g hg
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
  rw [pow_add, mul_mul_mul_comm, algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem,
    algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem, map_mul]

name: IsLocalRing.mul_le_chartCenter_pow_add
statement:
theorem mul_le_chartCenter_pow_add {I J : Ideal R} {m m' : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    (hJ : J ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m') : I * J ≤ chartCenter x r ^ (m + m')
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_add]
  exact Ideal.mul_mono hI hJ

name: IsLocalRing.transformIdeal_mul
statement:
theorem transformIdeal_mul {I J : Ideal R} {m m' : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    (hJ : J ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m') :
    transformIdeal x r (I * J) (m + m') = transformIdeal x r I m * transformIdeal x r J m'
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r (mul_le_chartCenter_pow_add x r hI hJ)
  rw [pow_add, mul_mul_mul_comm, span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hI,
    span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hJ, Ideal.map_mul]

name: IsLocalRing.transformIdeal_sup
statement:
theorem transformIdeal_sup {I J : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    (hJ : J ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m) :
    transformIdeal x r (I ⊔ J) m = transformIdeal x r I m ⊔ transformIdeal x r J m
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r (sup_le hI hJ)
  rw [Ideal.mul_sup, span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hI, span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hJ,
    Ideal.map_sup]

name: IsLocalRing.transformIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem transformIdeal_mono {I J : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (h : I ≤ J) :
    transformIdeal x r I m ≤ transformIdeal x r J m
proof:
:=
  Ideal.span_mono fun _ ⟨f, hf, hfg⟩ => ⟨f, h hf, hfg⟩

name: IsLocalRing.transformIdeal_iSup
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r (iSup_le hI)
  rw [Ideal.mul_iSup, Ideal.map_iSup]
  exact iSup_congr fun i => span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r (hI i)

name: IsLocalRing.pow_le_chartCenter_pow_mul
statement:
theorem pow_le_chartCenter_pow_mul {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m) (c : ℕ) :
    I ^ c ≤ chartCenter x r ^ (m * c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul]
  exact Ideal.pow_right_mono hI c

name: IsLocalRing.transformIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem transformIdeal_pow {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m) (c : ℕ) :
    transformIdeal x r (I ^ c) (m * c) = transformIdeal x r I m ^ c
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r (pow_le_chartCenter_pow_mul x r hI c)
  rw [pow_mul, ← mul_pow, span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hI, Ideal.map_pow]

name: IsLocalRing.transformIdeal_chartCenter
statement: theorem transformIdeal_chartCenter : transformIdeal x r (chartCenter x r) 1 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  symm
  have hI : chartCenter x r ≤ chartCenter x r ^ 1 := by rw [pow_one]
  apply eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r hI
  rw [pow_one, Ideal.mul_top, map_chartCenter]

name: IsLocalRing.transformIdeal_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem transformIdeal_chartCenter_pow (m : ℕ) :
    transformIdeal x r (chartCenter x r ^ m) m = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r le_rfl
  rw [Ideal.mul_top, Ideal.map_pow, map_chartCenter]

name: IsLocalRing.eq_transformIdeal_of_map_chartCenter_pow_mul_eq
proof:
:=
  eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r hI (by rwa [map_chartCenter] at hJ)

name: IsLocalRing.exists_unit_mul_transformElem
statement:
theorem exists_unit_mul_transformElem {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    {d : chartRing x r} (hd : Ideal.span {d} = Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)})
    {g : chartRing x r} (h : d ^ m * g = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) f) :
    ∃ v : (chartRing x r)ˣ, g = v * transformElem x r f hf
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : d ∈ Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)} :=
    hd ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self d
  have h2 : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ∈ Ideal.span {d} :=
    hd.symm ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h2
  have hba : b * a = 1 := by
    apply algebraMap_pow_mul_right_injective x r 1
    have : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) * (b * a) = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) := by
      calc algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) * (b * a)
          = b * (a * algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)) := by ring
        _ = b * d := by rw [ha]
        _ = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) := hb
    change algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ 1 * (b * a) =
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) ^ 1 * 1
    rw [pow_one, mul_one, this]
  have hab : a * b = 1 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hba
  let v : (chartRing x r)ˣ := ⟨a, b, hab, hba⟩
  have hT : a ^ m * g = transformElem x r f hf := by
    apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_comm (algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)) a, ha]
    exact h
  refine ⟨v⁻¹ ^ m, ?_⟩
  rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
  change g = b ^ m * transformElem x r f hf
  rw [← hT, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, hba, one_pow, one_mul]

name: IsLocalRing.mk_mem_chartRingOf_of_mem_chartCenter
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun z _ => Localization.mk z ⟨d, Submonoid.mem_powers d⟩ ∈ chartRingOf x r d)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    rcases (show i ≤ r from hi).lt_or_eq with hlt | rfl
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, hlt, rfl⟩
    · subst hd
      have : Localization.mk (x i) ⟨x i, Submonoid.mem_powers (x i)⟩ =
          (1 : Localization.Away (x i)) := Localization.mk_self ⟨x i, Submonoid.mem_powers (x i)⟩
      rw [this]
      exact one_mem _
  · rw [Localization.mk_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    rw [← Localization.add_mk_self]
    exact add_mem ha hb
  · intro c a _ ha
    have : Localization.mk (c • a) ⟨d, Submonoid.mem_powers d⟩ =
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away d) c * Localization.mk a ⟨d, Submonoid.mem_powers d⟩ := by
      rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ c) ha

name: IsLocalRing.chartRingOf_eq_of_chartCenter_eq
statement:
theorem chartRingOf_eq_of_chartCenter_eq (x' : Fin n → R) (hr : x' r = x r)
    (hP : chartCenter x' r = chartCenter x r) : chartRingOf x' r (x r) = chartRing x r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact mk_mem_chartRingOf_of_mem_chartCenter x r (x r) rfl
      (hP ▸ x_mem_chartCenter x' r (le_of_lt hi))
  · apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact mk_mem_chartRingOf_of_mem_chartCenter x' r (x r) hr.symm
      (hP.symm ▸ x_mem_chartCenter x r (le_of_lt hi))

name: IsLocalRing.chartCenter_eq_span_singleton_of_val_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chartCenter_eq_span_singleton_of_val_eq_zero (hr : (r : ℕ) = 0) :
    chartCenter x r = Ideal.span {x r}
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {i : Fin n | i ≤ r} = {r} := by
    ext i
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : i ≤ r := h
      exact Fin.ext (by have := Fin.le_def.mp h'; omega)
    · intro h
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
      rw [h]
      exact (le_rfl : r ≤ r)
  rw [chartCenter, hset, Set.image_singleton]

name: IsLocalRing.chartRing_eq_bot_of_val_eq_zero
statement: theorem chartRing_eq_bot_of_val_eq_zero (hr : (r : ℕ) = 0) : chartRing x r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {i : Fin n | i < r} = ∅ := by
    ext i
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro h
    have h' : i < r := h
    have := Fin.lt_def.mp h'
    omega
  change chartRingOf x r (x r) = ⊥
  rw [chartRingOf, hset, Set.image_empty, Algebra.adjoin_empty]

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_chartRing_bijective_of_val_eq_zero
statement:
theorem algebraMap_chartRing_bijective_of_val_eq_zero
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hr : (r : ℕ) = 0) : Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨algebraMap_chartRing_injective x r hx hn, fun g => ?_⟩
  have hg : (g : Localization.Away (x r)) ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra R (Localization.Away (x r))) := by
    rw [← chartRing_eq_bot_of_val_eq_zero x r hr]
    exact g.2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Algebra.mem_bot.mp hg
  exact ⟨a, Subtype.ext (by rw [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap]; exact ha)⟩

name: IsLocalRing.span_pow_mul_comap_transformIdeal_of_val_eq_zero
statement:
theorem span_pow_mul_comap_transformIdeal_of_val_eq_zero
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hr : (r : ℕ) = 0) {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m) :
    Ideal.span {x r ^ m} * (transformIdeal x r I m).comap (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) =
      I
proof:
:= by
  have hbij := algebraMap_chartRing_bijective_of_val_eq_zero x r hx hn hr
  have hcm : ∀ K : Ideal R,
      (K.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).comap (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) = K := by
    intro K
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hbij.2, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hbij.1, sup_bot_eq]
  have hkey : (Ideal.span {x r ^ m} *
      (transformIdeal x r I m).comap (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))).map
        (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) = I.map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ hbij.2, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton, map_pow, ← Ideal.span_singleton_pow, span_pow_mul_transformIdeal x r hI]
  rw [← hcm (Ideal.span {x r ^ m} * _), hkey, hcm]

name: IsLocalRing.sq_add_cube_mem_chartCenter_sq
statement: theorem sq_add_cube_mem_chartCenter_sq : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3 ∈ chartCenter x 1 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (x_mem_chartCenter x 1 (by decide)) 2) ?_
  rw [show x 1 ^ 3 = x 1 ^ 2 * x 1 from pow_succ (x 1) 2]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (x_mem_chartCenter x 1 le_rfl) 2)

name: IsLocalRing.transformElem_sq_add_cube
statement:
theorem transformElem_sq_add_cube (hf : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3 ∈ chartCenter x 1 ^ 2) :
    transformElem x 1 (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3) hf =
      chartYR x 1 0 ^ 2 + algebraMap R (chartRing x 1) (x 1)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
  rw [map_add, map_pow, map_pow, algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR x 1 (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide)]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.mem_pow_of_algebraMap_mem_map_pow
statement:
theorem mem_pow_of_algebraMap_mem_map_pow {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (P : Ideal A)
    [hP : P.IsMaximal] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {a : A}
    (h : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) a ∈
      (P ^ k).map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P))) : a ∈ P ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P)] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨b, s⟩, hbs⟩ := h
  dsimp only at hbs
  rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P)] at hbs
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hbs
  have hprim : (P ^ k).IsPrimary := Ideal.isPrimary_of_isMaximal_radical (by
    rw [Ideal.radical_pow P hk, hP.isPrime.radical]
    exact hP)
  have hmem : ((t : A) * s) • a ∈ P ^ k := by
    rw [smul_eq_mul, show (t : A) * s * a = t * (a * s) by ring, ht]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ b.2
  rcases hprim.2 hmem with h1 | ⟨q, hq⟩
  · exact h1
  · exfalso
    have hts : (t : A) * s ∈ P.primeCompl := P.primeCompl.mul_mem t.2 s.2
    have hpow : ((t : A) * s) ^ q ∈ P ^ k := by
      have := hq (Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul (1 : A) (((t : A) * s) ^ q) ⊤ Submodule.mem_top)
      rwa [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
    exact hts (hP.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem q (Ideal.pow_le_self hk hpow))

name: IsLocalRing.transformElem_sq_add_cube_notMem_chartOrigin_sq
statement:
theorem transformElem_sq_add_cube_notMem_chartOrigin_sq
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hf : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3 ∈ chartCenter x 1 ^ 2) :
    transformElem x 1 (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3) hf ∉ chartOrigin x 1 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hT
  set Q : Ideal R := Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin 2 | j.val < 1}) with hQ
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Q) := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt x hx hn 1
  have hdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Q) + ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
    ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_lt x hx hn (i := 1) (by norm_num)
  have hx1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x 1) ∉ maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Q) ^ 2 :=
    mk_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq_of x hx hn (i := 1) (by norm_num) hdim
  have hprime : Q.IsPrime := isPrime_span_image_lt x hx hn 1
  set S := R ⧸ Q with hSdef
  let F := FractionRing S
  let g : R →+* F := (algebraMap S F).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap S F) := IsFractionRing.injective S F
  have hg : IsUnit (g (x 1)) := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    apply hx1
    have : Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x 1) = 0 := hinj (by rw [map_zero]; exact h0)
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _
  let ψ : Localization.Away (x 1) →+* F := IsLocalization.Away.lift (x 1) hg
  have hψ : ∀ a, ψ (algebraMap R _ a) = g a := fun a => IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (x 1) hg a
  have hx0Q : x 0 ∈ Q := Ideal.subset_span ⟨0, show (0 : Fin 2).val < 1 by decide, rfl⟩
  have hψy : ψ (chartY x 1 0) = 0 := by
    rw [chartY_of_lt x 1 (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide), map_mul, hψ]
    have : g (x 0) = 0 := by
      change algebraMap S F (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x 0)) = 0
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx0Q, map_zero]
    rw [this, zero_mul]
  have hmk : ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x i) ∈ maximalIdeal S := fun i => by
    rw [maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq x hx i)
  have hy : ∀ i, ψ (chartY x 1 i) ∈ algebraMap S F '' (maximalIdeal S : Set S) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i < 1
    · have h0 : i = 0 := Fin.ext (by have := Fin.lt_def.mp hi; omega)
      subst h0
      rw [hψy]
      exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, map_zero _⟩
    · rw [chartY_eq_algebraMap_of_not_lt x 1 hi, hψ]
      exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x i), hmk i, rfl⟩
  have hR' : ∀ z ∈ chartRing x 1, ψ z ∈ Set.range (algebraMap S F) := by
    intro z hz
    refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun z _ => ψ z ∈ Set.range (algebraMap S F))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
    · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      have hi' : i < 1 := hi
      obtain ⟨s, -, hs⟩ := hy i
      rw [chartY_eq_mk_of_lt x 1 hi'] at hs
      exact ⟨s, hs⟩
    · intro a
      exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk Q a, (hψ a).symm⟩
    · rintro z w _ _ ⟨s, hs⟩ ⟨t, ht⟩
      exact ⟨s + t, by rw [map_add, map_add, hs, ht]⟩
    · rintro z w _ _ ⟨s, hs⟩ ⟨t, ht⟩
      exact ⟨s * t, by rw [map_mul, map_mul, hs, ht]⟩
  have hM : ∀ z ∈ chartOrigin x 1,
      ψ (z : Localization.Away (x 1)) ∈ algebraMap S F '' (maximalIdeal S : Set S) := by
    intro z hz
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun (z : chartRing x 1) _ =>
        ψ (z : Localization.Away (x 1)) ∈ algebraMap S F '' (maximalIdeal S : Set S))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hy i
    · exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, by rw [Subalgebra.coe_zero, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
    · rintro z w _ _ ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩
      exact ⟨s + t, add_mem hs ht, by rw [map_add, Subalgebra.coe_add, map_add, hs', ht']⟩
    · rintro b z _ ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hR' b b.2
      exact ⟨t * s, Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hs,
        by rw [map_mul, smul_eq_mul, Subalgebra.coe_mul, map_mul, ht, hs']⟩
  have hM2 : ∀ z ∈ chartOrigin x 1 ^ 2, ψ (z : Localization.Away (x 1)) ∈
      algebraMap S F '' ((maximalIdeal S ^ 2 : Ideal S) : Set S) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [sq] at hz
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on
      (C := fun (z : chartRing x 1) => ψ (z : Localization.Away (x 1)) ∈
        algebraMap S F '' ((maximalIdeal S ^ 2 : Ideal S) : Set S))
      hz ?_ ?_
    · intro a ha b hb
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := hM a ha
      obtain ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩ := hM b hb
      exact ⟨s * t, by rw [sq]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hs ht,
        by rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, map_mul, map_mul, hs', ht']⟩
    · rintro a b ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩
      exact ⟨s + t, add_mem hs ht, by rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, map_add, map_add, hs', ht']⟩
  have hTψ : ψ (transformElem x 1 (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3) hf : Localization.Away (x 1)) =
      algebraMap S F (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (x 1)) := by
    rw [transformElem_sq_add_cube x hf, Subalgebra.coe_add, Subalgebra.coe_pow,
      Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, map_add, map_pow, hψ,
      show ((chartYR x 1 0 : chartRing x 1) : Localization.Away (x 1)) = chartY x 1 0 from rfl,
      hψy, zero_pow two_ne_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := hM2 _ hT
  rw [hTψ] at hs'
  exact hx1 (hinj hs' ▸ hs)

name: IsLocalRing.transformElem_sq_add_cube_mem_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem transformElem_sq_add_cube_mem_chartOrigin (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hf : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3 ∈ chartCenter x 1 ^ 2) :
    transformElem x 1 (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3) hf ∈ chartOrigin x 1 ∧
      transformElem x 1 (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3) hf ∉ chartOrigin x 1 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, transformElem_sq_add_cube_notMem_chartOrigin_sq x hx hn hf⟩
  rw [transformElem_sq_add_cube x hf, sq]
  exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (chartYROf_mem_chartOriginOf x 1 (x 1) 0))
    (algebraMap_x_mem_chartOrigin x 1 1)

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_transformElem_sq_add_cube
statement:
theorem ordElem_transformElem_sq_add_cube (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hf : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3 ∈ chartCenter x 1 ^ 2) [(chartOrigin x 1).IsPrime] :
    ordElem (algebraMap (chartRing x 1) (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin x 1))
      (transformElem x 1 (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 3) hf)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hnot⟩ := transformElem_sq_add_cube_mem_chartOrigin x hx hn hf
  have hmax : (chartOrigin x 1).IsMaximal := chartOrigin_isMaximal x 1 hx hn
  rw [ordElem_eq_one_iff, ← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, ← Ideal.map_pow]
  exact ⟨Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hmem,
    fun h => hnot (mem_pow_of_algebraMap_mem_map_pow (chartOrigin x 1) two_ne_zero h)⟩

name: IsLocalRing.transformElem_X_sq_add_X_cube
statement:
theorem transformElem_X_sq_add_X_cube (hf : Xq 0 ^ 2 + Xq 1 ^ 3 ∈ chartCenter Xq 1 ^ 2) :
    transformElem Xq 1 (Xq 0 ^ 2 + Xq 1 ^ 3) hf =
      chartYR Xq 1 0 ^ 2 + algebraMap (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℚ) (chartRing Xq 1) (Xq 1)
proof:
:=
  transformElem_sq_add_cube Xq hf

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_transformElem_X_sq_add_X_cube
statement:
theorem ordElem_transformElem_X_sq_add_X_cube (hf : Xq 0 ^ 2 + Xq 1 ^ 3 ∈ chartCenter Xq 1 ^ 2) :
    ordElem (algebraMap (chartRing Xq 1) (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin Xq 1))
      (transformElem Xq 1 (Xq 0 ^ 2 + Xq 1 ^ 3) hf)) = 1
proof:
:=
  ordElem_transformElem_sq_add_cube Xq (MvPowerSeries.maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_X (Fin 2) ℚ)
    (ringKrullDim_mvPowerSeries ℚ 2).symm hf

name: IsLocalRing.mvPowerSeries_map_bijective
proof:
:= by
  let e' := RingEquiv.ofBijective e he
  have h1 : ∀ F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K,
      MvPowerSeries.map (σ := Fin n) (e'.symm : L →+* K) (MvPowerSeries.map (σ := Fin n) e F) = F :=
    fun F => by
      rw [MvPowerSeries.map_map]
      have : (e'.symm : L →+* K).comp e = RingHom.id K :=
        RingHom.ext fun k => e'.symm_apply_apply k
      rw [this, MvPowerSeries.map_id, RingHom.id_apply]
  have h2 : ∀ G : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) L,
      MvPowerSeries.map (σ := Fin n) e (MvPowerSeries.map (σ := Fin n) (e'.symm : L →+* K) G) = G :=
    fun G => by
      rw [MvPowerSeries.map_map]
      have : e.comp (e'.symm : L →+* K) = RingHom.id L :=
        RingHom.ext fun l => e'.apply_symm_apply l
      rw [this, MvPowerSeries.map_id, RingHom.id_apply]
  exact ⟨fun F G h => by rw [← h1 F, h, h1], fun G => ⟨_, h2 G⟩⟩

name: IsLocalRing.isCoefficientAlgebra_of_section
statement:
theorem isCoefficientAlgebra_of_section (ev : A →+* K) [IsLocalHom ev] (cA : K →+* A)
    (hevc : ∀ b, ev (cA b) = b) [Algebra (ResidueField A) (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)]
    (hσ : ∀ k, algebraMap (ResidueField A) (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) k =
      algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) (cA (ResidueField.lift ev k))) :
    IsCoefficientAlgebra A
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective k
  rw [hσ]
  change residue _ (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)
    (cA (ResidueField.lift ev (residue A a)))) =
      ResidueField.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) (residue A a)
  rw [ResidueField.map_residue]
  refine Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr ?_
  rw [← map_sub, AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
  refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_
  rw [← maximalIdeal_comap ev, Ideal.mem_comap, map_sub, hevc, ResidueField.lift_residue_apply,
    sub_self]
  exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: IsLocalRing.completionMap_bijective_of_cohen
statement:
theorem completionMap_bijective_of_cohen (f : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom f] (y : Fin n → A)
    (hy : maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span (Set.range y)) (hd : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim A)
    [Algebra (ResidueField A) (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)] (hι : IsCoefficientAlgebra A)
    (Θ : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B ≃+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)
    (e : ResidueField A →+* K) (he : Function.Bijective e)
    (hΘy : ∀ i, Θ (algebraMap B _ (f (y i))) = X i)
    (hΘk : ∀ k, Θ (completionMap f (algebraMap (ResidueField A) _ k)) = C (e k)) :
    Function.Bijective (completionMap f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Ψ := cohenEquivOfResidue A y hι hy hd with hΨdef
  let g : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K :=
    (Θ : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K).comp (completionMap f)
  have hg : ∀ (N : ℕ) (z : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A),
      z ∈ maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) ^ N →
        g z ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ N := by
    intro N z hz
    have h1 := completionMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow f hz
    have h2 : (maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) ^ N).map
        (Θ : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ≤
          maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ N := by
      rw [Ideal.map_pow]
      exact Ideal.pow_right_mono (map_maximalIdeal_le _) N
    exact h2 (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ h1)
  
  have hpoly : g.comp (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)
      (y i)).toRingHom = MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom.comp (MvPolynomial.map e) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun k => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_C, MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom_apply,
        MvPolynomial.coe_C]
      exact hΘk k
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.map_X, MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom_apply,
        MvPolynomial.coe_X]
      change Θ (completionMap f (algebraMap A _ (y i))) = X i
      rw [completionMap_algebraMap]
      exact hΘy i
  
  have hkey : ∀ F, g (Ψ F) = MvPowerSeries.map e F := by
    intro F
    refine eq_of_forall_mk_pow_eq (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) fun N => ?_
    have hΨ : Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) ^ N) (Ψ F) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.aeval
          (fun i => algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) (y i)) (truncTotal N F)) := by
      rw [hΨdef, cohenEquivOfResidue_apply, mk_cohenMap, levelEval_apply]
      have : (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ (ResidueField A)
          (maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) ^ N)).comp
            (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) (y i)) =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (levelVar A y N) := by
        rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval]
        rfl
      exact (congrArg (fun φ => φ (truncTotal N F)) this).symm
    have hz := hg N _ (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp hΨ)
    rw [map_sub] at hz
    have hmk : Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ N) (g (Ψ F)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (g (MvPolynomial.aeval
          (fun i => algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) (y i)) (truncTotal N F))) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr hz
    have hp := RingHom.congr_fun hpoly (truncTotal N F)
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
      MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom_apply] at hp
    rw [hmk, hp, ← truncTotal_map]
    rcases N with _ | N
    · exact eq_of_pow_zero _ _ _
    · exact (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr (sub_truncTotal_mem (MvPowerSeries.map e F) N)).symm
  have hfun : ⇑(completionMap f) =
      (Θ.symm : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K → AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) ∘
        MvPowerSeries.map e ∘ (Ψ.symm : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A →
          MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (ResidueField A)) := by
    funext z
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← hkey, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact (Θ.symm_apply_apply (completionMap f z)).symm
  rw [hfun]
  exact Θ.symm.bijective.comp ((mvPowerSeries_map_bijective he).comp Ψ.symm.bijective)

name: IsLocalRing.map_adicCompletion_le_iff
statement:
theorem map_adicCompletion_le_iff {I J : Ideal R} :
    I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) ≤
        J.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) ↔ I ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, Ideal.map_mono⟩
  have := Ideal.comap_mono (f := algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) h
  rwa [comap_map_adicCompletion, comap_map_adicCompletion] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.adicCompletion_pderiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_pderiv_algebraMap (i : Fin n) (f : R) :
    c.adicCompletion.pderiv i (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f) =
      algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) (c.pderiv i f)
proof:
:=
  Derivation.adicCompletion_algebraMap _ _ f

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem D_adicCompletion (I : Ideal R) :
    c.adicCompletion.D (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))) =
      (c.D I).map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))
proof:
:=
  c.D_map c.adicCompletion _ id (fun i f => c.adicCompletion_pderiv_algebraMap i f)
    (fun j hj => (hj (Set.mem_range_self j)).elim) I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem Dpow_adicCompletion (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.adicCompletion.Dpow r (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))) =
      (c.Dpow r I).map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih => rw [Dpow_succ, Dpow_succ, ih, c.D_adicCompletion]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_range_adicCompletion_map_subtype
statement:
theorem D_range_adicCompletion_map_subtype (I : Ideal R) :
    c.adicCompletion.D (LinearMap.range (AdicCompletion.map (maximalIdeal R) I.subtype)) =
      LinearMap.range (AdicCompletion.map (maximalIdeal R) (c.D I).subtype)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg c.adicCompletion.D (range_adicCompletion_map_subtype I)).trans
    ((c.D_adicCompletion I).trans (range_adicCompletion_map_subtype (c.D I)).symm)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.MC_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem MC_adicCompletion (I : Ideal R) (m : ℕ) :
    c.adicCompletion.MC (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))) m =
      (c.MC I m).map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))
proof:
:=
  c.Dpow_adicCompletion (m - 1) I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.comap_D_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem comap_D_adicCompletion (I : Ideal R) :
    (c.adicCompletion.D (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)))).comap
        (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) = c.D I
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.D_adicCompletion, comap_map_adicCompletion]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.comap_MC_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem comap_MC_adicCompletion (I : Ideal R) (m : ℕ) :
    (c.adicCompletion.MC (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))) m).comap
        (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) = c.MC I m
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.MC_adicCompletion, comap_map_adicCompletion]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isMCInvariant_adicCompletion_iff
statement:
theorem isMCInvariant_adicCompletion_iff (I : Ideal R) (m : ℕ) :
    c.adicCompletion.IsMCInvariant (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))) m ↔
      c.IsMCInvariant I m
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsMCInvariant
  rw [c.MC_adicCompletion, c.D_adicCompletion, ← Ideal.map_mul, map_adicCompletion_le_iff]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mul_D_le
statement: theorem mul_D_le (J K : Ideal R) : J * c.D K ≤ c.D (J * K) ⊔ K * c.D J
proof:
:= by
  have hcol : c.D K ≤ (c.D (J * K) ⊔ K * c.D J).colon (J : Set R) := by
    refine c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun h hh => Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun a ha => ?_,
      fun i h hh => Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun a ha => ?_⟩
    · rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm h a]
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.le_D _ (Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha hh))
    · rw [smul_eq_mul]
      have : c.pderiv i h * a = c.pderiv i (a * h) - h * c.pderiv i a := by
        rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.pderiv_mem_D (Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha hh) i))
        (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_mul hh (c.pderiv_mem_D ha i)))
  refine Ideal.mul_le.mpr fun a ha h hh => ?_
  have := Submodule.mem_colon.mp (hcol hh) a ha
  rwa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm h a] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pow_mul_Dpow_le
statement:
theorem pow_mul_Dpow_le (I B : Ideal R) (h2 : B * c.D I ≤ I) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → B ^ j * c.Dpow j I ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  induction j, hj using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simpa using h2
  | succ j hj ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ, pow_succ]
    refine (c.mul_D_le _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
    · have h1 : B ^ j * B * c.Dpow j I ≤ B * I := by
        rw [mul_comm (B ^ j) B, mul_assoc]
        exact Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl ih
      exact (c.D_mono h1).trans ((c.D_mul_le B I).trans (sup_le Ideal.mul_le_right h2))
    · have h1 : c.D (B ^ j * B) ≤ B ^ j := by
        rw [← pow_succ]
        refine (c.D_pow_le B (by omega)).trans ?_
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        exact Ideal.mul_le_right
      calc c.Dpow j I * c.D (B ^ j * B) ≤ c.Dpow j I * B ^ j := Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl h1
        _ = B ^ j * c.Dpow j I := mul_comm _ _
        _ ≤ I := ih

name: IsLocalRing.prod_pow_mem_pow
statement:
theorem prod_pow_mem_pow {B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)} {b : Fin n → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K}
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ B) (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) : ∏ i, b i ^ α i ∈ B ^ α.degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  exact Ideal.prod_mem_prod fun i _ => Ideal.pow_mem_pow (hb i) _

name: IsLocalRing.pderivEnd'_pow_mem_Dpow
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simpa using hf
  | succ b ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, RegularCoords.Dpow_succ]
    exact (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).pderiv_mem_D ih i

name: IsLocalRing.pderivPowSeries_mem_Dpow
statement:
theorem pderivPowSeries_mem_Dpow {I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)} (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ)
    {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hf : f ∈ I) :
    pderivPowSeries α f ∈ (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).Dpow α.degree I
proof:
:= by
  induction α using Finsupp.induction generalizing f with
  | zero => simpa [pderivPowSeries_zero] using hf
  | single_add a b g _ _ ih =>
    rw [pderivPowSeries_add, Module.End.mul_apply, pderivPowSeries_single, map_add,
      Finsupp.degree_single, ← RegularCoords.Dpow_Dpow]
    exact pderivEnd'_pow_mem_Dpow (ih hf) a b

name: IsLocalRing.IsOnePlus.eq_substAlgHom
statement:
theorem IsOnePlus.eq_substAlgHom {B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)}
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    {g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K ≃ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hg : IsOnePlus B g)
    (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) :
    g f = substAlgHom (R := K)
      (hasSubst_add (b := fun i => g (X (R := K) i) - X (R := K) i) fun i => hB (hg.2 i)) f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha, hga⟩, hgB⟩ := hg
  have h1 : (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K →ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) f =
      substAlgHom ha f := by
    rw [hga]
  have h2 : a = fun i => X (R := K) i + (g (X (R := K) i) - X (R := K) i) := by
    funext i
    have : (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K →ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) (X (R := K) i) =
        substAlgHom ha (X (R := K) i) := by rw [hga]
    rw [coe_substAlgHom, subst_X ha] at this
    rw [add_sub_cancel]
    exact this.symm
  rw [show g f = (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K →ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) f from rfl, h1,
    coe_substAlgHom, coe_substAlgHom, h2]

name: IsLocalRing.taylor_term_mem
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos α.degree with h0 | hpos
  · have hα : α = 0 := by
      ext i
      have := Finsupp.le_degree i α
      rw [h0] at this
      simpa using this
    subst hα
    simpa [pderivPowSeries_zero, multiFactorial] using hf
  · rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc]
    refine Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (h3 α.degree hpos ?_)
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (pderivPowSeries_mem_Dpow α hf) (prod_pow_mem_pow hbB α)

name: IsLocalRing.isInvariantOnePlus_of_forall_pow_mul_Dpow_le
statement:
theorem isInvariantOnePlus_of_forall_pow_mul_Dpow_le (I B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    (h3 : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → B ^ j * (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).Dpow j I ≤ I) :
    IsInvariantOnePlus I B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro g hg
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro f hf
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
  change g f ∈ I
  rw [hg.eq_substAlgHom hB f]
  have hb : ∀ i, g (X (R := K) i) - X (R := K) i ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) :=
    fun i => hB (hg.2 i)
  refine mem_of_forall_mem_sup_pow fun s => ?_
  rcases s with _ | s
  · simp
  · have hd := substAlgHom_add_sub_taylor_mem f hb s
    have hsum := Ideal.sum_mem I fun α (_ : α ∈ degreeLE n s) =>
      taylor_term_mem h3 hg.2 hf α
    have := Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left hsum) (Ideal.mem_sup_right hd)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel] at this

name: IsLocalRing.exists_admissible_scalars
statement:
theorem exists_admissible_scalars (q₀ : ℚ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ lam : Fin N → ℚ, Function.Injective lam ∧ ∀ i, lam i ≠ q₀ ∧ lam i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun i => if ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℚ) = q₀ then (N : ℚ) + 1 else (i : ℕ) + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    simp only at hij
    have key : ∀ {p q : ℕ}, ((p : ℚ) + 1 = (q : ℚ) + 1) → p = q := fun h => by
      exact_mod_cast add_right_cancel h
    split_ifs at hij with hi hj hj
    · exact Fin.ext (key (hi.trans hj.symm))
    · exfalso
      have hj' : ((j : ℕ) : ℚ) = N := by linarith
      have hj'' : (j : ℕ) = N := by exact_mod_cast hj'
      have := j.isLt
      omega
    · exfalso
      have hi' : ((i : ℕ) : ℚ) = N := by linarith
      have hi'' : (i : ℕ) = N := by exact_mod_cast hi'
      have := i.isLt
      omega
    · exact Fin.ext (key hij)
  · intro i
    simp only
    split_ifs with hi
    · refine ⟨fun h => ?_, by positivity⟩
      have : ((i : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 = N + 1 := hi.trans h.symm
      have hi' : ((i : ℕ) : ℚ) = N := by linarith
      have hi'' : (i : ℕ) = N := by exact_mod_cast hi'
      have := i.isLt
      omega
    · exact ⟨hi, by positivity⟩

name: IsLocalRing.taylor_shift_range_mem
statement:
theorem taylor_shift_range_mem {I B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)}
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) (h1 : IsInvariantOnePlus I B)
    {b : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hb : b ∈ B) {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hf : f ∈ I)
    (i : Fin n) {q : ℚ}
    (hq : ∃ g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K ≃ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K,
      IsOnePlus B g ∧ ∀ f, g f = subst (shiftSubst i (q • b)) f) (s : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), q ^ j • (((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (pderivEnd' i ^ j) f) * b ^ j) ∈
      I ⊔ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ (s + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩ := hq
  have hgI : g f ∈ I := by
    have := h1 g hg (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)
    simpa using this
  have hd := substAlgHom_shift_sub_taylor_mem f i (hB hb) q s
  rw [coe_substAlgHom, ← hgf] at hd
  have := Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left hgI) (Ideal.mem_sup_right hd)
  rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this

name: IsLocalRing.sum_range_succ_eq_add_sum_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_range_succ_eq_add_sum_Icc {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : ℕ → M) (s : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), F j = F 0 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 s, F j
proof:
:= by
  have h : Finset.Icc 1 s = Finset.Ico 1 (s + 1) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ico]
    omega
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', add_comm, Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.sum_Ico_add', zero_add, h]

name: IsLocalRing.taylor_shift_sum_mem
statement:
theorem taylor_shift_sum_mem {I B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)}
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) (h1 : IsInvariantOnePlus I B)
    {b : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hb : b ∈ B) {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hf : f ∈ I)
    (i : Fin n) {q : ℚ}
    (hq : ∃ g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K ≃ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K,
      IsOnePlus B g ∧ ∀ f, g f = subst (shiftSubst i (q • b)) f) (s : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 s, q ^ j • (((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (pderivEnd' i ^ j) f) * b ^ j) ∈
      I ⊔ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ (s + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := taylor_shift_range_mem hB h1 hb hf i hq s
  rw [sum_range_succ_eq_add_sum_Icc] at h
  have := Ideal.sub_mem _ h (Ideal.mem_sup_left hf)
  simpa using this

name: IsLocalRing.mul_pderiv_mem_sup_pow
statement:
theorem mul_pderiv_mem_sup_pow {I B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)}
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) (h1 : IsInvariantOnePlus I B)
    {b : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hb : b ∈ B) {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hf : f ∈ I)
    (i : Fin n) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    b * MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := K) i f ∈
      I ⊔ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := exists_onePlus_shift B hB i hb
  
  set u : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K := fun j =>
    ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ • (pderivEnd' i ^ j) f) * b ^ j with hu
  have hu0 : u 0 = f := by simp [hu]
  have hu1 : u 1 = b * MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := K) i f := by simp [hu, mul_comm]
  set J := I ⊔ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ (N + 1) with hJ
  obtain ⟨lam, hinj, hlam⟩ := exists_admissible_scalars q₀ N
  
  have hw : ∀ k : Fin N, ∑ j : Fin N, lam k ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) • u ((j : ℕ) + 1) ∈ J := by
    intro k
    have hfull := taylor_shift_range_mem hB h1 hb hf i (hq₀ (lam k) (hlam k).1) N
    change ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), lam k ^ j • u j ∈ J at hfull
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', pow_zero, one_smul, hu0, Finset.sum_range] at hfull
    have := Ideal.sub_mem _ hfull (Ideal.mem_sup_left hf)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_right] at this
  
  set V : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℚ := Matrix.of fun k j => lam k ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) with hV
  have hVdet : V.det ≠ 0 := by
    have hV' : V = Matrix.diagonal lam * Matrix.vandermonde lam := by
      ext k j
      rw [hV, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.vandermonde_apply, pow_succ']
    rw [hV', Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal]
    exact mul_ne_zero (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun k _ => (hlam k).2)
      (Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr hinj)
  set V' : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) :=
    V.map (algebraMap ℚ (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) with hV'
  have hV'det : IsUnit V'.det := by
    have : V'.det = algebraMap ℚ (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) V.det := by
      rw [hV', RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
    rw [this]
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hVdet).map _
  
  set u' : Fin N → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K := fun j => u ((j : ℕ) + 1) with hu'
  set w : Fin N → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K := fun k =>
    ∑ j : Fin N, lam k ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) • u ((j : ℕ) + 1) with hw'
  have hVu : V'.mulVec u' = w := by
    funext k
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hV', hV, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.of_apply, hu', hw',
      Algebra.smul_def]
  have hu'eq : u' = V'⁻¹.mulVec w := by
    rw [← hVu, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hV'det, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have h0 : (0 : ℕ) < N := hN
  have : u' ⟨0, h0⟩ ∈ J := by
    rw [hu'eq]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hw k)
  rw [← hu1]
  simpa [hu'] using this

name: IsLocalRing.mul_pderiv_mem_of_isInvariantOnePlus
statement:
theorem mul_pderiv_mem_of_isInvariantOnePlus {I B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)}
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) (h1 : IsInvariantOnePlus I B)
    {b : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hb : b ∈ B) {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hf : f ∈ I)
    (i : Fin n) : b * MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := K) i f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_of_forall_mem_sup_pow fun s => ?_
  rcases s with _ | s
  · simp
  · exact (sup_le_sup_left (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ _)) I)
      (mul_pderiv_mem_sup_pow hB h1 hb hf i (N := s + 1) (by omega))

name: IsLocalRing.mul_D_le_of_isInvariantOnePlus
proof:
:= by
  have hcol : (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).D I ≤ I.colon (B : Set _) := by
    refine (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).D_le_iff.mpr
      ⟨fun f hf => Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun b hb => ?_,
        fun i f hf => Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun b hb => ?_⟩
    · rw [smul_eq_mul]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hf
    · rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm _ b]
      exact mul_pderiv_mem_of_isInvariantOnePlus hB h1 hb hf i
  refine Ideal.mul_le.mpr fun b hb h hh => ?_
  have := Submodule.mem_colon.mp (hcol hh) b hb
  rwa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm h b] at this

name: IsLocalRing.isInvariantOnePlus_iff_mul_D_le
statement:
theorem isInvariantOnePlus_iff_mul_D_le (I B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) :
    IsInvariantOnePlus I B ↔ B * (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).D I ≤ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨mul_D_le_of_isInvariantOnePlus hB, fun h2 =>
    isInvariantOnePlus_of_forall_pow_mul_Dpow_le I B hB
      ((RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).pow_mul_Dpow_le I B h2)⟩

name: IsLocalRing.isInvariantOnePlus_iff_forall_pow_mul_Dpow_le
statement:
theorem isInvariantOnePlus_iff_forall_pow_mul_Dpow_le (I B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) :
    IsInvariantOnePlus I B ↔
      ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → B ^ j * (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).Dpow j I ≤ I
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h1 => (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).pow_mul_Dpow_le I B
      ((isInvariantOnePlus_iff_mul_D_le I B hB).mp h1),
    isInvariantOnePlus_of_forall_pow_mul_Dpow_le I B hB⟩

name: IsLocalRing.isMCInvariant_iff_isInvariantOnePlus
statement:
theorem isMCInvariant_iff_isInvariantOnePlus (I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) (m : ℕ)
    (hB : (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).MC I m ≤
      maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) :
    (RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).IsMCInvariant I m ↔
      IsInvariantOnePlus I ((RegularCoords.stdMvPowerSeries K n).MC I m)
proof:
:=
  (isInvariantOnePlus_iff_mul_D_le I _ hB).symm

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.mul_I
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_I (J K : MarkedIdeal R) : (J * K).I = J.I * K.I
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.mul_m
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_m (J K : MarkedIdeal R) : (J * K).m = J.m + K.m
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (J K : MarkedIdeal R) : J * K = ⟨J.I * K.I, J.m + K.m⟩
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.add_I
statement: @[simp] theorem add_I (J K : MarkedIdeal R) (h : J.m = K.m) : (J.add K h).I = J.I ⊔ K.I
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.add_m
statement: @[simp] theorem add_m (J K : MarkedIdeal R) (h : J.m = K.m) : (J.add K h).m = J.m
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_iff_le_pow
statement: theorem inCosupp_iff_le_pow (J : MarkedIdeal R) : J.InCosupp ↔ J.I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ J.m
proof:
:=
  le_ord_iff

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_anti
statement:
theorem inCosupp_anti {I J : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (h : I ≤ J) (hJ : InCosupp ⟨J, m⟩) :
    InCosupp ⟨I, m⟩
proof:
:=
  hJ.trans (ord_anti h)

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_mul
statement:
theorem inCosupp_mul {J K : MarkedIdeal R} (hJ : J.InCosupp) (hK : K.InCosupp) :
    (J * K).InCosupp
proof:
:= by
  unfold InCosupp at *
  rw [mul_I, mul_m, Nat.cast_add]
  exact (add_le_add hJ hK).trans (le_ord_mul _ _)

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_pow
statement:
theorem inCosupp_pow {J : MarkedIdeal R} (c : ℕ) (h : J.InCosupp) :
    InCosupp ⟨J.I ^ c, J.m * c⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold InCosupp at *
  dsimp only
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, mul_comm]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h zero_le).trans (le_ord_pow _ _)

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_add_iff
statement:
theorem inCosupp_add_iff {J K : MarkedIdeal R} (h : J.m = K.m) :
    (J.add K h).InCosupp ↔ J.InCosupp ∧ K.InCosupp
proof:
:= by
  unfold InCosupp
  rw [add_I, add_m, ord_sup, le_min_iff, h]

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_pow_iff_of_ordElem_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inCosupp_pow c, fun h => ?_⟩
  unfold InCosupp at *
  dsimp only at h
  rw [ord_pow_of_ordElem_mul hmul J.I hc, Nat.cast_mul, mul_comm] at h
  exact (ENat.mul_le_mul_left_iff (by exact_mod_cast (show c ≠ 0 by omega))
    (ENat.natCast_ne_top c)).mp h

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.mul_f
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_f [Mul R] (a b : MarkedElem R) : (a * b).f = a.f * b.f
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.mul_m
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_m [Mul R] (a b : MarkedElem R) : (a * b).m = a.m + b.m
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def [Mul R] (a b : MarkedElem R) : a * b = ⟨a.f * b.f, a.m + b.m⟩
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.add_f
statement: @[simp] theorem add_f [Add R] (a b : MarkedElem R) (h : a.m = b.m) : (a.add b h).f = a.f + b.f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.add_m
statement: @[simp] theorem add_m [Add R] (a b : MarkedElem R) (h : a.m = b.m) : (a.add b h).m = a.m
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.toMarkedIdeal_I
statement: @[simp] theorem toMarkedIdeal_I (a : MarkedElem R) : a.toMarkedIdeal.I = Ideal.span {a.f}
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.toMarkedIdeal_m
statement: @[simp] theorem toMarkedIdeal_m (a : MarkedElem R) : a.toMarkedIdeal.m = a.m
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.toMarkedIdeal_mul
statement:
theorem toMarkedIdeal_mul (a b : MarkedElem R) :
    (a * b).toMarkedIdeal = a.toMarkedIdeal * b.toMarkedIdeal
proof:
:=
  MarkedIdeal.ext (Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton _ _).symm rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.inCosupp_toMarkedIdeal
statement: theorem inCosupp_toMarkedIdeal (a : MarkedElem R) : a.toMarkedIdeal.InCosupp ↔ a.InCosupp
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.inCosupp_iff_mem_pow
statement: theorem inCosupp_iff_mem_pow (a : MarkedElem R) : a.InCosupp ↔ a.f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ a.m
proof:
:=
  mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem.symm

name: IsLocalRing.image_lt_eq_range
statement:
theorem image_lt_eq_range (hr : r ≤ n) :
    x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r} = Set.range fun i : Fin r => x (Fin.castLE hr i)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨j.val, hj⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Fin.castLE hr i, i.2, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_localization_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_localization_span_image_lt (hr : r ≤ n)
    [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : Fin r =>
        algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))
          (x (Fin.castLE hr i)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal).symm.trans ?_
  rw [Ideal.map_span]
  congr 1
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨j.val, hj⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x (Fin.castLE hr i), ⟨Fin.castLE hr i, i.2, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_le
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_le (hr : r ≤ n)
    [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))).spanFinrank
      ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximalIdeal_localization_span_image_lt x hr]
  refine le_trans (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_range _)) ?_
  rw [← Set.image_univ]
  exact le_trans (Set.ncard_image_le Set.finite_univ)
    (by rw [Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin])

name: IsLocalRing.natCast_le_height_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem natCast_le_height_span_image_lt (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (hr : r ≤ n) :
    (r : ℕ∞) ≤ (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).height
proof:
:= by
  have hP := isPrime_span_image_lt x hx hn r
  let chain : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R) := LTSeries.mk r
    (fun i : Fin (r + 1) =>
      ⟨Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i}), isPrime_span_image_lt x hx hn i⟩)
    (Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr fun i => by
      rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal]
      change Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < (i : ℕ)}) <
        Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < (i : ℕ) + 1})
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono fun j hj => ?_)) ?_
      · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj
      · intro heq
        have hi : (i : ℕ) < n := lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hr
        apply notMem_span_image_lt x hx hn hi
        rw [heq]
        exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, Nat.lt_succ_self _, rfl⟩)
  have hlast : chain.last ≤ ⟨Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}), hP⟩ := le_rfl
  have h := Order.length_le_height hlast
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight ⟨_, hP⟩]
  exact h

name: IsLocalRing.natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hr : r ≤ n) [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    (r : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))
    (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))), ← WithBot.coe_natCast,
    WithBot.coe_le_coe]
  exact natCast_le_height_span_image_lt x hx hn hr

name: IsLocalRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_localization_span_image_lt
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hr : r ≤ n) [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))
proof:
:=
  IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
    (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))
    (le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr (spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_le x hr))
      (natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt x hx hn hr))

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hr : r ≤ n) [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))) = r
proof:
:= by
  have := isRegularLocalRing_localization_span_image_lt x hx hn hr
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt x hx hn hr)
  rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal]
  exact Nat.cast_le.mpr (spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_le x hr)

name: IsLocalRing.localization_pderiv_algebraMap_x
statement:
theorem localization_pderiv_algebraMap_x (i j : Fin r) :
    (c.pderiv (Fin.castLE hr i)).localization
        (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).primeCompl
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))
          (c.x (Fin.castLE hr j))) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.localization_algebraMap, c.pderiv_x]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h' => h (Fin.castLE_inj.mp h')), ite_eq_right h, map_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.exists_localization_coords
statement:
theorem exists_localization_coords :
    ∃ _ : IsRegularLocalRing
      (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))),
      ∃ c' : RegularCoords (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))) r,
        c'.x = (fun i => algebraMap R _ (c.x (Fin.castLE hr i))) ∧
        c'.pderiv = fun i => (c.pderiv (Fin.castLE hr i)).localization
          (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).primeCompl
proof:
:=
  ⟨isRegularLocalRing_localization_span_image_lt c.x c.span_x c.card hr,
    localizationCoords c hr, rfl, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.transformElem_congr
statement:
theorem transformElem_congr {f₁ f₂ : R} (hf : f₁ = f₂) {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (hm : m₁ = m₂)
    (hf₁ : f₁ ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m₁) (hf₂ : f₂ ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m₂) :
    transformElem x r f₁ hf₁ = transformElem x r f₂ hf₂
proof:
:= by
  subst hf hm
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterate_chartDerivRing_transformElem
statement:
theorem iterate_chartDerivRing_transformElem {h : Fin n} (hh : h < r) {m : ℕ} {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    ∃ hf' : (⇑(c.pderiv h))^[j] f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m - j),
      (⇑(c.chartDerivRing r h))^[j] (transformElem c.x r f hf) =
        transformElem c.x r ((⇑(c.pderiv h))^[j] f) hf'
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact ⟨hf, rfl⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨hf', heq⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hj)
    
    have hf'' : (⇑(c.pderiv h))^[j] f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m - (j + 1) + 1) := by
      rwa [show m - (j + 1) + 1 = m - j by omega]
    have hnext : (⇑(c.pderiv h))^[j + 1] f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m - (j + 1)) := by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      have := c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r hf'' h
      rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this
    refine ⟨hnext, ?_⟩
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', heq, transformElem_congr c.x r rfl (by omega) hf' hf'',
      ← c.transform_pderiv_lt r hh hf'']
    exact transformElem_congr c.x r (Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _).symm rfl _ _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterate_chartDerivRing_transformElem_mem
statement:
theorem iterate_chartDerivRing_transformElem_mem {h : Fin n} (hh : h < r) {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) {f : R} (hf : f ∈ I) :
    (⇑(c.chartDerivRing r h))^[j] (transformElem c.x r f (hI hf)) ∈
      transformIdeal c.x r (c.Dpow j I) (m - j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hf', heq⟩ := c.iterate_chartDerivRing_transformElem r hh (hI hf) hj
  rw [heq]
  exact transformElem_mem_transformIdeal c.x r (c.iterate_pderiv_mem_Dpow h hf j) hf'

name: Derivation.mem_pow_of_mem_pow_succ
statement: theorem mem_pow_of_mem_pow_succ (a : ℕ) {f : R} (hf : f ∈ I ^ (a + 1)) : D f ∈ I ^ a
proof:
:= by
  induction a generalizing f with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [pow_succ] at hf
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf ?_ ?_
    · intro g hg h hh
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul g (D h), smul_eq_mul h (D g)]
      have h1 : h * D g ∈ I ^ (a + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ']
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hh (ih hg)
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hg) h1
    · intro x y hx hy
      rw [map_add]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy

name: Derivation.adicLevel_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicLevel_mk (n : ℕ) (f : R) :
    D.adicLevel I n (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (D f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Derivation.transitionMap_adicLevel
statement:
theorem transitionMap_adicLevel {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (y : R ⧸ (I ^ (n + 1) • ⊤ : Ideal R)) :
    AdicCompletion.transitionMap I R h (D.adicLevel I n y) =
      D.adicLevel I m (AdicCompletion.transitionMap I R (Nat.succ_le_succ h) y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ y
  rw [show D.adicLevel I n (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n • ⊤ : Ideal R) (D f) from rfl,
    AdicCompletion.transitionMap_ideal_mk,
    show (Submodule.Quotient.mk f : R ⧸ (I ^ (n + 1) • ⊤ : Ideal R)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1) • ⊤ : Ideal R) f from rfl,
    AdicCompletion.transitionMap_ideal_mk]
  rfl

name: Derivation.adicCompletionFun_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicCompletionFun_val (x : AdicCompletion I R) (n : ℕ) :
    (D.adicCompletionFun I x).val n = D.adicLevel I n (x.val (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Derivation.adicCompletion_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicCompletion_val (x : AdicCompletion I R) (n : ℕ) :
    (D.adicCompletion I x).val n = D.adicLevel I n (x.val (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Derivation.adicCompletion_of
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_of (f : R) :
    D.adicCompletion I (AdicCompletion.of I R f) = AdicCompletion.of I R (D f)
proof:
:= by
  apply AdicCompletion.ext
  intro n
  rw [adicCompletion_val, AdicCompletion.of_apply, AdicCompletion.of_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    Submodule.mkQ_apply, adicLevel_mk]

name: Derivation.adicCompletion_algebraMap
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_algebraMap (f : R) :
    D.adicCompletion I (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R) f) =
      algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R) (D f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AdicCompletion.algebraMap_apply, AdicCompletion.algebraMap_apply]
  exact adicCompletion_of I D f

name: Derivation.commutator_smul_smul
statement:
theorem _root_.Derivation.commutator_smul_smul (D₁ D₂ : Derivation k B B) (h : ⁅D₁, D₂⁆ = 0)
    (f g : B) : ⁅f • D₁, g • D₂⁆ = (f * D₁ g) • D₂ - (g * D₂ f) • D₁
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  have h' : D₁ (D₂ z) = D₂ (D₁ z) := by
    have := congrArg (fun D : Derivation k B B => D z) h
    simpa [Derivation.commutator_apply, sub_eq_zero] using this
  simp only [Derivation.commutator_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, Derivation.sub_apply,
    Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, h']
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_commutator
statement: theorem awayPderiv_commutator (i j : Fin n) : ⁅c.awayPderiv r i, c.awayPderiv r j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [Derivation.commutator_apply, Derivation.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero]
  exact Derivation.localization_comm _ (c.pderiv i) (c.pderiv j) (c.pderiv_comm i j) z

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_commutator_of_lt
statement:
theorem chartDeriv_commutator_of_lt {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) :
    ⁅c.chartDeriv r i, c.chartDeriv r j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hE := c.awayPderiv_commutator r
  rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hj | hj | hj
  · 
    rw [c.chartDeriv_of_lt r (hij.trans hj), c.chartDeriv_of_lt r hj,
      Derivation.commutator_smul_smul _ _ (hE i j), awayPderiv_algebraMap_x,
      awayPderiv_algebraMap_x, ite_eq_right (hij.trans hj).ne, ite_eq_right hj.ne]
    simp
  · 
    rw [hj]
    have hir : i < r := hj ▸ hij
    rw [c.chartDeriv_of_lt r hir, c.chartDeriv_self r, lie_add, lie_sum]
    have h1 : ⁅algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x r) • c.awayPderiv r i,
        c.awayPderiv r r⁆ = -c.awayPderiv r i := by
      rw [← one_smul (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.awayPderiv r r),
        Derivation.commutator_smul_smul _ _ (hE i r), awayPderiv_algebraMap_x, ite_eq_left rfl,
        Derivation.map_one_eq_zero]
      simp
    have h2 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin n => k < r),
        ⁅algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x r) • c.awayPderiv r i,
          chartY c.x r k • c.awayPderiv r k⁆ = if i = k then c.awayPderiv r i else 0 := by
      intro k hk
      have hk' : k < r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
      rw [Derivation.commutator_smul_smul _ _ (hE i k), awayPderiv_algebraMap_x,
        ite_eq_right hk'.ne, awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt c r i hk', ite_eq_right hir.ne]
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst hik
        simp [algebraMap_mul_invX]
      · simp [hik]
    rw [h1, Finset.sum_congr rfl h2, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp [hir]
  · 
    rw [c.chartDeriv_of_gt r hj]
    rcases lt_trichotomy i r with hi | hi | hi
    · 
      rw [c.chartDeriv_of_lt r hi, ← one_smul (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.awayPderiv r j),
        Derivation.commutator_smul_smul _ _ (hE i j), Derivation.map_one_eq_zero,
        awayPderiv_algebraMap_x, ite_eq_right hj.ne']
      simp
    · 
      rw [hi, c.chartDeriv_self r, add_lie, sum_lie, hE r j, zero_add]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
      have hk' : k < r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
      rw [← one_smul (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.awayPderiv r j),
        Derivation.commutator_smul_smul _ _ (hE k j), Derivation.map_one_eq_zero,
        awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt c r j hk', ite_eq_right (hk'.trans hj).ne', ite_eq_right hj.ne']
      simp
    · 
      rw [c.chartDeriv_of_gt r hi, hE i j]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_commutator
statement: theorem chartDeriv_commutator (i j : Fin n) : ⁅c.chartDeriv r i, c.chartDeriv r j⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
  · exact c.chartDeriv_commutator_of_lt r h
  · rw [h]; exact lie_self _
  · rw [← lie_skew, c.chartDeriv_commutator_of_lt r h, neg_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_comm
statement:
theorem chartDeriv_comm (i j : Fin n) (z : Localization.Away (c.x r)) :
    c.chartDeriv r i (c.chartDeriv r j z) = c.chartDeriv r j (c.chartDeriv r i z)
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun D : Derivation ℚ (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (Localization.Away (c.x r)) =>
    D z) (c.chartDeriv_commutator r i j)
  simpa [Derivation.commutator_apply, sub_eq_zero] using this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDerivRing_comm
statement:
theorem chartDerivRing_comm (i j : Fin n) (z : chartRing c.x r) :
    c.chartDerivRing r i (c.chartDerivRing r j z) =
      c.chartDerivRing r j (c.chartDerivRing r i z)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (c.chartDeriv_comm r i j z)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDerivRing_chartYR
statement:
theorem chartDerivRing_chartYR (i j : Fin n) :
    c.chartDerivRing r i (chartYR c.x r j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_chartDerivRing]
  change c.chartDeriv r i (chartY c.x r j) = _
  rw [chartDeriv_chartY]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.localization_chartDerivRing_algebraMap_chartYR
statement:
theorem localization_chartDerivRing_algebraMap_chartYR (i j : Fin n) :
    (c.chartDerivRing r i).localization (chartOrigin c.x r).primeCompl
      (algebraMap (chartRing c.x r) (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin c.x r))
        (chartYR c.x r j)) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.localization_algebraMap, chartDerivRing_chartYR]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_chartCoords
statement:
theorem exists_chartCoords :
    ∃ h : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin c.x r)),
      letI
proof:
:= h
      ∃ c' : RegularCoords (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin c.x r)) n,
        c'.x = (fun i => algebraMap (chartRing c.x r) _ (chartYR c.x r i)) ∧
        ∀ (j : Fin n) (f : chartRing c.x r), ∃ g : chartRing c.x r,
          (g : Localization.Away (c.x r)) = c.chartDeriv r j f ∧
          c'.pderiv j (algebraMap (chartRing c.x r) _ f) = algebraMap (chartRing c.x r) _ g :=
  ⟨isRegularLocalRing_localization_chartOrigin c.x r c.span_x c.card, c.chartCoords r, rfl,
    fun j f => ⟨c.chartDerivRing r j f, rfl, Derivation.localization_algebraMap _ _ f⟩⟩

name: IsLocalRing.chartYR_self_eq_algebraMap
statement: theorem chartYR_self_eq_algebraMap : chartYR x r r = algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_self]
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDerivRing_algebraMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chartDerivRing_algebraMap_eq_zero {a : R} (ha : ∀ i, c.pderiv i a = 0) (j : Fin n) :
    c.chartDerivRing r j (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_chartDerivRing, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_zero]
  rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hj | hjr | hj
  · rw [c.chartDeriv_of_lt r hj, Derivation.smul_apply, awayPderiv_algebraMap, ha, map_zero,
      smul_zero]
  · rw [hjr, c.chartDeriv_self r, Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.finset_sum_apply,
      awayPderiv_algebraMap, ha, map_zero, zero_add]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, awayPderiv_algebraMap, ha, map_zero, smul_zero]
  · rw [c.chartDeriv_of_gt r hj, awayPderiv_algebraMap, ha, map_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDerivRingOver_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartDerivRingOver_apply (hk : c.IsLinearOver k) (j : Fin n)
    (z : chartRing c.x r) : c.chartDerivRingOver r hk j z = c.chartDerivRing r j z
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_chartSat_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : Monotone fun i : ℕ => (Ideal.span {g}).colon
      ((Ideal.span {algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x r)} ^ i : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
        Set (chartRing c.x r)) :=
    fun i j hij => Submodule.colon_mono le_rfl (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hij)
  rw [chartSat, Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ hmono.directed_le]
  refine exists_congr fun i => ?_
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have := Submodule.mem_colon.mp hz _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rwa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at this
  · intro hz
    refine Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun w hw => ?_
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe] at hw
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hw
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm, mul_comm z]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hz

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_singleton_le_chartSat
statement: theorem span_singleton_le_chartSat (g : chartRing c.x r) : Ideal.span {g} ≤ c.chartSat r g
proof:
:=
  fun _ hz => (c.mem_chartSat_iff r).mpr ⟨0, by rwa [pow_zero, one_mul]⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_chartSat_of_pow_mul_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := (c.mem_chartSat_iff r).mp hz
  exact (c.mem_chartSat_iff r).mpr ⟨i' + i, by rwa [pow_add, mul_assoc]⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.preservesIdeal_chartSat_of_apply_mem
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (c.mem_chartSat_iff r).mp hz
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hi
  have h1 : δ (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x r) ^ i * z) ∈ c.chartSat r g := by
    rw [← ha, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hδ)
      (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (c.span_singleton_le_chartSat r g (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g)))
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h2 : z * δ (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x r) ^ i) ∈ c.chartSat r g :=
    Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hz
  exact c.mem_chartSat_of_pow_mul_mem r ((Ideal.add_mem_iff_left _ h2).mp h1)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.preservesIdeal_chartSat_smul_chartDerivRingOver
statement:
theorem preservesIdeal_chartSat_smul_chartDerivRingOver (hh : h < r) :
    (chartYR c.x r h • c.chartDerivRingOver r hk h).PreservesIdeal
      (c.chartSat r (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x h)))
proof:
:= by
  refine c.preservesIdeal_chartSat_of_apply_mem r _ ?_
  have hval : (chartYR c.x r h • c.chartDerivRingOver r hk h)
      (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x h)) = algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x h) := by
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, chartDerivRingOver_apply, algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR c.x r hh,
      Derivation.leibniz]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [c.chartDerivRing_chartYR r, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one,
      ← chartYR_self_eq_algebraMap c.x r, c.chartDerivRing_chartYR r, ite_eq_right hh.ne, mul_zero,
      add_zero]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  rw [hval]
  exact c.span_singleton_le_chartSat r _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.preservesIdeal_chartSat_chartDerivRingOver
statement:
theorem preservesIdeal_chartSat_chartDerivRingOver (hh : h < r) {i : Fin n} (hi : i ≠ h) :
    (c.chartDerivRingOver r hk i).PreservesIdeal
      (c.chartSat r (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x h)))
proof:
:= by
  refine c.preservesIdeal_chartSat_of_apply_mem r _ ?_
  have hval : c.chartDerivRingOver r hk i (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x h)) =
      if i = r then chartYR c.x r h else 0 := by
    rw [chartDerivRingOver_apply, algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR c.x r hh, Derivation.leibniz]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [c.chartDerivRing_chartYR r, ite_eq_right hi, mul_zero, zero_add,
      ← chartYR_self_eq_algebraMap c.x r, c.chartDerivRing_chartYR r]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [hval]
  split_ifs
  · exact (c.mem_chartSat_iff r).mpr ⟨1, by
      rw [pow_one, ← algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR c.x r hh]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _⟩
  · exact zero_mem _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlog_le_logDerivative
statement:
theorem chartDlog_le_logDerivative (hh : h < r) (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlog r h K ≤
      Ideal.logDerivative k (c.chartSat r (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x h))) K
proof:
:= by
  refine (c.chartDlog_le_iff r h).mpr
    ⟨Ideal.le_logDerivative _ _, fun z hz => ?_, fun i hi z hz => ?_⟩
  · exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_logDerivative
      (c.preservesIdeal_chartSat_smul_chartDerivRingOver r hk hh) hz
  · exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_logDerivative
      (c.preservesIdeal_chartSat_chartDerivRingOver r hk hh hi) hz

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDlogpow_le_logDerivativeIter
statement:
theorem chartDlogpow_le_logDerivativeIter (hh : h < r) (t : ℕ) (K : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) :
    c.chartDlogpow r h t K ≤
      Ideal.logDerivativeIter k (c.chartSat r (algebraMap R (chartRing c.x r) (c.x h))) t K
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [chartDlogpow_succ, Ideal.logDerivativeIter_succ]
    exact (c.chartDlog_le_logDerivative r hk hh _).trans (Ideal.logDerivative_mono ih)

name: IsLocalRing.le_ord_of_le
statement: theorem le_ord_of_le {I : Ideal R} {r : ℕ} (h : I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ r) : (r : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I
proof:
:=
  le_iSup₂_of_le r h le_rfl

name: IsLocalRing.le_ord_iff
statement: theorem le_ord_iff {I : Ideal R} {r : ℕ} : (r : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I ↔ I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, le_ord_of_le⟩
  by_contra hI
  have hs : ∀ s : ℕ, I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ s → s < r := by
    intro s hs
    by_contra hrs
    push Not at hrs
    exact hI (hs.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hrs))
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hI (by simp)
  have hle : ord I ≤ ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
    iSup₂_le fun s hs' => by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (hs s hs')
  have hlt : ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) < r := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_one_lt hr
  exact absurd (h.trans hle) (not_le.mpr hlt)

name: IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem {f : R} {r : ℕ} :
    f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ r ↔ (r : ℕ∞) ≤ ordElem f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordElem, le_ord_iff, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]

name: IsLocalRing.ord_anti
statement: theorem ord_anti {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : ord J ≤ ord I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le]
  intro r hr
  exact le_ord_iff.mpr (h.trans (le_ord_iff.mp hr))

name: IsLocalRing.ord_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_top : ord (⊤ : Ideal R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun r hr => ?_) bot_le
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with rfl | hr0
  · simp
  · exfalso
    have : maximalIdeal R = ⊤ := top_le_iff.mp (hr.trans (Ideal.pow_le_self hr0.ne'))
    exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top this

name: IsLocalRing.ord_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_zero_iff {I : Ideal R} : ord I = 0 ↔ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hI
    have h1 : ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I :=
      le_ord_iff.mpr (by rw [pow_one]; exact le_maximalIdeal hI)
    rw [h] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by simp)
  · rintro rfl
    exact ord_top

name: IsLocalRing.one_le_ordElem_iff
statement: theorem one_le_ordElem_iff {f : R} : 1 ≤ ordElem f ↔ f ∈ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_one, ← mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem, pow_one]

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem ordElem_eq_one_iff {f : R} :
    ordElem f = 1 ↔ f ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ f ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_le_ordElem_iff, mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem]
  induction ordElem f using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp
  | coe m =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      exact ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have h1' : 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast h1
      have h2' : ¬ 2 ≤ m := fun h => h2 (by exact_mod_cast h)
      exact_mod_cast (show m = 1 by omega)

name: IsLocalRing.ord_eq_iInf
statement: theorem ord_eq_iInf (I : Ideal R) : ord I = ⨅ f ∈ I, ordElem f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun f hf => ord_anti ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hf)) ?_
  rw [← ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le]
  intro r hr
  refine le_ord_iff.mpr fun f hf => ?_
  exact mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem.mpr (hr.trans (iInf₂_le f hf))

name: IsLocalRing.ord_span
statement: theorem ord_span (S : Set R) : ord (Ideal.span S) = ⨅ f ∈ S, ordElem f
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun f hf => ord_anti ?_) ?_
  · exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr (Ideal.subset_span hf)
  · rw [← ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le]
    intro r hr
    refine le_ord_iff.mpr (Ideal.span_le.mpr fun f hf => ?_)
    exact mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem.mpr (hr.trans (iInf₂_le f hf))

name: IsLocalRing.exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem
statement:
theorem exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem {S : Set R} (hS : S.Finite) (hne : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ f ∈ S, ord (Ideal.span S) = ordElem f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hmin⟩ := hS.toFinset.exists_min_image ordElem (by simpa using hne)
  rw [hS.mem_toFinset] at hf
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  rw [ord_span]
  refine le_antisymm (iInf₂_le f hf) (le_iInf₂ fun g hg => ?_)
  exact hmin g (hS.mem_toFinset.mpr hg)

name: IsLocalRing.ord_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_top_iff {I : Ideal R} : ord I = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hle : ∀ r : ℕ, I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ r := fun r => le_ord_iff.mp (h ▸ le_top)
    rw [eq_bot_iff, ← Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (I := maximalIdeal R)
      (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top]
    exact le_iInf hle
  · rintro rfl
    rw [ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_ge]
    exact fun r => le_ord_of_le bot_le

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem ordElem_eq_top_iff {f : R} : ordElem f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordElem, ord_eq_top_iff, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]

name: IsLocalRing.le_ord_mul
statement: theorem le_ord_mul (I J : Ideal R) : ord I + ord J ≤ ord (I * J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le]
  intro r hr
  rw [le_ord_iff]
  by_cases hI : ord I = ⊤
  · exact Ideal.mul_le_left.trans (le_ord_iff.mp (by rw [hI]; exact le_top))
  by_cases hJ : ord J = ⊤
  · exact Ideal.mul_le_right.trans (le_ord_iff.mp (by rw [hJ]; exact le_top))
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hI
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hJ
  have hIa : I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ a := le_ord_iff.mp ha.le
  have hJb : J ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ b := le_ord_iff.mp hb.le
  have hr' : r ≤ a + b := by
    rw [← ha, ← hb] at hr
    exact_mod_cast hr
  calc I * J ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ a * maximalIdeal R ^ b := Ideal.mul_mono hIa hJb
    _ = maximalIdeal R ^ (a + b) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ r := Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hr'

name: IsLocalRing.ord_sup
statement: theorem ord_sup (I J : Ideal R) : ord (I ⊔ J) = min (ord I) (ord J)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_ <;> rw [← ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le] <;> intro r hr
  · rw [le_ord_iff, sup_le_iff] at hr
    exact le_min_iff.mpr ⟨le_ord_iff.mpr hr.1, le_ord_iff.mpr hr.2⟩
  · rw [le_min_iff] at hr
    exact le_ord_iff.mpr (sup_le (le_ord_iff.mp hr.1) (le_ord_iff.mp hr.2))

name: IsLocalRing.le_ord_pow
statement: theorem le_ord_pow (I : Ideal R) (c : ℕ) : (c : ℕ∞) * ord I ≤ ord (I ^ c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => simp
  | succ c ih =>
    calc ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ord I = (c : ℕ∞) * ord I + ord I := by push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ ord (I ^ c) + ord I := add_le_add ih le_rfl
      _ ≤ ord (I ^ c * I) := le_ord_mul _ _
      _ = ord (I ^ (c + 1)) := by rw [pow_succ]

name: IsLocalRing.ord_le_ord_map
statement:
theorem ord_le_ord_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] (φ : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (I : Ideal R) : ord I ≤ ord (I.map φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le]
  intro r hr
  rw [le_ord_iff] at hr ⊢
  calc I.map φ ≤ (maximalIdeal R ^ r).map φ := Ideal.map_mono hr
    _ = (maximalIdeal R).map φ ^ r := Ideal.map_pow _ _ _
    _ ≤ maximalIdeal S ^ r := Ideal.pow_right_mono (map_maximalIdeal_le φ) r

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_one
statement: theorem ordElem_one : ordElem (1 : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordElem, Ideal.span_singleton_one, ord_top]

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_pow_of_ordElem_mul
statement:
theorem ordElem_pow_of_ordElem_mul
    (hmul : ∀ f g : R, ordElem (f * g) = ordElem f + ordElem g) (f : R) (n : ℕ) :
    ordElem (f ^ n) = (n : ℕ∞) * ordElem f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ordElem_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, hmul, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

name: IsLocalRing.ord_bot
statement: theorem ord_bot : ord (⊥ : Ideal R) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_ge]
  exact fun r => le_ord_of_le bot_le

name: IsLocalRing.ord_pow_of_ordElem_mul
statement:
theorem ord_pow_of_ordElem_mul (hmul : ∀ f g : R, ordElem (f * g) = ordElem f + ordElem g)
    (I : Ideal R) {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) : ord (I ^ c) = (c : ℕ∞) * ord I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_ord_pow I c)
  have hc0 : (c : ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hc)
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · subst hI
    rw [Ideal.bot_pow (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hc), ord_bot, ENat.mul_top hc0]
  obtain ⟨S, hSfin, hS'⟩ := Submodule.fg_def.mp (IsNoetherian.noetherian I)
  have hS : Ideal.span S = I := hS'
  have hne : S.Nonempty := by
    rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
    · exact absurd (by rw [← hS, h, Ideal.span_empty]) hI
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hord⟩ := exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem hSfin hne
  rw [hS] at hord
  have hfI : f ∈ I := hS ▸ Ideal.subset_span hf
  calc ord (I ^ c) ≤ ordElem (f ^ c) :=
        ord_anti ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hfI c))
    _ = (c : ℕ∞) * ordElem f := ordElem_pow_of_ordElem_mul hmul f c
    _ = (c : ℕ∞) * ord I := by rw [hord]

name: IsLocalRing.ord_span_singleton_mul_of_ordElem_mul
statement:
theorem ord_span_singleton_mul_of_ordElem_mul
    (hmul : ∀ f g : R, ordElem (f * g) = ordElem f + ordElem g) (f : R) (I : Ideal R) :
    ord (Ideal.span {f} * I) = ordElem f + ord I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_ord_mul _ _)
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · subst hI
    rw [Ideal.mul_bot, ord_bot, add_top]
  obtain ⟨S, hSfin, hS'⟩ := Submodule.fg_def.mp (IsNoetherian.noetherian I)
