  have hS : Ideal.span S = I := hS'
  have hne : S.Nonempty := by
    rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
    · exact absurd (by rw [← hS, h, Ideal.span_empty]) hI
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hord⟩ := exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem hSfin hne
  rw [hS] at hord
  have hgI : g ∈ I := hS ▸ Ideal.subset_span hg
  calc ord (Ideal.span {f} * I) ≤ ordElem (f * g) :=
        ord_anti ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr
          (Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self f) hgI))
    _ = ordElem f + ordElem g := hmul f g
    _ = ordElem f + ord I := by rw [hord]

name: IsLocalRing.isUnit_natCast
statement: theorem isUnit_natCast {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) : IsUnit (a : R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_natCast (algebraMap ℚ R) a]
  exact (IsUnit.mk0 (a : ℚ) (by exact_mod_cast ha)).map _

name: IsLocalRing.derivation_sum_apply
statement:
theorem derivation_sum_apply {R A M ι : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Algebra R A] [Module A M] [Module R M] (s : Finset ι)
    (D : ι → Derivation R A M) (a : A) : (∑ i ∈ s, D i) a = ∑ i ∈ s, D i a
proof:
:= by
  change Derivation.coeFnAddMonoidHom (∑ i ∈ s, D i) a = _
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.x_mem_maximalIdeal
statement: theorem x_mem_maximalIdeal (i : Fin n) : c.x i ∈ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.span_x]
  exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_pderiv_mem
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_pderiv_mem {y : R} (hy : y ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (h : ∀ i, c.pderiv i y ∈ maximalIdeal R) : y ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.span_x] at hy
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp hy
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro i
    have hi := h i
    simp only [map_sum, smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, c.pderiv_x, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true] at hi
    have : a i = c.pderiv i (∑ l, a l * c.x l) - ∑ l, c.x l * c.pderiv i (a l) := by
      simp only [map_sum, smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, c.pderiv_x, mul_ite, mul_one,
        mul_zero, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
      ring
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (h i)
      (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (c.x_mem_maximalIdeal l))
  rw [pow_two]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Ideal.mul_mem_mul (ha l) (c.x_mem_maximalIdeal l)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.jacobian_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem jacobian_apply (x' : Fin n → R) (i j : Fin n) : c.jacobian x' i j = c.pderiv i (x' j)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transportPderiv_apply
statement:
theorem transportPderiv_apply (x' : Fin n → R) (j : Fin n) (f : R) :
    c.transportPderiv x' j f = ∑ l, (c.jacobian x')⁻¹ j l * c.pderiv l f
proof:
:= by
  rw [transportPderiv, derivation_sum_apply]
  simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isUnit_jacobian
statement:
theorem isUnit_jacobian (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) :
    IsUnit (c.jacobian x')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx'm : ∀ j, x' j ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun j => by
    rw [hx']; exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
  rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, ← residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit, RingHom.map_det]
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨v, hv0, hv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
  choose w hw using fun j => residue_surjective (R := R) (v j)
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ : ∃ j₀, v j₀ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hv0 (funext h)
  
  set y : R := ∑ j, w j * x' j with hy_def
  have hy : y ∈ maximalIdeal R := Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hx'm j)
  have hdy : ∀ i, c.pderiv i y ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro i
    have h1 : c.pderiv i y = ∑ j, w j * c.pderiv i (x' j) + ∑ j, x' j * c.pderiv i (w j) := by
      simp only [hy_def, map_sum, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have h2 : ∑ j, w j * c.pderiv i (x' j) ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
      have hv' := congr_fun hv i
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply,
        jacobian_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at hv'
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      change residue R _ = 0
      rw [map_sum, ← hv']
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [map_mul, hw, mul_comm]
    rw [h1]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ h2 (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hx'm j))
  have hy2 := c.mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_pderiv_mem hy hdy
  
  have hu : IsUnit (w j₀) := (residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit _).mp (by rw [hw]; exact hj₀)
  set N : Ideal R := Ideal.span (x' '' {j₀}ᶜ) with hN_def
  have hgen : Set.range x' ⊆ (N ⊔ maximalIdeal R • maximalIdeal R : Ideal R) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    by_cases hj : j = j₀
    · subst hj
      have hrest : ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w l * x' l ∈ N :=
        Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l hl =>
          Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨l, Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hl, rfl⟩)
      have hsplit : w j * x' j = y - ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w l * x' l := by
        rw [hy_def, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]; ring
      have hmem : w j * x' j ∈ N ⊔ maximalIdeal R • maximalIdeal R := by
        rw [hsplit]
        refine Submodule.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_right ?_) (Ideal.mem_sup_left hrest)
        rwa [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← pow_two]
      have := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R) hmem
      rwa [← mul_assoc, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_mul] at this
    · exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩)
  have hle : maximalIdeal R ≤ N ⊔ maximalIdeal R • maximalIdeal R :=
    hx'.le.trans (Ideal.span_le.mpr hgen)
  have hNle : maximalIdeal R ≤ N :=
    Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
      (le_of_eq (jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal (⊥ : Ideal R) bot_ne_top).symm) hle
  have hNeq : maximalIdeal R = N := by
    refine le_antisymm hNle ?_
    rw [hN_def, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, -, rfl⟩
    exact hx'm j
  
  have hrank : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ≤ n - 1 := by
    rw [hNeq, hN_def]
    refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.toFinite _)).trans ?_
    refine (Set.ncard_image_le (Set.toFinite _)).trans ?_
    rw [Set.ncard_compl, Set.ncard_singleton, Nat.card_fin]
  have hdim : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = n := by
    have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
    rw [← c.card] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hn : 0 < n := Fin.pos j₀
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transportPderiv_x
statement:
theorem transportPderiv_x (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (i j : Fin n) : c.transportPderiv x' i (x' j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet : IsUnit (c.jacobian x').det :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (c.isUnit_jacobian x' hx')
  rw [transportPderiv_apply]
  have := congr_fun (congr_fun (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet) i) j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
  simpa [jacobian_apply] using this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.changeCoords_x
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeCoords_x (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (hcomm : ∀ i j f, c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)) :
    (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).x = x'
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.changeCoords_pderiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeCoords_pderiv (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (hcomm : ∀ i j f, c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)) :
    (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).pderiv = c.transportPderiv x'
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_eq_sum_transportPderiv
statement:
theorem pderiv_eq_sum_transportPderiv (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) (i : Fin n) :
    c.pderiv i = ∑ j, c.jacobian x' i j • c.transportPderiv x' j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet : IsUnit (c.jacobian x').det :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (c.isUnit_jacobian x' hx')
  have hmul := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet
  ext f
  rw [derivation_sum_apply]
  have h1 : ∀ j, (c.jacobian x' i j • c.transportPderiv x' j) f =
      ∑ l, c.jacobian x' i j * ((c.jacobian x')⁻¹ j l * c.pderiv l f) := by
    intro j
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, transportPderiv_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => h1 j, Finset.sum_comm]
  have h2 : ∀ l, ∑ j, c.jacobian x' i j * ((c.jacobian x')⁻¹ j l * c.pderiv l f) =
      (c.jacobian x' * (c.jacobian x')⁻¹) i l * c.pderiv l f := by
    intro l
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => h2 l, hmul]
  simp [Matrix.one_apply]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_range_transportPderiv
statement:
theorem span_range_transportPderiv (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range (c.transportPderiv x')) =
      Submodule.span R (Set.range c.pderiv)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [c.pderiv_eq_sum_transportPderiv x' hx' i]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.SpansDerivations.transport
statement:
theorem SpansDerivations.transport (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) (δ : Derivation ℚ R R) (f : R) :
    δ f = ∑ k, δ (x' k) * c.transportPderiv x' k f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdet : IsUnit (c.jacobian x').det :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (c.isUnit_jacobian x' hx')
  have hmul := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet
  have h1 : ∀ k, δ (x' k) = ∑ l, δ (c.x l) * c.jacobian x' l k := fun k => hs δ (x' k)
  calc δ f = ∑ l, δ (c.x l) * c.pderiv l f := hs δ f
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ p, δ (c.x l) * ((c.jacobian x' * (c.jacobian x')⁻¹) l p * c.pderiv p f) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
        rw [hmul]
        simp [Matrix.one_apply]
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ p, ∑ k, δ (c.x l) * c.jacobian x' l k * ((c.jacobian x')⁻¹ k p * c.pderiv p f) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ k, ∑ p, δ (c.x l) * c.jacobian x' l k * ((c.jacobian x')⁻¹ k p * c.pderiv p f) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ l, ∑ p, δ (c.x l) * c.jacobian x' l k * ((c.jacobian x')⁻¹ k p * c.pderiv p f) :=
        Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ k, δ (x' k) * c.transportPderiv x' k f := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        rw [h1, transportPderiv_apply, Finset.sum_mul_sum]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transportPderiv_comm
statement:
theorem transportPderiv_comm (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) (i j : Fin n) (f : R) :
    c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : ∀ k, ⁅c.transportPderiv x' i, c.transportPderiv x' j⁆ (x' k) = 0 := by
    intro k
    rw [Derivation.commutator_apply, c.transportPderiv_x x' hx', c.transportPderiv_x x' hx']
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have := SpansDerivations.transport c hs x' hx' ⁅c.transportPderiv x' i, c.transportPderiv x' j⁆ f
  simp only [hδ, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] at this
  rw [Derivation.commutator_apply] at this
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.spansDerivations_changeCoords
statement:
theorem spansDerivations_changeCoords (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (hcomm : ∀ i j f, c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)) :
    (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).SpansDerivations ℚ
proof:
:=
  fun δ f => SpansDerivations.transport c hs x' hx' δ f

name: IsLocalRing.chartYOf_of_lt
statement:
theorem chartYOf_of_lt {i : Fin n} (h : i < r) :
    chartYOf x r d i = Localization.mk (x i) ⟨d, Submonoid.mem_powers d⟩
proof: := ite_eq_left h

name: IsLocalRing.chartYOf_of_not_lt
statement: theorem chartYOf_of_not_lt {i : Fin n} (h : ¬ i < r) : chartYOf x r d i = algebraMap R _ (x i)
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right h

name: IsLocalRing.chartYOf_self
statement: theorem chartYOf_self : chartYOf x r d r = algebraMap R _ (x r)
proof: := ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl r)

name: IsLocalRing.chartYOf_mem
statement: theorem chartYOf_mem (i : Fin n) : chartYOf x r d i ∈ chartRingOf x r d
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartYOf
  split_ifs with h
  · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, h, rfl⟩
  · exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _

name: IsLocalRing.chartY_mem
statement: theorem chartY_mem (i : Fin n) : chartY x r i ∈ chartRing x r
proof: := chartYOf_mem x r (x r) i

name: IsLocalRing.coe_chartYROf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_chartYROf (i : Fin n) :
    (chartYROf x r d i : Localization.Away d) = chartYOf x r d i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.chartYROf_mem_chartOriginOf
statement: theorem chartYROf_mem_chartOriginOf (i : Fin n) : chartYROf x r d i ∈ chartOriginOf x r d
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_x_mem_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem algebraMap_x_mem_chartOrigin (i : Fin n) :
    algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x i) ∈ chartOrigin x r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i < r
  · have hx : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x i) = chartYR x r i * chartYR x r r := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_chartYROf,
        chartYOf_of_lt _ _ _ h, chartYOf_self, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap,
        Localization.mk_mul]
      rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
      exact ⟨1, by simp; ring⟩
    rw [hx]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (chartYROf_mem_chartOriginOf x r (x r) i)
  · have hx : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x i) = chartYR x r i :=
      Subtype.ext (by simp [chartYOf_of_not_lt _ _ _ h])
    rw [hx]
    exact chartYROf_mem_chartOriginOf x r (x r) i

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_comap_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_le_comap_chartOrigin [IsLocalRing R]
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) :
    maximalIdeal R ≤ (chartOrigin x r).comap (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact algebraMap_x_mem_chartOrigin x r i

name: IsLocalRing.shiftCoords_self
statement: theorem shiftCoords_self (a : Fin n → R) : shiftCoords x r a r = x r
proof: := ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl r)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_of_lt
statement:
theorem chartDeriv_of_lt {j : Fin n} (h : j < r) :
    c.chartDeriv r j = algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x r) • c.awayPderiv r j
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left h

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_self
statement:
theorem chartDeriv_self :
    c.chartDeriv r r = c.awayPderiv r r +
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i < r), chartY c.x r i • c.awayPderiv r i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartDeriv, ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl r), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_of_gt
statement: theorem chartDeriv_of_gt {j : Fin n} (h : r < j) : c.chartDeriv r j = c.awayPderiv r j
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartDeriv, ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h.le), ite_eq_right h.ne']

name: IsLocalRing.isLocalRing_adicCompletion
statement: theorem isLocalRing_adicCompletion : IsLocalRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_adicCompletion :
    maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) =
      (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))
proof:
:=
  AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map

name: IsLocalRing.residueField_map_adicCompletion_bijective
statement:
theorem residueField_map_adicCompletion_bijective :
    Function.Bijective
      (ResidueField.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)))
proof:
:=
  AdicCompletion.residueField_map_bijective R

name: IsLocalRing.isAdicComplete_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_adicCompletion :
    IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))
      (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff (f : R) (a : ℕ) :
    algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f ∈
        maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) ^ a ↔
      f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map, ← Ideal.map_pow, ← Submodule.restrictScalars_mem R,
    ← Ideal.smul_top_eq_map,
    AdicCompletion.pow_smul_top_eq_ker_eval (maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing,
    LinearMap.mem_ker]
  change AdicCompletion.eval (maximalIdeal R) R a (AdicCompletion.of (maximalIdeal R) R f) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [AdicCompletion.eval_of, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Ideal.smul_eq_mul,
    Ideal.mul_top]

name: IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_algebraMap_mem
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_algebraMap_mem (f : R) (a : ℕ) :
    f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ a ↔
      algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f ∈
        maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) ^ a
proof:
:=
  (algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff f a).symm

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_algebraMap_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem ordElem_algebraMap_adicCompletion (f : R) :
    ordElem (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f) = ordElem f
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.ENat.eq_of_forall_natCast_le_iff
  intro r
  rw [← mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem, ← mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem,
    algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff]

name: IsLocalRing.ord_map_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem ord_map_adicCompletion (I : Ideal R) :
    ord (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))) = ord I
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.ENat.eq_of_forall_natCast_le_iff
  intro r
  rw [le_ord_iff, le_ord_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h f hf
    exact (algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff f r).mp (h (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf))
  · intro h
    calc I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))
        ≤ (maximalIdeal R ^ r).map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) :=
          Ideal.map_mono h
      _ = (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) ^ r :=
          Ideal.map_pow _ _ _
      _ = maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) ^ r := by
          rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]

name: IsLocalRing.faithfullyFlat_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_adicCompletion :
    Module.FaithfullyFlat R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)
proof:
:=
  Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom

name: IsLocalRing.comap_map_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem comap_map_adicCompletion (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))).comap
      (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) = I
proof:
:= by
  have := faithfullyFlat_adicCompletion (R := R)
  exact Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat I

name: IsLocalRing.map_adicCompletion_injective
statement:
theorem map_adicCompletion_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (fun I : Ideal R => I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)))
proof:
:= by
  intro I J h
  have := congrArg (Ideal.comap (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))) h
  simpa only [comap_map_adicCompletion] using this

name: IsLocalRing.range_adicCompletion_map_subtype
statement:
theorem range_adicCompletion_map_subtype (I : Ideal R) :
    LinearMap.range (AdicCompletion.map (maximalIdeal R) I.subtype) =
      I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have : Module.Finite R I := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct_surjective_of_finite (maximalIdeal R) I z
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct_naturality, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul r i =>
      rw [TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.map_tmul, AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct_tmul]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ r (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ i.2)
    | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, map_add]
      exact add_mem hx hy
  · refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨AdicCompletion.of (maximalIdeal R) I ⟨i, hi⟩, by rw [AdicCompletion.map_of]; rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.adicCompletion_algebraMap_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_algebraMap_maximalIdeal {k : Type v} [CommRing k] [Algebra k R]
    (D : Derivation k R R) (f : R) :
    D.adicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f) =
      algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) (D f)
proof:
:=
  D.adicCompletion_algebraMap _ f

name: IsLocalRing.adicCompletion_algebraMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_algebraMap_eq_zero {k : Type v} [CommRing k] [Algebra k R] [Algebra ℚ R]
    (D : Derivation ℚ R R) (hD : ∀ a : k, D (algebraMap k R a) = 0) (a : k) :
    D.adicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) (algebraMap k (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [AdicCompletion.algebraMap_apply, D.adicCompletion_of, hD, map_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.adicCompletion_pderiv_x
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_pderiv_x (i j : Fin n) :
    (c.pderiv i).adicCompletion (maximalIdeal R)
        (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) (c.x j)) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.adicCompletion_algebraMap, c.pderiv_x]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.adicCompletion_pderiv_comm
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_pderiv_comm (i j : Fin n) (f : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) :
    (c.pderiv i).adicCompletion (maximalIdeal R)
        ((c.pderiv j).adicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) f) =
      (c.pderiv j).adicCompletion (maximalIdeal R)
        ((c.pderiv i).adicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) f)
proof:
:= by
  apply AdicCompletion.ext
  intro m
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ (f.val (m + 2))
  simp only [Derivation.adicCompletion_val]
  rw [← hh, Derivation.adicLevel_mk, Derivation.adicLevel_mk, Derivation.adicLevel_mk,
    Derivation.adicLevel_mk, c.pderiv_comm]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_adicCompletion_coords
statement:
theorem exists_adicCompletion_coords [IsRegularLocalRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)] :
    ∃ ĉ : RegularCoords (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) n,
      ĉ.x = (fun i => algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) (c.x i)) ∧
      ĉ.pderiv = fun i => (c.pderiv i).adicCompletion (maximalIdeal R)
proof:
:=
  ⟨c.adicCompletion, rfl, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.coeff_subst_chartSubst_truncTotal
statement:
theorem coeff_subst_chartSubst_truncTotal (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) {N : ℕ}
    {β : Fin n →₀ ℕ} (hβ : β.degree < N) :
    coeff β (subst (chartSubst (K := K) r) (truncTotal N F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) =
      coeff β (subst (chartSubst (K := K) r) F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ α, chartExp r α = β
  · obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [coeff_subst_chartSubst, coeff_subst_chartSubst, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_truncTotal]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by rw [degree_chartExp]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _) hβ
  · push Not at h
    rw [coeff_subst_chartSubst_eq_zero r (fun d _ => h d),
      coeff_subst_chartSubst_eq_zero r (fun d _ => h d)]

name: IsLocalRing.wt_add
statement: theorem wt_add (m : ℕ) (e e' : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) : wt m (e + e') = wt m e + wt m e'
proof:
:= by
  simp [wt, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: IsLocalRing.wt_single
statement: theorem wt_single (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (k : ℕ) : wt m (Pi.single j k) = (m - (j : ℕ)) * k
proof:
:= by
  unfold wt
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun j' _ hj' => by simp [hj']) (by simp)]
  simp

name: IsLocalRing.Lcm_pos
statement: theorem Lcm_pos (m : ℕ) : 0 < Lcm m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, Lcm, Ne, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff]
  rintro ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hx
  simp only [id] at hx0
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.dvd_Lcm
statement: theorem dvd_Lcm {m w : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ w) (h2 : w ≤ m) : w ∣ Lcm m
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with rfl | h1'
  · exact one_dvd _
  · exact Finset.dvd_lcm (f := id) (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h1', h2⟩)

name: IsLocalRing.exists_le_sum_eq
statement:
theorem exists_le_sum_eq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : ι → ℕ) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : r ≤ ∑ i, b i) : ∃ d : ι → ℕ, d ≤ b ∧ ∑ i, d i = r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction r with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ => Nat.zero_le _, by simp⟩
  | succ r ih =>
    obtain ⟨d, hdb, hd⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hr)
    have hex : ∃ i, d i < b i := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      have := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hcon i
      omega
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
    refine ⟨d + Pi.single i 1, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same]
        omega
      · simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, add_zero]
        exact hdb j
    · simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hd, Finset.sum_pi_single']
      simp

name: IsLocalRing.exists_le_wt_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hL0 : 0 < Lcm m := Lcm_pos m
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ, q = fun j : Fin (m + 1) => Lcm m / (m - (j : ℕ)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨bq, hbq⟩ : ∃ bq : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ, bq = fun j => e j / q j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨rem, hrem⟩ : ∃ rem : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ, rem = fun j => e j % q j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwq : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), (j : ℕ) < m → (m - (j : ℕ)) * q j = Lcm m := fun j hj => by
    rw [hq]
    exact Nat.mul_div_cancel' (dvd_Lcm (by omega) (Nat.sub_le m j))
  have hb0 : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), m ≤ (j : ℕ) → bq j = 0 := fun j hj => by
    rw [hbq, hq]
    simp [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hj]
  have hkey : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), (m - (j : ℕ)) * e j = bq j * Lcm m + (m - (j : ℕ)) * rem j := by
    intro j
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (j : ℕ) m with hj | hj
    · have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod (e j) (q j)
      rw [hbq, hrem]
      simp only
      calc (m - (j : ℕ)) * e j = (m - (j : ℕ)) * (q j * (e j / q j) + e j % q j) := by rw [hdm]
        _ = e j / q j * ((m - (j : ℕ)) * q j) + (m - (j : ℕ)) * (e j % q j) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hwq j hj]
    · rw [hb0 j hj, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hj]
      simp
  have hbound : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), (j : ℕ) < m → (m - (j : ℕ)) * rem j < Lcm m := by
    intro j hj
    have hqpos : 0 < q j := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (q j) with h0 | h0
      · have := hwq j hj
        rw [h0, mul_zero] at this
        omega
      · exact h0
    calc (m - (j : ℕ)) * rem j < (m - (j : ℕ)) * q j := by
          rw [hrem]
          exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.mod_lt _ hqpos) (by omega)
      _ = Lcm m := hwq j hj
  have hwt : wt m e = (∑ j, bq j) * Lcm m + ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (m - (j : ℕ)) * rem j := by
    unfold wt
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hkey j
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (∑ j, bq j) r with hr | hr
  swap
  · obtain ⟨d, hdb, hd⟩ := exists_le_sum_eq bq r hr
    refine ⟨fun j => d j * q j, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc d j * q j ≤ bq j * q j := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hdb j)
        _ ≤ e j := by rw [hbq]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
    · unfold wt
      calc ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (m - (j : ℕ)) * (d j * q j) = ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), d j * Lcm m := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
            rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (j : ℕ) m with hj | hj
            · rw [← hwq j hj]
              ring
            · have hd0 : d j = 0 := by
                have := Pi.le_def.mp hdb j
                rw [hb0 j hj] at this
                omega
              rw [hd0, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hj]
              simp
        _ = r * Lcm m := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hd]
  · exfalso
    have hsum : ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (m - (j : ℕ)) * rem j < m * Lcm m := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have hlast : (m - ((Fin.last m : Fin (m + 1)) : ℕ)) * rem (Fin.last m) = 0 := by simp
      rw [hlast, add_zero]
      calc ∑ i : Fin m, (m - ((Fin.castSucc i : Fin (m + 1)) : ℕ)) * rem (Fin.castSucc i)
          ≤ ∑ _i : Fin m, (Lcm m - 1) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
            have := hbound (Fin.castSucc i) (by simp)
            omega
        _ = m * (Lcm m - 1) := by simp
        _ < m * Lcm m := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.sub_lt hL0 Nat.one_pos) hm
    have h1 : (∑ j, bq j) * Lcm m ≤ (r - 1) * Lcm m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    have h2 : (r - 1) * Lcm m + m * Lcm m = (r + m - 1) * Lcm m := by
      rw [← Nat.add_mul]
      congr 1
      omega
    omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.prod_le_W
statement:
theorem prod_le_W {m s : ℕ} {e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ} (he : s ≤ wt m e) (I : Ideal R) :
    ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), c.Dpow j I ^ e j ≤ c.W m s I
proof:
:=
  le_iSup₂_of_le e he le_rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_le_iff
statement:
theorem W_le_iff {m s : ℕ} {I J : Ideal R} :
    c.W m s I ≤ J ↔ ∀ e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ, s ≤ wt m e → ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), c.Dpow j I ^ e j ≤ J
proof:
:=
  iSup₂_le_iff

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem W_zero (m : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.W m 0 I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine top_le_iff.mp ?_
  have := c.prod_le_W (e := (0 : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)) (Nat.zero_le _) I
  simpa [Ideal.top_pow] using this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pow_le_W
statement: theorem pow_le_W {m s k : ℕ} (h : s ≤ m * k) (I : Ideal R) : I ^ k ≤ c.W m s I
proof:
:= by
  have hw : s ≤ wt m (Pi.single (0 : Fin (m + 1)) k) := by
    rw [wt_single]
    simpa using h
  refine le_trans ?_ (c.prod_le_W hw I)
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (0 : Fin (m + 1)) (fun j _ hj => by simp [hj])
    (by simp)]
  simp

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pow_ceil_le_W
statement:
theorem pow_ceil_le_W {m s : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (I : Ideal R) :
    I ^ ((s + m - 1) / m) ≤ c.W m s I
proof:
:= by
  refine c.pow_le_W ?_ I
  have h1 := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (s + m - 1) hm
  rw [Nat.mul_succ] at h1
  generalize m * ((s + m - 1) / m) = t at h1 ⊢
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.MC_pow_le_W
statement: theorem MC_pow_le_W {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.MC I m ^ s ≤ c.W m s I
proof:
:= by
  have hw : s ≤ wt m (Pi.single (⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (m + 1)) s) := by
    rw [wt_single]
    simp only
    rw [Nat.sub_sub_self hm, one_mul]
  refine le_trans ?_ (c.prod_le_W hw I)
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (m + 1))
    (fun j _ hj => by simp [hj]) (by simp)]
  simp [MC]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pow_mem_W
statement:
theorem pow_mem_W {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {s : ℕ} {I : Ideal R} {h : R} (hh : h ∈ c.MC I m) :
    h ^ s ∈ c.W m s I
proof:
:=
  c.MC_pow_le_W hm s I (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hh s)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_one
statement: theorem W_one {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (I : Ideal R) : c.W m 1 I = c.MC I m
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.W_le_iff.mpr fun e he => ?_) (by simpa using c.MC_pow_le_W hm 1 I)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : Fin (m + 1), 1 ≤ (m - (j : ℕ)) * e j := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have : wt m e = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => by have := hcon j; omega
    omega
  have hjm : (j : ℕ) < m := by
    by_contra h'
    push Not at h'
    rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h', zero_mul] at hj
    omega
  have hej : e j ≠ 0 := by
    rintro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at hj
    omega
  calc ∏ j' : Fin (m + 1), c.Dpow j' I ^ e j'
      ≤ c.Dpow j I ^ e j := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]
        exact Ideal.mul_le_left
    _ ≤ c.Dpow j I := Ideal.pow_le_self hej
    _ ≤ c.Dpow (m - 1) I := c.Dpow_mono_left (by omega) I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_eq_top_of_ord_lt
statement:
theorem W_eq_top_of_ord_lt {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (h : ord I < m) (s : ℕ) :
    c.W m s I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := c.MC_pow_le_W hm s I
  rw [c.MC_eq_top_of_ord_lt hm h, Ideal.top_pow] at this
  exact top_le_iff.mp this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_anti
statement: theorem W_anti {m s t : ℕ} (h : s ≤ t) (I : Ideal R) : c.W m t I ≤ c.W m s I
proof:
:=
  c.W_le_iff.mpr fun _ he => c.prod_le_W (h.trans he) I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_succ_le
statement: theorem W_succ_le (m s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.W m (s + 1) I ≤ c.W m s I
proof:
:=
  c.W_anti (Nat.le_succ s) I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_mul_le
statement: theorem W_mul_le (m s t : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.W m s I * c.W m t I ≤ c.W m (s + t) I
proof:
:= by
  unfold W
  rw [Ideal.iSup_mul]
  refine iSup_le fun e => ?_
  rw [Ideal.iSup_mul]
  refine iSup_le fun he => ?_
  rw [Ideal.mul_iSup]
  refine iSup_le fun e' => ?_
  rw [Ideal.mul_iSup]
  refine iSup_le fun he' => ?_
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine le_iSup₂_of_le (e + e') (by rw [wt_add]; omega) (le_of_eq ?_)
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [Pi.add_apply, pow_add]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_pow_le_W
statement:
theorem Dpow_pow_le_W (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (k : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dpow j I ^ k ≤ c.W m ((m - (j : ℕ)) * k) I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (c.prod_le_W (e := Pi.single j k) (by rw [wt_single]) I)
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single j (fun j' _ hj' => by simp [hj']) (by simp)]
  simp

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_le_W_of_le
statement: theorem Dpow_le_W_of_le {m j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow j I ≤ c.W m (m - j) I
proof:
:= by
  have := c.Dpow_pow_le_W m ⟨j, by omega⟩ 1 I
  simpa using this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_Dpow_le_W
statement:
theorem D_Dpow_le_W (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.D (c.Dpow j I) ≤ c.W m (m - (j : ℕ) - 1) I
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Dpow_succ]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (j : ℕ) m with hj | hj
  · exact c.Dpow_le_W_of_le hj I
  · have hjm : (j : ℕ) = m := le_antisymm (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp j.isLt) hj
    rw [hjm, Nat.sub_self, Nat.zero_sub, W_zero]
    exact le_top

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_Dpow_pow_le_W
statement:
theorem D_Dpow_pow_le_W (m : ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (k : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.D (c.Dpow j I ^ k) ≤ c.W m ((m - (j : ℕ)) * k - 1) I
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · simp [D_top]
  · obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    refine (c.D_pow_le _ hk).trans ?_
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    refine ((Ideal.mul_mono (c.D_Dpow_le_W m j I) (c.Dpow_pow_le_W m j k' I)).trans
      (c.W_mul_le _ _ _ I)).trans (c.W_anti ?_ I)
    generalize m - (j : ℕ) = a
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
    generalize a * k' = t
    omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.prod_le_W_sum
statement:
theorem prod_le_W_sum (m : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin (m + 1))) (e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    ∏ l ∈ s, c.Dpow l I ^ e l ≤ c.W m (∑ l ∈ s, (m - (l : ℕ)) * e l) I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (Ideal.mul_mono (c.Dpow_pow_le_W m a (e a) I) ih).trans (c.W_mul_le _ _ _ I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_prod_le_W
statement:
theorem D_prod_le_W (m : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin (m + 1))) (e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.D (∏ l ∈ s, c.Dpow l I ^ e l) ≤ c.W m ((∑ l ∈ s, (m - (l : ℕ)) * e l) - 1) I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [D_top]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    refine (c.D_mul_le _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
    · refine ((Ideal.mul_mono (c.D_Dpow_pow_le_W m a (e a) I) (c.prod_le_W_sum m s e I)).trans
        (c.W_mul_le _ _ _ I)).trans (c.W_anti ?_ I)
      generalize (m - (a : ℕ)) * e a = A
      generalize (∑ l ∈ s, (m - (l : ℕ)) * e l) = S
      omega
    · refine ((Ideal.mul_mono (c.Dpow_pow_le_W m a (e a) I) ih).trans
        (c.W_mul_le _ _ _ I)).trans (c.W_anti ?_ I)
      generalize (m - (a : ℕ)) * e a = A
      generalize (∑ l ∈ s, (m - (l : ℕ)) * e l) = S
      omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_W_succ_le
statement: theorem D_W_succ_le (m s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.D (c.W m (s + 1) I) ≤ c.W m s I
proof:
:= by
  unfold W
  rw [D_iSup]
  refine iSup_le fun e => ?_
  rw [D_iSup]
  refine iSup_le fun he => ?_
  refine (c.D_prod_le_W m Finset.univ e I).trans (c.W_anti ?_ I)
  unfold wt at he
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_isUnit_pderiv
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_pderiv {h : R} (hh : h ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hh' : h ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    ∃ i, IsUnit (c.pderiv i h)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  refine hh' (c.mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_pderiv_mem hh fun i => ?_)
  by_contra hx
  exact hcon i (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hx)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_maximalContact_deriv
statement:
theorem exists_maximalContact_deriv {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ord I = m) :
    ∃ h ∈ c.MC I m, ordElem h = 1 ∧
      ∃ δ : Derivation ℚ R R, δ h = 1 ∧ ∀ (J : Ideal R) (f : R), f ∈ J → δ f ∈ c.D J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hmem, hh⟩ := c.exists_mem_MC_ordElem_eq_one hm hI
  obtain ⟨hh1, hh2⟩ := ordElem_eq_one_iff.mp hh
  obtain ⟨i, hu⟩ := c.exists_isUnit_pderiv hh1 hh2
  refine ⟨h, hmem, hh, (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R) • c.pderiv i, ?_, fun J f hf => ?_⟩
  · rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, IsUnit.val_inv_mul]
  · rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.pderiv_mem_D hf i)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pow_mem_D_W_succ
statement:
theorem pow_mem_D_W_succ {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} {h : R} (hh : h ∈ c.MC I m)
    {δ : Derivation ℚ R R} (h1 : δ h = 1) (hD : ∀ (J : Ideal R) (f : R), f ∈ J → δ f ∈ c.D J)
    (s : ℕ) : h ^ s ∈ c.D (c.W m (s + 1) I)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := hD _ _ (c.pow_mem_W hm hh (s := s + 1))
  rw [Derivation.leibniz_pow, h1, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel, nsmul_eq_mul] at hmem
  have hu : IsUnit ((s + 1 : ℕ) : R) := isUnit_natCast R (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)
  have := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R) hmem
  rwa [← mul_assoc, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_mul] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pow_mul_mem_D_W_succ
statement:
theorem pow_mul_mem_D_W_succ {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} {h : R} (hh : h ∈ c.MC I m)
    {δ : Derivation ℚ R R} (h1 : δ h = 1) (hD : ∀ (J : Ideal R) (f : R), f ∈ J → δ f ∈ c.D J)
    (s : ℕ) : ∀ t ≤ s, ∀ f ∈ c.W m t I, h ^ (s - t) * f ∈ c.D (c.W m (s + 1) I)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro _ f _
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (c.pow_mem_D_W_succ hm hh h1 hD s)
  | succ t ih =>
    intro ht f hf
    have hmul : h ^ (s - t) * f ∈ c.W m (s + 1) I := by
      have := Ideal.mul_mem_mul (c.pow_mem_W hm hh (s := s - t)) hf
      exact ((c.W_mul_le m (s - t) (t + 1) I).trans (c.W_anti (by omega) I)) this
    have hder := hD _ _ hmul
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz_pow, h1, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one, nsmul_eq_mul] at hder
    have h2 : h ^ (s - t) * δ f ∈ c.D (c.W m (s + 1) I) :=
      ih (by omega) (δ f) (c.D_W_succ_le m t I (hD _ _ hf))
    have h3 := Ideal.sub_mem _ hder h2
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at h3
    have hu : IsUnit ((s - t : ℕ) : R) := isUnit_natCast R (by omega)
    have h4 := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R) h3
    have heq : (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R) * (f * (((s - t : ℕ) : R) * h ^ (s - t - 1))) =
        h ^ (s - (t + 1)) * f := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_sub]
      calc _ = (↑hu.unit⁻¹ * ((s - t : ℕ) : R)) * (h ^ (s - t - 1) * f) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_mul]
    rwa [heq] at h4

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_W_succ
statement:
theorem D_W_succ {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I ≤ m) (s : ℕ) :
    c.D (c.W m (s + 1) I) = c.W m s I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.D_W_succ_le m s I) ?_
  rcases hI.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · rw [c.W_eq_top_of_ord_lt hm hlt, c.W_eq_top_of_ord_lt hm hlt, D_top]
  · obtain ⟨h, hh, -, δ, h1, hD⟩ := c.exists_maximalContact_deriv hm heq
    intro f hf
    have := c.pow_mul_mem_D_W_succ hm hh h1 hD s s le_rfl f hf
    rwa [Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_W
statement:
theorem Dpow_W {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I ≤ m) {i s : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ s) :
    c.Dpow i (c.W m s I) = c.W m (s - i) I
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ, ih (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, s - i = k + 1 := ⟨s - i - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hk, c.D_W_succ hm hI k, show s - (i + 1) = k by omega]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.prod_le_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem prod_le_maximalIdeal_pow {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ m)
    (e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) : ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), c.Dpow j I ^ e j ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ wt m e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold wt
  rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  induction (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (m + 1))) using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha]
    refine Ideal.mul_mono ?_ ih
    rw [pow_mul]
    exact Ideal.pow_right_mono ((c.Dpow_mono _ hI).trans
      (c.Dpow_maximalIdeal_pow (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp a.isLt))) _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_le_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem W_le_maximalIdeal_pow {m s : ℕ} {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ m) :
    c.W m s I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ s
proof:
:=
  c.W_le_iff.mpr fun e he => (c.prod_le_maximalIdeal_pow hI e).trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right he)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_ord_W
statement:
theorem le_ord_W {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal R} (hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I) (s : ℕ) :
    (s : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.W m s I)
proof:
:=
  le_ord_iff.mpr (c.W_le_maximalIdeal_pow (le_ord_iff.mp hm))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.ord_W_le
statement:
theorem ord_W_le {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I = m) (s : ℕ) :
    ord (c.W m s I) ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  have h1 : ((s + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.W m s I) := by
    push_cast
    exact (ENat.add_one_le_iff (ENat.natCast_ne_top s)).mpr hlt
  have h2 := (c.le_ord_iff_le_ord_Dpow (c.W m s I) (show s < s + 1 by omega)).mp h1
  rw [c.Dpow_W hm hI.le le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, W_zero, ord_top, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at h2
  exact absurd h2 (by simp)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.ord_W
statement:
theorem ord_W {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I = m) (s : ℕ) :
    ord (c.W m s I) = s
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (c.ord_W_le hm hI s) (c.le_ord_W hI.ge s)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_ord_W_iff
statement:
theorem le_ord_W_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} {s : ℕ} (hs1 : 1 ≤ s) :
    (s : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.W m s I) ↔ (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => c.le_ord_W h s⟩
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  rw [c.W_eq_top_of_ord_lt hm hlt, ord_top] at h
  have : s ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast h
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.MC_W
statement:
theorem MC_W {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I ≤ m) {s : ℕ} (hs1 : 1 ≤ s) :
    c.MC (c.W m s I) s = c.MC I m
proof:
:= by
  rw [MC, c.Dpow_W hm hI (Nat.sub_le s 1), Nat.sub_sub_self hs1, c.W_one hm]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isMCInvariant_W
statement:
theorem isMCInvariant_W {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I ≤ m) {s : ℕ}
    (hs1 : 1 ≤ s) : c.IsMCInvariant (c.W m s I) s
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsMCInvariant
  rw [c.MC_W hm hI hs1, ← c.W_one hm]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, s = k + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [c.D_W_succ hm hI k]
  exact (c.W_mul_le m 1 k I).trans (c.W_anti (by omega) I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_mul_W_eq
statement:
theorem W_mul_W_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (r t : ℕ) (ht : (m - 1) * Lcm m ≤ t) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.W m (r * Lcm m) I * c.W m t I = c.W m (r * Lcm m + t) I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.W_mul_le _ _ _ I) (c.W_le_iff.mpr fun e he => ?_)
  have hsplit : (r + m - 1) * Lcm m = r * Lcm m + (m - 1) * Lcm m := by
    rw [← Nat.add_mul]
    congr 1
    omega
  obtain ⟨e', he'e, hwt'⟩ := exists_le_wt_eq hm r (e := e) (by omega)
  have hsub : e = e' + (e - e') := by
    ext j
    have := Pi.le_def.mp he'e j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
    omega
  have hwt2 : t ≤ wt m (e - e') := by
    have : wt m e = wt m e' + wt m (e - e') := by rw [← wt_add, ← hsub]
    omega
  calc ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), c.Dpow j I ^ e j
      = (∏ j : Fin (m + 1), c.Dpow j I ^ e' j) * ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), c.Dpow j I ^ (e - e') j := by
        rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        rw [← pow_add]
        congr 1
        have := Pi.le_def.mp he'e j
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        omega
    _ ≤ c.W m (r * Lcm m) I * c.W m t I :=
        Ideal.mul_mono (c.prod_le_W hwt'.ge I) (c.prod_le_W hwt2 I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_pow_le
statement: theorem W_pow_le (m a k : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.W m a I ^ k ≤ c.W m (k * a) I
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    exact (Ideal.mul_mono ih le_rfl).trans (c.W_mul_le _ _ _ I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_pow
statement:
theorem W_pow {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {r : ℕ} (hr : m - 1 ≤ r) (j : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.W m (r * Lcm m) I ^ j = c.W m (j * (r * Lcm m)) I
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
    · simp
    · rw [pow_succ, ih, mul_comm (c.W m (j * (r * Lcm m)) I) (c.W m (r * Lcm m) I),
        c.W_mul_W_eq hm r _ ?_ I]
      · congr 1
        ring
      · calc (m - 1) * Lcm m ≤ r * Lcm m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hr
          _ ≤ j * (r * Lcm m) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hj

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_W_pow_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.Dpow_W hm hI hi.le, c.W_pow hm hr]
  exact (c.W_pow_le _ _ _ I).trans
    (le_of_eq (by rw [Nat.mul_comm (r * Lcm m) (r * Lcm m - i)]))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isDBalanced_W
statement:
theorem isDBalanced_W {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I ≤ m) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : m - 1 ≤ r) : c.IsDBalanced (c.W m (r * Lcm m) I) (r * Lcm m)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hi => c.Dpow_W_pow_le hm hI hr hi

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_D
statement: theorem le_D (I : Ideal R) : I ≤ c.D I
proof: := le_sup_left

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_mem_D
statement: theorem pderiv_mem_D {I : Ideal R} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ I) (i : Fin n) : c.pderiv i f ∈ c.D I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem i (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_le_iff
statement: theorem D_le_iff {I J : Ideal R} : c.D I ≤ J ↔ I ≤ J ∧ ∀ i, ∀ g ∈ I, c.pderiv i g ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(c.le_D I).trans h, fun i g hg => h (c.pderiv_mem_D hg i)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hIJ, hd⟩
    refine sup_le hIJ (iSup_le fun i => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact hd i g hg

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_mono
statement: theorem D_mono {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : c.D I ≤ c.D J
proof:
:=
  c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨h.trans (c.le_D J), fun i _ hf => c.pderiv_mem_D (h hf) i⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_top
statement: theorem D_top : c.D ⊤ = ⊤
proof: := top_le_iff.mp (c.le_D ⊤)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Dpow_zero (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow 0 I = I
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem Dpow_succ (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow (r + 1) I = c.D (c.Dpow r I)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_succ'
statement: theorem Dpow_succ' (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow (r + 1) I = c.Dpow r (c.D I)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply _ _ _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_one
statement: theorem Dpow_one (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow 1 I = c.D I
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_mono
statement: theorem Dpow_mono (r : ℕ) {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : c.Dpow r I ≤ c.Dpow r J
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ r ih => rw [Dpow_succ, Dpow_succ]; exact c.D_mono ih

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_Dpow
statement: theorem le_Dpow (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : I ≤ c.Dpow r I
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [Dpow_succ]; exact ih.trans (c.le_D _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_mono_left
statement: theorem Dpow_mono_left {r r' : ℕ} (h : r ≤ r') (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow r I ≤ c.Dpow r' I
proof:
:= by
  induction r', h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact le_rfl
  | succ r' _ ih => rw [Dpow_succ]; exact ih.trans (c.le_D _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_span
statement:
theorem D_span (S : Set R) :
    c.D (Ideal.span S) = Ideal.span (S ∪ ⋃ i, c.pderiv i '' S)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨Ideal.span_mono Set.subset_union_left, ?_⟩) ?_
  · intro i f hf
    induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem f hf =>
      exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_union_right _ (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, f, hf, rfl⟩))
    | zero => simp
    | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg
    | smul a f hf' hf =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hf) (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_)
      exact Ideal.span_mono Set.subset_union_left hf'
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro f (hf | hf)
    · exact c.le_D _ (Ideal.subset_span hf)
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hf
      obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hi
      exact c.pderiv_mem_D (Ideal.subset_span hs) i

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderiv_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem iterPderiv_nil (f : R) : c.iterPderiv [] f = f
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderiv_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem iterPderiv_cons (i : Fin n) (l : List (Fin n)) (f : R) :
    c.iterPderiv (i :: l) f = c.pderiv i (c.iterPderiv l f)
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_iterPderivSet
statement:
theorem mem_iterPderivSet {S : Set R} {r : ℕ} {f : R} :
    f ∈ c.iterPderivSet S r ↔ ∃ l : List (Fin n), l.length ≤ r ∧ ∃ s ∈ S, c.iterPderiv l s = f
proof:
:= by
  simp [iterPderivSet]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderivSet_zero
statement: theorem iterPderivSet_zero (S : Set R) : c.iterPderivSet S 0 = S
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_iterPderivSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, s, hs, rfl⟩
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (Nat.le_zero.mp hl), iterPderiv_nil]
    exact hs
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨[], le_rfl, f, hf, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderivSet_succ
statement:
theorem iterPderivSet_succ (S : Set R) (r : ℕ) :
    c.iterPderivSet S (r + 1) = c.iterPderivSet S r ∪ ⋃ i, c.pderiv i '' c.iterPderivSet S r
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_iterPderivSet, Set.mem_union, mem_iterPderivSet, Set.mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, s, hs, rfl⟩
    cases l with
    | nil => exact Or.inl ⟨[], by simp, s, hs, rfl⟩
    | cons i l =>
      refine Or.inr ⟨i, c.iterPderiv l s, ?_, rfl⟩
      exact c.mem_iterPderivSet.mpr ⟨l, by simpa using hl, s, hs, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨l, hl, s, hs, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, g, hg, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨l, hl.trans (Nat.le_succ r), s, hs, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨l, hl, s, hs, rfl⟩ := c.mem_iterPderivSet.mp hg
      exact ⟨i :: l, by simpa using hl, s, hs, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_span
statement:
theorem Dpow_span (S : Set R) (r : ℕ) :
    c.Dpow r (Ideal.span S) = Ideal.span (c.iterPderivSet S r)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rw [Dpow_zero, iterPderivSet_zero]
  | succ r ih => rw [Dpow_succ, ih, D_span, iterPderivSet_succ]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_sup
statement: theorem D_sup (I J : Ideal R) : c.D (I ⊔ J) = c.D I ⊔ c.D J
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨sup_le_sup (c.le_D I) (c.le_D J), ?_⟩)
    (sup_le (c.D_mono le_sup_left) (c.D_mono le_sup_right))
  intro i f hf
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hf
  rw [map_add]
  exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.pderiv_mem_D ha i))
    (Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.pderiv_mem_D hb i))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_iSup
statement: theorem D_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal R) : c.D (⨆ k, I k) = ⨆ k, c.D (I k)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨iSup_le fun k =>
      (c.le_D (I k)).trans (le_iSup (fun k => c.D (I k)) k), ?_⟩)
    (iSup_le fun k => c.D_mono (le_iSup I k))
  intro i f hf
  induction hf using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem k f hf => exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem k (c.pderiv_mem_D hf i)
  | zero => simp
  | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_changeCoords
statement:
theorem D_changeCoords (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (hcomm : ∀ i j f, c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)) (I : Ideal R) :
    (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).D I = c.D I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ((c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).D_le_iff.mpr ⟨c.le_D I, ?_⟩)
    (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨(c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).le_D I, ?_⟩)
  · intro j f hf
    rw [changeCoords_pderiv, transportPderiv_apply]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.pderiv_mem_D hf l)
  · intro i f hf
    have h := congrArg (fun δ : Derivation ℚ R R => δ f) (c.pderiv_eq_sum_transportPderiv x' hx' i)
    simp only [derivation_sum_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
    rw [h]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ =>
      Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (by
        have := (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).pderiv_mem_D hf j
        rwa [changeCoords_pderiv] at this)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_mul_le
statement: theorem D_mul_le (I J : Ideal R) : c.D (I * J) ≤ c.D I * J ⊔ I * c.D J
proof:
:= by
  refine c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨le_sup_left.trans' (Ideal.mul_mono (c.le_D I) le_rfl), ?_⟩
  intro i f hf
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf (fun a ha b hb => ?_) (fun f g hf hg => ?_)
  · rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha (c.pderiv_mem_D hb i)))
      (Ideal.mem_sup_left (mul_comm b _ ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_mul (c.pderiv_mem_D ha i) hb))
  · rw [map_add]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_maximalIdeal_pow_succ
statement:
theorem D_maximalIdeal_pow_succ (a : ℕ) :
    c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1)) ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ a
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; exact le_top
  | succ a ih =>
    calc c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 2)) = c.D (maximalIdeal R * maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1)) := by
          rw [pow_succ']
      _ ≤ c.D (maximalIdeal R) * maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1) ⊔
          maximalIdeal R * c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1)) := c.D_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1) ⊔ maximalIdeal R * maximalIdeal R ^ a :=
          sup_le_sup (Ideal.mul_le_right) (Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl ih)
      _ = maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1) := by rw [← pow_succ', sup_idem]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem D_maximalIdeal_pow {a : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
    c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ a) ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ (a - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, a = b + 1 := ⟨a - 1, by omega⟩
  simpa using c.D_maximalIdeal_pow_succ b

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_maximalIdeal_pow_zero
statement: theorem D_maximalIdeal_pow_zero : c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, D_top]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem Dpow_maximalIdeal_pow {r a : ℕ} (h : r ≤ a) :
    c.Dpow r (maximalIdeal R ^ a) ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ (a - r)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ]
    calc c.D (c.Dpow r (maximalIdeal R ^ a)) ≤ c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ (a - r)) :=
          c.D_mono (ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le h))
      _ ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ (a - r - 1) := c.D_maximalIdeal_pow (by omega)
      _ = maximalIdeal R ^ (a - (r + 1)) := by rw [Nat.sub_sub]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le_of_forall
statement:
theorem Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le_of_forall
    (h74 : ∀ (I : Ideal R) {r m : ℕ}, r < m →
      ((m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I ↔ ((m - r : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.Dpow r I)))
    {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hord : ord I ≤ m) : c.Dpow m I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.Dpow m I) :=
    Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 => hne (ord_eq_zero_iff.mp h0)
  have h2 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I :=
    (h74 I (r := m) (m := m + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self m)).mpr (by simpa using h1)
  have h3 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (m : ℕ∞) := h2.trans hord
  exact absurd (by exact_mod_cast h3 : m + 1 ≤ m) (by omega)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.markedD_I
statement:
@[simp] theorem markedD_I (J : MarkedIdeal R) (r : ℕ) (h : r ≤ J.m) :
    (c.markedD J r h).I = c.Dpow r J.I
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.markedD_m
statement:
@[simp] theorem markedD_m (J : MarkedIdeal R) (r : ℕ) (h : r ≤ J.m) :
    (c.markedD J r h).m = J.m - r
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dimg_eq_D
statement: theorem Dimg_eq_D (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (I : Ideal R) : Dimg I = c.D I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun δ => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (sup_le ?_ (iSup_le fun i => ?_))
  · rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    rw [hs δ f]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.pderiv_mem_D hf i)
  · intro f hf
    obtain ⟨i⟩ : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn⟩⟩
    have key : f = c.pderiv i (c.x i * f) - c.x i * c.pderiv i f := by
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]
      ring
    rw [key]
    refine Ideal.sub_mem _ ?_ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_)
    · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (c.pderiv i)
        (Ideal.subset_span ⟨c.x i * f, Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hf, rfl⟩)
    · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (c.pderiv i) (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)
  · exact le_iSup (fun δ : Derivation ℚ R R => Ideal.span (δ '' I)) (c.pderiv i)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_Dpow
statement: theorem Dpow_Dpow (r s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow r (c.Dpow s I) = c.Dpow (r + s) I
proof:
:=
  (Function.iterate_add_apply _ _ _ _).symm

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_mul_le
statement:
theorem Dpow_mul_le (r : ℕ) (I J : Ideal R) :
    c.Dpow r (I * J) ≤ ⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), c.Dpow i I * c.Dpow (r - i) J
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact le_iSup₂_of_le 0 (Finset.mem_range.mpr Nat.zero_lt_one) le_rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ]
    calc c.D (c.Dpow r (I * J))
        ≤ c.D (⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), c.Dpow i I * c.Dpow (r - i) J) := c.D_mono ih
      _ = ⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), c.D (c.Dpow i I * c.Dpow (r - i) J) := by
          rw [D_iSup]
          exact iSup_congr fun i => c.D_iSup _
      _ ≤ ⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1 + 1), c.Dpow i I * c.Dpow (r + 1 - i) J := by
          refine iSup₂_le fun i hi => ?_
          have hi' : i ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          refine (c.D_mul_le _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
          · rw [← Dpow_succ, show r - i = r + 1 - (i + 1) by omega]
            exact le_iSup₂_of_le (i + 1) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) le_rfl
          · rw [← Dpow_succ, show r - i + 1 = r + 1 - i by omega]
            exact le_iSup₂_of_le i (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) le_rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_pow_le
statement: theorem D_pow_le (J : Ideal R) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : c.D (J ^ k) ≤ c.D J * J ^ (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ k hk ih =>
    rw [pow_succ']
    refine (c.D_mul_le _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
    · simp
    · calc J * c.D (J ^ k) ≤ J * (c.D J * J ^ (k - 1)) := Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl ih
        _ = c.D J * J ^ (k + 1 - 1) := by
            rw [mul_left_comm, ← pow_succ', Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_finset_prod_le
statement:
theorem D_finset_prod_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (J : ι → Ideal R) :
    c.D (∏ k ∈ s, J k) ≤ ⨆ k ∈ s, c.D (J k) * ∏ l ∈ s.erase k, J l
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton a =>
    refine le_iSup₂_of_le a (Finset.mem_singleton_self a) ?_
    simp
  | cons a s ha hs ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_cons]
    refine (c.D_mul_le _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
    · refine le_iSup₂_of_le a (Finset.mem_cons_self a s) ?_
      rw [Finset.erase_cons]
    · calc J a * c.D (∏ k ∈ s, J k)
          ≤ J a * ⨆ k ∈ s, c.D (J k) * ∏ l ∈ s.erase k, J l := Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl ih
        _ = ⨆ k ∈ s, J a * (c.D (J k) * ∏ l ∈ s.erase k, J l) := by
            rw [Ideal.mul_iSup]
            exact iSup_congr fun k => Ideal.mul_iSup _ _
        _ ≤ ⨆ k ∈ Finset.cons a s ha, c.D (J k) * ∏ l ∈ (Finset.cons a s ha).erase k, J l := by
            refine iSup₂_le fun k hk => ?_
            have hak : a ≠ k := fun h => ha (h ▸ hk)
            refine le_iSup₂_of_le k (Finset.mem_cons_of_mem hk) ?_
            rw [Finset.erase_cons_of_ne ha hak, Finset.prod_cons, mul_left_comm]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_finset_prod_pow_le
statement:
theorem D_finset_prod_pow_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (J : ι → Ideal R) (e : ι → ℕ) (he : ∀ k ∈ s, 1 ≤ e k) :
    c.D (∏ k ∈ s, J k ^ e k) ≤
      ⨆ k ∈ s, c.D (J k) * J k ^ (e k - 1) * ∏ l ∈ s.erase k, J l ^ e l
proof:
:= by
  refine (c.D_finset_prod_le hs fun k => J k ^ e k).trans (iSup₂_le fun k hk => ?_)
  exact le_iSup₂_of_le k hk (Ideal.mul_mono (c.D_pow_le (J k) (he k hk)) le_rfl)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_ord_Dpow
statement:
theorem le_ord_Dpow {I : Ideal R} {m r : ℕ} (hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I) (hr : r ≤ m) :
    ((m - r : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.Dpow r I)
proof:
:=
  le_ord_iff.mpr ((c.Dpow_mono r (le_ord_iff.mp hm)).trans (c.Dpow_maximalIdeal_pow hr))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.euler_apply
statement: theorem euler_apply (f : R) : c.euler f = ∑ i, c.x i * c.pderiv i f
proof:
:= by
  rw [euler, derivation_sum_apply]
  simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.euler_x
statement: theorem euler_x (i : Fin n) : c.euler (c.x i) = c.x i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [euler_apply]
  simp [c.pderiv_x, eq_comm]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.euler_mem_maximalIdeal
statement: theorem euler_mem_maximalIdeal (f : R) : c.euler f ∈ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [euler_apply]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (c.x_mem_maximalIdeal i)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.euler_sub_self_mem_sq
statement:
theorem euler_sub_self_mem_sq {h : R} (hh : h ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
    c.euler h - h ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.span_x] at hh
  induction hh using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [euler_x, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    rw [map_add]
    convert Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy using 1
    ring
  | smul r x hx' hx =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have : r * c.euler x + x * c.euler r - r * x = r * (c.euler x - x) + x * c.euler r := by ring
    rw [this]
    refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx) ?_
    rw [pow_two]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (by rw [c.span_x]; exact hx') (c.euler_mem_maximalIdeal r)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.euler_sub_nsmul_mem
statement:
theorem euler_sub_nsmul_mem {a : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) {f : R} (hf : f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ a) :
    c.euler f - (a : R) * f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction a, ha using Nat.le_induction generalizing f with
  | base =>
    rw [pow_one] at hf
    simpa using c.euler_sub_self_mem_sq hf
  | succ a _ ih =>
    rw [pow_succ] at hf
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hf (fun g hg h hh => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
    · rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      have : g * c.euler h + h * c.euler g - ((a + 1 : ℕ) : R) * (g * h) =
          g * (c.euler h - h) + h * (c.euler g - (a : R) * g) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [this]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [show a + 1 + 1 = a + 2 by ring, pow_add]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hg (c.euler_sub_self_mem_sq hh)
      · rw [pow_succ']
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hh (ih hg)
    · rw [map_add]
      convert Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy using 1
      ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_pderiv_notMem_of_notMem_pow_succ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hf'
  have hE : c.euler f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1) := by
    rw [euler_apply, pow_succ']
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_mul (c.x_mem_maximalIdeal i) (h i)
  have haf : (a : R) * f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1) := by
    have := Ideal.sub_mem _ hE (c.euler_sub_nsmul_mem ha hf)
    rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this
  have hu : IsUnit (a : R) := isUnit_natCast R (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp ha)
  have := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R) haf
  rwa [← mul_assoc, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_mul] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_bot
statement: theorem D_bot : c.D ⊥ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨le_rfl, fun i f hf => ?_⟩) bot_le
  rw [Ideal.mem_bot] at hf ⊢
  rw [hf, map_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_eq_top_of_ord_eq_zero
statement: theorem D_eq_top_of_ord_eq_zero {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I = 0) : c.D I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_zero_iff.mp hI, D_top]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.ord_D_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem ord_D_of_ord_eq {a : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I = a) :
    ord (c.D I) = ((a - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_
    (le_ord_iff.mpr ((c.D_mono (le_ord_iff.mp hI.ge)).trans (c.D_maximalIdeal_pow ha)))
  have hnot : ¬ I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1) := fun hle => by
    have := le_ord_iff.mpr hle
    rw [hI] at this
    exact absurd (by exact_mod_cast this : a + 1 ≤ a) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨f, hfI, hf'⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnot
  have hfa : f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ a := le_ord_iff.mp hI.ge hfI
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := c.exists_pderiv_notMem_of_notMem_pow_succ ha hfa hf'
  have hlt : ord (c.D I) < a :=
    not_le.mp fun hle => hi (le_ord_iff.mp hle (c.pderiv_mem_D hfI i))
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (ne_top_of_lt hlt)
  rw [← hb] at hlt ⊢
  have hba : b < a := by exact_mod_cast hlt
  exact_mod_cast (show b ≤ a - 1 by omega)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.ord_Dpow_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem ord_Dpow_of_ord_eq {a : ℕ} {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I = a) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ a) :
    ord (c.Dpow r I) = ((a - r : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simpa using hI
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ, c.ord_D_of_ord_eq (by omega) (ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hr)), Nat.sub_sub]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_ord_iff_le_ord_Dpow
statement:
theorem le_ord_iff_le_ord_Dpow (I : Ideal R) {r m : ℕ} (h : r < m) :
    (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I ↔ ((m - r : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.Dpow r I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hm => c.le_ord_Dpow hm h.le, fun hD => ?_⟩
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (ne_top_of_lt hlt)
  have ham : a < m := by rw [← ha] at hlt; exact_mod_cast hlt
  by_cases hra : r ≤ a
  · rw [c.ord_Dpow_of_ord_eq ha.symm hra] at hD
    have : m - r ≤ a - r := by exact_mod_cast hD
    omega
  · push Not at hra
    have h0 : ord (c.Dpow a I) = 0 := by simpa using c.ord_Dpow_of_ord_eq ha.symm le_rfl
    have htop : c.Dpow r I = ⊤ :=
      top_le_iff.mp ((ord_eq_zero_iff.mp h0) ▸ c.Dpow_mono_left hra.le I)
    rw [htop, ord_top] at hD
    have : m - r ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD
    omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le
statement: theorem Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hord : ord I ≤ m) : c.Dpow m I = ⊤
proof:
:=
  c.Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le_of_forall (fun I {_ _} h => c.le_ord_iff_le_ord_Dpow I h) hord

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_span_singleton_x_pow
statement:
theorem D_span_singleton_x_pow (i : Fin n) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    c.D (Ideal.span {c.x i ^ m}) = Ideal.span {c.x i ^ (m - 1)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩) ?_
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton]
    exact pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.sub_le m 1)
  · intro j g hg
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hg
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz_pow, smul_eq_mul]
    refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (nsmul_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)) m)) (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_)
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.sub_le m 1))
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    have hu : IsUnit (m : R) := isUnit_natCast R (by omega)
    have h1 : c.pderiv i (c.x i ^ m) = (m : R) * c.x i ^ (m - 1) := by
      rw [Derivation.leibniz_pow, c.pderiv_x, ite_eq_left rfl, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h2 := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R)
      (c.pderiv_mem_D (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (c.x i ^ m)) i)
    rwa [h1, ← mul_assoc, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_mul] at h2

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_span_singleton_x_pow
statement:
theorem Dpow_span_singleton_x_pow (i : Fin n) {r m : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ m) :
    c.Dpow r (Ideal.span {c.x i ^ m}) = Ideal.span {c.x i ^ (m - r)}
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ, ih (by omega), c.D_span_singleton_x_pow i (by omega), Nat.sub_sub]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_span_singleton_x_mul_x
statement:
theorem D_span_singleton_x_mul_x {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    c.D (Ideal.span {c.x i * c.x j}) = Ideal.span {c.x i, c.x j}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩) ?_
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_pair.mpr ⟨c.x j, 0, by ring⟩
  · intro k g hg
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hg
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_) (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_)
    · rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)))
        (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)))
    · exact Ideal.mem_span_pair.mpr ⟨c.x j, 0, by ring⟩
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro y (rfl | rfl)
    · have h1 : c.pderiv j (c.x i * c.x j) = c.x i := by
        simp [Derivation.leibniz, c.pderiv_x, hij.symm]
      have h2 := c.pderiv_mem_D (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (c.x i * c.x j)) j
      rwa [h1] at h2
    · have h1 : c.pderiv i (c.x i * c.x j) = c.x j := by
        simp [Derivation.leibniz, c.pderiv_x, hij]
      have h2 := c.pderiv_mem_D (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (c.x i * c.x j)) i
      rwa [h1] at h2

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_map
statement:
theorem D_map {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsRegularLocalRing R'] [Algebra ℚ R'] {n' : ℕ}
    (c' : RegularCoords R' n') (φ : R →+* R') (e : Fin n → Fin n')
    (hφ : ∀ i f, c'.pderiv (e i) (φ f) = φ (c.pderiv i f))
    (hφ' : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range e → ∀ f, c'.pderiv j (φ f) = 0) (I : Ideal R) :
    c'.D (I.map φ) = (c.D I).map φ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c'.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨Ideal.map_mono (c.le_D I), ?_⟩) ?_
  · intro j g hg
    change g ∈ Ideal.span (φ '' (I : Set R)) at hg
    induction hg using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem g hg =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hg
      by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range e
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hj
        rw [hφ]
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ (c.pderiv_mem_D hf i)
      · rw [hφ' j hj]
        exact zero_mem _
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
    | smul r g hg' hg =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hg)
        (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.map_mono (c.le_D I) hg'))
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    refine c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun f hf => ?_, fun i f hf => ?_⟩
    · exact Ideal.mem_comap.mpr (c'.le_D _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ hf))
    · rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← hφ]
      exact c'.pderiv_mem_D (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ hf) (e i)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_map_le
statement:
theorem D_map_le {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsRegularLocalRing R'] [Algebra ℚ R'] {n' : ℕ}
    (c' : RegularCoords R' n') (φ : R →+* R') (e : Fin n' → Fin n)
    (hφ : ∀ j f, c'.pderiv j (φ f) = φ (c.pderiv (e j) f)) (I : Ideal R) :
    c'.D (I.map φ) ≤ (c.D I).map φ
proof:
:= by
  refine c'.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨Ideal.map_mono (c.le_D I), fun j g hg => ?_⟩
  change g ∈ Ideal.span (φ '' (I : Set R)) at hg
  induction hg using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem g hg =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hg
    rw [hφ]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ (c.pderiv_mem_D hf (e j))
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul r g hg' hg =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hg)
      (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.map_mono (c.le_D I) hg'))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_map_le
statement:
theorem Dpow_map_le {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsRegularLocalRing R'] [Algebra ℚ R'] {n' : ℕ}
    (c' : RegularCoords R' n') (φ : R →+* R') (e : Fin n' → Fin n)
    (hφ : ∀ j f, c'.pderiv j (φ f) = φ (c.pderiv (e j) f)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c'.Dpow r (I.map φ) ≤ (c.Dpow r I).map φ
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ, Dpow_succ]
    exact (c'.D_mono ih).trans (c.D_map_le c' φ e hφ _)

name: IsLocalRing.ordFaithful_algebraMap_atPrime_polynomial
statement:
theorem ordFaithful_algebraMap_atPrime_polynomial (Q : Ideal R[X]) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hQ : (maximalIdeal R).map (C : R →+* R[X]) ≤ Q) :
    OrdFaithful (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime Q))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set π : R[X] →+* (ResidueField R)[X] := mapRingHom (residue R) with hπdef
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := Polynomial.map_surjective _ residue_surjective
  have hker : RingHom.ker π = (maximalIdeal R).map (C : R →+* R[X]) := by
    rw [hπdef, Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, ker_residue]
  have hkerQ : RingHom.ker π ≤ Q := by rw [hker]; exact hQ
  have : (Q.map π).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hπ hkerQ
  have hmapker : (RingHom.ker π).map π = ⊥ := by
    rw [RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact le_bot_iff.mp Ideal.map_comap_le
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : (ResidueField R)[X], Q.map π = Ideal.span {g} :=
    ⟨_, (Ideal.span_singleton_generator _).symm⟩
  by_cases hg0 : g = 0
  · 
    have hQeq : Q = (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R[X]) := by
      refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) (by rwa [Polynomial.algebraMap_eq])
      have hx' : π x ∈ Q.map π := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem π hx
      rw [hg, hg0, Ideal.span_singleton_zero, Ideal.mem_bot] at hx'
      have hx'' := RingHom.mem_ker.mpr hx'
      rwa [hker, ← Polynomial.algebraMap_eq] at hx''
    exact ordFaithful_algebraMap_atPrime_of_flat Q hQeq
  · 
    have hmon : (normalize g).Monic := Polynomial.monic_normalize hg0
    obtain ⟨G, hGπ, -, hGmon⟩ := Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic
      ((Polynomial.mem_lifts _).mpr (Polynomial.map_surjective _ residue_surjective (normalize g)))
      hmon
    have hQg : Q.map π = Ideal.span {normalize g} := by
      rw [hg, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton]
      exact (normalize_associated g).symm
    have hQeq : Q = Ideal.span {G} ⊔ (maximalIdeal R).map (C : R →+* R[X]) := by
      have h1 : (Ideal.span {G} ⊔ (maximalIdeal R).map (C : R →+* R[X])).map π = Q.map π := by
        rw [Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, ← hker, hmapker, sup_bot_eq, hQg,
          hπdef, coe_mapRingHom, hGπ]
      have h2 := congrArg (Ideal.comap π) h1
      rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hπ, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hπ,
        ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, sup_eq_left.mpr hkerQ, sup_assoc, hker, sup_idem] at h2
      exact h2.symm
    
    have : Module.Free R (AdjoinRoot G) :=
      Module.Free.of_basis (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hGmon).basis
    have hkerG : RingHom.ker (AdjoinRoot.mk G) ≤ Q := by
      intro x hx
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero, ← Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hx
      rw [hQeq]
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_left hx
    have : (Q.map (AdjoinRoot.mk G)).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective AdjoinRoot.mk_surjective hkerG
    have hQt : Q.map (AdjoinRoot.mk G) = (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot G)) := by
      rw [hQeq, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, AdjoinRoot.mk_self,
        Ideal.span_singleton_zero, bot_sup_eq, Ideal.map_map, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
      rfl
    have hQQt : Q = (Q.map (AdjoinRoot.mk G)).comap (AdjoinRoot.mk G) := by
      rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ AdjoinRoot.mk_surjective, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
        sup_eq_left.mpr hkerG]
    have := Localization.isLocalHom_localRingHom Q _ (AdjoinRoot.mk G) hQQt
    refine OrdFaithful.of_comp (ψ := Localization.localRingHom Q _ (AdjoinRoot.mk G) hQQt)
      ((ordFaithful_algebraMap_atPrime_of_flat _ hQt).congr ?_)
    refine RingHom.ext fun r => ?_
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R R[X] (Localization.AtPrime Q),
      Localization.localRingHom_to_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (AdjoinRoot G)
        (Localization.AtPrime (Q.map (AdjoinRoot.mk G))), Polynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      AdjoinRoot.mk_C, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]

name: IsLocalRing.ordFaithful_localRingHom_C
statement:
theorem ordFaithful_localRingHom_C (Q : Ideal R[X]) [Q.IsPrime] {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime]
    (hpQ : p = Q.comap (C : R →+* R[X])) :
    OrdFaithful (Localization.localRingHom p Q (C : R →+* R[X]) hpQ)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocalization (p.primeCompl.map (C : R →+* R[X])) (Localization.AtPrime p)[X] :=
    Polynomial.isLocalization p.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime p)
  have hdisj : Disjoint (p.primeCompl.map (C : R →+* R[X]) : Set R[X]) (Q : Set R[X]) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ hrQ
    refine hr ?_
    rw [hpQ]
    exact Ideal.mem_comap.mpr hrQ
  have hQ' : (Q.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X])).IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint _ (Localization.AtPrime p)[X] Q inferInstance hdisj
  have hQ'Q : (Q.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X])).comap
      (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X]) = Q :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint _ (Localization.AtPrime p)[X] inferInstance hdisj
  have : IsLocalization.AtPrime
      (Localization.AtPrime (Q.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X]))) Q := by
    have := IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      (p.primeCompl.map (C : R →+* R[X])) (S := (Localization.AtPrime p)[X])
      (Localization.AtPrime (Q.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X])))
      (Q.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X]))
    have hM : (Ideal.comap (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X])
        (Q.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X]))).primeCompl = Q.primeCompl :=
      Submonoid.ext fun x => by rw [Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff, Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff, hQ'Q]
    unfold IsLocalization.AtPrime at this ⊢
    rw [hM] at this
    exact this
  let e : Localization.AtPrime Q ≃ₐ[R[X]]
      Localization.AtPrime (Q.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X])) :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv Q.primeCompl _ _
  have hmQ' : (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)).map (C : Localization.AtPrime p →+* _) ≤
      Q.map (algebraMap R[X] (Localization.AtPrime p)[X]) := by
    rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, Ideal.map_map]
    have hCC : (C : Localization.AtPrime p →+* _).comp (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p)) =
