  rw [h1, h2, Ideal.quotientMap_mk]

name: IsLocalRing.completionMap_injective_of_flat
statement:
theorem completionMap_injective_of_flat (hflat : φ.Flat)
    (hm : (maximalIdeal R).map φ = maximalIdeal S) :
    Function.Injective (completionMap φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  refine ext_evalₐ fun n => ?_
  rw [_root_.map_zero]
  apply quotientMap_injective_of_flat φ hflat hm n
  rw [_root_.map_zero, ← evalₐ_completionMap, hx, _root_.map_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.quotientMap_completionInvLevel
statement:
theorem quotientMap_completionInvLevel (n : ℕ) (y : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S) :
    Ideal.quotientMap (maximalIdeal S ^ n) φ (maximalIdeal_pow_le_comap φ n)
        (completionInvLevel φ hflat hm hres n y) = evalₐ (maximalIdeal S) n y
proof:
:= by
  change (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ ⟨quotientMap_injective_of_flat φ hflat hm n,
      quotientMap_surjective_of_surjective φ hm hres n⟩)
    ((RingEquiv.ofBijective _ ⟨quotientMap_injective_of_flat φ hflat hm n,
      quotientMap_surjective_of_surjective φ hm hres n⟩).symm (evalₐ (maximalIdeal S) n y)) = _
  exact RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: IsLocalRing.completionInvLevel_compat
statement:
theorem completionInvLevel_compat {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (maximalIdeal R) hle).comp (completionInvLevel φ hflat hm hres n) =
      completionInvLevel φ hflat hm hres m
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  apply quotientMap_injective_of_flat φ hflat hm m
  have h := congrArg (fun g => g (completionInvLevel φ hflat hm hres n y))
    (factorPow_comp_quotientMap φ hle)
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at h
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, ← h, quotientMap_completionInvLevel, quotientMap_completionInvLevel,
    factorPow_evalₐ]

name: IsLocalRing.completionMap_completionInv
statement:
theorem completionMap_completionInv (y : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S) :
    completionMap φ (completionInv φ hflat hm hres y) = y
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_evalₐ fun n => ?_
  rw [evalₐ_completionMap, completionInv, evalₐ_liftRingHom, quotientMap_completionInvLevel]

name: IsLocalRing.bijective_completionMap_of_flat_of_map_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem bijective_completionMap_of_flat_of_map_maximalIdeal (hflat : φ.Flat)
    (hm : (maximalIdeal R).map φ = maximalIdeal S)
    (hres : Function.Bijective (ResidueField.map φ)) :
    Function.Bijective (completionMap φ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨completionMap_injective_of_flat φ hflat hm, fun y =>
    ⟨completionInv φ hflat hm hres.2 y, completionMap_completionInv φ hflat hm hres.2 y⟩⟩

name: IsLocalRing.map_completionMap_map
statement:
theorem map_completionMap_map (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))).map (completionMap φ) =
      (I.map φ).map (algebraMap S (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map]
  exact congrArg (fun g : R →+* AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S => I.map g)
    (RingHom.ext fun a => completionMap_algebraMap φ a)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_topPderivSet
statement:
theorem mem_topPderivSet {S : Set R} {r : ℕ} {f : R} :
    f ∈ c.topPderivSet S r ↔ ∃ l : List (Fin n), l.length = r ∧ ∃ s ∈ S, c.iterPderiv l s = f
proof:
:= by
  simp [topPderivSet]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.topPderivSet_subset_iterPderivSet
statement:
theorem topPderivSet_subset_iterPderivSet (S : Set R) (r : ℕ) :
    c.topPderivSet S r ⊆ c.iterPderivSet S r
proof:
:= fun f hf => by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, s, hs, rfl⟩ := c.mem_topPderivSet.mp hf
  exact c.mem_iterPderivSet.mpr ⟨l, hl.le, s, hs, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderiv_perm
statement:
theorem iterPderiv_perm {l l' : List (Fin n)} (h : l.Perm l') (f : R) :
    c.iterPderiv l f = c.iterPderiv l' f
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i _ ih => rw [iterPderiv_cons, iterPderiv_cons, ih]
  | swap i j l => simp only [iterPderiv_cons]; exact c.pderiv_comm j i _
  | trans _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderiv_mem_Dpow
statement:
theorem iterPderiv_mem_Dpow {I : Ideal R} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ I) (l : List (Fin n)) :
    c.iterPderiv l f ∈ c.Dpow l.length I
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simpa using hf
  | cons i l ih => rw [iterPderiv_cons, List.length_cons, Dpow_succ]; exact c.pderiv_mem_D ih i

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_topPderivSet_le
statement:
theorem span_topPderivSet_le (I : Ideal R) (r : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span (c.topPderivSet (I : Set R) r) ≤ c.Dpow r I
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr fun g hg => ?_
  obtain ⟨l, hl, f, hf, rfl⟩ := c.mem_topPderivSet.mp hg
  rw [← hl]
  exact c.iterPderiv_mem_Dpow hf l

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_eq_of_ne
statement:
theorem pderiv_eq_of_ne {i j : Fin n} (h : j ≠ i) (f : R) :
    c.pderiv j f = c.pderiv j (c.pderiv i (c.x i * f)) - c.x i * c.pderiv j (c.pderiv i f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one, map_add,
    Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x, ite_eq_right h, mul_zero, add_zero]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.two_nsmul_pderiv
statement:
theorem two_nsmul_pderiv (i : Fin n) (f : R) :
    2 • c.pderiv i f = c.pderiv i (c.pderiv i (c.x i * f)) - c.x i * c.pderiv i (c.pderiv i f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one, map_add,
    Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one, two_smul]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderiv_x_mul
statement:
theorem iterPderiv_x_mul (l : List (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (f : R) :
    c.iterPderiv l (c.x i * f) =
      c.x i * c.iterPderiv l f + (l.count i) • c.iterPderiv (l.erase i) f
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons j l ih =>
    rw [iterPderiv_cons, ih, map_add, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x,
      map_nsmul, ← iterPderiv_cons, ← iterPderiv_cons]
    by_cases hij : j = i
    · subst hij
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one, List.count_cons_self, List.erase_cons_head, add_smul, one_smul]
      by_cases hmem : j ∈ l
      · rw [c.iterPderiv_perm (List.perm_cons_erase hmem).symm]
        simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · rw [List.count_eq_zero.mpr hmem]
        simp
    · rw [ite_eq_right hij, mul_zero, add_zero, List.count_cons_of_ne hij,
        List.erase_cons_tail (by simpa using hij)]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderiv_mem_span_topPderivSet_succ
statement:
theorem iterPderiv_mem_span_topPderivSet_succ (hn : 0 < n) {I : Ideal R} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ I)
    (l : List (Fin n)) :
    c.iterPderiv l f ∈ Ideal.span (c.topPderivSet (I : Set R) (l.length + 1))
proof:
:= by
  set i₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  have hid := c.iterPderiv_x_mul (i₀ :: l) i₀ f
  rw [List.count_cons_self, List.erase_cons_head] at hid
  have hmem : ((l.count i₀ + 1 : ℕ) : R) * c.iterPderiv l f ∈
      Ideal.span (c.topPderivSet (I : Set R) (l.length + 1)) := by
    have h2 : (l.count i₀ + 1) • c.iterPderiv l f =
        c.iterPderiv (i₀ :: l) (c.x i₀ * f) - c.x i₀ * c.iterPderiv (i₀ :: l) f :=
      eq_sub_of_add_eq' hid.symm
    rw [← nsmul_eq_mul, h2]
    refine Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ?_) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ?_))
    · exact c.mem_topPderivSet.mpr ⟨i₀ :: l, List.length_cons, c.x i₀ * f,
        Ideal.mul_mem_left I _ hf, rfl⟩
    · exact c.mem_topPderivSet.mpr ⟨i₀ :: l, List.length_cons, f, hf, rfl⟩
  have hu := isUnit_natCast (R := R) (Nat.succ_ne_zero (l.count i₀))
  have := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R) hmem
  rwa [← mul_assoc, hu.val_inv_mul, one_mul] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_topPderivSet_le_succ
statement:
theorem span_topPderivSet_le_succ (hn : 0 < n) (I : Ideal R) (r : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span (c.topPderivSet (I : Set R) r) ≤
      Ideal.span (c.topPderivSet (I : Set R) (r + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr fun g hg => ?_
  obtain ⟨l, hl, f, hf, rfl⟩ := c.mem_topPderivSet.mp hg
  rw [← hl]
  exact c.iterPderiv_mem_span_topPderivSet_succ hn hf l

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_topPderivSet_mono
statement:
theorem span_topPderivSet_mono (hn : 0 < n) (I : Ideal R) {r s : ℕ} (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    Ideal.span (c.topPderivSet (I : Set R) r) ≤ Ideal.span (c.topPderivSet (I : Set R) s)
proof:
:= by
  induction s, hrs using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact le_rfl
  | succ s _ ih => exact ih.trans (c.span_topPderivSet_le_succ hn I s)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_eq_span_topPderivSet
statement:
theorem Dpow_eq_span_topPderivSet (hn : 0 < n) (I : Ideal R) (r : ℕ) :
    c.Dpow r I = Ideal.span (c.topPderivSet (I : Set R) r)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (c.span_topPderivSet_le I r)
  conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.span_eq I]
  rw [Dpow_span]
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr fun g hg => ?_
  obtain ⟨l, hl, f, hf, rfl⟩ := c.mem_iterPderivSet.mp hg
  exact c.span_topPderivSet_mono hn I hl
    (Ideal.subset_span (c.mem_topPderivSet.mpr ⟨l, rfl, f, hf, rfl⟩))

name: IsLocalRing.weight_indicator_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem weight_indicator_eq_zero_iff (T : Finset (Fin n)) (d : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (indicatorWeight T) d = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ T, d i = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    by_contra hd
    have := h i (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hd)
    simp [indicatorWeight, hi, hd] at this
  · intro h i hi
    by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
    · exact absurd (h i hiT) (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi)
    · simp [indicatorWeight, hiT]

name: IsLocalRing.indicatorWeight_le_one
statement: theorem indicatorWeight_le_one (T : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) : indicatorWeight T i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold indicatorWeight
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: IsLocalRing.mem_weightedOrderIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_weightedOrderIdeal {w : Fin n → ℕ} {m : ℕ} {F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} :
    F ∈ weightedOrderIdeal w m ↔ (m : ℕ∞) ≤ F.weightedOrder w
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: IsLocalRing.span_X_le_weightedOrderIdeal_one
statement:
theorem span_X_le_weightedOrderIdeal_one [Nontrivial K] (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    Ideal.span (X '' (T : Set (Fin n))) ≤
      weightedOrderIdeal (K := K) (indicatorWeight T) 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  change ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (X i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K).weightedOrder _
  rw [X_def, weightedOrder_monomial_of_ne_zero _ one_ne_zero, Finsupp.weight_single, one_smul]
  simp [indicatorWeight, Finset.mem_coe.mp hi]

name: IsLocalRing.span_X_pow_le_weightedOrderIdeal
statement:
theorem span_X_pow_le_weightedOrderIdeal [Nontrivial K] (T : Finset (Fin n)) (m : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span (X '' (T : Set (Fin n))) ^ m ≤
      weightedOrderIdeal (K := K) (indicatorWeight T) m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro F _
    rw [mem_weightedOrderIdeal, Nat.cast_zero]
    exact zero_le
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Ideal.mul_le]
    intro F hF G hG
    rw [mem_weightedOrderIdeal, Nat.cast_succ]
    exact le_trans (add_le_add (ih hF) (span_X_le_weightedOrderIdeal_one T hG))
      (le_weightedOrder_mul _)

name: IsLocalRing.mem_span_X_mul_weightedOrderIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_span_X_mul_weightedOrderIdeal (T : Finset (Fin n)) (m : ℕ) (T' : Finset (Fin n)) :
    T' ⊆ T → ∀ F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K,
      (∀ d, coeff d F ≠ 0 →
        m + 1 ≤ Finsupp.weight (indicatorWeight T) d ∧ ∃ i ∈ T', d i ≠ 0) →
      F ∈ Ideal.span (X '' (T : Set (Fin n))) * weightedOrderIdeal (indicatorWeight T) m
proof:
:= by
  induction T' using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro _ F hF
    have : F = 0 := by
      ext d
      by_contra hd
      obtain ⟨_, i, hi, _⟩ := hF d hd
      exact Finset.notMem_empty i hi
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  | insert a T' _ ih =>
    intro hT F hF
    set G : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K := fun e => coeff (e + Finsupp.single a 1) F with hG
    set F' : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K := fun d => if d a = 0 then coeff d F else 0 with hF'
    have hsplit : F = X a * G + F' := by
      ext d
      rw [map_add, X_def, coeff_monomial_mul]
      by_cases hda : d a = 0
      · have hnle : ¬ Finsupp.single a 1 ≤ d := by
          rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff]
          omega
        rw [ite_eq_right hnle, zero_add]
        exact (ite_eq_left hda).symm
      · have hle : Finsupp.single a 1 ≤ d := by
          rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff]
          omega
        rw [ite_eq_left hle, one_mul]
        change coeff d F =
          coeff (d - Finsupp.single a 1 + Finsupp.single a 1) F + if d a = 0 then coeff d F else 0
        rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle, ite_eq_right hda, add_zero]
    rw [hsplit]
    refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_mul
      (Ideal.subset_span ⟨a, hT (Finset.mem_insert_self a T'), rfl⟩) ?_)
      (ih (fun i hi => hT (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)) F' ?_)
    · rw [mem_weightedOrderIdeal]
      refine nat_le_weightedOrder _ fun e he => ?_
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨hw, -⟩ := hF (e + Finsupp.single a 1) hne
      rw [map_add, Finsupp.weight_single, one_smul] at hw
      have := indicatorWeight_le_one T a
      omega
    · intro d hd
      have hda : d a = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hd (ite_eq_right h)
      obtain ⟨hw, i, hi, hdi⟩ :=
        hF d (by rwa [show coeff d F' = coeff d F from ite_eq_left hda] at hd)
      refine ⟨hw, i, ?_, hdi⟩
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi'
      · exact absurd hda hdi
      · exact hi'

name: IsLocalRing.weightedOrderIdeal_le_span_X_pow
statement:
theorem weightedOrderIdeal_le_span_X_pow (T : Finset (Fin n)) (m : ℕ) :
    weightedOrderIdeal (K := K) (indicatorWeight T) m ≤
      Ideal.span (X '' (T : Set (Fin n))) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
    exact le_top
  | succ m ih =>
    intro F hF
    rw [pow_succ']
    refine Ideal.mul_mono_right ih ?_
    refine mem_span_X_mul_weightedOrderIdeal T m T subset_rfl F fun d hd => ?_
    have hw : m + 1 ≤ Finsupp.weight (indicatorWeight T) d := by
      have h1 := weightedOrder_le (indicatorWeight T) hd
      exact_mod_cast le_trans (mem_weightedOrderIdeal.mp hF) h1
    refine ⟨hw, ?_⟩
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have h0 := (weight_indicator_eq_zero_iff T d).mpr hcon
    omega

name: IsLocalRing.mem_span_X_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem mem_span_X_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder [Nontrivial K] (T : Finset (Fin n)) (m : ℕ)
    (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) :
    F ∈ Ideal.span (X '' (T : Set (Fin n))) ^ m ↔
      (m : ℕ∞) ≤ F.weightedOrder (fun i => if i ∈ T then 1 else 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => span_X_pow_le_weightedOrderIdeal T m h, fun h => weightedOrderIdeal_le_span_X_pow T m h⟩

name: IsLocalRing.isPrime_chartCenter
statement: theorem isPrime_chartCenter : (chartCenter x r).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  have h := isPrime_span_image_lt x hx hn (r.val + 1)
  have hset : {i : Fin n | i ≤ r} = {j : Fin n | j.val < r.val + 1} := by
    ext j
    change j ≤ r ↔ j.val < r.val + 1
    rw [Fin.le_def]
    omega
  rw [chartCenter, hset]
  exact h

name: IsLocalRing.cohenEquiv_X
statement:
theorem cohenEquiv_X (i : Fin n) :
    cohenEquiv R x hx hn (X i) = algebraMap R R̂ (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cohenEquiv_apply]
  exact cohenMap_X R x _ i

name: IsLocalRing.map_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem map_chartCenter_pow (m : ℕ) :
    (chartCenter x r ^ m).map (algebraMap R R̂) =
      (Ideal.span (X '' ((Finset.univ.filter (· ≤ r) : Finset (Fin n)) : Set (Fin n))) ^ m).map
        (cohenEquiv R x hx hn)
proof:
:= by
  have hS : ((Finset.univ.filter (· ≤ r) : Finset (Fin n)) : Set (Fin n)) = {i | i ≤ r} := by
    ext i
    simp
  have hfun : (fun i => algebraMap R R̂ (x i)) = fun i => cohenEquiv R x hx hn (X i) := by
    funext i
    rw [cohenEquiv_X]
  rw [Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_pow, chartCenter, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_image,
    Set.image_image, hS, hfun]

name: IsLocalRing.mem_chartCenter_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder'
statement:
theorem mem_chartCenter_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder' (f : R) (m : ℕ) :
    f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m ↔
      (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ((cohenEquiv R x hx hn).symm (algebraMap R R̂ f)).weightedOrder
        (indicatorWeight (Finset.univ.filter (· ≤ r)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_span_X_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder, ← Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.comap_symm,
    ← map_chartCenter_pow x hx hn r, ← Ideal.mem_comap, comap_map_adicCompletion]

name: IsLocalRing.mem_chartCenter_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder
statement:
theorem mem_chartCenter_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder (f : R) (m : ℕ) :
    f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m ↔
      (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ((cohenEquiv R x hx hn).symm (algebraMap R R̂ f)).weightedOrder
        (fun i => if i ≤ r then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (fun i : Fin n => if i ≤ r then 1 else 0) =
      indicatorWeight (Finset.univ.filter (· ≤ r)) := by
    funext i
    simp [indicatorWeight]
  rw [hw]
  exact mem_chartCenter_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder' x hx hn r f m

name: IsLocalRing.weightedOrder_symm_algebraMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem weightedOrder_symm_algebraMap_eq_zero {s : R} (hs : s ∉ chartCenter x r) :
    ((cohenEquiv R x hx hn).symm (algebraMap R R̂ s)).weightedOrder
      (fun i => if i ≤ r then 1 else 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  apply hs
  rw [← pow_one (chartCenter x r), mem_chartCenter_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder x hx hn r,
    Nat.cast_one]
  exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne

name: IsLocalRing.mem_chartCenter_pow_of_mul_mem
statement:
theorem mem_chartCenter_pow_of_mul_mem {s f : R} (hs : s ∉ chartCenter x r) {m : ℕ}
    (h : s * f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m) : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartCenter_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder x hx hn r] at h ⊢
  rwa [map_mul, map_mul, weightedOrder_mul, weightedOrder_symm_algebraMap_eq_zero x hx hn r hs,
    zero_add] at h

name: IsLocalRing.comap_map_localization_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem comap_map_localization_chartCenter_pow (m : ℕ) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isPrime_chartCenter x hx hn r
    ((chartCenter x r ^ m).map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (chartCenter x r)))).comap
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (chartCenter x r))) = chartCenter x r ^ m := by
  have := isPrime_chartCenter x hx hn r
  refine le_antisymm (fun f hf => ?_) Ideal.le_comap_map
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff (chartCenter x r).primeCompl] at hf
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨s, hs⟩⟩, h⟩ := hf
  rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (chartCenter x r).primeCompl] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ht'⟩ := h
  have hmem : t * s * f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m := by
    have h1 : t * (f * s) = t * a := ht'
    rw [show t * s * f = t * (f * s) by ring, h1]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ha
  refine mem_chartCenter_pow_of_mul_mem x hx hn r (fun hts => ?_) hmem
  rcases (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem inferInstance hts) with h | h
  · exact ht h
  · exact hs h

name: IsLocalRing.le_ordAlong_chartCenter_iff
statement:
theorem le_ordAlong_chartCenter_iff (I : Ideal R) (m : ℕ) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isPrime_chartCenter x hx hn r
    (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ordAlong (chartCenter x r) I ↔ I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m := by
  have := isPrime_chartCenter x hx hn r
  rw [ordAlong, le_ord_iff, ← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, ← Ideal.map_pow,
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, comap_map_localization_chartCenter_pow x hx hn r m]

name: IsLocalRing.mem_tuningExponents
statement:
theorem mem_tuningExponents {m s : ℕ} {e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ} :
    e ∈ tuningExponents m s ↔ (∀ j, e j ≤ s) ∧ s ≤ wt m e ∧ e (Fin.last m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tuningExponents, Finset.mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_range,
    Nat.lt_succ_iff]

name: IsLocalRing.clampExponent_le
statement:
theorem clampExponent_le (m s : ℕ) (e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    clampExponent m s e j ≤ e j
proof:
:= by
  unfold clampExponent
  split_ifs
  · exact Nat.zero_le _
  · exact min_le_left _ _

name: IsLocalRing.wt_clampExponent_ge
statement:
theorem wt_clampExponent_ge {m s : ℕ} {e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ} (he : s ≤ wt m e) :
    s ≤ wt m (clampExponent m s e)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∃ j : Fin (m + 1), j ≠ Fin.last m ∧ s ≤ e j
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, hje⟩ := h
    have hj' : (j : ℕ) < m := by
      have := j.isLt
      have : (j : ℕ) ≠ m := fun h' => hj (Fin.ext (by simp [h']))
      omega
    have h1 : (m - (j : ℕ)) * clampExponent m s e j ≤ wt m (clampExponent m s e) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j : Fin (m + 1) => (m - (j : ℕ)) * clampExponent m s e j)
        (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have h2 : clampExponent m s e j = s := by
      simp [clampExponent, hj, min_eq_right hje]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left s (by omega)) h1
  · push Not at h
    have : wt m (clampExponent m s e) = wt m e := by
      unfold wt
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      by_cases hj : j = Fin.last m
      · subst hj
        simp
      · have := h j hj
        simp [clampExponent, hj, min_eq_left this.le]
    rw [this]
    exact he

name: IsLocalRing.clampExponent_mem_tuningExponents
statement:
theorem clampExponent_mem_tuningExponents {m s : ℕ} {e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ} (he : s ≤ wt m e) :
    clampExponent m s e ∈ tuningExponents m s
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_tuningExponents.mpr ⟨fun j => ?_, wt_clampExponent_ge he, by simp [clampExponent]⟩
  unfold clampExponent
  split_ifs
  · exact Nat.zero_le _
  · exact min_le_right _ _

name: IsLocalRing.prod_pow_le_prod_pow_of_le
statement:
theorem prod_pow_le_prod_pow_of_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (P : ι → Ideal R) {e e' : ι → ℕ}
    (h : ∀ j, e' j ≤ e j) : ∏ j, P j ^ e j ≤ ∏ j, P j ^ e' j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a t ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha]
    exact Ideal.mul_mono (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (h a)) ih

name: IsLocalRing.iSup_wt_eq_sum_tuningExponents
statement:
theorem iSup_wt_eq_sum_tuningExponents (m s : ℕ) (P : Fin (m + 1) → Ideal R) :
    (⨆ (e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (_ : s ≤ wt m e), ∏ j, P j ^ e j) =
      ∑ e ∈ tuningExponents m s, ∏ j, P j ^ e j
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup₂_le fun e he => ?_) ?_
  · calc ∏ j, P j ^ e j ≤ ∏ j, P j ^ clampExponent m s e j :=
          prod_pow_le_prod_pow_of_le P (clampExponent_le m s e)
      _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ tuningExponents m s, ∏ j, P j ^ e j := by
          rw [Ideal.sum_eq_sup]
          exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun e => ∏ j, P j ^ e j) (clampExponent_mem_tuningExponents he)
  · rw [Ideal.sum_eq_sup]
    exact Finset.sup_le fun e he => le_iSup₂_of_le e (mem_tuningExponents.mp he).2.1 le_rfl

name: IsLocalRing.weight_indicator_filter_le
statement:
theorem weight_indicator_filter_le (r : Fin n) (d : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (indicatorWeight (Finset.univ.filter (· ≤ r))) d =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· ≤ r), d i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset d (Finset.subset_univ _) _
    (fun i _ => by simp), Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  simp [indicatorWeight]

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_le_of_completionMap_eq_subst
statement:
theorem ordElem_le_of_completionMap_eq_subst
    (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (ResidueField R) ≃+* AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B)
    (hΨ : ∀ F, completionMap φ (cohenEquiv R x hx hn F) = Ψ (subst (chartSubst r) F))
    {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter x r ^ m) (hord : ordElem f = m)
    {g : B} (hg : φ (x r) ^ m * g = φ f) : ordElem g ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  have : IsDomain (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) :=
    MulEquiv.isDomain (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (ResidueField R)) Ψ.symm.toMulEquiv
  
  have hFord : ((cohenEquiv R x hx hn).symm
      (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f)).order = m := by
    rw [← ordElem_eq_order, ← ordElem_ringEquiv (cohenEquiv R x hx hn), RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      ordElem_algebraMap_adicCompletion (R := R), hord]
  have hFP : ∀ d, coeff d ((cohenEquiv R x hx hn).symm
      (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f)) ≠ 0 →
      m ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· ≤ r), d i := by
    intro d hd
    have h1 := (mem_chartCenter_pow_iff_le_weightedOrder' x hx hn r f m).mp hf
    have h2 := weightedOrder_le (indicatorWeight (Finset.univ.filter (· ≤ r))) hd
    rw [← weight_indicator_filter_le]
    exact_mod_cast le_trans h1 h2
  
  obtain ⟨G', hG', hordG'⟩ := exists_X_pow_mul_eq_subst_chartSubst r hFord hFP
  
  have hΨr : Ψ (X r) = algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) (φ (x r)) := by
    have h := hΨ (X r)
    rw [cohenEquiv_X, completionMap_algebraMap, subst_X (hasSubst_chartSubst r),
      chartSubst, ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl r)] at h
    exact h.symm
  
  have hcancel : algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) (φ (x r)) ^ m * Ψ G' =
      algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) (φ (x r)) ^ m *
        algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) g := by
    have h := hΨ ((cohenEquiv R x hx hn).symm (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f))
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, completionMap_algebraMap, ← hg, map_mul, map_pow, ← hG',
      map_mul, map_pow, hΨr] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hne : algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) (φ (x r)) ≠ 0 := by
    classical
    rw [← hΨr]
    refine (map_ne_zero_iff Ψ Ψ.injective).mpr fun hX => ?_
    have h := congrArg (coeff (Finsupp.single r 1)) hX
    rw [coeff_X, ite_eq_left rfl, map_zero] at h
    exact one_ne_zero h
  have hΨG : Ψ G' = algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) g :=
    mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero m hne) hcancel
  calc ordElem g = ordElem (algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) g) :=
        (ordElem_algebraMap_adicCompletion (R := B) g).symm
    _ = ordElem (Ψ G') := by rw [hΨG]
    _ = ordElem G' := ordElem_ringEquiv Ψ G'
    _ = G'.order := ordElem_eq_order G'
    _ ≤ m := hordG'

name: IsLocalRing.exists_mem_ordElem_eq_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mem_ordElem_eq_of_ord_eq {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hord : ord I = m) :
    ∃ f ∈ I, ordElem f = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  have hne : (S : Set R).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.coe_nonempty, Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    rintro rfl
    rw [← hS, Finset.coe_empty, Ideal.span_empty, ord_eq_top_iff.mpr rfl] at hord
    exact ENat.top_ne_natCast m hord
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfeq⟩ := exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem S.finite_toSet hne
  refine ⟨f, hS ▸ Ideal.subset_span hf, ?_⟩
  rw [← hfeq, hS, hord]

name: IsLocalRing.ord_map_transformIdeal_le_of_forall
statement:
theorem ord_map_transformIdeal_le_of_forall {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m)
    (hord : ord I = m) (ψ : chartRing x r →+* B)
    (h : ∀ f (hf : f ∈ I), ordElem f = m → ordElem (ψ (transformElem x r f (hI hf))) ≤ m) :
    ord ((transformIdeal x r I m).map ψ) ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfm⟩ := exists_mem_ordElem_eq_of_ord_eq hord
  have hmem : ψ (transformElem x r f (hI hf)) ∈ (transformIdeal x r I m).map ψ := by
    refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_
    rw [transformIdeal_eq_span_range_transformElem _ _ hI]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩
  refine le_trans ?_ (h f hf hfm)
  rw [ord_eq_iInf]
  exact iInf₂_le _ hmem

name: IsLocalRing.ord_map_ringEquiv
statement: theorem ord_map_ringEquiv (e : A ≃+* B) (K : Ideal A) : ord (K.map (e : A →+* B)) = ord K
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_iInf, ord_eq_iInf]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine le_iInf₂ fun f hf => ?_
    have : e f ∈ K.map (e : A →+* B) := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf
    exact (iInf₂_le (e f) this).trans (le_of_eq (ordElem_ringEquiv e f))
  · refine le_iInf₂ fun g hg => ?_
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ e.surjective).mp hg
    exact (iInf₂_le f hf).trans (le_of_eq (ordElem_ringEquiv e f).symm)

name: IsLocalRing.span_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_span_toCotangent_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_span_toCotangent_eq_top :
    maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range s) ↔
      Submodule.span (ResidueField R)
        (Set.range fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨s i, hs i⟩) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Set.range fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨s i, hs i⟩) =
      (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent '' Set.range (fun i => (⟨s i, hs i⟩ : maximalIdeal R)) := by
    rw [← Set.range_comp]; rfl
  rw [h1, CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff,
    ← (Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (Submodule.injective_subtype (maximalIdeal R))).eq_iff,
    Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  have h2 : (maximalIdeal R).subtype '' Set.range (fun i => (⟨s i, hs i⟩ : maximalIdeal R)) =
      Set.range s := by
    rw [← Set.range_comp]; rfl
  rw [h2]
  exact eq_comm

name: IsLocalRing.span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_card_eq_spanFinrank_iff
statement:
theorem span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_card_eq_spanFinrank_iff [Fintype ι] :
    (maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range s) ∧ Fintype.card ι = (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank) ↔
      ∃ b : Module.Basis ι (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R),
        ∀ i, b i = (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨s i, hs i⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_span_toCotangent_eq_top s hs,
    spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace R]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hsp, hcard⟩
    have hli : LinearIndependent (ResidueField R)
        (fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨s i, hs i⟩) := by
      rw [linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span, hcard]
      change _ = Module.finrank _ (Submodule.span _ _)
      rw [hsp, finrank_top]
    exact ⟨Module.Basis.mk hli hsp.ge, fun i => Module.Basis.mk_apply hli hsp.ge i⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    have hbv : ⇑b = fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨s i, hs i⟩ := funext hb
    exact ⟨by rw [← hbv]; exact b.span_eq, Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b ▸ rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x)) (i : Fin n) :
    x i ∈ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:=
  hx ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_of_natCast_eq
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_of_natCast_eq (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = n
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
  rw [← hn] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: IsLocalRing.exists_basis_cotangentSpace_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem exists_basis_cotangentSpace_of_span_eq (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin n) (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R),
      ∀ i, b i = (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨x i, hx ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
proof:
:=
  (span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_card_eq_spanFinrank_iff x (x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq x hx)).mp
    ⟨hx, by rw [Fintype.card_fin, spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_of_natCast_eq hn]⟩

name: IsLocalRing.notMem_sq_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem notMem_sq_of_span_eq (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (k : Fin n) : x k ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_basis_cotangentSpace_of_span_eq x hx hn
  intro hk
  apply b.ne_zero k
  rw [hb k]
  exact (Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero _ _).mpr hk

name: IsLocalRing.exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_notMem_sq
statement:
theorem exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_notMem_sq (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    {y : R} (hy : y ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hy2 : y ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    ∃ x' : Fin n → R, (∃ i, x' i = y) ∧ maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, -, hcard, hspan⟩ := exists_span_insert_eq_maximalIdeal hy hy2
  rw [spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_of_natCast_eq hn] at hcard
  let e : Fin (t.card + 1) → R := Fin.cons y fun j => ((t.equivFin.symm j : t) : R)
  have hrange : Set.range e = insert y (t : Set R) := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.mem_coe]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · exact Or.inl (Fin.cons_zero _ _)
      · exact Or.inr (by simp only [e, Fin.cons_succ]; exact (t.equivFin.symm j).2)
    · rintro (rfl | hz)
      · exact ⟨0, Fin.cons_zero _ _⟩
      · exact ⟨(t.equivFin ⟨z, hz⟩).succ, by simp [e, Fin.cons_succ]⟩
  refine ⟨e ∘ finCongr hcard.symm, ⟨finCongr hcard 0, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp [e]
  · rw [hspan, ← hrange, (finCongr hcard.symm).surjective.range_comp e]

name: IsLocalRing.span_image_lt_zero
statement: theorem span_image_lt_zero : span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < 0}) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have : {j : Fin n | j.val < 0} = ∅ :=
    Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun j hj => Nat.not_lt_zero _ hj
  rw [this, Set.image_empty, Ideal.span_empty]

name: IsLocalRing.span_image_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem span_image_lt_of_le (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x)) {i : ℕ} (hi : n ≤ i) :
    span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i}) = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  have : {j : Fin n | j.val < i} = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun j => lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hi
  rw [this, Set.image_univ, hx]

name: IsLocalRing.span_image_lt_succ
proof:
:= by
  have : {j : Fin n | j.val < i + 1} = insert ⟨i, hi⟩ {j : Fin n | j.val < i} := by
    ext j
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  rw [this, Set.image_insert_eq, Ideal.span_insert, sup_comm]

name: IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_quotient_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_quotient_span_image_lt (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (i : ℕ) :
    (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i}))) =
      span ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})) ∘ x) '' {j | i ≤ j.val})
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    by_cases hj : i ≤ j.val
    · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    · have h0 : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})) ∘ x) j = 0 :=
        Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, not_le.mp hj, rfl⟩)
      rw [h0]
      exact zero_mem _
  · exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_subset_range _ _)

name: IsLocalRing.mk_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq_of
statement:
theorem mk_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq_of (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i}))]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})) + i = ringKrullDim R) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})) (x ⟨i, hi⟩) ∉
      maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set P := span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i}) with hP
  let y : Fin (n - i) → R ⧸ P := fun k => Ideal.Quotient.mk P (x ⟨i + k, by omega⟩)
  have hy : maximalIdeal (R ⧸ P) = span (Set.range y) := by
    rw [maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map, map_maximalIdeal_quotient_span_image_lt x hx i]
    congr 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Function.comp_apply, Set.mem_range, y]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨j.val - i, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
      exact congrArg (fun k => Ideal.Quotient.mk P (x k))
        (Fin.ext (show i + (j.val - i) = j.val by omega))
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨i + k.val, by omega⟩, show i ≤ i + k.val by omega, rfl⟩
  have hn' : ((n - i : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (R ⧸ P)
    rw [hm] at hdim ⊢
    rw [← hn] at hdim
    have : m + i = n := by exact_mod_cast hdim
    congr 1
    omega
  have := notMem_sq_of_span_eq y hy hn' ⟨0, by omega⟩
  simpa [y] using this

name: IsLocalRing.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt_and_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt_and_ringKrullDim
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})) ∧
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})) + i = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    rw [span_image_lt_zero]
    refine ⟨IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.quotientBot R).symm, ?_⟩
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.quotientBot R), Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
  | succ i ih =>
    have hi' : i < n := hi
    obtain ⟨hreg, hdim⟩ := ih hi'.le
    set P := span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i}) with hP
    have hxi : Ideal.Quotient.mk P (x ⟨i, hi'⟩) ∈ maximalIdeal (R ⧸ P) := by
      rw [maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq x hx _)
    have hxi2 := mk_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq_of x hx hn hi' hdim
    obtain ⟨hQ, hQdim⟩ := IsRegularLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton hxi hxi2
    have hmap : span {Ideal.Quotient.mk P (x ⟨i, hi'⟩)} =
        (span {x ⟨i, hi'⟩}).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk P) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    let e : ((R ⧸ P) ⧸ span {Ideal.Quotient.mk P (x ⟨i, hi'⟩)}) ≃+*
        R ⧸ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i + 1}) :=
      (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hmap).trans
        ((DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup P (span {x ⟨i, hi'⟩})).trans
          (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (span_image_lt_succ x hi').symm))
    refine ⟨IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e, ?_⟩
    rw [← ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e, Nat.cast_succ, add_comm (i : WithBot ℕ∞) 1,
      ← add_assoc, hQdim, hdim]

name: IsLocalRing.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (i : ℕ) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i}))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i ≤ n
  · exact (isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt_and_ringKrullDim x hx hn hi).1
  · rw [span_image_lt_of_le x hx (not_le.mp hi).le, ← span_image_lt_of_le x hx le_rfl]
    exact (isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt_and_ringKrullDim x hx hn le_rfl).1

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_lt (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})) + i = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:=
  (isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt_and_ringKrullDim x hx hn hi).2

name: IsLocalRing.isPrime_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem isPrime_span_image_lt (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (i : ℕ) :
    (span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  have := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt x hx hn i
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp inferInstance

name: IsLocalRing.notMem_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem notMem_span_image_lt (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) :
    x ⟨i, hi⟩ ∉ span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < i})
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hreg := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt_and_ringKrullDim x hx hn hi.le
  have := hreg.1
  exact mk_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq_of x hx hn hi hreg.2
    (by rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr h]; exact zero_mem _)

name: IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isRegular_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal (rs : List R) (hspan : Ideal.ofList rs = maximalIdeal R)
    (len : (rs.length : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R rs
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : Fin rs.length → R := fun i => rs[i]
  have hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x) := by
    rw [← hspan]
    change span {r | r ∈ rs} = span (Set.range x)
    congr 1
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_range, x, List.mem_iff_getElem, Fin.exists_iff,
      Fin.getElem_fin]
  have hP : ∀ i : ℕ, Ideal.ofList (rs.take i) = span (x '' {j : Fin rs.length | j.val < i}) := by
    intro i
    change span {r | r ∈ rs.take i} = span (x '' {j : Fin rs.length | j.val < i})
    congr 1
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_image, x, List.mem_take_iff_getElem, Fin.getElem_fin]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨j, (lt_min_iff.mp hj).2⟩, (lt_min_iff.mp hj).1, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨j.val, lt_min_iff.mpr ⟨hj, j.2⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨⟨fun i hi => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hP i, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
    have hreg := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt_and_ringKrullDim x hx len hi.le
    have := hreg.1
    have hne : Ideal.Quotient.mk (span (x '' {j : Fin rs.length | j.val < i})) (x ⟨i, hi⟩) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h => notMem_span_image_lt x hx len hi (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h)
    intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
    have key : ∀ c : R, rs[i] • Ideal.Quotient.mk (span (x '' {j : Fin rs.length | j.val < i})) c =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (span (x '' {j : Fin rs.length | j.val < i})) (x ⟨i, hi⟩ * c) :=
      fun c => rfl
    dsimp only at hab
    rw [key, key, map_mul, map_mul] at hab
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne hab
  · rw [hspan, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
    exact fun h => (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top h.symm

name: IsLocalRing.exists_regularSystem
statement:
theorem exists_regularSystem (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → R),
      maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x) ∧ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hspan⟩ := Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank
    (maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  refine ⟨s.card, fun i => ((s.equivFin.symm i : s) : R), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hspan]
    congr 1
    ext r
    constructor
    · intro hr
      exact ⟨s.equivFin ⟨r, Finset.mem_coe.mp hr⟩, by simp⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (s.equivFin.symm i).2
  · rw [hs, IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal]

name: IsLocalRing.ordFaithful_localRingHom_of_etale
statement:
theorem ordFaithful_localRingHom_of_etale {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.Etale R S] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime]
    (hpq : p = q.comap (algebraMap R S)) :
    OrdFaithful (Localization.localRingHom p q (algebraMap R S) hpq)
proof:
:= by
  have : q.LiesOver p := ⟨hpq⟩
  let := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
  have : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)) := by
    rw [Localization.AtPrime.algebraMap_eq]
    exact Localization.isLocalHom_localRingHom p q (algebraMap R S) _
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType R (Localization.AtPrime q) := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp R S _
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp R _ _
  have : Algebra.FormallyUnramified (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_restrictScalars R _ _
  have h := ordFaithful_of_flat_of_map_maximalIdeal_eq (A := Localization.AtPrime p)
    (B := Localization.AtPrime q) Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal
  rwa [Localization.AtPrime.algebraMap_eq] at h

name: IsLocalRing.ordFaithful_localRingHom_of_isSmoothAt
statement:
theorem ordFaithful_localRingHom_of_isSmoothAt {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [Algebra.IsSmoothAt R q] {p : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime] (hpq : p = q.comap (algebraMap R S)) :
    OrdFaithful (Localization.localRingHom p q (algebraMap R S) hpq)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hfq, n, _, _, _⟩ :=
    Algebra.IsSmoothAt.exists_isStandardEtale_mvPolynomial (R := R) (p := q)
  
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submonoid.powers f : Set S) (q : Set S) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ hk
    exact hfq (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_of_pow_mem inferInstance k hk)
  have hq' : (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))).IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers f) _ q inferInstance hdisj
  have hq'q : (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))).comap
      (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f)) = q :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers f) _ inferInstance hdisj
  have : IsLocalization.AtPrime
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f)))) q := by
    have := IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers f) (S := Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))))
      (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f)))
    have hM : ((q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))).comap
        (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))).primeCompl = q.primeCompl :=
      Submonoid.ext fun x => by rw [Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff, Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff, hq'q]
    unfold IsLocalization.AtPrime at this ⊢
    rw [hM] at this
    exact this
  let e : Localization.AtPrime q ≃ₐ[S]
      Localization.AtPrime (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))) :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv q.primeCompl _ _
  
  have hp' : p = ((q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))).comap
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away f))).comap
      (MvPolynomial.C : R →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_comap, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S (Localization.Away f), ← Ideal.comap_comap, hq'q]
    exact hpq
  have h₁ := ordFaithful_localRingHom_mvPolynomial_C n _ hp'
  have h₂ := ordFaithful_localRingHom_of_etale (R := MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f)))
    (p := (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))).comap
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away f))) rfl
  refine ((h₁.comp h₂).comp_ringEquiv (e.symm : Localization.AtPrime
    (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f))) ≃+* Localization.AtPrime q)).congr ?_
  refine (Localization.localRingHom_unique p q _ hpq fun r => ?_).symm
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, Localization.localRingHom_to_map,
    Localization.localRingHom_to_map, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away f),
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S (Localization.Away f),
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S (Localization.Away f)]
  exact e.symm.commutes (algebraMap R S r)

name: IsLocalRing.formallySmooth_of_charZero
statement:
theorem formallySmooth_of_charZero (k K : Type*) [Field k] [Field K] [CharZero k] [Algebra k K] :
    Algebra.FormallySmooth k K
proof:
:= by
  have : FaithfulSMul k K :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective k K).mpr (algebraMap k K).injective
  have : CharZero K := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap k K).injective
  obtain ⟨ι, v, hv⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' k K
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range v)) K := hv.isAlgebraic_field
  have : CharZero (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range v)) :=
    (algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range v)) K).charZero
  exact Algebra.FormallySmooth.of_algebraicIndependent_of_isSeparable hv.1

name: IsLocalRing.residueFieldEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem residueFieldEquiv_algebraMap (a : k) :
    residueFieldEquiv R (algebraMap k (ResidueField R) a) =
      algebraMap k (ResidueField R̂) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k R (ResidueField R) a,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k R̂ (ResidueField R̂) a]
  change ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R̂) (residue R (algebraMap k R a)) =
    residue R̂ (algebraMap k R̂ a)
  rw [ResidueField.map_residue]
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.exists_coefficientField_over
statement:
theorem exists_coefficientField_over :
    ∃ σ : ResidueField R →ₐ[k] R̂, ∀ a, residue R̂ (σ a) = residueFieldEquiv R a
proof:
:= by
  have := formallySmooth_of_charZero k (ResidueField R)
  let f : ResidueField R →ₐ[k] R̂ ⧸ maximalIdeal R̂ :=
    { toRingHom := (residueFieldEquiv R : ResidueField R →+* ResidueField R̂)
      commutes' := fun a => residueFieldEquiv_algebraMap R k a }
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Algebra.FormallySmooth.exists_mkₐ_comp_eq_of_isAdicComplete
    (R := k) (A := ResidueField R) (S := R̂) (I := maximalIdeal R̂) f
  exact ⟨g, fun a => congrArg (fun φ => φ a) hg⟩

name: IsLocalRing.cohenAlgEquivOver_X
statement:
theorem cohenAlgEquivOver_X (σ : ResidueField R →ₐ[k] R̂)
    (hσ : ∀ a, residue R̂ (σ a) = residueFieldEquiv R a) {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → R)
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hd : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (i : Fin d) : cohenAlgEquivOver σ hσ x hx hd (X i) = algebraMap R R̂ (x i)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra (ResidueField R) R̂ := σ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  change cohenEquivOfResidue R x hσ hx hd (X i) = _
  rw [cohenEquivOfResidue_apply, cohenMap_X]

name: IsLocalRing.cohenAlgEquivOver_C
statement:
theorem cohenAlgEquivOver_C (σ : ResidueField R →ₐ[k] R̂)
    (hσ : ∀ a, residue R̂ (σ a) = residueFieldEquiv R a) {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → R)
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hd : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (a : ResidueField R) : cohenAlgEquivOver σ hσ x hx hd (C a) = σ a
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra (ResidueField R) R̂ := σ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  change cohenEquivOfResidue R x hσ hx hd (C a) = σ.toRingHom a
  rw [cohenEquivOfResidue_apply, cohenMap_C]
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.residue_cohenAlgEquivOver_C
statement:
theorem residue_cohenAlgEquivOver_C (σ : ResidueField R →ₐ[k] R̂)
    (hσ : ∀ a, residue R̂ (σ a) = residueFieldEquiv R a) {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → R)
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hd : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (a : ResidueField R) :
    residue R̂ (cohenAlgEquivOver σ hσ x hx hd (C a)) = residueFieldEquiv R a
proof:
:= by
  rw [cohenAlgEquivOver_C, hσ]

name: IsLocalRing.exists_cohenAlgEquiv_over
statement:
theorem exists_cohenAlgEquiv_over {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → R)
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hd : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField R) ≃ₐ[k] R̂,
      (∀ i, Φ (X i) = algebraMap R R̂ (x i)) ∧
      ∀ a, residue R̂ (Φ (C a)) = residueFieldEquiv R a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_coefficientField_over R k
  exact ⟨cohenAlgEquivOver σ hσ x hx hd, cohenAlgEquivOver_X σ hσ x hx hd,
    residue_cohenAlgEquivOver_C σ hσ x hx hd⟩

name: IsLocalRing.exists_algEquiv_of_regularSystems
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_of_regularSystems {d : ℕ} (x x' : Fin d → R)
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) (hd : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ φ : R̂ ≃ₐ[k] R̂, ∀ i, φ (algebraMap R R̂ (x' i)) = algebraMap R R̂ (x i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_coefficientField_over R k
  refine ⟨(cohenAlgEquivOver σ hσ x' hx' hd).symm.trans (cohenAlgEquivOver σ hσ x hx hd),
    fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, ← cohenAlgEquivOver_X σ hσ x' hx' hd i, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    cohenAlgEquivOver_X]

name: IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_mvPowerSeries_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_mvPowerSeries_iff {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} :
    f ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ↔ constantCoeff f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, isUnit_iff_ne_zero,
    not_not]

name: IsLocalRing.X_mem_maximalIdeal_mvPowerSeries
statement:
theorem X_mem_maximalIdeal_mvPowerSeries (i : Fin n) :
    (X i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_X (Fin n) K]
  exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le_of_forall_X_mem
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_le_of_forall_X_mem
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ (X i) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) :
    (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)).map σ ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)
proof:
:= by
  have hX := hσ
  rw [maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_X (Fin n) K, Ideal.map_span]
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have := hX i
  rwa [maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_X (Fin n) K] at this

name: IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_map_of_forall_X_mem
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_map_of_forall_X_mem
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ (X i) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) {N : ℕ}
    {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hf : f ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ N) :
    σ f ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ N
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ N).map σ ≤
      maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ N := by
    rw [Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.pow_right_mono (map_maximalIdeal_le_of_forall_X_mem σ hσ) N
  exact h1 (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)

name: IsLocalRing.algHom_coe_eq_of_forall_X
statement:
theorem algHom_coe_eq_of_forall_X (τ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K →ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)
    (h : ∀ i, σ (X i) = τ (X i)) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) :
    σ (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) = τ (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
    (motive := fun P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K =>
      σ (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) = τ (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    P (fun a => ?_) (fun p q hp hq => ?_) (fun p i hp => ?_)
  · have hc : ((MvPolynomial.C a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) =
        algebraMap K (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) a := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.coe_C, MvPowerSeries.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
        RingHom.id_apply]
    rw [hc, σ.commutes, τ.commutes]
  · rw [MvPolynomial.coe_add, map_add, map_add, hp, hq]
  · rw [MvPolynomial.coe_mul, MvPolynomial.coe_X, map_mul, map_mul, hp, h]

name: IsLocalRing.sub_map_mem_of_forall_sub_X_mem
statement:
theorem sub_map_mem_of_forall_sub_X_mem (B : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    (hB : B ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ (X i) - X i ∈ B) (h : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) : σ h - h ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  have hX : ∀ i, σ (X i) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) := fun i => by
    have := Ideal.add_mem _ (hB (hσ i)) (X_mem_maximalIdeal_mvPowerSeries (K := K) i)
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
  have hpoly : ∀ P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K,
      σ (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) - P ∈ B := by
    intro P
    refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
      (motive := fun P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K => σ (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) - P ∈ B)
      P (fun a => ?_) (fun p q hp hq => ?_) (fun p i hp => ?_)
    · have hc : ((MvPolynomial.C a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) =
          algebraMap K (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) a := by
        rw [MvPolynomial.coe_C, MvPowerSeries.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
          RingHom.id_apply]
      rw [hc, σ.commutes, sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _
    · rw [MvPolynomial.coe_add, map_add]
      have := B.add_mem hp hq
      convert this using 1
      ring
    · rw [MvPolynomial.coe_mul, MvPolynomial.coe_X, map_mul]
      have : σ (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) * σ (X i) - (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) * X i =
          (σ (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) - (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) * σ (X i) +
            (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) * (σ (X i) - X i) := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact B.add_mem (B.mul_mem_right _ hp) (B.mul_mem_left _ (hσ i))
  refine mem_of_forall_mem_sup_pow fun s => ?_
  have hr := sub_truncTotal_mem h s
  set P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K := truncTotal (s + 1) h with hP
  have hs : maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ (s + 1) ≤
      maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ s := Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ s)
  have h1 : σ (h - P) - (h - P) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ s :=
    hs (Ideal.sub_mem _ (mem_maximalIdeal_pow_map_of_forall_X_mem σ hX hr) hr)
  have h2 : σ h - h = (σ (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) - P) + (σ (h - P) - (h - P)) := by
    rw [map_sub]; ring
  rw [h2]
  exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (hpoly P)) (Ideal.mem_sup_right h1)

name: IsLocalRing.hasSubst_of_forall_X_mem
statement:
theorem hasSubst_of_forall_X_mem (hσ : ∀ i, σ (X i) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) :
    HasSubst fun i => σ (X i)
proof:
:=
  hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero fun i => mem_maximalIdeal_mvPowerSeries_iff.mp (hσ i)

name: IsLocalRing.eq_substAlgHom_of_forall_X_mem
statement:
theorem eq_substAlgHom_of_forall_X_mem
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ (X i) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) :
    σ f = substAlgHom (R := K) (hasSubst_of_forall_X_mem σ hσ) f
proof:
:= by
  set τ := substAlgHom (R := K) (hasSubst_of_forall_X_mem σ hσ) with hτ
  have hX : ∀ i, σ (X i) = τ (X i) := fun i => by
    rw [hτ, coe_substAlgHom, subst_X (hasSubst_of_forall_X_mem σ hσ)]
  have hmem : ∀ s : ℕ, σ f - τ f ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) ⊔
      maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ s := by
    intro s
    have hr := sub_truncTotal_mem f s
    set P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K := truncTotal (s + 1) f with hP
    have hs : maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ (s + 1) ≤
        maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ s := Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ s)
    have h1 : σ (f - P) - τ (f - P) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ^ s :=
      hs (Ideal.sub_mem _ (mem_maximalIdeal_pow_map_of_forall_X_mem σ hσ hr)
        (substAlgHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow _ hr))
    have h2 : σ f - τ f = (σ (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) - τ P) + (σ (f - P) - τ (f - P)) := by
      rw [map_sub, map_sub]; ring
    rw [h2, algHom_coe_eq_of_forall_X σ τ hX P, sub_self, zero_add]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_right h1
  have := mem_of_forall_mem_sup_pow hmem
  rwa [Ideal.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero] at this

name: IsLocalRing.algHom_ext_of_forall_X_mem
statement:
theorem algHom_ext_of_forall_X_mem (τ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K →ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ (X i) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) (h : ∀ i, σ (X i) = τ (X i)) :
    σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  have hτ : ∀ i, τ (X i) ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) := fun i => (h i) ▸ hσ i
  refine AlgHom.ext fun f => ?_
  rw [eq_substAlgHom_of_forall_X_mem σ hσ f, eq_substAlgHom_of_forall_X_mem τ hτ f,
    coe_substAlgHom, coe_substAlgHom]
  exact congrArg (fun a => subst a f) (funext h)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_preservingDer
statement:
theorem mem_preservingDer {J : Ideal R} {δ : Derivation ℚ R R} :
    δ ∈ preservingDer J ↔ ∀ f ∈ J, δ f ∈ J
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne'
statement:
theorem pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne' (i : Fin n) {j : Fin n} (hj : j ≠ i) {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ Ideal.span {c.x i}) : c.pderiv j f ∈ Ideal.span {c.x i}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hf
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x, ite_eq_right hj, mul_zero, add_zero]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_logDerE
statement:
theorem mem_logDerE {E : Finset (Fin n)} {δ : Derivation ℚ R R} :
    δ ∈ c.logDerE E ↔
      δ ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range c.pderiv) ∧
        ∀ i ∈ E, ∀ f ∈ Ideal.span {c.x i}, δ f ∈ Ideal.span {c.x i}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [logDerE, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_iInf, mem_preservingDer]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.sum_smul_pderiv_apply_x
statement:
theorem sum_smul_pderiv_apply_x (a : Fin n → R) (i : Fin n) :
    (∑ l, a l • c.pderiv l) (c.x i) = a i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.finset_sum_apply]
  simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun l _ hl => by rw [ite_eq_right hl, mul_zero]) (by simp)]
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.sum_smul_pderiv_mem_logDerE_iff
statement:
theorem sum_smul_pderiv_mem_logDerE_iff (E : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → R) :
    (∑ i, a i • c.pderiv i) ∈ c.logDerE E ↔ ∀ i ∈ E, a i ∈ Ideal.span {c.x i}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_logDerE]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hpres⟩ i hi
    have := hpres i hi (c.x i) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rwa [c.sum_smul_pderiv_apply_x] at this
  · intro ha
    refine ⟨Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ =>
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
    intro i hi f hf
    rw [Derivation.finset_sum_apply]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l _ => ?_
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hl : l = i
    · rw [hl]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (ha i hi)
    · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne' i hl hf)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.sum_smul_pderiv_mem_logDer_iff
statement:
theorem sum_smul_pderiv_mem_logDer_iff (h : Fin n) (a : Fin n → R) :
    (∑ i, a i • c.pderiv i) ∈ c.logDer h ↔ a h ∈ Ideal.span {c.x h}
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDer, sum_smul_pderiv_mem_logDerE_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.x_smul_pderiv_mem_logDerE
statement:
theorem x_smul_pderiv_mem_logDerE (E : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    c.x i • c.pderiv i ∈ c.logDerE E
proof:
:= by
  refine c.mem_logDerE.mpr ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
  intro l _ f hf
  rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hil : i = l
  · subst hil
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne' l hil hf)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_mem_logDerE
statement:
theorem pderiv_mem_logDerE {E : Finset (Fin n)} {j : Fin n} (hj : j ∉ E) :
    c.pderiv j ∈ c.logDerE E
proof:
:= by
  refine c.mem_logDerE.mpr ⟨Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro l hl f hf
  exact c.pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne' l (by rintro rfl; exact hj hl) hf

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.logDerE_eq_span
statement:
theorem logDerE_eq_span (E : Finset (Fin n)) :
    c.logDerE E = Submodule.span R (c.logGens E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨hspan, hpres⟩ := c.mem_logDerE.mp hδ
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun R).mp hspan
    
    have hcoef : ∀ i ∈ E, ∃ b, b * c.x i = a i := by
      intro i hi
      have h1 := hpres i hi (c.x i) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
      rw [c.sum_smul_pderiv_apply_x] at h1
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h1
    choose! b hb using hcoef
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl E]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => ?_)
      (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => ?_)
    · rw [← hb i hi, ← smul_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩))
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span
        (Or.inr ⟨j, Finset.mem_compl.mp hj, rfl⟩))
  · rintro δ (⟨i, -, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩)
    · exact c.x_smul_pderiv_mem_logDerE E i
    · exact c.pderiv_mem_logDerE hj

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.logDer_eq_span
statement:
theorem logDer_eq_span (h : Fin n) :
    c.logDer h = Submodule.span R ({c.x h • c.pderiv h} ∪ c.pderiv '' {j | j ≠ h})
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDer, logDerE_eq_span, logGens, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton,
    Set.compl_singleton_eq]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem DlogEpow_zero (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : Ideal R) : c.DlogEpow E 0 I = I
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_succ
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_succ (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E (r + 1) I = c.DlogE E (c.DlogEpow E r I)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_succ'
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_succ' (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E (r + 1) I = c.DlogEpow E r (c.DlogE E I)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply _ _ _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_add
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_add (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r (c.DlogEpow E s I) = c.DlogEpow E (r + s) I
proof:
:=
  (Function.iterate_add_apply _ _ _ _).symm

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_DlogE
statement: theorem le_DlogE (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : Ideal R) : I ≤ c.DlogE E I
proof:
:=
  le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE
statement:
theorem x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE {E : Finset (Fin n)} {i : Fin n} (hi : i ∈ E) {I : Ideal R} {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ I) : c.x i * c.pderiv i f ∈ c.DlogE E I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem i
    (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem hi (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩))))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_mem_DlogE
statement:
theorem pderiv_mem_DlogE {E : Finset (Fin n)} {j : Fin n} (hj : j ∉ E) {I : Ideal R} {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ I) : c.pderiv j f ∈ c.DlogE E I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem j (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem hj
    (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_le_iff
statement:
theorem DlogE_le_iff {E : Finset (Fin n)} {I J : Ideal R} :
    c.DlogE E I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ J ∧ (∀ i ∈ E, ∀ f ∈ I, c.x i * c.pderiv i f ∈ J) ∧
        ∀ j, j ∉ E → ∀ f ∈ I, c.pderiv j f ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(c.le_DlogE E I).trans h, fun _ hi _ hf => h (c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE hi hf),
      fun _ hj _ hf => h (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE hj hf)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    refine sup_le (sup_le h1 (iSup_le fun i => iSup_le fun hi => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_))
      (iSup_le fun j => iSup_le fun hj => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
      exact h2 i hi f hf
    · rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
      exact h3 j hj f hf

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_mono
statement: theorem DlogE_mono {E : Finset (Fin n)} {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : c.DlogE E I ≤ c.DlogE E J
proof:
:=
  c.DlogE_le_iff.mpr ⟨h.trans (c.le_DlogE E J), fun _ hi _ hf => c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE hi (h hf),
    fun _ hj _ hf => c.pderiv_mem_DlogE hj (h hf)⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_mono
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_mono {E : Finset (Fin n)} (r : ℕ) {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) :
    c.DlogEpow E r I ≤ c.DlogEpow E r J
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ r ih => rw [DlogEpow_succ, DlogEpow_succ]; exact c.DlogE_mono ih

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_DlogEpow
statement: theorem le_DlogEpow (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : I ≤ c.DlogEpow E r I
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [DlogEpow_succ]; exact ih.trans (c.le_DlogE E _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_mono_left
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_mono_left {E : Finset (Fin n)} {r s : ℕ} (h : r ≤ s) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r I ≤ c.DlogEpow E s I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [add_comm, ← DlogEpow_add]
  exact c.le_DlogEpow E t _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_sup
statement:
theorem DlogE_sup (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I J : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogE E (I ⊔ J) = c.DlogE E I ⊔ c.DlogE E J
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.DlogE_le_iff.mpr ⟨sup_le_sup (c.le_DlogE E I) (c.le_DlogE E J), ?_, ?_⟩)
    (sup_le (c.DlogE_mono le_sup_left) (c.DlogE_mono le_sup_right))
  · intro i hi f hf
    obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hf
    rw [map_add, mul_add]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE hi hg₁))
      (Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE hi hg₂))
  · intro j hj f hf
    obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hf
    rw [map_add]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE hj hg₁))
      (Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE hj hg₂))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_iSup
statement:
theorem DlogE_iSup {ι : Sort*} (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : ι → Ideal R) :
    c.DlogE E (⨆ k, I k) = ⨆ k, c.DlogE E (I k)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.DlogE_le_iff.mpr ⟨iSup_le fun k =>
      (c.le_DlogE E (I k)).trans (le_iSup (fun k => c.DlogE E (I k)) k), ?_, ?_⟩)
    (iSup_le fun k => c.DlogE_mono (le_iSup I k))
  · intro i hi f hf
    induction hf using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem k f hf => exact Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem k (c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE hi hf)
    | zero => rw [map_zero, mul_zero]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [map_add, mul_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg
  · intro j hj f hf
    induction hf using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
    | mem k f hf => exact Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem k (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE hj hf)
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_sup
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_sup (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I J : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r (I ⊔ J) = c.DlogEpow E r I ⊔ c.DlogEpow E r J
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [DlogEpow_succ, ih, DlogE_sup, DlogEpow_succ, DlogEpow_succ]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_iSup
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_iSup {ι : Sort*} (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : ι → Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r (⨆ k, I k) = ⨆ k, c.DlogEpow E r (I k)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih => simp only [DlogEpow_succ, ih, DlogE_iSup]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_eq_iSup_logDerE
statement:
theorem DlogE_eq_iSup_logDerE (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogE E I = I ⊔ ⨆ δ ∈ c.logDerE E, Ideal.span (δ '' I)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.DlogE_le_iff.mpr ⟨le_sup_left, ?_, ?_⟩) (sup_le (c.le_DlogE E I) ?_)
  · intro i _ f hf
    refine Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem (c.x i • c.pderiv i)
      (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem (c.x_smul_pderiv_mem_logDerE E i) (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩)))
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · intro j hj f hf
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem (c.pderiv j)
      (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem (c.pderiv_mem_logDerE hj) (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)))
  · refine iSup_le fun δ => iSup_le fun hδ => Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    rw [c.logDerE_eq_span] at hδ
    induction hδ using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem δ hgen =>
      rcases hgen with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      · rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        exact c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE hi hf
      · exact c.pderiv_mem_DlogE hj hf
    | zero => rw [Derivation.zero_apply]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    | add δ₁ δ₂ _ _ h₁ h₂ => rw [Derivation.add_apply]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
    | smul a δ _ h => rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlog_eq_iSup_logDer
statement:
theorem Dlog_eq_iSup_logDer (h : Fin n) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlog h I = I ⊔ ⨆ δ ∈ c.logDer h, Ideal.span (δ '' I)
proof:
:=
  c.DlogE_eq_iSup_logDerE {h} I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlog_le_iff
statement:
theorem Dlog_le_iff (h : Fin n) {I J : Ideal R} :
    c.Dlog h I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ J ∧ (∀ f ∈ I, c.x h * c.pderiv h f ∈ J) ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ h → ∀ f ∈ I, c.pderiv j f ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dlog, DlogE_le_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq, ne_eq]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Dlogpow_zero (h : Fin n) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dlogpow h 0 I = I
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_succ
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_succ (h : Fin n) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (r + 1) I = c.Dlog h (c.Dlogpow h r I)
proof:
:=
  c.DlogEpow_succ {h} r I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_le_D
statement: theorem DlogE_le_D (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : Ideal R) : c.DlogE E I ≤ c.D I
proof:
:=
  c.DlogE_le_iff.mpr ⟨c.le_D I, fun i _ _ hf => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.pderiv_mem_D hf i),
    fun j _ _ hf => c.pderiv_mem_D hf j⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_eq_Dlog_sup
statement:
theorem D_eq_Dlog_sup (h : Fin n) (J : Ideal R) :
    c.D J = c.Dlog h J ⊔ Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' J)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨(c.le_DlogE _ J).trans le_sup_left, fun i f hf => ?_⟩)
    (sup_le (c.DlogE_le_D _ J) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_))
  · by_cases hi : i = h
    · subst hi
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)
    · exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE (by simpa using hi) hf)
  · rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact c.pderiv_mem_D hf h

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_succ_le
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_succ_le (h : Fin n) (s : ℕ) (J : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (s + 1) J ≤ c.Dlogpow h s (c.D J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dlogpow, DlogEpow_succ']
  exact c.DlogEpow_mono s (c.DlogE_le_D _ J)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_Dpow_le
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_Dpow_le (h : Fin n) {s j : ℕ} (hj : j < s) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I) ≤ c.Dlogpow h (s - (j + 1)) (c.Dpow (j + 1) I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, s = j + 1 + t := ⟨s - (j + 1), by omega⟩
  rw [show j + 1 + t - j = t + 1 by omega, show j + 1 + t - (j + 1) = t by omega, Dpow_succ]
  exact c.Dlogpow_succ_le h t _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_le_Dpow
statement: theorem Dlogpow_le_Dpow (h : Fin n) (s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dlogpow h s I ≤ c.Dpow s I
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [Dlogpow, DlogEpow_succ, Dpow_succ]
    exact (c.DlogE_le_D _ _).trans (c.D_mono ih)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_empty
statement: theorem DlogE_empty (I : Ideal R) : c.DlogE ∅ I = c.D I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.DlogE_le_D ∅ I) (c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨c.le_DlogE ∅ I, fun j _ hf =>
    c.pderiv_mem_DlogE (Finset.notMem_empty j) hf⟩)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_empty
statement: theorem DlogEpow_empty (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.DlogEpow ∅ r I = c.Dpow r I
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [DlogEpow_succ, ih, DlogE_empty, Dpow_succ]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_le_Dpow
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_le_Dpow (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r I ≤ c.Dpow r I
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [DlogEpow_succ, Dpow_succ]; exact (c.DlogE_le_D _ _).trans (c.D_mono ih)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_span_x_self
statement:
theorem DlogE_span_x_self {E : Finset (Fin n)} {h : Fin n} (hh : h ∈ E) :
    c.DlogE E (Ideal.span {c.x h}) = Ideal.span {c.x h}
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (c.DlogE_le_iff.mpr ⟨le_rfl, fun i _ f hf => ?_,
    fun j hj f hf => c.pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne' h (by rintro rfl; exact hj hh) hf⟩) (c.le_DlogE E _)
  by_cases hi : i = h
  · rw [hi]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne' h hi hf)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_derivStable
statement:
theorem mem_derivStable {δ : Derivation ℚ R R} {K : Ideal R} {f : R} :
    f ∈ derivStable δ K ↔ f ∈ K ∧ δ f ∈ K
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_pderiv_image_span_le
statement:
theorem span_pderiv_image_span_le (h : Fin n) (S : Set R) :
    Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' Ideal.span S) ≤ Ideal.span S ⊔ Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' S)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Ideal.span S ≤
      derivStable (c.pderiv h) (Ideal.span S ⊔ Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' S)) :=
    Ideal.span_le.mpr fun f hf => ⟨Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span hf),
      Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)⟩
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  exact (hle hf).2

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_pderiv_image_mono
statement:
theorem span_pderiv_image_mono (h : Fin n) {J₁ J₂ : Ideal R} (hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) :
    Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' J₁) ≤ Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' J₂)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono hJ)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_pderiv_image_iSup_le
statement:
theorem span_pderiv_image_iSup_le {ι : Sort*} (h : Fin n) (J : ι → Ideal R) :
    Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' (⨆ k, J k : Ideal R)) ≤ ⨆ k, Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' J k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  induction hf using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem k f hf => exact Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem k (Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_pderiv_image_DlogE_le
statement:
theorem span_pderiv_image_DlogE_le (E : Finset (Fin n)) (h : Fin n) (J : Ideal R) :
    Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' c.DlogE E J) ≤
      c.DlogE E (Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' J)) ⊔ c.DlogE E J
proof:
:= by
  have hΔ : ∀ f ∈ J, c.pderiv h f ∈ Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' J) :=
    fun f hf => Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  have hle : c.DlogE E J ≤
      derivStable (c.pderiv h) (c.DlogE E (Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' J)) ⊔ c.DlogE E J) := by
    refine c.DlogE_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun f hf => ⟨Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.le_DlogE E J hf),
      Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.le_DlogE E _ (hΔ f hf))⟩, fun i hi f hf =>
      ⟨Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE hi hf), ?_⟩, fun j hj f hf =>
      ⟨Ideal.mem_sup_right (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE hj hf), ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, c.pderiv_x, c.pderiv_comm]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.x_mul_pderiv_mem_DlogE hi (hΔ f hf))) ?_
      split_ifs with hih
      · rw [mul_one, ← hih]
        exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.le_DlogE E _ (hΔ f hf))
      · rw [mul_zero]
        exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    · rw [c.pderiv_comm]
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE hj (hΔ f hf))
  refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  exact (hle hf).2

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_pderiv_image_DlogEpow_le
statement:
theorem span_pderiv_image_DlogEpow_le (E : Finset (Fin n)) (h : Fin n) (t : ℕ) (J : Ideal R) :
    Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' c.DlogEpow E t J) ≤
      c.DlogEpow E t (Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' J)) ⊔ c.DlogEpow E t J
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing J with
  | zero => exact le_sup_left
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [DlogEpow_succ']
    refine (ih _).trans (sup_le_sup_right (c.DlogEpow_mono t (c.span_pderiv_image_DlogE_le E h J)) _
      |>.trans ?_)
    rw [DlogEpow_sup, sup_assoc, sup_idem]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderivIdeal_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem iterPderivIdeal_zero (h : Fin n) (I : Ideal R) : c.iterPderivIdeal h 0 I = I
proof:
:= by
  rw [iterPderivIdeal, Function.iterate_zero, Set.image_id, Ideal.span_eq]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterate_pderiv_mem_Dpow
statement:
theorem iterate_pderiv_mem_Dpow (h : Fin n) {I : Ideal R} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ I) (j : ℕ) :
    (⇑(c.pderiv h))^[j] f ∈ c.Dpow j I
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact hf
  | succ j ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Dpow_succ]; exact c.pderiv_mem_D ih h

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderivIdeal_le_Dpow
statement:
theorem iterPderivIdeal_le_Dpow (h : Fin n) (j : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.iterPderivIdeal h j I ≤ c.Dpow j I
proof:
:=
  Ideal.span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩; exact c.iterate_pderiv_mem_Dpow h hf j)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_pderiv_image_iterPderivIdeal_le
statement:
theorem span_pderiv_image_iterPderivIdeal_le (h : Fin n) (j : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' c.iterPderivIdeal h j I) ≤
      c.iterPderivIdeal h j I ⊔ c.iterPderivIdeal h (j + 1) I
proof:
:= by
  refine (c.span_pderiv_image_span_le h _).trans (sup_le_sup_left (le_of_eq ?_) _)
  rw [iterPderivIdeal, Set.image_image, Function.iterate_succ']
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_Dpow_le_of_le
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_Dpow_le_of_le (h : Fin n) {s i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ s) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (s - i) (c.Dpow i I) ≤ c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I)
proof:
:= by
  induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact le_rfl
  | succ j hij ih => exact (ih (by omega)).trans (c.Dlogpow_Dpow_le h (by omega) I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iSup_Dlogpow_iterPderivIdeal_le
statement:
theorem iSup_Dlogpow_iterPderivIdeal_le (h : Fin n) {s j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ s) (I : Ideal R) :
    ⨆ i ≤ j, c.Dlogpow h (s - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h i I) ≤ c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I)
proof:
:=
  iSup₂_le fun i hi => (c.DlogEpow_mono _ (c.iterPderivIdeal_le_Dpow h i I)).trans
    (c.Dlogpow_Dpow_le_of_le h hi hj I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_Dpow_le_iSup
statement:
