theorem Dlogpow_Dpow_le_iSup (h : Fin n) (j : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    ∀ s, j ≤ s → c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I) ≤
      ⨆ i ≤ j, c.Dlogpow h (s - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h i I)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro s _
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le 0 le_rfl (le_of_eq (by rw [Dpow_zero, iterPderivIdeal_zero]))
  | succ j ih =>
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, s = j + 1 + t := ⟨s - (j + 1), by omega⟩
    
    have hDj : c.Dpow j I ≤ ⨆ i ≤ j, c.DlogEpow {h} (j - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h i I) := by
      have := ih j le_rfl
      rwa [Nat.sub_self, Dlogpow, DlogEpow_zero] at this
    
    have h2 : Ideal.span (c.pderiv h '' c.Dpow j I) ≤ ⨆ i ≤ j,
        (c.DlogEpow {h} (j - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h i I) ⊔
          c.DlogEpow {h} (j - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h (i + 1) I)) := by
      refine (c.span_pderiv_image_mono h hDj).trans ((c.span_pderiv_image_iSup_le h _).trans
        (iSup_mono fun i => (c.span_pderiv_image_iSup_le h _).trans (iSup_mono fun _ => ?_)))
      refine (c.span_pderiv_image_DlogEpow_le {h} h _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ le_sup_left)
      refine (c.DlogEpow_mono _ (c.span_pderiv_image_iterPderivIdeal_le h i I)).trans ?_
      rw [DlogEpow_sup]
    have h1 := ih (j + 1 + t) (by omega)
    rw [show j + 1 + t - j = t + 1 by omega] at h1
    rw [show j + 1 + t - (j + 1) = t by omega, Dpow_succ, c.D_eq_Dlog_sup h]
    simp only [Dlogpow, Dlog] at h1 ⊢
    rw [DlogEpow_succ'] at h1
    rw [DlogEpow_sup]
    refine sup_le (h1.trans (iSup₂_mono' fun i hi => ⟨i, by omega, le_rfl⟩)) ?_
    refine (c.DlogEpow_mono t h2).trans ?_
    simp only [DlogEpow_iSup, DlogEpow_sup, DlogEpow_add]
    refine iSup₂_le fun i hi => sup_le ?_ ?_
    · exact le_iSup₂_of_le i (by omega) (c.DlogEpow_mono_left (by omega) _)
    · rw [show t + (j - i) = j + 1 + t - (i + 1) by omega]
      exact le_iSup₂_of_le (i + 1) (by omega) le_rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_Dpow_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_Dpow_eq_iSup (h : Fin n) {s j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ s) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I) = ⨆ i ≤ j, c.Dlogpow h (s - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h i I)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (c.Dlogpow_Dpow_le_iSup h j I s hj) (c.iSup_Dlogpow_iterPderivIdeal_le h hj I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_eq_sum_Dlogpow
statement:
theorem Dpow_eq_sum_Dlogpow (h : Fin n) (s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dpow s I = ⨆ j ≤ s, c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.iterPderivIdeal h j I)
proof:
:= by
  have := c.Dlogpow_Dpow_eq_iSup h le_rfl (s := s) I
  rwa [Nat.sub_self, Dlogpow, DlogEpow_zero] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlog_map_quotient
statement:
theorem Dlog_map_quotient (J : Ideal R) :
    (c.Dlog h J).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x h})) =
      (c.quotientCoords h).D (J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x h})))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    refine c.DlogE_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun f hf => ?_, fun i hi f _ => ?_, fun j hj f hf => ?_⟩
    · exact Ideal.mem_comap.mpr ((c.quotientCoords h).le_D _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf))
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hi, Ideal.mem_comap, map_mul,
        Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _), zero_mul]
      exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    · obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq (Finset.mem_singleton.not.mp hj)
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← c.quotientCoords_pderiv_mk h j' f]
      exact (c.quotientCoords h).pderiv_mem_D (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf) j'
  · refine (c.quotientCoords h).D_le_iff.mpr
      ⟨Ideal.map_mono (c.le_DlogE _ J), fun j' g hg => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ :=
      (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp hg
    rw [c.quotientCoords_pderiv_mk h j' f]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
      (c.pderiv_mem_DlogE (fun e => Fin.succAbove_ne h j' (Finset.mem_singleton.mp e)) hf)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_map_quotient
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_map_quotient (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    (c.Dlogpow h r I).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x h})) =
      (c.quotientCoords h).Dpow r (I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x h})))
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [Dlogpow, DlogEpow_succ, Dpow_succ, ← ih]; exact c.Dlog_map_quotient h _

name: Ideal.eq_bot_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_eq
statement:
theorem Ideal.eq_bot_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_eq [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {J : Ideal R} (hJ : J ≤ maximalIdeal R) (hdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) = ringKrullDim R) :
    J = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨z, hzJ, hz0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
  have hzm : z ∈ maximalIdeal R := hJ hzJ
  have h1 := ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hz0) hzm
  have h2 : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {z}) :=
    ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective _
      (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective ((span_singleton_le_iff_mem J).mpr hzJ))
  rw [hdim, ← h1] at h2
  have : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ span {z}) :=
    isLocalRing_quotient_of_le_maximalIdeal ((span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hzm)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (R ⧸ span {z})
  rw [hm] at h2
  have : m + 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast h2
  omega

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_eq_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem IsRegularLocalRing.exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_eq_span_image_lt [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) [IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ I)] :
    ∃ (n c : ℕ) (x : Fin n → R), c ≤ n ∧ (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R ∧
      maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x) ∧ I = span (x '' {j | j.val < c})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mp inferInstance
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := le_maximalIdeal hIne
  
  set d := (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)).spanFinrank with hd_def
  have hd : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
  obtain ⟨s, hs_card, hs_span⟩ := Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)))
  have hmax : maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) = (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) :=
    maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map I
  have hlift : ∀ a : s, ∃ y : R, y ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ Ideal.Quotient.mk I y = a := fun a => by
    have ha : (a : R ⧸ I) ∈ maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) := by
      rw [← hs_span]
      exact Submodule.subset_span (Finset.mem_coe.mpr a.2)
    rw [hmax] at ha
    exact (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp ha
  choose y hy using hlift
  
  have hmy : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range y) ⊔ I := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro m hm
      have hrange : Set.range (Ideal.Quotient.mk I ∘ y) = (s : Set (R ⧸ I)) := by
        ext z
        simp only [Set.mem_range, Function.comp_apply, Finset.mem_coe]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
          rw [(hy a).2]
          exact a.2
        · intro hz
          exact ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, (hy ⟨z, hz⟩).2⟩
      have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk I m ∈ (span (Set.range y)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
        rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp, hrange]
        change Ideal.Quotient.mk I m ∈ Submodule.span (R ⧸ I) (s : Set (R ⧸ I))
        rw [hs_span, hmax]
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hm
      have h2 : m ∈ ((span (Set.range y)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) :=
        Ideal.mem_comap.mpr h1
      rwa [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
        ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker] at h2
    · exact sup_le (span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact (hy a).1)) hIle
  
  let tc : maximalIdeal R →ₗ[R] CotangentSpace R := (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent
  let y' : s → maximalIdeal R := fun a => ⟨y a, (hy a).1⟩
  let i' : I → maximalIdeal R := fun i => ⟨i, hIle i.2⟩
  set t : Set (CotangentSpace R) := Set.range fun i : I => tc (i' i) with ht
  set A := Submodule.span (ResidueField R) (Set.range fun a : s => tc (y' a)) with hA
  set B := Submodule.span (ResidueField R) t with hB
  
  have hsup : A ⊔ B = ⊤ := by
    have hspanI : span (Set.range fun i : I => (i : R)) = I :=
      le_antisymm (span_le.mpr (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact i.2))
        fun x hx => subset_span ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    have hfam : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range (Sum.elim y fun i : I => (i : R))) := by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range, span_union, hspanI]
      exact hmy
    have hmem : ∀ p, Sum.elim y (fun i : I => (i : R)) p ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun p => by
      rcases p with a | i
      exacts [(hy a).1, hIle i.2]
    have := (span_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_span_toCotangent_eq_top _ hmem).mp hfam
    rw [hA, hB, ← Submodule.span_union, ← this]
    congr 1
    ext v
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨a, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨Sum.inl a, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨Sum.inr i, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨a | i, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨a, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨b, hbt, hbspan, hbli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent (ResidueField R) t
  have hbfin : Finite b := hbli.set_finite_of_isNoetherian.to_subtype
  set c := Nat.card b with hc
  have hBcard : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) B = c := by
    have hspan' : Submodule.span (ResidueField R) (Set.range ((↑) : b → CotangentSpace R)) = B := by
      rw [Subtype.range_coe, hbspan]
    have := Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (Module.Basis.span hbli)
    rwa [hspan'] at this
  
  have hcount : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) ≤ d + c := by
    have h := Submodule.finrank_add_le_finrank_add_finrank A B
    rw [hsup, finrank_top] at h
    refine h.trans (add_le_add ?_ hBcard.le)
    exact (finrank_range_le_card _).trans (by rw [Fintype.card_coe, hs_card])
  
  set B0 := Module.Basis.sumExtend hbli with hB0
  have hfin := Module.Finite.finite_basis B0
  have hJfin : Finite (Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hbli) :=
    Finite.of_injective (Sum.inr : Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hbli → b ⊕ _) Sum.inr_injective
  set e := Nat.card (Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hbli) with he
  have hn : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = c + e := by
    rw [Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis B0, Nat.card_sum]
  have hed : e ≤ d := by omega
  let E : b ⊕ Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hbli ≃ Fin (c + e) :=
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Finite.equivFin b) (Finite.equivFin _)).trans finSumFinEquiv
  have hb_inl : ∀ i : b, B0 (Sum.inl i) = (i : CotangentSpace R) := fun i => by
    rw [hB0]
    unfold Module.Basis.sumExtend
    rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.extend_apply_self]
    rfl
  
  choose f hf using fun i : b => (show ∃ j : I, tc (i' j) = (i : CotangentSpace R) from hbt i.2)
  choose g hg using fun j : Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hbli =>
    (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_surjective (B0 (Sum.inr j))
  let lift0 : b ⊕ Module.Basis.sumExtendIndex hbli → maximalIdeal R :=
    Sum.elim (fun i => i' (f i)) g
  have hlift0 : ∀ p, tc (lift0 p) = B0 p := by
    rintro (i | j)
    · exact (hf i).trans (hb_inl i).symm
    · exact hg j
  let x : Fin (c + e) → R := fun k => (lift0 (E.symm k) : R)
  have hxm : ∀ k, x k ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun k => (lift0 (E.symm k)).2
  have hBx : ∀ k, (B0.reindex E) k = (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨x k, hxm k⟩ := fun k => by
    rw [Module.Basis.reindex_apply, ← hlift0]
  obtain ⟨hx, hcard⟩ :=
    (span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_card_eq_spanFinrank_iff x hxm).mpr ⟨B0.reindex E, hBx⟩
  have hnR : ((c + e : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R := by
    rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R), ← hcard, Fintype.card_fin]
  
  set J := span (x '' {j : Fin (c + e) | j.val < c}) with hJ
  have hJI : J ≤ I := by
    rw [hJ, span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    have hk' : k.val < c := hk
    have hE : E.symm k = Sum.inl ((Finite.equivFin b).symm ⟨k.val, hk'⟩) := by
      have hk2 : k = Fin.castAdd e ⟨k.val, hk'⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
      conv_lhs => rw [hk2]
      change ((Equiv.sumCongr (Finite.equivFin b) (Finite.equivFin _)).trans finSumFinEquiv).symm
        (Fin.castAdd e ⟨k.val, hk'⟩) = _
      rw [Equiv.symm_trans_apply, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd, Equiv.sumCongr_symm,
        Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl]
    change (lift0 (E.symm k) : R) ∈ I
    rw [hE]
    exact (f _).2
  
  have hcle : c ≤ c + e := Nat.le_add_right c e
  have hregJ := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt x hx hnR c
  have hdimJ := ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_lt x hx hnR hcle
  have hsurjJ : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) :=
    ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hJI)
  have hm : ((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ J)).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
  set m := (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ J)).spanFinrank with hm_def
  have hme : m + c = c + e := by
    have h := hdimJ
    rw [← hm, ← hnR] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hdm : d ≤ m := by
    have h := hsurjJ
    rw [← hm, ← hd] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hmd : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) := by
    rw [← hm, ← hd]
    congr 1
    omega
  
  have hIJ : I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) = ⊥ := by
    have hle : I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) ≤ maximalIdeal (R ⧸ J) := by
      rw [maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_map J]
      exact Ideal.map_mono hIle
    refine Ideal.eq_bot_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_eq hle ?_
    rw [← hmd]
    exact ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv
      ((DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup J I).trans (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (sup_eq_right.mpr hJI)))
  refine ⟨c + e, c, x, hcle, hnR, hx, ?_⟩
  rw [← hJ]
  exact le_antisymm (((Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker _).mp hIJ).trans_eq Ideal.mk_ker) hJI

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.reindex_x
statement: @[simp] theorem reindex_x (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) : (c.reindex σ).x i = c.x (σ i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.reindex_pderiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindex_pderiv (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    (c.reindex σ).pderiv i = c.pderiv (σ i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_span_update
statement:
theorem exists_span_update {h : R} (hh : h ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hh' : h ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range (Function.update c.x i h))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hh1 := hh
  rw [c.span_x] at hh1
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp hh1
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hall : ∀ i, a i ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro i
    by_contra hai
    have hu : IsUnit (a i) := IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hai
    apply hcon i
    refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · rw [c.span_x, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst hji
        have hsum : a j * c.x j + ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, a k * c.x k = h :=
          (Finset.add_sum_erase _ (fun k => a k * c.x k) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans ha
        have hmem : a j * c.x j ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (Function.update c.x j h)) := by
          rw [← sub_eq_of_eq_add hsum.symm]
          refine Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, Function.update_self j h c.x⟩)
            (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun k hk => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨k, ?_⟩))
          exact Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hk) h c.x
        have := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (↑hu.unit⁻¹ : R) hmem
        rwa [← mul_assoc, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_mul] at this
      · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, Function.update_of_ne hji h c.x⟩
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst hji
        rw [Function.update_self]
        exact hh
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hji]
        exact c.x_mem_maximalIdeal j
  apply hh'
  rw [← ha, pow_two]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hall i) (c.x_mem_maximalIdeal i)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_coords_x_eq
statement:
theorem exists_coords_x_eq (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) {h : R} (hh : ordElem h = 1) :
    ∃ (c' : RegularCoords R n) (i : Fin n), c'.x i = h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hh1, hh2⟩ := ordElem_eq_one_iff.mp hh
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := c.exists_span_update hh1 hh2
  refine ⟨c.changeCoordsOfSpans hs (Function.update c.x i h) hi, i, ?_⟩
  rw [changeCoordsOfSpans, changeCoords_x, Function.update_self]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_coords_x_zero_eq
statement:
theorem exists_coords_x_zero_eq (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) {h : R} (hh : ordElem h = 1) :
    ∃ (hn : 0 < n) (c' : RegularCoords R n), c'.x ⟨0, hn⟩ = h ∧ c'.pderiv ⟨0, hn⟩ h = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c₁, i, hi⟩ := c.exists_coords_x_eq hs hh
  refine ⟨i.pos, c₁.reindex (Equiv.swap ⟨0, i.pos⟩ i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [reindex_x, Equiv.swap_apply_left, hi]
  · have := (c₁.reindex (Equiv.swap ⟨0, i.pos⟩ i)).pderiv_x ⟨0, i.pos⟩ ⟨0, i.pos⟩
    rwa [ite_eq_left rfl, reindex_x, Equiv.swap_apply_left, hi] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.ord_MC_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem ord_MC_of_ord_eq {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ord I = m) :
    ord (c.MC I m) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [MC, c.ord_Dpow_of_ord_eq hI (Nat.sub_le m 1), Nat.sub_sub_self hm, Nat.cast_one]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.MC_eq_top_of_ord_lt
statement:
theorem MC_eq_top_of_ord_lt {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ord I < m) :
    c.MC I m = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (ne_top_of_lt hI)
  rw [← ha] at hI
  have ham : a < m := by exact_mod_cast hI
  exact c.Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le (by rw [← ha]; exact_mod_cast (show a ≤ m - 1 by omega))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_mem_MC_ordElem_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_mem_MC_ordElem_eq_one {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ord I = m) :
    ∃ h ∈ c.MC I m, ordElem h = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hord := c.ord_MC_of_ord_eq hm hI
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hspan⟩ := Submodule.fg_def.mp (IsNoetherian.noetherian (c.MC I m))
  have hspan' : Ideal.span S = c.MC I m := hspan
  have hne : S.Nonempty := by
    rw [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    rintro rfl
    rw [← hspan', Ideal.span_empty, ord_bot] at hord
    exact ENat.top_ne_one hord
  obtain ⟨h, hhS, hh⟩ := exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem hS hne
  exact ⟨h, hspan' ▸ Ideal.subset_span hhS, by rw [← hh, hspan', hord]⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.exists_maximalContact
statement:
theorem exists_maximalContact (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hI : ord I = m) :
    ∃ h ∈ c.MC I m, ordElem h = 1 ∧
      ∃ (hn : 0 < n) (c' : RegularCoords R n), c'.x ⟨0, hn⟩ = h ∧ c'.pderiv ⟨0, hn⟩ h = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hmem, hh⟩ := c.exists_mem_MC_ordElem_eq_one hm hI
  exact ⟨h, hmem, hh, c.exists_coords_x_zero_eq hs hh⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.MC_span_singleton_x_pow
statement:
theorem MC_span_singleton_x_pow (i : Fin n) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    c.MC (Ideal.span {c.x i ^ m}) m = Ideal.span {c.x i}
proof:
:= by
  rw [MC, c.Dpow_span_singleton_x_pow i (Nat.sub_le m 1), Nat.sub_sub_self hm, pow_one]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isMCInvariant_span_singleton_x_pow
statement:
theorem isMCInvariant_span_singleton_x_pow (i : Fin n) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    c.IsMCInvariant (Ideal.span {c.x i ^ m}) m
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsMCInvariant
  rw [c.MC_span_singleton_x_pow i hm, c.D_span_singleton_x_pow i hm,
    Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, ← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hm]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.not_isMCInvariant_span_singleton_x_mul_x
statement:
theorem not_isMCInvariant_span_singleton_x_mul_x {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (h : c.x i ^ 2 ∉ Ideal.span {c.x i * c.x j}) :
    ¬ c.IsMCInvariant (Ideal.span {c.x i * c.x j}) 2
proof:
:= by
  intro hinv
  unfold IsMCInvariant at hinv
  rw [MC, Nat.add_one_sub_one, Dpow_one, c.D_span_singleton_x_mul_x hij] at hinv
  apply h
  rw [sq]
  exact hinv (Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)) (Ideal.subset_span (by simp)))

name: IsLocalRing.chartExp_apply_of_ne
statement: theorem chartExp_apply_of_ne {i : Fin n} (hi : i ≠ r) (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) : chartExp r α i = α i
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartExp, hi.symm]

name: IsLocalRing.chartExp_apply_self
statement:
theorem chartExp_apply_self (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    chartExp r α r = α r + ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· < r), α i
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartExp]

name: IsLocalRing.sum_filter_le_chartExp_apply_self
statement:
theorem sum_filter_le_chartExp_apply_self (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· ≤ r), α i = chartExp r α r
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartExp_apply_self, add_comm]
  have h : univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i ≤ r) = insert r (univ.filter (· < r)) := by
    ext i
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_insert]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases h.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inl h
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact h.le
      · exact h.le
  rw [h, sum_insert (by simp), add_comm]

name: IsLocalRing.chartExp_injective
statement: theorem chartExp_injective : Function.Injective (chartExp r)
proof:
:= by
  intro α β h
  have h1 : ∀ i, i ≠ r → α i = β i := fun i hi => by
    rw [← chartExp_apply_of_ne r hi α, h, chartExp_apply_of_ne r hi β]
  have h2 : ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· < r), α i = ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· < r), β i :=
    sum_congr rfl fun i hi => h1 i (ne_of_lt (mem_filter.mp hi).2)
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · subst hi
    have := congrArg (fun γ : Fin n →₀ ℕ => γ i) h
    simp only [chartExp_apply_self] at this
    omega
  · exact h1 i hi

name: IsLocalRing.degree_add'
statement: theorem degree_add' (α β : Fin n →₀ ℕ) : (α + β).degree = α.degree + β.degree
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, sum_add_distrib]

name: IsLocalRing.degree_chartExp
statement:
theorem degree_chartExp (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    (chartExp r α).degree = α.degree + ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· < r), α i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartExp, degree_add', Finsupp.degree_single]

name: IsLocalRing.sum_filter_lt_le_degree
statement: theorem sum_filter_lt_le_degree (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· < r), α i ≤ α.degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]
  exact sum_le_sum_of_subset (filter_subset _ _)

name: IsLocalRing.degree_chartExp_le
statement: theorem degree_chartExp_le (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) : (chartExp r α).degree ≤ 2 * α.degree
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_chartExp]
  have := sum_filter_lt_le_degree r α
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.degree_chartExp_sub_le
statement:
theorem degree_chartExp_sub_le {α : Fin n →₀ ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : α.degree = m) :
    (chartExp r α).degree - m ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_chartExp, h]
  have := sum_filter_lt_le_degree r α
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.hasSubst_chartSubst
statement: theorem hasSubst_chartSubst : HasSubst (chartSubst (K := K) r)
proof:
:=
  hasSubst_of_constantCoeff_zero fun i => by
    unfold chartSubst
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: IsLocalRing.chartSubst_prod
statement:
theorem chartSubst_prod (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    (α.prod fun s e => chartSubst (K := K) r s ^ e) = monomial (chartExp r α) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold Finsupp.prod
  have h1 : ∀ s ∈ α.support, chartSubst (K := K) r s ^ α s =
      monomial (Finsupp.single s (α s)) 1 * (if s < r then monomial (Finsupp.single r (α s)) 1
        else 1) := by
    intro s _
    unfold chartSubst
    split_ifs with hs
    · rw [mul_pow, X_pow_eq, X_pow_eq]
    · rw [mul_one, X_pow_eq]
  have hA : ∏ x ∈ α.support, monomial (Finsupp.single x (α x)) (1 : K) = monomial α 1 := by
    rw [prod_monomial, prod_const_one,
      show (∑ i ∈ α.support, Finsupp.single i (α i)) = α from Finsupp.sum_single α]
  have hsum : (∑ x ∈ α.support.filter (· < r), α x) = ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· < r), α i := by
    refine sum_subset (filter_subset_filter _ (subset_univ _)) fun i hi hi' => ?_
    by_contra hne
    exact hi' (mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hne, (mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩)
  have hB : (∏ x ∈ α.support, if x < r then monomial (Finsupp.single r (α x)) (1 : K) else 1) =
      monomial (Finsupp.single r (∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· < r), α i)) 1 := by
    rw [prod_ite, prod_const_one, mul_one, prod_monomial, prod_const_one,
      ← Finsupp.single_finsetSum, hsum]
  rw [prod_congr rfl h1, prod_mul_distrib, hA, hB, monomial_mul_monomial, mul_one]
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.coeff_subst_chartSubst
statement:
theorem coeff_subst_chartSubst (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) (α : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff (chartExp r α) (subst (chartSubst r) f) = coeff α f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_subst (hasSubst_chartSubst r), finsum_eq_single _ α]
  · rw [chartSubst_prod, coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left rfl, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  · intro d hd
    rw [chartSubst_prod, coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right (fun h => hd (chartExp_injective r h).symm),
      smul_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.coeff_subst_chartSubst_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_subst (hasSubst_chartSubst r)]
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun d => ?_
  by_cases hd : coeff d f = 0
  · rw [hd, zero_smul]
  · rw [chartSubst_prod, coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right (fun h => hβ d hd h.symm), smul_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.coeff_subst_chartSubst_eq_zero_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  refine coeff_subst_chartSubst_eq_zero r fun d hd h => ?_
  have := hP d hd
  rw [sum_filter_le_chartExp_apply_self, h] at this
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.exists_X_pow_mul_eq_subst_chartSubst
statement:
theorem exists_X_pow_mul_eq_subst_chartSubst {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} {m : ℕ}
    (hord : f.order = m) (hP : ∀ d, coeff d f ≠ 0 → m ≤ ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (· ≤ r), d i) :
    ∃ g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K, X r ^ m * g = subst (chartSubst (K := K) r) f ∧
      g.order ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K :=
    fun β => coeff (β + Finsupp.single r m) (subst (chartSubst (K := K) r) f) with hg
  have hcoeff : ∀ β, coeff β g =
      coeff (β + Finsupp.single r m) (subst (chartSubst (K := K) r) f) := fun β => rfl
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext β
    rw [X_pow_eq, coeff_monomial_mul]
    split_ifs with hle
    · rw [one_mul, hcoeff, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle]
    · rw [coeff_subst_chartSubst_eq_zero_of_lt r hP]
      have := (not_le.mp (fun h => hle (Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr h)) : β r < m)
      exact this
  · have hfin : f.order.toNat = f.order := by rw [hord]; simp
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hdeg⟩ := exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_order hfin
    rw [hord] at hdeg
    have hdeg' : d.degree = m := by exact_mod_cast hdeg
    have hle : Finsupp.single r m ≤ chartExp r d := by
      rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff, ← sum_filter_le_chartExp_apply_self]
      exact hP d hd
    have hne : coeff (chartExp r d - Finsupp.single r m) g ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hcoeff, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle, coeff_subst_chartSubst]
      exact hd
    refine (order_le hne).trans ?_
    have h1 : (chartExp r d - Finsupp.single r m).degree + (Finsupp.single r m).degree =
        (chartExp r d).degree := by
      rw [← degree_add', tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle]
    rw [Finsupp.degree_single] at h1
    have h2 := degree_chartExp_sub_le r hdeg'
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : (chartExp r d - Finsupp.single r m).degree ≤ m)

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.wsum_I
statement:
@[simp] theorem wsum_I {k : ℕ} (L : Fin k → MarkedIdeal R) :
    (wsum L).I = ∑ i, (L i).I ^ ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (L j).m
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.wsum_m
statement: @[simp] theorem wsum_m {k : ℕ} (L : Fin k → MarkedIdeal R) : (wsum L).m = ∏ j, (L j).m
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.wsum_two
statement: theorem wsum_two (J K : MarkedIdeal R) : wsum ![J, K] = ⟨J.I ^ K.m + K.I ^ J.m, J.m * K.m⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).erase 0 = {1} := by decide
  have h1 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).erase 1 = {0} := by decide
  unfold wsum
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.prod_univ_two, h0, h1, Finset.prod_singleton, Finset.prod_singleton]
  rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_wsum
statement:
theorem inCosupp_wsum [IsLocalRing R] {k : ℕ} {L : Fin k → MarkedIdeal R}
    (h : ∀ i, (L i).InCosupp) : (wsum L).InCosupp
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold InCosupp at *
  rw [wsum_I, wsum_m, le_ord_iff, Ideal.sum_eq_sup, Finset.sup_le_iff]
  intro i _
  have hi := le_ord_iff.mp (h i)
  calc (L i).I ^ ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (L j).m
      ≤ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ (L i).m) ^ ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (L j).m :=
        Ideal.pow_right_mono hi _
    _ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ ∏ j, (L j).m := by
        rw [← pow_mul]
        congr 1
        exact Finset.mul_prod_erase _ (fun j => (L j).m) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.pow_I
statement: @[simp] theorem pow_I (J : MarkedIdeal R) (k : ℕ) : (J ^ k).I = J.I ^ k
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.pow_m
statement: @[simp] theorem pow_m (J : MarkedIdeal R) (k : ℕ) : (J ^ k).m = J.m * k
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.homogenized_le_iff
statement:
theorem homogenized_le_iff {I J : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} :
    c.homogenized I μ ≤ J ↔ ∀ i < μ, c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  unfold homogenized
  rw [Ideal.sum_eq_sup, Finset.sup_le_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_range]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized
statement:
theorem Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized {I : Ideal R} {μ i : ℕ} (hi : i < μ) :
    c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i ≤ c.homogenized I μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold homogenized
  rw [Ideal.sum_eq_sup]
  exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun i => c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_homogenized
statement: theorem le_homogenized {I : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} (hμ : 0 < μ) : I ≤ c.homogenized I μ
proof:
:= by
  have := c.Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized (I := I) hμ
  simpa using this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.homogenized_one
statement: theorem homogenized_one (I : Ideal R) : c.homogenized I 1 = I
proof:
:= by
  simp [homogenized]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized'
statement:
theorem Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized' {I : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} (hμ : 1 ≤ μ) (i : ℕ) :
    c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i ≤ c.homogenized I μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i μ with hi | hi
  · exact c.Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized hi
  · calc c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i ≤ c.MC I μ ^ i := Ideal.mul_le_right
      _ ≤ c.MC I μ ^ μ := Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hi
      _ = c.Dpow (μ - 1) I * c.MC I μ ^ (μ - 1) := by
        change c.MC I μ ^ μ = c.MC I μ * c.MC I μ ^ (μ - 1)
        rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hμ]
      _ ≤ c.homogenized I μ := c.Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized (by omega)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.homogenized_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem homogenized_eq_iSup {I : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} (hμ : 1 ≤ μ) :
    c.homogenized I μ = ⨆ i : ℕ, c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (c.homogenized_le_iff.mpr fun i _ => le_iSup (fun i => c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i) i)
    (iSup_le fun i => c.Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized' hμ i)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.homogenized_le_W
statement: theorem homogenized_le_W {I : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} (hμ : 1 ≤ μ) : c.homogenized I μ ≤ c.W μ μ I
proof:
:= by
  refine c.homogenized_le_iff.mpr fun i hi => ?_
  calc c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i ≤ c.W μ (μ - i) I * c.W μ i I :=
        Ideal.mul_mono (c.Dpow_le_W_of_le hi.le I) (c.MC_pow_le_W hμ i I)
    _ ≤ c.W μ (μ - i + i) I := c.W_mul_le μ (μ - i) i I
    _ = c.W μ μ I := by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hi.le]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.markedD_mul_MC_pow
statement:
theorem markedD_mul_MC_pow (I : Ideal R) {μ i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ μ) :
    c.markedD ⟨I, μ⟩ i hi * (⟨c.MC I μ, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal R) ^ i =
      ⟨c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i, μ⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [MarkedIdeal.mul_def]
  simp only [markedD_I, markedD_m, MarkedIdeal.pow_I, MarkedIdeal.pow_m, one_mul]
  congr 1
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.homogenized_marked
statement:
theorem homogenized_marked (I : Ideal R) (μ : ℕ) :
    (⟨c.homogenized I μ, μ⟩ : MarkedIdeal R) =
      ⟨∑ i : Fin μ, (c.markedD ⟨I, μ⟩ i i.isLt.le * (⟨c.MC I μ, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal R) ^ (i : ℕ)).I,
        μ⟩
proof:
:= by
  congr 1
  unfold homogenized
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => c.Dpow i I * c.MC I μ ^ i) μ]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [c.markedD_mul_MC_pow I i.isLt.le]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.MC_D
statement: theorem MC_D {I : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} (hμ : 1 < μ) : c.MC (c.D I) (μ - 1) = c.MC I μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold MC
  rw [← Dpow_one, Dpow_Dpow]
  congr 1
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_finset_sum
statement:
theorem D_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ideal R) :
    c.D (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, c.D (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [D_bot]
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, Ideal.add_eq_sup, D_sup, ih,
      Ideal.add_eq_sup]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_homogenized_le
statement:
theorem D_homogenized_le {I : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} (hμ : 1 < μ) :
    c.D (c.homogenized I μ) ≤ c.homogenized (c.D I) (μ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ j : ℕ, c.Dpow (j + 1) I * c.MC I μ ^ j ≤ c.homogenized (c.D I) (μ - 1) := by
    intro j
    have := c.Dpow_mul_MC_pow_le_homogenized' (I := c.D I) (μ := μ - 1) (by omega) j
    rwa [c.MC_D hμ, ← Dpow_succ'] at this
  unfold homogenized
  rw [D_finset_sum, Ideal.sum_eq_sup, Finset.sup_le_iff]
  intro i _
  refine (c.D_mul_le _ _).trans (sup_le ?_ ?_)
  · rw [← Dpow_succ]
    exact key i
  · rcases i with _ | j
    · simp only [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, D_top, Dpow_zero, Ideal.mul_top]
      exact (c.le_D I).trans (c.le_homogenized (by omega))
    · calc c.Dpow (j + 1) I * c.D (c.MC I μ ^ (j + 1))
          ≤ c.Dpow (j + 1) I * (c.D (c.MC I μ) * c.MC I μ ^ (j + 1 - 1)) :=
            Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl (c.D_pow_le _ (by omega))
        _ ≤ c.Dpow (j + 1) I * c.MC I μ ^ j := by
            rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
            exact Ideal.mul_mono le_rfl Ideal.mul_le_right
        _ ≤ c.homogenized (c.D I) (μ - 1) := key j

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_W_le
statement:
theorem Dpow_W_le {m : ℕ} (I : Ideal R) {i s : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ s) :
    c.Dpow i (c.W m s I) ≤ c.W m (s - i) I
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [Dpow_succ]
    refine (c.D_mono (ih (by omega))).trans ?_
    have h := c.D_W_succ_le m (s - (i + 1)) I
    rwa [show s - (i + 1) + 1 = s - i by omega] at h

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.W_one_le_MC
statement: theorem W_one_le_MC {μ : ℕ} (I : Ideal R) : c.W μ 1 I ≤ c.MC I μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine c.W_le_iff.mpr fun e he => ?_
  obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero (s := Finset.univ)
    (f := fun j : Fin (μ + 1) => (μ - (j : ℕ)) * e j) (by
      unfold wt at he
      exact Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp he)
  rw [mul_ne_zero_iff] at hj
  calc ∏ l : Fin (μ + 1), c.Dpow l I ^ e l ≤ c.Dpow j I ^ e j := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]
        exact Ideal.mul_le_left
    _ ≤ c.Dpow j I := Ideal.pow_le_self hj.2
    _ ≤ c.MC I μ := c.Dpow_mono_left (by have := hj.1; omega) I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.MC_homogenized
statement:
theorem MC_homogenized {I : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} (hμ : 1 ≤ μ) :
    c.MC (c.homogenized I μ) μ = c.MC I μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (c.Dpow_mono _ (c.le_homogenized hμ))
  calc c.MC (c.homogenized I μ) μ ≤ c.Dpow (μ - 1) (c.W μ μ I) :=
        c.Dpow_mono _ (c.homogenized_le_W hμ)
    _ ≤ c.W μ (μ - (μ - 1)) I := c.Dpow_W_le I (by omega)
    _ = c.W μ 1 I := by rw [show μ - (μ - 1) = 1 by omega]
    _ ≤ c.MC I μ := c.W_one_le_MC I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.prod_fin_sub_eq_factorial
statement: theorem prod_fin_sub_eq_factorial (μ : ℕ) : ∏ i : Fin μ, (μ - (i : ℕ)) = μ.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun i => μ - i) μ, ← Finset.prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial,
    ← Finset.prod_range_reflect (fun i => i + 1) μ]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
  omega

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.coefficientIdeal_m
statement: theorem coefficientIdeal_m (I : Ideal R) (μ : ℕ) : (c.coefficientIdeal I μ).m = μ.factorial
proof:
:= by
  unfold coefficientIdeal
  rw [MarkedIdeal.wsum_m]
  simpa using prod_fin_sub_eq_factorial μ

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.coefficientIdeal_I
statement:
theorem coefficientIdeal_I (I : Ideal R) (μ : ℕ) :
    (c.coefficientIdeal I μ).I = ∑ i : Fin μ, c.Dpow i I ^ (μ.factorial / (μ - (i : ℕ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold coefficientIdeal
  rw [MarkedIdeal.wsum_I]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  simp only [markedD_I, markedD_m]
  congr 1
  refine (Nat.div_eq_of_eq_mul_left (by have := i.isLt; omega) ?_).symm
  rw [← prod_fin_sub_eq_factorial μ]
  exact (Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.coefficientIdeal_I_le_W
statement:
theorem coefficientIdeal_I_le_W (I : Ideal R) (μ : ℕ) :
    (c.coefficientIdeal I μ).I ≤ c.W μ μ.factorial I
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.coefficientIdeal_I, Ideal.sum_eq_sup, Finset.sup_le_iff]
  intro i _
  have hi := i.isLt
  have hdvd : μ - (i : ℕ) ∣ μ.factorial := Nat.dvd_factorial (by omega) (by omega)
  have := c.Dpow_pow_le_W μ ⟨i, by omega⟩ (μ.factorial / (μ - (i : ℕ))) I
  rwa [Fin.val_mk, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd] at this

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.inCosupp_coefficientIdeal
statement:
theorem inCosupp_coefficientIdeal {I : Ideal R} {μ : ℕ} (hI : (μ : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I) :
    (c.coefficientIdeal I μ).InCosupp
proof:
:=
  MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_wsum fun i => by
    change ((μ - (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.Dpow i I)
    exact c.le_ord_Dpow hI i.isLt.le

name: IsLocalRing.powers_shiftCoords_self
statement:
theorem powers_shiftCoords_self :
    Submonoid.powers (shiftCoords x r a r) = Submonoid.powers (x r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftCoords_self]

name: IsLocalRing.isLocalization_powers_shiftCoords
statement:
theorem isLocalization_powers_shiftCoords :
    IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers (shiftCoords x r a r)) (Localization.Away (x r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [powers_shiftCoords_self]
  infer_instance

name: IsLocalRing.awayEquivShift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayEquivShift_algebraMap (b : R) :
    awayEquivShift x r a (algebraMap R _ b) = algebraMap R _ b
proof:
:=
  (awayEquivShift x r a).commutes b

name: IsLocalRing.awayEquivShift_mk
statement:
theorem awayEquivShift_mk (b : R) :
    awayEquivShift x r a (Localization.mk b ⟨shiftCoords x r a r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩) =
      Localization.mk b ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hxr : algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (shiftCoords x r a r) := by
    rw [shiftCoords_self]
  have h1 : awayEquivShift x r a
      (Localization.mk b ⟨shiftCoords x r a r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩) *
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) = algebraMap R _ b := by
    rw [hxr, ← awayEquivShift_algebraMap, ← map_mul, Localization.mk_eq_mk',
      IsLocalization.mk'_spec, awayEquivShift_algebraMap]
  have h2 : Localization.mk b ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ *
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) = algebraMap R _ b := by
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_spec]
  exact (IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away (x r))
    ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩).mul_right_cancel (h1.trans h2.symm)

name: IsLocalRing.map_chartRing_awayEquivShift
statement:
theorem map_chartRing_awayEquivShift :
    (chartRing (shiftCoords x r a) r).map (awayEquivShift x r a : _ →ₐ[R] _) = chartRing x r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← chartRingOf_shiftCoords x r a, chartRing, chartRingOf, AlgHom.map_adjoin, Set.image_image]
  congr 1
  refine Set.image_congr fun i _ => ?_
  exact awayEquivShift_mk x r a (shiftCoords x r a i)

name: IsLocalRing.coe_chartRingEquivShift
statement:
theorem coe_chartRingEquivShift (z : chartRing (shiftCoords x r a) r) :
    (chartRingEquivShift x r a z : Localization.Away (x r)) = awayEquivShift x r a z
proof: := rfl

name: IsLocalRing.chartRingEquivShift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartRingEquivShift_algebraMap (b : R) :
    chartRingEquivShift x r a (algebraMap R _ b) = algebraMap R _ b
proof:
:=
  (chartRingEquivShift x r a).commutes b

name: IsLocalRing.chartRingEquivShift_chartYR_of_lt
statement:
theorem chartRingEquivShift_chartYR_of_lt {i : Fin n} (hi : i < r) :
    chartRingEquivShift x r a (chartYR (shiftCoords x r a) r i) =
      chartYR x r i - algebraMap R _ (a i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_chartRingEquivShift, coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_of_lt _ _ _ hi, awayEquivShift_mk,
    Subalgebra.coe_sub, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_of_lt _ _ _ hi]
  exact mk_shiftCoords_of_lt x r a hi

name: IsLocalRing.chartRingEquivShift_chartYR_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem chartRingEquivShift_chartYR_of_not_lt {j : Fin n} (hj : ¬ j < r) :
    chartRingEquivShift x r a (chartYR (shiftCoords x r a) r j) = chartYR x r j
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_chartRingEquivShift, coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_of_not_lt _ _ _ hj,
    awayEquivShift_algebraMap, coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_of_not_lt _ _ _ hj,
    shiftCoords_of_not_lt _ _ _ hj]

name: IsLocalRing.map_chartOrigin_chartRingEquivShift
statement:
theorem map_chartOrigin_chartRingEquivShift :
    (chartOrigin (shiftCoords x r a) r).map (chartRingEquivShift x r a) = chartOriginAt x r a
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (chartRingEquivShift x r a) ∘ chartYR (shiftCoords x r a) r = fun i : Fin n =>
      if i < r then chartYR x r i - algebraMap R _ (a i) else chartYR x r i := by
    funext i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact chartRingEquivShift_chartYR_of_lt x r a hi
    · exact chartRingEquivShift_chartYR_of_not_lt x r a hi
  rw [chartOrigin, chartOriginOf, Ideal.map_span, chartOriginAt, ← Set.range_comp, hf]

name: IsLocalRing.chartCenter_shiftCoords
statement: theorem chartCenter_shiftCoords : chartCenter (shiftCoords x r a) r = chartCenter x r
proof:
:=
  span_shiftCoords_le x r a

name: IsLocalRing.chartRingEquivShift_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartRingEquivShift_comp_algebraMap :
    (chartRingEquivShift x r a : chartRing (shiftCoords x r a) r →+* chartRing x r).comp
      (algebraMap R (chartRing (shiftCoords x r a) r)) = algebraMap R (chartRing x r)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext (chartRingEquivShift_algebraMap x r a)

name: IsLocalRing.map_transformIdeal_chartRingEquivShift
statement:
theorem map_transformIdeal_chartRingEquivShift {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m) :
    (transformIdeal (shiftCoords x r a) r I m).map
        (chartRingEquivShift x r a : chartRing (shiftCoords x r a) r →+* chartRing x r) =
      transformIdeal x r I m
proof:
:= by
  have hI' : I ≤ chartCenter (shiftCoords x r a) r ^ m := by rwa [chartCenter_shiftCoords]
  refine eq_transformIdeal_of_span_pow_mul_eq x r hI ?_
  have h := congrArg
    (Ideal.map (chartRingEquivShift x r a : chartRing (shiftCoords x r a) r →+* chartRing x r))
    (span_pow_mul_transformIdeal (shiftCoords x r a) r hI')
  rw [Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.map_map,
    chartRingEquivShift_comp_algebraMap] at h
  have hxr : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (shiftCoords x r a r) =
      algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (x r) := by
    rw [shiftCoords_self]
  rw [← h, RingHom.coe_coe, chartRingEquivShift_algebraMap, hxr]

name: IsLocalRing.map_primeCompl_chartRingEquivShift
statement:
theorem map_primeCompl_chartRingEquivShift :
    (chartOrigin (shiftCoords x r a) r).primeCompl.map
        (chartRingEquivShift x r a).toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom = (chartOriginAt x r a).primeCompl
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  have hmap : ∀ w, chartRingEquivShift x r a w ∈ chartOriginAt x r a ↔
      w ∈ chartOrigin (shiftCoords x r a) r := by
    intro w
    rw [← map_chartOrigin_chartRingEquivShift]
    constructor
    · intro hw
      obtain ⟨w', hw', hww'⟩ := Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _
        (chartRingEquivShift x r a).surjective |>.mp hw
      rwa [(chartRingEquivShift x r a).injective hww'] at hw'
    · exact fun hw => Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hw
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact fun hz => hw ((hmap w).mp hz)
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨(chartRingEquivShift x r a).symm z, fun hw => hz ?_,
      (chartRingEquivShift x r a).apply_symm_apply z⟩
    have := (hmap _).mpr hw
    rwa [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this

name: IsLocalRing.localizationEquivShift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem localizationEquivShift_algebraMap (z : chartRing (shiftCoords x r a) r) :
    localizationEquivShift x r a (algebraMap _ _ z) =
      algebraMap _ _ (chartRingEquivShift x r a z)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_eq _ z

name: IsLocalRing.localizationEquivShift_algebraMap_R
statement:
theorem localizationEquivShift_algebraMap_R (b : R) :
    localizationEquivShift x r a (algebraMap R _ b) = algebraMap R _ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (chartRing (shiftCoords x r a) r),
    localizationEquivShift_algebraMap, chartRingEquivShift_algebraMap,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (chartRing x r)]

name: IsLocalRing.map_transformIdeal_localizationEquivShift
statement:
theorem map_transformIdeal_localizationEquivShift {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I ≤ chartCenter x r ^ m) :
    ((transformIdeal (shiftCoords x r a) r I m).map
        (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin (shiftCoords x r a) r)))).map
        (localizationEquivShift x r a : _ →+* _) =
      (transformIdeal x r I m).map (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime (chartOriginAt x r a)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_map, ← map_transformIdeal_chartRingEquivShift x r a hI, Ideal.map_map]
  congr 1
  exact RingHom.ext (localizationEquivShift_algebraMap x r a)

name: IsLocalRing.Lcm_dvd_Lcm_succ
statement: theorem Lcm_dvd_Lcm_succ (n : ℕ) : Lcm n ∣ Lcm (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  Finset.lcm_dvd fun k hk => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
    change k ∣ Lcm (n + 1)
    exact dvd_Lcm (by omega) (by omega)

name: IsLocalRing.succ_dvd_Lcm_succ
statement: theorem succ_dvd_Lcm_succ (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : n + 1 ∣ Lcm (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  dvd_Lcm (by omega) le_rfl

name: IsLocalRing.Lcm_dvd_factorial
statement: theorem Lcm_dvd_factorial (m : ℕ) : Lcm m ∣ m !
proof:
:=
  Finset.lcm_dvd fun k hk => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
    change k ∣ Nat.factorial m
    exact Nat.dvd_factorial (by omega) h2

name: IsLocalRing.Lcm_succ
statement: theorem Lcm_succ (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Lcm (n + 1) = Nat.lcm (Lcm n) (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.dvd_antisymm
    (Finset.lcm_dvd fun k hk => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk
      change k ∣ Nat.lcm (Lcm n) (n + 1)
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (n + 1) with h | h
      · exact (dvd_Lcm (by omega) (by omega)).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _)
      · have : k = n + 1 := le_antisymm h2 h
        rw [this]
        exact Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)
    (Nat.lcm_dvd (Lcm_dvd_Lcm_succ n) (succ_dvd_Lcm_succ n hn))

name: IsLocalRing.mul_Lcm_succ_le
statement:
theorem mul_Lcm_succ_le {n d : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hd : d ∣ Lcm n) (hd' : d ∣ n + 1) :
    d * Lcm (n + 1) ≤ Lcm n * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lcm_succ n hn, ← Nat.gcd_mul_lcm (Lcm n) (n + 1)]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
    (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (Lcm_pos n)) (Nat.dvd_gcd hd hd'))

name: IsLocalRing.Lcm_succ_le
statement: theorem Lcm_succ_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Lcm (n + 1) ≤ Lcm n * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := mul_Lcm_succ_le hn (one_dvd (Lcm n)) (one_dvd (n + 1))
  simpa using this

name: IsLocalRing.mul_Lcm_le_factorial_step
statement:
theorem mul_Lcm_le_factorial_step {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (h1 : n * Lcm n ≤ n !)
    (h2 : (n + 1) * Lcm (n + 1) ≤ (n + 1)!) : (n + 2) * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ (n + 2)!
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ (n + 1)]
  refine Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ?_
  have hB : Lcm (n + 2) ≤ Lcm (n + 1) * (n + 2) := Lcm_succ_le (n + 1) (by omega)
  by_cases hp : Nat.Prime (n + 2)
  · have hodd : Odd (n + 2) := hp.odd_of_ne_two (by omega)
    have h2n : 2 ∣ n + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hodd
      exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
    have hA : 2 * Lcm (n + 1) ≤ Lcm n * (n + 1) :=
      mul_Lcm_succ_le (by omega) (dvd_Lcm (by omega) (by omega)) h2n
    have hfac : (n + 1)! = (n + 1) * n ! := Nat.factorial_succ n
    have hchain : 2 * n * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ n ! * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
      calc 2 * n * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ 2 * n * (Lcm (n + 1) * (n + 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hB
        _ = n * (2 * Lcm (n + 1)) * (n + 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ n * (Lcm n * (n + 1)) * (n + 2) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hA)
        _ = n * Lcm n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ n ! * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h1)
    have : 2 * n * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ 2 * n * (n + 1)! := by
      calc 2 * n * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ n ! * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := hchain
        _ ≤ n ! * (n + 1) * (2 * n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
        _ = 2 * n * (n + 1)! := by rw [hfac]; ring
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left this (by omega)
  · have hne1 : n + 2 ≠ 1 := by omega
    have hmin := Nat.minFac_dvd (n + 2)
    have hmin2 : 2 ≤ Nat.minFac (n + 2) := (Nat.minFac_prime hne1).two_le
    have hminlt : Nat.minFac (n + 2) < n + 2 := (Nat.not_prime_iff_minFac_lt (by omega)).mp hp
    have hA : Nat.minFac (n + 2) * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ Lcm (n + 1) * (n + 2) :=
      mul_Lcm_succ_le (by omega) (dvd_Lcm (by omega) (by omega)) hmin
    have hA2 : 2 * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ Lcm (n + 1) * (n + 2) :=
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hmin2).trans hA
    have hchain : 2 * (n + 1) * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ (n + 1)! * (n + 2) := by
      calc 2 * (n + 1) * Lcm (n + 2) = (n + 1) * (2 * Lcm (n + 2)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (n + 1) * (Lcm (n + 1) * (n + 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hA2
        _ = (n + 1) * Lcm (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ (n + 1)! * (n + 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h2
    have : 2 * (n + 1) * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ 2 * (n + 1) * (n + 1)! := by
      calc 2 * (n + 1) * Lcm (n + 2) ≤ (n + 1)! * (n + 2) := hchain
        _ ≤ (n + 1)! * (2 * (n + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
        _ = 2 * (n + 1) * (n + 1)! := by ring
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left this (by omega)

name: IsLocalRing.mul_Lcm_le_factorial
statement: theorem mul_Lcm_le_factorial {m : ℕ} (hm : 6 ≤ m) : m * Lcm m ≤ m !
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ k, (k + 6) * Lcm (k + 6) ≤ (k + 6)! ∧ (k + 7) * Lcm (k + 7) ≤ (k + 7)! := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨by decide, by decide⟩
    | succ k ih => exact ⟨ih.2, mul_Lcm_le_factorial_step (by omega) ih.1 ih.2⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 6 := ⟨m - 6, by omega⟩
  exact (key k).1

name: IsLocalRing.sub_one_mul_Lcm_le_factorial
statement: theorem sub_one_mul_Lcm_le_factorial {m : ℕ} (hm : 6 ≤ m) : (m - 1) * Lcm m ≤ m !
proof:
:=
  (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.sub_le m 1)).trans (mul_Lcm_le_factorial hm)

name: IsLocalRing.exists_factorial_eq_mul_Lcm
statement:
theorem exists_factorial_eq_mul_Lcm {m : ℕ} (hm : m = 1 ∨ m = 2 ∨ 6 ≤ m) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, m ! = r * Lcm m ∧ m - 1 ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨m ! / Lcm m, (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Lcm_dvd_factorial m)).symm, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Lcm_pos m)]
  rcases hm with rfl | rfl | hm
  · decide
  · decide
  · exact sub_one_mul_Lcm_le_factorial hm

name: IsLocalRing.one_le_tuningParam
statement: theorem one_le_tuningParam (m : ℕ) : 1 ≤ tuningParam m
proof:
:= by
  change 1 * 1 ≤ max (m - 1) 1 * Lcm m
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul (le_max_right _ _) (Lcm_pos m)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isDBalanced_W_factorial
statement:
theorem isDBalanced_W_factorial {m : ℕ} (hm : m = 1 ∨ m = 2 ∨ 6 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R}
    (hI : ord I ≤ m) : c.IsDBalanced (c.W m (m !) I) (m !)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ := exists_factorial_eq_mul_Lcm hm
  rw [hr]
  exact c.isDBalanced_W (by omega) hI hr'

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isDBalanced_W_tuningParam
statement:
theorem isDBalanced_W_tuningParam {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I ≤ m) :
    c.IsDBalanced (c.W m (tuningParam m) I) (tuningParam m)
proof:
:=
  c.isDBalanced_W hm hI (le_max_left _ _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isMCInvariant_W_tuningParam
statement:
theorem isMCInvariant_W_tuningParam {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I ≤ m) :
    c.IsMCInvariant (c.W m (tuningParam m) I) (tuningParam m)
proof:
:=
  c.isMCInvariant_W hm hI (one_le_tuningParam m)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.ord_W_tuningParam
statement:
theorem ord_W_tuningParam {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I = m) :
    ord (c.W m (tuningParam m) I) = tuningParam m
proof:
:=
  c.ord_W hm hI _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) (j : Fin n) :
    c.pderiv j f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with _ | m
  · simp
  · have h := (c.D_pow_le (chartCenter c.x r) (Nat.succ_pos m)) (c.pderiv_mem_D hf j)
    simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one] at h ⊢
    exact Ideal.mul_le_right h

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_le_chartCenter_pow
statement:
theorem D_le_chartCenter_pow {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    c.D I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ m
proof:
:=
  c.D_le_iff.mpr ⟨hI.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ m)), fun j f hf => by
    have := c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r (hI hf) j
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this⟩

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mk_eq_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow
statement:
theorem mk_eq_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow (f : R) (m : ℕ) :
    Localization.mk f ⟨c.x r ^ m, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers _) m⟩ =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) f * invX c.x r ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, invX, Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_mul]
  congr 1
  · simp
  · exact Subtype.ext (by simp)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.algebraMap_mul_invX_pow_succ
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mul_invX_pow_succ (m : ℕ) :
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x r) * invX c.x r ^ (m + 1) = invX c.x r ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (algebraMap R _ (c.x r)), mul_assoc, algebraMap_mul_invX,
    mul_one]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_invX_pow
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_invX_pow (j : Fin n) (m : ℕ) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (invX c.x r ^ m) =
      -((m : ℕ) • (invX c.x r ^ (m + 1) * if j = r then 1 else 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.leibniz_pow, awayPderiv_invX]
  rcases m with _ | m
  · simp
  · rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow (j : Fin n) (f : R) (m : ℕ) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) f * invX c.x r ^ m) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.pderiv j f) * invX c.x r ^ m -
        (m : ℕ) • (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) f * invX c.x r ^ (m + 1) *
          if j = r then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, awayPderiv_invX_pow, awayPderiv_algebraMap, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
    nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.coe_transformElem_eq
statement:
theorem coe_transformElem_eq (f : R) {m : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) :
    (transformElem c.x r f hf : Localization.Away (c.x r)) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) f * invX c.x r ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_transformElem, mk_eq_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transform_pderiv_lt
statement:
theorem transform_pderiv_lt {j : Fin n} (hj : j < r) {m : ℕ} {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    transformElem (m := m) c.x r (c.pderiv j f)
        (by simpa using c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r hf j) =
      c.chartDerivRing r j (transformElem c.x r f hf)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [coe_chartDerivRing, coe_transformElem_eq, coe_transformElem_eq, chartDeriv_of_lt _ _ hj,
    Derivation.smul_apply, awayPderiv_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow, ite_eq_right hj.ne, mul_zero,
    nsmul_zero, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm, algebraMap_mul_invX_pow_succ]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transform_pderiv_gt
statement:
theorem transform_pderiv_gt {j : Fin n} (hj : r < j) {m : ℕ} {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    transformElem (m := m) c.x r (c.pderiv j f)
        (by simpa using c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r hf j) =
      chartYR c.x r r * c.chartDerivRing r j (transformElem c.x r f hf)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_chartDerivRing, coe_transformElem_eq, coe_transformElem_eq,
    chartDeriv_of_gt _ _ hj, coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_self, awayPderiv_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow,
    ite_eq_right hj.ne', mul_zero, nsmul_zero, sub_zero, mul_left_comm,
    algebraMap_mul_invX_pow_succ]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transform_pderiv_eq
statement:
theorem transform_pderiv_eq {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    transformElem (m := m) c.x r (c.pderiv r f)
        (by simpa using c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r hf r) =
      chartYR c.x r r * c.chartDerivRing r r (transformElem c.x r f hf) -
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < r),
          chartYR c.x r i * c.chartDerivRing r i (transformElem c.x r f hf) +
        (m + 1) • transformElem c.x r f hf
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  have hx1 := c.algebraMap_mul_invX_pow_succ r m
  have hx2 := c.algebraMap_mul_invX_pow_succ r (m + 1)
  
  have hsum : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < r),
      (((chartYR c.x r i * c.chartDerivRing r i (transformElem c.x r f hf) : chartRing c.x r)) :
        Localization.Away (c.x r)) =
        algebraMap R _ (c.x r) * (chartY c.x r i *
          (algebraMap R _ (c.pderiv i f) * invX c.x r ^ (m + 1))) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_chartDerivRing, coe_transformElem_eq, chartDeriv_of_lt _ _ hi',
      Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, coe_chartYROf, awayPderiv_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow,
      ite_eq_right hi'.ne, mul_zero, nsmul_zero, sub_zero]
    ring
  have hinner : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < r),
      (chartY c.x r i • c.awayPderiv r i) (algebraMap R _ f * invX c.x r ^ (m + 1)) =
        chartY c.x r i * (algebraMap R _ (c.pderiv i f) * invX c.x r ^ (m + 1)) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, awayPderiv_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow, ite_eq_right hi'.ne,
      mul_zero, nsmul_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, Subalgebra.coe_sub, Subalgebra.coe_mul, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl hsum, ← Finset.mul_sum, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_nsmul, coe_chartDerivRing,
    coe_transformElem_eq, coe_transformElem_eq, chartDeriv_self, Derivation.add_apply,
    Derivation.finset_sum_apply, Finset.sum_congr rfl hinner, coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_self,
    awayPderiv_algebraMap_mul_invX_pow, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one, nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (-(algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.pderiv r f))) * hx1 +
    (((m + 1 : ℕ) : Localization.Away (c.x r)) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) f) * hx2

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transform_x_pderiv
statement:
theorem transform_x_pderiv {j : Fin n} (hj : j < r) {m : ℕ} {f : R}
    (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    transformElem (m := m) c.x r (c.x j * c.pderiv j f)
        (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (by simpa using c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r hf j)) =
      chartYR c.x r r * chartYR c.x r j * c.chartDerivRing r j (transformElem c.x r f hf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← transform_pderiv_lt c r hj hf]
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_transformElem_eq, coe_transformElem_eq,
    coe_chartYROf, coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_self, chartYOf_of_lt _ _ _ hj,
    mk_eq_algebraMap_mul_invX, map_mul]
  have hx := algebraMap_mul_invX c.x r
  linear_combination (-(algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x j) *
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.pderiv j f) * invX c.x r ^ m)) * hx

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_chartD
statement: theorem le_chartD (J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) : J ≤ c.chartD r J
proof: := le_sup_left

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDerivRing_mem_chartD
statement:
theorem chartDerivRing_mem_chartD {J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)} {z : chartRing c.x r} (hz : z ∈ J)
    (j : Fin n) : c.chartDerivRing r j z ∈ c.chartD r J
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem j (Ideal.subset_span ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transformElem_add
statement:
theorem transformElem_add {m : ℕ} {f g : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m)
    (hg : g ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) (hfg : f + g ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) :
    transformElem c.x r (f + g) hfg = transformElem c.x r f hf + transformElem c.x r g hg
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
  rw [mul_add, algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem, algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem, map_add]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transformElem_smul
statement:
theorem transformElem_smul {m : ℕ} (a : R) {g : R} (hg : g ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m)
    (hag : a • g ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) :
    transformElem c.x r (a • g) hag = algebraMap R _ a * transformElem c.x r g hg
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
  rw [mul_left_comm, algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem, ← map_mul, smul_eq_mul]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transformElem_zero
statement:
theorem transformElem_zero {m : ℕ} (h0 : (0 : R) ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) :
    transformElem c.x r 0 h0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
  rw [mul_zero, map_zero]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transformElem_succ
statement:
theorem transformElem_succ {m : ℕ} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1))
    (hf' : f ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m) :
    transformElem c.x r f hf' = algebraMap R _ (c.x r) * transformElem c.x r f hf
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply eq_transformElem_of_pow_mul_eq
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transform_D_le_chartD
statement:
theorem transform_D_le_chartD {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hI : I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ (m + 1)) :
    transformIdeal c.x r (c.D I) m ≤ c.chartD r (transformIdeal c.x r I (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDI : c.D I ≤ chartCenter c.x r ^ m := c.D_le_chartCenter_pow r hI
  have hDspan := c.D_span (I : Set R)
  rw [Ideal.span_eq] at hDspan
  have hT : ∀ (f : R) (hf : f ∈ I),
      transformElem c.x r f (hI hf) ∈ transformIdeal c.x r I (m + 1) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [transformIdeal_eq_span_range_transformElem _ _ hI]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩
  have hgen : ∀ (f : R) (hf : f ∈ I) (j : Fin n),
      transformElem (m := m) c.x r (c.pderiv j f)
          (by simpa using c.pderiv_mem_chartCenter_pow r (hI hf) j) ∈
        c.chartD r (transformIdeal c.x r I (m + 1)) := by
    intro f hf j
    rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hj | hj | hj
    · rw [c.transform_pderiv_lt r hj (hI hf)]
      exact c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartD r (hT f hf) j
    · subst hj
      rw [c.transform_pderiv_eq j (hI hf)]
      refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.sub_mem _ ?_ ?_) ?_
      · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartD j (hT f hf) j)
      · exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
          Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartD j (hT f hf) i)
      · exact nsmul_mem (c.le_chartD j _ (hT f hf)) _
    · rw [c.transform_pderiv_gt r hj (hI hf)]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.chartDerivRing_mem_chartD r (hT f hf) j)
  suffices key : ∀ g, g ∈ Ideal.span ((I : Set R) ∪ ⋃ j, c.pderiv j '' (I : Set R)) →
      ∀ hg : g ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m,
        transformElem c.x r g hg ∈ c.chartD r (transformIdeal c.x r I (m + 1)) by
    rw [transformIdeal_eq_span_range_transformElem _ _ hDI]
    refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, rfl⟩
    exact key g (hDspan ▸ hg) (hDI hg)
  intro g hg
  induction hg using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem g hmem =>
    intro hgP
    rcases hmem with hgI | hgD
    · rw [c.transformElem_succ r (hI hgI) hgP]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (c.le_chartD r _ (hT g hgI))
    · obtain ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, f, hfI, rfl⟩ := hgD
      exact hgen f hfI j
  | zero =>
    intro h0
    rw [c.transformElem_zero r h0]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  | add g₁ g₂ hg₁ hg₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro hsum
    have h₁ : g₁ ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m := hDI (hDspan ▸ hg₁)
    have h₂ : g₂ ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m := hDI (hDspan ▸ hg₂)
    rw [c.transformElem_add r h₁ h₂ hsum]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (ih₁ h₁) (ih₂ h₂)
  | smul a g hg ih =>
    intro hag
    have h₁ : g ∈ chartCenter c.x r ^ m := hDI (hDspan ▸ hg)
    rw [c.transformElem_smul r a h₁ hag]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (ih h₁)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_Dimg_chartRing
statement: theorem le_Dimg_chartRing (J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) : J ≤ Dimg J
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have h1 : c.chartDerivRing r r (chartYR c.x r r * z) =
      z + chartYR c.x r r * c.chartDerivRing r r z := by
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [coe_chartDerivRing, Subalgebra.coe_add, Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_mul,
      coe_chartDerivRing, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, coe_chartYROf,
      chartDeriv_chartY, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one, add_comm]
  have h2 : z = c.chartDerivRing r r (chartYR c.x r r * z) -
      chartYR c.x r r * c.chartDerivRing r r z := by rw [h1]; ring
  rw [h2]
  unfold Dimg
  refine Ideal.mem_iSup_of_mem (c.chartDerivRing r r) (Ideal.sub_mem _ ?_ ?_)
  · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hz, rfl⟩
  · exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartD_le_Dimg
statement: theorem chartD_le_Dimg (J : Ideal (chartRing c.x r)) : c.chartD r J ≤ Dimg J
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := c.le_Dimg_chartRing r J
  unfold chartD Dimg at h1 ⊢
  exact sup_le h1 (iSup_le fun j => le_iSup
    (fun δ : Derivation ℚ (chartRing c.x r) (chartRing c.x r) => Ideal.span (δ '' J))
    (c.chartDerivRing r j))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transform_D_le_Dimg_transform
proof:
:=
  (c.transform_D_le_chartD r hI).trans (c.chartD_le_Dimg r _)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.smul_awayPderiv_of_lt
statement:
theorem smul_awayPderiv_of_lt {j : Fin n} (hj : j < r) :
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x r) • c.awayPderiv r j = c.chartDeriv r j
proof:
:=
  (chartDeriv_of_lt c r hj).symm

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.smul_awayPderiv_of_gt
statement:
theorem smul_awayPderiv_of_gt {j : Fin n} (hj : r < j) :
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x r) • c.awayPderiv r j =
      chartY c.x r r • c.chartDeriv r j
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartDeriv_of_gt c r hj, chartY, chartYOf_self]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.smul_awayPderiv_self
statement:
theorem smul_awayPderiv_self :
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x r) • c.awayPderiv r r =
      chartY c.x r r • c.chartDeriv r r -
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < r), chartY c.x r i • c.chartDeriv r i
proof:
:= by
  refine Derivation.ext fun z => ?_
  have hsum : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < r),
      (chartY c.x r i • c.chartDeriv r i) z =
        algebraMap R _ (c.x r) * (chartY c.x r i * c.awayPderiv r i z) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, chartDeriv_of_lt _ _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2,
      Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [Derivation.sub_apply, Derivation.finset_sum_apply, Finset.sum_congr rfl hsum,
    ← Finset.mul_sum,
    Derivation.smul_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, chartDeriv_self, Derivation.add_apply,
    Derivation.finset_sum_apply, chartY, chartYOf_self, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.smul_awayPderiv_mem
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hj | hj | hj
  · rw [smul_awayPderiv_of_lt c r hj]
    exact c.chartDeriv_mem r j hz
  · subst hj
    rw [smul_awayPderiv_self, Derivation.sub_apply, Derivation.finset_sum_apply,
      Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    refine Subalgebra.sub_mem _ (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (chartY_mem _ _ _) (c.chartDeriv_mem j j hz))
      (Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (chartY_mem _ _ _) (c.chartDeriv_mem j i hz)
  · rw [smul_awayPderiv_of_gt c r hj, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (chartY_mem _ _ _) (c.chartDeriv_mem r j hz)

name: Derivation.finset_sum_apply
statement:
theorem finset_sum_apply {ι M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [Module A M]
    (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → Derivation k A M) (z : A) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, D i) z = ∑ i ∈ s, D i z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, Derivation.add_apply, ih]

name: Derivation.extendAway_algebraMap
statement:
theorem extendAway_algebraMap (D : Derivation k A A) (a f : A) :
    D.extendAway a (algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) f) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) (D f)
proof:
:=
  D.localization_algebraMap _ f

name: Derivation.eq_extendAway_of_algebraMap
statement:
theorem eq_extendAway_of_algebraMap (D : Derivation k A A) (a : A)
    (D' : Derivation k (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away a))
    (h : ∀ f, D' (algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) f) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) (D f)) :
    D' = D.extendAway a
proof:
:=
  D.eq_localization_of_algebraMap _ D' h

name: Derivation.extendAway_mk
statement:
theorem extendAway_mk (D : Derivation k A A) (a f : A) (m : ℕ) :
    D.extendAway a (Localization.mk f ⟨a ^ m, pow_mem (Submonoid.mem_powers a) m⟩) =
      Localization.mk (a * D f - (m : A) * f * D a)
        ⟨a ^ (m + 1), pow_mem (Submonoid.mem_powers a) (m + 1)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendAway, Derivation.localization_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, Submonoid.coe_one, one_mul]
  cases m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m =>
    rw [Derivation.leibniz_pow, Nat.succ_sub_one, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    ring

name: IsLocalRing.x_ne_zero_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem x_ne_zero_of_span_eq (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (i : Fin n) : x i ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h => notMem_sq_of_span_eq x hx hn i (h ▸ zero_mem _)

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_away_injective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_away_injective (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)))
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.injective (Localization.Away (x r))
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors (x_ne_zero_of_span_eq x hx hn r))

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_chartRing_injective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_chartRing_injective (hx : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap R (chartRing x r))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply algebraMap_away_injective x r hx hn
  have := congrArg (fun z : chartRing x r => (z : Localization.Away (x r))) hab
  simpa using this

name: IsLocalRing.chartPresentation_surjective
statement: theorem chartPresentation_surjective : Function.Surjective (chartPresentation x r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AlgHom.range_eq_top, chartPresentation, MvPolynomial.aeval_range, eq_top_iff]
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ -
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction
    (p := fun z hz => (⟨z, hz⟩ : chartRing x r) ∈
      Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range fun i : Fin r => chartYR x r (Fin.castLE r.2.le i)))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    refine Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    simp [chartYOf_of_lt _ _ _ hi]
  · intro a
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ a
  · intro z w _ _ hz' hw'
    exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hz' hw'
  · intro z w _ _ hz' hw'
    exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hz' hw'

name: IsLocalRing.algebraMap_mul_invX
statement: theorem algebraMap_mul_invX : algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) * invX x r = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
  exact Localization.mk_self ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩

name: IsLocalRing.mk_eq_algebraMap_mul_invX
statement:
theorem mk_eq_algebraMap_mul_invX (b : R) :
    Localization.mk b ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) b * invX x r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul, mul_one, one_mul]

name: IsLocalRing.chartY_eq_mk_of_lt
statement:
theorem chartY_eq_mk_of_lt {k : Fin n} (hk : k < r) :
    chartY x r k = Localization.mk (x k) ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩
proof:
:=
  chartYOf_of_lt _ _ _ hk

name: IsLocalRing.chartY_eq_algebraMap_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem chartY_eq_algebraMap_of_not_lt {k : Fin n} (hk : ¬ k < r) :
    chartY x r k = algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x k)
proof:
:=
  chartYOf_of_not_lt _ _ _ hk

name: IsLocalRing.chartY_of_lt
statement:
theorem chartY_of_lt {k : Fin n} (hk : k < r) :
    chartY x r k = algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x k) * invX x r
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartY_eq_mk_of_lt x r hk, mk_eq_algebraMap_mul_invX]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_algebraMap (j : Fin n) (a : R) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) a) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.pderiv j a)
proof:
:=
  Derivation.localization_algebraMap _ _ a

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_algebraMap_x
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_algebraMap_x (j i : Fin n) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x i)) =
      if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayPderiv_algebraMap, c.pderiv_x]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_invX
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_invX (j : Fin n) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (invX c.x r) = -(invX c.x r ^ 2 * if j = r then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : invX c.x r * algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x r) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact algebraMap_mul_invX c.x r
  rw [(c.awayPderiv r j).leibniz_of_mul_eq_one hu, awayPderiv_algebraMap_x, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt (j : Fin n) {k : Fin n} (hk : k < r) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (chartY c.x r k) =
      (if j = k then 1 else 0) * invX c.x r -
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x k) * invX c.x r ^ 2 *
          (if j = r then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartY_of_lt c.x r hk, Derivation.leibniz, awayPderiv_algebraMap_x, awayPderiv_invX,
    smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_chartY_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_chartY_of_not_lt (j : Fin n) {k : Fin n} (hk : ¬ k < r) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (chartY c.x r k) = if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartY_eq_algebraMap_of_not_lt c.x r hk, awayPderiv_algebraMap_x]

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_chartY
statement:
theorem chartDeriv_chartY (j k : Fin n) :
    c.chartDeriv r j (chartY c.x r k) = if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hu := algebraMap_mul_invX c.x r
  rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hj | hjr | hj
  · rw [c.chartDeriv_of_lt r hj, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hk : k < r
    · rw [awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt c r j hk, ite_eq_right hj.ne]
      split_ifs
      · linear_combination hu
      · ring
    · rw [awayPderiv_chartY_of_not_lt c r j hk]
      have hjk : j ≠ k := fun h => hk (h ▸ hj)
      simp [hjk]
  · rw [hjr, c.chartDeriv_self r, Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.finset_sum_apply]
    simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hk : k < r
    · rw [awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt c r r hk, ite_eq_left (rfl : r = r), ite_eq_right hk.ne']
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
      · rw [awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt c r k hk, ite_eq_left (rfl : k = k), ite_eq_right hk.ne,
          chartY_of_lt c.x r hk]
        ring
      · intro i hi hik
        rw [awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt c r i hk, ite_eq_right hik,
          ite_eq_right (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2.ne]
        ring
      · intro hk'
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk⟩ :
          k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i < r)) hk'
    · rw [awayPderiv_chartY_of_not_lt c r r hk]
      have : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i < r),
          chartY c.x r i * c.awayPderiv r i (chartY c.x r k) = 0 := by
        intro i hi
        rw [awayPderiv_chartY_of_not_lt c r i hk,
          ite_eq_right (fun (h : i = k) => hk (h ▸ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2)), mul_zero]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero this, add_zero]
  · rw [c.chartDeriv_of_gt r hj]
    by_cases hk : k < r
    · rw [awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt c r j hk, ite_eq_right hj.ne', ite_eq_right (hk.trans hj).ne']
      ring
    · exact awayPderiv_chartY_of_not_lt c r j hk

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_algebraMap_mem
statement:
theorem chartDeriv_algebraMap_mem (j : Fin n) (a : R) :
    c.chartDeriv r j (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) a) ∈ chartRing c.x r
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hj | hjr | hj
  · rw [c.chartDeriv_of_lt r hj, Derivation.smul_apply, awayPderiv_algebraMap, smul_eq_mul,
      ← map_mul]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
  · rw [hjr, c.chartDeriv_self r, Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.finset_sum_apply,
      awayPderiv_algebraMap]
    refine Subalgebra.add_mem _ (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _) (Subalgebra.sum_mem _ ?_)
    intro i _
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, awayPderiv_algebraMap, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (chartY_mem _ _ _) (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _)
  · rw [c.chartDeriv_of_gt r hj, awayPderiv_algebraMap]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.chartDeriv_mem
statement:
theorem chartDeriv_mem (j : Fin n) {z : Localization.Away (c.x r)} (hz : z ∈ chartRing c.x r) :
    c.chartDeriv r j z ∈ chartRing c.x r
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun z _ => c.chartDeriv r j z ∈ chartRing c.x r)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    have hi' : i < r := hi
    change c.chartDeriv r j (Localization.mk (c.x i) ⟨c.x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩) ∈
      chartRing c.x r
    rw [← chartY_eq_mk_of_lt c.x r hi', chartDeriv_chartY]
    split_ifs
    · exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
    · exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
  · exact chartDeriv_algebraMap_mem c r j
  · intro z w _ _ hz' hw'
    rw [Derivation.map_add]
    exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hz' hw'
  · intro z w hz hw hz' hw'
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hz hw') (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hw hz')

name: IsLocalRing.exists_algebraMap_sub_mem_chartOriginOf
statement:
theorem exists_algebraMap_sub_mem_chartOriginOf (d : R) (z : chartRingOf x r d) :
    ∃ a : R, z - algebraMap R _ a ∈ chartOriginOf x r d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := z
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction
    (p := fun z hz => ∃ a : R, (⟨z, hz⟩ : chartRingOf x r d) - algebraMap R _ a ∈
      chartOriginOf x r d) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [map_zero, sub_zero]
    have : (⟨Localization.mk (x i) ⟨d, Submonoid.mem_powers d⟩,
        Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩⟩ : chartRingOf x r d) = chartYROf x r d i :=
      Subtype.ext (chartYOf_of_lt x r d hi).symm
    rw [this]
    exact chartYROf_mem_chartOriginOf x r d i
  · intro a
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    rw [show (⟨algebraMap R (Localization.Away d) a, Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ a⟩ :
      chartRingOf x r d) = algebraMap R _ a from rfl, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  · rintro z w hz hw ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine ⟨a + b, ?_⟩
    have : (⟨z + w, Subalgebra.add_mem _ hz hw⟩ : chartRingOf x r d) - algebraMap R _ (a + b) =
        (⟨z, hz⟩ - algebraMap R _ a) + (⟨w, hw⟩ - algebraMap R _ b) :=
      Subtype.ext (by simp; ring)
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem ha hb
  · rintro z w hz hw ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine ⟨a * b, ?_⟩
    have : (⟨z * w, Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hz hw⟩ : chartRingOf x r d) - algebraMap R _ (a * b) =
        ⟨z, hz⟩ * (⟨w, hw⟩ - algebraMap R _ b) +
          algebraMap R _ b * (⟨z, hz⟩ - algebraMap R _ a) :=
      Subtype.ext (by simp; ring)
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hb) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ha)

name: IsLocalRing.one_notMem_chartOriginOf
statement:
theorem one_notMem_chartOriginOf (d : R) (hd : d = x r)
