    (fun k _ => mem_degreeSet.mpr (degree_countVec k))]
  simp

name: Analytic.summable_sum_degreeSet
statement:
theorem summable_sum_degreeSet {w : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ ν, 0 ≤ w ν) (hw : Summable w) :
    Summable fun n => ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, w ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine summable_of_sum_le (c := ∑' ν, w ν) (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg fun ν _ => hw0 ν)
    fun s => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_biUnion (pairwiseDisjoint_degreeSet s)]
  exact hw.sum_le_tsum _ fun ν _ => hw0 ν

name: Analytic.summable_of_summable_sum_degreeSet
statement:
theorem summable_of_summable_sum_degreeSet {w : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) → ℝ} (hw0 : ∀ ν, 0 ≤ w ν)
    (hs : Summable fun n => ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, w ν) : Summable w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine summable_of_sum_le (c := ∑' n, ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, w ν) hw0 fun s => ?_
  calc ∑ ν ∈ s, w ν ≤ ∑ ν ∈ (s.image Finsupp.degree).biUnion (degreeSet m), w ν := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun ν hν => ?_) fun ν _ _ => hw0 ν
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨ν.degree, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hν,
          mem_degreeSet.mpr rfl⟩
    _ = ∑ n ∈ s.image Finsupp.degree, ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, w ν :=
        Finset.sum_biUnion (pairwiseDisjoint_degreeSet _)
    _ ≤ ∑' n, ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, w ν :=
        hs.sum_le_tsum _ fun n _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun ν _ => hw0 ν

name: Analytic.hasSum_sum_degreeSet
statement:
theorem hasSum_sum_degreeSet {g : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) → E} {a : E} (hg : HasSum g a) :
    HasSum (fun n => ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, g ν) a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he := (Equiv.hasSum_iff (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv fun ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ => ν.degree)).mpr hg
  refine he.sigma fun n => ?_
  have : Fintype {ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ // ν.degree = n} :=
    Fintype.ofFinset (degreeSet m n) fun _ => mem_degreeSet
  rw [Finset.sum_subtype (degreeSet m n) (fun _ => mem_degreeSet) g]
  exact hasSum_fintype fun c : {ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ // ν.degree = n} => g c.1

name: Analytic.hasSum_sum_antidiagonal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he := (Equiv.hasSum_iff
    (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv fun p : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) × (Fin m →₀ ℕ) => p.1 + p.2)).mpr hh
  refine he.sigma fun ν => ?_
  have : Fintype {p : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) × (Fin m →₀ ℕ) // p.1 + p.2 = ν} :=
    Fintype.ofFinset (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν)
      fun _ => Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal
  rw [Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν)
    (fun _ => Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal) h]
  exact hasSum_fintype fun c : {p : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) × (Fin m →₀ ℕ) // p.1 + p.2 = ν} => h c.1

name: Analytic.prod_map_expList
statement:
theorem prod_map_expList (x : Fin m → R) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    ((expList ν).map x).prod = monomialEval x ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [expList, ← Multiset.prod_coe, ← Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.coe_toList,
    Finsupp.toMultiset_map, Finsupp.prod_toMultiset, monomialEval,
    Finsupp.prod_mapDomain_index (fun _ => pow_zero _) fun _ _ _ => pow_add _ _ _]

name: Analytic.monomialEval_sum
statement:
theorem monomialEval_sum (x : Fin m → R) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    monomialEval x (∑ i ∈ s, g i) = ∏ i ∈ s, monomialEval x (g i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, monomialEval_add, ih]

name: Analytic.monomialEval_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem monomialEval_single (x : Fin m → R) (j : Fin m) :
    monomialEval x (Finsupp.single j 1) = x j
proof:
:= by
  simp [monomialEval, Finsupp.prod_single_index]

name: Analytic.monomialEval_countVec
statement:
theorem monomialEval_countVec (x : Fin m → R) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n → Fin m) :
    monomialEval x (countVec k) = ∏ i, x (k i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [countVec, monomialEval_sum]
  simp

name: Analytic.ConvNorm_zero
statement: theorem ConvNorm_zero (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) : ConvNorm ρ (0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [ConvNorm]

name: Analytic.ConvNorm_one
statement: theorem ConvNorm_one (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) : ConvNorm ρ (1 : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold ConvNorm
  rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro ν hν
    simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_one, hν]

name: Analytic.ConvNorm_neg
statement:
theorem ConvNorm_neg (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (-f) = ConvNorm ρ f
proof:
:= by
  simp [ConvNorm]

name: Analytic.ConvNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem ConvNorm_add_le (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (f + g) ≤ ConvNorm ρ f + ConvNorm ρ g
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvNorm
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_add]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun ν => ?_
  rw [← add_mul, map_add]
  exact mul_le_mul' (enorm_add_le _ _) le_rfl

name: Analytic.ConvNorm_smul
statement:
theorem ConvNorm_smul (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (c : K) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (c • f) = ‖c‖ₑ * ConvNorm ρ f
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvNorm
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun ν => ?_
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_smul, enorm_mul, mul_assoc]

name: Analytic.ConvNorm_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ConvNorm_algebraMap (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (c : K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (algebraMap K (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) c) = ‖c‖ₑ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ConvNorm_smul, ConvNorm_one, mul_one]

name: Analytic.ConvNorm_mono
statement:
theorem ConvNorm_mono {ρ ρ' : Fin m → ℝ≥0} (h : ∀ k, ρ k ≤ ρ' k) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ f ≤ ConvNorm ρ' f
proof:
:=
  ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun ν =>
    mul_le_mul' le_rfl (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (monomialEval_le_monomialEval h ν))

name: Analytic.ConvNorm_mul_le
statement:
theorem ConvNorm_mul_le (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (f * g) ≤ ConvNorm ρ f * ConvNorm ρ g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set F : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun μ => ‖coeff μ f‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ μ : ℝ≥0∞) with hF
  set G : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun μ => ‖coeff μ g‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ μ : ℝ≥0∞) with hG
  
  have hterm : ∀ ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ, ‖coeff ν (f * g)‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ≥0∞)
      ≤ ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν, F p.1 * G p.2 := by
    intro ν
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    refine le_trans (mul_le_mul' (enorm_sum_le _ _) le_rfl) ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp => ?_
    have hp' : p.1 + p.2 = ν := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
    rw [← hp', monomialEval_add, ENNReal.coe_mul, enorm_mul, hF, hG]
    dsimp only
    ring_nf
    exact le_rfl
  
  have hregroup : ∑' ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ, ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν, F p.1 * G p.2
      = ∑' p : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) × (Fin m →₀ ℕ), F p.1 * G p.2 := by
    have h1 : ∀ ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ, ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν, F p.1 * G p.2
        = ∑' p : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) × (Fin m →₀ ℕ), if p.1 + p.2 = ν then F p.1 * G p.2 else 0 := by
      intro ν
      rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν)]
      · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => by
          rw [ite_eq_left (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp)]
      · intro p hp
        rw [ite_eq_right fun h => hp (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr h)]
    simp_rw [h1]
    rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]
    exact tsum_congr fun p => by
      rw [tsum_eq_single (p.1 + p.2) fun ν hν => ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hν)]
      exact ite_eq_left rfl
  calc ∑' ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ, ‖coeff ν (f * g)‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ≥0∞)
      ≤ ∑' ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ, ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν, F p.1 * G p.2 :=
        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hterm
    _ = ∑' p : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) × (Fin m →₀ ℕ), F p.1 * G p.2 := hregroup
    _ = (∑' μ, F μ) * ∑' ν, G ν := by
        rw [ENNReal.tsum_prod']
        simp_rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
        rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]

name: Analytic.mem_banachSeries
statement:
theorem mem_banachSeries {ρ : Radius m} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} :
    f ∈ BanachSeries K ρ ↔ ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Analytic.BanachSeries.mono
statement:
theorem BanachSeries.mono {ρ ρ' : Radius m} (h : ∀ k, ρ k ≤ ρ' k) :
    BanachSeries K ρ' ≤ BanachSeries K ρ
proof:
:= fun _ hf =>
  ne_top_of_le_ne_top hf (ConvNorm_mono h _)

name: Analytic.mem_conv
statement:
theorem mem_conv {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} :
    f ∈ Conv K m ↔ ∃ ρ : Radius m, ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Analytic.BanachSeries.le_conv
statement: theorem BanachSeries.le_conv (ρ : Radius m) : BanachSeries K ρ ≤ Conv K m
proof: := fun _ hf => ⟨ρ, hf⟩

name: Analytic.convNorm_monomial
statement:
theorem convNorm_monomial (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) (a : K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (monomial ν a) = ‖a‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold ConvNorm
  rw [tsum_eq_single ν]
  · rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left rfl]
  · intro μ hμ
    rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right hμ, enorm_zero, zero_mul]

name: Analytic.monomial_mem_conv
statement: theorem monomial_mem_conv (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) (a : K) : monomial ν a ∈ Conv K m
proof:
:=
  ⟨Radius.one m, by
    rw [mem_banachSeries, convNorm_monomial]
    exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (enorm_ne_top) ENNReal.coe_ne_top⟩

name: Analytic.X_mem_conv
statement: theorem X_mem_conv (k : Fin m) : (X k : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) ∈ Conv K m
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_def]
  exact monomial_mem_conv _ _

name: Analytic.IsLeadIndex.unique
statement:
theorem IsLeadIndex.unique {i j : Fin n} {d : Fin n →₀ ℕ} (hi : IsLeadIndex i d)
    (hj : IsLeadIndex j d) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
  · exact absurd (hj.2 i h) hi.1
  · exact h
  · exact absurd (hi.2 j h) hj.1

name: Analytic.exists_isLeadIndex
statement: theorem exists_isLeadIndex {d : Fin n →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) : ∃ i, IsLeadIndex i d
proof:
:= by
  have hne : d.support.Nonempty := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hd
  refine ⟨d.support.min' hne, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp (d.support.min'_mem hne), fun j hj => ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  exact absurd (d.support.min'_le j (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr h)) (not_le.mpr hj)

name: Analytic.coeff_divPart
statement:
theorem coeff_divPart (i : Fin n) (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) (e : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff e (divPart i c) =
      if IsLeadIndex i (e + single i 1) then coeff (e + single i 1) c else 0
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.coeff_X_mul'
statement:
theorem coeff_X_mul' (i : Fin n) (φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) (d : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff d (X i * φ) = if single i 1 ≤ d then coeff (d - single i 1) φ else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← pow_one (X i), X_pow_eq, coeff_monomial_mul, one_mul]

name: Analytic.sum_X_mul_divPart
statement:
theorem sum_X_mul_divPart {c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hc : constantCoeff c = 0) :
    ∑ i, X i * divPart i c = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [coeff_X_mul']
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · subst hd
    rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at hc
    rw [hc]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    rw [ite_eq_right]
    intro h
    have := h i
    simp at this
  · obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := exists_isLeadIndex hd
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i₀]
    · have hle : single i₀ 1 ≤ d := single_le_iff.mpr (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi₀.1)
      rw [ite_eq_left hle, coeff_divPart, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle, ite_eq_left hi₀]
    · intro i _ hi
      split_ifs with hle
      · rw [coeff_divPart, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle, ite_eq_right]
        exact fun h => hi (h.unique hi₀)
      · rfl
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i₀) h

name: Analytic.divPart_mem_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem divPart_mem_maximalIdeal_pow {c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} {k : ℕ} (hc : c ∈ 𝔪 ^ (k + 1))
    (i : Fin n) : divPart i c ∈ 𝔪 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff] at hc ⊢
  intro e he
  rw [coeff_divPart]
  split_ifs
  · refine hc _ ?_
    rw [map_add, degree_single]
    omega
  · rfl

name: Analytic.convNorm_divPart_mul_le
statement:
theorem convNorm_divPart_mul_le (ρ : Fin n → ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (divPart i c) * (ρ i : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ConvNorm ρ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold ConvNorm
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
  calc ∑' e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, ‖coeff e (divPart i c)‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ e : ℝ≥0∞) * (ρ i : ℝ≥0∞)
      ≤ ∑' e : Fin n →₀ ℕ,
          ‖coeff (e + single i 1) c‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ (e + single i 1) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun e => ?_
        rw [monomialEval_add, monomialEval_single_pow, pow_one, ENNReal.coe_mul, ← mul_assoc,
          coeff_divPart]
        split_ifs
        · exact le_rfl
        · simp
    _ ≤ ∑' d : Fin n →₀ ℕ, ‖coeff d c‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ d : ℝ≥0∞) :=
        ENNReal.tsum_comp_le_tsum_of_injective (add_left_injective (single i 1))
          (fun d => ‖coeff d c‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ d : ℝ≥0∞))

name: Analytic.divPart_mem_conv
statement:
theorem divPart_mem_conv {c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K} (hc : c ∈ Conv K n) (i : Fin n) :
    divPart i c ∈ Conv K n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨ρ, fun h => hρ ?_⟩
  have h1 := convNorm_divPart_mul_le ρ i c
  rw [h, ENNReal.top_mul (ENNReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr (ρ.2 i).ne')] at h1
  exact top_le_iff.mp h1

name: Analytic.C_mem_conv
statement: theorem C_mem_conv (a : K) : (C a : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ∈ Conv K n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← congrFun monomial_zero_eq_C a]
  exact monomial_mem_conv _ _

name: Analytic.mem_degreeBelow
statement: theorem mem_degreeBelow {k : ℕ} {d : Fin n →₀ ℕ} : d ∈ degreeBelow n k ↔ d.degree < k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degreeBelow, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_range, mem_degreeSet]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨j, hj, hd⟩ => hd ▸ hj, fun h => ⟨_, h, rfl⟩⟩

name: Analytic.coeff_truncDeg
statement:
theorem coeff_truncDeg (k : ℕ) (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) (d : Fin n →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff d (truncDeg k c) = if d.degree < k then coeff d c else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold truncDeg
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [coeff_monomial, Finset.sum_ite_eq, mem_degreeBelow]

name: Analytic.truncDeg_mem_conv
statement: theorem truncDeg_mem_conv (k : ℕ) (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) : truncDeg k c ∈ Conv K n
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun d _ => monomial_mem_conv d (coeff d c)

name: Analytic.sub_truncDeg_mem_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem sub_truncDeg_mem_maximalIdeal_pow (k : ℕ) (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) :
    c - truncDeg k c ∈ 𝔪 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff]
  intro d hd
  rw [map_sub, coeff_truncDeg, ite_eq_left hd, sub_self]

name: Analytic.norm_monomialEval_le
statement:
theorem norm_monomialEval_le {x : Fin m → K} {ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0} (hx : ∀ k, ‖x k‖ ≤ ρ k)
    (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) : ‖monomialEval x ν‖ ≤ monomialEval ρ ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_monomialEval, monomialEval, Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.prod, norm_prod]
  refine Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun k _ => norm_nonneg _) fun k _ => ?_
  rw [norm_pow]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hx k) _

name: Analytic.summable_weighted
statement:
theorem summable_weighted {ρ : Radius m} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} (hf : ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤) :
    Summable fun ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ => ‖coeff ν f‖ * (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [convNorm_eq_tsum_coe] at hf
  have h := NNReal.summable_coe.mpr (ENNReal.tsum_coe_ne_top_iff_summable.mp hf)
  convert h using 1
  funext ν
  rw [NNReal.coe_mul, coe_nnnorm]

name: Analytic.summable_norm_evalTerm
proof:
:=
  (summable_weighted hf).of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) fun ν => by
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_monomialEval_le hx ν) (norm_nonneg _)

name: Analytic.hasSum_evalSeries
statement:
theorem hasSum_evalSeries {ρ : Radius m} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} (hf : ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤)
    {x : Fin m → K} (hx : ∀ k, ‖x k‖ ≤ ρ k) :
    HasSum (fun ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ => coeff ν f * monomialEval x ν) (evalSeries f x)
proof:
:=
  (summable_norm_evalTerm hf hx).of_norm.hasSum

name: Analytic.monoMap_apply
statement:
theorem monoMap_apply (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n → Fin m) (v : Fin n → (Fin m → K)) :
    monoMap K n k v = ∏ i, v i (k i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [monoMap, ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebraFin_apply, List.prod_ofFn]

name: Analytic.norm_monoMap_le
statement: theorem norm_monoMap_le (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n → Fin m) : ‖monoMap K n k‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 : ‖ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebraFin K n K‖ ≤ 1 := by simp
  have h2 : ∀ i : Fin n, ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (k i) : (Fin m → K) →L[K] K)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    fun i => ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one fun x => by
      rw [one_mul]
      exact norm_le_pi_norm x (k i)
  calc ‖ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebraFin K n K‖
        * ∏ i, ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.proj (k i) : (Fin m → K) →L[K] K)‖
      ≤ 1 * ∏ i : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul h1 (Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) fun i _ => h2 i)
          (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
    _ = 1 := by simp

name: Analytic.monoMapExp_apply_diag
statement:
theorem monoMapExp_apply_diag {n : ℕ} {ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ} (h : ν.degree = n) (x : Fin m → K) :
    monoMapExp K n ν (fun _ => x) = monomialEval x ν
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (expList ν).length = n := (length_expList ν).trans h
  rw [monoMapExp, dite_eq_left hl, monoMap_apply, ← prod_map_expList, ← List.prod_ofFn]
  congr 1
  subst hl
  change List.ofFn (x ∘ (expList ν).get) = _
  rw [← List.map_ofFn, List.ofFn_get]

name: Analytic.norm_monoMapExp_le
statement: theorem norm_monoMapExp_le (n : ℕ) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) : ‖monoMapExp K n ν‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold monoMapExp
  split_ifs
  · exact norm_monoMap_le _ _
  · simp

name: Analytic.toFMS_apply_diag
statement:
theorem toFMS_apply_diag (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin m → K) :
    toFMS f n (fun _ => x) = ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, coeff ν f * monomialEval x ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFMS, sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν hν => ?_
  rw [smul_apply, monoMapExp_apply_diag (mem_degreeSet.mp hν),
    smul_eq_mul]

name: Analytic.norm_toFMS_le
statement:
theorem norm_toFMS_le (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖toFMS f n‖ ≤ ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, ‖coeff ν f‖
proof:
:= by
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun ν _ => ?_)
  rw [norm_smul]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (norm_monoMapExp_le n ν)

name: Analytic.le_radius_toFMS
statement:
theorem le_radius_toFMS {ρ : Radius m} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} (hf : ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤)
    {r : ℝ≥0} (hr : ∀ k, r ≤ ρ k) : (r : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (toFMS f).radius
proof:
:= by
  refine FormalMultilinearSeries.le_radius_of_summable_norm _ ?_
  refine (summable_sum_degreeSet (w := fun ν => ‖coeff ν f‖ * (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ))
    (fun ν => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (monomialEval ρ ν).2)
    (summable_weighted hf)).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun n => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg r.2 _)) fun n => ?_
  calc ‖toFMS f n‖ * (r : ℝ) ^ n
      ≤ (∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, ‖coeff ν f‖) * (r : ℝ) ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_toFMS_le f n) (pow_nonneg r.2 _)
    _ = ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, ‖coeff ν f‖ * (r : ℝ) ^ n := Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, ‖coeff ν f‖ * (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun ν hν => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
        exact_mod_cast pow_le_monomialEval hr (mem_degreeSet.mp hν)

name: Analytic.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_evalSeries
statement:
theorem hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_evalSeries {ρ : Radius m} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K}
    (hf : ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤) {r : ℝ≥0} (hr0 : 0 < r) (hr : ∀ k, r ≤ ρ k) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (evalSeries f) (toFMS f) 0 r where
  r_le
proof:
:= le_radius_toFMS hf hr
  r_pos := by exact_mod_cast hr0
  hasSum := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : ‖y‖ < r := by
      rw [Metric.mem_eball, edist_zero_right, enorm_eq_nnnorm] at hy
      exact_mod_cast hy
    have hyρ : ∀ k, ‖y k‖ ≤ ρ k := fun k =>
      (norm_le_pi_norm y k).trans (hy'.le.trans (hr k))
    rw [zero_add]
    simp_rw [toFMS_apply_diag]
    exact hasSum_sum_degreeSet (hasSum_evalSeries hf hyρ)

name: Analytic.analyticOnNhd_evalSeries_ball
proof:
:= fun y hy =>
  (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_evalSeries hf hr0 hr).analyticAt_of_mem (by
    rw [Metric.mem_eball, edist_zero_right, enorm_eq_nnnorm]
    exact_mod_cast (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hy))

name: Analytic.factorial_smul_sum_eq_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
theorem factorial_smul_sum_eq_iteratedFDeriv {ρ : Radius m} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K}
    (hf : ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin m → K) :
    n.factorial • ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, coeff ν f * monomialEval x ν
      = iteratedFDeriv K n (evalSeries f) 0 (fun _ => x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hr⟩ := ρ.exists_le
  rw [← toFMS_apply_diag]
  exact (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_evalSeries hf hr0 hr).factorial_smul x n

name: Analytic.evalSeries_monomial
statement:
theorem evalSeries_monomial (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) (a : K) (x : Fin m → K) :
    evalSeries (monomial ν a) x = a * monomialEval x ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold evalSeries
  rw [tsum_eq_single ν]
  · rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left rfl]
  · intro μ hμ
    rw [coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right hμ, zero_mul]

name: Analytic.evalSeries_X_pow
statement:
theorem evalSeries_X_pow (k : Fin m) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin m → K) :
    evalSeries (X k ^ n : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) x = x k ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq, evalSeries_monomial, one_mul, monomialEval_single_pow]

name: Analytic.convNorm_X_pow_ne_top
statement:
theorem convNorm_X_pow_ne_top (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (k : Fin m) (n : ℕ) :
    ConvNorm ρ (X k ^ n : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq, convNorm_monomial]
  exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top enorm_ne_top ENNReal.coe_ne_top

name: Analytic.abs_monomialEval_le
statement:
theorem abs_monomialEval_le {x : Fin m → ℝ} {ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0} (hx : ∀ k, |x k| ≤ ρ k)
    (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) : |monomialEval x ν| ≤ monomialEval ρ ν
proof:
:=
  norm_monomialEval_le (K := ℝ) (x := x) (ρ := ρ) hx ν

name: Analytic.order_mul
statement: theorem order_mul (f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) : (f * g).order = f.order + g.order
proof:
:=
  MvPowerSeries.order_mul f g

name: Analytic.toFMS_eq_zero_of_coeff
statement:
theorem toFMS_eq_zero_of_coeff (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ ν, ν.degree = n → coeff ν f = 0) : toFMS f n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFMS]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ν hν => ?_
  rw [h ν (mem_degreeSet.mp hν)]
  exact zero_smul K (monoMapExp K n ν)

name: Analytic.le_order_iff_iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem le_order_iff_iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} (hf : f ∈ Conv K m)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (k : ℕ∞) ≤ f.order ↔ ∀ j < k, iteratedFDeriv K j (evalSeries f) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hf
  have hρ' : ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤ := hρ
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hr⟩ := ρ.exists_le
  have hp := hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_evalSeries hρ' hr0 hr
  constructor
  · intro hk j hj
    have hcoeff : ∀ ν, ν.degree = j → coeff ν f = 0 := by
      intro ν hν
      refine MvPowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order ?_
      rw [hν]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hj) hk
    ext v
    rw [hp.iteratedFDeriv_eq_sum_of_completeSpace v]
    simp [toFMS_eq_zero_of_coeff f hcoeff]
  · intro h
    refine MvPowerSeries.nat_le_order fun ν hν => ?_
    have hj := h ν.degree hν
    
    have hpoly : homogeneousPoly f ν.degree = 0 := by
      refine MvPolynomial.funext fun x => ?_
      rw [eval_homogeneousPoly, map_zero]
      have hn : (ν.degree.factorial : K) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast ν.degree.factorial_ne_zero
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hn
      have e := factorial_smul_sum_eq_iteratedFDeriv hρ' ν.degree x
      rw [nsmul_eq_mul] at e
      rw [e, hj, mul_zero]
      rfl
    have := congrArg (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff · ν) hpoly
    rwa [coeff_homogeneousPoly f rfl, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero] at this

name: Analytic.evalSeries_mul
statement:
theorem evalSeries_mul {ρ : Radius m} {f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} (hf : ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤)
    (hg : ConvNorm ρ g ≠ ⊤) {x : Fin m → K} (hx : ∀ k, ‖x k‖ ≤ ρ k) :
    evalSeries (f * g) x = evalSeries f x * evalSeries g x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsf := summable_norm_evalTerm hf hx
  have hsg := summable_norm_evalTerm hg hx
  
  have hprod : HasSum (fun p : (Fin m →₀ ℕ) × (Fin m →₀ ℕ) =>
      (coeff p.1 f * monomialEval x p.1) * (coeff p.2 g * monomialEval x p.2))
      (evalSeries f x * evalSeries g x) := by
    rw [evalSeries, evalSeries, tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm hsf hsg]
    exact (summable_mul_of_summable_norm hsf hsg).hasSum
  
  have hreg := hasSum_sum_antidiagonal hprod
  have hterm : ∀ ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ, ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal ν,
      (coeff p.1 f * monomialEval x p.1) * (coeff p.2 g * monomialEval x p.2)
      = coeff ν (f * g) * monomialEval x ν := by
    intro ν
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
    have hp' : p.1 + p.2 = ν := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
    rw [← hp', monomialEval_add]
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm] at hreg
  exact hreg.tsum_eq

name: Analytic.evalSeries_zero_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalSeries_zero_eq (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) : evalSeries f 0 = constantCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold evalSeries
  rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro ν hν
    have : monomialEval (0 : Fin m → K) ν = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, ν k ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h
        push Not at h
        exact hν (Finsupp.ext h)
      rw [monomialEval, Finsupp.prod]
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hk) (by simp [hk])
    rw [this, mul_zero]

name: Analytic.evalSeries_one
statement: theorem evalSeries_one (x : Fin m → K) : evalSeries (1 : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) x = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold evalSeries
  rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro ν hν
    simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_one, hν]

name: Analytic.eq_sum_smul_single
statement:
theorem eq_sum_smul_single (y : Fin m → K) :
    y = ∑ j, y j • (Pi.single j (1 : K) : Fin m → K)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: Analytic.fms_apply_diag_eq_sum
statement:
theorem fms_apply_diag_eq_sum (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (Fin m → K) K) (n : ℕ)
    (y : Fin m → K) :
    p n (fun _ => y)
      = ∑ k : Fin n → Fin m, (∏ i, y (k i)) * p n (fun i => Pi.single (k i) (1 : K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_smul_single y]
  rw [(p n).map_sum_finset (fun (_ : Fin n) j => y j • (Pi.single j (1 : K) : Fin m → K))
    (fun _ => Finset.univ), Fintype.piFinset_univ]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, smul_eq_mul]

name: Analytic.coeff_coeffOfFMS
statement:
theorem coeff_coeffOfFMS (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (Fin m → K) K) {n : ℕ} {ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ}
    (h : ν.degree = n) :
    coeff ν (coeffOfFMS p) = ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Fin m)).filter
      (fun k => countVec k = ν), p n (fun i => Pi.single (k i) (1 : K))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Analytic.fms_apply_diag_eq_sum_coeff
statement:
theorem fms_apply_diag_eq_sum_coeff (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (Fin m → K) K) (n : ℕ)
    (y : Fin m → K) :
    p n (fun _ => y) = ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, coeff ν (coeffOfFMS p) * monomialEval y ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [fms_apply_diag_eq_sum, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := countVec)
    (t := degreeSet m n) (fun k _ => mem_degreeSet.mpr (degree_countVec k))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν hν => ?_
  rw [coeff_coeffOfFMS p (mem_degreeSet.mp hν), Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  have hk' : countVec k = ν := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hk).2
  rw [← hk', monomialEval_countVec, mul_comm]

name: Analytic.norm_coeff_coeffOfFMS_le
statement:
theorem norm_coeff_coeffOfFMS_le (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (Fin m → K) K) {n : ℕ}
    {ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ} (h : ν.degree = n) :
    ‖coeff ν (coeffOfFMS p)‖ ≤ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Fin m)).filter
      (fun k => countVec k = ν)).card * ‖p n‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_coeffOfFMS p h]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
  rw [Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  refine ((p n).le_opNorm _).trans ?_
  simp [Pi.norm_single]

name: Analytic.sum_norm_coeffOfFMS_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_coeffOfFMS_le (p : FormalMultilinearSeries K (Fin m → K) K) (r' : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, ‖coeff ν (coeffOfFMS p)‖ * (monomialEval (fun _ => r') ν : ℝ)
      ≤ ‖p n‖ * ((m : ℝ) * r') ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpow : ∀ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, (monomialEval (fun _ => r') ν : ℝ) = (r' : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro ν hν
    rw [coe_monomialEval, Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ fun _ => pow_zero _, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum,
      ← Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, mem_degreeSet.mp hν]
  calc ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, ‖coeff ν (coeffOfFMS p)‖ * (monomialEval (fun _ => r') ν : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Fin m)).filter
          (fun k => countVec k = ν)).card : ℝ) * ‖p n‖ * (r' : ℝ) ^ n := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun ν hν => ?_
        rw [hpow ν hν]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_coeff_coeffOfFMS_le p (mem_degreeSet.mp hν))
          (pow_nonneg r'.2 _)
    _ = (m : ℝ) ^ n * ‖p n‖ * (r' : ℝ) ^ n := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_card_fiber_countVec]
    _ = ‖p n‖ * ((m : ℝ) * r') ^ n := by rw [mul_pow]; ring

name: AnalyticAt.exists_conv_coeff
statement:
theorem _root_.AnalyticAt.exists_conv_coeff {f : (Fin m → K) → K} {a : Fin m → K}
    (hf : AnalyticAt K f a) :
    ∃ (ρ : Radius m) (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K), ConvNorm ρ c ≠ ⊤ ∧
      ∀ x : Fin m → K, (∀ k, ‖x k‖ < ρ k) → f (a + x) = evalSeries c x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, r, hp⟩ := hf
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀pos, hr₀r⟩ : ∃ r₀ : ℝ≥0, 0 < r₀ ∧ (r₀ : ℝ≥0∞) < r := by
    rcases ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_nnreal_btwn.mp hp.r_pos with ⟨r₀, h0, hr⟩
    exact ⟨r₀, by exact_mod_cast h0, hr⟩
  set r' : ℝ≥0 := r₀ / (2 * (m + 1)) with hr'
  have hr'pos : 0 < r' := by positivity
  have hmr' : (m : ℝ≥0) * r' < r₀ := by
    rw [hr', mul_div_assoc']
    refine (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr ?_
    have : (m : ℝ≥0) < 2 * (m + 1) := by
      have h1 : (m : ℝ≥0) < m + 1 := lt_add_one _
      have h2 : (m : ℝ≥0) + 1 ≤ 2 * (m + 1) := by nlinarith
      exact h1.trans_le h2
    calc (m : ℝ≥0) * r₀ = r₀ * m := mul_comm _ _
      _ < r₀ * (2 * (m + 1)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left this hr₀pos
  have hr'r₀ : r' < r₀ := by
    rw [hr']
    refine (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr ?_
    have : (1 : ℝ≥0) < 2 * (m + 1) := by
      have : (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ m := zero_le
      nlinarith
    calc r₀ = r₀ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ < r₀ * (2 * (m + 1)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left this hr₀pos
  set ρ : Radius m := ⟨fun _ => r', fun _ => hr'pos⟩ with hρ
  set c := coeffOfFMS p with hc
  
  have hsum : Summable fun n => ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, ‖coeff ν c‖ * (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) := by
    have hrad : ((m : ℝ≥0) * r' : ℝ≥0∞) < p.radius := lt_of_lt_of_le
      (by exact_mod_cast hmr') (hr₀r.le.trans hp.r_le)
    refine (p.summable_norm_mul_pow hrad).of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg fun ν _ => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (monomialEval ρ ν).2)
      fun n => ?_
    have := sum_norm_coeffOfFMS_le p r' n
    simpa [hρ, hc] using this
  have hw : Summable fun ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ => ‖coeff ν c‖ * (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) :=
    summable_of_summable_sum_degreeSet
      (fun ν => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (monomialEval ρ ν).2) hsum
  have hnorm : ConvNorm ρ c ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [convNorm_eq_tsum_coe]
    refine ENNReal.tsum_coe_ne_top_iff_summable.mpr (NNReal.summable_coe.mp ?_)
    convert hw using 1
    funext ν
    rw [NNReal.coe_mul, coe_nnnorm]
  refine ⟨ρ, c, hnorm, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  
  have hxr : ‖x‖ < r' := by
    rw [pi_norm_lt_iff (by exact_mod_cast hr'pos)]
    exact hx
  have hxball : x ∈ Metric.eball (0 : Fin m → K) r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_eball, edist_zero_right, enorm_eq_nnnorm]
    calc ((‖x‖₊ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) < r' := by exact_mod_cast hxr
      _ < r₀ := by exact_mod_cast hr'r₀
      _ < r := hr₀r
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n => p n fun _ => x) (f (a + x)) := hp.hasSum hxball
  have hxρ : ∀ k, ‖x k‖ ≤ ρ k := fun k => (hx k).le
  have h2 : HasSum (fun n => ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, coeff ν c * monomialEval x ν) (evalSeries c x) :=
    hasSum_sum_degreeSet (hasSum_evalSeries hnorm hxρ)
  simp_rw [fms_apply_diag_eq_sum_coeff p] at h1
  exact h1.unique h2

name: Analytic.eval_homogeneousPoly
statement:
theorem eval_homogeneousPoly (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin m → K) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (homogeneousPoly f n)
      = ∑ ν ∈ degreeSet m n, coeff ν f * monomialEval x ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousPoly, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ => ?_
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_monomial]
  rfl

name: Analytic.coeff_homogeneousPoly
statement:
theorem coeff_homogeneousPoly (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) {n : ℕ} {ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ}
    (hν : ν.degree = n) : (homogeneousPoly f n).coeff ν = coeff ν f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [homogeneousPoly, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  simp only [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (degreeSet m n) ν, ite_eq_left (mem_degreeSet.mpr hν)]

name: Analytic.eq_of_evalSeries_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem eq_of_evalSeries_eventuallyEq {f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} (hf : f ∈ Conv K m)
    (hg : g ∈ Conv K m) (h : evalSeries f =ᶠ[𝓝 0] evalSeries g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρf, hρf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨ρg, hρg⟩ := hg
  have hf' : ConvNorm (ρf.min ρg) f ≠ ⊤ := BanachSeries.mono (ρf.min_le_left ρg) hρf
  have hg' : ConvNorm (ρf.min ρg) g ≠ ⊤ := BanachSeries.mono (ρf.min_le_right ρg) hρg
  
  have hparts : ∀ n, homogeneousPoly f n = homogeneousPoly g n := by
    intro n
    refine MvPolynomial.funext fun x => ?_
    rw [eval_homogeneousPoly, eval_homogeneousPoly]
    have hd : iteratedFDeriv K n (evalSeries f) 0 = iteratedFDeriv K n (evalSeries g) 0 :=
      (h.iteratedFDeriv K n).eq_of_nhds
    have hn : (n.factorial : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_ne_zero
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hn
    have e1 := factorial_smul_sum_eq_iteratedFDeriv hf' n x
    have e2 := factorial_smul_sum_eq_iteratedFDeriv hg' n x
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul] at e1 e2
    rw [e1, e2, hd]
  ext ν
  have := congrArg (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff · ν) (hparts ν.degree)
  rwa [coeff_homogeneousPoly f rfl, coeff_homogeneousPoly g rfl] at this

name: Analytic.eventually_norm_sub_lt
statement:
theorem eventually_norm_sub_lt (a : Fin m → K) (ρ : Radius m) :
    ∀ᶠ x : Fin m → K in 𝓝 a, ∀ k, ‖(x - a) k‖ < (ρ k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.eventually_all]
  intro k
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x : Fin m → K => ‖(x - a) k‖) a :=
    ((continuous_apply k).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm.continuousAt
  have h0 : ‖(a - a) k‖ < (ρ k : ℝ) := by
    rw [sub_self, Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]
    exact NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (ρ.2 k)
  exact hcont.eventually_lt continuousAt_const h0

name: AnalyticAt.exists_eventuallyEq_evalSeries
statement:
theorem _root_.AnalyticAt.exists_eventuallyEq_evalSeries {f : (Fin m → K) → K} {a : Fin m → K}
    (hf : AnalyticAt K f a) :
    ∃ (ρ : Radius m) (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K), ConvNorm ρ c ≠ ⊤ ∧
      f =ᶠ[𝓝 a] fun x => evalSeries c (x - a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, c, hc, hfc⟩ := AnalyticAt.exists_conv_coeff hf
  refine ⟨ρ, c, hc, (eventually_norm_sub_lt a ρ).mono fun x hx => ?_⟩
  change f x = evalSeries c (x - a)
  rw [← hfc (x - a) hx, add_sub_cancel]

name: Analytic.coeff_rescale
statement:
theorem coeff_rescale (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff ν (rescale ρ f) = coeff ν f * ((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K)
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.convNorm_rescale
statement:
theorem convNorm_rescale (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ConvNorm (fun _ => 1) (rescale ρ f) = ConvNorm ρ f
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvNorm
  refine tsum_congr fun ν => ?_
  rw [coeff_rescale, monomialEval_one, ENNReal.coe_one, mul_one, enorm_mul, enorm_eq_nnnorm,
    enorm_eq_nnnorm, nnnorm_coe_monomialEval]

name: Analytic.coe_monomialEval_eq_prod
statement:
theorem coe_monomialEval_eq_prod (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    ((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K) = ν.prod fun k n => ((ρ k : ℝ) : K) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_monomialEval, Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.prod]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Analytic.monomialEval_mul_left
statement:
theorem monomialEval_mul_left (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (y : Fin m → K) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    monomialEval (fun k => ((ρ k : ℝ) : K) * y k) ν
      = ((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K) * monomialEval y ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_monomialEval_eq_prod, monomialEval, monomialEval, Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.prod,
    Finsupp.prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_pow _ _ _

name: Analytic.evalSeries_rescale
statement:
theorem evalSeries_rescale (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (y : Fin m → K) :
    evalSeries (rescale ρ f) y = evalSeries f fun k => ((ρ k : ℝ) : K) * y k
proof:
:= by
  unfold evalSeries
  refine tsum_congr fun ν => ?_
  rw [coeff_rescale, monomialEval_mul_left]
  ring

name: Analytic.analyticOnNhd_evalSeries
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hres : ConvNorm (Radius.one m) (rescale ρ f) ≠ ⊤ := by
    change ConvNorm (fun _ => 1) (rescale ρ f) ≠ ⊤
    rw [convNorm_rescale]
    exact hf
  have hball := analyticOnNhd_evalSeries_ball hres one_pos fun k => le_rfl
  have hρk : ∀ k, (0 : ℝ) < ρ k := fun k => NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (ρ.pos k)
  have hρK : ∀ k, ((ρ k : ℝ) : K) ≠ 0 := fun k => by exact_mod_cast (hρk k).ne'
  let L : (Fin m → K) →L[K] (Fin m → K) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => (((ρ k : ℝ) : K)⁻¹) • ContinuousLinearMap.proj k
  have hL : ∀ (z : Fin m → K) k, L z k = z k / ((ρ k : ℝ) : K) := fun z k => by
    simp [L, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have heq : evalSeries f = evalSeries (rescale ρ f) ∘ L := by
    funext z
    rw [Function.comp_apply, evalSeries_rescale]
    congr 1
    funext k
    rw [hL, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hρK k)]
  rw [heq]
  refine (hball (L x) ?_).comp (L.analyticAt x)
  rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, NNReal.coe_one, pi_norm_lt_iff one_pos]
  intro k
  rw [hL, norm_div, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_pos (hρk k), div_lt_one (hρk k)]
  exact hx k

name: Analytic.pi_Ioo_eq_setOf_norm_lt
statement:
theorem pi_Ioo_eq_setOf_norm_lt (ρ : Radius m) :
    (Set.univ.pi fun k => Set.Ioo (-(ρ k : ℝ)) (ρ k)) = {x : Fin m → ℝ | ∀ k, ‖x k‖ < ρ k}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]

name: Analytic.BanachSeries.convNorm_ne_top
statement:
theorem BanachSeries.convNorm_ne_top (f : BanachSeries K ρ) :
    ConvNorm ρ (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) ≠ ⊤

name: Analytic.eq_zero_of_convNorm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_convNorm_eq_zero {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} (h : ConvNorm ρ f = 0) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext ν
  have hν := (ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.mp h) ν
  rw [mul_eq_zero, enorm_eq_zero, ENNReal.coe_eq_zero] at hν
  rcases hν with h0 | h0
  · simpa using h0
  · exact absurd h0 (monomialEval_pos' ρ ν).ne'

name: Analytic.BanachSeries.norm_def
statement:
theorem BanachSeries.norm_def (f : BanachSeries K ρ) :
    ‖f‖ = (ConvNorm ρ (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)).toReal
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.convNorm_eq_tsum_coe
statement:
theorem convNorm_eq_tsum_coe (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ f = ∑' ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ, ((‖coeff ν f‖₊ * monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvNorm
  refine tsum_congr fun ν => ?_
  rw [ENNReal.coe_mul, enorm_eq_nnnorm]

name: Analytic.norm_coe_monomialEval
statement:
theorem norm_coe_monomialEval (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    ‖((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K)‖ = (monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal, NNReal.abs_eq]

name: Analytic.nnnorm_coe_monomialEval
statement:
theorem nnnorm_coe_monomialEval (ρ : Fin m → ℝ≥0) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    ‖((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K)‖₊ = monomialEval ρ ν
proof:
:=
  NNReal.eq (by rw [coe_nnnorm, norm_coe_monomialEval])

name: Analytic.coe_monomialEval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coe_monomialEval_ne_zero (ρ : Radius m) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    ((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (monomialEval_pos' ρ ν)).ne'

name: Analytic.BanachSeries.summable_weighted
statement:
theorem BanachSeries.summable_weighted (f : BanachSeries K ρ) :
    Summable fun ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ =>
      ‖coeff ν (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) * ((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ConvNorm ρ (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) ≠ ⊤ := f.2
  rw [convNorm_eq_tsum_coe] at hf
  have h := NNReal.summable_coe.mpr (ENNReal.tsum_coe_ne_top_iff_summable.mp hf)
  convert h using 1
  funext ν
  rw [NNReal.coe_mul, coe_nnnorm, norm_mul, norm_coe_monomialEval]

name: Analytic.BanachSeries.toLp_apply
statement:
theorem BanachSeries.toLp_apply (f : BanachSeries K ρ) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    BanachSeries.toLp f ν = coeff ν (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) * ((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Analytic.BanachSeries.norm_toLp
statement: theorem BanachSeries.norm_toLp (f : BanachSeries K ρ) : ‖BanachSeries.toLp f‖ = ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow (by simp) (BanachSeries.toLp f), BanachSeries.norm_def]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_one, Real.rpow_one, div_one, BanachSeries.toLp_apply]
  unfold ConvNorm
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_toReal_eq fun _ => ENNReal.mul_ne_top enorm_ne_top ENNReal.coe_ne_top]
  refine tsum_congr fun ν => ?_
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, toReal_enorm, ENNReal.coe_toReal, norm_mul, norm_coe_monomialEval]

name: Analytic.coeff_ofLpSeries
statement:
theorem coeff_ofLpSeries (g : lp (fun _ : Fin m →₀ ℕ => K) 1) (ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff ν (ofLpSeries K ρ g) = (g ν : K) / ((monomialEval ρ ν : ℝ) : K)
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.convNorm_ofLpSeries_ne_top
statement:
theorem convNorm_ofLpSeries_ne_top (g : lp (fun _ : Fin m →₀ ℕ => K) 1) :
    ConvNorm ρ (ofLpSeries K ρ g) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Summable fun ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ => ‖(g ν : K)‖ := by
    simpa using (memℓp_gen_iff (p := 1) (by simp)).mp (lp.memℓp g)
  have hsum : Summable fun ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ => ‖(g ν : K)‖₊ :=
    NNReal.summable_coe.mp (by simpa [coe_nnnorm] using h1)
  have h : (∑' ν : Fin m →₀ ℕ, ((‖(g ν : K)‖₊ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.tsum_coe_ne_top_iff_summable.mpr hsum
  rw [convNorm_eq_tsum_coe]
  refine ne_of_eq_of_ne (tsum_congr fun ν => ?_) h
  rw [coeff_ofLpSeries]
  congr 1
  rw [nnnorm_div, nnnorm_coe_monomialEval, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (monomialEval_pos' ρ ν).ne']

name: Analytic.banachSeries_completeSpace
statement: theorem banachSeries_completeSpace (ρ : Radius m) : CompleteSpace (BanachSeries ℝ ρ)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: Analytic.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_iff_constantCoeff_ne_zero {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K} (hf : f ∈ Conv K m) :
    IsUnit (⟨f, hf⟩ : Conv K m) ↔ constantCoeff f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hu
    have hfu : IsUnit f := hu.map (Conv K m).val
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp (MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mp hfu)
  · intro h0
    have hf' := hf
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hf'
    have hρ' : ConvNorm ρ f ≠ ⊤ := hρ
    obtain ⟨r, hr0, hr⟩ := ρ.exists_le
    have han : AnalyticAt K (evalSeries f) 0 :=
      (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_evalSeries hρ' hr0 hr).analyticAt
    have hval : evalSeries f 0 ≠ 0 := by rw [evalSeries_zero_eq]; exact h0
    obtain ⟨ρ', c, hc, hce⟩ := AnalyticAt.exists_conv_coeff (han.inv hval)
    have hcConv : c ∈ Conv K m := ⟨ρ', hc⟩
    have hfc : f * c ∈ Conv K m := mul_mem hf hcConv
    
    have hev : evalSeries (f * c) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] evalSeries (1 : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) := by
      have hne : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin m → K), evalSeries f x ≠ 0 :=
        han.continuousAt.eventually_ne hval
      obtain ⟨r'', hr''0, hr''⟩ := (ρ.min ρ').exists_le
      have hnb : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin m → K), ∀ k, ‖x k‖ < ((ρ.min ρ') k : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : Fin m → K)
          (show (0 : ℝ) < r'' by exact_mod_cast hr''0)] with x hx k
        exact (norm_le_pi_norm x k).trans_lt ((mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx).trans_le
          (by exact_mod_cast hr'' k))
      filter_upwards [hne, hnb] with x hx0 hxk
      have hxρ' : ∀ k, ‖x k‖ < ρ' k := fun k =>
        (hxk k).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast ρ.min_le_right ρ' k)
      rw [evalSeries_mul (ρ := ρ.min ρ') (BanachSeries.mono (ρ.min_le_left ρ') hρ)
        (BanachSeries.mono (ρ.min_le_right ρ') hc) (fun k => (hxk k).le), evalSeries_one,
        ← sub_eq_zero]
      have hcx := hce x hxρ'
      rw [zero_add, Pi.inv_apply] at hcx
      rw [← hcx, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx0, sub_self]
    have hmul : f * c = 1 := eq_of_evalSeries_eventuallyEq hfc (one_mem _) hev
    refine ⟨⟨⟨f, hf⟩, ⟨c, hcConv⟩, Subtype.ext hmul, Subtype.ext ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    change c * f = 1
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact hmul

name: Analytic.DegLt.mono
statement:
theorem mono {N N' : ℕ} (h : N ≤ N') {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt N f) :
    DegLt N' f
proof:
:=
  fun ν hν => hf ν (h.trans hν)

name: Analytic.DegLt.zero
statement: theorem zero (N : ℕ) : DegLt N (0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)
proof: := fun _ _ => by simp

name: Analytic.DegLt.add
statement:
theorem add {N : ℕ} {f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt N f) (hg : DegLt N g) :
    DegLt N (f + g)
proof:
:= fun ν hν => by
  rw [map_add, hf ν hν, hg ν hν, add_zero]

name: Analytic.DegLt.neg
statement: theorem neg {N : ℕ} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt N f) : DegLt N (-f)
proof:
:=
  fun ν hν => by rw [map_neg, hf ν hν, neg_zero]

name: Analytic.DegLt.sub
statement:
theorem sub {N : ℕ} {f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt N f) (hg : DegLt N g) :
    DegLt N (f - g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact hf.add hg.neg

name: Analytic.DegLt.sum
statement:
theorem sum {N : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K}
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, DegLt N (f i)) : DegLt N (∑ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using DegLt.zero N
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add
      (ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: Analytic.DegLt.mul
statement:
theorem mul {a b : ℕ} {f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt a f) (hg : DegLt b g) :
    DegLt (a + b) (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro ν hν
  rw [coeff_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun μ hμ => ?_
  have hμ' : μ.1 + μ.2 = ν := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hμ
  have hsum : μ.1 0 + μ.2 0 = ν 0 := by rw [← hμ']; rfl
  by_cases h1 : a ≤ μ.1 0
  · rw [hf _ h1, zero_mul]
  · have h2 : b ≤ μ.2 0 := by omega
    rw [hg _ h2, mul_zero]

name: Analytic.DegLt.mul_succ
statement:
theorem mul_succ {a b : ℕ} {f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt (a + 1) f)
    (hg : DegLt (b + 1) g) : DegLt (a + b + 1) (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro ν hν
  rw [coeff_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun μ hμ => ?_
  have hμ' : μ.1 + μ.2 = ν := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hμ
  have hsum : μ.1 0 + μ.2 0 = ν 0 := by rw [← hμ']; rfl
  by_cases h1 : a + 1 ≤ μ.1 0
  · rw [hf _ h1, zero_mul]
  · have h2 : b + 1 ≤ μ.2 0 := by omega
    rw [hg _ h2, mul_zero]

name: Analytic.DegLt.one_mul
statement:
theorem one_mul {N : ℕ} {f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt 1 f) (hg : DegLt N g) :
    DegLt N (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro ν hν
  rw [coeff_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun μ hμ => ?_
  have hμ' : μ.1 + μ.2 = ν := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hμ
  have hsum : μ.1 0 + μ.2 0 = ν 0 := by rw [← hμ']; rfl
  by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ μ.1 0
  · rw [hf _ h1, zero_mul]
  · have h2 : N ≤ μ.2 0 := by omega
    rw [hg _ h2, mul_zero]

name: Analytic.DegLt.smul
statement:
theorem smul {N : ℕ} (c : K) {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt N f) :
    DegLt N (c • f)
proof:
:= fun ν hν => by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_smul, hf ν hν, mul_zero]

name: Analytic.degLt_liftTail
statement:
theorem degLt_liftTail (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    DegLt 1 (liftTail c : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)
proof:
:= by
  intro ν hν
  rw [← Finsupp.cons_tail ν, coeff_cons_liftTail]
  rw [ite_eq_right]
  omega

name: Analytic.degLt_X_zero_pow
statement: theorem degLt_X_zero_pow (k : ℕ) : DegLt (k + 1) ((X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  intro ν hν
  rw [← Finsupp.cons_tail ν, coeff_cons_X_pow]
  rw [ite_eq_right]
  intro h
  have := h.1
  omega

name: Analytic.degLt_weierstrassPoly
statement:
theorem degLt_weierstrassPoly (e : ℕ) (c : Fin e → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    DegLt (e + 1) (weierstrassPoly e c : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold weierstrassPoly
  refine (degLt_X_zero_pow e).add (DegLt.sum _ fun j _ => ?_)
  have := (degLt_liftTail (c j)).one_mul (degLt_X_zero_pow (e - 1 - (j : ℕ)))
  exact this.mono (by omega)

name: Analytic.degLt_iff_splitFirst
statement:
theorem degLt_iff_splitFirst {N : ℕ} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} :
    DegLt N f ↔ ∀ k, N ≤ k → PowerSeries.coeff k (splitFirst K m f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf k hk
    exact coeff_splitFirst_eq_zero_of_le hf hk
  · intro h ν hν
    have h2 := congrArg (fun φ => MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.tail ν) φ) (h (ν 0) hν)
    simp only [MvPowerSeries.coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv, Finsupp.cons_tail] at h2
    rw [h2]
    exact map_zero _

name: Analytic.ofPoly_def
statement:
theorem ofPoly_def (P : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) :
    ofPoly P = (splitFirst K m).symm (P : PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K))
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.splitFirst_ofPoly
statement:
theorem splitFirst_ofPoly (P : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) :
    splitFirst K m (ofPoly P) = (P : PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K))
proof:
:=
  (splitFirst K m).apply_symm_apply _

name: Analytic.ofPoly_add
statement:
theorem ofPoly_add (P Q : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) :
    ofPoly (P + Q) = ofPoly P + ofPoly Q
proof: := map_add ofPolyHom P Q

name: Analytic.ofPoly_mul
statement:
theorem ofPoly_mul (P Q : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) :
    ofPoly (P * Q) = ofPoly P * ofPoly Q
proof: := map_mul ofPolyHom P Q

name: Analytic.ofPoly_neg
statement: theorem ofPoly_neg (P : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) : ofPoly (-P) = -ofPoly P
proof:
:=
  map_neg ofPolyHom P

name: Analytic.ofPoly_zero
statement: theorem ofPoly_zero : ofPoly (0 : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) = 0
proof: := map_zero ofPolyHom

name: Analytic.ofPoly_one
statement: theorem ofPoly_one : ofPoly (1 : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) = 1
proof: := map_one ofPolyHom

name: Analytic.ofPoly_pow
statement:
theorem ofPoly_pow (P : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) (k : ℕ) :
    ofPoly (P ^ k) = ofPoly P ^ k
proof: := map_pow ofPolyHom P k

name: Analytic.ofPoly_sum
statement:
theorem ofPoly_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (P : ι → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) :
    ofPoly (∑ i ∈ s, P i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ofPoly (P i)
proof: := map_sum ofPolyHom P s

name: Analytic.ofPoly_X
statement: theorem ofPoly_X : ofPoly (Polynomial.X : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) = X 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPoly_def, Polynomial.coe_X, ← splitFirst_X_zero, (splitFirst K m).symm_apply_apply]

name: Analytic.ofPoly_C
statement: theorem ofPoly_C (a : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) : ofPoly (Polynomial.C a) = liftTail a
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPoly_def, Polynomial.coe_C, ← splitFirst_liftTail, (splitFirst K m).symm_apply_apply]

name: Analytic.ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial
statement:
theorem ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial (e : ℕ) (c : Fin e → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ofPoly (weierstrassPolynomial e c) = weierstrassPoly e c
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPoly_def, ← splitFirst_weierstrassPoly, (splitFirst K m).symm_apply_apply]

name: Analytic.degLt_ofPoly
statement:
theorem degLt_ofPoly (P : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) :
    DegLt (P.natDegree + 1) (ofPoly P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degLt_iff_splitFirst, splitFirst_ofPoly]
  intro k hk
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe]
  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)

name: Analytic.degLt_ofPoly_of_natDegree_lt
statement:
theorem degLt_ofPoly_of_natDegree_lt {N : ℕ} {P : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)}
    (hP : P.natDegree < N) : DegLt N (ofPoly P)
proof:
:=
  (degLt_ofPoly P).mono (by omega)

name: Analytic.ofPoly_toPoly
statement:
theorem ofPoly_toPoly {N : ℕ} {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : DegLt N f) :
    ofPoly (toPoly N f) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPoly_def, toPoly, ← splitFirst_eq_trunc hf, (splitFirst K m).symm_apply_apply]

name: Analytic.natDegree_toPoly_lt
statement:
theorem natDegree_toPoly_lt (N : ℕ) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (toPoly N f).natDegree < N
proof:
:= by
  unfold toPoly
  have := PowerSeries.degree_trunc_lt (splitFirst K m f) N
  rcases eq_or_ne (PowerSeries.trunc N (splitFirst K m f)) 0 with h | h
  · rw [h, Polynomial.natDegree_zero]; exact hN
  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt h |>.2 this

name: Analytic.exists_isRegularIn_ofPoly
statement:
theorem exists_isRegularIn_ofPoly {Q : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)} (hQ : Q.Monic) :
    ∃ d' : ℕ, d' ≤ Q.natDegree ∧ IsRegularIn (ofPoly Q) d'
proof:
:= by
  set φ := (splitFirst K m (ofPoly Q)).map (IsLocalRing.residue (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) with hφ
  have hcoe : PowerSeries.coeff Q.natDegree φ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hφ, PowerSeries.coeff_map, splitFirst_ofPoly, Polynomial.coeff_coe, hQ.coeff_natDegree,
      map_one]
    exact one_ne_zero
  have hle : φ.order ≤ Q.natDegree := PowerSeries.order_le _ hcoe
  have hne : φ.order ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (WithTop.coe_ne_top) hle
  have hcast : (φ.order.toNat : ℕ∞) = φ.order := ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr hne
  refine ⟨φ.order.toNat, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : (φ.order.toNat : ℕ∞) ≤ Q.natDegree := hcast ▸ hle
    exact_mod_cast this
  · change φ.order = _
    exact hcast.symm

name: Analytic.exists_isRegularIn_weierstrassPoly
statement:
theorem exists_isRegularIn_weierstrassPoly (e : ℕ) (c : Fin e → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    ∃ d' : ℕ, d' ≤ e ∧ IsRegularIn (weierstrassPoly e c : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) d'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d', hd', hreg⟩ := exists_isRegularIn_ofPoly (monic_weierstrassPolynomial e c)
  rw [ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial] at hreg
  rw [natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial] at hd'
  exact ⟨d', hd', hreg⟩

name: Analytic.mem_rowKer_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rowKer_iff {p : ℕ} (G : Fin p → 𝒪) (P : Fin p → 𝒪) :
    P ∈ rowKer G ↔ ∑ j, G j * P j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowKer, mem_relKer_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => h 0, fun h _ => h⟩

name: Analytic.degLtRel_mono
statement:
theorem degLtRel_mono {p : ℕ} {N N' : ℕ} (h : N ≤ N') (G : Fin p → 𝒪) :
    degLtRel N G ⊆ degLtRel N' G
proof:
:=
  fun _ hb => ⟨fun j => (hb.1 j).mono h, hb.2⟩

name: Analytic.scaled_eq_smul
statement: theorem scaled_eq_smul (c : 𝒪) (H : Fin (p + 1) → 𝒪) : scaled c H = c • H
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.trivialRel_mem_rowKer
statement:
theorem trivialRel_mem_rowKer (Q : 𝒪) (F : Fin p → 𝒪) (j : Fin p) :
    trivialRel Q F j ∈ rowKer (Fin.cons Q F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rowKer_iff, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [trivialRel, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun i _ hi => by simp [hi]) (by simp)]
  simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]
  ring

name: Analytic.rowKer_le_span_degLt_of_weierstrass
statement:
theorem rowKer_le_span_degLt_of_weierstrass (hd' : d' < d) {c : Fin d' → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K}
    (hc0 : ∀ k, constantCoeff (c k) = 0) (Q : 𝒪)
    (hQ : (Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = weierstrassPoly d' c)
    (F : Fin p → 𝒪) (hF : ∀ j, DegLt d (F j : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)) :
    rowKer (Fin.cons Q F) ≤ Submodule.span 𝒪 (degLtRel d (Fin.cons Q F))
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsRegularIn (Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) d' := by
    rw [hQ]; exact isRegularIn_weierstrassPoly hc0
  have hQdeg : DegLt d (Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
    rw [hQ]; exact (degLt_weierstrassPoly d' c).mono hd'
  intro P hP
  rw [mem_rowKer_iff, Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hP
  simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ] at hP
  
  choose! q r hq hr hrdeg heq _ using fun j : Fin p =>
    exists_unique_weierstrassDivision (P j.succ).2 Q.2 hreg
  obtain ⟨qs, hqs⟩ : ∃ qs : Fin p → 𝒪, ∀ j, (qs j : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = q j :=
    ⟨fun j => ⟨q j, hq j⟩, fun j => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs⟩ : ∃ rs : Fin p → 𝒪, ∀ j, (rs j : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = r j :=
    ⟨fun j => ⟨r j, hr j⟩, fun j => rfl⟩
  have hrdeg' : ∀ j, DegLt d' (rs j : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := fun j => by
    rw [hrs]; exact hrdeg j
  have heq' : ∀ j, P j.succ = qs j * Q + rs j := fun j => Subtype.ext (by
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, Subalgebra.coe_mul, hqs, hrs]; exact heq j)
  
  obtain ⟨P', hP'def⟩ : ∃ P' : Fin (p + 1) → 𝒪,
      P' = P - ∑ j, scaled (qs j) (trivialRel Q F j) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hP'0 : P' 0 = P 0 + ∑ j, qs j * F j := by
    rw [hP'def, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
    have hneg : ∀ x, scaled (qs x) (trivialRel Q F x) 0 = -(qs x * F x) := fun x => by
      simp only [scaled, trivialRel, Fin.cons_zero]
      exact mul_neg (qs x) (F x)
    simp only [hneg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sub_neg_eq_add]
  have hP'succ : ∀ j, P' j.succ = rs j := by
    intro j
    rw [hP'def, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
    have hcomp : ∀ i, scaled (qs i) (trivialRel Q F i) j.succ = if i = j then qs j * Q else 0 := by
      intro i
      simp only [scaled, trivialRel, Fin.cons_succ]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; simp only [Pi.single_eq_same, ite_true]
      · simp only [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij), mul_zero, ite_eq_right hij]
    simp only [hcomp, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [heq' j]; ring
  have hP'mem : P' ∈ rowKer (Fin.cons Q F) := by
    have hPmem : P ∈ rowKer (Fin.cons Q F) := by
      rw [mem_rowKer_iff, Fin.sum_univ_succ]; simpa using hP
    rw [hP'def]
    refine Submodule.sub_mem _ hPmem (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [scaled_eq_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (trivialRel_mem_rowKer Q F j)
  
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : 𝒪, T = ∑ j, F j * rs j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTdeg : DegLt (d + d') (T : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
    rw [hTdef, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
    exact DegLt.sum _ fun j _ => by
      rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul]; exact (hF j).mul (hrdeg' j)
  have hQP' : Q * P' 0 = -T := by
    have := (mem_rowKer_iff _ _).1 hP'mem
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at this
    simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, hP'succ] at this
    rw [hTdef]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left this
  have hQP'c : (Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) * (P' 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
      -(T : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hQP'
    rwa [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_neg] at this
  
  
  have hP'0deg : DegLt d (P' 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
    obtain ⟨Tp, hTp⟩ : ∃ Tp, Tp = toPoly (d + d') (T : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Qp, hQp⟩ : ∃ Qp, Qp = weierstrassPolynomial d' c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hQpm : Qp.Monic := by rw [hQp]; exact monic_weierstrassPolynomial d' c
    have hQpdeg : Qp.natDegree = d' := by rw [hQp]; exact natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial d' c
    have hQpoly : ofPoly Qp = (Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
      rw [hQp, ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial, hQ]
    have hTpdeg : Tp.natDegree < d + d' := by rw [hTp]; exact natDegree_toPoly_lt _ _ (by omega)
    have hdiv := Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div Tp Qp
    have hqdeg : (Tp /ₘ Qp).natDegree < d := by
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_divByMonic _ hQpm, hQpdeg]
      omega
    have hrdegp : DegLt d' (ofPoly (Tp %ₘ Qp) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
      rcases eq_or_ne (Tp %ₘ Qp) 0 with h0 | h0
      · rw [h0, ofPoly_zero]; exact DegLt.zero _
      · apply degLt_ofPoly_of_natDegree_lt
        have := Polynomial.degree_modByMonic_lt Tp hQpm
        rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hQpm.ne_zero, hQpdeg] at this
        exact (Polynomial.natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt h0).2 this
    have hT : (T : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
        ofPoly (Tp %ₘ Qp) + (Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) * ofPoly (Tp /ₘ Qp) := by
      have h1 : (T : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = ofPoly Tp := by
        rw [hTp, ofPoly_toPoly hTdeg]
      rw [h1]
      conv_lhs => rw [← hdiv]
      rw [ofPoly_add, ofPoly_mul, hQpoly]
    
    obtain ⟨q0, r0, -, -, -, -, huniq⟩ :=
      exists_unique_weierstrassDivision (neg_mem T.2) Q.2 hreg
    have h1 := huniq (P' 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) 0 (fun _ _ => by simp)
      (by rw [add_zero, mul_comm]; exact hQP'c.symm)
    have hT' : -(T : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
        (-(ofPoly (Tp /ₘ Qp))) * (Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) + (-(ofPoly (Tp %ₘ Qp))) := by
      rw [hT]; ring
    have h2 := huniq (-(ofPoly (Tp /ₘ Qp))) (-(ofPoly (Tp %ₘ Qp))) hrdegp.neg hT'
    have : (P' 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = -(ofPoly (Tp /ₘ Qp)) := h1.1.trans h2.1.symm
    rw [this]
    exact (degLt_ofPoly_of_natDegree_lt hqdeg).neg
  
  have hP'set : P' ∈ degLtRel d (Fin.cons Q F) := by
    refine ⟨fun j => ?_, hP'mem⟩
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
    · exact hP'0deg
    · rw [hP'succ]; exact (hrdeg' i).mono hd'.le
  have hHset : ∀ j, trivialRel Q F j ∈ degLtRel d (Fin.cons Q F) := by
    intro j
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, trivialRel_mem_rowKer Q F j⟩
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · simp only [trivialRel, Fin.cons_zero]
      rw [Subalgebra.coe_neg]; exact (hF j).neg
    · simp only [trivialRel, Fin.cons_succ]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; simp only [Pi.single_eq_same]; exact hQdeg
      · simp only [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hij]; exact DegLt.zero _
  have : P = P' + ∑ j, scaled (qs j) (trivialRel Q F j) := by rw [hP'def]; abel
  rw [this]
  refine Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span hP'set) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [scaled_eq_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (hHset j))

name: Analytic.weierstrassPoly_mem_conv
proof:
:= by
  unfold weierstrassPoly
  refine Subalgebra.add_mem _ (Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (X_mem_conv 0) _)
    (Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun j _ => ?_)
  exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (liftTail_mem_conv (hc j)) (Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (X_mem_conv 0) _)

name: Analytic.degLt_unit_of_monic
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Qp, hQp⟩ : ∃ Qp, Qp = weierstrassPolynomial d' c' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQpm : Qp.Monic := by rw [hQp]; exact monic_weierstrassPolynomial d' c'
  have hQpdeg : Qp.natDegree = d' := by rw [hQp]; exact natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial d' c'
  have hdiv := Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div Q Qp
  have hqdeg : (Q /ₘ Qp).natDegree < Q.natDegree - d' + 1 := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_divByMonic _ hQpm, hQpdeg]; omega
  have hrdeg : DegLt d' (ofPoly (Q %ₘ Qp) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
    rcases eq_or_ne (Q %ₘ Qp) 0 with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0, ofPoly_zero]; exact DegLt.zero _
    · apply degLt_ofPoly_of_natDegree_lt
      have := Polynomial.degree_modByMonic_lt Q hQpm
      rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hQpm.ne_zero, hQpdeg] at this
      exact (Polynomial.natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt h0).2 this
  have hQreg : IsRegularIn (weierstrassPoly d' c' : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) d' :=
    isRegularIn_weierstrassPoly hc'0
  have hF' : ofPoly Q = ofPoly (Q /ₘ Qp) * weierstrassPoly d' c' + ofPoly (Q %ₘ Qp) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hdiv]
    rw [ofPoly_add, ofPoly_mul, hQp, ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial]; ring
  obtain ⟨q0, r0, -, -, -, -, huniq⟩ :=
    exists_unique_weierstrassDivision hF (weierstrassPoly_mem_conv hc') hQreg
  have h1 := huniq u 0 (fun _ _ => by simp) (by rw [add_zero]; exact hprep)
  have h2 := huniq (ofPoly (Q /ₘ Qp)) (ofPoly (Q %ₘ Qp)) hrdeg hF'
  have : u = ofPoly (Q /ₘ Qp) := h1.1.trans h2.1.symm
  rw [this]
  exact degLt_ofPoly_of_natDegree_lt hqdeg

name: Analytic.rowKer_le_span_degLt
statement:
theorem rowKer_le_span_degLt (he : e < d) {Q : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)} (hQ : Q.Monic)
    (hQe : Q.natDegree = e) (F0 : 𝒪) (hF0 : (F0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = ofPoly Q)
    (F : Fin p → 𝒪) (hF : ∀ j, DegLt d (F j : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)) :
    rowKer (Fin.cons F0 F) ≤ Submodule.span 𝒪 (degLtRel (3 * d) (Fin.cons F0 F))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d', hd'e, hreg⟩ := exists_isRegularIn_ofPoly hQ
  rw [hQe] at hd'e
  have hregF : IsRegularIn (F0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) d' := by rw [hF0]; exact hreg
  obtain ⟨u, c', hu, hu0, hc', hprep, -⟩ := exists_unique_weierstrassPreparation F0.2 hregF
  have hprep' : ofPoly Q = u * weierstrassPoly d' c' := by rw [← hF0]; exact hprep
  have hFconv : ofPoly Q ∈ Conv K (m + 1) := hF0 ▸ F0.2
  have hudeg : DegLt d u :=
    (degLt_unit_of_monic hFconv (fun j => (hc' j).1) (fun j => (hc' j).2) hprep').mono
      (by omega)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : 𝒪, (Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = weierstrassPoly d' c' :=
    ⟨⟨_, weierstrassPoly_mem_conv fun j => (hc' j).1⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : 𝒪, (U : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = u := ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, rfl⟩
  have hUdeg : DegLt d (U : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by rw [hU]; exact hudeg
  have hF0eq : F0 = U * Q := Subtype.ext (by rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, hU, hQ, hF0]; exact hprep')
  have hUunit : IsUnit U := by
    have h := (isUnit_iff_constantCoeff_ne_zero hu).2 hu0
    have hUeq : U = ⟨u, hu⟩ := Subtype.ext hU
    rw [hUeq]; exact h
  
  have hA :=
    rowKer_le_span_degLt_of_weierstrass (show d' < d by omega) (fun j => (hc' j).2) Q hQ F hF
  intro P hP
  have hP' := (mem_rowKer_iff _ _).1 hP
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hP'
  simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, hF0eq] at hP'
  
  have hPt : Fin.cons (U * P 0) (fun j => P j.succ) ∈ rowKer (Fin.cons Q F) := by
    rw [mem_rowKer_iff, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
    rw [← hP']; ring
  have hspan := hA hPt
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ0, hΦs⟩ : ∃ Φ : (Fin (p + 1) → 𝒪) →ₗ[𝒪] (Fin (p + 1) → 𝒪),
      (∀ b, Φ b 0 = b 0) ∧ ∀ b (j : Fin p), Φ b j.succ = U * b j.succ :=
    ⟨{ toFun := fun b => Fin.cons (b 0) fun j => U * b j.succ
       map_add' := fun a b => by
         funext i
         refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
         · simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Pi.add_apply]
         · simp only [Fin.cons_succ, Pi.add_apply, mul_add]
       map_smul' := fun r b => by
         funext i
         refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
         · simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Pi.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
         · simp only [Fin.cons_succ, Pi.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm] },
      fun b => rfl, fun b j => rfl⟩
  have hΦP : Φ (Fin.cons (U * P 0) fun j => P j.succ) = U • P := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · rw [hΦ0]; simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    · rw [hΦs]; simp only [Fin.cons_succ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hΦS : Φ '' degLtRel d (Fin.cons Q F) ⊆ degLtRel (3 * d) (Fin.cons F0 F) := by
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
      · rw [hΦ0]; exact (hb.1 0).mono (by omega)
      · rw [hΦs, Subalgebra.coe_mul]
        exact (hUdeg.mul (hb.1 i.succ)).mono (by omega)
    · rw [mem_rowKer_iff, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, hΦ0, hΦs, hF0eq]
      have hb2 := (mem_rowKer_iff _ _).1 hb.2
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hb2
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ] at hb2
      calc U * Q * b 0 + ∑ j, F j * (U * b j.succ) = U * (Q * b 0 + ∑ j, F j * b j.succ) := by
            rw [mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
            congr 1
            · ring
            · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hb2, mul_zero]
  have hUP : U • P ∈ Submodule.span 𝒪 (degLtRel (3 * d) (Fin.cons F0 F)) := by
    rw [← hΦP]
    have hmem : Φ (Fin.cons (U * P 0) fun j => P j.succ) ∈
        Submodule.map Φ (Submodule.span 𝒪 (degLtRel d (Fin.cons Q F))) :=
      Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hspan
    rw [Submodule.map_span] at hmem
    exact Submodule.span_mono hΦS hmem
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := hUunit.exists_left_inv
  have : P = V • (U • P) := by rw [smul_smul, hV, one_smul]
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hUP

name: Analytic.coeff_axis
statement:
theorem coeff_axis (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) (ν : Fin 1 →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff ν (axis f) = coeff (Finsupp.single 0 (ν 0)) f
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.coeff_single_axis
statement:
theorem coeff_single_axis (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) (k : ℕ) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 1) k) (axis f) = coeff (Finsupp.single 0 k) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_axis, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: Analytic.constantCoeff_axis
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_axis (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) :
    constantCoeff (axis f) = constantCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_axis, Finsupp.zero_apply, Finsupp.single_zero,
    coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]

name: Analytic.axis_zero
statement: theorem axis_zero : axis (0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext ν; simp [coeff_axis]

name: Analytic.axis_add
statement: theorem axis_add (f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) : axis (f + g) = axis f + axis g
proof:
:= by
  ext ν; simp only [coeff_axis, map_add]

name: Analytic.axis_one
statement: theorem axis_one : axis (1 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ν
  rw [coeff_axis, coeff_one, coeff_one]
  have : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin (m + 1)) (ν 0) = 0) ↔ ν = 0 := by
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_zero, Fin1.eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [this]

name: Analytic.axis_mul
statement: theorem axis_mul (f g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) : axis (f * g) = axis f * axis g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ν
  have hν : ν = Finsupp.single 0 (ν 0) := Fin1.eq_single ν
  rw [coeff_axis, coeff_mul, coeff_mul, hν, Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finsupp.antidiagonal_single,
    Finsupp.antidiagonal_single, Finset.sum_map, Finset.sum_map]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  simp only [Function.Embedding.coe_prodMap, Prod.map_fst, Prod.map_snd,
    Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, coeff_single_axis]

name: Analytic.axisHom_apply
statement: theorem axisHom_apply (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) : axisHom K f = axis f
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.axis_X_zero
statement: theorem axis_X_zero : axis (X 0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = X 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ν
  rw [coeff_axis, coeff_X, coeff_X]
  have : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin (m + 1)) (ν 0) = Finsupp.single 0 1) ↔
      ν = Finsupp.single 0 1 := by
    rw [(Finsupp.single_injective 0).eq_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h; rw [Fin1.eq_single ν, h]
    · intro h; rw [h, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
  simp only [this]

name: Analytic.axis_X_zero_pow
statement: theorem axis_X_zero_pow (d : ℕ) : axis (X 0 ^ d : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = X 0 ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← axisHom_apply, map_pow, axisHom_apply, axis_X_zero]

name: Analytic.axis_C
statement: theorem axis_C (c : K) : axis (C c : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = C c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ν
  rw [coeff_axis, coeff_C, coeff_C]
  have : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin (m + 1)) (ν 0) = 0) ↔ ν = 0 := by
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_zero, Fin1.eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [this]

name: Analytic.coeff_single_liftFirst
statement:
theorem coeff_single_liftFirst (e : MvPowerSeries (Fin 1) K) (k : ℕ) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single 0 k) (liftFirst e : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
      coeff (Finsupp.single 0 k) e
proof:
:= by
  have h := coeff_embDomain_rename (embFirst m) e (Finsupp.single 0 k)
  rw [Finsupp.embDomain_single] at h
  exact h

name: Analytic.constantCoeff_liftFirst
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_liftFirst (e : MvPowerSeries (Fin 1) K) :
    constantCoeff (liftFirst e : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = constantCoeff e
proof:
:= by
  have h := coeff_single_liftFirst (m := m) e 0
  rwa [Finsupp.single_zero, Finsupp.single_zero, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
    coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at h

name: Analytic.coeff_liftFirst_of_ne
statement:
theorem coeff_liftFirst_of_ne (e : MvPowerSeries (Fin 1) K) {μ : Fin (m + 1) →₀ ℕ}
    (hμ : μ ≠ Finsupp.single 0 (μ 0)) : coeff μ (liftFirst e) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply coeff_rename_eq_zero
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  apply hμ
  have hy' : Finsupp.mapDomain (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : Fin (m + 1))) y =
      Finsupp.single 0 (y 0) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [Fin1.eq_single y]
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_single
  rw [← hy, hy', Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: Analytic.axis_liftFirst
statement:
theorem axis_liftFirst (e : MvPowerSeries (Fin 1) K) :
    axis (liftFirst e : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = e
proof:
:= by
  ext ν
  rw [coeff_axis, coeff_single_liftFirst, ← Fin1.eq_single]

name: Analytic.liftFirst_mul
statement:
theorem liftFirst_mul (e e' : MvPowerSeries (Fin 1) K) :
    (liftFirst (e * e') : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = liftFirst e * liftFirst e'
proof:
:=
  map_mul _ _ _

name: Analytic.liftFirst_one
statement: theorem liftFirst_one : (liftFirst 1 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = 1
proof:
:=
  map_one _

name: Analytic.convNorm_liftFirst
statement:
theorem convNorm_liftFirst (ρ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ≥0) (e : MvPowerSeries (Fin 1) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (liftFirst e) = ConvNorm (fun _ => ρ 0) e
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvNorm
  refine (Function.Injective.tsum_eq (f := fun μ : Fin (m + 1) →₀ ℕ =>
    ‖coeff μ (liftFirst e)‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ μ : ℝ≥0∞)) Fin1.single_apply_injective ?_).symm.trans
    (tsum_congr fun ν => ?_)
  · intro μ hμ
    by_contra hμ'
    apply hμ
    have : μ ≠ Finsupp.single 0 (μ 0) := fun h => hμ' ⟨Finsupp.single 0 (μ 0), by
      beta_reduce
      rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, ← h]⟩
    simp [coeff_liftFirst_of_ne e this]
  · rw [coeff_single_liftFirst, ← Fin1.eq_single, monomialEval_single_pow, monomialEval_fin1]

name: Analytic.liftFirst_mem_conv
statement:
theorem liftFirst_mem_conv {e : MvPowerSeries (Fin 1) K} (he : e ∈ Conv K 1) :
    (liftFirst e : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) ∈ Conv K (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := he
  refine ⟨⟨fun _ => r 0, fun _ => r.pos 0⟩, ?_⟩
  change ConvNorm (fun _ => r 0) (liftFirst e) ≠ ⊤
  rw [convNorm_liftFirst]
  have : (fun _ : Fin 1 => r 0) = ⇑r := funext fun i => by rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]
  rw [this]
  exact hr

name: Analytic.convNorm_axis_le
statement:
theorem convNorm_axis_le (ρ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) :
    ConvNorm (fun _ => ρ 0) (axis f) ≤ ConvNorm ρ f
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvNorm
  calc ∑' ν, ‖coeff ν (axis f)‖ₑ * (monomialEval (fun _ => ρ 0) ν : ℝ≥0∞)
      = ∑' ν : Fin 1 →₀ ℕ,
          (fun μ => ‖coeff μ f‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ μ : ℝ≥0∞)) (Finsupp.single 0 (ν 0)) := by
        refine tsum_congr fun ν => ?_
        beta_reduce
        rw [coeff_axis, monomialEval_fin1, monomialEval_single_pow]
    _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.tsum_comp_le_tsum_of_injective Fin1.single_apply_injective
          (fun μ => ‖coeff μ f‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ μ : ℝ≥0∞))

name: Analytic.axis_mem_conv
statement:
theorem axis_mem_conv {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K} (hf : f ∈ Conv K (m + 1)) :
    axis f ∈ Conv K 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hf
  exact ⟨⟨fun _ => ρ 0, fun _ => ρ.pos 0⟩, ne_top_of_le_ne_top hρ (convNorm_axis_le ρ f)⟩

name: Analytic.axis_liftTail
statement:
theorem axis_liftTail (a : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    axis (liftTail a : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = C (constantCoeff a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ν
  rw [coeff_axis, coeff_C]
  by_cases h : ν 0 = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left ((Fin1.eq_zero_iff ν).mpr h), h, Finsupp.single_zero]
    have := coeff_embDomain_rename (Fin.succEmb m) a 0
    rw [Finsupp.embDomain_zero] at this
    exact this.trans (coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply a)
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h' => h ((Fin1.eq_zero_iff ν).mp h'))]
    apply coeff_rename_eq_zero
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h0 : (Finsupp.mapDomain Fin.succ y) 0 = (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin (m + 1)) (ν 0)) 0 :=
      congrArg (fun μ : Fin (m + 1) →₀ ℕ => μ 0) hy
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ (by rintro ⟨j, hj⟩; exact Fin.succ_ne_zero j hj),
      Finsupp.single_eq_same] at h0
    exact h (h0.symm)

name: Analytic.constantCoeff_liftTail
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_liftTail (a : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    constantCoeff (liftTail a : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = constantCoeff a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← constantCoeff_axis, axis_liftTail, constantCoeff_C]

name: Analytic.residue_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem residue_eq_zero_iff (a : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    IsLocalRing.residue (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) a = 0 ↔ constantCoeff a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff,
    MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, isUnit_iff_ne_zero, not_not]

name: Analytic.constantCoeff_coeff_splitFirst
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_coeff_splitFirst (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) (k : ℕ) :
    constantCoeff (PowerSeries.coeff k (splitFirst K m g)) = coeff (Finsupp.single 0 k) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, MvPowerSeries.coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv]
  have h : Finsupp.cons k (0 : Fin m →₀ ℕ) = Finsupp.single 0 k := by
    ext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp
    · simp [Finsupp.cons_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero]
  rw [h]

name: Analytic.isRegularIn_iff
statement:
theorem isRegularIn_iff (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) (d : ℕ) :
    IsRegularIn g d ↔
      (∀ k < d, coeff (Finsupp.single 0 k) g = 0) ∧ coeff (Finsupp.single 0 d) g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsRegularIn
  rw [PowerSeries.order_eq_nat]
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_map, ne_eq, residue_eq_zero_iff, constantCoeff_coeff_splitFirst]
  exact and_comm

name: Analytic.map_residue_ne_zero_of_isRegularIn
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have := (PowerSeries.order_eq_nat.mp hg).1
  rw [h0, map_zero] at this
  exact this rfl

name: Analytic.zero_iff_of_unit_mul
proof:
:= fun x hx => by
  rw [hfP x hx, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right (hu x hx)]

name: Analytic.coeff_cons_liftTail
statement:
theorem coeff_cons_liftTail (a : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (k : ℕ) (x : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff (Finsupp.cons k x) (liftTail a : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
      if k = 0 then coeff x a else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hk
  · subst hk
    have h := coeff_embDomain_rename (Fin.succEmb m) a x
    rw [embDomain_succEmb] at h
    exact h
  · apply coeff_rename_eq_zero
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h0 : (Finsupp.mapDomain Fin.succ y) 0 = (Finsupp.cons k x) 0 :=
      congrArg (fun μ : Fin (m + 1) →₀ ℕ => μ 0) hy
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ (by rintro ⟨j, hj⟩; exact Fin.succ_ne_zero j hj),
      Finsupp.cons_zero] at h0
    exact hk h0.symm

name: Analytic.coeff_cons_liftTail_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_cons_liftTail_mul_X_pow (a : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (n k : ℕ) (x : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff (Finsupp.cons k x) (liftTail a * X 0 ^ n : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
      if k = n then coeff x a else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq, coeff_mul_monomial]
  have hle : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin (m + 1)) n ≤ Finsupp.cons k x) ↔ n ≤ k := by
    rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff, Finsupp.cons_zero]
  by_cases h : n ≤ k
  · rw [ite_eq_left (hle.mpr h), cons_sub_single_zero, coeff_cons_liftTail, mul_one]
    by_cases hk : k = n
    · rw [ite_eq_left hk, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hk, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h' => h (hle.mp h')), ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: Analytic.coeff_cons_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_cons_X_pow (d k : ℕ) (x : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff (Finsupp.cons k x) (X 0 ^ d : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
      if k = d ∧ x = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coeff_X_pow, ← cons_zero_eq_single]
  by_cases h : k = d ∧ x = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (cons_eq_cons_iff.mpr h)]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun h' => h (cons_eq_cons_iff.mp h'))]

name: Analytic.coeff_cons_weierstrassPoly
statement:
theorem coeff_cons_weierstrassPoly (d : ℕ) (c : Fin d → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (k : ℕ)
    (x : Fin m →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff (Finsupp.cons k x) (weierstrassPoly d c) =
      (if k = d ∧ x = 0 then 1 else 0) +
        ∑ j : Fin d, if k = d - 1 - (j : ℕ) then coeff x (c j) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold weierstrassPoly
  rw [map_add, map_sum, coeff_cons_X_pow]
