      have hyfib : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range e → i ≠ i₀ →
          Af (y ∘ e) * y i = (specialize (B i) (y ∘ e)).eval (τ (y ∘ e)) := fun i hi hii => by
        have h := congrFun hyφ i
        rw [h, hφ_fib (y ∘ e) i hi hii, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hyA]
      have hy_q : evalSeries (polyElt e i₀ Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) y = 0 := by
        rw [hy.eq_q, hyi₀]; exact hyτ
      have hy_rel : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range e →
          evalSeries (relElt e i₀ A B i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) y = 0 := fun i hi => by
        by_cases hii : i = i₀
        · subst hii
          rw [hy.eq_rel0, hy_q, zero_mul]
        · rw [hy.eq_rel i, hyi₀, hyfib i hi hii, sub_self]
      have hy_qf : ∀ i : {i : Fin n // i ∉ Set.range e},
          evalSeries (polyElt e i (Qf i) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) y = 0 := fun i => by
        have hmem : y ∈ zeroSet {relElt e i₀ A B i} := by
          rw [mem_zeroSet_iff]
          intro g hg
          rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hg
          rw [hg]
          exact hy_rel i i.2
        have h1 := hy.vcl i hmem
        rw [hy.eq_cl i, hy.eq_g i, hy_q, zero_mul, sub_zero] at h1
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hyA)
      have hyG₀ : y ∈ zeroSet (gensFinset e i₀ Q A B Qf) := by
        rw [mem_zeroSet_iff]
        intro g hg
        rw [gensFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hg
        rcases hg with (hg | ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩) | ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩
        · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hg
          rw [hg]
          exact hy_q
        · exact hy_qf ⟨i, hi⟩
        · exact hy_rel i hi
      rw [mem_zeroSet_iff]
      intro g hg
      have h1 := hy.vAN g hg hyG₀
      rw [hy.eq_AN g hg] at h1
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hyA)

name: Analytic.monomialEval_embDomain
statement:
theorem monomialEval_embDomain (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (x : Fin n → K) (μ : Fin d →₀ ℕ) :
    monomialEval x (Finsupp.embDomain e μ) = monomialEval (x ∘ e) μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold monomialEval
  rw [Finsupp.prod_embDomain]
  rfl

name: Analytic.evalSeries_rename
statement:
theorem evalSeries_rename (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) (x : Fin n → K) :
    evalSeries (rename e f) x = evalSeries f (x ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  unfold evalSeries
  have hsupp : Function.support (fun ν : Fin n →₀ ℕ => coeff ν (rename e f) * monomialEval x ν) ⊆
      Set.range (Finsupp.embDomain (M := ℕ) e) := by
    intro ν hν
    by_contra hnot
    apply hν
    have : ν ∉ Set.range (Finsupp.mapDomain e) := by
      rintro ⟨μ, hμ⟩
      exact hnot ⟨μ, by rw [Finsupp.embDomain_eq_mapDomain, hμ]⟩
    change coeff ν (rename e f) * monomialEval x ν = 0
    rw [coeff_rename_eq_zero _ f this, zero_mul]
  rw [← (Finsupp.embDomain_injective (M := ℕ) e).tsum_eq hsupp]
  refine tsum_congr fun μ => ?_
  rw [coeff_embDomain_rename, monomialEval_embDomain]

name: Analytic.convResidue_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem convResidue_apply (c : Conv K m) :
    convResidue K c = constantCoeff (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.map_weierstrassPolynomial
statement:
theorem map_weierstrassPolynomial {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (d : ℕ)
    (c : Fin d → R) :
    (weierstrassPolynomial d c).map f = weierstrassPolynomial d fun j => f (c j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold weierstrassPolynomial
  simp only [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_sum,
    Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C]

name: Analytic.coeff_eq_zero_of_monic_dvd_X_pow
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_monic_dvd_X_pow {a : Polynomial K} (ha : a.Monic) {d : ℕ}
    (hdvd : a ∣ Polynomial.X ^ d) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < a.natDegree) : a.coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hdvd
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [mul_zero] at hb
    exact pow_ne_zero d X_ne_zero hb
  have hbm : b.Monic := ha.of_mul_monic_left (hb ▸ monic_X_pow d)
  have hdeg : a.natDegree + b.natDegree = d := by
    rw [← ha.natDegree_mul hbm, ← hb, natDegree_X_pow]
  have htr : a.natTrailingDegree + b.natTrailingDegree = d := by
    rw [← natTrailingDegree_mul ha.ne_zero hb0, ← hb, natTrailingDegree_X_pow]
  have h1 := natTrailingDegree_le_natDegree a
  have h2 := natTrailingDegree_le_natDegree b
  by_contra hne
  have := natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero hne
  omega

name: Analytic.constantCoeff_coeff_eq_zero_of_map_dvd_X_pow
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_coeff_eq_zero_of_map_dvd_X_pow {Q : Polynomial (Conv K m)} (hQ : Q.Monic)
    {d : ℕ} (hmap : Q.map (convResidue K) ∣ Polynomial.X ^ d) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < Q.natDegree) :
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (Q.coeff i : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i < (Q.map (convResidue K)).natDegree := by rwa [hQ.natDegree_map]
  have := coeff_eq_zero_of_monic_dvd_X_pow (hQ.map _) hmap hi'
  rwa [Polynomial.coeff_map] at this

name: Analytic.exists_weierstrassPolynomial_of_monic_dvd
statement:
theorem exists_weierstrassPolynomial_of_monic_dvd {d : ℕ} {c : Fin d → Conv K m}
    (hc : ∀ j, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (c j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0)
    {Q : Polynomial (Conv K m)} (hQ : Q.Monic) (hdvd : Q ∣ weierstrassPolynomial d c) :
    ∃ (d' : ℕ) (c' : Fin d' → Conv K m),
      (∀ j, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (c' j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0) ∧
      Q = weierstrassPolynomial d' c'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Q.natDegree, fun j => Q.coeff (Q.natDegree - 1 - j), fun j => ?_,
    eq_weierstrassPolynomial_coeff_of_monic hQ⟩
  have hmap : Q.map (convResidue K) ∣ Polynomial.X ^ d := by
    have := Polynomial.map_dvd (convResidue K) hdvd
    rwa [map_weierstrassPolynomial,
      show (fun j => convResidue K (c j)) = fun _ : Fin d => (0 : K) from funext fun j => hc j,
      weierstrassPolynomial_zero] at this
  exact constantCoeff_coeff_eq_zero_of_map_dvd_X_pow hQ hmap (by omega)

name: Analytic.exists_weierstrassPolynomial_mul
statement:
theorem exists_weierstrassPolynomial_mul {d₁ d₂ : ℕ} {c₁ : Fin d₁ → Conv K m}
    {c₂ : Fin d₂ → Conv K m}
    (hc₁ : ∀ j, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (c₁ j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0)
    (hc₂ : ∀ j, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (c₂ j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0) :
    ∃ c : Fin (d₁ + d₂) → Conv K m,
      (∀ j, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (c j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0) ∧
      weierstrassPolynomial d₁ c₁ * weierstrassPolynomial d₂ c₂ =
        weierstrassPolynomial (d₁ + d₂) c
proof:
:= by
  set Q := weierstrassPolynomial d₁ c₁ * weierstrassPolynomial d₂ c₂ with hQdef
  have hQ : Q.Monic := (monic_weierstrassPolynomial d₁ c₁).mul (monic_weierstrassPolynomial d₂ c₂)
  have hdeg : Q.natDegree = d₁ + d₂ := by
    rw [hQdef, (monic_weierstrassPolynomial d₁ c₁).natDegree_mul
      (monic_weierstrassPolynomial d₂ c₂), natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial,
      natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial]
  have hmap : Q.map (convResidue K) ∣ Polynomial.X ^ (d₁ + d₂) := by
    rw [hQdef, Polynomial.map_mul, map_weierstrassPolynomial, map_weierstrassPolynomial,
      show (fun j => convResidue K (c₁ j)) = fun _ : Fin d₁ => (0 : K) from funext fun j => hc₁ j,
      show (fun j => convResidue K (c₂ j)) = fun _ : Fin d₂ => (0 : K) from funext fun j => hc₂ j,
      weierstrassPolynomial_zero, weierstrassPolynomial_zero, ← pow_add]
  have hQW := eq_weierstrassPolynomial_coeff_of_monic hQ
  rw [hdeg] at hQW
  refine ⟨fun j => Q.coeff (d₁ + d₂ - 1 - j), fun j => ?_, hQW⟩
  exact constantCoeff_coeff_eq_zero_of_map_dvd_X_pow hQ hmap (by omega)

name: Analytic.coe_convTail
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_convTail (c : Conv K m) :
    (convTail K c : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = liftTail c
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Analytic.convPolyEval_C
statement: @[simp] theorem convPolyEval_C (c : Conv K m) : convPolyEval K (Polynomial.C c) = convTail K c
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.eval₂_C _ _

name: Analytic.convPolyEval_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem convPolyEval_X :
    convPolyEval K (Polynomial.X : Polynomial (Conv K m)) = convX K 0
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.eval₂_X _ _

name: Analytic.coe_convPolyEval_eq_sum
statement:
theorem coe_convPolyEval_eq_sum (Q : Polynomial (Conv K m)) :
    (convPolyEval K Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1),
        liftTail (Q.coeff k : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) * X 0 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  change ((Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (convTail K).toRingHom (convX K 0) Q : Conv K (m + 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) = _
  rw [Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum_range]
  push_cast
  simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, coe_convTail, coe_convX]

name: Analytic.coeff_splitFirst_convPolyEval
statement:
theorem coeff_splitFirst_convPolyEval (Q : Polynomial (Conv K m)) (k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff k (splitFirst K m (convPolyEval K Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)) =
      (Q.coeff k : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_convPolyEval_eq_sum, map_sum]
  simp only [splitFirst_liftTail_mul_X_pow, map_sum, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1)) k]
  split_ifs with hk
  · rfl
  · rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hk
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]
    rfl

name: Analytic.convPolyEval_injective
statement:
theorem convPolyEval_injective :
    Function.Injective (convPolyEval K : Polynomial (Conv K m) → Conv K (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro Q Q' h
  refine Polynomial.ext fun k => ?_
  apply Subtype.ext
  have := congrArg (fun F : Conv K (m + 1) =>
    PowerSeries.coeff k (splitFirst K m (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K))) h
  simpa only [coeff_splitFirst_convPolyEval] using this

name: Analytic.coeff_convPolyEval_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finsupp.cons_tail ν, ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_coeff_finSuccEquiv]
  change coeff ν.tail (PowerSeries.coeff (ν 0) (splitFirst K m _)) = 0
  have hz : Q.coeff (ν 0) = 0 :=
    Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hQ (by exact_mod_cast hν))
  rw [coeff_splitFirst_convPolyEval, hz]
  simp

name: Analytic.coe_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial
statement:
theorem coe_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial (d : ℕ) (c : Fin d → Conv K m) :
    (convPolyEval K (weierstrassPolynomial d c) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
      weierstrassPoly d fun j => (c j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)
proof:
:= by
  apply (splitFirst K m).injective
  rw [splitFirst_weierstrassPoly]
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun k => ?_
  rw [coeff_splitFirst_convPolyEval, Polynomial.coeff_coe]
  have := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) => p.coeff k)
    (map_weierstrassPolynomial (Conv K m).val.toRingHom d c)
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_map] at this
  exact this

name: Analytic.isRegularIn_weierstrassPoly
statement:
theorem isRegularIn_weierstrassPoly {d : ℕ} {c : Fin d → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K}
    (hc : ∀ j, constantCoeff (c j) = 0) : IsRegularIn (weierstrassPoly d c) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRegularIn_iff]
  have hsum : ∀ k, (∑ j : Fin d, if k = d - 1 - (j : ℕ) then coeff (0 : Fin m →₀ ℕ) (c j) else 0) =
      0 := fun k => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => by
    split_ifs
    · rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hc]
    · rfl
  constructor
  · intro k hk
    rw [← cons_zero_eq_single, coeff_cons_weierstrassPoly, ite_eq_right (fun h => by omega),
      zero_add, hsum]
  · rw [← cons_zero_eq_single, coeff_cons_weierstrassPoly, ite_eq_left ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hsum, add_zero]
    exact one_ne_zero

name: Analytic.isRegularIn_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial]
  exact isRegularIn_weierstrassPoly hc

name: Analytic.exists_ringEquiv_quotient_weierstrass
statement:
theorem exists_ringEquiv_quotient_weierstrass {d : ℕ} {c : Fin d → Conv K m}
    (hc : ∀ j, constantCoeff (c j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0) :
    ∃ e : (Conv K (m + 1) ⧸ Ideal.span {convPolyEval K (weierstrassPolynomial d c)}) ≃+*
        (Polynomial (Conv K m) ⧸ Ideal.span {weierstrassPolynomial d c}),
      ∀ q : Polynomial (Conv K m),
        e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (convPolyEval K q)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q
proof:
:= by
  have hreg₀ := isRegularIn_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial hc
  have hmonic₀ := monic_weierstrassPolynomial d c
  have hdeg₀ := natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial d c
  generalize hW : weierstrassPolynomial d c = W at hreg₀ hmonic₀ hdeg₀ ⊢
  generalize hP : convPolyEval K W = P at hreg₀ ⊢
  have hle : Ideal.span {W} ≤ Ideal.comap (convPolyEval K) (Ideal.span {P}) := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, hP]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  let Φ : Polynomial (Conv K m) ⧸ Ideal.span {W} →+* Conv K (m + 1) ⧸ Ideal.span {P} :=
    Ideal.quotientMap (Ideal.span {P}) (convPolyEval K) hle
  have hΦmk : ∀ q : Polynomial (Conv K m),
      Φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (convPolyEval K q) := fun q =>
    Ideal.quotientMap_mk
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective Φ := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    obtain ⟨q, r, hdeg, hF⟩ := exists_division_conv (f := F) (g := P) hreg₀
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (∑ j : Fin d,
      Polynomial.C (sliceConv r (d - 1 - j)) * Polynomial.X ^ (d - 1 - (j : ℕ))), ?_⟩
    rw [hΦmk, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    have hr : convPolyEval K (∑ j : Fin d,
        Polynomial.C (sliceConv r (d - 1 - j)) * Polynomial.X ^ (d - 1 - (j : ℕ))) = r := by
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow, convPolyEval_C, convPolyEval_X K]
      exact (eq_sum_convTail_sliceConv hdeg).symm
    rw [hr, hF, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact ⟨-q, by ring⟩
  have key : ∀ Q : Polynomial (Conv K m), P ∣ convPolyEval K Q → W ∣ Q := by
    intro Q hy
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hy
    have hdiv := Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div Q W
    have hdegR : (Q %ₘ W).degree < d := by
      have := Polynomial.degree_modByMonic_lt Q hmonic₀
      rwa [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hmonic₀.ne_zero, hdeg₀] at this
    have hRP : convPolyEval K (Q %ₘ W) = (A - convPolyEval K (Q /ₘ W)) * P := by
      have h1 : convPolyEval K Q = convPolyEval K (Q %ₘ W) + P * convPolyEval K (Q /ₘ W) := by
        rw [← hP, ← map_mul, ← map_add, hdiv]
      rw [h1] at hA
      linear_combination hA
    obtain ⟨q0, r0, -, -, -, -, huniq⟩ :=
      exists_unique_weierstrassDivision (convPolyEval K (Q %ₘ W)).2 P.2 hreg₀
    have h1 := huniq
      ((A - convPolyEval K (Q /ₘ W) : Conv K (m + 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) 0
      (fun ν _ => by simp) (by rw [add_zero, ← Subalgebra.coe_mul, ← hRP])
    have h2 := huniq 0 (convPolyEval K (Q %ₘ W) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)
      (fun ν hν => coeff_convPolyEval_eq_zero_of_degree_lt hdegR hν) (by rw [zero_mul, zero_add])
    have hzero : convPolyEval K (Q %ₘ W) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [h2.2, ← h1.2]
      rfl
    have hmod : Q %ₘ W = 0 := convPolyEval_injective (by rw [hzero, map_zero])
    have hQ : W * (Q /ₘ W) = Q := by
      conv_rhs => rw [← hdiv]
      rw [hmod, zero_add]
    exact Dvd.intro _ hQ
  have hinj : Function.Injective Φ := by
    intro y y' hyy'
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    obtain ⟨Q', rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y'
    rw [hΦmk, hΦmk, Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← map_sub, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hyy'
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact key (Q - Q') hyy'
  let e : (Polynomial (Conv K m) ⧸ Ideal.span {W}) ≃+* (Conv K (m + 1) ⧸ Ideal.span {P}) :=
    RingEquiv.ofBijective Φ ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
  refine ⟨e.symm, fun q => ?_⟩
  apply e.injective
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (hΦmk q).symm

name: Analytic.convEmbed_surjective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem convEmbed_surjective_of_surjective (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (hsurj : Function.Surjective e) :
    Function.Surjective (convEmbed ℂ e)
proof:
:= by
  have hbij : Function.Bijective e := ⟨e.injective, hsurj⟩
  let ε : Fin d ≃ Fin n := Equiv.ofBijective e hbij
  intro g
  have hmem : MvPowerSeries.rename (⇑ε.symm.toEmbedding) g.1 ∈ Conv ℂ d :=
    rename_mem_conv ε.symm.toEmbedding g.2
  refine ⟨⟨_, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_convEmbed]
  change MvPowerSeries.rename ⇑e (MvPowerSeries.rename ⇑ε.symm.toEmbedding g.1) = g.1
  rw [MvPowerSeries.rename_rename]
  have key : ∀ (φ : Fin n → Fin n) [Filter.TendstoCofinite φ], φ = id →
      MvPowerSeries.rename φ g.1 = g.1 := by
    intro φ _ hφ
    subst hφ
    rw [MvPowerSeries.rename_id]
    rfl
  exact key _ (by funext x; change ε (ε.symm x) = x; exact ε.apply_symm_apply x)

name: Analytic.exists_notMem_range_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_notMem_range_of_ne_bot (P : Ideal (Conv ℂ n)) (hP : P ≠ ⊥) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n)
    (L : (Fin n → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ)) (hinj : Function.Injective (normMap ℂ P e L)) :
    ∃ i, i ∉ Set.range e
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hall
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective e := fun i => by
    by_contra hi
    exact hall ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hsurjC := convEmbed_surjective_of_surjective e hsurj
  apply hP
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hsurjC ((substEquiv L).symm g)
  have hgc : substEquiv L (convEmbed ℂ e c) = g := by rw [hc, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have h1 : normMap ℂ P e L c = 0 := by
    rw [normMap_apply, hgc, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]; exact hg
  have h2 : c = 0 := hinj (by rw [h1, map_zero])
  rw [← hgc, h2, map_zero, map_zero]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: Analytic.mk_substEquiv_eval_map
statement:
theorem mk_substEquiv_eval_map (P : Ideal (Conv ℂ n)) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n)
    (σ : Conv ℂ n ≃ₐ[ℂ] Conv ℂ n) (Q : (Conv ℂ d)[X]) (x : Conv ℂ n) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk P (σ ((Q.map (convEmbed ℂ e).toRingHom).eval x)) =
      eval₂ ((Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp ((σ : Conv ℂ n →+* Conv ℂ n).comp
        (convEmbed ℂ e).toRingHom)) (Ideal.Quotient.mk P (σ x)) Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_map]
  have h := hom_eval₂ Q (convEmbed ℂ e).toRingHom
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp (σ : Conv ℂ n →+* Conv ℂ n)) x
  rw [RingHom.comp_assoc] at h
  exact h

name: Analytic.exists_primitive_normalization
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_normalization (P : Ideal (Conv ℂ n)) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (L : (Fin n → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ)),
      Function.Injective (normMap ℂ P e L) ∧
      RingHom.Finite (A := Conv ℂ d) (B := Conv ℂ n ⧸ P)
        (normMap ℂ P e L : Conv ℂ d →+* Conv ℂ n ⧸ P) ∧
      ∃ (i₀ : Fin n) (_ : i₀ ∉ Set.range e) (Q : Polynomial (Conv ℂ d)) (A : Conv ℂ d),
        Q.Monic ∧ Irreducible Q ∧ A ≠ 0 ∧
        (Q.map (convEmbed ℂ e).toRingHom).eval (convX ℂ i₀) ∈ Ideal.comap (substEquiv L) P ∧
        ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range e → ∃ B : Polynomial (Conv ℂ d),
          convEmbed ℂ e A * convX ℂ i - (B.map (convEmbed ℂ e).toRingHom).eval (convX ℂ i₀) ∈
            Ideal.comap (substEquiv L) P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨d, e, L₀, hinj₀, hfin₀⟩ :=
    exists_noetherNormalization_analytic P (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance)
  obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ := exists_notMem_range_of_ne_bot P hP e L₀ hinj₀
  
  have hdom : IsDomain (Conv ℂ n ⧸ P) := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain P
  set f : Conv ℂ d →+* Conv ℂ n ⧸ P := (normMap ℂ P e L₀ : Conv ℂ d →+* Conv ℂ n ⧸ P) with hf
  have hC : ∀ c : ℂ, f (algebraMap ℂ (Conv ℂ d) c) = algebraMap ℂ (Conv ℂ n ⧸ P) c := fun c => by
    rw [hf, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, AlgHom.commutes]
  set s : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i ∉ Set.range e) with hs
  have hmem_s : ∀ i, i ∈ s ↔ i ∉ Set.range e := fun i =>
    Finset.mem_filter.trans (and_iff_right (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hi₁s : i₁ ∈ s := (hmem_s i₁).mpr hi₁
  set ξ : Fin n → Conv ℂ n ⧸ P := fun i => Ideal.Quotient.mk P (substEquiv L₀ (convX ℂ i)) with hξ
  obtain ⟨c, hc₁, hcz, Q, hQm, hQi, hQ0, A, hA, hB⟩ :=
    exists_linear_primitive_relations (R := Conv ℂ d) (S := Conv ℂ n ⧸ P) (C := ℂ) f hfin₀ hinj₀
      hC s ξ hi₁s
  set γ : Conv ℂ n ⧸ P := ∑ j ∈ s, algebraMap ℂ (Conv ℂ n ⧸ P) (c j) * ξ j with hγ
  
  set L := L₀.trans (mixLinear i₁ c hc₁) with hL
  have hσ : ∀ g, substEquiv L g = substEquiv L₀ (substEquiv (mixLinear i₁ c hc₁) g) := fun g => by
    rw [hL]
    simp only [substEquiv_apply]
    rw [substConv_substConv]
    congr 1
  have hσ₁base : ∀ a, substEquiv (mixLinear i₁ c hc₁) (convEmbed ℂ e a) = convEmbed ℂ e a :=
    fun a => by rw [substEquiv_apply]; exact substConv_mixLinear_convEmbed i₁ c hc₁ e hi₁ a
  have hσ₁self : substEquiv (mixLinear i₁ c hc₁) (convX ℂ i₁) =
      ∑ j, algebraMap ℂ (Conv ℂ n) (c j) * convX ℂ j := by
    rw [substEquiv_apply]; exact substConv_mixLinear_convX_self i₁ c hc₁
  have hσ₁ne : ∀ i, i ≠ i₁ → substEquiv (mixLinear i₁ c hc₁) (convX ℂ i) = convX ℂ i :=
    fun i hi => by rw [substEquiv_apply]; exact substConv_mixLinear_convX_of_ne i₁ c hc₁ hi
  have hσbase : ∀ a, substEquiv L (convEmbed ℂ e a) = substEquiv L₀ (convEmbed ℂ e a) := fun a => by
    rw [hσ, hσ₁base]
  
  have hnm : (normMap ℂ P e L : Conv ℂ d →+* Conv ℂ n ⧸ P) = f := by
    ext a
    simp only [hf, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, normMap_apply, hσbase]
  have hnm' : normMap ℂ P e L = normMap ℂ P e L₀ := AlgHom.ext fun a =>
    congrArg (fun φ : Conv ℂ d →+* Conv ℂ n ⧸ P => φ a) hnm
  
  have hcomp : (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp (((substEquiv L : Conv ℂ n ≃ₐ[ℂ] Conv ℂ n) :
      Conv ℂ n →+* Conv ℂ n).comp (convEmbed ℂ e).toRingHom) = f := by
    rw [← hnm]
    rfl
  
  have hXi₁ : Ideal.Quotient.mk P (substEquiv L (convX ℂ i₁)) = γ := by
    rw [hσ, hσ₁self, map_sum, map_sum, hγ]
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s)]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, AlgEquiv.commutes, hξ]
      rfl
    · intro j _ hj
      have : c j = 0 := hcz j hj
      rw [this, map_zero, zero_mul, map_zero, map_zero]
  
  have hXi : ∀ i, i ≠ i₁ → Ideal.Quotient.mk P (substEquiv L (convX ℂ i)) = ξ i := fun i hi => by
    rw [hσ, hσ₁ne i hi, hξ]
  
  have hmemP : ∀ g : Conv ℂ n, g ∈ Ideal.comap (substEquiv L) P ↔
      Ideal.Quotient.mk P (substEquiv L g) = 0 := fun g => by
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  refine ⟨d, e, L, ?_, ?_, i₁, hi₁, Q, A, hQm, hQi, hA, ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · rw [hnm']; exact hinj₀
  · rw [hnm]; exact hfin₀
  · rw [hmemP, mk_substEquiv_eval_map, hcomp, hXi₁]
    exact hQ0
  · by_cases hii : i = i₁
    · subst hii
      refine ⟨Polynomial.C A * X, ?_⟩
      rw [hmemP, map_sub, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, mk_substEquiv_eval_map, hcomp, hXi₁,
        eval₂_mul, eval₂_C, eval₂_X]
      have : Ideal.Quotient.mk P (substEquiv L (convEmbed ℂ e A)) = f A := by
        rw [hσbase]; rfl
      rw [this, sub_self]
    · obtain ⟨B, hBi⟩ := hB i ((hmem_s i).mpr hi)
      refine ⟨B, ?_⟩
      rw [hmemP, map_sub, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, mk_substEquiv_eval_map, hcomp, hXi₁,
        hXi i hii]
      have : Ideal.Quotient.mk P (substEquiv L (convEmbed ℂ e A)) = f A := by
        rw [hσbase]; rfl
      rw [this, hBi, sub_self]

name: Analytic.smul_eq_C_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem smul_eq_C_algebraMap_mul (b : R) (c : (FractionRing R)[X]) :
    b • c = C (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) b) * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul (FractionRing R) b c, Polynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]

name: Analytic.exists_C_mul_eq_map_of_mem_span_image
statement:
theorem exists_C_mul_eq_map_of_mem_span_image (𝔅 : Finset R[X]) {z : (FractionRing R)[X]}
    (hz : z ∈ Ideal.span ((𝔅 : Set R[X]).image (map (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))))) :
    ∃ r : R, r ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (𝔅 : Set R[X]),
      C (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) r) * z = map (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)) q
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun z _ => ∃ r : R, r ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (𝔅 : Set R[X]),
    C (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) r) * z = map (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)) q) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, B, Ideal.subset_span hB, by rw [map_one, C_1, one_mul]⟩
  · exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, 0, Ideal.zero_mem _, by rw [mul_zero, Polynomial.map_zero]⟩
  · rintro z₁ z₂ - - ⟨r₁, hr₁, q₁, hq₁, h₁⟩ ⟨r₂, hr₂, q₂, hq₂, h₂⟩
    refine ⟨r₁ * r₂, mul_ne_zero hr₁ hr₂, C r₂ * q₁ + C r₁ * q₂,
      Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hq₁) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hq₂), ?_⟩
    rw [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, map_C, ← h₁, ← h₂,
      map_mul, C_mul]
    ring
  · rintro c z - ⟨r, hr, q, hq, h⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbc⟩ := IsLocalization.integerNormalization_spec (nonZeroDivisors R) c
    refine ⟨b * r, mul_ne_zero (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb) hr,
      IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) c * q, Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hq, ?_⟩
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, hbc, ← h, smul_eq_C_algebraMap_mul, map_mul, C_mul]
    ring

name: Analytic.exists_common_factor_of_span
statement:
theorem exists_common_factor_of_span (𝔅 : Finset R[X]) (hne : ∃ W ∈ 𝔅, W ≠ 0)
    (hprop : ∀ r : R, C r ∈ Ideal.span (𝔅 : Set R[X]) → r = 0) :
    ∃ ω : R[X], 0 < ω.natDegree ∧
      ∀ B ∈ 𝔅, ∃ c : R, c ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ H : R[X], C c * B = ω * H
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set φ := algebraMap R (FractionRing R) with hφ
  have hinj : Function.Injective (map φ) := map_injective φ (IsFractionRing.injective R _)
  set J : Ideal (FractionRing R)[X] := Ideal.span ((𝔅 : Set R[X]).image (map φ)) with hJ
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal J).principal
  
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hW0⟩ := hne
    have : map φ W ∈ J := Ideal.subset_span ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩
    rw [hg, Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr rfl, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact hW0 (hinj (by rw [this, Polynomial.map_zero]))
  
  
  have hgu : ¬ IsUnit g := by
    intro hu
    have h1 : (1 : (FractionRing R)[X]) ∈ J := by
      rw [hg]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hu.dvd
    obtain ⟨r, hr, q, hq, hrq⟩ := exists_C_mul_eq_map_of_mem_span_image 𝔅 h1
    rw [mul_one, ← map_C] at hrq
    exact hr (hprop r (hinj hrq ▸ hq))
  have hdeg : 0 < g.degree := degree_pos_of_ne_zero_of_nonunit hg0 hgu
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hag⟩ := IsLocalization.integerNormalization_spec (nonZeroDivisors R) g
  refine ⟨IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) g, ?_, fun B hB => ?_⟩
  · have ha0 : φ a ≠ 0 :=
      (map_ne_zero_iff φ (IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R))).mpr
        (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero ha)
    rw [← natDegree_map_eq_of_injective (IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)), hag,
      smul_eq_C_algebraMap_mul, natDegree_C_mul ha0, natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos]
    exact hdeg
  · have hBJ : map φ B ∈ J := Ideal.subset_span ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
    rw [hg, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hBJ
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hBJ
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbh⟩ := IsLocalization.integerNormalization_spec (nonZeroDivisors R) h
    refine ⟨a * b, mul_ne_zero (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero ha) (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb),
      IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) h, hinj ?_⟩
    rw [Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, Polynomial.map_mul, hag, hbh, hh, map_mul, C_mul,
      smul_eq_C_algebraMap_mul, smul_eq_C_algebraMap_mul]
    ring

name: Analytic.evalSeries_finsetProd_eventually
statement:
theorem evalSeries_finsetProd_eventually {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Conv K n) :
    evalSeries (∏ i ∈ s, (F i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K)]
      fun x => ∏ i ∈ s, evalSeries (F i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => by simp [evalSeries_one]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
    have hmem : (∏ i ∈ s, (F i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) ∈ Conv K n :=
      Subalgebra.prod_mem _ fun i _ => (F i).2
    filter_upwards [ih, evalSeries_mul_eventually (F a).2 hmem] with x ih h
    rw [h, ih, Finset.prod_insert ha]

name: Analytic.convPolyEval_mem_of_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem convPolyEval_mem_of_coeff_mem {P : Ideal (Conv K (m + 1))} {Q : Polynomial (Conv K m)}
    (hQ : ∀ i, Q.coeff i ∈ P.comap (convTail K).toRingHom) : convPolyEval K Q ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  change Q.eval₂ (convTail K).toRingHom (convX K 0) ∈ P
  rw [eval₂_eq_sum_range]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_comap.mp (hQ i))

name: Analytic.eventually_specialize_eq_zero_of_coeff_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (D.natDegree + 1), VanishesOn Sp (D.coeff i) := fun i _ =>
    (mem_vanishingIdeal_iff hSp).mp (le_vanishingIdeal p (hD i))
  filter_upwards [(eventually_all_finset _).mpr hv] with y hy hyS
  ext k
  rw [coeff_specialize, coeff_zero]
  by_cases hk : k ∈ Finset.range (D.natDegree + 1)
  · exact hy k hk hyS
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by simpa using hk), Subalgebra.coe_zero, evalSeries_zero]

name: Analytic.exists_eq_mul_add_convPolyEval
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, hrd, hG⟩ := exists_division_conv (f := G) hreg
  refine ⟨q, ∑ j : Fin d, C (sliceConv r (d - 1 - j)) * X ^ (d - 1 - (j : ℕ)), ?_⟩
  rw [hG, map_sum]
  congr 1
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_convTail_sliceConv hrd]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, convPolyEval_C, convPolyEval_X]

name: Analytic.exists_eventually_exists_cons_mem_zeroSet
statement:
theorem exists_eventually_exists_cons_mem_zeroSet {P : Ideal (Conv ℂ (m + 1))} [hP : P.IsPrime]
    {d : ℕ} {c : Fin d → Conv ℂ m}
    (hc : ∀ j, MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (c j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ℂ) = 0)
    (hW : convPolyEval ℂ (weierstrassPolynomial d c) ∈ P)
    {S : Finset (Conv ℂ (m + 1))} (hS : Ideal.span (S : Set (Conv ℂ (m + 1))) = P)
    {Sp : Finset (Conv ℂ m)}
    (hSp : Ideal.span (Sp : Set (Conv ℂ m)) = P.comap (convTail ℂ).toRingHom)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ A : Conv ℂ m, A ∉ P.comap (convTail ℂ).toRingHom ∧
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (0 : Fin m → ℂ), y ∈ zeroSet Sp →
        evalSeries (A : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ℂ) y ≠ 0 →
          ∃ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < δ ∧ Fin.cons t y ∈ zeroSet S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, hpdef⟩ : ∃ p : Ideal (Conv ℂ m), p = P.comap (convTail ℂ).toRingHom := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hpdef] at hSp ⊢
  have hp : p.IsPrime := by rw [hpdef]; exact Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _
  have : IsDomain (Conv ℂ m ⧸ p) := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain p
  have : Nontrivial (Conv ℂ m ⧸ p) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hp.ne_top
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : Conv ℂ m →+* Conv ℂ m ⧸ p, π = Ideal.Quotient.mk p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hπsurj : Function.Surjective π := by rw [hπ]; exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hπker : ∀ a, π a = 0 ↔ a ∈ p := fun a => by rw [hπ]; exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem
  obtain ⟨Wp, hWp⟩ : ∃ Wp : Polynomial (Conv ℂ m), Wp = weierstrassPolynomial d c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hWp] at hW
  have hWmonic : Wp.Monic := by rw [hWp]; exact monic_weierstrassPolynomial d c
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with h0 | h
    · exfalso
      have h1 : Wp = 1 := eq_one_of_monic_natDegree_zero hWmonic
        (by rw [hWp, natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial, h0])
      rw [h1, map_one] at hW
      exact hP.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr hW)
    · exact h
  have hreg : IsRegularIn (convPolyEval ℂ Wp : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) d := by
    rw [hWp]; exact isRegularIn_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial hc
  
  choose qf Bf hqB using fun G : Conv ℂ (m + 1) => exists_eq_mul_add_convPolyEval hreg G
  obtain ⟨𝔅, h𝔅⟩ : ∃ 𝔅 : Finset (Polynomial (Conv ℂ m)), 𝔅 = insert Wp (S.image Bf) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWp𝔅 : Wp ∈ 𝔅 := by rw [h𝔅]; exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
  have hBf𝔅 : ∀ G ∈ S, Bf G ∈ 𝔅 := fun G hG => by
    rw [h𝔅]; exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hG)
  have h𝔅P : ∀ B ∈ 𝔅, convPolyEval ℂ B ∈ P := by
    intro B hB
    rw [h𝔅, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image] at hB
    rcases hB with rfl | ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩
    · exact hW
    · have hGP : G ∈ P := hS ▸ Ideal.subset_span hG
      have h2 : convPolyEval ℂ (Bf G) = G - qf G * convPolyEval ℂ Wp :=
        eq_sub_of_add_eq' (hqB G).symm
      rw [h2]
      exact P.sub_mem hGP (P.mul_mem_left _ hW)
  
  obtain ⟨𝔅', h𝔅'⟩ : ∃ 𝔅' : Finset (Polynomial (Conv ℂ m ⧸ p)), 𝔅' = 𝔅.image (Polynomial.map π) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hne : ∃ W' ∈ 𝔅', W' ≠ 0 :=
    ⟨Wp.map π, by rw [h𝔅']; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hWp𝔅, (hWmonic.map π).ne_zero⟩
  have hprop : ∀ r : Conv ℂ m ⧸ p,
      C r ∈ Ideal.span (𝔅' : Set (Polynomial (Conv ℂ m ⧸ p))) → r = 0 := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ := hπsurj r
    rw [h𝔅', Finset.coe_image, ← coe_mapRingHom, ← Ideal.map_span,
      Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ (map_surjective π hπsurj)] at hr
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqr⟩ := hr
    have hcoef : ∀ i, (q - C r').coeff i ∈ p := by
      intro i
      have : ((q - C r').map π).coeff i = 0 := by
        rw [Polynomial.map_sub, map_C, ← coe_mapRingHom, hqr, sub_self, coeff_zero]
      rwa [coeff_map, hπker] at this
    have h1 : convPolyEval ℂ (q - C r') ∈ P :=
      convPolyEval_mem_of_coeff_mem fun i => by rw [← hpdef]; exact hcoef i
    have h2 : convPolyEval ℂ q ∈ P := by
      have : Ideal.span (𝔅 : Set (Polynomial (Conv ℂ m))) ≤ P.comap (convPolyEval ℂ) :=
        Ideal.span_le.mpr fun B hB => h𝔅P B hB
      exact this hq
    have h3 : convTail ℂ r' ∈ P := by
      have h4 : convPolyEval ℂ (C r') ∈ P := by
        have h6 := P.sub_mem h2 h1
        have h7 : convPolyEval ℂ q - convPolyEval ℂ (q - C r') = convPolyEval ℂ (C r') := by
          rw [show convPolyEval ℂ (q - C r') = convPolyEval ℂ q - convPolyEval ℂ (C r') from
            Polynomial.eval₂_sub _, sub_sub_cancel]
        rwa [h7] at h6
      rwa [convPolyEval_C] at h4
    exact (hπker r').mpr (by rw [hpdef]; exact h3)
  obtain ⟨ω', hω'deg, hω'⟩ := exists_common_factor_of_span (R := Conv ℂ m ⧸ p) 𝔅' hne hprop
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := map_surjective π hπsurj ω'
  have hω'0 : ω' ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt hω'deg
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓdef⟩ : ∃ ℓ : Conv ℂ m, ℓ = ω.coeff ω'.natDegree := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hℓ : ℓ ∉ p := by
    intro h
    have h1 : π ℓ = ω'.leadingCoeff := by rw [hℓdef, ← coeff_map, hω, leadingCoeff]
    rw [(hπker ℓ).mpr h] at h1
    exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hω'0 h1.symm
  have hrel : ∀ B ∈ 𝔅, ∃ (cB : Conv ℂ m) (H : Polynomial (Conv ℂ m)), cB ∉ p ∧
      ∀ i, (C cB * B - ω * H).coeff i ∈ p := by
    intro B hB
    obtain ⟨c', hc', H', hH'⟩ := hω' (B.map π) (by rw [h𝔅']; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hB)
    obtain ⟨cB, rfl⟩ := hπsurj c'
    obtain ⟨H, rfl⟩ := map_surjective π hπsurj H'
    refine ⟨cB, H, fun h => hc' ((hπker cB).mpr h), fun i => ?_⟩
    have : ((C cB * B - ω * H).map π).coeff i = 0 := by
      rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, hω, hH', sub_self,
        coeff_zero]
    rwa [coeff_map, hπker] at this
  choose! cf Hf hcf using hrel
  refine ⟨ℓ * ∏ B ∈ 𝔅, cf B, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    rcases hp.mem_or_mem h with h | h
    · exact hℓ h
    · rw [Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, hp.multiset_prod_mem_iff_exists_mem] at h
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
      exact (hcf B (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp (by simpa using hB))).1 hxp
  
  have hball : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ),
      (∀ B ∈ 𝔅, evalSeries (convPolyEval ℂ B : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) z =
        (specialize B (Fin.tail z)).eval (z 0)) ∧
      ∀ G ∈ S, evalSeries (G : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) z =
        evalSeries (qf G : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) z *
          evalSeries (convPolyEval ℂ Wp : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) z +
        evalSeries (convPolyEval ℂ (Bf G) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) z := by
    refine ((eventually_all_finset 𝔅).mpr fun B _ =>
      evalSeries_convPolyEval_eq_eval_specialize B).and
      ((eventually_all_finset S).mpr fun G _ => ?_)
    filter_upwards [evalSeries_add_eventually (qf G * convPolyEval ℂ Wp).2
      (convPolyEval ℂ (Bf G)).2, evalSeries_mul_eventually (qf G).2 (convPolyEval ℂ Wp).2]
      with z h1 h2
    have hG := hqB G
    calc evalSeries (G : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) z
        = evalSeries ((qf G * convPolyEval ℂ Wp + convPolyEval ℂ (Bf G) : Conv ℂ (m + 1)) :
            MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) ℂ) z := by rw [← hG]
      _ = _ := by rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, h1, Subalgebra.coe_mul, h2]
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hball'⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hball
  have hδ₀2 : 0 < δ₀ / 2 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε1, hεδ, hεδ₀⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1 ∧ ε ≤ δ ∧ ε ≤ δ₀ / 2 :=
    ⟨min (min δ (δ₀ / 2)) 1, lt_min (lt_min hδ hδ₀2) one_pos, min_le_right _ _,
      (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _), (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)⟩
  have hroots := eventually_forall_root_norm_lt hc hε hε1
  rw [← hWp] at hroots
  have hspec : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (0 : Fin m → ℂ), ∀ B ∈ 𝔅,
      (y ∈ zeroSet Sp → specialize (C (cf B) * B - ω * Hf B) y = 0) ∧
      specialize (C (cf B) * B) y =
        C (evalSeries (cf B : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ℂ) y) * specialize B y ∧
      specialize (ω * Hf B + (C (cf B) * B - ω * Hf B)) y =
        specialize ω y * specialize (Hf B) y + specialize (C (cf B) * B - ω * Hf B) y := by
    refine (eventually_all_finset 𝔅).mpr fun B hB => ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_specialize_eq_zero_of_coeff_mem hSp (hcf B hB).2,
      specialize_mul_eventually (C (cf B)) B,
      specialize_add_eventually (ω * Hf B) (C (cf B) * B - ω * Hf B),
      specialize_mul_eventually ω (Hf B)] with y h1 h2 h3 h4
    exact ⟨h1, by rw [h2, specialize_C], by rw [h3, h4]⟩
  have hAeval := evalSeries_mul_eventually ℓ.2 (∏ B ∈ 𝔅, cf B).2
  have hprod := evalSeries_finsetProd_eventually 𝔅 cf
  filter_upwards [hroots, hspec, hAeval, hprod,
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mpr ⟨δ₀ / 2, hδ₀2, fun y hy => hy⟩]
    with y hroots hspec hAeval hprod hyδ hySp hAy
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, hAeval, SubmonoidClass.coe_finsetProd, hprod] at hAy
  have hℓy : evalSeries (ℓ : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ℂ) y ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hAy
  have hcfy : ∀ B ∈ 𝔅, evalSeries (cf B : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ℂ) y ≠ 0 := fun B hB =>
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp (right_ne_zero_of_mul hAy) B hB
  have hωdeg : (specialize ω y).degree ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : (specialize ω y).coeff ω'.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
      rw [coeff_specialize, ← hℓdef]; exact hℓy
    have h2 := le_degree_of_ne_zero h1
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at h2
    exact hω'deg.ne' (Nat.le_zero.mp (by exact_mod_cast h2))
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_root (specialize ω y) hωdeg
  rw [IsRoot.def] at ht
  have hBt : ∀ B ∈ 𝔅, (specialize B y).eval t = 0 := by
    intro B hB
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hspec B hB
    have hrel : specialize (C (cf B) * B) y =
        specialize (ω * Hf B + (C (cf B) * B - ω * Hf B)) y := by
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [h2, h3, h1 hySp, add_zero] at hrel
    have := congrArg (Polynomial.eval t) hrel
    rw [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_mul, ht, zero_mul] at this
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (hcfy B hB)
  have htε : ‖t‖ < ε := hroots t (hBt Wp hWp𝔅)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ, z = Fin.cons t y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hzball : dist z 0 < δ₀ := by
    rw [dist_zero_right, pi_norm_lt_iff hδ₀]
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [hz, Fin.cons_zero]
      exact htε.trans_le (hεδ₀.trans (by linarith))
    · rw [hz, Fin.cons_succ]
      have hy' : ‖y‖ < δ₀ / 2 := by rwa [dist_zero_right] at hyδ
      exact ((pi_norm_lt_iff hδ₀2).mp hy' j).trans (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨hzB, hzG⟩ := hball' hzball
  refine ⟨t, htε.trans_le hεδ, fun G hG => ?_⟩
  rw [← hz, hzG G hG, hzB Wp hWp𝔅, hzB (Bf G) (hBf𝔅 G hG), hz, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.cons_zero,
    hBt Wp hWp𝔅, hBt (Bf G) (hBf𝔅 G hG), mul_zero, add_zero]

name: Analytic.convNorm_rename
statement:
theorem convNorm_rename (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (ρ : Fin n → ℝ≥0) (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) :
    ConvNorm ρ (rename e f) = ConvNorm (fun i => ρ (e i)) f
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvNorm
  refine (Function.Injective.tsum_eq (f := fun μ : Fin n →₀ ℕ =>
    ‖coeff μ (rename e f)‖ₑ * (monomialEval ρ μ : ℝ≥0∞)) (embDomain_injective e) ?_).symm.trans
    (tsum_congr fun x => ?_)
  · intro μ hμ
    by_contra hμ'
    apply hμ
    have : coeff μ (rename e f) = 0 := by
      refine coeff_rename_eq_zero e f fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => hμ' ⟨x, ?_⟩
      rw [embDomain_eq_mapDomain, hx]
    simp [this]
  · rw [coeff_embDomain_rename]
    congr 2
    unfold monomialEval
    rw [prod_embDomain]

name: Analytic.rename_mem_conv
statement:
theorem rename_mem_conv (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) {f : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K} (hf : f ∈ Conv K d) :
    rename e f ∈ Conv K n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hf
  let ρ' : Fin n → ℝ≥0 := fun j => if h : ∃ i, e i = j then ρ h.choose else 1
  have hρ' : ∀ i, ρ' (e i) = ρ i := fun i => by
    have h : ∃ i', e i' = e i := ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simp only [ρ', dite_eq_left h]
    rw [e.injective h.choose_spec]
  refine ⟨⟨ρ', fun j => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · by_cases h : ∃ i, e i = j
    · simp only [ρ', dite_eq_left h]
      exact ρ.pos _
    · simp only [ρ', dite_eq_right h]
      exact one_pos
  · change ConvNorm ρ' (rename e f) ≠ ⊤
    rw [convNorm_rename]
    have : (fun i => ρ' (e i)) = ⇑ρ := funext hρ'
    rw [this]
    exact hρ

name: Analytic.coe_convEmbed
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_convEmbed (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (c : Conv K d) :
    (convEmbed K e c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) = rename e c
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Analytic.convEmbed_injective
statement: theorem convEmbed_injective (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) : Function.Injective (convEmbed K e)
proof:
:= by
  intro c c' h
  have h' := congrArg (fun c : Conv K n => (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) h
  simp only [coe_convEmbed] at h'
  exact Subtype.ext (rename_injective e h')

name: Analytic.exists_linear_primitive_relations
statement:
theorem exists_linear_primitive_relations (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.Finite)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) (hC : ∀ c, f (algebraMap C R c) = algebraMap C S c)
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (ξ : ι → S) {i₀ : ι} (hi₀ : i₀ ∈ s) :
    ∃ c : ι → C, c i₀ = 1 ∧ (∀ i, i ∉ s → c i = 0) ∧
      ∃ Q : R[X], Q.Monic ∧ Irreducible Q ∧
        eval₂ f (∑ j ∈ s, algebraMap C S (c j) * ξ j) Q = 0 ∧
        ∃ A : R, A ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ B : R[X],
          f A * ξ i = eval₂ f (∑ j ∈ s, algebraMap C S (c j) * ξ j) B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : CharZero C := (algebraMap C R).charZero
  let _ := f.toAlgebra
  have halg : algebraMap R S = f := rfl
  have hint : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := ⟨fun x => hf.to_isIntegral x⟩
  
  let K := FractionRing R
  let Lf := FractionRing S
  have hfs : FaithfulSMul R Lf := by
    rw [faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S Lf]
    exact (IsFractionRing.injective S Lf).comp hinj
  let _ : Algebra K Lf := FractionRing.liftAlgebra R Lf
  have : IsScalarTower R K Lf := FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra R Lf
  
  let β : ι → Lf := fun i => algebraMap S Lf (ξ i)
  have hβint : ∀ i ∈ s, IsIntegral K (β i) := fun i _ =>
    ((hint.isIntegral (ξ i)).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S Lf)).tower_top
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc₀, hcz, hcmem⟩ :=
    exists_linear_primitive_of_isIntegral (F := K) (algebraMap C K) s β hβint hi₀
  set γS : S := ∑ j ∈ s, algebraMap C S (c j) * ξ j with hγS
  have hγ : algebraMap S Lf γS = ∑ j ∈ s, algebraMap C K (c j) • β j := by
    simp only [γS, map_sum, map_mul, β, Algebra.smul_def]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    congr 1
    rw [← hC, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C R K, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K Lf]
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S Lf _).symm
  have hγint : IsIntegral R γS := hint.isIntegral γS
  have hγLint : IsIntegral K (algebraMap S Lf γS) :=
    (hγint.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S Lf)).tower_top
  
  have hmem : ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ p : K[X], aeval (algebraMap S Lf γS) p = β i := fun i hi => by
    have h := hcmem i hi
    rw [← hγ] at h
    have h2 : β i ∈ (IntermediateField.adjoin K {algebraMap S Lf γS}).toSubalgebra := h
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic hγLint.isAlgebraic,
      Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.mem_range] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have hclear : ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ (b : R) (B : R[X]), b ≠ 0 ∧ f b * ξ i = eval₂ f γS B := fun i hi => by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hmem i hi
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbp⟩ :=
      IsLocalization.integerNormalization_spec (nonZeroDivisors R) (S := K) p
    refine ⟨b, IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) p,
      nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb, ?_⟩
    apply IsFractionRing.injective S Lf
    have h1 : aeval (algebraMap S Lf γS)
        (IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) p) = algebraMap R Lf b * β i := by
      rw [← aeval_map_algebraMap K, hbp, ← algebraMap_smul K b p, map_smul, hp, Algebra.smul_def,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
    rw [map_mul]
    change algebraMap S Lf (algebraMap R S b) * algebraMap S Lf (ξ i) =
      algebraMap S Lf (aeval γS (IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) p))
    have h2 : aeval (algebraMap S Lf γS)
        (IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) p) =
        algebraMap S Lf (aeval γS (IsLocalization.integerNormalization (nonZeroDivisors R) p)) :=
      aeval_algebraMap_apply Lf γS _
    rw [← h2, h1, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S Lf]
  choose! b B hb hB using hclear
  
  refine ⟨c, hc₀, hcz, minpoly R γS, minpoly.monic hγint, minpoly.irreducible hγint,
    minpoly.aeval R γS, ∏ j ∈ s, b j, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j hj => hb j hj,
    fun i hi => ⟨Polynomial.C (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, b j) * B i, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [eval₂_mul, eval₂_C, ← hB i hi, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase s b hi, map_mul]
  ring

name: Analytic.zero_mem_polydisc
statement: theorem zero_mem_polydisc (ρ : Radius m) : (0 : Fin m → K) ∈ polydisc K ρ
proof:
:= fun k => by
  simp [ρ.pos k]

name: Analytic.convex_polydisc
statement: theorem convex_polydisc (ρ : Radius m) : Convex ℝ (polydisc K ρ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab k
  have hx' := hx k
  have hy' := hy k
  calc ‖(a • x + b • y) k‖ = ‖a • x k + b • y k‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ ‖a • x k‖ + ‖b • y k‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = a * ‖x k‖ + b * ‖y k‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb]
    _ < a * (ρ k : ℝ) + b * (ρ k : ℝ) := by
      rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha' | rfl
      · rcases hb.lt_or_eq with hb' | rfl
        · exact add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx' ha') (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy' hb')
        · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero]
          exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx' ha'
      · simp only [zero_mul, zero_add] at hab ⊢
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy' (by rw [hab]; exact one_pos)
    _ = (ρ k : ℝ) := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]

name: Analytic.exists_evalSeries_ne_zero_of_isOpen
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have han : AnalyticOnNhd K (evalSeries f) (polydisc K ρ) := analyticOnNhd_evalSeries hf
  obtain ⟨y0, hy0⟩ := hVne
  have hev : evalSeries f =ᶠ[𝓝 y0] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hy0] with y hy
    exact h y hy
  have hzero := han.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
    (convex_polydisc ρ).isPreconnected (hVρ hy0) hev
  apply hf0
  have : (⟨f, ⟨ρ, hf⟩⟩ : Conv K m) = 0 := Conv.ext_of_evalSeries_eventuallyEq (by
    filter_upwards [(isOpen_polydisc ρ).mem_nhds (zero_mem_polydisc ρ)] with y hy
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_zero, evalSeries_zero]
    exact hzero hy)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: Analytic.evalSeries_finsetSum_eventually
statement:
theorem evalSeries_finsetSum_eventually {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Conv K n) :
    evalSeries (∑ i ∈ s, (F i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K)]
      fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, evalSeries (F i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => by simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    have hmem : (∑ i ∈ s, (F i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)) ∈ Conv K n :=
      Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun i _ => (F i).2
    filter_upwards [ih, evalSeries_add_eventually (F a).2 hmem] with x ih h
    rw [h, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: Analytic.evalSeries_convPolyEval_eventually
statement:
theorem evalSeries_convPolyEval_eventually (Q : Polynomial (Conv K m)) :
    evalSeries (convPolyEval K Q : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin (m + 1) → K)]
      fun x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1),
        evalSeries (Q.coeff k : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (Fin.tail x) * x 0 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_convPolyEval_eq_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ k, evalSeries (liftTail (Q.coeff k : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) * X 0 ^ k)
      =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin (m + 1) → K)]
        fun x => evalSeries (Q.coeff k : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (Fin.tail x) * x 0 ^ k := by
    intro k
    have h := evalSeries_mul_eventually (convTail K (Q.coeff k)).2 (convX K (0 : Fin (m + 1)) ^ k).2
    rw [coe_convTail, Subalgebra.coe_pow, coe_convX] at h
    filter_upwards [h] with x hx
    rw [hx, evalSeries_liftTail, evalSeries_X_pow]
  have hsum := evalSeries_finsetSum_eventually (Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1))
    fun k => convTail K (Q.coeff k) * convX K (0 : Fin (m + 1)) ^ k
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, coe_convTail, coe_convX] at hsum
  filter_upwards [hsum, (eventually_all_finset (Finset.range (Q.natDegree + 1))).mpr
    fun k _ => hterm k] with x hx hk
  rw [hx]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk' => hk k hk'

name: Analytic.norm_root_lt_of_monic
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hle
  push Not at hle
  set d := p.natDegree with hd'
  have heval : p.eval t = t ^ d + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, p.coeff i * t ^ i := by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_succ, hp.coeff_natDegree, one_mul,
      add_comm]
  rw [heval] at ht
  have hsum : ‖t‖ ^ d = ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, p.coeff i * t ^ i‖ := by
    rw [← norm_pow, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left ht, norm_neg]
  have hbound : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, p.coeff i * t ^ i‖ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ‖p.coeff i‖ * ‖t‖ ^ i := by
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  rcases le_or_gt ‖t‖ 1 with h1 | h1
  · 
    have : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ‖p.coeff i‖ * ‖t‖ ^ i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ‖p.coeff i‖ :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
        mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1)
    have hlt : ‖t‖ ^ d < ε ^ d := (hsum.le.trans hbound).trans_lt (this.trans_lt hsmall)
    exact absurd (pow_le_pow_left₀ hε.le hle d) (not_le.mpr hlt)
  · 
    have : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ‖p.coeff i‖ * ‖t‖ ^ i ≤
        ‖t‖ ^ (d - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ‖p.coeff i‖ := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (pow_le_pow_right₀ h1.le (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hεd : ε ^ d ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hε.le hε1
    have hlt : ‖t‖ ^ d < ‖t‖ ^ (d - 1) * 1 := by
      calc ‖t‖ ^ d ≤ ‖t‖ ^ (d - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ‖p.coeff i‖ :=
            (hsum.le.trans hbound).trans this
        _ < ‖t‖ ^ (d - 1) * 1 := by
            refine mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hsmall.trans_le hεd) (pow_pos ?_ _)
            exact zero_lt_one.trans h1
    rw [mul_one] at hlt
    exact absurd (pow_le_pow_right₀ h1.le (Nat.sub_le d 1)) (not_le.mpr hlt)

name: Analytic.constantCoeffConv_apply
statement:
theorem constantCoeffConv_apply (f : Conv K n) :
    constantCoeffConv f = constantCoeff (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.constantCoeffConv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem constantCoeffConv_algebraMap (r : K) :
    constantCoeffConv (algebraMap K (Conv K n) r) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [constantCoeffConv_apply, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, MvPowerSeries.algebraMap_apply,
    constantCoeff_C]
  simp

name: Analytic.mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff (f : Conv K n) :
    f ∈ maximalIdeal (Conv K n) ↔ constantCoeff (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := f
  rw [isUnit_iff_constantCoeff_ne_zero hf, not_not]

name: Analytic.maximalIdeal_conv_eq_span_convX
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_conv_eq_span_convX :
    maximalIdeal (Conv K n) = Ideal.span (Set.range (convX K (n := n)))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff] at hf
    have h := sum_X_mul_divPart hf
    have : f = ∑ i, convX K i *
        ⟨divPart i (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K), divPart_mem_conv f.2 i⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_convX]
      exact h.symm
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff, coe_convX, constantCoeff_X]

name: Analytic.mem_maximalIdeal_algEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_algEquiv_iff (σ : Conv K n ≃ₐ[K] Conv K n) (f : Conv K n) :
    σ f ∈ maximalIdeal (Conv K n) ↔ f ∈ maximalIdeal (Conv K n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h hf
    exact h (hf.map σ)
  · intro h hf
    have := hf.map σ.symm
    rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
    exact h this

name: Analytic.maximalIdeal_conv_eq_span_algEquiv_convX
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_conv_eq_span_algEquiv_convX (σ : Conv K n ≃ₐ[K] Conv K n) :
    maximalIdeal (Conv K n) = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => σ (convX K i))
proof:
:= by
  have h : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => σ (convX K i)) =
      Ideal.map σ (Ideal.span (Set.range (convX K (n := n)))) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  rw [h, ← maximalIdeal_conv_eq_span_convX]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    have : f = σ (σ.symm f) := (AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply σ f).symm
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ((mem_maximalIdeal_algEquiv_iff σ.symm f).mpr hf)
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro f hf
    exact Ideal.mem_comap.mpr ((mem_maximalIdeal_algEquiv_iff σ f).mpr hf)

name: Analytic.convEmbed_sub_algebraMap_mem
statement:
theorem convEmbed_sub_algebraMap_mem (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (c : Conv K d) :
    convEmbed K e c - algebraMap K (Conv K n) (constantCoeff (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K)) ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => convX K (e j))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ : ∃ c₀ : Conv K d,
      c₀ = c - algebraMap K (Conv K d) (constantCoeff (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc₀' : (c₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) =
      (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) - C (constantCoeff (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K)) := by
    rw [hc₀, Subalgebra.coe_sub, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, MvPowerSeries.algebraMap_apply]
    simp
  have h0 : constantCoeff (c₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) = 0 := by
    rw [hc₀', map_sub, constantCoeff_C, sub_self]
  have h := sum_X_mul_divPart h0
  have h1 : convEmbed K e c -
      algebraMap K (Conv K n) (constantCoeff (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K)) = convEmbed K e c₀ := by
    rw [hc₀, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes]
  have h2 : convEmbed K e c₀ = ∑ j, convX K (e j) *
      convEmbed K e ⟨divPart j (c₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K), divPart_mem_conv c₀.2 j⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_convX, coe_convEmbed]
    conv_lhs => rw [← h]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_mul, rename_X]
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)

name: Analytic.constantCoeffConv_aeval
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
  have hx0 : constantCoeffConv x = 0 := (mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff x).mp hx
  rw [hx0]
  have : constantCoeffConv.comp (algebraMap K (Conv K n)) = RingHom.id K := by
    ext r
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, constantCoeffConv_algebraMap]
  rw [this, Polynomial.eval₂_id]

name: Analytic.isUnit_conv_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_conv_iff (f : Conv K n) :
    IsUnit f ↔ constantCoeff (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := f
  exact isUnit_iff_constantCoeff_ne_zero hf

name: Analytic.mem_radical_of_monic_aeval_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hpq, hq⟩ := Polynomial.exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd p hp.ne_zero 0
  rw [Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot, Polynomial.IsRoot.def] at hq
  have hunit : IsUnit (Polynomial.aeval x q) := by
    rw [isUnit_conv_iff, ← constantCoeffConv_apply, constantCoeffConv_aeval q hx]
    exact hq
  rw [hpq, map_mul, map_pow, map_sub, Polynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.aeval_C, map_zero, sub_zero,
    Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem I hunit] at hmem
  exact Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mpr ⟨_, hmem⟩

name: Analytic.span_algEquiv_convX_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem span_algEquiv_convX_le_maximalIdeal (σ : Conv K n ≃ₐ[K] Conv K n) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) :
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => σ (convX K (e j))) ≤ maximalIdeal (Conv K n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_maximalIdeal_algEquiv_iff, mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff, coe_convX,
    constantCoeff_X]

name: Analytic.maximalIdeal_le_radical_sup_of_parameters
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_le_radical_sup_of_parameters (I : Ideal (Conv K n))
    (σ : Conv K n ≃ₐ[K] Conv K n) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n)
    (hrel : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range e → ∃ p : Polynomial K, p.Monic ∧
      Polynomial.aeval (σ (convX K i)) p ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => σ (convX K (e j)))) :
    maximalIdeal (Conv K n) ≤ (I ⊔ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => σ (convX K (e j)))).radical
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximalIdeal_conv_eq_span_algEquiv_convX σ, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range e
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hi
    exact Ideal.le_radical (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩))
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hmem⟩ := hrel i hi
    refine mem_radical_of_monic_aeval_mem ?_ hp hmem
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal_algEquiv_iff, mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff, coe_convX, constantCoeff_X]

name: Analytic.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_parameters
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_parameters (I : Ideal (Conv K n))
    (σ : Conv K n ≃ₐ[K] Conv K n) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n)
    (hrel : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range e → ∃ p : Polynomial K, p.Monic ∧
      Polynomial.aeval (σ (convX K i)) p ∈ I ⊔ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => σ (convX K (e j)))) :
    ringKrullDim (Conv K n ⧸ I) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:=
  ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical_sup I
    (fun j => σ (convX K (e j)))
    (fun j => by rw [mem_maximalIdeal_algEquiv_iff, mem_maximalIdeal_conv_iff, coe_convX,
      constantCoeff_X])
    (maximalIdeal_le_radical_sup_of_parameters I σ e hrel)

name: Analytic.exists_monic_aeval_mem_of_pow_add_sum
statement:
theorem exists_monic_aeval_mem_of_pow_add_sum {J : Ideal (Conv K n)} {x : Conv K n} {D : ℕ}
    (c : Fin D → K) (a : K)
    (hmem : (x + algebraMap K (Conv K n) a) ^ D + ∑ k : Fin D,
      algebraMap K (Conv K n) (c k) * (x + algebraMap K (Conv K n) a) ^ (k : ℕ) ∈ J) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial K, p.Monic ∧ Polynomial.aeval x p ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(Polynomial.X ^ D + ∑ k : Fin D, Polynomial.C (c k) * Polynomial.X ^ (k : ℕ)).comp
    (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add (Polynomial.degree_sum_fin_lt c)).comp
      (Polynomial.monic_X_add_C a) ?_
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_add_C]
    exact one_ne_zero
  · rw [Polynomial.aeval_comp]
    simpa [map_add, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.aeval_C] using hmem

name: Analytic.evalSeries_convEmbed
statement:
theorem evalSeries_convEmbed (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (c : Conv K d) (x : Fin n → K) :
    evalSeries (convEmbed K e c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x =
      evalSeries (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) (x ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_convEmbed, evalSeries_rename]

name: Analytic.evalSeries_algebraMap_conv
statement:
theorem evalSeries_algebraMap_conv (a : K) (x : Fin n → K) :
    evalSeries ((algebraMap K (Conv K n) a : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, MvPowerSeries.algebraMap_apply]
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, evalSeries_C']

name: Analytic.evalSeries_convX
statement:
theorem evalSeries_convX (i : Fin n) (x : Fin n → K) :
    evalSeries (convX K i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x = x i
proof:
:= by
  have := evalSeries_X_pow i 1 x
  rwa [pow_one, pow_one, ← coe_convX] at this

name: Analytic.evalSeries_conv_add_eventually
statement:
theorem evalSeries_conv_add_eventually (f g : Conv K n) :
    evalSeries ((f + g : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K)] fun x =>
      evalSeries (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x + evalSeries (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_add]
  exact evalSeries_add_eventually f.2 g.2

name: Analytic.evalSeries_conv_mul_eventually
statement:
theorem evalSeries_conv_mul_eventually (f g : Conv K n) :
    evalSeries ((f * g : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K)] fun x =>
      evalSeries (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x * evalSeries (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul]
  exact evalSeries_mul_eventually f.2 g.2

name: Analytic.evalSeries_conv_pow_eventually
statement:
theorem evalSeries_conv_pow_eventually (f : Conv K n) (k : ℕ) :
    evalSeries ((f ^ k : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K)] fun x =>
      evalSeries (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_pow]
  exact evalSeries_pow_eventually f.2 k

name: Analytic.evalSeries_conv_sum_eventually
statement:
theorem evalSeries_conv_sum_eventually {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Conv K n) :
    evalSeries ((∑ i ∈ s, F i : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K)] fun x =>
      ∑ i ∈ s, evalSeries (F i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  exact evalSeries_finsetSum_eventually s F

name: Analytic.evalSeries_shapeSeries
statement:
theorem evalSeries_shapeSeries (i : Fin n) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) {D : ℕ} (a : K)
    (c : Fin D → Conv K d) :
    evalSeries (shapeSeries K i e a c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K)] fun x =>
      (x i + a) ^ D + ∑ k : Fin D, evalSeries (c k : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) (x ∘ e) *
        (x i + a) ^ (k : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  set A : Conv K n := convX K i + algebraMap K (Conv K n) a with hA
  have h3 : evalSeries (A : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K)] fun x => x i + a := by
    refine (evalSeries_conv_add_eventually _ _).trans (Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    simp only [evalSeries_convX, evalSeries_algebraMap_conv]
  have h1 := evalSeries_conv_add_eventually (A ^ D)
    (∑ k : Fin D, convEmbed K e (c k) * A ^ (k : ℕ))
  have h2 := evalSeries_conv_pow_eventually A D
  have h4 := evalSeries_conv_sum_eventually Finset.univ fun k : Fin D =>
    convEmbed K e (c k) * A ^ (k : ℕ)
  have h5 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K), ∀ k : Fin D,
      evalSeries ((convEmbed K e (c k) * A ^ (k : ℕ) : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x =
        evalSeries (convEmbed K e (c k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x *
          evalSeries ((A ^ (k : ℕ) : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x :=
    eventually_all.mpr fun k => evalSeries_conv_mul_eventually _ _
  have h6 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K), ∀ k : Fin D,
      evalSeries ((A ^ (k : ℕ) : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x =
        evalSeries (A : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x ^ (k : ℕ) :=
    eventually_all.mpr fun k => evalSeries_conv_pow_eventually A k
  filter_upwards [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6] with x h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  change evalSeries ((A ^ D + ∑ k : Fin D, convEmbed K e (c k) * A ^ (k : ℕ) : Conv K n) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x = _
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [h5 k, h6 k, h3, evalSeries_convEmbed]

name: Analytic.substEquiv_shapeSeries_sub_mem
statement:
theorem substEquiv_shapeSeries_sub_mem (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) (i : Fin n)
    (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) {D : ℕ} (a : K) (c : Fin D → Conv K d) :
    substEquiv L (shapeSeries K i e a c) -
      ((substEquiv L (convX K i) + algebraMap K (Conv K n) a) ^ D +
        ∑ k : Fin D, algebraMap K (Conv K n) (constantCoeff (c k : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K)) *
          (substEquiv L (convX K i) + algebraMap K (Conv K n) a) ^ (k : ℕ)) ∈
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => substEquiv L (convX K (e j)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold shapeSeries
  simp only [map_add, map_pow, map_sum, map_mul, AlgEquiv.commutes]
  rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun k _ => ?_
  rw [← sub_mul]
  refine Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ?_
  have h2 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (substEquiv L) (convEmbed_sub_algebraMap_mem e (c k))
  rw [map_sub, AlgEquiv.commutes, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at h2
  exact h2

name: Analytic.exists_reexpansion
statement:
theorem exists_reexpansion (c : Conv K d) :
    ∀ᶠ u₀ in 𝓝 (0 : Fin d → K), ∃ c' : Conv K d,
      ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 u₀, evalSeries (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) u =
        evalSeries (c' : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) (u - u₀)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := c.2
  have h0 : polydisc K ρ ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Fin d → K) :=
    (isOpen_polydisc ρ).mem_nhds fun k => by simpa using ρ.pos k
  filter_upwards [h0] with u₀ hu₀
  obtain ⟨ρ', c'', hc'', h⟩ :=
    AnalyticAt.exists_eventuallyEq_evalSeries (analyticOnNhd_evalSeries hρ u₀ hu₀)
  exact ⟨⟨c'', ρ', hc''⟩, h⟩

name: Analytic.eventually_eventually_add_of_eventuallyEq
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h.eventually_nhds] with v hv
  have ht : Tendsto (fun z : Fin n → K => z + v) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 v) := by
    have := (continuous_add_const v).tendsto (0 : Fin n → K)
    rwa [zero_add] at this
  exact ht.eventually hv

name: Analytic.tendsto_comp_embedding
statement:
theorem tendsto_comp_embedding (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) :
    Tendsto (fun v : Fin n → K => v ∘ e) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : Continuous fun v : Fin n → K => v ∘ e := continuous_pi fun j => continuous_apply (e j)
  simpa using this.tendsto (0 : Fin n → K)

name: Analytic.tendsto_clequiv_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_clequiv_zero (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) :
    Tendsto (fun z : Fin n → K => L z) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  L.continuous.tendsto' 0 0 (map_zero L)

name: Analytic.exists_substEquiv_shapeSeries_translate
statement:
theorem exists_substEquiv_shapeSeries_translate (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) (i : Fin n)
    (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) {D : ℕ} (c : Fin D → Conv K d) :
    ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K), ∃ c' : Fin D → Conv K d,
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K),
        evalSeries (substEquiv L (shapeSeries K i e 0 c) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) (z + w) =
          evalSeries (substEquiv L (shapeSeries K i e (L w i) c') : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) z
proof:
:= by
  have hL := tendsto_clequiv_zero L
  have hE1 := eventually_eventually_add_of_eventuallyEq
    (evalSeries_substConv (L : (Fin n → K) →L[K] (Fin n → K)) (shapeSeries K i e 0 c))
  have hE3 := hL.eventually
    (eventually_eventually_add_of_eventuallyEq (evalSeries_shapeSeries i e 0 c))
  have hE2 : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K), ∀ k : Fin D, ∃ c' : Conv K d,
      ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 ((L w) ∘ e), evalSeries (c k : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) u =
        evalSeries (c' : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) (u - (L w) ∘ e) :=
    ((tendsto_comp_embedding e).comp hL).eventually
      (eventually_all.mpr fun k => exists_reexpansion (c k))
  filter_upwards [hE1, hE3, hE2] with w hw1 hw3 hw2
  choose c' hc' using hw2
  refine ⟨c', ?_⟩
  have hw3' := hL.eventually hw3
  have hu : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K), ∀ k : Fin D,
      evalSeries (c k : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) ((L z + L w) ∘ e) =
        evalSeries (c' k : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K) ((L z) ∘ e) := by
    have hc : Continuous fun z : Fin n → K => (L z + L w) ∘ e :=
      continuous_pi fun j => (continuous_apply (e j)).comp (L.continuous.add continuous_const)
    have ht : Tendsto (fun z : Fin n → K => (L z + L w) ∘ e) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 ((L w) ∘ e)) :=
      hc.tendsto' 0 _ (by rw [map_zero, zero_add])
    refine (eventually_all.mpr fun k => ht.eventually (hc' k)).mono fun z hz k => ?_
    rw [hz k]
    congr 1
    funext j
    simp
  have hE0' := hL.eventually (evalSeries_shapeSeries i e (L w i) c')
  have hsub := evalSeries_substConv (L : (Fin n → K) →L[K] (Fin n → K))
    (shapeSeries K i e (L w i) c')
  filter_upwards [hw1, hw3', hu, hE0', hsub] with z h1 h3 hu h0 hs
  rw [substEquiv_apply, h1, Function.comp_apply, map_add, substEquiv_apply, hs,
    Function.comp_apply]
  change evalSeries (↑(shapeSeries K i e 0 c)) (L z + L w) = evalSeries _ (L z)
  rw [h3, h0]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_zero]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [hu k]

name: Analytic.exists_monic_relation_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_monic_relation_of_finite (I : Ideal (Conv K n)) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n)
    (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K))
    (hfin : RingHom.Finite (A := Conv K d) (B := Conv K n ⧸ I)
      (normMap K I e L : Conv K d →+* Conv K n ⧸ I)) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (c : Fin D → Conv K d), substEquiv L (shapeSeries K i e 0 c) ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ := hfin.to_isIntegral (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (substEquiv L (convX K i)))
  refine ⟨p.natDegree, fun k => p.coeff k, ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← hp0]
  conv_rhs => rw [hp.as_sum]
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_add, Polynomial.eval₂_X_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum, Finset.sum_range]
  simp only [shapeSeries, map_zero, add_zero, map_add, map_pow, map_sum, map_mul]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.eval₂_monomial]
  rfl

name: Analytic.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_forall_exists_shape_mem
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_forall_exists_shape_mem (I : Ideal (Conv K n))
    (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ (D : ℕ) (a : K) (c : Fin D → Conv K d),
      substEquiv L (shapeSeries K i e a c) ∈ I) :
    ringKrullDim (Conv K n ⧸ I) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  refine ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_parameters I (substEquiv L) e fun i _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨D, a, c, hmem⟩ := h i
  have h1 := substEquiv_shapeSeries_sub_mem L i e a c
  have h2 := Ideal.sub_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left hmem) (Ideal.mem_sup_right h1)
  rw [sub_sub_cancel] at h2
  exact exists_monic_aeval_mem_of_pow_add_sum
    (fun k => constantCoeff (c k : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) K)) a h2

name: Analytic.substEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem substEquiv_symm_apply (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) (f : Conv K n) :
    (substEquiv L).symm f = substConv (L.symm : (Fin n → K) →L[K] (Fin n → K)) f
proof: := rfl

name: Analytic.eventually_mem_zeroSet_image_symm_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_mem_zeroSet_image_symm_iff [DecidableEq (Conv K n)]
    (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) (S : Finset (Conv K n)) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K),
      (x ∈ zeroSet (S.image (substEquiv L).symm) ↔ L.symm x ∈ zeroSet S)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → K), ∀ g ∈ S,
      evalSeries (((substEquiv L).symm g : Conv K n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) x =
        evalSeries (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K) (L.symm x) := by
    rw [eventually_all_finset]
    intro g _
    have := evalSeries_substConv (L.symm : (Fin n → K) →L[K] (Fin n → K)) g
    filter_upwards [this] with x hx
    rw [substEquiv_symm_apply, hx]
    rfl
  filter_upwards [h] with x hx
  simp only [mem_zeroSet_iff, Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro h' g hg
    rw [← hx g hg]
    exact h' _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  · rintro h' _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    rw [hx g hg]
    exact h' g hg

name: Analytic.span_image_symm
statement:
theorem span_image_symm (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) (S : Finset (Conv K n))
    [DecidableEq (Conv K n)] :
    Ideal.span ((S.image (substEquiv L).symm : Finset (Conv K n)) : Set (Conv K n)) =
      Ideal.comap (substEquiv L) (Ideal.span (S : Set (Conv K n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.coe_image]
  have : (⇑(substEquiv L).symm : Conv K n → Conv K n) = ⇑((substEquiv L).toRingEquiv.symm) := rfl
  rw [this, ← Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_symm]
  rfl

name: Analytic.eq_of_isRadical_of_zeroSet_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem eq_of_isRadical_of_zeroSet_eventuallyEq {I₁ I₂ : Ideal (Conv ℂ n)} (h₁ : I₁.IsRadical)
    (h₂ : I₂.IsRadical) {S₁ S₂ : Finset (Conv ℂ n)} (hS₁ : Ideal.span (S₁ : Set (Conv ℂ n)) = I₁)
    (hS₂ : Ideal.span (S₂ : Set (Conv ℂ n)) = I₂)
    (h : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), (x ∈ zeroSet S₁ ↔ x ∈ zeroSet S₂)) : I₁ = I₂
proof:
:= by
  have hv : vanishingIdeal I₁ = vanishingIdeal I₂ := by
    ext g
    rw [mem_vanishingIdeal_iff hS₁, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff hS₂]
    constructor
    · intro hg
      filter_upwards [hg, h] with x hx hx'
      exact fun h2 => hx (hx'.mpr h2)
    · intro hg
      filter_upwards [hg, h] with x hx hx'
      exact fun h1 => hx (hx'.mp h1)
  rw [vanishingIdeal_eq_radical, vanishingIdeal_eq_radical, h₁.radical, h₂.radical] at hv
  exact hv

name: Analytic.frequently_mem_zeroSet_and_ne_zero
statement:
theorem frequently_mem_zeroSet_and_ne_zero {P : Ideal (Conv ℂ n)} [hP : P.IsPrime]
    {S : Finset (Conv ℂ n)} (hS : Ideal.span (S : Set (Conv ℂ n)) = P) {g : Conv ℂ n}
    (hg : g ∉ P) :
    ∃ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), x ∈ zeroSet S ∧ evalSeries (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : g ∉ vanishingIdeal P := by
    rw [vanishingIdeal_eq_radical, hP.radical]
    exact hg
  rw [mem_vanishingIdeal_iff hS] at hnot
  unfold VanishesOn at hnot
  rw [Filter.not_eventually] at hnot
  exact hnot.mono fun x hx => Classical.not_imp.mp hx

name: Analytic.exists_conv_eventuallyEq_shift
statement:
theorem exists_conv_eventuallyEq_shift {g : (Fin d → ℂ) → ℂ} {u₀ : Fin d → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g u₀) :
    ∃ T : Conv ℂ d, ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 (0 : Fin d → ℂ),
      g (u₀ + u) = evalSeries (T : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) ℂ) u
proof:
:= by
  have h : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun u : Fin d → ℂ => g (u₀ + u)) 0 := by
    have := hg.comp_of_eq (f := fun u : Fin d → ℂ => u₀ + u) (x := 0)
      (analyticAt_const.add analyticAt_id) (by simp)
    exact this
  obtain ⟨ρ, c, hc, h'⟩ := AnalyticAt.exists_eventuallyEq_evalSeries h
  refine ⟨⟨c, ρ, hc⟩, h'.mono fun u hu => ?_⟩
  simpa using hu

name: Analytic.evalSeries_conv_sub_eventually
statement:
theorem evalSeries_conv_sub_eventually (f g : Conv ℂ n) :
    evalSeries ((f - g : Conv ℂ n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ)] fun x =>
      evalSeries (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x - evalSeries (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) x
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : f - g = f + algebraMap ℂ (Conv ℂ n) (-1) * g := by
    rw [map_neg, map_one]
    ring
  rw [hfg]
  filter_upwards [evalSeries_conv_add_eventually f (algebraMap ℂ (Conv ℂ n) (-1) * g),
    evalSeries_conv_mul_eventually (algebraMap ℂ (Conv ℂ n) (-1)) g] with x h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, evalSeries_algebraMap_conv, neg_one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Analytic.eventually_graph_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_graph_eq_zero_iff (e : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (φ : (Fin d → ℂ) → (Fin n → ℂ))
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) (hφe : ∀ u, φ u ∘ e = u) (T : Fin n → Conv ℂ d)
    (hT : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range e → ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 (0 : Fin d → ℂ),
      φ (x ∘ e + u) j - x j = evalSeries (T j : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) ℂ) u) :
    ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ),
      ((∀ j, j ∉ Set.range e →
        evalSeries ((convX ℂ j - convEmbed ℂ e (T j) : Conv ℂ n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) y' = 0)
        ↔ x + y' = φ ((x + y') ∘ e))
proof:
:= by
  have hT' : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range e →
      φ (x ∘ e + y' ∘ e) j - x j = evalSeries (T j : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) ℂ) (y' ∘ e) := by
    rw [eventually_all]
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j ∉ Set.range e
    · filter_upwards [(tendsto_comp_embedding e).eventually (hT j hj)] with y' h _
      exact h
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ h => absurd h hj
  have hsub : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → ℂ), ∀ j,
      evalSeries ((convX ℂ j - convEmbed ℂ e (T j) : Conv ℂ n) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ) y' =
        y' j - evalSeries (T j : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) ℂ) (y' ∘ e) := by
    rw [eventually_all]
    intro j
    filter_upwards [evalSeries_conv_sub_eventually (convX ℂ j) (convEmbed ℂ e (T j))] with y' h
    rw [h, evalSeries_convX, evalSeries_convEmbed]
  have hx : ∀ y' : Fin n → ℂ, x ∘ e + y' ∘ e = (x + y') ∘ e := fun y' => by
    funext k
    simp
  filter_upwards [hT', hsub] with y' h1 h2
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hj
      have := congrFun (hφe ((x + y') ∘ e)) k
      exact this.symm
    · have h3 := h1 j hj
      rw [hx] at h3
      have h4 := h j hj
      rw [h2 j] at h4
      rw [Pi.add_apply]
      linear_combination h4 - h3
  · intro h j hj
    rw [h2 j]
    have h3 := h1 j hj
    rw [hx, ← h, Pi.add_apply] at h3
    linear_combination h3

name: Analytic.isRegularIn_iff_order_axis
statement:
theorem isRegularIn_iff_order_axis (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) (d : ℕ) :
    IsRegularIn g d ↔ (axis g).order = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRegularIn_iff, MvPowerSeries.order_eq_nat]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlt, hd⟩
    refine ⟨⟨Finsupp.single 0 d, ?_, ?_⟩, fun ν hν => ?_⟩
    · rwa [coeff_single_axis]
    · rw [degree_fin1, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    · rw [Fin1.eq_single ν, coeff_single_axis]
      apply hlt
      rwa [degree_fin1] at hν
  · rintro ⟨⟨ν, hν, hνd⟩, hlt⟩
    refine ⟨fun k hk => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hlt (Finsupp.single 0 k) (by rw [degree_fin1, Finsupp.single_eq_same]; exact hk)
      rwa [coeff_single_axis] at this
    · rw [degree_fin1] at hνd
      rw [Fin1.eq_single ν, coeff_single_axis, hνd] at hν
      exact hν

name: Analytic.isRegularIn_of_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRegularIn_iff_order_axis, axis_mul, order_mul] at h
  have ha : (axis a).order ≠ ⊤ := fun ht => by
    rw [ht, top_add] at h
    exact ENat.top_ne_natCast d h
  have hb : (axis b).order ≠ ⊤ := fun ht => by
    rw [ht, add_top] at h
    exact ENat.top_ne_natCast d h
  refine ⟨(axis a).order.toNat, (axis b).order.toNat, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg ENat.toNat h
    rwa [ENat.toNat_add ha hb, ENat.toNat_natCast] at this
  · rw [isRegularIn_iff_order_axis, ENat.natCast_toNat ha]
  · rw [isRegularIn_iff_order_axis, ENat.natCast_toNat hb]

name: Analytic.exists_preparation_conv
statement:
theorem exists_preparation_conv {g : Conv K (m + 1)} {d : ℕ}
    (hreg : IsRegularIn (g : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) d) :
    ∃ (u : Conv K (m + 1)) (c : Fin d → Conv K m), IsUnit u ∧
      (∀ j, constantCoeff (c j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0) ∧
      g = u * convPolyEval K (weierstrassPolynomial d c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, c, hu, hu0, hc, hg, -⟩ := exists_unique_weierstrassPreparation g.2 hreg
  refine ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, fun j => ⟨c j, (hc j).1⟩, (isUnit_iff_constantCoeff_ne_zero hu).mpr hu0,
    fun j => (hc j).2, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial]
  exact hg

name: Analytic.preparation_unique
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u₀, c₀, -, -, -, -, huniq⟩ := exists_unique_weierstrassPreparation g.2 hreg
  have e1 := huniq (u : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) (fun j => (c j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K))
    hc (by rw [h, Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial])
  have e2 := huniq (u' : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)
    (fun j => (c' j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) hc'
    (by rw [h', Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial])
  refine ⟨Subtype.ext (e1.1.trans e2.1.symm), funext fun j => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  exact congrFun (e1.2.trans e2.2.symm) j

name: Analytic.irreducible_convPolyEval_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem irreducible_convPolyEval_of_irreducible {d : ℕ} {c : Fin d → Conv K m}
    (hc : ∀ j, constantCoeff (c j : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) = 0)
    (hirr : Irreducible (weierstrassPolynomial d c)) :
    Irreducible (convPolyEval K (weierstrassPolynomial d c))
proof:
:= by
  set W : Polynomial (Conv K m) := weierstrassPolynomial d c with hW
  set P : Conv K (m + 1) := convPolyEval K W with hP
  have hreg : IsRegularIn (P : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) d :=
    isRegularIn_convPolyEval_weierstrassPolynomial hc
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      subst h0
      exact hirr.not_isUnit (by rw [hW, weierstrassPolynomial_zero_eq_one]; exact isUnit_one)
    · exact h0
  refine ⟨fun hu => ?_, fun a b hab => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := ((isRegularIn_iff _ _).mp hreg).1 0 hd
    rw [Finsupp.single_zero, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at h1
    have hu' : IsUnit (⟨(P : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K), P.2⟩ : Conv K (m + 1)) := hu
    exact (isUnit_iff_constantCoeff_ne_zero P.2).mp hu' h1
  · have hab' : IsRegularIn ((a : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) *
        (b : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)) d := by
