  have hstalk := birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_map_transformIdeal hY h hφ hΦ ha''Φ haY κ.x r
    τ hτr hτ hlt χ hχ K (fun b hb => (hord b hb).ge)
  refine ⟨a'', ha''α, ?_⟩
  rw [hstalk]
  
  have hmul : algebraMap _ (IsLocalRing.chartRing κ.x r) (κ.x r) ^ d *
      IsLocalRing.transformElem κ.x r f hfP = algebraMap _ _ f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
      IsLocalRing.coe_transformElem]
    rw [← map_pow, mul_comm, Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_spec]
  have hmem : IsLocalRing.transformElem κ.x r f hfP ∈
      IsLocalRing.transformIdeal κ.x r (K.stalkIdeal (π a'')) d :=
    Ideal.subset_span ⟨f, hfK, hmul⟩
  refine Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem χ hmem) ?_
  rw [hQ, ← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E]
  
  have hlt' : ∀ j : Fin r, Fin.castLE r.2.le j < r := fun j => by
    rw [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castLE]
    exact j.2
  have hval : eval 𝕜 E M' a'' (χ (IsLocalRing.chartPresentation κ.x r Q)) =
      MvPolynomial.eval t Qb := by
    rw [IsLocalRing.chartPresentation, MvPolynomial.aeval_def, hQb, MvPolynomial.eval_map,
      ← RingHom.comp_apply (eval 𝕜 E M' a'') χ, MvPolynomial.eval₂_comp_left]
    congr 1
    · ext z
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
      rw [hχ]
      exact eval_germMapOn _ _ _ _ z
    · funext j
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply]
      rw [hχy _ (hlt' j), eval_coord, hΦa'']
      have hj : ∃ k, k ≠ i ∧ σ k = τ (Fin.castLE r.2.le j) := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hkτ⟩ := (hlt _).mp (hlt' j)
        exact ⟨k, hk, hkτ.symm⟩
      simp only [ite_eq_left hj]
      exact hs j
  rw [hval]
  exact ht

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentExponent_weakTransformOf_inr
statement:
theorem componentExponent_weakTransformOf_inr [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M]
    (K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {d : ℕ}
    (hord : ∀ a ∈ Y, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf K a = d)
    (hle : ∀ a ∈ Y, K.ord a ≤ d)
    (α : ConnectedComponents ((F.totalTransform π Y).hyp (toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))) :
    componentExponent (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
      (IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h K) ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), α⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hF' := HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc
  obtain ⟨a'', ha'', htop⟩ :=
    exists_mem_componentSet_inr_birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_top hY h F K hord hle α
  have haY'' : a'' ∈ π ⁻¹' Y := Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _ ha''
  have hD : (componentIdeal (F.totalTransform π Y) hF'
      ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), α⟩).stalkIdeal a'' ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [stalkIdeal_componentIdeal_totalTransform_inr hY h F hF hsnc α ha'']
    have hcos := (isIdealSheafOf_exceptionalIdealSheaf hY h).1
    have hmem : a'' ∈ (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).support := by
      rw [hcos]
      exact haY''
    exact hmem
  rw [← birationalTransform_eq_weakTransformOf_of_ordAlong_eq hY h K hord,
    componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal (F.totalTransform π Y) hF' _ _ ha'',
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top _ _ _ htop hD]
  rfl

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentExponent_weakTransformOf_eq_zero
statement:
theorem componentExponent_weakTransformOf_eq_zero [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M]
    (K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {d : ℕ}
    (hord : ∀ a ∈ Y, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf K a = d)
    (hle : ∀ a ∈ Y, K.ord a ≤ d)
    (hpure : ∀ i : ComponentIndex F, componentExponent F hF K i = 0)
    (i' : ComponentIndex (F.totalTransform π Y)) :
    componentExponent (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
      (IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h K) i' = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, C⟩ := i'
  obtain j | u := k
  · exact componentExponent_weakTransformOf_inl hY h F hF hsnc K hpure C
  · obtain ⟨⟩ := u
    exact componentExponent_weakTransformOf_inr hY h F hF hsnc K hord hle C

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.monomialPart_weakTransformOf_eq_top
statement:
theorem monomialPart_weakTransformOf_eq_top [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M]
    (K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {d : ℕ}
    (hord : ∀ a ∈ Y, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf K a = d)
    (hle : ∀ a ∈ Y, K.ord a ≤ d)
    (hpure : ∀ i : ComponentIndex F, componentExponent F hF K i = 0) :
    monomialPart (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
      (IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h K) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  monomialPart_eq_top_of_forall_componentExponent_eq_zero (F.totalTransform π Y)
    (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc) _
    (componentExponent_weakTransformOf_eq_zero hY h F hF hsnc K hord hle hpure)

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_weakTransformOf_eq_self
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_weakTransformOf_eq_self [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M]
    (K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {d : ℕ}
    (hord : ∀ a ∈ Y, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf K a = d)
    (hle : ∀ a ∈ Y, K.ord a ≤ d)
    (hpure : ∀ i : ComponentIndex F, componentExponent F hF K i = 0) :
    nonmonomialPart (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
      (IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h K) = IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h K
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := monomialPart_mul_nonmonomialPart (F.totalTransform π Y)
    (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc) (IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h K)
  rw [monomialPart_weakTransformOf_eq_top hY h F hF hsnc K hord hle hpure] at h1
  have h2 : (⊤ : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M')) *
      nonmonomialPart (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
        (IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h K) =
      nonmonomialPart (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
        (IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h K) := by
    refine IdealSheaf.ext fun p => ?_
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top, Ideal.top_mul]
  exact h2.symm.trans h1

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_birationalTransform_eq_self
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_birationalTransform_eq_self [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M]
    (K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {d : ℕ}
    (hord : ∀ a ∈ Y, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf K a = d)
    (hle : ∀ a ∈ Y, K.ord a ≤ d)
    (hpure : ∀ i : ComponentIndex F, componentExponent F hF K i = 0) :
    nonmonomialPart (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
        (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨K, d⟩).I =
      (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨K, d⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  rw [birationalTransform_eq_weakTransformOf_of_ordAlong_eq hY h K hord]
  exact nonmonomialPart_weakTransformOf_eq_self hY h F hF hsnc K hord hle hpure

name: Ideal.exists_mem_emultiplicity_eq

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top (D J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) (a : X)
    (hD : D.stalkIdeal a = ⊤) : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_ge.mpr fun m => ?_
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, hD, Ideal.top_pow]
  exact le_top

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top (D J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) (a : X)
    (hJ : J.stalkIdeal a = ⊤) (hD : D.stalkIdeal a ≠ ⊤) : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ zero_le
  by_contra h
  rw [not_le] at h
  have h1 : ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a := by
    rw [Nat.cast_one]
    exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h.ne'
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, hJ, pow_one] at h1
  exact hD (top_le_iff.mp h1)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span_of_not_dvd (D J : IdealSheaf 𝒪)
    (a : X) {c d : 𝒪.presheaf.stalk a} (hD : D.stalkIdeal a = Ideal.span {c})
    (hJ : J.stalkIdeal a = Ideal.span {d}) (hcd : ¬ c ∣ d) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ zero_le
  by_contra h
  rw [not_le] at h
  have h1 : ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a := by
    rw [Nat.cast_one]
    exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h.ne'
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, hD, hJ, pow_one,
    Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton] at h1
  exact hcd h1

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_self_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_self_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D D a = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra h
    rw [not_le] at h
    have h2 : ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D D a := by
      have := (ENat.add_one_le_iff (ENat.natCast_ne_top 1)).mpr (by exact_mod_cast h)
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, hD, Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at h2
    have hc2 : c ∈ Ideal.span {c ^ 2} := h2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self c)
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hc2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hc2
    have hzero : c * (1 - c * u) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_two]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hu
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with h0 | h0
    · exact hc.ne_zero h0
    · have hcu : c * u = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h0).symm
      exact hc.not_isUnit ⟨⟨c, u, hcu, (mul_comm u c).trans hcu⟩, rfl⟩
  · have h1 : ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D D a := by
      rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, pow_one]
    exact_mod_cast h1

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_mul_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_mul_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span (J K : IdealSheaf 𝒪) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D (J * K) a =
      IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a + IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D K a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a) ⊤ with hJ | hJ
  · rw [hJ, top_add]
    refine ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_ge.mpr fun m => ?_
    rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul]
    exact Ideal.mul_le_left.trans ((IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff D J a m).mp (hJ ▸ le_top))
  rcases eq_or_ne (IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D K a) ⊤ with hK | hK
  · rw [hK, add_top]
    refine ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_ge.mpr fun m => ?_
    rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul]
    exact Ideal.mul_le_right.trans ((IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff D K a m).mp (hK ▸ le_top))
  lift IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a to ℕ using hJ with k hk
  lift IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D K a to ℕ using hK with l hl
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra hlt
    rw [not_le] at hlt
    have h1 : ((k + l + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D (J * K) a := by
      have := (ENat.add_one_le_iff (ENat.natCast_ne_top (k + l))).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hlt)
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, hD] at h1
    have hJk : J.stalkIdeal a ≤ Ideal.span {c} ^ k := by
      rw [← hD, ← IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, ← hk]
    have hJk' : ¬ J.stalkIdeal a ≤ Ideal.span {c} ^ (k + 1) := by
      rw [← hD, ← IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, ← hk]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.not_succ_le_self k
    have hKl : K.stalkIdeal a ≤ Ideal.span {c} ^ l := by
      rw [← hD, ← IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, ← hl]
    have hKl' : ¬ K.stalkIdeal a ≤ Ideal.span {c} ^ (l + 1) := by
      rw [← hD, ← IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, ← hl]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.not_succ_le_self l
    obtain ⟨f, hfJ, hf⟩ := Ideal.exists_mem_emultiplicity_eq hJk hJk'
    obtain ⟨g, hgK, hg⟩ := Ideal.exists_mem_emultiplicity_eq hKl hKl'
    have hfg : f * g ∈ Ideal.span {c} ^ (k + l + 1) := h1 (Ideal.mul_mem_mul hfJ hgK)
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity,
      emultiplicity_mul hc, hf, hg] at hfg
    have hfg' : k + l + 1 ≤ k + l := by exact_mod_cast hfg
    omega
  · have := le_ordAlongIdeal_mul D hk.le hl.le
    exact_mod_cast this

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_pow_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_pow_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span (J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) (s : ℕ) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D (J ^ s) a = (s : ℕ∞) * IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
    have hne : D.stalkIdeal a ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [hD]
      exact fun h => hc.not_isUnit (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp h)
    exact IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top D 1 a (IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one a)
      hne
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_mul_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span D a hD hc, ih, Nat.cast_succ,
      add_mul, one_mul]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_finset_prod_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_finset_prod_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι)
    (G : ι → IdealSheaf 𝒪) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D (∏ i ∈ F, G i) a = ∑ i ∈ F, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D (G i) a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    rw [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    have hne : D.stalkIdeal a ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [hD]
      exact fun h => hc.not_isUnit (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp h)
    exact IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top D 1 a (IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one a)
      hne
  | insert i F hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi,
      IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_mul_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span D a hD hc, ih]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_top_iff_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_top_iff_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span (D J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) (a : X)
    [hnoeth : IsNoetherianRing (𝒪.presheaf.stalk a)] [hloc : IsLocalRing (𝒪.presheaf.stalk a)]
    {c : 𝒪.presheaf.stalk a} (hD : D.stalkIdeal a = Ideal.span {c}) (hc : ¬ IsUnit c) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a = ⊤ ↔ J.stalkIdeal a = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hne : Ideal.span {c} ≠ ⊤ := fun ht => hc (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp ht)
    rw [eq_bot_iff, ← Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (Ideal.span {c}) hne]
    refine le_iInf fun p => ?_
    rw [← hD, ← IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, h]
    exact le_top
  · intro h
    refine ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_ge.mpr fun m => ?_
    rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, h]
    exact bot_le

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.exists_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prime
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.exists_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prime
    (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    ∃ c : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x,
      Prime c ∧ hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {c}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, σ, hxφ, hφ⟩ := hS.exists_adaptedChart x hx
  refine ⟨coord E ψ φ hφ.1 hxφ (σ default), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact prime_coord_of_eq_zero φ hφ.1 hxφ ((hφ.2 x hxφ).mp hx default)
  · rw [hS.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span hx hφ hxφ, Set.range_unique]

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_ne_top
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_ne_top (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ S) : hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hD⟩ := hS.exists_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prime hx
  rw [hD]
  exact fun h => hc.not_isUnit (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp h)

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {x : M} (hx : x ∉ S) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf J x = ⊤
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top _ _ _ (hS.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hx)

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_one
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_one (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ S) : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf 1 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top hS.idealSheaf 1 x
    (IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one _) (hS.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_ne_top hx)

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    (J K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (x : M) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf (J * K) x =
      IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf J x + IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf K x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ S
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hxφ, hφ⟩ := hS.exists_adaptedChart x hx
    have hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) := isDomain_stalk ψ hφ.1 hxφ
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hD⟩ := hS.exists_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prime hx
    exact IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_mul_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span hS.idealSheaf x (hdom := hdom) hD hc
      J K
  · rw [hS.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem J hx, hS.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem K hx,
      hS.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem (J * K) hx, top_add]

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_pow
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_pow (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (s : ℕ) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf (J ^ s) x =
      (s : ℕ∞) * IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf J x
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, hS.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_one hx]
  | succ s ih => rw [pow_succ, hS.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul, ih, Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, one_mul]

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_finset_prod
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_finset_prod (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι) (G : ι → IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf (∏ i ∈ F, G i) x =
      ∑ i ∈ F, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf (G i) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rw [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty, hS.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_one hx]
  | insert i F hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, hS.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul, ih]

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_self
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_self (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ S) : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf hS.idealSheaf x = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, σ, hxφ, hφ⟩ := hS.exists_adaptedChart x hx
  have hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) := isDomain_stalk ψ hφ.1 hxφ
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hD⟩ := hS.exists_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prime hx
  exact IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_self_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span hS.idealSheaf x (hdom := hdom) hD hc

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_top_iff (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hS.idealSheaf J x = ⊤ ↔ J.stalkIdeal x = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, σ, hxφ, hφ⟩ := hS.exists_adaptedChart x hx
  have hnoeth : IsNoetherianRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isNoetherianRing_stalk_of_chart E ψ φ hxφ hφ.1
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hD⟩ := hS.exists_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prime hx
  exact IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_top_iff_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span hS.idealSheaf J x (hnoeth :=
  hnoeth)
    hD hc.not_isUnit

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.genericOrdAlong_idealSheaf_mul
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.genericOrdAlong_idealSheaf_mul (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    (J K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (x : M) :
    IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong hS.idealSheaf (J * K) x =
      IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong hS.idealSheaf J x + IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong hS.idealSheaf K x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ S
  · rw [genericOrdAlong_eq_ordAlong hS _ hx, genericOrdAlong_eq_ordAlong hS _ hx,
      genericOrdAlong_eq_ordAlong hS _ hx, hS.ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul]
  · have h : ∀ L : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M),
        IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong hS.idealSheaf L x = ⊤ := fun L => by
      rw [IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong_def, hS.cosupport_idealSheaf, connectedComponentIn_eq_empty hx]
      simp
    rw [h, h, h, top_add]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.out_mem_componentSet
statement:
theorem out_mem_componentSet (i : ComponentIndex F) :
    (i.2.out : F.hyp i.1).val ∈ componentSet F i
proof:
:=
  ⟨i.2.out, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; exact Quotient.out_eq' i.2, rfl⟩

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.isPreconnected_componentSet
statement: theorem isPreconnected_componentSet (i : ComponentIndex F) : IsPreconnected (componentSet F i)
proof:
:= by
  have hset : (ConnectedComponents.mk ⁻¹' {i.2} : Set (F.hyp i.1)) =
      connectedComponent i.2.out := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Quotient.out_eq' i.2]
    exact connectedComponents_preimage_singleton
  rw [componentSet, hset]
  exact isPreconnected_connectedComponent.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal
statement:
theorem componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (i : ComponentIndex F) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ componentSet F i) :
    componentExponent F hF I i =
      (IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) I x).toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentExponent componentIdeal
  rw [genericOrdAlong_eq_ordAlong (componentSubmanifold F hF i) I (out_mem_componentSet F i),
    ordAlong_eq_of_isPreconnected (componentSubmanifold F hF i) I subset_rfl
      (isPreconnected_componentSet F i) (out_mem_componentSet F i) hx]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_self
proof:
:=
  (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_self hx

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_of_notMem
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_top (componentIdeal F hF i)
    (componentIdeal F hF i') x ?_ ?_
  · change (componentSubmanifold F hF i').idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x = ⊤
    exact (componentSubmanifold F hF i').stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hx'
  · change (componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊤
    exact (componentSubmanifold F hF i).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_ne_top hx

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_of_ne
statement:
theorem componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_of_ne (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) {i i' : ComponentIndex F} (hne : i ≠ i')
    {x : M} (hx : x ∈ componentSet F i) (hx' : x ∈ componentSet F i') :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) (componentIdeal F hF i') x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, c, hc⟩ := hF.exists_isSncChartAt x
  have hxi : x ∈ F.hyp i.1 := Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _ hx
  have hxi' : x ∈ F.hyp i'.1 := Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _ hx'
  have hstalk : ∀ (k : ComponentIndex F) (hk : x ∈ componentSet F k) (hkm : x ∈ F.hyp k.1),
      (componentIdeal F hF k).stalkIdeal x =
        Ideal.span {coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (c ⟨k.1, hkm⟩)} := by
    intro k hk hkm
    have hadapt : IsAdaptedChart ψ (F.hyp k.1) φ (singleEmb (c ⟨k.1, hkm⟩)) :=
      isAdaptedChart_singleIdx hc.1 fun y hy => hc.mem_iff ⟨k.1, hkm⟩ hy
    rw [componentIdeal_stalkIdeal_eq F hF k hk,
      (hF.isClosedSubmanifold k.1).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span hkm hadapt hc.2.1,
      range_singleIdx_coord]
  refine IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_eq_zero_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span_of_not_dvd (componentIdeal F hF i)
    (componentIdeal F hF i') x (hstalk i hx hxi) (hstalk i' hx' hxi') ?_
  refine hc.not_coord_dvd fun h => hne ?_
  exact active_component_injective_fst F hx hx' (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.ordAlongIdeal_componentIdeal_monomialPart
statement:
theorem ordAlongIdeal_componentIdeal_monomialPart (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (i : ComponentIndex F) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ componentSet F i) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) (monomialPart F hF I) x =
      componentExponent F hF I i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set T : Finset (ComponentIndex F) :=
    IdealSheaf.activeFinset (componentSet F) (componentSet_locallyFinite F hF) x with hT
  have hiT : i ∈ T := IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mpr hx
  have hstalk : (monomialPart F hF I).stalkIdeal x =
      (∏ k ∈ T, componentFactor F hF I k).stalkIdeal x := by
    rw [stalkIdeal_monomialPart, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_prod]
  have hD : componentIdeal F hF i = (componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf := rfl
  rw [IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_congr_stalk (componentIdeal F hF i) _ _ x hstalk, hD,
    (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_finset_prod T _ hx,
    Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · change IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i)
      (componentIdeal F hF i ^ componentExponent F hF I i) x = _
    rw [hD, (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_pow _ _ hx, ← hD,
      componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_self F hF i hx, mul_one]
  · intro k hkT hki
    change IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i)
      (componentIdeal F hF k ^ componentExponent F hF I k) x = 0
    rw [hD, (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_pow _ _ hx, ← hD,
      componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_of_ne F hF (Ne.symm hki) hx (IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hkT),
      mul_zero]
  · intro hi
    exact absurd hiT hi

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentExponent_nonmonomialPart_eq_zero
statement:
theorem componentExponent_nonmonomialPart_eq_zero (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (i : ComponentIndex F) :
    componentExponent F hF (nonmonomialPart F hF I) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hyD : (i.2.out : F.hyp i.1).val ∈ componentSet F i := out_mem_componentSet F i
  set y := (i.2.out : F.hyp i.1).val with hy
  have hsplit : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i)
      (monomialPart F hF I * nonmonomialPart F hF I) y =
        IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) I y := by
    rw [monomialPart_mul_nonmonomialPart]
  have hD : componentIdeal F hF i = (componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf := rfl
  rw [hD, (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul, ← hD,
    ordAlongIdeal_componentIdeal_monomialPart F hF I i hyD,
    componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF I i hyD] at hsplit
  rw [componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF _ i hyD]
  rcases eq_or_ne (IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) I y) ⊤ with htop | hfin
  · rw [htop, ENat.toNat_top, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add] at hsplit
    rw [hsplit, ENat.toNat_top]
  · rw [ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr hfin] at hsplit
    have h0 : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) (nonmonomialPart F hF I) y = 0 :=
      WithTop.add_left_cancel hfin (hsplit.trans (add_zero _).symm)
    rw [h0, ENat.toNat_zero]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.monomialPart_nonmonomialPart_eq_top
statement:
theorem monomialPart_nonmonomialPart_eq_top (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    monomialPart F hF (nonmonomialPart F hF I) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun x => by
    rw [stalkIdeal_monomialPart, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top, ← Ideal.one_eq_top]
    refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun i _ => ?_
    change (componentIdeal F hF i ^ componentExponent F hF (nonmonomialPart F hF I) i).stalkIdeal x
      = 1
    rw [componentExponent_nonmonomialPart_eq_zero, pow_zero, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one,
      Ideal.one_eq_top]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_nonmonomialPart
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_nonmonomialPart (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    nonmonomialPart F hF (nonmonomialPart F hF I) = nonmonomialPart F hF I
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun x => by
    rw [stalkIdeal_nonmonomialPart, monomialPart_nonmonomialPart_eq_top, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top,
      Submodule.top_coe, Submodule.colon_univ]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.ordAlongIdeal_componentIdeal_ne_top
statement:
theorem ordAlongIdeal_componentIdeal_ne_top (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (hI : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere) (i : ComponentIndex F) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ componentSet F i) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) I x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= fun h =>
  hI x (((componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_top_iff I hx).mp h)

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentExponent_mul
statement:
theorem componentExponent_mul (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (I J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (hI : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere) (hJ : J.IsNonzeroEverywhere) (i : ComponentIndex F) :
    componentExponent F hF (I * J) i = componentExponent F hF I i + componentExponent F hF J i
proof:
:= by
  have hyD := out_mem_componentSet F i
  have hD : componentIdeal F hF i = (componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf := rfl
  rw [componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF _ i hyD,
    componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF I i hyD,
    componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF J i hyD, hD,
    (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul, ← hD,
    ENat.toNat_add (ordAlongIdeal_componentIdeal_ne_top F hF I hI i hyD)
      (ordAlongIdeal_componentIdeal_ne_top F hF J hJ i hyD)]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentExponent_componentIdeal_pow_mul
statement:
theorem componentExponent_componentIdeal_pow_mul (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (hI : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere) (i : ComponentIndex F)
    (k : ℕ) :
    componentExponent F hF (componentIdeal F hF i ^ k * I) i = k + componentExponent F hF I i
proof:
:= by
  have hyD := out_mem_componentSet F i
  have hD : componentIdeal F hF i = (componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf := rfl
  rw [componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF _ i hyD,
    componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF I i hyD, hD,
    (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul,
    (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_pow _ _ hyD, ← hD,
    componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_self F hF i hyD, mul_one,
    ENat.toNat_add (ENat.natCast_ne_top k) (ordAlongIdeal_componentIdeal_ne_top F hF I hI i hyD),
    ENat.toNat_natCast]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentExponent_componentIdeal_pow_mul_of_ne
statement:
theorem componentExponent_componentIdeal_pow_mul_of_ne (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {i i' : ComponentIndex F} (hne : i ≠ i') (k : ℕ) :
    componentExponent F hF (componentIdeal F hF i' ^ k * I) i = componentExponent F hF I i
proof:
:= by
  have hyD := out_mem_componentSet F i
  have hD : componentIdeal F hF i = (componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf := rfl
  have h0 : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) (componentIdeal F hF i')
      (i.2.out : F.hyp i.1).val = 0 := by
    by_cases hy' : (i.2.out : F.hyp i.1).val ∈ componentSet F i'
    · exact componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_of_ne F hF hne hyD hy'
    · exact componentIdeal_ordAlongIdeal_of_notMem F hF i i' hyD hy'
  rw [componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF _ i hyD,
    componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF I i hyD, hD,
    (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_mul,
    (componentSubmanifold F hF i).ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf_pow _ _ hyD, ← hD, h0, mul_zero,
    zero_add]

name: Ideal.colon_span_singleton_mul_mul
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.colon_span_singleton_mul_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {a : R}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (I J : Ideal R) :
    Submodule.colon (Ideal.span {a} * I) (↑(Ideal.span {a} * J) : Set R) =
      Submodule.colon I (↑J : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  simp only [Submodule.mem_colon, SetLike.mem_coe, smul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj
    obtain ⟨z, hzI, hz⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mp (h (a * j)
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mpr ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩))
    have : a * z = a * (r * j) := by rw [hz]; ring
    rwa [← mul_left_cancel₀ ha this]
  · intro h s hs
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mp hs
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mpr ⟨r * j, h j hj, by ring⟩

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.monomialPart_componentIdeal_pow_mul
statement:
theorem monomialPart_componentIdeal_pow_mul (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (hI : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere) (i : ComponentIndex F) (k : ℕ) :
    monomialPart F hF (componentIdeal F hF i ^ k * I) =
      componentIdeal F hF i ^ k * monomialPart F hF I
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun x => by
    classical
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, stalkIdeal_monomialPart,
      stalkIdeal_monomialPart]
    set T := IdealSheaf.activeFinset (componentSet F) (componentSet_locallyFinite F hF) x with hT
    have hother : ∀ j ∈ T, j ≠ i →
        (componentFactor F hF (componentIdeal F hF i ^ k * I) j).stalkIdeal x =
          (componentFactor F hF I j).stalkIdeal x := by
      intro j _ hji
      unfold componentFactor
      rw [componentExponent_componentIdeal_pow_mul_of_ne F hF I hji k]
    by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
    · rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase T _ hiT, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase T _ hiT,
        Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j hj => hother j (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hj)
          (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
      unfold componentFactor
      rw [componentExponent_componentIdeal_pow_mul F hF I hI i k, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow,
        IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, pow_add, mul_assoc]
    · rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j hj => hother j hj (fun h => hiT (h ▸ hj))]
      have hx : x ∉ componentSet F i := fun h => hiT (IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mpr h)
      change _ = ((componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x) ^ k * _
      rw [(componentSubmanifold F hF i).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hx, Ideal.top_pow,
        Ideal.top_mul]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_componentIdeal_pow_mul
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_componentIdeal_pow_mul (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (hI : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere) (i : ComponentIndex F)
    (k : ℕ) :
    nonmonomialPart F hF (componentIdeal F hF i ^ k * I) = nonmonomialPart F hF I
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun x => by
    rw [stalkIdeal_nonmonomialPart, stalkIdeal_nonmonomialPart,
      monomialPart_componentIdeal_pow_mul F hF I hI i k, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ componentSet F i
    · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hxφ, hφ⟩ := (componentSubmanifold F hF i).exists_adaptedChart x hx
      have hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) := isDomain_stalk ψ hφ.1 hxφ
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hD⟩ :=
        (componentSubmanifold F hF i).exists_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prime hx
      change Submodule.colon ((componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x ^ k * _)
        ↑((componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x ^ k * _) = _
      rw [hD, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      exact Ideal.colon_span_singleton_mul_mul (pow_ne_zero k hc.ne_zero) _ _
    · change Submodule.colon ((componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x ^ k * _)
        ↑((componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x ^ k * _) = _
      rw [(componentSubmanifold F hF i).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hx, Ideal.top_pow,
        Ideal.top_mul, Ideal.top_mul]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_isNonzeroEverywhere
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_isNonzeroEverywhere (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (hI : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere) :
    (nonmonomialPart F hF I).IsNonzeroEverywhere
proof:
:= by
  intro x hN
  exact hI x (by rw [← stalkIdeal_monomialPart_mul_nonmonomialPart F hF I x, hN, Ideal.mul_bot])

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_le_nonmonomialPart
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_le_nonmonomialPart (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (x : M) :
    I.stalkIdeal x ≤ (nonmonomialPart F hF I).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← stalkIdeal_monomialPart_mul_nonmonomialPart F hF I x]
  exact Ideal.mul_le.mpr fun r _ s hs => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ r hs

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.le_nonmonomialPart
statement:
theorem le_nonmonomialPart (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    I ≤ nonmonomialPart F hF I
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.le_def.mpr (stalkIdeal_le_nonmonomialPart F hF I)

name: prod_pow_dvd_of_prime_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem _root_.prod_pow_dvd_of_prime_of_not_dvd {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → R) (e : ι → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (p i))
    (hnd : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → ¬ p i ∣ p j) {z : R} (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, p i ^ e i ∣ z) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, p i ^ e i ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing z with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s has ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert has]
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := ih (fun i hi => hp i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
      (fun i hi j hj hij => hnd i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) hij)
      (fun i hi => hz i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    have hpa : Prime (p a) := hp a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have hpa_ndvd : ¬ p a ∣ ∏ i ∈ s, p i ^ e i := by
      rw [hpa.dvd_finsetProd_iff]
      rintro ⟨i, hi, hdvd⟩
      exact hnd a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s) i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
        (fun h => has (h ▸ hi)) (hpa.dvd_of_dvd_pow hdvd)
    have hpat : p a ^ e a ∣ t :=
      hpa.pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (e a) hpa_ndvd (hz a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
    rw [mul_comm (∏ i ∈ s, p i ^ e i) t]
    exact mul_dvd_mul_right hpat _

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_monomialPart_eq_span
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_monomialPart_eq_span (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (x : M) :
    ∃ g : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x, g ≠ 0 ∧
      (monomialPart F hF I).stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {g}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have _hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isDomain_stalk ψ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x) (mem_chart_source E x)
  rw [stalkIdeal_monomialPart]
  refine Finset.prod_induction _
    (fun J => ∃ g : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x, g ≠ 0 ∧ J = Ideal.span {g})
    (fun J J' hJ hJ' => ?_) ⟨1, one_ne_zero, by rw [Ideal.span_singleton_one]; exact
      Ideal.one_eq_top⟩ fun i hi => ?_
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := hJ
    obtain ⟨g', hg', rfl⟩ := hJ'
    exact ⟨g * g', mul_ne_zero hg hg', Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton g g'⟩
  · rw [IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset] at hi
    obtain ⟨φ, σ, haφ, hφ⟩ := (componentSubmanifold F hF i).exists_adaptedChart x hi
    refine ⟨coord E ψ φ hφ.1 haφ (σ default) ^ componentExponent F hF I i,
      pow_ne_zero _ (coord_ne_zero hφ.1 haφ (σ default)), ?_⟩
    change ((componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf ^ componentExponent F hF I i).stalkIdeal x = _
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow,
      (componentSubmanifold F hF i).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span hi hφ haφ, Set.range_unique,
      Ideal.span_singleton_pow]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.exists_nonZeroDivisor_stalkIdeal_monomialPart
statement:
theorem exists_nonZeroDivisor_stalkIdeal_monomialPart (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (x : M) :
    ∃ g ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x),
      (monomialPart F hF I).stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {g}
proof:
:= by
  have _hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isDomain_stalk ψ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x) (mem_chart_source E x)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, heq⟩ := stalkIdeal_monomialPart_eq_span F hF I x
  exact ⟨g, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hg, heq⟩

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_le_componentFactor
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_le_componentFactor (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (i : ComponentIndex F) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ componentSet F i) :
    I.stalkIdeal x ≤ (componentFactor F hF I i).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  have hset : (ConnectedComponents.mk ⁻¹' {i.2} : Set (F.hyp i.1)) =
      connectedComponent i.2.out := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Quotient.out_eq' i.2]
    exact connectedComponents_preimage_singleton
  have hpre : IsPreconnected (componentSet F i) := by
    rw [componentSet, hset]
    exact isPreconnected_connectedComponent.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
  have hrepr : (i.2.out : F.hyp i.1).val ∈ componentSet F i :=
    ⟨i.2.out, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]; exact Quotient.out_eq' i.2, rfl⟩
  have hxin : x ∈ connectedComponentIn (componentIdeal F hF i).support
      (i.2.out : F.hyp i.1).val := by
    rw [componentIdeal, (componentSubmanifold F hF i).cosupport_idealSheaf]
    exact hpre.subset_connectedComponentIn hrepr subset_rfl hx
  change I.stalkIdeal x ≤ (componentIdeal F hF i ^ componentExponent F hF I i).stalkIdeal x
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
  refine (IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff _ _ _ _).mp ?_
  calc (componentExponent F hF I i : ℕ∞)
      ≤ IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong (componentIdeal F hF i) I (i.2.out : F.hyp i.1).val :=
        ENat.natCast_toNat_le_self _
    _ ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal F hF i) I x := by
        rw [IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong]
        exact biInf_le _ hxin

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.active_component_injective_fst
statement:
theorem active_component_injective_fst {i i' : ComponentIndex F} {x : M}
    (hi : x ∈ componentSet F i) (hi' : x ∈ componentSet F i') (hfst : i.1 = i'.1) : i = i'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, C⟩ := i
  obtain ⟨j', C'⟩ := i'
  obtain rfl : j = j' := hfst
  simp only [componentSet, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hi hi'
  obtain ⟨x1, hx1, hx1v⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨x2, hx2, hx2v⟩ := hi'
  have hx12 : x1 = x2 := Subtype.ext (hx1v.trans hx2v.symm)
  exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (by rw [← hx1, ← hx2, hx12]))

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nhds_subtype_map_eq
statement:
theorem nhds_subtype_map_eq {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ s) :
    Filter.map (Subtype.val : s → X) (𝓝 (⟨x, hx⟩ : s)) = 𝓝[s] x
proof:
:=
  map_nhds_subtype_val _

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentIdeal_stalkIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem componentIdeal_stalkIdeal_eq (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (i : ComponentIndex F) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ componentSet F i) :
    (componentIdeal F hF i).stalkIdeal x =
      (hF.isClosedSubmanifold i.1).idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : componentSet F i ⊆ F.hyp i.1 := Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _
  have hxmem : x ∈ F.hyp i.1 := hsub hx
  have hnhds : 𝓝[componentSet F i] x = 𝓝[F.hyp i.1] x := by
    have hmem : componentSet F i ∈ 𝓝[F.hyp i.1] x := by
      have _hlc : LocallyConnectedSpace (F.hyp i.1) :=
        (hF.isClosedSubmanifold i.1).locallyConnectedSpace'
      have hpre : (Subtype.val : F.hyp i.1 → M) ⁻¹' componentSet F i =
          connectedComponent i.2.out := by
        rw [componentSet, Set.preimage_image_eq _ Subtype.val_injective]
        conv_lhs => rw [← Quotient.out_eq' i.2]
        exact connectedComponents_preimage_singleton
      have hxc : (⟨x, hxmem⟩ : F.hyp i.1) ∈
          (Subtype.val : F.hyp i.1 → M) ⁻¹' componentSet F i := Set.mem_preimage.mpr hx
      have hpremem : (Subtype.val : F.hyp i.1 → M) ⁻¹' componentSet F i ∈
          𝓝 (⟨x, hxmem⟩ : F.hyp i.1) := by
        rw [hpre] at hxc ⊢
        exact isOpen_connectedComponent.mem_nhds hxc
      rw [← nhds_subtype_map_eq hxmem]
      exact Filter.mem_map.mpr hpremem
    have hint := nhdsWithin_inter_of_mem' hmem
    rwa [Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right hsub] at hint
  ext s
  obtain ⟨V, haV, g, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  rw [componentIdeal, (componentSubmanifold F hF i).germ_mem_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_iff V hx haV,
    (hF.isClosedSubmanifold i.1).germ_mem_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_iff V hxmem haV]
  have hL : Filter.map (Subtype.val : componentSet F i → M) (𝓝 (⟨x, hx⟩ : componentSet F i)) =
      𝓝[componentSet F i] x := nhds_subtype_map_eq hx
  have hR : Filter.map (Subtype.val : F.hyp i.1 → M) (𝓝 (⟨x, hxmem⟩ : F.hyp i.1)) =
      𝓝[F.hyp i.1] x := nhds_subtype_map_eq hxmem
  have hLiff : (∀ᶠ y : componentSet F i in 𝓝 (⟨x, hx⟩ : componentSet F i),
        extendSection 𝕜 E g (y : M) = 0) ↔
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[componentSet F i] x, extendSection 𝕜 E g z = 0 := by
    rw [← hL]; exact Iff.rfl
  have hRiff : (∀ᶠ y : F.hyp i.1 in 𝓝 (⟨x, hxmem⟩ : F.hyp i.1),
        extendSection 𝕜 E g (y : M) = 0) ↔
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[F.hyp i.1] x, extendSection 𝕜 E g z = 0 := by
    rw [← hR]; exact Iff.rfl
  rw [hLiff, hRiff, hnhds]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_le_monomialPart
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_le_monomialPart (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (x : M) : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ (monomialPart F hF I).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨φ, c, hc⟩ := hF.exists_isSncChartAt x
  have _hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isDomain_stalk ψ hc.1 hc.2.1
  intro s hs
  rw [stalkIdeal_monomialPart]
  set T : Finset (ComponentIndex F) :=
    IdealSheaf.activeFinset (componentSet F) (componentSet_locallyFinite F hF) x with hTdef
  have hmemC : ∀ i ∈ T, x ∈ componentSet F i := fun i hi =>
    IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp (hTdef ▸ hi)
  have hmemx : ∀ i ∈ T, x ∈ F.hyp i.1 := fun i hi =>
    Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _ (hmemC i hi)
  set g : ComponentIndex F → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x :=
    fun i => if h : x ∈ F.hyp i.1 then coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (c ⟨i.1, h⟩) else 1 with hgdef
  have hg : ∀ (i : ComponentIndex F) (hi : i ∈ T),
      g i = coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (c ⟨i.1, hmemx i hi⟩) := by
    intro i hi
    simp only [hgdef]
    exact dite_eq_left (hmemx i hi)
  have hCF : ∀ i ∈ T, (componentFactor F hF I i).stalkIdeal x =
      Ideal.span {g i ^ componentExponent F hF I i} := by
    intro i hi
    have hadapt : IsAdaptedChart ψ (F.hyp i.1) φ (singleEmb (c ⟨i.1, hmemx i hi⟩)) :=
      isAdaptedChart_singleIdx hc.1 fun y hy => hc.mem_iff ⟨i.1, hmemx i hi⟩ hy
    rw [componentFactor, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow,
      componentIdeal_stalkIdeal_eq F hF i (hmemC i hi),
      (hF.isClosedSubmanifold i.1).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span (hmemx i hi) hadapt hc.2.1,
      range_singleIdx_coord, hg i hi, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  have hMeq : (∏ i ∈ T, (componentFactor F hF I i).stalkIdeal x) =
      Ideal.span {∏ i ∈ T, g i ^ componentExponent F hF I i} := by
    rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl hCF, Ideal.prod_span_singleton]
  rw [hMeq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  refine prod_pow_dvd_of_prime_of_not_dvd T g (fun i => componentExponent F hF I i)
    (fun i hi => ?_) (fun i hi j hj hij => ?_) (fun i hi => ?_)
  · rw [hg i hi]; exact hc.prime_coord _
  · rw [hg i hi, hg j hj]
    refine hc.not_coord_dvd fun h => hij ?_
    exact active_component_injective_fst F (hmemC i hi)
      (hmemC j hj) (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  · rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← hCF i hi]
    exact stalkIdeal_le_componentFactor F hF I i (hmemC i hi) hs

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentSubmanifold
statement:
theorem componentSubmanifold (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (i : ComponentIndex F) :
    IsClosedSubmanifold ψ (componentSet F i) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hF.isClosedSubmanifold i.1).connectedComponent' i.2.out
  have hmk : (ConnectedComponents.mk i.2.out : ConnectedComponents (F.hyp i.1)) = i.2 :=
    Quotient.out_eq' i.2
  have hset : (ConnectedComponents.mk ⁻¹' {i.2} : Set (F.hyp i.1)) =
      connectedComponent i.2.out := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hmk]
    rw [connectedComponents_preimage_singleton]
  rwa [componentSet, hset]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentSet_locallyFinite
statement: theorem componentSet_locallyFinite (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) : LocallyFinite (componentSet F)
proof:
:=
  locallyFinite_sigma hF.locallyFinite
    (fun j => (hF.isClosedSubmanifold j).locallyFinite_connectedComponents')
    (fun _ _ => Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _)

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentFactor_stalkIdeal_top_of_notMem
statement:
theorem componentFactor_stalkIdeal_top_of_notMem (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (i : ComponentIndex F) (x : M)
    (hx : x ∉ componentSet F i) : (componentFactor F hF I i).stalkIdeal x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  change ((componentSubmanifold F hF i).idealSheaf ^ componentExponent F hF I i).stalkIdeal x = ⊤
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, (componentSubmanifold F hF i).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hx,
    ← Ideal.one_eq_top, one_pow]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_monomialPart
statement:
@[simp] theorem stalkIdeal_monomialPart (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (x : M) :
    (monomialPart F hF I).stalkIdeal x =
      ∏ i ∈ IdealSheaf.activeFinset (componentSet F) (componentSet_locallyFinite F hF) x,
        (componentFactor F hF I i).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_locallyFiniteProduct _ _ _ _ x

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_totalTransform_eq_exc_pow_mul_birationalTransform
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_totalTransform_eq_exc_pow_mul_birationalTransform
    {J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)} {k : ℕ}
    (hk : ∀ x ∈ Y, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J x)
    {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n} {i : Fin c}
    {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M' E} (hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ σ) (hΦ : IsBlowUpChart ψ π φ σ i Φ)
    {p : M'} (hp : p ∈ Φ.source) (hpY : π p ∈ Y) :
    (J.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal p =
      (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal p ^ k *
        (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, k⟩).I.stalkIdeal p
proof:
:= by
  rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h hk hφ hΦ hp,
    stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ hp, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  exact (Ideal.span_pow_mul_colon_of_le _ _ k
    (totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le_span_coord_pow hY h hk hφ hΦ hp hpY)).symm

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.totalTransform_eq_exc_pow_mul_birationalTransform
statement:
theorem totalTransform_eq_exc_pow_mul_birationalTransform
    {J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)} {k : ℕ}
    (hk : ∀ x ∈ Y, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J x) :
    J.pullback π h.contMDiff =
      hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff ^ k *
        (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, k⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun p => ?_
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
  by_cases hpY : π p ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hpφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart _ hpY
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hpΦ⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ p hpφ
    exact stalkIdeal_totalTransform_eq_exc_pow_mul_birationalTransform hY h hk hφ hΦ hpΦ hpY
  · rw [stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem hY h hpY, Ideal.top_pow, Ideal.top_mul,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h hk hpY]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.comap_idealSheaf_eq_exc_mul_strictTransform
statement:
theorem comap_idealSheaf_eq_exc_mul_strictTransform {D : Set M} (hD : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ D 1)
    (hYD : Y ⊆ D) :
    hD.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff =
      hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff *
        (isClosedSubmanifold_strictTransform hY h hD hYD).idealSheaf
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalTransform_eq_exc_pow_mul_birationalTransform hY h
      (hY.one_le_ordAlongIdeal_idealSheaf hD hYD), pow_one,
    ← idealSheaf_strictTransform_eq_markedTransform_one hY h hD hYD]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.coe_roundOrderOn
statement:
theorem coe_roundOrderOn (T : AnalyticTriple ψ₀ M) (U : Opens M)
    (hU : IsCompact (closure (U : Set M))) :
    (roundOrderOn T U : ℕ∞) =
      ⨆ x : closure (U : Set M), (nonmonomialPart T.F T.isSnc T.I).ord (x : M)
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional_of_chartIso ψ₀
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IdealSheaf.bddAbove_ord_on_compact
    (nonmonomialPart_isNonzeroEverywhere T.F T.isSnc T.I T.isNonzeroEverywhere) hU
  exact ENat.natCast_toNat
    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.natCast_ne_top m) (iSup_le fun x => hm x.1 x.2))

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.ord_le_roundOrderOn
statement:
theorem ord_le_roundOrderOn (T : AnalyticTriple ψ₀ M) (U : Opens M)
    (hU : IsCompact (closure (U : Set M))) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ (U : Set M)) :
    (nonmonomialPart T.F T.isSnc T.I).ord x ≤ (roundOrderOn T U : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_roundOrderOn T U hU]
  exact le_iSup (fun y : closure (U : Set M) => (nonmonomialPart T.F T.isSnc T.I).ord (y : M))
    ⟨x, subset_closure hx⟩

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.boClass_nonmonomialTriple_pullback
statement:
theorem boClass_nonmonomialTriple_pullback (T : AnalyticTriple ψ₀ M) (U : Opens M)
    (hU : IsCompact (closure (U : Set M))) (hpos : 1 ≤ roundOrderOn T U) :
    AnalyticTriple.BOClass (roundOrderOn T U)
      ((nonmonomialTriple T).pullback (M.inclusion U) (isLocalDiffeomorph_inclusion M U))
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteDimensional_of_chartIso ψ₀
  exact boClass_pullback_inclusion (nonmonomialTriple T) hpos U hU fun x hx => by
    rw [nonmonomialTriple_I]; exact ord_le_roundOrderOn T U hU hx

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.le_monomialPart
statement:
theorem le_monomialPart (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    I ≤ monomialPart F hF I
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.le_def.mpr (stalkIdeal_le_monomialPart F hF I)

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.monomialPart_mul_nonmonomialPart
statement:
theorem monomialPart_mul_nonmonomialPart (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    monomialPart F hF I * nonmonomialPart F hF I = I
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun x => by
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, stalkIdeal_monomialPart_mul_nonmonomialPart F hF I x]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.isNonzeroEverywhere_mul
statement:
theorem isNonzeroEverywhere_mul (I J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (hI : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere) (hJ : J.IsNonzeroEverywhere) :
    (I * J).IsNonzeroEverywhere
proof:
:= by
  intro x hIJ
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul] at hIJ
  have _hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isDomain_stalk ψ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x) (mem_chart_source E x)
  rcases Ideal.mul_eq_bot.mp hIJ with h | h
  · exact hI x h
  · exact hJ x h

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.isNonzeroEverywhere_pow
statement:
theorem isNonzeroEverywhere_pow (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (hI : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere) (k : ℕ) : (I ^ k).IsNonzeroEverywhere
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero]; intro x hx
    have _hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :=
      isDomain_stalk ψ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x) (mem_chart_source E x)
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one] at hx
    exact absurd hx top_ne_bot
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact isNonzeroEverywhere_mul (ψ := ψ) _ _ ih hI

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.isNonzeroEverywhere_of_mul_right
statement:
theorem isNonzeroEverywhere_of_mul_right {I J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)}
    (h : (I * J).IsNonzeroEverywhere) : J.IsNonzeroEverywhere
proof:
:=
  fun x hJ => h x (by rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, hJ, Ideal.mul_bot])

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.isNonzeroEverywhere_of_mul_left
statement:
theorem isNonzeroEverywhere_of_mul_left {I J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)}
    (h : (I * J).IsNonzeroEverywhere) : I.IsNonzeroEverywhere
proof:
:=
  fun x hI => h x (by rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, hI, Ideal.bot_mul])

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.map_finset_prod_ideal
statement:
theorem map_finset_prod_ideal {R S F : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [FunLike F R S]
    [RingHomClass F R S] (f : F) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (J : ι → Ideal R) :
    Ideal.map f (∏ i ∈ s, J i) = ∏ i ∈ s, Ideal.map f (J i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.map_top]
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, Ideal.map_mul, ih]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.exists_isOpen_componentSet_eq
statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_componentSet_eq (G : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hG : G.IsSnc ψ₀)
    (i₀ : ComponentIndex G) :
    ∃ W : Set M, IsOpen W ∧ componentSet G i₀ = G.hyp i₀.1 ∩ W
proof:
:= by
  have _hlc : LocallyConnectedSpace (G.hyp i₀.1) :=
    (hG.isClosedSubmanifold i₀.1).locallyConnectedSpace'
  have hpre : (Subtype.val : G.hyp i₀.1 → M) ⁻¹' componentSet G i₀
      = connectedComponent i₀.2.out := by
    rw [componentSet, Set.preimage_image_eq _ Subtype.val_injective]
    conv_lhs => rw [← Quotient.out_eq' i₀.2]
    exact connectedComponents_preimage_singleton
  have hopen : IsOpen ((Subtype.val : G.hyp i₀.1 → M) ⁻¹' componentSet G i₀) := by
    rw [hpre]; exact isOpen_connectedComponent
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hW⟩ := isOpen_induced_iff.mp hopen
  have hsub : componentSet G i₀ ⊆ G.hyp i₀.1 := Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _
  have hrange : Set.range (Subtype.val : G.hyp i₀.1 → M) = G.hyp i₀.1 := Subtype.range_coe
  refine ⟨W, hWo, ?_⟩
  have e1 : componentSet G i₀
      = (Subtype.val : G.hyp i₀.1 → M) '' ((Subtype.val) ⁻¹' componentSet G i₀) := by
    rw [Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range, hrange, Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hsub]
  rw [e1, ← hW, Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range, hrange, Set.inter_comm]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.mem_componentSet_mk
statement:
theorem mem_componentSet_mk (G : HypersurfaceFamily M) (j : G.ι) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ G.hyp j) :
    x ∈ componentSet G ⟨j, ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.mk_eq_of_mem_componentSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hx
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
  rw [show (⟨x, hxmem⟩ : G.hyp i₀.1) = y from Subtype.ext hyx.symm, hy]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentIndex_ext_of_mem
statement:
theorem componentIndex_ext_of_mem {G : HypersurfaceFamily M} {i₁ i₂ : ComponentIndex G} {x : M}
    (h1 : x ∈ componentSet G i₁) (h2 : x ∈ componentSet G i₂) (hj : i₁.1 = i₂.1) : i₁ = i₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j₁, C₁⟩ := i₁
  obtain ⟨j₂, C₂⟩ := i₂
  obtain rfl : j₁ = j₂ := hj
  have hm : x ∈ G.hyp j₁ := (Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _) h1
  rw [Sigma.mk.inj_iff]
  refine ⟨rfl, heq_of_eq ?_⟩
  calc C₁ = ConnectedComponents.mk (⟨x, hm⟩ : G.hyp j₁) :=
        (mk_eq_of_mem_componentSet G ⟨j₁, C₁⟩ h1 hm).symm
    _ = C₂ := mk_eq_of_mem_componentSet G ⟨j₁, C₂⟩ h2 hm

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentIdeal_comap_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem componentIdeal_comap_stalkIdeal (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ₀)
    (i : ComponentIndex F) (i' : ComponentIndex (F.comap h)) {b : N}
    (hib : b ∈ componentSet (F.comap h) i') (hnb : h b ∈ componentSet F i)
    (hji : i'.1 = i.1) :
    (componentIdeal (F.comap h) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_comap hF h hh) i').stalkIdeal b
      = ((componentIdeal F hF i).pullback h h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal b
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨W1, hW1o, hW1⟩ :=
    exists_isOpen_componentSet_eq (F.comap h) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_comap hF h hh) i'
  obtain ⟨O, hOo, hO⟩ := exists_isOpen_componentSet_eq F hF i
  have hcomap_hyp : (F.comap h).hyp i'.1 = ⇑h ⁻¹' F.hyp i.1 := by
    simp only [HypersurfaceFamily.comap_hyp, hji]
  have hbU : b ∈ W1 ∩ ⇑h ⁻¹' O :=
    ⟨(hW1 ▸ hib).2, Set.mem_preimage.mpr (hO ▸ hnb).2⟩
  have hYY' : componentSet (F.comap h) i' ∩ (W1 ∩ ⇑h ⁻¹' O)
      = (⇑h ⁻¹' componentSet F i) ∩ (W1 ∩ ⇑h ⁻¹' O) := by
    rw [hW1, hcomap_hyp, hO, Set.preimage_inter]
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
    tauto
  rw [componentIdeal, componentIdeal,
    comap_idealSheaf_of_isLocalDiffeomorph ψ₀ h hh (componentSubmanifold F hF i)]
  exact IsClosedSubmanifold.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_congr_nhds _ _ hib
    (hW1o.inter (hOo.preimage h.contMDiff.continuous)) hbU hYY'

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentExponent_comap
statement:
theorem componentExponent_comap (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ₀)
    (I : AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf M) (i : ComponentIndex F)
        (i' : ComponentIndex (F.comap h)) {b : N}
    (hib : b ∈ componentSet (F.comap h) i') (hnb : h b ∈ componentSet F i) (hji : i'.1 = i.1) :
    componentExponent (F.comap h) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_comap hF h hh)
        (I.pullback h h.contMDiff) i'
      = componentExponent F hF I i
proof:
:= by
  have hcongr : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal (componentIdeal (F.comap h)
        (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_comap hF h hh) i') (I.pullback h h.contMDiff) b
      = IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal ((componentIdeal F hF i).pullback h h.contMDiff)
        (I.pullback h h.contMDiff) b := by
    unfold IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal
    rw [componentIdeal_comap_stalkIdeal h hh F hF i i' hib hnb hji]
  rw [componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal (F.comap h)
        (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_comap hF h hh) (I.pullback h h.contMDiff) i' hib,
      componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal F hF I i hnb, hcongr,
      IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_comap_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt h (componentIdeal F hF i) I (hh b)]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentFactor_comap_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem componentFactor_comap_stalkIdeal (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ₀)
    (I : AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf M) (i : ComponentIndex F)
        (i' : ComponentIndex (F.comap h)) {b : N}
    (hib : b ∈ componentSet (F.comap h) i') (hnb : h b ∈ componentSet F i) (hji : i'.1 = i.1) :
    (componentFactor (F.comap h) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_comap hF h hh)
        (I.pullback h h.contMDiff) i').stalkIdeal b
      = ((componentFactor F hF I i).stalkIdeal (h b)).map (germAlgEquiv h (hh b))
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentFactor
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow,
    componentExponent_comap h hh F hF I i i' hib hnb hji,
    componentIdeal_comap_stalkIdeal h hh F hF i i' hib hnb hji,
    stalkIdeal_comap_eq_map_germAlgEquiv h hh (componentIdeal F hF i) b, Ideal.map_pow]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.monomialPart_comap
statement:
theorem monomialPart_comap (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ₀)
    (I : AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf M) :
    monomialPart (F.comap h) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_comap hF h hh)
        (I.pullback h h.contMDiff)
      = (monomialPart F hF I).pullback h h.contMDiff
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun b => ?_
  rw [stalkIdeal_comap_eq_map_germAlgEquiv h hh (monomialPart F hF I) b, stalkIdeal_monomialPart,
    stalkIdeal_monomialPart, map_finset_prod_ideal]
  
  have key : ∀ i' : ComponentIndex (F.comap h), b ∈ componentSet (F.comap h) i' →
      h b ∈ F.hyp i'.1 := by
    intro i' hi'
    have hb : b ∈ (F.comap h).hyp i'.1 := (Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _) hi'
    exact hb
  refine Finset.prod_bij
    (fun i' hi' => (⟨i'.1, ConnectedComponents.mk
      ⟨h b, key i' (IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hi')⟩⟩ : ComponentIndex F)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i' hi'
    rw [IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset]
    exact mem_componentSet_mk F i'.1 (key i' (IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hi'))
  · intro i₁ hi₁ i₂ hi₂ heq
    have hj : i₁.1 = i₂.1 := by have hf := congrArg Sigma.fst heq; exact hf
    exact componentIndex_ext_of_mem (IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hi₁)
      (IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hi₂) hj
  · intro i hi
    have hi_mem := IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hi
    have hhb : h b ∈ F.hyp i.1 := (Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _) hi_mem
    have hbmem : b ∈ (F.comap h).hyp i.1 := hhb
    refine ⟨⟨i.1, ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨b, hbmem⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset]
      exact mem_componentSet_mk (F.comap h) i.1 hbmem
    · exact componentIndex_ext_of_mem
        (mem_componentSet_mk F i.1 (key _ (mem_componentSet_mk (F.comap h) i.1 hbmem)))
        hi_mem rfl
  · intro i' hi'
    exact componentFactor_comap_stalkIdeal h hh F hF I _ i'
      (IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hi')
      (mem_componentSet_mk F i'.1 (key i' (IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hi'))) rfl

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_comap
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_comap (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) (hF : F.IsSnc ψ₀)
    (I : AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf M) :
    nonmonomialPart (F.comap h) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_comap hF h hh)
        (I.pullback h h.contMDiff)
      = (nonmonomialPart F hF I).pullback h h.contMDiff
proof:
:= by
  have hM := monomialPart_comap h hh F hF I
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun b => ?_
  have hbij := germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt (⇑h) h.contMDiff (hh b)
  have hcs : ∀ J :
      AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf M, (J.pullback h h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal b
      = Ideal.map (germMap (⇑h) h.contMDiff b) (J.stalkIdeal (h b)) := by
    intro J
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback]
  rw [stalkIdeal_nonmonomialPart, hM, hcs I, hcs (monomialPart F hF I),
    hcs (nonmonomialPart F hF I), stalkIdeal_nonmonomialPart]
  conv_rhs => rw [← pow_one ((monomialPart F hF I).stalkIdeal (h b))]
  rw [Ideal.map_colon_pow_of_bijective _ hbij, pow_one]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentIdeal_pow_stalkIdeal_top_of_notMem
statement:
theorem componentIdeal_pow_stalkIdeal_top_of_notMem (a : ComponentIndex G → ℕ)
    (i : ComponentIndex G) (x : X) (hx : x ∉ componentSet G i) :
    (componentIdeal G hG i ^ a i).stalkIdeal x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  change ((componentSubmanifold G hG i).idealSheaf ^ a i).stalkIdeal x = ⊤
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, (componentSubmanifold G hG i).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hx,
    ← Ideal.one_eq_top, one_pow]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.componentIdeal_isNonzeroEverywhere
statement:
theorem componentIdeal_isNonzeroEverywhere (i : ComponentIndex G) :
    (componentIdeal G hG i).IsNonzeroEverywhere
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have _hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E X).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isDomain_stalk ψ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x) (mem_chart_source E x)
  change (componentSubmanifold G hG i).idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥
  by_cases hx : x ∈ componentSet G i
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hspan⟩ :=
      (componentSubmanifold G hG i).exists_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prime hx
    rw [hspan, Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact hp.ne_zero
  · rw [(componentSubmanifold G hG i).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hx]
    exact top_ne_bot

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.isNonzeroEverywhere_finset_prod_componentIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem isNonzeroEverywhere_finset_prod_componentIdeal_pow (s : Finset (ComponentIndex G))
    (a : ComponentIndex G → ℕ) : (∏ i ∈ s, componentIdeal G hG i ^ a i).IsNonzeroEverywhere
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.prod_induction (fun i => componentIdeal G hG i ^ a i) IdealSheaf.IsNonzeroEverywhere
    (fun I J hI hJ => isNonzeroEverywhere_mul (ψ := ψ) I J hI hJ) ?_
    (fun i _ =>
      isNonzeroEverywhere_pow (ψ := ψ) _ (componentIdeal_isNonzeroEverywhere G hG i) (a i))
  intro x hx
  have _hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E X).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isDomain_stalk ψ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x) (mem_chart_source E x)
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one] at hx
  exact absurd hx top_ne_bot

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.monomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr
statement:
theorem monomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr (K K' : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X)) (x : X)
    (hKK' : K.stalkIdeal x = K'.stalkIdeal x) :
    (monomialPart G hG K).stalkIdeal x = (monomialPart G hG K').stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_monomialPart, stalkIdeal_monomialPart]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hxi : x ∈ componentSet G i := IdealSheaf.mem_activeFinset.mp hi
  change (componentIdeal G hG i ^ componentExponent G hG K i).stalkIdeal x =
    (componentIdeal G hG i ^ componentExponent G hG K' i).stalkIdeal x
  rw [componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal G hG K i hxi,
    componentExponent_eq_toNat_ordAlongIdeal G hG K' i hxi,
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal_congr_stalk (componentIdeal G hG i) K K' x hKK']

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr (K K' : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X)) (x : X)
    (hKK' : K.stalkIdeal x = K'.stalkIdeal x) :
    (nonmonomialPart G hG K).stalkIdeal x = (nonmonomialPart G hG K').stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_nonmonomialPart, stalkIdeal_nonmonomialPart, hKK',
    monomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr G hG K K' x hKK']

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_locallyFiniteProduct_pow_mul
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_locallyFiniteProduct_pow_mul (a : ComponentIndex G → ℕ)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X)) (hJ : J.IsNonzeroEverywhere) :
    nonmonomialPart G hG
        (IdealSheaf.locallyFiniteProduct (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X)
          (fun i => componentIdeal G hG i ^ a i) (componentSet G) (componentSet_locallyFinite G hG)
          (componentIdeal_pow_stalkIdeal_top_of_notMem G hG a) * J) =
      nonmonomialPart G hG J
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun x => ?_
  have hst : (IdealSheaf.locallyFiniteProduct (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X)
        (fun i => componentIdeal G hG i ^ a i) (componentSet G) (componentSet_locallyFinite G hG)
        (componentIdeal_pow_stalkIdeal_top_of_notMem G hG a) * J).stalkIdeal x =
      ((∏ i ∈ IdealSheaf.activeFinset (componentSet G) (componentSet_locallyFinite G hG) x,
        componentIdeal G hG i ^ a i) * J).stalkIdeal x := by
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_locallyFiniteProduct, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_prod]
  rw [nonmonomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr G hG _ _ x hst,
    nonmonomialPart_finprod_componentIdeal_pow_mul G hG J a _
      (isNonzeroEverywhere_mul (ψ := ψ) _ _
        (isNonzeroEverywhere_finset_prod_componentIdeal_pow G hG _ a) hJ)]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.isNonzeroEverywhere_top
statement: theorem isNonzeroEverywhere_top : (⊤ : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X)).IsNonzeroEverywhere
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have _hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E X).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isDomain_stalk ψ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x) (mem_chart_source E x)
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top] at hx
  exact absurd hx top_ne_bot

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_eq_top_of_forall_stalkIdeal_eq_prod
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_eq_top_of_forall_stalkIdeal_eq_prod
    (K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X))
    (hK : ∀ x, ∃ b : ComponentIndex G → ℕ, K.stalkIdeal x =
      ∏ i ∈ IdealSheaf.activeFinset (componentSet G) (componentSet_locallyFinite G hG) x,
        (componentIdeal G hG i).stalkIdeal x ^ b i) :
    nonmonomialPart G hG K = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hK x
  have hst : K.stalkIdeal x =
      ((∏ i ∈ IdealSheaf.activeFinset (componentSet G) (componentSet_locallyFinite G hG) x,
        componentIdeal G hG i ^ b i) * ⊤).stalkIdeal x := by
    rw [hb, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top, Ideal.mul_top,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => (IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow _ _ _).symm
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top, nonmonomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr G hG K _ x hst,
    nonmonomialPart_finprod_componentIdeal_pow_mul G hG ⊤ b _
      (isNonzeroEverywhere_mul (ψ := ψ) _ _
        (isNonzeroEverywhere_finset_prod_componentIdeal_pow G hG _ b)
        (isNonzeroEverywhere_top (ψ := ψ))),
    stalkIdeal_nonmonomialPart, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top]
  exact eq_top_iff.mpr fun r _ => Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun p _ => Submodule.mem_top

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.monomialPart_eq_self_of_nonmonomialPart_eq_top
statement:
theorem monomialPart_eq_self_of_nonmonomialPart_eq_top (K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X))
    (hN : nonmonomialPart G hG K = ⊤) : monomialPart G hG K = K
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun x => ?_
  have h := congrArg (fun J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E X) => J.stalkIdeal x)
    (monomialPart_mul_nonmonomialPart G hG K)
  simp only [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, hN, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top, Ideal.mul_top] at h
  exact h

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_idealSheaf_preimage
statement:
theorem exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_idealSheaf_preimage :
    hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff = (h.isClosedSubmanifold_preimage hY).idealSheaf
proof:
:=
  IsIdealSheafOf.eq_idealSheaf (h.isClosedSubmanifold_preimage hY)
    (isIdealSheafOf_exceptionalIdealSheaf hY h)

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_componentIdeal_totalTransform_inr
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_componentIdeal_totalTransform_inr
    (α : ConnectedComponents ((F.totalTransform π Y).hyp (toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))) {x : M'}
    (hx : x ∈ componentSet (F.totalTransform π Y) ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), α⟩) :
    (componentIdeal (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
        ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), α⟩).stalkIdeal x =
      (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  have hF' := HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hW⟩ := exists_isOpen_componentSet_eq (M := (⟨M'⟩ : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E))
    (F.totalTransform π Y) hF' ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), α⟩
  rw [exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_idealSheaf_preimage hY h, componentIdeal]
  exact ((h.isClosedSubmanifold_preimage hY).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_of_inter_eq_left
    (componentSubmanifold _ hF' _) hWo hW.symm hx).symm

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.nonmonomialPart_exceptionalIdealSheaf_pow_mul
statement:
theorem nonmonomialPart_exceptionalIdealSheaf_pow_mul (m : ℕ)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M')) (hJ : J.IsNonzeroEverywhere) :
    nonmonomialPart (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
        (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff ^ m * J) =
      nonmonomialPart (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
        J
proof:
:= by
  have hF' := HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun x => ?_
  by_cases hxY : π x ∈ Y
  · have hmem : x ∈ (F.totalTransform π Y).hyp (toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) := hxY
    have hcs : x ∈ componentSet (F.totalTransform π Y)
        ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨x, hmem⟩⟩ := ⟨⟨x, hmem⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
    have hS2 := stalkIdeal_componentIdeal_totalTransform_inr hY h F hF hsnc _ hcs
    have hst : (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff ^ m * J).stalkIdeal x =
        ((∏ i ∈ ({⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨x, hmem⟩⟩} :
            Finset (ComponentIndex (F.totalTransform π Y))),
          componentIdeal (F.totalTransform π Y) hF' i ^ m) * J).stalkIdeal x := by
      rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow,
        Finset.prod_singleton, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, hS2]
    rw [nonmonomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr _ hF' _ _ x hst,
      nonmonomialPart_finprod_componentIdeal_pow_mul _ hF' J (fun _ => m) _
        (isNonzeroEverywhere_mul (ψ := ψ) _ _
          (isNonzeroEverywhere_finset_prod_componentIdeal_pow _ hF' _ _) hJ)]
  · have hst : (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff ^ m * J).stalkIdeal x = J.stalkIdeal x := by
      rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow,
        stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem hY h hxY, Ideal.top_pow, Ideal.top_mul]
    exact nonmonomialPart_stalkIdeal_congr _ hF' _ _ x hst

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_totalTransform_componentIdeal_of_notMem
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_totalTransform_componentIdeal_of_notMem {x : M'} (hxY : π x ∉ Y)
    (i : ComponentIndex F) (hxi : π x ∈ componentSet F i)
    (hxj : x ∈ strictTransformSet π Y (F.hyp i.1)) :
    ((componentIdeal F hF i).pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal x =
      (componentIdeal (F.totalTransform π Y) (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
        ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i.1), ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨x, hxj⟩⟩).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  have hF' := HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc
  have hπc : Continuous π := h.contMDiff.continuous
  have hmem : π x ∈ F.hyp i.1 := Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _ hxi
  have hcs : x ∈ componentSet (F.totalTransform π Y)
      ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i.1), ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨x, hxj⟩⟩ := ⟨⟨x, hxj⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, σ₁, e, hpφ, hφ, hpe, he, h5⟩ :=
    exists_adaptedChart_strictTransform_off hY h (hF.isClosedSubmanifold i.1) hmem hxY
  have hgerm : germMap π h.contMDiff x (coord E ψ φ hφ.1 hpφ (σ₁ 0)) =
      coord E ψ e he.1 hpe (σ₁ 0) := by
    apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M' x
    rw [stalkToGerm_germMap, stalkToGerm_coord, stalkToGerm_coord, Filter.Germ.coe_compTendsto,
      Filter.Germ.coe_eq]
    filter_upwards [e.open_source.mem_nhds hpe, (φ.open_source.preimage hπc).mem_nhds hpφ]
      with y hy hy'
    rw [Function.comp_apply, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy', extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy]
    exact (h5 y hy).symm
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, componentIdeal_stalkIdeal_eq (F := F) hF i hxi,
    componentIdeal_stalkIdeal_eq (F := F.totalTransform π Y) hF' _ hcs,
    (hF.isClosedSubmanifold i.1).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span hmem hφ hpφ,
    (hF'.isClosedSubmanifold (toLex (Sum.inl i.1))).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span hxj he hpe,
    Set.range_unique, Set.range_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    hgerm]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_totalTransform_componentIdeal_eq_span_germMap
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_totalTransform_componentIdeal_eq_span_germMap (i : ComponentIndex F)
    (hai : a ∈ componentSet F i) :
    ((componentIdeal F hF i).pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal x =

proof:

    (hF.isClosedSubmanifold i.1).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span hmem
      (isAdaptedChart_singleIdx hc.1 fun y hy => hc.mem_iff ⟨i.1, hmem⟩ hy) hc.2.1,
    range_singleIdx_coord hc.1 hc.2.1, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_totalTransform_componentIdeal_of_eq_scaling
statement:

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_componentIdeal_totalTransform_inl
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_componentIdeal_totalTransform_inl {j : F.ι} (haj : a ∈ F.hyp j)
    (C' : ConnectedComponents ((F.totalTransform π Y).hyp (toLex (Sum.inl j))))
    (hxC : x ∈ componentSet (F.totalTransform π Y) ⟨toLex (Sum.inl j), C'⟩) :

      Ideal.span {coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hx (cidx ⟨j, haj⟩)}
proof:

  have hsnc' := HypersurfaceFamily.totalTransform_isSncChartAt h hF hφ hc hΦ hx hxa
  have hxmem : x ∈ (F.totalTransform π Y).hyp (toLex (Sum.inl j)) :=
    Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _ hxC

    (hF'.isClosedSubmanifold (toLex (Sum.inl j))).stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span hxmem
      (isAdaptedChart_singleIdx hsnc'.1 fun y hy => hsnc'.mem_iff ⟨toLex (Sum.inl j), hxmem⟩ hy)
      hsnc'.2.1,

name: Hironaka.Manifold.BMO.stalkIdeal_totalTransform_componentIdeal_of_eq_ratio_of_mem
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_totalTransform_componentIdeal_of_eq_ratio_of_mem (i : ComponentIndex F)
    (hai : a ∈ componentSet F i) {k : Fin c} (hk : k ≠ i₀)
    (hidx : cidx ⟨i.1, Subtype.coe_image_subset _ _ hai⟩ = σ k)
    (hxj : x ∈ strictTransformSet π Y (F.hyp i.1)) :
    ((componentIdeal F hF i).pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal x =
      (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal x *
        (componentIdeal (F.totalTransform π Y)
          (HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_totalTransform hY h hF hsnc)
          ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i.1), ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨x, hxj⟩⟩).stalkIdeal x
proof:

      ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i.1), ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨x, hxj⟩⟩ := ⟨⟨x, hxj⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [stalkIdeal_totalTransform_componentIdeal_of_eq_ratio hY h F hF hφ hc hΦ hx hxa i hai hk hidx,
    stalkIdeal_componentIdeal_totalTransform_inl hY h F hF hsnc hφ hc hΦ hx hxa
