  exact (isSmoothDivisor_iff_forall_isSmoothDivisorAt H).mp hH x hxH

name: Hironaka.Resolution.mem_genericPoints_of_Zminus1_le
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_of_Zminus1_le [NoetherianSpace X] (I H : X.IdealSheafData) {η : X}
    (hη : η ∈ I.support.genericPoints)
    (hle : Zminus1 I 1 H ≤ IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})) :
    η ∈ H.support.genericPoints
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : η ∈ (Zminus1 I 1 H).support := by
    have hη' : η ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).support := by
      rw [support_vanishingIdeal_eq]
      exact subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton η)
    exact IdealSheafData.support_antitone hle hη'
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_support_Zminus1] at hmem
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hord, hsp⟩ := hmem
  have hξI : ξ ∈ I.support := by
    rw [Nat.cast_one] at hord
    exact (IdealSheafData.one_le_ord_iff I ξ).mp hord
  rw [← hη.2 hξI hsp]
  exact hξ

name: Hironaka.Resolution.monomialOf_add
statement:
theorem monomialOf_add {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → R) (a b : Fin n → ℕ) :
    monomialOf z (a + b) = monomialOf z a * monomialOf z b
proof:
:= by
  unfold monomialOf
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [Pi.add_apply, pow_add]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_stalkIdeal_monomial_eq_prod
statement:
theorem exists_stalkIdeal_monomial_eq_prod [NoetherianSpace X] (E : DivisorFamily X)
    (hE : E.IsSnc) (a : X → ℕ) (x : X) :
    ∃ b : E.ι → ℕ, (E.monomial a).stalkIdeal x = ∏ i, ((E.component i).stalkIdeal x) ^ b i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun i => if h : x ∈ (E.component i).support then
    a (Classical.choose (Hironaka.BMO.exists_genericPoint_specializes _ h)) else 0, ?_⟩
  rw [Hironaka.BMO.stalkIdeal_monomial E (Hironaka.BMO.Snc.genericPoints_component_finite E) a x]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hx : x ∈ (E.component i).support
  · dsimp only
    rw [dite_eq_left hx]
    exact Hironaka.BMO.Snc.finprod_stalk_eq_of_specializes E hE
      (Classical.choose_spec (Hironaka.BMO.exists_genericPoint_specializes _ hx)).1
      (Classical.choose_spec (Hironaka.BMO.exists_genericPoint_specializes _ hx)).2 a
  · dsimp only
    rw [dite_eq_right hx, pow_zero]
    exact Hironaka.BMO.Snc.finprod_stalk_eq_one_of_notMem E hx a

name: Hironaka.Resolution.support_monomial_le
statement:
theorem support_monomial_le [NoetherianSpace X] (E : DivisorFamily X) (a : X → ℕ) :
    (E.monomial a).support ≤ E.support
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hxE
  have hnot : ∀ i, x ∉ (E.component i).support := fun i hi =>
    hxE ((DivisorFamily.mem_support_iff_exists E x).mpr ⟨i, hi⟩)
  have htop : (E.monomial a).stalkIdeal x = ⊤ := by
    rw [Hironaka.BMO.stalkIdeal_monomial E (Hironaka.BMO.Snc.genericPoints_component_finite E) a x]
    exact (Finset.prod_eq_one fun i _ =>
      Hironaka.BMO.Snc.finprod_stalk_eq_one_of_notMem E (hnot i) a).trans one_eq_top
  have hle := (mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal _ x).mp hx
  rw [htop] at hle
  exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hle)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChainCoords.prod_pow_stalkIdeal_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨-, -, hc, -, -, -, -⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun k => ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter
    (fun j : {j : E.ι // p ∈ (E.component j).support} => c j = k), b j.1, fun k hk => ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra hkc
    exact hk (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j hj => absurd ⟨j, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2⟩ hkc)
  
  have hsub : ∏ j, ((E.component j).stalkIdeal p) ^ b j =
      ∏ j : {j : E.ι // p ∈ (E.component j).support}, ((E.component j.1).stalkIdeal p) ^ b j.1 := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_subtype (Finset.univ.filter fun j : E.ι => p ∈ (E.component j).support)
      (fun j => by simp) (fun j => ((E.component j).stalkIdeal p) ^ b j)]
    refine (Finset.prod_filter_of_ne fun j _ hj => ?_).symm
    by_contra hjp
    exact hj (by rw [stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support _ hjp, top_pow]; exact one_eq_top.symm)
  
  have hcoord : ∀ j : {j : E.ι // p ∈ (E.component j).support},
      ((E.component j.1).stalkIdeal p) ^ b j.1 = span {z (c j) ^ b j.1} := fun j => by
    rw [hc j, span_singleton_pow]
  rw [hsub, Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => hcoord j, prod_span_singleton]
  congr 2
  
  unfold monomialOf
  rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise Finset.univ c fun j => z (c j) ^ b j.1]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j hj => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.chainRelativeAt_mul_monomial
statement:
theorem chainRelativeAt_mul_monomial [NoetherianSpace X] {E : DivisorFamily X} (hE : E.IsSnc)
    {N Γ : X.IdealSheafData} {p : X} (h : ChainRelativeAt E N Γ p) (a : X → ℕ) :
    ChainRelativeAt E (N * E.monomial a) Γ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, z, c, r, σ, a₀, b₀, hcoords, hb₀, hN⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_stalkIdeal_monomial_eq_prod E hE a p
  obtain ⟨b', hb', hprod⟩ := hcoords.prod_pow_stalkIdeal_eq_span b
  refine ⟨n, z, c, r, σ, a₀, b₀ + b', hcoords, fun k hk => ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_cases h0 : b₀ k = 0
    · exact hb' k (by simpa [h0] using hk)
    · exact hb₀ k h0
  · rw [stalkIdeal_mul, hN, hb, hprod, mul_right_comm, span_singleton_mul_span_singleton,
      ← monomialOf_add]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial
statement:
theorem exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial [IsNoetherian X] (E : DivisorFamily X) (hE : E.IsSnc)
    (D : X.IdealSheafData) [Smooth (D.subschemeι ≫ f)] (hD : E.HasSncWith D) (a : X → ℕ) :
    ∃ a' : D.blowUp → ℕ,
      (E.monomial a).comap D.blowUpπ = (E.totalTransform D).monomial a'
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : Smooth (D.blowUpπ ≫ f) := smooth_blowUpπ_comp_of_smooth' f D
  have hE' : (E.totalTransform D).IsSnc :=
    totalTransform_isSnc f E D hE hD
  have hB : IsNoetherian D.blowUp := blowUp.isNoetherian D
  have hinv : ((E.monomial a).comap D.blowUpπ).IsInvertible :=
    blowUp.isInvertible_comap_of_isInvertible D _
      (Hironaka.BMO.Snc.isInvertible_monomial f E hE a)
  have hsupp : ((E.monomial a).comap D.blowUpπ).support ≤
      (E.totalTransform D).support := by
    intro b hb
    rw [support_comap] at hb
    have hbE : D.blowUpπ b ∈ E.support := support_monomial_le E a hb
    obtain ⟨i, hbi⟩ := (DivisorFamily.mem_support_iff_exists E _).mp hbE
    by_cases hF : b ∈ D.exceptionalDivisor.support
    · exact le_iSup (fun j => ((E.totalTransform D).component j).support)
        (toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) hF
    · refine (DivisorFamily.mem_support_iff_exists _ b).mpr ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i), ?_⟩
      have hbi' : b ∈ ((E.component i).comap D.blowUpπ).support := by
        rw [support_comap]
        exact hbi
      change b ∈ (((E.component i).comap D.blowUpπ).saturate
          D.exceptionalDivisor).support
      rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_support_saturate]
      exact subset_closure ⟨hbi', hF⟩
  exact ⟨fun η => (((E.monomial a).comap D.blowUpπ).ord η).toNat,
    (Hironaka.BMO.Snc.eq_monomialPart_of_isInvertible_of_support_le
        (D.blowUpπ ≫ f) _ hE' hinv
      hsupp).trans (Hironaka.BMO.monomialPart_eq_monomial _ _)⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_stageMap_mk
statement:
theorem exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_stageMap_mk (hA : IsNoetherian X) (S : BlowUpSequence X)
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (hsm : S.IsSmooth f) (hE : E.IsSnc)
    (hsnc : ∀ i : Fin S.length, (S.totalTransformSeq E i.castSucc).HasSncWith (S.center i))
    (a : X → ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < S.length + 1) :
    ∃ a' : S.stage ⟨j, hj⟩ → ℕ,
      (E.monomial a).comap (S.stageMap ⟨j, hj⟩) = (S.totalTransformSeq E ⟨j, hj⟩).monomial a'
proof:
:= by
  induction S generalizing j with
  | nil X => exact ⟨a, comap_id _⟩
  | cons X D rest ih =>
    cases j with
    | zero => exact ⟨a, comap_id _⟩
    | succ j =>
      obtain ⟨hD, hsm'⟩ := (isSmooth_cons_iff f D rest).1 hsm
      have hπ : Smooth (D.blowUpπ ≫ f) := smooth_blowUpπ_comp_of_smooth' f D
      have hB : IsNoetherian D.blowUp := blowUp.isNoetherian D
      obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ :=
        exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial f E hE D (hsnc ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩) a
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := ih (D.blowUpπ ≫ f) hB (E.totalTransform D) hsm'
        (totalTransform_isSnc f E D hE
          (hsnc ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩))
        (fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => hsnc ⟨i + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hi⟩) a₁ j (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj)
      refine ⟨a', ?_⟩
      change (E.monomial a).comap (rest.stageMap ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ ≫ D.blowUpπ) =
        (rest.totalTransformSeq (E.totalTransform D) ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩).monomial a'
      rw [comap_comp, ha₁]
      exact ha'

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_stageMap
statement:
theorem exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_stageMap [IsNoetherian X] (S : BlowUpSequence X)
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (hsm : S.IsSmooth f) (hE : E.IsSnc)
    (hsnc : ∀ i : Fin S.length, (S.totalTransformSeq E i.castSucc).HasSncWith (S.center i))
    (a : X → ℕ) (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) :
    ∃ a' : S.stage i → ℕ,
      (E.monomial a).comap (S.stageMap i) = (S.totalTransformSeq E i).monomial a'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := i
  exact exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_stageMap_mk f inferInstance S E hsm hE hsnc a j hj

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_of_isOrderGeSeq
statement:
theorem exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_of_isOrderGeSeq [IsNoetherian X] {S : BlowUpSequence X}
    {N : X.IdealSheafData} {m : ℕ} {E : DivisorFamily X} (hS : S.IsOrderGeSeq f N m E)
    (hE : E.IsSnc) (a : X → ℕ) (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) :
    ∃ a' : S.stage i → ℕ,
      (E.monomial a).comap (S.stageMap i) = (S.totalTransformSeq E i).monomial a'
proof:
:=
  exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_stageMap f S E hS.1 hE (fun i => (hS.2 i).1) a i

name: Hironaka.Resolution.chainRelativeAt_markedTransformSeq_mul_monomial
statement:
theorem chainRelativeAt_markedTransformSeq_mul_monomial [IsNoetherian X] (n : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] {S : BlowUpSequence X} {N : X.IdealSheafData} {m : ℕ}
    {E : DivisorFamily X} (hS : S.IsOrderGeSeq f N m E) (hE : E.IsSnc) (a : X → ℕ)
    (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) {Γ : (S.stage i).IdealSheafData} {p : S.stage i}
    (h : ChainRelativeAt (S.totalTransformSeq E i) (S.markedTransformSeq N m i) Γ p) :
    ChainRelativeAt (S.totalTransformSeq E i) (S.markedTransformSeq (N * E.monomial a) m i)
      Γ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := exists_comap_monomial_eq_monomial_of_isOrderGeSeq f hS hE a i
  have hNoeth : IsNoetherian (S.stage i) := isNoetherian_stage S i
  have hsm : Smooth (S.stageMap i ≫ f) := IsSmooth.smooth_stageMap' hS.1 i
  rw [Hironaka.Sequence.markedTransformSeq_mul_comap S N _ m
    (Hironaka.Sequence.exceptionalAt_pow_dvd_comap_step_of_isOrderGeSeq f n S N m E hS) i, ha']
  exact chainRelativeAt_mul_monomial (IsOrderGeSeq.isSnc_totalTransformSeq f n hS hE i) h a'

name: Hironaka.Resolution.find_lt_length
statement:
theorem find_lt_length (T : MarkedTriple k) (hm : T.m = 1) (C : Finset T.X.left.IdealSheafData)
    (h : ∃ n, HasAbsorptionAt T hm C n) : Nat.find h < (bmoOneRun T hm).length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hcc⟩ := Nat.find_spec h
  exact hcc.1

name: Hironaka.Resolution.not_centerContains_of_lt_find
statement:
theorem not_centerContains_of_lt_find (T : MarkedTriple k) (hm : T.m = 1)
    (C : Finset T.X.left.IdealSheafData) (h : ∃ n, HasAbsorptionAt T hm C n)
    {c : T.X.left.IdealSheafData}
    (hc : c ∈ C) {m : ℕ} (hm' : m < Nat.find h) : ¬ CenterContains (bmoOneRun T hm) c m
proof:
:=
  fun hcc => Nat.find_min h hm' ⟨c, hc, hcc⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.find_le_firstCenterIndex
statement:
theorem find_le_firstCenterIndex (T : MarkedTriple k) (hm : T.m = 1)
    (C : Finset T.X.left.IdealSheafData) (h : ∃ n, HasAbsorptionAt T hm C n)
    {c : T.X.left.IdealSheafData}
    (hc : c ∈ C) : Nat.find h ≤ firstCenterIndex (bmoOneRun T hm) c
proof:
:=
  le_firstCenterIndex_of_forall_lt_not (bmoOneRun T hm) c (find_lt_length T hm C h).le
    fun _ hm' => not_centerContains_of_lt_find T hm C h hc hm'

name: Hironaka.Resolution.markedTransformSeq_bmoOneRun_last_eq_top
statement:
theorem markedTransformSeq_bmoOneRun_last_eq_top (T : MarkedTriple k) (hm : T.m = 1) :
    (bmoOneRun T hm).markedTransformSeq T.I 1 (Fin.last _) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, m⟩ := T
  have h1 : m = 1 := hm
  subst h1
  have hlt := dimFreeBMO_maxOrd_lt stage0 1 (⟨T, 1⟩ : MarkedTriple k) ⟨le_rfl, hm⟩
  by_contra hne
  have hge := one_le_maxOrd_of_ne_top _ hne
  rw [Nat.cast_one] at hge hlt
  exact (not_le.mpr hlt) hge

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_centerContains_bmoOneRun_of_invCE
statement:
theorem exists_centerContains_bmoOneRun_of_invCE (T : MarkedTriple k) (hm : T.m = 1)
    {C : Finset T.X.left.IdealSheafData} (hinv : InvCE T.I T.E C)
    {c : T.X.left.IdealSheafData} (hc : c ∈ C)
    [IsIntegral c.subscheme] : ∃ n, CenterContains (bmoOneRun T hm) c n
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian T.X.left := (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)).isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
  obtain ⟨η, hη, rfl, -, hIc⟩ := hinv.mem c hc
  exact exists_centerContains_of_markedTransformSeq_last_eq_top (bmoOneRun T hm) T.I _ 1
    (Hironaka.BMO.isGenericPoint_support_vanishingIdeal_closure η) hη hIc
    (markedTransformSeq_bmoOneRun_last_eq_top T hm)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.le_firstCenterIndex_of_forall_lt_not
statement:
theorem le_firstCenterIndex_of_forall_lt_not (S : BlowUpSequence A) (I : A.IdealSheafData) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ≤ S.length) (h : ∀ m < n, ¬ CenterContains S I m) : n ≤ firstCenterIndex S I
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hex : ∃ m, CenterContains S I m
  · by_contra hlt
    exact h _ (not_le.mp hlt) (firstCenterIndex_of_exists hex)
  · unfold firstCenterIndex
    rw [dite_eq_right hex]
    exact hn

name: Hironaka.Resolution.stageMapBetween_notMem_center_support_of_le_firstCenterIndex
statement:
theorem stageMapBetween_notMem_center_support_of_le_firstCenterIndex [IsLocallyNoetherian A]
    (S : BlowUpSequence A) (I : A.IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral I.subscheme] {η : A}
    (hη : IsGenericPoint η (I.support : Set A)) (i : Fin (S.length + 1))
    (hi : i.val ≤ firstCenterIndex S I) {y : S.stage i} (hy : S.stageMap i y = η)
    (m : Fin S.length) (hmi : m.val < i.val) :
    S.stageMapBetween i m.castSucc (Nat.le_of_lt hmi) y ∉ (S.center m).support
proof:
:=
  notMem_center_support_of_stageMap_eq_of_lt_firstCenterIndex S I hη m (lt_of_lt_of_le hmi hi) _
    (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, stageMapBetween_comp_stageMap]; exact hy)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.stalkIdeal_markedTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem_mk
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_markedTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem_mk :
    ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} (S : BlowUpSequence X) (J : X.IdealSheafData) (c j : ℕ)
      (hj : j < S.length + 1) (p : S.stage ⟨j, hj⟩),
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < S.length) (hmj : m < j),
        S.stageMapBetween ⟨j, hj⟩ ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hm⟩ (Nat.le_of_lt hmj) p ∉
          (S.center ⟨m, hm⟩).support) →
      (S.markedTransformSeq J c ⟨j, hj⟩).stalkIdeal p =
        (J.stalkIdeal (S.stageMap ⟨j, hj⟩ p)).map ((S.stageMap ⟨j, hj⟩).stalkMap p).hom
  | _, nil Y, J, c, j, hj, p, _ => by
    obtain rfl : j = 0
proof:
:= Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hj
    exact (stalkIdeal_map_stalkMap_id J p).symm
  | _, cons Y D rest, J, c, 0, hj, p, _ => (stalkIdeal_map_stalkMap_id J p).symm
  | _, cons Y D rest, J, c, j + 1, hj, p, h => by
    revert p h
    change ∀ (p : rest.stage ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩),
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < rest.length + 1) (hmj : m < j + 1),
        (cons Y D rest).stageMapBetween ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hm⟩ (Nat.le_of_lt hmj) p ∉
          ((cons Y D rest).center ⟨m, hm⟩).support) →
      (rest.markedTransformSeq (J.markedTransform D c) c ⟨j, _⟩).stalkIdeal p =
        (J.stalkIdeal (D.blowUpπ (rest.stageMap ⟨j, _⟩ p))).map
          ((rest.stageMap ⟨j, _⟩ ≫ D.blowUpπ).stalkMap p).hom
    intro p h
    have h0 : D.blowUpπ (rest.stageMap ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ p) ∉ D.support :=
      h 0 (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.succ_pos _)
    have hy : rest.stageMap ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ p ∉
        (D.comap D.blowUpπ).support := by
      rw [mem_support_comap_iff_apply]
      exact h0
    have h' : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < rest.length) (hmj : m < j),
        rest.stageMapBetween ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩ ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hm⟩
          (Nat.le_of_lt hmj) p ∉ (rest.center ⟨m, hm⟩).support :=
      fun m hm hmj => h (m + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hm) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hmj)
    rw [stalkIdeal_markedTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem_mk rest (J.markedTransform D c) c j
      (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj) p h', stalkIdeal_markedTransform_of_notMem D J c hy,
      Ideal.map_map, Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
    rfl

name: Hironaka.Resolution.stalkIdeal_markedTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_markedTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem (S : BlowUpSequence A)
    (J : A.IdealSheafData) (c : ℕ) (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) (p : S.stage i)
    (h : ∀ (m : Fin S.length) (hmi : m.val < i.val),
      S.stageMapBetween i m.castSucc (Nat.le_of_lt hmi) p ∉ (S.center m).support) :
    (S.markedTransformSeq J c i).stalkIdeal p =
      (J.stalkIdeal (S.stageMap i p)).map ((S.stageMap i).stalkMap p).hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := i
  exact stalkIdeal_markedTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem_mk S J c j hj p fun m hm hmj => h ⟨m, hm⟩ hmj

name: Hironaka.Resolution.notMem_component_support_of_notMem_support
statement:
theorem notMem_component_support_of_notMem_support {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : DivisorFamily X) {p : X}
    (hp : p ∉ F.support) (l : F.ι) : p ∉ (F.component l).support
proof:
:=
  fun hl => hp (le_iSup (fun i => (F.component i).support) l hl)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.notMem_support_totalTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem
statement:
theorem notMem_support_totalTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem [IsLocallyNoetherian A]
    (S : BlowUpSequence A) (E : DivisorFamily A) (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) (p : S.stage i)
    (h : ∀ (m : Fin S.length) (hmi : m.val < i.val),
      S.stageMapBetween i m.castSucc (Nat.le_of_lt hmi) p ∉ (S.center m).support)
    (hE : S.stageMap i p ∉ E.support) : p ∉ (S.totalTransformSeq E i).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_support_totalTransformSeq_iff]
  rintro (hp | ⟨m, hmi, hp⟩)
  · exact hE hp
  · exact h m hmi hp

name: Hironaka.Resolution.mem_genericPoints_markedTransformSeq_support_of_forall_notMem
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_markedTransformSeq_support_of_forall_notMem (S : BlowUpSequence A)
    (I J : A.IdealSheafData) (c : ℕ) {η : A} (hη : IsGenericPoint η (J.support : Set A))
    (hηI : η ∈ I.support.genericPoints) (hIJ : I.stalkIdeal η = J.stalkIdeal η)
    (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) {η' : S.stage i} (hη' : S.stageMap i η' = η)
    (huniq : ∀ y, S.stageMap i y = η → y = η')
    (h : ∀ (m : Fin S.length) (hmi : m.val < i.val),
      S.stageMapBetween i m.castSucc (Nat.le_of_lt hmi) η' ∉ (S.center m).support) :
    η' ∈ (S.markedTransformSeq I c i).support.genericPoints
proof:
:= by
  have hiso : IsIso ((S.stageMap i).stalkMap η') :=
    isIso_stalkMap_stageMap_of_forall_notMem S i η' h
  have hIJ' : I.stalkIdeal (S.stageMap i η') = J.stalkIdeal (S.stageMap i η') := by
    rw [hη']
    exact hIJ
  have hstalk : (S.markedTransformSeq I c i).stalkIdeal η' =
      (J.stalkIdeal (S.stageMap i η')).map ((S.stageMap i).stalkMap η').hom := by
    rw [stalkIdeal_markedTransformSeq_of_forall_notMem S I c i η' h, hIJ']
  have hJ : J.stalkIdeal (S.stageMap i η') ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [hη']
    intro hJtop
    have := (mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal J η).mp hη.mem
    rw [hJtop] at this
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top (top_le_iff.mp this)
  refine ⟨?_, fun ζ hζ hspec => ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal]
    apply IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal
    rw [hstalk]
    intro htop
    apply hJ
    have hbij : Function.Bijective ((S.stageMap i).stalkMap η').hom :=
      (asIso ((S.stageMap i).stalkMap η')).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.bijective
    have hc := congrArg (Ideal.comap ((S.stageMap i).stalkMap η').hom) htop
    rwa [Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij, Ideal.comap_top] at hc
  · 
    have hζI : S.stageMap i ζ ∈ I.support := by
      have hle : (S.markedTransformSeq I c i).support ≤ (I.comap (S.stageMap i)).support :=
        support_antitone (comap_stageMap_le_markedTransformSeq S I c i)
      exact (mem_support_comap_iff_apply I (S.stageMap i) ζ).mp (hle hζ)
    have hsp : S.stageMap i ζ ⤳ η := by
      rw [← hη']
      exact hspec.map (S.stageMap i).continuous
    exact huniq ζ (hηI.2 hζI hsp)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_isGenericPoint_strictTransformSeq_and_isIso_of_le_firstCenterIndex
statement:
theorem exists_isGenericPoint_strictTransformSeq_and_isIso_of_le_firstCenterIndex
    [IsLocallyNoetherian A] (S : BlowUpSequence A) (J : A.IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral J.subscheme]
    {η : A} (hη : IsGenericPoint η (J.support : Set A)) (i : Fin (S.length + 1))
    (hi : i.val ≤ firstCenterIndex S J) :
    ∃ η' : S.stage i, IsGenericPoint η' ((S.strictTransformSeq J i).support : Set (S.stage i)) ∧
      S.stageMap i η' = η ∧ (∀ y, S.stageMap i y = η → y = η') ∧
      (∀ (m : Fin S.length) (hmi : m.val < i.val),
        S.stageMapBetween i m.castSucc (Nat.le_of_lt hmi) η' ∉ (S.center m).support) ∧
      IsIso ((S.stageMap i).stalkMap η')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η', hgen, hmap, huniq⟩ :=
    exists_isGenericPoint_strictTransformSeq_of_le_firstCenterIndex S J hη i hi
  have havoid : ∀ (m : Fin S.length) (hmi : m.val < i.val),
      S.stageMapBetween i m.castSucc (Nat.le_of_lt hmi) η' ∉ (S.center m).support :=
    fun m hmi => stageMapBetween_notMem_center_support_of_le_firstCenterIndex S J hη i hi hmap m hmi
  exact ⟨η', hgen, hmap, huniq, havoid, isIso_stalkMap_stageMap_of_forall_notMem S i η' havoid⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_pivot_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem exists_pivot_of_mem_support [IsRegularLocalRing ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)]
    {n : ℕ}
    {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)} (C : Finset (Fin n))
    (hZC : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = span (z '' ↑C)) :
    ∃ c₀ ∈ C, (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal q = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z c₀)} ∧
      (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z c₀) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he, hFe⟩ := IsInvertible.exists_mem_nonZeroDivisors_stalkIdeal_eq_span
    (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π Z) q
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero he
  have hF : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal q =
      span (Set.range fun c : (↑C : Set (Fin n)) => (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z c)) := by
    rw [stalkIdeal_comap, hZC, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_image, Set.image_eq_range]
  have : Finite (↑C : Set (Fin n)) := C.finite_toSet.to_subtype
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_span_singleton_eq_of_span_range_eq
    (fun c : (↑C : Set (Fin n)) => (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z c)) he0 (hF.symm.trans hFe)
  refine ⟨c.1, c.2, hFe.trans hc.symm, fun h0 => he0 ?_⟩
  rw [h0, span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr rfl, eq_comm, span_singleton_eq_bot] at hc
  exact hc

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_inducedCoords
statement:
theorem exists_inducedCoords {n : ℕ} {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)}
    (hz : IsRegularSystemOfParameters z) (C : Finset (Fin n))
    (hZC : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = span (z '' ↑C)) {c₀ : Fin n} (hc₀ : c₀ ∈ C)
    (hF : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal q = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z c₀)})
    (hne : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z c₀) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : Fin n → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q,
      (∀ i, i ∉ C ∨ i = c₀ → w i = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z i)) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ C, i ≠ c₀ →
        (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z i) = w i * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z c₀)) ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (z' : Fin m → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q), IsRegularSystemOfParameters z' ∧
        ∃ τ : {i : Fin n // w i ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)} → Fin m,
          Function.Injective τ ∧ ∀ i, z' (τ i) = w i.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσc⟩ := exists_equiv_image_eq C hc₀
  set kk := C.card with hkk
  have hk : 1 ≤ kk := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩
  have hkn : kk ≤ n := by
    have := Finset.card_le_univ C
    rwa [Fintype.card_fin] at this
  
  set ρ : Fin n ≃ Fin n := Fin.revPerm.trans σ with hρ
  have hρapp : ∀ i, ρ i = σ (Fin.rev i) := fun i => rfl
  have hρmem : ∀ i : Fin n, ρ i ∈ C ↔ n - kk ≤ i.val := by
    intro i
    rw [hρapp, hσ, Fin.val_rev]
    have := i.2
    omega
  have hjlt : n - kk < n := by omega
  set j : Fin n := ⟨n - kk, hjlt⟩ with hj
  have hρj : ρ j = c₀ := by
    have h1 : kk - 1 < n := by omega
    have hrev : Fin.rev j = ⟨kk - 1, h1⟩ := Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.val_rev, hj]; simp; omega)
    rw [hρapp, hrev]
    exact hσc h1
  set zR : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q) := z ∘ ρ with hzR
  have hzRrs : span (Set.range zR) = maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) ∧
      (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, hz.2⟩
    rw [hzR, ρ.surjective.range_comp]
    exact hz.1
  have himg : ρ '' {i : Fin n | n - kk ≤ i.val} = ↑C := by
    ext c
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact (hρmem i).mpr hi
    · intro hc
      refine ⟨ρ.symm c, ?_, ρ.apply_symm_apply c⟩
      change n - kk ≤ (ρ.symm c).val
      rw [← hρmem, ρ.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hc
  have hZzR : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = span (zR '' {i : Fin n | n - kk ≤ i.val}) := by
    rw [hZC, hzR, Set.image_comp, himg]
  have hjv : n - kk ≤ j.val := le_rfl
  have hzRj : zR j = z c₀ := by rw [hzR, Function.comp_apply, hρj]
  have hF' : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal q = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR j)} := by
    rw [hzRj]
    exact hF
  have hne' : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR j) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hzRj]
    exact hne
  
  have hex : ∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → i ≠ j → ∃ y : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q,
      (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR i) = y * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR j) := by
    intro i hi _
    have hmem : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR i) ∈ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal q := by
      rw [stalkIdeal_comap, hZzR]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    rw [hF'] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
    exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩
  choose! yy hyy using hex
  set wR : Fin n → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q := fun i =>
    if i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j then (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR i) else yy i with hwR
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j → wR i = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR i) :=
    fun i hi => ite_eq_left hi
  have hw' : ∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → i ≠ j →
      (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR i) = wR i * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (zR j) := by
    intro i h1 h2
    have : wR i = yy i := ite_eq_right fun h => h.elim (fun h => by omega) h2
    rw [this]
    exact hyy i h1 h2
  obtain ⟨m, z', hz', τ', hτ'inj, hτ'⟩ :=
    exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_induced f Z q hk hkn hzRrs hZzR hjv hF' hne' wR hw hw'
  
  have hzRsymm : ∀ i, zR (ρ.symm i) = z i := fun i => by
    rw [hzR, Function.comp_apply, ρ.apply_symm_apply]
  have hρsymm_j : ρ.symm c₀ = j := by
    rw [← hρj, ρ.symm_apply_apply]
  refine ⟨fun i => wR (ρ.symm i), ?_, ?_, m, z', hz', fun i => τ' ⟨ρ.symm i.1, i.2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    change wR (ρ.symm i) = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z i)
    rcases hi with hi | hi
    · have hlt : (ρ.symm i).val < n - kk := by
        have h1 : ¬ n - kk ≤ (ρ.symm i).val := by
          rw [← hρmem, ρ.apply_symm_apply]
          exact hi
        omega
      rw [hw _ (Or.inl hlt), hzRsymm]
    · rw [hi, hw _ (Or.inr hρsymm_j), hzRsymm]
  · intro i hi hne
    change (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z i) = wR (ρ.symm i) * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z c₀)
    have h1 : n - kk ≤ (ρ.symm i).val := by
      rw [← hρmem, ρ.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hi
    have h2 : ρ.symm i ≠ j := fun h => hne (by rw [← ρ.apply_symm_apply i, h, hρj])
    have := hw' _ h1 h2
    rwa [hzRsymm, hzRj] at this
  · intro i₁ i₂ h
    have := hτ'inj h
    exact Subtype.ext (ρ.symm.injective (Subtype.mk.inj this))
  · intro i
    exact hτ' ⟨ρ.symm i.1, i.2⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.nonempty_chartAt
statement:
theorem nonempty_chartAt [IsRegularLocalRing ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)] {n : ℕ}
    {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)} (hz : IsRegularSystemOfParameters z)
    (C : Finset (Fin n)) (hZC : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = span (z '' ↑C)) :
    Nonempty (ChartAt Z q z C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, hF, hne⟩ := exists_pivot_of_mem_support Z q C hZC
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hw', m, z', hz', τ, hτinj, hτ⟩ :=
    exists_inducedCoords f Z q hz C hZC hc₀ hF hne
  exact ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀, hF, hne, w, hw, hw', m, z', hz', τ, hτinj, hτ⟩⟩

theorem strictTransform_eq_strictTransformAlong (Y : X.IdealSheafData) :

theorem totalTransform_component_toLex_inr (u : PUnit.{u + 1}) :

name: Hironaka.Resolution.eq_toLex_inl_or_inr
statement:
theorem eq_toLex_inl_or_inr (j' : (E.totalTransform Z).ι) :
    (∃ j : E.ι, j' = toLex (Sum.inl j)) ∨ ∃ u : PUnit.{u + 1}, j' = toLex (Sum.inr u)
proof:

  | Sum.inr u => exact Or.inr ⟨u, by rw [← h]; rfl⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.ε_def
statement: theorem ε_def : D.ε = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z D.c₀)
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.w_c₀
statement: theorem w_c₀ : D.w D.c₀ = D.ε
proof: := D.hw D.c₀ (Or.inr rfl)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.hF_ε
statement: theorem hF_ε : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal q = span {D.ε}
proof: := D.hF

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.ε_ne_zero
statement: theorem ε_ne_zero : D.ε ≠ 0
proof: := D.ε_ne

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.ε_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem ε_mem_maximalIdeal (hq : q ∈ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).support) :
    D.ε ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)
proof:
:=
  (mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal (I := Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) (x := q)).mp hq
    (D.hF_ε ▸ mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkMap_eq
statement:
theorem stalkMap_eq (i : Fin n) :
    (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z i) = D.wHat i * if i ∈ C then D.ε else 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : i = D.c₀
  · subst hi
    rw [wHat, Function.update_self, ite_eq_left D.mem, one_mul, ε_def]
  · rw [wHat, Function.update_of_ne hi]
    by_cases hiC : i ∈ C
    · rw [ite_eq_left hiC, ε_def]
      exact D.hw' i hiC hi
    · rw [ite_eq_right hiC, mul_one]
      exact (D.hw i (Or.inl hiC)).symm

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkMap_monomialOf
statement:
theorem stalkMap_monomialOf (a : Fin n → ℕ) :
    (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (monomialOf z a) =
      D.ε ^ (∑ i ∈ C, a i) * monomialOf D.wHat a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [monomialOf_map]
  have : ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom ∘ z =
      fun i => D.wHat i * if i ∈ C then D.ε else 1 := funext fun i => D.stalkMap_eq i
  rw [this, monomialOf_mul, monomialOf_ite_mem, mul_comm]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkMap_eq_pow
statement:
theorem stalkMap_eq_pow (i : Fin n) :
    (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (z i) = D.ε ^ (if i ∈ C then 1 else 0) * D.wHat i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [D.stalkMap_eq i, mul_comm]
  congr 1
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.wHat_of_ne
statement: theorem wHat_of_ne {i : Fin n} (hi : i ≠ D.c₀) : D.wHat i = D.w i
proof:
:=
  Function.update_of_ne hi _ _

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.isUnit_w_of_notMem
proof:
:=
  IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hi

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.w_mem_maximalIdeal_of_notMem
statement:
theorem w_mem_maximalIdeal_of_notMem {i : Fin n} (hi : i ∉ C)
    (hz : z i ∈ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q))) :
    D.w i ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)
proof:
:= by

  exact stalkMap_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem Z q hz

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq (Y : X.IdealSheafData) :
    (Y.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).stalkIdeal q =
      ⨆ i : ℕ, ((Y.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q)).map ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom).colon
        ((span {D.ε} ^ i : Ideal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)) :
          Set ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [strictTransformAlong, stalkIdeal_saturate_of_isInvertible _ (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π Z),
    stalkIdeal_comap, D.hF_ε]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_top_of_mem
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_top_of_mem (Y : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hY : z D.c₀ ∈ Y.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q)) :
    (Y.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).stalkIdeal q = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [strictTransformAlong, stalkIdeal_saturate_of_isInvertible _ (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π Z),
    stalkIdeal_comap, D.hF_ε]
  exact iSup_colon_pow_eq_top_of_pow_mem (t := 1)
    (by rw [pow_one, ChartAt.ε_def]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hY)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.w_σ_mem_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem w_σ_mem_of_mem_support {r : ℕ} (σ : Fin r → Fin n) (hσc₀ : ∀ i, σ i ≠ D.c₀)
    (Y : X.IdealSheafData) (hY : Y.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = span (Set.range (z ∘ σ)))
    (hqY : q ∈ (Y.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).support) :
    ∀ i, D.w (σ i) ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsat := D.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq Y
  
  set J := (Y.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q)).map ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom with hJ
  have hJgen : J = span (Set.range fun i => D.ε ^ (if σ i ∈ C then 1 else 0) * D.w (σ i)) := by
    rw [hJ, hY, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    congr 1
    refine congrArg Set.range (funext fun i => ?_)
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, D.stalkMap_eq_pow, D.wHat_of_ne (hσc₀ i)]
  have hgen : ∀ i, D.w (σ i) * D.ε ∈ J := by
    intro i
    rw [hJgen]
    by_cases hi : σ i ∈ C
    · rw [mul_comm]
      exact subset_span ⟨i, by simp [hi]⟩
    · exact mul_mem_right _ _ (subset_span ⟨i, by simp [hi]⟩)
  
  have hle : ∀ i, D.w (σ i) ∈
      (Y.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).stalkIdeal q := by
    intro i
    rw [hsat]
    refine le_iSup (fun i : ℕ => J.colon ((span {D.ε} ^ i : Ideal _) : Set _)) 1 ?_
    rw [pow_one, Submodule.mem_colon_span_singleton, smul_eq_mul]
    exact hgen i
  exact fun i => (mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal (I := _) (x := q)).mp hqY (hle i)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_range_of_mem
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_range_of_mem
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)]
        (hq : q ∈ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).support)
    {r : ℕ} (σ : Fin r → Fin n) (hσc₀ : ∀ i, σ i ≠ D.c₀) (Y : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hY : Y.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = span (Set.range (z ∘ σ)))
    (hmem : ∀ i, D.w (σ i) ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)) :
    (Y.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).stalkIdeal q =
      span (Set.range fun i => D.w (σ i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsat := D.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq Y
  set J := (Y.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q)).map ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom with hJ
  have hJgen : J = span (Set.range fun i => D.ε ^ (if σ i ∈ C then 1 else 0) * D.w (σ i)) := by
    rw [hJ, hY, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    congr 1
    refine congrArg Set.range (funext fun i => ?_)
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, D.stalkMap_eq_pow, D.wHat_of_ne (hσc₀ i)]
  set P := span (Set.range fun i => D.w (σ i)) with hP
  have hJP : J ≤ P := by
    rw [hJgen, span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact mul_mem_left _ _ (subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hPJ : ∀ x ∈ P, x * D.ε ^ 1 ∈ J := by
    intro x hx
    rw [pow_one]
    have hgen : ∀ i, D.w (σ i) * D.ε ∈ J := by
      intro i
      rw [hJgen]
      by_cases hi : σ i ∈ C
      · rw [mul_comm]
        exact subset_span ⟨i, by simp [hi]⟩
      · exact mul_mem_right _ _ (subset_span ⟨i, by simp [hi]⟩)
    have : P ≤ J.colon (span {D.ε}) := by
      rw [hP, span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.mem_colon_span_singleton.mpr (by rw [smul_eq_mul]; exact hgen i)
    exact Submodule.mem_colon_span_singleton.mp (this hx)
  
  have hεmem := D.ε_mem_maximalIdeal hq
  have hPimg : P = span (D.z' '' ↑(Finset.univ.image fun i => D.τ ⟨σ i, hmem i⟩)) := by
    rw [hP, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, ← Set.range_comp]
    congr 1
    exact congrArg Set.range (funext fun i => (D.hτ ⟨σ i, hmem i⟩).symm)
  have hPprime : P.IsPrime := by
    rw [hPimg]
    exact isPrime_span_image_finset D.hz'.1.symm D.hz'.2 _
  have hεP : D.ε ∉ P := by
    rw [hPimg]
    have hεz : D.ε = D.z' (D.τ ⟨D.c₀, D.w_c₀ ▸ hεmem⟩) := by rw [D.hτ, D.w_c₀]
    rw [hεz]
    refine notMem_span_image_of_notMem D.hz'.1.symm D.hz'.2 fun h => ?_
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact hσc₀ i (Subtype.mk.inj (D.τ_injective hi))
  rw [hsat]
  exact iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_eq_of_isPrime hPprime hεP hJP hPJ

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_range
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_range
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)]
        (hq : q ∈ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).support)
    {r : ℕ} (σ : Fin r → Fin n) (hσc₀ : ∀ i, σ i ≠ D.c₀) (Y : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hY : Y.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = span (Set.range (z ∘ σ)))
    (hqY : q ∈ (Y.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).support) :
    (∀ i, D.w (σ i) ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)) ∧
      (Y.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).stalkIdeal q =
        span (Set.range fun i => D.w (σ i))
proof:
:=
  ⟨D.w_σ_mem_of_mem_support σ hσc₀ Y hY hqY,
    D.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_range_of_mem hq σ hσc₀ Y hY
      (D.w_σ_mem_of_mem_support σ hσc₀ Y hY hqY)⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkIdeal_controlledTransformAlong_one
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_controlledTransformAlong_one (K : X.IdealSheafData) :
    (K.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) 1).stalkIdeal q =
      ((K.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q)).map ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom).colon (span {D.ε})
proof:
:= by
  rw [controlledTransformAlong, pow_one,
    stalkIdeal_colon_of_isInvertible _ (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π Z), stalkIdeal_comap, D.hF_ε]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.map_span_mul_chainKIdeal
statement:
theorem map_span_mul_chainKIdeal {r : ℕ} (σ : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n) (a : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n → ℕ)
    (b : Fin n → ℕ) :
    (span {monomialOf z b} * chainKIdeal (z ∘ σ) fun i => monomialOf z (a i)).map
        ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom =
      span {D.ε ^ (∑ k ∈ C, b k) * monomialOf D.wHat b} *
        chainKIdeal (fun i => D.ε ^ (if σ i ∈ C then 1 else 0) * D.wHat (σ i))
          (fun i => D.ε ^ (∑ k ∈ C, a i k) * monomialOf D.wHat (a i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, ← chainKIdeal_comp,
    D.stalkMap_monomialOf]
  congr 2
  · funext i
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, D.stalkMap_eq_pow]
  · funext i
    rw [Function.comp_apply, D.stalkMap_monomialOf]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.map_span_mul_chainIdeal
statement:
theorem map_span_mul_chainIdeal {r : ℕ} (σ : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n) (a : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n → ℕ)
    (b : Fin n → ℕ) :
    (span {monomialOf z b} * chainIdeal (z ∘ σ) fun i => monomialOf z (a i)).map
        ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom =
      span {D.ε ^ (∑ k ∈ C, b k) * monomialOf D.wHat b} *
        chainIdeal (fun i => D.ε ^ (if σ i ∈ C then 1 else 0) * D.wHat (σ i))
          (fun i => D.ε ^ (∑ k ∈ C, a i k) * monomialOf D.wHat (a i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, ← chainIdeal_comp,
    D.stalkMap_monomialOf]
  congr 2
  · funext i
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, D.stalkMap_eq_pow]
  · funext i
    rw [Function.comp_apply, D.stalkMap_monomialOf]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkIdeal_controlledTransformAlong_chainKIdeal
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_controlledTransformAlong_chainKIdeal
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)] {r : ℕ} (σ : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n)
    (a : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n → ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hK : K.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) =
      span {monomialOf z b} * chainKIdeal (z ∘ σ) fun i => monomialOf z (a i))
    (δ : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = if σ i ∈ C then 1 else 0)
    (hpos : 1 ≤ epsOrderC C a b (Function.update δ (Fin.last r) 0) 0)
    (hmono : ∀ i : Fin r, epsOrderC C a b (Function.update δ (Fin.last r) 0) i.castSucc ≤
      epsOrderC C a b (Function.update δ (Fin.last r) 0) i.succ)
    (Dexp : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin r, Dexp i.castSucc =
      epsOrderC C a b (Function.update δ (Fin.last r) 0) i.succ -
        epsOrderC C a b (Function.update δ (Fin.last r) 0) i.castSucc) :
    (K.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) 1).stalkIdeal q =
      span
        {D.ε ^ (epsOrderC C a b (Function.update δ (Fin.last r) 0) 0 - 1) * monomialOf D.wHat b} *
        chainKIdeal (fun i => D.wHat (σ i)) (fun i => D.ε ^ Dexp i * monomialOf D.wHat (a i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [D.stalkIdeal_controlledTransformAlong_one, hK, D.map_span_mul_chainKIdeal]
  have hδ' : (fun i => D.ε ^ (if σ i ∈ C then 1 else 0) * D.wHat (σ i)) =
      fun i => D.ε ^ δ i * D.wHat (σ i) := funext fun i => by rw [hδ i]
  rw [hδ']
  exact colon_span_mul_chainKIdeal_pow D.ε_ne_zero _ _ δ _ _ _ hpos hmono Dexp hD

name: Hironaka.Resolution.ChartAt.stalkIdeal_controlledTransformAlong_chainIdeal
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_controlledTransformAlong_chainIdeal
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)] {r : ℕ} (σ : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n)
    (a : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n → ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hI : I.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) =
      span {monomialOf z b} * chainIdeal (z ∘ σ) fun i => monomialOf z (a i))
    (δ : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = if σ i ∈ C then 1 else 0)
    (hpos : 1 ≤ epsOrderC C a b δ 0)
    (hmono : ∀ i : Fin r, epsOrderC C a b δ i.castSucc ≤ epsOrderC C a b δ i.succ)
    (Dexp : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin r, Dexp i.castSucc =
      epsOrderC C a b δ i.succ - epsOrderC C a b δ i.castSucc) :
    (I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) 1).stalkIdeal q =
      span {D.ε ^ (epsOrderC C a b δ 0 - 1) * monomialOf D.wHat b} *
        chainIdeal (fun i => D.wHat (σ i)) (fun i => D.ε ^ Dexp i * monomialOf D.wHat (a i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [D.stalkIdeal_controlledTransformAlong_one, hI, D.map_span_mul_chainIdeal]
  have hδ' : (fun i => D.ε ^ (if σ i ∈ C then 1 else 0) * D.wHat (σ i)) =
      fun i => D.ε ^ δ i * D.wHat (σ i) := funext fun i => by rw [hδ i]
  rw [hδ']
  exact colon_span_mul_chainIdeal_pow D.ε_ne_zero _ _ δ _ _ _ hpos hmono Dexp hD

name: Hironaka.Resolution.monomialOf_cons_zero
statement:
theorem monomialOf_cons_zero {n : ℕ} (x : R) (l : Fin n → R) (b : Fin n → ℕ) :
    monomialOf (Fin.cons x l) (Fin.cons 0 b : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) = monomialOf l b
proof:
:= by
  simp [monomialOf, Fin.prod_univ_succ]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.monomialOf_map
statement:
theorem monomialOf_map {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) {n : ℕ} (l : Fin n → R)
    (b : Fin n → ℕ) : φ (monomialOf l b) = monomialOf (φ ∘ l) b
proof:
:= by
  simp [monomialOf, map_prod φ]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.comap_map_eq_of_ker_le
statement:
theorem comap_map_eq_of_ker_le {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) {K : Ideal R} (hK : RingHom.ker φ ≤ K) :
    (K.map φ).comap φ = K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective φ hφ, sup_eq_left]
  exact hK

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_chain_lift
statement:
theorem exists_chain_lift {R' : Type u} [IsRegularLocalRing R] [CommRing R']
    [IsRegularLocalRing R'] (φ : R →+* R') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) {n : ℕ} {z : Fin n → R}
    (hz : IsRegularSystemOfParameters z) {j₀ : Fin n} (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span {z j₀})
    {ι : Type v} (e : ι → R) {n' : ℕ} (w : Fin n' → R') (hw : IsRegularSystemOfParameters w)
    (c' : ι → Fin n') (hc' : Function.Injective c') (hce : ∀ j, span {w (c' j)} = span {φ (e j)})
    {r : ℕ} (σ' : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n') (hσ' : Function.Injective σ') (hσc : ∀ i j, σ' i ≠ c' j)
    (a' : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n' → ℕ) (ha' : ∀ i k, a' i k ≠ 0 → k ∈ Set.range c')
    (b' : Fin n' → ℕ) (hb' : ∀ k, b' k ≠ 0 → k ∈ Set.range c')
    (J Γ : Ideal R) (hJh : z j₀ ∈ J) (hΓh : z j₀ ∈ Γ)
    (hΓ : Γ.map φ = span (Set.range (w ∘ σ')))
    (hJ : J.map φ = span {monomialOf w b'} * chainIdeal (w ∘ σ') fun i => monomialOf w (a' i)) :
    ∃ (zz : Fin (n' + 1) → R) (c : ι → Fin (n' + 1)) (σ : Fin (r + 2) → Fin (n' + 1))
      (a : Fin (r + 2) → Fin (n' + 1) → ℕ),
      IsRegularSystemOfParameters zz ∧ Function.Injective c ∧
        (∀ j, span {e j} = span {zz (c j)}) ∧ Function.Injective σ ∧ (∀ i j, σ i ≠ c j) ∧
        (∀ i k, a i k ≠ 0 → k ∈ Set.range c) ∧ Γ = span (Set.range (zz ∘ σ)) ∧
        J = chainIdeal (zz ∘ σ) fun i => monomialOf zz (a i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : IsLocalHom φ := IsLocalHom.of_surjective φ hφ
  have hkerle : ∀ {K : Ideal R}, z j₀ ∈ K → RingHom.ker φ ≤ K := fun hK => by
    rw [hker, span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact hK
  
  
  have hlift : ∀ k : Fin n', ∃ x : R, φ x = w k ∧ ∀ j, c' j = k → span {x} = span {e j} := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : ∃ j, c' j = k
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hk
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mp (hce j)
      
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hφ ((u⁻¹ : R'ˣ) : R')
      refine ⟨v * e j, ?_, fun j' hj' => ?_⟩
      · rw [map_mul, hv, ← hu, mul_comm (w (c' j)) (u : R'), ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
      · have : j' = j := hc' hj'
        subst this
        have hvu : IsUnit v := (isUnit_map_iff φ v).mp (hv ▸ (u⁻¹).isUnit)
        exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hvu _
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hφ (w k)
      exact ⟨x, hx, fun j hj => (hk ⟨j, hj⟩).elim⟩
  choose l hl using hlift
  have hφl : φ ∘ l = w := funext fun k => (hl k).1
  
  set zz : Fin (n' + 1) → R := Fin.cons (z j₀) l with hzz_def
  have hmemR : ∀ x : R, x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ↔ φ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R' := by
    intro x
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff,
      mem_nonunits_iff, isUnit_map_iff]
  have hzz : IsRegularSystemOfParameters zz := by
    refine ⟨le_antisymm ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k' => ?_) k
      · rw [hzz_def, Fin.cons_zero, ← hz.1]
        exact subset_span ⟨j₀, rfl⟩
      · rw [hzz_def, Fin.cons_succ, SetLike.mem_coe, hmemR, (hl k').1, ← hw.1]
        exact subset_span ⟨k', rfl⟩
    · intro x hx
      rw [hmemR, ← hw.1] at hx
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp hx
      choose dl hdl using fun k => hφ (d k)
      have hmem : x - ∑ k, dl k * l k ∈ RingHom.ker φ := by
        rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_sum, sub_eq_zero]
        simp_rw [map_mul, hdl, (hl _).1]
        rw [← hd]
      rw [hker] at hmem
      have hsum : ∑ k, dl k * l k ∈ span (Set.range zz) := by
        refine sum_mem fun k _ => mul_mem_left _ _ (subset_span ⟨k.succ, ?_⟩)
        rw [hzz_def, Fin.cons_succ]
      have h0 : x - ∑ k, dl k * l k ∈ span (Set.range zz) := by
        refine span_mono ?_ hmem
        rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        exact ⟨0, by rw [hzz_def, Fin.cons_zero]⟩
      simpa using add_mem h0 hsum
    · have hdim := AlgebraicGeometry.natCast_sub_card_eq_ringKrullDim_of_ker hz.1.symm hz.2 hφ
        (s := {j₀}) (by rw [hker, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton])
      rw [Finset.card_singleton, ← hw.2] at hdim
      have hn : n - 1 = n' := by exact_mod_cast hdim
      have hn' : n' + 1 = n := by
        have := j₀.pos
        omega
      rw [← hz.2, ← hn']
  set σσ : Fin (r + 2) → Fin (n' + 1) := Fin.cons 0 (fun i => (σ' i).succ) with hσσ
  set aa : Fin (r + 2) → Fin (n' + 1) → ℕ := Fin.cons (Fin.cons 0 b') (fun i => Fin.cons 0 (a' i))
    with haa
  have hcomp : zz ∘ σσ = Fin.cons (z j₀) (l ∘ σ') := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_) i
    · rw [Function.comp_apply, hσσ, Fin.cons_zero, hzz_def, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero]
    · rw [Function.comp_apply, hσσ, Fin.cons_succ, hzz_def, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ]
      rfl
  have hφlσ : φ ∘ (l ∘ σ') = w ∘ σ' := by rw [← Function.comp_assoc, hφl]
  have hφM : φ ∘ (fun i => monomialOf l (a' i)) = fun i => monomialOf w (a' i) :=
    funext fun i => by rw [Function.comp_apply, monomialOf_map, hφl]
  refine ⟨zz, fun j => (c' j).succ, σσ, aa, hzz, fun j j' h => hc' (Fin.succ_injective _ h),
    fun j => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hzz_def, Fin.cons_succ]
    exact ((hl (c' j)).2 j rfl).symm
  · rw [hσσ, Fin.cons_injective_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, fun i i' h => hσ' (Fin.succ_injective _ h)⟩
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact Fin.succ_ne_zero _ hi
  · intro i j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_) i
    · rw [hσσ, Fin.cons_zero]
      exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm
    · rw [hσσ, Fin.cons_succ]
      exact fun h => hσc i' j (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
  · intro i k
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k' => ?_) k <;> intro hik
    · simp [haa] at hik
    · rw [haa, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ] at hik
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hb' k' hik
      exact ⟨j, by simp [hj]⟩
    · simp [haa] at hik
    · rw [haa, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ] at hik
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ha' i' k' hik
      exact ⟨j, by simp [hj]⟩
  · 
    have h1 : span (Set.range (w ∘ σ')) = (span (Set.range (l ∘ σ'))).map φ := by
      rw [map_span, ← Set.range_comp, hφlσ]
    rw [hcomp, Fin.range_cons, span_insert, ← comap_map_eq_of_ker_le φ hφ (hkerle hΓh), hΓ, h1,
      Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective φ hφ, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker, sup_comm]
  · 
    have hM : (fun i : Fin (r + 2) => monomialOf zz (aa i)) =
        Fin.cons (monomialOf l b') (fun i => monomialOf l (a' i)) := by
      funext i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_) i
      · rw [haa, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero, hzz_def, monomialOf_cons_zero]
      · rw [haa, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ, hzz_def, monomialOf_cons_zero]
    have hmapJ : (span {monomialOf l b'} * chainIdeal (l ∘ σ') fun i => monomialOf l (a' i)).map φ
        = span {monomialOf w b'} * chainIdeal (w ∘ σ') fun i => monomialOf w (a' i) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_mul, map_span, Set.image_singleton, monomialOf_map, hφl, ← chainIdeal_comp,
        hφlσ, hφM]
    rw [hcomp, hM, chainIdeal_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.tail_cons,
      ← comap_map_eq_of_ker_le φ hφ (hkerle hJh), hJ, ← hmapJ, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective φ hφ,
      ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker, sup_comm]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.disjoint_support_markedTransformSeq_step21_final
statement:
theorem disjoint_support_markedTransformSeq_step21_final {n : ℕ} (T : Triple k)
    (hn : T.HasDimLE n) (hmax : T.I.maxOrd ≤ 1) (bd : ∀ j : ℕ, BDData.{u} n 1 j)
    (hm : T.I.maxOrd = 1) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < Fintype.card T.E.ι) :
    Disjoint
      (SetLike.coe ((Hironaka.BO.step21Seq T hn hmax bd (Fintype.card T.E.ι)).1.markedTransformSeq
        T.I 1 (Fin.last _)).support)
      (SetLike.coe ((Hironaka.BO.step21Seq T hn hmax bd (Fintype.card T.E.ι)).1.strictTransformSeq
        (T.E.nth ⟨i, hi⟩) (Fin.last _)).support)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := T.smoothOfRelativeDimension
  have hsmn : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n' (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := hn'
  have hLN : IsLocallyNoetherian T.X.left := (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)).isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
  have hord := Hironaka.BO.isOrderSeq_step21Seq T hn hmax bd (Fintype.card T.E.ι)
  have hge : (Hironaka.BO.step21Seq T hn hmax bd (Fintype.card T.E.ι)).1.IsOrderGeSeq
      (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) T.I 1 T.E :=
    IsOrderSeq.isOrderGeSeq (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) n' hord
  have hm' : T.I.maxOrd = ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_one]
    exact hm
  have hmw := IsOrderGeSeq.markedTransformSeq_eq_weakTransformSeq (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) n' hm'
    hge (Fin.last _)
  have hdisj := Hironaka.BO.disjoint_cosupp_step21_final T hn hmax bd hi
  have hset : SetLike.coe ((Hironaka.BO.step21Seq T hn hmax bd
      (Fintype.card T.E.ι)).1.weakTransformSeq T.I (Fin.last _)).support =
      {x | ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((Hironaka.BO.step21Seq T hn hmax bd
        (Fintype.card T.E.ι)).1.weakTransformSeq T.I (Fin.last _)).ord x} := by
    ext x
    change x ∈ ((Hironaka.BO.step21Seq T hn hmax bd (Fintype.card T.E.ι)).1.weakTransformSeq T.I
      (Fin.last _)).support ↔ ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ _
    rw [Nat.cast_one]
    exact (Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_le_ord_iff _ _).symm
  rw [hmw, hset]
  exact hdisj

name: Hironaka.Resolution.cp1For_rawSeq_of_cp1
statement:
theorem cp1For_rawSeq_of_cp1 (T : Triple k) (m : ℕ) (hm1 : m = 1) (j : T.E.ι)
    (hI : T.I.IsDBalanced (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) m) (hmax : T.I.maxOrd = m) (hn : T.HasDimLE n)
    (hDom : ∀ T' : MarkedTriple k, T'.toTriple.HasDimLE (n - 1) → T'.m = m → Dom T')
    (hcp1 : ∀ (T' : MarkedTriple k) (hT' : Dom T'), T'.m = 1 → ∀ η' : T'.X.left,
      η' ∈ T'.I.support.genericPoints → (∀ i, η' ∉ (T'.E.component i).support) →
      T'.I.stalkIdeal η' = (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η'})).stalkIdeal η' →
      CP1For (B.seq T' hT') T'.I T'.E η')
    (hH : IsSmoothDivisor (T.E.component j)) (hHJ : T.E.component j ≤ T.I) {η : T.X.left}
    (hη : η ∈ T.I.support.genericPoints)
    (hηE : ∀ i, η ∉ ((T.E.erase j).component i).support)
    (hIc : T.I.stalkIdeal η = (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal η) :
    CP1For (rawSeq T m j hI hmax hn B hDom) T.I (T.E.erase j) η
proof:
:= by
  subst hm1
  
  obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := T.smoothOfRelativeDimension
  have hsmn : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n' (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := hn'
  have hsm : Smooth (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n' _
  have hLN : IsLocallyNoetherian T.X.left := (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)).isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
  have hNS : NoetherianSpace T.X.left := Hironaka.BD.noetherianSpace_triple T
  have hN : IsNoetherian T.X.left :=
    { toIsLocallyNoetherian := hLN, toCompactSpace := inferInstance }
  have hker : (T.E.component j).subschemeι.ker = T.E.component j := IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι _
  have hηH : η ∈ (T.E.component j).support := IdealSheafData.support_antitone hHJ hη.1
  
  have hZ : Closeds.closure {η} ≤ (T.E.component j).support := by
    rw [← SetLike.coe_subset_coe, Closeds.coe_closure]
    exact (T.E.component j).support.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hηH)
  have hHc : T.E.component j ≤ IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η}) :=
    IdealSheafData.le_support_iff_le_vanishingIdeal.mp hZ
  have hZI : Closeds.closure {η} ≤ T.I.support := by
    rw [← SetLike.coe_subset_coe, Closeds.coe_closure]
    exact T.I.support.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hη.1)
  have hIc' : T.I ≤ IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η}) :=
    IdealSheafData.le_support_iff_le_vanishingIdeal.mp hZI
  
  set L : BlowUpSequence (T.E.component j).subscheme :=
    BlowUpSequence.cons (T.E.component j).subscheme (centerS T 1 j)
      (B.seq (restrictedTriple T 1 j hI hmax)
        (hDom _ (hasDimLE_restrictedTriple T 1 j hI hmax hn) rfl)) with hL
  have hraw : rawSeq T 1 j hI hmax hn B hDom = L.pushforward (T.E.component j).subschemeι := rfl
  have hord := isOrderSeq_rawSeq_erase T 1 j hI hmax hn B hDom
  have hS : (L.pushforward (T.E.component j).subschemeι).IsOrderGeSeq
      (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) T.I 1 (T.E.erase j) :=
    IsOrderSeq.isOrderGeSeq (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) n' hord
  have hEerase : (T.E.erase j).IsSnc := isSnc_erase T.E j T.isSnc
  have hEH : ((T.E.erase j).append (T.E.component j)).IsSnc :=
    DivisorFamily.isSnc_erase_append T.E j T.isSnc
  rw [hraw]
  by_cases hA : Zminus1 T.I 1 (T.E.component j) ≤ IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure
      {η})
  · 
    have hηgen : η ∈ (T.E.component j).support.genericPoints :=
      mem_genericPoints_of_Zminus1_le T.I (T.E.component j) hη hA
    have hst : ∀ x ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).support,
        (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal x =
            (T.E.component j).stalkIdeal x := by
      intro x hx
      rw [support_vanishingIdeal_eq] at hx
      exact stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_of_isSmoothDivisor hH hηgen
        (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hx)
    have hcsm : IsSmoothDivisor (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})) :=
      isSmoothDivisor_vanishingIdeal_closure_of_mem_genericPoints hH hηgen
    have hsupp : (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).support ≤
        (T.E.component j).support := by
      rw [support_vanishingIdeal_eq]
      exact hZ
    have hsnc : (T.E.erase j).HasSncWith (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})) :=
      HasSncWith.of_embeds (fun i : (T.E.erase j).ι => i.1) Subtype.val_injective (fun _ => rfl)
        (HasSncWith.of_stalkIdeal_eq (hasSncWith_component_of_isSnc T.isSnc j) hsupp hst)
    have hord1 : ∀ p ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).support,
        (nonmonomialPart T.I (T.E.erase j)).ord p ≤ 1 := by
      intro p _
      have h1 : T.I.ord p ≤ 1 := by
        have := IdealSheafData.le_maxOrd T.I p
        rwa [hmax, Nat.cast_one] at this
      exact (IdealSheafData.ord_anti (IdealSheafData.le_colon_self _ _) p).trans h1
    have hnc : NotContainedInMembers (T.E.erase j) (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure
        {η})) :=
      notContainedInMembers_vanishingIdeal_closure _ hηE
    have hS3 := chainRelativeAt_of_le_isSmoothDivisor (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) hEerase
      hcsm hsnc hIc' hord1 hnc
    
    have h0 : CenterContains (L.pushforward (T.E.component j).subschemeι)
        (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})) 0 := by
      refine ⟨Nat.succ_pos _, ?_⟩
      change (centerS T 1 j).map (T.E.component j).subschemeι ≤ _
      exact (map_centerS T 1 j).le.trans hA
    rintro ⟨i, hi'⟩ _ hmin p hp
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hpos
    · exact hS3 p hp
    · exact absurd h0 (hmin 0 hpos)
  · 
    obtain ⟨η', hη'⟩ := exists_eq_of_mem_support_ker (T.E.component j).subschemeι
      (by rw [hker]; exact hηH)
    have hHdim := smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_isSmoothDivisor (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) n'
      (T.E.component j) hH
    have hLN' : IsLocallyNoetherian (T.E.component j).subscheme :=
      ((T.E.component j).subschemeι ≫ (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))).isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
    
    have hη'gen : η' ∈ (T.I.comap (T.E.component j).subschemeι).support.genericPoints :=
      mem_genericPoints_comap_of_isClosedImmersion _ T.I (hη' ▸ hη)
    have hη'E : ∀ i,
        η' ∉ (((T.E.erase j).comap (T.E.component j).subschemeι).component i).support :=
      fun i hi => hηE i (by rw [← hη']; exact (mem_support_comap_iff_apply _ _ _).mp hi)
    have hIc'' : (T.I.comap (T.E.component j).subschemeι).stalkIdeal η' =
        (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η'})).stalkIdeal η' :=
      stalkIdeal_comap_eq_vanishingIdeal_closure_of_eq _ T.I η' (hη' ▸ hIc)
    have hcomap : (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).comap
        (T.E.component j).subschemeι =
        IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η'}) := by
      rw [← hη']
      exact comap_vanishingIdeal_closure_of_isClosedImmersion _ η'
    have hkerc : (T.E.component j).subschemeι.ker ≤ IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure
        {η}) := by
      rw [hker]
      exact hHc
    
    have hD : ¬ CenterContains L (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η'})) 0 := by
      intro hc
      apply hA
      rw [← hcomap] at hc
      obtain ⟨h0', hle⟩ := id ((centerContains_pushforward_iff_of_ker_le L _ hkerc 0).mpr hc)
      change (centerS T 1 j).map (T.E.component j).subschemeι ≤ _ at hle
      exact (map_centerS T 1 j).symm.le.trans hle
    
    have hCP : CP1For L (T.I.comap (T.E.component j).subschemeι)
        ((T.E.erase j).comap (T.E.component j).subschemeι) η' := by
      refine cp1For_cons_of_not_centerContains (centerS T 1 j) _ _ _ hη'gen hη'E hIc'' hD ?_
      intro η₁ hlift
      exact hcp1 (restrictedTriple T 1 j hI hmax)
        (hDom _ (hasDimLE_restrictedTriple T 1 j hI hmax hn) rfl) rfl η₁
        hlift.mem_genericPoints hlift.notMem hlift.stalk_eq
    exact cp1For_pushforward (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) n' hH hEerase hEH hHJ hηH L hS hη' hCP

name: Hironaka.Resolution.sncDataWith_of_admissibleK
statement:
theorem sncDataWith_of_admissibleK {K : X.IdealSheafData} {x : X}
    (h : AdmissibleChainStratumKAt E K Γ Z x) : SncDataWith E Z x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, z, c, r, σ, a, b, l, -, s, ⟨hz, hcinj, hc, -, -, -, -⟩, -, -, -, hZ, -⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, z, hz, ⟨c, hcinj, hc⟩, stratumCoords σ s l, hZ.trans (span_image_comp_sup_eq σ s z l)⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.sncDataWith_of_admissibleAt
statement:
theorem sncDataWith_of_admissibleAt {I : X.IdealSheafData} {x : X}
    (h : AdmissibleChainStratumAt E I Γ Z x) : SncDataWith E Z x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, z, c, r, σ, a, b, l, -, s, ⟨hz, hcinj, hc, -, -, -, -⟩, -, -, -, hZ, -⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, z, hz, ⟨c, hcinj, hc⟩, stratumCoords σ s l, hZ.trans (span_image_comp_sup_eq σ s z l)⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.span_range_comp_sup_eq
statement:
theorem span_range_comp_sup_eq {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n r : ℕ} (z : Fin n → R)
    (σ : Fin (r + 1) → Fin n) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    span (Set.range (z ∘ σ)) ⊔ span (z '' ↑s) = span (z '' ↑(stratumCoords σ s (r + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_image_comp_sup_eq σ s z (r + 1)]
  congr 2
  rw [show {i : Fin (r + 1) | i.val < r + 1} = Set.univ from Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun i => i.2,
    Set.image_univ]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.sncDataWith_of_terminalNormal
statement:
theorem sncDataWith_of_terminalNormal {I : X.IdealSheafData} {x : X}
    (h : TerminalNormalStratumAt E I Γ Z x) : SncDataWith E Z x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, z, c, r, σ, a, b, s, ⟨hz, hcinj, hc, -, -, -, -⟩, -, -, -, -, hZ⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, z, hz, ⟨c, hcinj, hc⟩, stratumCoords σ s (r + 1),
    hZ.trans (span_range_comp_sup_eq z σ s)⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_blowUp_of_sncDataWith
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_blowUp_of_sncDataWith {q : IdealSheafData.blowUp Z}
    (hq : q ∈ (Z.comap (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)).support) (hΓ : IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q ∈
        Γ.support)
    (hdata : ∀ x ∈ Z.support, x ∈ Γ.support → SncDataWith E Z x) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)
proof:
:=
  (exists_totalTransformData_of_mem_support_of_specializes f E.component Z q hq
    fun x hx hspec => hdata x hx (hspec.mem_closed Γ.support.isClosed hΓ)).1.1

name: Hironaka.Resolution.δAdm_eq
statement:
theorem δAdm_eq (hσ : Function.Injective σ) (hs : ∀ i, σ i ∉ s) (l : ℕ) (i : Fin (r + 1)) :
    (if σ i ∈ stratumCoords σ s l then 1 else 0) = δAdm l i
proof:
:= by
  unfold δAdm
  simp only [mem_stratumCoords_iff σ s hσ hs]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.one_le_sum_of_exists
statement: theorem one_le_sum_of_exists {c : Fin n → ℕ} (h : ∃ k ∈ s, c k ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, c k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hck⟩ := h
  exact le_trans (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hck)
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hk)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.one_le_epsOrderC_K
statement:
theorem one_le_epsOrderC_K (h₁ : l = 0 → ∃ k ∈ s, b k ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b (Function.update (δAdm l) (Fin.last r) 0) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [epsOrderC, epsOrder_zero, sum_stratumCoords_eq σ s l b hb]
  by_cases hl0 : l = 0
  · have := one_le_sum_of_exists s (h₁ hl0)
    omega
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with hr | hr
    · omega
    · have hne : (0 : Fin (r + 1)) ≠ Fin.last r := by
        intro h
        have := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_last] at this
        omega
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, δAdm, ite_eq_left (by simp only [Fin.val_zero]; omega)]
      omega

name: Hironaka.Resolution.one_le_epsOrderC_I
statement:
theorem one_le_epsOrderC_I (h₁ : l = 0 → ∃ k ∈ s, b k ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b (δAdm l) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [epsOrderC, epsOrder_zero, sum_stratumCoords_eq σ s l b hb]
  by_cases hl0 : l = 0
  · have := one_le_sum_of_exists s (h₁ hl0)
    omega
  · rw [δAdm, ite_eq_left (by simp only [Fin.val_zero]; omega)]
    omega

name: Hironaka.Resolution.epsOrderC_I_mono
statement:
theorem epsOrderC_I_mono (h₂ : 0 < l → ∃ k ∈ s, a ⟨l - 1, by omega⟩ k ≠ 0) (i : Fin r) :
    epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b (δAdm l) i.castSucc ≤
      epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b (δAdm l) i.succ
proof:
:= by
  refine epsOrder_mono_of _ _ _ (fun i => ?_) i
  simp only [sum_stratumCoords_eq σ s l (a _) (ha _), δAdm, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
  by_cases hi : i.val < l
  · rw [ite_eq_left hi]
    by_cases hi1 : i.val + 1 < l
    · rw [ite_eq_left hi1]
      omega
    · have hl' : l = i.val + 1 := by omega
      have := one_le_sum_of_exists s (h₂ (by omega))
      have hidx : (⟨l - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (r + 1)) = i.castSucc := Fin.ext (by
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]; omega)
      rw [hidx] at this
      omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right hi]
    omega

name: Hironaka.Resolution.epsOrderC_K_mono
statement:
theorem epsOrderC_K_mono (h₂ : 0 < l → ∃ k ∈ s, a ⟨l - 1, by omega⟩ k ≠ 0) (i : Fin r) :
    epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b (Function.update (δAdm l) (Fin.last r) 0) i.castSucc ≤
      epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b (Function.update (δAdm l) (Fin.last r) 0) i.succ
proof:
:= by
  refine epsOrder_mono_of _ _ _ (fun i => ?_) i
  have hcs : Function.update (δAdm l) (Fin.last r) 0 i.castSucc = δAdm l i.castSucc :=
    Function.update_of_ne (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne _ _
  rw [hcs, sum_stratumCoords_eq σ s l (a _) (ha _)]
  simp only [δAdm, Fin.val_castSucc]
  by_cases hi : i.val < l
  · rw [ite_eq_left hi]
    by_cases hsucc : i.succ = Fin.last r
    · have hval : i.val + 1 = r := by
        have := congrArg Fin.val hsucc
        simpa using this
      have := one_le_sum_of_exists s (h₂ (by omega))
      have hidx : (⟨l - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (r + 1)) = i.castSucc := Fin.ext (by
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]; omega)
      rw [hidx] at this
      omega
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hsucc]
      simp only [δAdm, Fin.val_succ]
      by_cases hi1 : i.val + 1 < l
      · rw [ite_eq_left hi1]
        omega
      · have := one_le_sum_of_exists s (h₂ (by omega))
        have hidx : (⟨l - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (r + 1)) = i.castSucc := Fin.ext (by
          simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]; omega)
        rw [hidx] at this
        omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right hi]
    omega

name: Hironaka.Resolution.δ_terminal_eq
statement:
theorem δ_terminal_eq (hσ : Function.Injective σ) (hs : ∀ i, σ i ∉ s) (i : Fin (r + 1)) :
    (if σ i ∈ stratumCoords σ s (r + 1) then 1 else 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ite_eq_left ((mem_stratumCoords_iff σ s hσ hs (r + 1) i).mpr i.2)]

name: Hironaka.Resolution.one_le_epsOrderC_terminal
statement:
theorem one_le_epsOrderC_terminal :
    1 ≤ epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s (r + 1)) a b (fun _ => 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [epsOrderC, epsOrder_zero]
  omega

name: Hironaka.Resolution.epsOrderC_terminal_mono
statement:
theorem epsOrderC_terminal_mono (i : Fin r) :
    epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s (r + 1)) a b (fun _ => 1) i.castSucc ≤
      epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s (r + 1)) a b (fun _ => 1) i.succ
proof:
:=
  epsOrder_mono_of _ _ _ (fun _ => by omega) i

name: Hironaka.Resolution.Dexp_castSucc
statement:
theorem Dexp_castSucc (Efun : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) (i : Fin r) :
    Dexp Efun i.castSucc = Efun i.succ - Efun i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  unfold Dexp
  rw [dite_eq_left (by simp)]
  rfl

name: Hironaka.Resolution.σ_notMem_of_subset_range
proof:
:= fun hi => by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hs hi
  exact hσc i j hj.symm

name: Hironaka.Resolution.notMem_range_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcc k hk
  exact hσc i j (hi.trans hj.symm)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.chainRelativeKAt_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem chainRelativeKAt_of_mem_support (K : X.IdealSheafData)
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)] (hq : q ∈ (Z.comap
        (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)).support)
    (hqΓ : q ∈ (Γ.strictTransform Z).support)
    (h : AdmissibleChainStratumKAt E K Γ Z (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q)) :
    ChainRelativeKAt (E.totalTransform Z) (K.markedTransform Z 1) (Γ.strictTransform Z) q ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (z' : Fin m → (IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q),
          (E.totalTransform Z).IsSncAt q z' ∧
        ∃ t : Finset (Fin m), (Γ.strictTransform Z).stalkIdeal q = span (z' '' ↑t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hregp : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q)) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f _
  obtain ⟨n, z, c, r, σ, a, b, l, hl, s, hcoords, hb, hK, hs, hZ, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hz, hcinj, hc, hσinj, hσc, ha, hΓ⟩ := id hcoords
  have hσs : ∀ i, σ i ∉ s := σ_notMem_of_subset_range hσc hs
  have hb' : ∀ k, b k ≠ 0 → k ∉ Set.range σ := notMem_range_of_ne_zero hσc hb
  have ha' : ∀ i k, a i k ≠ 0 → k ∉ Set.range σ := fun i => notMem_range_of_ne_zero hσc (ha i)
  have hZC : Z.stalkIdeal (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q) = span (z '' ↑(stratumCoords σ s l)) :=
    hZ.trans (span_image_comp_sup_eq σ s z l)
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := nonempty_chartAt Z q f hz (stratumCoords σ s l) hZC
  have hσc₀ := D.σ_ne_c₀ Γ σ hΓ hqΓ
  have hmem := (D.w_σ_mem_and_stalkIdeal_strictTransform Γ σ hq hΓ hqΓ).1
  have hδ : ∀ i, δAdm l i = if σ i ∈ stratumCoords σ s l then 1 else 0 :=
    fun i => (δAdm_eq σ s hσinj hσs l i).symm
  set δK := Function.update (δAdm l) (Fin.last r) 0 with hδK
  refine ⟨⟨D.m, D.z', fun j' => D.newMemberIdx E c hq j'.1, r, D.newChain σ hmem,
    fun i => D.newExp (Dexp (epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b δK) i) (a i),
    D.newExp (epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b δK 0 - 1) b,
    D.chainCoords_totalTransform E Γ c σ a hq hcoords hqΓ _,
    fun k' hk' => D.newExp_support E c hq hz hc _ _ hb k' hk', ?_⟩,
    D.m, D.z', D.isSncAt_totalTransform E c hq hz hcinj hc,
    Finset.univ.image (D.newChain σ hmem), ?_⟩
  · exact D.stalkIdeal_markedTransform_chainKIdeal σ a hq hσc₀ hmem b K hK (δAdm l) hδ
      (one_le_epsOrderC_K σ s a b hb' l hl h₁) (epsOrderC_K_mono σ s a b ha' l hl h₂) _
      (fun i => Dexp_castSucc _ i)
  · rw [(D.w_σ_mem_and_stalkIdeal_strictTransform Γ σ hq hΓ hqΓ).2, Finset.coe_image,
      Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, ← Set.range_comp]
    exact congrArg span (congrArg Set.range (funext fun i => (D.z'_newChain σ hmem i).symm))

name: Hironaka.Resolution.chainRelativeAt_of_mem_support_of_admissible
statement:
theorem chainRelativeAt_of_mem_support_of_admissible (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)] (hq : q ∈ (Z.comap
        (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)).support)
    (hqΓ : q ∈ (Γ.strictTransform Z).support)
    (h : AdmissibleChainStratumAt E I Γ Z (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q)) :
    ChainRelativeAt (E.totalTransform Z) (I.markedTransform Z 1) (Γ.strictTransform Z) q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hregp : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q)) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f _
  obtain ⟨n, z, c, r, σ, a, b, l, hl, s, hcoords, hb, hI, hs, hZ, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hz, hcinj, hc, hσinj, hσc, ha, hΓ⟩ := id hcoords
  have hσs : ∀ i, σ i ∉ s := σ_notMem_of_subset_range hσc hs
  have hb' : ∀ k, b k ≠ 0 → k ∉ Set.range σ := notMem_range_of_ne_zero hσc hb
  have ha' : ∀ i k, a i k ≠ 0 → k ∉ Set.range σ := fun i => notMem_range_of_ne_zero hσc (ha i)
  have hZC : Z.stalkIdeal (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q) = span (z '' ↑(stratumCoords σ s l)) :=
    hZ.trans (span_image_comp_sup_eq σ s z l)
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := nonempty_chartAt Z q f hz (stratumCoords σ s l) hZC
  have hσc₀ := D.σ_ne_c₀ Γ σ hΓ hqΓ
  have hmem := (D.w_σ_mem_and_stalkIdeal_strictTransform Γ σ hq hΓ hqΓ).1
  have hδ : ∀ i, δAdm l i = if σ i ∈ stratumCoords σ s l then 1 else 0 :=
    fun i => (δAdm_eq σ s hσinj hσs l i).symm
  refine ⟨D.m, D.z', fun j' => D.newMemberIdx E c hq j'.1, r, D.newChain σ hmem,
    fun i => D.newExp (Dexp (epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b (δAdm l)) i) (a i),
    D.newExp (epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s l) a b (δAdm l) 0 - 1) b,
    D.chainCoords_totalTransform E Γ c σ a hq hcoords hqΓ _,
    fun k' hk' => D.newExp_support E c hq hz hc _ _ hb k' hk', ?_⟩
  exact D.stalkIdeal_markedTransform_chainIdeal σ a hq hσc₀ hmem b I hI (δAdm l) hδ
    (one_le_epsOrderC_I σ s a b hb' l h₁) (epsOrderC_I_mono σ s a b ha' l hl h₂) _
    (fun i => Dexp_castSucc _ i)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.chainRelativeAt_of_mem_support_of_terminal
statement:
theorem chainRelativeAt_of_mem_support_of_terminal (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q)] (hq : q ∈ (Z.comap
        (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)).support)
    (hqΓ : q ∈ (Γ.strictTransform Z).support)
    (h : TerminalNormalStratumAt E I Γ Z (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q)) :
    ChainRelativeAt (E.totalTransform Z) (I.markedTransform Z 1) (Γ.strictTransform Z) q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hregp : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q)) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f _
  obtain ⟨n, z, c, r, σ, a, b, s, hcoords, hb, hI, hs, -, hZ⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hz, hcinj, hc, hσinj, hσc, ha, hΓ⟩ := id hcoords
  have hσs : ∀ i, σ i ∉ s := σ_notMem_of_subset_range hσc hs
  have hZC : Z.stalkIdeal (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q) = span (z '' ↑(stratumCoords σ s (r + 1))) :=
    hZ.trans (span_range_comp_sup_eq z σ s)
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := nonempty_chartAt Z q f hz (stratumCoords σ s (r + 1)) hZC
  have hσc₀ := D.σ_ne_c₀ Γ σ hΓ hqΓ
  have hmem := (D.w_σ_mem_and_stalkIdeal_strictTransform Γ σ hq hΓ hqΓ).1
  have hδ : ∀ i, (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => (1 : ℕ)) i =
      if σ i ∈ stratumCoords σ s (r + 1) then 1 else 0 :=
    fun i => (δ_terminal_eq σ s hσinj hσs i).symm
  refine ⟨D.m, D.z', fun j' => D.newMemberIdx E c hq j'.1, r, D.newChain σ hmem,
    fun i => D.newExp (Dexp (epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s (r + 1)) a b fun _ => 1) i) (a i),
    D.newExp (epsOrderC (stratumCoords σ s (r + 1)) a b (fun _ => 1) 0 - 1) b,
    D.chainCoords_totalTransform E Γ c σ a hq hcoords hqΓ _,
    fun k' hk' => D.newExp_support E c hq hz hc _ _ hb k' hk', ?_⟩
  exact D.stalkIdeal_markedTransform_chainIdeal σ a hq hσc₀ hmem b I hI (fun _ => 1) hδ
    (one_le_epsOrderC_terminal σ s a b) (epsOrderC_terminal_mono σ s a b) _
    (fun i => Dexp_castSucc _ i)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.mem_inf_support
statement:
theorem mem_inf_support {Z Γ : X.IdealSheafData} {p : X} (hZ : p ∈ Z.support) (hΓ : p ∈ Γ.support) :
    p ∈ Z.support ⊓ Γ.support
proof:
:= by
  change p ∈ ((Z.support ⊓ Γ.support : Closeds X) : Set X)
  rw [Closeds.coe_inf]
  exact ⟨hZ, hΓ⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.cp4K_pointwise
statement:
theorem cp4K_pointwise (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth f] (E : DivisorFamily X)
    (K Γ Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hΓ : E.HasSncWith Γ)
    (hK : ∀ p ∈ Γ.support, ChainRelativeKAt E K Γ p)
    (hZ : ∀ p ∈ Z.support ⊓ Γ.support, AdmissibleChainStratumKAt E K Γ Z p)
    (q : IdealSheafData.blowUp Z) (hqΓ : q ∈ (Γ.strictTransform Z).support) :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q) ∧
      ChainRelativeKAt (E.totalTransform Z) (K.markedTransform Z 1) (Γ.strictTransform Z) q ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (z' : Fin m → (IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q),
          (E.totalTransform Z).IsSncAt q z' ∧
        ∃ t : Finset (Fin m), (Γ.strictTransform Z).stalkIdeal q = span (z' '' ↑t)
proof:
:= by
  have : PerfectField k := PerfectField.ofCharZero
  have hpΓ : IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q ∈ Γ.support :=
    π_mem_support_of_mem_support_strictTransformAlong Z Γ q hqΓ
  by_cases hq : q ∈ (Z.comap (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)).support
  · have hpZ : IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q ∈ Z.support := (mem_support_comap_iff' Z _ q).mp hq
    have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing ((IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q) :=
      isRegularLocalRing_stalk_blowUp_of_sncDataWith E Γ Z f hq hpΓ fun x hx hxΓ =>
        sncDataWith_of_admissibleK E Γ Z (hZ x (mem_inf_support hx hxΓ))
    exact ⟨hreg, chainRelativeKAt_of_mem_support f E Γ Z K hq hqΓ (hZ _ (mem_inf_support hpZ hpΓ))⟩
  · have hiso := isIso_stalkMap_π_of_notMem_support Z hq
    have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing ((IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q) := by
      have := isRegularLocalRing_stalk f (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q)
      exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (stalkMapπEquiv Z hq)
    obtain ⟨n, z, hsnc, t, ht⟩ := hΓ _ hpΓ
    obtain ⟨z', hsnc', ht'⟩ := exists_isSncAt_totalTransform_of_notMem E Z hq Γ hsnc ht
    exact ⟨hreg, chainRelativeKAt_totalTransform_of_notMem E Z hq K Γ (hK _ hpΓ), n, z', hsnc', t,
      ht'⟩

name: Hironaka.Resolution.chainRelativeKAt_strictTransform
statement:
theorem chainRelativeKAt_strictTransform (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (K Γ Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hE : E.IsSnc)
    (hΓ : E.HasSncWith Γ) (hsm : Smooth (Γ.subschemeι ≫ f))
    (hK : ∀ p ∈ Γ.support, ChainRelativeKAt E K Γ p)
    (hZ : ∀ p ∈ Z.support ⊓ Γ.support, AdmissibleChainStratumKAt E K Γ Z p) :
    Smooth ((Γ.strictTransform Z).subschemeι ≫ Z.blowUpπ ≫ f) ∧
      (E.totalTransform Z).HasSncWith (Γ.strictTransform Z) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ (Γ.strictTransform Z).support,
        ChainRelativeKAt (E.totalTransform Z) (K.markedTransform Z 1) (Γ.strictTransform Z) q
proof:
:= by
  have _hE := hE
  have _hsm := hsm
  have : PerfectField k := PerfectField.ofCharZero
  have haux := cp4K_pointwise f E K Γ Z hΓ hK hZ
  refine ⟨?_, fun q hq => (haux q hq).2.2, fun q hq => (haux q hq).2.1⟩
  have hLN : IsLocallyNoetherian X := f.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
  have hπ : IsProper Z.blowUpπ := blowUp.isProper_π Z
  rw [Scheme.smooth_iff_isRegular]
  refine ⟨fun w => ?_⟩
  have hqw := subschemeι_mem_support (Γ.strictTransform Z) w
  obtain ⟨hreg, -, m, z', hsnc, t, ht⟩ := haux _ hqw
  exact isRegularLocalRing_stalk_subscheme (Γ.strictTransform Z) w hsnc.1 ht

name: Hironaka.Resolution.chainRelativeAt_strictTransform
statement:
theorem chainRelativeAt_strictTransform (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (I Γ Z : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hE : E.IsSnc) (hΓ : E.HasSncWith Γ) (hI : ∀ p ∈ Γ.support, ChainRelativeAt E I Γ p)
    (hZ : ∀ p ∈ Z.support ⊓ Γ.support,
      AdmissibleChainStratumAt E I Γ Z p ∨ TerminalNormalStratumAt E I Γ Z p) :
    ∀ q ∈ (Γ.strictTransform Z).support,
      ChainRelativeAt (E.totalTransform Z) (I.markedTransform Z 1) (Γ.strictTransform Z) q
proof:
:= by
  have _hE := hE
  have _hΓ := hΓ
  have : PerfectField k := PerfectField.ofCharZero
  intro q hqΓ
  have hpΓ : IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q ∈ Γ.support :=
    π_mem_support_of_mem_support_strictTransformAlong Z Γ q hqΓ
  by_cases hq : q ∈ (Z.comap (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)).support
  · have hpZ : IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z q ∈ Z.support := (mem_support_comap_iff' Z _ q).mp hq
    have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing ((IdealSheafData.blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q) :=
      isRegularLocalRing_stalk_blowUp_of_sncDataWith E Γ Z f hq hpΓ fun x hx hxΓ =>
        (hZ x (mem_inf_support hx hxΓ)).elim (sncDataWith_of_admissibleAt E Γ Z)
          (sncDataWith_of_terminalNormal E Γ Z)
    rcases hZ _ (mem_inf_support hpZ hpΓ) with h | h
    · exact chainRelativeAt_of_mem_support_of_admissible f E Γ Z I hq hqΓ h
    · exact chainRelativeAt_of_mem_support_of_terminal f E Γ Z I hq hqΓ h
  · exact chainRelativeAt_totalTransform_of_notMem E Z hq I Γ (hI _ hpΓ)

name: Hironaka.Resolution.stageTriple_I
statement:
theorem stageTriple_I (T : MarkedTriple k) (hm : T.m = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (stageTriple T hm n).I = ((bmoOneRun T hm).take n).markedTransformSeq T.I 1 (Fin.last _)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, m⟩ := T
  obtain rfl : m = 1 := hm
  rfl

name: Hironaka.Resolution.strictTransform_biInf_of_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
theorem strictTransform_biInf_of_pairwise_disjoint [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (D : X.IdealSheafData) (Γs : Finset X.IdealSheafData)
    (hred : ∀ γ ∈ Γs, IsReduced γ.subscheme)
    (hdisj : (↑Γs : Set X.IdealSheafData).Pairwise fun a b => Disjoint a.support b.support) :
    (⨅ γ ∈ Γs, γ).strictTransform D = ⨅ γ ∈ Γs, γ.strictTransform D
proof:
:=
  strictTransformSeq_biInf_of_pairwise_disjoint (cons X D (nil _)) Γs hred hdisj (Fin.last 1)
