name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.chart_stalkMap_π_stalkMap_germ
statement:
theorem chart_stalkMap_π_stalkMap_germ (C : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (c' c : C.ideal V) (q : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c')))
    (hp : C.blowUpπ ((blowUp.chart C V c') q) ∈ V.1) :
    (blowUp.chart C V c').stalkMap q (C.blowUpπ.stalkMap
        ((blowUp.chart C V c') q) (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hp c)) =
      chartGerm _ q (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c') c)
proof:
:=
          by
  have e1 : C.blowUpπ.stalkMap ((blowUp.chart C V c') q)
      (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hp c) =
      C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
          ((blowUp.chart C V c') q) hp
        (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) le_rfl
            c) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.germ_appLE_apply C.blowUpπ V.1
        (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) le_rfl hp hp c).symm
  have e2 : (blowUp.chart C V c').stalkMap q
      (C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
          ((blowUp.chart C V c') q) hp
        (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) le_rfl
            c)) =
      (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))).presheaf.germ ⊤ q
        (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top q) ((blowUp.chart C V c').appLE
          (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) ⊤ (chart_le_preimage C V c')
          (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) le_rfl
              c)) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.germ_appLE_apply (blowUp.chart C V c') (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) ⊤
      (chart_le_preimage C V c') (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top q) hp _).symm
  have e3 : (blowUp.chart C V c').appLE (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) ⊤
      (chart_le_preimage C V c') (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1
          (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) le_rfl c) =
      (blowUp.chart C V c' ≫ C.blowUpπ).appLE V.1 ⊤
        (chart_comp_le C V c') c :=
    congrArg (fun φ : Γ(X, V) ⟶ Γ(Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c')),
        ⊤)
      => φ c) (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE (blowUp.chart C V c') C.blowUpπ V.1
        (C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) ⊤ le_rfl (chart_le_preimage C V c'))
  have e5 : (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))).presheaf.germ ⊤ q
        (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top q) ((blowUp.chart C V c' ≫ C.blowUpπ).appLE
          V.1 ⊤ (chart_comp_le C V c') c) =
      chartGerm _ q (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c') c) :=
    (congrArg (fun s => (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V)
        c'))).presheaf.germ
      ⊤ q (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top q) s) (appLE_chart_comp_π C V c' c)).trans
      (chartGerm_apply _ q _).symm
  exact (congrArg (fun y => (blowUp.chart C V c').stalkMap q y) e1).trans
    (e2.trans ((congrArg (fun s => (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))
      ).presheaf.germ ⊤ q (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top q) s) e3).trans e5))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap_chart_of_span
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_comap_chart_of_span (C : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (c' c : C.ideal V) (q : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c')))
    (hp : C.blowUpπ ((blowUp.chart C V c') q) ∈ V.1)
    (hgen : (C.comap C.blowUpπ).stalkIdeal ((blowUp.chart C V c') q) =
      Ideal.span
        {C.blowUpπ.stalkMap ((blowUp.chart C V c') q) (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hp c)}) :
    ((C.comap C.blowUpπ).comap (blowUp.chart C V c')).stalkIdeal q =
      Ideal.span
        {chartGerm _ q (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c') c)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_comap]
  refine (congrArg (Ideal.map ((blowUp.chart C V c').stalkMap q).hom)
    hgen).trans ?_
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  exact congrArg (fun x => Ideal.span {x}) (chart_stalkMap_π_stalkMap_germ C V c' c q hp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.subring_closure_chart_generators_eq_top
statement:
theorem subring_closure_chart_generators_eq_top {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (a : I) :
    Subring.closure (Set.range (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I (a : R))) ∪
      Set.range (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I a)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set S := affineBlowUpAlgebra I (a : R) with hS
  set T := Set.range (algebraMap R S) ∪ Set.range (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I a)
    with hT
  rw [Subring.eq_top_iff']
  intro y
  have hy : (y : Localization.Away (a : R)) ∈ (Algebra.adjoin R
      ((fun x => Localization.mk x ⟨(a : R), Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩) '' (I : Set R))).toSubring :=
    y.2
  rw [Algebra.adjoin_eq_ring_closure] at hy
  have himg : (SubringClass.subtype S) '' T = Set.range (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a : R))) ∪
      (fun x => Localization.mk x ⟨(a : R), Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩) '' (I : Set R) := by
    rw [hT, Set.image_union]
    congr 1
    · ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, ⟨r, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨r, (Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap S r).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨algebraMap R S r, ⟨r, rfl⟩, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap S r⟩
    · ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨b, b.2, (awayFrac_one (a := (a : R)) (b : R)).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I a ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩,
          awayFrac_one (a := (a : R)) x⟩
  rw [← himg, ← RingHom.map_closure, Subring.mem_map] at hy
  obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩ := hy
  exact (Subtype.ext hyy : y' = y) ▸ hy'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ratio_mul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ratio_mul_algebraMap {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (a b : I) :
    affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I a b * algebraMap R
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra I (a : R)) a =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I (a : R)) b
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap]
  change awayFrac (a : R) 1 (b : R) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a : R)) a =
    algebraMap R _ b
  have := affineBlowUpAlgebra.awayFrac_mul_algebraMap_pow (a := (a : R)) 1 (b : R)
  rwa [pow_one] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.appIso_inv_ΓSpecIso_inv_ratio_mul
statement:
theorem appIso_inv_ΓSpecIso_inv_ratio_mul (C : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (a b : C.ideal V) :
    ((blowUp.chart C V a).appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) a))).inv
          (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) a b)) *
      ((blowUp.chart C V a).appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) a))).inv
          (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) a) a)) =
      ((blowUp.chart C V a).appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) a))).inv
          (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) a) b))
proof:
:=
  (map_mul ((blowUp.chart C V a).appIso ⊤).inv.hom _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun t => ((blowUp.chart C V a).appIso ⊤).inv t)
      (map_mul (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) a))).inv.hom
        _ _).symm).trans
      (congrArg (fun z => ((blowUp.chart C V a).appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) a))).inv z))
        (ratio_mul_algebraMap (C.ideal V) a b)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_chartOpen_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem mem_chartOpen_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span (C : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (c : C.ideal V) {p : C.blowUp} (hp : C.blowUpπ p ∈
        V.1)
    (hgen : (C.comap C.blowUpπ).stalkIdeal p =
      Ideal.span {C.blowUpπ.stalkMap p (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hp c)}) :
    p ∈ (chartOpen C V c).1
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : p ∈ C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := hp
  rw [← blowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart C V, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hp'
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := hp'
  obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hc'
  have h2 := stalkIdeal_comap_chart_of_span C V c' c q' hp hgen
  have hnzd := chartGerm_algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors C V c' q'
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvc⟩ := exists_isUnit_mul_of_span_singleton_eq hnzd
    (h2.symm.trans (stalkIdeal_comap_chart C V c' q'))
  have h3 := congrArg (chartGerm (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c')) q')
    (ratio_mul_algebraMap (C.ideal V) c' c)
  rw [map_mul, hvc] at h3
  have h4 : chartGerm _ q' (algebraMap Γ(X, V) _ c') *
      chartGerm _ q' (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c' c) =
      chartGerm _ q' (algebraMap Γ(X, V) _ c') * v :=
    (mul_comm _ _).trans (h3.trans (mul_comm _ _))
  have hr := (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hnzd).mp h4
  have hunit : IsUnit (chartGerm (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c')) q'
      (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c' c)) :=
    (congrArg (fun x => IsUnit x) hr).mpr hv
  have hq : q' ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio
      (C.ideal V) c' c) :=
    (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen _ q').mpr ((isUnit_chartGerm_iff _ q' _).mp hunit)
  rw [← blowUp.chart_preimage_chart C V c' c] at hq
  change (blowUp.chart C V c') q' ∈ blowUp.chart C V c ''ᵁ ⊤
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
  exact hq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.appLE_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem appLE_eq_of_eq {B : Scheme.{u}} (h h' : B ⟶ X) (hh : h = h') (V : X.Opens) (W : B.Opens)
    (e : W ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ V) (s : Γ(X, V)) : h.appLE V W e s = h'.appLE V W (hh ▸ e) s
proof:
:= by
  subst hh; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.germ_appLE_comp_eq
statement:
theorem germ_appLE_comp_eq {T : Scheme.{u}} (π : T ⟶ U) (f : U ⟶ X) (V : X.Opens) (W : T.Opens)
    (e : W ≤ (π ≫ f) ⁻¹ᵁ V) {w : T} (hw : w ∈ W) (hfw : f (π w) ∈ V) (s : Γ(X, V)) :
    T.presheaf.germ W w hw ((π ≫ f).appLE V W e s) =
      π.stalkMap w (f.stalkMap (π w) (X.presheaf.germ V _ hfw s))
proof:
:= by
  have hf := Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE π f V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) W le_rfl e
  rw [← hf, CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE,
    Scheme.Hom.germ_appLE_apply π (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) W e hw hfw, Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.eq_comp_of_forall_gen
statement:
theorem eq_comp_of_forall_gen {B Y : Scheme.{u}} (φ φ' : B ⟶ Y) {A : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (ch : Spec A ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion ch] (W : B.affineOpens)
    (hW : W.1 ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ (ch ''ᵁ ⊤)) (hW' : W.1 ≤ φ' ⁻¹ᵁ (ch ''ᵁ ⊤)) (N : B.IdealSheafData)
    {T : Set A} (hT : Subring.closure T = ⊤)
    (h : ∀ s ∈ T, φ.appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) W.1 hW ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv s)) -
      φ'.appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) W.1 hW' ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv s)) ∈ N.ideal W) :
    (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι ≫ N.subschemeι ≫ φ =
      (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι ≫ N.subschemeι ≫ φ'
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ∀ ψ : B ⟶ Y, W.1 ≤ ψ ⁻¹ᵁ (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) →
      Set.range ((N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι ≫ N.subschemeι ≫ ψ) ⊆ Set.range ch := by
    intro ψ hψ
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hz : N.subschemeι ((N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι z) ∈ W.1 := z.2
    have hmem := hψ hz
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hmem
    exact ⟨y, by rw [hy]; rfl⟩
  have hfa := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac ch _ (hr φ hW)
  have hfa' := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac ch _ (hr φ' hW')
  rw [← hfa, ← hfa']
  congr 1
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_isAffine
  have key : ∀ (ψ : B ⟶ Y) (hψ : W.1 ≤ ψ ⁻¹ᵁ (ch ''ᵁ ⊤)) (y : Γ(Spec A, ⊤)),
      (IsOpenImmersion.lift ch _ (hr ψ hψ)).appTop y =
        (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι.appLE (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) ⊤ (fun x _ => x.2)
          (N.subschemeι.app W.1 (ψ.appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) W.1 hψ ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv y))) := by
    intro ψ hψ y
    set l := IsOpenImmersion.lift ch _ (hr ψ hψ) with hl
    have hlf : l ≫ ch = (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι ≫ N.subschemeι ≫ ψ :=
      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac ch _ (hr ψ hψ)
    have e₁ : (⊤ : (Spec A).Opens) ≤ ch ⁻¹ᵁ (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) := (Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq ch ⊤).ge
    have e₂ : (⊤ : (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 : Scheme).Opens) ≤ l ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := fun _ _ => trivial
    have hc := Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE l ch (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ ⊤ e₁ e₂
    have hy : ch.appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ e₁ ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv y) = y := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom']; simp
    have e₁' : N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 ≤ (N.subschemeι ≫ ψ) ⁻¹ᵁ (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) := fun x hx => hψ hx
    have e₂' : (⊤ : (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 : Scheme).Opens) ≤
        (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) := fun x _ => x.2
    have h0 : l.appTop y = l.appLE ⊤ ⊤ e₂ y := by
      change l.app ⊤ y = _
      rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
      rfl
    calc l.appTop y = l.appLE ⊤ ⊤ e₂ y := h0
      _ = l.appLE ⊤ ⊤ e₂ (ch.appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ e₁ ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv y)) := by rw [hy]
      _ = (l ≫ ch).appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ _ ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv y) := by
          rw [← hc, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
      _ = ((N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι ≫ N.subschemeι ≫ ψ).appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ _
            ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv y) := appLE_eq_of_eq _ _ hlf _ _ _ _
      _ = (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι.appLE (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) ⊤ e₂'
            ((N.subschemeι ≫ ψ).appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) e₁'
              ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv y)) := by
          rw [← Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι (N.subschemeι ≫ ψ) (ch ''ᵁ ⊤)
            (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) ⊤ e₁' e₂', CommRingCat.comp_apply]
      _ = (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι.appLE (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) ⊤ e₂'
            (N.subschemeι.appLE W.1 (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) le_rfl
              (ψ.appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) W.1 hψ ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv y))) := by
          rw [← Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE N.subschemeι ψ (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) W.1 (N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1)
            hψ le_rfl, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
      _ = _ := by rw [← Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
  ext x
  have hx : x = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).hom x) := by simp
  rw [hx, key φ hW, key φ' hW']
  congr 1
  let ρ : A →+* Γ(N.subscheme, N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) :=
    (N.subschemeι.app W.1).hom.comp ((φ.appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) W.1 hW).hom.comp
      ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom))
  let ρ' : A →+* Γ(N.subscheme, N.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) :=
    (N.subschemeι.app W.1).hom.comp ((φ'.appLE (ch ''ᵁ ⊤) W.1 hW').hom.comp
      ((ch.appIso ⊤).inv.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv.hom))
  have hgen := sub_mem_of_forall_mem_closure ρ ρ' ⊥ hT (fun s hs => by
    have hker := h s hs
    rw [← ker_subschemeι_app N W, RingHom.mem_ker] at hker
    rw [Ideal.mem_bot]
    simpa [ρ, ρ', RingHom.comp_apply, map_sub] using hker) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).hom x)
  rw [Ideal.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero] at hgen
  simpa [ρ, ρ', RingHom.comp_apply] using hgen

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comap_eq_exceptionalDivisor
statement:
theorem comap_comap_eq_exceptionalDivisor (f₀ : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData) (J : U.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ₀ : C.comap f₀ = J) (φ : J.blowUp ⟶ C.blowUp)
    (hφ : φ ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀) :
    (C.comap C.blowUpπ).comap φ = J.exceptionalDivisor
proof:
:= by
  change _ = J.comap J.blowUpπ
  rw [← comap_comp, hφ, comap_comp, hJ₀]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkMap_germ_appLE_chart_eq
statement:
theorem stalkMap_germ_appLE_chart_eq (f₀ : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData) (J : U.IdealSheafData)
    (φ : J.blowUp ⟶ C.blowUp)
        (hφ : φ ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀)
        (V : X.affineOpens)
    (c : C.ideal V) {w : J.blowUp} (hw : φ w ∈ (chartOpen C V c).1)
    (hfw : f₀ (J.blowUpπ w) ∈ V.1) (s : Γ(X, V)) :
    φ.stalkMap w (C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V c).1 (φ w) hw
        (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 (chartOpen C V c).1
          (chart_image_top_le C V c) s)) =
      J.blowUpπ.stalkMap w (f₀.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hfw s))
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := Scheme.Hom.germ_appLE_apply φ (chartOpen C V c).1
    (φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1) le_rfl hw hw
    (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 (chartOpen C V c).1
      (chart_image_top_le C V c) s)
  have e2 : φ.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 (φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1)
      le_rfl (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 (chartOpen C V c).1
        (chart_image_top_le C V c) s) =
      (φ ≫ C.blowUpπ).appLE V.1 (φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1)
        (fun x hx => chart_image_top_le C V c hx) s :=
    congrArg (fun ψ : Γ(X, V) ⟶ Γ(J.blowUp, φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1)
      => ψ s) (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE φ C.blowUpπ V.1
        (chartOpen C V c).1 _ (chart_image_top_le C V c) le_rfl)
  have e3 := appLE_eq_of_eq (φ ≫ C.blowUpπ)
      (J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀) hφ V.1
    (φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1)
    (fun x hx => chart_image_top_le C V c hx) s
  rw [← e1, e2, e3, germ_appLE_comp_eq J.blowUpπ f₀ V.1 (φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V
      c).1)
    _ (w := w) hw hfw]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_exceptionalDivisor_eq_span
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_exceptionalDivisor_eq_span (f₀ : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (J : U.IdealSheafData) (hJ₀ : C.comap f₀ = J) (φ : J.blowUp ⟶
        C.blowUp)
    (hφ : φ ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀)
        (V : X.affineOpens) (c : C.ideal V)
    {w : J.blowUp} (hw : φ w ∈ (chartOpen C V c).1)
    (hfw : f₀ (J.blowUpπ w) ∈ V.1) :
    J.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal w =
      Ideal.span
        {J.blowUpπ.stalkMap w (f₀.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hfw c))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comap_comap_eq_exceptionalDivisor f₀ C J hJ₀ φ hφ, stalkIdeal_comap_comap_eq_span C V c φ
      hw,
    stalkMap_germ_appLE_chart_eq f₀ C J φ hφ V c hw hfw]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.eqToHom_comp_blowUpMap_comp_π
statement:
theorem eqToHom_comp_blowUpMap_comp_π (f g : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : C.comap f = C.comap g) :
    (eqToHom (congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp hJ) ≫ Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap g C) ≫
        C.blowUpπ =
      (C.comap f).blowUpπ ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  have h1' : Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap g C ≫ C.blowUpπ = (C.comap g).blowUpπ ≫ g :=
    blowUpMap_π g C
  rw [Category.assoc, h1', ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact eqToHom_comp_blowUpπ hJ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_preimage_comp
statement:
theorem le_preimage_comp (f₀ : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData) (J : U.IdealSheafData)
    (φ : J.blowUp ⟶ C.blowUp)
        (hφ : φ ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀)
        (V : X.affineOpens)
    (c : C.ideal V) (W : J.blowUp.Opens) (hW : W ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ
        (chartOpen C V c).1) :
    W ≤ (J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h1 : C.blowUpπ (φ x) ∈ V.1 := chart_image_top_le C V c (hW hx)
  have h2 : (φ ≫ C.blowUpπ) x = (J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀) x :=
    congrArg (fun h : J.blowUp ⟶ X => h x) hφ
  change (J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀) x ∈ V.1
  rw [← h2, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.appLE_chart_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem appLE_chart_algebraMap_eq (f₀ : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData) (J : U.IdealSheafData)
    (φ : J.blowUp ⟶ C.blowUp)
        (hφ : φ ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀)
        (V : X.affineOpens)
    (c : C.ideal V) (W : J.blowUp.Opens) (hW : W ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1)
    (r : Γ(X, V)) :
    φ.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W hW
        (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
            (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c) r))) =
      (J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀).appLE V.1 W (le_preimage_comp f₀ C J φ hφ V c W hW) r
proof:
:=
          by
  rw [← appLE_chart_eq C V c r]
  have e2 := congrArg (fun ψ : Γ(X, V) ⟶ Γ(J.blowUp, W) => ψ r)
    (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE φ C.blowUpπ V.1 (chartOpen C V c).1 W
      (chart_image_top_le C V c) hW)
  simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply] at e2
  rw [e2]
  exact appLE_eq_of_eq _ _ hφ V.1 W _ r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.appLE_chart_ratio_mul
statement:
theorem appLE_chart_ratio_mul (f₀ : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData) (J : U.IdealSheafData)
    (φ : J.blowUp ⟶ C.blowUp)
        (hφ : φ ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀)
        (V : X.affineOpens)
    (c : C.ideal V) (W : J.blowUp.Opens) (hW : W ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1)
    (b : C.ideal V) :
    φ.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W hW
        (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
            (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c b))) *
      (J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀).appLE V.1 W (le_preimage_comp f₀ C J φ hφ V c W hW) c =
      (J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀).appLE V.1 W (le_preimage_comp f₀ C J φ hφ V c W hW) b
proof:
:=
          by
  have h1 := appLE_chart_algebraMap_eq f₀ C J φ hφ V c W hW c
  have h2 := appLE_chart_algebraMap_eq f₀ C J φ hφ V c W hW b
  have h3 := appIso_inv_ΓSpecIso_inv_ratio_mul C V c b
  calc _ = φ.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W hW
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c b))) *
        φ.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W hW
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c) c))) :=
        congrArg (fun t => φ.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W hW
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c b))) * t) h1.symm
    _ = _ := (map_mul (φ.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W hW).hom _ _).symm
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun t => φ.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W hW t) h3
    _ = _ := h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpens_eq_comp
statement:
theorem exists_affineOpens_eq_comp (f g : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData) (J M : U.IdealSheafData)
    (hJf : C.comap f = J) (hJg : C.comap g = J) (hM : M ≤ J) (hfg : AgreeOn f g M)
    (f' g' : J.blowUp ⟶ C.blowUp)
        (hf' : f' ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ f)
    (hg' : g' ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ g)
        (u : J.blowUp)
    (hu : u ∈ (M.markedTransform J 1).support) :
    ∃ W : J.blowUp.affineOpens, u ∈ W.1 ∧
      ((M.markedTransform J 1).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι ≫ (M.markedTransform J 1).subschemeι ≫ f' =
      ((M.markedTransform J 1).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ W.1).ι ≫ (M.markedTransform J 1).subschemeι ≫ g'
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : J.exceptionalDivisor.IsInvertible :=
    blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π J
  have hπu : J.blowUpπ u ∈ M.support :=
      support_markedTransform_one_subset J M hu
  have hfgu : f (J.blowUpπ u) = g (J.blowUpπ u) :=
      hfg.base_eq hπu
  have hpt : ∀ (f₀ : U ⟶ X) (φ : J.blowUp ⟶ C.blowUp)
      (hφ : φ ≫ C.blowUpπ = J.blowUpπ ≫ f₀)
          (w : J.blowUp),
      C.blowUpπ (φ w) = f₀ (J.blowUpπ w) := by
    intro f₀ φ hφ w
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply φ C.blowUpπ w, hφ, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (f (J.blowUpπ u))
  have hVg : g (J.blowUpπ u) ∈ V.1 := hfgu ▸ hV
  
  have hfu : f' u ∈ C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := by
    change C.blowUpπ (f' u) ∈ V.1
    exact (hpt f f' hf' u).symm ▸ hV
  rw [← blowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart C V, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hfu
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hfu
  have hfc : f' u ∈ (chartOpen C V c).1 := by
    change _ ∈ blowUp.chart C V c ''ᵁ ⊤
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]; exact hc
  
  have hgenF := stalkIdeal_exceptionalDivisor_eq_span f C J hJf f' hf' V c hfc hV
  
  have hgu : C.blowUpπ (g' u) ∈ V.1 := (hpt g g' hg' u).symm ▸ hVg
  have hgu' : g' u ∈ C.blowUpπ ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := hgu
  rw [← blowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart C V, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hgu'
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := hgu'
  have hgc' : g' u ∈ (chartOpen C V c').1 := by
    change _ ∈ blowUp.chart C V c' ''ᵁ ⊤
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]; exact hc'
  have hgenG := stalkIdeal_exceptionalDivisor_eq_span g C J hJg g' hg' V c' hgc' hVg
  have hdef := stalkMap_sub_stalkMap_mem_comap J.blowUpπ f g M hfg V.1 c hπu
      hV hVg
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hed⟩ := exists_mem_markedTransform_mul_eq hM hgenF hdef
  have hΨ : J.blowUpπ.stalkMap u (g.stalkMap _
      (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hVg c)) =
      J.blowUpπ.stalkMap u (f.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hV c)) *
          (1 - d) := by
    linear_combination hed
  have hunit : IsUnit (1 - d) := isUnit_one_sub_of_mem_stalkIdeal _ hu hd
  have hspanΨ : Ideal.span
    {J.blowUpπ.stalkMap u (g.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hVg c))} =
      J.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal u :=
    (congrArg (fun x => Ideal.span {x}) hΨ).trans
      ((Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hunit _).trans hgenF.symm)
  have hθ := appIso_inv_ΓSpecIso_inv_ratio_mul C V c' c
  have hsec : C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 (chartOpen C V c').1
      (chart_image_top_le C V c') c =
      ((blowUp.chart C V c').appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))).inv
          (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c' c)) *
      C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 (chartOpen C V c').1
        (chart_image_top_le C V c') c' :=
    (appLE_chart_eq C V c' c).trans (hθ.symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun t => ((blowUp.chart C V c').appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))).inv
          (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c' c)) * t)
        (appLE_chart_eq C V c' c').symm))
  have hγ : C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V c').1 (g' u) hgc'
      (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 _ (chart_image_top_le C V c') c) =
      C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V c').1 (g' u) hgc'
        (((blowUp.chart C V c').appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))).inv
            (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c' c))) *
      C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V c').1 (g' u) hgc'
        (C.blowUpπ.appLE V.1 _ (chart_image_top_le C V c') c') :=
    (congrArg (fun t => C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V c').1
        (g' u) hgc'
        t)
      hsec).trans (map_mul (C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V c').1 (g' u)
        hgc').hom _ _)
  have hΨc := stalkMap_germ_appLE_chart_eq g C J g' hg' V c' hgc' hVg c
  have hΨc' := stalkMap_germ_appLE_chart_eq g C J g' hg' V c' hgc' hVg c'
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkspan⟩ := hinv.exists_mem_nonZeroDivisors_stalkIdeal_eq_span u
  have hnzd := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_span_singleton_eq hk
    (hgenG.symm.trans hkspan).symm
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvΨ⟩ := exists_isUnit_mul_of_span_singleton_eq hnzd (hspanΨ.trans hgenG)
  have hρunit : IsUnit (C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V c').1
      (g' u) hgc'
      (((blowUp.chart C V c').appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))).inv
          (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c' c)))) := by
    refine (isUnit_map_iff (g'.stalkMap u).hom _).mp ?_
    have h5 : g'.stalkMap u (C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V c').1
        (g' u)
        hgc' (((blowUp.chart C V c').appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))).inv
            (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c' c)))) *
        J.blowUpπ.stalkMap u (g.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hVg c')) =
        v * J.blowUpπ.stalkMap u (g.stalkMap _
            (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hVg c')) :=
      (congrArg (fun t => g'.stalkMap u (C.blowUp.presheaf.germ (chartOpen C V
          c').1
        (g' u) hgc' (((blowUp.chart C V c').appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c'))).inv
            (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c' c)))) * t) hΨc'.symm).trans
        ((map_mul (g'.stalkMap u).hom _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun t => g'.stalkMap u t)
            hγ.symm).trans
          (hΨc.trans hvΨ)))
    have h6 := (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hnzd).mp
      ((mul_comm _ _).trans (h5.trans (mul_comm _ _)))
    exact (congrArg (fun x => IsUnit x) h6).mpr hv
  have hgenp : (C.comap C.blowUpπ).stalkIdeal (g' u) =
      Ideal.span {C.blowUpπ.stalkMap (g' u) (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ hgu c)} :=
    (stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ (chartOpen C V c') hgc').trans
      ((congrArg (Ideal.map _) (ideal_comap_π_chartOpen C V c')).trans
        ((Ideal.map_span _ _).trans ((congrArg Ideal.span Set.image_singleton).trans
          ((Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hρunit _).symm.trans
            ((congrArg (fun x => Ideal.span {x}) hγ.symm).trans
              (congrArg (fun x => Ideal.span {x})
                (Scheme.Hom.germ_appLE_apply C.blowUpπ V.1 _
                  (chart_image_top_le C V c') hgc' hgu c)))))))
  have hgc : g' u ∈ (chartOpen C V c).1 :=
    mem_chartOpen_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span C V c hgu hgenp
  
  have hu2 : u ∈ f' ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1 ⊓
      g' ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1 := ⟨hfc, hgc⟩
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀, huW, hWle⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp (Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens
        J.blowUp) hu2
  refine ⟨⟨W₀, hW₀⟩, huW, ?_⟩
  have hWf : W₀ ≤ f' ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1 := hWle.trans inf_le_left
  have hWg : W₀ ≤ g' ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen C V c).1 := hWle.trans inf_le_right
  have hfV : ∀ w ∈ W₀, f (J.blowUpπ w) ∈ V.1 := fun w hw => by
    rw [← hpt f f' hf' w]; exact chart_image_top_le C V c (hWf hw)
  have hgV : ∀ w ∈ W₀, g (J.blowUpπ w) ∈ V.1 := fun w hw => by
    rw [← hpt g g' hg' w]; exact chart_image_top_le C V c (hWg hw)
  apply eq_comp_of_forall_gen f' g' (blowUp.chart C V c) ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩ hWf hWg
    (M.markedTransform J 1) (subring_closure_chart_generators_eq_top (C.ideal V) c)
  rintro s (⟨r, rfl⟩ | ⟨b, rfl⟩)
  · 
    change f'.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W₀ hWf
        (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
            (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c) r))) -
      g'.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W₀ hWg
        (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
            (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c) r))) ∈
      (M.markedTransform J 1).ideal ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩
    refine (congrArg₂ (fun x y => x - y ∈ (M.markedTransform J 1).ideal ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩)
      (appLE_chart_algebraMap_eq f C J f' hf' V c W₀ hWf r)
      (appLE_chart_algebraMap_eq g C J g' hg' V c W₀ hWg r)).mpr ?_
    apply mem_ideal_of_forall_germ_mem
    intro w hw
    by_cases hws : w ∈ (M.markedTransform J 1).support
    · have hπw : J.blowUpπ w ∈ M.support :=
        support_markedTransform_one_subset J M hws
      have g1 := germ_appLE_comp_eq J.blowUpπ f V.1 W₀
          (le_preimage_comp f C J f' hf' V c W₀
          hWf)
        hw (hfV w hw) r
      have g2 := germ_appLE_comp_eq J.blowUpπ g V.1 W₀
          (le_preimage_comp g C J g' hg' V c W₀
          hWg)
        hw (hgV w hw) r
      rw [map_sub]
      refine (congrArg₂ (fun x y => x - y ∈ (M.markedTransform J 1).stalkIdeal w) g1 g2).mpr ?_
      exact stalkIdeal_mono (comap_blowUpπ_le_markedTransform_one J M) w
        (stalkMap_sub_stalkMap_mem_comap J.blowUpπ f g M hfg V.1 r hπw
            (hfV w hw) (hgV w hw))
    · rw [stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support _ hws]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  · 
    change f'.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W₀ hWf
        (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
            (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c b))) -
      g'.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W₀ hWg
        (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
            (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c b))) ∈
      (M.markedTransform J 1).ideal ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩
    apply mem_ideal_of_forall_germ_mem
    intro w hw
    by_cases hws : w ∈ (M.markedTransform J 1).support
    · have hπw : J.blowUpπ w ∈ M.support :=
        support_markedTransform_one_subset J M hws
      rw [map_sub]
      have hfwc : f' w ∈ (chartOpen C V c).1 := hWf hw
      have hgenw := stalkIdeal_exceptionalDivisor_eq_span f C J hJf f' hf' V c hfwc (hfV w hw)
      have hk0 := hinv.exists_mem_nonZeroDivisors_stalkIdeal_eq_span (X :=
          J.blowUp) w
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hkspan⟩ := hk0
      have he := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_span_singleton_eq hk
        (hgenw.symm.trans hkspan).symm
      have hf1 := congrArg (J.blowUp.presheaf.germ W₀ w hw)
        (appLE_chart_ratio_mul f C J f' hf' V c W₀ hWf b)
      have hg1 := congrArg (J.blowUp.presheaf.germ W₀ w hw)
        (appLE_chart_ratio_mul g C J g' hg' V c W₀ hWg b)
      simp only [map_mul] at hf1 hg1
      have g1c := germ_appLE_comp_eq J.blowUpπ f V.1 W₀
          (le_preimage_comp f C J f' hf' V c W₀
          hWf)
        hw (hfV w hw) c
      have g1b := germ_appLE_comp_eq J.blowUpπ f V.1 W₀
          (le_preimage_comp f C J f' hf' V c W₀
          hWf)
        hw (hfV w hw) b
      have g2c := germ_appLE_comp_eq J.blowUpπ g V.1 W₀
          (le_preimage_comp g C J g' hg' V c W₀
          hWg)
        hw (hgV w hw) c
      have g2b := germ_appLE_comp_eq J.blowUpπ g V.1 W₀
          (le_preimage_comp g C J g' hg' V c W₀
          hWg)
        hw (hgV w hw) b
      have hdc0 := exists_mem_markedTransform_mul_eq hM hgenw
        (stalkMap_sub_stalkMap_mem_comap J.blowUpπ f g M hfg V.1 c hπw
            (hfV w hw) (hgV w hw))
      have hdb0 := exists_mem_markedTransform_mul_eq hM hgenw
        (stalkMap_sub_stalkMap_mem_comap J.blowUpπ f g M hfg V.1 b hπw
            (hfV w hw) (hgV w hw))
      obtain ⟨dc, hdc, hedc⟩ := hdc0
      obtain ⟨db, hdb, hedb⟩ := hdb0
      have hunitc : IsUnit (1 - dc) := isUnit_one_sub_of_mem_stalkIdeal _ hws hdc
      have h1 : J.blowUpπ.stalkMap w (f.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _
          (hfV w hw) c)) *
          (J.blowUp.presheaf.germ W₀ w hw (f'.appLE (chartOpen C V c).1 W₀ hWf
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c
                  b))))) = J.blowUpπ.stalkMap w (f.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ (hfV w hw) b))
                  :=
        (congrArg (fun t => t * (J.blowUp.presheaf.germ W₀ w hw (f'.appLE
            (chartOpen C V c).1 W₀ hWf
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c b)))))) g1c.symm).trans
                  ((mul_comm _ _).trans (hf1.trans g1b))
      have hg1' : (J.blowUp.presheaf.germ W₀ w hw (g'.appLE
          (chartOpen C V c).1
          W₀ hWg
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c
                  b))))) * J.blowUpπ.stalkMap w (g.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ (hgV w hw) c))
                  =
                      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUpπ
                  J).stalkMap w (g.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ (hgV w hw) b)) :=
        (congrArg (fun t => (J.blowUp.presheaf.germ W₀ w hw (g'.appLE
            (chartOpen C V c).1 W₀ hWg
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c b))))) * t) g2c.symm).trans
                  (hg1.trans g2b)
      have h2 : J.blowUpπ.stalkMap w (f.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _
          (hfV w hw) c)) * ((1
          - dc) * (J.blowUp.presheaf.germ W₀ w hw (g'.appLE
              (chartOpen C V c).1
          W₀ hWg
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c
                  b)))))) = J.blowUpπ.stalkMap w (f.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ (hfV w hw) b))
                  -
                      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUpπ
                  J).stalkMap w (f.stalkMap _ (X.presheaf.germ V.1 _ (hfV w hw) c)) * db := by
        linear_combination hg1' + hedb - (J.blowUp.presheaf.germ W₀ w hw
            (g'.appLE
            (chartOpen C V c).1 W₀ hWg
          (((blowUp.chart C V c).appIso ⊤).inv
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (C.ideal V) c))).inv
              (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (C.ideal V) c b))))) * hedc
      have hid := ratio_identity he h1 h2
      have hmem := (congrArg (fun x => x ∈ (M.markedTransform J 1).stalkIdeal w) hid).mpr
        (sub_mem hdb (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hdc))
      exact (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem _ hunitc).mp hmem
    · exact (stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support _ hws).ge Submodule.mem_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.agreeOn_blowUpMap
statement:
theorem agreeOn_blowUpMap (f g : U ⟶ X) (C : X.IdealSheafData) (M : U.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : C.comap f = C.comap g) (hM : M ≤ C.comap f) (hfg : AgreeOn f g M) :
    AgreeOn (Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap f C) (eqToHom (congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp hJ) ≫
        Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap g C)
      (M.markedTransform (C.comap f) 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AgreeOn
  apply hom_ext_of_forall
  intro z
  obtain ⟨W, huW, hW⟩ := exists_affineOpens_eq_comp f g C (C.comap f) M rfl hJ.symm hM hfg
    (Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap f C) (eqToHom (congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp hJ) ≫
        Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap g C)
    (blowUpMap_π f C) (eqToHom_comp_blowUpMap_comp_π f g C hJ) _
    (subschemeι_mem_support _ z)
  exact ⟨_, huW, hW⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.step_agreeOn
statement:
theorem step_agreeOn (ψ ψ' : U ⟶ X) [Flat ψ] [Flat ψ'] (Z Z' : X.IdealSheafData)
    (M : U.IdealSheafData) (hZ : Z.comap ψ = Z'.comap ψ')
    (hsup : (Z.support : Set X) ⊆ Set.range ψ) (hsup' : (Z'.support : Set X) ⊆ Set.range ψ')
    (hM : M ≤ Z.comap ψ) (hfg : AgreeOn ψ ψ' M) :
    ∃ e : Z = Z', AgreeOn (Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap ψ Z)
      (eqToHom (congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp
        (hZ.trans (congrArg (fun W : X.IdealSheafData => W.comap ψ')
            e.symm))) ≫ Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap ψ' Z)
      (M.markedTransform (Z.comap ψ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  have e := eq_of_comap_eq_of_agreeOn_of_le ψ ψ' Z Z' M hZ hsup hsup' hM hfg
  exact ⟨e, agreeOn_blowUpMap ψ ψ' Z M
    (hZ.trans (congrArg (fun W : X.IdealSheafData => W.comap ψ') e.symm)) hM hfg⟩

name: Hironaka.Local.ordElem_mul_of_isUnit
statement: theorem ordElem_mul_of_isUnit {a v : R} (hv : IsUnit v) : ordElem (a * v) = ordElem a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ord_span_singleton, ← ord_span_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.principal_ideal
statement:
theorem principal_ideal (h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (principal h).ideal U = Ideal.span {X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op h}
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofIdealTop_ideal, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_principal
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_principal (h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (x : X) :
    (principal h).stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial h}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ U hxU, principal_ideal, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    X.presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.principal_le_iff
statement:
theorem principal_le_iff (h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (J : X.IdealSheafData) :
    principal h ≤ J ↔ ∀ U : X.affineOpens, X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op h ∈ J.ideal U
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_def, principal_ideal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.principal_one
statement: theorem principal_one : principal (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) = (⊤ : X.IdealSheafData)
proof:
:=
  IdealSheafData.ext (funext fun U => by simp [Ideal.map_top])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_principal
statement:
theorem ord_principal (h : Γ(X, ⊤)) (x : X) :
    (principal h).ord x = ordElem (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, stalkIdeal_principal, ord_span_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_principal
statement:
theorem comap_principal {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (h : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (principal h).comap g = principal (g.appTop h)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ y : Y, ((principal h).comap g).stalkIdeal y =
      (principal (g.appTop h)).stalkIdeal y := fun y => by
    rw [stalkIdeal_comap, stalkIdeal_principal, stalkIdeal_principal, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton]
    congr 2
    exact g.germ_stalkMap_apply ⊤ y trivial h
  exact le_antisymm (le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun y => (key y).le)
    (le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun y => (key y).ge)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.MC_comap_eq_top_of_forall_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem MC_comap_eq_top_of_forall_ord_eq_zero (I : X.IdealSheafData) (m : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ u : U, (MC f I m).ord (U.ι u) = 0) : MC (U.ι ≫ f) (I.comap U.ι) m = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [MC_comap_of_smooth f n U.ι I m]
  refine top_le_iff.mp (le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun u => ?_)
  have h0 : ((MC f I m).comap U.ι).ord u = 0 := (ord_comap_ι (MC f I m) U u).trans (hU u)
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, IsLocalRing.ord_eq_zero_iff] at h0
  rw [h0]
  exact le_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_opens_MC_comap_eq_top_of_ord_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen {y : X | I.ord y < m} := by
    convert (isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I m).isOpen_compl using 1
    ext y
    change I.ord y < m ↔ ¬ (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord y
    exact not_le.symm
  refine ⟨⟨_, hopen⟩, hx, ?_⟩
  exact MC_comap_eq_top_of_forall_ord_eq_zero f n I m _ fun u => ord_MC_eq_zero f n I u.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_mem_ideal_MC_ordElem_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_mem_ideal_MC_ordElem_eq_one (I : X.IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {x : X}
    (hx : I.ord x = m) :
    ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (hxU : x ∈ U.1) (h : Γ(X, U.1)),
      h ∈ (MC f I m).ideal U ∧ ordElem (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU h) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsLocalRing.ord ((MC f I m).stalkIdeal x) = 1 := by
    rw [← ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal]
    exact ord_MC_eq_one f n I hm hx
  have hle : (MC f I m).stalkIdeal x ≤ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    have := (IsLocalRing.le_ord_iff (r := 1)).mp (by rw [h1, Nat.cast_one])
    rwa [pow_one] at this
  have hnle : ¬ (MC f I m).stalkIdeal x ≤ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ^ 2 := by
    intro h2
    have := (IsLocalRing.le_ord_iff (r := 2)).mpr h2
    rw [h1] at this
    have h21 : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  obtain ⟨a, haJ, ha2⟩ := IsConcreteLE.not_le_iff_exists.mp hnle
  have ha1 : ordElem a = 1 := ordElem_eq_one_iff.mpr ⟨hle haJ, ha2⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  let _ : Algebra Γ(X, U.1) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U.1)
  have hloc := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ U hxU] at haJ
  obtain ⟨⟨s, u⟩, hsu⟩ := (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff
    (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk x)).mp haJ
  have hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU u.1) :=
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal u.1).mpr u.2
  refine ⟨U, hxU, s.1, s.2, ?_⟩
  have hs : X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU s.1 = a * X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU u.1 := hsu.symm
  rw [hs, Hironaka.Local.ordElem_mul_of_isUnit hu, ha1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_opens_isSmoothDivisor_comap_principal
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  let U : X.Opens := ⟨{y | ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (principal h).ord y}ᶜ,
    (isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n (principal h) 2).isOpen_compl⟩
  refine ⟨U, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change ¬ ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (principal h).ord x
    rw [ord_principal, hord]
    intro h2
    have h21 : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h2
    omega
  · 
    have key : ∀ u ∈ ((principal h).comap U.ι).support,
        ∃ a : U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk u, a ∈ maximalIdeal _ ∧ a ∉ maximalIdeal _ ^ 2 ∧
          ((principal h).comap U.ι).stalkIdeal u = Ideal.span {a} := by
      intro u hu
      have hstalk := stalkIdeal_comap (principal h) U.ι u
      rw [stalkIdeal_principal, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hstalk
      have hord1 : ((principal h).comap U.ι).ord u = 1 := by
        have hlt : ¬ ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((principal h).comap U.ι).ord u := by
          rw [ord_comap_ι (principal h) U u]
          exact u.2
        have hge : 1 ≤ ((principal h).comap U.ι).ord u := (one_le_ord_iff _ _).mpr hu
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (ne_top_of_lt (not_le.mp hlt))
        rw [← hj] at hlt hge ⊢
        have h1 : 1 ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hge
        have h2 : ¬ 2 ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hlt
        have hj1 : j = 1 := by omega
        rw [hj1, Nat.cast_one]
      have hoa : IsLocalRing.ord (((principal h).comap U.ι).stalkIdeal u) = 1 := by
        rw [← ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal]
        exact hord1
      rw [hstalk, ord_span_singleton] at hoa
      exact ⟨_, (ordElem_eq_one_iff.mp hoa).1,
        (ordElem_eq_one_iff.mp hoa).2, hstalk⟩
    refine ⟨?_, key⟩
    refine isRegular_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_quotient _ fun w hw => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, ha, ha2, hspan⟩ := key w hw
    have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk w) :=
      isRegularLocalRing_stalk (U.ι ≫ f) w
    rw [hspan]
    exact (IsRegularLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton ha ha2).1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_opens_principal_isSmoothDivisor_isMaximalContact
statement:
theorem exists_opens_principal_isSmoothDivisor_isMaximalContact (I : X.IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I.maxOrd = m) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ h : Γ(U, ⊤), IsSmoothDivisor (principal h) ∧
      IsMaximalContact (U.ι ≫ f) (I.comap U.ι) m (principal h)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  
  have top_case : ∀ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U → MC (U.ι ≫ f) (I.comap U.ι) m = ⊤ →
      ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ h : Γ(U, ⊤), IsSmoothDivisor (principal h) ∧
        IsMaximalContact (U.ι ≫ f) (I.comap U.ι) m (principal h) := by
    intro U hxU hMC
    refine ⟨U, hxU, 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [principal_one]
      exact Hironaka.Snc.isSmoothDivisor_top
    · unfold IsMaximalContact
      rw [principal_one, hMC]
  have hxle : I.ord x ≤ m := (le_maxOrd I x).trans hI.le
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hm
  · 
    subst hm0
    refine top_case ⊤ trivial (MC_comap_eq_top_of_forall_ord_eq_zero f n I 0 ⊤ fun u => ?_)
    rw [MC_zero]
    have := (le_maxOrd I ((⊤ : X.Opens).ι u)).trans hI.le
    rw [Nat.cast_zero] at this
    exact le_antisymm this zero_le
  rcases hxle.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · obtain ⟨U, hxU, hMC⟩ := exists_opens_MC_comap_eq_top_of_ord_lt f n I hlt
    exact top_case U hxU hMC
  
  obtain ⟨U₁, hxU₁, h₁, hh₁, hord₁⟩ := exists_mem_ideal_MC_ordElem_eq_one f n I hm heq
  let g : U₁.1.toScheme ⟶ X := U₁.1.ι
  have hg : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (0 + n) (g ≫ f) := inferInstance
  let h₂ : Γ(U₁.1.toScheme, ⊤) := U₁.1.topIso.inv h₁
  let x₀ : U₁.1.toScheme := ⟨x, hxU₁⟩
  have hy : ∀ y : U₁.1.toScheme, g y ∈ U₁.1 := fun y => y.2
  
  have hgerm : ∀ y : U₁.1.toScheme,
      (U₁.1.stalkIso y).hom
          (U₁.1.toScheme.presheaf.germ ⊤ y (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top y) h₂) =
        X.presheaf.germ U₁.1 (g y) (hy y) h₁ := by
    intro y
    have hcomp :=
      Scheme.Opens.germ_stalkIso_hom U₁.1 (V := ⊤) y (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top y)
    have h1 : (U₁.1.stalkIso y).hom
          (U₁.1.toScheme.presheaf.germ ⊤ y (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top y) h₂) =
        X.presheaf.germ (U₁.1.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) (g y)
          ⟨y, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top y, rfl⟩ h₂ :=
      congrArg (fun φ => (ConcreteCategory.hom φ) h₂) hcomp
    rw [h1]
    simp only [h₂, Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv]
    exact X.presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _
  
  have hβ :
      ordElem (U₁.1.toScheme.presheaf.germ ⊤ x₀ (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top x₀) h₂) = 1 := by
    rw [← ordElem_ringEquiv (U₁.1.stalkIso x₀).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv]
    have : (U₁.1.stalkIso x₀).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
        (U₁.1.toScheme.presheaf.germ ⊤ x₀ (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top x₀) h₂) =
          X.presheaf.germ U₁.1 x hxU₁ h₁ :=
      hgerm x₀
    rw [this, hord₁]
  
  have hα : principal h₂ ≤ MC (g ≫ f) (I.comap g) m := by
    rw [MC_comap_of_smooth f n g I m]
    refine le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun y => ?_
    rw [stalkIdeal_principal, stalkIdeal_comap, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    have hmem : X.presheaf.germ U₁.1 (g y) (hy y) h₁ ∈ (MC f I m).stalkIdeal (g y) := by
      rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ U₁ (hy y)]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hh₁
    have hinv : ∀ a, (U₁.1.ι.stalkMap y) ((U₁.1.stalkIso y).hom a) = a := fun a => by
      have h := Scheme.Opens.stalkIso_inv U₁.1 y
      exact h ▸ Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (U₁.1.stalkIso y) a
    convert Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (g.stalkMap y).hom hmem using 1
    rw [← hgerm y]
    exact (hinv _).symm
  
  obtain ⟨V, hx₀V, hVsm⟩ :=
    exists_opens_isSmoothDivisor_comap_principal (g ≫ f) (0 + n) h₂ hβ
  
  let ι' : V.toScheme ⟶ X := V.ι ≫ g
  let e : V.toScheme ≅ ι'.opensRange.toScheme := ι'.isoOpensRange
  have heW : (e.inv ≫ V.ι) ≫ g = ι'.opensRange.ι := by
    rw [Category.assoc]
    exact ι'.isoOpensRange_inv_comp
  refine ⟨ι'.opensRange, ⟨⟨x₀, hx₀V⟩, rfl⟩, (e.inv ≫ V.ι).appTop h₂, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← comap_principal, comap_comp]
    exact hVsm.comap_of_isOpenImmersion e.inv
  · have := IsMaximalContact.comap (g ≫ f) (0 + n) hα (e.inv ≫ V.ι)
    unfold IsMaximalContact at this ⊢
    rw [← comap_comp, ← Category.assoc, heW] at this
    rwa [← comap_principal]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_opens_isSmoothDivisor_isMaximalContact
statement:
theorem exists_opens_isSmoothDivisor_isMaximalContact (I : X.IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I.maxOrd = m) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ H : (U : Scheme.{u}).IdealSheafData, IsSmoothDivisor H ∧
      IsMaximalContact (U.ι ≫ f) (I.comap U.ι) m H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, h, hsm, hmc⟩ := exists_opens_principal_isSmoothDivisor_isMaximalContact f n I hI x
  exact ⟨U, hxU, principal h, hsm, hmc⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_opens_isSmoothDivisor_isDynamicMaximalContact
statement:
theorem exists_opens_isSmoothDivisor_isDynamicMaximalContact (I : X.IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ}
    (hI : I.maxOrd = m) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ H : (U : Scheme.{u}).IdealSheafData, IsSmoothDivisor H ∧
      IsMaximalContact (U.ι ≫ f) (I.comap U.ι) m H ∧
        IsDynamicMaximalContact (U.ι ≫ f) (I.comap U.ι) m H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, H, hsm, hmc⟩ := exists_opens_isSmoothDivisor_isMaximalContact f n I hI x
  refine ⟨U, hxU, H, hsm, hmc, ?_⟩
  intro Y j _ S hS i
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (0 + n) (U.ι ≫ f) := inferInstance
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (0 + (0 + n)) (j ≫ U.ι ≫ f) := inferInstance
  exact Hironaka.Sequence.IsOrderSeq.strictTransformSeq_le_center_of_le_MC (j ≫ U.ι ≫ f)
    (0 + (0 + n)) hm hS (hsm.comap_of_isOpenImmersion j) (hmc.comap (U.ι ≫ f) (0 + n) j) i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_ι_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem comap_ι_eq_of_le {J J' : W.IdealSheafData} {V V₁ : W.Opens} (hle : V ≤ V₁)
    (h : J.comap V₁.ι = J'.comap V₁.ι) : J.comap V.ι = J'.comap V.ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.homOfLE_ι W hle, comap_comp, comap_comp, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.AgreeOn.restrict_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have hι : V.ι = W.homOfLE hle ≫ V₁.ι := (Scheme.homOfLE_ι W hle).symm
  have hM : M.comap V.ι = (M.comap V₁.ι).comap (W.homOfLE hle) := by rw [hι, comap_comp]
  rw [hM]
  have hsq := (isPullback_subschemeι_comap (M.comap V₁.ι) (W.homOfLE hle)).w
  have hsq' : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (φ : (V₁ : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ Y),
      ((M.comap V₁.ι).comap (W.homOfLE hle)).subschemeι ≫ W.homOfLE hle ≫ φ =
        subschemeMap ((M.comap V₁.ι).comap (W.homOfLE hle)) (M.comap V₁.ι) (W.homOfLE hle)
          (le_map_comap _ _) ≫ (M.comap V₁.ι).subschemeι ≫ φ := fun φ => by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hsq, Category.assoc]
  unfold AgreeOn at h ⊢
  rw [hι]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hsq' (V₁.ι ≫ ψ), hsq' (V₁.ι ≫ ψ'), h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_opens_conditions_of_formalAutomorphism
statement:
theorem exists_opens_conditions_of_formalAutomorphism [Smooth f] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (m : ℕ)
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (H H' : X.IdealSheafData) {p : X} (Q : EtaleNbhdPair X p)
    (ha : Function.Bijective (completionMap Q.stalkHom))
    (ha' : Function.Bijective (completionMap Q.stalkHom'))
    (h1 : (H'.completionIdeal p).map (Q.formalAutomorphism ha ha').symm = H.completionIdeal p)
    (h2 : (I.completionIdeal p).map (Q.formalAutomorphism ha ha').symm = I.completionIdeal p)
    (h3 : ∀ i, ((E.component i).completionIdeal p).map (Q.formalAutomorphism ha ha').symm =
      (E.component i).completionIdeal p)
    (h4 : ∀ h, h - (Q.formalAutomorphism ha ha').symm h ∈ (MC f I m).completionIdeal p) :
    ∃ V : Q.W.Opens, Q.q ∈ V ∧ H.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = H'.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') ∧
      I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') ∧
      (∀ i, (E.component i).comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = (E.component i).comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ')) ∧
      AgreeOn (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') (MC ((V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) ≫ f) (I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ)) m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hX : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
  have hW : IsLocallyNoetherian Q.W := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian Q.ψ
  
  have hcomp : (completionMap Q.stalkHom).comp
      ((Q.formalAutomorphism ha ha').symm : Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p) →+* Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p)) =
      completionMap Q.stalkHom' :=
    RingHom.ext fun x => Q.completionMap_stalkHom_formalAutomorphism_symm ha ha' x
  
  have trans : ∀ (J J' : X.IdealSheafData),
      (J'.completionIdeal p).map (Q.formalAutomorphism ha ha').symm = J.completionIdeal p →
      ((J.comap Q.ψ).stalkIdeal Q.q).map (algebraMap _ Ô(Q.W.presheaf.stalk Q.q)) =
        ((J'.comap Q.ψ').stalkIdeal Q.q).map (algebraMap _ Ô(Q.W.presheaf.stalk Q.q)) := by
    intro J J' hJ
    have hJ' : (J'.completionIdeal p).map
        ((Q.formalAutomorphism ha ha').symm : Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p) →+* Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p)) =
        J.completionIdeal p := hJ
    rw [← map_completionMap_stalkHom Q J, ← map_completionMap_stalkHom' Q J',
      ← completionIdeal_eq, ← completionIdeal_eq, ← hJ', Ideal.map_map, hcomp]
  
  obtain ⟨V₁, hqV₁, hV₁⟩ := exists_comap_eq_of_map_adicCompletion_eq (H.comap Q.ψ)
    (H'.comap Q.ψ') Q.q (trans H H' h1)
  obtain ⟨V₂, hqV₂, hV₂⟩ := exists_comap_eq_of_map_adicCompletion_eq (I.comap Q.ψ)
    (I.comap Q.ψ') Q.q (trans I I h2)
  choose V₃ hqV₃ hV₃ using fun i => exists_comap_eq_of_map_adicCompletion_eq
    ((E.component i).comap Q.ψ) ((E.component i).comap Q.ψ') Q.q (trans _ _ (h3 i))
  
  have h4' : ∀ x : Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p),
      completionMap Q.stalkHom x - completionMap Q.stalkHom' x ∈
        ((MC f I m).comap Q.ψ).completionIdeal Q.q := by
    intro x
    have hx := h4 x
    rw [← Q.completionMap_stalkHom_formalAutomorphism_symm ha ha' x, ← map_sub,
      completionIdeal_eq, ← map_completionMap_stalkHom Q]
    rw [completionIdeal_eq] at hx
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx
  obtain ⟨V₄, hqV₄, hV₄⟩ :=
    exists_agreeOn_of_forall_completionMap_sub_mem f Q ((MC f I m).comap Q.ψ) h4'
  
  let V₃' : Q.W.Opens := ⟨⋂ i, (V₃ i : Set Q.W), isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => (V₃ i).isOpen⟩
  have hqV₃' : Q.q ∈ V₃' := Set.mem_iInter.mpr hqV₃
  have hV₃'le : ∀ i, V₃' ≤ V₃ i := fun i => Set.iInter_subset (fun i => (V₃ i : Set Q.W)) i
  refine ⟨V₁ ⊓ V₂ ⊓ V₃' ⊓ V₄, ⟨⟨⟨hqV₁, hqV₂⟩, hqV₃'⟩, hqV₄⟩, ?_, ?_, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [comap_comp, comap_comp]
    exact comap_ι_eq_of_le (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)) hV₁
  · rw [comap_comp, comap_comp]
    exact comap_ι_eq_of_le (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)) hV₂
  · rw [comap_comp, comap_comp]
    exact comap_ι_eq_of_le (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_right.trans (hV₃'le i))) (hV₃ i)
  · rw [MC_comap_of_etale f _ I m, comap_comp]
    exact AgreeOn.restrict_of_le Q.ψ Q.ψ' _ inf_le_right hV₄

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.conditions_restrict_of_le
statement:
theorem conditions_restrict_of_le [Smooth f] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (m : ℕ) (E : DivisorFamily X)
    (H H' : X.IdealSheafData) {p : X} (Q : EtaleNbhdPair X p) {V V₁ : Q.W.Opens} (hle : V ≤ V₁)
    (h1 : H.comap (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = H'.comap (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ'))
    (h2 : I.comap (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = I.comap (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ'))
    (h3 : ∀ i, (E.component i).comap (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = (E.component i).comap (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ'))
    (h4 : AgreeOn (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ) (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ')
      (MC ((V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ) ≫ f) (I.comap (V₁.ι ≫ Q.ψ)) m)) :
    H.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = H'.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') ∧ I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') ∧
      (∀ i, (E.component i).comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = (E.component i).comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ')) ∧
      AgreeOn (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') (MC ((V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) ≫ f) (I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ)) m)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : ∀ W : Q.W.Opens, MC ((W.ι ≫ Q.ψ) ≫ f) (I.comap (W.ι ≫ Q.ψ)) m =
      (MC (Q.ψ ≫ f) (I.comap Q.ψ) m).comap W.ι := by
    intro W
    rw [MC_comap_of_etale f (W.ι ≫ Q.ψ) I m, MC_comap_of_etale f Q.ψ I m, comap_comp]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [comap_comp, comap_comp] at h1 ⊢
    exact comap_ι_eq_of_le hle h1
  · rw [comap_comp, comap_comp] at h2 ⊢
    exact comap_ι_eq_of_le hle h2
  · have h := h3 i
    rw [comap_comp, comap_comp] at h ⊢
    exact comap_ι_eq_of_le hle h
  · rw [hM] at h4 ⊢
    exact AgreeOn.restrict_of_le Q.ψ Q.ψ' _ hle h4

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_etaleEquiv_isAffine
statement:
theorem exists_etaleEquiv_isAffine [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f]
    [QuasiCompact f] (I : X.IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : IsMCInvariant f I m)
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (H H' : X.IdealSheafData) (hH : IsMaximalContact f I m H)
    (hH' : IsMaximalContact f I m H') (hHE : (E.append H).IsSnc) (hH'E : (E.append H').IsSnc) :
    ∃ Q : EtaleEquiv f I m E H H', IsAffine Q.U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsm : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  have hcs : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
  have hS : IsClosed {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} := isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I m
  
  have key : ∀ p : {p : X // IsClosed ({p} : Set X) ∧ p ∈ {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x}},
      ∃ (Q : EtaleNbhdPair X p.1) (V : Q.W.Opens), IsAffineOpen V ∧ Q.q ∈ V ∧
        Q.ψ ≫ f = Q.ψ' ≫ f ∧ H.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = H'.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') ∧
        I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') ∧
        (∀ i, (E.component i).comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) = (E.component i).comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ')) ∧
        AgreeOn (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ') (MC ((V.ι ≫ Q.ψ) ≫ f) (I.comap (V.ι ≫ Q.ψ)) m) := by
    intro p
    obtain ⟨Q, V₁, hqV₁, hf, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ :=
      exists_etaleNbhdPair_conditions f n I hm hI E H H' hH hH' hHE hH'E p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
    obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hqV, hle⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset hqV₁
    obtain ⟨h1', h2', h3', h4'⟩ := conditions_restrict_of_le f I m E H H' Q hle h1 h2 h3 h4
    exact ⟨Q, V, hVaff, hqV, hf, h1', h2', h3', h4'⟩
  choose Q V hVaff hqV hf h1 h2 h3 h4 using key
  
  obtain ⟨t, hcov, hcov'⟩ := exists_finset_subset_biUnion_range f hS Q V hqV
  have hcovι : {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} ⊆
      ⋃ i : {p // p ∈ t}, Set.range ((V i.1).ι ≫ (Q i.1).ψ).base := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcov hx)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hxp⟩
  have hcovι' : {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} ⊆
      ⋃ i : {p // p ∈ t}, Set.range ((V i.1).ι ≫ (Q i.1).ψ').base := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcov' hx)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hxp⟩
  
  have : ∀ i : {p // p ∈ t}, IsAffine ((V i.1).toScheme) := fun i => hVaff i.1
  refine ⟨etaleEquivOfFamily f I m E H H' (fun i : {p // p ∈ t} => (V i.1).toScheme)
    (fun i => (V i.1).ι ≫ (Q i.1).ψ) (fun i => (V i.1).ι ≫ (Q i.1).ψ') hcovι hcovι'
    (fun i => by rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hf]) (fun i => h1 i.1) (fun i => h2 i.1)
    (fun i j => h3 i.1 j) (fun i => h4 i.1), ?_⟩
  change IsAffine (∐ fun i : {p // p ∈ t} => (V i.1).toScheme)
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BlowUpSequence.isMarkedOneSeq_cons_iff
statement:
theorem isMarkedOneSeq_cons_iff (Z : U.IdealSheafData) (rest : BlowUpSequence Z.blowUp)
    (M : U.IdealSheafData) :
    (cons U Z rest).IsMarkedOneSeq M ↔ M ≤ Z ∧ rest.IsMarkedOneSeq
        (M.markedTransform Z 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := i
    exact h ⟨j + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨h0, hr⟩ ⟨_ | j, hi⟩
    · exact h0
    · exact hr ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BlowUpSequence.centersInRange_cons_iff
statement:
theorem centersInRange_cons_iff (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (rest : BlowUpSequence Z.blowUp)
    (ψ : U ⟶ X) :
    (cons X Z rest).CentersInRange ψ ↔
      (Z.support : Set X) ⊆ Set.range ψ ∧ rest.CentersInRange (Scheme.Hom.blowUpMap ψ Z)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := i
    exact h ⟨j + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨h0, hr⟩ ⟨_ | j, hi⟩
    · exact h0
    · exact hr ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BlowUpSequence.centersInRange_eqToHom_comp
statement:
theorem centersInRange_eqToHom_comp (S : BlowUpSequence X) {U' : Scheme.{u}} (e : U' = U)
    (ψ : U ⟶ X) : S.CentersInRange (eqToHom e ≫ ψ) ↔ S.CentersInRange ψ
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rw [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.AgreeOn.mono
statement:
theorem AgreeOn.mono {f g : U ⟶ X} {M J : U.IdealSheafData} (h : M ≤ J) (hfg : AgreeOn f g M) :
    AgreeOn f g J
proof:
:= by
  unfold AgreeOn at hfg ⊢
  rw [← inclusion_subschemeι h, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hfg]

name: Hironaka.Sequence.hasSncWith_of_isSubfamilyVia
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, z, ⟨hz, c, hcinj, hcF⟩, s, hs⟩ := h x hx
  have hmem : ∀ a : F'.ι, x ∈ (F'.component a).support → x ∈ (F.component (σ a)).support :=
    fun a ha => by rw [hσ.2 a]; exact ha
  refine ⟨n, z, ⟨hz, fun a => c ⟨σ a.1, hmem a.1 a.2⟩, fun a a' haa' => ?_, fun a => ?_⟩, s, hs⟩
  · exact Subtype.ext (hσ.1 (congrArg Subtype.val (hcinj haa')))

name: Hironaka.Sequence.isSubfamilyVia_totalTransform
statement:
theorem isSubfamilyVia_totalTransform {F' F : DivisorFamily X} {σ : F'.ι → F.ι}
    (hσ : IsSubfamilyVia F' F σ) (D : X.IdealSheafData) :
    IsSubfamilyVia (F'.totalTransform D) (F.totalTransform D)
      (fun a => toLex (Sum.map σ id (ofLex a)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a a' h => ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · exact ofLex.injective ((hσ.1.sumMap Function.injective_id) (toLex.injective h))
  · rcases ha : ofLex a with e | u
    · have : a = toLex (Sum.inl e) := congrArg toLex ha
      subst this
      change (F.component (σ e)).strictTransform D = (F'.component e).strictTransform D
      rw [hσ.2 e]
    · cases u
      have : a = toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) := congrArg toLex ha
      subst this
      rfl

name: Hironaka.Sequence.exists_isSubfamilyVia_totalTransformSeq
statement:
theorem exists_isSubfamilyVia_totalTransformSeq (S : BlowUpSequence X) {F' F : DivisorFamily X}
    (σ : F'.ι → F.ι) (hσ : IsSubfamilyVia F' F σ) (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) :
    ∃ τ : (S.totalTransformSeq F' i).ι → (S.totalTransformSeq F i).ι,
      IsSubfamilyVia (S.totalTransformSeq F' i) (S.totalTransformSeq F i) τ
proof:
:= by
  induction S with
  | nil _ => exact ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  | cons X D rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := i
    cases j with
    | zero => exact ⟨σ, hσ⟩
    | succ j =>
      exact ih _ (isSubfamilyVia_totalTransform hσ D) ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩

name: Hironaka.Sequence.empty_isSubfamilyVia
statement:
theorem empty_isSubfamilyVia (E : DivisorFamily X) :
    IsSubfamilyVia (DivisorFamily.empty X) E (fun a => a.elim)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a => a.elim, fun a => a.elim⟩

name: Hironaka.Sequence.IsOrderSeq.empty_of_isOrderSeq
statement:
theorem IsOrderSeq.empty_of_isOrderSeq {S : BlowUpSequence X} (h : S.IsOrderSeq f I E m) :
    S.IsOrderSeq f I (DivisorFamily.empty X) m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.1, fun i => ⟨?_, (h.2 i).2⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_isSubfamilyVia_totalTransformSeq S _ (empty_isSubfamilyVia E) i.castSucc
  exact hasSncWith_of_isSubfamilyVia hτ (h.2 i).1

name: Hironaka.Sequence.IsDBalanced.bijOn_pushforward
statement:
theorem IsDBalanced.bijOn_pushforward (H : X.IdealSheafData) (hI : I.IsDBalanced f m)
    (hmax : I.maxOrd = m) (hH : IsSmoothDivisor H) (hE : (E.append H).IsSnc)
    (hMC : IsDynamicMaximalContact f I m H)
    (_hHc : ∀ η ∈ H.support.genericPoints, I.ord η < (m : ℕ∞)) :
    Set.BijOn (fun T : BlowUpSequence H.subscheme => T.pushforward H.subschemeι)
      {T | T.IsOrderGeSeq (H.subschemeι ≫ f) (I.comap H.subschemeι) m (E.comap H.subschemeι)}
      {B | B.IsOrderSeq f I E m}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun T hT => ?_, fun T _ T' _ h => pushforward_injective H.subschemeι h, fun B hB => ?_⟩
  · exact IsDBalanced.isOrderSeq_pushforward f n H I E m T hI hmax hH hE hT
  · have hB : B.IsOrderSeq f I E m := hB
    have hZ : ∀ i : Fin B.length, B.strictTransformSeq H i.castSucc ≤ B.center i :=
      strictTransformSeq_le_center_of_isDynamicMaximalContact f I H m B hMC
        (IsOrderSeq.empty_of_isOrderSeq f I E m hB)
    refine ⟨B.pullback H.subschemeι, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact isOrderGeSeq_pullback_of_strictTransformSeq_le f n I H E m B hH hE hB hZ
    · exact pushforward_pullback_of_strictTransformSeq_le B H.subschemeι
        (by rw [ker_subschemeι]; exact hZ)

name: Hironaka.Sequence.IsDBalanced.bijOn_pushforward_of_isMaximalContact
statement:
theorem IsDBalanced.bijOn_pushforward_of_isMaximalContact (H : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hI : I.IsDBalanced f m) (hmax : I.maxOrd = m) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hH : IsSmoothDivisor H)
    (hE : (E.append H).IsSnc) (hMC : IsMaximalContact f I m H)
    (_hHc : ∀ η ∈ H.support.genericPoints, I.ord η < (m : ℕ∞)) :
    Set.BijOn (fun T : BlowUpSequence H.subscheme => T.pushforward H.subschemeι)
      {T | T.IsOrderGeSeq (H.subschemeι ≫ f) (I.comap H.subschemeι) m (E.comap H.subschemeι)}
      {B | B.IsOrderSeq f I E m}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun T hT => ?_, fun T _ T' _ h => pushforward_injective H.subschemeι h, fun B hB => ?_⟩
  · exact IsDBalanced.isOrderSeq_pushforward f n H I E m T hI hmax hH hE hT
  · have hB : B.IsOrderSeq f I E m := hB
    have hZ : ∀ i : Fin B.length, B.strictTransformSeq H i.castSucc ≤ B.center i := fun i =>
      IsOrderSeq.strictTransformSeq_le_center_of_le_MC f n hm hB hH hMC i
    refine ⟨B.pullback H.subschemeι, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact isOrderGeSeq_pullback_of_strictTransformSeq_le f n I H E m B hH hE hB hZ
    · exact pushforward_pullback_of_strictTransformSeq_le B H.subschemeι
        (by rw [ker_subschemeι]; exact hZ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.symm_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem symm_mem_maximalIdeal_iff {d : ℕ}
    (Φ : letI := f.stalkAlgebra p
      MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk p)) ≃ₐ[k] Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p))
    (x : Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p)) :
    letI
proof:
:= f.stalkAlgebra p
    haveI : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := f.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
    Φ.symm x ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk p))) ↔
      x ∈ maximalIdeal Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p) := by
  let _ := f.stalkAlgebra p
  have hsm : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  have hloc : IsLocallyNoetherian X := f.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
  rw [← comap_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv Φ.toRingEquiv, Ideal.mem_comap]
  change Φ (Φ.symm x) ∈ _ ↔ _
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_adicCompletion
proof:
:= SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := f.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
    algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk p) Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p) x ∈
      maximalIdeal Ô(X.presheaf.stalk p) := by
  have hsm : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  have hloc : IsLocallyNoetherian X := f.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
