name: Hironaka.Sequence.coe_support_strictTransform
statement:
theorem coe_support_strictTransform [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (D J : X.IdealSheafData) :
    ((J.strictTransform D).support : Set D.blowUp) =
      closure (D.blowUpπ ⁻¹' (J.support : Set X) \ D.blowUpπ ⁻¹'
          (D.support : Set X))
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian D.blowUp := blowUp.isLocallyNoetherian D
  change (((J.comap D.blowUpπ).saturate (D.comap D.blowUpπ)).support :
    Set D.blowUp) = _
  rw [coe_support_saturate, support_comap, support_comap]
  rfl

name: Hironaka.Sequence.support_totalTransform_eq
statement:
theorem support_totalTransform_eq [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : DivisorFamily X)
    (D : X.IdealSheafData) :
    (F.totalTransform D).support =
      F.support.preimage D.blowUpπ.continuous ⊔
        D.support.preimage D.blowUpπ.continuous
proof:
:= by
  apply Closeds.ext
  rw [DivisorFamily.coe_support_eq_iUnion, Closeds.coe_sup]
  change (⋃ i : (F.totalTransform D).ι, (((F.totalTransform D).component i).support :
      Set D.blowUp)) =
    D.blowUpπ ⁻¹' (F.support : Set X) ∪ D.blowUpπ ⁻¹' (D.support : Set X)
  ext x'
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_preimage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases i with j | _
    · left
      change x' ∈ (((F.component j).strictTransform D).support : Set D.blowUp) at hi
      rw [coe_support_strictTransform] at hi
      have hcl : IsClosed (D.blowUpπ ⁻¹' ((F.component j).support : Set X)) :=
        (F.component j).support.isClosed.preimage D.blowUpπ.continuous
      have hx' := (hcl.closure_subset_iff.mpr Set.sdiff_subset) hi
      rw [DivisorFamily.coe_support_eq_iUnion]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hx'⟩
    · right
      change x' ∈ ((D.comap D.blowUpπ).support : Set D.blowUp) at hi
      rw [support_comap] at hi
      exact hi
  · intro h
    by_cases hD : D.blowUpπ x' ∈ (D.support : Set X)
    · refine ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), ?_⟩
      change x' ∈ ((D.comap D.blowUpπ).support : Set D.blowUp)
      rw [support_comap]
      exact hD
    · rcases h with hF | hD'
      · rw [DivisorFamily.coe_support_eq_iUnion] at hF
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hF
        refine ⟨toLex (Sum.inl j), ?_⟩
        change x' ∈ (((F.component j).strictTransform D).support : Set D.blowUp)
        rw [coe_support_strictTransform]
        exact subset_closure ⟨hj, hD⟩
      · exact absurd hD' hD

name: Hironaka.Sequence.unionIdeal_totalTransform
statement:
theorem unionIdeal_totalTransform [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : DivisorFamily X)
    (D : X.IdealSheafData) :
    (F.totalTransform D).unionIdeal = F.unionIdeal.reducedTransform D
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => unfold DivisorFamily.unionIdeal
  rw [support_totalTransform_eq]
  unfold reducedTransform
  rw [support_unionIdeal]

name: Hironaka.Sequence.boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq_aux
statement:
theorem boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq_aux {X : Scheme.{u}} (S : BlowUpSequence X)
    (hX : IsLocallyNoetherian X) (F : DivisorFamily X) (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) :
    S.boundarySeq F.unionIdeal i = (S.totalTransformSeq F i).unionIdeal
proof:
:= by
  induction S with
  | nil Y => rfl
  | cons Y D rest ih =>
    rcases i with ⟨_ | j, hi⟩
    · rfl
    · have hY : IsLocallyNoetherian D.blowUp := blowUp.isLocallyNoetherian D
      change rest.boundarySeq (F.unionIdeal.reducedTransform D) ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩ =
        (rest.totalTransformSeq (F.totalTransform D) ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩).unionIdeal
      rw [← unionIdeal_totalTransform]
      exact ih hY (F.totalTransform D) ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩

name: Hironaka.Sequence.boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq
statement:
theorem boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (S : BlowUpSequence X) (F : DivisorFamily X) (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) :
    S.boundarySeq F.unionIdeal i = (S.totalTransformSeq F i).unionIdeal
proof:
:=
  boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq_aux S inferInstance F i

name: Hironaka.Sequence.boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq_componentFamily
statement:
theorem boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq_componentFamily [IsNoetherian X]
    (S : BlowUpSequence X) (E : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced E.subscheme]
    (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) :
    S.boundarySeq E i = (S.totalTransformSeq E.componentFamily i).unionIdeal
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← unionIdeal_componentFamily_of_isReduced E]
  exact boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq S E.componentFamily i

name: Hironaka.Sequence.support_finset_prod
statement:
theorem support_finset_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (I : ι → X.IdealSheafData) :
    (∏ j ∈ s, I j).support = ⨆ j ∈ s, (I j).support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s has ih => rw [Finset.prod_insert has, support_mul, ih, Finset.iSup_insert]

name: Hironaka.Sequence.unionIdeal_eq_radical_prod
statement:
theorem unionIdeal_eq_radical_prod (F : DivisorFamily X) :
    F.unionIdeal = (∏ j, F.component j).radical
proof:
:= by
  unfold DivisorFamily.unionIdeal
  rw [← vanishingIdeal_support, support_finset_prod]
  congr 1
  change (⨆ j, (F.component j).support) = ⨆ j ∈ Finset.univ, (F.component j).support
  simp

name: Hironaka.Sequence.stalkIdeal_le_stalkIdeal_radical
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_le_stalkIdeal_radical (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X) :
    I.stalkIdeal x ≤ I.radical.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_mono I.le_radical x

name: Hironaka.Sequence.stalkIdeal_radical_le
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_radical_le (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X) :
    I.radical.stalkIdeal x ≤ (I.stalkIdeal x).radical
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hx⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ I.radical U hx, stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ I U hx]
  change Ideal.map _ (I.ideal U).radical ≤ _
  exact Ideal.map_radical_le _

name: Hironaka.Sequence.minimalPrimes_stalkIdeal_radical
statement:
theorem minimalPrimes_stalkIdeal_radical (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X) :
    (I.radical.stalkIdeal x).minimalPrimes = (I.stalkIdeal x).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.radical_minimalPrimes, ← Ideal.radical_minimalPrimes (I := I.stalkIdeal x)]
  congr 1
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Ideal.radical_le_radical_iff.mpr (stalkIdeal_radical_le I x)
  · exact Ideal.radical_mono (stalkIdeal_le_stalkIdeal_radical I x)

name: Hironaka.Sequence.prime_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  have hZ' : Z.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span (z '' ↑({j} : Finset (Fin n))) := by
    rw [hZ]; simp
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Z.stalkIdeal x) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_quotient_stalkIdeal_of_eq_span hrs hZ'
  have hdom : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Z.stalkIdeal x) := inferInstance
  rw [hZ] at hdom
  have hprime : (Ideal.span {z j}).IsPrime := (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp hdom
  have hne : z j ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := (mem_maximalIdeal_and_notMem_sq_of_span_eq hrs j).2
    rw [h0] at this
    exact this (Ideal.zero_mem _)
  exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hne).mp hprime

name: Hironaka.Sequence.HasSncWith.isSncBoundaryWith_unionIdeal
statement:
theorem HasSncWith.isSncBoundaryWith_unionIdeal (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    {F : DivisorFamily X} {Z : X.IdealSheafData} (h : F.HasSncWith Z) :
    IsSncBoundaryWith F.unionIdeal Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, z, ⟨hrs, c, hcinj, hc⟩, s, hs⟩ := h x hx
  refine ⟨n, z, hrs, ?_, s, hs⟩
  intro P hP
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f x
  change P ∈ (F.unionIdeal.stalkIdeal x).minimalPrimes at hP
  rw [unionIdeal_eq_radical_prod, minimalPrimes_stalkIdeal_radical,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_finset_prod, prod_stalkIdeal_eq_span c hc] at hP
  obtain ⟨i, -, hPi⟩ := minimalPrimes_span_prod
    (fun i _ => prime_of_stalkIdeal_eq_span hrs (hc i)) hP
  exact ⟨c i, hPi⟩

name: Hironaka.Sequence.IsSnc.isSncBoundary_unionIdeal
statement:
theorem IsSnc.isSncBoundary_unionIdeal (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    {F : DivisorFamily X} (h : F.IsSnc) : IsSncBoundary F.unionIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : F.HasSncWith ⊥ := by
    intro x _
    obtain ⟨n, z, hz⟩ := h.2 x
    refine ⟨n, z, hz, ∅, ?_⟩
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_bot]
    simp
  exact HasSncWith.isSncBoundaryWith_unionIdeal f hZ

name: Hironaka.Sequence.HasSncWith.isSncBoundaryWith_boundarySeq
statement:
theorem HasSncWith.isSncBoundaryWith_boundarySeq (hS : S.IsSmooth f) (i : Fin S.length)
    (h : (S.totalTransformSeq E.componentFamily i.castSucc).HasSncWith (S.center i)) :
    IsSncBoundaryWith (S.boundarySeq E i.castSucc) (S.center i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq_componentFamily]
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (S.stageMap i.castSucc ≫ f) :=
    IsSmooth.stageMap_smoothOfRelativeDimension hS i.castSucc
  have : Smooth (S.stageMap i.castSucc ≫ f) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n _
  exact HasSncWith.isSncBoundaryWith_unionIdeal (S.stageMap i.castSucc ≫ f) h

name: Hironaka.Sequence.IsOrderSeq.isSncBoundaryWith_boundarySeq
proof:
:=
  HasSncWith.isSncBoundaryWith_boundarySeq f n E h.1 i (h.2 i).1

name: Hironaka.Monomial.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_of_isRegular_subscheme
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_of_isRegular_subscheme
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {D : X.IdealSheafData} (hD : IsRegular D.subscheme) {η x : X}
    (hη : η ∈ D.support.genericPoints) (hηx : η ⤳ x) :
    (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal x = D.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ D.support := hηx.mem_closed D.support.isClosed hη.1
  have hmin := Hironaka.Sequence.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes D hη hηx
  have := Hironaka.Sequence.isPrime_stalkIdeal_of_isRegular _ hD hx
  rwa [Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hmin

name: Hironaka.Monomial.finprod_stalk_eq_of_specializes_of_isRegular_subscheme
statement:
theorem finprod_stalk_eq_of_specializes_of_isRegular_subscheme
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {D : X.IdealSheafData} (hD : IsRegular D.subscheme) {η₀ x : X}
    (hη₀ : η₀ ∈ D.support.genericPoints) (h₀ : η₀ ⤳ x) (a : X → ℕ) :
    ∏ᶠ η ∈ D.support.genericPoints, ((IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure
        {η})).stalkIdeal x) ^ a η =
      (D.stalkIdeal x) ^ a η₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [finprod_mem_def, finprod_eq_single _ η₀]
  · rw [Set.mulIndicator_of_mem hη₀,
      Hironaka.Monomial.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_of_isRegular_subscheme hD hη₀ h₀]
  · intro η hne
    by_cases hη : η ∈ D.support.genericPoints
    · rw [Set.mulIndicator_of_mem hη]
      have hnot : ¬ η ⤳ x := fun hηx => hne
        (Hironaka.Sequence.eq_of_stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq hηx h₀
          ((Hironaka.Monomial.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_of_isRegular_subscheme hD hη
            hηx).trans
            (Hironaka.Monomial.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_of_isRegular_subscheme hD hη₀
              h₀).symm))
      rw [stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_top_of_not_specializes hnot, Ideal.top_pow]
      exact Ideal.one_eq_top.symm
    · exact Set.mulIndicator_of_notMem hη _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.notMem_support_of_ne_of_isSnc
proof:
:= by
  intro hj
  have hi : η ∈ (E.component i).support := hη.1
  obtain ⟨n, z, hrs, c, hc, hstalk⟩ := hE.2 η
  have hi' : (E.component i).stalkIdeal η = span {z (c ⟨i, hi⟩)} := hstalk ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hne : c ⟨i, hi⟩ ≠ c ⟨j, hj⟩ := fun h => hji (congrArg Subtype.val (hc h)).symm
  have hmem : z (c ⟨j, hj⟩) ∈ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk η) :=
    (mem_maximalIdeal_and_notMem_sq_of_span_eq hrs _).1
  have hmax : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk η) = (E.component i).stalkIdeal η := by
    rw [← stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_self η]
    exact Hironaka.Monomial.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_of_isRegular_subscheme (hE.1 i) hη
      (specializes_refl η)
  rw [hmax, hi', Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
  exact not_dvd_of_ne hrs.1.symm hrs.2 hne hmem

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSmoothDivisor_component_of_isSnc
statement:
theorem isSmoothDivisor_component_of_isSnc (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] {F : DivisorFamily X}
    (hF : F.IsSnc) (j : F.ι) : IsSmoothDivisor (F.component j)
proof:
:=
  isSmoothDivisor_of_snc_data F.component hF.1 (fun x => hF.2 x)
    (fun x => isRegularLocalRing_stalk f x) j

name: Hironaka.Snc.isInvertible_of_isSmoothDivisor
statement:
theorem isInvertible_of_isSmoothDivisor (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    {D : X.IdealSheafData} (hD : IsSmoothDivisor D) : D.IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  have := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_of_forall_stalkIdeal_eq_span D fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx : x ∈ D.support
  · obtain ⟨a, _, ha2, hDa⟩ := hD.2 x hx
    have := isRegularLocalRing_stalk f x
    refine ⟨a, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ?_, hDa⟩
    rintro rfl
    exact ha2 (Ideal.zero_mem _)
  · exact ⟨1, (nonZeroDivisors _).one_mem, by
      rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support D hx, Ideal.span_singleton_one]⟩

name: Hironaka.Snc.IsSnc.isInvertible_component
statement:
theorem IsSnc.isInvertible_component (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    {F : DivisorFamily X} (hF : F.IsSnc) (j : F.ι) : (F.component j).IsInvertible
proof:
:=
  isInvertible_of_isSmoothDivisor f (isSmoothDivisor_component_of_isSnc f hF j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsIdealOfSncDivisor.isInvertible
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsIdealOfSncDivisor.isInvertible
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] {I : X.IdealSheafData} (h : IsIdealOfSncDivisor I) :
    I.IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, a, hF, rfl⟩ := h
  exact Finset.prod_induction (fun j => F.component j ^ a j) Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible
    (fun _ _ h₁ h₂ => h₁.mul h₂)
    (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_eq_top]; exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_top)
    (fun j _ => Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_pow (IsSnc.isInvertible_component f hF j) (a j))

name: Hironaka.Sequence.fromSpec_primeAt
statement:
theorem fromSpec_primeAt {η : X} (hη : η ∈ U.1) :
    (U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).fromSpec (primeAt U hη) = η
proof:
:=
  (U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨η, hη⟩

name: Hironaka.Sequence.primeAt_le_iff_specializes
statement:
theorem primeAt_le_iff_specializes {η x : X} (hη : η ∈ U.1) (hx : x ∈ U.1) :
    primeAt U hη ≤ primeAt U hx ↔ η ⤳ x
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := h.map hU.fromSpec.continuous
    rwa [fromSpec_primeAt, fromSpec_primeAt] at h'
  · intro h
    have h' : hU.fromSpec (primeAt U hη) ⤳ hU.fromSpec (primeAt U hx) := by
      rwa [fromSpec_primeAt, fromSpec_primeAt]
    exact hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp h'

name: Hironaka.Sequence.mem_support_iff_le_primeAt
statement:
theorem mem_support_iff_le_primeAt (E : X.IdealSheafData) {η : X} (hη : η ∈ U.1) :
    η ∈ E.support ↔ E.ideal U ≤ (primeAt U hη).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_support_iff_of_mem hη, mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf U hη]
  rfl

name: Hironaka.Sequence.vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton_ideal
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton_ideal {η : X} (hη : η ∈ U.1) :
    (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).ideal U = (primeAt U hη).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  rw [vanishingIdeal_ideal]
  have h1 : (⇑hU.fromSpec ⁻¹' ((Closeds.closure {η} : Closeds X) : Set X)) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ((primeAt U hη).asIdeal : Set Γ(X, U)) := by
    ext q
    change hU.fromSpec q ∈ closure {η} ↔ ((primeAt U hη).asIdeal : Set Γ(X, U)) ⊆ q.asIdeal
    constructor
    · intro hq
      have h1 : η ⤳ hU.fromSpec q := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hq
      have h2 : hU.fromSpec (primeAt U hη) ⤳ hU.fromSpec q := by rwa [fromSpec_primeAt]
      exact (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr
        (hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp h2)
    · intro hq
      have h1 : primeAt U hη ⤳ q := (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hq
      have h2 := h1.map hU.fromSpec.continuous
      rw [fromSpec_primeAt] at h2
      exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h2
  exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal h1).trans
    (by rw [PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, (primeAt U hη).isPrime.radical])

name: Hironaka.Sequence.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton (U : X.affineOpens) {η x : X} (hη : η ∈ U.1)
    (hx : x ∈ U.1) :
    (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal x =
      ((primeAt U hη).asIdeal).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hx).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ U hx, vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton_ideal]

name: Hironaka.Sequence.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  have hηU : η ∈ U.1 := hηx.mem_open U.1.2 hxU
  let := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U.1)
  have hloc := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  have hyx : primeAt U hηU ≤ primeAt U hxU := (primeAt_le_iff_specializes U hηU hxU).mpr hηx
  have hdisj : Disjoint ((primeAt U hxU).asIdeal.primeCompl : Set Γ(X, U))
      ((primeAt U hηU).asIdeal : Set Γ(X, U)) :=
    Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun a ha hay => ha (hyx hay)
  have hW : (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal x =
      (primeAt U hηU).asIdeal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton U hηU hxU
  have hE : E.stalkIdeal x = (E.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ E U hxU
  have hEy : E.ideal U ≤ (primeAt U hηU).asIdeal := (mem_support_iff_le_primeAt U E hηU).mp hη.1
  rw [hW, hE]
  refine ⟨⟨IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint _ _ _ (primeAt U hηU).isPrime hdisj,
    Ideal.map_mono hEy⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro Q ⟨hQ, hEQ⟩ hQy
  have hQ' : Q.IsPrime := hQ
  have hqprime : (Ideal.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) Q).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  have hqy : Ideal.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) Q ≤ (primeAt U hηU).asIdeal := by
    have h1 := Ideal.comap_mono (f := algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) hQy
    have h2 := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint _ (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (primeAt U hηU).isPrime hdisj
    change Ideal.under Γ(X, U) Q ≤ Ideal.under Γ(X, U) _ at h1
    rwa [h2] at h1
  have hEq : E.ideal U ≤ Ideal.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) Q :=
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hEQ
  let ξ := hU.fromSpec (⟨_, hqprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U))
  have hξU : ξ ∈ (U.1 : Set X) := by
    rw [← hU.range_fromSpec]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hξq : primeAt U hξU = ⟨_, hqprime⟩ :=
    hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective (fromSpec_primeAt U hξU)
  have hξE : ξ ∈ E.support := (mem_support_iff_le_primeAt U E hξU).mpr (by rw [hξq]; exact hEq)
  have hξη : ξ ⤳ η := (primeAt_le_iff_specializes U hξU hηU).mp (by rw [hξq]; exact hqy)
  have hξeq : ξ = η := hη.2 hξE hξη
  have hqeq : (⟨_, hqprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U)) = primeAt U hηU := by
    apply hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    rw [fromSpec_primeAt]
    exact hξeq
  have hQmap : Ideal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (Ideal.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) Q) = Q :=
    IsLocalization.map_under (primeAt U hxU).asIdeal.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk x) Q
  rw [← hQmap]
  exact Ideal.map_mono (le_of_eq (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hqeq).symm)

name: Hironaka.Sequence.exists_mem_genericPoints_of_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem exists_mem_genericPoints_of_mem_minimalPrimes (E : X.IdealSheafData) {x : X}
    {P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)} (hP : P ∈ (E.stalkIdeal x).minimalPrimes) :
    ∃ η ∈ E.support.genericPoints, η ⤳ x ∧
      (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal x = P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  let := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U.1)
  have hloc := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  have hPprime : P.IsPrime := hP.1.1
  have hEP : E.stalkIdeal x ≤ P := hP.1.2
  have hE : E.stalkIdeal x = (E.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ E U hxU
  have hpprime : (Ideal.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) P).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  have hpx : Ideal.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) P ≤ (primeAt U hxU).asIdeal := by
    intro a ha
    by_contra hna
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) a) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (⟨a, hna⟩ : (primeAt U hxU).asIdeal.primeCompl)
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hPprime.ne_top ha) hu
  have hpmap : Ideal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (Ideal.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) P) = P :=
    IsLocalization.map_under (primeAt U hxU).asIdeal.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk x) P
  have hEp : E.ideal U ≤ Ideal.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) P :=
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp (hE ▸ hEP)
  let η := hU.fromSpec (⟨_, hpprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U))
  have hηU : η ∈ (U.1 : Set X) := by
    rw [← hU.range_fromSpec]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hηp : primeAt U hηU = ⟨_, hpprime⟩ :=
    hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective (fromSpec_primeAt U hηU)
  have hηE : η ∈ E.support := (mem_support_iff_le_primeAt U E hηU).mpr (by rw [hηp]; exact hEp)
  have hηx : η ⤳ x := (primeAt_le_iff_specializes U hηU hxU).mp (by rw [hηp]; exact hpx)
  refine ⟨η, ⟨hηE, fun ξ hξE hξη => ?_⟩, hηx, ?_⟩
  · have hξU : ξ ∈ U.1 := hξη.mem_open U.1.2 hηU
    have hqp : primeAt U hξU ≤ primeAt U hηU := (primeAt_le_iff_specializes U hξU hηU).mpr hξη
    rw [hηp] at hqp
    have hEq : E.ideal U ≤ (primeAt U hξU).asIdeal := (mem_support_iff_le_primeAt U E hξU).mp hξE
    have hdisjq : Disjoint ((primeAt U hxU).asIdeal.primeCompl : Set Γ(X, U))
        ((primeAt U hξU).asIdeal : Set Γ(X, U)) :=
      Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun a ha haq => ha (hpx (hqp haq))
    have hQ : ((primeAt U hξU).asIdeal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x))).IsPrime :=
      IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint _ _ _ (primeAt U hξU).isPrime hdisjq
    have hEQ : E.stalkIdeal x ≤
        (primeAt U hξU).asIdeal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
      rw [hE]
      exact Ideal.map_mono hEq
    have hQP : (primeAt U hξU).asIdeal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ≤ P := by
      rw [← hpmap]
      exact Ideal.map_mono hqp
    have hPQ : P ≤ (primeAt U hξU).asIdeal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
      hP.2 ⟨hQ, hEQ⟩ hQP
    have h1 := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint _ (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (primeAt U hξU).isPrime hdisjq
    rw [le_antisymm hQP hPQ] at h1
    have hqeq : primeAt U hξU = ⟨_, hpprime⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.ext h1.symm
    rw [← fromSpec_primeAt U hξU, hqeq]
  · rw [stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton U hηU hxU, hηp]
    exact hpmap

name: Hironaka.Sequence.eq_of_stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq {η η' x : X} (hηx : η ⤳ x) (hη'x : η' ⤳ x)
    (h : (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal x =
      (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η'})).stalkIdeal x) : η = η'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  have hηU : η ∈ U.1 := hηx.mem_open U.1.2 hxU
  have hη'U : η' ∈ U.1 := hη'x.mem_open U.1.2 hxU
  let := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U.1)
  have hloc := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  have hW : (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal x =
      (primeAt U hηU).asIdeal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton U hηU hxU
  have hW' : (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η'})).stalkIdeal x =
      (primeAt U hη'U).asIdeal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_singleton U hη'U hxU
  rw [hW, hW'] at h
  have hdisj : ∀ {ζ : X} (hζU : ζ ∈ U.1), ζ ⤳ x →
      Disjoint ((primeAt U hxU).asIdeal.primeCompl : Set Γ(X, U))
        ((primeAt U hζU).asIdeal : Set Γ(X, U)) := fun hζU hζx =>
    Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun a ha haq =>
      ha ((primeAt_le_iff_specializes U hζU hxU).mpr hζx haq)
  have h1 := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint _ (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (primeAt U hηU).isPrime (hdisj hηU hηx)
  have h2 := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint _ (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (primeAt U hη'U).isPrime (hdisj hη'U hη'x)
  have hp : primeAt U hηU = primeAt U hη'U := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    rw [← h1, ← h2, h]
  rw [← fromSpec_primeAt U hηU, ← fromSpec_primeAt U hη'U, hp]

name: Hironaka.Sequence.componentFamily_isSncAt_iff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hrs, c, -, hc⟩
    refine ⟨hrs, fun P hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηx, hW⟩ := exists_mem_genericPoints_of_mem_minimalPrimes E hP
    have hxη : x ∈ (E.componentFamily.component ⟨η, hη⟩).support := by
      change x ∈ (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).support
      rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_support_vanishingIdeal]
      exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hηx
    refine ⟨c ⟨⟨η, hη⟩, hxη⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hW]
    exact hc ⟨⟨η, hη⟩, hxη⟩
  · rintro ⟨hrs, hmin⟩
    refine ⟨hrs, ?_⟩
    have hspec : ∀ η : {i : E.componentFamily.ι // x ∈ (E.componentFamily.component i).support},
        η.1.1 ⤳ x := by
      intro η
      have := η.2
      change x ∈ (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η.1.1})).support at this
      rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_support_vanishingIdeal] at this
      exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr this
    have key : ∀ η : {i : E.componentFamily.ι // x ∈ (E.componentFamily.component i).support},
        ∃ i : Fin n, (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η.1.1})).stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {z i} :=
      fun η => hmin _ (stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes E η.1.2 (hspec η))
    choose c hc using key
    refine ⟨c, fun η η' hηη' => ?_, hc⟩
    have heq : (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η.1.1})).stalkIdeal x =
        (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η'.1.1})).stalkIdeal x := by
      rw [hc η, hc η', hηη']
    have hpt : η.1.1 = η'.1.1 :=
      eq_of_stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq (hspec η) (hspec η') heq
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hpt)

name: Hironaka.Sequence.isSncBoundaryWith_iff_hasSncWith_componentFamily
statement:
theorem isSncBoundaryWith_iff_hasSncWith_componentFamily [NoetherianSpace X]
    (_f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (E D : X.IdealSheafData) :
    IsSncBoundaryWith E D ↔ E.componentFamily.HasSncWith D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    obtain ⟨n, z, hrs, hmin, s, hs⟩ := h x hx
    exact ⟨n, z, (componentFamily_isSncAt_iff E x z).mpr ⟨hrs, hmin⟩, s, hs⟩
  · intro h x hx
    obtain ⟨n, z, hz, s, hs⟩ := h x hx
    obtain ⟨hrs, hmin⟩ := (componentFamily_isSncAt_iff E x z).mp hz
    exact ⟨n, z, hrs, hmin, s, hs⟩

name: Hironaka.Sequence.isSncBoundary_iff_isSnc_componentFamily
statement:
theorem isSncBoundary_iff_isSnc_componentFamily [NoetherianSpace X]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (E : X.IdealSheafData) :
    IsSncBoundary E ↔ E.componentFamily.IsSnc
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun η => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
    · apply isRegular_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_quotient
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨n, z, hrs, hmin, -, -⟩ := h w (by rw [support_bot]; trivial)
      have hwη : η.1 ⤳ w := by
        change w ∈ (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η.1})).support at hw
        rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_support_vanishingIdeal] at hw
        exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hw
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hmin _ (stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes E η.2 hwη)
      have := isRegularLocalRing_stalk f w
      refine isRegularLocalRing_quotient_stalkIdeal_of_eq_span hrs
        (s := {i}) ?_
      change (vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η.1})).stalkIdeal w = _
      rw [hi]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨n, z, hrs, hmin, -, -⟩ := h x (by rw [support_bot]; trivial)
      exact ⟨n, z, (componentFamily_isSncAt_iff E x z).mpr ⟨hrs, hmin⟩⟩
  · intro h x _
    obtain ⟨n, z, hz⟩ := h.2 x
    obtain ⟨hrs, hmin⟩ := (componentFamily_isSncAt_iff E x z).mp hz
    refine ⟨n, z, hrs, hmin, ∅, ?_⟩
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_bot]
    simp

name: Hironaka.Sequence.IsOrderSeq.isSncBoundary_boundarySeq
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  have hsnc : E.componentFamily.IsSnc :=
    (isSncBoundary_iff_isSnc_componentFamily f E).mp hE
  have hsnc_i : (S.totalTransformSeq E.componentFamily i).IsSnc :=
    IsOrderSeq.isSnc_totalTransformSeq f n h hsnc i
  rw [boundarySeq_eq_unionIdeal_totalTransformSeq_componentFamily]
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (S.stageMap i ≫ f) :=
    IsSmooth.stageMap_smoothOfRelativeDimension h.1 i
  have : Smooth (S.stageMap i ≫ f) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n _
  exact IsSnc.isSncBoundary_unionIdeal (S.stageMap i ≫ f) hsnc_i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivisorFamily.components_component
statement:
theorem components_component (E : DivisorFamily X) (p : E.components.ι) :
    E.components.component p =
      (E.component (ofLex p).1).componentFamily.component (ofLex p).2
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivisorFamily.support_components_component_le
statement:
theorem support_components_component_le (E : DivisorFamily X) (p : E.components.ι) :
    (E.components.component p).support ≤ (E.component (ofLex p).1).support
proof:
:=
  IsConcreteLE.le_iff.mpr fun x hx =>
    ((Hironaka.Sequence.mem_support_componentFamily_iff _ _ x).mp hx).mem_closed
      (E.component (ofLex p).1).support.isClosed (ofLex p).2.2.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivisorFamily.monomial_eq_prod_components
statement:
theorem monomial_eq_prod_components (E : DivisorFamily X) (a : X → ℕ) :
    E.monomial a = ∏ p : E.components.ι, E.components.component p ^ a (ofLex p).2.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold DivisorFamily.monomial
  change _ = ∏ p : (Σ i : E.ι, (E.component i).componentFamily.ι),
    (E.component p.1).componentFamily.component p.2 ^ a p.2.1
  rw [Fintype.prod_sigma]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← finprod_set_coe_eq_finprod_mem,
    @finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype ((E.component i).support.genericPoints) _ _
      ((E.component i).componentFamily.fintype : Fintype ((E.component i).support.genericPoints))]
  rfl

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSnc_components
statement: theorem isSnc_components {E : DivisorFamily X} (hE : E.IsSnc) : E.components.IsSnc
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p => Hironaka.Sequence.isRegular_subscheme_componentFamily _ (hE.1 _) _, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, z, hz, c, hcinj, hc⟩ := hE.2 x
  have hmem : ∀ p : {p : E.components.ι // x ∈ (E.components.component p).support},
      x ∈ (E.component (ofLex p.1).1).support :=
    fun p => DivisorFamily.support_components_component_le E p.1 p.2
  refine ⟨n, z, hz, fun p => c ⟨(ofLex p.1).1, hmem p⟩, fun p q hpq => ?_, fun p => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨⟨i, η⟩, hp⟩ := p
    obtain ⟨⟨j, ζ⟩, hq⟩ := q
    have hij : i = j := congrArg Subtype.val (hcinj hpq)
    subst hij
    have hηζ : η = ζ :=
      Hironaka.Sequence.eq_of_mem_support_componentFamily (E.component i) (hE.1 i) hp hq
    subst hηζ
    rfl
  · exact (Hironaka.Sequence.stalkIdeal_componentFamily_eq _ (hE.1 _) _ p.2).trans
      (hc ⟨(ofLex p.1).1, hmem p⟩)

name: Hironaka.Snc.isIdealOfSncDivisor_monomial
statement:
theorem isIdealOfSncDivisor_monomial {E : DivisorFamily X} (hE : E.IsSnc) (a : X → ℕ) :
    IsIdealOfSncDivisor (E.monomial a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨E.components, fun p => a (ofLex p).2.1, isSnc_components hE, E.monomial_eq_prod_components a⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsIdealOfSncDivisor.comap_of_smooth
statement:
theorem comap_of_smooth (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (h : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth h]
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} (hI : IsIdealOfSncDivisor I) : IsIdealOfSncDivisor (I.comap h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, a, hF, rfl⟩ := hI
  refine ⟨F.comap h, a, isSnc_comap_of_smooth f h hF, ?_⟩
  rw [comap_finset_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => comap_pow _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivisorFamily.IsSnc.subfamily
statement:
theorem IsSnc.subfamily {E : DivisorFamily X} (hE : E.IsSnc) (p : E.ι → Prop) :
    (E.subfamily p).IsSnc
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun i => hE.1 i.1, fun x =>
    let ⟨n, z, h⟩ := hE.2 x
    ⟨n, z, isSncAt_of_injective_components (F' := E.subfamily p) (F := E) (fun i => i.1)
      Subtype.val_injective (fun _ => rfl) h⟩⟩

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSmoothDivisor_iff_forall_isSmoothDivisorAt
statement:
theorem isSmoothDivisor_iff_forall_isSmoothDivisorAt (D : X.IdealSheafData) :
    IsSmoothDivisor D ↔ ∀ x ∈ D.support, IsSmoothDivisorAt D x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hreg, hgen⟩ x hx
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := exists_subschemeι_eq D hx
    refine ⟨?_, hgen _ hx⟩
    have : IsRegularLocalRing (D.subscheme.presheaf.stalk z) := hreg.isRegularAt z
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (D.stalkQuotientEquiv z).symm
  · intro h
    exact ⟨isRegular_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_quotient D fun w hw => (h w hw).1,
      fun x hx => (h x hx).2⟩

name: Hironaka.Snc.IsSmoothIdealAt.map
statement:
theorem IsSmoothIdealAt.map {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsLocalRing S] (e : R ≃+* S) {I : Ideal R} (h : IsSmoothIdealAt I) :
    IsSmoothIdealAt (I.map e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hreg, a, ha, ha2, hI⟩ := h
  refine ⟨IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (Ideal.quotientEquiv I (I.map e) e rfl), e a, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha
  · intro h2
    apply ha2
    rw [← map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e, ← Ideal.map_pow, ← Ideal.comap_symm, Ideal.mem_comap,
      RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h2
    exact h2
  · rw [hI, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSmoothIdealAt_map_iff
statement:
theorem isSmoothIdealAt_map_iff {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsLocalRing S] (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) : IsSmoothIdealAt (I.map e) ↔ IsSmoothIdealAt I
proof:
:=
    by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.map e⟩
  have h' := h.map e.symm
  rwa [Ideal.map_symm, Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ e.bijective] at h'

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSmoothDivisorAt_comap_iff
statement:
theorem isSmoothDivisorAt_comap_iff (D : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (y : Y) : IsSmoothDivisorAt (D.comap f) y ↔ IsSmoothDivisorAt D (f y)
proof:
:= by
  have hiso : IsIso (f.stalkMap y) := inferInstance
  let e : X.presheaf.stalk (f y) ≃+* Y.presheaf.stalk y :=
    (asIso (f.stalkMap y)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hmap : (D.comap f).stalkIdeal y = (D.stalkIdeal (f y)).map e := stalkIdeal_comap D f y
  unfold IsSmoothDivisorAt
  rw [hmap]
  exact isSmoothIdealAt_map_iff e _

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSmoothDivisor_of_forall_comap
statement:
theorem isSmoothDivisor_of_forall_comap {ι : Type*} {Y : ι → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (f i)] (hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ (i : ι) (y : Y i), f i y = x)
    {D : X.IdealSheafData} (h : ∀ i, IsSmoothDivisor (D.comap (f i))) : IsSmoothDivisor D
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSmoothDivisor_iff_forall_isSmoothDivisorAt]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := hcov x
  rw [← isSmoothDivisorAt_comap_iff D (f i) y]
  refine (isSmoothDivisor_iff_forall_isSmoothDivisorAt _).1 (h i) y ?_
  rw [support_comap]
  exact hx

name: Hironaka.Snc.comap_iInf_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem comap_iInf_of_isOpenImmersion {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (I : ι → X.IdealSheafData)
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] : (⨅ i, I i).comap f = ⨅ i, (I i).comap f
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  have h1 : (⨅ i, (I i).comap f).ideal U = ⨅ i, ((I i).comap f).ideal U := by
    rw [ideal_iInf, iInf_apply]
  have h2 : (⨅ i, I i).ideal ⟨f ''ᵁ U, U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion f⟩ =
      ⨅ i, (I i).ideal ⟨f ''ᵁ U, U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion f⟩ := by
    rw [ideal_iInf, iInf_apply]
  rw [h1, ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion, h2, Ideal.comap_iInf]
  exact iInf_congr fun i => (ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion (I i) f U).symm

name: Hironaka.Snc.le_of_forall_comap_le
statement:
theorem le_of_forall_comap_le {ι : Type*} {Y : ι → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (f i)] (hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ (i : ι) (y : Y i), f i y = x)
    {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : ∀ i, I.comap (f i) ≤ J.comap (f i)) : I ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := hcov x
  have hiso : IsIso ((f i).stalkMap y) := inferInstance
  let e : X.presheaf.stalk (f i y) ≃+* (Y i).presheaf.stalk y :=
    (asIso ((f i).stalkMap y)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have h' : (I.stalkIdeal (f i y)).map e ≤ (J.stalkIdeal (f i y)).map e := by
    have := stalkIdeal_mono (h i) y
    rwa [stalkIdeal_comap, stalkIdeal_comap] at this
  rw [← Ideal.comap_symm, ← Ideal.comap_symm] at h'
  intro a ha
  have := h' (Ideal.mem_comap.mpr (by rwa [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]) : e a ∈ _)
  rwa [Ideal.mem_comap, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this

name: Hironaka.Snc.comap_map_eq_top_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem comap_map_eq_top_of_disjoint {Z : Scheme.{u}} (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion g] (f : Z ⟶ X) (hdisj : Disjoint (Set.range g) (Set.range f)) :
    (I.map g).comap f = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← support_eq_bot_iff, support_comap, support_map]
  ext z
  simp only [TopologicalSpace.Closeds.coe_preimage, TopologicalSpace.Closeds.coe_closure,
    Set.mem_preimage, TopologicalSpace.Closeds.coe_bot, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  intro hz
  have hcl : closure (g '' (I.support : Set Y)) ⊆ Set.range g :=
    closure_minimal (Set.image_subset_range _ _) g.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj (hcl hz) ⟨z, rfl⟩

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSncAt_of_injective_components
proof:
:=
  Hironaka.Sequence.isSncAt_of_stalk_injection h
    (fun i => ⟨θ i.1, by rw [← hcomp]; exact i.2⟩)
    (fun i₁ i₂ h12 => Subtype.ext (hθ (congrArg Subtype.val h12)))
    (fun i => congrArg (fun J : X.IdealSheafData => J.stalkIdeal x) (hcomp i.1))

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSncOn_of_injective_components
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  let ⟨n, z, hz⟩ := h x hx
  ⟨n, z, isSncAt_of_injective_components θ hθ hcomp hz⟩

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSncOn_subfamily_append_mono
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Function.Injective
      (fun a : {a : E.ι // p a} => (⟨a.1, hpq a.1 a.2⟩ : {a : E.ι // q a})) :=
    fun a₁ a₂ h12 => Subtype.ext (Subtype.mk.inj h12)
  refine isSncOn_of_injective_components
    (toLex ∘ Sum.map (fun a : {a : E.ι // p a} => (⟨a.1, hpq a.1 a.2⟩ : {a : E.ι // q a})) id ∘
      ofLex) (toLex.injective.comp ((hf.sumMap Function.injective_id).comp ofLex.injective))
    ?_ h
  intro i
  rcases i with a | u
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Hironaka.Snc.component_stepIdx
statement:
theorem component_stepIdx (E : DivisorFamily X) (p : E.ι → Prop) (D H : X.IdealSheafData) (i) :
    (((E.totalTransform D).subfamily (extendPred p)).append (H.strictTransform D)).component i =
      (((E.subfamily p).append H).totalTransform D).component (stepIdx E p i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨j, hj⟩ | u
  · rcases j with a | v
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · rfl

name: Hironaka.Snc.stepIdxInv_stepIdx
statement:
theorem stepIdxInv_stepIdx (E : DivisorFamily X) (p : E.ι → Prop) (i) :
    stepIdxInv E p (stepIdx E p i) = i
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨j, hj⟩ | u
  · rcases j with a | v
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · rfl

name: Hironaka.Snc.stepIdx_injective
statement:
theorem stepIdx_injective (E : DivisorFamily X) (p : E.ι → Prop) :
    Function.Injective (stepIdx E p)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (stepIdxInv_stepIdx E p)

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSncAt_append_of_subfamily
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hrs, c, hcinj, hc⟩ := h
  let θ : {i : (E.append H).ι // x ∈ ((E.append H).component i).support} →
      {i : ((E.subfamily p).append H).ι // x ∈ (((E.subfamily p).append H).component i).support} :=
    fun i => Sum.rec
      (motive := fun s => x ∈ ((E.append H).component (toLex s)).support →
        {i : ((E.subfamily p).append H).ι // x ∈ (((E.subfamily p).append H).component i).support})
      (fun a ha => ⟨toLex (Sum.inl ⟨a, hP a ha⟩), ha⟩) (fun u hu => ⟨toLex (Sum.inr u), hu⟩)
      (ofLex i.1) i.2
  refine ⟨hrs, fun i => c (θ i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i₁ i₂ h12
    have h12' := hcinj h12
    obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁⟩ := i₁
    obtain ⟨i₂, hi₂⟩ := i₂
    rcases i₁ with a₁ | u₁ <;> rcases i₂ with a₂ | u₂
    · have h0 : (⟨a₁, hP a₁ hi₁⟩ : {a : E.ι // p a}) = ⟨a₂, hP a₂ hi₂⟩ :=
        Sum.inl_injective (toLex.injective (Subtype.mk.inj h12'))
      have h1 : a₁ = a₂ := Subtype.mk.inj h0
      subst h1
      rfl
    · exact absurd (toLex.injective (Subtype.mk.inj h12')) Sum.inl_ne_inr
    · exact absurd (toLex.injective (Subtype.mk.inj h12')) Sum.inr_ne_inl
    · cases u₁; cases u₂; rfl
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
    rcases i with a | u
    · exact hc (θ ⟨Sum.inl a, hi⟩)
    · exact hc (θ ⟨Sum.inr u, hi⟩)

name: Hironaka.Snc.isSncOn_subfamily_false_append
statement:
theorem isSncOn_subfamily_false_append (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (E : DivisorFamily X)
    {H : X.IdealSheafData} (hH : IsSmoothDivisor H) (s : Set X) :
    ((E.subfamily fun _ => False).append H).IsSncOn s
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    fun x => isRegularLocalRing_stalk f x
  have h := (isSnc_append_empty_of_isSmoothDivisor hreg hH).isSncOn s
  have hf : Function.Injective (fun a : {a : E.ι // False} => (a.2.elim : PEmpty.{u + 1})) :=
    fun a _ _ => a.2.elim
  refine isSncOn_of_injective_components
    (toLex ∘ Sum.map (fun a : {a : E.ι // False} => (a.2.elim : PEmpty.{u + 1})) id ∘ ofLex)
    (toLex.injective.comp ((hf.sumMap Function.injective_id).comp ofLex.injective)) ?_ h
  intro i
  rcases i with a | u
  · exact a.2.elim
  · rfl

name: TopologicalSpace.Closeds.mem_genericPoints_of_le
statement:
theorem _root_.TopologicalSpace.Closeds.mem_genericPoints_of_le [T0Space α] [QuasiSober α]
    {Z Z' : Closeds α} (hle : Z' ≤ Z) {η : α} (hη : η ∈ Z.genericPoints) (hη' : η ∈ Z') :
    η ∈ Z'.genericPoints
proof:
:= by
  rw [Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff] at hη ⊢
  refine ⟨⟨Z'.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hη'),
    isIrreducible_singleton.closure⟩, fun T hT hTη => ?_⟩
  exact hη.2 ⟨hT.1.trans (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr hle), hT.2⟩ hTη

name: Hironaka.Snc.isClosed_of_openCover
statement:
theorem isClosed_of_openCover (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover.{v}) (S : Set Y)
    (h : ∀ i, IsClosed (𝒰.f i ⁻¹' S)) : IsClosed S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff]
  have hS : Sᶜ = ⋃ i, 𝒰.f i '' (𝒰.f i ⁻¹' Sᶜ) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨i, w, rfl⟩ := 𝒰.exists_eq y
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, w, hy, rfl⟩
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨i, w, hw, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
      exact hw
  rw [hS]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun i => (𝒰.f i).isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap _ (h i).isOpen_compl

name: Hironaka.Snc.preimage_closure_singleton
statement:
theorem preimage_closure_singleton (η : W) :
    (Closeds.closure {ι η}).preimage ι.continuous = Closeds.closure {η}
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  change ι ⁻¹' closure {ι η} = closure {η}
  rw [ι.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.preimage_closure_eq_closure_preimage ι.continuous,
    ← Set.image_singleton, ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective.preimage_image]

name: Hironaka.Snc.exists_stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq
statement:
theorem exists_stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq [NoetherianSpace Y] (S : Closeds Y)
    {F : DivisorFamily W} (hF : F.IsSnc) (hsupp : (F.support : Set W) = ι ⁻¹' S) {η : Y}
    (hη : η ∈ S.genericPoints) {w : W} (hηw : η ⤳ ι w) :
    ∃ j : F.ι, w ∈ (F.component j).support ∧
      (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal (ι w) =
        ((F.component j).stalkIdeal w).map (stalkEquivOfIsOpenImmersion ι w).symm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η', rfl⟩ : η ∈ Set.range ι :=
    hηw.mem_open ι.isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range (Set.mem_range_self w)
  have hη'w : η' ⤳ w := ι.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hηw
  have hpre : F.support = S.preimage ι.continuous := SetLike.coe_injective hsupp
  have hη'S : η' ∈ F.support.genericPoints := by
    have h1 : ι η' ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal S).support.genericPoints := by
      rwa [support_vanishingIdeal_eq]
    have h2 := mem_genericPoints_comap_of_isOpenImmersion ι (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal S) h1
    rwa [Hironaka.Smooth.comap_vanishingIdeal_of_smooth, support_vanishingIdeal_eq, ← hpre] at h2
  obtain ⟨j, hη'j⟩ := (F.mem_support_iff_exists η').mp hη'S.1
  have hgen : η' ∈ (F.component j).support.genericPoints :=
    Closeds.mem_genericPoints_of_le
      (le_iSup (fun i => (F.component i).support) j : (F.component j).support ≤ F.support)
      hη'S hη'j
  have hwj : w ∈ (F.component j).support :=
    hη'w.mem_closed (F.component j).support.isClosed hη'j
  refine ⟨j, hwj, ?_⟩
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_symm_stalkIdeal_comap ι, Hironaka.Smooth.comap_vanishingIdeal_of_smooth,
    preimage_closure_singleton,
    Hironaka.Monomial.stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_of_isRegular_subscheme (hF.1 j) hgen
      hη'w]

name: Hironaka.Snc.exists_snc_of_openCover
statement:
theorem exists_snc_of_openCover [NoetherianSpace Y] (S : Set Y) (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover.{v})
    (h : ∀ i, ∃ F : DivisorFamily (𝒰.X i), F.IsSnc ∧ (F.support : Set (𝒰.X i)) = 𝒰.f i ⁻¹' S) :
    ∃ F : DivisorFamily Y, F.IsSnc ∧ (F.support : Set Y) = S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose F hF hsupp using h
  have hS : IsClosed S := isClosed_of_openCover 𝒰 S fun i => by
    rw [← hsupp i]
    exact (F i).support.isClosed
  let Z : Closeds Y := ⟨S, hS⟩
  have key : ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀) (w : 𝒰.X i) {η : Y}, η ∈ Z.genericPoints → η ⤳ 𝒰.f i w →
      ∃ j : (F i).ι, w ∈ ((F i).component j).support ∧
        (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η})).stalkIdeal (𝒰.f i w) =
          (((F i).component j).stalkIdeal w).map
            (stalkEquivOfIsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i) w).symm :=
    fun i w _ hη hηw =>
      exists_stalkIdeal_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq (𝒰.f i) Z (hF i) (hsupp i) hη hηw
  refine ⟨(IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).componentFamily, ⟨fun η => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine isRegular_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_quotient _ fun x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨i, w, rfl⟩ := 𝒰.exists_eq x
    have hηx : η.1 ⤳ 𝒰.f i w := by
      change 𝒰.f i w ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η.1})).support at hx
      rw [support_vanishingIdeal_eq] at hx
      exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr (Closeds.mem_closure.mp hx)
    have hη : η.1 ∈ Z.genericPoints := by
      have h : η.1 ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).support.genericPoints := η.2
      generalize η.1 = y at h ⊢
      rwa [support_vanishingIdeal_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨j, hwj, heq⟩ := key i w hη hηx
    change IsRegularLocalRing (Y.presheaf.stalk (𝒰.f i w) ⧸
      (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {η.1})).stalkIdeal (𝒰.f i w))
    rw [heq]
    obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := ((F i).component j).exists_subschemeι_eq hwj
    have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing
        ((𝒰.X i).presheaf.stalk (((F i).component j).subschemeι w') ⧸
          ((F i).component j).stalkIdeal (((F i).component j).subschemeι w')) := by
      have : IsRegularLocalRing (((F i).component j).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w') :=
        ((hF i).1 j).isRegularAt w'
      exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (((F i).component j).stalkQuotientEquiv w').symm
    refine IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
      (Ideal.quotientEquiv
        (Ideal.map (stalkEquivOfIsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i) (((F i).component j).subschemeι w')).symm
          (((F i).component j).stalkIdeal (((F i).component j).subschemeι w')))
        (((F i).component j).stalkIdeal (((F i).component j).subschemeι w'))
        (stalkEquivOfIsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i) (((F i).component j).subschemeι w')) ?_).symm
    rw [Ideal.map_symm]
    exact (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective
      (stalkEquivOfIsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i) (((F i).component j).subschemeι w') :
        Y.presheaf.stalk (𝒰.f i (((F i).component j).subschemeι w')) →+*
          (𝒰.X i).presheaf.stalk (((F i).component j).subschemeι w'))
      (stalkEquivOfIsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i) _).surjective _).symm
  · 
    obtain ⟨i, w, rfl⟩ := 𝒰.exists_eq x
    obtain ⟨n, z, hz⟩ := (hF i).2 w
    refine ⟨n, transportCoords (𝒰.f i) w z, ?_⟩
    rw [componentFamily_isSncAt_iff]
    refine ⟨isRegularSystemOfParameters_comp_ringEquiv
      (stalkEquivOfIsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i) w).symm hz.1, fun P hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηx, rfl⟩ := exists_mem_genericPoints_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ hP
    have hη' : η ∈ Z.genericPoints := by
      rwa [support_vanishingIdeal_eq] at hη
    obtain ⟨j, hwj, heq⟩ := key i w hη' hηx
    obtain ⟨-, c, -, hc⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨c ⟨j, hwj⟩, ?_⟩
    have hcj : ((F i).component j).stalkIdeal w = Ideal.span {z (c ⟨j, hwj⟩)} := hc ⟨j, hwj⟩
    rw [heq, hcj, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  · 
    rw [support_componentFamily, support_vanishingIdeal_eq]
    rfl

name: Hironaka.Stage.exists_hypersurfaceCover
statement:
theorem exists_hypersurfaceCover {n : ℕ} (TX TY : MarkedTriple k) (j : TY.X.left ⟶ TX.X.left)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (hj : MarkedTriple.ClosedEmbedding TX TY j) (hE : IsEmpty TX.E.ι)
    (hTX : TX.BMOClass (n + 1) 1) (hK : j.ker.maxOrd ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) [Nonempty TX.X.left] :
    Nonempty (HypersurfaceCover n TX TY j)
proof:
:= by
  have hPF : PerfectField k := PerfectField.ofCharZero
  
  have hKnz : IsNonzeroEverywhere j.ker := by
    intro x hx
    have : IsLocallyNoetherian TX.X.left := (TX.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)).isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
    have h1 : j.ker.ord x = ⊤ := (ord_eq_top_iff j.ker x).mpr hx
    have h2 : j.ker.ord x ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := (maxOrd_le_iff _).mp hK x
    rw [h1] at h2
    exact absurd h2 (by simp)
  
  let TK : Triple k := { TX.toTriple with I := j.ker, isNonzeroEverywhere := hKnz }
  have hTK : Triple.BOClass (n + 1) 1 TK := ⟨le_rfl, hTX.2.1, hK⟩
  have : Nonempty TK.X.left := ‹Nonempty TX.X.left›
  
  
  obtain ⟨T', g, -, hLT, hM, hsurj, hpb⟩ :=
    Triple.exists_isLocalCover (globalizationData_localClass (n + 1) 1) hTK
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hmc⟩ := hLT.2
  have hHle : H ≤ j.ker.comap g := by
    have h := hmc
    change H ≤ MC (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) T'.I 1 at h
    rwa [MC_one, hpb.2.1] at h
  have hsm : Smooth g := openImmersionCoprods.smooth hM
  have hgo : g.IsOver (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨hpb.1⟩
  
  let TX' : MarkedTriple k := MarkedTriple.pullback TX T'.smoothOfRelativeDimension g
  have hpbX : TX'.IsPullbackOf TX g :=
    MarkedTriple.isPullbackOf_pullback TX T'.smoothOfRelativeDimension g
  
  let Y' : Scheme.{u} := Limits.pullback g j
  let j' : Y' ⟶ T'.X.left := pullback.fst g j
  let hS : Y' ⟶ TY.X.left := pullback.snd g j
  have sq : IsPullback j' hS g j := IsPullback.of_hasPullback g j
  have hM' : openImmersionCoprods hS :=
    isStableUnderBaseChange_openImmersionCoprods.of_isPullback sq hM
  have hsmS : Smooth hS := openImmersionCoprods.smooth hM'
  have hetS : Etale hS := openImmersionCoprods_etale hS hM'
  have hsepS : IsSeparated hS := openImmersionCoprods_isSeparated hM'
  have hsurjS : Function.Surjective hS := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hsurj (j y)
    obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback x' y hx'
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  let _ : Y'.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨hS ≫ (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))⟩
  have hSo : hS.IsOver (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨rfl⟩
  have hcptX' : CompactSpace T'.X.left :=
    QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))
  have hcptY' : CompactSpace Y' := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace j'
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (hS ≫ (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))))
  have : IsSeparated (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsSeparated (hS ≫ (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))))
  have : QuasiCompact (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k)) := inferInstance
  have hY' : ∃ d : ℕ, SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k)) := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := TY.smoothOfRelativeDimension
    exact ⟨0 + d, smoothOfRelativeDimension_comp 0 d hS (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))⟩
  let TY' : MarkedTriple k := MarkedTriple.pullback TY hY' hS
  have hpbY : TY'.IsPullbackOf TY hS := MarkedTriple.isPullbackOf_pullback TY hY' hS
  
  have hover' : j' ≫ (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) = hS ≫ (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := by
    rw [← hpb.1, ← Category.assoc, sq.w, Category.assoc]
    change hS ≫ j ≫ (TX.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) = _
    rw [hj.1.1]
  have hI' : TX.I.comap g = (TY.I.comap hS).map j' := by
    rw [hj.1.2.1]
    exact comap_map_of_isPullback sq TY.I
  have hE' : TY.E.comap hS = (TX.E.comap g).comap j' := by
    rw [hj.1.2.2, ← DivisorFamily.comap_comp, ← DivisorFamily.comap_comp, sq.w]
  
  have hker' : j'.ker = j.ker.comap g := ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion j g
  have hHle' : H.subschemeι.ker ≤ j'.ker := by
    rw [ker_subschemeι, hker']
    exact hHle
  let ℓ : Y' ⟶ H.subscheme := IsClosedImmersion.lift H.subschemeι j' hHle'
  have hfac : ℓ ≫ H.subschemeι = j' := IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac H.subschemeι j' hHle'
  have hcij' : IsClosedImmersion j' := inferInstanceAs (IsClosedImmersion (pullback.fst g j))
  have hciH : IsClosedImmersion H.subschemeι := inferInstance
  have hciℓ : IsClosedImmersion ℓ := by
    have : IsClosedImmersion (ℓ ≫ H.subschemeι) := by
      rw [hfac]
      exact hcij'
    exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp_isClosedImmersion ℓ H.subschemeι
  have hHsd : IsSmoothDivisor H.subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [ker_subschemeι]
    exact hH
  
  obtain ⟨n', hn'le, hn'⟩ := hLT.1.2.1
  have hn'i : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n' (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := hn'
  have hHdim : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (n' - 1) (H.subschemeι ≫ (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))) :=
    smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_isSmoothDivisor (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) n' H hH
  have hHsm : Smooth (H.subschemeι ≫ (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))) :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth (n' - 1) _
  have hEι : IsEmpty ((TX.E.comap g).comap H.subschemeι).ι := hE
  
  let TH' : MarkedTriple k :=
    { X := .ofHom (H.subschemeι ≫ (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)))
        (inferInstanceAs (FiniteType (H.subschemeι ≫ (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)))))
        (inferInstanceAs (IsSeparated (H.subschemeι ≫ (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)))))
      smoothOfRelativeDimension := ⟨n' - 1, hHdim⟩
      I := TY'.I.map ℓ
      isNonzeroEverywhere :=
        isNonzeroEverywhere_map_of_isClosedImmersion ℓ TY'.I TY'.isNonzeroEverywhere
      E := (TX.E.comap g).comap H.subschemeι
      isSnc := isSnc_of_isEmpty (H.subschemeι ≫ (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))) _
      m := 1 }
  refine ⟨⟨TX', TY', TH', g, hsm, hsurj, j', hcij', hS, hsmS, hsurjS, sq, hpbX, hpbY,
    H.subschemeι, hciH, hHsd, ℓ, hciℓ, hfac, ⟨⟨rfl, ?_, rfl⟩, hTX.2.2.symm⟩,
    ⟨⟨?_, rfl, ?_⟩, hj.2.trans hTX.2.2⟩, hE, hLT.1.2.1, ⟨n' - 1, by omega, hHdim⟩⟩⟩
  · 
    change TX.I.comap g = (TY'.I.map ℓ).map H.subschemeι
    exact hI'.trans ((congrArg (fun f : Y' ⟶ T'.X.left => TY'.I.map f) hfac.symm).trans
      (map_comp TY'.I ℓ H.subschemeι))
  · 
    change ℓ ≫ H.subschemeι ≫ (T'.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) = hS ≫ (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k))
    rw [← Category.assoc, hfac]
    exact hover'
  · 
    change TY.E.comap hS = ((TX.E.comap g).comap H.subschemeι).comap ℓ
    rw [hE', ← hfac, DivisorFamily.comap_comp]

name: Hironaka.Stage.dimFreeBO_seq_eq_tower
statement:
theorem dimFreeBO_seq_eq_tower (n : ℕ) (T : Triple k) (hT : T.BOClassFree m)
    (hT' : T.BOClass n m) :
    (dimFreeBO base m k).seq T hT = (((tower base n).bo m).functor k).seq T hT'
proof:
:= by
  have hN : T.BOClass (max T.dim n) m :=
    Triple.boClass_mono (le_max_left _ _) (Triple.boClass_of_boClassFree hT)
  rw [dimFreeBO_seq,
    ← tower_bo_coherent base m (le_max_left T.dim n) T hN (Triple.boClass_of_boClassFree hT),
    tower_bo_coherent base m (le_max_right T.dim n) T hN hT']

name: Hironaka.Stage.dimFreeBMO_seq_eq_tower
statement:
theorem dimFreeBMO_seq_eq_tower (n : ℕ) (T : MarkedTriple k) (hT : T.BMOClassFree m)
    (hT' : T.BMOClass n m) :
    (dimFreeBMO base m k).seq T hT = (((tower base n).bmo m).functor k).seq T hT'
proof:
:= by
  have hN : T.BMOClass (max T.toTriple.dim n) m :=
    MarkedTriple.bmoClass_mono (le_max_left _ _) (MarkedTriple.bmoClass_of_bmoClassFree hT)
  rw [dimFreeBMO_seq,
    ← tower_bmo_coherent base m (le_max_left T.toTriple.dim n) T hN
      (MarkedTriple.bmoClass_of_bmoClassFree hT),

name: Hironaka.Stage.tower_coherent_aux
statement:
theorem tower_coherent_aux (n : ℕ) : ∀ n' ≤ n,
    (∀ (m : ℕ) (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (T : Triple k) (hT : T.BOClass n m)
      (hT' : T.BOClass n' m),
      (((tower base n).bo m).functor k).seq T hT = (((tower base n').bo m).functor k).seq T hT') ∧
    (∀ (m : ℕ) (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (T : MarkedTriple k) (hT : T.BMOClass n m)
      (hT' : T.BMOClass n' m),
      (((tower base n).bmo m).functor k).seq T hT =
        (((tower base n').bmo m).functor k).seq T hT')
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro n' hn'
    obtain rfl : n' = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hn'
    exact ⟨fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro n' hn'
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hn' with hlt | rfl
    · have hn'n : n' ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt
      have hbo : ∀ (m : ℕ) (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (T : Triple k)
          (hT : T.BOClass (n + 1) m) (hT' : T.BOClass n' m),
          (((tower base (n + 1)).bo m).functor k).seq T hT =
            (((tower base n').bo m).functor k).seq T hT' := by
        intro m k _ _ T hT hT'
        cases n' with
        | zero =>
          rw [OrderSeqAssignment.seq_eq_nil_of_hasDimLE_zero _ T hT hT'.2.1 hT'.1,
            OrderSeqAssignment.seq_eq_nil_of_hasDimLE_zero _ T hT' hT'.2.1 hT'.1]
        | succ n'' =>
          have hn''n : n'' ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt hn'n
          exact Hironaka.BO.data_congr (n := n + 1) (n' := n'' + 1) (by omega) (amalgamDom n)
            (amalgamDom n'') (fun k _ _ => amalgam (tower base n).bmo k)
            (fun k _ _ => amalgam (tower base n'').bmo k)
            (fun m k _ _ T' hd hm => amalgamClass_of_tuningParam k m T' hd hm)
            (fun m k _ _ T' hd hm => amalgamClass_of_tuningParam k m T' hd hm)
            (fun k _ _ T' hT' => amalgam_maxOrd_endTriple_lt _ k T' hT')
            (fun k _ _ T' hT' => amalgam_maxOrd_endTriple_lt _ k T' hT')
            (fun k _ _ => amalgam_commutesWithSmooth _ k)
            (fun k _ _ => amalgam_commutesWithSmooth _ k)
            (fun k _ _ _ _ _ σ => amalgam_commutesWithBaseChange _ k σ)
            (fun k _ _ _ _ _ σ => amalgam_commutesWithBaseChange _ k σ)
            (fun k _ _ => amalgam_indifferentToEmptyMembers _ k)
            (fun k _ _ => amalgam_indifferentToEmptyMembers _ k)
            (fun k _ _ T' h₁ h₂ _ =>
              (ih n'' hn''n).2 T'.m k T' ⟨h₁.1, h₁.2, rfl⟩ ⟨h₂.1, h₂.2, rfl⟩)
            k T hT hT'
      have hbmo : ∀ (m : ℕ) (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharZero k] (T : MarkedTriple k)
          (hT : T.BMOClass (n + 1) m) (hT' : T.BMOClass n' m),
          (((tower base (n + 1)).bmo m).functor k).seq T hT =
            (((tower base n').bmo m).functor k).seq T hT' := by
        intro m k _ _ T hT hT'
        have hm : 1 ≤ T.m := by
          rw [hT'.2.2]
          exact hT'.1
        cases n' with
        | zero =>
          rw [OrderGeSeqAssignment.seq_eq_nil_of_hasDimLE_zero _ T hT hT'.2.1 hm,
            OrderGeSeqAssignment.seq_eq_nil_of_hasDimLE_zero _ T hT' hT'.2.1 hm]
        | succ n'' =>
          exact Hironaka.BMO.data_congr (by omega) (boOfBMO (tower base n).bmo)
            (boOfBMO (tower base n'').bmo)
            (fun d k _ _ => boOfBMO_indifferentToEmptyMembers _ d k)
            (fun d k _ _ => boOfBMO_indifferentToEmptyMembers _ d k)
            (fun d k _ _ T h₁ h₂ => hbo d k T h₁ h₂) k T hT hT'
      exact ⟨hbo, hbmo⟩
    · exact ⟨fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Triple.I_eq_top_of_hasDimLE_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Triple.I_eq_top_of_hasDimLE_zero (T : Triple k)
    (h : T.HasDimLE 0) : T.I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdim⟩ := h
  obtain rfl : d = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hd
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) := hdim
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_eq_bot_iff]
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, x ∈ T.I.support := by
    by_contra h
    exact hne (le_antisymm (fun y hy => (h ⟨y, hy⟩).elim) bot_le)
  have hle := (IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal T.I x).mp hx
  have hfield : IsField (T.X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isField_stalk_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_zero (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) x
  have hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (T.X.left.presheaf.stalk x) = ⊥ :=
    (IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq).mp hfield
  rw [hmax] at hle
  have hne0 : T.I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥ := T.isNonzeroEverywhere x
  exact hne0 (le_bot_iff.mp hle)

name: Hironaka.OrderSeqAssignment.seq_eq_nil_of_hasDimLE_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hI := T.I_eq_top_of_hasDimLE_zero h0

    rw [hI]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt ((IdealSheafData.maxOrd_le_iff _).mpr fun x => ?_)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (by exact_mod_cast hm))
    simp
  exact Hironaka.BO.eq_nil_of_isOrderSeq_of_maxOrd_lt (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) (B.isOrderSeq T hT)
    (B.noEmptyCenters T hT) hlt

name: Hironaka.OrderGeSeqAssignment.seq_eq_nil_of_hasDimLE_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hI : T.I = ⊤ := T.toTriple.I_eq_top_of_hasDimLE_zero h0
  have hlt : T.I.maxOrd < (T.m : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hI]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt ((IdealSheafData.maxOrd_le_iff _).mpr fun x => ?_)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (by exact_mod_cast hm))
    simp

    (B.isOrderGeSeq T hT) (B.noEmptyCenters T hT) hlt

statement:
theorem tower_bmo_one_eq_pushforward_closedEmbedding_aux (base : OrderReductionStage.{u} 0)
    (n : ℕ) : ∀ (TX TY : MarkedTriple k) (j : TY.X.left ⟶ TX.X.left) [IsClosedImmersion j]
      (hj : MarkedTriple.ClosedEmbedding TX TY j), IsEmpty TX.E.ι →
      ∀ hTX : TX.BMOClass n 1,
        (((tower base n).bmo 1).functor k).seq TX hTX =
          ((((tower base n).bmo 1).functor k).seq TY
            (bmoClass_of_closedEmbedding hj hTX)).pushforward j
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro TX TY j _ hj _ hTX
    exact seq_eq_pushforward_of_hasDimLE_zero base TX TY j hj hTX
  | succ n ih =>
    intro TX TY j _ hj hE hTX
    by_cases hK : j.ker.maxOrd ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    · exact seq_eq_pushforward_of_maxOrd_ker_le_one base ih TX TY j hj hE hTX hK
    · exact seq_eq_pushforward_of_not_maxOrd_ker_le_one base TX TY j hj hE hTX hK

name: Hironaka.Stage.tower_bmo_one_commutesWithClosedEmbeddingsOfEmptyDivisor
statement:
theorem tower_bmo_one_commutesWithClosedEmbeddingsOfEmptyDivisor
    (base : OrderReductionStage.{u} 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (((tower base n).bmo 1).functor k).CommutesWithClosedEmbeddingsOfEmptyDivisor

:=

    tower_bmo_one_eq_pushforward_closedEmbedding_aux base n TX TY j hj hE hX

name: Hironaka.Stage.hasDimLE_of_closedEmbedding
statement:
theorem hasDimLE_of_closedEmbedding [CharZero k] {TX TY : Triple k} (j : TY.X.left ⟶ TX.X.left)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] {n : ℕ} (hX : TX.HasDimLE n) : TY.HasDimLE n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨dX, hdXn, hdX⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨dY, hdY⟩ := TY.smoothOfRelativeDimension
  by_cases hemp : IsEmpty TY.X.left
  · exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, Hironaka.BO.smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_isEmpty _ 0⟩
  · rw [not_isEmpty_iff] at hemp
    obtain ⟨y⟩ := hemp
    have : JacobsonSpace TY.X.left :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    obtain ⟨p, hp, -, -⟩ := exists_isClosed_singleton_mem_specializes
      (X := TY.X.left) isClosed_univ (Set.mem_univ y)
    have hjp : IsClosed ({j.base p} : Set TX.X.left) := by
      have := j.isClosedEmbedding.isClosedMap _ hp
      rwa [Set.image_singleton] at this
    have : PerfectField k := PerfectField.ofCharZero
    have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension dX (TX.X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := hdX
    have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension dY (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := hdY
    have hX' := Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_isClosed
      (TX.X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) dX hjp
    have hY' := Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_isClosed
      (TY.X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) dY hp
    have hle := ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective (j.stalkMap p).hom (j.stalkMap_surjective p)
    rw [hX', hY'] at hle
    have hdd : dY ≤ dX := by exact_mod_cast hle
    exact ⟨dY, hdd.trans hdXn, hdY⟩

name: Hironaka.Stage.bmoClass_of_closedEmbedding
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_rfl, hasDimLE_of_closedEmbedding j hTX.2.1, hj.2.trans hTX.2.2⟩

name: Hironaka.Stage.boOfBMO_indifferentToEmptyMembers
statement:
theorem boOfBMO_indifferentToEmptyMembers (bmo : ∀ m : ℕ, BMOData.{u} n m) (d : ℕ) (k : Type u)
    [Field k] [CharZero k] : ((boOfBMO bmo d).functor k).IndifferentToEmptyMembers
proof:
:=
  Hironaka.BO.data_indifferentToEmptyMembers (n + 1) d (amalgamDom n) (fun k _ _ => amalgam bmo k)
    (fun m k _ _ T' hd hm => amalgamClass_of_tuningParam k m T' hd hm)
    (fun k _ _ T' hT' => amalgam_maxOrd_endTriple_lt bmo k T' hT')
    (fun k _ _ => amalgam_commutesWithSmooth bmo k)
    (fun k _ _ _ _ _ σ => amalgam_commutesWithBaseChange bmo k σ)
    (fun k _ _ => amalgam_indifferentToEmptyMembers bmo k) k
