    change (D.comap (eqToHom (stage_zero rest) ≫ D.blowUpπ)).IsInvertible
    rw [comap_comp]
    exact (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π (I := D)).comap_of_isOpenImmersion _
  | _, cons _ D rest, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ => isInvertible_exceptionalAt rest ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩

name: Hironaka.Sequence.isInvertible_comap_stageMapBetween
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_stageMapBetween :
    ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} (S : BlowUpSequence X) {i j : Fin (S.length + 1)} (h : j ≤ i)
      {K : (S.stage j).IdealSheafData}, K.IsInvertible →
      (K.comap (S.stageMapBetween i j h)).IsInvertible
  | _, nil _, _, _, _, K, hK =>
    (congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible (comap_id K)).mpr hK
  | _, cons _ _ _, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, _, K, hK =>
    (congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible (comap_id K)).mpr hK
  | _, cons _ _ _, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, h, _, _ => (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _ h).elim
  | _, cons X D rest, ⟨i + 1, hi⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, _, K, hK =>
    (congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible
      (comap_comp K (rest.stageMap ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩) D.blowUpπ)).mpr
      (isInvertible_comap_stageMap rest
        (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_of_isInvertible (I := D) K hK) _)
  | _, cons _ _ rest, ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, h, _, hK =>
    isInvertible_comap_stageMapBetween rest (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h) hK

name: Hironaka.Sequence.preimage_support_subset_support_totalTransform
statement:
theorem preimage_support_subset_support_totalTransform (E : DivisorFamily X)
    (D : X.IdealSheafData) :
    D.blowUpπ ⁻¹' (E.support : Set X) ⊆ ((E.totalTransform D).support : Set
        D.blowUp)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨i, hbi⟩ := (DivisorFamily.mem_support_iff_exists E _).mp hb
  by_cases hF : b ∈ D.exceptionalDivisor.support
  · exact (DivisorFamily.mem_support_iff_exists _ b).mpr ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), hF⟩
  · refine (DivisorFamily.mem_support_iff_exists _ b).mpr ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i), ?_⟩
    exact (mem_support_strictTransformAlong_iff_of_notMem_support D (E.component i)
      hF).mpr hbi

name: Hironaka.Sequence.preimage_stageMap_support_subset
statement:
theorem preimage_stageMap_support_subset :
    ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} (S : BlowUpSequence X) (E : DivisorFamily X) (i : Fin (S.length + 1)),
      (S.stageMap i) ⁻¹' (E.support : Set X) ⊆ ((S.totalTransformSeq E i).support : Set (S.stage i))
  | _, nil _, _, _ => fun _ hb => hb
  | _, cons _ _ _, _, ⟨0, _⟩ => fun _ hb => hb
  | _, cons X D rest, E, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ => fun _ hb =>
    preimage_stageMap_support_subset rest (E.totalTransform D) ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩
      (preimage_support_subset_support_totalTransform E D hb)

name: Hironaka.Sequence.preimage_stageMapBetween_support_subset
statement:
theorem preimage_stageMapBetween_support_subset :
    ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} (S : BlowUpSequence X) (E : DivisorFamily X) {i l : Fin (S.length + 1)}
      (h : i ≤ l),
      (S.stageMapBetween l i h) ⁻¹' ((S.totalTransformSeq E i).support : Set (S.stage i)) ⊆
        ((S.totalTransformSeq E l).support : Set (S.stage l))
  | _, nil _, _, _, _, _ => fun _ hb => hb
  | _, cons _ _ _, _, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, _ => fun _ hb => hb
  | _, cons _ _ _, _, ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, ⟨0, _⟩, h => (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _ h).elim
  | _, cons X D rest, E, ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨l + 1, hl⟩, _ => fun _ hb =>
    preimage_stageMap_support_subset rest (E.totalTransform D) ⟨l, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hl⟩
      (preimage_support_subset_support_totalTransform E D hb)
  | _, cons _ D rest, E, ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, h =>
    preimage_stageMapBetween_support_subset rest (E.totalTransform D) (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)

name: Hironaka.Sequence.support_exceptionalAt_le_support_totalTransformSeq
statement:
theorem support_exceptionalAt_le_support_totalTransformSeq (S : BlowUpSequence X)
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (j : Fin S.length) :
    (S.exceptionalAt j).support ≤ (S.totalTransformSeq E j.succ).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalTransformSeq_succ E S j]
  exact IsConcreteLE.le_iff.mpr fun b hb =>
    (DivisorFamily.mem_support_iff_exists _ b).mpr ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), hb⟩

name: Hironaka.Sequence.isIdealOfSncDivisor_prod_comap_exceptionalAt
statement:
theorem isIdealOfSncDivisor_prod_comap_exceptionalAt (T : MarkedTriple k)
    (S : BlowUpSequence T.X.left) (hS : S.IsOrderGeSeq (T.X.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) T.I T.m T.E) :
    IsIdealOfSncDivisor (∏ j : Fin S.length,
      (S.exceptionalAt j).comap (S.stageMapBetween (Fin.last _) j.succ (Fin.le_last _)))
proof:
:= by
  set K := ∏ j : Fin S.length,
    (S.exceptionalAt j).comap (S.stageMapBetween (Fin.last _) j.succ (Fin.le_last _)) with hK
  let T' : Triple k := (T.induced S hS (Fin.last _)).toTriple
  have hinv : K.IsInvertible := by
    refine Finset.prod_induction _
      (fun J : (S.stage (Fin.last _)).IdealSheafData => J.IsInvertible)
      (fun _ _ h₁ h₂ => h₁.mul h₂) (one_eq_top ▸ isInvertible_top) fun j _ => ?_
    exact isInvertible_comap_stageMapBetween S _ (isInvertible_exceptionalAt S j)
  have hsupp : K.support ≤ T'.E.support := by
    rw [hK, support_finset_prod]
    refine iSup₂_le fun j _ => IsConcreteLE.le_iff.mpr fun b hb => ?_
    rw [mem_support_comap_iff_apply] at hb
    exact preimage_stageMapBetween_support_subset S T.E (Fin.le_last _)
      (support_exceptionalAt_le_support_totalTransformSeq S T.E j hb)
  have hmono : K = T'.E.monomial fun η => (K.ord η).toNat :=
    (Hironaka.BMO.eq_monomialPart_of_isInvertible_of_support_le T' hinv hsupp).trans
      (Hironaka.BMO.monomialPart_eq_monomial K T'.E)
  have := Hironaka.BD.noetherianSpace_triple T'
  rw [hmono]
  exact Hironaka.Snc.isIdealOfSncDivisor_monomial T'.isSnc _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_sortedList
statement: theorem mem_sortedList {s : Finset ℕ} {x : ℕ} : x ∈ sortedList s ↔ x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sortedList, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := id) h), h⟩⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.sortedList_toFinset
statement: theorem sortedList_toFinset (s : Finset ℕ) : (sortedList s).toFinset = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [List.mem_toFinset, mem_sortedList]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.sortedList_injective
statement: theorem sortedList_injective : Function.Injective sortedList
proof:
:= fun s t h => by
  rw [← sortedList_toFinset s, ← sortedList_toFinset t, h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.sortedList_pairwise
statement: theorem sortedList_pairwise (s : Finset ℕ) : (sortedList s).Pairwise (· < ·)
proof:
:=
  List.pairwise_lt_range.filter _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_insert
statement:
theorem total_insert {T : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : c ∉ T) :
    st.total (insert c T) = st.a c + st.total T
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_insert hc

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_erase_add
statement:
theorem total_erase_add {T : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hc : c ∈ T) :
    st.total (T.erase c) + st.a c = st.total T
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hc

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_empty
statement: theorem total_empty : st.total ∅ = 0
proof: := Finset.sum_empty

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.labelTuple_eq_iff
statement:
theorem labelTuple_eq_iff {T T' : Finset ℕ} :
    st.labelTuple T = st.labelTuple T' ↔ st.labels T = st.labels T'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => sortedList_injective h, fun h => by rw [labelTuple, labelTuple, h]⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem
statement:
theorem lt_nextComp_of_mem {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ st.nerve) {c : ℕ} (hc : c ∈ T) :
    c < st.nextComp
proof:
:=
  st.nerve_lt T hT c hc

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_nerve_of_subset
statement:
theorem mem_nerve_of_subset {T T' : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ st.nerve) (h : T' ⊆ T)
    (hne : T'.Nonempty) : T' ∈ st.nerve
proof:
:=
  st.nerve_down T hT T' h hne

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_faces
statement: theorem mem_faces {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} : T ∈ st.faces r ↔ T ∈ st.nerve ∧ T.card = r
proof:
:=
  Finset.mem_filter

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_le_maxTotal
statement:
theorem total_le_maxTotal {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ st.faces r) :
    st.total T ≤ st.maxTotal r
proof:
:=
  Finset.le_sup (f := st.total) hT

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.maxTotal_le
statement: theorem maxTotal_le {r b : ℕ} (h : ∀ T ∈ st.faces r, st.total T ≤ b) : st.maxTotal r ≤ b
proof:
:=
  Finset.sup_le h

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.star_zero
statement: theorem star_zero : st.Star 0
proof:
:= fun T hT => by
  have h := (st.mem_faces.mp hT)
  exact absurd (Finset.card_eq_zero.mp h.2) (st.nerve_nonempty T h.1).ne_empty

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.star_of_lt
statement: theorem star_of_lt {s : ℕ} (hs : st.n < s) : st.Star s
proof:
:= fun T hT => by
  have h := st.mem_faces.mp hT
  exact absurd (h.2 ▸ st.nerve_card T h.1) (not_le.mpr hs)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_candidates
statement:
theorem mem_candidates {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} :
    T ∈ st.candidates r ↔ T ∈ st.faces r ∧ st.m ≤ st.total T
proof:
:=
  Finset.mem_filter

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_maximizers
statement:
theorem mem_maximizers {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} :
    T ∈ st.maximizers r ↔ T ∈ st.faces r ∧ st.m ≤ st.total T ∧
      ∀ T' ∈ st.faces r, st.m ≤ st.total T' → st.total T' ≤ st.total T
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximizers, Finset.mem_filter, mem_candidates]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
    exact ⟨h1, h2, fun T' hT' hm =>
      h3 ▸ Finset.le_sup (f := st.total) (st.mem_candidates.mpr ⟨hT', hm⟩)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, le_antisymm (Finset.le_sup (f := st.total) (st.mem_candidates.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩))
      (Finset.sup_le fun T' hT' => ?_)⟩
    obtain ⟨hT', hm⟩ := st.mem_candidates.mp hT'
    exact h3 T' hT' hm

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_choice
statement:
theorem mem_choice {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} :
    T ∈ st.choice r ↔ T ∈ st.faces r ∧ st.m ≤ st.total T ∧
      (∀ T' ∈ st.faces r, st.m ≤ st.total T' → st.total T' ≤ st.total T) ∧
      ∀ T' ∈ st.faces r, st.total T' = st.total T → st.labelTuple T ≤ st.labelTuple T'
proof:
:= by
  rw [choice, Finset.mem_filter, mem_maximizers]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, h4⟩
    refine ⟨h1, h2, h3, fun T' hT' he => h4 T' (st.mem_maximizers.mpr ⟨hT', he ▸ h2, ?_⟩)⟩
    exact fun T'' hT'' hm => he ▸ h3 T'' hT'' hm
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    refine ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, fun T' hT' => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h1', h2', h3'⟩ := st.mem_maximizers.mp hT'
    exact h4 T' h1' (le_antisymm (h3 T' h1' h2') (h3' T h1 h2))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_faces_of_mem_choice
statement:
theorem mem_faces_of_mem_choice {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (h : T ∈ st.choice r) :
    T ∈ st.faces r
proof:
:=
  (st.mem_choice.mp h).1

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_nerve_of_mem_choice
statement: theorem mem_nerve_of_mem_choice {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (h : T ∈ st.choice r) : T ∈ st.nerve
proof:
:=
  (st.mem_faces.mp (st.mem_faces_of_mem_choice h)).1

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.card_of_mem_choice
statement: theorem card_of_mem_choice {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (h : T ∈ st.choice r) : T.card = r
proof:
:=
  (st.mem_faces.mp (st.mem_faces_of_mem_choice h)).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.m_le_total_of_mem_choice
statement:
theorem m_le_total_of_mem_choice {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (h : T ∈ st.choice r) :
    st.m ≤ st.total T
proof:
:=
  (st.mem_choice.mp h).2.1

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_eq_of_mem_choice
statement:
theorem total_eq_of_mem_choice {r : ℕ} {T T' : Finset ℕ} (h : T ∈ st.choice r)
    (h' : T' ∈ st.choice r) : st.total T = st.total T'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := st.mem_choice.mp h
  obtain ⟨h1', h2', h3', -⟩ := st.mem_choice.mp h'
  exact le_antisymm (h3' T h1 h2) (h3 T' h1' h2')

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.labelTuple_eq_of_mem_choice
statement:
theorem labelTuple_eq_of_mem_choice {r : ℕ} {T T' : Finset ℕ} (h : T ∈ st.choice r)
    (h' : T' ∈ st.choice r) : st.labelTuple T = st.labelTuple T'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, -, h4⟩ := st.mem_choice.mp h
  obtain ⟨h1', -, -, h4'⟩ := st.mem_choice.mp h'
  exact le_antisymm (h4 T' h1' (st.total_eq_of_mem_choice h' h))
    (h4' T h1 (st.total_eq_of_mem_choice h h'))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_eq_maxTotal_of_mem_choice
statement:
theorem total_eq_maxTotal_of_mem_choice {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (h : T ∈ st.choice r) :
    st.total T = st.maxTotal r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := st.mem_choice.mp h
  refine le_antisymm (st.total_le_maxTotal h1) (st.maxTotal_le fun T' hT' => ?_)
  by_cases hm : st.m ≤ st.total T'
  · exact h3 T' hT' hm
  · exact (not_le.mp hm).le.trans h2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.choice_eq_empty_iff
statement: theorem choice_eq_empty_iff {r : ℕ} : st.choice r = ∅ ↔ st.Star r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h T hT
    by_contra hm
    have hne : (st.candidates r).Nonempty := ⟨T, st.mem_candidates.mpr ⟨hT, not_lt.mp hm⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀, hsup⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ hne st.total
    have hmax : (st.maximizers r).Nonempty := ⟨T₀, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hT₀, hsup.symm⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image _ st.labelTuple hmax
    exact Finset.notMem_empty T₁ (h ▸ Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hT₁, hmin⟩)
  · intro h
    refine Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun T hT => ?_
    exact absurd (st.m_le_total_of_mem_choice hT) (not_le.mpr (h T (st.mem_faces_of_mem_choice hT)))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.choice_nonempty_iff
statement: theorem choice_nonempty_iff {r : ℕ} : (st.choice r).Nonempty ↔ ¬ st.Star r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, not_iff_not, choice_eq_empty_iff]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_blowUpNerve
statement:
theorem mem_blowUpNerve {N S : Finset (Finset ℕ)} {c : Finset ℕ → ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} :
    T ∈ blowUpNerve N S c ↔ (T ∈ N ∧ ∀ P ∈ S, ¬ P ⊆ T) ∨
      ∃ P ∈ S, ∃ T₁, (T₁ = ∅ ∨ T₁ ∈ N) ∧ T₁ ∪ P ∈ N ∧ (∀ Q ∈ S, ¬ Q ⊆ T₁) ∧
        T = insert (c P) T₁
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blowUpNerve, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_biUnion,
    Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_insert]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨P, hP, T₁, ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨P, hP, T₁, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
  · rintro (h | ⟨P, hP, T₁, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨P, hP, T₁, ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, rfl⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.faceList_injective
statement: theorem faceList_injective : Function.Injective faceList
proof: := fun _ _ h => sortedList_injective h

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.rank_lt_card
statement: theorem rank_lt_card {S : Finset (Finset ℕ)} {P : Finset ℕ} (hP : P ∈ S) : rank S P < S.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.filter_ssubset.mpr ⟨P, hP, lt_irrefl _⟩)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.rank_lt_rank
statement:
theorem rank_lt_rank {S : Finset (Finset ℕ)} {P Q : Finset ℕ} (hP : P ∈ S)
    (h : faceList P < faceList Q) : rank S P < rank S Q
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.card_lt_card ⟨fun R hR => ?_, fun hsub => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨hR, hlt⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hR
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hR, hlt.trans h⟩
  · have := Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsub (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hP, h⟩))
    exact lt_irrefl _ this.2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.rank_injOn
statement: theorem rank_injOn (S : Finset (Finset ℕ)) : Set.InjOn (rank S) S
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP Q hQ h
  by_contra hne : P ≠ Q
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (faceList_injective.ne hne) with hlt | hlt
  · exact absurd h (ne_of_lt (rank_lt_rank hP hlt))
  · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt (rank_lt_rank hQ hlt))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.nextComp_le_newComp
statement:
theorem nextComp_le_newComp (S : Finset (Finset ℕ)) (P : Finset ℕ) :
    st.nextComp ≤ st.newComp S P
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_add_right _ _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.newComp_lt
statement:
theorem newComp_lt {S : Finset (Finset ℕ)} {P : Finset ℕ} (hP : P ∈ S) :
    st.newComp S P < st.nextComp + S.card
proof:
:=
  Nat.add_lt_add_left (rank_lt_card hP) _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.newComp_injOn
statement: theorem newComp_injOn (S : Finset (Finset ℕ)) : Set.InjOn (st.newComp S) S
proof:
:=
  fun _ hP _ hQ h => rank_injOn S hP hQ (Nat.add_left_cancel h)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.newComp_notMem
statement:
theorem newComp_notMem {S : Finset (Finset ℕ)} {P T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ st.nerve) :
    st.newComp S P ∉ T
proof:
:= fun h =>
  absurd (st.lt_nextComp_of_mem hT h) (not_lt.mpr (st.nextComp_le_newComp S P))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_n
statement: @[simp] theorem blowUp_n : (st.blowUp S).n = st.n
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_m
statement: @[simp] theorem blowUp_m : (st.blowUp S).m = st.m
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_nextComp
statement: @[simp] theorem blowUp_nextComp : (st.blowUp S).nextComp = st.nextComp + S.card
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_nextLabel
statement: @[simp] theorem blowUp_nextLabel : (st.blowUp S).nextLabel = st.nextLabel + 1
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_nerve
statement: theorem blowUp_nerve : (st.blowUp S).nerve = blowUpNerve st.nerve S (st.newComp S)
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_label_of_lt
statement: theorem blowUp_label_of_lt {c : ℕ} (hc : c < st.nextComp) : (st.blowUp S).label c = st.label c
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left hc

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_a_of_lt
statement: theorem blowUp_a_of_lt {c : ℕ} (hc : c < st.nextComp) : (st.blowUp S).a c = st.a c
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left hc

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_label_newComp
statement: theorem blowUp_label_newComp (P : Finset ℕ) : (st.blowUp S).label (st.newComp S P) = st.nextLabel
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr (st.nextComp_le_newComp S P))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_a_newComp
statement:
theorem blowUp_a_newComp {P : Finset ℕ} (hP : P ∈ S) :
    (st.blowUp S).a (st.newComp S P) = st.total P - st.m
proof:
:= by
  change (if st.newComp S P < st.nextComp then st.a (st.newComp S P)
    else (S.filter fun Q => st.newComp S Q = st.newComp S P).sup fun Q => st.total Q - st.m) = _
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr (st.nextComp_le_newComp S P))]
  have : (S.filter fun Q => st.newComp S Q = st.newComp S P) = {P} :=
    Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hP, rfl⟩,
      fun Q hQ => st.newComp_injOn S (Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ).1 hP (Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ).2⟩
  rw [this, Finset.sup_singleton]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_total_of_lt
statement:
theorem blowUp_total_of_lt {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < st.nextComp) :
    (st.blowUp S).total T = st.total T
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c hc => st.blowUp_a_of_lt S (hT c hc)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_total_insert_newComp
statement:
theorem blowUp_total_insert_newComp {P T₁ : Finset ℕ} (hP : P ∈ S)
    (hT₁ : ∀ c ∈ T₁, c < st.nextComp) :
    (st.blowUp S).total (insert (st.newComp S P) T₁) = (st.total P - st.m) + st.total T₁
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : st.newComp S P ∉ T₁ := fun h =>
    absurd (hT₁ _ h) (not_lt.mpr (st.nextComp_le_newComp S P))
  rw [total_insert _ hnot, st.blowUp_a_newComp S hP, st.blowUp_total_of_lt S hT₁]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.isCenter_choice
statement: theorem isCenter_choice (r : ℕ) : st.IsCenter (st.choice r)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ hP => st.mem_nerve_of_mem_choice hP, fun _ hP _ hQ =>
    st.labelTuple_eq_iff.mp (st.labelTuple_eq_of_mem_choice hP hQ)⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.eq_of_isCenter_of_subset
statement:
theorem eq_of_isCenter_of_subset {P Q T : Finset ℕ} (hS : st.IsCenter S) (hP : P ∈ S) (hQ : Q ∈ S)
    (hT : T ∈ st.nerve) (hPT : P ⊆ T) (hQT : Q ⊆ T) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := st.nerve_labels T hT
  have key : ∀ {A B : Finset ℕ}, A ∈ S → B ∈ S → A ⊆ T → B ⊆ T → A ⊆ B := by
    intro A B hA hB hAT hBT x hx
    have hlx : st.label x ∈ st.labels B := hS.2 A hA B hB ▸ Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hlx
    exact hinj (hBT hy) (hAT hx) hxy ▸ hy
  exact le_antisymm (key hP hQ hPT hQT) (key hQ hP hQT hPT)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.mem_blowUp_nerve
statement:
theorem mem_blowUp_nerve {T : Finset ℕ} (hS : st.IsCenter S) :
    T ∈ (st.blowUp S).nerve ↔ (T ∈ st.nerve ∧ ∀ P ∈ S, ¬ P ⊆ T) ∨
      ∃ P ∈ S, ∃ T₁, T₁ ∪ P ∈ st.nerve ∧ ¬ P ⊆ T₁ ∧ T = insert (st.newComp S P) T₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowUp_nerve, mem_blowUpNerve]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨P, hP, T₁, -, h1, h3, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨P, hP, T₁, h1, h3 P hP, rfl⟩
  · rintro (h | ⟨P, hP, T₁, h1, h3, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · refine Or.inr ⟨P, hP, T₁, ?_, h1, fun Q hQ hQT₁ => ?_, rfl⟩
      · by_cases he : T₁ = ∅
        · exact Or.inl he
        · exact Or.inr (st.mem_nerve_of_subset h1 Finset.subset_union_left
            (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr he))
      · exact h3 (st.eq_of_isCenter_of_subset S hS hQ hP h1
          (hQT₁.trans Finset.subset_union_left) Finset.subset_union_right ▸ hQT₁)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.valid_self
statement:
theorem valid_self (st : MonomialState) :
    MonomialState.Valid st.n st.m st.nextComp st.nextLabel st.label st.nerve
proof:
:=
  ⟨st.one_le_m, st.nerve_nonempty, st.nerve_lt, fun c _ hc => st.label_lt c hc,
    fun T hT T' hT' hne => st.nerve_down T hT T' (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hT') hne, st.nerve_card,
    st.nerve_labels⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_newFace_lt
statement:
theorem total_newFace_lt (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) (hP : P ∈ st.choice r)
    (hT₁ : T₁ ∪ P ∈ st.nerve) (hc : c ∈ P) (hcT₁ : c ∉ T₁) :
    insert c T₁ ∈ st.nerve ∧
    (insert c T₁).card = (insert (st.newComp (st.choice r) P) T₁).card ∧
    (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total (insert (st.newComp (st.choice r) P) T₁) + st.m =
      st.total (insert c T₁) + st.total (P.erase c) ∧
    st.total (P.erase c) < st.m ∧
    (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total (insert (st.newComp (st.choice r) P) T₁) <
      st.total (insert c T₁)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : insert c T₁ ∈ st.nerve :=
    st.mem_nerve_of_subset hT₁ (Finset.insert_subset (Finset.mem_union_right _ hc)
      Finset.subset_union_left) (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _)
  have hold : ∀ x ∈ T₁, x < st.nextComp := fun x hx =>
    st.lt_nextComp_of_mem hT₁ (Finset.mem_union_left _ hx)
  have hnew : st.newComp (st.choice r) P ∉ T₁ := fun h =>
    st.newComp_notMem hT₁ (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
  have hcard : (insert c T₁).card = (insert (st.newComp (st.choice r) P) T₁).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hcT₁, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnew]
  have hmP : st.m ≤ st.total P := st.m_le_total_of_mem_choice hP
  have h1 := st.blowUp_total_insert_newComp (st.choice r) hP hold
  have h2 := st.total_insert (T := T₁) hcT₁
  have h3 := st.total_erase_add hc
  have heq : (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total (insert (st.newComp (st.choice r) P) T₁) + st.m =
      st.total (insert c T₁) + st.total (P.erase c) := by
    rw [h1, h2]; omega
  have hlt : st.total (P.erase c) < st.m := by
    by_cases hne : (P.erase c).Nonempty
    · have hface : P.erase c ∈ st.nerve :=
        st.mem_nerve_of_subset (st.mem_nerve_of_mem_choice hP) (Finset.erase_subset _ _) hne
      have hr : P.card = r := st.card_of_mem_choice hP
      have hpos : 0 < r := hr ▸ Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine hs (r - 1) (Nat.sub_lt hpos Nat.one_pos) _ (st.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hface, ?_⟩)
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hc, hr]
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, total_empty]
      exact st.one_le_m
  exact ⟨hmem, hcard, heq, hlt, by omega⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_le_maxTotal_of_mem_blowUp_faces
statement:
theorem total_le_maxTotal_of_mem_blowUp_faces {s : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (hT : T ∈ (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).faces s) :
    (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total T ≤ st.maxTotal s ∧
    ((st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total T = st.maxTotal s →
      T ∈ st.faces s ∧ st.total T = st.maxTotal s ∧ T ∉ st.choice r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hTn, hTs⟩ := (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).mem_faces.mp hT
  rcases (st.mem_blowUp_nerve (st.choice r) (st.isCenter_choice r)).mp hTn with
    ⟨hTold, hnot⟩ | ⟨P, hP, T₁, hT₁, hPT₁, rfl⟩
  · have htot : (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total T = st.total T :=
      st.blowUp_total_of_lt _ fun x hx => st.lt_nextComp_of_mem hTold hx
    have hTf : T ∈ st.faces s := st.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hTold, hTs⟩
    refine ⟨htot ▸ st.total_le_maxTotal hTf, fun he => ⟨hTf, htot ▸ he, fun hTS => ?_⟩⟩
    exact hnot T hTS subset_rfl
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hcT₁⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hPT₁
    obtain ⟨hmem, hcard, -, -, hlt⟩ := st.total_newFace_lt hs hP hT₁ hc hcT₁
    have hface : insert c T₁ ∈ st.faces s := st.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hmem, hcard.trans hTs⟩
    have hle := st.total_le_maxTotal hface
    exact ⟨(hlt.trans_le hle).le, fun he => absurd he (ne_of_lt (hlt.trans_le hle))⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.measure_blowUp_lt
statement:
theorem measure_blowUp_lt (h : (st.choice r).Nonempty) :
    (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).measure r < st.measure r
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).maxTotal r ≤ st.maxTotal r :=
    maxTotal_le _ fun T hT => (st.total_le_maxTotal_of_mem_blowUp_faces hs hT).1
  rw [measure, measure, Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex]
  rcases hle.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  · refine Or.inr ⟨heq, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := h
    refine Finset.card_lt_card ((Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset fun T hT => ?_).mpr ⟨P, ?_, ?_⟩)
    · obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hT
      obtain ⟨hf, ht, -⟩ := (st.total_le_maxTotal_of_mem_blowUp_faces hs hT1).2 (heq ▸ hT2)
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hf, ht⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨st.mem_faces_of_mem_choice hP,
        st.total_eq_maxTotal_of_mem_choice hP⟩
    · intro hPm
      obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hPm
      exact (st.total_le_maxTotal_of_mem_blowUp_faces hs hT1).2 (heq ▸ hT2) |>.2.2 hP

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.star_blowUp
statement: theorem star_blowUp {s : ℕ} (hsr : s < r) : (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).Star s
proof:
:= by
  intro T hT
  obtain ⟨hTn, hTs⟩ := (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).mem_faces.mp hT
  rcases (st.mem_blowUp_nerve (st.choice r) (st.isCenter_choice r)).mp hTn with
    ⟨hTold, -⟩ | ⟨P, hP, T₁, hT₁, hPT₁, rfl⟩
  · rw [st.blowUp_total_of_lt _ fun x hx => st.lt_nextComp_of_mem hTold hx]
    exact hs s hsr T (st.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hTold, hTs⟩)
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hcT₁⟩ := Finset.not_subset.mp hPT₁
    obtain ⟨hmem, hcard, -, -, hlt⟩ := st.total_newFace_lt hs hP hT₁ hc hcT₁
    exact hlt.trans (hs s hsr _ (st.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hmem, hcard.trans hTs⟩))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.measure_blowUp_le
statement:
theorem measure_blowUp_le (s : ℕ) :
    (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).measure s ≤ st.measure s
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).maxTotal s ≤ st.maxTotal s :=
    maxTotal_le _ fun T hT => (st.total_le_maxTotal_of_mem_blowUp_faces hs hT).1
  rw [measure, measure, Prod.Lex.toLex_le_toLex]
  rcases hle.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  · refine Or.inr ⟨heq, Finset.card_le_card fun T hT => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hT
    obtain ⟨hf, ht, -⟩ := (st.total_le_maxTotal_of_mem_blowUp_faces hs hT1).2 (heq ▸ hT2)
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hf, ht⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem phase_of_nonempty (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s)
    (h : (st.choice r).Nonempty) :
    phase r st hs = ((phase r (st.blowUp (st.choice r)) fun _ hsr => st.star_blowUp hs hsr).1,
      st.choice r :: (phase r (st.blowUp (st.choice r)) fun _ hsr => st.star_blowUp hs hsr).2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [phase, ite_eq_left h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_of_not_nonempty
statement:
theorem phase_of_not_nonempty (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s)
    (h : ¬ (st.choice r).Nonempty) : phase r st hs = (st, [])
proof:
:= by
  rw [phase, ite_eq_right h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.IsRun.exists_get_eq_choice
statement:
theorem IsRun.exists_get_eq_choice {st st' : MonomialState}
    {L : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))} (h : MonomialState.IsRun st L st') (i : Fin L.length) :
    ∃ r, 1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ ((L.take i).foldl MonomialState.blowUp st).n ∧
      (((L.take i).foldl MonomialState.blowUp st).choice r).Nonempty ∧
      L.get i = ((L.take i).foldl MonomialState.blowUp st).choice r
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil st => exact i.elim0
  | cons r hr hrn hne _ ih =>
    rcases i with ⟨_ | j, hj⟩
    · exact ⟨r, hr, hrn, hne, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨r', hr', hrn', hne', hget⟩ := ih ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj⟩
      exact ⟨r', hr', hrn', hne', hget⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.IsRun.append
statement:
theorem IsRun.append {st st₁ st₂ : MonomialState} {L₁ L₂ : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))}
    (h₁ : IsRun st L₁ st₁) (h₂ : IsRun st₁ L₂ st₂) : IsRun st (L₁ ++ L₂) st₂
proof:
:= by
  induction h₁ with
  | nil => exact h₂
  | cons r hr hrn h _ ih => exact IsRun.cons r hr hrn h (ih h₂)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.IsRun.fold
statement:
theorem IsRun.fold {st st' : MonomialState} {L : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))} (h : IsRun st L st') :
    st' = L.foldl blowUp st
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.IsRun.n_eq
statement:
theorem IsRun.n_eq {st st' : MonomialState} {L : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))} (h : IsRun st L st') :
    st'.n = st.n
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.IsRun.m_eq
statement:
theorem IsRun.m_eq {st st' : MonomialState} {L : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))} (h : IsRun st L st') :
    st'.m = st.m
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_isRun
statement:
theorem phase_isRun (hr : 1 ≤ r) (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) (hrn : r ≤ st.n) :
    IsRun st (phase r st hs).2 (phase r st hs).1
proof:
:= by
  induction st, hs using phase.induct r with
  | case1 st hs h ih =>
    rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs h]
    exact IsRun.cons r hr hrn h (ih hrn)
  | case2 st hs h =>
    rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs h]
    exact IsRun.nil st

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_star
statement: theorem phase_star (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) : (phase r st hs).1.Star r
proof:
:= by
  induction st, hs using phase.induct r with
  | case1 st hs h ih => rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs h]; exact ih
  | case2 st hs h =>
    rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs h]
    exact st.choice_eq_empty_iff.mp (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_star_of_lt
statement:
theorem phase_star_of_lt (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) {s : ℕ} (hsr : s < r) :
    (phase r st hs).1.Star s
proof:
:= by
  induction st, hs using phase.induct r with
  | case1 st hs h ih => rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs h]; exact ih
  | case2 st hs h => rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs h]; exact hs s hsr

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_n
statement: theorem phase_n (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) : (phase r st hs).1.n = st.n
proof:
:= by
  induction st, hs using phase.induct r with
  | case1 st hs h ih => rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs h]; exact ih
  | case2 st hs h => rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_m
statement: theorem phase_m (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) : (phase r st hs).1.m = st.m
proof:
:= by
  induction st, hs using phase.induct r with
  | case1 st hs h ih => rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs h]; exact ih
  | case2 st hs h => rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_star_succ
statement:
theorem phase_star_succ (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    ∀ s < r + 1, (phase r st hs).1.Star s
proof:
:= fun s hsr => by
  rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hsr with h | rfl
  · exact phase_star_of_lt st hs h
  · exact phase_star st hs

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_zero
statement:
theorem phases_zero (r : ℕ) (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    phases 0 r st hs = (st, [])
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_succ
statement:
theorem phases_succ (k r : ℕ) (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    phases (k + 1) r st hs =
      ((phases k (r + 1) (phase r st hs).1 (phase_star_succ st hs)).1,
        (phase r st hs).2 ++ (phases k (r + 1) (phase r st hs).1 (phase_star_succ st hs)).2)
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_n
statement:
theorem phases_n (k r : ℕ) (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    (phases k r st hs).1.n = st.n
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing r st with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => rw [phases_succ, ih, phase_n]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_m
statement:
theorem phases_m (k r : ℕ) (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    (phases k r st hs).1.m = st.m
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing r st with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => rw [phases_succ, ih, phase_m]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_star
statement:
theorem phases_star (k r : ℕ) (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    ∀ s < r + k, (phases k r st hs).1.Star s
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing r st with
  | zero => intro s hsr; exact hs s (by simpa using hsr)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro s hsr
    rw [phases_succ]
    exact ih (r + 1) _ (phase_star_succ st hs) s (by omega)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_isRun
statement:
theorem phases_isRun (k r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s)
    (hk : r + k ≤ st.n + 1) : IsRun st (phases k r st hs).2 (phases k r st hs).1
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing r st with
  | zero => exact IsRun.nil st
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [phases_succ]
    have hp := phase_isRun hr st hs (by omega)
    refine hp.append (ih (r + 1) (by omega) _ (phase_star_succ st hs) ?_)
    rw [phase_n]; omega

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.star_of_lt_one
statement: theorem star_of_lt_one (st : MonomialState) : ∀ s < 1, st.Star s
proof:
:= fun s hs => by
  obtain rfl : s = 0 := by omega
  exact st.star_zero

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_n
statement: theorem step3_n (st : MonomialState) : (step3 st).1.n = st.n
proof: := phases_n _ _ _ _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_m
statement: theorem step3_m (st : MonomialState) : (step3 st).1.m = st.m
proof: := phases_m _ _ _ _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_star
statement: theorem step3_star (st : MonomialState) (s : ℕ) : (step3 st).1.Star s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : s < 1 + st.n
  · exact phases_star st.n 1 st (star_of_lt_one st) s hs
  · exact star_of_lt _ (by rw [step3_n]; omega)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_maxOrd_lt
statement:
theorem step3_maxOrd_lt (st : MonomialState) {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ (step3 st).1.nerve) :
    (step3 st).1.total T < st.m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← step3_m st]
  exact step3_star st T.card T ((step3 st).1.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hT, rfl⟩)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_isRun
statement: theorem step3_isRun (st : MonomialState) : IsRun st (step3 st).2 (step3 st).1
proof:
:=
  phases_isRun st.n 1 le_rfl st (star_of_lt_one st) (by omega)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_eq_of_phaseFuel
statement:
theorem phase_eq_of_phaseFuel {fuel : ℕ} {st : MonomialState} (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s)
    {res : MonomialState × List (Finset (Finset ℕ))} (h : phaseFuel fuel r st = some res) :
    phase r st hs = res
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing st res with
  | zero => exact absurd h (by simp [phaseFuel])
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases hne : (st.choice r).Nonempty
    · rw [phaseFuel, ite_eq_left hne, Option.map_eq_some_iff] at h
      obtain ⟨res', hres', rfl⟩ := h
      rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs hne, ih (fun _ hsr => st.star_blowUp hs hsr) hres']
    · rw [phaseFuel, ite_eq_right hne, Option.some.injEq] at h
      rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs hne, h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_eq_of_phasesFuel
statement:
theorem phases_eq_of_phasesFuel {fuel k r : ℕ} {st : MonomialState} (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s)
    {res : MonomialState × List (Finset (Finset ℕ))} (h : phasesFuel fuel k r st = some res) :
    phases k r st hs = res
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing r st res with
  | zero =>
    simp only [phasesFuel, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [phases_zero, h]
  | succ k ih =>
    rcases hp : phaseFuel fuel r st with _ | p
    · simp [phasesFuel, hp] at h
    · rcases hq : phasesFuel fuel k (r + 1) p.1 with _ | q
      · simp [phasesFuel, hp, hq] at h
      · simp only [phasesFuel, hp, hq, Option.some.injEq] at h
        have hpe : phase r st hs = p := phase_eq_of_phaseFuel hs hp
        have hq' : phasesFuel fuel k (r + 1) (phase r st hs).1 = some q := by rw [hpe]; exact hq
        rw [phases_succ, ih (phase_star_succ st hs) hq', hpe, ← h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_eq_of_step3Fuel
proof:
:=
  phases_eq_of_phasesFuel (star_of_lt_one st) h

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_map_eq_of_step3Fuel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨res, hres, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp h
  rw [step3_eq_of_step3Fuel hres]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUpNerve_mono
statement:
theorem blowUpNerve_mono {N N' S : Finset (Finset ℕ)} {c : Finset ℕ → ℕ} (h : N ⊆ N') :
    blowUpNerve N S c ⊆ blowUpNerve N' S c
proof:
:= by
  intro T hT
  rcases mem_blowUpNerve.mp hT with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨P, hP, T₁, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
  · exact mem_blowUpNerve.mpr (Or.inl ⟨h h1, h2⟩)
  · exact mem_blowUpNerve.mpr (Or.inr ⟨P, hP, T₁, h1.imp_right (fun h1 => h h1), h h2, h3, rfl⟩)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.total_eq
statement:
theorem Sub.total_eq {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) (T : Finset ℕ) :
    L.total T = N.total T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [total, h.a_eq]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.newComp_eq
statement:
theorem Sub.newComp_eq {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) (S : Finset (Finset ℕ)) (P : Finset ℕ) :
    L.newComp S P = N.newComp S P
proof:
:= by
  simp only [newComp, h.nextComp_eq]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.blowUp
statement:
theorem Sub.blowUp {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) (S : Finset (Finset ℕ)) :
    Sub (L.blowUp S) (N.blowUp S) where
  n_eq
proof:
:= h.n_eq
  m_eq := h.m_eq
  nextComp_eq := by simp only [blowUp_nextComp, h.nextComp_eq]
  nextLabel_eq := by simp only [blowUp_nextLabel, h.nextLabel_eq]
  label_eq := by
    funext c
    change (if c < L.nextComp then L.label c else L.nextLabel) =
      (if c < N.nextComp then N.label c else N.nextLabel)
    rw [h.nextComp_eq, h.label_eq, h.nextLabel_eq]
  a_eq := by
    funext c
    change (if c < L.nextComp then L.a c
        else (S.filter fun P => L.newComp S P = c).sup fun P => L.total P - L.m) =
      (if c < N.nextComp then N.a c
        else (S.filter fun P => N.newComp S P = c).sup fun P => N.total P - N.m)
    simp only [h.nextComp_eq, h.a_eq, h.m_eq, h.total_eq, h.newComp_eq]
  nerve_sub := by
    rw [blowUp_nerve, blowUp_nerve]
    have : L.newComp S = N.newComp S := funext (h.newComp_eq S)
    rw [this]
    exact blowUpNerve_mono h.nerve_sub

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.mem_faces
statement:
theorem Sub.mem_faces {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (hT : T ∈ L.faces r) : T ∈ N.faces r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := L.mem_faces.mp hT
  exact N.mem_faces.mpr ⟨h.nerve_sub h1, h2⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.labelTuple_eq
statement:
theorem Sub.labelTuple_eq {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) (T : Finset ℕ) :
    L.labelTuple T = N.labelTuple T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [labelTuple, labels, h.label_eq]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.choice_eq_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hPf, hPm, hPmax, hPlex⟩ := N.mem_choice.mp hP
  have hPfL : P ∈ L.faces r := L.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hPL, (N.mem_faces.mp hPf).2⟩
  ext T
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, L.mem_choice, N.mem_choice]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hTf, hTm, hTmax, hTlex⟩
    have hTN : T ∈ N.faces r := h.mem_faces hTf
    have hTL : T ∈ L.nerve := (L.mem_faces.mp hTf).1
    have hPT : N.total P ≤ N.total T := by
      rw [← h.total_eq, ← h.total_eq]; exact hTmax P hPfL (h.m_eq ▸ (h.total_eq P).symm ▸ hPm)
    have hTP : N.total T ≤ N.total P := hPmax T hTN (h.m_eq ▸ h.total_eq T ▸ hTm)
    have hTeq : N.total T = N.total P := le_antisymm hTP hPT
    refine ⟨⟨hTN, h.m_eq ▸ h.total_eq T ▸ hTm, fun T' hT' hm => (hPmax T' hT' hm).trans hPT,
      fun T' hT' he => ?_⟩, hTL⟩
    have h1 : L.labelTuple T ≤ L.labelTuple P := hTlex P hPfL (by
      rw [h.total_eq, h.total_eq]; exact hTeq.symm)
    rw [h.labelTuple_eq, h.labelTuple_eq] at h1
    exact h1.trans (hPlex T' hT' (he.trans hTeq))
  · rintro ⟨⟨hTf, hTm, hTmax, hTlex⟩, hTL⟩
    refine ⟨L.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hTL, (N.mem_faces.mp hTf).2⟩, ?_, fun T' hT' hm => ?_,
      fun T' hT' he => ?_⟩
    · rw [h.m_eq, h.total_eq]; exact hTm
    · rw [h.total_eq, h.total_eq]
      exact hTmax T' (h.mem_faces hT') (by rw [← h.m_eq, ← h.total_eq]; exact hm)
    · rw [h.labelTuple_eq, h.labelTuple_eq]
      exact hTlex T' (h.mem_faces hT') (by rw [← h.total_eq, ← h.total_eq]; exact he)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.blowUp_nerve_of_forall_notMem
statement:
theorem blowUp_nerve_of_forall_notMem (L : MonomialState) {S : Finset (Finset ℕ)}
    (hS0 : ∀ P ∈ S, P.Nonempty) (hS : ∀ P ∈ S, P ∉ L.nerve) : (L.blowUp S).nerve = L.nerve
proof:
:= by
  ext T
  rw [blowUp_nerve, mem_blowUpNerve]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨h1, -⟩ | ⟨P, hP, T₁, -, h1, h3, rfl⟩)
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd (L.mem_nerve_of_subset h1 Finset.subset_union_right (hS0 P hP)) (hS P hP)
  · intro hT
    exact Or.inl ⟨hT, fun P hP hPT => hS P hP (L.mem_nerve_of_subset hT hPT (hS0 P hP))⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.foldl
statement:
theorem Sub.foldl {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) (Ns : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))) :
    Sub (Ns.foldl MonomialState.blowUp L) (Ns.foldl MonomialState.blowUp N)
proof:
:= by
  induction Ns generalizing L N with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons S Ns ih => exact ih (h.blowUp S)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.sub_foldl_step3
statement:
theorem sub_foldl_step3 {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) :
    Sub ((step3 N).2.foldl MonomialState.blowUp L) (step3 N).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [(step3_isRun N).fold]
  exact h.foldl _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.image_filter_mem_image
statement:
theorem image_filter_mem_image {ρ : ℕ → ℕ} {W A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A ⊆ W.image ρ) :
    (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ A).image ρ = A
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).2
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (hA hy)
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hw, hy⟩)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.card_image
statement: theorem card_image {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ Y.nerve) : (T.image ρ).card = T.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_image_of_injOn (h.injOn T hT)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.total_image
statement: theorem total_image {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ Y.nerve) : L.total (T.image ρ) = Y.total T
proof:
:= by
  rw [total, total, Finset.sum_image (h.injOn T hT)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c hc => h.a_eq c (MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem _ hT hc)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.labels_image
statement: theorem labels_image {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ Y.nerve) : L.labels (T.image ρ) = Y.labels T
proof:
:= by
  rw [labels, labels, Finset.image_image]
  exact Finset.image_congr fun c hc => h.label_eq c (MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem _ hT hc)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.labelTuple_image
statement:
theorem labelTuple_image {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ Y.nerve) :
    L.labelTuple (T.image ρ) = Y.labelTuple T
proof:
:= by
  rw [labelTuple, labelTuple, h.labels_image hT]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.image_mem_faces
statement: theorem image_mem_faces {r : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ Y.faces r) : T.image ρ ∈ L.faces r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hT, hc⟩ := Y.mem_faces.mp hT
  exact L.mem_faces.mpr ⟨h.image_mem T hT, (h.card_image hT).trans hc⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.exists_lift_faces
statement:
theorem exists_lift_faces {r : ℕ} {T' : Finset ℕ} (hT' : T' ∈ L.faces r) :
    ∃ T ∈ Y.faces r, T.image ρ = T'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hT', hc⟩ := L.mem_faces.mp hT'
  obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := h.exists_lift T' hT'
  exact ⟨T, Y.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hT, (h.card_image hT).symm.trans hc⟩, rfl⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.star_iff
statement: theorem star_iff (s : ℕ) : L.Star s ↔ Y.Star s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs T hT
    have := hs _ (h.image_mem_faces hT)
    rwa [h.total_image (Y.mem_faces.mp hT).1, ← h.m_eq] at this
  · intro hs T' hT'
    obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := h.exists_lift_faces hT'
    rw [h.total_image (Y.mem_faces.mp hT).1, ← h.m_eq]
    exact hs T hT

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.choice_eq
statement: theorem choice_eq (r : ℕ) : Y.choice r = Y.nerve.filter fun Q => Q.image ρ ∈ L.choice r
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Y.mem_choice, L.mem_choice]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hm, hmax, hlex⟩
    have hQ : Q ∈ Y.nerve := (Y.mem_faces.mp hf).1
    refine ⟨hQ, h.image_mem_faces hf, ?_, fun T' hT' hm' => ?_, fun T' hT' he => ?_⟩
    · rw [h.total_image hQ, ← h.m_eq]; exact hm
    · obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := h.exists_lift_faces hT'
      have hTn : T ∈ Y.nerve := (Y.mem_faces.mp hT).1
      rw [h.total_image hTn, h.total_image hQ]
      exact hmax T hT (by rwa [h.total_image hTn, ← h.m_eq] at hm')
    · obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := h.exists_lift_faces hT'
      have hTn : T ∈ Y.nerve := (Y.mem_faces.mp hT).1
      rw [h.labelTuple_image hQ, h.labelTuple_image hTn]
      exact hlex T hT (by rwa [h.total_image hTn, h.total_image hQ] at he)
  · rintro ⟨hQ, hf, hm, hmax, hlex⟩
    have hQf : Q ∈ Y.faces r := Y.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hQ, by
      have := (L.mem_faces.mp hf).2; rwa [h.card_image hQ] at this⟩
    refine ⟨hQf, ?_, fun T hT hm' => ?_, fun T hT he => ?_⟩
    · rwa [h.total_image hQ, ← h.m_eq] at hm
    · have hTn : T ∈ Y.nerve := (Y.mem_faces.mp hT).1
      have := hmax (T.image ρ) (h.image_mem_faces hT)
        (by rw [h.total_image hTn, ← h.m_eq]; exact hm')
      rwa [h.total_image hTn, h.total_image hQ] at this
    · have hTn : T ∈ Y.nerve := (Y.mem_faces.mp hT).1
      have := hlex (T.image ρ) (h.image_mem_faces hT)
        (by rw [h.total_image hTn, h.total_image hQ]; exact he)
      rwa [h.labelTuple_image hQ, h.labelTuple_image hTn] at this

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.choice_image
statement: theorem choice_image (r : ℕ) : L.choice r = (Y.choice r).image (Finset.image ρ)
proof:
:= by
  ext T'
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro hT'
    obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := h.exists_lift T' (L.mem_nerve_of_mem_choice hT')
    exact ⟨T, by rw [h.choice_eq]; exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hT, hT'⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
    rw [h.choice_eq] at hT
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.choice_nonempty_iff
statement: theorem choice_nonempty_iff (r : ℕ) : (Y.choice r).Nonempty ↔ (L.choice r).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.choice_image, Finset.image_nonempty]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.image_mem_center'
statement:
theorem image_mem_center' (hSL : S_L = S_Y.image (Finset.image ρ)) {Q : Finset ℕ} (hQ : Q ∈ S_Y) :
    Q.image ρ ∈ S_L
proof:
:= by
  rw [hSL]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hQ

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.exists_of_mem_center'
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_center' (hSL : S_L = S_Y.image (Finset.image ρ)) {Q' : Finset ℕ}
    (hQ' : Q' ∈ S_L) : ∃ Q ∈ S_Y, Q.image ρ = Q'
proof:
:= by
  rw [hSL] at hQ'; exact Finset.mem_image.mp hQ'

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.nonempty_of_mem_center'
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_mem_center' (hSY : S_Y ⊆ Y.nerve) (hSL : S_L = S_Y.image (Finset.image ρ))
    {Q' : Finset ℕ} (hQ' : Q' ∈ S_L) : Q'.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_center' hSL hQ'
  exact (Y.nerve_nonempty Q (hSY hQ)).image _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.not_subset_image_of_forall
statement:
theorem not_subset_image_of_forall {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ Y.nerve)
    (hTS : ∀ Q ∈ S_Y, ¬ Q ⊆ T) : ∀ Q' ∈ S_L, ¬ Q' ⊆ T.image ρ
proof:
:= fun Q' hQ' hQ'T => by
  have hQ'ne : Q'.Nonempty := nonempty_of_mem_center' hSY hSL hQ'
  have hfil : (T.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q').image ρ = Q' := image_filter_mem_image hQ'T
  have hne : (T.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q').Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.image_nonempty (f := ρ), hfil]; exact hQ'ne
  have hmem : (T.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q') ∈ Y.nerve :=
    Y.mem_nerve_of_subset hT (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hne
  exact hTS _ (hpre _ hmem (by rw [hfil]; exact hQ')) (Finset.filter_subset _ _)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Refines.blowUp
statement:
theorem blowUp : Refines (extendComp ρ Y L S_Y S_L) (Y.blowUp S_Y) (L.blowUp S_L) where
  n_eq
proof:
:= by rw [blowUp_n, blowUp_n, h.n_eq]
  m_eq := by rw [blowUp_m, blowUp_m, h.m_eq]
  nextLabel_eq := by rw [blowUp_nextLabel, blowUp_nextLabel, h.nextLabel_eq]
  lt c hc := by
    rw [blowUp_nextComp] at hc ⊢
    rcases lt_or_exists_newComp Y S_Y hc with hc' | ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    · rw [extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L hc']
      exact (h.lt c hc').trans_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    · rw [extendComp_newComp ρ Y L S_Y S_L hQ]
      exact L.newComp_lt (image_mem_center' hSL hQ)
  label_eq c hc := by
    rw [blowUp_nextComp] at hc
    rcases lt_or_exists_newComp Y S_Y hc with hc' | ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    · rw [extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L hc', L.blowUp_label_of_lt S_L (h.lt c hc'),
        Y.blowUp_label_of_lt S_Y hc', h.label_eq c hc']
    · rw [extendComp_newComp ρ Y L S_Y S_L hQ, L.blowUp_label_newComp, Y.blowUp_label_newComp,
        h.nextLabel_eq]
  a_eq c hc := by
    rw [blowUp_nextComp] at hc
    rcases lt_or_exists_newComp Y S_Y hc with hc' | ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    · rw [extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L hc', L.blowUp_a_of_lt S_L (h.lt c hc'),
        Y.blowUp_a_of_lt S_Y hc', h.a_eq c hc']
    · rw [extendComp_newComp ρ Y L S_Y S_L hQ, L.blowUp_a_newComp S_L (image_mem_center' hSL hQ),
        Y.blowUp_a_newComp S_Y hQ, h.total_image (hSY hQ), h.m_eq]
  injOn T hT := by
    rw [Y.blowUp_nerve] at hT
    rcases mem_blowUpNerve.mp hT with ⟨h1, -⟩ | ⟨Q, hQ, T₁, -, h2, -, rfl⟩
    · exact (h.injOn T h1).congr fun c hc =>
        (extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L (MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem _ h1 hc)).symm
    · have hT₁c : ∀ c ∈ T₁, c < Y.nextComp := fun c hc =>
        MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem _ h2 (Finset.mem_union_left _ hc)
      have hnew : ¬ Y.newComp S_Y Q < Y.nextComp := not_lt.mpr (Y.nextComp_le_newComp S_Y Q)
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx <;> rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
      · rfl
      · rw [extendComp_newComp ρ Y L S_Y S_L hQ, extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L (hT₁c y hy)] at hxy
        exact absurd hxy (ne_of_gt ((h.lt y (hT₁c y hy)).trans_le (L.nextComp_le_newComp _ _)))
      · rw [extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L (hT₁c x hx), extendComp_newComp ρ Y L S_Y S_L hQ] at hxy
        exact absurd hxy (ne_of_lt ((h.lt x (hT₁c x hx)).trans_le (L.nextComp_le_newComp _ _)))
      · rw [extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L (hT₁c x hx),
          extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L (hT₁c y hy)] at hxy
        exact h.injOn _ h2 (Finset.mem_union_left _ hx) (Finset.mem_union_left _ hy) hxy
  image_mem T hT := by
    rw [Y.blowUp_nerve] at hT
    rw [L.blowUp_nerve]
    rcases mem_blowUpNerve.mp hT with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨Q, hQ, T₁, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
    · rw [image_extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L
        (fun _ hc => MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem _ h1 hc)]
      exact mem_blowUpNerve.mpr (Or.inl ⟨h.image_mem T h1,
        not_subset_image_of_forall hSY hSL hpre h1 h2⟩)
    · have hT₁c : ∀ c ∈ T₁, c < Y.nextComp := fun c hc =>
        MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem _ h2 (Finset.mem_union_left _ hc)
      rw [Finset.image_insert, extendComp_newComp ρ Y L S_Y S_L hQ,
        image_extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L hT₁c]
      refine mem_blowUpNerve.mpr (Or.inr ⟨Q.image ρ, image_mem_center' hSL hQ, T₁.image ρ, ?_, ?_,
        fun Q' hQ' hQ'T => ?_, rfl⟩)
      · rcases h1 with h1 | h1
        · exact Or.inl (by rw [h1, Finset.image_empty])
        · exact Or.inr (h.image_mem T₁ h1)
      · rw [← Finset.image_union]; exact h.image_mem _ h2
      · have hQ'ne : Q'.Nonempty := nonempty_of_mem_center' hSY hSL hQ'
        have hfil : (T₁.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q').image ρ = Q' := image_filter_mem_image hQ'T
        have hne : (T₁.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q').Nonempty := by
          rw [← Finset.image_nonempty (f := ρ), hfil]; exact hQ'ne
        have hmem : (T₁.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q') ∈ Y.nerve :=
          Y.mem_nerve_of_subset h2 ((Finset.filter_subset _ _).trans Finset.subset_union_left) hne
        exact h3 _ (hpre _ hmem (by rw [hfil]; exact hQ')) (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  exists_lift T' hT' := by
    rw [L.blowUp_nerve] at hT'
    rcases mem_blowUpNerve.mp hT' with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨Q', hQ', T₁', h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := h.exists_lift T' h1
      refine ⟨T, ?_,
        image_extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L (fun _ hc => MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem _ hT hc)⟩
      rw [Y.blowUp_nerve]
      exact mem_blowUpNerve.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hT, fun Q hQ hQT =>
        h2 (Q.image ρ) (image_mem_center' hSL hQ) (Finset.image_subset_image hQT)⟩)
    · obtain ⟨W, hW, hWe⟩ := h.exists_lift _ h2
      have hQ'ne : Q'.Nonempty := nonempty_of_mem_center' hSY hSL hQ'
      have hQe : (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q').image ρ = Q' :=
        image_filter_mem_image (hWe ▸ Finset.subset_union_right)
      have hT₁e : (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ T₁').image ρ = T₁' :=
        image_filter_mem_image (hWe ▸ Finset.subset_union_left)
      have hQne : (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q').Nonempty := by
        rw [← Finset.image_nonempty (f := ρ), hQe]; exact hQ'ne
      have hQmem : (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q') ∈ Y.nerve :=
        Y.mem_nerve_of_subset hW (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hQne
      have hQS : (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q') ∈ S_Y := hpre _ hQmem (by rw [hQe]; exact hQ')
      have hunion : (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ T₁') ∪ (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q') ∈ Y.nerve :=
        Y.mem_nerve_of_subset hW (Finset.union_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
          (Finset.filter_subset _ _)) (hQne.mono Finset.subset_union_right)
      have hT₁c : ∀ c ∈ (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ T₁'), c < Y.nextComp := fun c hc =>
        MonomialState.lt_nextComp_of_mem _ hW (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).1
      refine ⟨insert (Y.newComp S_Y (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ Q')) (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ T₁'),
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Y.blowUp_nerve]
        refine mem_blowUpNerve.mpr (Or.inr ⟨_, hQS, _, ?_, hunion, fun Q hQ hQT => ?_, rfl⟩)
        · by_cases he : (W.filter fun c => ρ c ∈ T₁') = ∅
          · exact Or.inl he
          · exact Or.inr (Y.mem_nerve_of_subset hW (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
              (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr he))
        · exact h3 (Q.image ρ) (image_mem_center' hSL hQ)
            (hT₁e ▸ Finset.image_subset_image hQT)
      · rw [Finset.image_insert, extendComp_newComp ρ Y L S_Y S_L hQS,
          image_extendComp_of_lt ρ Y L S_Y S_L hT₁c, hQe, hT₁e]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.sortedList_image
statement:
theorem sortedList_image {s : Finset ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMonoOn f s) :
    sortedList (s.image f) = (sortedList s).map f
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((sortedList s).map f).Pairwise (· < ·) :=
    List.pairwise_map.mpr ((sortedList_pairwise s).imp_of_mem fun ha hb h =>
      hf (mem_sortedList.mp ha) (mem_sortedList.mp hb) h)
  have h2 := sortedList_pairwise (s.image f)
  have hperm : List.Perm (sortedList (s.image f)) ((sortedList s).map f) := by
    apply List.perm_of_nodup_nodup_toFinset_eq (h2.imp ne_of_lt) (h1.imp ne_of_lt)
    ext x
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, mem_sortedList, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_image]
  exact hperm.eq_of_sortedLE (List.sortedLE_iff_pairwise.mpr (h2.imp le_of_lt))
    (List.sortedLE_iff_pairwise.mpr (h1.imp le_of_lt))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.lex_cons_cons_iff
statement:
theorem lex_cons_cons_iff {a b : ℕ} {l l' : List ℕ} :
    List.Lex (· < ·) (a :: l) (b :: l') ↔ a < b ∨ (a = b ∧ List.Lex (· < ·) l l')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | cons h => exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, h⟩
    | rel h => exact Or.inl h
  · rintro (h | ⟨rfl, h⟩)
    · exact List.Lex.rel h
    · exact List.Lex.cons h

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.lex_map_iff
statement:
theorem lex_map_iff {f : ℕ → ℕ} {A : Set ℕ} (hf : StrictMonoOn f A) :
    ∀ {l l' : List ℕ}, (∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ A) → (∀ x ∈ l', x ∈ A) →
      (List.Lex (· < ·) (l.map f) (l'.map f) ↔ List.Lex (· < ·) l l')
  | [], [], _, _ => ⟨(fun h => nomatch h), (fun h => nomatch h)⟩
  | [], _ :: _, _, _ => ⟨fun _ => List.Lex.nil, fun _ => List.Lex.nil⟩
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => ⟨(fun h => nomatch h), (fun h => nomatch h)⟩
  | a :: l, b :: l', hl, hl' => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, lex_cons_cons_iff]
    have ha : a ∈ A
proof:
:= hl a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hb : b ∈ A := hl' b (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    rw [hf.lt_iff_lt ha hb, hf.injOn.eq_iff ha hb,
      lex_map_iff hf (fun x hx => hl x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
        (fun x hx => hl' x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.map_lt_map_iff
statement:
theorem map_lt_map_iff {f : ℕ → ℕ} {A : Set ℕ} (hf : StrictMonoOn f A) {l l' : List ℕ}
    (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ A) (hl' : ∀ x ∈ l', x ∈ A) : l.map f < l'.map f ↔ l < l'
proof:
:=
  lex_map_iff hf hl hl'

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.map_le_map_iff
statement:
theorem map_le_map_iff {f : ℕ → ℕ} {A : Set ℕ} (hf : StrictMonoOn f A) {l l' : List ℕ}
    (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ A) (hl' : ∀ x ∈ l', x ∈ A) : l.map f ≤ l'.map f ↔ l ≤ l'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_lt, ← not_lt, map_lt_map_iff hf hl' hl]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.refl
statement:
theorem refl (D : MonomialState) : Rel id id D D where
  n_eq
proof:
:= rfl
  m_eq := rfl
  mono := strictMono_id.strictMonoOn _
  lt _ hc := hc
  a_eq _ _ := rfl
  label_eq _ _ := rfl
  σmono := strictMono_id.strictMonoOn _
  σlt _ hℓ := hℓ
  nerve_eq := by
    rw [show Finset.image (id : ℕ → ℕ) = id from funext fun T => Finset.image_id, Finset.image_id]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.injOn_of_subset
statement: theorem injOn_of_subset {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp) : Set.InjOn ρ T
proof:
:=
  h.mono.injOn.mono hT

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.injOn_face
statement: theorem injOn_face {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ D.nerve) : Set.InjOn ρ T
proof:
:=
  h.injOn_of_subset fun _ hc => D.lt_nextComp_of_mem hT hc

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.card_image
statement: theorem card_image {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp) : (T.image ρ).card = T.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_image_of_injOn (h.injOn_of_subset hT)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.total_image
statement:
theorem total_image {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp) :
    P.total (T.image ρ) = D.total T
proof:
:= by
  rw [total, total, Finset.sum_image (h.injOn_of_subset hT)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c hc => h.a_eq c (hT c hc)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.labels_image
statement:
theorem labels_image {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp) :
    P.labels (T.image ρ) = (D.labels T).image σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [labels, labels, Finset.image_image, Finset.image_image]
  exact Finset.image_congr fun c hc => h.label_eq c (hT c hc)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.labels_lt
statement:
theorem labels_lt {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp) :
    ∀ ℓ ∈ D.labels T, ℓ < D.nextLabel
proof:
:= fun ℓ hℓ => by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hℓ
  exact D.label_lt c (hT c hc)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.labelTuple_image
statement:
theorem labelTuple_image {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp) :
    P.labelTuple (T.image ρ) = (D.labelTuple T).map σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [labelTuple, labelTuple, h.labels_image hT]
  exact sortedList_image fun ℓ hℓ ℓ' hℓ' hlt =>
    h.σmono (labels_lt hT ℓ hℓ) (labels_lt hT ℓ' hℓ') hlt

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.labelTuple_le_iff
statement:
theorem labelTuple_le_iff {T T' : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp)
    (hT' : ∀ c ∈ T', c < D.nextComp) :
    P.labelTuple (T.image ρ) ≤ P.labelTuple (T'.image ρ) ↔ D.labelTuple T ≤ D.labelTuple T'
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.labelTuple_image hT, h.labelTuple_image hT']
  exact map_le_map_iff h.σmono (fun ℓ hℓ => labels_lt hT ℓ (mem_sortedList.mp hℓ))
    (fun ℓ hℓ => labels_lt hT' ℓ (mem_sortedList.mp hℓ))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.image_mem_nerve
statement: theorem image_mem_nerve {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : T ∈ D.nerve) : T.image ρ ∈ P.nerve
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.nerve_eq]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hT

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.exists_of_mem_nerve
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_nerve {T' : Finset ℕ} (hT' : T' ∈ P.nerve) :
    ∃ T ∈ D.nerve, T.image ρ = T'
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.nerve_eq] at hT'; exact Finset.mem_image.mp hT'

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.image_mem_nerve_iff
statement:
theorem image_mem_nerve_iff {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp) :
    T.image ρ ∈ P.nerve ↔ T ∈ D.nerve
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hi => ?_, h.image_mem_nerve⟩
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀, he⟩ := h.exists_of_mem_nerve hi
  have h1 : (↑(T₀.image ρ) : Set ℕ) = ↑(T.image ρ) := by rw [he]
  rw [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_image] at h1
  have : T₀ = T := Finset.coe_inj.mp ((h.mono.injOn.image_eq_image_iff
    (fun _ hc => D.lt_nextComp_of_mem hT₀ hc) (fun c hc => hT c hc)).mp h1)
  exact this ▸ hT₀

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.faces_eq
statement: theorem faces_eq (r : ℕ) : P.faces r = (D.faces r).image (Finset.image ρ)
proof:
:= by
  ext T'
  rw [Finset.mem_image, P.mem_faces]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hT', hc⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := h.exists_of_mem_nerve hT'
    refine ⟨T, D.mem_faces.mpr ⟨hT, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    rwa [h.card_image fun _ hc => D.lt_nextComp_of_mem hT hc] at hc
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hT, hc⟩ := D.mem_faces.mp hT
    exact ⟨h.image_mem_nerve hT, hc ▸ h.card_image fun _ hc => D.lt_nextComp_of_mem hT hc⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.star_iff
statement: theorem star_iff (s : ℕ) : P.Star s ↔ D.Star s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs T hT
    have := hs (T.image ρ) (by rw [h.faces_eq]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hT)
    rwa [h.total_image fun _ hc => D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (D.mem_faces.mp hT).1 hc, ← h.m_eq] at this
  · intro hs T' hT'
    rw [h.faces_eq, Finset.mem_image] at hT'
    obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := hT'
    rw [h.total_image fun _ hc => D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (D.mem_faces.mp hT).1 hc, ← h.m_eq]
    exact hs T hT

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.choice_eq
statement: theorem choice_eq (r : ℕ) : P.choice r = (D.choice r).image (Finset.image ρ)
proof:
:= by
  ext T'
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro hT'
    obtain ⟨hf, hm, hmax, hlex⟩ := P.mem_choice.mp hT'
    rw [h.faces_eq, Finset.mem_image] at hf
    obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := hf
    have hTc : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp := fun c hc =>
      D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (D.mem_faces.mp hT).1 hc
    refine ⟨T, D.mem_choice.mpr ⟨hT, ?_, fun T₁ hT₁ hm₁ => ?_, fun T₁ hT₁ he => ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    · rwa [h.total_image hTc, ← h.m_eq] at hm
    · have hT₁c : ∀ c ∈ T₁, c < D.nextComp := fun c hc =>
        D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (D.mem_faces.mp hT₁).1 hc
      have := hmax (T₁.image ρ) (by rw [h.faces_eq]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hT₁)
        (by rw [h.total_image hT₁c, ← h.m_eq]; exact hm₁)
      rwa [h.total_image hT₁c, h.total_image hTc] at this
    · have hT₁c : ∀ c ∈ T₁, c < D.nextComp := fun c hc =>
        D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (D.mem_faces.mp hT₁).1 hc
      have := hlex (T₁.image ρ) (by rw [h.faces_eq]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hT₁)
        (by rw [h.total_image hT₁c, h.total_image hTc]; exact he)
      rwa [h.labelTuple_le_iff hTc hT₁c] at this
  · rintro ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hf, hm, hmax, hlex⟩ := D.mem_choice.mp hT
    have hTc : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp := fun c hc =>
      D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (D.mem_faces.mp hf).1 hc
    refine P.mem_choice.mpr ⟨by rw [h.faces_eq]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hf, ?_,
      fun T₁' hT₁' hm₁ => ?_, fun T₁' hT₁' he => ?_⟩
    · rw [h.total_image hTc, ← h.m_eq]; exact hm
    · rw [h.faces_eq, Finset.mem_image] at hT₁'
      obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁, rfl⟩ := hT₁'
      have hT₁c : ∀ c ∈ T₁, c < D.nextComp := fun c hc =>
        D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (D.mem_faces.mp hT₁).1 hc
      rw [h.total_image hT₁c, h.total_image hTc]
      exact hmax T₁ hT₁ (by rwa [h.total_image hT₁c, ← h.m_eq] at hm₁)
    · rw [h.faces_eq, Finset.mem_image] at hT₁'
      obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁, rfl⟩ := hT₁'
      have hT₁c : ∀ c ∈ T₁, c < D.nextComp := fun c hc =>
        D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (D.mem_faces.mp hT₁).1 hc
      rw [h.labelTuple_le_iff hTc hT₁c]
      exact hlex T₁ hT₁ (by rwa [h.total_image hT₁c, h.total_image hTc] at he)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.choice_eq_empty_iff
statement: theorem choice_eq_empty_iff (r : ℕ) : P.choice r = ∅ ↔ D.choice r = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.choice_eq, Finset.image_eq_empty]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.restrictRun_nil
statement: theorem restrictRun_nil (st : MonomialState) : restrictRun st [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.restrictRun_cons_of_eq_empty
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrictRun, h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.restrictRun_cons_of_ne_empty
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrictRun, h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.restrictRun_append
statement:
theorem restrictRun_append (st : MonomialState) (L₁ L₂ : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))) :
    restrictRun st (L₁ ++ L₂) = restrictRun st L₁ ++ restrictRun (L₁.foldl blowUp st) L₂
proof:
:= by
  induction L₁ generalizing st with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons S L₁ ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases h : S.filter (· ∈ st.nerve) = ∅
    · rw [restrictRun_cons_of_eq_empty st _ h, restrictRun_cons_of_eq_empty st _ h, ih]
    · rw [restrictRun_cons_of_ne_empty st _ h, restrictRun_cons_of_ne_empty st _ h, ih,
        List.cons_append]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.nextComp_le_blowUp
statement:
theorem nextComp_le_blowUp (st : MonomialState) (S : Finset (Finset ℕ)) :
    st.nextComp ≤ (st.blowUp S).nextComp
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_add_right _ _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.nextLabel_le_blowUp
statement:
theorem nextLabel_le_blowUp (st : MonomialState) (S : Finset (Finset ℕ)) :
    st.nextLabel ≤ (st.blowUp S).nextLabel
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_succ _

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_nextComp_le
statement:
theorem phase_nextComp_le (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    st.nextComp ≤ (phase r st hs).1.nextComp
proof:
:= by
  induction st, hs using phase.induct r with
  | case1 st hs h ih =>
    rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs h]
    exact (nextComp_le_blowUp st _).trans ih
  | case2 st hs h => rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_nextLabel_le
statement:
theorem phase_nextLabel_le (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    st.nextLabel ≤ (phase r st hs).1.nextLabel
proof:
:= by
  induction st, hs using phase.induct r with
  | case1 st hs h ih =>
    rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs h]
    exact (nextLabel_le_blowUp st _).trans ih
  | case2 st hs h => rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs h]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_centers_lt
statement:
theorem phase_centers_lt (st : MonomialState) (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) :
    ∀ S ∈ (phase r st hs).2, ∀ Q ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ Q, c < (phase r st hs).1.nextComp
proof:
:= by
  induction st, hs using phase.induct r with
  | case1 st hs h ih =>
    rw [phase_of_nonempty st hs h]
    intro S hS Q hQ c hc
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hS with rfl | hS
    · exact (st.lt_nextComp_of_mem (st.mem_nerve_of_mem_choice hQ) hc).trans_le
        ((nextComp_le_blowUp st _).trans (phase_nextComp_le _ _))
    · exact ih S hS Q hQ c hc
  | case2 st hs h =>
    rw [phase_of_not_nonempty st hs h]
    intro S hS
    exact absurd hS (List.not_mem_nil)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.star_of_star
statement: theorem Sub.star_of_star {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) {s : ℕ} (hs : N.Star s) : L.Star s
proof:
:=
  fun T hT => by
  rw [h.total_eq, h.m_eq]
  exact hs T (h.mem_faces hT)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Sub.choice_eq_empty_of
statement:
theorem Sub.choice_eq_empty_of {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) {r : ℕ}
    (hN : N.choice r = ∅) : L.choice r = ∅
proof:
:=
  L.choice_eq_empty_iff.mpr (h.star_of_star (N.choice_eq_empty_iff.mp hN))

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.Rel.of_blowUp_disjoint
statement:
theorem Rel.of_blowUp_disjoint {ρ σ : ℕ → ℕ} {D P : MonomialState} (h : Rel ρ σ D P)
    {S : Finset (Finset ℕ)} (hS0 : ∀ Q ∈ S, Q.Nonempty) (hdis : ∀ Q ∈ S, Q ∉ P.nerve) :
    Rel ρ σ D (P.blowUp S) where
  n_eq
proof:
:= h.n_eq
  m_eq := h.m_eq
  mono := h.mono
  lt c hc := (h.lt c hc).trans_le (nextComp_le_blowUp P S)
  a_eq c hc := by rw [P.blowUp_a_of_lt S (h.lt c hc), h.a_eq c hc]
  label_eq c hc := by rw [P.blowUp_label_of_lt S (h.lt c hc), h.label_eq c hc]
  σmono := h.σmono
  σlt ℓ hℓ := (h.σlt ℓ hℓ).trans_le (nextLabel_le_blowUp P S)
  nerve_eq := by rw [blowUp_nerve_of_forall_notMem P hS0 hdis, h.nerve_eq]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.image_image_congr
statement:
theorem image_image_congr {ρ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ} {K : ℕ} (hρ : ∀ c, c < K → ρ' c = ρ c)
    {S : Finset (Finset ℕ)} (hS : ∀ Q ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ Q, c < K) :
    S.image (Finset.image ρ') = S.image (Finset.image ρ)
proof:
:=
  Finset.image_congr fun Q hQ => Finset.image_congr fun c hc => hρ c (hS Q hQ c hc)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_restrict
statement:
theorem phase_restrict (r : ℕ) : ∀ (N : MonomialState) (hsN : ∀ s < r, N.Star s)
    (D P : MonomialState) (ρ σ : ℕ → ℕ), Rel ρ σ D P → Sub P N →
    ∀ hsD : ∀ s < r, D.Star s,
    ∃ ρ' σ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < D.nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) ∧ (∀ ℓ, ℓ < D.nextLabel → σ' ℓ = σ ℓ) ∧
      Rel ρ' σ' (phase r D hsD).1 ((phase r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) ∧
      Sub ((phase r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) (phase r N hsN).1 ∧
      (phase r D hsD).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) =
        restrictRun P (phase r N hsN).2
proof:
:= by
  intro N hsN
  induction N, hsN using phase.induct r with
  | case1 N hsN hne ih =>
    intro D P ρ σ hrel hsub hsD
    rw [phase_of_nonempty N hsN hne]
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    have hS0 : ∀ Q ∈ N.choice r, Q.Nonempty := fun Q hQ =>
      N.nerve_nonempty Q (N.mem_nerve_of_mem_choice hQ)
    have hsub' : Sub (P.blowUp (N.choice r)) (N.blowUp (N.choice r)) := hsub.blowUp _
    by_cases hdis : (N.choice r).filter (· ∈ P.nerve) = ∅
    · have hdis' : ∀ Q ∈ N.choice r, Q ∉ P.nerve := fun Q hQ hQP =>
        Finset.notMem_empty Q (hdis ▸ Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hQ, hQP⟩)
      obtain ⟨ρ', σ', hρ', hσ', hrel', hsub'', hmap⟩ :=
        ih D (P.blowUp (N.choice r)) ρ σ (hrel.of_blowUp_disjoint hS0 hdis') hsub' hsD
      refine ⟨ρ', σ', hρ', hσ', hrel', hsub'', ?_⟩
      rw [hmap, restrictRun_cons_of_eq_empty P _ hdis]
    · obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hdis
      obtain ⟨hQN, hQP⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ
      have hPc : P.choice r = (N.choice r).filter (· ∈ P.nerve) := hsub.choice_eq_of_mem hQN hQP
      have hfilter : (N.choice r).filter (· ∈ P.nerve) = (D.choice r).image (Finset.image ρ) := by
        rw [← hPc, hrel.choice_eq]
      have hDne : (D.choice r).Nonempty := by
        rw [← Finset.image_nonempty (f := Finset.image ρ), ← hfilter]
        exact ⟨Q, hQ⟩
      have hSD : D.choice r ⊆ D.nerve := (D.isCenter_choice r).1
      rw [phase_of_nonempty D hsD hDne]
      simp only [List.map_cons]
      obtain ⟨ρ', σ', hρ', hσ', hrel', hsub'', hmap⟩ :=
        ih (D.blowUp (D.choice r)) (P.blowUp (N.choice r)) _ _
          (hrel.blowUp hSD hfilter hS0) hsub' (fun _ hsr => D.star_blowUp hsD hsr)
      refine ⟨ρ', σ', fun c hc => ?_, fun ℓ hℓ => ?_, hrel', hsub'', ?_⟩
      · rw [hρ' c (hc.trans_le (nextComp_le_blowUp D _)), extendComp_of_lt ρ D P _ _ hc]
      · rw [hσ' ℓ (hℓ.trans_le (nextLabel_le_blowUp D _)), extendLabel_of_lt σ D P hℓ]
      · rw [hmap, restrictRun_cons_of_ne_empty P _ hdis, hfilter]
        congr 1
        have hlt : ∀ Q ∈ D.choice r, ∀ c ∈ Q, c < D.nextComp := fun Q hQ c hc =>
          D.lt_nextComp_of_mem (hSD hQ) hc
        rw [image_image_congr hρ'
          (fun Q hQ c hc => (hlt Q hQ c hc).trans_le (nextComp_le_blowUp D _)),
          image_image_congr (fun c hc => extendComp_of_lt ρ D P _ _ hc) hlt]
  | case2 N hsN hne =>
    intro D P ρ σ hrel hsub hsD
    rw [phase_of_not_nonempty N hsN hne]
    have hD : D.choice r = ∅ := (hrel.choice_eq_empty_iff r).mp
      (hsub.choice_eq_empty_of (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne))
    rw [phase_of_not_nonempty D hsD (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mpr hD)]
    exact ⟨ρ, σ, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, hrel, hsub, rfl⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_restrict
statement:
theorem phases_restrict (k : ℕ) : ∀ (r : ℕ) (N : MonomialState) (hsN : ∀ s < r, N.Star s)
    (D P : MonomialState) (ρ σ : ℕ → ℕ), Rel ρ σ D P → Sub P N → ∀ hsD : ∀ s < r, D.Star s,
    ∃ ρ' σ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < D.nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) ∧ (∀ ℓ, ℓ < D.nextLabel → σ' ℓ = σ ℓ) ∧
      Rel ρ' σ' (phases k r D hsD).1 ((phases k r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) ∧
      Sub ((phases k r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) (phases k r N hsN).1 ∧
      (phases k r D hsD).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) =
        restrictRun P (phases k r N hsN).2
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro r N hsN D P ρ σ hrel hsub hsD
    exact ⟨ρ, σ, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, hrel, hsub, rfl⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro r N hsN D P ρ σ hrel hsub hsD
    rw [phases_succ, phases_succ]
    simp only [List.foldl_append, List.map_append]
    obtain ⟨ρ₁, σ₁, hρ₁, hσ₁, hrel₁, hsub₁, hmap₁⟩ :=
      phase_restrict r N hsN D P ρ σ hrel hsub hsD
    obtain ⟨ρ', σ', hρ', hσ', hrel', hsub', hmap'⟩ := ih (r + 1) _ (phase_star_succ N hsN) _ _
      ρ₁ σ₁ hrel₁ hsub₁ (phase_star_succ D hsD)
    refine ⟨ρ', σ', fun c hc => ?_, fun ℓ hℓ => ?_, hrel', hsub', ?_⟩
    · rw [hρ' c (hc.trans_le (phase_nextComp_le D hsD)), hρ₁ c hc]
    · rw [hσ' ℓ (hℓ.trans_le (phase_nextLabel_le D hsD)), hσ₁ ℓ hℓ]
    · rw [restrictRun_append, ← hmap', ← hmap₁]
      congr 1
      exact List.map_congr_left fun S hS => image_image_congr hρ' (phase_centers_lt D hsD S hS)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.IsRun.nextComp_le
statement:
theorem IsRun.nextComp_le {st st' : MonomialState} {L : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))}
    (h : IsRun st L st') : st.nextComp ≤ st'.nextComp
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons r _ _ _ _ ih => exact (nextComp_le_blowUp _ _).trans ih

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.IsRun.nextLabel_le
statement:
theorem IsRun.nextLabel_le {st st' : MonomialState} {L : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))}
    (h : IsRun st L st') : st.nextLabel ≤ st'.nextLabel
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons r _ _ _ _ ih => exact (nextLabel_le_blowUp _ _).trans ih

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.IsRun.centers_lt
statement:
theorem IsRun.centers_lt {st st' : MonomialState} {L : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))}
    (h : IsRun st L st') : ∀ S ∈ L, ∀ Q ∈ S, ∀ c ∈ Q, c < st'.nextComp
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => intro S hS; exact absurd hS List.not_mem_nil
  | cons r _ _ _ hL ih =>
    intro S hS Q hQ c hc
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hS with rfl | hS
    · exact (lt_nextComp_of_mem _ (mem_nerve_of_mem_choice _ hQ) hc).trans_le
        ((nextComp_le_blowUp _ _).trans hL.nextComp_le)
    · exact ih S hS Q hQ c hc

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.exists_orderEmbedding_extend
statement:
theorem exists_orderEmbedding_extend (f : ℕ → ℕ) (K : ℕ) (hf : StrictMonoOn f (Set.Iio K)) :
    ∃ g : ℕ ↪o ℕ, ∀ c, c < K → g c = f c
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos K with rfl | hK
  · exact ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono id strictMono_id, fun c hc => absurd hc (Nat.not_lt_zero c)⟩
  · have hg : StrictMono fun c => if c < K then f c else f (K - 1) + 1 + (c - K) := by
      intro a b hab
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with ha hb hb
      · exact hf ha hb hab
      · have h1 : f a ≤ f (K - 1) :=
          (hf.le_iff_le ha (Nat.sub_lt hK Nat.one_pos)).mpr (by omega)
        omega
      · omega
      · omega
    exact ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono _ hg, fun c hc => by
      rw [OrderEmbedding.coe_ofStrictMono]; exact ite_eq_left hc⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_restrict_aux
statement:
theorem step3_restrict_aux {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) :
    ∃ ρ' σ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < L.nextComp → ρ' c = c) ∧ (∀ ℓ, ℓ < L.nextLabel → σ' ℓ = ℓ) ∧
      Rel ρ' σ' (step3 L).1 ((step3 N).2.foldl blowUp L) ∧
      (step3 L).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) = restrictRun L (step3 N).2
proof:
:= by
  have e : step3 L = phases N.n 1 L (star_of_lt_one L) := by rw [step3, h.n_eq]
  rw [e, step3]
  obtain ⟨ρ', σ', hρ', hσ', hrel, -, hmap⟩ :=
    phases_restrict N.n 1 N (star_of_lt_one N) L L id id (Rel.refl L) h (star_of_lt_one L)
  exact ⟨ρ', σ', hρ', hσ', hrel, hmap⟩

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_restrict
statement:
theorem step3_restrict {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) :
    ∃ ρ : ℕ ↪o ℕ, (∀ c, c < L.nextComp → ρ c = c) ∧
      ∃ σ : ℕ ↪o ℕ, (∀ ℓ, ℓ < L.nextLabel → σ ℓ = ℓ) ∧
        (∀ c, c < (step3 L).1.nextComp →
          ((step3 N).2.foldl blowUp L).a (ρ c) = (step3 L).1.a c ∧
          ((step3 N).2.foldl blowUp L).label (ρ c) = σ ((step3 L).1.label c)) ∧
        ((step3 N).2.foldl blowUp L).nerve = (step3 L).1.nerve.image (Finset.image ρ) ∧
        (step3 L).2.map (fun S : Finset (Finset ℕ) => S.image (Finset.image ρ)) =
          restrictRun L (step3 N).2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ', σ', hρ', hσ', hrel, hmap⟩ := step3_restrict_aux h
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := exists_orderEmbedding_extend ρ' (step3 L).1.nextComp hrel.mono
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_orderEmbedding_extend σ' (step3 L).1.nextLabel hrel.σmono
  have hLD : L.nextComp ≤ (step3 L).1.nextComp := (step3_isRun L).nextComp_le
  have hLD' : L.nextLabel ≤ (step3 L).1.nextLabel := (step3_isRun L).nextLabel_le
  refine ⟨ρ, fun c hc => by rw [hρ c (hc.trans_le hLD), hρ' c hc], σ,
    fun ℓ hℓ => by rw [hσ ℓ (hℓ.trans_le hLD'), hσ' ℓ hℓ], fun c hc => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hρ c hc]; exact hrel.a_eq c hc
  · rw [hρ c hc, hσ _ ((step3 L).1.label_lt c hc)]; exact hrel.label_eq c hc
  · rw [hrel.nerve_eq]
    exact (image_image_congr hρ fun Q hQ c hc => (step3 L).1.lt_nextComp_of_mem hQ hc).symm
  · rw [← hmap]
    exact List.map_congr_left fun S hS => image_image_congr hρ ((step3_isRun L).centers_lt S hS)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.extendComp_of_lt
statement: theorem extendComp_of_lt {c : ℕ} (hc : c < D.nextComp) : extendComp ρ D P S_D S c = ρ c
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left hc

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.extendComp_newComp
statement:
theorem extendComp_newComp {Q : Finset ℕ} (hQ : Q ∈ S_D) :
    extendComp ρ D P S_D S (D.newComp S_D Q) = P.newComp S (Q.image ρ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendComp, ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr (D.nextComp_le_newComp S_D Q))]
  have : (S_D.filter fun Q' => D.newComp S_D Q' = D.newComp S_D Q) = {Q} :=
    Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hQ, rfl⟩,
      fun Q' hQ' =>
        D.newComp_injOn S_D (Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ').1 hQ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ').2⟩
  rw [this, Finset.sup_singleton]

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.extendLabel_of_lt
statement: theorem extendLabel_of_lt {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ < D.nextLabel) : extendLabel σ D P ℓ = σ ℓ
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left hℓ

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.extendLabel_nextLabel
statement: theorem extendLabel_nextLabel : extendLabel σ D P D.nextLabel = P.nextLabel
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl _)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.image_extendComp_of_lt
