          IsTaylorHom.constantCoeff' E ψ φ ha (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ)]
        exact (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E t).mp ht
      have h2 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ) hs
      rw [Ideal.map_pow] at h2
      exact Ideal.pow_right_mono h1 _ h2

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff
statement:
theorem IsTaylorHom.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff
    {T : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hT : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) (k : ℕ) :
    T s ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜) ^ k ↔
      s ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := IsTaylorHom.eq E ψ φ hT (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ)
  exact taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s k

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.image_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem IsTaylorHom.image_maximalIdeal_pow
    {T : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hT : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T) (k : ℕ) :
    T '' ↑(maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ k) =
      ↑(maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜) ^ k) ∩ Set.range T
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(hT.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s k).mpr hs, s, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hc, s, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨s, (hT.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s k).mp hc, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.exists_eq_sum_coord_mul'
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sum_coord_mul' (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
    (hs : eval 𝕜 E M a s = 0) :
    ∃ g : Fin n → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a,
      s = ∑ i, (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i))) *
        g i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, -⟩ := exists_eq_sum_coord_mul_of_constantCoeff E ψ φ ha hφ s (by
    rw [IsTaylorHom.constantCoeff' E ψ φ ha (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ), hs])
  exact ⟨g, hg⟩

name: Manifold.maximalIdeal_eq_span_coord'
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_eq_span_coord' :
    maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
        coord E ψ φ hφ ha i - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i)))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun s hs => ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ :=
      exists_eq_sum_coord_mul' E ψ φ ha hφ s ((mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E s).mp hs)
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact coord_sub_mem_maximalIdeal E ψ φ ha hφ i

name: Ideal.prod_pow_mem_pow_sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, pow_add]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (hy i) _) ih

name: Manifold.maximalIdeal_pow_eq_span_monomials'
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_pow_eq_span_monomials' (k : ℕ) :
    maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ k =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun ν : {ν : Fin n →₀ ℕ // ν.degree = k} =>
        ∏ i, (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i -
          const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i))) ^ ν.1 i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set y : Fin n → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a := fun i =>
    coord E ψ φ hφ ha i - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i)) with hy
  have hymem : ∀ i, y i ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) := fun i =>
    coord_sub_mem_maximalIdeal E ψ φ ha hφ i
  have hgen : ∀ (k : ℕ) (ν : Fin n →₀ ℕ), ν.degree = k →
      ∏ i, y i ^ ν i ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ k := by
    intro k ν hν
    rw [← hν, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]
    exact Ideal.prod_pow_mem_pow_sum _ _ hymem ν
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, eq_comm, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
    refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    refine le_antisymm (fun s hs => ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
    · have hs' := (taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s (k + 1)).mpr hs
      have hs0 : constantCoeff (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s) = 0 :=
        (mem_maximalIdeal_iff _).mp (Ideal.pow_le_self k.succ_ne_zero hs')
      obtain ⟨g, rfl, hg⟩ := exists_eq_sum_coord_mul_of_constantCoeff E ψ φ ha hφ s hs0
      refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
      have hgi : g i ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ k := by
        rw [← taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ, hg]
        exact divPart_mem_maximalIdeal_pow hs' i
      rw [ih] at hgi
      change y i * g i ∈ _
      refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ => y i * x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun
        ν : {ν : Fin n →₀ ℕ // ν.degree = k + 1} => ∏ j, y j ^ ν.1 j)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hgi
      · rintro _ ⟨ν, rfl⟩
        refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨ν.1 + Finsupp.single i 1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rw [map_add, ν.2, Finsupp.degree_single]
        · simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
          rw [mul_comm]
          congr 1
          rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i]
          · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, pow_one]
          · intro j _ hj
            rw [Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right (fun h => hj h.symm), pow_zero]
          · intro h
            exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h
      · rw [mul_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
      · intro x z _ _ hx hz
        rw [mul_add]
        exact add_mem hx hz
      · intro r x _ hx
        rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx
    · rintro _ ⟨ν, rfl⟩
      exact hgen (k + 1) ν.1 ν.2

name: Manifold.germCompRingHom_coe
statement:
theorem germCompRingHom_coe {α β : Type*} {l : Filter α} {l' : Filter β} (g : α → β)
    (hg : Tendsto g l l') (f : β → 𝕜) :
    germCompRingHom (𝕜 := 𝕜) g hg (↑f : l'.Germ 𝕜) = (↑(f ∘ g) : l.Germ 𝕜)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.germCompChart_coe
statement:
theorem germCompChart_coe (f : M → 𝕜) :
    germCompChart E φ ha (↑f : (𝓝 a).Germ 𝕜) = (↑(f ∘ φ.symm) : (𝓝 (φ a)).Germ 𝕜)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.germCompChart_injective
statement: theorem germCompChart_injective : Function.Injective (germCompChart (𝕜 := 𝕜) E φ ha)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  induction f using Germ.inductionOn with | h f => ?_
  induction g using Germ.inductionOn with | h g => ?_
  rw [germCompChart_coe, germCompChart_coe, Germ.coe_eq] at hfg
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  have h1 := (φ.continuousAt ha).eventually hfg
  filter_upwards [h1, φ.eventually_left_inverse ha] with x hx hx'
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, hx'] using hx

name: Manifold.stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ
statement:
theorem stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ (U : Opens M) (hU : a ∈ U)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a hU f) =
      ↑(extendSection 𝕜 E f)
proof:
:=
  stalkToGerm_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a U hU f

name: Manifold.stalkToChartGerm_germ
statement:
theorem stalkToChartGerm_germ (U : Opens M) (hU : a ∈ U)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    stalkToChartGerm E φ ha ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a hU f) =
      ↑(extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkToChartGerm, RingHom.comp_apply, stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ, germCompChart_coe]

name: Manifold.stalkToChartGerm_injective
statement:
theorem stalkToChartGerm_injective :
    Function.Injective (stalkToChartGerm (𝕜 := 𝕜) E (M := M) φ ha)
proof:
:=
  (germCompChart_injective E φ ha).comp (stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a)

name: Manifold.contMDiffAt_chart_symm
statement: theorem contMDiffAt_chart_symm : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω φ.symm (φ a)
proof:
:=
  (contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas (n := ω) hφ).contMDiffAt
    (φ.open_target.mem_nhds (φ.map_source ha))

name: Manifold.range_stalkToChartGerm
statement:
theorem range_stalkToChartGerm :
    Set.range (stalkToChartGerm (𝕜 := 𝕜) E (M := M) φ ha) =
      (analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E (φ a) : Set ((𝓝 (φ a)).Germ 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h, hg, U, haU, hU⟩ := (mem_range_stalkToGerm_iff 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a
      (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a s)).mp ⟨s, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨h ∘ φ.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [stalkToChartGerm, RingHom.comp_apply, hg, germCompChart_coe]
    · have h1 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω h a := hU.contMDiffAt (U.2.mem_nhds haU)
      have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (h ∘ φ.symm) (φ a) :=
        ContMDiffAt.comp_of_eq h1 (contMDiffAt_chart_symm E φ ha hφ) (φ.left_inv ha)
      exact (contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mp h2).analyticAt
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl, hg⟩
    obtain ⟨V, hVg, hVo, haV⟩ := eventually_nhds_iff.mp hg.eventually_analyticAt
    let U : Opens M := ⟨φ.source ∩ φ ⁻¹' V,
      φ.continuousOn_toFun.isOpen_inter_preimage φ.open_source hVo⟩
    have haU : a ∈ U := ⟨ha, (haV : φ a ∈ V)⟩
    have hU : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (g ∘ φ) U := by
      intro x hx
      refine ContMDiffAt.contMDiffWithinAt ?_
      have hφ' : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω φ x :=
        (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas (n := ω) hφ).contMDiffAt
          (φ.open_source.mem_nhds hx.1)
      have hg' : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω g (φ x) :=
        contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mpr ((hVg _ hx.2).contDiffAt)
      exact hg'.comp x hφ'
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (mem_range_stalkToGerm_iff 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a ↑(g ∘ φ)).mpr
      ⟨g ∘ φ, rfl, U, haU, hU⟩
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    rw [stalkToChartGerm, RingHom.comp_apply, hs, germCompChart_coe]
    refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
    filter_upwards [φ.eventually_right_inverse' ha] with y hy
    exact congrArg g hy

name: Manifold.chartTransport_apply_coe
statement:
theorem chartTransport_apply_coe (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    (chartTransport E φ ha hφ s : (𝓝 (φ a)).Germ 𝕜) = stalkToChartGerm E φ ha s
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.isChartTransport_chartTransport
statement:
theorem isChartTransport_chartTransport :
    IsChartTransport 𝕜 E φ a (chartTransport E φ ha hφ)
proof:
:=
  fun U hU f => by rw [chartTransport_apply_coe, stalkToChartGerm_germ]

name: Manifold.IsChartTransport.eq
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  obtain ⟨U, haU, f, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  exact (he U haU f).trans (he' U haU f).symm

name: Manifold.IsChartTransport.mem_nonunits_iff'
statement:
theorem IsChartTransport.mem_nonunits_iff'
    {e : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a ≃+* analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E (φ a)}
    (he : IsChartTransport 𝕜 E φ a e) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    s ∈ nonunits ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ↔
      ((e s : (𝓝 (φ a)).Germ 𝕜)).value = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, haU, f, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  rw [he U haU f]
  have h1 : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a haU f ∈
      nonunits ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ↔
      eval 𝕜 E M a ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a haU f) = 0 := by
    rw [show nonunits ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) =
      ↑(RingHom.ker (eval 𝕜 E M a)) from contMDiffSheafCommRing.nonunits_stalk 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a]
    exact RingHom.mem_ker
  have h2 : eval 𝕜 E M a ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a haU f) = f ⟨a, haU⟩ :=
    contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 U a haU f
  rw [h1, h2]
  change _ ↔ extendSection 𝕜 E f (φ.symm (φ a)) = 0
  rw [φ.left_inv ha]
  exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (· = 0) (extendBy0_of_mem 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M f haU).symm)

name: Manifold.taylorHom_apply
statement:
theorem taylorHom_apply (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s =
      (taylorGerm ψ (φ a) (chartTransport E φ ha hφ s) : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Manifold.taylorHom_mem_conv
statement:
theorem taylorHom_mem_conv (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s ∈ Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n
proof:
:=
  (taylorGerm ψ (φ a) (chartTransport E φ ha hφ s)).2

name: Manifold.isTaylorHom_taylorHom
statement: theorem isTaylorHom_taylorHom : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨taylorHom_mem_conv E ψ φ ha hφ, fun U hU f => ?_⟩
  have h1 := (isSeriesOf_taylorGerm ψ (φ a) (chartTransport E φ ha hφ
    ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a hU f))).2
  rw [isChartTransport_chartTransport E φ ha hφ U hU f, germCompCoord_coe] at h1
  rw [taylorHom_apply]
  exact Germ.coe_eq.mp h1

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.eq
statement:
theorem IsTaylorHom.eq {T T' : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hT : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T) (hT' : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T') : T = T'
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun s => ?_
  obtain ⟨U, hU, f, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  exact eq_of_evalSeries_sub_eventuallyEq ψ (φ a) (hT.1 _) (hT'.1 _)
    ((hT.2 U hU f).symm.trans (hT'.2 U hU f))

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.injective'
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst
  obtain ⟨U, hU, f, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  obtain ⟨V, hV, g, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq t
  have h1 := hT.2 U hU f
  have h2 := hT.2 V hV g
  rw [hst] at h1
  have h3 : (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm ∘ ψ.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (ψ (φ a))]
      (extendSection 𝕜 E g ∘ φ.symm ∘ ψ.symm) := h1.trans h2.symm
  have h4 : germCompCoord ψ (φ a) (↑(extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) : (𝓝 (φ a)).Germ 𝕜) =
      germCompCoord ψ (φ a) ↑(extendSection 𝕜 E g ∘ φ.symm) := by
    rw [germCompCoord_coe, germCompCoord_coe]
    exact Germ.coe_eq.mpr h3
  have h5 := germCompCoord_injective ψ (φ a) h4
  apply stalkToChartGerm_injective E φ ha
  rw [stalkToChartGerm_germ, stalkToChartGerm_germ]
  exact h5

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.constantCoeff'
statement:
theorem IsTaylorHom.constantCoeff'
    {T : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hT : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (T s) = eval 𝕜 E M a s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, f, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  have h1 := (hT.2 U hU f).eq_of_nhds
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, ψ.symm_apply_apply, φ.left_inv ha, sub_self,
    evalSeries_zero_eq] at h1
  rw [← h1, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f hU]
  exact (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 U a hU f).symm

name: Manifold.algebraMap_sections_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_sections_apply (V : Opens M) (c : 𝕜) (x : V) :
    algebraMap 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) c x = c
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.algebraMap_stalk_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_stalk_eq (a : M) :
    algebraMap 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) = const 𝕜 E M a
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.algebraMap_rat_stalk_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_rat_stalk_eq (a : M) :
    algebraMap ℚ ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) =
      (const 𝕜 E M a).comp (algebraMap ℚ 𝕜)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.extendSection_add
statement:
theorem extendSection_add (f g : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    extendSection 𝕜 E (f + g) = extendSection 𝕜 E f + extendSection 𝕜 E g
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ V
  · rw [Pi.add_apply, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f hy,
      extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E g hy]
    rfl
  · simp only [Pi.add_apply, extendSection, extendBy0, dite_eq_right hy, add_zero]

name: Manifold.extendSection_mul
statement:
theorem extendSection_mul (f g : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    extendSection 𝕜 E (f * g) = extendSection 𝕜 E f * extendSection 𝕜 E g
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ V
  · rw [Pi.mul_apply, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f hy,
      extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E g hy]
    rfl
  · simp only [Pi.mul_apply, extendSection, extendBy0, dite_eq_right hy, mul_zero]

name: Manifold.extendSection_smul
statement:
theorem extendSection_smul (c : 𝕜) (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    extendSection 𝕜 E (c • f) = c • extendSection 𝕜 E f
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ V
  · rw [Pi.smul_apply, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f hy]
    rfl
  · simp only [Pi.smul_apply, extendSection, extendBy0, dite_eq_right hy, smul_zero]

name: Manifold.analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm
statement:
theorem analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V))
    (x : V) : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) (φ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (x : M) ∈ φ.source := hV x.2
  have h1 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (extendSection 𝕜 E f) x :=
    (contMDiffOn_extendSection f).contMDiffAt (V.2.mem_nhds x.2)
  have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) :=
    ContMDiffAt.comp_of_eq h1 (contMDiffAt_chart_symm E φ hx hφ) (φ.left_inv hx)
  exact (contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mp h2).analyticAt

name: Manifold.contMDiff_coordDerivFun
statement:
theorem contMDiff_coordDerivFun (i : Fin n) (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (coordDerivFun E ψ φ V i f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have h4 : AnalyticAt 𝕜
      (fun y => fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) y (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))) (φ x) :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply 𝕜 𝕜 (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))).analyticAt _).comp
      (analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm E φ hφ V hV f x).fderiv
  have h5 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω
      (fun y => fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) y (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))) (φ x) :=
    contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mpr h4.contDiffAt
  have h6 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (fun x : V => φ x) x :=
    ((contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas (n := ω) hφ).comp_contMDiff contMDiff_subtype_val
      fun x => hV x.2) x
  exact h5.comp x h6

name: Manifold.coordDerivSection_apply
statement:
theorem coordDerivSection_apply (i : Fin n) (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V))
    (x : V) :
    coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i f x =
      fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.coordDerivSection_add
statement:
theorem coordDerivSection_add (i : Fin n) (f g : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i (f + g) =
      coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i f + coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i g
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun x => ?_)
  have hf := (analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm E φ hφ V hV f x).differentiableAt
  have hg := (analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm E φ hφ V hV g x).differentiableAt
  change fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E (f + g) ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) =
    fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) +
      fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E g ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))
  rw [extendSection_add, ← _root_.add_apply, ← fderiv_add hf hg]
  rfl

name: Manifold.coordDerivSection_smul
statement:
theorem coordDerivSection_smul (i : Fin n) (c : 𝕜)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i (c • f) = c • coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i f
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun x => ?_)
  have hf := (analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm E φ hφ V hV f x).differentiableAt
  change fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E (c • f) ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) =
    c • fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))
  rw [extendSection_smul, ← _root_.smul_apply, ← fderiv_const_smul hf]
  rfl

name: Manifold.coordDerivSection_mul
statement:
theorem coordDerivSection_mul (i : Fin n) (f g : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i (f * g) =
      f * coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i g + g * coordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV i f
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun x => ?_)
  have hf := (analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm E φ hφ V hV f x).differentiableAt
  have hg := (analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm E φ hφ V hV g x).differentiableAt
  have hx : (x : M) ∈ φ.source := hV x.2
  change fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E (f * g) ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) =
    f x * fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E g ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) +
      g x * fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))
  rw [extendSection_mul]
  change fderiv 𝕜 ((extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) * (extendSection 𝕜 E g ∘ φ.symm)) (φ x)
    (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) = _
  rw [fderiv_mul hf hg, _root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
    _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply,
    Function.comp_apply, φ.left_inv hx, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f x.2,
    extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E g x.2]

name: Manifold.coordDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem coordDeriv_apply (i : Fin n) (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) (x : V) :
    coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i f x =
      fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.coordSection_apply
statement: theorem coordSection_apply (j : Fin n) (x : V) : coordSection E ψ φ hφ V hV j x = ψ (φ x) j
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.pderivGerm_coe'
statement:
theorem pderivGerm_coe' (i : Fin n) {b : E} {g : analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b} {F : E → 𝕜}
    (hF : (g : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜) = ↑F) :
    (pderivGerm E ψ i b g : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜) =
      ↑(fun y => fderiv 𝕜 F y (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := g
  change g = ↑F at hF
  subst hF
  rfl

name: Manifold.pderivGerm_add
statement:
theorem pderivGerm_add (i : Fin n) (b : E) (g h : analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b) :
    pderivGerm E ψ i b (g + h) = pderivGerm E ψ i b g + pderivGerm E ψ i b h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, f, rfl, hf⟩ := g
  obtain ⟨h, f', rfl, hf'⟩ := h
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [Subring.coe_add, pderivGerm_coe' E ψ i (F := f + f') rfl, pderivGerm_coe' E ψ i (F := f) rfl,
    pderivGerm_coe' E ψ i (F := f') rfl, ← Germ.coe_add]
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  filter_upwards [hf.eventually_analyticAt, hf'.eventually_analyticAt] with y hy hy'
  change fderiv 𝕜 (f + f') y _ = fderiv 𝕜 f y _ + fderiv 𝕜 f' y _
  rw [fderiv_add hy.differentiableAt hy'.differentiableAt, _root_.add_apply]

name: Manifold.pderivGerm_mul
statement:
theorem pderivGerm_mul (i : Fin n) (b : E) (g h : analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b) :
    pderivGerm E ψ i b (g * h) = g * pderivGerm E ψ i b h + h * pderivGerm E ψ i b g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, f, rfl, hf⟩ := g
  obtain ⟨h, f', rfl, hf'⟩ := h
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [pderivGerm_coe' E ψ i (F := f * f') rfl, Subring.coe_add, Subring.coe_mul, Subring.coe_mul,
    pderivGerm_coe' E ψ i (F := f') rfl, pderivGerm_coe' E ψ i (F := f) rfl, ← Germ.coe_mul,
    ← Germ.coe_mul, ← Germ.coe_add]
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  filter_upwards [hf.eventually_analyticAt, hf'.eventually_analyticAt] with y hy hy'
  change fderiv 𝕜 (f * f') y _ = f y * fderiv 𝕜 f' y _ + f' y * fderiv 𝕜 f y _
  rw [fderiv_mul hy.differentiableAt hy'.differentiableAt, _root_.add_apply,
    _root_.smul_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalkFun_add
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalkFun_add (i : Fin n) (s t : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    coordDerivStalkFun E ψ φ hφ ha i (s + t) =
      coordDerivStalkFun E ψ φ hφ ha i s + coordDerivStalkFun E ψ φ hφ ha i t
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordDerivStalkFun
  rw [map_add, pderivGerm_add, map_add]

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalkFun_mul
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalkFun_mul (i : Fin n) (s t : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    coordDerivStalkFun E ψ φ hφ ha i (s * t) =
      s * coordDerivStalkFun E ψ φ hφ ha i t + t * coordDerivStalkFun E ψ φ hφ ha i s
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordDerivStalkFun
  rw [map_mul, pderivGerm_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Manifold.chartTransport_const
statement:
theorem chartTransport_const (c : 𝕜) :
    (chartTransport E φ ha hφ (const 𝕜 E M a c) : (𝓝 (φ a)).Germ 𝕜) = ↑(fun _ : E => c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [const_apply, isChartTransport_chartTransport E φ ha hφ ⊤ trivial (constSection 𝕜 E M c)]
  refine congrArg _ (funext fun y => ?_)
  exact extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E (constSection 𝕜 E M c) trivial

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalkFun_const
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalkFun_const (i : Fin n) (c : 𝕜) :
    coordDerivStalkFun E ψ φ hφ ha i (const 𝕜 E M a c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordDerivStalkFun
  rw [← map_zero (chartTransport E φ ha hφ).symm]
  refine congrArg _ (Subtype.ext ?_)
  rw [pderivGerm_coe' E ψ i (chartTransport_const E φ hφ ha c), Subring.coe_zero]
  refine congrArg _ (funext fun y => ?_)
  rw [fderiv_fun_const, Pi.zero_apply, _root_.zero_apply]

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalk_apply
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalk_apply (i : Fin n) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i s =
      (chartTransport E φ ha hφ).symm (pderivGerm E ψ i (φ a) (chartTransport E φ ha hφ s))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalk_const
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalk_const (i : Fin n) (c : 𝕜) :
    coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i (const 𝕜 E M a c) = 0
proof:
:=
  coordDerivStalkFun_const E ψ φ hφ ha i c

name: Manifold.coordDeriv_coordSection
statement:
theorem coordDeriv_coordSection (i j : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i (coordSection E ψ φ hφ V hV j) =
      algebraMap 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) (if i = j then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun x => ?_)
  have hx : (x : M) ∈ φ.source := hV x.2
  change fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E (coordSection E ψ φ hφ V hV j) ∘ φ.symm) (φ x)
    (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) = if i = j then 1 else 0
  have h1 : (extendSection 𝕜 E (coordSection E ψ φ hφ V hV j) ∘ φ.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ x)]
      fun y => ψ y j := by
    filter_upwards [(φ.tendsto_symm hx).eventually (V.2.mem_nhds x.2),
      φ.eventually_right_inverse' hx] with y hy hy'
    change extendSection 𝕜 E (coordSection E ψ φ hφ V hV j) (φ.symm y) = ψ y j
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy, coordSection_apply, hy']
  have h2 : (fun y => ψ y j) =
      ⇑((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := 𝕜) (φ := fun _ : Fin n => 𝕜) j).comp
        (ψ : E →L[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜))) := rfl
  rw [h1.fderiv_eq, h2, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
  change ψ (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) j = _
  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, ite_eq_left rfl]
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm h), ite_eq_right h]

name: Manifold.coordDeriv_map
statement:
theorem coordDeriv_map (W : Opens M) (hW : (W : Set M) ⊆ φ.source) (hWV : W ≤ V) (i : Fin n)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ W hW i ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op f) =
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun x => ?_)
  have hx : (x : M) ∈ φ.source := hW x.2
  change fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op f) ∘
    φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) =
      fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) (φ x) (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1))
  have h1 : (extendSection 𝕜 E ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op f) ∘ φ.symm)
      =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ x)] (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) := by
    filter_upwards [(φ.tendsto_symm hx).eventually (W.2.mem_nhds x.2)] with y hy
    change extendSection 𝕜 E ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op f) (φ.symm y) =
      extendSection 𝕜 E f (φ.symm y)
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f (hWV hy)]
    rfl
  rw [h1.fderiv_eq]

name: Manifold.germ_coordSection
statement:
theorem germ_coordSection (haV : a ∈ V) (j : Fin n) :
    (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V a haV (coordSection E ψ φ hφ V hV j) =
      coord E ψ φ hφ ha j
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _

name: Manifold.germ_algebraMap
statement:
theorem germ_algebraMap (haV : a ∈ V) (c : 𝕜) :
    (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V a haV
        (algebraMap 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) c) =
      const 𝕜 E M a c
proof:
:= by
  rw [const_apply]
  have h1 : algebraMap 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) c =
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (constSection 𝕜 E M c) := rfl
  rw [h1]
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalk_germ
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalk_germ (V : Opens M) (hV : (V : Set M) ⊆ φ.source) (haV : a ∈ V) (i : Fin n)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V a haV f) =
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V a haV (coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordDerivStalk_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [isChartTransport_chartTransport E φ ha hφ V haV (coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i f),
    pderivGerm_coe' E ψ i (isChartTransport_chartTransport E φ ha hφ V haV f)]
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  filter_upwards [(φ.tendsto_symm ha).eventually (V.2.mem_nhds haV),
    φ.eventually_right_inverse' ha] with y hy hy'
  change fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ.symm) y (ψ.symm (Pi.single i 1)) =
    extendSection 𝕜 E (coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i f) (φ.symm y)
  rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy, coordDeriv_apply, hy']

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalk_coord
proof:
:= by
  rw [← germ_coordSection E ψ φ hφ ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source⟩ subset_rfl ha ha j,
    coordDerivStalk_germ E ψ φ hφ ha _ subset_rfl ha, coordDeriv_coordSection, germ_algebraMap]

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalk_coord_sub_const
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalk_coord_sub_const (i j : Fin n) :
    coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i
        (coord E ψ φ hφ ha j - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha j))) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, coordDerivStalk_coord, coordDerivStalk_const, sub_zero]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [map_one, map_zero]

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.pderiv
statement:
theorem IsTaylorHom.pderiv
    {T : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hT : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T) (i : Fin n) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    T (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i s) = MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := 𝕜) i (T s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsTaylorHom.pderiv' E ψ φ ha hφ hT (isChartTransport_chartTransport E φ ha hφ) i
    (chartTransport E φ ha hφ s)
  rwa [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h

name: Manifold.tendsto_coord_symm
statement: theorem tendsto_coord_symm (b : E) : Tendsto ψ.symm (𝓝 (ψ b)) (𝓝 b)
proof:
:= by
  have := ψ.symm.continuous.continuousAt (x := ψ b)
  rwa [ContinuousAt, ψ.symm_apply_apply] at this

name: Manifold.germCompCoord_coe
statement:
theorem germCompCoord_coe (b : E) (f : E → 𝕜) :
    germCompCoord ψ b (↑f : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜) = (↑(f ∘ ψ.symm) : (𝓝 (ψ b)).Germ 𝕜)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.germCompCoord_injective
statement: theorem germCompCoord_injective (b : E) : Function.Injective (germCompCoord ψ b)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  induction f using Germ.inductionOn with | h f => ?_
  induction g using Germ.inductionOn with | h g => ?_
  rw [germCompCoord_coe, germCompCoord_coe, Germ.coe_eq] at hfg
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  have h1 := (ψ.continuous.continuousAt (x := b)).eventually hfg
  filter_upwards [h1] with x hx
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, ψ.symm_apply_apply] using hx

name: Manifold.tendsto_add_coord
statement:
theorem tendsto_add_coord (b : E) :
    Tendsto (fun y : Fin n → 𝕜 => y + ψ b) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (ψ b))
proof:
:= by
  have := (continuous_add_const (ψ b)).tendsto (0 : Fin n → 𝕜)
  rwa [zero_add] at this

name: Manifold.eq_of_evalSeries_sub_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem eq_of_evalSeries_sub_eventuallyEq (b : E) {c c' : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hc : c ∈ Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n) (hc' : c' ∈ Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n)
    (h : (fun y : Fin n → 𝕜 => evalSeries c (y - ψ b)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (ψ b)]
      fun y => evalSeries c' (y - ψ b)) : c = c'
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_evalSeries_eventuallyEq hc hc' ?_
  have := h.comp_tendsto (tendsto_add_coord ψ b)
  filter_upwards [this] with y hy
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, add_sub_cancel_right] using hy

name: Manifold.IsSeriesOf.unique
statement:
theorem IsSeriesOf.unique {b : E} {g : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜} {c c' : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hc : IsSeriesOf ψ b g c) (hc' : IsSeriesOf ψ b g c') : c = c'
proof:
:=
  eq_of_evalSeries_sub_eventuallyEq ψ b hc.1 hc'.1
    (Germ.coe_eq.mp (hc.2.symm.trans hc'.2))

name: Manifold.exists_isSeriesOf
statement:
theorem exists_isSeriesOf {b : E} {g : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜} (hg : g ∈ analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b) :
    ∃ c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜, IsSeriesOf ψ b g c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl, hf⟩ := hg
  have hfψ : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (f ∘ ψ.symm) (ψ b) := by
    have := (ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E).analyticAt (ψ b)
    rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe] at this
    exact AnalyticAt.comp (by rwa [ψ.symm_apply_apply]) this
  obtain ⟨ρ, c, hc, hfc⟩ := AnalyticAt.exists_eventuallyEq_evalSeries hfψ
  exact ⟨c, ⟨ρ, hc⟩, by rw [germCompCoord_coe]; exact Germ.coe_eq.mpr hfc⟩

name: Manifold.IsSeriesOf.mul
statement:
theorem IsSeriesOf.mul {b : E} {g g' : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜} {c c' : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hc : IsSeriesOf ψ b g c) (hc' : IsSeriesOf ψ b g' c') : IsSeriesOf ψ b (g * g') (c * c')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hc.1
  obtain ⟨ρ', hρ'⟩ := hc'.1
  have h1 : ConvNorm (ρ.min ρ') c ≠ ⊤ := BanachSeries.mono (ρ.min_le_left ρ') hρ
  have h2 : ConvNorm (ρ.min ρ') c' ≠ ⊤ := BanachSeries.mono (ρ.min_le_right ρ') hρ'
  refine ⟨(Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n).mul_mem hc.1 hc'.1, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, hc.2, hc'.2, ← Germ.coe_mul]
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  filter_upwards [Analytic.eventually_norm_sub_lt (ψ b) (ρ.min ρ')] with y hy
  exact (evalSeries_mul h1 h2 fun k => (hy k).le).symm

name: Manifold.IsSeriesOf.add
statement:
theorem IsSeriesOf.add {b : E} {g g' : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜} {c c' : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hc : IsSeriesOf ψ b g c) (hc' : IsSeriesOf ψ b g' c') : IsSeriesOf ψ b (g + g') (c + c')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hc.1
  obtain ⟨ρ', hρ'⟩ := hc'.1
  have h1 : ConvNorm (ρ.min ρ') c ≠ ⊤ := BanachSeries.mono (ρ.min_le_left ρ') hρ
  have h2 : ConvNorm (ρ.min ρ') c' ≠ ⊤ := BanachSeries.mono (ρ.min_le_right ρ') hρ'
  refine ⟨(Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n).add_mem hc.1 hc'.1, ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, hc.2, hc'.2, ← Germ.coe_add]
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  filter_upwards [Analytic.eventually_norm_sub_lt (ψ b) (ρ.min ρ')] with y hy
  exact (evalSeries_add h1 h2 fun k => (hy k).le).symm

name: Manifold.IsSeriesOf.one
statement: theorem IsSeriesOf.one (b : E) : IsSeriesOf ψ b (1 : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜) 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n).one_mem, by
    rw [map_one]
    refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr (Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    exact (evalSeries_one _).symm⟩

name: Manifold.IsSeriesOf.zero
statement: theorem IsSeriesOf.zero (b : E) : IsSeriesOf ψ b (0 : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜) 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n).zero_mem, by
    rw [map_zero]
    refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr (Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    exact (evalSeries_zero _).symm⟩

name: Manifold.isSeriesOf_taylorGermFun
statement:
theorem isSeriesOf_taylorGermFun (b : E) (g : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜) (hg : g ∈ analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b) :
    IsSeriesOf ψ b g (taylorGermFun ψ b g hg)
proof:
:=
  (exists_isSeriesOf ψ hg).choose_spec

name: Manifold.taylorGermFun_eq_of_isSeriesOf
statement:
theorem taylorGermFun_eq_of_isSeriesOf {b : E} {g : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜} (hg : g ∈ analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b)
    {c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜} (hc : IsSeriesOf ψ b g c) : taylorGermFun ψ b g hg = c
proof:
:=
  IsSeriesOf.unique ψ (isSeriesOf_taylorGermFun ψ b g hg) hc

name: Manifold.taylorGermFun_one
statement:
theorem taylorGermFun_one (b : E) :
    taylorGermFun ψ b 1 (analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b).one_mem = 1
proof:
:=
  taylorGermFun_eq_of_isSeriesOf ψ _ (IsSeriesOf.one ψ b)

name: Manifold.taylorGermFun_zero
statement:
theorem taylorGermFun_zero (b : E) :
    taylorGermFun ψ b 0 (analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b).zero_mem = 0
proof:
:=
  taylorGermFun_eq_of_isSeriesOf ψ _ (IsSeriesOf.zero ψ b)

name: Manifold.taylorGermFun_mul
statement:
theorem taylorGermFun_mul (b : E) {g g' : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜} (hg : g ∈ analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b)
    (hg' : g' ∈ analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b) :
    taylorGermFun ψ b (g * g') ((analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b).mul_mem hg hg') =
      taylorGermFun ψ b g hg * taylorGermFun ψ b g' hg'
proof:
:=
  taylorGermFun_eq_of_isSeriesOf ψ _
    (IsSeriesOf.mul ψ (isSeriesOf_taylorGermFun ψ b g hg) (isSeriesOf_taylorGermFun ψ b g' hg'))

name: Manifold.taylorGermFun_add
statement:
theorem taylorGermFun_add (b : E) {g g' : (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜} (hg : g ∈ analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b)
    (hg' : g' ∈ analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b) :
    taylorGermFun ψ b (g + g') ((analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b).add_mem hg hg') =
      taylorGermFun ψ b g hg + taylorGermFun ψ b g' hg'
proof:
:=
  taylorGermFun_eq_of_isSeriesOf ψ _
    (IsSeriesOf.add ψ (isSeriesOf_taylorGermFun ψ b g hg) (isSeriesOf_taylorGermFun ψ b g' hg'))

name: Manifold.coe_taylorGerm
statement:
theorem coe_taylorGerm (b : E) (g : analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b) :
    (taylorGerm ψ b g : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜) = taylorGermFun ψ b g.1 g.2
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.isSeriesOf_taylorGerm
statement:
theorem isSeriesOf_taylorGerm (b : E) (g : analyticGermsAt 𝕜 E b) :
    IsSeriesOf ψ b g.1 (taylorGerm ψ b g)
proof:
:=
  isSeriesOf_taylorGermFun ψ b g.1 g.2

name: Manifold.taylorGerm_injective
statement: theorem taylorGerm_injective (b : E) : Function.Injective (taylorGerm ψ b)
proof:
:= by
  intro g g' h
  have h1 := isSeriesOf_taylorGerm ψ b g
  have h2 := isSeriesOf_taylorGerm ψ b g'
  rw [h] at h1
  exact Subtype.ext (germCompCoord_injective ψ b (h1.2.trans h2.2.symm))

name: Manifold.residue_eq_residue_const
statement:
theorem residue_eq_residue_const (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    residue _ s = residue _ (const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a s))
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr
    ((mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E _).mpr (by rw [map_sub, eval_const, sub_self]))

name: Manifold.bijective_residue_comp_const
statement:
theorem bijective_residue_comp_const :
    Function.Bijective
      ((residue ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)).comp (const 𝕜 E M a))
proof:
:=
  ⟨((residue _).comp (const 𝕜 E M a)).injective, fun x => by
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective x
    exact ⟨eval 𝕜 E M a s, (residue_eq_residue_const E s).symm⟩⟩

name: Manifold.nontrivial_quotient_maximalIdeal_pow_one
statement:
theorem nontrivial_quotient_maximalIdeal_pow_one :
    Nontrivial ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a ⧸
      maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_one]
  exact inferInstanceAs (Nontrivial (ResidueField ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)))

name: Manifold.nontrivial_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem nontrivial_adicCompletion :
    Nontrivial (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
proof:
:=
  have := nontrivial_quotient_maximalIdeal_pow_one (𝕜 := 𝕜) E (a := a)
  (AdicCompletion.surjective_evalₐ (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
    1).nontrivial

name: Manifold.injective_algebraMap_comp_const
statement:
theorem injective_algebraMap_comp_const :
    Function.Injective
      ((algebraMap ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
        (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
          ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))).comp (const 𝕜 E M a))
proof:
:=
  have := nontrivial_adicCompletion (𝕜 := 𝕜) E (a := a)
  RingHom.injective _

name: Manifold.exists_evalₐ_one_eq_const
statement:
theorem exists_evalₐ_one_eq_const
    (x : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :
    ∃ c : 𝕜, AdicCompletion.evalₐ (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) 1 x =
      AdicCompletion.evalₐ (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) 1
        (algebraMap _ _ (const 𝕜 E M a c))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (AdicCompletion.evalₐ (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) 1 x)
  refine ⟨eval 𝕜 E M a s, ?_⟩
  have h2 : AdicCompletion.evalₐ (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) 1
      (algebraMap _ _ (const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a s))) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a s)) :=
    AdicCompletion.evalₐ_of _ 1 _
  rw [h2, ← hs]
  refine Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr ?_
  rw [pow_one]
  exact (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E _).mpr (by rw [map_sub, eval_const, sub_self])

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.map_const
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsTaylorHom.eq E ψ φ hT (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ), taylorHom_const]

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.map_coord_sub_const
statement:
theorem IsTaylorHom.map_coord_sub_const
    {T : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hT : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T) (i : Fin n) :
    T (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i))) = X i
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsTaylorHom.eq E ψ φ hT (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ), taylorHom_coord_sub]

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.exists_adicCompletion_equiv_const_coord
statement:
theorem IsTaylorHom.exists_adicCompletion_equiv_const_coord
    {T : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hT : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T) :
    ∃ e : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ≃+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜,
      (∀ s, e (algebraMap _ _ s) = T s) ∧
        (∀ c : 𝕜, e (algebraMap _ _ (const 𝕜 E M a c)) = C c) ∧
        ∀ i, e (algebraMap _ _ (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i -
          const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i)))) = X i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := IsTaylorHom.exists_adicCompletion_equiv' E ψ φ ha hφ hT
  exact ⟨e, he, fun c => by rw [he, IsTaylorHom.map_const E ψ φ hφ ha hT],
    fun i => by rw [he, IsTaylorHom.map_coord_sub_const E ψ φ hφ ha hT]⟩

name: Manifold.taylorQuot_mk
statement:
theorem taylorQuot_mk (k : ℕ) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    taylorQuot E ψ φ ha hφ k (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.quotientMap_mk

name: Manifold.taylorQuot_injective
statement: theorem taylorQuot_injective (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (taylorQuot E ψ φ ha hφ k)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.quotientMap_injective' fun s hs =>
    (taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s k).mp (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hs)

name: Manifold.taylorQuot_surjective
statement: theorem taylorQuot_surjective (k : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (taylorQuot E ψ φ ha hφ k)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Set.mem_range.mp ((range_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ).ge (truncDeg_mem_conv k c))
  refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s, ?_⟩
  rw [taylorQuot_mk, hs, Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← neg_sub, neg_mem_iff]
  exact sub_truncDeg_mem_maximalIdeal_pow k c

name: Manifold.taylorCompletionFamily_mk
statement:
theorem taylorCompletionFamily_mk (k : ℕ)
    (f : AdicCompletion.AdicCauchySequence
      (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :
    taylorCompletionFamily E ψ φ ha hφ k (AdicCompletion.mk _ _ f) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ (f.val k))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [taylorCompletionFamily, RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
    AdicCompletion.evalₐ_mk, taylorQuot_mk]

name: Manifold.taylorCompletionFamily_compat
statement:
theorem taylorCompletionFamily_compat {m k : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ k) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜)) hle).comp
        (taylorCompletionFamily E ψ φ ha hφ k) =
      taylorCompletionFamily E ψ φ ha hφ m
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := AdicCompletion.mk_surjective _ _ x
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, taylorCompletionFamily_mk, taylorCompletionFamily_mk]
  refine (Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk _ _).trans (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr ?_)
  rw [← map_sub, taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff, ← neg_sub, neg_mem_iff]
  have h1 := SModEq.sub_mem.mp (f.property hle)
  simpa using h1

name: Manifold.mk_taylorCompletion
statement:
theorem mk_taylorCompletion (k : ℕ)
    (x : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜) ^ k)
        (taylorCompletion E ψ φ ha hφ x) = taylorCompletionFamily E ψ φ ha hφ k x
proof:
:=
  IsAdicComplete.mk_liftRingHom _ _ _ k x

name: Manifold.eq_of_forall_mk_eq
proof:
:=
  congrFun (IsHausdorff.funext' (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜)) (f := fun _ : Unit => c)
    (g := fun _ => c') fun k _ => h k) ()

name: Manifold.taylorCompletion_of
statement:
theorem taylorCompletion_of (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    taylorCompletion E ψ φ ha hφ (AdicCompletion.of _ _ s) = taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_forall_mk_eq fun k => ?_
  rw [mk_taylorCompletion]
  simp only [taylorCompletionFamily, RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
    AdicCompletion.evalₐ_of, taylorQuot_mk]

name: Manifold.taylorCompletion_injective
statement: theorem taylorCompletion_injective : Function.Injective (taylorCompletion E ψ φ ha hφ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun x hx => ?_
  refine AdicCompletion.ext_evalₐ fun k => ?_
  apply taylorQuot_injective E ψ φ ha hφ k
  have h1 := mk_taylorCompletion E ψ φ ha hφ k x
  rw [hx, map_zero] at h1
  simp only [taylorCompletionFamily, RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingHom.coe_coe] at h1
  rw [← h1, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Manifold.taylorCompletion_surjective
statement: theorem taylorCompletion_surjective : Function.Surjective (taylorCompletion E ψ φ ha hφ)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  have h1 : ∀ k, ∃ s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a,
      taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s - c ∈ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜) ^ k := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := taylorQuot_surjective E ψ φ ha hφ k (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ c)
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
    rw [taylorQuot_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq] at hq
    exact ⟨s, hq⟩
  choose s hs using h1
  have hcauchy : AdicCompletion.IsAdicCauchy
      (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) s := by
    intro m k hmk
    rw [SModEq.sub_mem]
    have h2 : s m - s k ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ m := by
      rw [← taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ, map_sub]
      have := Ideal.sub_mem _ (hs m) (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hmk (hs k))
      rwa [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] at this
    simpa using h2
  refine ⟨AdicCompletion.mk _ _ ⟨s, hcauchy⟩, eq_of_forall_mk_eq fun k => ?_⟩
  rw [mk_taylorCompletion]
  exact (taylorCompletionFamily_mk E ψ φ ha hφ k ⟨s, hcauchy⟩).trans (Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr (hs k))

name: Manifold.taylorCompletionEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem taylorCompletionEquiv_algebraMap (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    taylorCompletionEquiv E ψ φ ha hφ (algebraMap _ _ s) = taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s
proof:
:=
  taylorCompletion_of E ψ φ ha hφ s

name: Manifold.IsTaylorHom.exists_adicCompletion_equiv'
statement:
theorem IsTaylorHom.exists_adicCompletion_equiv'
    {T : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜}
    (hT : IsTaylorHom E ψ φ a T) :
    ∃ e : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ≃+* MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜,
      ∀ s, e (algebraMap _ _ s) = T s
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := IsTaylorHom.eq E ψ φ hT (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ)
  exact ⟨taylorCompletionEquiv E ψ φ ha hφ, taylorCompletionEquiv_algebraMap E ψ φ ha hφ⟩

name: Manifold.germAt_apply
statement:
theorem germAt_apply (a : TopCat.of M) (U : Opens M) (ha : a ∈ U)
    (f : (contMDiffSheafCommRing IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    germAt IM n M a U ha f = ↑(extendBy0 IM n M f)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.germAt_restrict
statement:
theorem germAt_restrict (a : TopCat.of M) (U V : Opens M) (i : U ⟶ V) (ha : a ∈ U)
    (f : (contMDiffSheafCommRing IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    germAt IM n M a U ha ((contMDiffSheafCommRing IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜).presheaf.map i.op f) =
      germAt IM n M a V (leOfHom i ha) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [germAt_apply, germAt_apply]
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  filter_upwards [U.2.mem_nhds ha] with x hx
  rw [extendBy0_of_mem IM n M _ hx, extendBy0_of_mem IM n M _ (leOfHom i hx)]
  rfl

name: Manifold.sectionOfContMDiffOn_apply
statement:
theorem sectionOfContMDiffOn_apply (h : N → 𝕜) (W : Opens N)
    (hW : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E') 𝓘(𝕜) ω h W) (x : W) :
    sectionOfContMDiffOn h W hW x = h x
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.stalkToGerm_germ_sectionOfContMDiffOn
statement:
theorem stalkToGerm_germ_sectionOfContMDiffOn (h : N → 𝕜) (W : Opens N)
    (hW : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E') 𝓘(𝕜) ω h W) {b : N} (hb : b ∈ W) :
    stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E') ω N b
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E' N).presheaf.germ W b hb (sectionOfContMDiffOn h W hW)) = ↑h
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ]
  refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
  filter_upwards [W.2.mem_nhds hb] with x hx
  exact extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E' _ hx

name: Manifold.eval_eq_value
statement:
theorem eval_eq_value (a : M) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    eval 𝕜 E M a s = (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a s).value
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, ha, f, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  rw [stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ, Germ.value_ofFun, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f ha]
  exact contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 U a ha f

name: Manifold.stalkToGerm_stalkEquivRange_symm
statement:
theorem stalkToGerm_stalkEquivRange_symm (b : N) (g : (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E') ω N b).range) :
    stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E') ω N b ((stalkEquivRange b).symm g) = g
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val ((stalkEquivRange b).apply_symm_apply g)

name: Manifold.stalkToGerm_germMapOn
statement:
theorem stalkToGerm_germMapOn (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk c) :
    stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E') ω N b (germMapOn φ hφ hb hc s) =
      (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M c s).compTendsto φ (tendsto_of_contMDiffOn_of_eq φ hφ hb hc)
proof:
:=
  stalkToGerm_stalkEquivRange_symm b _

name: Manifold.germMapOn_germ
statement:
theorem germMapOn_germ {U : Opens M} (hcU : c ∈ U) (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U))
    {W : Opens N} (hbW : b ∈ W) (hW : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E') 𝓘(𝕜) ω (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ φ) W) :
    germMapOn φ hφ hb hc ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U c hcU f) =
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E' N).presheaf.germ W b hbW (sectionOfContMDiffOn _ W hW)
proof:
:= by
  apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E') ω N b
  rw [stalkToGerm_germMapOn, stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ, Germ.coe_compTendsto,
    stalkToGerm_germ_sectionOfContMDiffOn]

name: Manifold.eval_germMapOn
statement:
theorem eval_germMapOn (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk c) :
    eval 𝕜 E' N b (germMapOn φ hφ hb hc s) = eval 𝕜 E M c s
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_eq_value, eval_eq_value, stalkToGerm_germMapOn]
  induction stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M c s using Germ.inductionOn with
  | h g => rw [Germ.coe_compTendsto, Germ.value_ofFun, Germ.value_ofFun, Function.comp_apply, hc]

name: Manifold.stalkToGerm_germMap
statement:
theorem stalkToGerm_germMap (b : N)
    (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (φ b)) :
    stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E') ω N b (germMap φ hφ b s) =
      (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M (φ b) s).compTendsto φ
        (hφ.continuous.tendsto b)
proof:
:=
  stalkToGerm_germMapOn φ (V := ⊤) hφ.contMDiffOn (Opens.mem_top b) rfl s

name: Manifold.mem_preimageOpens
statement: theorem mem_preimageOpens {U : Opens M} {x : N} : x ∈ preimageOpens φ hφ U ↔ φ x ∈ U
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.contMDiffOn_extendSection
statement:
theorem contMDiffOn_extendSection {U : Opens M} (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (extendSection 𝕜 E f) U
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine ContMDiffAt.contMDiffWithinAt ?_
  have hf : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ Subtype.val) (⟨x, hx⟩ : U) := by
    rw [extendSection, extendBy0_comp_val]
    exact f.2 ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ((contDiffWithinAt_localInvariantProp (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)) (I' := 𝓘(𝕜))
    ω).liftPropAt_iff_comp_subtype_val (U := U) (extendSection 𝕜 E f) ⟨x, hx⟩).mpr hf

name: Manifold.comapSection_apply
statement:
theorem comapSection_apply {U : Opens M} (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U))
    (x : preimageOpens φ hφ U) : comapSection φ hφ f x = f ⟨φ x, x.2⟩
proof:
:=
  extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f x.2

name: Manifold.germMap_germ
statement:
theorem germMap_germ {U : Opens M} {b : N} (hU : φ b ∈ U)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    germMap φ hφ b ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U (φ b) hU f) =
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E' N).presheaf.germ (preimageOpens φ hφ U) b
        ((mem_preimageOpens φ hφ).mpr hU) (comapSection φ hφ f)
proof:
:=
  germMapOn_germ φ (V := ⊤) hφ.contMDiffOn (Opens.mem_top b) rfl hU f
    ((mem_preimageOpens φ hφ).mpr hU) _

name: Manifold.germMap_id
statement:
theorem germMap_id (x : M) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :
    germMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E' := E) (id : M → M) contMDiff_id x s = s
proof:
:= by
  refine stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x ?_
  rw [stalkToGerm_germMap]
  change (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x s).compTendsto id (continuous_id.tendsto x) =
    stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x s
  induction stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x s using Germ.inductionOn with
  | h f => rw [Germ.coe_compTendsto]; rfl

name: Manifold.taylorEquivConv_apply_coe
statement:
theorem taylorEquivConv_apply_coe (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    (taylorEquivConv E ψ φ ha hφ s : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜) = taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.isNoetherianRing_stalk_of_chart
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_stalk_of_chart :
    IsNoetherianRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
proof:
:=
  isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv (Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n) (taylorEquivConv E ψ φ ha hφ).symm

name: Manifold.ringKrullDim_stalk_of_chart
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_of_chart :
    ringKrullDim ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) = n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isNoetherianRing_stalk_of_chart E ψ φ ha hφ
  have h2 : IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion
      (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :=
    isNoetherianRing_adicCompletion ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
      (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha) (maximalIdeal_eq_span_coord' E ψ φ ha hφ)
  have h3 := ringKrullDim_adicCompletion_eq ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
  have h4 := ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (taylorCompletionEquiv E ψ φ ha hφ)
  rw [← h3, h4, ringKrullDim_mvPowerSeries]

name: Manifold.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_stalk_le
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_stalk_le :
    (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)).spanFinrank ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximalIdeal_eq_span_coord' E ψ φ ha hφ]
  refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_range _)).trans ?_
  calc (Set.range fun i => coord E ψ φ hφ ha i -
          const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i))).ncard
      = ((fun i => coord E ψ φ hφ ha i - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i))) ''
          Set.univ).ncard := by rw [Set.image_univ]
    _ ≤ (Set.univ : Set (Fin n)).ncard := Set.ncard_image_le Set.finite_univ
    _ = n := by rw [Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Manifold.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_chart
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_chart :
    IsRegularLocalRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isNoetherianRing_stalk_of_chart E ψ φ ha hφ
  refine IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le _ ?_
  rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_of_chart E ψ φ ha hφ]
  exact_mod_cast spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_stalk_le E ψ φ ha hφ

name: Manifold.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_stalk_of_chart
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_stalk_of_chart :
    (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)).spanFinrank = n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_chart E ψ φ ha hφ
  have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
    (R := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
  rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_of_chart E ψ φ ha hφ] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: Manifold.ringKrullDim_stalk
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_stalk (a : M) :
    ringKrullDim ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) = Module.finrank 𝕜 E
proof:
:=
  ringKrullDim_stalk_of_chart E (IdealSheaf.modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)) (chartAt E a)
    (mem_chart_source E a) (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a)

name: Manifold.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_stalk
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_stalk (a : M) :
    (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)).spanFinrank = Module.finrank 𝕜 E
proof:
:=
  spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_stalk_of_chart E (IdealSheaf.modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)) (chartAt E a)
    (mem_chart_source E a) (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a)

name: Manifold.pderiv_comm
statement:
theorem pderiv_comm (i j : Fin n) (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) 𝕜) :
    MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := 𝕜) i (MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := 𝕜) j F) =
      MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := 𝕜) j (MvPowerSeries.pderiv (R := 𝕜) i F)
proof:
:= by
  ext ν
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_pderiv, MvPowerSeries.coeff_pderiv, MvPowerSeries.coeff_pderiv,
    MvPowerSeries.coeff_pderiv, add_right_comm ν (Finsupp.single i 1) (Finsupp.single j 1),
    Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm h)]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalk_centredCoord
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalk_centredCoord (i j : Fin n) :
    coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  coordDerivStalk_coord_sub_const E ψ φ hφ ha i j

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalk_comm
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalk_comm (i j : Fin n) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha j s) =
      coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha j (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i s)
proof:
:= by
  have hT := isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ
  apply IsTaylorHom.injective' E ψ φ ha hT
  rw [IsTaylorHom.pderiv E ψ φ hφ ha hT, IsTaylorHom.pderiv E ψ φ hφ ha hT,
    IsTaylorHom.pderiv E ψ φ hφ ha hT, IsTaylorHom.pderiv E ψ φ hφ ha hT, pderiv_comm]

name: Manifold.eq_zero_of_forall_mem_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_mem_maximalIdeal_pow (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
    (h : ∀ k, s ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ k) : s = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply IsTaylorHom.injective' E ψ φ ha (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ)
  rw [map_zero]
  refine eq_of_forall_mk_eq fun k => ?_
  rw [map_zero, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact (taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s k).mpr (h k)

name: Manifold.exists_mem_adjoin_sub_mem_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem exists_mem_adjoin_sub_mem_maximalIdeal_pow (k : ℕ)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    ∃ p ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕜 (Set.range (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha)),
      f - p ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing f with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, Subalgebra.zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := ih f
    rw [maximalIdeal_pow_eq_span_monomials' E ψ φ ha hφ k] at hfp
    obtain ⟨m, c, g, hsum⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_set'.mp hfp
    have hsum' : f - p = ∑ l, c l * (g l : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) := by
      rw [← hsum]
      rfl
    refine ⟨p + ∑ l, const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (c l)) *
      (g l : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a), ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Subalgebra.add_mem _ hp (Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Subalgebra.mul_mem _ ?_ ?_)
      · exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ (eval 𝕜 E M a (c l))
      · obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := (g l).2
        rw [← hν]
        exact Subalgebra.prod_mem _ fun i _ =>
          Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)) _
    · have h1 : f - (p + ∑ l, const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (c l)) *
          (g l : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) =
          ∑ l, (c l - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a (c l))) *
            (g l : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) := by
        simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← hsum']
        ring
      rw [h1, pow_succ']
      refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Ideal.mul_mem_mul ?_ ?_
      · exact (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E _).mpr (by rw [map_sub, eval_const, sub_self])
      · rw [maximalIdeal_pow_eq_span_monomials' E ψ φ ha hφ k]
        exact Ideal.subset_span (g l).2

name: Manifold.derivation_eq_sum_coordDerivStalk
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_sum_coordDerivStalk
    (δ : Derivation 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
    (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    δ s = ∑ i, δ (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha i) * coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i s
proof:
:= by
  set δ' : Derivation 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :=
    δ - ∑ i, δ (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha i) • coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i with hδ'
  have hδ'x : ∀ j, δ' (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    rw [hδ', Derivation.sub_apply, derivation_sum_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, coordDerivStalk_centredCoord, mul_boole,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  have hδ'poly : ∀ p ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕜 (Set.range (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha)), δ' p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    induction hp using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem p hp =>
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hp
      exact hδ'x j
    | algebraMap r => exact Derivation.map_algebraMap δ' r
    | add p q _ _ hp hq => rw [map_add, hp, hq, add_zero]
    | mul p q _ _ hp hq => rw [Derivation.leibniz, hp, hq, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hδ'zero : ∀ f, δ' f = 0 := by
    intro f
    refine eq_zero_of_forall_mem_maximalIdeal_pow E ψ φ hφ ha _ fun k => ?_
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_mem_adjoin_sub_mem_maximalIdeal_pow E ψ φ hφ ha (k + 1) f
    have h1 := Derivation.mem_pow_of_mem_pow_succ _ δ' k hfp
    rwa [map_sub, hδ'poly p hp, sub_zero] at h1
  have h2 := hδ'zero s
  rw [hδ', Derivation.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero, derivation_sum_apply] at h2
  simpa only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using h2

name: Manifold.exists_regularCoords_stalk
statement:
theorem exists_regularCoords_stalk [IsRegularLocalRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)]
    (hdim : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :
    ∃ c : RegularCoords ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) n,
      (∀ i, c.x i = centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha i) ∧
        (∀ i, c.pderiv i = (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i).restrictScalars ℚ) ∧
          c.IsLinearOver 𝕜 ∧ c.SpansDerivations 𝕜
proof:
:=
  ⟨{ x := centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha
     pderiv := fun i => (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i).restrictScalars ℚ
     span_x := maximalIdeal_eq_span_coord' E ψ φ ha hφ
     card := hdim
     pderiv_x := fun i j => by
       rw [Derivation.restrictScalars_apply, coordDerivStalk_centredCoord]
     pderiv_comm := fun i j f => by
       simp only [Derivation.restrictScalars_apply]
       exact coordDerivStalk_comm E ψ φ hφ ha i j f },
    fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl,
    fun i c => by simp only [Derivation.restrictScalars_apply, Derivation.map_algebraMap],
    fun δ f => derivation_eq_sum_coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha δ f⟩

name: Manifold.det_clm_comp
statement: theorem det_clm_comp (A B : E →L[𝕜] E) : (A.comp B).det = A.det * B.det
proof:
:=
  Analytic.det_clm_comp A B

name: Manifold.contDiff_det
statement: theorem contDiff_det {n : WithTop ℕ∞} : ContDiff 𝕜 n fun L : E →L[𝕜] E => L.det
proof:
:=
  Analytic.contDiff_det

name: Manifold.contDiffOn_det_fderiv
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_det_fderiv {F : E → E} {s : Set E} (hF : ContDiffOn 𝕜 ω F s) (hs : IsOpen s) :
    ContDiffOn 𝕜 ω (fun x => (fderiv 𝕜 F x).det) s
proof:
:=
  Analytic.contDiffOn_det_fderiv hF hs

name: Manifold.det_fderiv_mul_det_fderiv_eq_one
statement:
theorem det_fderiv_mul_det_fderiv_eq_one {g g' : E → E} {V : Set E} (hV : IsOpen V) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ V) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g x) (hg' : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g' (g x))
    (hgg' : ∀ y ∈ V, g' (g y) = y) :
    (fderiv 𝕜 g' (g x)).det * (fderiv 𝕜 g x).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (fderiv 𝕜 g' (g x)).comp (fderiv 𝕜 g x) = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 E := by
    rw [← fderiv_comp x hg' hg]
    have : (g' ∘ g) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id := eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hx) fun z hz => hgg' z hz
    rw [this.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
  have h2 := congrArg ContinuousLinearMap.det h1
  have hid : (ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 E).det = 1 := LinearMap.det_id
  rw [det_clm_comp, hid] at h2
  exact h2

name: Manifold.isOpen_target_inter_preimage_symm
statement:
theorem isOpen_target_inter_preimage_symm (χ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E) {s : Set M}
    (hs : IsOpen s) : IsOpen (χ.target ∩ χ.symm ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:=
  χ.symm.isOpen_inter_preimage hs

name: Manifold.mapsTo_chart_target_inter
statement:
theorem mapsTo_chart_target_inter (χ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E) (φ' : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E) :
    MapsTo φ' (φ'.source ∩ f ⁻¹' χ.source) (φ'.target ∩ φ'.symm ⁻¹' (f ⁻¹' χ.source))
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  refine ⟨φ'.map_source hy.1, ?_⟩
  change f (φ'.symm (φ' y)) ∈ χ.source
  rw [φ'.left_inv hy.1]
  exact hy.2

name: Manifold.contDiffOn_chartRep
proof:
:=
  contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp <|
    (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hχ).comp
      (hf.comp_contMDiffOn ((contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ').mono inter_subset_left))
      fun _ hv => hv.2

name: Manifold.contMDiffOn_jacobianFun
statement:
theorem contMDiffOn_jacobianFun (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f)
    {χ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} (hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    {φ' : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E} (hφ' : φ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N) :
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (jacobianFun 𝕜 f χ φ') (φ'.source ∩ f ⁻¹' χ.source)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen (φ'.target ∩ φ'.symm ⁻¹' (f ⁻¹' χ.source)) :=
    isOpen_target_inter_preimage_symm φ' (χ.open_source.preimage hf.continuous)
  have hG : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (fun x => (fderiv 𝕜 (χ ∘ f ∘ φ'.symm) x).det)
      (φ'.target ∩ φ'.symm ⁻¹' (f ⁻¹' χ.source)) :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mpr (contDiffOn_det_fderiv (contDiffOn_chartRep hf hχ hφ') hopen)
  exact hG.comp ((contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ').mono inter_subset_left)
    (mapsTo_chart_target_inter χ φ')

name: Manifold.jacobianFun_comp
proof:
:= by
  unfold jacobianFun
  have hopen : IsOpen (φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' (φ.source ∩ f ⁻¹' θ.source)) :=
    isOpen_target_inter_preimage_symm φ
      (φ.open_source.inter (θ.open_source.preimage hf.continuous))
  have hmem : φ y ∈ φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' (φ.source ∩ f ⁻¹' θ.source) :=
    ⟨φ.map_source hy, by rw [mem_preimage, φ.left_inv hy]; exact ⟨hy, hfy⟩⟩
  have hloc : (χ ∘ (g ∘ f) ∘ φ.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ y)] (χ ∘ g ∘ θ.symm) ∘ (θ ∘ f ∘ φ.symm) := by
    filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmem] with v hv
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [θ.left_inv hv.2.2]
  rw [hloc.fderiv_eq]
  have hB : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (θ ∘ f ∘ φ.symm) (φ y) := differentiableAt_chartRep hf hθ hφ hy hfy
  have hBy : (θ ∘ f ∘ φ.symm) (φ y) = θ (f y) := by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, φ.left_inv hy]
  have hA : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (χ ∘ g ∘ θ.symm) ((θ ∘ f ∘ φ.symm) (φ y)) := by
    rw [hBy]; exact differentiableAt_chartRep hg hχ hθ hfy hgfy
  rw [fderiv_comp (φ y) hA hB, det_clm_comp, hBy]

name: Manifold.jacobianStalk_comp
statement:
theorem jacobianStalk_comp {f : P → N} {g : N → M} (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f)
    (hg : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω g) (a : P) :
    jacobianStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (g ∘ f) a =
      Ideal.map (germMap f hf a) (jacobianStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) g (f a)) *
        jacobianStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) f a
proof:
:= by
  have hχ := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)) (n := ω) (g (f a))
  have hθ := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)) (n := ω) (f a)
  have hφ := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)) (n := ω) a
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, h₁⟩ := exists_stalk_jacobianStalk_eq_span_of_charts (hg.comp hf) hχ hφ
    (mem_chart_source E a) (mem_chart_source E (g (f a)))
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂, h₂⟩ := exists_stalk_jacobianStalk_eq_span_of_charts hg hχ hθ
    (mem_chart_source E (f a)) (mem_chart_source E (g (f a)))
  obtain ⟨s₃, hs₃, h₃⟩ := exists_stalk_jacobianStalk_eq_span_of_charts hf hθ hφ
    (mem_chart_source E a) (mem_chart_source E (f a))
  have key : s₁ = germMap f hf a s₂ * s₃ := by
    apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω P a
    rw [hs₁, map_mul, stalkToGerm_germMap, hs₂, hs₃, Germ.coe_compTendsto, ← Germ.coe_mul,
      Germ.coe_eq]
    have hopen : IsOpen (((chartAt E a).source ∩ f ⁻¹' (chartAt E (f a)).source) ∩
        (g ∘ f) ⁻¹' (chartAt E (g (f a))).source) :=
      ((chartAt E a).open_source.inter
        ((chartAt E (f a)).open_source.preimage hf.continuous)).inter
        ((chartAt E (g (f a))).open_source.preimage (hg.comp hf).continuous)
    filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds ⟨⟨mem_chart_source E a, mem_chart_source E (f a)⟩,
      mem_chart_source E (g (f a))⟩] with y hy
    exact jacobianFun_comp hf hg hχ hθ hφ hy.1.1 hy.1.2 hy.2
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton,
    key]

name: Manifold.jacobianStalk_comp_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt_left
statement:
theorem jacobianStalk_comp_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt_left {f : P → N} {g : N → M}
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f) (hg : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω g) (a : P)
    (hloc : IsLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω g (f a)) :
    jacobianStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (g ∘ f) a = jacobianStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobianStalk_comp hf hg a, jacobianStalk_eq_top_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt hg hloc,
    Ideal.map_top, Ideal.top_mul]

name: Manifold.jacobianStalk_comp_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt_right
statement:
theorem jacobianStalk_comp_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt_right {f : P → N} {g : N → M}
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f) (hg : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω g) (a : P)
    (hloc : IsLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f a) :
    jacobianStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (g ∘ f) a =
      Ideal.map (germMap f hf a) (jacobianStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) g (f a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobianStalk_comp hf hg a, jacobianStalk_eq_top_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt hf hloc,
    Ideal.mul_top]

name: Manifold.jacobianFun_blowUpChart
proof:
:= by
  have _hφ := hφ
  
  have hloc : (φ ∘ π ∘ Φ.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (Φ p)] (ψ.symm ∘ blowUpChartMap σ i ∘ ψ) := by
    filter_upwards [Φ.open_target.mem_nhds (Φ.map_source hp)] with v hv
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    have hcomm := hΦ.comm (Φ.symm v) (Φ.map_target hv)
    rw [Φ.right_inv hv] at hcomm
    rw [← hcomm, ψ.symm_apply_apply]
  unfold jacobianFun
  rw [hloc.fderiv_eq, ContinuousLinearEquiv.comp_fderiv, ContinuousLinearEquiv.comp_right_fderiv,
    ← det_fderiv_blowUpChartMap σ (ψ (Φ p))]
  exact LinearMap.det_conj
    (fderiv 𝕜 (blowUpChartMap σ i) (ψ (Φ p)) : (Fin n → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜))
    ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv

name: Manifold.jacobianStalk_blowUp
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hspan⟩ := exists_stalk_jacobianStalk_eq_span_of_charts h.contMDiff hφ.1
    hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp (hΦ.source_subset hp)
  have hs' : s = coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp (σ i) ^ (c - 1) := by
    apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M' p
    rw [hs, map_pow, stalkToGerm_coord, ← Germ.coe_pow]
    refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
    filter_upwards [Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hp] with q hq
    rw [Pi.pow_apply, jacobianFun_blowUpChart hφ hΦ hq, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hq]
    rfl
  rw [hspan, hs']

name: Manifold.jacobianIdeal_eq_of_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem jacobianIdeal_eq_of_hasLocalGenerators (f : AnalyticMap N' N)
    (h : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E N') (jacobianStalk ⇑f)) :
    AnalyticMap.jacobianIdeal f = IdealSheaf.ofStalks _ _ h
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left h

name: Manifold.jacobianIdeal_eq_top_of_not
statement:
theorem jacobianIdeal_eq_top_of_not (f : AnalyticMap N' N)
    (h : ¬ IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E N') (jacobianStalk ⇑f)) :
    AnalyticMap.jacobianIdeal f = ⊤
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right h

name: Manifold.jacobianIdeal_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem jacobianIdeal_stalkIdeal (f : AnalyticMap N' N) (a' : N') :
    (AnalyticMap.jacobianIdeal f).stalkIdeal a' = jacobianStalk ⇑f a'
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobianIdeal_eq_of_hasLocalGenerators f (hasLocalGenerators_jacobianStalk f.contMDiff),
    IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks]

name: Manifold.jacobianIdeal_blowUp_stalkIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobianIdeal_stalkIdeal, jacobianStalk_blowUp h hφ hΦ hp]

name: Manifold.jacobianIdeal_blowUp_eq_pow
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun p => ?_
  rw [jacobianIdeal_stalkIdeal, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
  by_cases hpY : π p ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hπp, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart (π p) hpY
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hp⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ p hπp
    rw [jacobianStalk_blowUp h hφ hΦ hp,
      stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ hp, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  · rw [stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem hY h hpY, Ideal.top_pow]
    exact jacobianStalk_eq_top_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt π.contMDiff
      (h.isLocalDiffeomorphOn_compl ⟨p, hpY⟩)

name: Manifold.isOpen_chartPairDomain
statement:
theorem isOpen_chartPairDomain (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f)
    (χ χ' : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E) (φ' φ'' : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E) :
    IsOpen (chartPairDomain f χ χ' φ' φ'')
proof:
:=
  (φ'.open_source.inter φ''.open_source).inter
    ((χ.open_source.inter χ'.open_source).preimage hf.continuous)

name: Manifold.differentiableAt_chartChange
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : χ x ∈ χ.target ∩ χ.symm ⁻¹' χ'.source :=
    ⟨χ.map_source hx, by rw [mem_preimage, χ.left_inv hx]; exact hx'⟩
  exact ((contDiffOn_chartChange hχ hχ').differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
    ((isOpen_target_inter_preimage_symm χ χ'.open_source).mem_nhds hmem)

name: Manifold.differentiableAt_chartRep
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_chartRep (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f)
    {χ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} (hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    {φ' : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E} (hφ' : φ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N) {y : N}
    (hy : y ∈ φ'.source) (hfy : f y ∈ χ.source) :
    DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (χ ∘ f ∘ φ'.symm) (φ' y)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : φ' y ∈ φ'.target ∩ φ'.symm ⁻¹' (f ⁻¹' χ.source) :=
    mapsTo_chart_target_inter χ φ' ⟨hy, hfy⟩
  exact ((contDiffOn_chartRep hf hχ hφ').differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
    ((isOpen_target_inter_preimage_symm φ' (χ.open_source.preimage hf.continuous)).mem_nhds hmem)

name: Manifold.fderiv_chartRep_eq
statement:
theorem fderiv_chartRep_eq (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f) {χ χ' : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E}
    (hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M) (hχ' : χ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    {φ' φ'' : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E} (hφ' : φ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N)
    (hφ'' : φ'' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N) {y : N} (hy : y ∈ chartPairDomain f χ χ' φ' φ'') :
    fderiv 𝕜 (χ' ∘ f ∘ φ''.symm) (φ'' y) =
      (fderiv 𝕜 (χ' ∘ χ.symm) (χ (f y))).comp
        ((fderiv 𝕜 (χ ∘ f ∘ φ'.symm) (φ' y)).comp (fderiv 𝕜 (φ' ∘ φ''.symm) (φ'' y)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨hy', hy''⟩, hfy, hfy'⟩ := hy
  
  have hloc : (χ' ∘ f ∘ φ''.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ'' y)]
      (χ' ∘ χ.symm) ∘ ((χ ∘ f ∘ φ'.symm) ∘ (φ' ∘ φ''.symm)) := by
    have hopen : IsOpen (φ''.target ∩ φ''.symm ⁻¹' chartPairDomain f χ χ' φ' φ'') :=
      isOpen_target_inter_preimage_symm φ'' (isOpen_chartPairDomain hf χ χ' φ' φ'')
    have hmem : φ'' y ∈ φ''.target ∩ φ''.symm ⁻¹' chartPairDomain f χ χ' φ' φ'' :=
      ⟨φ''.map_source hy'', by
        rw [mem_preimage, φ''.left_inv hy'']; exact ⟨⟨hy', hy''⟩, hfy, hfy'⟩⟩
    filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmem] with v hv
    have hz' : φ''.symm v ∈ φ'.source := hv.2.1.1
    have hfz : f (φ''.symm v) ∈ χ.source := hv.2.2.1
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [φ'.left_inv hz', χ.left_inv hfz]
  rw [hloc.fderiv_eq]
  have hB : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (φ' ∘ φ''.symm) (φ'' y) :=
    differentiableAt_chartChange hφ'' hφ' hy'' hy'
  have hBy : (φ' ∘ φ''.symm) (φ'' y) = φ' y := by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, φ''.left_inv hy'']
  have hG : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (χ ∘ f ∘ φ'.symm) ((φ' ∘ φ''.symm) (φ'' y)) := by
    rw [hBy]; exact differentiableAt_chartRep hf hχ hφ' hy' hfy
  have hA : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (χ' ∘ χ.symm) (((χ ∘ f ∘ φ'.symm) ∘ (φ' ∘ φ''.symm)) (φ'' y)) := by
    have : ((χ ∘ f ∘ φ'.symm) ∘ (φ' ∘ φ''.symm)) (φ'' y) = χ (f y) := by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, φ''.left_inv hy'', φ'.left_inv hy']
    rw [this]; exact differentiableAt_chartChange hχ hχ' hfy hfy'
  rw [fderiv_comp (φ'' y) hA (hG.comp (φ'' y) hB), fderiv_comp (φ'' y) hG hB]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, φ''.left_inv hy'', φ'.left_inv hy']

name: Manifold.jacobianFun_eq_mul
statement:
theorem jacobianFun_eq_mul (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f) {χ χ' : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E}
    (hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M) (hχ' : χ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    {φ' φ'' : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E} (hφ' : φ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N)
    (hφ'' : φ'' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N) {y : N} (hy : y ∈ chartPairDomain f χ χ' φ' φ'') :
    jacobianFun 𝕜 f χ' φ'' y =
      (fderiv 𝕜 (χ' ∘ χ.symm) (χ (f y))).det *
        (jacobianFun 𝕜 f χ φ' y * (fderiv 𝕜 (φ' ∘ φ''.symm) (φ'' y)).det)
proof:
:= by
  unfold jacobianFun
  rw [fderiv_chartRep_eq hf hχ hχ' hφ' hφ'' hy, det_clm_comp, det_clm_comp]

name: Manifold.det_fderiv_chartChange_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : χ x ∈ χ.target ∩ χ.symm ⁻¹' χ'.source :=
    ⟨χ.map_source hx, by rw [mem_preimage, χ.left_inv hx]; exact hx'⟩
  have hgg' : ∀ v ∈ χ.target ∩ χ.symm ⁻¹' χ'.source, (χ ∘ χ'.symm) ((χ' ∘ χ.symm) v) = v := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [χ'.left_inv hv.2, χ.right_inv hv.1]
  have hg' : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (χ ∘ χ'.symm) ((χ' ∘ χ.symm) (χ x)) := by
    have : (χ' ∘ χ.symm) (χ x) = χ' x := by simp only [Function.comp_apply, χ.left_inv hx]
    rw [this]
    exact differentiableAt_chartChange hχ' hχ hx' hx
  have h1 := det_fderiv_mul_det_fderiv_eq_one (isOpen_target_inter_preimage_symm χ χ'.open_source)
    hmem (differentiableAt_chartChange hχ hχ' hx hx') hg' hgg'
  exact right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h1

name: Manifold.stalkToGerm_jacobianGerm
statement:
theorem stalkToGerm_jacobianGerm (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f)
    {χ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} (hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    {φ' : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E} (hφ' : φ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N) {a' : N}
    (ha' : a' ∈ φ'.source) (hfa' : f a' ∈ χ.source) :
    stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N a' (jacobianGerm hf hχ hφ' ha' hfa') =
      ((jacobianFun 𝕜 f χ φ' : N → 𝕜) : (𝓝 a').Germ 𝕜)
proof:
:=
  stalkToGerm_germ_sectionOfContMDiffOn _ _ _ _

name: Manifold.exists_unit_jacobianFun_germ_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_jacobianFun_germ_eq (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f)
    {χ χ' : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} (hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    (hχ' : χ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M) {φ' φ'' : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E}
    (hφ' : φ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N) (hφ'' : φ'' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N) {a' : N}
    (ha' : a' ∈ φ'.source) (ha'' : a' ∈ φ''.source) (hfa' : f a' ∈ χ.source)
    (hfa'' : f a' ∈ χ'.source) :
    ∃ u : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E N).presheaf.stalk a', IsUnit u ∧
      ((jacobianFun 𝕜 f χ' φ'' : N → 𝕜) : (𝓝 a').Germ 𝕜) =
        stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N a' u * ((jacobianFun 𝕜 f χ φ' : N → 𝕜) : (𝓝 a').Germ 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  
  set a : N → 𝕜 := fun y => (fderiv 𝕜 (χ' ∘ χ.symm) (χ (f y))).det with ha_def
