      (PartialDiffeomorph.chartChange he he') hx⟩

name: Manifold.mdifferentiableAt_of_differentiableAt_comp_symm
proof:
:= by
  have hφa : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) φ a :=
    (mdifferentiable_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ).mdifferentiableAt ha
  have hcomp : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ((z ∘ φ.symm) ∘ φ) a :=
    (mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mpr hd).comp a hφa
  exact hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq ((φ.eventually_left_inverse ha).mono fun y hy => by
    simp [Function.comp, hy])

name: Manifold.linearIndependent_fderiv_chart_iff'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : ∀ i, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) (z i) a
  · exact hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_chart hφ ha hz
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.mp hz
    have h1 : mderivFun E (z i) a = 0 := mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt hi
    have h2 : fderiv 𝕜 (z i ∘ φ.symm) (φ a) = 0 :=
      fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt fun hd =>
        hi (mdifferentiableAt_of_differentiableAt_comp_symm hφ ha hd)
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact absurd h1 (h.ne_zero i)
    · intro h
      exact absurd h2 (h.ne_zero i)

name: Manifold.linearPart_apply
statement:
theorem linearPart_apply (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) (i : Fin n) :
    linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha s i =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single i 1) (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Manifold.linearPart_const
statement: theorem linearPart_const (c : 𝕜) : linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha (const 𝕜 E M a c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [linearPart_apply, taylorHom_const, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, ite_eq_right (by simp)]
  rfl

name: Manifold.linearPart_eq_zero_of_mem_sq
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s).order := by
    have := (taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s 2).mpr hs
    rwa [mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem, MvPowerSeries.ordElem_eq_order] at this
  ext i
  rw [linearPart_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
  apply MvPowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order
  rw [Finsupp.degree_single]
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast one_lt_two) h2

name: Manifold.mem_sq_of_linearPart_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_sq_of_linearPart_eq_zero {s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a}
    (hs : s ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
    (h : linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha s = 0) :
    s ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s 2,
    mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem, MvPowerSeries.ordElem_eq_order]
  apply MvPowerSeries.le_order
  intro d hd
  have hd' : Finsupp.degree d < 2 := by exact_mod_cast hd
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (Finsupp.degree d) 1 with h0 | h1
  · rw [Nat.lt_one_iff, Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    subst h0
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
      IsTaylorHom.constantCoeff' E ψ φ ha (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ)]
    exact (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E s).mp hs
  · have h1' : Finsupp.degree d = 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (Finsupp.degree_eq_one_iff d).mp h1'
    exact congrFun h i

name: Manifold.cotangentClassₗ_apply
statement:
theorem cotangentClassₗ_apply (a : M) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    cotangentClassₗ E a s = cotangentClass E a s
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.cotangentClass_eq_zero_iff_linearPart
statement:
theorem cotangentClass_eq_zero_iff_linearPart (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    cotangentClass E a s = 0 ↔ linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha s = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold cotangentClass
  rw [Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero]
  have hmem : s - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a s) ∈
      maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :=
    (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E _).mpr (by simp [map_sub])
  have hlp : linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha (s - const 𝕜 E M a (eval 𝕜 E M a s)) =
      linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha s := by
    rw [map_sub, linearPart_const, sub_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← hlp]
    exact linearPart_eq_zero_of_mem_sq E ψ φ hφ ha h
  · intro h
    exact mem_sq_of_linearPart_eq_zero E ψ φ hφ ha hmem (hlp.trans h)

name: Manifold.linearIndependent_cotangentClass_iff_linearPart
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_cotangentClass_iff_linearPart {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (s : ι → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    LinearIndependent 𝕜 (fun i => cotangentClass E a (s i)) ↔
      LinearIndependent 𝕜 (fun i => linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha (s i))
proof:
:= by
  let _i : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff, Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun g => imp_congr_left ?_
  have h1 : ∑ i, g i • cotangentClass E a (s i) = cotangentClass E a (∑ i, g i • s i) := by
    rw [← cotangentClassₗ_apply, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, cotangentClassₗ_apply]
  have h2 : ∑ i, g i • linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha (s i) = linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha (∑ i, g i • s i) := by
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact cotangentClass_eq_zero_iff_linearPart E ψ φ hφ ha _

name: ContinuousLinearMap.ext_of_symm_single
statement:
theorem _root_.ContinuousLinearMap.ext_of_symm_single {L L' : E →L[𝕜] 𝕜}
    (h : ∀ j, L (ψ.symm (Pi.single j 1)) = L' (ψ.symm (Pi.single j 1))) : L = L'
proof:
:= by
  have hpi : ((L.comp (ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E) : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] 𝕜) :
      (Fin n → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) = (L'.comp (ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E) : (Fin n → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) := by
    apply LinearMap.pi_ext
    intro j x
    have : Pi.single j x = x • Pi.single j (1 : 𝕜) := by
      rw [← Pi.single_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    simp [this, h j]
  have hpi' : L.comp (ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E) = L'.comp (ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective hpi
  have e1 : L = (L.comp (ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E)).comp (ψ : E →L[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜)) := by
    ext v
    simp
  have e2 : L' = (L'.comp (ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E)).comp (ψ : E →L[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜)) := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [e1, e2, hpi']

name: Manifold.evalBasis_apply
statement:
theorem evalBasis_apply (L : E →L[𝕜] 𝕜) (j : Fin n) :
    evalBasis E ψ L j = L (ψ.symm (Pi.single j 1))
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.ker_evalBasis
statement: theorem ker_evalBasis : LinearMap.ker (evalBasis E ψ) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
  intro L L' h
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.ext_of_symm_single E ψ fun j => congrFun h j

name: Manifold.hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_linearIndependent_cotangentClass'
statement:
theorem hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_linearIndependent_cotangentClass' {U : Opens M}
    {a : M} (ha : a ∈ U) {c : ℕ} (z : Fin c → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    HasIndependentDifferentialsAt E (fun i => extendSection 𝕜 E (z i)) a ↔
      LinearIndependent 𝕜 fun i =>
        cotangentClass E a ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a ha (z i))
proof:
:= by
  set χ := chartAt E a with hχdef
  have hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a
  have haχ : a ∈ χ.source := mem_chart_source E a
  set ψ := IdealSheaf.modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)
  rw [linearIndependent_cotangentClass_iff_linearPart E ψ χ hχ haχ,
    linearIndependent_fderiv_chart_iff' hχ haχ]
  have hlp : ∀ i, linearPart E ψ χ hχ haχ ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a ha (z i)) =
      evalBasis E ψ (fderiv 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E (z i) ∘ χ.symm) (χ a)) := fun i => by
    ext j
    rw [linearPart_apply, ← eval_coordDerivStalk, eval_coordDerivStalk_germ, evalBasis_apply]
  simp_rw [hlp]
  exact (LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff (evalBasis E ψ) (ker_evalBasis E ψ)).symm

name: Manifold.exists_smoothDivisor_of_ordElem_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_smoothDivisor_of_ordElem_eq_one (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    {V : Opens M} {x : M} (hxV : x ∈ V) (g : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V))
    (hg : g ∈ J.carrier V)
    (hord : ordElem ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V x hxV g) = 1) :
    ∃ (U : Opens M) (_ : x ∈ U) (h : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)),
      h ∈ J.carrier U ∧
        IsClosedSubmanifoldOn ψ (U : Set M) ((U : Set M) ∩ {y | extendSection 𝕜 E h y = 0}) 1 ∧
          ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), extendSection 𝕜 E h y = 0 →
            ordElem ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U y hy h) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, σ, he, hxe, hsub, -, hcoord, -, hclosed⟩ :=
    exists_adapted_chart_of_ord_eq_one' E ψ hxV g hord
  let U : Opens M := ⟨e.source, e.open_source⟩
  have hUV : U ≤ V := hsub
  have hxU : x ∈ U := hxe
  let h : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U) :=
    (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op g
  have hext : ∀ y ∈ U, extendSection 𝕜 E h y = extendSection 𝕜 E g y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E h hy, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E g (hUV hy)]
    rfl
  refine ⟨U, hxU, h, J.res_mem _ g hg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hset : (U : Set M) ∩ {y | extendSection 𝕜 E h y = 0} =
        e.source ∩ {y | extendSection 𝕜 E g y = 0} := by
      ext y
      refine and_congr_right fun hy => ⟨fun hy0 => ?_, fun hy0 => ?_⟩
      · change extendSection 𝕜 E g y = 0
        rw [← hext y hy]
        exact hy0
      · change extendSection 𝕜 E h y = 0
        rw [hext y hy]
        exact hy0
    rw [hset]
    exact hclosed
  · intro y hy hy0
    have hgerm : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U y hy h = coord E ψ e he hy (σ 0) := by
      rw [← germ_coordSection E ψ e he U (fun _ hz => hz) hy hy (σ 0)]
      change (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U y hy
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op g) = _
      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
      refine TopCat.Presheaf.germ_ext (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf U hy
        (homOfLE hUV : U ⟶ V) (homOfLE (le_refl U) : U ⟶ U) ?_
      refine Subtype.ext (funext fun z => ?_)
      change g (Set.inclusion hUV z) = ψ (e z) (σ 0)
      rw [← extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E g (hUV z.2)]
      exact hcoord z z.2
    rw [hgerm, ord_eq_one_iff_exists_coordDerivStalk_ne_zero' E ψ e he hy]
    refine ⟨?_, σ 0, ?_⟩
    · rw [eval_coord, ← hcoord y hy, ← hext y hy]
      exact hy0
    · rw [coordDerivStalk_coord_eq_ite he hy, ite_eq_left rfl, map_one]
      exact one_ne_zero

name: Manifold.ord_iteratedDeriv_eq_one
statement:
theorem ord_iteratedDeriv_eq_one {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {x : M} (hx : I.ord x = m) :
    (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).ord x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : chartAt E x ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x
  have hdim : ((Module.finrank 𝕜 E : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ringKrullDim ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) := (ringKrullDim_stalk E x).symm
  obtain ⟨c, -, -, hk, hs⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk E (IdealSheaf.modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E))
    (chartAt E x) hφ (mem_chart_source E x) hdim
  rw [IdealSheaf.ord, I.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs,
    c.ord_Dpow_of_ord_eq hx (Nat.sub_le m 1), Nat.sub_sub_self hm, Nat.cast_one]

name: Manifold.exists_mem_carrier_iteratedDeriv_ordElem_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_mem_carrier_iteratedDeriv_ordElem_eq_one {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {x : M}
    (hx : I.ord x = m) :
    ∃ (U : Opens M) (hxU : x ∈ U) (h : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)),
      h ∈ (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).carrier U ∧
        ordElem ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U x hxU h) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := ord_iteratedDeriv_eq_one I hm hx
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, k, f, hf, hspan⟩ := (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).exists_generators x
  have hne : (Set.range fun i => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U x hxU (f i)).Nonempty := by
    rw [Set.range_nonempty_iff_nonempty]
    by_contra hk
    have hbot : (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).stalkIdeal x = ⊥ := by
      rw [hspan x hxU, Set.range_eq_empty_iff.mpr (not_nonempty_iff.mp hk), Ideal.span_empty]
    have := (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).ord_eq_top_of_stalkIdeal_eq_bot hbot
    rw [h1] at this
    exact ENat.one_ne_top this
  obtain ⟨g, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hg⟩ := exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem (Set.finite_range _) hne
  refine ⟨U, hxU, f i, hf i, ?_⟩
  rw [← hg, ← hspan x hxU]
  exact h1

name: Manifold.exists_maximalContactHypersurface_nhd
statement:
theorem exists_maximalContactHypersurface_nhd {m : ℕ} (hI : ∀ y, I.ord y ≤ m) (x : M) :
    ∃ (U : Opens M) (_ : x ∈ U) (h : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)),
      h ∈ (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).carrier U ∧
        IsClosedSubmanifoldOn ψ (U : Set M) ((U : Set M) ∩ {y | extendSection 𝕜 E h y = 0}) 1 ∧
          ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), extendSection 𝕜 E h y = 0 →
            ordElem ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U y hy h) = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).support
  · have hm : 1 ≤ m := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hpos
      · exfalso
        rw [Nat.zero_sub, IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_zero] at hx
        exact (IdealSheaf.ord_eq_zero_iff (J := I)).mp
          (nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp (by simpa using hI x)) hx
      · exact hpos
    have hxm : I.ord x = m := by
      refine le_antisymm (hI x) ?_
      rw [IdealSheaf.support_iteratedDeriv I hm] at hx
      exact hx
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, g, hg, hord⟩ := exists_mem_carrier_iteratedDeriv_ordElem_eq_one I hm hxm
    exact exists_smoothDivisor_of_ordElem_eq_one ψ _ hxV g hg hord
  · refine ⟨⟨_, (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).isOpen_compl_support⟩, hx, 1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [IdealSheaf.mem_carrier_iff]
      intro y hy
      have htop : (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).stalkIdeal y = ⊤ := not_not.mp hy
      rw [htop]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    · have hempty : ((⟨_, (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).isOpen_compl_support⟩ : Opens M) : Set M) ∩
          {y | extendSection 𝕜 E (1 : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj
            (op ⟨_, (I.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).isOpen_compl_support⟩)) y = 0} = ∅ := by
        refine Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr fun y ⟨hy, h0⟩ => ?_
        change extendSection 𝕜 E _ y = 0 at h0
        rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy] at h0
        exact one_ne_zero h0
      rw [hempty]
      exact ⟨by rw [Set.preimage_empty]; exact isClosed_empty,
        fun a ha => absurd ha.1 (Set.notMem_empty a)⟩
    · intro y hy h0
      exfalso
      rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy] at h0
      exact one_ne_zero h0

name: Manifold.chartAt_rechartedSpace
statement:
theorem chartAt_rechartedSpace (e : M' ≃ₜ M) (c : M → OpenPartialHomeomorph M H)

      e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c (e p))

:=

statement:
theorem extChartAt_rechartedSpace (e : M' ≃ₜ M) (c : M → OpenPartialHomeomorph M H)
    (hc : ∀ x, x ∈ (c x).source) (p q : M') :
    letI

:= rechartedSpace e c hc
    extChartAt I p q = I (c (e p) (e q)) :=

name: Manifold.trans_symm_trans_trans_toOpenPartialHomeomorph
statement:
theorem trans_symm_trans_trans_toOpenPartialHomeomorph (e : M' ≃ₜ M)
    (c : M → OpenPartialHomeomorph M H) (x y : M) :
    (e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c x)).symm.trans (e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c y)) =
      (c x).symm.trans (c y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_symm_eq_symm_trans_symm, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_assoc,
    ← OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_assoc e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.symm,
    ← Homeomorph.symm_toOpenPartialHomeomorph, ← Homeomorph.trans_toOpenPartialHomeomorph,
    Homeomorph.symm_trans_self, Homeomorph.refl_toOpenPartialHomeomorph,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_trans]

name: Manifold.contDiffWithinAt_of_eqOn_target
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : φ.extend I w ∈ (φ.extend I).target :=
    (φ.extend I).map_source (by rwa [OpenPartialHomeomorph.extend_source])
  refine contDiffWithinAt_id.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ (hg hmem)
  filter_upwards [φ.extend_target_mem_nhdsWithin (I := I) hw] with v hv
  exact hg hv

name: Manifold.isManifold_rechartedSpace
statement:
theorem isManifold_rechartedSpace [IsManifold I n M] (e : M' ≃ₜ M)
    (c : M → OpenPartialHomeomorph M H) (hc : ∀ x, x ∈ (c x).source)
    (hcm : ∀ x, c x ∈ maximalAtlas I n M) :
    @IsManifold 𝕜 _ E _ _ H _ I n M' _ (rechartedSpace e c hc)
proof:
:= by
  let := rechartedSpace e c hc
  refine { compatible := ?_ }
  rintro _ _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  dsimp only
  rw [trans_symm_trans_trans_toOpenPartialHomeomorph]
  exact IsManifold.compatible_of_mem_maximalAtlas (hcm x) (hcm y)

name: Manifold.contMDiff_rechartedSpace
statement:
theorem contMDiff_rechartedSpace :
    letI
proof:
:= rechartedSpace e c hc
    ContMDiff I I n e := by
  let := rechartedSpace e c hc
  have := isManifold_rechartedSpace e c hc hcm
  intro p
  have hmem : e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c (e p)) ∈ maximalAtlas I n M' :=
    IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas p
  have hsrc : p ∈ (e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c (e p))).source :=
    mem_chart_source H p
  rw [contMDiffAt_iff_of_mem_maximalAtlas hmem (hcm (e p)) hsrc (hc (e p))]
  refine ⟨e.continuous.continuousAt, ?_⟩
  have h := contDiffWithinAt_of_eqOn_target (I := I) (n := n) (g := ((c (e p)).extend I ∘ e ∘
    ((e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c (e p))).extend I).symm)) (c (e p)) (hc (e p))
    (fun v hv => ?_)
  · simpa [OpenPartialHomeomorph.extend] using h
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.extend_target] at hv
  simp only [OpenPartialHomeomorph.extend, PartialEquiv.coe_trans, PartialEquiv.coe_trans_symm,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_toPartialEquiv, OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_toPartialEquiv_symm,
    ModelWithCorners.toPartialEquiv_coe, ModelWithCorners.toPartialEquiv_coe_symm,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans_symm, Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_symm_apply,
    Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply, id]
  rw [(c (e p)).right_inv hv.1, I.right_inv hv.2]

name: Manifold.contMDiff_symm_rechartedSpace
statement:
theorem contMDiff_symm_rechartedSpace :
    letI
proof:
:= rechartedSpace e c hc
    ContMDiff I I n e.symm := by
  let := rechartedSpace e c hc
  have := isManifold_rechartedSpace e c hc hcm
  intro x
  have hmem : e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c x) ∈ maximalAtlas I n M' :=
    IsManifold.subset_maximalAtlas ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hsrc : e.symm x ∈ (e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c x)).source := by
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source]
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, by simpa using hc x⟩
  rw [contMDiffAt_iff_of_mem_maximalAtlas (hcm x) hmem (hc x) hsrc]
  refine ⟨e.symm.continuous.continuousAt, ?_⟩
  have h := contDiffWithinAt_of_eqOn_target (I := I) (n := n)
    (g := ((e.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans (c x)).extend I ∘ e.symm ∘ ((c x).extend I).symm))
    (c x) (hc x) (fun v hv => ?_)
  · exact h
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.extend_target] at hv
  simp only [OpenPartialHomeomorph.extend, PartialEquiv.coe_trans, PartialEquiv.coe_trans_symm,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_toPartialEquiv, OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_toPartialEquiv_symm,
    ModelWithCorners.toPartialEquiv_coe, ModelWithCorners.toPartialEquiv_coe_symm,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans, Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply,
    Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply, id]
  rw [(c x).right_inv hv.1, I.right_inv hv.2]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem stalkIdeal_zero (x : X) : (0 : IdealSheaf 𝒪).stalkIdeal x = ⊥
proof: := stalkIdeal_bot x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one
statement: @[simp] theorem stalkIdeal_one (x : X) : (1 : IdealSheaf 𝒪).stalkIdeal x = ⊤
proof: := stalkIdeal_top x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_sum
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι) (G : ι → IdealSheaf 𝒪) (x : X) :
    (∑ i ∈ F, G i).stalkIdeal x = ∑ i ∈ F, (G i).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a F ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, stalkIdeal_add, ih]; rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stalkIdeal_finset_prod {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι) (G : ι → IdealSheaf 𝒪) (x : X) :
    (∏ i ∈ F, G i).stalkIdeal x = ∏ i ∈ F, (G i).stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a F ha ih => rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, stalkIdeal_mul, ih]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.hasLocalGenerators_stalkIdeal
statement: theorem hasLocalGenerators_stalkIdeal (J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) : HasLocalGenerators J.stalkIdeal
proof:
:=
  fun a => by
    obtain ⟨U, ha, k, f, -, hf⟩ := J.exists_generators a
    exact ⟨U, ha, Fin k, inferInstance, f, hf⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.germ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem germ_eq_zero_iff {U : Opens M} {a : M} (ha : a ∈ U)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a ha f = 0 ↔ extendSection 𝕜 E f =ᶠ[𝓝 a] 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a).eq_iff, map_zero, stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ]
  exact Germ.coe_eq

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isOpen_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot
statement: theorem isOpen_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot : IsOpen {a : M | J.stalkIdeal a = ⊥}
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨U, haU, k, f, -, hgen⟩ := J.exists_generators a
  have h0 : ∀ i, extendSection 𝕜 E (f i) =ᶠ[𝓝 a] 0 := fun i =>
    (germ_eq_zero_iff haU (f i)).mp (by
      rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← (show J.stalkIdeal a = ⊥ from ha), hgen a haU]
      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hVo, haV⟩ :=
    eventually_nhds_iff.mp ((eventually_all.mpr h0).and (U.2.mem_nhds haU))
  refine ⟨V, fun b hb => ?_, hVo, haV⟩
  have hbU : b ∈ U := (hV b hb).2
  rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hgen b hbU, eq_bot_iff, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_bot, germ_eq_zero_iff hbU]
  filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds hb] with x hx
  exact (hV x hx).1 i

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isClosed_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot
statement: theorem isClosed_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot : IsClosed {a : M | J.stalkIdeal a = ⊥}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs0⟩ : ∃ s ∈ J.stalkIdeal b, s ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_not] at h
    exact hb (eq_bot_iff.mpr fun s hs => Ideal.mem_bot.mpr (h s hs))
  obtain ⟨V, hbV, g, hg, rfl⟩ := J.mem_stalkIdeal_iff.mp hs
  set φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E := chartAt E b with hφdef
  have hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas b
  have hbφ : b ∈ φ.source := mem_chart_source E b
  set h : E → 𝕜 := extendSection 𝕜 E g ∘ φ.symm with hhdef
  let W : Opens M := V ⊓ ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source⟩
  have hbW : b ∈ W := Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hbV, hbφ⟩
  have hWφ : (W : Set M) ⊆ φ.source := fun x hx => (Opens.mem_inf.mp hx).2
  have hSo : IsOpen (φ '' W) := (φ.isOpen_image_iff_of_subset_source hWφ).mpr W.2
  
  have hSan : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 h (φ '' W) := by
    rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hcV, hcφ⟩ := Opens.mem_inf.mp hc
    have h1 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (extendSection 𝕜 E g) c :=
      (contMDiffOn_extendSection g).contMDiffAt (V.2.mem_nhds hcV)
    have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω h (φ c) :=
      ContMDiffAt.comp_of_eq h1 (contMDiffAt_chart_symm E φ hcφ hφ) (φ.left_inv hcφ)
    exact (contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mp h2).analyticAt
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hSo (φ b) ⟨b, hbW, rfl⟩
  have hpre : IsPreconnected (Metric.ball (φ b) r) := by
    let _i : NormedSpace ℝ E := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ 𝕜 E
    exact Metric.isPreconnected_ball
  refine ⟨(W : Set M) ∩ (φ.source ∩ φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (φ b) r), fun c hc => ?_,
    W.2.inter (φ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage φ.open_source Metric.isOpen_ball),
    ⟨hbW, hbφ, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨hcW, -, hcb⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨hcV, hcφ⟩ := Opens.mem_inf.mp hcW
  
  intro hc0
  apply hs0
  have hgc : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V c hcV g = 0 := by
    rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← hc0]
    exact J.germ_mem_stalkIdeal hcV hg
  have h0c : h =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ c)] 0 := (φ.tendsto_symm hcφ).eventually ((germ_eq_zero_iff hcV g).mp hgc)
  have hzero : Set.EqOn h 0 (Metric.ball (φ b) r) :=
    (hSan.mono hball).eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hpre hcb h0c
  rw [germ_eq_zero_iff hbV g]
  filter_upwards [φ.open_source.mem_nhds hbφ,
    (φ.continuousAt hbφ).preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))]
    with x hxφ hxb
  have : extendSection 𝕜 E g x = h (φ x) := by
    simp only [hhdef, Function.comp_apply, φ.left_inv hxφ]
  rw [this, hzero hxb]
  rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isClopen_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot
statement: theorem isClopen_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot : IsClopen {a : M | J.stalkIdeal a = ⊥}
proof:
:=
  ⟨J.isClosed_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot, J.isOpen_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.eq_bot_of_isPreconnected
statement:
theorem eq_bot_of_isPreconnected [PreconnectedSpace M] {a : M} (h : J.stalkIdeal a = ⊥) :
    J = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have huniv : {x : M | J.stalkIdeal x = ⊥} = Set.univ :=
    J.isClopen_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot.eq_univ ⟨a, h⟩
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [stalkIdeal_bot]
  exact Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mp huniv x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isNonzeroEverywhere_iff_exists
statement:
theorem isNonzeroEverywhere_iff_exists [ConnectedSpace M] :
    J.IsNonzeroEverywhere ↔ ∃ a, J.stalkIdeal a ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty M)
    exact ⟨a, h a⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩ x hx
    exact ha (by rw [J.eq_bot_of_isPreconnected hx, stalkIdeal_bot])

name: Manifold.germMap_algebraMap
statement:
theorem germMap_algebraMap (b : M') (a : 𝕜) :
    germMap f hf b (algebraMap 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (f b)) a) =
      algebraMap 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk b) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraMap_stalk_eq, algebraMap_stalk_eq]
  apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M' b
  rw [stalkToGerm_germMap, stalkToGerm_const, stalkToGerm_const, Filter.Germ.coe_compTendsto]
  rfl

name: Manifold.germMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : germMap f hf b s ∈ Ideal.map (germMap f hf b)
      (maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (f b)) ^ k) :=
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hs
  rw [Ideal.map_pow] at h1
  exact Ideal.pow_right_mono (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le _) k h1

name: Manifold.derivation_germMap_eq_sum_coordDerivStalk
statement:
theorem derivation_germMap_eq_sum_coordDerivStalk (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E)
    (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M) {b : M'} (hb : f b ∈ φ.source)
    (δ : Derivation 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk b)
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk b))
    (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (f b)) :
    δ (germMap f hf b s) =
      ∑ k, δ (germMap f hf b (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ hb k)) *
        germMap f hf b (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hb k s)
proof:
:= by
  set ρ := germMap f hf b with hρ
  set c : Fin n → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk b :=
    fun k => δ (ρ (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ hb k)) with hc
  set F : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (f b) → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk b :=
    fun t => δ (ρ t) - ∑ k, c k * ρ (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hb k t) with hF
  have hFadd : ∀ t u, F (t + u) = F t + F u := by
    intro t u
    simp only [hF, map_add, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    ring
  have hFmul : ∀ t u, F (t * u) = ρ t * F u + ρ u * F t := by
    intro t u
    simp only [hF, map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, map_add]
    have e1 : ∑ k, c k * (ρ t * ρ (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hb k u) +
        ρ u * ρ (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hb k t)) =
        ρ t * ∑ k, c k * ρ (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hb k u) +
          ρ u * ∑ k, c k * ρ (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hb k t) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
    rw [e1]
    ring
  have hFx : ∀ j, F (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ hb j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    simp only [hF, coordDerivStalk_centredCoord, apply_ite ρ, map_one, map_zero, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, hc, sub_self]
  have hFalg : ∀ a : 𝕜, F (algebraMap 𝕜 _ a) = 0 := by
    intro a
    simp only [hF, hρ, germMap_algebraMap, Derivation.map_algebraMap, map_zero, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero]
  have hFpoly : ∀ p ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝕜 (Set.range (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ hb)), F p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    induction hp using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem p hp =>
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hp
      exact hFx j
    | algebraMap r => exact hFalg r
    | add p q _ _ hp hq => rw [hFadd, hp, hq, add_zero]
    | mul p q _ _ hp hq => rw [hFmul, hp, hq, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hFpow : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (f b)),
      t ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (f b)) ^ (k + 1) →
        F t ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk b) ^ k := by
    intro k t ht
    refine Ideal.sub_mem _ ?_ (Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_)
    · exact Derivation.mem_pow_of_mem_pow_succ _ δ k (germMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow f hf ht)
    · exact germMap_mem_maximalIdeal_pow f hf
        (Derivation.mem_pow_of_mem_pow_succ _ (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hb j) k ht)
  have hFs : F s = 0 := by
    refine eq_zero_of_forall_mem_maximalIdeal_pow E ψ (chartAt E b)
      (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas b) (mem_chart_source E b) (F s) fun k => ?_
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hsp⟩ := exists_mem_adjoin_sub_mem_maximalIdeal_pow E ψ φ hφ hb (k + 1) s
    have h2 : F s = F p + F (s - p) := by rw [← hFadd, add_sub_cancel]
    rw [h2, hFpoly p hp, zero_add]
    exact hFpow k _ hsp
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hFs

name: Manifold.Germ.vanishesOn_coe
statement:
theorem Germ.vanishesOn_coe (Z : Set M) (x : M) (f : M → 𝕜) :
    Germ.VanishesOn Z x (f : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜) ↔ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[Z] x, f y = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.Germ.vanishesOn_compTendsto_of_isEmbedding
statement:
theorem Germ.vanishesOn_compTendsto_of_isEmbedding {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {h : M → Y}
    (hh : Topology.IsEmbedding h) (hs : Function.Surjective h) (Z : Set Y) (x : M)
    (k : (𝓝 (h x)).Germ 𝕜) :
    Germ.VanishesOn (h ⁻¹' Z) x (k.compTendsto h (hh.continuous.tendsto x)) ↔
      Germ.VanishesOn Z (h x) k
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Germ.inductionOn with
  | h f =>
    rw [Germ.coe_compTendsto, Germ.vanishesOn_coe, Germ.vanishesOn_coe]
    have hmap : Filter.map h (𝓝[h ⁻¹' Z] x) = 𝓝[Z] (h x) := by
      rw [hh.map_nhdsWithin_eq, Set.image_preimage_eq Z hs]
    rw [← hmap, Filter.eventually_map]
    exact Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.mem_vanishingGermIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_vanishingGermIdeal_iff (Z : Set M) (x : M) (g : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜) :
    g ∈ vanishingGermIdeal Z x ↔ Germ.VanishesOn Z x g
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.vanishingGermIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_closure
statement:
theorem vanishingGermIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_closure {Z : Set M} {x : M} (hx : x ∉ closure Z) :
    vanishingGermIdeal (𝕜 := 𝕜) Z x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : 𝓝[Z] x = ⊥ := by
    by_contra h
    exact hx (mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mpr ⟨h⟩)
  refine (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr ?_
  change Germ.VanishesOn Z x ((1 : M → 𝕜) : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜)
  rw [Germ.vanishesOn_coe, hbot]
  exact Filter.eventually_bot

name: Manifold.vanishingGermIdeal_ne_top_of_mem_closure
statement:
theorem vanishingGermIdeal_ne_top_of_mem_closure {Z : Set M} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ closure Z) :
    vanishingGermIdeal (𝕜 := 𝕜) Z x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : Germ.VanishesOn Z x ((1 : M → 𝕜) : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜) :=
    (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mp h
  rw [Germ.vanishesOn_coe] at h1
  have : NeBot (𝓝[Z] x) := mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mp hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h1.exists
  exact one_ne_zero hy

name: Manifold.mem_vanishingStalk_iff
statement:
theorem mem_vanishingStalk_iff (Z : Set M) (x : M) (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :
    s ∈ vanishingStalk Z x ↔ Germ.VanishesOn Z x (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x s)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.vanishingStalk_eq_top_of_notMem_closure
statement:
theorem vanishingStalk_eq_top_of_notMem_closure {Z : Set M} {x : M} (hx : x ∉ closure Z) :
    vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) Z x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [vanishingStalk, vanishingGermIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_closure hx, Ideal.comap_top]

name: Manifold.vanishingStalk_ne_top_of_mem_closure
statement:
theorem vanishingStalk_ne_top_of_mem_closure {Z : Set M} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ closure Z) :
    vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) Z x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply vanishingGermIdeal_ne_top_of_mem_closure (𝕜 := 𝕜) hx
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  have h1 : (1 : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) ∈ vanishingStalk Z x := by
    rw [h]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  simpa [vanishingStalk, Ideal.mem_comap, map_one] using h1

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.le_logDeriv
statement: theorem le_logDeriv (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) : J ≤ IdealSheaf.logDeriv E ψ hS J
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv]
  exact Ideal.le_logDerivative (k := 𝕜) _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDeriv_mono
statement:
theorem logDeriv_mono {J K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)} (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    IdealSheaf.logDeriv E ψ hS J ≤ IdealSheaf.logDeriv E ψ hS K
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv]
  exact Ideal.logDerivative_mono (k := 𝕜) (IdealSheaf.le_def.mp hJK a)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_mono
statement:
theorem logDerivIter_mono (r : ℕ) {J K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)} (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS r J ≤ IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS r K
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simpa using hJK
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ, IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ]
    exact logDeriv_mono E ψ hS ih

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_logDerivIter
statement:
theorem logDerivIter_logDerivIter (a b : ℕ) (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS a (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS b J) =
      IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (a + b) J
proof:
:=
  (Function.iterate_add_apply _ a b J).symm

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter_of_notMem
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rw [IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_zero, IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_zero]
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv,
      hS.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem ha, Ideal.logDerivative_top, ih,
      IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_succ, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_deriv]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDeriv_le_deriv
statement:
theorem logDeriv_le_deriv (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.logDeriv E ψ hS J ≤ J.deriv
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_deriv]
  exact Ideal.logDerivative_le_derivative (k := 𝕜) _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ_le_logDerivIter_deriv
statement:
theorem logDerivIter_succ_le_logDerivIter_deriv (k : ℕ)
    (X : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (k + 1) X ≤ IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS k X.deriv
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ']
  exact logDerivIter_mono E ψ hS k (logDeriv_le_deriv E ψ hS X)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_iteratedDeriv_le
statement:
theorem logDerivIter_iteratedDeriv_le {s j : ℕ} (hj : j < s)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (s - j) (J.iteratedDeriv j) ≤
      IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (s - (j + 1)) (J.iteratedDeriv (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hsj : s - j = (s - (j + 1)) + 1 := by omega
  have e1 : IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (s - j) (J.iteratedDeriv j) =
      IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS ((s - (j + 1)) + 1) (J.iteratedDeriv j) := by rw [hsj]
  have e2 : IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (s - (j + 1)) (J.iteratedDeriv (j + 1)) =
      IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (s - (j + 1)) (J.iteratedDeriv j).deriv := by
    rw [IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_succ]
  rw [e1, e2]
  exact logDerivIter_succ_le_logDerivIter_deriv E ψ hS _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_le_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem logDerivIter_le_iteratedDeriv (r : ℕ) (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS r J ≤ J.iteratedDeriv r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rw [IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_zero, IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_zero]
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ, IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_succ]
    exact (logDeriv_le_deriv E ψ hS _).trans (IdealSheaf.deriv_mono ih)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter_eq_Dlogpow
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_logDerivIter_eq_Dlogpow {a : M}
    (κ : IsLocalRing.RegularCoords ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) n)
    (hk : κ.IsLinearOver 𝕜) (hs : κ.SpansDerivations 𝕜) (h : Fin n)
    (hSa : hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a = Ideal.span {κ.x h}) (r : ℕ)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS r J).stalkIdeal a = κ.Dlogpow h r (J.stalkIdeal a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv, hSa, ih,
      κ.logDerivative_eq_Dlog hk hs h, IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_succ]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_iSup_Dlogpow
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_iSup_Dlogpow {a : M}
    (κ : IsLocalRing.RegularCoords ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) n)
    (hk : κ.IsLinearOver 𝕜) (hs : κ.SpansDerivations 𝕜) (h : Fin n) (s : ℕ)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    (J.iteratedDeriv s).stalkIdeal a =
      ⨆ j ≤ s, κ.Dlogpow h (s - j) (κ.iterPderivIdeal h j (J.stalkIdeal a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [J.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow κ hk hs s, ← κ.Dlogpow_Dpow_eq_iSup h le_rfl,
    Nat.sub_self, IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_zero]

name: Manifold.coordDerivStalk_mem_span
statement:
theorem coordDerivStalk_mem_span
    (δ : Derivation 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :
    δ ∈ Submodule.span ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
      (Set.range (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha))
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : δ = ∑ i, δ (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha i) • coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i := by
    ext s
    rw [derivation_sum_apply]
    simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact derivation_eq_sum_coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha δ s
  rw [hδ]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: Manifold.derivative_eq_sup_iSup_span_image_coordDerivStalk
statement:
theorem derivative_eq_sup_iSup_span_image_coordDerivStalk
    (I : Ideal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :
    Ideal.derivative 𝕜 I =
      I ⊔ ⨆ i, Ideal.span (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i '' (I : Set _))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.span_eq I]
  rw [Ideal.derivative_span_eq_of_span _ (coordDerivStalk_mem_span ψ φ hφ ha), Ideal.span_union,
    Ideal.span_iUnion, Ideal.span_eq]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.derivative_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem derivative_stalkIdeal_eq_span {U : Opens M} {k : ℕ}
    (f : Fin k → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hf : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ U), J.stalkIdeal b =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U b hb (f j)))
    {V : Opens M} (hVU : V ≤ U) (hV : (V : Set M) ⊆ φ.source) {b : M} (hb : b ∈ V) :
    Ideal.derivative 𝕜 (J.stalkIdeal b) = Ideal.span
      ((Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
          ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))) ∪
        ⋃ i, Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
          (coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i
            ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))))
proof:
:= by
  have hbφ : b ∈ φ.source := hV hb
  rw [hf b (hVU hb), ← range_germ_map (homOfLE hVU) hb f,
    Ideal.derivative_span_eq_of_span _ (coordDerivStalk_mem_span ψ φ hφ hbφ)]
  refine congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg (_ ∪ ·) (congrArg Set.iUnion (funext fun i => ?_)))
  rw [← Set.range_comp]
  refine congrArg Set.range (funext fun j => ?_)
  exact coordDerivStalk_germ E ψ φ hφ hbφ V hV hb i _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.hasLocalGenerators_derivative_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_derivative_stalkIdeal :
    HasLocalGenerators fun a => Ideal.derivative 𝕜 (J.stalkIdeal a)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨U, haU, k, f, -, hf⟩ := J.exists_generators a
  have hφ : chartAt E a ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a
  let V : Opens M := U ⊓ ⟨(chartAt E a).source, (chartAt E a).open_source⟩
  have hV : (V : Set M) ⊆ (chartAt E a).source := fun x hx => hx.2
  have hVU : V ≤ U := inf_le_left
  refine ⟨V, Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨haU, mem_chart_source E a⟩,
    Fin k ⊕ Fin (Module.finrank 𝕜 E) × Fin k, inferInstance,
    Sum.elim (fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))
      (fun p => coordDeriv E (modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)) (chartAt E a) hφ V hV p.1
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f p.2))), fun b hb => ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  rw [J.derivative_stalkIdeal_eq_span (modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)) (chartAt E a) hφ f hf hVU
    hV hb]
  congr 1
  ext s
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Prod.exists, Sum.exists, Sum.elim_inl,
    Sum.elim_inr]

name: Manifold.embedComplL_apply

name: Manifold.embedCompl_single
statement:
theorem embedCompl_single (j : Fin (n - c)) :
    embedCompl σ (Pi.single j (1 : 𝕜)) = Pi.single ((complEquiv σ).symm j).1 1
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases h : i ∈ Set.range σ
  · rw [embedCompl, dite_eq_left h, Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
    rintro rfl
    exact ((complEquiv σ).symm j).2 h
  · rw [embedCompl, dite_eq_right h]
    by_cases hk : complEquiv σ ⟨i, h⟩ = j
    · have hi : i = ((complEquiv σ).symm j).1 := by rw [← hk, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_left hk, Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_left hi]
    · have hi : i ≠ ((complEquiv σ).symm j).1 := fun hi =>
        hk ((Equiv.eq_symm_apply (complEquiv σ)).mp (Subtype.ext hi))
      rw [Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_right hk, Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_right hi]

name: Manifold.comapSection_coordDeriv_inclusionMap
statement:
theorem comapSection_coordDeriv_inclusionMap (V : Opens M)
    (hV : (V : Set M) ⊆ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).source)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) (j : Fin (n - 1)) :
    comapSection ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff
        (coordDeriv E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) (hS.isAdaptedChart_adaptedChartAt
          (hS.subOf p)).1 V hV
          (complIdx hS p j) f) =
      coordDeriv (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 _) (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p)
        (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas p)
        (preimageOpens ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff V) (fun _ hq => hV hq) j
        (comapSection ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff f)
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ S (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p)) :=
    hS.isAdaptedChart_adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun q => ?_)
  have hqV : hS.inclusionMap q ∈ V := q.2
  have hqφ : hS.inclusionMap q ∈ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).source := hV hqV
  
  have e1 : comapSection ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff
      (coordDeriv E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) hφ.1 V hV (complIdx hS p j) f) q =
      coordDeriv E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) hφ.1 V hV (complIdx hS p j) f
        ⟨hS.inclusionMap q, hqV⟩ :=
    comapSection_apply _ _ _ q
  rw [e1, coordDeriv_apply]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (coordDeriv_apply (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 _)
    (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p) (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas p)
    (preimageOpens ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff V) (fun _ hq => hV hq) j
    (comapSection ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff f) q).symm
  have hcoord : ∀ i, ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p) (hS.inclusionMap q)) (hS.adaptedIdx
    (hS.subOf p) i) = 0 :=
    (hφ.2 _ hqφ).mp (inclusionMap_mem hS q)
  
  set L : (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E :=
    (ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E).comp (embedComplL (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p))) with hL
  have hLapply : ∀ w, L w = ψ.symm (embedCompl (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p)) w) := fun w => rfl
  have hw₀ : chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p q =
      projCompl (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p)) (ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)
        (hS.inclusionMap q))) := rfl
  have hLw : L (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p q) = hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)
    (hS.inclusionMap q) := by
    rw [hLapply, hw₀, embedCompl_projCompl _ hcoord, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  
  have hev : (extendSection 𝕜 (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜)
      (comapSection ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff f) ∘
        (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p).symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p q)]
        (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).symm) ∘ L := by
    have hopen : IsOpen (L ⁻¹' ((hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).target ∩ (hS.adaptedChartAt
      (hS.subOf p)).symm ⁻¹' V)) :=
      ((hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).symm.isOpen_inter_preimage V.2).preimage L.continuous
    have hmem : chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p q ∈
        L ⁻¹' ((hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).target ∩ (hS.adaptedChartAt
          (hS.subOf p)).symm ⁻¹' V) := by
      rw [Set.mem_preimage, hLw]
      exact ⟨(hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).map_source hqφ,
        by rw [Set.mem_preimage, (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).left_inv hqφ]; exact q.2⟩
    filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmem] with w hw
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := hw
    rw [hLapply] at hw1 hw2
    have hsymm : hS.inclusionMap ((chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p).symm w) =
        (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).symm
          (ψ.symm (embedCompl (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p)) w)) :=
      hφ.coe_symmAux (hS.subOf p).2 hw1
    have hwV : hS.inclusionMap ((chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p).symm w) ∈ V := by
      rw [hsymm]; exact hw2
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hLapply]
    have hwV' : (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p).symm w ∈
        preimageOpens ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff V := hwV
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) _ hwV', comapSection_apply, ← hsymm]
    exact (extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E f hwV).symm
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (extendSection 𝕜 E f ∘ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).symm)
      (L (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p q)) := by
    rw [hLw]
    exact (analyticAt_extendSection_comp_symm E (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) hφ.1 V hV f
      ⟨_, q.2⟩).differentiableAt
  rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_comp _ hFd L.differentiableAt, L.fderiv,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hLw]
  congr 1
  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl_symm, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_refl', id_eq, hLapply,
    embedCompl_single]

name: Manifold.germMap_inclusionMap_coordDerivStalk
statement:
theorem germMap_inclusionMap_coordDerivStalk (j : Fin (n - 1))
    (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (hS.inclusionMap p)) :
    germMap ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff p
        (coordDerivStalk E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) (hS.isAdaptedChart_adaptedChartAt
          (hS.subOf p)).1
          (inclusionMap_mem_source_adaptedChartAt hS p) (complIdx hS p j) s) =
      coordDerivStalk (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 _)
        (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p) (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas p) (mem_chart_source _ p) j
        (germMap ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff p s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, f, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  let V : Opens M := U ⊓ ⟨(hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).source, (hS.adaptedChartAt
    (hS.subOf p)).open_source⟩
  have hV : (V : Set M) ⊆ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).source := fun y hy => hy.2
  have hxV : hS.inclusionMap p ∈ V := ⟨hxU, inclusionMap_mem_source_adaptedChartAt hS p⟩
  have hres : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U (hS.inclusionMap p) hxU f =
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V (hS.inclusionMap p) hxV
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ≤ U)).op f) :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _).symm
  rw [hres, coordDerivStalk_germ E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) _ _ V hV hxV,
    germMap_germ _ _ hxV, germMap_germ _ _ hxV,
    coordDerivStalk_germ (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 _)
      (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p) (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas p) (mem_chart_source _ p)
      (preimageOpens ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff V) (fun _ hq => hV hq)
      ((mem_preimageOpens _ _).mpr hxV) j,
    comapSection_coordDeriv_inclusionMap hS p V hV]

name: Manifold.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_inclusionMap
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_inclusionMap :
    hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal (hS.inclusionMap p) =
      Ideal.span
        {coord E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) (hS.isAdaptedChart_adaptedChartAt
          (hS.subOf p)).1
          (inclusionMap_mem_source_adaptedChartAt hS p) (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p) 0)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [hS.isIdealSheafOf_idealSheaf.2 _ _ (hS.isAdaptedChart_adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p))
    (hS.inclusionMap p)
    (inclusionMap_mem_source_adaptedChartAt hS p) (inclusionMap_mem hS p), Set.range_unique]
  rfl

name: Manifold.germMap_inclusionMap_coord_adaptedIdx
statement:
theorem germMap_inclusionMap_coord_adaptedIdx :
    germMap ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff p
      (coord E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) (hS.isAdaptedChart_adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).1
        (inclusionMap_mem_source_adaptedChartAt hS p) (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p) 0)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : coord E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) (hS.isAdaptedChart_adaptedChartAt
    (hS.subOf p)).1
      (inclusionMap_mem_source_adaptedChartAt hS p) (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p) 0) ∈
        hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal (hS.inclusionMap p) := by
    rw [stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_inclusionMap]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  have hker := hS.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_mem (a := hS.inclusionMap p) (inclusionMap_mem hS p)
  rw [hker] at hmem
  exact (hS.germMap_inclusionMap_eq_restrictStalk p _).trans (RingHom.mem_ker.mp hmem)

name: Manifold.map_germMap_logDerivative_eq_derivative
statement:
theorem map_germMap_logDerivative_eq_derivative
    (I : Ideal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (hS.inclusionMap p))) :
    Ideal.map (germMap ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff p)
        (Ideal.logDerivative 𝕜 (hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal (hS.inclusionMap p)) I) =
      Ideal.derivative 𝕜 (Ideal.map (germMap ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff p) I)
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ S (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p)) :=
    hS.isAdaptedChart_adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)
  have hx : hS.inclusionMap p ∈ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)).source :=
    inclusionMap_mem_source_adaptedChartAt hS p
  rw [stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_inclusionMap, ← Ideal.span_eq I,
    logDerivative_span_coord_eq E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) hφ.1 hx, Ideal.map_span,
      Ideal.map_span,
    Ideal.derivative_span_eq_of_span _ (coordDerivStalk_mem_span (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 _)
      (chartAt (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜) p) (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas p) (mem_chart_source _ p))]
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨t, ht | ht, rfl⟩
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)
    · obtain ⟨i, u, hu, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ht
      by_cases hi : i = hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p) 0
      · subst hi
        rw [logCoordDerivStalk_self, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul,
          germMap_inclusionMap_coord_adaptedIdx, zero_mul]
        exact Ideal.zero_mem _
      · have hi' : i ∉ Set.range (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p)) := fun ⟨k, hk⟩ =>
          hi (by rw [← hk, Subsingleton.elim k 0])
        have hij : complIdx hS p (complEquiv (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p)) ⟨i, hi'⟩) = i := by
          simp only [complIdx, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        rw [logCoordDerivStalk_of_ne E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) hφ.1 hx hi, ← hij,
          germMap_inclusionMap_coordDerivStalk hS p]
        exact Ideal.subset_span (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
          ⟨complEquiv (hS.adaptedIdx (hS.subOf p)) ⟨i, hi'⟩, ⟨_, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩⟩))
  · rintro _ (⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ | ht)
    · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨t, Or.inl ht, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨j, _, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp ht
      rw [← germMap_inclusionMap_coordDerivStalk hS p j u]
      refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨complIdx hS p j, ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩⟩), rfl⟩
      rw [logCoordDerivStalk_of_ne E ψ (hS.adaptedChartAt (hS.subOf p)) hφ.1 hx]
      intro h0
      exact complIdx_notMem_range hS p j ⟨0, h0.symm⟩

name: Manifold.logDerivIter_pullback_inclusionMap
statement:
theorem logDerivIter_pullback_inclusionMap (r : ℕ)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS r J).pullback ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff =
      (J.pullback ⇑hS.inclusionMap hS.inclusionMap.contMDiff).iteratedDeriv r
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun (p : hS.toAnalyticManifold) => ?_
  induction r with
  | zero => rw [IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_zero, IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_zero]
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv,
      map_germMap_logDerivative_eq_derivative hS p, IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_succ,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_deriv, ← ih, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.mem_support_iff_forall_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_support, Ne, J.stalkIdeal_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit ha (hgen a ha), not_exists]
  refine forall_congr' fun i => ?_
  have hu : IsUnit ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a ha (f i)) ↔
      eval 𝕜 E M a ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a ha (f i)) ≠ 0 :=
    contMDiffSheafCommRing.isUnit_stalk_iff 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M _
  have he : eval 𝕜 E M a ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a ha (f i)) = f i ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
    contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 U a ha (f i)
  rw [hu, not_not, he]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ordElem_eq_order_taylorHom
statement:
theorem ordElem_eq_order_taylorHom (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) :
    IsLocalRing.ordElem s = (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ s).order
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MvPowerSeries.ordElem_eq_order]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_ <;> rw [← ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le] <;> intro r hr <;>
    rw [← IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem] at hr ⊢
  · exact (taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s r).mpr hr
  · exact (taylorHom_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff E ψ φ ha hφ s r).mp hr

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ord_eq_iInf_order_taylorHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord, hgen a haU, IsLocalRing.ord_span, iInf_range]
  exact iInf_congr fun i => ordElem_eq_order_taylorHom ψ φ hφ ha _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.le_ord_iff_forall_coeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem le_ord_iff_forall_coeff_eq_zero {U : Opens M} (haU : a ∈ U) {k : ℕ}
    {f : Fin k → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)}
    (hgen : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ U), J.stalkIdeal b =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U b hb (f i))) (p : ℕ) :
    (p : ℕ∞) ≤ J.ord a ↔ ∀ i (ν : Fin n →₀ ℕ), ν.degree < p →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff ν (taylorHom E ψ φ ha hφ
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a haU (f i))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [J.ord_eq_iInf_order_taylorHom ψ φ hφ ha haU hgen, le_iInf_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun i => ⟨fun h ν hν => MvPowerSeries.coeff_of_lt_order
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hν) h), fun h => MvPowerSeries.nat_le_order h⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ord_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_top_iff (a : M) : J.ord a = ⊤ ↔ J.stalkIdeal a = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, J.ord_eq_top_of_stalkIdeal_eq_bot⟩
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro s hs
  have h1 : IsLocalRing.ordElem s = ⊤ := by
    refine top_le_iff.mp ?_
    rw [← h, ord, IsLocalRing.ord_eq_iInf]
    exact iInf₂_le s hs
  have hφ := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)) (n := ω) a
  rw [ordElem_eq_order_taylorHom (modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)) (chartAt E a) hφ
    (mem_chart_source E a),
    MvPowerSeries.order_eq_top_iff] at h1
  exact (IsTaylorHom.injective' E _ _ (mem_chart_source E a) (isTaylorHom_taylorHom E _ _ _ hφ))
    (h1.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isReduced_pullback_of_isLocalDiffeomorph
statement:
theorem isReduced_pullback_of_isLocalDiffeomorph {M N : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E}
    (φ : AnalyticMap N M) (hφ : IsLocalDiffeomorph 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω φ)
    {J : AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf M} (hJ : AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf.IsReduced J) :
    AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf.IsReduced (J.pullback ⇑φ φ.contMDiff)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  rw [stalkIdeal_pullback]
  obtain ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩ := germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt ⇑φ φ.contMDiff (hφ b)
  have hker : RingHom.ker (germMap ⇑φ φ.contMDiff b) ≤ J.stalkIdeal (φ b) := by
    rw [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hinj]
    exact bot_le
  rw [← Ideal.radical_eq_iff, ← Ideal.map_radical_of_surjective hsurj hker,
    Ideal.radical_eq_iff.mpr (hJ (φ b))]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.mem_stalkIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_stalkIdeal_iff {b : X} {s : 𝒪.presheaf.stalk b} :
    s ∈ J.stalkIdeal b ↔ ∃ (V : Opens X) (hb : b ∈ V) (g : 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op V)),
      g ∈ J.carrier V ∧ 𝒪.presheaf.germ V b hb g = s
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.germ_mem_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem germ_mem_stalkIdeal {U : Opens X} {b : X} (hb : b ∈ U) {f : 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)}
    (hf : f ∈ J.carrier U) : 𝒪.presheaf.germ U b hb f ∈ J.stalkIdeal b
proof:
:=
  ⟨U, hb, f, hf, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.mem_carrier_iff
statement:
theorem mem_carrier_iff {U : Opens X} {f : 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)} :
    f ∈ J.carrier U ↔ ∀ x (hx : x ∈ U), 𝒪.presheaf.germ U x hx f ∈ J.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf x hx => J.germ_mem_stalkIdeal hx hf, fun h => J.mem_of_locally U f fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, g, hg, hgf⟩ := h x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iV, iU, hW⟩ := 𝒪.presheaf.germ_eq x hxV hx g f hgf
  exact ⟨W, iU, hxW, hW ▸ J.res_mem iV g hg⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ext
statement: theorem ext {I J : IdealSheaf 𝒪} (h : ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x = J.stalkIdeal x) : I = J
proof:
:= by
  have hc : I.carrier = J.carrier := by
    funext U
    ext f
    rw [I.mem_carrier_iff, J.mem_carrier_iff]
    exact forall_congr' fun x => forall_congr' fun hx => by rw [h x]
  cases I
  cases J
  cases hc
  rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.le_def
statement: theorem le_def {I J : IdealSheaf 𝒪} : I ≤ J ↔ ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x ≤ J.stalkIdeal x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.carrier_mono
statement: theorem carrier_mono {I J : IdealSheaf 𝒪} (h : I ≤ J) (U : Opens X) : I.carrier U ≤ J.carrier U
proof:
:=
  fun _ hf => J.mem_carrier_iff.mpr fun x hx => h x (I.mem_carrier_iff.mp hf x hx)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stalkIdeal_ofStalks (I : ∀ x : X, Ideal (𝒪.presheaf.stalk x)) (hI : HasLocalGenerators I)
    (b : X) : (ofStalks 𝒪 I hI).stalkIdeal b = I b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hb, k, f, hf⟩ := hI.exists_fin b
  obtain ⟨U', hb', k', f', -, hf'⟩ := (ofStalks 𝒪 I hI).locallyFG b
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rintro s ⟨V, hbV, g, hg, rfl⟩
    change g ∈ ⨅ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ V), (I x).comap (𝒪.presheaf.germ V x hx).hom at hg
    simp only [Ideal.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_comap] at hg
    exact hg b hbV
  · rw [hf b hb, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro s ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨U, hb, f i, ?_, rfl⟩
    change f i ∈ ⨅ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U), (I x).comap (𝒪.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom
    simp only [Ideal.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_comap]
    intro x hx
    rw [hf x hx]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofGlobal
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_ofGlobal {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (x : X) :
    (ofGlobal 𝒪 f).stalkIdeal x =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial (f i))
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ _ x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top
statement: @[simp] theorem stalkIdeal_top (x : X) : (⊤ : IdealSheaf 𝒪).stalkIdeal x = ⊤
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ _ x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem stalkIdeal_bot (x : X) : (⊥ : IdealSheaf 𝒪).stalkIdeal x = ⊥
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ _ x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.carrier_top
statement: theorem carrier_top (U : Opens X) : (⊤ : IdealSheaf 𝒪).carrier U = ⊤
proof:
:=
  Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _ |>.mpr <| mem_carrier_iff _ |>.mpr fun x hx => by
    rw [stalkIdeal_top]; exact Submodule.mem_top

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.carrier_bot
statement: theorem carrier_bot (U : Opens X) : (⊥ : IdealSheaf 𝒪).carrier U = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_carrier_iff, Ideal.mem_bot]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext 𝒪 U f 0 fun x hx => ?_
    have := h x hx
    rw [stalkIdeal_bot, Ideal.mem_bot] at this
    rw [this, map_zero]
  · rintro rfl x hx
    rw [stalkIdeal_bot, Ideal.mem_bot, map_zero]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.range_germ_map
statement:
theorem range_germ_map {U W : Opens X} (i : W ⟶ U) {b : X} (hb : b ∈ W) {ι : Type*}
    (f : ι → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    (Set.range fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ W b hb (𝒪.presheaf.map i.op (f j))) =
      Set.range fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U b (i.le hb) (f j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.hasLocalGenerators_sup
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_sup (I J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) :
    HasLocalGenerators fun x => I.stalkIdeal x ⊔ J.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨U, haU, k, f, -, hf⟩ := I.exists_generators a
  obtain ⟨V, haV, l, g, -, hg⟩ := J.exists_generators a
  refine ⟨U ⊓ V, Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨haU, haV⟩, Fin k ⊕ Fin l, inferInstance,
    Sum.elim (fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (f i))
      (fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (g j)), fun b hb => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hbU, hbV⟩ := Opens.mem_inf.mp hb
  change I.stalkIdeal b ⊔ J.stalkIdeal b = _
  rw [hf b hbU, hg b hbV, ← Submodule.span_union]
  congr 1
  rw [show (fun p => 𝒪.presheaf.germ (U ⊓ V) b hb (Sum.elim
      (fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (f i))
      (fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (g j)) p)) =
    Sum.elim (fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ (U ⊓ V) b hb (𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (f i)))
      (fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ (U ⊓ V) b hb (𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (g j)))
    from funext fun p => by cases p <;> rfl]
  rw [Set.Sum.elim_range, range_germ_map, range_germ_map]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem stalkIdeal_add (I J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) (x : X) :
    (I + J).stalkIdeal x = I.stalkIdeal x ⊔ J.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ _ x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem stalkIdeal_mul (I J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) (x : X) :
    (I * J).stalkIdeal x = I.stalkIdeal x * J.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ _ x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem stalkIdeal_pow (J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    (J ^ n).stalkIdeal x = J.stalkIdeal x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change (⊤ : IdealSheaf 𝒪).stalkIdeal x = _
    rw [stalkIdeal_top, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
  | succ n ih =>
    change (J.pow n * J).stalkIdeal x = _
    rw [stalkIdeal_mul, pow_succ]
    exact congrArg (· * J.stalkIdeal x) ih

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.mem_support
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_support {x : X} : x ∈ J.support ↔ J.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊤
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isOpen_compl_support
statement: theorem isOpen_compl_support : IsOpen J.supportᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro x hx
  have h1 : (1 : 𝒪.presheaf.stalk x) ∈ J.stalkIdeal x := by
    rw [not_not.mp hx]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, g, hg, hg1⟩ := h1
  have hgerm : 𝒪.presheaf.germ V x hxV g = 𝒪.presheaf.germ V x hxV 1 := by rw [hg1, map_one]
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, i, i', hW⟩ := 𝒪.presheaf.germ_eq x hxV hxV g 1 hgerm
  refine ⟨W, fun y hy => ?_, W.2, hxW⟩
  rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, mem_support, not_not, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  have hmem : 𝒪.presheaf.map i.op g ∈ J.carrier W := J.res_mem i g hg
  rw [hW, map_one] at hmem
  simpa only [map_one] using J.germ_mem_stalkIdeal hy hmem

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isClosed_support
statement: theorem isClosed_support : IsClosed J.support
proof:
:=
  isOpen_compl_iff.mp J.isOpen_compl_support

name: Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (S : Set R) : Ideal.span S = ⊤ ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, IsUnit s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hcon
    simp only [not_exists, not_and] at hcon
    have hle : Ideal.span S ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      Ideal.span_le.mpr fun s hs => (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal s).mpr (hcon s hs)
    have h1 : (1 : R) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := hle (h ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal 1).mp h1 isUnit_one
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, ⟨u, rfl⟩⟩
    refine (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr ?_
    simpa using Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (↑u⁻¹ : R) (Ideal.subset_span hs)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ord_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_zero_iff {x : X} : J.ord x = 0 ↔ x ∉ J.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord, IsLocalRing.ord_eq_zero_iff, mem_support, not_not]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ord_eq_top_of_stalkIdeal_eq_bot
statement: theorem ord_eq_top_of_stalkIdeal_eq_bot {x : X} (h : J.stalkIdeal x = ⊥) : J.ord x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord, h]; exact IsLocalRing.ord_bot

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ord_anti
statement: theorem ord_anti {I J : IdealSheaf 𝒪} (h : I ≤ J) (x : X) : J.ord x ≤ I.ord x
proof:
:=
  IsLocalRing.ord_anti (h x)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit {U : Opens X} {k : ℕ}
    {f : Fin k → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)} {b : X} (hb : b ∈ U)
    (hf : J.stalkIdeal b = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U b hb (f i))) :
    J.stalkIdeal b = ⊤ ↔ ∃ i, IsUnit (𝒪.presheaf.germ U b hb (f i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf, Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hu⟩; exact ⟨i, hu⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hu⟩; exact ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hu⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.hasLocalGenerators_tuning
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_tuning (m s : ℕ) :
    HasLocalGenerators fun x =>
      ⨆ (e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (_ : s ≤ wt m e),
        ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), (J.iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ)).stalkIdeal x ^ e j
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun x => ⨆ (e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (_ : s ≤ wt m e),
        ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), (J.iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ)).stalkIdeal x ^ e j) =
      (∑ e ∈ tuningExponents m s, ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), J.iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) ^ e j).stalkIdeal := by
    funext x
    rw [stalkIdeal_finset_sum, iSup_wt_eq_sum_tuningExponents m s
      (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => (J.iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ)).stalkIdeal x)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    rw [stalkIdeal_finset_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => (stalkIdeal_pow _ _ _).symm
  rw [h]
  exact hasLocalGenerators_stalkIdeal _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isDBalanced_one
statement: theorem isDBalanced_one : J.IsDBalanced 1
proof:
:= fun i hi => by
  obtain rfl : i = 0 := Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hi
  simp only [Nat.sub_zero, pow_one]
  exact le_rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear
statement:
theorem exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear (a : M) :
    ∃ c : RegularCoords ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) (Module.finrank 𝕜 E),
      c.IsLinearOver 𝕜 ∧ c.SpansDerivations 𝕜
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : chartAt E a ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a
  have hdim : ((Module.finrank 𝕜 E : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ringKrullDim ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) := (ringKrullDim_stalk E a).symm
  obtain ⟨c, -, -, hk, hs⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk E (modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E))
    (chartAt E a) hφ (mem_chart_source E a) hdim
  exact ⟨c, hk, hs⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_tuning
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_tuning (x : M) :
    (J.tuning m s).stalkIdeal x =
      ⨆ (e : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (_ : s ≤ wt m e),
        ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), (J.iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ)).stalkIdeal x ^ e j
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ (J.hasLocalGenerators_tuning m s) x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W {a : M} {n : ℕ}
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)]
    (c : RegularCoords ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) n) (hk : c.IsLinearOver 𝕜)
    (hs : c.SpansDerivations 𝕜) :
    (J.tuning m s).stalkIdeal a = c.W m s (J.stalkIdeal a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_tuning, RegularCoords.W]
  refine iSup_congr fun e => iSup_congr fun _ => Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [J.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.tuning_eq_finset_sum
statement:
theorem tuning_eq_finset_sum :
    J.tuning m s = ∑ e ∈ tuningExponents m s, ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), J.iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) ^ e j
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [stalkIdeal_tuning, stalkIdeal_finset_sum, iSup_wt_eq_sum_tuningExponents m s
    (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => (J.iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ)).stalkIdeal x)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  rw [stalkIdeal_finset_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => (stalkIdeal_pow _ _ _).symm

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.tuning_zero
statement: theorem tuning_zero : J.tuning m 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun a => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m 0 c hk hs, c.W_zero, stalkIdeal_top]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.tuning_anti
statement: theorem tuning_anti {t : ℕ} (h : s ≤ t) : J.tuning m t ≤ J.tuning m s
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m t c hk hs', J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs']
  exact c.W_anti h _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.tuning_mul_le
statement: theorem tuning_mul_le (t : ℕ) : J.tuning m s * J.tuning m t ≤ J.tuning m (s + t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [stalkIdeal_mul, J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs', J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m t c hk hs',
    J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m (s + t) c hk hs']
  exact c.W_mul_le m s t _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.pow_le_tuning
statement: theorem pow_le_tuning {k : ℕ} (h : s ≤ m * k) : J ^ k ≤ J.tuning m s
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [stalkIdeal_pow, J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs']
  exact c.pow_le_W h _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_pow_le_tuning
statement: theorem iteratedDeriv_pow_le_tuning (hm : 1 ≤ m) : J.iteratedDeriv (m - 1) ^ s ≤ J.tuning m s
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [stalkIdeal_pow, J.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs',
    J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs']
  exact c.MC_pow_le_W hm s _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.tuning_one
statement: theorem tuning_one (hm : 1 ≤ m) : J.tuning m 1 = J.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun a => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m 1 c hk hs, J.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs]
  exact c.W_one hm _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.deriv_tuning_succ
statement:
theorem deriv_tuning_succ (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ∀ y, J.ord y ≤ m) :
    (J.tuning m (s + 1)).deriv = J.tuning m s
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun a => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [(J.tuning m (s + 1)).stalkIdeal_deriv_eq_D c hk hs',
    J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m (s + 1) c hk hs', J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs']
  exact c.D_W_succ hm (hI a) s

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_tuning
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_tuning (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ∀ y, J.ord y ≤ m) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (J.tuning m s).iteratedDeriv (s - 1) = J.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun a => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [(J.tuning m s).stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs',
    J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs', J.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs',
    c.Dpow_W hm (hI a) (Nat.sub_le s 1), Nat.sub_sub_self hs]
  exact c.W_one hm _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isMCInvariant_tuning
statement:
theorem isMCInvariant_tuning (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ∀ y, J.ord y ≤ m) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (J.tuning m s).IsMCInvariant s
proof:
:= by
  change _ * _ ≤ _
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [stalkIdeal_mul, (J.tuning m s).stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs',
    (J.tuning m s).stalkIdeal_deriv_eq_D c hk hs', J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs']
  exact c.isMCInvariant_W hm (hI a) hs

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.tuning_mul_tuning
statement:
theorem tuning_mul_tuning (hm : 1 ≤ m) (r t : ℕ) (ht : (m - 1) * Lcm m ≤ t) :
    J.tuning m (r * Lcm m) * J.tuning m t = J.tuning m (r * Lcm m + t)
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun a => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [stalkIdeal_mul, J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m (r * Lcm m) c hk hs,
    J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m t c hk hs, J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m (r * Lcm m + t) c hk hs]
  exact c.W_mul_W_eq hm r t ht _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.tuning_pow
statement:
theorem tuning_pow (hm : 1 ≤ m) {r : ℕ} (hr : m - 1 ≤ r) (j : ℕ) :
    J.tuning m (r * Lcm m) ^ j = J.tuning m (j * (r * Lcm m))
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun a => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [stalkIdeal_pow, J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m (r * Lcm m) c hk hs,
    J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m (j * (r * Lcm m)) c hk hs]
  exact c.W_pow hm hr j _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isDBalanced_tuning
statement:
theorem isDBalanced_tuning (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ∀ y, J.ord y ≤ m) {r : ℕ} (hr : m - 1 ≤ r) :
    (J.tuning m (r * Lcm m)).IsDBalanced (r * Lcm m)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [stalkIdeal_pow, stalkIdeal_pow,
    (J.tuning m (r * Lcm m)).stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs,
    J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m (r * Lcm m) c hk hs]
  exact c.isDBalanced_W hm (hI a) hr i hi

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isDBalanced_tuning_tuningParam
statement:
theorem isDBalanced_tuning_tuningParam (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ∀ y, J.ord y ≤ m) :
    (J.tuning m (tuningParam m)).IsDBalanced (tuningParam m)
proof:
:=
  J.isDBalanced_tuning m hm hI (le_max_left _ _)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isMCInvariant_tuning_tuningParam
statement:
theorem isMCInvariant_tuning_tuningParam (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hI : ∀ y, J.ord y ≤ m) :
    (J.tuning m (tuningParam m)).IsMCInvariant (tuningParam m)
proof:
:=
  J.isMCInvariant_tuning m (tuningParam m) hm hI (one_le_tuningParam m)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.le_ord_tuning_iff
statement:
theorem le_ord_tuning_iff (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (x : M) :
    (s : ℕ∞) ≤ (J.tuning m s).ord x ↔ (m : ℕ∞) ≤ J.ord x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E x
  unfold IdealSheaf.ord
  rw [J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs']
  exact c.le_ord_W_iff hm hs

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.support_tuning
statement:
theorem support_tuning (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (J.tuning m s).support = {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ J.ord x}
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext fun a => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E a
  rw [mem_support, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs', IdealSheaf.ord,
    ne_eq, ← IsLocalRing.ord_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hlt
    rw [not_le] at hlt
    exact h (by rw [c.W_eq_top_of_ord_lt hm hlt, ord_top])
  · intro h h0
    have h1 : (s : ℕ∞) ≤ 0 := h0 ▸ c.le_ord_W h s
    have h2 : s = 0 := by exact_mod_cast le_antisymm h1 bot_le
    omega

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ord_tuning
statement: theorem ord_tuning (hm : 1 ≤ m) {x : M} (hx : J.ord x = m) : (J.tuning m s).ord x = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hk, hs'⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk_linear 𝕜 E x
  unfold IdealSheaf.ord at hx ⊢
  rw [J.stalkIdeal_tuning_eq_W m s c hk hs']
  exact c.ord_W hm hx s

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.tuning_one_tuningParam
statement: theorem tuning_one_tuningParam : J.tuning 1 (tuningParam 1) = J
proof:
:= by
  rw [show tuningParam 1 = 1 by decide, J.tuning_one 1 le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, iteratedDeriv_zero]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.support_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem support_iteratedDeriv {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (J.iteratedDeriv (m - 1)).support = {a | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ J.ord a}
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  have hφ : chartAt E a ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a
  have hdim : ((Module.finrank 𝕜 E : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ringKrullDim ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) := (ringKrullDim_stalk E a).symm
  obtain ⟨c, -, -, hk, hs⟩ := exists_regularCoords_stalk E (modelCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E))
    (chartAt E a) hφ (mem_chart_source E a) hdim
  rw [mem_support, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, J.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow c hk hs, IdealSheaf.ord,
    c.le_ord_iff_le_ord_Dpow (J.stalkIdeal a) (Nat.sub_lt hm one_pos), Nat.sub_sub_self hm,
    Nat.cast_one, Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, ne_eq, IsLocalRing.ord_eq_zero_iff]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.isOpen_setOf_ord_le
statement:
theorem isOpen_setOf_ord_le (I : AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf M) (k : ℕ) :
    IsOpen {y : M | I.ord y ≤ (k : ℕ∞)}
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (I.iteratedDeriv k).support = {a : M | (k : ℕ∞) < I.ord a} := by
    have h0 := support_iteratedDeriv I (Nat.succ_pos k)
    rw [Nat.succ_sub_one] at h0
    rw [h0]
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Nat.cast_succ, ENat.add_one_le_iff (ENat.natCast_ne_top k)]
  have h : {y : M | I.ord y ≤ (k : ℕ∞)} = (I.iteratedDeriv k).supportᶜ := by
    ext y
    rw [h1]
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, mem_compl_iff, not_lt]
  rw [h]
  exact (I.iteratedDeriv k).isClosed_support.isOpen_compl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.exists_generators
statement:
theorem exists_generators (a : X) :
    ∃ (U : Opens X) (_ : a ∈ U) (k : ℕ) (f : Fin k → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)),
      (∀ i, f i ∈ J.carrier U) ∧ ∀ b (hb : b ∈ U),
        J.stalkIdeal b = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U b hb (f i))
proof:
:=
  J.locallyFG a

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators.exists_fin
statement:
theorem HasLocalGenerators.exists_fin {I : ∀ x : X, Ideal (𝒪.presheaf.stalk x)}
    (hI : HasLocalGenerators I) (a : X) :
    ∃ (U : Opens X) (_ : a ∈ U) (k : ℕ) (f : Fin k → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)),
      ∀ b (hb : b ∈ U), I b = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U b hb (f i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, ha, ι, _, f, hf⟩ := hI a
  refine ⟨U, ha, Fintype.card ι, f ∘ (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm, fun b hb => ?_⟩
  rw [hf b hb]
  congr 1
  exact ((Fintype.equivFin ι).symm.surjective.range_comp
    fun i => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U b hb (f i)).symm

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.hasLocalGenerators_top
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_top :
    HasLocalGenerators (fun x : X => (⊤ : Ideal (𝒪.presheaf.stalk x)))
proof:
:=
  fun _ => ⟨⊤, trivial, Unit, inferInstance, fun _ => 1, fun b hb => by
    rw [eq_comm, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨(), map_one _⟩⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.hasLocalGenerators_bot
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_bot :
    HasLocalGenerators (fun x : X => (⊥ : Ideal (𝒪.presheaf.stalk x)))
proof:
:=
  fun _ => ⟨⊤, trivial, Empty, inferInstance, fun i => i.elim, fun _ _ => by
    simp only [Set.range_eq_empty, Ideal.span_empty]⟩

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.hasLocalGenerators_mul
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_mul (I J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) :
    HasLocalGenerators fun x => I.stalkIdeal x * J.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨U, haU, k, f, -, hf⟩ := I.exists_generators a
  obtain ⟨V, haV, l, g, -, hg⟩ := J.exists_generators a
  refine ⟨U ⊓ V, Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨haU, haV⟩, Fin k × Fin l, inferInstance,
    fun p => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (f p.1) *
