      𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (g p.2), fun b hb => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hbU, hbV⟩ := Opens.mem_inf.mp hb
  change I.stalkIdeal b * J.stalkIdeal b = _
  rw [hf b hbU, hg b hbV, Ideal.span_mul_span]
  congr 1
  ext s
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_mul, map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, Prod.exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, _, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i, j, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, j, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, _, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.hasLocalGenerators_pullback
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_pullback (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators fun b : N => Ideal.map (germMap φ hφ b) (J.stalkIdeal (φ b))
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  obtain ⟨U, hU, k, f, -, hf⟩ := J.exists_generators (φ b)
  refine ⟨preimageOpens φ hφ U, (mem_preimageOpens φ hφ).mpr hU, Fin k, inferInstance,
    fun i => comapSection φ hφ (f i), fun c hc => ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  have hcU : φ c ∈ U := (mem_preimageOpens φ hφ).mp hc
  rw [hf (φ c) hcU, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  exact congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext fun i => germMap_germ φ hφ hcU (f i)))

name: Manifold.stalkIdeal_deriv_pullback_of_bijective
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_deriv, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
    IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_deriv]
  have h := Ideal.derivative_map_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb)
    (fun a => germMap_algebraMap φ hφ b a) (J.stalkIdeal (φ b))
  have he : (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hb).toRingHom = germMap φ hφ b := RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl
  rw [he] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Manifold.deriv_pullback_of_bijective
statement:
theorem deriv_pullback_of_bijective (hb : ∀ b, Function.Bijective (germMap φ hφ b)) :
    (J.pullback φ hφ).deriv = J.deriv.pullback φ hφ
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun b => stalkIdeal_deriv_pullback_of_bijective φ hφ J (hb b)

name: Manifold.iteratedDeriv_pullback_of_bijective
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_pullback_of_bijective (hb : ∀ b, Function.Bijective (germMap φ hφ b))
    (j : ℕ) : (J.pullback φ hφ).iteratedDeriv j = (J.iteratedDeriv j).pullback φ hφ
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_succ, ih, deriv_pullback_of_bijective φ hφ _ hb,
      IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_succ]

name: Manifold.germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt
statement:
theorem germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt {b : N}
    (h : IsLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω φ b) : Function.Bijective (germMap φ hφ b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Φ, hbΦ, heq⟩ := h.exists_partialDiffeomorph
  have hφb : φ b ∈ Φ.target := heq hbΦ ▸ Φ.map_source hbΦ
  have hinv : Φ.invFun (φ b) = b := by rw [heq hbΦ]; exact Φ.left_inv hbΦ
  set g := germMapOn Φ.invFun (V := ⟨Φ.target, Φ.open_target⟩) Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun hφb hinv
    with hg
  have hcomp : g.comp (germMap φ hφ b) = RingHom.id _ := by
    refine RingHom.ext fun t => stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M (φ b) ?_
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, hg, stalkToGerm_germMapOn, stalkToGerm_germMap, RingHom.id_apply]
    induction stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M (φ b) t using Germ.inductionOn with
    | h k =>
      rw [Germ.coe_compTendsto, Germ.coe_compTendsto]
      refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
      filter_upwards [Φ.open_target.mem_nhds hφb] with y hy
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      have hmem : Φ.invFun y ∈ Φ.source := Φ.map_target hy
      have hri : Φ.toPartialEquiv (Φ.invFun y) = y := Φ.right_inv hy
      rw [heq hmem, hri]
  have hcomp' : (germMap φ hφ b).comp g = RingHom.id _ := by
    refine RingHom.ext fun t => stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N b ?_
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, stalkToGerm_germMap, hg, stalkToGerm_germMapOn, RingHom.id_apply]
    induction stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω N b t using Germ.inductionOn with
    | h k =>
      rw [Germ.coe_compTendsto, Germ.coe_compTendsto]
      refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
      filter_upwards [Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hbΦ] with y hy
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [heq hy]
      exact congrArg k (Φ.left_inv hy)
  refine ⟨Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := g) fun t => ?_,
    Function.RightInverse.surjective (g := g) fun t => ?_⟩
  · rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, hcomp, RingHom.id_apply]
  · rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, hcomp', RingHom.id_apply]

name: Manifold.stalkIdeal_deriv_pullback_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_deriv_pullback_of_bijective φ hφ J (germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt φ hφ hb)

name: Manifold.iteratedDeriv_pullback_of_isLocalDiffeomorph
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_pullback_of_isLocalDiffeomorph
    (hloc : IsLocalDiffeomorph 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω φ) (j : ℕ) :
    (J.pullback φ hφ).iteratedDeriv j = (J.iteratedDeriv j).pullback φ hφ
proof:
:=
  iteratedDeriv_pullback_of_bijective φ hφ J
    (fun b => germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt φ hφ (hloc b)) j

name: Manifold.vanishingStalk_preimage_diffeomorph
statement:
theorem vanishingStalk_preimage_diffeomorph (Z : Set M₂) (x : M₁) :
    vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (⇑g ⁻¹' Z) x =
      Ideal.map (germMap ⇑g g.contMDiff x) (vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) Z (g x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comap_germMap_vanishingStalk g Z x]
  exact (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _
    (germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt ⇑g g.contMDiff (g.isLocalDiffeomorph x)).2 _).symm

name: Manifold.hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_preimage_of
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_preimage_of (W : Set M₂)
    (h : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M₂) fun y : M₂ =>
      vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) W y) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M₁) fun x : M₁ =>
      vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (⇑g ⁻¹' W) x
proof:
:= by
  have := hasLocalGenerators_pullback ⇑g g.contMDiff (IdealSheaf.ofStalks _ _ h)
  refine (congrArg IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (funext fun x => ?_)).mp this
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks, vanishingStalk_preimage_diffeomorph]

name: Manifold.hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_preimage_iff
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_preimage_iff (W : Set M₂) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M₁) (fun x : M₁ =>
      vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (⇑g ⁻¹' W) x) ↔
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M₂) fun y : M₂ =>
      vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) W y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_preimage_of g W⟩
  have := hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_preimage_of g.symm (⇑g ⁻¹' W) h
  refine (congrArg IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (funext fun y => ?_)).mp this
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply]

name: AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_restrictOpens
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_restrictOpens (J : IdealSheaf M) (U : Opens M) (j : ℕ) :
    (J.restrict U).iteratedDeriv j = restrict (J.iteratedDeriv j) U
proof:
:=
  iteratedDeriv_pullback_of_bijective _ _ J (fun p => germMap_val_bijective (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) U p) j

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_le_of_comap_le
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_le_of_comap_le {g : AnalyticMap N M}
    (hg : IsLocalDiffeomorph 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω g) {A B : AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf M} (y : N)
    (h : (A.pullback g g.contMDiff).stalkIdeal y ≤ (B.pullback g g.contMDiff).stalkIdeal y) :
    A.stalkIdeal (g y) ≤ B.stalkIdeal (g y)
proof:
:= by
  have hbij := germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt (⇑g) g.contMDiff (hg y)
  change (A.pullback ⇑g g.contMDiff).stalkIdeal y ≤ (B.pullback ⇑g g.contMDiff).stalkIdeal y at h
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback] at h
  calc A.stalkIdeal (g y) = ((A.stalkIdeal (g y)).map (germMap (⇑g) g.contMDiff y)).comap _ :=
        (Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij).symm
    _ ≤ ((B.stalkIdeal (g y)).map (germMap (⇑g) g.contMDiff y)).comap _ := Ideal.comap_mono h
    _ = B.stalkIdeal (g y) := Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij

name: Ideal.map_eq_top_iff_of_isLocalHom
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.map_eq_top_iff_of_isLocalHom {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] (g : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom g] (I : Ideal R) :
    I.map g = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hI
    have hle : I.map g ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S :=
      (Ideal.map_mono (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hI)).trans (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le g)
    have h1 : (1 : S) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S := hle (h ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal 1).mp h1 isUnit_one
  · rintro rfl
    exact Ideal.map_top g

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback
statement:
@[simp] theorem IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (b : N) :
    (J.pullback φ hφ).stalkIdeal b = Ideal.map (germMap φ hφ b) (J.stalkIdeal (φ b))
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks (fun b => Ideal.map (germMap φ hφ b) (J.stalkIdeal (φ b)))
    (hasLocalGenerators_pullback φ hφ J) b

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.pullback_le_pullback
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.pullback_le_pullback {J K : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)} (h : J ≤ K) :
    J.pullback φ hφ ≤ K.pullback φ hφ
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro b
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback]
  exact Ideal.map_mono (IdealSheaf.le_def.mp h _)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.pullback_pow
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.pullback_pow (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (k : ℕ) :
    (J ^ k).pullback φ hφ = (J.pullback φ hφ) ^ k
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun b => by
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, Ideal.map_pow]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback_eq_span
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback_eq_span (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    {U : Opens M} {k : ℕ} {f : Fin k → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)}
    (hgen : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ U), J.stalkIdeal b =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U b hb (f i)))
    {b : N} (hb : φ b ∈ U) :
    (J.pullback φ hφ).stalkIdeal b = Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E' N).presheaf.germ (preimageOpens φ hφ U) b
        ((mem_preimageOpens φ hφ).mpr hb) (comapSection φ hφ (f i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, hgen (φ b) hb, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  exact congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext fun i => germMap_germ φ hφ hb (f i)))

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.support_pullback
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IdealSheaf.support_pullback (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    (J.pullback φ hφ).support = φ ⁻¹' J.support
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, mem_support, mem_support,
    IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, not_iff_not]
  exact Ideal.map_eq_top_iff_of_isLocalHom _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ord_le_ord_pullback
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ord_le_ord_pullback (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (b : N) :
    J.ord (φ b) ≤ (J.pullback φ hφ).ord b
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.ord, IdealSheaf.ord, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback]
  exact IsLocalRing.ord_le_ord_map _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.ord_pullback_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.ord_pullback_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    {b : N} (h : IsLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(𝕜, E') 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω φ b) :
    (J.pullback φ hφ).ord b = J.ord (φ b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Φ, hbΦ, heq⟩ := h.exists_partialDiffeomorph
  have hφb : φ b ∈ Φ.target := heq hbΦ ▸ Φ.map_source hbΦ
  have hinv : Φ.invFun (φ b) = b := by rw [heq hbΦ]; exact Φ.left_inv hbΦ
  have hcomp : (germMapOn Φ.invFun (V := ⟨Φ.target, Φ.open_target⟩) Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun hφb
      hinv).comp (germMap φ hφ b) = RingHom.id _ := by
    refine RingHom.ext fun t => stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M (φ b) ?_
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, stalkToGerm_germMapOn, stalkToGerm_germMap, RingHom.id_apply]
    induction stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M (φ b) t using Germ.inductionOn with
    | h k =>
      rw [Germ.coe_compTendsto, Germ.coe_compTendsto]
      refine Germ.coe_eq.mpr ?_
      filter_upwards [Φ.open_target.mem_nhds hφb] with y hy
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      have hmem : Φ.invFun y ∈ Φ.source := Φ.map_target hy
      have hri : Φ.toPartialEquiv (Φ.invFun y) = y := Φ.right_inv hy
      rw [heq hmem, hri]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (IdealSheaf.ord_le_ord_pullback φ hφ J b)
  rw [IdealSheaf.ord, IdealSheaf.ord, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback]
  refine (IsLocalRing.ord_le_ord_map (germMapOn Φ.invFun (V := ⟨Φ.target, Φ.open_target⟩)
    Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun hφb hinv) _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [Ideal.map_map, hcomp, Ideal.map_id]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.pullback_mul
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.pullback_mul (I J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    (I * J).pullback φ hφ = I.pullback φ hφ * J.pullback φ hφ
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun x => by
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, Ideal.map_mul]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.pullback_top
statement: theorem IdealSheaf.pullback_top : (⊤ : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)).pullback φ hφ = ⊤
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun x => by
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top, Ideal.map_top,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.pullback_id_eq_self
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.pullback_id_eq_self (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.pullback (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E' := E) (id : M → M) contMDiff_id J = J
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback]
  have : germMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E' := E) (id : M → M) contMDiff_id x = RingHom.id _ :=
    RingHom.ext (germMap_id x)
  rw [this, Ideal.map_id]
  rfl

name: Manifold.comap_germMap_vanishingStalk
statement:
theorem comap_germMap_vanishingStalk (Z : Set M₂) (x : M₁) :
    (vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (⇑g ⁻¹' Z) x).comap (germMap ⇑g g.contMDiff x) =
      vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) Z (g x)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_vanishingStalk_iff, mem_vanishingStalk_iff, stalkToGerm_germMap]
  exact Germ.vanishesOn_compTendsto_of_isEmbedding (h := ⇑g) g.toHomeomorph.isEmbedding
    g.toEquiv.surjective Z x _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_principal
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)
    (fun x => Ideal.span {(structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ ⊤ x (Opens.mem_top x) t})
    (hasLocalGenerators_span_germ_top t) x

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_principal_eq_top_iff
proof:
:= by
  have h : eval 𝕜 E M x ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ ⊤ x (Opens.mem_top x) t) =
      t ⟨x, Opens.mem_top x⟩ :=
    contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 ⊤ x (Opens.mem_top x) t
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_principal, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top,
    ← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval, h]

name: Ideal.logDerivative_span_eq_of_span
statement:
theorem logDerivative_span_eq_of_span {ι : Type*} (der : ι → Derivation k A A) {J : Ideal A}
    (hder : ∀ i, (der i).PreservesIdeal J)
    (h : ∀ δ : Derivation k A A, δ.PreservesIdeal J → δ ∈ Submodule.span A (Set.range der))
    (S : Set A) :
    logDerivative k J (Ideal.span S) = Ideal.span (S ∪ ⋃ i, der i '' S)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (logDerivative_le_iff.mpr
    ⟨Ideal.span_mono Set.subset_union_left, fun δ hδ f hf => ?_⟩) ?_
  · have hδS : ∀ s ∈ S, δ s ∈ Ideal.span (S ∪ ⋃ i, der i '' S) := by
      intro s hs
      have hmem := h δ hδ
      clear hδ
      induction hmem using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem δ' hδ' =>
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hδ'
        exact Ideal.subset_span (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩⟩))
      | zero => simp
      | add δ₁ δ₂ _ _ h1 h2 => rw [Derivation.add_apply]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ h1 h2
      | smul a δ' _ h' => rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h'
    induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem s hs => exact hδS s hs
    | zero => simp
    | add f g _ _ hf hg => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ hf hg
    | smul a f hf' hf =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hf)
        (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.span_mono Set.subset_union_left hf'))
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x (hx | hx)
    · exact le_logDerivative (k := k) _ _ (Ideal.subset_span hx)
    · obtain ⟨i, s, hs, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      exact derivation_apply_mem_logDerivative (hder i) (Ideal.subset_span hs)

name: Manifold.logCoordDerivStalk_self
statement:
theorem logCoordDerivStalk_self (h : Fin n) :
    logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha h h = coord E ψ φ hφ ha h • coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha h
proof:
:= by
  simp [logCoordDerivStalk]

name: Manifold.logCoordDerivStalk_of_ne
statement:
theorem logCoordDerivStalk_of_ne {h i : Fin n} (hi : i ≠ h) :
    logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha h i = coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i
proof:
:= by
  simp [logCoordDerivStalk, hi]

name: Manifold.logCoordDerivStalk_preservesIdeal
statement:
theorem logCoordDerivStalk_preservesIdeal (h i : Fin n) :
    (logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha h i).PreservesIdeal (Ideal.span {coord E ψ φ hφ ha h})
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.preservesIdeal_span_singleton_iff]
  by_cases hi : i = h
  · subst hi
    rw [logCoordDerivStalk_self, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  · rw [logCoordDerivStalk_of_ne E ψ φ hφ ha hi, coordDerivStalk_coord, ite_eq_right hi, map_zero]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: Manifold.mem_span_logCoordDerivStalk_of_preservesIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_span_logCoordDerivStalk_of_preservesIdeal (h : Fin n)
    (δ : Derivation 𝕜 ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a))
    (hδ : δ.PreservesIdeal (Ideal.span {coord E ψ φ hφ ha h})) :
    δ ∈ Submodule.span ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)
      (Set.range (logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha h))
proof:
:= by
  have hδ' : δ = ∑ i, δ (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha i) • coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i := by
    ext s
    rw [derivation_eq_sum_coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha δ s, IsLocalRing.derivation_sum_apply]
    simp only [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hδ']
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hi : i = h
  · subst hi
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hδ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))
    have hc : δ (centredCoord E ψ φ hφ ha i) = δ (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i) := by
      simp only [centredCoord, map_sub, sub_eq_self]
      exact Derivation.map_algebraMap δ _
    rw [hc, ← hg, mul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, logCoordDerivStalk_self E ψ φ hφ ha i⟩)
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, logCoordDerivStalk_of_ne E ψ φ hφ ha hi⟩)

name: Manifold.logDerivative_span_coord_eq
statement:
theorem logDerivative_span_coord_eq (h : Fin n)
    (T : Set ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :
    Ideal.logDerivative 𝕜 (Ideal.span {coord E ψ φ hφ ha h}) (Ideal.span T) =
      Ideal.span (T ∪ ⋃ i, logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha h i '' T)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.logDerivative_span_eq_of_span _ (logCoordDerivStalk_preservesIdeal E ψ φ hφ ha h)
    (mem_span_logCoordDerivStalk_of_preservesIdeal E ψ φ hφ ha h) T

name: Manifold.derivative_span_eq_span_logCoordDerivStalk
statement:
theorem derivative_span_eq_span_logCoordDerivStalk (h : Fin n)
    (hu : IsUnit (coord E ψ φ hφ ha h)) (T : Set ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)) :
    Ideal.derivative 𝕜 (Ideal.span T) =
      Ideal.span (T ∪ ⋃ i, logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha h i '' T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.derivative_span_eq_of_span _ (coordDerivStalk_mem_span ψ φ hφ ha)]
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro x (hx | hx)
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (Or.inl hx)
    · obtain ⟨i, t, ht, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      by_cases hi : i = h
      · subst hi
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
        have : coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i t =
            (↑v⁻¹ : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) *
              (logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i i t) := by
          rw [logCoordDerivStalk_self, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← hv,
            Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
        rw [this]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
          (Ideal.subset_span (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩)))
      · rw [← logCoordDerivStalk_of_ne E ψ φ hφ ha hi]
        exact Ideal.subset_span (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩))
  · rintro x (hx | hx)
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (Or.inl hx)
    · obtain ⟨i, t, ht, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
      by_cases hi : i = h
      · subst hi
        rw [logCoordDerivStalk_self, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _
          (Ideal.subset_span (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩)))
      · rw [logCoordDerivStalk_of_ne E ψ φ hφ ha hi]
        exact Ideal.subset_span (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩⟩))

name: Manifold.germ_logCoordDerivSection
statement:
theorem germ_logCoordDerivSection {b : M} (hb : b ∈ V) (h i : Fin n)
    (f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb (logCoordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV h i f) =
      logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ (hV hb) h i ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold logCoordDerivSection logCoordDerivStalk
  split_ifs with hi
  · rw [map_mul, germ_coordSection, ← coordDerivStalk_germ, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · rw [← coordDerivStalk_germ]

name: Manifold.logDerivative_stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem logDerivative_stalkIdeal_eq_span (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    {σ : Fin 1 ↪ Fin n} (hφS : IsAdaptedChart ψ S φ σ) (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    {U : Opens M} {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hf : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ U), J.stalkIdeal b =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U b hb (f j)))
    (hVU : V ≤ U) {b : M} (hb : b ∈ V) :
    Ideal.logDerivative 𝕜 (hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal b) (J.stalkIdeal b) = Ideal.span
      ((Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
          ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))) ∪
        ⋃ i, Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
          (logCoordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV (σ 0) i
            ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))))
proof:
:= by
  have hbφ : b ∈ φ.source := hV hb
  have hgen : J.stalkIdeal b = Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))) := by
    rw [hf b (hVU hb), ← IdealSheaf.range_germ_map (homOfLE hVU) hb f]
  have hfam : ∀ i, (Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
      (logCoordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV (σ 0) i
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j)))) =
      logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hbφ (σ 0) i '' (Set.range fun j =>
        (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
          ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))) := by
    intro i
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    exact congrArg Set.range (funext fun j => germ_logCoordDerivSection E ψ φ hφ V hV hb _ i _)
  simp only [hfam]
  rw [hgen]
  by_cases hbS : b ∈ S
  · rw [hS.isIdealSheafOf_idealSheaf.2 φ σ hφS b hbφ hbS, Set.range_unique]
    exact logDerivative_span_coord_eq E ψ φ hφ hbφ (σ 0) _
  · rw [hS.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hbS, Ideal.logDerivative_top]
    refine derivative_span_eq_span_logCoordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ hbφ (σ 0) ?_ _
    rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval, eval_coord]
    intro h0
    exact hbS ((hφS.2 b hbφ).mpr fun i => by rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]; exact h0)

name: Manifold.hasLocalGenerators_logDerivative_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_logDerivative_stalkIdeal (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators fun a =>
      Ideal.logDerivative 𝕜 (hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a) (J.stalkIdeal a)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  by_cases haS : a ∈ S
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, haφ, hφS⟩ := hS.exists_adaptedChart a haS
    obtain ⟨U, haU, k, f, -, hf⟩ := J.exists_generators a
    let V : Opens M := U ⊓ ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source⟩
    have hV : (V : Set M) ⊆ φ.source := fun x hx => hx.2
    have hVU : V ≤ U := inf_le_left
    refine ⟨V, Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨haU, haφ⟩, Fin k ⊕ Fin n × Fin k, inferInstance,
      Sum.elim (fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))
        (fun p => logCoordDerivSection E ψ φ hφS.1 V hV (σ 0) p.1
          ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f p.2))), fun b hb => ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [logDerivative_stalkIdeal_eq_span E ψ φ hφS.1 V hV hS hφS J f hf hVU hb]
    congr 1
    ext s
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Prod.exists, Sum.exists, Sum.elim_inl,
      Sum.elim_inr]
  · have : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E := ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
    obtain ⟨U, haU, ι, _, f, hf⟩ := J.hasLocalGenerators_derivative_stalkIdeal a
    let V : Opens M := U ⊓ ⟨Sᶜ, hS.isClosed.isOpen_compl⟩
    have hVU : V ≤ U := inf_le_left
    refine ⟨V, Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨haU, haS⟩, ι, inferInstance,
      fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j), fun b hb => ?_⟩
    have hfb := hf b (hVU hb)
    dsimp only at hfb ⊢
    rw [hS.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem hb.2, Ideal.logDerivative_top, hfb,
      ← IdealSheaf.range_germ_map (homOfLE hVU) hb f]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDeriv (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (a : M) :
    (IdealSheaf.logDeriv E ψ hS J).stalkIdeal a =
      Ideal.logDerivative 𝕜 (hS.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a) (J.stalkIdeal a)
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ (hasLocalGenerators_logDerivative_stalkIdeal E ψ hS J) a

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_zero (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) : IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS 0 J = J
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1) (r : ℕ)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (r + 1) J =
      IdealSheaf.logDeriv E ψ hS (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS r J)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ'
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_succ' (hS : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ S 1) (r : ℕ)
    (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS (r + 1) J =
      IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS r (IdealSheaf.logDeriv E ψ hS J)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply _ _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.le_deriv
statement: theorem le_deriv : J ≤ J.deriv
proof:
:= fun a => by
  rw [stalkIdeal_deriv]
  exact Ideal.le_derivative _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_deriv_eq_sup_iSup_coordDerivStalk
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_deriv_eq_sup_iSup_coordDerivStalk {a : M} (ha : a ∈ φ.source) :
    J.deriv.stalkIdeal a = J.stalkIdeal a ⊔
      ⨆ i, Ideal.span (coordDerivStalk E ψ φ hφ ha i '' (J.stalkIdeal a : Set _))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_deriv]
  exact derivative_eq_sup_iSup_span_image_coordDerivStalk ψ φ hφ ha _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.coordDeriv_mem_carrier_deriv
statement:
theorem coordDeriv_mem_carrier_deriv (V : Opens M) (hV : (V : Set M) ⊆ φ.source)
    {f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op V)} (hf : f ∈ J.carrier V) (i : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i f ∈ J.deriv.carrier V
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_carrier_iff]
  intro x hx
  rw [stalkIdeal_deriv, ← coordDerivStalk_germ E ψ φ hφ (hV hx) V hV hx i f]
  exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_derivative _ (J.germ_mem_stalkIdeal hx hf)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_deriv_eq_span
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_deriv_eq_span {U : Opens M} {k : ℕ}
    (f : Fin k → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hf : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ U), J.stalkIdeal b =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U b hb (f j)))
    {V : Opens M} (hVU : V ≤ U) (hV : (V : Set M) ⊆ φ.source) {b : M} (hb : b ∈ V) :
    J.deriv.stalkIdeal b = Ideal.span
      ((Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
          ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))) ∪
        ⋃ i, Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V b hb
          (coordDeriv E ψ φ hφ V hV i
            ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f j))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_deriv]
  exact J.derivative_stalkIdeal_eq_span ψ φ hφ f hf hVU hV hb

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_deriv_eq_D
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_deriv_eq_D {a : M} [IsRegularLocalRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)]
    (c : RegularCoords ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) n) (hk : c.IsLinearOver 𝕜)
    (hs : c.SpansDerivations 𝕜) : J.deriv.stalkIdeal a = c.D (J.stalkIdeal a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_deriv, Ideal.derivative_eq_D c hk hs]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem iteratedDeriv_zero : J.iteratedDeriv 0 = J
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem iteratedDeriv_succ (r : ℕ) : J.iteratedDeriv (r + 1) = (J.iteratedDeriv r).deriv
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_succ'
statement: theorem iteratedDeriv_succ' (r : ℕ) : J.iteratedDeriv (r + 1) = J.deriv.iteratedDeriv r
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply _ _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.le_iteratedDeriv
statement: theorem le_iteratedDeriv (r : ℕ) : J ≤ J.iteratedDeriv r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]; exact ih.trans (le_deriv _)

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_le_succ
statement: theorem iteratedDeriv_le_succ (r : ℕ) : J.iteratedDeriv r ≤ J.iteratedDeriv (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
  exact le_deriv _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_add
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_add (r s : ℕ) :
    J.iteratedDeriv (r + s) = (J.iteratedDeriv s).iteratedDeriv r
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_add_apply _ _ _ _

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv (r : ℕ) (a : M) :
    (J.iteratedDeriv r).stalkIdeal a = Ideal.derivativeIter 𝕜 r (J.stalkIdeal a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, stalkIdeal_deriv, ih, Ideal.derivativeIter_succ]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow {a : M}
    [IsRegularLocalRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a)]
    (c : RegularCoords ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk a) n) (hk : c.IsLinearOver 𝕜)
    (hs : c.SpansDerivations 𝕜) (r : ℕ) :
    (J.iteratedDeriv r).stalkIdeal a = c.Dpow r (J.stalkIdeal a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv, Ideal.derivativeIter_eq_Dpow c hk hs]

name: Manifold.blowUpChartMap_apply_scaling
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpChartMap_apply_scaling : blowUpChartMap σ i u (σ i) = u (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [blowUpChartMap]

name: Manifold.blowUpChartMap_apply_ratio
statement:
theorem blowUpChartMap_apply_ratio (hk : k ≠ i) :
    blowUpChartMap σ i u (σ k) = u (σ i) * u (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [blowUpChartMap, hk]

name: Manifold.blowUpChartMap_apply_off
statement:
theorem blowUpChartMap_apply_off {j : Fin n} (hj : ∀ k, σ k ≠ j) :
    blowUpChartMap σ i u j = u j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ¬ ∃ k, k ≠ i ∧ σ k = j := fun ⟨k, _, hkj⟩ => hj k hkj
  simp [blowUpChartMap, h]

name: Manifold.blowUpTransition_self
statement: theorem blowUpTransition_self (i : Fin c) : blowUpTransition (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ i i = id
proof:
:= by
  simp [blowUpTransition]

name: Manifold.blowUpTransition_apply_k
statement:
theorem blowUpTransition_apply_k (hik : i ≠ k) :
    blowUpTransition σ i k u (σ k) = u (σ i) * u (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [blowUpTransition, hik]

name: Manifold.blowUpTransition_apply_i
statement: theorem blowUpTransition_apply_i (hik : i ≠ k) : blowUpTransition σ i k u (σ i) = (u (σ k))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : σ i ≠ σ k := fun h => hik (σ.injective h)
  simp [blowUpTransition, hik, h]

name: Manifold.blowUpTransition_apply_block
statement:
theorem blowUpTransition_apply_block (hik : i ≠ k) {l : Fin c} (hli : l ≠ i) (hlk : l ≠ k) :
    blowUpTransition σ i k u (σ l) = u (σ l) / u (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 : σ l ≠ σ k := fun h => hlk (σ.injective h)
  have h2 : σ l ≠ σ i := fun h => hli (σ.injective h)
  simp [blowUpTransition, hik, h1, h2]

name: Manifold.blowUpTransition_apply_off
statement:
theorem blowUpTransition_apply_off (hik : i ≠ k) {j : Fin n} (hj : ∀ l, σ l ≠ j) :
    blowUpTransition σ i k u j = u j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 : j ≠ σ k := fun h => hj k h.symm
  have h2 : j ≠ σ i := fun h => hj i h.symm
  have h3 : ¬ ∃ l, σ l = j := fun ⟨l, hl⟩ => hj l hl
  simp [blowUpTransition, hik, h1, h2, h3]

name: Manifold.mem_blowUpTransitionDomain
statement:
theorem mem_blowUpTransitionDomain (hik : i ≠ k) :
    u ∈ blowUpTransitionDomain σ i k ↔ u (σ k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [blowUpTransitionDomain, hik]

name: Manifold.blowUpTransitionDomain_self
statement:
theorem blowUpTransitionDomain_self (i : Fin c) :
    blowUpTransitionDomain (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ i i = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  simp [blowUpTransitionDomain]

name: Manifold.blowUpChartInv_apply_scaling
statement:
theorem blowUpChartInv_apply_scaling (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n) {i : Fin c} (x : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    blowUpChartInv σ i x (σ i) = x (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [blowUpChartInv]

name: Manifold.blowUpChartInv_apply_ratio
statement:
theorem blowUpChartInv_apply_ratio (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n) {i k : Fin c} (x : Fin n → 𝕜) (hk : k ≠ i) :
    blowUpChartInv σ i x (σ k) = x (σ k) / x (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [blowUpChartInv, hk]

name: Manifold.blowUpChartInv_apply_off
statement:
theorem blowUpChartInv_apply_off (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n) {i : Fin c} (x : Fin n → 𝕜) {j : Fin n}
    (hj : ∀ k, σ k ≠ j) : blowUpChartInv σ i x j = x j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ¬ ∃ k, k ≠ i ∧ σ k = j := fun ⟨k, _, hkj⟩ => hj k hkj
  simp [blowUpChartInv, h]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.isAdaptedChart_piece
statement:
theorem isAdaptedChart_piece (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) :
    IsAdaptedChart ψ Y (pieceChart j) (pieceEmb j)
proof: := (pieceData j).2

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.mem_maximalAtlas_piece
statement:
theorem mem_maximalAtlas_piece (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) :
    pieceChart j ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M
proof: := (isAdaptedChart_piece j).1

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.exists_piece
proof:
:=
  ⟨(equivShrink (AdaptedChart ψ Y c) ⟨(φ, σ), hφ⟩, i), by simp [pieceChart, pieceData],
    by simp [pieceEmb, pieceData], rfl⟩

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.isOpen_pieceSet
statement: theorem isOpen_pieceSet (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) : IsOpen (pieceSet j)
proof:
:=
  (ψ.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap _ (pieceChart j).open_target).preimage
    (contDiff_blowUpChartMap _).continuous

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.symm_pieceMap_mem_target
statement:
theorem symm_pieceMap_mem_target {j : PieceIdx ψ Y c} {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ pieceSet j) :
    ψ.symm (pieceMap j u) ∈ (pieceChart j).target
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyu⟩ := hu
  rw [← hyu, ψ.symm_apply_apply]
  exact hy

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.blowDown_mem_source
statement:
theorem blowDown_mem_source {j : PieceIdx ψ Y c} {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ pieceSet j) :
    blowDown j u ∈ (pieceChart j).source
proof:
:=
  (pieceChart j).map_target (symm_pieceMap_mem_target hu)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.apply_blowDown
statement:
theorem apply_blowDown {j : PieceIdx ψ Y c} {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ pieceSet j) :
    ψ (pieceChart j (blowDown j u)) = pieceMap j u
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowDown, (pieceChart j).right_inv (symm_pieceMap_mem_target hu), ψ.apply_symm_apply]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.continuousOn_blowDown
statement: theorem continuousOn_blowDown (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) : ContinuousOn (blowDown j) (pieceSet j)
proof:
:=
  (pieceChart j).continuousOn_symm.comp
    (ψ.symm.continuous.comp_continuousOn (contDiff_blowUpChartMap _).continuous.continuousOn)
    fun _ hu => symm_pieceMap_mem_target hu

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.isOpen_pieceChangeDom
statement: theorem isOpen_pieceChangeDom : IsOpen (pieceChangeDom j j')
proof: := isOpen_chartChangeDom ψ

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.analyticOnNhd_pieceChange
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_pieceChange :
    AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (pieceChange j j') (pieceChangeDom j j')
proof:
:=
  analyticOnNhd_chartChange ψ (mem_maximalAtlas_piece j) (mem_maximalAtlas_piece j')

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.mem_center_iff_pieceChange
statement:
theorem mem_center_iff_pieceChange {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ pieceChangeDom j j') :
    x ∈ blowUpCenter (pieceEmb j) ↔ pieceChange j j' x ∈ blowUpCenter (pieceEmb j')
proof:
:=
  mem_center_iff_chartChange ψ (isAdaptedChart_piece j) (isAdaptedChart_piece j') hx

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transDom_subset
statement: theorem transDom_subset : transDom j j' ⊆ pieceSet j
proof:
:= fun _ hu =>
  chartChangeDom_subset ψ hu.1

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.isOpen_transDom
statement: theorem isOpen_transDom : IsOpen (transDom j j')
proof:
:=
  (analyticOnNhd_liftDir (isOpen_pieceChangeDom j j') (analyticOnNhd_pieceChange j j')
    (fun _ hx => mem_center_iff_pieceChange j j' hx) j'.2).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage
    ((isOpen_pieceChangeDom j j').preimage (contDiff_blowUpChartMap _).continuous)
    isOpen_compl_singleton

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.analyticOnNhd_transMap
statement: theorem analyticOnNhd_transMap : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (transMap j j') (transDom j j')
proof:
:=
  analyticOnNhd_liftMap (isOpen_pieceChangeDom j j') (analyticOnNhd_pieceChange j j')
    (fun _ hx => mem_center_iff_pieceChange j j' hx) j'.2

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.analyticOnNhd_transDir
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_transDir :
    AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (transDir j j') (pieceMap j ⁻¹' pieceChangeDom j j')
proof:
:=
  analyticOnNhd_liftDir (isOpen_pieceChangeDom j j') (analyticOnNhd_pieceChange j j')
    (fun _ hx => mem_center_iff_pieceChange j j' hx) j'.2

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_iff
statement:
theorem pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_iff {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ pieceSet j) :
    pieceMap j u ∈ pieceChangeDom j j' ↔ blowDown j u ∈ (pieceChart j').source
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartChangeDom_iff]
  exact and_iff_right (symm_pieceMap_mem_target hu)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_self
statement:
theorem pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_self {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ pieceSet j) :
    pieceMap j u ∈ pieceChangeDom j j
proof:
:=
  (pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_iff hu).mpr (blowDown_mem_source hu)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.pieceMap_transMap
statement:
theorem pieceMap_transMap {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ transDom j j') :
    pieceMap j' (transMap j j' u) = pieceChange j j' (pieceMap j u)
proof:
:=
  blowUpChartMap_liftMap (fun _ hx => mem_center_iff_pieceChange j j' hx) j'.2 hu.1 hu.2

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.blowDown_transMap
statement:
theorem blowDown_transMap {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ transDom j j') :
    blowDown j' (transMap j j' u) = blowDown j u
proof:
:= by
  have hx : pieceMap j u ∈ pieceChangeDom j j' := hu.1
  rw [mem_chartChangeDom_iff] at hx
  rw [blowDown, pieceMap_transMap hu, blowDown]
  simp only [pieceChange, chartChange, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    (pieceChart j').left_inv hx.2]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transMap_mem_pieceSet
statement:
theorem transMap_mem_pieceSet {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ transDom j j') :
    transMap j j' u ∈ pieceSet j'
proof:
:= by
  change pieceMap j' (transMap j j' u) ∈ ψ '' (pieceChart j').target
  rw [pieceMap_transMap hu]
  exact chartChangeDom_subset ψ (chartChange_mem ψ hu.1)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transDir_self
statement: theorem transDir_self {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ pieceSet j) : transDir j j u = 1
proof:
:=
  liftDir_self_of_eqOn_id (isOpen_pieceChangeDom j j) (fun _ hx => chartChange_self ψ hx)
    (pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_self hu)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transDom_self
statement: theorem transDom_self : transDom j j = pieceSet j
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (transDom_subset j j) fun u hu =>
    ⟨pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_self hu, ?_⟩
  change transDir j j u ≠ 0
  rw [transDir_self hu]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transMap_self
statement: theorem transMap_self {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ pieceSet j) : transMap j j u = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [transMap, liftMap_eq_blowUpTransition (isOpen_pieceChangeDom j j)
    (fun _ hx => chartChange_self ψ hx) j.2 (pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_self hu)
    (by change transDir j j u ≠ 0; rw [transDir_self hu]; exact one_ne_zero), blowUpTransition_self,
    id]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transDir_transMap
statement:
theorem transDir_transMap {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ transDom j j')
    (hu' : pieceMap j u ∈ pieceChangeDom j j'') :
    transDir j j'' u = transDir j j' u * transDir j' j'' (transMap j j' u)
proof:
:= by
  have hV : IsOpen (pieceChangeDom j j' ∩ pieceChangeDom j j'') :=
    (isOpen_pieceChangeDom j j').inter (isOpen_pieceChangeDom j j'')
  have hcomp : ∀ x ∈ pieceChangeDom j j' ∩ pieceChangeDom j j'',
      (pieceChange j' j'' ∘ pieceChange j j') x = pieceChange j j'' x := fun x hx =>
    chartChange_comp ψ hx.1
  change liftDir (pieceEmb j) (pieceEmb j'') j.2 (pieceChange j j'') j''.2 u = _
  rw [← liftDir_congr hV hcomp j''.2 ⟨hu.1, hu'⟩]
  exact liftDir_comp hV ((analyticOnNhd_pieceChange j j').mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    (fun _ hx => mem_center_iff_pieceChange j j' hx.1) (isOpen_pieceChangeDom j' j'')
    (analyticOnNhd_pieceChange j' j'') (fun _ hx => mem_center_iff_pieceChange j' j'' hx)
    (fun _ hx => chartChange_mem_of_mem ψ hx.1 hx.2) j'.2 j''.2 ⟨hu.1, hu'⟩ hu.2

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transMap_mem
statement:
theorem transMap_mem {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ transDom j j') :
    transMap j j' u ∈ transDom j' j
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : pieceMap j' (transMap j j' u) ∈ pieceChangeDom j' j := by
    rw [pieceMap_transMap hu]
    exact chartChange_mem ψ hu.1
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  change transDir j' j (transMap j j' u) ≠ 0
  have hS := transDom_subset j j' hu
  have h := transDir_transMap hu (pieceMap_mem_pieceChangeDom_self hS)
  rw [transDir_self hS] at h
  exact right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h.symm

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transMap_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem transMap_mem_of_mem {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ transDom j j') (hu' : u ∈ transDom j j'') :
    transMap j j' u ∈ transDom j' j''
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : pieceMap j' (transMap j j' u) ∈ pieceChangeDom j' j'' := by
    rw [pieceMap_transMap hu]
    exact chartChange_mem_of_mem ψ hu.1 hu'.1
  refine ⟨h1, fun h0 => ?_⟩
  have h := transDir_transMap hu hu'.1
  rw [h0, mul_zero] at h
  exact hu'.2 h

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.transMap_transMap
statement:
theorem transMap_transMap {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : u ∈ transDom j j') (hu' : u ∈ transDom j j'') :
    transMap j' j'' (transMap j j' u) = transMap j j'' u
proof:
:= by
  have hN : IsOpen (transDom j j' ∩ transDom j j'') :=
    (isOpen_transDom j j').inter (isOpen_transDom j j'')
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (transMap j j') (transDom j j' ∩ transDom j j'') (transDom j' j'') :=
    fun _ hv => transMap_mem_of_mem hv.1 hv.2
  refine eqOn_of_lift_blowUpChartMap (σ := pieceEmb j) (τ := pieceEmb j'') (i := j.2) (k := j''.2)
    (g := pieceChange j j'') hN
    ((analyticOnNhd_transMap j' j'').continuousOn.comp
      ((analyticOnNhd_transMap j j').continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left) hmaps)
    ((analyticOnNhd_transMap j j'').continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_right) ?_ ?_ ?_ ⟨hu, hu'⟩
  · rintro v ⟨hv, hv'⟩
    change pieceMap j'' (transMap j' j'' (transMap j j' v)) = pieceChange j j'' (pieceMap j v)
    rw [pieceMap_transMap (transMap_mem_of_mem hv hv'), pieceMap_transMap hv]
    exact chartChange_comp ψ hv.1
  · rintro v ⟨-, hv'⟩
    exact pieceMap_transMap hv'
  · rintro v ⟨-, hv'⟩ hvi hmem
    have h := (mem_center_iff_pieceChange j j'' hv'.1).mpr hmem
    exact hvi ((blowUpChartMap_mem_center_iff (pieceEmb j) v).mp h)

name: Manifold.hasFDerivAt_blowUpChartMap
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_blowUpChartMap :
    HasFDerivAt (blowUpChartMap σ i) (blowUpChartMapDeriv σ i u) u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr fun j => ?_
  by_cases h : ∃ k, k ≠ i ∧ σ k = j
  · simp only [blowUpChartMap, h, ite_true]
    have := (hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := 𝕜) (σ i) u).mul (hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := 𝕜) j u)
    exact this
  · simp only [blowUpChartMap, h, ite_false]
    exact hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := 𝕜) j u

name: Manifold.fderiv_blowUpChartMap
statement: theorem fderiv_blowUpChartMap : fderiv 𝕜 (blowUpChartMap σ i) u = blowUpChartMapDeriv σ i u
proof:
:=
  (hasFDerivAt_blowUpChartMap σ i u).fderiv

name: Manifold.not_exists_ne_and_apply_eq_self
statement: theorem not_exists_ne_and_apply_eq_self : ¬ ∃ k, k ≠ i ∧ σ k = σ i
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨_, hk, hke⟩ => hk (σ.injective hke)

name: Manifold.toMatrix'_blowUpChartMapDeriv
statement:
theorem toMatrix'_blowUpChartMapDeriv :
    LinearMap.toMatrix' (blowUpChartMapDeriv σ i u : (Fin n → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜)) =
      (diagonal (jacobianDiag σ i u)).updateCol (σ i)
        ((fun j => diagonal (jacobianDiag σ i u) j (σ i)) + jacobianCol σ i u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext j k
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix'_apply, updateCol_apply]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  change blowUpChartMapDeriv σ i u (Pi.single k 1) j = _
  simp only [blowUpChartMapDeriv, ContinuousLinearMap.pi_apply]
  by_cases hk : k = σ i
  · subst hk
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
    by_cases h : ∃ l, l ≠ i ∧ σ l = j
    · have hj : j ≠ σ i := fun hji => not_exists_ne_and_apply_eq_self σ i (hji ▸ h)
      rw [ite_eq_left h, _root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.single_apply,
        Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_right hj, ite_eq_left rfl,
        smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, diagonal_apply_ne _ hj, zero_add,
        jacobianCol, ite_eq_left h]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.single_apply, jacobianCol,
        ite_eq_right h, add_zero]
      by_cases hj : j = σ i
      · subst hj
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl, diagonal_apply_eq, jacobianDiag,
          ite_eq_right (not_exists_ne_and_apply_eq_self σ i)]
      · rw [ite_eq_right hj, diagonal_apply_ne _ hj]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hk]
    have hk' : σ i ≠ k := Ne.symm hk
    by_cases h : ∃ l, l ≠ i ∧ σ l = j
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, _root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.single_apply,
        Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_right hk', smul_eq_mul,
        smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, diagonal_apply, jacobianDiag, ite_eq_left h]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.single_apply, diagonal_apply,
        jacobianDiag, ite_eq_right h]

name: Manifold.prod_jacobianDiag
statement: theorem prod_jacobianDiag : ∏ j, jacobianDiag σ i u j = u (σ i) ^ (c - 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [jacobianDiag]
  rw [Finset.prod_ite, Finset.prod_const, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one]
  congr 1
  have himg : (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin n => ∃ k, k ≠ i ∧ σ k = j) =
      (Finset.univ.erase i).image σ := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_erase,
      and_true]
  rw [himg, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ σ.injective,
    Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Manifold.det_fderiv_blowUpChartMap
statement:
theorem det_fderiv_blowUpChartMap :
    (fderiv 𝕜 (blowUpChartMap σ i) u).det = u (σ i) ^ (c - 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [fderiv_blowUpChartMap]
  change LinearMap.det (blowUpChartMapDeriv σ i u : (Fin n → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜)) = _
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix', toMatrix'_blowUpChartMapDeriv, det_updateCol_add,
    updateCol_eq_self, det_diagonal, prod_jacobianDiag, det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero (σ i), add_zero]
  intro k
  rw [updateCol_apply]
  split_ifs with hk
  · simp [jacobianCol]
  · exact diagonal_apply_ne _ (Ne.symm hk)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.pieceEmbChart_symm_toGlued
statement:
theorem pieceEmbChart_symm_toGlued (u : pieceSet j) :
    (pieceEmbChart j hj).symm (toGlued j u) = u
proof:
:=
  haveI : Nonempty (pieceSet j) := hj.to_subtype
  IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_left_inv (toGlued j) (isOpenEmbedding_toGlued j)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.pieceEmbChart_target
statement: theorem pieceEmbChart_target : (pieceEmbChart j hj).target = Set.range (toGlued j)
proof:
:=
  haveI : Nonempty (pieceSet j) := hj.to_subtype
  IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target (toGlued j) (isOpenEmbedding_toGlued j)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.gluedChart_source
statement: theorem gluedChart_source : (gluedChart j hj).source = Set.range (toGlued j)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.gluedChart_target
statement: theorem gluedChart_target : (gluedChart j hj).target = ψ ⁻¹' pieceSet j
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.gluedChart_toGlued
statement: theorem gluedChart_toGlued (u : pieceSet j) : gluedChart j hj (toGlued j u) = ψ.symm u
proof:
:= by
  change ψ.symm ((pieceEmbChart j hj).symm (toGlued j u)).1 = ψ.symm u
  rw [pieceEmbChart_symm_toGlued]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.gluedChart_symm_apply
statement:
theorem gluedChart_symm_apply {v : E} (hv : ψ v ∈ pieceSet j) :
    (gluedChart j hj).symm v = toGlued j ⟨ψ v, hv⟩
proof:
:= by
  change (if h : ψ v ∈ pieceSet j then toGlued j ⟨ψ v, h⟩
    else toGlued j ⟨hj.some, hj.some_mem⟩) = _
  rw [dite_eq_left hv]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.toGlued_mem_gluedChart_source
statement:
theorem toGlued_mem_gluedChart_source (u : pieceSet j) :
    toGlued j u ∈ (gluedChart j hj).source
proof: := ⟨u, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.pieceSet_pieceOf_nonempty
statement: theorem pieceSet_pieceOf_nonempty (p : Glued ψ Y c) : (pieceSet (pieceOf p)).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, (pieceElt p).2⟩

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.mem_atlas_iff
statement:
theorem mem_atlas_iff {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Glued ψ Y c) E} :
    Φ ∈ atlas E (Glued ψ Y c) ↔
      ∃ (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) (hj : (pieceSet j).Nonempty), Φ = gluedChart j hj
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.gluedChart_mem_atlas
statement:
theorem gluedChart_mem_atlas (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) (hj : (pieceSet j).Nonempty) :
    gluedChart j hj ∈ atlas E (Glued ψ Y c)
proof: := ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.gluedChart_transition
statement:
theorem gluedChart_transition {j j' : PieceIdx ψ Y c} (hj : (pieceSet j).Nonempty)
    (hj' : (pieceSet j').Nonempty) {v : E}
    (hv : v ∈ (gluedChart j hj).target ∩ (gluedChart j hj).symm ⁻¹' (gluedChart j' hj').source) :
    ψ v ∈ transDom j j' ∧
      gluedChart j' hj' ((gluedChart j hj).symm v) = ψ.symm (transMap j j' (ψ v))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ := hv
  rw [gluedChart_target, Set.mem_preimage] at hv1
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, gluedChart_symm_apply j hj hv1, gluedChart_source,
    toGlued_mem_range_iff] at hv2
  refine ⟨hv2, ?_⟩
  rw [gluedChart_symm_apply j hj hv1, ← toGlued_transMap hv2, gluedChart_toGlued]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.gluedChart_mem_maximalAtlas
statement:
theorem gluedChart_mem_maximalAtlas (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) (hj : (pieceSet j).Nonempty) :
    gluedChart j hj ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (Glued ψ Y c)
proof:
:=
  IsManifold.subset_maximalAtlas (gluedChart_mem_atlas j hj)

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.exists_disjoint_open_of_ne_same_piece
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_open_of_ne_same_piece (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) {u u' : pieceSet j}
    (h : u ≠ u') :
    ∃ U V : Set (Glued ψ Y c), IsOpen U ∧ IsOpen V ∧ toGlued j u ∈ U ∧ toGlued j u' ∈ V ∧
      Disjoint U V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hu, hu', hUV⟩ := t2_separation h
  exact ⟨toGlued j '' U, toGlued j '' V, (isOpenEmbedding_toGlued j).isOpenMap _ hU,
    (isOpenEmbedding_toGlued j).isOpenMap _ hV, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, ⟨u', hu', rfl⟩,
    (Set.disjoint_image_iff (toGlued_injective j)).mpr hUV⟩

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.exists_disjoint_open_same_chart
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_open_same_chart (s : Shrink.{u} (AdaptedChart ψ Y c)) (k k' : Fin c)
    (w : pieceSet (s, k)) (w' : pieceSet (s, k')) (hne : toGlued (s, k) w ≠ toGlued (s, k') w') :
    ∃ U V : Set (Glued ψ Y c), IsOpen U ∧ IsOpen V ∧ toGlued (s, k) w ∈ U ∧
      toGlued (s, k') w' ∈ V ∧ Disjoint U V
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : (w : Fin n → 𝕜) ∈ transDom (s, k) (s, k')
  · have h := toGlued_transMap hw
    rw [← h] at hne ⊢
    exact exists_disjoint_open_of_ne_same_piece (s, k') fun h' => hne (congrArg _ h')
  by_cases hw' : (w' : Fin n → 𝕜) ∈ transDom (s, k') (s, k)
  · have h := toGlued_transMap hw'
    rw [← h] at hne ⊢
    exact exists_disjoint_open_of_ne_same_piece (s, k) fun h' => hne (congrArg _ h')
  have hkk' : k ≠ k' := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hw (by rw [transDom_self]; exact w.2)
  rw [mem_transDom_same s k k' (Ne.symm hkk')] at hw
  rw [mem_transDom_same s k' k hkk'] at hw'
  push Not at hw hw'
  have h1 : (w : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k) k') = 0 := hw w.2
  have h2 : (w' : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k') k) = 0 := hw' w'.2
  refine ⟨toGlued (s, k) '' {v | ‖(v : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k) k')‖ < 1},
    toGlued (s, k') '' {v | ‖(v : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k') k)‖ < 1}, ?_, ?_,
    ⟨w, by change ‖_‖ < 1; rw [h1, norm_zero]; exact zero_lt_one, rfl⟩,
    ⟨w', by change ‖_‖ < 1; rw [h2, norm_zero]; exact zero_lt_one, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact (isOpenEmbedding_toGlued _).isOpenMap _
      (isOpen_lt ((continuous_apply _).comp continuous_subtype_val).norm continuous_const)
  · exact (isOpenEmbedding_toGlued _).isOpenMap _
      (isOpen_lt ((continuous_apply _).comp continuous_subtype_val).norm continuous_const)
  · rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hb, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨hdom, hb'⟩ := toGlued_eq_iff.mp hab.symm
    have hdom' := hdom
    rw [mem_transDom_same s k k' (Ne.symm hkk')] at hdom'
    have hbk : (b : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k) k) = ((a : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k) k'))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← hb', transMap_same s k k' hdom, blowUpTransition_apply_i _ _ hkk']
    have ha1 : ‖(a : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k) k')‖ < 1 := ha
    have hb1 : ‖(b : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k) k)‖ < 1 := hb
    rw [hbk, norm_inv] at hb1
    have hpos : 0 < ‖(a : Fin n → 𝕜) (pieceEmb (s, k) k')‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hdom'.2
    have hlt := (mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) hb1.le).trans_lt ha1
    rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hpos.ne'] at hlt
    exact lt_irrefl _ hlt

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.mem_source_chartIdxAt
statement: theorem mem_source_chartIdxAt (a : M) : a ∈ (pieceChart (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a, i₀)).source
proof:
:=
  (exists_piece_mem_source hY σ₀ i₀ a).choose_spec

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.t2Space_glued
statement: theorem t2Space_glued [T2Space M] : T2Space (Glued ψ Y c)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p q hpq => ?_⟩
  by_cases hproj : gluedProj p = gluedProj q
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_piece_mem_source hY σ₀ i₀ (gluedProj p)
    obtain ⟨k, w, rfl⟩ := exists_toGlued_eq p s hs
    have hs' : gluedProj q ∈ (pieceChart (s, i₀)).source := by rw [← hproj]; exact hs
    obtain ⟨k', w', rfl⟩ := exists_toGlued_eq q s hs'
    exact exists_disjoint_open_same_chart s k k' w w' hpq
  · obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hp, hq, hUV⟩ := t2_separation hproj
    exact ⟨gluedProj ⁻¹' U, gluedProj ⁻¹' V, hU.preimage continuous_gluedProj,
      hV.preimage continuous_gluedProj, hp, hq, hUV.preimage _⟩

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.secondCountableTopology_glued
statement:
theorem secondCountableTopology_glued [SecondCountableTopology M] :
    SecondCountableTopology (Glued ψ Y c)
proof:
:= by
  have : ProperSpace (Fin n → 𝕜) := FiniteDimensional.proper_rclike 𝕜 _
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcover⟩ := countable_cover_nhds
    (f := fun a : M => (pieceChart (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a, i₀)).source)
    fun a => (pieceChart _).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_source_chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a)
  have hb : ∀ j : PieceIdx ψ Y c,
      ∃ b : Set (Set (pieceSet j)), b.Countable ∧ IsTopologicalBasis b := fun j => by
    obtain ⟨b, hb1, -, hb3⟩ := exists_countable_basis (α := pieceSet j)
    exact ⟨b, hb1, hb3⟩
  choose b hbc hbb using hb
  let B : Set (Set (Glued ψ Y c)) := ⋃ a ∈ S, ⋃ k : Fin c,
    (fun v => toGlued (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a, k) '' v) '' b (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a, k)
  have hBc : B.Countable :=
    hS.biUnion fun a _ => Set.countable_iUnion fun k => (hbc _).image _
  refine (isTopologicalBasis_of_isOpen_of_nhds ?_ ?_).secondCountableTopology hBc
  · intro U hU
    obtain ⟨a, -, hU⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hU
    obtain ⟨k, hU⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hU
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hU
    exact (isOpenEmbedding_toGlued _).isOpenMap _ ((hbb _).isOpen hv)
  · intro p U hpU hU
    have hmem : gluedProj p ∈ ⋃ a ∈ S, (pieceChart (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a, i₀)).source := by
      rw [hcover]
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    obtain ⟨a, haS, ha⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hmem
    obtain ⟨k, w, rfl⟩ := exists_toGlued_eq p (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a) ha
    obtain ⟨v, hvb, hwv, hvU⟩ := (hbb (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a, k)).exists_subset_of_mem_open
      (show w ∈ toGlued (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a, k) ⁻¹' U from hpU)
      (hU.preimage (continuous_toGlued _))
    refine ⟨toGlued (chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ a, k) '' v, ?_, ⟨w, hwv, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a, haS, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k, v, hvb, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact hvU hx

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.isProperMap_gluedProj
statement: theorem isProperMap_gluedProj [T2Space M] : IsProperMap (gluedProj : Glued ψ Y c → M)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E := ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have : ProperSpace E := FiniteDimensional.proper_rclike 𝕜 E
  have : ProperSpace (Fin n → 𝕜) := FiniteDimensional.proper_rclike 𝕜 _
  have : LocallyCompactSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyCompactSpace E M
  rw [isProperMap_iff_isCompact_preimage]
  refine ⟨continuous_gluedProj, fun K hK => ?_⟩
  set s : M → Shrink.{u} (AdaptedChart ψ Y c) := chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀ with hs_def
  have hs : ∀ a, a ∈ (pieceChart (s a, i₀)).source := mem_source_chartIdxAt hY σ₀ i₀
  
  have hball : ∀ a : M, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      Metric.closedBall (ψ (pieceChart (s a, i₀) a)) r ⊆ ψ '' (pieceChart (s a, i₀)).target := by
    intro a
    have hopen : IsOpen (ψ '' (pieceChart (s a, i₀)).target) :=
      ψ.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap _ (pieceChart _).open_target
    have hmem : ψ (pieceChart (s a, i₀) a) ∈ ψ '' (pieceChart (s a, i₀)).target :=
      ⟨_, (pieceChart _).map_source (hs a), rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen _ hmem
    exact ⟨r / 2, half_pos hr, (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hr)).trans hsub⟩
  choose r hr hrsub using hball
  
  let O : M → Set M := fun a => (pieceChart (s a, i₀)).source ∩
    pieceChart (s a, i₀) ⁻¹' (ψ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (ψ (pieceChart (s a, i₀) a)) (r a))
  have hO : ∀ a, IsOpen (O a) := fun a =>
    (pieceChart _).isOpen_inter_preimage (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage ψ.continuous)
  have hKO : K ⊆ ⋃ a, O a := fun a _ =>
    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a, hs a, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr a)⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover O hO hKO
  
  let Box : M → Fin c → Set (Glued ψ Y c) := fun a k => toGlued (s a, k) ''
    (Subtype.val ⁻¹' {u : Fin n → 𝕜 |
      blowUpChartMap (pieceEmb (s a, k)) k u ∈
        Metric.closedBall (ψ (pieceChart (s a, i₀) a)) (r a) ∧
      ∀ l, l ≠ k → ‖u (pieceEmb (s a, k) l)‖ ≤ 1})
  have hBox : ∀ a k, IsCompact (Box a k) := by
    intro a k
    have hC := isCompact_blowUpChartMap_preimage_inter_box (pieceEmb (s a, k)) (i := k)
      (isCompact_closedBall (ψ (pieceChart (s a, i₀) a)) (r a))
    have hind := (isOpen_pieceSet (s a, k)).isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isInducing
    refine ((hind.isCompact_preimage_iff ?_).mpr hC).image (continuous_toGlued _)
    rintro u ⟨hu1, -⟩
    rw [Subtype.range_val]
    exact hrsub a hu1
  refine IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset
    (t.finite_toSet.isCompact_biUnion fun a _ => isCompact_iUnion (hBox a))
    (hK.isClosed.preimage continuous_gluedProj) ?_
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨a, hat, has, hpb⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht hp)
  obtain ⟨k', w, rfl⟩ := exists_toGlued_eq p (s a) has
  obtain ⟨k, hkdom, hkbox⟩ :=
    exists_blowUpTransition_mem_box (pieceEmb (s a, k')) (i := k') (w : Fin n → 𝕜)
  have hw' : (w : Fin n → 𝕜) ∈ transDom (s a, k') (s a, k) := by
    by_cases hkk : k' = k
    · subst hkk
      rw [transDom_self]
      exact w.2
    · rw [mem_transDom_same (s a) k' k (Ne.symm hkk)]
      exact ⟨w.2, (mem_blowUpTransitionDomain _ _ hkk).mp hkdom⟩
  have hπ : pieceMap (s a, k') w = ψ (pieceChart (s a, i₀) (gluedProj (toGlued (s a, k') w))) := by
    rw [gluedProj_toGlued, pieceChart_mk (s a) i₀ k', apply_blowDown w.2]
  refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a, hat, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k,
    ⟨transMap (s a, k') (s a, k) w, transMap_mem_pieceSet hw'⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, toGlued_transMap hw'⟩⟩
  · change blowUpChartMap (pieceEmb (s a, k)) k (transMap (s a, k') (s a, k) w) ∈ _
    rw [transMap_same _ _ _ hw', pieceEmb_mk (s a) k k',
      blowUpChartMap_blowUpTransition _ _ hkdom]
    change pieceMap (s a, k') w ∈ _
    rw [hπ]
    exact Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hpb
  · intro l hl
    change ‖transMap (s a, k') (s a, k) w (pieceEmb (s a, k) l)‖ ≤ 1
    rw [transMap_same _ _ _ hw']
    exact hkbox l hl

name: Manifold.mem_maximalAtlas_trans_of_mem_groupoid
proof:
:= by
  intro e' he'
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := he e' he'
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_symm_eq_symm_trans_symm, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_assoc]
    exact G.trans (G.symm hf) h1
  · rw [← OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_assoc]
    exact G.trans h2 hf

name: Manifold.addRight_mem_contDiffGroupoid
statement:
theorem addRight_mem_contDiffGroupoid (t : E) :
    (Homeomorph.addRight t).toOpenPartialHomeomorph ∈ contDiffGroupoid ω 𝓘(𝕜, E)
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_contDiffGroupoid_omega_of_analytic' _ (fun x _ => ?_) (fun x _ => ?_)
  · have h : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (fun y : E => y + t) x := analyticAt_id.add analyticAt_const
    refine h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    rw [Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply, Homeomorph.coe_addRight]
  · have h : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (fun y : E => y + -t) x := analyticAt_id.add analyticAt_const
    refine h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    rw [← Homeomorph.symm_toOpenPartialHomeomorph, Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply,
      Homeomorph.addRight_symm, Homeomorph.coe_addRight]

name: Manifold.exists_isAdaptedChart_of_notMem
statement:
theorem exists_isAdaptedChart_of_notMem (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n)
    (i₀ : Fin c) {a : M} (ha : a ∉ Y) :
    ∃ φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E, a ∈ φ.source ∧ IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ σ
proof:
:= by
  set e := chartAt E a with he
  set x₀ : 𝕜 := ψ (e a) (σ i₀) with hx₀
  set s : Set M := Yᶜ ∩ (e.source ∩ e ⁻¹' (ψ ⁻¹' {x | ‖x (σ i₀) - x₀‖ < 1})) with hs_def
  have hsopen : IsOpen s := by
    refine hY.isClosed.isOpen_compl.inter (e.isOpen_inter_preimage ?_)
    exact (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).preimage ψ.continuous
  set t : E := ψ.symm (Pi.single (σ i₀) (1 - x₀)) with ht
  refine ⟨(e.restrOpen s hsopen).trans (Homeomorph.addRight t).toOpenPartialHomeomorph, ?_, ?_,
    ?_⟩
  · simp only [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source,
      Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source, Set.preimage_univ, Set.inter_univ]
    refine ⟨mem_chart_source E a, ha, mem_chart_source E a, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hx₀, sub_self, norm_zero]
    exact zero_lt_one
  · rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_eq_restr]
    exact mem_maximalAtlas_trans_of_mem_groupoid
      (restr_mem_maximalAtlas _ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a) hsopen)
      (addRight_mem_contDiffGroupoid t)
  · intro x hx
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hxY, -, hxlt⟩, -⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨fun h => absurd h hxY, fun h => ?_⟩
    exfalso
    have h1 := h i₀
    simp only [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_apply, Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply,
      Homeomorph.coe_addRight, OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_restrOpen, map_add, Pi.add_apply, ht,
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Pi.single_eq_same] at h1
    have h2 : ψ (e x) (σ i₀) - x₀ = -1 := by linear_combination h1
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, h2, norm_neg, norm_one] at hxlt
    exact lt_irrefl _ hxlt

name: Manifold.isOpen_chartChangeDom
statement: theorem isOpen_chartChangeDom : IsOpen (chartChangeDom ψ φ φ')
proof:
:=
  ψ.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap _ (φ.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm φ'.open_source)

name: Manifold.mem_chartChangeDom_iff
statement:
theorem mem_chartChangeDom_iff {x : Fin n → 𝕜} :
    x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ φ' ↔ ψ.symm x ∈ φ.target ∧ φ.symm (ψ.symm x) ∈ φ'.source
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simpa using hy
  · intro h
    exact ⟨ψ.symm x, h, ψ.apply_symm_apply x⟩

name: Manifold.mem_chartChangeDom_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_chartChangeDom_of_mem {y : M} (hy : y ∈ φ.source) (hy' : y ∈ φ'.source) :
    ψ (φ y) ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ φ'
proof:
:=
  ⟨φ y, ⟨φ.map_source hy, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, φ.left_inv hy]; exact hy'⟩, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.chartChangeDom_subset
statement: theorem chartChangeDom_subset : chartChangeDom ψ φ φ' ⊆ ψ '' φ.target
proof:
:=
  Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_left

name: Manifold.chartChange_mem
statement:
theorem chartChange_mem {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ φ') :
    chartChange ψ φ φ' x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ' φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartChangeDom_iff] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [chartChange, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact φ'.map_source h2
  · simp only [chartChange, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, φ'.left_inv h2]
    exact φ.map_target h1

name: Manifold.chartChange_chartChange
statement:
theorem chartChange_chartChange {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ φ') :
    chartChange ψ φ' φ (chartChange ψ φ φ' x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartChangeDom_iff] at hx
  simp only [chartChange, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, φ'.left_inv hx.2,
    φ.right_inv hx.1, ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Manifold.bijOn_chartChange
statement:
theorem bijOn_chartChange :
    Set.BijOn (chartChange ψ φ φ') (chartChangeDom ψ φ φ') (chartChangeDom ψ φ' φ)
proof:
:=
  Set.InvOn.bijOn
    ⟨fun _ hx => chartChange_chartChange ψ hx, fun _ hx => chartChange_chartChange ψ hx⟩
    (fun _ hx => chartChange_mem ψ hx) (fun _ hx => chartChange_mem ψ hx)

name: Manifold.chartChange_self
statement:
theorem chartChange_self {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ φ) :
    chartChange ψ φ φ x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartChangeDom_iff] at hx
  simp only [chartChange, φ.right_inv hx.1, ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Manifold.chartChange_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem chartChange_mem_of_mem {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ φ')
    (hx' : x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ φ'') : chartChange ψ φ φ' x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ' φ''
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartChangeDom_iff] at hx hx' ⊢
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [chartChange, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact φ'.map_source hx.2
  · simp only [chartChange, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, φ'.left_inv hx.2]
    exact hx'.2

name: Manifold.chartChange_comp
statement:
theorem chartChange_comp {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ chartChangeDom ψ φ φ') :
    chartChange ψ φ' φ'' (chartChange ψ φ φ' x) = chartChange ψ φ φ'' x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartChangeDom_iff] at hx
  simp only [chartChange, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, φ'.left_inv hx.2]

name: Manifold.analyticOnNhd_chartChange
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_chartChange (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    (hφ' : φ' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M) :
    AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (chartChange ψ φ φ') (chartChangeDom ψ φ φ')
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (φ' ∘ φ.symm) (φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' φ'.source) :=
    (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ').comp
      ((contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ).mono Set.inter_subset_left) fun _ hx => hx.2
  have h2 : ContDiffOn 𝕜 ω (φ' ∘ φ.symm) (φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' φ'.source) :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  have hopen : IsOpen (φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' φ'.source) :=
    φ.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm φ'.open_source
  rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have hy' : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (φ' ∘ φ.symm) y := (h2.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hy)).analyticAt
  have hψ : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (⇑ψ) (φ' (φ.symm y)) := ψ.toContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt _
  have hψs : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (⇑ψ.symm) (ψ y) := ψ.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt _
  have h : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (⇑ψ ∘ (φ' ∘ φ.symm) ∘ ⇑ψ.symm) (ψ y) :=
    hψ.comp_of_eq (hy'.comp_of_eq hψs (ψ.symm_apply_apply y)) (by simp)
  exact h

name: Manifold.mem_center_iff_chartChange
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_chartChangeDom_iff] at hx
  have h1 := hφ.2 _ (φ.map_target hx.1)
  have h2 := hφ'.2 _ hx.2
  rw [φ.right_inv hx.1, ψ.apply_symm_apply] at h1
  exact h1.symm.trans h2

name: Manifold.exists_isBlowUp_of_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_isBlowUp_of_embedding (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (σ₀ : Fin c ↪ Fin n)
    (i₀ : Fin c) :
    ∃ (M' : Type u) (_ : TopologicalSpace M') (_ : ChartedSpace E M')
      (_ : IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M') (_ : T2Space M') (_ : SecondCountableTopology M')
      (π : M' → M), IsBlowUp ψ Y c π
proof:
:= by
  have := t2Space_glued hY σ₀ i₀
  have := secondCountableTopology_glued hY σ₀ i₀
  refine ⟨Glued ψ Y c, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    gluedProj, ?_⟩
  exact
    { contMDiff := contMDiff_gluedProj
      isProperMap := isProperMap_gluedProj hY σ₀ i₀
      isLocalDiffeomorphOn_compl := isLocalDiffeomorphOn_gluedProj
      bijOn_compl := bijOn_gluedProj hY σ₀ i₀
      exists_chart := fun φ _ hφ i => by
        have : Nonempty M := ⟨φ.symm 0⟩
        have := nonempty_glued hY σ₀ i₀
        exact exists_isBlowUpChart hφ i
      cover := fun _ _ hφ p hp => exists_isBlowUpChart_mem_source hφ p hp }

name: Manifold.exists_isBlowUp_of_c_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_isBlowUp_of_c_eq_zero (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y 0) :
    ∃ (M' : Type u) (_ : TopologicalSpace M') (_ : ChartedSpace E M')
      (_ : IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M') (_ : T2Space M') (_ : SecondCountableTopology M')
      (π : M' → M), IsBlowUp ψ Y 0 π
proof:
:= by
  have hYopen : IsOpen Y := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨φ, σ, haφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart a ha
    exact ⟨φ.source, fun x hx => (hφ.2 x hx).mpr fun i => i.elim0, φ.open_source, haφ⟩
  have hYc : IsClosed Yᶜ := IsOpen.isClosed_compl hYopen
  let U : Opens M := ⟨Yᶜ, hY.isClosed.isOpen_compl⟩
  refine ⟨U, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    Subtype.val, ?_⟩
  refine
    { contMDiff := contMDiff_subtype_val
      isProperMap :=
        Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.isProperMap (IsClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal hYc)
      isLocalDiffeomorphOn_compl := fun x =>
        IsLocalDiffeomorphAt.of_eqOn (opensValDiffeo U x.1) (Set.mem_univ _) fun _ _ => rfl
      bijOn_compl :=
        ⟨fun x _ => x.2, fun _ _ _ _ h => Subtype.ext h, fun a ha => ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ha, rfl⟩⟩
      exists_chart := fun _ _ _ i => i.elim0
      cover := fun _ _ hφ p hp => ?_ }
  exact (p.2 ((hφ.2 _ hp).mpr fun i => i.elim0)).elim

name: Manifold.exists_isBlowUp_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem exists_isBlowUp_of_isEmpty (hemp : IsEmpty (Fin c ↪ Fin n)) :
    ∃ (M' : Type u) (_ : TopologicalSpace M') (_ : ChartedSpace E M')
      (_ : IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M') (_ : T2Space M') (_ : SecondCountableTopology M')
      (π : M' → M), IsBlowUp ψ Y c π
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨M, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, id, ?_⟩
  refine
    { contMDiff := contMDiff_id
      isProperMap := isProperMap_id
      isLocalDiffeomorphOn_compl := fun _ =>
        IsLocalDiffeomorphAt.of_eqOn (Diffeomorph.refl 𝓘(𝕜, E) M ω).toPartialDiffeomorphUniv
          (Set.mem_univ _) fun _ _ => rfl
      bijOn_compl := by rw [Set.preimage_id]; exact Set.bijOn_id _
      exists_chart := fun _ σ _ _ => (hemp.false σ).elim
      cover := fun _ σ _ _ _ => (hemp.false σ).elim }

name: Manifold.exists_isBlowUp
statement:
theorem exists_isBlowUp (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) :
    ∃ (M' : Type u) (_ : TopologicalSpace M') (_ : ChartedSpace E M')
      (_ : IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M') (_ : T2Space M') (_ : SecondCountableTopology M')
      (π : M' → M), IsBlowUp ψ Y c π
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos c with hc | hc
  · subst hc
    exact exists_isBlowUp_of_c_eq_zero ψ hY
  · by_cases hcn : c ≤ n
    · exact exists_isBlowUp_of_embedding ψ hY (Fin.castLEEmb hcn) ⟨0, hc⟩
    · refine exists_isBlowUp_of_isEmpty ψ ⟨fun σ => hcn ?_⟩
      simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_embedding σ

name: Manifold.blowUpSpace_spec
statement:
theorem blowUpSpace_spec :
    ∃ (_ : IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (BlowUpSpace ψ hY)) (_ : T2Space (BlowUpSpace ψ hY))
      (_ : SecondCountableTopology (BlowUpSpace ψ hY)) (π : BlowUpSpace ψ hY → M),
      IsBlowUp ψ Y c π
proof:
:=
  (exists_isBlowUp ψ hY).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec

name: Manifold.isBlowUp_blowUpMap
statement: theorem isBlowUp_blowUpMap : IsBlowUp ψ Y c (blowUpMap ψ hY)
proof:
:=
  (blowUpSpace_spec ψ hY).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec

name: TopologicalSpace.Opens.openPartialHomeomorphSubtypeCoe_symm_apply
proof:
:=
  IsOpenEmbedding.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_left_inv (Subtype.val : s → M)
    s.2.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal (x := ⟨x, hx⟩)

name: TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_extendChart_source_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_extendChart_source_iff {x : M} :
    x ∈ (Opens.extendChart hs φ).source ↔ ∃ hx : x ∈ s, (⟨x, hx⟩ : s) ∈ φ.source
proof:
:= by
  rw [Opens.extendChart, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source,
    Opens.openPartialHomeomorphSubtypeCoe_target]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hx'⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Opens.openPartialHomeomorphSubtypeCoe_symm_apply hs hx] at hx'
    exact hx'
  · rintro ⟨hx, hx'⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Opens.openPartialHomeomorphSubtypeCoe_symm_apply hs hx]
    exact hx'

name: TopologicalSpace.Opens.extendChart_source_subset
statement:
theorem _root_.TopologicalSpace.Opens.extendChart_source_subset :
    (Opens.extendChart hs φ).source ⊆ s
proof:
:= fun _ hx =>
  ((Opens.mem_extendChart_source_iff hs φ).mp hx).1

name: TopologicalSpace.Opens.extendChart_apply
statement:
theorem _root_.TopologicalSpace.Opens.extendChart_apply {x : M} (hx : x ∈ s) :
    Opens.extendChart hs φ x = φ ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [Opens.extendChart, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_apply,
    Opens.openPartialHomeomorphSubtypeCoe_symm_apply hs hx]

name: TopologicalSpace.Opens.extendChart_target
statement:
theorem _root_.TopologicalSpace.Opens.extendChart_target : (Opens.extendChart hs φ).target =
    φ.target
proof:
:= by
  rw [Opens.extendChart, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_target, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_target,
    Opens.openPartialHomeomorphSubtypeCoe_source, Set.preimage_univ, Set.inter_univ]

name: Manifold.subtypeRestr_mem_maximalAtlas_of_mem_maximalAtlas
statement:
theorem subtypeRestr_mem_maximalAtlas_of_mem_maximalAtlas {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M H}
    (he : e ∈ G.maximalAtlas M) : e.subtypeRestr hs ∈ G.maximalAtlas s
proof:
:= by
  intro e' he'
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Opens.chart_eq hs he'
  exact ⟨G.mem_of_eqOnSource (closedUnderRestriction'
      (G.compatible_of_mem_maximalAtlas he (G.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (x : M)))
      (e.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm s.2)) (e.subtypeRestr_symm_trans_subtypeRestr hs _),
    G.mem_of_eqOnSource (closedUnderRestriction'
      (G.compatible_of_mem_maximalAtlas (G.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (x : M)) he)
      ((chartAt H (x : M)).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm s.2))
      ((chartAt H (x : M)).subtypeRestr_symm_trans_subtypeRestr hs _)⟩

name: TopologicalSpace.Opens.extendChart_mem_maximalAtlas
statement:
theorem _root_.TopologicalSpace.Opens.extendChart_mem_maximalAtlas (hφ : φ ∈ G.maximalAtlas s) :
    Opens.extendChart hs φ ∈ G.maximalAtlas M
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have h1 := G.compatible_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ (G.subtypeRestr_mem_maximalAtlas he hs)
  have h2 := G.compatible_of_mem_maximalAtlas (G.subtypeRestr_mem_maximalAtlas he hs) hφ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Opens.extendChart, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_symm_eq_symm_trans_symm,
      OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_symm, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_assoc,
      ← OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeRestr_def]
    exact h1
  · rw [Opens.extendChart, ← OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_assoc,
      ← OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_symm_eq_symm_trans_symm,
      ← OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeRestr_def]
    exact h2

name: Manifold.contMDiff_codRestrict_opens
statement:
theorem contMDiff_codRestrict_opens {f : N → M} (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E') 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f)
    {V : Opens M} {W : Opens N} {f' : W → V} (hf' : ∀ p, (f' p : M) = f p) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E') 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω f'
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have h1 : Subtype.val ∘ f' = f ∘ Subtype.val := funext hf'
  have : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E') 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (Subtype.val ∘ f') p := by
    rw [h1]
    exact (hf.comp contMDiff_subtype_val) p
  exact (ChartedSpace.liftPropWithinAt_subtypeVal_comp_iff f' Set.univ p).mp this

name: Manifold.mem_opens_of_blowDown_mem
statement:
theorem mem_opens_of_blowDown_mem {U : Opens M} {U' : Opens M'} (hU' : (U' : Set M') = π ⁻¹' U)
    {q : M'} (hq : π q ∈ U) : q ∈ U'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, hU']
  exact hq

name: Manifold.IsBlowUpChart.subtypeRestr
statement:
theorem IsBlowUpChart.subtypeRestr (hU : Nonempty U) (hU'ne : Nonempty U')
    {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph U E} {σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n} {i : Fin c}
    {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M' E} (hΦ : IsBlowUpChart ψ π (Opens.extendChart hU φ) σ i Φ) :
    IsBlowUpChart ψ π' φ σ i (Φ.subtypeRestr hU'ne) where
  mem_maximalAtlas
proof:
:=
    subtypeRestr_mem_maximalAtlas_of_mem_maximalAtlas hU'ne hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas
  source_subset := by
    intro q hq
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeRestr_source] at hq
    have hs := hΦ.source_subset hq
    obtain ⟨hxU, hx'⟩ := (Opens.mem_extendChart_source_iff hU φ).mp hs
    have : π' q = ⟨π q, hxU⟩ := Subtype.ext (hπ' q)
    change π' q ∈ φ.source
    rw [this]
    exact hx'
  mem_target_iff v := by
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeRestr_def, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_target,
      Opens.openPartialHomeomorphSubtypeCoe_target, ← Opens.extendChart_target hU φ,
      ← hΦ.mem_target_iff]
    constructor
    · exact fun hv => hv.1
    · intro hv
      refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
      have hq := Φ.map_target hv
      exact mem_opens_of_blowDown_mem hU'
        (Opens.extendChart_source_subset hU φ (hΦ.source_subset hq))
  comm q hq := by
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeRestr_source] at hq
    have hs := hΦ.source_subset hq
    have hxU : π q ∈ U := Opens.extendChart_source_subset hU φ hs
    have h1 := hΦ.comm q hq
    rw [Opens.extendChart_apply hU φ hxU] at h1
    have : π' q = ⟨π q, hxU⟩ := Subtype.ext (hπ' q)
    rw [this, OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeRestr_coe]
    exact h1

name: Manifold.isAdaptedChart_extendChart
statement:
theorem isAdaptedChart_extendChart [IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M] {U : Opens M} (hU : Nonempty U)
    {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph U E} {σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n}
    (hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ (Subtype.val ⁻¹' Y) φ σ) :
    IsAdaptedChart ψ Y (Opens.extendChart hU φ) σ
