    contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mpr (ψ.symm.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_blowUpChartMap _).comp ψ.contDiff))
  have h3 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (pieceChart j).symm (pieceChart j).target :=
    contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas (mem_maximalAtlas_piece j)
  have h4 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω
      ((pieceChart j).symm ∘ (fun v : E => ψ.symm (pieceMap j (ψ v))) ∘ gluedChart j hj)
      (Set.range (toGlued j)) := by
    refine h3.comp (h2.comp_contMDiffOn h1) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
    change ψ.symm (pieceMap j (ψ (gluedChart j hj (toGlued j u)))) ∈ (pieceChart j).target
    rw [gluedChart_toGlued, ψ.apply_symm_apply]
    exact symm_pieceMap_mem_target u.2
  refine h4.congr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
  change gluedProj (toGlued j u) =
    (pieceChart j).symm (ψ.symm (pieceMap j (ψ (gluedChart j hj (toGlued j u)))))
  rw [gluedProj_toGlued, gluedChart_toGlued, ψ.apply_symm_apply, blowDown]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.contMDiff_gluedProj
statement: theorem contMDiff_gluedProj : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (gluedProj : Glued ψ Y c → M)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have hp : Set.range (toGlued (pieceOf p)) ∈ 𝓝 p :=
    (isOpenEmbedding_toGlued _).isOpen_range.mem_nhds ⟨pieceElt p, toGlued_pieceElt p⟩
  exact (contMDiffOn_gluedProj_range (pieceOf p) (pieceSet_pieceOf_nonempty p)).contMDiffAt hp

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.isBlowUpChart_gluedChart
statement:
theorem isBlowUpChart_gluedChart (j : PieceIdx ψ Y c) (hj : (pieceSet j).Nonempty) :
    IsBlowUpChart ψ gluedProj (pieceChart j) (pieceEmb j) j.2 (gluedChart j hj) where
  mem_maximalAtlas
proof:
:= gluedChart_mem_maximalAtlas j hj
  source_subset := by
    rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact gluedProj_mem_source j u
  mem_target_iff _ := Iff.rfl
  comm := by
    rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
    rw [gluedProj_toGlued, apply_blowDown u.2, gluedChart_toGlued, ψ.apply_symm_apply]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.exists_mem_maximalAtlas_source_empty
statement:
theorem exists_mem_maximalAtlas_source_empty [Nonempty (Glued ψ Y c)] :
    ∃ Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Glued ψ Y c) E,
      Φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (Glued ψ Y c) ∧ Φ.source = ∅ ∧ Φ.target = ∅
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := ‹Nonempty (Glued ψ Y c)›
  refine ⟨(chartAt E p).restr ∅,
    restr_mem_maximalAtlas _ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas p) isOpen_empty, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restr_source' _ _ isOpen_empty, Set.inter_empty]
  · rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restr_toPartialEquiv, PartialEquiv.restr_target, interior_empty,
      Set.preimage_empty, Set.inter_empty]

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.exists_isBlowUpChart
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_piece hφ i
  by_cases hj : (pieceSet j).Nonempty
  · exact ⟨_, isBlowUpChart_gluedChart j hj⟩
  · rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hj
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ, hs, ht⟩ := exists_mem_maximalAtlas_source_empty (ψ := ψ) (Y := Y) (c := c)
    refine ⟨Φ, hΦ, by rw [hs]; exact Set.empty_subset _, fun v => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ht]
      refine ⟨fun h => h.elim, fun h => ?_⟩
      have h' : ψ v ∈ pieceSet j := h
      rw [hj] at h'
      exact h'.elim
    · rw [hs]
      intro p hp
      exact hp.elim

name: Manifold.BlowUpGlue.exists_isBlowUpChart_mem_source
statement:
theorem exists_isBlowUpChart_mem_source {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n}
    (hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ σ) (p : Glued ψ Y c) (hp : gluedProj p ∈ φ.source) :
    ∃ (i : Fin c) (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Glued ψ Y c) E),
      IsBlowUpChart ψ gluedProj φ σ i Φ ∧ p ∈ Φ.source
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j₀, h1, h2, -⟩ := exists_piece hφ (pieceOf p).2
  have hs' : blowDown (pieceOf p) (pieceElt p) ∈ (pieceChart (j₀.1, (pieceOf p).2)).source := by
    rw [← gluedProj_toGlued, toGlued_pieceElt, pieceChart_mk j₀.1 (pieceOf p).2 j₀.2, h1]
    exact hp
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_mem_transDom (pieceElt p).2 j₀.1 hs'
  have hne : (pieceSet (j₀.1, k)).Nonempty := ⟨_, transMap_mem_pieceSet hk⟩
  refine ⟨k, gluedChart (j₀.1, k) hne, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := isBlowUpChart_gluedChart (j₀.1, k) hne
    rwa [pieceChart_mk j₀.1 k j₀.2, h1, pieceEmb_mk j₀.1 k j₀.2, h2] at h
  · exact ⟨_, (toGlued_transMap hk).trans (toGlued_pieceElt p)⟩

name: Manifold.coordQuot_of_ne
statement: theorem coordQuot_of_ne {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x k ≠ 0) : coordQuot k F x = F x / x k
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordQuot, hx]

name: Manifold.coordQuot_of_eq
statement:
theorem coordQuot_of_eq {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x k = 0) :
    coordQuot k F x = fderiv 𝕜 F x (Pi.single k 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordQuot, hx]

name: Manifold.mul_coordQuot
statement:
theorem mul_coordQuot {N : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)} (h0 : ∀ x ∈ N, x k = 0 → F x = 0) {x : Fin n → 𝕜}
    (hx : x ∈ N) : x k * coordQuot k F x = F x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxk : x k = 0
  · rw [hxk, zero_mul, h0 x hx hxk]
  · rw [coordQuot_of_ne k F hxk]
    field_simp

name: Manifold.eq_fderiv_of_eq_mul
statement:
theorem eq_fderiv_of_eq_mul {G Q : (Fin n → 𝕜) → 𝕜} {U : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hQ : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 Q U) (h : ∀ y ∈ U, G y = y k * Q y) {y : Fin n → 𝕜} (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hyk : y k = 0) : fderiv 𝕜 G y (Pi.single k 1) = Q y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Fin n → 𝕜 => y k * Q y)
      (y k • fderiv 𝕜 Q y + Q y • pr k) y :=
    (hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := 𝕜) k y).mul (hQ y hy).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hG : HasFDerivAt G (y k • fderiv 𝕜 Q y + Q y • pr k) y :=
    h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) fun z hz => h z hz)
  rw [hG.fderiv]
  simp [hyk]

name: Manifold.analyticOnNhd_coordQuot
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_coordQuot {N : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)} (hN : IsOpen N) (hF : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 F N)
    (h0 : ∀ x ∈ N, x k = 0 → F x = 0) : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (coordQuot k F) N
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpk : p k = 0
  · 
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (0 : Fin n → 𝕜), p + y ∈ N := by
      have ht : Tendsto (fun y : Fin n → 𝕜 => p + y) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 p) :=
        (continuous_const.add continuous_id).tendsto' 0 p (by simp)
      exact ht (hN.mem_nhds hp)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := exists_polydisc_of_eventually hev
    have hopen : IsOpen (polydisc 𝕜 ρ) := isOpen_polydisc ρ
    have hGan : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (fun y => F (p + y)) (polydisc 𝕜 ρ) := fun y hy =>
      (hF _ (hρ y hy)).comp_of_eq (analyticAt_const.add analyticAt_id) rfl
    have hG0 : ∀ y ∈ polydisc 𝕜 ρ, y k = 0 → F (p + y) = 0 := fun y hy hyk =>
      h0 _ (hρ y hy) (by simp [hpk, hyk])
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hGQ⟩ := exists_eq_mul_coord_of_vanish k hGan hG0
    have key : ∀ y ∈ polydisc 𝕜 ρ, coordQuot k F (p + y) = Q y := by
      intro y hy
      by_cases hyk : y k = 0
      · rw [coordQuot_of_eq k F (by simp [hpk, hyk])]
        have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Fin n → 𝕜 => F (p + y)) (fderiv 𝕜 F (p + y)) y := by
          have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Fin n → 𝕜 => p + y) (ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 _) y :=
            (hasFDerivAt_id y).const_add p
          have h2 := (hF _ (hρ y hy)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt.comp y h1
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at h2
          exact h2
        rw [← hd.fderiv]
        exact eq_fderiv_of_eq_mul k hopen hQ hGQ hy hyk
      · rw [coordQuot_of_ne k F (by simpa [hpk] using hyk), hGQ y hy]
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, hpk, zero_add]
        field_simp
    have h0ρ : (0 : Fin n → 𝕜) ∈ polydisc 𝕜 ρ := fun j => by
      rw [Pi.zero_apply, norm_zero]; exact_mod_cast ρ.2 j
    have hQp : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (fun x => Q (x - p)) p :=
      (hQ 0 h0ρ).comp_of_eq (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const) (sub_self p)
    refine hQp.congr ?_
    have hmem : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, x - p ∈ polydisc 𝕜 ρ := by
      have ht : Tendsto (fun x : Fin n → 𝕜 => x - p) (𝓝 p) (𝓝 0) :=
        (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).tendsto' p 0 (by simp)
      exact ht (hopen.mem_nhds h0ρ)
    filter_upwards [hmem] with x hx
    have := key (x - p) hx
    rw [add_sub_cancel] at this
    exact this.symm
  · have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, x k ≠ 0 := (continuous_apply k).continuousAt.eventually_ne hpk
    refine ((hF p hp).div (analyticAt_apply k p) hpk).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
    exact (coordQuot_of_ne k F hx).symm

name: Manifold.fderiv_apply_mem_of_preserves_center
statement:
theorem fderiv_apply_mem_of_preserves_center {h : (Fin n → 𝕜) → (Fin n → 𝕜)} {U : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hh : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 h U) (hpres : ∀ y ∈ U, y ∈ blowUpCenter σ →
      h y ∈ blowUpCenter τ) {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ U) (hxc : x ∈ blowUpCenter σ)
    {t : Fin n → 𝕜} (ht : ∀ k, t (σ k) = 0) (k : Fin c) : fderiv 𝕜 h x t (τ k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hline : HasDerivAt (fun s : 𝕜 => x + s • t) t 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : 𝕜)).smul_const t).const_add x
  have hcurve : HasDerivAt (fun s : 𝕜 => h (x + s • t) (τ k)) (fderiv 𝕜 h x t (τ k)) 0 := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : 𝕜 => h (x + s • t)) (fderiv 𝕜 h x t) 0 := by
      exact (hh x hx).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0 : 𝕜) hline (by simp)
    exact (pr (τ k)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : 𝕜) h1
  have hev : ∀ᶠ s : 𝕜 in 𝓝 0, h (x + s • t) (τ k) = 0 := by
    have hU' : ∀ᶠ s : 𝕜 in 𝓝 0, x + s • t ∈ U := by
      have ht0 : Tendsto (fun s : 𝕜 => x + s • t) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 x) := by
        simpa using hline.continuousAt.tendsto
      exact ht0 (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    filter_upwards [hU'] with s hs
    have hmem : x + s • t ∈ blowUpCenter σ := fun l => by
      simp [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, hxc l, ht l]
    exact hpres _ hs hmem k
  have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : 𝕜 => h (x + s • t) (τ k)) 0 0 :=
    (hasDerivAt_const (0 : 𝕜) (0 : 𝕜)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (by filter_upwards [hev] with s hs; simpa using hs)
  exact hcurve.unique h0

name: Manifold.fderiv_comp_fderiv_eq_id
statement:
theorem fderiv_comp_fderiv_eq_id {g g' : (Fin n → 𝕜) → (Fin n → 𝕜)} {V₁ V₂ : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)}
    (hV₁ : IsOpen V₁) (hg : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g V₁) (hg' : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g' V₂)
    (hmaps : ∀ x ∈ V₁, g x ∈ V₂) (hgg' : ∀ x ∈ V₁, g' (g x) = x) {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hx : x ∈ V₁) :
    (fderiv 𝕜 g' (g x)).comp (fderiv 𝕜 g x) = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 (Fin n → 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_comp x (hg' _ (hmaps x hx)).differentiableAt (hg x hx).differentiableAt]
  have : (g' ∘ g) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id := eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV₁.mem_nhds hx) fun z hz => hgg' z hz
  rw [this.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]

name: Manifold.liftMap_apply_k
statement:
theorem liftMap_apply_k (k : Fin c) (v : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    liftMap σ τ i g k v (τ k) = v (σ i) * liftDir σ τ i g k v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [liftMap]

name: Manifold.liftMap_apply_block
statement:
theorem liftMap_apply_block {k l : Fin c} (hlk : l ≠ k) (v : Fin n → 𝕜) :
    liftMap σ τ i g k v (τ l) = liftDir σ τ i g l v / liftDir σ τ i g k v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [liftMap, hlk]

name: Manifold.liftMap_apply_off
statement:
theorem liftMap_apply_off (k : Fin c) (v : Fin n → 𝕜) {j : Fin n} (hj : ∀ l, τ l ≠ j) :
    liftMap σ τ i g k v j = g (blowUpChartMap σ i v) j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ¬ ∃ l, τ l = j := fun ⟨l, hl⟩ => hj l hl
  simp [liftMap, h]

name: Manifold.normalComp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem normalComp_eq_zero (k : Fin c) {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V₁)
    (h0 : u (σ i) = 0) : normalComp σ τ i g k u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ blowUpCenter σ := (blowUpChartMap_mem_center_iff σ u).mpr h0
  exact (hc _ hu).mp hmem k

name: Manifold.analyticOnNhd_normalComp
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_normalComp (k : Fin c) :
    AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (normalComp σ τ i g k) (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V₁)
proof:
:= fun u hu =>
  (analyticAt_apply (τ k) _).comp ((hg _ hu).comp
    ((contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).contDiffAt.analyticAt (x := u)))

name: Manifold.analyticOnNhd_liftDir
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_liftDir (k : Fin c) :
    AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (liftDir σ τ i g k) (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V₁)
proof:
:=
  analyticOnNhd_coordQuot (σ i) _ (hV₁.preimage (contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).continuous)
    (analyticOnNhd_normalComp hg k) fun _ hu h0 => normalComp_eq_zero hc k hu h0

name: Manifold.mul_liftDir
statement:
theorem mul_liftDir (k : Fin c) {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V₁) :
    u (σ i) * liftDir σ τ i g k u = g (blowUpChartMap σ i u) (τ k)
proof:
:=
  mul_coordQuot (σ i) _ (fun _ hv h0 => normalComp_eq_zero hc k hv h0) hu

name: Manifold.exists_liftDir_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_liftDir_ne_zero {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V₁) :
    ∃ k, liftDir σ τ i g k u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : u (σ i) = 0
  · 
    set x₀ := blowUpChartMap σ i u with hx₀
    have hx₀c : x₀ ∈ blowUpCenter σ := (blowUpChartMap_mem_center_iff σ u).mpr h0
    set d := fderiv 𝕜 (blowUpChartMap σ i) u (Pi.single (σ i) 1) with hd
    have hπ : HasFDerivAt (blowUpChartMap σ i) (fderiv 𝕜 (blowUpChartMap σ i) u) u :=
      ((contDiff_blowUpChartMap (𝕜 := 𝕜) σ (i := i)).contDiffAt.differentiableAt
        (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    
    have hdi : d (σ i) = 1 := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun v : Fin n → 𝕜 => blowUpChartMap σ i v (σ i))
          ((pr (σ i)).comp (fderiv 𝕜 (blowUpChartMap σ i) u)) u :=
        (pr (σ i)).hasFDerivAt.comp u hπ
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun v : Fin n → 𝕜 => blowUpChartMap σ i v (σ i))
          (pr (σ i)) u := by
        have := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := 𝕜) (σ i) u
        refine this.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Eventually.of_forall fun v => ?_)
        exact blowUpChartMap_apply_scaling σ (i := i) v
      have := congrArg (fun L => L (Pi.single (σ i) 1)) (h1.unique h2)
      simpa [d] using this
    
    have hDk : ∀ k, liftDir σ τ i g k u = fderiv 𝕜 g x₀ d (τ k) := by
      intro k
      rw [liftDir, coordQuot_of_eq _ _ h0]
      have hF : HasFDerivAt (normalComp σ τ i g k)
          ((pr (τ k)).comp ((fderiv 𝕜 g x₀).comp
            (fderiv 𝕜 (blowUpChartMap σ i) u))) u := by
        have hgx : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv 𝕜 g x₀) x₀ := (hg _ hu).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
        exact (pr (τ k)).hasFDerivAt.comp u (hgx.comp u hπ)
      rw [hF.fderiv]
      rfl
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    
    have hmaps : ∀ x ∈ V₁, g x ∈ V₂ := fun x hx => hg₁.mapsTo hx
    have hpres' : ∀ y ∈ V₂, y ∈ blowUpCenter τ → g' y ∈ blowUpCenter σ := by
      intro y hy hyc
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hg₁.surjOn hy
      rw [hgg' x hx]
      exact (hc x hx).mpr hyc
    have hw : ∀ k, fderiv 𝕜 g x₀ d (τ k) = 0 := fun k => by rw [← hDk k]; exact hcon k
    have hgx₀ : g x₀ ∈ V₂ := hmaps x₀ hu
    have hgx₀c : g x₀ ∈ blowUpCenter τ := (hc x₀ hu).mp hx₀c
    have hdt : fderiv 𝕜 g' (g x₀) (fderiv 𝕜 g x₀ d) (σ i) = 0 :=
      fderiv_apply_mem_of_preserves_center τ σ hV₂ hg' hpres' hgx₀ hgx₀c hw i
    have hid := congrArg (fun L => L d (σ i)) (fderiv_comp_fderiv_eq_id hV₁ hg hg' hmaps hgg' hu)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] at hid
    rw [hid, hdi] at hdt
    exact one_ne_zero hdt
  · 
    have hnot : g (blowUpChartMap σ i u) ∉ blowUpCenter τ := fun hmem =>
      h0 ((blowUpChartMap_mem_center_iff σ u).mp ((hc _ hu).mpr hmem))
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, g (blowUpChartMap σ i u) (τ k) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      exact hnot hall
    refine ⟨k, fun hD => hk ?_⟩
    rw [← mul_liftDir hc k hu, hD, mul_zero]

name: Manifold.blowUpChartMap_liftMap
statement:
theorem blowUpChartMap_liftMap (k : Fin c) {v : Fin n → 𝕜} (hv : blowUpChartMap σ i v ∈ V₁)
    (hk : liftDir σ τ i g k v ≠ 0) :
    blowUpChartMap τ k (liftMap σ τ i g k v) = g (blowUpChartMap σ i v)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rcases exists_eq_or_forall_ne τ j with ⟨l, rfl⟩ | hj
  · by_cases hlk : l = k
    · subst hlk
      rw [blowUpChartMap_apply_scaling, liftMap_apply_k, mul_liftDir hc _ hv]
    · rw [blowUpChartMap_apply_ratio τ _ hlk, liftMap_apply_k, liftMap_apply_block hlk,
        ← mul_liftDir hc l hv]
      field_simp
  · rw [blowUpChartMap_apply_off τ _ hj, liftMap_apply_off k v hj]

name: Manifold.analyticOnNhd_liftMap
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_liftMap (k : Fin c) :
    AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (liftMap σ τ i g k)
      (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V₁ ∩ {v | liftDir σ τ i g k v ≠ 0})
proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨hv, hk⟩
  refine analyticAt_pi_of_forall fun j => ?_
  rcases exists_eq_or_forall_ne τ j with ⟨l, rfl⟩ | hj
  · by_cases hlk : l = k
    · subst hlk
      refine ((analyticAt_apply (σ i) v).mul (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV₁ hg hc l v hv)).congr ?_
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun w => (liftMap_apply_k l w).symm
    · refine ((analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV₁ hg hc l v hv).div
        (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV₁ hg hc k v hv) hk).congr ?_
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun w => (liftMap_apply_block hlk w).symm
  · refine ((analyticAt_apply j _).comp ((hg _ hv).comp
      ((contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).contDiffAt.analyticAt (x := v)))).congr ?_
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun w => (liftMap_apply_off k w hj).symm

name: Manifold.exists_lift_blowUpChartMap
statement:
theorem exists_lift_blowUpChartMap {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V₁) :
    ∃ (k : Fin c) (N : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)) (G : (Fin n → 𝕜) → (Fin n → 𝕜)), IsOpen N ∧ u ∈ N ∧
      AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 G N ∧ ∀ v ∈ N, blowUpChartMap τ k (G v) = g (blowUpChartMap σ i v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_liftDir_ne_zero hV₁ hg hc hV₂ hg₁ hg' hgg' hu
  refine ⟨k, blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V₁ ∩ {v | liftDir σ τ i g k v ≠ 0}, liftMap σ τ i g k, ?_,
    ⟨hu, hk⟩, analyticOnNhd_liftMap hV₁ hg hc k, fun v ⟨hv, hvk⟩ =>
      blowUpChartMap_liftMap hc k hv hvk⟩
  have hpre : IsOpen (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V₁) :=
    hV₁.preimage (contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).continuous
  exact (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV₁ hg hc k).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hpre
    isOpen_compl_singleton

name: Manifold.subset_closure_ne
statement:
theorem subset_closure_ne {N : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)} (hN : IsOpen N) :
    N ⊆ closure {v ∈ N | v (σ i) ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds]
  intro U hU
  have hline : Tendsto (fun s : 𝕜 => v + s • Pi.single (σ i) (1 : 𝕜)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 v) :=
    (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).tendsto' 0 v (by simp)
  have hmem : ∀ᶠ s : 𝕜 in 𝓝[≠] 0, v + s • Pi.single (σ i) (1 : 𝕜) ∈ U ∩ N :=
    nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hline (Filter.inter_mem hU (hN.mem_nhds hv)))
  have hne : ∀ᶠ s : 𝕜 in 𝓝[≠] 0, v (σ i) + s ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases hvi : v (σ i) = 0
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
      rw [hvi, zero_add]; exact hs
    · exact nhdsWithin_le_nhds
        ((continuous_const.add continuous_id).continuousAt.eventually_ne (by simpa using hvi))
  obtain ⟨s, hsU, hs⟩ := (hmem.and hne).exists
  refine ⟨v + s • Pi.single (σ i) (1 : 𝕜), hsU.1, hsU.2, ?_⟩
  simpa using hs

name: Manifold.eqOn_of_lift_blowUpChartMap
statement:
theorem eqOn_of_lift_blowUpChartMap {τ : Fin c ↪ Fin n} {N : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)} (hN : IsOpen N)
    {g G₁ G₂ : (Fin n → 𝕜) → (Fin n → 𝕜)} (h₁ : ContinuousOn G₁ N) (h₂ : ContinuousOn G₂ N)
    (hG₁ : ∀ v ∈ N, blowUpChartMap τ k (G₁ v) = g (blowUpChartMap σ i v))
    (hG₂ : ∀ v ∈ N, blowUpChartMap τ k (G₂ v) = g (blowUpChartMap σ i v))
    (hinj : ∀ v ∈ N, v (σ i) ≠ 0 → g (blowUpChartMap σ i v) ∉ blowUpCenter τ) :
    Set.EqOn G₁ G₂ N
proof:
:= by
  have hS : Set.EqOn G₁ G₂ {v ∈ N | v (σ i) ≠ 0} := by
    rintro v ⟨hv, hvi⟩
    have hk₁ : G₁ v (τ k) ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hinj v hv hvi (by
      rw [← hG₁ v hv]; exact (blowUpChartMap_mem_center_iff τ (G₁ v)).mpr h0)
    have hk₂ : G₂ v (τ k) ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hinj v hv hvi (by
      rw [← hG₂ v hv]; exact (blowUpChartMap_mem_center_iff τ (G₂ v)).mpr h0)
    exact blowUpChartMap_injOn τ hk₁ hk₂ ((hG₁ v hv).trans (hG₂ v hv).symm)
  exact hS.of_subset_closure h₁ h₂ (fun v hv => hv.1) (subset_closure_ne σ hN)

name: Manifold.liftDir_congr
statement:
theorem liftDir_congr {g₁ g₂ : (Fin n → 𝕜) → (Fin n → 𝕜)} {V : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)} (hV : IsOpen V)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ V, g₁ x = g₂ x) (k : Fin c) {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V) :
    liftDir σ τ i g₁ k u = liftDir σ τ i g₂ k u
proof:
:= by
  have hev : normalComp σ τ i g₁ k =ᶠ[𝓝 u] normalComp σ τ i g₂ k := by
    have hpre : ∀ᶠ v in 𝓝 u, blowUpChartMap σ i v ∈ V :=
      (contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hV.mem_nhds hu)
    filter_upwards [hpre] with v hv
    simp only [normalComp, h _ hv]
  simp only [liftDir, coordQuot, hev.fderiv_eq, hev.eq_of_nhds]

name: Manifold.liftMap_congr
statement:
theorem liftMap_congr {g₁ g₂ : (Fin n → 𝕜) → (Fin n → 𝕜)} {V : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)} (hV : IsOpen V)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ V, g₁ x = g₂ x) (k : Fin c) {v : Fin n → 𝕜} (hv : blowUpChartMap σ i v ∈ V) :
    liftMap σ τ i g₁ k v = liftMap σ τ i g₂ k v
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rcases exists_eq_or_forall_ne τ j with ⟨l, rfl⟩ | hj
  · by_cases hlk : l = k
    · subst hlk
      rw [liftMap_apply_k, liftMap_apply_k, liftDir_congr hV h l hv]
    · rw [liftMap_apply_block hlk, liftMap_apply_block hlk, liftDir_congr hV h l hv,
        liftDir_congr hV h k hv]
  · rw [liftMap_apply_off k v hj, liftMap_apply_off k v hj, h _ hv]

name: Manifold.analyticOnNhd_of_eqOn_id
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_of_eqOn_id (hV : IsOpen V) (hid : ∀ x ∈ V, g x = x) :
    AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g V
proof:
:= fun _ hx =>
  analyticAt_id.congr (eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hx) fun y hy => (hid y hy).symm)

name: Manifold.mem_center_iff_of_eqOn_id
statement:
theorem mem_center_iff_of_eqOn_id (hid : ∀ x ∈ V, g x = x) :
    ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ blowUpCenter σ ↔ g x ∈ blowUpCenter σ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [hid x hx]

name: Manifold.liftDir_self_of_eqOn_id
statement:
theorem liftDir_self_of_eqOn_id (hV : IsOpen V) (hid : ∀ x ∈ V, g x = x) {u : Fin n → 𝕜}
    (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V) : liftDir σ σ i g i u = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hg := analyticOnNhd_of_eqOn_id hV hid
  have hc := mem_center_iff_of_eqOn_id (σ := σ) hid
  have hN : IsOpen (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V) :=
    hV.preimage (contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).continuous
  have hS : Set.EqOn (liftDir σ σ i g i) (fun _ => 1)
      {v ∈ blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V | v (σ i) ≠ 0} := by
    rintro v ⟨hv, hvi⟩
    have := mul_liftDir hc i hv
    rw [hid _ hv, blowUpChartMap_apply_scaling] at this
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hvi (this.trans (mul_one _).symm)
  exact hS.of_subset_closure (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV hg hc i).continuousOn continuousOn_const
    (fun v hv => hv.1) (subset_closure_ne σ hN) hu

name: Manifold.liftDir_of_eqOn_id
statement:
theorem liftDir_of_eqOn_id (hV : IsOpen V) (hid : ∀ x ∈ V, g x = x) {k : Fin c} (hk : k ≠ i)
    {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V) : liftDir σ σ i g k u = u (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := analyticOnNhd_of_eqOn_id hV hid
  have hc := mem_center_iff_of_eqOn_id (σ := σ) hid
  have hN : IsOpen (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V) :=
    hV.preimage (contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).continuous
  have hS : Set.EqOn (liftDir σ σ i g k) (fun v => v (σ k))
      {v ∈ blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V | v (σ i) ≠ 0} := by
    rintro v ⟨hv, hvi⟩
    have := mul_liftDir hc k hv
    rw [hid _ hv, blowUpChartMap_apply_ratio σ _ hk] at this
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hvi this
  exact hS.of_subset_closure (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV hg hc k).continuousOn
    (continuous_apply (σ k)).continuousOn (fun v hv => hv.1) (subset_closure_ne σ hN) hu

name: Manifold.liftMap_eq_blowUpTransition
statement:
theorem liftMap_eq_blowUpTransition (hV : IsOpen V) (hid : ∀ x ∈ V, g x = x) (k : Fin c)
    {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V) (hk : liftDir σ σ i g k u ≠ 0) :
    liftMap σ σ i g k u = blowUpTransition σ i k u
proof:
:= by
  have hg := analyticOnNhd_of_eqOn_id hV hid
  have hc := mem_center_iff_of_eqOn_id (σ := σ) hid
  have hpre : IsOpen (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V) :=
    hV.preimage (contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).continuous
  have hNo : IsOpen (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V ∩ {v | liftDir σ σ i g k v ≠ 0}) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV hg hc k).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hpre
      isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hdom : ∀ v ∈ blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V ∩ {v | liftDir σ σ i g k v ≠ 0},
      v ∈ blowUpTransitionDomain σ i k := by
    rintro v ⟨hv, hvk⟩
    by_cases hik : i = k
    · subst hik
      rw [blowUpTransitionDomain_self]
      exact Set.mem_univ v
    · rw [mem_blowUpTransitionDomain σ v hik, ← liftDir_of_eqOn_id hV hid (Ne.symm hik) hv]
      exact hvk
  refine eqOn_of_lift_blowUpChartMap (τ := σ) (i := i) (k := k) (g := g) σ hNo
    (analyticOnNhd_liftMap hV hg hc k).continuousOn
    ((analyticOnNhd_blowUpTransition σ).continuousOn.mono hdom) ?_ ?_ ?_ ⟨hu, hk⟩
  · rintro v ⟨hv, hvk⟩
    exact blowUpChartMap_liftMap hc k hv hvk
  · intro v hv
    rw [blowUpChartMap_blowUpTransition σ v (hdom v hv), hid _ hv.1]
  · rintro v ⟨hv, -⟩ hvi hmem
    rw [hid _ hv] at hmem
    exact hvi ((blowUpChartMap_mem_center_iff σ v).mp hmem)

name: Manifold.liftDir_comp
statement:
theorem liftDir_comp {g' : (Fin n → 𝕜) → (Fin n → 𝕜)} {W : Set (Fin n → 𝕜)} (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g V) (hc : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ blowUpCenter σ ↔ g x ∈ blowUpCenter τ)
    (hW : IsOpen W) (hg' : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 g' W)
    (hc' : ∀ x ∈ W, x ∈ blowUpCenter τ ↔ g' x ∈ blowUpCenter ρ) (hmaps : ∀ x ∈ V, g x ∈ W)
    (k l : Fin c) {u : Fin n → 𝕜} (hu : blowUpChartMap σ i u ∈ V) (hk : liftDir σ τ i g k u ≠ 0) :
    liftDir σ ρ i (g' ∘ g) l u =
      liftDir σ τ i g k u * liftDir τ ρ k g' l (liftMap σ τ i g k u)
proof:
:= by
  have hgg : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (g' ∘ g) V := fun x hx => (hg' _ (hmaps x hx)).comp (hg x hx)
  have hcc : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ blowUpCenter σ ↔ (g' ∘ g) x ∈ blowUpCenter ρ := fun x hx =>
    (hc x hx).trans (hc' _ (hmaps x hx))
  have hpre : IsOpen (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V) :=
    hV.preimage (contDiff_blowUpChartMap σ).continuous
  have hNo : IsOpen (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V ∩ {v | liftDir σ τ i g k v ≠ 0}) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV hg hc k).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hpre
      isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hmapsN : Set.MapsTo (liftMap σ τ i g k)
      (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V ∩ {v | liftDir σ τ i g k v ≠ 0}) (blowUpChartMap τ k ⁻¹' W) := by
    rintro v ⟨hv, hvk⟩
    change blowUpChartMap τ k (liftMap σ τ i g k v) ∈ W
    rw [blowUpChartMap_liftMap hc k hv hvk]
    exact hmaps _ hv
  have h1 : ContinuousOn (liftDir σ ρ i (g' ∘ g) l)
      (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V ∩ {v | liftDir σ τ i g k v ≠ 0}) :=
    (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV hgg hcc l).continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have h2 : ContinuousOn
      (fun v => liftDir σ τ i g k v * liftDir τ ρ k g' l (liftMap σ τ i g k v))
      (blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V ∩ {v | liftDir σ τ i g k v ≠ 0}) := by
    refine ((analyticOnNhd_liftDir hV hg hc k).continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left).mul ?_
    exact (analyticOnNhd_liftDir hW hg' hc' l).continuousOn.comp
      (analyticOnNhd_liftMap hV hg hc k).continuousOn hmapsN
  have hS : Set.EqOn (liftDir σ ρ i (g' ∘ g) l)
      (fun v => liftDir σ τ i g k v * liftDir τ ρ k g' l (liftMap σ τ i g k v))
      {v ∈ blowUpChartMap σ i ⁻¹' V ∩ {v | liftDir σ τ i g k v ≠ 0} | v (σ i) ≠ 0} := by
    rintro v ⟨⟨hv, hvk⟩, hvi⟩
    have e1 := mul_liftDir hcc l hv
    have e2 := mul_liftDir hc' l (hmapsN ⟨hv, hvk⟩)
    rw [liftMap_apply_k, blowUpChartMap_liftMap hc k hv hvk] at e2
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hvi
    rw [e1, ← mul_assoc, e2]
    rfl
  exact hS.of_subset_closure h1 h2 (fun v hv => hv.1) (subset_closure_ne σ hNo) ⟨hu, hk⟩

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheaf.obj_eq
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheaf.obj_eq (U : (Opens (TopCat.of M))ᵒᵖ) :
    (contMDiffSheaf IM I n M N).presheaf.obj U = C^n⟮IM, (unop U : Opens M); I, N⟯
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheaf.contMDiff_section
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheaf.contMDiff_section {U : (Opens (TopCat.of M))ᵒᵖ}
    (f : (contMDiffSheaf IM I n M N).presheaf.obj U) : ContMDiff IM I n f

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.obj_eq
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.obj_eq (U : (Opens (TopCat.of M))ᵒᵖ) :
    ((contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.obj U : Type u) =
      C^n⟮IM, (unop U : Opens M); I, R⟯
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.contMDiff_section
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.contMDiff_section {U : (Opens (TopCat.of M))ᵒᵖ}
    (f : (contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.obj U) : ContMDiff IM I n f

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.map_apply {U V : Opens (TopCat.of M)} (h : U ≤ V)
    (f : (contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.obj (op V)) (x : U) :
    ((contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op f) x =
      f (Set.inclusion h x)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.ι_evalHom
statement:
@[simp, reassoc, elementwise]
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.ι_evalHom (x : TopCat.of M) (U) :
    colimit.ι ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ _) U ≫ contMDiffSheafCommRing.evalHom IM I n M R x =
      contMDiffSheafCommRing.evalAt IM I n M R x (unop U)
proof:
:=
  colimit.ι_desc _ _

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.evalHom_germ
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.evalHom_germ (U : Opens (TopCat.of M)) (x : M) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (f : (contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    contMDiffSheafCommRing.evalHom IM I n M R (x : TopCat.of M)
      ((contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.germ U x hx f) = ULift.up (f ⟨x, hx⟩)
proof:
:=
  congr_arg (fun a => a f) <| contMDiffSheafCommRing.ι_evalHom IM I n M R x (op ⟨U, hx⟩)

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ (U : Opens M) (x : M) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (f : (contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval IM I n M R x
      ((contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.germ U x hx f) = f ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
  change ULift.ringEquiv (contMDiffSheafCommRing.evalHom IM I n M R x _) = _
  rw [contMDiffSheafCommRing.evalHom_germ]
  rfl

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_surjective
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_surjective (x : M) :
    Function.Surjective (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval IM I n M R x)
proof:
:= fun r =>
  ⟨(contMDiffSheafCommRing IM I n M R).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial
    (⟨fun _ => r, contMDiff_const⟩ : C^n⟮IM, ((⊤ : Opens M) : Opens M); I, R⟯),
    contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ IM I n M R _ _ _ _⟩

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.isUnit_stalk_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨f, g, hf, hg⟩, rfl⟩ (h' : contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜 x f = 0)
    simpa [h'] using congr_arg (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜 x) hf
  · let S := (contMDiffSheafCommRing IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜).presheaf
    rintro (hf : _ ≠ 0)
    obtain ⟨U : Opens M, hxU, f : C^n⟮IM, U; 𝓘(𝕜), 𝕜⟯, rfl⟩ := S.exists_germ_eq f
    have hf' : f ⟨x, hxU⟩ ≠ 0 := by
      convert! hf
      exact (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜 U x hxU f).symm
    have H : ∀ᶠ (z : U) in 𝓝 ⟨x, hxU⟩, f z ≠ 0 :=
      f.2.continuous.continuousAt.eventually_ne hf'
    rw [eventually_nhds_iff] at H
    obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀f, hV₀, hxV₀⟩ := H
    let V : Opens M := ⟨Subtype.val '' V₀, U.2.isOpenMap_subtype_val V₀ hV₀⟩
    have hUV : V ≤ U := Subtype.coe_image_subset (U : Set M) V₀
    have hV : V₀ = Set.range (Set.inclusion hUV) := by
      convert! (Set.range_inclusion hUV).symm
      ext y
      change _ ↔ y ∈ Subtype.val ⁻¹' Subtype.val '' V₀
      rw [Set.preimage_image_eq _ Subtype.coe_injective]
    clear_value V
    subst hV
    have hxV : x ∈ (V : Set M) := by
      obtain ⟨x₀, hxx₀⟩ := hxV₀
      convert! x₀.2
      exact congr_arg Subtype.val hxx₀.symm
    have hVf : ∀ y : V, f (Set.inclusion hUV y) ≠ 0 :=
      fun y => hV₀f (Set.inclusion hUV y) (Set.mem_range_self y)
    let g : C^n⟮IM, V; 𝓘(𝕜), 𝕜⟯ := ⟨(f ∘ Set.inclusion hUV)⁻¹, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨⟨S.germ _ x hxV (ContMDiffMap.restrictRingHom IM 𝓘(𝕜) 𝕜 hUV f), S.germ _ x hxV g,
        ?_, ?_⟩, S.germ_res_apply hUV.hom x hxV f⟩
      · rw [← map_mul]
        convert! RingHom.map_one _
        apply Subtype.ext
        ext y
        apply mul_inv_cancel₀
        exact hVf y
      · rw [← map_mul]
        convert! RingHom.map_one _
        apply Subtype.ext
        ext y
        apply inv_mul_cancel₀
        exact hVf y
    · intro y
      exact (((contDiffAt_inv _ (hVf y)).contMDiffAt).comp y
        (f.contMDiff.comp (contMDiff_inclusion hUV)).contMDiffAt :)

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.nonunits_stalk
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.nonunits_stalk (x : M) :
    nonunits ((contMDiffSheafCommRing IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜).presheaf.stalk x) =
      RingHom.ker (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜 x)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 f
  rw [mem_nonunits_iff, not_iff_comm, Iff.comm]
  apply contMDiffSheafCommRing.isUnit_stalk_iff

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.maximalIdeal_stalk
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.maximalIdeal_stalk (x : M) :
    maximalIdeal ((contMDiffSheafCommRing IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜).presheaf.stalk x) =
      RingHom.ker (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜 x)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_maximalIdeal, contMDiffSheafCommRing.nonunits_stalk]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.contMDiffSheafCommRing.residueFieldEquiv_residue
statement:
theorem contMDiffSheafCommRing.residueFieldEquiv_residue (x : M)
    (f : (contMDiffSheafCommRing IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜).presheaf.stalk x) :
    contMDiffSheafCommRing.residueFieldEquiv IM n M x (residue _ f) =
      contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval IM 𝓘(𝕜) n M 𝕜 x f
proof: := rfl

name: ChartedSpace.mem_atlas_sigma
statement:
theorem mem_atlas_sigma [h : Nonempty H] {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Σ i, M i) H}
    (he : e ∈ atlas H (Σ i, M i)) :
    ∃ (i : ι) (f : OpenPartialHomeomorph (M i) H), f ∈ atlas H (M i) ∧
      e = f.lift_openEmbedding IsOpenEmbedding.sigmaMk
proof:
:= by
  simp +instances only [atlas, sigma, h, ↓reduceDIte] at he
  obtain ⟨i, f, hf, hfe⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp he
  exact ⟨i, f, hf, hfe.symm⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iter_self
statement: theorem iter_self (n : ℕ) : c.iter (le_refl n) = ContMDiffMap.id
proof: := Nat.leRecOn_self _

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iter_self_apply
statement: theorem iter_self_apply (n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ n) (x : c.X n) : c.iter h x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [iter_self]
  rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iter_succ
statement:
theorem iter_succ {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (h' : n ≤ m + 1) :
    c.iter h' = (c.ι m).comp (c.iter h)
proof: := Nat.leRecOn_succ h _

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iter_succ_apply
statement:
theorem iter_succ_apply {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (h' : n ≤ m + 1) (x : c.X n) :
    c.iter h' x = c.ι m (c.iter h x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iter_succ c h h']
  rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iter_one_apply
statement: theorem iter_one_apply (n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ n + 1) (x : c.X n) : c.iter h x = c.ι n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [iter_succ_apply c (le_refl n) h, iter_self_apply]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iter_trans
statement:
theorem iter_trans {n m k : ℕ} (h₁ : n ≤ m) (h₂ : m ≤ k) (x : c.X n) :
    c.iter h₂ (c.iter h₁ x) = c.iter (h₁.trans h₂) x
proof:
:= by
  induction k, h₂ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rw [iter_self_apply]
  | succ k hmk ih =>
    rw [iter_succ_apply c hmk (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmk), ih,
      iter_succ_apply c (h₁.trans hmk) (h₁.trans (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmk))]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iter_injective
statement: theorem iter_injective {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) : Function.Injective (c.iter h)
proof:
:= by
  induction m, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => intro x y hxy; rwa [iter_self_apply, iter_self_apply] at hxy
  | succ m hnm ih =>
    intro x y hxy
    rw [iter_succ_apply c hnm, iter_succ_apply c hnm] at hxy
    exact ih ((c.isAnalyticOpenEmbedding m).2 hxy)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isLocalDiffeomorph_iter
statement:
theorem isLocalDiffeomorph_iter {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    IsLocalDiffeomorph 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (c.iter h)
proof:
:= by
  induction m, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rw [iter_self]; exact AnalyticManifold.BlowUpSequence.isLocalDiffeomorph_id _
  | succ m hnm ih =>
    rw [iter_succ c hnm]
    exact AnalyticManifold.BlowUpSequence.isLocalDiffeomorph_comp (c.isAnalyticOpenEmbedding m).1 ih

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isAnalyticOpenEmbedding_iter
statement:
theorem isAnalyticOpenEmbedding_iter {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    IsAnalyticOpenEmbedding (c.iter h)
proof:
:=
  ⟨c.isLocalDiffeomorph_iter h, c.iter_injective h⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isOpenEmbedding_iter
statement: theorem isOpenEmbedding_iter {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) : IsOpenEmbedding (c.iter h)
proof:
:=
  .of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap (c.iter h).contMDiff.continuous (c.iter_injective h)
    (c.isLocalDiffeomorph_iter h).isOpenMap

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.LimitRel.iter_eq
statement:
theorem LimitRel.iter_eq {a b : Σ n, (c.X n : Type u)} (hab : c.LimitRel a b) {k : ℕ} (h₁ : a.1 ≤ k)
    (h₂ : b.1 ≤ k) : c.iter h₁ a.2 = c.iter h₂ b.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k', h₁', h₂', e⟩ := hab
  apply c.iter_injective (le_max_left k k')
  rw [iter_trans, iter_trans, ← iter_trans c h₁' (le_max_right k k'), e,
    iter_trans c h₂' (le_max_right k k')]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitRel_refl
statement: theorem limitRel_refl (a : Σ n, (c.X n : Type u)) : c.LimitRel a a
proof: := ⟨a.1, le_rfl, le_rfl, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitRel_symm
statement: theorem limitRel_symm {a b : Σ n, (c.X n : Type u)} (h : c.LimitRel a b) : c.LimitRel b a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, h₁, h₂, e⟩ := h
  exact ⟨k, h₂, h₁, e.symm⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitRel_trans
statement:
theorem limitRel_trans {a b d : Σ n, (c.X n : Type u)} (hab : c.LimitRel a b)
    (hbd : c.LimitRel b d) : c.LimitRel a d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, h₁, h₂, e⟩ := hab
  obtain ⟨k', h₃, h₄, e'⟩ := hbd
  refine ⟨max k k', h₁.trans (le_max_left k k'), h₄.trans (le_max_right k k'), ?_⟩
  rw [← iter_trans c h₁ (le_max_left k k'), e, iter_trans c h₂ (le_max_left k k'),
    ← iter_trans c h₄ (le_max_right k k'), ← e', iter_trans c h₃ (le_max_right k k')]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_eq_iff
statement:
theorem toLimit_eq_iff {n m : ℕ} {x : c.X n} {y : c.X m} :
    c.toLimit n x = c.toLimit m y ↔ c.LimitRel ⟨n, x⟩ ⟨m, y⟩
proof:
:=
  Quotient.eq

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_eq_iff_iter
statement:
theorem toLimit_eq_iff_iter {n m k : ℕ} (h₁ : n ≤ k) (h₂ : m ≤ k) {x : c.X n} {y : c.X m} :
    c.toLimit n x = c.toLimit m y ↔ c.iter h₁ x = c.iter h₂ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLimit_eq_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.iter_eq c h₁ h₂, fun h => ⟨k, h₁, h₂, h⟩⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_iter
statement: theorem toLimit_iter {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (x : c.X n) : c.toLimit m (c.iter h x) = c.toLimit n x
proof:
:=
  (c.toLimit_eq_iff_iter (le_refl m) h).mpr (c.iter_self_apply m _ _)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_succ
statement: theorem toLimit_succ (n : ℕ) (x : c.X n) : c.toLimit (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = c.toLimit n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← c.iter_one_apply n (Nat.le_succ n), toLimit_iter]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_injective
statement: theorem toLimit_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:= fun x y h => by
  rw [c.toLimit_eq_iff_iter (le_refl n) (le_refl n), iter_self_apply, iter_self_apply] at h
  exact h

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_surjective
statement: theorem toLimit_surjective (p : c.Limit) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (x : c.X n), c.toLimit n x = p
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn p fun a => ⟨a.1, a.2, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.exists_common_toLimit
statement:
theorem exists_common_toLimit (p q : c.Limit) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (x y : c.X k), c.toLimit k x = p ∧ c.toLimit k y = q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x, rfl⟩ := c.toLimit_surjective p
  obtain ⟨m, y, rfl⟩ := c.toLimit_surjective q
  exact ⟨max n m, c.iter (le_max_left n m) x, c.iter (le_max_right n m) y, c.toLimit_iter _ _,
    c.toLimit_iter _ _⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.range_toLimit_mono
statement:
theorem range_toLimit_mono {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    Set.range (c.toLimit n) ⊆ Set.range (c.toLimit m)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨c.iter h x, c.toLimit_iter h x⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iUnion_range_toLimit
statement: theorem iUnion_range_toLimit : ⋃ n, Set.range (c.toLimit n) = univ
proof:
:=
  eq_univ_of_forall fun p => by
    obtain ⟨n, x, rfl⟩ := c.toLimit_surjective p
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, x, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.continuous_toLimit
statement: theorem continuous_toLimit (n : ℕ) : Continuous (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:=
  continuous_quotient_mk'.comp continuous_sigmaMk

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.preimage_toLimit_image
statement:
theorem preimage_toLimit_image (n m : ℕ) (U : Set (c.X n)) :
    Sigma.mk m ⁻¹' (Quotient.mk c.setoid ⁻¹' (c.toLimit n '' U)) =
      c.iter (le_max_left m n) ⁻¹' (c.iter (le_max_right m n) '' U)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, (c.toLimit_eq_iff_iter (le_max_right m n) (le_max_left m n)).mp hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, (c.toLimit_eq_iff_iter (le_max_right m n) (le_max_left m n)).mpr hxy⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isOpenMap_toLimit
statement: theorem isOpenMap_toLimit (n : ℕ) : IsOpenMap (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  have hsat : IsOpen (Quotient.mk c.setoid ⁻¹' (c.toLimit n '' U)) := by
    rw [isOpen_sigma_iff]
    intro m
    rw [preimage_toLimit_image]
    exact ((c.isOpenEmbedding_iter (le_max_right m n)).isOpenMap U hU).preimage
      (c.iter (le_max_left m n)).contMDiff.continuous
  exact (isQuotientMap_quotient_mk' (s := c.setoid)).isOpen_preimage.mp hsat

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isOpenEmbedding_toLimit
statement: theorem isOpenEmbedding_toLimit (n : ℕ) : IsOpenEmbedding (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:=
  .of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap (c.continuous_toLimit n) (c.toLimit_injective n)
    (c.isOpenMap_toLimit n)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isOpen_range_toLimit
statement: theorem isOpen_range_toLimit (n : ℕ) : IsOpen (Set.range (c.toLimit n))
proof:
:=
  (c.isOpenEmbedding_toLimit n).isOpen_range

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.apply_iter
statement:
theorem apply_iter {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E} (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y)
    (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (x : c.X n) :
    f m (c.iter h x) = f n x
proof:
:= by
  induction m, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rw [iter_self_apply]
  | succ m hnm ih => rw [iter_succ_apply c hnm, hf, ih]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitDescFun_toLimit
statement:
theorem limitDescFun_toLimit {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E} (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y)
    (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x) (n : ℕ) (x : c.X n) :
    c.limitDescFun f hf (c.toLimit n x) = f n x
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.contMDiff_limitDescFun
statement:
theorem contMDiff_limitDescFun {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E} (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y)
    (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (c.limitDescFun f hf)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  obtain ⟨n, x, rfl⟩ := c.toLimit_surjective p
  have : Nonempty (c.X n) := ⟨x⟩
  have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (f n ∘ (c.pieceOpenEmb n).symm)
      (Set.range (c.toLimit n)) :=
    (f n).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn (c.contMDiffOn_pieceOpenEmb_symm n)
  refine (h1.congr fun q hq => ?_).contMDiffAt ((c.isOpen_range_toLimit n).mem_nhds ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  rw [Function.comp_apply, ← c.limitDescFun_toLimit f hf n, c.toLimit_pieceOpenEmb_symm n hq]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitDesc_toLimit
statement:
theorem limitDesc_toLimit {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E} (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y)
    (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x) (n : ℕ) (x : c.X n) :
    c.limitDesc f hf (c.toLimit n x) = f n x
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitDesc_comp_toLimitMap
statement:
theorem limitDesc_comp_toLimitMap {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E} (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y)
    (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x) (n : ℕ) :
    (c.limitDesc f hf).comp (c.toLimitMap n) = f n
proof: := ContMDiffMap.ext fun _ => rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.apply_mem_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem apply_mem_of_range_eq {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E} (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y)
    (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x) (V : ℕ → Set Y)
    (hι : ∀ n, Set.range (c.ι n) = f (n + 1) ⁻¹' V n) (n : ℕ) (x : c.X n) : f n x ∈ V n
proof:
:= by
  have h : c.ι n x ∈ Set.range (c.ι n) := ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rwa [hι n, mem_preimage, hf n x] at h

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_mem_range_of_apply_mem
statement:
theorem toLimit_mem_range_of_apply_mem {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E}
    (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y) (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x)
    (V : ℕ → Set Y) (hV : ∀ n, V n ⊆ V (n + 1))
    (hι : ∀ n, Set.range (c.ι n) = f (n + 1) ⁻¹' V n) {n m : ℕ} (y : c.X m) (hy : f m y ∈ V n) :
    c.toLimit m y ∈ Set.range (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact c.range_toLimit_mono (Nat.zero_le n) ⟨y, rfl⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    by_cases h : m + 1 ≤ n
    · exact c.range_toLimit_mono h ⟨y, rfl⟩
    · have hmn : n ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_not_le h)
      have hy' : y ∈ Set.range (c.ι m) := by
        rw [hι m, mem_preimage]
        exact (monotone_nat_of_le_succ hV hmn : V n ⊆ V m) hy
      obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hy'
      rw [toLimit_succ]
      exact ih y' (by rwa [← hf m y'])

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.preimage_limitDesc_eq_range_toLimit
statement:
theorem preimage_limitDesc_eq_range_toLimit {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E}
    (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y) (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x)
    (V : ℕ → Set Y) (hV : ∀ n, V n ⊆ V (n + 1))
    (hι : ∀ n, Set.range (c.ι n) = f (n + 1) ⁻¹' V n) (n : ℕ) :
    c.limitDesc f hf ⁻¹' V n = Set.range (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  obtain ⟨m, y, rfl⟩ := c.toLimit_surjective p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    exact c.toLimit_mem_range_of_apply_mem f hf V hV hι y hp
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h1 : c.limitDescFun f hf (c.toLimit n x) ∈ V n := c.apply_mem_of_range_eq f hf V hι n x
    rw [hx] at h1
    exact h1

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.preimage_limitDesc_eq_range_toLimitMap
statement:
theorem preimage_limitDesc_eq_range_toLimitMap {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E}
    (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y) (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x)
    (V : ℕ → Set Y) (hV : ∀ n, V n ⊆ V (n + 1))
    (hι : ∀ n, Set.range (c.ι n) = f (n + 1) ⁻¹' V n) (n : ℕ) :
    c.limitDesc f hf ⁻¹' V n = Set.range (c.toLimitMap n)
proof:
:=
  c.preimage_limitDesc_eq_range_toLimit f hf V hV hι n

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isAnalyticIsoOver_toLimitMap_limitDesc
statement:
theorem isAnalyticIsoOver_toLimitMap_limitDesc {Y : AnalyticManifold.{u} 𝕜 E}
    (f : ∀ n, AnalyticMap (c.X n) Y) (hf : ∀ n (x : c.X n), f (n + 1) (c.ι n x) = f n x)
    (V : ℕ → Set Y) (hV : ∀ n, V n ⊆ V (n + 1))
    (hι : ∀ n, Set.range (c.ι n) = f (n + 1) ⁻¹' V n) (n : ℕ) :
    (c.toLimitMap n).IsIsoOver (c.limitDesc f hf ⁻¹' V n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.preimage_limitDesc_eq_range_toLimitMap f hf V hV hι n]
  exact c.isAnalyticIsoOver_toLimitMap n

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isClosed_iff_forall_preimage_toLimit
statement:
theorem isClosed_iff_forall_preimage_toLimit (s : Set c.Limit) :
    IsClosed s ↔ ∀ n, IsClosed (c.toLimit n ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs n
    exact hs.preimage (c.continuous_toLimit n)
  · intro h
    have hsat : IsClosed (Quotient.mk c.setoid ⁻¹' s) := by
      rw [isClosed_sigma_iff]
      exact h
    exact (isQuotientMap_quotient_mk' (s := c.setoid)).isClosed_preimage.mp hsat

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitChart_mem_maximalAtlas
statement:
theorem limitChart_mem_maximalAtlas (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)]
    {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E} (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (c.X n)) :
    c.limitChart n φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω c.Limit
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_maximalAtlas_of_contMDiffOn _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [c.limitChart_source]
    exact (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ).comp
      ((c.contMDiffOn_pieceOpenEmb_symm n).mono inter_subset_left) fun _ hx => hx.2
  · rw [c.limitChart_target]
    refine ((c.contMDiff_toLimit n).comp_contMDiffOn
      (contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ)).congr fun v _ => ?_
    exact (c.limitChart_symm_apply n φ v).symm

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_mem_limitChart_source
statement:
theorem toLimit_mem_limitChart_source (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)]
    (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E) {x : c.X n} (hx : x ∈ φ.source) :
    c.toLimit n x ∈ (c.limitChart n φ).source
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.limitChart_source]
  refine ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  change (c.pieceOpenEmb n).symm (c.toLimit n x) ∈ φ.source
  rw [c.pieceOpenEmb_symm_toLimit]
  exact hx

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.exists_eq_toLimit_of_mem_limitChart_source
statement:
theorem exists_eq_toLimit_of_mem_limitChart_source (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)]
    (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E) {q : c.Limit} (hq : q ∈ (c.limitChart n φ).source) :
    ∃ x ∈ φ.source, c.toLimit n x = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.limitChart_source] at hq
  obtain ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩, hx⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩
  change (c.pieceOpenEmb n).symm (c.toLimit n x) ∈ φ.source at hx
  rwa [c.pieceOpenEmb_symm_toLimit] at hx

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitChart_toLimit
statement:
theorem limitChart_toLimit (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E)
    (x : c.X n) : c.limitChart n φ (c.toLimit n x) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.limitChart_apply, c.pieceOpenEmb_symm_toLimit]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.iter_self
statement: theorem iter_self (m : ℕ) : D.iter (le_refl m) = RelEmbedding.refl _
proof: := Nat.leRecOn_self _

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.iter_self_apply
statement: theorem iter_self_apply (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ m) (j : (D.H m).ι) : D.iter h j = j
proof:
:= by
  rw [iter_self]
  rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.iter_succ
statement:
theorem iter_succ {m m' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ m') (h' : m ≤ m' + 1) :
    D.iter h' = (D.iter h).trans (D.ε m')
proof: := Nat.leRecOn_succ h _

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.iter_succ_apply
statement:
theorem iter_succ_apply {m m' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ m') (h' : m ≤ m' + 1) (j : (D.H m).ι) :
    D.iter h' j = D.ε m' (D.iter h j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.iter_succ h h']
  rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.iter_trans
statement:
theorem iter_trans {m m' k : ℕ} (h₁ : m ≤ m') (h₂ : m' ≤ k) (j : (D.H m).ι) :
    D.iter h₂ (D.iter h₁ j) = D.iter (h₁.trans h₂) j
proof:
:= by
  induction k, h₂ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rw [iter_self_apply]
  | succ k hmk ih =>
    rw [D.iter_succ_apply hmk (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmk), ih,
      D.iter_succ_apply (h₁.trans hmk) (h₁.trans (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmk))]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.preimage_iter_hyp_iter
statement:
theorem preimage_iter_hyp_iter {m m' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ m') (j : (D.H m).ι) :
    ⇑(c.iter h) ⁻¹' (D.H m').hyp (D.iter h j) = (D.H m).hyp j
proof:
:= by
  induction m', h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    rw [D.iter_self_apply, c.iter_self]
    rfl
  | succ k hmk ih =>
    rw [D.iter_succ_apply hmk (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmk), c.iter_succ hmk (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmk)]
    change ⇑(c.iter hmk) ⁻¹' (⇑(c.ι k) ⁻¹' (D.H (k + 1)).hyp (D.ε k (D.iter hmk j))) = _
    rw [D.preimage_hyp_ε, ih]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.preimage_iter_hyp_eq_empty
statement:
theorem preimage_iter_hyp_eq_empty {m m' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ m') (b : (D.H m').ι)
    (hb : b ∉ Set.range (D.iter h)) : ⇑(c.iter h) ⁻¹' (D.H m').hyp b = ∅
proof:
:= by
  induction m', h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact absurd ⟨b, D.iter_self_apply m _ b⟩ hb
  | succ k hmk ih =>
    rw [c.iter_succ hmk (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmk)]
    change ⇑(c.iter hmk) ⁻¹' (⇑(c.ι k) ⁻¹' (D.H (k + 1)).hyp b) = ∅
    by_cases hbr : b ∈ Set.range (D.ε k)
    · obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hbr
      have hb' : b' ∉ Set.range (D.iter hmk) := fun ⟨j, hj⟩ =>
        hb ⟨j, by rw [D.iter_succ_apply hmk (Nat.le_succ_of_le hmk), hj]⟩
      rw [D.preimage_hyp_ε, ih b' hb']
    · rw [D.preimage_hyp_eq_empty k b hbr, preimage_empty]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.born_zero
statement: theorem born_zero (j : (D.H 0).ι) : D.Born 0 j
proof: := trivial

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.born_succ_iff
statement: theorem born_succ_iff (m : ℕ) (j : (D.H (m + 1)).ι) : D.Born (m + 1) j ↔ j ∉ Set.range (D.ε m)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.exists_born
statement:
theorem exists_born : ∀ (m' : ℕ) (b : (D.H m').ι),
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ m') (j : (D.H m).ι), D.Born m j ∧ D.iter h j = b
  | 0, b => ⟨0, le_rfl, b, trivial, D.iter_self_apply 0 le_rfl b⟩
  | m' + 1, b => by
    by_cases hb : b ∈ Set.range (D.ε m')
    · obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩
proof:
:= hb
      obtain ⟨m, h, j, hj, hjb⟩ := exists_born m' b'
      exact ⟨m, h.trans (Nat.le_succ m'), j, hj,
        by rw [D.iter_succ_apply h (h.trans (Nat.le_succ m')), hjb]⟩
    · exact ⟨m' + 1, le_rfl, b, hb, D.iter_self_apply _ le_rfl b⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.not_lt_of_born_of_iter_eq
statement:
theorem not_lt_of_born_of_iter_eq {m₁ m₂ m' : ℕ} (h₁ : m₁ ≤ m') (h₂ : m₂ ≤ m')
    {j₁ : (D.H m₁).ι} {j₂ : (D.H m₂).ι} (hb₂ : D.Born m₂ j₂)
    (heq : D.iter h₁ j₁ = D.iter h₂ j₂) : ¬ m₁ < m₂
proof:
:= by
  intro hlt
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m₂ = k + 1 := ⟨m₂ - 1, by omega⟩
  have hk : m₁ ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt
  have h3 : D.iter h₂ (D.iter (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk) j₁) = D.iter h₂ j₂ := by
    rw [D.iter_trans]
    exact heq
  have e := (D.iter h₂).injective h3
  exact hb₂ ⟨D.iter hk j₁, by rw [← D.iter_succ_apply hk (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)]; exact e⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.eq_of_born_of_iter_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_born_of_iter_eq {m₁ m₂ m' : ℕ} (h₁ : m₁ ≤ m') (h₂ : m₂ ≤ m')
    {j₁ : (D.H m₁).ι} {j₂ : (D.H m₂).ι} (hb₁ : D.Born m₁ j₁) (hb₂ : D.Born m₂ j₂)
    (heq : D.iter h₁ j₁ = D.iter h₂ j₂) :
    (⟨m₁, j₁⟩ : Σ m, (D.H m).ι) = ⟨m₂, j₂⟩
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy m₁ m₂ with hlt | hm | hgt
  · exact absurd hlt (D.not_lt_of_born_of_iter_eq h₁ h₂ hb₂ heq)
  · subst hm
    rw [(D.iter h₁).injective heq]
  · exact absurd hgt (D.not_lt_of_born_of_iter_eq h₂ h₁ hb₁ heq.symm)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.birth_le
statement: theorem birth_le (m' : ℕ) (b : (D.H m').ι) : (D.birth m' b).1 ≤ m'
proof:
:=
  (D.exists_born m' b).choose_spec.choose

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.born_birth
statement: theorem born_birth (m' : ℕ) (b : (D.H m').ι) : D.Born (D.birth m' b).1 (D.birth m' b).2
proof:
:=
  (D.exists_born m' b).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.iter_birth
statement: theorem iter_birth (m' : ℕ) (b : (D.H m').ι) : D.iter (D.birth_le m' b) (D.birth m' b).2 = b
proof:
:=
  (D.exists_born m' b).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec.2

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.iter_congr_sigma
statement:
theorem iter_congr_sigma {m' : ℕ} {p q : Σ m, (D.H m).ι} (hp : p.1 ≤ m') (hq : q.1 ≤ m')
    (h : p = q) : D.iter hp p.2 = D.iter hq q.2
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.eq_of_birth_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_birth_eq {m' : ℕ} {b₁ b₂ : (D.H m').ι} (h : D.birth m' b₁ = D.birth m' b₂) :
    b₁ = b₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.iter_birth m' b₁, ← D.iter_birth m' b₂]
  exact D.iter_congr_sigma _ _ h

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.birth_iter_of_born
statement:
theorem birth_iter_of_born {m m' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ m') {j : (D.H m).ι} (hj : D.Born m j) :
    D.birth m' (D.iter h j) = ⟨m, j⟩
proof:
:=
  D.eq_of_born_of_iter_eq (D.birth_le m' _) h (D.born_birth m' _) hj (D.iter_birth m' _)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.glue_hyp
statement: theorem glue_hyp (p : Σₗ m : ℕ, (D.H m).ι) : D.glue.hyp p = D.glueHyp (ofLex p).1 (ofLex p).2
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.glueHyp_of_not_born
statement: theorem glueHyp_of_not_born {m : ℕ} {j : (D.H m).ι} (hj : ¬ D.Born m j) : D.glueHyp m j = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold glueHyp
  rw [ite_eq_right hj]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.preimage_toLimit_glueHyp
statement:
theorem preimage_toLimit_glueHyp {m : ℕ} {j : (D.H m).ι} (hj : D.Born m j) (m'' : ℕ) :
    c.toLimit m'' ⁻¹' D.glueHyp m j =
      if h : m ≤ m'' then (D.H m'').hyp (D.iter h j) else ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  unfold glueHyp
  rw [ite_eq_left hj]
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_iUnion, mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m', h, y, hy, hxy⟩
    have hx₀ : c.iter (le_max_right m' m'') x = c.iter (le_max_left m' m'') y :=
      (c.toLimit_eq_iff_iter (le_max_right m' m'') (le_max_left m' m'')).mp hxy.symm
    have hy₀ : c.iter (le_max_left m' m'') y ∈
        (D.H (max m' m'')).hyp (D.iter (h.trans (le_max_left m' m'')) j) := by
      rw [← D.iter_trans h (le_max_left m' m''), ← mem_preimage, D.preimage_iter_hyp_iter]
      exact hy
    rw [← hx₀] at hy₀
    by_cases hmm : m ≤ m''
    · rw [dite_eq_left hmm]
      have e := D.iter_trans hmm (le_max_right m' m'') j
      rw [← e, ← mem_preimage, D.preimage_iter_hyp_iter] at hy₀
      exact hy₀
    · exfalso
      have hnot : D.iter (h.trans (le_max_left m' m'')) j ∉ Set.range (D.iter (le_max_right m' m''))
          := by
        rintro ⟨ν, hν⟩
        have hlt : m'' < m := Nat.lt_of_not_le hmm
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
        have hk : m'' ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt
        have h3 : D.iter (h.trans (le_max_left m' m'')) (D.iter (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk) ν) =
            D.iter (h.trans (le_max_left m' m'')) j := by
          rw [D.iter_trans]
          exact hν
        have e := (D.iter (h.trans (le_max_left m' m''))).injective h3
        exact hj ⟨D.iter hk ν, by rw [← D.iter_succ_apply hk (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)]; exact e⟩
      have := D.preimage_iter_hyp_eq_empty (le_max_right m' m'') _ hnot
      rw [← mem_preimage, this] at hy₀
      exact hy₀
  · intro hx
    by_cases hmm : m ≤ m''
    · rw [dite_eq_left hmm] at hx
      exact ⟨m'', hmm, x, hx, rfl⟩
    · rw [dite_eq_right hmm] at hx
      exact absurd hx (notMem_empty x)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.preimage_toLimit_glueHyp_birth
statement:
theorem preimage_toLimit_glueHyp_birth (m' : ℕ) (b : (D.H m').ι) :
    c.toLimit m' ⁻¹' D.glueHyp (D.birth m' b).1 (D.birth m' b).2 = (D.H m').hyp b
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.preimage_toLimit_glueHyp (D.born_birth m' b), dite_eq_left (D.birth_le m' b), D.iter_birth]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff
statement:
theorem toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff (m : ℕ) (j : (D.H m).ι) (m'' : ℕ) (x : c.X m'') :
    c.toLimit m'' x ∈ D.glueHyp m j ↔
      D.Born m j ∧ ∃ h : m ≤ m'', x ∈ (D.H m'').hyp (D.iter h j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : D.Born m j
  · rw [← mem_preimage, D.preimage_toLimit_glueHyp hj]
    by_cases hmm : m ≤ m''
    · rw [dite_eq_left hmm]
      exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨hj, hmm, hx⟩, fun ⟨_, _, hx⟩ => hx⟩
    · rw [dite_eq_right hmm]
      exact ⟨fun hx => absurd hx (notMem_empty x), fun ⟨_, h, _⟩ => absurd h hmm⟩
  · rw [D.glueHyp_of_not_born hj]
    exact ⟨fun hx => absurd hx (notMem_empty _), fun ⟨h, _⟩ => absurd h hj⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.isClosed_glueHyp
statement:
theorem isClosed_glueHyp (hcl : ∀ (m : ℕ) (j : (D.H m).ι), IsClosed ((D.H m).hyp j)) (m : ℕ)
    (j : (D.H m).ι) : IsClosed (D.glueHyp m j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.isClosed_iff_forall_preimage_toLimit]
  intro n
  by_cases hj : D.Born m j
  · rw [D.preimage_toLimit_glueHyp hj]
    split_ifs
    · exact hcl _ _
    · exact isClosed_empty
  · rw [D.glueHyp_of_not_born hj, preimage_empty]
    exact isClosed_empty

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.preimage_toLimit_support_glue
statement:
theorem preimage_toLimit_support_glue (m'' : ℕ) :
    c.toLimit m'' ⁻¹' D.glue.support = (D.H m'').support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [HypersurfaceFamily.support, mem_preimage, mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨-, h, hx⟩ := (D.toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff _ _ m'' x).mp hp
    exact ⟨_, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine ⟨toLex (D.birth m'' b), ?_⟩
    change c.toLimit m'' x ∈ D.glueHyp (D.birth m'' b).1 (D.birth m'' b).2
    rw [D.toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff]
    exact ⟨D.born_birth m'' b, D.birth_le m'' b, by rw [D.iter_birth]; exact hb⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isAdaptedChart_limitChart
statement:
theorem _root_.Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isAdaptedChart_limitChart (m : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X m)]
    {Y' : Set c.Limit} {Y : Set (c.X m)} (hY : c.toLimit m ⁻¹' Y' = Y)
    {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X m) E} {k : ℕ} {σ : Fin k ↪ Fin n}
    (hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ σ) : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y' (c.limitChart m φ) σ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨c.limitChart_mem_maximalAtlas m hφ.1, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := c.exists_eq_toLimit_of_mem_limitChart_source m φ hy
  rw [c.limitChart_toLimit, ← hφ.2 z hz, ← hY]
  rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.isClosedSubmanifold_glueHyp
statement:
theorem isClosedSubmanifold_glueHyp (hH : ∀ m, (D.H m).IsSnc ψ) (m : ℕ) (j : (D.H m).ι) :
    IsClosedSubmanifold ψ (D.glueHyp m j) 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨D.isClosed_glueHyp (fun m j => ((hH m).1 j).isClosed) m j, fun q hq => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m'', x, rfl⟩ := c.toLimit_surjective q
  have : Nonempty (c.X m'') := ⟨x⟩
  obtain ⟨hj, h, hx⟩ := (D.toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff m j m'' x).mp hq
  obtain ⟨φ, σ, hxφ, hadapt⟩ := ((hH m'').1 (D.iter h j)).exists_adaptedChart x hx
  refine ⟨c.limitChart m'' φ, σ, c.toLimit_mem_limitChart_source m'' φ hxφ,
    c.isAdaptedChart_limitChart ψ m'' ?_ hadapt⟩
  rw [D.preimage_toLimit_glueHyp hj, dite_eq_left h]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.glueIdx_injective
statement:
theorem glueIdx_injective {m'' : ℕ} {x : c.X m''} :
    Function.Injective (D.glueIdx (m'' := m'') (x := x))
proof:
:= by
  intro p₁ p₂ hp
  have born : ∀ p : {p // c.toLimit m'' x ∈ D.glue.hyp p}, D.Born (ofLex p.1).1 (ofLex p.1).2 :=
    fun p => ((D.toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff _ _ m'' x).mp p.2).1
  have e := D.eq_of_born_of_iter_eq _ _ (born p₁) (born p₂) (congrArg Subtype.val hp)
  apply Subtype.ext
  change p₁.1 = p₂.1
  exact ofLex.injective (e : ofLex p₁.1 = ofLex p₂.1)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.isSncChartAt_glue_limitChart
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨c.limitChart_mem_maximalAtlas m'' hc.mem_maximalAtlas,
    c.toLimit_mem_limitChart_source m'' φ hc.mem_source, fun p y hy => ?_,
    fun p₁ p₂ hp => D.glueIdx_injective (hc.injective hp)⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := c.exists_eq_toLimit_of_mem_limitChart_source m'' φ hy
  rw [c.limitChart_toLimit]
  change c.toLimit m'' z ∈ D.glueHyp (ofLex p.1).1 (ofLex p.1).2 ↔
    ψ (φ z) (cidx (D.glueIdx p)) = 0
  rw [D.toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff, ← hc.mem_iff (D.glueIdx p) hz]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h', hz'⟩
    exact hz'
  · intro hz'
    exact ⟨((D.toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff _ _ m'' x).mp p.2).1, _, hz'⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.locallyFinite_glue
statement: theorem locallyFinite_glue (hH : ∀ m, LocallyFinite (D.H m).hyp) : LocallyFinite D.glue.hyp
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨m'', x, rfl⟩ := c.toLimit_surjective q
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hfin⟩ := hH m'' x
  refine ⟨c.toLimit m'' '' t, (c.isOpenEmbedding_toLimit m'').isOpenMap.image_mem_nhds ht, ?_⟩
  refine ((hfin.image (fun b => toLex (D.birth m'' b))).subset fun p hp => ?_)
  obtain ⟨_, hpq, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩ := hp
  rw [glue_hyp, D.toLimit_mem_glueHyp_iff] at hpq
  obtain ⟨hb, h, hy'⟩ := hpq
  refine ⟨D.iter h (ofLex p).2, ⟨y, hy', hy⟩, ?_⟩
  change toLex (D.birth m'' (D.iter h (ofLex p).2)) = p
  rw [D.birth_iter_of_born h hb]
  rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.FamilyChain.isSnc_glue
statement: theorem isSnc_glue (hH : ∀ m, (D.H m).IsSnc ψ) : D.glue.IsSnc ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p => D.isClosedSubmanifold_glueHyp ψ hH _ _,
    D.locallyFinite_glue fun m => (hH m).2.1, fun q => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m'', x, rfl⟩ := c.toLimit_surjective q
  have : Nonempty (c.X m'') := ⟨x⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, cidx, hc⟩ := (hH m'').2.2 x
  exact ⟨c.limitChart m'' φ, _, D.isSncChartAt_glue_limitChart ψ hc⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.pieceOpenEmb_apply
statement:
theorem pieceOpenEmb_apply (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] (x : c.X n) :
    c.pieceOpenEmb n x = c.toLimit n x
proof:
:=
  congr_fun ((c.isOpenEmbedding_toLimit n).toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply (c.toLimit n)) x

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.pieceOpenEmb_source
statement: theorem pieceOpenEmb_source (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] : (c.pieceOpenEmb n).source = univ
proof:
:=
  (c.isOpenEmbedding_toLimit n).toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source (c.toLimit n)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.pieceOpenEmb_target
statement:
theorem pieceOpenEmb_target (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] :
    (c.pieceOpenEmb n).target = Set.range (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:=
  (c.isOpenEmbedding_toLimit n).toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target (c.toLimit n)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.pieceOpenEmb_symm_toLimit
statement:
theorem pieceOpenEmb_symm_toLimit (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] (x : c.X n) :
    (c.pieceOpenEmb n).symm (c.toLimit n x) = x
proof:
:=
  (c.isOpenEmbedding_toLimit n).toOpenPartialHomeomorph_left_inv (c.toLimit n)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_pieceOpenEmb_symm
statement:
theorem toLimit_pieceOpenEmb_symm (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] {p : c.Limit}
    (hp : p ∈ Set.range (c.toLimit n)) : c.toLimit n ((c.pieceOpenEmb n).symm p) = p
proof:
:=
  (c.isOpenEmbedding_toLimit n).toOpenPartialHomeomorph_right_inv (c.toLimit n) hp

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_rep
statement: theorem toLimit_rep (p : c.Limit) : c.toLimit (c.repIdx p) (c.rep p) = p
proof:
:=
  (c.toLimit_surjective p).choose_spec.choose_spec

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.nonempty_repIdx
statement: theorem nonempty_repIdx (p : c.Limit) : Nonempty (c.X (c.repIdx p))
proof: := ⟨c.rep p⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitChart_source
statement:
theorem limitChart_source (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E) :
    (c.limitChart n φ).source = Set.range (c.toLimit n) ∩ (c.pieceOpenEmb n).symm ⁻¹' φ.source
proof:
:= by
  rw [limitChart, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source,
    pieceOpenEmb_target]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitChart_target
statement:
theorem limitChart_target (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E) :
    (c.limitChart n φ).target = φ.target
proof:
:= by
  rw [limitChart, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_target, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_target,
    pieceOpenEmb_source, preimage_univ, inter_univ]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitChart_apply
statement:
theorem limitChart_apply (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E)
    (p : c.Limit) : c.limitChart n φ p = φ ((c.pieceOpenEmb n).symm p)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitChart_symm_apply
statement:
theorem limitChart_symm_apply (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E)
    (v : E) : (c.limitChart n φ).symm v = c.toLimit n (φ.symm v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [limitChart, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_symm_eq_symm_trans_symm,
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_symm]
  exact c.pieceOpenEmb_apply n _

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.pieceOpenEmb_symm_rep
statement:
theorem pieceOpenEmb_symm_rep (p : c.Limit) :
    haveI
proof:
:= c.nonempty_repIdx p
    (c.pieceOpenEmb (c.repIdx p)).symm p = c.rep p := by
  have := c.nonempty_repIdx p
  have h := c.pieceOpenEmb_symm_toLimit (c.repIdx p) (c.rep p)
  rwa [c.toLimit_rep p] at h

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.mem_atlas_limit_iff
statement:
theorem mem_atlas_limit_iff {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph c.Limit E} :
    Φ ∈ atlas E c.Limit ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : Nonempty (c.X n)) (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E),
      φ ∈ atlas E (c.X n) ∧ Φ = c.limitChart n φ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.limitChart_mem_atlas
statement:
theorem limitChart_mem_atlas (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E}
    (hφ : φ ∈ atlas E (c.X n)) : c.limitChart n φ ∈ atlas E c.Limit
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, inferInstance, φ, hφ, rfl⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimit_transition
proof:
:=
  c.toLimit_pieceOpenEmb_symm m hx

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.iter_transition
proof:
:=
  (c.toLimit_eq_iff_iter (le_max_right n m) (le_max_left n m)).mp (c.toLimit_transition n m hx)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isOpen_transitionDomain
statement:
theorem isOpen_transitionDomain (n m : ℕ) :
    IsOpen (c.toLimit n ⁻¹' Set.range (c.toLimit m))
proof:
:=
  (c.isOpen_range_toLimit m).preimage (c.continuous_toLimit n)

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.continuousOn_transition
statement:
theorem continuousOn_transition (n m : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X m)] :
    ContinuousOn (c.transition n m) (c.toLimit n ⁻¹' Set.range (c.toLimit m))
proof:
:=
  (c.pieceOpenEmb m).symm.continuousOn.comp (c.continuous_toLimit n).continuousOn fun x hx => by
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source, pieceOpenEmb_target]
    exact hx

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.contMDiffOn_transition
statement:
theorem contMDiffOn_transition (n m : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X m)] :
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (c.transition n m)
      (c.toLimit n ⁻¹' Set.range (c.toLimit m))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hD := c.isOpen_transitionDomain n m
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦx, hΦ⟩ :=
    (c.isLocalDiffeomorph_iter (le_max_right n m) (c.transition n m x)).exists_partialDiffeomorph
  have key : c.transition n m =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => Φ.symm (c.iter (le_max_left n m) y) := by
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, y ∈ c.toLimit n ⁻¹' Set.range (c.toLimit m) := hD.mem_nhds hx
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, c.transition n m y ∈ Φ.source :=
      ((c.continuousOn_transition n m).continuousAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)).preimage_mem_nhds
        (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hΦx)
    filter_upwards [h1, h2] with y hyD hyΦ
    rw [← c.iter_transition n m hyD, hΦ hyΦ]
    exact (Φ.left_inv hyΦ).symm
  refine (ContMDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ key).contMDiffWithinAt
  have hmem : c.iter (le_max_left n m) x ∈ Φ.target := by
    rw [← c.iter_transition n m hx, hΦ hΦx]
    exact Φ.map_source hΦx
  exact (Φ.symm.contMDiffOn.contMDiffAt (Φ.open_target.mem_nhds hmem)).comp x
    (c.iter (le_max_left n m)).contMDiff.contMDiffAt

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.mem_source_trans_limitChart
statement:
theorem mem_source_trans_limitChart (n m : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] [Nonempty (c.X m)]
    (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X n) E) (ψ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (c.X m) E) {v : E}
    (hv : v ∈ ((c.limitChart n φ).symm ≫ₕ c.limitChart m ψ).source) :
    v ∈ φ.target ∧ φ.symm v ∈ c.toLimit n ⁻¹' Set.range (c.toLimit m) ∩ φ.source ∩
      c.transition n m ⁻¹' ψ.source
proof:
:= by
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source,
    limitChart_target] at hv
  obtain ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ := hv
  rw [mem_preimage, limitChart_symm_apply, limitChart_source, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage] at hv2
  exact ⟨hv1, ⟨⟨hv2.1, φ.map_target hv1⟩, hv2.2⟩⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.contMDiffOn_pieceOpenEmb_symm
statement:
theorem contMDiffOn_pieceOpenEmb_symm (n : ℕ) [Nonempty (c.X n)] :
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (c.pieceOpenEmb n).symm (Set.range (c.toLimit n))
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hΦ : c.limitChart n (chartAt E y) ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω c.Limit :=
    IsManifold.subset_maximalAtlas (c.limitChart_mem_atlas n (chart_mem_atlas E y))
  have hsrc : c.toLimit n y ∈ (c.limitChart n (chartAt E y)).source := by
    rw [limitChart_source, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage, pieceOpenEmb_symm_toLimit]
    exact ⟨⟨y, rfl⟩, mem_chart_source E y⟩
  have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω ((chartAt E y).symm ∘ c.limitChart n (chartAt E y))
      (c.limitChart n (chartAt E y)).source :=
    (contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas
      (IsManifold.subset_maximalAtlas (chart_mem_atlas E y))).comp
      (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hΦ) fun p hp => by
        have h := (c.limitChart n (chartAt E y)).map_source hp
        rwa [limitChart_target] at h
  refine ((h1.congr fun p hp => ?_).contMDiffAt
    ((c.limitChart n (chartAt E y)).open_source.mem_nhds hsrc)).contMDiffWithinAt
  rw [limitChart_source, mem_inter_iff, mem_preimage] at hp
  rw [Function.comp_apply, limitChart_apply, (chartAt E y).left_inv hp.2]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.contMDiff_toLimit
statement: theorem contMDiff_toLimit (n : ℕ) : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have : Nonempty (c.X n) := ⟨x⟩
  have hΦ : c.limitChart n (chartAt E x) ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω c.Limit :=
    IsManifold.subset_maximalAtlas (c.limitChart_mem_atlas n (chart_mem_atlas E x))
  have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω ((c.limitChart n (chartAt E x)).symm ∘ chartAt E x)
      (chartAt E x).source :=
    (contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hΦ).comp
      (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas (IsManifold.subset_maximalAtlas (chart_mem_atlas E x)))
      fun y hy => by
        rw [limitChart_target]
        exact (chartAt E x).map_source hy
  refine (h1.congr fun y hy => ?_).contMDiffAt
    ((chartAt E x).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E x))
  rw [Function.comp_apply, limitChart_symm_apply, (chartAt E x).left_inv hy]

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.toLimitMap_apply
statement: theorem toLimitMap_apply (n : ℕ) (x : c.X n) : c.toLimitMap n x = c.toLimit n x
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isLocalDiffeomorph_toLimit
statement:
theorem isLocalDiffeomorph_toLimit (n : ℕ) :
    IsLocalDiffeomorph 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (c.toLimit n)
proof:
:= fun x =>
  haveI : Nonempty (c.X n) := ⟨x⟩
  IsLocalDiffeomorphAt.of_eqOn (c.pieceDiffeomorph n)
    (by
      change x ∈ (c.pieceOpenEmb n).source
      rw [pieceOpenEmb_source]
      exact mem_univ x)
    fun y _ => (c.pieceOpenEmb_apply n y).symm

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isAnalyticOpenEmbedding_toLimitMap
statement: theorem isAnalyticOpenEmbedding_toLimitMap (n : ℕ) : IsAnalyticOpenEmbedding (c.toLimitMap n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨c.isLocalDiffeomorph_toLimit n, c.toLimit_injective n⟩

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.range_toLimitMap
statement: theorem range_toLimitMap (n : ℕ) : Set.range (c.toLimitMap n) = Set.range (c.toLimit n)
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.OpenEmbeddingChain.isAnalyticIsoOver_toLimitMap
statement:
theorem isAnalyticIsoOver_toLimitMap (n : ℕ) :
    (c.toLimitMap n).IsIsoOver (Set.range (c.toLimitMap n))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => c.isLocalDiffeomorph_toLimit n x, fun x _ => ⟨x, rfl⟩,
    fun _ _ _ _ hxy => c.toLimit_injective n hxy, fun _ ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, hx⟩⟩

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.mem_singularLocus
statement:
theorem mem_singularLocus {F : HypersurfaceFamily M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ F.singularLocus ↔ ∃ i j : F.ι, i ≠ j ∧ x ∈ F.hyp i ∧ x ∈ F.hyp j
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.singularLocus_subset_support
statement: theorem singularLocus_subset_support (F : HypersurfaceFamily M) : F.singularLocus ⊆ F.support
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨i, _, _, hi, _⟩
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.singularLocus_empty
statement: theorem singularLocus_empty : (HypersurfaceFamily.empty M).singularLocus = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨i, -, -, -, -⟩ := hx
  exact i.elim

name: Manifold.dense_setOf_coord_ne_zero
statement: theorem dense_setOf_coord_ne_zero (i : Fin n) : Dense {z : E | ψ z i ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  set S : Submodule 𝕜 E := (LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.proj i : (Fin n → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜)).comap
    ψ.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap with hS
  have hmem : ∀ z : E, z ∈ S ↔ ψ z i = 0 := fun z => by
    simp [hS, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  have hne : S ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    have h1 : ψ.symm (Pi.single i (1 : 𝕜)) ∈ S := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    rw [hmem, ψ.apply_symm_apply, Pi.single_eq_same] at h1
    exact one_ne_zero h1
  have := NormedField.nhdsWithin_isUnit_neBot (α := 𝕜)
  have hint : interior (S : Set E) = ∅ := by
    by_contra h
    exact hne (Submodule.eq_top_of_nonempty_interior' S (Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr h))
  have hd := interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl.mp hint
  convert hd using 1
  ext z
  simp [hmem]

name: Manifold.dense_setOf_forall_coord_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dense_setOf_forall_coord_ne_zero {J : Type*} [Finite J] (c : J → Fin n) :
    Dense {z : E | ∀ j, ψ z (c j) ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E := ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete 𝕜 E
  have h := dense_iInter_of_isOpen (f := fun j : J => {z : E | ψ z (c j) ≠ 0})
    (fun j => isOpen_ne.preimage ((continuous_apply (c j)).comp ψ.continuous))
    (fun j => dense_setOf_coord_ne_zero ψ (c j))
  convert h using 1
  ext z
  exact ⟨fun hz => mem_iInter.mpr hz, fun hz => mem_iInter.mp hz⟩

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.exists_notMem_support_of_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem IsSnc.exists_notMem_support_of_mem_nhds (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) {a : M} {N : Set M}
    (hN : N ∈ 𝓝 a) : ∃ x ∈ N, x ∉ F.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hVo, haV, hV⟩ := hF.exists_nhds_support_eq a
  obtain ⟨φ, c, hφatlas, haφ, hchart, hcinj⟩ := hF.2.2 a
  obtain ⟨N', hN'N, hN'o, haN'⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hN
  have : Finite {j // a ∈ F.hyp j} := Finite.of_injective c hcinj
  have hWo : IsOpen (N' ∩ V ∩ φ.source) := (hN'o.inter hVo).inter φ.open_source
  have haW : a ∈ N' ∩ V ∩ φ.source := ⟨⟨haN', haV⟩, haφ⟩
  have himg : IsOpen (φ '' (N' ∩ V ∩ φ.source)) :=
    (φ.isOpen_image_iff_of_subset_source fun _ hx => hx.2).mpr hWo
  obtain ⟨z, hz, x, hxW, rfl⟩ :=
    (dense_setOf_forall_coord_ne_zero ψ c).exists_mem_open himg ⟨φ a, a, haW, rfl⟩
  have hz' : ∀ j, ψ (φ x) (c j) ≠ 0 := hz
  refine ⟨x, hN'N hxW.1.1, fun hxs => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j, haj, hxj⟩ := (hV x hxW.1.2).mp hxs
  exact hz' ⟨j, haj⟩ ((hchart ⟨j, haj⟩ x hxW.2).mp hxj)

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.dense_compl_support
statement: theorem IsSnc.dense_compl_support (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) : Dense F.supportᶜ
proof:
:=
  dense_iff_inter_open.mpr fun _U hU ⟨_a, ha⟩ =>
    let ⟨x, hxU, hxs⟩ := hF.exists_notMem_support_of_mem_nhds (hU.mem_nhds ha)
    ⟨x, hxU, hxs⟩

name: Manifold.exists_nhds_coord_eq_zero_iff_of_associated
statement:
theorem exists_nhds_coord_eq_zero_iff_of_associated (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E)
    (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ φ.source) (k : Fin n) {U : Opens M}
    (hxU : x ∈ U) (g : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hassoc : Associated (coord E ψ φ hφ hx k) ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U x hxU g)) :
    ∃ V : Set M, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ φ.source ∧ V ⊆ U ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V, (ψ (φ y) k = 0 ↔ extendSection 𝕜 E g y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hassoc
  obtain ⟨Va, hxVa, a, ha⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq
    (u : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x)
  let Q : Opens M := ⟨φ.source ∩ (Va : Set M) ∩ U, (φ.open_source.inter Va.2).inter U.2⟩
  have hxQ : x ∈ Q := ⟨⟨hx, hxVa⟩, hxU⟩
  have hQφ : Q ≤ ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source⟩ := fun _ h => h.1.1
  have hQa : Q ≤ Va := fun _ h => h.1.2
  have hQU : Q ≤ U := fun _ h => h.2
  
  have hgerm : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ Q x hxQ
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hQφ).op (chartSection E ψ φ hφ k) *
        (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hQa).op a) =
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ Q x hxQ
        ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hQU).op g) := by
    rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply,
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, ha]
    exact hu
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iQ, iQ', hW⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ_eq x hxQ hxQ _ _ hgerm
  
  have hval : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ W), ψ (φ y) k * extendSection 𝕜 E a y = extendSection 𝕜 E g y := by
    intro y hy
    have hyφ : y ∈ φ.source := hQφ (iQ.le hy)
    have hya : y ∈ Va := hQa (iQ.le hy)
    have hyU : y ∈ U := hQU (iQ.le hy)
    have hW' := congrArg ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ W y hy) hW
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, map_mul,
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply,
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at hW'
    have h1 := congrArg (eval 𝕜 E M y) hW'
