    rw [map_mul] at h1
    have e1 : eval 𝕜 E M y ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source⟩ y hyφ
        (chartSection E ψ φ hφ k)) = ψ (φ y) k := eval_coord E ψ φ hyφ hφ k
    have e2 : eval 𝕜 E M y ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ Va y hya a) =
        extendSection 𝕜 E a y := by
      rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E a hya]
      exact contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 Va y hya a
    have e3 : eval 𝕜 E M y ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U y hyU g) =
        extendSection 𝕜 E g y := by
      rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E g hyU]
      exact contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 U y hyU g
    rw [e1, e2, e3] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have hax : extendSection 𝕜 E a x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E a hxVa]
    have h1 : eval 𝕜 E M x ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ Va x hxVa a) = a ⟨x, hxVa⟩ :=
      contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 Va x hxVa a
    rw [← h1, ha]
    have h2 := IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr u.isUnit
    rwa [mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval] at h2
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (extendSection 𝕜 E a) x :=
    (contMDiffOn_extendBy0 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a).continuousOn.continuousAt (Va.isOpen.mem_nhds hxVa)
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTo, hxT⟩ := eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hcont.eventually_ne hax)
  refine ⟨(W : Set M) ∩ T, W.isOpen.inter hTo, ⟨hxW, hxT⟩, fun y hy => hQφ (iQ.le hy.1),
    fun y hy => hQU (iQ.le hy.1), fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hval y hy.1
  have h2 := hT y hy.2
  constructor
  · intro h0
    rw [← h1, h0, zero_mul]
  · intro h0
    rw [h0] at h1
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_right h2

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.exists_adaptedChart_isSncChartAt_of_parameters
statement:
theorem exists_adaptedChart_isSncChartAt_of_parameters [IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M] (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) {x : M} (hxY : x ∈ Y) {m : ℕ}
    (z : Fin m → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x)
    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range z) = maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x))
    (hdim : (m : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x))
    (hmin : ∀ P ∈ ((F.idealSheaf (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)).stalkIdeal x).minimalPrimes,
      ∃ i, P = Ideal.span {z i})
    (s : Finset (Fin m)) (hD : hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span (z '' ↑s)) :
    ∃ (φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E) (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n) (cidx : {j // x ∈ F.hyp j} → Fin n),
      IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ σ ∧ F.IsSncChartAt ψ φ x cidx
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have _hfd : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E := ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have : Finite {j // x ∈ F.hyp j} := (hF.2.1.point_finite x).to_subtype
  obtain ⟨φ, cF, hc⟩ := hF.exists_isSncChartAt x
  have hxφ : x ∈ φ.source := hc.2.1
  have hreg₀ : IsRegularLocalRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_chart E ψ φ hxφ hc.1
  have hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) := fun i =>
    hspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hliκ := IsRegularLocalRing.linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_span_eq z hz hspan hdim
  
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, g, hg⟩ := exists_sections_of_germs (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M) z
  have hz0 : ∀ i, extendSection 𝕜 E (g i) x = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hxU]
    have h1 : eval 𝕜 E M x ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U x hxU (g i)) = (g i) ⟨x, hxU⟩ :=
      contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 U x hxU (g i)
    rw [← h1, hg i]
    exact (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E _).mp (hz i)
  have hzc : ∀ i, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (extendSection 𝕜 E (g i)) x := fun i =>
    (contMDiffOn_extendBy0 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M (g i)).contMDiffAt (U.isOpen.mem_nhds hxU)
  have hind : HasIndependentDifferentialsAt E (fun i => extendSection 𝕜 E (g i)) x := by
    rw [hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_linearIndependent_cotangentClass' E hxU g]
    simpa only [hg] using linearIndependent_cotangentClass_of_residueField z hz hliκ
  obtain ⟨e, σ₀, he, hxe, -, hcoord⟩ :=
    exists_chart_extending ψ (fun i => extendSection 𝕜 E (g i)) x hzc hz0 hind
  have hgerm : ∀ y (hyU : y ∈ U) (hye : y ∈ e.source) i,
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U y hyU (g i) = coord E ψ e he hye (σ₀ i) := by
    intro y hyU hye i
    apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M y
    rw [stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ, stalkToGerm_coord, Germ.coe_eq]
    filter_upwards [(e.open_source.inter U.isOpen).mem_nhds ⟨hye, hyU⟩] with y' hy'
    have h1 : extendSection 𝕜 E (g i) y' = ψ (e y') (σ₀ i) := hcoord y' hy'.1 i
    rw [h1, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy'.1]
    rfl
  
  obtain ⟨φY, σY, hxφY, hφY⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart x hxY
  have hDx : hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => coord E ψ φY hφY.1 hxφY (σY i)) :=
    hY.isIdealSheafOf_idealSheaf.2 φY σY hφY x hxφY hxY
  have hDs : hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : s => z j.1) := by
    rw [hD]
    congr 1
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Set.mem_range, Subtype.exists, exists_prop]
  have hY0 : ∀ i, ψ (φY x) (σY i) = 0 := (hφY.2 x hxφY).mp hxY
  have hcs : s.card = c := by
    have h1 := IsRegularLocalRing.card_eq_of_span_range_eq (fun j : s => z j.1)
      (fun i => coord E ψ φY hφY.1 hxφY (σY i)) (fun j => hz j.1)
      (fun i => coord_mem_maximalIdeal_of_eq_zero φY hφY.1 hxφY (hY0 i))
      (hliκ.comp Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective)
      (linearIndependent_toCotangent_coord φY hφY.1 hxφY σY hY0) (by rw [← hDs, ← hDx])
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fin] using h1
  have hDx' : hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : s =>
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U x hxU (g j.1)) := by
    rw [hDs]
    congr 1
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_range, hg]
  obtain ⟨WD, hxWD, hWDU, hWD⟩ :=
    hY.idealSheaf.exists_opens_stalkIdeal_eq_span hxU (fun j : s => g j.1) hDx'
  
  have hEx := hF.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prod hc
  have hminj : ∀ j : {j // x ∈ F.hyp j},
      ∃ i, Ideal.span {coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (cF j)} = Ideal.span {z i} := by
    intro j
    have hjS : (⟨j.1, (hF.2.1.point_finite x).mem_toFinset.mpr j.2⟩ :
        {k // k ∈ (hF.2.1.point_finite x).toFinset}) ∈ (hF.2.1.point_finite x).toFinset.attach :=
      Finset.mem_attach _ _
    have hmem := mem_minimalPrimes_span_prod
      (p := fun k : {k // k ∈ (hF.2.1.point_finite x).toFinset} =>
        coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (cF ⟨k.1, (hF.2.1.point_finite x).mem_toFinset.mp k.2⟩))
      (fun k _ => hc.prime_coord _)
      (fun k _ k' _ hkk' => hc.not_coord_dvd fun h => hkk' (by
        have h2 := congrArg Subtype.val h
        exact Subtype.ext (show k.1 = k'.1 from h2)))
      hjS
    rw [← hEx] at hmem
    exact hmin _ hmem
  choose idx hidx using hminj
  have hassoc : ∀ j : {j // x ∈ F.hyp j}, Associated (coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (cF j))
      ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U x hxU (g (idx j))) := fun j => by
    have h := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mp (hidx j)
    rwa [← hg (idx j)] at h
  have hnbhd : ∀ j : {j // x ∈ F.hyp j}, ∃ V : Set M, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ φ.source ∧ V ⊆ U ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V, (ψ (φ y) (cF j) = 0 ↔ extendSection 𝕜 E (g (idx j)) y = 0) := fun j =>
    exists_nhds_coord_eq_zero_iff_of_associated φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (cF j) hxU (g (idx j)) (hassoc j)
  choose V hVo hxV hVφ hVU hV using hnbhd
  
  let N : Set M := e.source ∩ (WD : Set M) ∩ ⋂ j, V j
  have hNo : IsOpen N := (e.open_source.inter WD.isOpen).inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite hVo)
  have hxN : x ∈ N := ⟨⟨hxe, hxWD⟩, Set.mem_iInter.mpr hxV⟩
  have he' : e.restrOpen N hNo ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M := by
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_eq_restr]
    exact restr_mem_maximalAtlas _ he hNo
  have hxe' : x ∈ (e.restrOpen N hNo).source := ⟨hxe, hxN⟩
  
  have hadapt : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y (e.restrOpen N hNo)
      ((s.orderEmbOfFin hcs).toEmbedding.trans σ₀) := by
    refine ⟨he', fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have hyW : y ∈ WD := hy.2.1.2
    have hyU : y ∈ U := hWDU hyW
    have hye : y ∈ e.source := hy.2.1.1
    have hmemY : y ∈ Y ↔ hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal y ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [← IdealSheaf.mem_support, hY.cosupport_idealSheaf]
    rw [hmemY, hWD y hyW, ne_eq, Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_exists_isUnit]
    have hu : ∀ j : s, IsUnit ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U y hyU (g j.1)) ↔
        ψ (e y) (σ₀ j.1) ≠ 0 := fun j => by
      rw [hgerm y hyU hye j.1, ← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval,
        eval_coord]
    constructor
    · intro h i
      by_contra h0
      have hmem : s.orderEmbOfFin hcs i ∈ s := s.orderEmbOfFin_mem hcs i
      exact h ⟨_, ⟨⟨_, hmem⟩, rfl⟩, (hu ⟨_, hmem⟩).mpr h0⟩
    · rintro h ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, hunit⟩
      have hj : (j : Fin m) ∈ Set.range (s.orderEmbOfFin hcs) := by
        rw [s.range_orderEmbOfFin hcs]
        exact j.2
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hj
      apply (hu j).mp hunit
      have h1 := h i
      change ψ (e y) (σ₀ (s.orderEmbOfFin hcs i)) = 0 at h1
      rwa [hi] at h1
  
  have hsnc : F.IsSncChartAt ψ (e.restrOpen N hNo) x fun j => σ₀ (idx j) := by
    refine ⟨he', hxe', fun j y hy => ?_, fun j j' hjj' => ?_⟩
    · have hyN : y ∈ N := hy.2
      have hyV : y ∈ V j := Set.mem_iInter.mp hyN.2 j
      have h1 : extendSection 𝕜 E (g (idx j)) y = ψ (e y) (σ₀ (idx j)) := hcoord y hyN.1.1 (idx j)
      rw [hc.mem_iff j (hVφ j hyV), hV j y hyV, h1]
      exact Iff.rfl
    · have h1 : idx j = idx j' := σ₀.injective hjj'
      have h2 : Ideal.span {coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (cF j)} =
          Ideal.span {coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (cF j')} := by
        rw [hidx j, hidx j', h1]
      by_contra hne
      exact hc.not_coord_dvd (Ne.symm hne) (Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mp h2.le)
  exact ⟨e.restrOpen N hNo, _, _, hadapt, hsnc⟩

name: Manifold.hasOnlyNormalCrossingsWith_idealSheaf_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x hxY => ?_,
    fun hsnc => HasSncWith.hasOnlyNormalCrossingsWith_idealSheaf hF hY hsnc⟩
  have hx : x ∈ IdealSheaf.support hY.idealSheaf := by
    rw [hY.cosupport_idealSheaf]
    exact hxY
  obtain ⟨m, z, ⟨hspan, hdim⟩, hmin, s, hD⟩ := h x hx
  exact HypersurfaceFamily.exists_adaptedChart_isSncChartAt_of_parameters hF hY hxY z hspan hdim
    hmin s hD

name: Manifold.vanishingStalk_anti
statement:
theorem vanishingStalk_anti {Z Z' : Set M} (h : Z ⊆ Z') (x : M) :
    vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) Z' x ≤ vanishingStalk Z x
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  rw [mem_vanishingStalk_iff] at hs ⊢
  generalize stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x s = g at hs ⊢
  refine Filter.Germ.inductionOn g (fun f (hf : Germ.VanishesOn Z' x (f : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜)) => ?_) hs
  rw [Germ.vanishesOn_coe] at hf ⊢
  exact hf.filter_mono (nhdsWithin_mono x h)

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ker_restrictStalk_eq_vanishingStalk
proof:
:= by
  let _i := hY.chartedSpace
  ext s
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, mem_vanishingStalk_iff]
  have h1 := hY.stalkToGerm_restrictStalk ⟨a, ha⟩ s
  have hinj := stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, Fin (n - c) → 𝕜) ω Y ⟨a, ha⟩
  rw [← hinj.eq_iff, map_zero, h1]
  generalize stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a s = g
  refine Filter.Germ.inductionOn g fun f => ?_
  rw [germRestrict_coe, Germ.vanishesOn_coe, ← Germ.coe_zero, Germ.coe_eq,
    nhdsWithin_eq_map_subtype_coe ha, Filter.eventually_map]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSncChartAt.isAdaptedChart_hyp
statement:
theorem IsSncChartAt.isAdaptedChart_hyp (hc : F.IsSncChartAt ψ φ a c) (j : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j}) :
    IsAdaptedChart ψ (F.hyp j.1) φ (singleEmb (c j))
proof:
:=
  isAdaptedChart_singleIdx hc.1 fun _ hx => hc.mem_iff j hx

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSncChartAt.mem_vanishingStalk_hyp_iff
statement:
theorem IsSncChartAt.mem_vanishingStalk_hyp_iff (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (hc : F.IsSncChartAt ψ φ a c)
    (j : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j}) {b : M} (hb : b ∈ φ.source) (hbj : b ∈ F.hyp j.1)
    (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk b) :
    s ∈ vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (F.hyp j.1) b ↔ coord E ψ φ hc.1 hb (c j) ∣ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (hF.1 j.1).ker_restrictStalk_eq_vanishingStalk hbj,
    (hF.1 j.1).ker_restrictStalk_eq_span hbj (hc.isAdaptedChart_hyp j) hb, Set.range_unique,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  rfl

name: Manifold.coord_mem_maximalIdeal_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coord_mem_maximalIdeal_of_eq_zero {k : Fin n} (h0 : ψ (φ b) k = 0) :
    coord E ψ φ hφ hb k ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval, eval_coord]
  exact h0

name: Manifold.isUnit_coord_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_coord_of_ne_zero {k : Fin n} (h0 : ψ (φ b) k ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (coord E ψ φ hφ hb k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval, eval_coord]
  exact h0

name: Manifold.linearPart_coord
statement:
theorem linearPart_coord (k i : Fin n) :
    linearPart E ψ φ hφ hb (coord E ψ φ hφ hb k) i = if i = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearPart_apply, taylorHom_coord, map_add, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C,
    ite_eq_right (Finsupp.single_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero), add_zero]
  by_cases hik : i = k
  · subst hik
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hik, ite_eq_right]
    exact fun h => hik ((Finsupp.single_left_inj one_ne_zero).mp h)

name: Manifold.coord_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq
statement:
theorem coord_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq {k : Fin n} :
    coord E ψ φ hφ hb k ∉ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk b) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := congrFun (linearPart_eq_zero_of_mem_sq E ψ φ hφ hb h) k
  rw [linearPart_coord, ite_eq_left rfl, Pi.zero_apply] at h1
  exact one_ne_zero h1

name: Manifold.prime_coord_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem prime_coord_of_eq_zero {k : Fin n} (h0 : ψ (φ b) k = 0) :
    Prime (coord E ψ φ hφ hb k)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg := isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_chart E ψ φ hb hφ
  have hq := (IsRegularLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton
    (coord_mem_maximalIdeal_of_eq_zero φ hφ hb h0) (coord_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq φ hφ hb)).1
  have hdom : IsDomain ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk b ⧸
      Ideal.span {coord E ψ φ hφ hb k}) := inferInstance
  have hne : coord E ψ φ hφ hb k ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact coord_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq φ hφ hb (h ▸ Submodule.zero_mem _)
  exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hne).mp ((Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp hdom)

name: Manifold.not_coord_dvd_coord_of_ne
statement:
theorem not_coord_dvd_coord_of_ne {k l : Fin n} (hk0 : ψ (φ b) k = 0) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    ¬ coord E ψ φ hφ hb k ∣ coord E ψ φ hφ hb l
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
  by_cases hu0 : eval 𝕜 E M b u = 0
  · apply coord_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq φ hφ hb (k := l)
    rw [hu, pow_two]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (coord_mem_maximalIdeal_of_eq_zero φ hφ hb hk0)
      ((mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E u).mpr hu0)
  · have hmem : coord E ψ φ hφ hb l - eval 𝕜 E M b u • coord E ψ φ hφ hb k ∈
        maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk b) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hu, pow_two, Algebra.smul_def, algebraMap_stalk_eq]
      have : coord E ψ φ hφ hb k * u - const 𝕜 E M b (eval 𝕜 E M b u) * coord E ψ φ hφ hb k =
          coord E ψ φ hφ hb k * (u - const 𝕜 E M b (eval 𝕜 E M b u)) := by ring
      rw [this]
      refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul (coord_mem_maximalIdeal_of_eq_zero φ hφ hb hk0) ?_
      rw [mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval, map_sub, eval_const, sub_self]
    have h1 := congrFun (linearPart_eq_zero_of_mem_sq E ψ φ hφ hb hmem) l
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, linearPart_coord, linearPart_coord,
      ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hkl), smul_zero, sub_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at h1
    exact one_ne_zero h1

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.exists_nhds_support_eq
statement:
theorem IsSnc.exists_nhds_support_eq (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (a : M) :
    ∃ V : Set M, IsOpen V ∧ a ∈ V ∧ ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ F.support ↔ ∃ j, a ∈ F.hyp j ∧ x ∈ F.hyp j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hfin⟩ := hF.2.1 a
  refine ⟨interior U ∩ ⋂ j ∈ hfin.toFinset.filter (fun j => a ∉ F.hyp j), (F.hyp j)ᶜ,
    isOpen_interior.inter (isOpen_biInter_finset fun j _ => (hF.1 j).isClosed.isOpen_compl),
    ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hU, Set.mem_iInter₂.mpr fun j hj => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2⟩,
    fun x hx => ⟨fun hxs => ?_, fun ⟨j, _, hxj⟩ => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hxj⟩⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxs
  refine ⟨j, ?_, hxj⟩
  by_contra haj
  have hjT : j ∈ hfin.toFinset := hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, hxj, interior_subset hx.1⟩
  exact Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hx.2 j (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjT, haj⟩) hxj

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSncChartAt.vanishingStalk_support_eq
statement:
theorem IsSncChartAt.vanishingStalk_support_eq (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (hc : F.IsSncChartAt ψ φ a c)
    {V : Set M} (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hVs : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ F.support ↔ ∃ j, a ∈ F.hyp j ∧ x ∈ F.hyp j) {b : M} (hb : b ∈ φ.source)
    (hbV : b ∈ V) (S : Finset F.ι) (hS : ∀ j, j ∈ S ↔ a ∈ F.hyp j) :
    vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) F.support b =
      Ideal.span {∏ j ∈ S.attach, coord E ψ φ hc.1 hb (c ⟨j.1, (hS j.1).mp j.2⟩)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmem : ∀ j : {j // j ∈ S}, a ∈ F.hyp j.1 := fun j => (hS j.1).mp j.2
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_))
  · 
    
    intro s hs
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton,
      ← Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not S.attach (fun j => b ∈ F.hyp j.1)]
    have hu : IsUnit (∏ j ∈ S.attach.filter (fun j => ¬ b ∈ F.hyp j.1),
        coord E ψ φ hc.1 hb (c ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩)) := by
      refine Finset.prod_induction _ IsUnit (fun _ _ => IsUnit.mul) isUnit_one fun j hj => ?_
      refine isUnit_coord_of_ne_zero φ hc.1 hb fun h0 => ?_
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2 ((hc.mem_iff ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩ hb).mpr h0)
    rw [IsUnit.mul_right_dvd hu]
    refine prod_dvd_of_prime_of_not_dvd _ _ (fun j hj => ?_)
      (fun i hi j hj hij => ?_) fun j hj => ?_
    · exact prime_coord_of_eq_zero φ hc.1 hb
        ((hc.mem_iff ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩ hb).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2)
    · refine not_coord_dvd_coord_of_ne φ hc.1 hb
        ((hc.mem_iff ⟨i.1, hmem i⟩ hb).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2) fun h => hij ?_
      have h' : (⟨i.1, hmem i⟩ : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j}) = ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩ := hc.injective h
      have h2 := congrArg Subtype.val h'
      exact Subtype.ext (show i.1 = j.1 from h2)
    · have hbj : b ∈ F.hyp j.1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      rw [← hc.mem_vanishingStalk_hyp_iff hF ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩ hb hbj]
      exact vanishingStalk_anti (Set.subset_iUnion F.hyp j.1) b hs
  · 
    
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_vanishingStalk_iff, map_prod]
    have hcoe : ∀ j : {j // j ∈ S},
        stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M b (coord E ψ φ hc.1 hb (c ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩)) =
        ((extendSection 𝕜 E (chartSection E ψ φ hc.1 (c ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩)) : M → 𝕜) :
          (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜) :=
      fun j => stalkToGerm_coord hc.1 hb _
    simp only [hcoe]
    have hprod : (∏ j ∈ S.attach,
        ((extendSection 𝕜 E (chartSection E ψ φ hc.1 (c ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩)) : M → 𝕜) :
          (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜)) =
        ((∏ j ∈ S.attach, extendSection 𝕜 E (chartSection E ψ φ hc.1 (c ⟨j.1, hmem j⟩)) : M → 𝕜) :
          (𝓝 b).Germ 𝕜) :=
      (map_prod (Filter.Germ.coeRingHom (𝓝 b)) _ _).symm
    rw [hprod, Germ.vanishesOn_coe]
    filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds ((hV.inter φ.open_source).mem_nhds ⟨hbV, hb⟩),
      self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hyV hys
    obtain ⟨j, haj, hyj⟩ := (hVs y hyV.1).mp hys
    rw [Finset.prod_apply]
    refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := ⟨j, (hS j).mpr haj⟩) (Finset.mem_attach _ _) ?_
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hyV.2]
    exact (hc.mem_iff ⟨j, haj⟩ hyV.2).mp hyj

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_support
statement:
theorem IsSnc.hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_support (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)
      fun x => vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) F.support x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a
  obtain ⟨φ, c, hc⟩ := hF.exists_isSncChartAt a
  obtain ⟨V, hV, haV, hVs⟩ := hF.exists_nhds_support_eq a
  let W : Opens M := ⟨V ∩ φ.source, hV.inter φ.open_source⟩
  have hW : W ≤ ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source⟩ := fun _ hx => hx.2
  refine ⟨W, ⟨haV, hc.2.1⟩, Unit, inferInstance, fun _ =>
    (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
      (∏ j ∈ (hF.2.1.point_finite a).toFinset.attach,
        chartSection E ψ φ hc.1 (c ⟨j.1, (hF.2.1.point_finite a).mem_toFinset.mp j.2⟩)),
    fun b hb => ?_⟩
  beta_reduce
  rw [hc.vanishingStalk_support_eq hF hV hVs hb.2 hb.1 _
    fun j => (hF.2.1.point_finite a).mem_toFinset, Set.range_const]
  congr 2
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  have key : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source⟩ b hb.2
      (∏ j ∈ (hF.2.1.point_finite a).toFinset.attach,
        chartSection E ψ φ hc.1 (c ⟨j.1, (hF.2.1.point_finite a).mem_toFinset.mp j.2⟩)) =
      ∏ j ∈ (hF.2.1.point_finite a).toFinset.attach,
        coord E ψ φ hc.1 hb.2 (c ⟨j.1, (hF.2.1.point_finite a).mem_toFinset.mp j.2⟩) :=
    map_prod ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source⟩ b hb.2).hom _ _
  exact key.symm

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf
statement:
theorem IsSnc.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (x : M) :
    F.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x = vanishingStalk (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) F.support x
proof:
:= by
  unfold HypersurfaceFamily.idealSheaf
  rw [dite_eq_left hF.hasLocalGenerators_vanishingStalk_support, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks]

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.cosupport_idealSheaf
statement:
theorem IsSnc.cosupport_idealSheaf (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) :
    (F.idealSheaf (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E)).support = F.support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [IdealSheaf.mem_support, hF.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hx
    exact h (vanishingStalk_eq_top_of_notMem_closure (by rwa [hF.isClosed_support.closure_eq]))
  · intro hx
    exact vanishingStalk_ne_top_of_mem_closure (by rwa [hF.isClosed_support.closure_eq])

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prod
statement:
theorem IsSnc.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span_prod (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (hc : F.IsSncChartAt ψ φ a c) :
    F.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a = Ideal.span
      {∏ j ∈ (hF.2.1.point_finite a).toFinset.attach,
        coord E ψ φ hc.1 hc.2.1 (c ⟨j.1, (hF.2.1.point_finite a).mem_toFinset.mp j.2⟩)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [hF.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf]
  obtain ⟨V, hV, haV, hVs⟩ := hF.exists_nhds_support_eq a
  exact hc.vanishingStalk_support_eq hF hV hVs hc.2.1 haV _
    fun j => (hF.2.1.point_finite a).mem_toFinset

name: Manifold.exists_finset_linearIndependent_sum_of_subset
statement:
theorem exists_finset_linearIndependent_sum_of_subset {c s : ℕ} (e : Fin c → V)
    (he : LinearIndependent 𝕜 e) (d : Fin s → V)
    (hsub : ∀ j, d j ∈ Submodule.span 𝕜 (range e)) (P : Finset (Fin c))
    (hP : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (Sum.elim d fun p : P => e p)) :
    ∃ K : Finset (Fin c), P ⊆ K ∧ s + K.card = c ∧
      LinearIndependent 𝕜 (Sum.elim d fun k : K => e k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set E₁ : Fin s ⊕ P ≃ Fin (s + P.card) :=
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin s)) P.equivFin).trans finSumFinEquiv with hE₁
  set d' : Fin (s + P.card) → V := (Sum.elim d fun p : P => e p) ∘ E₁.symm with hd'def
  have hd' : LinearIndependent 𝕜 d' := (linearIndependent_equiv E₁.symm).mpr hP
  have hsub' : ∀ j, d' j ∈ Submodule.span 𝕜 (range e) := by
    intro j
    rcases hj : E₁.symm j with i | p
    · simp only [hd'def, Function.comp_apply, hj, Sum.elim_inl]
      exact hsub i
    · simp only [hd'def, Function.comp_apply, hj, Sum.elim_inr]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨p, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K', hK'c, hli'⟩ := exists_finset_linearIndependent_sum e he d' hd' hsub'
  
  have hdisj : ∀ k ∈ K', k ∉ P := by
    intro k hk hkP
    have h : (Sum.inl (E₁ (Sum.inr ⟨k, hkP⟩)) : Fin (s + P.card) ⊕ K') = Sum.inr ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
      hli'.injective (by simp [hd'def])
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  refine ⟨P ∪ K', Finset.subset_union_left, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun k hkP hkK' => hdisj k hkK' hkP)]
    omega
  · 
    set f : Fin s ⊕ ↥(P ∪ K') → Fin (s + P.card) ⊕ K' := fun x =>
      match x with
      | Sum.inl j => Sum.inl (E₁ (Sum.inl j))
      | Sum.inr k =>
        if hk : (k : Fin c) ∈ P then Sum.inl (E₁ (Sum.inr ⟨k, hk⟩))
        else Sum.inr ⟨k, (Finset.mem_union.mp k.2).resolve_left hk⟩ with hfdef
    have hcomp : (Sum.elim d fun k : ↥(P ∪ K') => e k) = (Sum.elim d' fun k : K' => e k) ∘ f := by
      funext x
      rcases x with j | k
      · simp [hfdef, hd'def]
      · by_cases hk : (k : Fin c) ∈ P
        · simp [hfdef, hd'def, hk]
        · simp [hfdef, hk]
    have hfinj : Function.Injective f := by
      rintro (j | k) (j' | k') hxy
      · simp only [hfdef, Sum.inl.injEq] at hxy
        exact congrArg Sum.inl (Sum.inl_injective (E₁.injective hxy))
      · by_cases hk' : (k' : Fin c) ∈ P
        · simp only [hfdef, hk', dite_true, Sum.inl.injEq] at hxy
          exact absurd (E₁.injective hxy) (by simp)
        · simp [hfdef, hk'] at hxy
      · by_cases hk : (k : Fin c) ∈ P
        · simp only [hfdef, hk, dite_true, Sum.inl.injEq] at hxy
          exact absurd (E₁.injective hxy) (by simp)
        · simp [hfdef, hk] at hxy
      · by_cases hk : (k : Fin c) ∈ P <;> by_cases hk' : (k' : Fin c) ∈ P
        · simp only [hfdef, hk, hk', dite_true, Sum.inl.injEq] at hxy
          have := Sum.inr_injective (E₁.injective hxy)
          exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext (Subtype.mk.inj this))
        · simp [hfdef, hk, hk'] at hxy
        · simp [hfdef, hk, hk'] at hxy
        · simp only [hfdef, hk, hk', dite_false, Sum.inr.injEq] at hxy
          exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext (Subtype.mk.inj hxy))
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hli'.comp f hfinj

name: Manifold.exists_adaptedChart_flag_protected
statement:
theorem exists_adaptedChart_flag_protected (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (hYS : Y ⊆ S)
    {φ₀ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ₀ : Fin c ↪ Fin n} (hφ₀ : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ₀ σ₀)
    {φ₁ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ₁ : Fin s ↪ Fin n} (hφ₁ : IsAdaptedChart ψ S φ₁ σ₁)
    {a : M} (ha : a ∈ Y) (haφ₀ : a ∈ φ₀.source) (haφ₁ : a ∈ φ₁.source) (P : Finset (Fin c))
    (hP : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (Sum.elim
      (fun j => fderiv 𝕜 ((fun x => ψ (φ₁ x) (σ₁ j)) ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a))
      fun p : P => coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ p))) :
    ∃ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E) (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n) (τ : Fin s ↪ Fin c),
      a ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ φ₀.source ∩ φ₁.source ∧ IsAdaptedChart ψ Y e σ ∧
        (∀ x ∈ e.source, x ∈ S ↔ ∀ j, ψ (e x) (σ (τ j)) = 0) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ e.source, ∀ j, ψ (e x) (σ (τ j)) = ψ (φ₁ x) (σ₁ j)) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ P, p ∉ Set.range τ ∧ ∀ x ∈ e.source, ψ (e x) (σ p) = ψ (φ₀ x) (σ₀ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set z : Fin c → M → 𝕜 := fun k x => ψ (φ₀ x) (σ₀ k) with hzdef
  set hfun : Fin s → M → 𝕜 := fun j x => ψ (φ₁ x) (σ₁ j) with hhdef
  set V : Opens M := ⟨φ₀.source ∩ φ₁.source, φ₀.open_source.inter φ₁.open_source⟩ with hVdef
  have haV : a ∈ V := ⟨haφ₀, haφ₁⟩
  
  have hrepr : ∀ j, ∃ g : Fin c → M → 𝕜,
      (∀ k, ∃ U : Opens M, a ∈ U ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (g k) U) ∧
        ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, hfun j x = ∑ k, g k x * z k x := by
    intro j
    have hhV : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (hfun j) V :=
      (coordFunctional ψ (σ₁ j)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
        ((contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ₁.1).mono fun x hx => hx.2)
    set hsec := sectionOfContMDiffOn (hfun j) V hhV with hhsec
    have hmem : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V a haV hsec ∈ hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a := by
      rw [hY.germ_mem_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_iff V ha haV]
      filter_upwards [(continuous_subtype_val.isOpen_preimage _ V.2).mem_nhds
        (show (⟨a, ha⟩ : Y) ∈ {y : Y | (y : M) ∈ V} from haV)] with y hyV
      rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hyV, sectionOfContMDiffOn_apply]
      exact (hφ₁.2 _ hyV.2).1 (hYS y.2) j
    rw [hY.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span ha hφ₀ haφ₀, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
      at hmem
    obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := hmem
    have hg : ∀ k, ∃ g : M → 𝕜, stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a (cf k) = ↑g ∧
        ∃ U : Opens M, a ∈ U ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω g U := fun k =>
      (mem_range_stalkToGerm_iff 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a _).mp ⟨_, rfl⟩
    choose g hgc U haU hgU using hg
    refine ⟨g, fun k => ⟨U k, haU k, hgU k⟩, ?_⟩
    have h1 := congrArg (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a) hcf
    rw [map_sum, stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ] at h1
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, hgc, stalkToGerm_coord, ← Germ.coe_mul] at h1
    rw [germ_coe_sum, Germ.coe_eq] at h1
    filter_upwards [h1, V.2.mem_nhds haV] with x hx hxV
    rw [Finset.sum_apply] at hx
    have hx' : extendSection 𝕜 E hsec x = hfun j x := by
      rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hxV, sectionOfContMDiffOn_apply]
    rw [← hx', ← hx]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Pi.mul_apply, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hxV.1]
    rfl
  choose g hgU hrep using hrepr
  choose U haU hgU using hgU
  
  have hcd : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (fun v : E => ψ v (σ₀ k)) (φ₀ a) := fun k =>
    (coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ k)).differentiableAt
  have hcf : ∀ k, fderiv 𝕜 (fun v : E => ψ v (σ₀ k)) (φ₀ a) = coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ k) := fun k =>
    (coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ k)).fderiv
  have hgd : ∀ j k, DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (g j k ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a) := by
    intro j k
    have h2 : IsOpen (φ₀.target ∩ φ₀.symm ⁻¹' (U j k : Set M)) :=
      φ₀.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (U j k).2
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (g j k ∘ φ₀.symm)
        (φ₀.target ∩ φ₀.symm ⁻¹' (U j k : Set M)) :=
      (hgU j k).comp ((contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ₀.1).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        fun v hv => hv.2
    have h3 : φ₀ a ∈ φ₀.target ∩ φ₀.symm ⁻¹' (U j k : Set M) :=
      ⟨φ₀.map_source haφ₀, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, φ₀.left_inv haφ₀]; exact haU j k⟩
    exact (contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mp (h1.contMDiffAt (h2.mem_nhds h3))).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  set e : Fin c → E →L[𝕜] 𝕜 := fun k => coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ k) with hedef
  set d : Fin s → E →L[𝕜] 𝕜 := fun j => fderiv 𝕜 (hfun j ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a) with hddef
  have hDh : ∀ j, d j = ∑ k, g j k a • e k := by
    intro j
    have hrep' : (hfun j ∘ φ₀.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ₀ a)]
        fun v => ∑ k, (g j k ∘ φ₀.symm) v * ψ v (σ₀ k) := by
      filter_upwards [(φ₀.tendsto_symm haφ₀).eventually (hrep j),
        φ₀.open_target.mem_nhds (φ₀.map_source haφ₀)] with v hv hvT
      rw [Function.comp_apply, hv]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      change g j k (φ₀.symm v) * ψ (φ₀ (φ₀.symm v)) (σ₀ k) = g j k (φ₀.symm v) * ψ v (σ₀ k)
      rw [φ₀.right_inv hvT]
    change fderiv 𝕜 (hfun j ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a) = _
    rw [hrep'.fderiv_eq]
    have hsumfun : (fun v : E => ∑ k, (g j k ∘ φ₀.symm) v * ψ v (σ₀ k)) =
        ∑ k, fun v : E => (g j k ∘ φ₀.symm) v * ψ v (σ₀ k) := by
      ext v
      simp [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [hsumfun, fderiv_sum (A := fun k => fun v : E => (g j k ∘ φ₀.symm) v * ψ v (σ₀ k))
      fun k _ => (hgd j k).mul (hcd k)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    change fderiv 𝕜 ((g j k ∘ φ₀.symm) * fun v : E => ψ v (σ₀ k)) (φ₀ a) = _
    rw [fderiv_mul (hgd j k) (hcd k), hcf k]
    have h0 : ψ (φ₀ a) (σ₀ k) = 0 := (hφ₀.2 a haφ₀).1 ha k
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    simp [h0, Function.comp_apply, φ₀.left_inv haφ₀, hedef]
  have hfdz : ∀ k, fderiv 𝕜 (z k ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a) = e k := by
    intro k
    have hev : (z k ∘ φ₀.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ₀ a)] fun v => ψ v (σ₀ k) := by
      filter_upwards [φ₀.open_target.mem_nhds (φ₀.map_source haφ₀)] with v hv
      change ψ (φ₀ (φ₀.symm v)) (σ₀ k) = ψ v (σ₀ k)
      rw [φ₀.right_inv hv]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact hcf k
  have hdiffz : ∀ k, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) (z k) a := fun k =>
    (((coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ k)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
      (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ₀.1)).contMDiffAt
        (φ₀.open_source.mem_nhds haφ₀)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have heind : LinearIndependent 𝕜 e := by
    have h1 := (hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_chart hφ₀.1 haφ₀ hdiffz).mp
      (hφ₀.hasIndependentDifferentialsAt haφ₀)
    have h2 : (fun k => fderiv 𝕜 (z k ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a)) = e := funext hfdz
    rwa [h2] at h1
  have hsub : ∀ j, d j ∈ Submodule.span 𝕜 (range e) := fun j => by
    rw [hDh j]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨K, hPK, hKc, hli⟩ := exists_finset_linearIndependent_sum_of_subset e heind d hsub P hP
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_embedding_range_eq_compl K hKc
  have hmapK : Finset.univ.map τ = Kᶜ := by
    ext k
    rw [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_compl, ← hτ k]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_range]
  
  set F : Fin s ⊕ K → Fin c := Sum.elim τ Subtype.val with hFdef
  have hFinj : Function.Injective F := by
    rintro (j | k) (j' | k') hxy
    · exact congrArg Sum.inl (τ.injective hxy)
    · exact absurd ((hτ k').mp ⟨j, hxy⟩) (not_not.mpr k'.2)
    · exact absurd ((hτ k).mp ⟨j', hxy.symm⟩) (not_not.mpr k.2)
    · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext hxy)
  have hFsurj : Function.Surjective F := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k ∈ K
    · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨k, hk⟩, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (hτ k).mpr hk
      exact ⟨Sum.inl j, hj⟩
  set Eq : Fin s ⊕ K ≃ Fin c := Equiv.ofBijective F ⟨hFinj, hFsurj⟩ with hEqdef
  have hEq_inl : ∀ j, Eq.symm (τ j) = Sum.inl j := fun j => Eq.symm_apply_eq.mpr rfl
  have hEq_inr : ∀ k : K, Eq.symm k = Sum.inr k := fun k => Eq.symm_apply_eq.mpr rfl
  set Z : Fin s ⊕ K → M → 𝕜 := Sum.elim hfun fun k : K => z k with hZdef
  set z' : Fin c → M → 𝕜 := fun k => Z (Eq.symm k) with hz'def
  have hz'τ : ∀ j, z' (τ j) = hfun j := fun j => by
    simp only [hz'def, hEq_inl j, hZdef, Sum.elim_inl]
  have hz'K : ∀ k : K, z' k = z k := fun k => by
    simp only [hz'def, hEq_inr k, hZdef, Sum.elim_inr]
  have hZc : ∀ x, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (Z x) a := by
    rintro (j | k)
    · exact ((coordFunctional ψ (σ₁ j)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
        (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ₁.1)).contMDiffAt (φ₁.open_source.mem_nhds haφ₁)
    · exact ((coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ k)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
        (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ₀.1)).contMDiffAt (φ₀.open_source.mem_nhds haφ₀)
  have hz'c : ∀ k, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (z' k) a := fun k => hZc (Eq.symm k)
  have hZ0 : ∀ x, Z x a = 0 := by
    rintro (j | k)
    · exact (hφ₁.2 a haφ₁).1 (hYS ha) j
    · exact (hφ₀.2 a haφ₀).1 ha k
  have hz'0 : ∀ k, z' k a = 0 := fun k => hZ0 (Eq.symm k)
  have hz'd : ∀ k, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) (z' k) a := fun k =>
    (hz'c k).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hZfd : ∀ x, fderiv 𝕜 (Z x ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a) = Sum.elim d (fun k : K => e k) x := by
    rintro (j | k)
    · rfl
    · exact hfdz k
  have hind : HasIndependentDifferentialsAt E z' a := by
    rw [hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_chart hφ₀.1 haφ₀ hz'd]
    have h2 : (fun k => fderiv 𝕜 (z' k ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a)) =
        (Sum.elim d fun k : K => e k) ∘ Eq.symm := funext fun k => hZfd (Eq.symm k)
    rw [h2]
    exact (linearIndependent_equiv Eq.symm).mpr hli
  
  obtain ⟨e₀, σ, he₀, hae₀, -, hZad, hz'e⟩ := exists_adaptedChart_zeroSet' E ψ z' a hz'c hz'0 hind
  set Gτ : M → Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) 𝕜 := fun x => Matrix.of fun j j' => g j (τ j') x with hGτ
  
  have hGa : IsUnit (Gτ a) := by
    rw [← Matrix.vecMul_injective_iff_isUnit]
    have hker : ∀ v : Fin s → 𝕜, Matrix.vecMul v (Gτ a) = 0 → v = 0 := by
      intro v hv
      have hv' : ∀ j', ∑ j, v j * g j (τ j') a = 0 := fun j' => congrFun hv j'
      have hsum : ∑ x : Fin s ⊕ K,
          (Sum.elim v fun k : K => -(∑ j, v j * g j k a)) x •
            Sum.elim d (fun k : K => e k) x = 0 := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
        simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
        have hA : ∑ j, v j • d j = ∑ k, (∑ j, v j * g j k a) • e k := by
          simp_rw [hDh, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          simp_rw [Finset.sum_smul]
        rw [hA, ← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl K, ← hmapK, Finset.sum_map]
        have hB : ∑ j', (∑ j, v j * g j (τ j') a) • e (τ j') = 0 :=
          Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ => by rw [hv' j', zero_smul]
        rw [hB, add_zero, Finset.sum_coe_sort K fun k => -(∑ j, v j * g j k a) • e k]
        simp only [neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, add_neg_cancel]
      have := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hli _ hsum
      funext j
      exact this (Sum.inl j)
    intro v w hvw
    have hvw' : Matrix.vecMul v (Gτ a) = Matrix.vecMul w (Gτ a) := hvw
    have := hker (v - w) (by rw [Matrix.sub_vecMul, hvw', sub_self])
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  have hdet_a : (Gτ a).det ≠ 0 := ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hGa).ne_zero
  
  have hN : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, x ∈ V ∧ (∀ j, hfun j x = ∑ k, g j k x * z k x) ∧
      (∀ j k, x ∈ U j k) ∧ (Gτ x).det ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, ∀ j, hfun j x = ∑ k, g j k x * z k x := eventually_all.mpr hrep
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, ∀ j k, x ∈ U j k :=
      eventually_all.mpr fun j => eventually_all.mpr fun k => (U j k).2.mem_nhds (haU j k)
    have h3 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, (Gτ x).det ≠ 0 := by
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x => (Gτ x).det) a := by
        refine (Continuous.matrix_det continuous_id).continuousAt.comp ?_
        refine continuousAt_pi.mpr fun j => continuousAt_pi.mpr fun j' => ?_
        exact ((hgU j (τ j')).continuousOn.continuousAt ((U j (τ j')).2.mem_nhds (haU j (τ j'))))
      exact hcont.eventually_ne hdet_a
    filter_upwards [V.2.mem_nhds haV, h1, h2, h3] with x hxV hx1 hx2 hx3 using ⟨hxV, hx1, hx2, hx3⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hNsub, hNo, haN⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hN
  have hZad' := hZad.restrOpen' N hNo
  have hsrc : ∀ x, x ∈ (e₀.restrOpen N hNo).source ↔ x ∈ e₀.source ∧ x ∈ N := fun x => by
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source]
    exact Iff.rfl
  have hcoordτ : ∀ x ∈ (e₀.restrOpen N hNo).source, ∀ j,
      ψ ((e₀.restrOpen N hNo) x) (σ (τ j)) = hfun j x := by
    intro x hx j
    change ψ (e₀ x) (σ (τ j)) = hfun j x
    rw [← hz'e x ((hsrc x).mp hx).1 (τ j), hz'τ j]
  refine ⟨e₀.restrOpen N hNo, σ, τ, ?_, ?_, ⟨hZad'.1, fun x hx => ?_⟩, fun x hx => ?_,
    hcoordτ, fun p hpP => ⟨?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩⟩
  · exact (hsrc a).mpr ⟨hae₀, haN⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact (hNsub ((hsrc x).mp hx).2).1
  · have hx' := hx
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source] at hx
    obtain ⟨hxV, hxrep, hxU, hxdet⟩ := hNsub hx.2
    rw [← hZad'.2 x hx']
    constructor
    · intro hxY
      refine ⟨hx.1, fun k => ?_⟩
      rcases hEqk : Eq.symm k with j | kk
      · change Z (Eq.symm k) x = 0
        rw [hEqk]
        exact (hφ₁.2 x hxV.2).1 (hYS hxY) j
      · change Z (Eq.symm k) x = 0
        rw [hEqk]
        exact (hφ₀.2 x hxV.1).1 hxY kk
    · rintro ⟨-, hall⟩
      have hh0 : ∀ j, hfun j x = 0 := fun j => by
        have := hall (τ j)
        rwa [hz'τ j] at this
      have hzK : ∀ k : K, z k x = 0 := fun k => by
        have := hall k
        rwa [hz'K k] at this
      have hzτ : ∀ j', z (τ j') x = 0 := by
        have hGx : IsUnit (Gτ x) :=
          (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hxdet)
        have hinj := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hGx
        have hmul : (Gτ x).mulVec (fun j' => z (τ j') x) = 0 := by
          funext j
          change ∑ j', g j (τ j') x * z (τ j') x = 0
          rw [← hh0 j, hxrep j, ← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl K, ← hmapK, Finset.sum_map]
          have hK0 : ∑ k ∈ K, g j k x * z k x = 0 :=
            Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => by rw [hzK ⟨k, hk⟩, mul_zero]
          rw [hK0, zero_add]
        have := hinj (hmul.trans (Matrix.mulVec_zero _).symm)
        exact fun j' => congrFun this j'
      rw [hφ₀.2 x hxV.1]
      intro k
      by_cases hk : k ∈ K
      · exact hzK ⟨k, hk⟩
      · obtain ⟨j', hj'⟩ := (hτ k).mpr hk
        rw [← hj']
        exact hzτ j'
  · rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source] at hx
    obtain ⟨hxV, -, -, -⟩ := hNsub hx.2
    rw [hφ₁.2 x hxV.2]
    refine forall_congr' fun j => ?_
    rw [hcoordτ x ((hsrc x).mpr hx) j]
  · intro hpτ
    exact ((hτ p).mp hpτ) (hPK hpP)
  · change ψ (e₀ x) (σ p) = z p x
    rw [← hz'e x ((hsrc x).mp hx).1 p, hz'K ⟨p, hPK hpP⟩]

name: Manifold.fderiv_comp_symm_mem_span_of_forall_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_comp_symm_mem_span_of_forall_eq_zero (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c)
    {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n} (hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ σ) {a : M}
    (ha : a ∈ Y) (haφ : a ∈ φ.source) {f : M → 𝕜} (U : Opens M) (haU : a ∈ U)
    (hfU : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω f U) (hf0 : ∀ x ∈ U, x ∈ Y → f x = 0) :
    fderiv 𝕜 (f ∘ φ.symm) (φ a) ∈ Submodule.span 𝕜 (range fun k => coordFunctional ψ (σ k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set hsec := sectionOfContMDiffOn f U hfU with hhsec
  have hmem : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U a haU hsec ∈ hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a := by
    rw [hY.germ_mem_stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_iff U ha haU]
    filter_upwards [(continuous_subtype_val.isOpen_preimage _ U.2).mem_nhds
      (show (⟨a, ha⟩ : Y) ∈ {y : Y | (y : M) ∈ U} from haU)] with y hyU
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hyU, sectionOfContMDiffOn_apply]
    exact hf0 y hyU y.2
  rw [hY.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span ha hφ haφ, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hmem
  obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := hmem
  have hg : ∀ k, ∃ g : M → 𝕜, stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a (cf k) = ↑g ∧
      ∃ W : Opens M, a ∈ W ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω g W := fun k =>
    (mem_range_stalkToGerm_iff 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a _).mp ⟨_, rfl⟩
  choose g hgc W haW hgW using hg
  
  have hrep : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, f x = ∑ k, g k x * ψ (φ x) (σ k) := by
    have h1 := congrArg (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a) hcf
    rw [map_sum, stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ] at h1
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, hgc, stalkToGerm_coord, ← Germ.coe_mul] at h1
    rw [germ_coe_sum, Germ.coe_eq] at h1
    filter_upwards [h1, U.2.mem_nhds haU, φ.open_source.mem_nhds haφ] with x hx hxU hxφ
    rw [Finset.sum_apply] at hx
    have hx' : extendSection 𝕜 E hsec x = f x := by
      rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hxU, sectionOfContMDiffOn_apply]
    rw [← hx', ← hx]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Pi.mul_apply, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hxφ]
    rfl
  
  have hcd : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (fun v : E => ψ v (σ k)) (φ a) := fun k =>
    (coordFunctional ψ (σ k)).differentiableAt
  have hcf' : ∀ k, fderiv 𝕜 (fun v : E => ψ v (σ k)) (φ a) = coordFunctional ψ (σ k) := fun k =>
    (coordFunctional ψ (σ k)).fderiv
  have hgd : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (g k ∘ φ.symm) (φ a) := by
    intro k
    have h2 : IsOpen (φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' (W k : Set M)) :=
      φ.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (W k).2
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (g k ∘ φ.symm) (φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' (W k : Set M)) :=
      (hgW k).comp ((contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ.1).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        fun v hv => hv.2
    have h3 : φ a ∈ φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' (W k : Set M) :=
      ⟨φ.map_source haφ, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, φ.left_inv haφ]; exact haW k⟩
    exact (contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.mp (h1.contMDiffAt (h2.mem_nhds h3))).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have hrep' : (f ∘ φ.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ a)] fun v => ∑ k, (g k ∘ φ.symm) v * ψ v (σ k) := by
    filter_upwards [(φ.tendsto_symm haφ).eventually hrep,
      φ.open_target.mem_nhds (φ.map_source haφ)] with v hv hvT
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hv]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    change g k (φ.symm v) * ψ (φ (φ.symm v)) (σ k) = g k (φ.symm v) * ψ v (σ k)
    rw [φ.right_inv hvT]
  rw [hrep'.fderiv_eq]
  have hsumfun : (fun v : E => ∑ k, (g k ∘ φ.symm) v * ψ v (σ k)) =
      ∑ k, fun v : E => (g k ∘ φ.symm) v * ψ v (σ k) := by
    ext v
    simp [Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [hsumfun, fderiv_sum (A := fun k => fun v : E => (g k ∘ φ.symm) v * ψ v (σ k))
    fun k _ => (hgd k).mul (hcd k)]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => ?_
  change fderiv 𝕜 ((g k ∘ φ.symm) * fun v : E => ψ v (σ k)) (φ a) ∈ _
  rw [fderiv_mul (hgd k) (hcd k), hcf' k]
  have h0 : ψ (φ a) (σ k) = 0 := (hφ.2 a haφ).1 ha k
  simp only [h0, zero_smul, add_zero]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩)

name: Manifold.linearIndependent_fderiv_comp_symm_iff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin ι
  have hw' : ∀ i, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ((w ∘ e.symm) i) a := fun i => hw _
  have h0 := hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_chart hχ₀ haχ₀ hw'
  have h1 := hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_chart hχ₁ haχ₁ hw'
  rw [← linearIndependent_equiv e.symm (f := fun i => fderiv 𝕜 (w i ∘ χ₀.symm) (χ₀ a)),
    ← linearIndependent_equiv e.symm (f := fun i => fderiv 𝕜 (w i ∘ χ₁.symm) (χ₁ a))]
  exact h0.symm.trans h1

name: Manifold.exists_adaptedChart_extend
statement:
theorem exists_adaptedChart_extend {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n}
    (he : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y e σ) {a : M} (ha : a ∈ Y) (hae : a ∈ e.source)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (v : ι → M → 𝕜) (hv : ∀ l, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (v l) a)
    (hv0 : ∀ l, v l a = 0) {χ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} (hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    (haχ : a ∈ χ.source)
    (hind : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (Sum.elim
      (fun k => fderiv 𝕜 ((fun x => ψ (e x) (σ k)) ∘ χ.symm) (χ a))
      fun l => fderiv 𝕜 (v l ∘ χ.symm) (χ a))) :
    ∃ (e' : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E) (σ' : Fin c ↪ Fin n) (ρ : ι ↪ Fin n),
      a ∈ e'.source ∧ e'.source ⊆ e.source ∧ IsAdaptedChart ψ Y e' σ' ∧
        (∀ x ∈ e'.source, ∀ k, ψ (e' x) (σ' k) = ψ (e x) (σ k)) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ e'.source, ∀ l, ψ (e' x) (ρ l) = v l x) ∧ ∀ l, ρ l ∉ Set.range σ'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨eι⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin ι
  set E₂ : Fin c ⊕ ι ≃ Fin (c + N) :=
    (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl _) eι).trans finSumFinEquiv with hE₂
  set Z : Fin c ⊕ ι → M → 𝕜 := Sum.elim (fun k x => ψ (e x) (σ k)) v with hZ
  set w : Fin (c + N) → M → 𝕜 := Z ∘ E₂.symm with hw
  have hZc : ∀ i, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (Z i) a := by
    rintro (k | l)
    · exact ((coordFunctional ψ (σ k)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
        (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas he.1)).contMDiffAt (e.open_source.mem_nhds hae)
    · exact hv l
  have hZ0 : ∀ i, Z i a = 0 := by
    rintro (k | l)
    · exact (he.2 a hae).1 ha k
    · exact hv0 l
  have hwc : ∀ i, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (w i) a := fun i => hZc _
  have hw0 : ∀ i, w i a = 0 := fun i => hZ0 _
  have hwd : ∀ i, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) (w i) a := fun i =>
    (hwc i).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hind' : HasIndependentDifferentialsAt E w a := by
    rw [hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_chart hχ haχ hwd]
    have : (fun i => fderiv 𝕜 (w i ∘ χ.symm) (χ a)) =
        (Sum.elim (fun k => fderiv 𝕜 ((fun x => ψ (e x) (σ k)) ∘ χ.symm) (χ a))
          fun l => fderiv 𝕜 (v l ∘ χ.symm) (χ a)) ∘ E₂.symm := by
      funext i
      rcases hi : E₂.symm i with k | l <;> simp [hw, hZ, hi]
    rw [this]
    exact (linearIndependent_equiv E₂.symm).mpr hind
  obtain ⟨e₀, σ₀, he₀, hae₀, -, hwe⟩ := exists_chart_extending ψ w a hwc hw0 hind'
  set e' := e₀.restrOpen e.source e.open_source with he'
  have hsrc : ∀ x, x ∈ e'.source ↔ x ∈ e₀.source ∧ x ∈ e.source := fun x => by
    rw [he', OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source]
    exact Iff.rfl
  have he'mem : e' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M := by
    rw [he', OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_eq_restr]
    exact restr_mem_maximalAtlas _ he₀ e.open_source
  set σ' : Fin c ↪ Fin n :=
    ⟨fun k => σ₀ (E₂ (Sum.inl k)), fun k k' h =>
      Sum.inl_injective (E₂.injective (σ₀.injective h))⟩ with hσ'
  set ρ : ι ↪ Fin n :=
    ⟨fun l => σ₀ (E₂ (Sum.inr l)), fun l l' h =>
      Sum.inr_injective (E₂.injective (σ₀.injective h))⟩ with hρ
  have hcoordσ : ∀ x ∈ e'.source, ∀ k, ψ (e' x) (σ' k) = ψ (e x) (σ k) := by
    intro x hx k
    change ψ (e₀ x) (σ₀ (E₂ (Sum.inl k))) = ψ (e x) (σ k)
    rw [← hwe x ((hsrc x).mp hx).1]
    simp [hw, hZ]
  have hcoordρ : ∀ x ∈ e'.source, ∀ l, ψ (e' x) (ρ l) = v l x := by
    intro x hx l
    change ψ (e₀ x) (σ₀ (E₂ (Sum.inr l))) = v l x
    rw [← hwe x ((hsrc x).mp hx).1]
    simp [hw, hZ]
  refine ⟨e', σ', ρ, (hsrc a).mpr ⟨hae₀, hae⟩, fun x hx => ((hsrc x).mp hx).2,
    ⟨he'mem, fun x hx => ?_⟩, hcoordσ, hcoordρ, fun l ⟨k, hk⟩ => ?_⟩
  · rw [he.2 x ((hsrc x).mp hx).2]
    exact forall_congr' fun k => by rw [hcoordσ x hx k]
  · have hk' : σ₀ (E₂ (Sum.inl k)) = σ₀ (E₂ (Sum.inr l)) := hk
    exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (E₂.injective (σ₀.injective hk'))

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.exists_isSncChartAt_flag_proper
statement:
theorem HypersurfaceFamily.exists_isSncChartAt_flag_proper (hF : F.IsSnc ψ)
    (hZ : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Z c) (hZH : Z ⊆ H)
    {φ₀ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ₀ : Fin c ↪ Fin n} (hφ₀ : IsAdaptedChart ψ Z φ₀ σ₀)
    {a : M} (ha : a ∈ Z) {cidx₀ : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j} → Fin n} (hc₀ : F.IsSncChartAt ψ φ₀ a cidx₀)
    {φ₁ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ₁ : Fin s ↪ Fin n} (hφ₁ : IsAdaptedChart ψ H φ₁ σ₁)
    {cidx₁ : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j} → Fin n} (hc₁ : F.IsSncChartAt ψ φ₁ a cidx₁)
    (hproper : ∀ j, cidx₁ j ∉ Set.range σ₁) :
    ∃ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E) (σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n) (τ : Fin s ↪ Fin c)
      (cidx : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j} → Fin n),
      IsAdaptedChart ψ Z e σ ∧ (∀ x ∈ e.source, x ∈ H ↔ ∀ j, ψ (e x) (σ (τ j)) = 0) ∧
        F.IsSncChartAt ψ e a cidx ∧ ∀ j, cidx j ∉ Set.range (τ.trans σ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have haφ₀ : a ∈ φ₀.source := hc₀.2.1
  have haφ₁ : a ∈ φ₁.source := hc₁.2.1
  
  have hfd : ∀ (χ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E), a ∈ χ.source → ∀ i : Fin n,
      fderiv 𝕜 ((fun x => ψ (χ x) i) ∘ χ.symm) (χ a) = coordFunctional ψ i := by
    intro χ haχ i
    have hev : ((fun x => ψ (χ x) i) ∘ χ.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (χ a)] fun v => ψ v i := by
      filter_upwards [χ.open_target.mem_nhds (χ.map_source haχ)] with v hv
      change ψ (χ (χ.symm v)) i = ψ v i
      rw [χ.right_inv hv]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact (coordFunctional ψ i).fderiv
  
  set P : Finset (Fin c) := Finset.univ.filter fun p => ∃ j : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j}, cidx₀ j = σ₀ p
    with hPdef
  have hPj : ∀ p : P, ∃ j : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j}, cidx₀ j = σ₀ p := fun p =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp p.2).2
  choose jp hjp using hPj
  set z : Fin c → M → 𝕜 := fun p x => ψ (φ₀ x) (σ₀ p) with hzdef
  have hzV : ∀ p, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (z p) φ₀.source := fun p =>
    (coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ p)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
      (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ₀.1)
  have hzc : ∀ p, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (z p) a := fun p =>
    (hzV p).contMDiffAt (φ₀.open_source.mem_nhds haφ₀)
  have hzd : ∀ p, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) (z p) a := fun p =>
    (hzc p).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  
  
  have hzind : LinearIndependent 𝕜 fun p => fderiv 𝕜 (z p ∘ φ₁.symm) (φ₁ a) :=
    (hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_chart hφ₁.1 haφ₁ hzd).mp
      (hφ₀.hasIndependentDifferentialsAt haφ₀)
  have hzP : ∀ p : P, ∃ t : 𝕜, t ≠ 0 ∧
      fderiv 𝕜 (z p ∘ φ₁.symm) (φ₁ a) = t • coordFunctional ψ (cidx₁ (jp p)) := by
    intro p
    have hmem := fderiv_comp_symm_mem_span_of_forall_eq_zero (hF.1 (jp p).1)
      (hc₁.isAdaptedChart_hyp (jp p)) (jp p).2 haφ₁ ⟨φ₀.source, φ₀.open_source⟩ haφ₀ (hzV p)
      fun x hx hxj => by
        have := (hc₀.mem_iff (jp p) hx).mp hxj
        rwa [hjp p] at this
    simp only [singleEmb_apply, Set.range_const, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨t, fun ht0 => ?_, ht.symm⟩
    have hne := hzind.ne_zero (p : Fin c)
    rw [← ht, ht0, zero_smul] at hne
    exact hne rfl
  choose t ht0 htz using hzP
  
  set hfun : Fin s → M → 𝕜 := fun j x => ψ (φ₁ x) (σ₁ j) with hhdef
  have hhc : ∀ j, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (hfun j) a := fun j =>
    ((coordFunctional ψ (σ₁ j)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
      (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ₁.1)).contMDiffAt (φ₁.open_source.mem_nhds haφ₁)
  set W : Fin s ⊕ P → M → 𝕜 := Sum.elim hfun fun p : P => z p with hWdef
  have hWd : ∀ i, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) (W i) a := by
    rintro (j | p)
    · exact (hhc j).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    · exact hzd p
  have hW₁ : LinearIndependent 𝕜 fun i => fderiv 𝕜 (W i ∘ φ₁.symm) (φ₁ a) := by
    set ι : Fin s ⊕ P → Fin n := Sum.elim σ₁ fun p => cidx₁ (jp p) with hιdef
    have hιinj : Function.Injective ι := by
      rintro (j | p) (j' | p') h <;> simp only [hιdef, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at h
      · exact congrArg Sum.inl (σ₁.injective h)
      · exact absurd ⟨j, h⟩ (hproper (jp p'))
      · exact absurd ⟨j', h.symm⟩ (hproper (jp p))
      · have h1 : jp p = jp p' := hc₁.injective h
        have h2 : σ₀ p = σ₀ p' := by rw [← hjp p, ← hjp p', h1]
        exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext (σ₀.injective h2))
    have hbase : LinearIndependent 𝕜 fun i => coordFunctional ψ (ι i) :=
      (linearIndependent_coordFunctional ψ (Function.Embedding.refl _)).comp ι hιinj
    set u : Fin s ⊕ P → 𝕜ˣ := Sum.elim (fun _ => 1) fun p => Units.mk0 (t p) (ht0 p) with hudef
    have := hbase.units_smul u
    convert this using 1
    funext i
    rcases i with j | p
    · simp only [hWdef, hudef, hιdef, Sum.elim_inl, Pi.smul_apply', one_smul]
      exact hfd φ₁ haφ₁ (σ₁ j)
    · simp only [hWdef, hudef, hιdef, Sum.elim_inr, Pi.smul_apply', Units.smul_def, Units.val_mk0]
      exact htz p
  have hW₀ : LinearIndependent 𝕜 fun i => fderiv 𝕜 (W i ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a) :=
    (linearIndependent_fderiv_comp_symm_iff hWd hφ₀.1 haφ₀ hφ₁.1 haφ₁).mpr hW₁
  have hP : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (Sum.elim
      (fun j => fderiv 𝕜 ((fun x => ψ (φ₁ x) (σ₁ j)) ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a))
      fun p : P => coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ p)) := by
    convert hW₀ using 1
    funext i
    rcases i with j | p
    · rfl
    · simp only [Sum.elim_inr, hWdef]
      exact (hfd φ₀ haφ₀ (σ₀ p)).symm
  obtain ⟨e, σ, τ, hae, hesub, heZ, hflag, hcoordτ, hkeep⟩ :=
    exists_adaptedChart_flag_protected hZ hZH hφ₀ hφ₁ ha haφ₀ haφ₁ P hP
  
  have : Finite {j // a ∈ F.hyp j} := Finite.of_injective cidx₀ hc₀.injective
  set Q := {j : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j} // cidx₀ j ∉ Set.range σ₀} with hQdef
  set v : Q → M → 𝕜 := fun q x => ψ (φ₀ x) (cidx₀ q.1) with hvdef
  have hvc : ∀ q : Q, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (v q) a := fun q =>
    ((coordFunctional ψ (cidx₀ q.1)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
      (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ₀.1)).contMDiffAt (φ₀.open_source.mem_nhds haφ₀)
  have hv0 : ∀ q : Q, v q a = 0 := fun q => (hc₀.mem_iff q.1 haφ₀).mp q.1.2
  have hed : ∀ k, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) (fun y => ψ (e y) (σ k)) a := fun k =>
    (((coordFunctional ψ (σ k)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
      (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas heZ.1)).contMDiffAt
        (e.open_source.mem_nhds hae)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hA : LinearIndependent 𝕜 fun k => fderiv 𝕜 ((fun y => ψ (e y) (σ k)) ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a) :=
    (hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_chart hφ₀.1 haφ₀ hed).mp
      (heZ.hasIndependentDifferentialsAt hae)
  have hAspan : ∀ k, fderiv 𝕜 ((fun y => ψ (e y) (σ k)) ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a) ∈
      Submodule.span 𝕜 (range fun k' => coordFunctional ψ (σ₀ k')) := fun k =>
    fderiv_comp_symm_mem_span_of_forall_eq_zero hZ hφ₀ ha haφ₀ ⟨e.source, e.open_source⟩ hae
      ((coordFunctional ψ (σ k)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
        (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas heZ.1))
      fun x hx hxZ => (heZ.2 x hx).1 hxZ k
  have hBli : LinearIndependent 𝕜 fun q : Q => coordFunctional ψ (cidx₀ q.1) :=
    (linearIndependent_coordFunctional ψ (Function.Embedding.refl _)).comp (fun q : Q => cidx₀ q.1)
      fun q q' h => Subtype.ext (hc₀.injective h)
  have hindext : LinearIndependent 𝕜 (Sum.elim
      (fun k => fderiv 𝕜 ((fun x => ψ (e x) (σ k)) ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a))
      fun q : Q => fderiv 𝕜 (v q ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a)) := by
    have hB : (fun q : Q => fderiv 𝕜 (v q ∘ φ₀.symm) (φ₀ a)) =
        fun q => coordFunctional ψ (cidx₀ q.1) := funext fun q => hfd φ₀ haφ₀ (cidx₀ q.1)
    rw [hB]
    refine LinearIndependent.sum_type hA hBli ?_
    have hLI := linearIndependent_coordFunctional ψ (Function.Embedding.refl (Fin n))
    have hst : Disjoint (range σ₀) (range fun q : Q => cidx₀ q.1) := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_right]
      rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩ hq
      exact q.2 hq
    have hd := hLI.disjoint_span_image hst
    simp only [Function.Embedding.refl_apply, ← Set.range_comp] at hd
    refine Disjoint.mono_left ?_ hd
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact hAspan k
  obtain ⟨e', σ', ρ, hae', he'sub, he'Z, hcoordσ, hcoordρ, hρσ⟩ :=
    exists_adaptedChart_extend heZ ha hae v hvc hv0 hφ₀.1 haφ₀ hindext
  
  have hcidx : ∀ j : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j}, ∃ i : Fin n,
      (∀ x ∈ e'.source, x ∈ F.hyp j.1 ↔ ψ (e' x) i = 0) ∧ i ∉ range (τ.trans σ') ∧
        ((∃ p : P, i = σ' p ∧ cidx₀ j = σ₀ p) ∨ ∃ q : Q, q.1 = j ∧ i = ρ q) := by
    intro j
    by_cases h : cidx₀ j ∈ range σ₀
    · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h
      have hpP : p ∈ P := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, j, hp.symm⟩
      obtain ⟨hpτ, hpz⟩ := hkeep p hpP
      refine ⟨σ' p, fun x hx => ?_, ?_, Or.inl ⟨⟨p, hpP⟩, rfl, hp.symm⟩⟩
      · have hxe : x ∈ e.source := he'sub hx
        rw [hcoordσ x hx p, hpz x hxe, hp]
        exact hc₀.mem_iff j (hesub hxe).1
      · rintro ⟨j', hj'⟩
        have hj'' : σ' (τ j') = σ' p := hj'
        exact hpτ ⟨j', σ'.injective hj''⟩
    · refine ⟨ρ ⟨j, h⟩, fun x hx => ?_, ?_, Or.inr ⟨⟨j, h⟩, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
      · rw [hcoordρ x hx ⟨j, h⟩]
        exact hc₀.mem_iff j (hesub (he'sub hx)).1
      · rintro ⟨j', hj'⟩
        exact hρσ ⟨j, h⟩ ⟨τ j', hj'⟩
  choose cidx hcmem hcτ hccase using hcidx
  refine ⟨e', σ', τ, cidx, he'Z, fun x hx => ?_, ⟨he'Z.1, hae', hcmem, ?_⟩, hcτ⟩
  · rw [hflag x (he'sub hx)]
    exact forall_congr' fun j => by rw [hcoordσ x hx (τ j)]
  · intro j j' hjj'
    rcases hccase j with ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ | ⟨q, hq, hq0⟩ <;>
      rcases hccase j' with ⟨p', hp', hp0'⟩ | ⟨q', hq', hq0'⟩
    · have h1 : σ' p = σ' p' := by rw [← hp, ← hp', hjj']
      have h2 : (p : Fin c) = p' := σ'.injective h1
      exact hc₀.injective (by rw [hp0, hp0', h2])
    · exact absurd (hp.symm.trans (hjj'.trans hq0')) fun h => hρσ q' ⟨p, h⟩
    · exact absurd (hp'.symm.trans (hjj'.symm.trans hq0)) fun h => hρσ q ⟨p', h⟩
    · have h1 : ρ q = ρ q' := by rw [← hq0, ← hq0', hjj']
      have h2 : q = q' := ρ.injective h1
      rw [← hq, ← hq', h2]

name: Manifold.prod_pow_extend_embedding
statement:
theorem prod_pow_extend_embedding {R : Type*} [CommMonoid R] {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin m ↪ Fin n)
    (f : Fin n → R) (α : Fin m → ℕ) :
    ∏ j, f j ^ Function.extend σ α 0 j = ∏ i, f (σ i) ^ α i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.prod_subset (Finset.subset_univ (Finset.univ.map σ)) fun j _ hj => ?_,
    Finset.prod_map]
  · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [σ.injective.extend_apply]
  · have hj' : ¬ ∃ i, σ i = j := fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => hj (Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hi⟩)
    rw [Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hj', Pi.zero_apply, pow_zero]

name: Manifold.exists_associated_prod_pow_of_dvd_prod_pow
statement:
theorem exists_associated_prod_pow_of_dvd_prod_pow {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] {m : ℕ} {p : Fin m → R} (hp : ∀ i, Prime (p i))
    (α : Fin m → ℕ) {a : R} (ha : a ∣ ∏ i, p i ^ α i) :
    ∃ γ : Fin m → ℕ, Associated (∏ i, p i ^ γ i) a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : ∏ i, p i ^ α i ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => pow_ne_zero _ (hp i).ne_zero
  induction a using UniqueFactorizationMonoid.induction_on_prime with
  | h₁ => exact absurd (zero_dvd_iff.mp ha) hne
  | h₂ x hx =>
    exact ⟨0, by simpa using (associated_one_iff_isUnit.mpr hx).symm⟩
  | h₃ a q _ hq ih =>
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := ih (dvd_of_mul_left_dvd ha)
    have hqd : q ∣ ∏ i, p i ^ α i := dvd_of_mul_right_dvd ha
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff hq _).mp hqd
    have hqj : Associated q (p j) := hq.associated_of_dvd (hp j) (hq.dvd_of_dvd_pow hj)
    refine ⟨γ + Pi.single j 1, ?_⟩
    have h1 : ∏ i, p i ^ ((γ + Pi.single j 1 : Fin m → ℕ) i) = p j * ∏ i, p i ^ γ i := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ j),
        ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun i => p i ^ γ i) (Finset.mem_univ j)]
      rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i hi => by
        rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi), add_zero]]
      rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [h1]
    exact hqj.symm.mul_mul hγ

name: Manifold.exists_chart_forall_dvd_prod_pow
statement:
theorem exists_chart_forall_dvd_prod_pow (ψ : E ≃L[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜)) {x : M} {m : ℕ}
    {z : Fin m → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x}
    (hz : IsLocalRing.IsRegularSystemOfParameters z) (α : Fin m → ℕ) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E, e ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M ∧ x ∈ e.source ∧
      ∀ (s : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) (F : M → 𝕜), s ∣ ∏ i, z i ^ α i →
        stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x s = (F : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜) →
        ∃ (β : Fin n → ℕ) (u : M → 𝕜), ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω u x ∧ u x ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, F y = u y * ∏ j, ψ (e y) j ^ β j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have _hfd : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E := ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  obtain ⟨hzspan, hdim⟩ := hz
  have hreg₀ : IsRegularLocalRing ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_chart E ψ (chartAt E x) (mem_chart_source E x)
      (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas x)
  have hzm : ∀ i, z i ∈ maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x) := fun i =>
    hzspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hliκ := IsRegularLocalRing.linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_span_eq z hzm hzspan hdim
  
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, g, hg⟩ := exists_sections_of_germs (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M) z
  have hz0 : ∀ i, extendSection 𝕜 E (g i) x = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hxU]
    have h1 : eval 𝕜 E M x ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U x hxU (g i)) = (g i) ⟨x, hxU⟩ :=
      contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 U x hxU (g i)
    rw [← h1, hg i]
    exact (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E _).mp (hzm i)
  have hzc : ∀ i, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (extendSection 𝕜 E (g i)) x := fun i =>
    (contMDiffOn_extendBy0 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M (g i)).contMDiffAt (U.isOpen.mem_nhds hxU)
  have hind : HasIndependentDifferentialsAt E (fun i => extendSection 𝕜 E (g i)) x := by
    rw [hasIndependentDifferentialsAt_iff_linearIndependent_cotangentClass' E hxU g]
    simpa only [hg] using linearIndependent_cotangentClass_of_residueField z hzm hliκ
  obtain ⟨e, σ₀, he, hxe, he0, hcoord⟩ :=
    exists_chart_extending ψ (fun i => extendSection 𝕜 E (g i)) x hzc hz0 hind
  have := isDomain_stalk ψ he hxe
  have := uniqueFactorizationMonoid_stalk_of_chart E ψ e hxe he
  
  have hzcoord : ∀ i, z i = coord E ψ e he hxe (σ₀ i) := by
    intro i
    apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x
    rw [← hg i, stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ, stalkToGerm_coord, Germ.coe_eq]
    filter_upwards [(e.open_source.inter U.isOpen).mem_nhds ⟨hxe, hxU⟩] with y hy
    rw [hcoord y hy.1 i, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hy.1]
    rfl
  have hzprime : ∀ i, Prime (z i) := fun i => by
    rw [hzcoord i]
    exact prime_coord_of_eq_zero e he hxe (by rw [he0, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply])
  refine ⟨e, he, hxe, fun s F hsd hs => ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨γ, v, hv⟩ := exists_associated_prod_pow_of_dvd_prod_pow hzprime α hsd
  set w : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk x := ↑v with hw
  obtain ⟨V₀, hxV₀, a₀, ha₀⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq w
  set A : M → 𝕜 := extendSection 𝕜 E a₀ with hA
  have hA0 : A x ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : eval 𝕜 E M x w ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
      (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr v.isUnit) ((mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E w).mpr h0)
    have h2 : eval 𝕜 E M x ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V₀ x hxV₀ a₀) = a₀ ⟨x, hxV₀⟩ :=
      contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω M 𝕜 V₀ x hxV₀ a₀
    rw [← ha₀, h2] at h1
    rwa [hA, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E a₀ hxV₀]
  have hAc : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω A x :=
    (contMDiffOn_extendBy0 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a₀).contMDiffAt (V₀.isOpen.mem_nhds hxV₀)
  
  have hwA : stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x w = (A : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜) := by
    rw [← ha₀]
    exact stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ E V₀ hxV₀ a₀
  have hgerm : (F : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜) =
      ((fun y => (∏ i, extendSection 𝕜 E (g i) y ^ γ i) * A y : M → 𝕜) : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜) := by
    have h5 : (fun y => (∏ i, extendSection 𝕜 E (g i) y ^ γ i) * A y : M → 𝕜) =
        (∏ i, (extendSection 𝕜 E (g i)) ^ γ i) * A := by
      funext y
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Finset.prod_apply, Pi.pow_apply]
    rw [← hs, ← hv, map_mul, map_prod, hwA, h5]
    change _ = Filter.Germ.coeRingHom (𝓝 x) (_ * _)
    rw [map_mul, map_prod]
    simp only [map_pow, ← hg]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => by
      rw [stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ E U hxU (g i)]
      rfl
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, F y = (∏ i, extendSection 𝕜 E (g i) y ^ γ i) * A y :=
    Filter.Germ.coe_eq.mp hgerm
  refine ⟨Function.extend σ₀ γ 0, A, hAc, hA0, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hev, e.open_source.mem_nhds hxe] with y hy hye
  rw [hy, mul_comm, prod_pow_extend_embedding σ₀ (fun j => ψ (e y) j) γ]
  simp only [hcoord y hye]

name: AnalyticManifold.IdealSheaf.IsNormalCrossingsDivisor.exists_chart_forall_le_span
statement:
theorem IsNormalCrossingsDivisor.exists_chart_forall_le_span (ψ : E ≃L[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜))
    {J : IdealSheaf M} (hJ : J.IsNormalCrossingsDivisor) (x : M) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E, e ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M ∧ x ∈ e.source ∧
      ∀ (s : stalkRing M x) (F : M → 𝕜), J.stalkIdeal x ≤ Ideal.span {s} →
        Manifold.stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M x s = (F : (𝓝 x).Germ 𝕜) →
        ∃ (β : Fin n → ℕ) (u : M → 𝕜), ContMDiffAt 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω u x ∧ u x ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, F y = u y * ∏ j, ψ (e y) j ^ β j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, z, α, hz, hJx⟩ := hJ x
  obtain ⟨e, he, hxe, h⟩ := Manifold.exists_chart_forall_dvd_prod_pow ψ hz α
  refine ⟨e, he, hxe, fun s F hle hs => h s F ?_ hs⟩
  rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact hle (hJx ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSncChartAt.notMem_range_of_frequently
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[H] a, x ∈ φ.source ∧ x ∈ H :=
    (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds (φ.open_source.mem_nhds hc.2.1)).and
      self_mem_nhdsWithin
  obtain ⟨x, hxj, hxφ, hxH⟩ := (hne.and_eventually hev).exists
  refine hxj ((hc.mem_iff j hxφ).mpr ?_)
  rw [← hi]
  exact (hφ.2 x hxφ).mp hxH i

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSncChartAt.restrict_isSncChartAt
proof:
:= hH.chartedSpace
    (F.restrict H).IsSncChartAt (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜)) (hφ.chartOn ha)
      ⟨a, ha⟩ fun j => complEquiv σ
        ⟨cidx ⟨j.1, j.2⟩, hc.notMem_range_of_frequently hφ ⟨j.1, j.2⟩ (hne j.1 j.2)⟩ := by
  let _i := hH.chartedSpace
  refine ⟨hφ.chartOn_mem_maximalAtlas' hH ha, hc.2.1, fun j x hx => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
  · have hxφ : (x : M) ∈ φ.source := hx
    change (x : M) ∈ F.hyp j.1 ↔ projCompl σ (ψ (φ x)) (complEquiv σ ⟨cidx ⟨j.1, j.2⟩, _⟩) = 0
    rw [hc.mem_iff ⟨j.1, j.2⟩ hxφ]
    simp only [projCompl, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  · have h1 : (⟨cidx ⟨i.1, i.2⟩, _⟩ : {k : Fin n // k ∉ Set.range σ}) = ⟨cidx ⟨j.1, j.2⟩, _⟩ :=
      (complEquiv σ).injective hij
    have h2 : (⟨i.1, i.2⟩ : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j}) = ⟨j.1, j.2⟩ :=
      hc.injective (congrArg Subtype.val h1)
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val h2)

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_restrict
statement:
theorem isSnc_restrict (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) (hH : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ H 1)
    (hsnc : F.HasSncWith ψ H 1)
    (hne : ∀ a ∈ H, ∀ j, a ∈ F.hyp j → ∃ᶠ x in 𝓝[H] a, x ∉ F.hyp j) :
    letI
proof:
:= hH.chartedSpace
    (F.restrict H).IsSnc (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl 𝕜 (Fin (n - 1) → 𝕜)) := by
  let _i := hH.chartedSpace
  refine ⟨fun j => ⟨(hF.1 j).isClosed.preimage continuous_subtype_val, fun x hx => ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, cidx, hφ, hc⟩ := hsnc x.1 x.2
    have hsc := hc.restrict_isSncChartAt hH hφ x.2 (hne x.1 x.2)
    refine ⟨hφ.chartOn x.2, singleEmb (complEquiv σ ⟨cidx ⟨j, hx⟩,
      hc.notMem_range_of_frequently hφ ⟨j, hx⟩ (hne x.1 x.2 j hx)⟩), hc.2.1, ?_⟩
    exact isAdaptedChart_singleIdx hsc.1 fun y hy => hsc.mem_iff ⟨j, hx⟩ hy
  · exact hF.2.1.preimage_continuous continuous_subtype_val
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨φ, σ, cidx, hφ, hc⟩ := hsnc x.1 x.2
    exact ⟨hφ.chartOn x.2, _, hc.restrict_isSncChartAt hH hφ x.2 (hne x.1 x.2)⟩

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSncChartAt.mem_iff
Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSncChartAt.injective
statement:
theorem IsSncChartAt.injective {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {a : M}
    {c : {j // a ∈ F.hyp j} → Fin n} (h : F.IsSncChartAt ψ φ a c) : Function.Injective c

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.isClosed_support
statement: theorem IsSnc.isClosed_support (hF : F.IsSnc ψ) : IsClosed F.support

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.IsSnc.finite_of_isCompact

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.isSnc_empty
statement: theorem isSnc_empty [IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M] : (HypersurfaceFamily.empty M).IsSnc ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j => j.elim, fun x => ⟨Set.univ, Filter.univ_mem,
    Set.finite_empty.subset fun j _ => j.elim⟩, fun a =>
    ⟨chartAt E a, fun j => j.1.elim, IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a, mem_chart_source E a,
      fun j => j.1.elim, fun j => j.1.elim⟩⟩

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.hasSncWith_empty
statement:
theorem hasSncWith_empty {Y : Set M} {c : ℕ} (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) :

proof:
:= fun a ha => by

  exact ⟨φ, σ, fun j => j.1.elim, hφ, hφ.1, haφ, fun j => j.1.elim, fun j => j.1.elim⟩

name: Manifold.HypersurfaceFamily.HasSncWith.exists_chart
statement:
