  choose g hg using fun j => exists_algebraMap_pow_mul_eq x r (hJle (hfJ j))
  have hgT : ∀ j, g j ∈ transformIdeal x r (I.stalkIdeal (π a')) m := fun j =>
    Ideal.subset_span ⟨f j, hfJ j, hg j⟩
  have hρf : ∀ j, germMap π h.contMDiff a' (f j) =
      coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i) ^ m * χ (g j) := by
    intro j
    rw [← hχ, ← hg j, map_mul, map_pow, hχr]
  have hmap : Ideal.map (germMap π h.contMDiff a') (I.stalkIdeal (π a')) = Ideal.span
      (Set.range fun j => coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i) ^ m * χ (g j)) := by
    rw [← hf, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    exact congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext hρf))
  rw [hmap, Ideal.colon_span_range_pow_mul hu0 m]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hgT j)
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, transformIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro g' ⟨f', hf', hg'⟩
    have hmem' : coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i) ^ m * χ g' =
        germMap π h.contMDiff a' f' := by
      rw [← hχr, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, hg', hχ]
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, ← Ideal.colon_span_range_pow_mul hu0 m,
      Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, hmem', ← hmap]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf'

name: Manifold.x_eq_coord_of_eq_σ
statement:
theorem x_eq_coord_of_eq_σ {m : Fin n} {k : Fin c} (hmk : τ m = σ k) :
    x m = coord E ψ φ hφ.1 (hΦ.source_subset ha') (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hτ m, hmk, eval_coord, (hφ.2 _ (hΦ.source_subset ha')).1 haY k, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: Manifold.germMap_x_of_lt
statement:
theorem germMap_x_of_lt {m : Fin n} (hm : m < r) :
    germMap π h.contMDiff a' (x m) =
      coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ r) * coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hmk⟩ := (hlt m).mp hm
  rw [x_eq_coord_of_eq_σ hφ hΦ ha' haY x τ hτ hmk,
    IsBlowUpChart.germMap_coord_of_ne h.contMDiff hφ.1 hΦ ha' hk, ← hτr, ← hmk]

name: Manifold.germMap_x_self
statement:
theorem germMap_x_self :
    germMap π h.contMDiff a' (x r) = coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [x_eq_coord_of_eq_σ hφ hΦ ha' haY x τ hτ hτr,
    IsBlowUpChart.germMap_coord_self h.contMDiff hφ.1 hΦ ha', hτr]

name: Manifold.germMap_x_of_gt
statement:
theorem germMap_x_of_gt {m : Fin n} (hm : r < m) :
    germMap π h.contMDiff a' (x m) =
      coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ m) -
        const 𝕜 E M' a' (eval 𝕜 E M (π a') (coord E ψ φ hφ.1 (hΦ.source_subset ha') (τ m)))
proof:
:= by
  have hoff : ∀ k, σ k ≠ τ m := by
    intro k hk
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst hki
      exact hm.ne (τ.injective (hτr.trans hk))
    · exact absurd ((hlt m).mpr ⟨k, hki, hk.symm⟩) (not_lt.mpr hm.le)
  rw [hτ m, map_sub, IsBlowUpChart.germMap_coord_off h.contMDiff hφ.1 hΦ ha' hoff]
  congr 1
  exact germMap_algebraMap π h.contMDiff a' _

name: Manifold.chartRingHom_chartDerivRing_eq_coordDerivStalk
statement:
theorem chartRingHom_chartDerivRing_eq_coordDerivStalk (j : Fin n) (g : chartRing κ.x r) :
    χ (κ.chartDerivRing r j g) = coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j) (χ g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have haφ : π a' ∈ φ.source := hΦ.source_subset ha'
  
  have hδu : ∀ m, coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
      (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' m) = if τ j = m then 1 else 0 :=
    fun m => coordDerivStalk_coord_eq_ite hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j) m
  
  have hδx_lt : ∀ m, m < r → coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
      (germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.x m)) =
        coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ r) * (if τ j = τ m then 1 else 0) +
          coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ m) * (if τ j = τ r then 1 else 0) := by
    intro m hm
    rw [germMap_x_of_lt h hφ hΦ ha' haY κ.x r τ hτr hτ hlt hm, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul, hδu, hδu]
  have hδx_r : coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
      (germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.x r)) = if τ j = τ r then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [germMap_x_self h hφ hΦ ha' haY κ.x r τ hτr hτ, hδu]
  have hδx_gt : ∀ m, r < m → coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
      (germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.x m)) = if τ j = τ m then 1 else 0 := by
    intro m hm
    rw [germMap_x_of_gt h hφ hΦ ha' κ.x r τ hτr hτ hlt hm, map_sub, hδu,
      coordDerivStalk_const, sub_zero]
  
  have hδx_ne : j ≠ r → ∀ m, m ≠ j →
      coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
        (germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.x m)) = 0 := by
    intro hjr m hmj
    have h1 : τ j ≠ τ m := τ.injective.ne (Ne.symm hmj)
    have h2 : τ j ≠ τ r := τ.injective.ne hjr
    rcases lt_trichotomy m r with hm | rfl | hm
    · rw [hδx_lt m hm, ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_right h2, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    · rw [hδx_r, ite_eq_right h2]
    · rw [hδx_gt m hm, ite_eq_right h1]
  have hδx_self : j ≠ r → coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
      (germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.x j)) =
        if j < r then coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ r) else 1 := by
    intro hjr
    have h2 : τ j ≠ τ r := τ.injective.ne hjr
    rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hj | hj | hj
    · rw [hδx_lt j hj, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right h2, ite_eq_left hj, mul_one, mul_zero,
        add_zero]
    · exact absurd hj hjr
    · rw [hδx_gt j hj, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hj.le)]
  
  have hchain : ∀ f, coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
      (germMap π h.contMDiff a' f) =
        ∑ m, coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
          (germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.x m)) * germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.pderiv m f) := by
    intro f
    rw [derivation_germMap_eq_sum_coordDerivStalk ψ π h.contMDiff φ hφ.1 haφ]
    exact (Fintype.sum_equiv τ _ _ fun m => by
      rw [hpd m, Derivation.restrictScalars_apply, hτ m]).symm
  
  have hGalg : ∀ f : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (π a'),
      χ (κ.chartDerivRing r j (algebraMap _ _ f)) =
      coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j) (χ (algebraMap _ _ f)) := by
    intro f
    rw [hχ, hchain]
    rcases lt_trichotomy j r with hj | rfl | hj
    · 
      have hL : κ.chartDerivRing r j (algebraMap _ _ f) =
          algebraMap _ _ (κ.x r) * algebraMap _ _ (κ.pderiv j f) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rw [κ.coe_chartDerivRing r j]
        simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap]
        rw [κ.chartDeriv_of_lt r hj, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          κ.awayPderiv_algebraMap r j f]
      rw [hL, map_mul, hχ, hχ, germMap_x_self h hφ hΦ ha' haY κ.x r τ hτr hτ,
        Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun m _ hm => by rw [hδx_ne hj.ne m hm, zero_mul])
          (fun hj' => absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj'),
        hδx_self hj.ne, ite_eq_left hj]
    · 
      have hL : κ.chartDerivRing j j (algebraMap _ _ f) =
          algebraMap _ _ (κ.pderiv j f) +
            ∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin n => m < j),
              chartYR κ.x j m * algebraMap _ _ (κ.pderiv m f) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rw [κ.coe_chartDerivRing j j]
        simp only [Subalgebra.coe_add, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
          Subalgebra.coe_mul]
        rw [κ.chartDeriv_self j, Derivation.add_apply, derivation_sum_apply,
          κ.awayPderiv_algebraMap j j f]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
        rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, κ.awayPderiv_algebraMap j m f]
        rfl
      rw [hL, map_add, map_sum, hχ]
      have hR : ∀ m, coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j)
          (germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.x m)) * germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.pderiv m f) =
            if m < j then coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ m) *
              germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.pderiv m f)
            else if m = j then germMap π h.contMDiff a' (κ.pderiv j f) else 0 := by
        intro m
        rcases lt_trichotomy m j with hm | rfl | hm
        · rw [hδx_lt m hm, ite_eq_left hm, ite_eq_right (τ.injective.ne hm.ne'), ite_eq_left rfl,
            mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one]
        · rw [hδx_r, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl m), ite_eq_left rfl, one_mul]
        · rw [hδx_gt m hm, ite_eq_right (τ.injective.ne hm.ne), ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hm.le),
            ite_eq_right hm.ne', zero_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => hR m, Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
        ite_eq_left (by simp), add_comm]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
      rw [map_mul, hχy m (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2, hχ]
    · 
      have hL : κ.chartDerivRing r j (algebraMap _ _ f) = algebraMap _ _ (κ.pderiv j f) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rw [κ.coe_chartDerivRing r j]
        simp only [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap]
        rw [κ.chartDeriv_of_gt r hj, κ.awayPderiv_algebraMap r j f]
      rw [hL, hχ,
        Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun m _ hm => by rw [hδx_ne hj.ne' m hm, zero_mul])
          (fun hj' => absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj'),
        hδx_self hj.ne', ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hj.le), one_mul]
  
  have hGy : ∀ k, k < r → χ (κ.chartDerivRing r j (chartYR κ.x r k)) =
      coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j) (χ (chartYR κ.x r k)) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [κ.chartDerivRing_chartYR r j k, hχy k hk, hδu]
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
    · exact map_one χ
    · exact absurd (congrArg τ h1) h2
    · exact absurd (τ.injective h2) h1
    · exact map_zero χ
  
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := g
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction
    (p := fun z hz => χ (κ.chartDerivRing r j ⟨z, hz⟩) =
      coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j) (χ ⟨z, hz⟩)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    have hy : (⟨Localization.mk (κ.x k) ⟨κ.x r, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩, Algebra.subset_adjoin
        ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩⟩ : chartRing κ.x r) = chartYR κ.x r k :=
      Subtype.ext (chartYOf_of_lt κ.x r (κ.x r) hk).symm
    rw [hy]
    exact hGy k hk
  · intro f
    exact hGalg f
  · intro z w hz hw ihz ihw
    change χ (κ.chartDerivRing r j (⟨z, hz⟩ + ⟨w, hw⟩)) =
      coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j) (χ (⟨z, hz⟩ + ⟨w, hw⟩))
    rw [map_add, map_add, ihz, ihw, map_add, map_add]
  · intro z w hz hw ihz ihw
    change χ (κ.chartDerivRing r j (⟨z, hz⟩ * ⟨w, hw⟩)) =
      coordDerivStalk E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j) (χ (⟨z, hz⟩ * ⟨w, hw⟩))
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, ihz, ihw,
      map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, add_comm]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_logDerivIter_le
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_logDerivIter_le (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {m j : ℕ}
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ Y, (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J a) (hj : j ≤ m) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS j J, m - j⟩).I ≤
      IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS' j (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, m⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  have hmD : ∀ a ∈ Y, ((m - j : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤
      IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf (J.iteratedDeriv j) a :=
    fun a ha => le_ordAlongIdeal_iteratedDeriv hY J ha hj (hm a ha)
  have hmL : ∀ a ∈ Y, ((m - j : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤
      IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS j J) a :=
    fun a ha => IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_of_le
      (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_le_iteratedDeriv E ψ hS j J) (hmD a ha)
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a'
  by_cases haS' : a' ∈ strictTransformSet π Y S
  · by_cases haY : π a' ∈ Y
    · 
      obtain ⟨κ, r, h₀, χ, δ, hk, hs, hh₀, hP, hSa, hS'a, hδ, hpres, -, hbt⟩ :=
        exists_kollarChartData_of_mem_strictTransform hY h hS hYS hS' haS' haY
      have hI : J.stalkIdeal (π a') ≤ chartCenter κ.x r ^ (m - j + j) := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hj, hP]
        exact (IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hm _ haY)
      have h1 := κ.transform_Dlogpow_le_chartDlogpow r hh₀ hI
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hj] at h1
      rw [hbt _ hmL, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter_eq_Dlogpow E ψ hS κ hk hs h₀ hSa j J,
        IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter hS' j, hS'a, hbt J hm]
      exact (Ideal.map_mono h1).trans
        (κ.map_chartDlogpow_le_logDerivativeIter r χ δ hδ h₀ hpres j _)
    · 
      have hb := germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt π h.contMDiff
        (h.isLocalDiffeomorphOn_compl ⟨a', haY⟩)
      refine le_of_eq ?_
      rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h hmL haY,
        IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter hS' j,
        birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h hm haY,
        ← IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter hS' j (J.pullback π h.contMDiff) a',
        stalkIdeal_logDerivIter_pullback_of_bijective π h.contMDiff hS hS' J hb
          (stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_strictTransform_of_notMem hY h hS hYS hS' haY) j]
  · 
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter, hS'.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem haS',
      Ideal.logDerivativeIter_top, ← IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv]
    exact IdealSheaf.le_def.mp
      ((birationalTransform_mono hY h (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_le_iteratedDeriv E ψ hS j J)
        hmD).trans (markedTransform_iteratedDeriv_le hY h J hm hj)) a'

name: Manifold.iteratedDeriv_birationalTransform_eq_sum
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_birationalTransform_eq_sum (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {m s : ℕ}
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ Y, (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J a) (hs : s ≤ m) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, m⟩).I.iteratedDeriv s =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS' (s - j)
        (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J.iteratedDeriv j, m - j⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  have hmD : ∀ j ≤ s, ∀ a ∈ Y, ((m - j : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤
      IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf (J.iteratedDeriv j) a :=
    fun j hj a ha => le_ordAlongIdeal_iteratedDeriv hY J ha (hj.trans hs) (hm a ha)
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
    intro a'
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_sum, Ideal.sum_eq_sup]
    by_cases haS' : a' ∈ strictTransformSet π Y S
    · by_cases haY : π a' ∈ Y
      · 
        obtain ⟨κ, r, h₀, χ, δ, hk, hs', hh₀, hP, hSa, hS'a, hδ, hpres, hspan, hbt⟩ :=
          exists_kollarChartData_of_mem_strictTransform hY h hS hYS hS' haS' haY
        have hI : J.stalkIdeal (π a') ≤ chartCenter κ.x r ^ m := by
          rw [hP]
          exact (IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hm _ haY)
        rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv, hbt J hm]
        refine (κ.derivativeIter_map_le_map_iterate_chartD_of_span r χ δ hδ hspan s _).trans ?_
        refine (Ideal.map_mono (κ.iterate_chartD_transformIdeal_le r hh₀ hI hs)).trans ?_
        rw [Ideal.map_iSup]
        refine iSup_le fun j => ?_
        rw [Ideal.map_iSup]
        refine iSup_le fun hj => ?_
        refine (κ.map_chartDlogpow_le_logDerivativeIter r χ δ hδ h₀ hpres (s - j) _).trans
          (le_of_eq_of_le ?_ (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS' (s - j)
            (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J.iteratedDeriv j, m - j⟩).I).stalkIdeal a')
            (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mpr hj)))
        rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter, hS'a, hbt (J.iteratedDeriv j) (hmD j hj),
          J.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_eq_Dpow κ hk hs' j]
      · 
        have hb := germMap_bijective_of_isLocalDiffeomorphAt π h.contMDiff
          (h.isLocalDiffeomorphOn_compl ⟨a', haY⟩)
        refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS'
          (s - j) (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h
            ⟨J.iteratedDeriv j, m - j⟩).I).stalkIdeal a') (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mpr le_rfl))
        rw [Nat.sub_self, IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_zero, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv,
          birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h hm haY,
          birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h (hmD s le_rfl) haY,
          ← IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv,
          stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv_pullback_of_bijective π h.contMDiff J hb s]
    · 
      refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => (IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS'
        (s - j) (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h
          ⟨J.iteratedDeriv j, m - j⟩).I).stalkIdeal a')
        (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mpr (Nat.zero_le s)))
      rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_logDerivIter, hS'.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_of_notMem haS',
        Ideal.logDerivativeIter_top]
      simp only [Nat.sub_zero, IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_zero, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_iteratedDeriv]
  · 
    rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
    intro a'
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_sum, Ideal.sum_eq_sup]
    refine Finset.sup_le fun j hj => ?_
    have hj' : j ≤ s := Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mp hj
    refine IdealSheaf.le_def.mp ?_ a'
    calc IdealSheaf.logDerivIter E ψ hS' (s - j)
          (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J.iteratedDeriv j, m - j⟩).I
        ≤ (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J.iteratedDeriv j, m - j⟩).I.iteratedDeriv
            (s - j) :=
          IdealSheaf.logDerivIter_le_iteratedDeriv E ψ hS' _ _
      _ ≤ ((MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, m⟩).I.iteratedDeriv j).iteratedDeriv
            (s - j) :=
          IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_mono
            (markedTransform_iteratedDeriv_le hY h J hm (hj'.trans hs)) _
      _ = (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, m⟩).I.iteratedDeriv s := by
          rw [← IdealSheaf.iteratedDeriv_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hj']

name: Ideal.eq_bot_of_colon_pow_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.eq_bot_of_colon_pow_eq {u : R} (hu : u ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hu0 : u ≠ 0)
    {J : Ideal R} {m k : ℕ} (hmk : m < k) (hle : J ≤ Ideal.span {u} ^ k)
    (hcol : J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u} ^ m) = J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u} ^ k)) : J = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hkm : u ^ k = u ^ m * u ^ (k - m) := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hmk.le]
  have hpow : u ^ (k - m) ∈ maximalIdeal R := Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ hu _ (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hmk)
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Submodule.colon_span,
    Submodule.colon_span] at hcol
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at hle
  have hC : J.colon {u ^ k} = ⊥ := by
    refine Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (maximalIdeal R) _
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) ?_ (IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top).ge
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ J.colon {u ^ m} := by rw [hcol]; exact hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul] at hx hx'
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hle hx')
    have hx2 : x = u ^ (k - m) * y := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero m hu0)
      rw [mul_comm (u ^ m) x, ← hy, hkm]
      ring
    have hyJ : y ∈ J.colon {u ^ k} := by
      rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, hy]
      exact hx'
    rw [hx2]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul hpow hyJ
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hle hz)
  have hwC : w ∈ J.colon {u ^ k} := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, hw]
    exact hz
  rw [hC, Ideal.mem_bot] at hwC
  rw [Ideal.mem_bot, ← hw, hwC, zero_mul]

name: Manifold.IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlong_ne_top
statement:
theorem IsClosedSubmanifold.ordAlong_ne_top (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {a : M} (ha : a ∈ Y) (hne : I.stalkIdeal a ≠ ⊥) :
    IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro htop
  have : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E := LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv
  have hD : hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a ≠ ⊤ := by
    have : a ∈ hY.idealSheaf.support := by rw [hY.cosupport_idealSheaf]; exact ha
    exact this
  have hle : ∀ p : ℕ, I.stalkIdeal a ≤ hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a ^ p := fun p =>
    (IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff hY.idealSheaf I a p).mp (by rw [htop]; exact le_top)
  have hK := Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (I := hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a) hD
  exact hne (le_bot_iff.mp (by rw [← hK]; exact le_iInf hle))

name: Manifold.IsBlowUp.germMap_injective
statement:
theorem IsBlowUp.germMap_injective (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c)
    (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) (a' : M') : Function.Injective (germMap π h.contMDiff a')
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun s hs => ?_
  obtain ⟨V, haV, f, rfl⟩ := (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  have hπc : Continuous π := h.contMDiff.continuous
  have h1 : ∀ᶠ b in 𝓝 a', extendSection 𝕜 E f (π b) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (stalkToGerm 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M' a') hs
    rw [stalkToGerm_germMap, stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ, map_zero, Germ.coe_compTendsto,
      ← Germ.coe_zero, Germ.coe_eq] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨N, hNsub, hNo, haN⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp h1
  set a : M := π a' with hadef
  set χ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E := chartAt E a with hχdef
  have hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M :=
    IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)) (n := ω) a
  have haχ : a ∈ χ.source := mem_chart_source E a
  set T : Set (Fin n → 𝕜) := ψ '' (χ.target ∩ χ.symm ⁻¹' (V : Set M)) with hTdef
  have hTo : IsOpen T := ψ.isOpenMap _ (χ.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm V.2)
  have haT : ψ (χ a) ∈ T :=
    ⟨χ a, ⟨χ.map_source haχ, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, χ.left_inv haχ]; exact haV⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hTo _ haT
  set F : (Fin n → 𝕜) → 𝕜 := fun w => extendSection 𝕜 E f (χ.symm (ψ.symm w)) with hFdef
  have hFan : AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 F (Metric.ball (ψ (χ a)) r) := by
    have h2 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, Fin n → 𝕜) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (fun w => χ.symm (ψ.symm w)) T := by
      refine (contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hχ).comp
        ((ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E).contMDiff.contMDiffOn) ?_
      rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      change ψ.symm (ψ v) ∈ χ.target
      rw [ψ.symm_apply_apply]
      exact hv.1
    have h3 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, Fin n → 𝕜) 𝓘(𝕜) ω F T := by
      refine (contMDiffOn_extendSection f).comp h2 ?_
      rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      change χ.symm (ψ.symm (ψ v)) ∈ (V : Set M)
      rw [ψ.symm_apply_apply]
      exact hv.2
    exact fun w hw => ((contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (h3.mono hball)).contDiffAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw)).analyticAt
  have hopen : IsOpen (N ∩ π ⁻¹' (χ.source ∩ χ ⁻¹' (ψ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (ψ (χ a)) r))) :=
    hNo.inter ((χ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage χ.open_source
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage ψ.continuous)).preimage hπc)
  have hmem : a' ∈ N ∩ π ⁻¹' (χ.source ∩ χ ⁻¹' (ψ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (ψ (χ a)) r)) :=
    ⟨haN, haχ, Metric.mem_ball_self hr0⟩
  obtain ⟨b, ⟨hbN, hbχ, hbball⟩, hbY⟩ :=
    (h.dense_preimage_compl hY).inter_open_nonempty _ hopen ⟨a', hmem⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hbΨ, hEq⟩ := (h.isLocalDiffeomorphOn_compl ⟨b, hbY⟩).exists_partialDiffeomorph
  set W : Set M := Ψ.toPartialEquiv '' (Ψ.source ∩ N) with hWdef
  have hWo : IsOpen W := by
    rw [hWdef, Ψ.toPartialEquiv.image_source_inter_eq']
    exact Ψ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hNo
  have hbW : π b ∈ W := ⟨b, ⟨hbΨ, hbN⟩, (hEq hbΨ).symm⟩
  have hfW : ∀ y ∈ W, extendSection 𝕜 E f y = 0 := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hxΨ, hxN⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [← hEq hxΨ]
    exact hNsub hxN
  have hev : F =ᶠ[𝓝 (ψ (χ (π b)))] 0 := by
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun w => χ.symm (ψ.symm w)) (ψ (χ (π b))) := by
      have h4 : ContinuousAt χ.symm (ψ.symm (ψ (χ (π b)))) := by
        rw [ψ.symm_apply_apply]
        exact χ.continuousAt_symm (χ.map_source hbχ)
      exact h4.comp ψ.symm.continuous.continuousAt
    have hW' : (fun w => χ.symm (ψ.symm w)) ⁻¹' W ∈ 𝓝 (ψ (χ (π b))) := by
      refine hcont.preimage_mem_nhds ?_
      rw [ψ.symm_apply_apply, χ.left_inv hbχ]
      exact hWo.mem_nhds hbW
    filter_upwards [hW'] with w hw
    exact hfW _ hw
  have hEqOn := hFan.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
    (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected hbball hev
  apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M a
  rw [stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ, map_zero, ← Germ.coe_zero, Germ.coe_eq]
  filter_upwards [((ψ.continuous.comp_continuousOn χ.continuousOn).continuousWithinAt haχ
      |>.continuousAt (χ.open_source.mem_nhds haχ)).preimage_mem_nhds
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr0)), χ.open_source.mem_nhds haχ]
    with x hx hxs
  have := hEqOn hx
  change extendSection 𝕜 E f (χ.symm (ψ.symm (ψ (χ x)))) = 0 at this
  rwa [ψ.symm_apply_apply, χ.left_inv hxs] at this

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_eq_weakTransformOf_of_ordAlong_eq
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_eq_weakTransformOf_of_ordAlong_eq [T2Space M]
    [SecondCountableTopology M] (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) (I :
        IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {m : ℕ}
    (hord : ∀ a ∈ Y, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a = m) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨I, m⟩).I = IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h I
proof:
:= by
  have hm' : ∀ y ∈ Y, (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I y := fun y hy =>
    (hord y hy).ge
  have hexp : ∀ a' : M', π a' ∈ Y →
      (IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong hY.idealSheaf I (π a')).toNat = m := fun a' ha' => by
    rw [genericOrdAlong_eq_ordAlong hY I ha', hord _ ha', ENat.toNat_natCast]
  refine IsDivExceptional.unique (isDivExceptional_birationalTransform hY h ⟨I, m⟩ hm') ?_
  intro a'
  have h2 := isDivExceptional_weakTransformOf hY h I a'
  dsimp only at h2 ⊢
  rw [h2]
  by_cases ha' : π a' ∈ Y
  · rw [hexp a' ha']
  · rw [stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem hY h ha', Ideal.top_pow, Ideal.top_pow]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_eq_weakTransformOf_iff
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_eq_weakTransformOf_iff [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M]
    (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (hconn : IsPreconnected Y) (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) (I :
        IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (hne : ∀ a ∈ Y, I.stalkIdeal a ≠ ⊥) {a : M} (ha : a ∈ Y) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨I, m⟩).I = IdealSheaf.weakTransformOf hY h I ↔
      (m : ℕ∞) = IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : ∀ y ∈ Y,
      IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I y = IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a :=
    fun y hy => ordAlong_eq_of_isPreconnected hY I (subset_refl Y) hconn hy ha
  have hm' : ∀ y ∈ Y, (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I y := fun y hy => by
    rw [hconst y hy]; exact hm
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a = k :=
    ⟨_, (ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr (hY.ordAlong_ne_top I ha (hne a ha))).symm⟩
  have hbt := isDivExceptional_birationalTransform hY h ⟨I, m⟩ hm'
  have hwk := isDivExceptional_weakTransformOf hY h I
  have hexp : ∀ a' : M', π a' ∈ Y →
      (IdealSheaf.genericOrdAlong hY.idealSheaf I (π a')).toNat = k := fun a' ha' => by
    rw [genericOrdAlong_eq_ordAlong hY I ha', hconst _ ha', hk, ENat.toNat_natCast]
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_contra hne'
    have hlt : m < k := by
      rw [hk] at hm hne'
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (by exact_mod_cast hm) (by exact_mod_cast hne')
    obtain ⟨φ, σ, haφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart a ha
    have hc : Nonempty (Fin c) := by
      by_contra hemp
      have : IsEmpty (Fin c) := not_nonempty_iff.mp hemp
      have hD : hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a = ⊥ := by
        rw [hY.stalkIdeal_idealSheaf_eq_span ha hφ haφ, Set.range_eq_empty, Ideal.span_empty]
      have h1 : I.stalkIdeal a ≤ hY.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal a ^ k :=
        (IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff hY.idealSheaf I a k).mp hk.ge
      rw [hD, ← Ideal.zero_eq_bot, zero_pow (by omega)] at h1
      exact hne a ha (le_bot_iff.mp h1)
    obtain ⟨i₀⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨a', ha'eq⟩ := IsBlowUp.surjective hY h i₀ a
    have ha' : π a' ∈ Y := by rw [ha'eq]; exact ha
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hp⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ a' (by rw [ha'eq]; exact haφ)
    have : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E := LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv
    have hdom := isDomain_stalk ψ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp
    have hu : coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp (σ i) ∈
        maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk a') := by
      rw [mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval, eval_coord]
      exact (IsBlowUpChart.mem_preimage_iff hφ hΦ hp).mp ha'
    have hle := IsBlowUp.totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le hY h I (m := k) (a' := a')
      (le_of_eq (by rw [ha'eq, hk]))
    rw [stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ hp] at hle
    have h1 := hbt a'
    have h2 := hwk a'
    dsimp only at h1 h2
    rw [heq, h2, hexp a' ha', stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ hp] at h1
    have hbot := Ideal.eq_bot_of_colon_pow_eq hu (coord_ne_zero hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp (σ i)) hlt
      hle h1.symm
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
      Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective (h.germMap_injective hY a')] at hbot
    exact hne _ ha' hbot
  · intro hmk
    exact birationalTransform_eq_weakTransformOf_of_ordAlong_eq hY h I fun y hy =>
      (hconst y hy).trans hmk.symm

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff (D J : IdealSheaf 𝒪) (a : X) (p : ℕ) :
    (p : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a ↔ J.stalkIdeal a ≤ D.stalkIdeal a ^ p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    by_contra hcon
    have hlt : ∀ q : ℕ, J.stalkIdeal a ≤ D.stalkIdeal a ^ q → q < p := fun q hq => by
      by_contra hqp
      exact hcon (hq.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (not_lt.mp hqp)))
    have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := hlt 0 (by rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; exact le_top)
    have h1 : IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      refine iSup₂_le fun q hq => ?_
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (hlt q hq)
    have h2 : p ≤ p - 1 := by exact_mod_cast hp.trans h1
    omega
  · intro h
    exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun (q : ℕ) (_ : J.stalkIdeal a ≤ D.stalkIdeal a ^ q) => (q : ℕ∞)) p h

name: Manifold.coord_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coord_ne_zero {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} (hΦ : Φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M) {b : M}
    (hb : b ∈ Φ.source) (i : Fin n) : coord E ψ Φ hΦ hb i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h1 := coordDerivStalk_coord E ψ Φ hΦ hb i i
  rw [h0, map_zero, ite_eq_left rfl, map_one] at h1
  exact zero_ne_one h1

name: Manifold.isDomain_stalk
proof:
:=
  MulEquiv.isDomain (Analytic.Conv 𝕜 n) (taylorEquivConv E ψ Φ hb hΦ).toMulEquiv

name: Manifold.isIdealSheafOf_exceptionalIdealSheaf
statement:
theorem isIdealSheafOf_exceptionalIdealSheaf (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c)
    (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) :
    IsIdealSheafOf ψ (π ⁻¹' Y) 1 (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff)
proof:
:=
  h.isIdealSheafOf_pullback hY hY.isIdealSheafOf_idealSheaf

name: Manifold.stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord
proof:
:=
  h.stalkIdeal_pullback_eq_span_coord hY.isIdealSheafOf_idealSheaf hφ hΦ hp

name: Manifold.stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c)
    (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) {p : M'} (hp : π p ∉ Y) :
    (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal p = ⊤
proof:
:=
  (isIdealSheafOf_exceptionalIdealSheaf hY h).stalkIdeal_of_notMem hp

name: Manifold.IsBlowUp.totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le
statement:
theorem IsBlowUp.totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c)
    (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {m : ℕ} {a' : M'}
    (hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I (π a')) :
    (I.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal a' ≤
      (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal a' ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
    IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, ← Ideal.map_pow]
  exact Ideal.map_mono ((IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff _ _ _ _).mp hm)

name: Manifold.totalTransform_le_pow_exceptional
statement:
theorem totalTransform_le_pow_exceptional (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ Y, (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a) :
    I.pullback π h.contMDiff ≤ hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro a'
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
  by_cases ha : π a' ∈ Y
  · exact h.totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le hY I (hm _ ha)
  · rw [stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem hY h ha, Ideal.top_pow]
    exact le_top

name: Manifold.IsBlowUpChart.isUnit_coord_of_notMem
statement:
theorem IsBlowUpChart.isUnit_coord_of_notMem {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E}
    {σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n} {i : Fin c} {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M' E} (hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ σ)
    (hΦ : IsBlowUpChart ψ π φ σ i Φ) {p : M'} (hp : p ∈ Φ.source) (hpY : π p ∉ Y) :
    IsUnit (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp (σ i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval, eval_coord]
  exact fun h0 => hpY ((IsBlowUpChart.mem_preimage_iff hφ hΦ hp).mpr h0)

name: Manifold.hasLocalGenerators_colon
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_colon (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (m : M' → ℕ)
    (hm : ∀ a', π a' ∈ Y → ((m a' : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I (π a'))
    (hloc : ∀ a', π a' ∈ Y → ∀ᶠ b in 𝓝 a', π b ∈ Y → m b = m a') :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M') fun a' =>
      ((I.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal a').colon
        ↑((hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal a' ^ m a')
proof:
:= by
  intro a'
  obtain ⟨V, hV, k, f, -, hf⟩ := I.exists_generators (π a')
  have hπc : Continuous π := h.contMDiff.continuous
  by_cases ha : π a' ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, haφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart (π a') ha
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, ha'Φ⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ a' haφ
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTo, ha'T⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp (hloc a' ha)
    set W : Opens M' := ⟨Φ.source ∩ π ⁻¹' (V : Set M) ∩ T,
      (Φ.open_source.inter (V.2.preimage hπc)).inter hTo⟩ with hWdef
    have ha'W : a' ∈ W := ⟨⟨ha'Φ, hV⟩, ha'T⟩
    have hWsub : (W : Set M') ⊆ Φ.source := fun x hx => hx.1.1
    have hWV : ∀ x ∈ W, x ∈ preimageOpens π h.contMDiff V := fun x hx => hx.1.2
    set N : Set (Fin n → 𝕜) := ψ '' (Φ '' W) with hNdef
    have hNo : IsOpen N := ψ.isOpenMap _ (Φ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source W.2 hWsub)
    have hmemN : ∀ x ∈ W, ψ (Φ x) ∈ N := fun x hx => ⟨Φ x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    
    have h2 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, Fin n → 𝕜) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω (fun w => Φ.symm (ψ.symm w)) N := by
      refine (contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas).comp
        ((ψ.symm : (Fin n → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] E).contMDiff.contMDiffOn) ?_
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      change ψ.symm (ψ (Φ x)) ∈ Φ.target
      rw [ψ.symm_apply_apply]
      exact Φ.map_source (hWsub hx)
    have hinv : ∀ x ∈ W, Φ.symm (ψ.symm (ψ (Φ x))) = x := fun x hx => by
      rw [ψ.symm_apply_apply, Φ.left_inv (hWsub hx)]
    
    set F : Fin k → (Fin n → 𝕜) → 𝕜 := fun j w =>
      extendSection 𝕜 E (comapSection π h.contMDiff (f j)) (Φ.symm (ψ.symm w)) with hFdef
    have hFan : ∀ j, AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 (F j) N := by
      intro j
      have h3 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, Fin n → 𝕜) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (F j) N := by
        refine (contMDiffOn_extendSection (comapSection π h.contMDiff (f j))).comp h2 ?_
        rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        change Φ.symm (ψ.symm (ψ (Φ x))) ∈ (preimageOpens π h.contMDiff V : Set M')
        rw [hinv x hx]
        exact hWV x hx
      exact fun w hw =>
        ((contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h3).contDiffAt (hNo.mem_nhds hw)).analyticAt
    
    have hdiv : ∀ j, ∀ v ∈ N, v (σ i) = 0 → ∃ N' : Set (Fin n → 𝕜), IsOpen N' ∧ v ∈ N' ∧
        ∃ G : (Fin n → 𝕜) → 𝕜, AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 G N' ∧
          ∀ w ∈ N', F j w = w (σ i) ^ m a' * G w := by
      intro j v hv hvk
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨b, hbW, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hv
      have hbF : π b ∈ Y := (IsBlowUpChart.mem_preimage_iff hφ hΦ (hWsub hbW)).mpr hvk
      have hmb : m b = m a' := hT hbW.2 hbF
      have hmem : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.germ (preimageOpens π h.contMDiff V) b
          (hWV b hbW) (comapSection π h.contMDiff (f j)) ∈
            Ideal.span {coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas (hWsub hbW) (σ i) ^ m a'} := by
        rw [← germMap_germ π h.contMDiff (hWV b hbW) (f j), ← Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
          ← stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ (hWsub hbW), ← hmb]
        refine h.totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le hY I (hm b hbF) ?_
        rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback]
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
          (by rw [hf (π b) (hWV b hbW)]; exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
      exact exists_eq_pow_mul_of_mem_span_pow_coord hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas (hWsub hbW) (σ i) (m a')
        (hWV b hbW) (comapSection π h.contMDiff (f j)) hmem
    
    have hQ := fun j => coordQuot_iterate_spec hNo (σ i) (m a') (F j) (hFan j) (hdiv j)
    set Q : Fin k → (Fin n → 𝕜) → 𝕜 := fun j => (coordQuot (σ i))^[m a'] (F j) with hQdef
    have hQW : ∀ j, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (fun b => Q j (ψ (Φ b))) W := by
      intro j
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, Fin n → 𝕜) 𝓘(𝕜) ω (Q j) N :=
        contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mpr ((hQ j).1.contDiffOn hNo.uniqueDiffOn)
      have h3 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, Fin n → 𝕜) ω (fun b => ψ (Φ b)) W :=
        (ψ : E →L[𝕜] (Fin n → 𝕜)).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
          ((contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas).mono hWsub)
      exact h1.comp h3 fun b hb => hmemN b hb
    refine ⟨W, ha'W, Fin k, inferInstance,
      fun j => sectionOfContMDiffOn (fun b => Q j (ψ (Φ b))) W (hQW j), fun b hb => ?_⟩
    change Submodule.colon ((I.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal b)
      ↑((hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal b ^ m b) = _
    have hbΦ : b ∈ Φ.source := hWsub hb
    
    have hkey : ∀ j, coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hbΦ (σ i) ^ m a' *
        (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.germ W b hb
          (sectionOfContMDiffOn (fun b => Q j (ψ (Φ b))) W (hQW j)) =
        germMap π h.contMDiff b
          ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ V (π b) (hWV b hb) (f j)) := by
      intro j
      rw [germMap_germ π h.contMDiff (hWV b hb) (f j)]
      apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M' b
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, stalkToGerm_coord, stalkToGerm_germ_sectionOfContMDiffOn,
        stalkToGerm_structureSheaf_germ, ← Germ.coe_pow, ← Germ.coe_mul, Germ.coe_eq]
      filter_upwards [W.2.mem_nhds hb] with x hx
      rw [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ (hWsub hx)]
      change (ψ (Φ x) (σ i)) ^ m a' * (coordQuot (σ i))^[m a'] (F j) (ψ (Φ x)) = _
      rw [(hQ j).2 (ψ (Φ x)) (hmemN x hx)]
      change extendSection 𝕜 E (comapSection π h.contMDiff (f j)) (Φ.symm (ψ.symm (ψ (Φ x)))) = _
      rw [hinv x hx]
    have hItot : (I.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal b = Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hbΦ (σ i) ^ m a' *
          (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.germ W b hb
            (sectionOfContMDiffOn (fun b => Q j (ψ (Φ b))) W (hQW j))) := by
      rw [totalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_span h I hf (hWV b hb)]
      exact congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext fun j => (hkey j).symm))
    by_cases hbF : π b ∈ Y
    · have hmb : m b = m a' := hT hb.2 hbF
      rw [hItot, stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ hbΦ,
        Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Submodule.colon_span, hmb]
      have := isDomain_stalk ψ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hbΦ
      exact Ideal.colon_span_range_pow_mul (coord_ne_zero hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hbΦ (σ i)) (m a') _
    · rw [hItot, stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem hY h hbF, Ideal.top_pow,
        Submodule.top_coe, Submodule.colon_univ]
      exact Ideal.span_range_unit_mul ((IsBlowUpChart.isUnit_coord_of_notMem hφ hΦ hbΦ hbF).pow _) _
  · 
    set W : Opens M' := ⟨π ⁻¹' (V : Set M) ∩ π ⁻¹' Yᶜ,
      (V.2.preimage hπc).inter (hY.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage hπc)⟩ with hWdef
    have hWV : W ≤ preimageOpens π h.contMDiff V := fun x hx => hx.1
    refine ⟨W, ⟨hV, ha⟩, Fin k, inferInstance, fun j =>
      (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (comapSection π h.contMDiff (f j)),
      fun b hb => ?_⟩
    change Submodule.colon ((I.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal b)
      ↑((hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).stalkIdeal b ^ m b) = _
    rw [stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem hY h hb.2, Ideal.top_pow, Submodule.top_coe,
      Submodule.colon_univ, totalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_span h I hf hb.1,
      IdealSheaf.range_germ_map]
    exact congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext fun j =>
      germMap_germ π h.contMDiff hb.1 (f j)))

name: Manifold.exists_isDivExceptional
statement:
theorem exists_isDivExceptional (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ Y, (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a) :
    ∃ J' : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M'), IdealSheaf.IsDivExceptional
      (I.pullback π h.contMDiff) (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff) (fun _ => m) J'
proof:
:=
  ⟨IdealSheaf.ofStalks _ _ (hasLocalGenerators_colon hY h I (fun _ => m) (fun _ ha' => hm _ ha')
      fun _ _ => Eventually.of_forall fun _ _ => rfl),
    fun a' => IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks _ _ a'⟩

name: Manifold.IsDivExceptional.unique
proof:
:=
  IdealSheaf.ext fun a => (h₁ a).trans (h₂ a).symm

name: Manifold.isDivExceptional_birationalTransform
statement:
theorem isDivExceptional_birationalTransform (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c)
    (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) (J : MarkedIdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M))
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ Y, (J.m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J.I a) :
    IdealSheaf.IsDivExceptional (J.I.pullback π h.contMDiff)
      (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff) (fun _ => J.m)
      (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h J).I
proof:
:= by
  have hex := exists_isDivExceptional hY h J.I hm
  unfold MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform
  dsimp only
  rw [dite_eq_left hex]
  exact Classical.choose_spec hex

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_m
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_m (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π)
    (J : MarkedIdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h J).m = J.m
proof: := rfl

name: Manifold.IsDivExceptional.stalkIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem IsDivExceptional.stalkIdeal_eq_span (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c)
    (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ Y, (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf I a)
    {J' : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M')}
    (hJ' : IdealSheaf.IsDivExceptional (I.pullback π h.contMDiff)
      (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff) (fun _ => m) J')
    {U : Opens M} {k : ℕ} {f : Fin k → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.obj (op U)}
    (hgen : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ U), I.stalkIdeal b =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U b hb (f j)))
    {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} {σ : Fin c ↪ Fin n} {i : Fin c}
    {Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M' E} (hφ : IsAdaptedChart ψ Y φ σ) (hΦ : IsBlowUpChart ψ π φ σ i Φ)
    {a' : M'} (ha' : a' ∈ Φ.source) (hU : π a' ∈ U) :
    ∃ g : Fin k → (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk a',
      (∀ j, coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i) ^ m * g j =
        germMap π h.contMDiff a' ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U (π a') hU (f j))) ∧
      J'.stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span (Set.range g)
proof:
:= by
  have hItot := totalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_span h I hgen hU
  by_cases haF : π a' ∈ Y
  · 
    have hmem : ∀ j, ∃ g, coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i) ^ m * g =
        germMap π h.contMDiff a' ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U (π a') hU (f j)) := by
      intro j
      have h1 : germMap π h.contMDiff a'
          ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U (π a') hU (f j)) ∈
            Ideal.span {coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i) ^ m} := by
        rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
          ← stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ ha']
        refine h.totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le hY I (hm _ haF) ?_
        rw [hItot]
        exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h1
      exact ⟨g, by rw [mul_comm]; exact hg⟩
    choose g hg using hmem
    refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
    rw [hJ' a', hItot, stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ ha',
      Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Submodule.colon_span]
    have := isDomain_stalk ψ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha'
    rw [← Ideal.colon_span_range_pow_mul (coord_ne_zero hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i)) m g]
    exact congrArg (fun S : Ideal _ => Submodule.colon S _)
      (congrArg Ideal.span (congrArg Set.range (funext fun j => (hg j).symm)))
  · have hu := IsBlowUpChart.isUnit_coord_of_notMem hφ hΦ ha' haF
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
    refine ⟨fun j => (↑u⁻¹ : (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M').presheaf.stalk a') ^ m *
      germMap π h.contMDiff a' ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.germ U (π a') hU (f j)),
      fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hu, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, Units.mul_inv, one_pow, one_mul]
    · rw [hJ' a', stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_of_notMem hY h haF, Ideal.top_pow,
        Submodule.top_coe, Submodule.colon_univ, hItot]
      exact (Ideal.span_range_unit_mul ((Units.isUnit u⁻¹).pow m) _).symm

name: Manifold.IsBlowUp.cosupport_exceptionalIdealSheaf
statement:
theorem IsBlowUp.cosupport_exceptionalIdealSheaf :
    (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).support = π ⁻¹' Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.support_pullback, hY.cosupport_idealSheaf]

name: Manifold.stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_notMem_cosupport_of_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_notMem_cosupport_of_hasLocalGenerators
    (hex : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M') (saturationStalk hY h I))
    {a' : M'} (ha' : a' ∉ (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).support) :
    (strictTransformSubspace hY h I).stalkIdeal a' =
      Ideal.map (germMap π h.contMDiff a') (I.stalkIdeal (π a'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators hY h I hex,
    saturationStalk_of_notMem_cosupport hY h I ha', IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback π h.contMDiff]

name: Manifold.cosupport_strictTransformSubspace_diff_of_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem cosupport_strictTransformSubspace_diff_of_hasLocalGenerators
    (hex : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M') (saturationStalk hY h I)) :
    (strictTransformSubspace hY h I).support \ (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).support =
      π ⁻¹' I.support \ (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).support
proof:
:= by
  ext a'
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
    rw [← IdealSheaf.support_pullback π h.contMDiff I]
    rw [IdealSheaf.mem_support,
      stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators hY h I hex,
      saturationStalk_of_notMem_cosupport hY h I h2] at h1
    exact h1
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
    rw [← IdealSheaf.support_pullback π h.contMDiff I] at h1
    rw [IdealSheaf.mem_support,
      stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators hY h I hex,
      saturationStalk_of_notMem_cosupport hY h I h2]
    exact h1

name: Manifold.closure_subset_cosupport_strictTransformSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem closure_subset_cosupport_strictTransformSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators
    (hex : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf 𝕜 E M') (saturationStalk hY h I)) :
    closure (π ⁻¹' (I.support \ Y)) ⊆ (strictTransformSubspace hY h I).support
proof:
:= by
  refine (IdealSheaf.isClosed_support (strictTransformSubspace hY h I)).closure_subset_iff.mpr
    fun a' ha' => ?_
  have hF : a' ∉ (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).support := by
    rw [IsBlowUp.cosupport_exceptionalIdealSheaf hY h]
    exact ha'.2
  have hmem : a' ∈ (strictTransformSubspace hY h I).support \
      (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).support := by
    rw [cosupport_strictTransformSubspace_diff_of_hasLocalGenerators hY h I hex]
    exact ⟨ha'.1, hF⟩
  exact hmem.1

name: Manifold.saturationStalk_restrict
statement:
theorem saturationStalk_restrict (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (q : U') :
    saturationStalk (hY.preimage_val U) (IsBlowUp.restrictOpens' hU' hπ' hY h)
        (I.pullback (Subtype.val : U → M) (contMDiff_subtype_val (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)))) q =
      Ideal.map (germMap (Subtype.val : U' → M') (contMDiff_subtype_val (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E))) q)
        (saturationStalk hY h I q.1)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (I.pullback (Subtype.val : U → M) (contMDiff_subtype_val (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)))).pullback _
      (IsBlowUp.restrictOpens' hU' hπ' hY h).contMDiff =
      (I.pullback π h.contMDiff).pullback (Subtype.val : U' → M')
        (contMDiff_subtype_val (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E))) := by
    rw [IdealSheaf.pullback_pullback, IdealSheaf.pullback_pullback]
    exact IdealSheaf.pullback_congr I _ _ (funext hπ')
  have e2 : (hY.preimage_val U).idealSheaf.pullback _ (IsBlowUp.restrictOpens' hU' hπ' hY
      h).contMDiff =
      (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).pullback (Subtype.val : U' → M')
        (contMDiff_subtype_val (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E))) := by
    rw [hY.idealSheaf_preimage_val U (hY.preimage_val U), IdealSheaf.pullback_pullback,
      IdealSheaf.pullback_pullback]
    exact IdealSheaf.pullback_congr _ _ _ (funext hπ')
  unfold saturationStalk
  rw [e1, e2, Ideal.map_iSup]
  refine iSup_congr fun k => ?_
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback (φ := (Subtype.val : U' → M')),
    IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback (φ := (Subtype.val : U' → M')),
    Ideal.map_colon_pow_of_bijective _ (germMap_val_bijective (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) U' q)]

name: Manifold.strictTransformSet_inter_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem strictTransformSet_inter_of_isOpen {π : M' → M} (hπ : Continuous π) (Z : Set M)
    {H O : Set M} (hO : IsOpen O) (hHO : IsClosed (H ∩ O)) :
    strictTransformSet π Z (H ∩ O) = strictTransformSet π Z H ∩ π ⁻¹' O
proof:
:= by
  unfold strictTransformSet
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · refine Set.subset_inter (closure_mono ?_) ?_
    · exact Set.preimage_mono (Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left Set.inter_subset_left)
    · refine (closure_minimal ?_ (hHO.preimage hπ)).trans (Set.preimage_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
      exact Set.preimage_mono Set.sdiff_subset
  · intro p hp
    have h1 : p ∈ π ⁻¹' O ∩ closure (π ⁻¹' (H \ Z)) := ⟨hp.2, hp.1⟩
    have h2 := (hO.preimage hπ).inter_closure h1
    refine closure_mono ?_ h2
    rintro q ⟨hqO, hqH, hqZ⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hqH, hqO⟩, hqZ⟩

name: Manifold.saturationStalk_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem saturationStalk_hasLocalGenerators (hY : IsClosedSubmanifold ψ Y c) (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π)
    (I : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf K E M)) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf K E M') (saturationStalk hY h I)
proof:
:=
  AnalyticSpace.saturation_hasLocalGenerators
    (AnalyticSpace.toSpace ψ (⟨M'⟩ : AnalyticManifold.{u} K E))
    (I.pullback π h.contMDiff) (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff)

name: Manifold.iSup_colon_pow_le_radical_of_le_radical
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_le_radical_of_le_radical (K K' : Ideal R) (y : R)
    (hK' : K' ≤ K.radical) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, Submodule.colon K' (SetLike.coe (Ideal.span {y} ^ k))) ≤
      (⨆ k : ℕ, Submodule.colon K (SetLike.coe (Ideal.span {y} ^ k))).radical
proof:
:= by
  refine iSup_le fun k g hg => ?_
  have h1 : g * y ^ k ∈ K' := by
    have := Submodule.mem_colon.mp hg (y ^ k)
      (by rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rwa [smul_eq_mul] at this
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp (hK' h1)
  refine Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mpr ⟨m, Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (k * m) ?_⟩
  refine Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun p hp => ?_
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hp
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hp
  rw [smul_eq_mul, pow_mul, show g ^ m * (d * (y ^ k) ^ m) = d * (g * y ^ k) ^ m by ring]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hm

name: Manifold.iSup_colon_pow_mono
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_mono {K K' : Ideal R} (h : K ≤ K') (F : Ideal R) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, Submodule.colon K (SetLike.coe (F ^ k))) ≤
      ⨆ k : ℕ, Submodule.colon K' (SetLike.coe (F ^ k))
proof:
:=
  iSup_mono fun _ => Submodule.colon_mono h le_rfl

name: Manifold.IsBlowUp.exists_span_singleton_stalkIdeal_exceptional
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha' : π a' ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, ha, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart (π a') ha'
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hpΦ⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ a' ha
    exact ⟨_, h.stalkIdeal_pullback_eq_span_coord hY.isIdealSheafOf_idealSheaf hφ hΦ hpΦ⟩
  · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_one]
    have hF : a' ∉ (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff).support := by
      rw [IsBlowUp.cosupport_exceptionalIdealSheaf hY h]
      exact ha'
    exact not_not.mp (mt (IdealSheaf.mem_support _).mpr hF)

name: Manifold.hasLocalGenerators_colon_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_colon_stalkIdeal (K F' : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf ℂ E M')) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf ℂ E M')
      fun x => Submodule.colon (K.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (F'.stalkIdeal x))
proof:
:=
  AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGenerators_colon_idealSheaf
    (AnalyticSpace.toSpace ψ
        ({ carrier := M' } : AnalyticManifold.{u} ℂ E)) K F'

name: Manifold.exists_opens_pow_mem_carrier
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, ha'V, k, hk, hkg⟩ := (IdealSheaf.mem_stalkIdeal_iff K').mp hs
  rw [← map_pow] at hkg
  obtain ⟨W, ha'W, iV, iU, hW⟩ :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf a' ha'V ha'U k (s ^ m) hkg
  refine ⟨W, ha'W, iU, ?_⟩
  rw [← map_pow, ← hW]
  exact K'.res_mem iV k hk

name: Manifold.hasLocalGenerators_span_germ
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_span_germ {N : Type u} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E N]
    (V : Opens N) (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V) (t : (structureSheaf ℂ E N).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf ℂ E N)
      fun x => Ideal.span {(structureSheaf ℂ E N).presheaf.germ V x (hV x) t}
proof:
:=
  fun a => ⟨V, hV a, Unit, inferInstance, fun _ => t, fun b _ => by rw [Set.range_const]⟩

name: Manifold.mem_iSup_colon_pow_of_pow_mem
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional ℂ E := ψ.symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  
  have hmono : Monotone fun k : ℕ =>
      Submodule.colon (K.stalkIdeal a') (SetLike.coe (F.stalkIdeal a' ^ k)) := fun j j' hjj' =>
    Submodule.colon_mono le_rfl (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hjj')
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ hmono.directed_le).mp hg
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf ℂ E M'),
      C = IdealSheaf.ofStalks _ _ (hasLocalGenerators_colon_stalkIdeal ψ K (F ^ j)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCst : ∀ x, C.stalkIdeal x =
      Submodule.colon (K.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (F.stalkIdeal x ^ j)) := by
    intro x
    rw [hC, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
  obtain ⟨U₀, ha'U₀, s₀, hs₀⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf g
  have hgm : (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf.germ U₀ a' ha'U₀ s₀ ^ m ∈ C.stalkIdeal a' := by
    rw [hs₀, hCst]
    exact hj
  obtain ⟨W, ha'W, iU, hW⟩ := exists_opens_pow_mem_carrier C ha'U₀ s₀ hgm
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf.obj (op W),
      s = (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf.map iU.op s₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsg : (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf.germ W a' ha'W s = g := by
    rw [hs, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, hs₀]
  rw [← hs] at hW
  
  have hsK : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ W), x ∉ F.support →
      (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf.germ W x hx s ∈ K.stalkIdeal x := by
    intro x hx hxF
    have h1 : (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf.germ W x hx s ^ m ∈ C.stalkIdeal x := by
      rw [← map_pow]
      exact C.germ_mem_stalkIdeal hx hW
    rw [hCst] at h1
    have htop : F.stalkIdeal x = ⊤ := not_not.mp (mt (IdealSheaf.mem_support _).mpr hxF)
    rw [htop, Ideal.top_pow] at h1
    have h2 := Submodule.mem_colon.mp h1 1 Submodule.mem_top
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h2
    exact hrad x hxF (Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mpr ⟨m, h2⟩)
  
  have hιc : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℂ, E) 𝓘(ℂ, E) ω (Subtype.val : W → M') := contMDiff_subtype_val
  have hVW : ∀ x : W, x ∈ preimageOpens (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc W := fun x => x.2
  obtain ⟨KW, hKW⟩ : ∃ KW : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf ℂ E W),
      KW = K.pullback (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨FW, hFW⟩ : ∃ FW : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf ℂ E W),
      FW = F.pullback (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨sW, hsW⟩ : ∃ sW : (structureSheaf ℂ E W).presheaf.obj
      (op (preimageOpens (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc W)),
      sW = comapSection (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf ℂ E W), P = IdealSheaf.ofStalks _ _
      (hasLocalGenerators_span_germ (preimageOpens (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc W) hVW sW) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨CW, hCW⟩ : ∃ CW : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf ℂ E W),
      CW = IdealSheaf.ofStalks _ _ (hasLocalGenerators_colon_stalkIdeal ψ KW P) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPst : ∀ x : W, P.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span
      {(structureSheaf ℂ E W).presheaf.germ (preimageOpens (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc W) x
        (hVW x) sW} := fun x => by
    rw [hP, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks]
  have hCWst : ∀ x : W, CW.stalkIdeal x =
      Submodule.colon (KW.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (P.stalkIdeal x)) := fun x => by
    rw [hCW, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks]
  have hgerm : ∀ x : W, germMap (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc x
      ((structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf.germ W x.1 x.2 s) =
        (structureSheaf ℂ E W).presheaf.germ (preimageOpens (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc W) x
          (hVW x) sW := by
    intro x
    rw [hsW]
    exact germMap_germ (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc x.2 s
  
  have hsub : ∀ y ∈ (⊤ : Opens W), y ∈ CW.support → y ∈ FW.support := by
    intro y _ hyC
    by_contra hyF
    apply hyC
    have hyF' : y.1 ∉ F.support := by
      intro hmem
      apply hyF
      rw [hFW, IdealSheaf.support_pullback]
      exact hmem
    have hPle : P.stalkIdeal y ≤ KW.stalkIdeal y := by
      rw [hPst, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, hKW, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
        ← hgerm y]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hsK y.1 y.2 hyF')
    rw [hCWst, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
    exact Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun p hp => by rw [one_smul]; exact hPle hp
  
  have hle : FW.stalkIdeal ⟨a', ha'W⟩ ≤ (CW.stalkIdeal ⟨a', ha'W⟩).radical := fun f hf =>
    mem_radical_stalkIdeal_of_cosupport_subset ψ CW FW (o := ⊤) trivial hsub hf
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg_radical hle (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
  
  refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem k (Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun p hp => ?_)
  rw [smul_eq_mul]
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (germMap (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc ⟨a', ha'W⟩) :=
    germMap_val_bijective (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := E) W ⟨a', ha'W⟩
  have hp' : germMap (Subtype.val : W → M') hιc ⟨a', ha'W⟩ p ∈ FW.stalkIdeal ⟨a', ha'W⟩ ^ k := by
    rw [hFW, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, ← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hp
  have h3 := hk hp'
  rw [hCWst] at h3
  have h4 := Submodule.mem_colon.mp h3 _
    (by rw [hPst]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  rw [smul_eq_mul, ← hgerm ⟨a', ha'W⟩, ← map_mul, hKW, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback] at h4
  have hsg' : (structureSheaf ℂ E M').presheaf.germ W (⟨a', ha'W⟩ : W).1 ha'W s = g := hsg
  rw [hsg'] at h4
  rw [mul_comm, ← Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij (I := K.stalkIdeal a')]
  exact Ideal.mem_comap.mpr h4

name: Manifold.isRadical_saturationStalk_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem isRadical_saturationStalk_of_isReduced (hI : ∀ x, (I.stalkIdeal x).IsRadical) (a' : M') :
    (saturationStalk hY h I a').IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.radical_eq_iff.mp (le_antisymm (fun g hg => ?_) Ideal.le_radical)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp hg
  exact mem_iSup_colon_pow_of_pow_mem ψ (I.pullback π h.contMDiff)
    (hY.idealSheaf.pullback π h.contMDiff) (fun x hx =>
        isRadical_stalkIdeal_totalTransform_of_notMem
      h I hI (by rwa [IsBlowUp.cosupport_exceptionalIdealSheaf hY h] at hx)) hm

name: Manifold.saturationStalk_radical
statement:
theorem saturationStalk_radical
    (hI : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf ℂ E M)
      fun x => (I.stalkIdeal x).radical) (a' : M') :
    (saturationStalk hY h I a').radical =
      saturationStalk hY h (IdealSheaf.ofStalks (structureSheaf ℂ E M) _ hI) a'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h.exists_span_singleton_stalkIdeal_exceptional hY a'
  have hJ : ∀ x, ((IdealSheaf.ofStalks (structureSheaf ℂ E M) _ hI).stalkIdeal x).IsRadical :=
    fun x => by
      rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks]
      exact Ideal.radical_isRadical _
  have hrad := isRadical_saturationStalk_of_isReduced hY h _ hJ a'
  refine le_antisymm (hrad.radical_le_iff.mpr ?_) ?_
  · unfold saturationStalk
    refine iSup_colon_pow_mono ?_ _
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback π h.contMDiff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback π h.contMDiff,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks]
    exact Ideal.map_mono Ideal.le_radical
  · unfold saturationStalk
    rw [hy]
    refine iSup_colon_pow_le_radical_of_le_radical _ _ y ?_
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback π h.contMDiff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback π h.contMDiff,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks]
    exact Ideal.map_radical_le (f := germMap π h.contMDiff a')

name: Manifold.isRadical_stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem isRadical_stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_isReduced
    (hI : ∀ x, (I.stalkIdeal x).IsRadical) (a' : M') :
    ((strictTransformSubspace hY h I).stalkIdeal a').IsRadical
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hex : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf ℂ E M') (saturationStalk hY h I)
  · rw [stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators hY h I hex]
    exact isRadical_saturationStalk_of_isReduced hY h I hI a'
  · rw [strictTransformSubspace_of_not_hasLocalGenerators hY h I hex, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_top]
    exact Ideal.radical_eq_iff.mp (Ideal.radical_top _)

name: Manifold.strictTransformSubspace_radicalSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem strictTransformSubspace_radicalSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators
    (hI : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf ℂ E M)
      fun x => (I.stalkIdeal x).radical)
    (hex : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf ℂ E M') (saturationStalk hY h I))
    (hex' : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf ℂ E M')
      (saturationStalk hY h (IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace I)))
    (hR : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := structureSheaf ℂ E M')
      fun x => ((strictTransformSubspace hY h I).stalkIdeal x).radical) :
    strictTransformSubspace hY h (IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace I) =
      IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace (strictTransformSubspace hY h I)
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun a' => ?_
  rw [stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators _ _ _ hex',
    IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_radicalSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators _ hR,
    stalkIdeal_strictTransformSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators hY h I hex,
    saturationStalk_radical hY h I hI a', IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace, dite_eq_left hI]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_radicalSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_radicalSubspace_of_hasLocalGenerators (J : IdealSheaf 𝒪)
    (hex : IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := 𝒪) fun x => (J.stalkIdeal x).radical) (x : X) :
    (IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace J).stalkIdeal x = (J.stalkIdeal x).radical
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace, dite_eq_left hex, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks]

name: Manifold.IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace_of_not_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace_of_not_hasLocalGenerators (J : IdealSheaf 𝒪)
    (hex : ¬ IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := 𝒪) fun x => (J.stalkIdeal x).radical) :
    IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace J = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.radicalSubspace, dite_eq_right hex]

name: Manifold.le_ordAlongIdeal_mul
statement:
theorem le_ordAlongIdeal_mul {J K : IdealSheaf 𝒪} {p q : ℕ}
    (hp : (p : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D J a)
    (hq : (q : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D K a) :
    ((p + q : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D (J * K) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff] at hp hq ⊢
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, pow_add]
  exact Ideal.mul_mono hp hq

name: Manifold.le_ordAlongIdeal_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff] at hp ⊢
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, pow_mul]
  exact Ideal.pow_right_mono hp s

name: Manifold.le_ordAlongIdeal_finset_sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ (fun I : Ideal _ => I ≤ D.stalkIdeal a ^ p)
    (fun A B hA hB => ?_) bot_le fun i hi => (IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hG i hi)
  rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup]
  exact sup_le hA hB

name: Manifold.le_ordAlongIdeal_finset_prod
statement:
theorem le_ordAlongIdeal_finset_prod {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι) (G : ι → IdealSheaf 𝒪) (c : ι → ℕ)
    (hG : ∀ i ∈ F, (c i : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D (G i) a) :
    ((∑ i ∈ F, c i : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal D (∏ i ∈ F, G i) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_finset_prod,
    ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod fun i hi => (IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hG i hi)

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord
proof:
:= by
  have hcol := isDivExceptional_birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, k⟩ hk p
  dsimp only at hcol
  rw [hcol, stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ hp,
    Ideal.colon_coe_span_singleton_pow]

name: Manifold.totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le_span_coord_pow
proof:
:= by
  have := h.totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le hY J (hk _ hpY)
  rwa [stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdealSheaf_eq_span_coord hY h hφ hΦ hp, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    at this

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_mul
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_mul (J₁ J₂ : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (a b : ℕ)
    (h₁ : ∀ x ∈ Y, (a : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J₁ x)
    (h₂ : ∀ x ∈ Y, (b : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J₂ x) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J₁ * J₂, a + b⟩).I =
      (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J₁, a⟩).I *
        (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J₂, b⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  have h₁₂ : ∀ x ∈ Y, ((a + b : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf (J₁ * J₂) x :=
    fun x hx => le_ordAlongIdeal_mul _ (h₁ x hx) (h₂ x hx)
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun p => ?_
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul]
  by_cases hpY : π p ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hpφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart _ hpY
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hpΦ⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ p hpφ
    have := isDomain_stalk ψ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hpΦ
    rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h h₁₂ hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h h₁ hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h h₂ hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul, Ideal.map_mul]
    refine Ideal.colon_mul_pow_add _ _ (coord_ne_zero hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hpΦ _) a b ?_ ?_
    · have := totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le_span_coord_pow hY h h₁ hφ hΦ hpΦ hpY
      rwa [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback] at this
    · have := totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le_span_coord_pow hY h h₂ hφ hΦ hpΦ hpY
      rwa [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback] at this
  · rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h h₁₂ hpY,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h h₁ hpY,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h h₂ hpY, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_mul,
      Ideal.map_mul]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_pow
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_pow (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (k s : ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ x ∈ Y, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J x) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J ^ s, k * s⟩).I =
      (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, k⟩).I ^ s
proof:
:= by
  have hks : ∀ x ∈ Y, ((k * s : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf (J ^ s) x :=
    fun x hx => le_ordAlongIdeal_pow _ (hk x hx) s
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun p => ?_
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
  by_cases hpY : π p ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hpφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart _ hpY
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hpΦ⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ p hpφ
    have := isDomain_stalk ψ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hpΦ
    rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h hks hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h hk hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, Ideal.map_pow]
    refine Ideal.colon_pow_pow_mul _ (coord_ne_zero hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hpΦ _) k s ?_
    have := totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le_span_coord_pow hY h hk hφ hΦ hpΦ hpY
    rwa [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback] at this
  · rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h hks hpY,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h hk hpY, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow, Ideal.map_pow]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_add
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_add (J₁ J₂ : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (k : ℕ)
    (h₁ : ∀ x ∈ Y, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J₁ x)
    (h₂ : ∀ x ∈ Y, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J₂ x) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J₁ + J₂, k⟩).I =
      (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J₁, k⟩).I +
        (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J₂, k⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  have h₁₂ : ∀ x ∈ Y, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf (J₁ + J₂) x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_add]
    exact sup_le ((IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff _ _ _ _).mp (h₁ x hx))
      ((IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff _ _ _ _).mp (h₂ x hx))
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun p => ?_
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_add]
  by_cases hpY : π p ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hpφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart _ hpY
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hpΦ⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ p hpφ
    have := isDomain_stalk ψ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hpΦ
    rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h h₁₂ hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h h₁ hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h h₂ hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_add, Ideal.map_sup]
    refine Ideal.colon_sup_pow _ _ (coord_ne_zero hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hpΦ _) k ?_ ?_
    · have := totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le_span_coord_pow hY h h₁ hφ hΦ hpΦ hpY
      rwa [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback] at this
    · have := totalTransform_stalkIdeal_le_span_coord_pow hY h h₂ hφ hΦ hpΦ hpY
      rwa [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback] at this
  · rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h h₁₂ hpY,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h h₁ hpY,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h h₂ hpY, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_add,
      Ideal.map_sup]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_one
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_one :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨1, 0⟩).I = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ x ∈ Y, ((0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf 1 x :=
    fun x _ => by rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; exact le_top
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun p => ?_
  have hcol := isDivExceptional_birationalTransform hY h ⟨1, 0⟩ h0 p
  dsimp only at hcol
  rw [hcol, pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, Submodule.top_coe, Submodule.colon_univ,
    IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_one,
    Ideal.map_top]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_finset_prod
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_finset_prod {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι)
    (G : ι → IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (c : ι → ℕ)
    (hG : ∀ i ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ Y, (c i : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf (G i) x) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨∏ i ∈ F, G i, ∑ i ∈ F, c i⟩).I =
      ∏ i ∈ F, (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨G i, c i⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    rw [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty, Finset.prod_empty]
    exact birationalTransform_one hY h
  | insert j F hj ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hj, Finset.sum_insert hj, Finset.prod_insert hj,
      birationalTransform_mul hY h _ _ _ _ (hG j (Finset.mem_insert_self j F))
        (fun x hx => le_ordAlongIdeal_finset_prod _ F G c
          (fun i hi => hG i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) x hx)),
      ih fun i hi => hG i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_zero
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_zero (k : ℕ) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨0, k⟩).I = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ x ∈ Y, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf 0 x :=
    fun x _ => by rw [IdealSheaf.le_ordAlongIdeal_iff, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_zero]; exact bot_le
  refine IdealSheaf.ext fun p => ?_
  rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_zero]
  by_cases hpY : π p ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hpφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart _ hpY
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hpΦ⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ p hpφ
    have := isDomain_stalk ψ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hpΦ
    rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h h0 hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_zero, Ideal.map_bot]
    refine le_bot_iff.mp fun x hx => ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mem_bot] at hx
    exact Ideal.mem_bot.mpr
      ((mul_eq_zero.mp hx).resolve_right (pow_ne_zero k (coord_ne_zero hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hpΦ _)))
  · rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h h0 hpY, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pullback,
      IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_zero, Ideal.map_bot]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_finset_sum
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι)
    (G : ι → IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) (k : ℕ)
    (hG : ∀ i ∈ F, ∀ x ∈ Y, (k : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf (G i) x) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨∑ i ∈ F, G i, k⟩).I =
      ∑ i ∈ F, (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨G i, k⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    rw [Finset.sum_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    exact birationalTransform_zero hY h k
  | insert j F hj ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hj, Finset.sum_insert hj,
      birationalTransform_add hY h _ _ _ (hG j (Finset.mem_insert_self j F))
        (fun x hx => le_ordAlongIdeal_finset_sum _ F G
          (fun i hi => hG i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) x hx)),
      ih fun i hi => hG i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)]

name: Manifold.birationalTransform_le_of_le_mark
statement:
theorem birationalTransform_le_of_le_mark (J : IdealSheaf (structureSheaf 𝕜 E M)) {s t : ℕ}
    (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : ∀ x ∈ Y, (t : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J x) :
    (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, s⟩).I ≤
      (MarkedIdealSheaf.birationalTransform hY h ⟨J, t⟩).I
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ x ∈ Y, (s : ℕ∞) ≤ IdealSheaf.ordAlongIdeal hY.idealSheaf J x :=
    fun x hx => (Nat.cast_le.mpr hst).trans (ht x hx)
  rw [IdealSheaf.le_def]
  intro p
  by_cases hpY : π p ∈ Y
  · obtain ⟨φ, σ, hpφ, hφ⟩ := hY.exists_adaptedChart _ hpY
    obtain ⟨i, Φ, hΦ, hpΦ⟩ := h.cover φ σ hφ p hpφ
    rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h hs hφ hΦ hpΦ,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_eq_colon_coord hY h ht hφ hΦ hpΦ]
    exact Ideal.colon_singleton_pow_mono _ _ hst
  · rw [birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h hs hpY,
      birationalTransform_stalkIdeal_of_notMem hY h ht hpY]

name: Manifold.germMap_const
statement:
theorem germMap_const (hπ : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω π) (p : M') (a : 𝕜) :
    germMap π hπ p (const 𝕜 E M (π p) a) = const 𝕜 E M' p a
proof:
:= by
  apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M' p
  rw [stalkToGerm_germMap, stalkToGerm_const, stalkToGerm_const, Germ.coe_compTendsto]
  rfl

name: Manifold.IsBlowUpChart.germMap_coord_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem IsBlowUpChart.germMap_coord_of_forall_ne (hπ : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω π)
    (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M) (hΦ : IsBlowUpChart ψ π φ σ i Φ) {p : M'}
    (hp : p ∈ Φ.source) {m : Fin n} (hm : ∀ k, σ k ≠ m) :
    germMap π hπ p (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) m) =
      coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp m
proof:
:= by
  apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M' p
  rw [stalkToGerm_germMap, stalkToGerm_coord, stalkToGerm_coord, Germ.coe_compTendsto,
    Germ.coe_eq]
  filter_upwards [Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hp] with x hx
  rw [Function.comp_apply, extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ (hΦ.source_subset hx),
    extendSection_of_mem 𝕜 E _ hx]
  change ψ (φ (π x)) m = ψ (Φ x) m
  rw [hΦ.comm x hx, blowUpChartMap_apply_off _ _ hm]

name: Manifold.IsBlowUpChart.eval_coord_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem IsBlowUpChart.eval_coord_of_forall_ne (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(𝕜, E) ω M)
    (hΦ : IsBlowUpChart ψ π φ σ i Φ) {p : M'} (hp : p ∈ Φ.source) {m : Fin n}
    (hm : ∀ k, σ k ≠ m) :
    eval 𝕜 E M (π p) (coord E ψ φ hφ (hΦ.source_subset hp) m) =
      eval 𝕜 E M' p (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas hp m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_coord, eval_coord, hΦ.comm p hp, blowUpChartMap_apply_off _ _ hm]

name: Manifold.kollarCoords_of_lt
statement:
theorem kollarCoords_of_lt {j : Fin n} (hj : j < r) :
    kollarCoords hφ hΦ ha' r τ j = centredCoords hφ hΦ ha' τ j -
      const 𝕜 E M (π a') (eval 𝕜 E M' a' (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j))) *
        centredCoords hφ hΦ ha' τ r
proof:
:=
  shiftCoords_of_lt _ _ _ hj

name: Manifold.kollarCoords_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem kollarCoords_of_not_lt {j : Fin n} (hj : ¬ j < r) :
    kollarCoords hφ hΦ ha' r τ j = centredCoords hφ hΦ ha' τ j
proof:
:=
  shiftCoords_of_not_lt _ _ _ hj

name: Manifold.maximalIdeal_eq_span_centredCoords
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_eq_span_centredCoords :
    maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (π a')) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (centredCoords hφ hΦ ha' τ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximalIdeal_eq_span_coord' E ψ φ (hΦ.source_subset ha') hφ.1]
  congr 1
  exact (τ.surjective.range_comp _).symm

name: Manifold.maximalIdeal_eq_span_kollarCoords
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_eq_span_kollarCoords :
    maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf 𝕜 E M).presheaf.stalk (π a')) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (kollarCoords hφ hΦ ha' r τ))
proof:
:=
  span_range_shiftCoords _ _ _ (maximalIdeal_eq_span_centredCoords hφ hΦ ha' τ)

name: Manifold.centredCoords_of_le
statement:
theorem centredCoords_of_le {j : Fin n} (hj : j ≤ r) :
    centredCoords hφ hΦ ha' τ j = coord E ψ φ hφ.1 (hΦ.source_subset ha') (τ j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, τ j = σ k := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hj with hj' | rfl
    · obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := (hlt j).mp hj'
      exact ⟨k, hk⟩
    · exact ⟨i, hτr⟩
  unfold centredCoords
  rw [hk, eval_coord, (hφ.2 _ (hΦ.source_subset ha')).1 haY k, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: Manifold.germMap_kollarCoords_self
statement:
theorem germMap_kollarCoords_self (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) :
    germMap π h.contMDiff a' (kollarCoords hφ hΦ ha' r τ r) =
      coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kollarCoords_of_not_lt hφ hΦ ha' r τ (lt_irrefl r),
    centredCoords_of_le hφ hΦ ha' r τ haY hτr hlt le_rfl, hτr]
  exact hΦ.germMap_coord_self h.contMDiff hφ.1 ha'

name: Manifold.germMap_kollarCoords_of_lt
statement:
theorem germMap_kollarCoords_of_lt (h : IsBlowUp ψ Y c π) {j : Fin n} (hj : j < r) :
    germMap π h.contMDiff a' (kollarCoords hφ hΦ ha' r τ j) =
      coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (σ i) * (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j) -
        const 𝕜 E M' a' (eval 𝕜 E M' a' (coord E ψ Φ hΦ.mem_maximalAtlas ha' (τ j))))
