name: AnalyticSpace.exists_toFun_stratumIncl_eq
statement:
theorem exists_toFun_stratumIncl_eq {d : ℕ} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ dimSet X d) :
    ∃ m : stratumSpaceOf X hX d, Hom.toFun (stratumIncl X hX d) m = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (stratumKIso X hX d).hom m =
      (⟨x, hx⟩ : dimOpens X hX d) :=
    ⟨KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (stratumKIso X hX d).inv ⟨x, hx⟩,
      congrArg (fun g : stratumRestrict X hX d ⟶ stratumRestrict X hX d =>
        KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun g (⟨x, hx⟩ : dimOpens X hX d))
        (stratumKIso X hX d).inv_hom_id⟩
  exact ⟨m, congrArg Subtype.val hm⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.isIso_stratumDesc
statement: theorem isIso_stratumDesc : IsIso (stratumDesc X hX)
proof:
:= by
  refine isIso_sigmaDesc_of_isOpenImmersion _ ?_ ?_
  · intro d d' hdd' a b h
    apply hdd'
    have ha := toFun_stratumIncl_mem X hX d a
    have hb := toFun_stratumIncl_mem X hX d' b
    rw [h] at ha
    have : ((d : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = d' := ha.symm.trans hb
    exact_mod_cast this
  · intro x
    have hx : x ∈ ⋃ d, dimSet X d := by
      rw [iUnion_dimSet_eq_univ X hX]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_toFun_stratumIncl_eq X hX hd
    exact ⟨d, m, hm⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.toFun_stratumSigmaIso_hom_eq_iff
statement:
theorem toFun_stratumSigmaIso_hom_eq_iff (d : ℕ) (x : X) (m : stratumSpaceOf X hX d) :
    Hom.toFun (stratumSigmaIso X hX).hom x =
        Hom.toFun (sigmaι (fun d => stratumSpaceOf X hX d) d) m ↔
      x = Hom.toFun (stratumIncl X hX d) m
proof:
:= by
  have := isIso_stratumDesc X hX
  have h₁ : ∀ y, Hom.toFun (stratumDesc X hX) (Hom.toFun (stratumSigmaIso X hX).hom y) = y :=
    fun y => congrArg (fun g : X ⟶ X => Hom.toFun g y) (IsIso.inv_hom_id (stratumDesc X hX))
  have h₂ : ∀ z, Hom.toFun (stratumSigmaIso X hX).hom (Hom.toFun (stratumDesc X hX) z) = z :=
    fun z => congrArg (fun g : sigma (fun d => stratumSpaceOf X hX d) ⟶ _ => Hom.toFun g z)
      (IsIso.hom_inv_id (stratumDesc X hX))
  rw [← toFun_sigmaDesc_toFun_sigmaι (stratumIncl X hX) d m]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h₁ x, h]
    rfl
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact h₂ _

name: AnalyticSpace.ringKrullDim_eq_iff_exists
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_eq_iff_exists (d : ℕ) (x : X) :
    ringKrullDim (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.presheaf.stalk x) = ((d : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ↔
      ∃ m : stratumManifold X hX d, Hom.toFun (stratumSigmaIso X hX).hom x =
        Hom.toFun (sigmaι (fun d => stratumSpaceOf X hX d) d) m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_toFun_stratumIncl_eq X hX (d := d) hx
    exact ⟨m, (toFun_stratumSigmaIso_hom_eq_iff X hX d x m).mpr hm.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    rw [(toFun_stratumSigmaIso_hom_eq_iff X hX d x m).mp hm]
    exact toFun_stratumIncl_mem X hX d m

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_reg_of_isNonsingular
statement: theorem mem_reg_of_isNonsingular (hX : X.IsNonsingular) (x : X) : x ∈ regularLocus X
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsNonsingular] at hX
  rw [hX]
  trivial

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_dimSet_of_chart
proof:
:=
  (isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_kIso_analyticSpaceOfOpen (e.hom.1.base q).2 e.symm).2

name: AnalyticSpace.subset_dimSet_of_chart
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, e.hom.1.base q = ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    ⟨(KIso.homeomorph e).symm ⟨x, hx⟩, (KIso.homeomorph e).apply_symm_apply _⟩
  have h := mem_dimSet_of_chart X e q
  rw [hq] at h
  exact h

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_chart_of_mem_dimSet
statement:
theorem exists_chart_of_mem_dimSet (hX : X.IsNonsingular) {d : ℕ} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ dimSet X d) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ V) (G' : Opens (Kn.{u} K d)),
      Nonempty (KIso (analyticSpaceOfOpen K d G') (X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen V))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d', hd', V, hxV, G', ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    (isRegular_stalk_iff_exists_manifold_nhd X x).mp (mem_reg_of_isNonsingular X hX x)
  have hdd : d' = d := by
    have h : ((d' : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ((d : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := hd'.symm.trans hx
    exact_mod_cast h
  subst hdd
  exact ⟨V, hxV, G', ⟨e.symm⟩⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.isOpen_dimSet
statement: theorem isOpen_dimSet (hX : X.IsNonsingular) (d : ℕ) : IsOpen (dimSet X d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, G', ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_chart_of_mem_dimSet X hX hx
  exact ⟨V, subset_dimSet_of_chart X e, V.isOpen, hxV⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.iUnion_dimSet_eq_univ
statement: theorem iUnion_dimSet_eq_univ (hX : X.IsNonsingular) : ⋃ d : ℕ, dimSet X d = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨d, hd, -⟩ :=
    (isRegular_stalk_iff_exists_manifold_nhd X x).mp (mem_reg_of_isNonsingular X hX x)
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨d, hd⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_chartV
statement: theorem mem_chartV (x : dimOpens X hX d) : x.1 ∈ chartV X hX d x
proof:
:=
  (exists_chart_of_mem_dimSet X hX x.2).choose_spec.choose

name: AnalyticSpace.chartV_subset
statement: theorem chartV_subset (x : dimOpens X hX d) : (chartV X hX d x : Set X) ⊆ dimSet X d
proof:
:=

name: AnalyticSpace.chartHomeo_apply
statement:
theorem chartHomeo_apply (x : dimOpens X hX d) (q : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)) :
    chartHomeo X hX d x q = (chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base q
proof:
:=

name: AnalyticSpace.chartPt_val
statement:
theorem chartPt_val (x : dimOpens X hX d) (q : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)) :
    (chartPt x q).1 = ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base q).1
proof:
:=

name: AnalyticSpace.stratumCoord_chartPt
statement:
theorem stratumCoord_chartPt (x : dimOpens X hX d) (q : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)) :
    stratumCoord x (chartPt x q) ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base q).2 = q.1.down
proof:
:= by
  unfold stratumCoord
  have h : ((chartHomeo X hX d x).symm ⟨(chartPt x q).1, ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base q).2⟩) =
      q := by
    rw [show (⟨(chartPt x q).1, ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base q).2⟩ :
      X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen (chartV X hX d x)) = chartHomeo X hX d x q from rfl]
    exact (chartHomeo X hX d x).symm_apply_apply q
  rw [h]

name: AnalyticSpace.continuous_stratumCoord
statement:
theorem continuous_stratumCoord (x : dimOpens X hX d) :
    Continuous fun w : {w : dimOpens X hX d // w.1 ∈ chartV X hX d x} =>
      stratumCoord x w.1 w.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold stratumCoord
  exact Homeomorph.ulift.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp
    ((chartHomeo X hX d x).symm.continuous.comp
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)))

name: AnalyticSpace.continuous_chartPt
statement:
theorem continuous_chartPt (x : dimOpens X hX d) :
    Continuous fun z : {z : Fin d → K // (ULift.up z : Kn.{u} K d) ∈ chartG X hX d x} =>
      chartPt x ⟨ULift.up z.1, z.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
  exact continuous_subtype_val.comp ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base.hom.continuous.comp
    ((Homeomorph.ulift.symm.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _))

statement:
theorem stratumChart_source (x : dimOpens X hX d) :

:=

theorem stratumChart_target (x : dimOpens X hX d) :

name: AnalyticSpace.stratumChart_apply
proof:
:= by
  change (if hw : w.1 ∈ chartV X hX d x then stratumCoord x w hw else 0) = _
  rw [dite_eq_left hw]

name: AnalyticSpace.stratumChart_symm_apply
proof:
:= by
  change (if hz : (ULift.up z : Kn.{u} K d) ∈ chartG X hX d x then chartPt x ⟨ULift.up z, hz⟩
    else x) = _

statement: theorem mem_stratumChart_source (x : dimOpens X hX d) : x ∈ (stratumChart x).source

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_overlapOpens
statement:
theorem mem_overlapOpens {q : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)} :
    q ∈ overlapOpens x y ↔ ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base q).1 ∈ chartV X hX d y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.overlapIncl_base_apply
statement:
theorem overlapIncl_base_apply (p : (analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)).restrictOpen
    (overlapOpens x y)) : (overlapIncl x y).1.base p = ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base p.1).1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.range_overlapIncl
statement:
theorem range_overlapIncl :
    Set.range (KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun (overlapIncl x y)) =
      (chartV X hX d x : Set X) ∩ chartV X hX d y
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base p.1).2, p.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hwx, hwy⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, (chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base q = ⟨w, hwx⟩ :=
      ⟨(chartHomeo X hX d x).symm ⟨w, hwx⟩, (chartHomeo X hX d x).apply_symm_apply _⟩
    refine ⟨⟨q, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_overlapOpens, hq]
      exact hwy
    · change ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base q).1 = w
      rw [hq]

name: AnalyticSpace.transitionIso_hom_base
statement:
theorem transitionIso_hom_base (p : (analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)).restrictOpen
    (overlapOpens x y)) :
    ((chartE X hX d y).hom.1.base ((transitionIso x y).hom.1.base p).1).1 =
      ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base p.1).1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun φ p)
    (isoOfRangeEq_hom_comp (overlapIncl x y) (overlapIncl y x)
      (by rw [range_overlapIncl, range_overlapIncl, Set.inter_comm]))
  exact h

name: AnalyticSpace.overlapTrace_le
statement: theorem overlapTrace_le : overlapTrace x y ≤ chartG X hX d x
proof:
:=
  (exists_opens_le_eq_trace K d (chartG X hX d x) (overlapOpens x y)).choose_spec.1

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_overlapOpens_iff
statement:
theorem mem_overlapOpens_iff (p : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)) :
    p ∈ overlapOpens x y ↔ p.1 ∈ overlapTrace x y
proof:
:=
  (exists_opens_le_eq_trace K d (chartG X hX d x) (overlapOpens x y)).choose_spec.2 p

name: AnalyticSpace.overlapTraceIso_inv_base
statement:
theorem overlapTraceIso_inv_base (p : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (overlapTrace x y)) :
    ((overlapTraceIso x y).inv.1.base p).1.1 = p.1
proof:
:=
  traceIncl_base_apply K d (chartG X hX d x) (overlapTrace_le x y) (overlapOpens x y)
    (mem_overlapOpens_iff x y) p

name: AnalyticSpace.overlapTraceIso_hom_base
statement:
theorem overlapTraceIso_hom_base (p : (analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)).restrictOpen
    (overlapOpens x y)) : ((overlapTraceIso x y).hom.1.base p).1 = p.1.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := overlapTraceIso_inv_base x y ((overlapTraceIso x y).hom.1.base p)
  have h2 : (overlapTraceIso x y).inv.1.base ((overlapTraceIso x y).hom.1.base p) = p :=
    KIso.inv_base_hom_base (overlapTraceIso x y) p
  rw [h2] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AnalyticSpace.ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso_hom_base
statement:
theorem ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso_hom_base {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace K E]
    {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace E M] (U : Opens M)
    (p : (ofManifold K E M).restrictOpen U) :
    ((ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := E) U).hom.1.base p).1 = p.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => KLocallyRingedSpace.Hom.toFun φ p)
    (ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso_hom_comp (K := K) (E := E) U)
  exact h

name: AnalyticSpace.ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso_inv_base
statement:
theorem ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso_inv_base {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace K E]
    {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace E M] (U : Opens M) (q : U) :
    ((ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := E) U).inv.1.base q).1 = q.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso_hom_base (K := K) (E := E) U
    ((ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := E) U).inv.1.base q)
  have h2 : (ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := E) U).hom.1.base
      ((ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := E) U).inv.1.base q) = q :=
    KIso.hom_base_inv_base (ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := E) U) q
  rw [h2] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AnalyticSpace.contMDiff_transitionFun
statement:
theorem contMDiff_transitionFun :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K d) 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K d) ω (transitionFun x y)
proof:
:=
  contMDiff_baseFun ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift (transitionManifoldIso x y).hom

name: AnalyticSpace.chartE_transitionFun
statement:
theorem chartE_transitionFun (p : overlapTrace x y) :
    ((chartE X hX d y).hom.1.base ⟨(transitionFun x y p).1, overlapTrace_le y x
        (transitionFun x y p).2⟩).1 =
      ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base ⟨p.1, overlapTrace_le x y p.2⟩).1
proof:
:= by
  
  set p₁ := (ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := Kn.{u} K d) (M := Kn.{u} K d)
    (overlapTrace x y)).inv.1.base p with hp₁
  set p₂ := (overlapTraceIso x y).inv.1.base p₁ with hp₂
  set p₃ := (transitionIso x y).hom.1.base p₂ with hp₃
  set p₄ := (overlapTraceIso y x).hom.1.base p₃ with hp₄
  have hτ : transitionFun x y p = (ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso (K := K) (E := Kn.{u} K d)
      (M := Kn.{u} K d) (overlapTrace y x)).hom.1.base p₄ := rfl
  have e1 : p₁.1 = p.1 := ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso_inv_base _ p
  have e2 : p₂.1.1 = p₁.1 := overlapTraceIso_inv_base x y p₁
  have e3 := transitionIso_hom_base x y p₂
  have e4 : p₄.1 = p₃.1.1 := overlapTraceIso_hom_base y x p₃
  have e5 : (transitionFun x y p).1 = p₄.1 := by
    rw [hτ]
    exact ofManifold_restrictOpen_iso_hom_base _ p₄
  have hp₂' : (⟨p.1, overlapTrace_le x y p.2⟩ : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)) =
      p₂.1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [e2, e1]
  have hp₃' : (⟨(transitionFun x y p).1, overlapTrace_le y x (transitionFun x y p).2⟩ :
      analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d y)) = p₃.1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [e5, e4]
  rw [hp₂', hp₃']
  exact e3

name: AnalyticSpace.transitionExt_of_mem
statement:
theorem transitionExt_of_mem {w : Kn.{u} K d} (hw : w ∈ overlapTrace x y) :
    transitionExt x y w = (transitionFun x y ⟨w, hw⟩).1
proof:
:= by
  change (if hw : w ∈ overlapTrace x y then (transitionFun x y ⟨w, hw⟩).1 else 0) = _
  rw [dite_eq_left hw]

name: AnalyticSpace.contMDiffOn_transitionExt
statement:
theorem contMDiffOn_transitionExt :
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K d) 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K d) ω (transitionExt x y) (overlapTrace x y)
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  refine ContMDiffAt.contMDiffWithinAt ?_
  have hf : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K d) 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K d) ω
      (transitionExt x y ∘ Subtype.val) (⟨w, hw⟩ : overlapTrace x y) := by
    have h : transitionExt x y ∘ (Subtype.val : overlapTrace x y → Kn.{u} K d) =
        Subtype.val ∘ transitionFun x y :=
      funext fun p => transitionExt_of_mem x y p.2
    rw [h]
    exact (contMDiff_subtype_val.comp (contMDiff_transitionFun x y)).contMDiffAt
  exact ((contDiffWithinAt_localInvariantProp (I := 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K d)) (I' := 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K d))
    ω).liftPropAt_iff_comp_subtype_val (U := overlapTrace x y) (transitionExt x y) ⟨w, hw⟩).mpr hf

name: AnalyticSpace.contDiffOn_transitionExt
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_transitionExt :
    ContDiffOn K ω (transitionExt x y) (overlapTrace x y)
proof:
:=
  contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (contMDiffOn_transitionExt x y)

name: AnalyticSpace.stratumChart_trans_apply
statement:
theorem stratumChart_trans_apply {z : Fin d → K}
    (hz : z ∈ ((stratumChart x).symm ≫ₕ stratumChart y).source) :
    stratumChart y ((stratumChart x).symm z) =
      ((transitionExt x y (ULift.up z)).down)
proof:
:= by
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source,
    stratumChart_target] at hz
  obtain ⟨hzx, hzy⟩ := hz
  have hzx' : (ULift.up z : Kn.{u} K d) ∈ chartG X hX d x := hzx
  have hzy₀ : (stratumChart x).symm z ∈ (stratumChart y).source := hzy
  rw [stratumChart_symm_apply x hzx'] at hzy₀ ⊢
  have hzy' : ((chartE X hX d x).hom.1.base ⟨ULift.up z, hzx'⟩).1 ∈ chartV X hX d y := hzy₀
  have hmem : (⟨ULift.up z, hzx'⟩ : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d x)) ∈
      overlapOpens x y := hzy'
  have hT : (ULift.up z : Kn.{u} K d) ∈ overlapTrace x y :=
    (mem_overlapOpens_iff x y _).mp hmem
  rw [stratumChart_apply y hzy', transitionExt_of_mem x y hT]
  unfold stratumCoord
  have h1 := chartE_transitionFun x y ⟨ULift.up z, hT⟩
  have h2 : (⟨(chartPt x ⟨ULift.up z, hzx'⟩).1, hzy'⟩ :
      X.toKLocallyRingedSpace.restrictOpen (chartV X hX d y)) =
      chartHomeo X hX d y ⟨(transitionFun x y ⟨ULift.up z, hT⟩).1,
        overlapTrace_le y x (transitionFun x y ⟨ULift.up z, hT⟩).2⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact h1.symm
  rw [h2]
  exact congrArg (fun q : analyticSpaceOfOpen K d (chartG X hX d y) => q.1.down)
    ((chartHomeo X hX d y).symm_apply_apply ⟨(transitionFun x y ⟨ULift.up z, hT⟩).1,
      overlapTrace_le y x (transitionFun x y ⟨ULift.up z, hT⟩).2⟩)

name: AnalyticSpace.stratumChart_trans_source_subset
statement:
theorem stratumChart_trans_source_subset :
    ((stratumChart x).symm ≫ₕ stratumChart y).source ⊆
      (fun z : Fin d → K => (ULift.up z : Kn.{u} K d)) ⁻¹' overlapTrace x y
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source,
    stratumChart_target] at hz
  obtain ⟨hzx, hzy⟩ := hz
  have hzx' : (ULift.up z : Kn.{u} K d) ∈ chartG X hX d x := hzx
  have hzy₀ : (stratumChart x).symm z ∈ (stratumChart y).source := hzy
  rw [stratumChart_symm_apply x hzx'] at hzy₀
  exact (mem_overlapOpens_iff x y ⟨ULift.up z, hzx'⟩).mp hzy₀

name: AnalyticSpace.contDiffOn_stratumChart_trans
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_stratumChart_trans :
    ContDiffOn K ω ((stratumChart x).symm ≫ₕ stratumChart y)
      ((stratumChart x).symm ≫ₕ stratumChart y).source
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ContDiffOn K ω (fun z : Fin d → K =>
      (transitionExt x y (ULift.up z)).down)
      ((fun z : Fin d → K => (ULift.up z : Kn.{u} K d)) ⁻¹' overlapTrace x y) := by
    have h1 : ContDiff K ω (fun w : Kn.{u} K d => w.down) :=
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift : Kn.{u} K d ≃L[K] (Fin d → K)).contDiff
    have h2 : ContDiff K ω (fun z : Fin d → K => (ULift.up z : Kn.{u} K d)) :=
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift.symm : (Fin d → K) ≃L[K] Kn.{u} K d).contDiff
    exact h1.comp_contDiffOn ((contDiffOn_transitionExt x y).comp h2.contDiffOn
      (Set.mapsTo_preimage _ _))
  refine (hg.mono (stratumChart_trans_source_subset x y)).congr fun z hz => ?_
  rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans, Function.comp_apply, stratumChart_trans_apply x y hz]

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.baseFun_apply
statement:
theorem baseFun_apply (F : ofManifold K E M ⟶ ofManifold K E' N) (x : M) :
    baseFun F x = F.1.base x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.continuous_baseFun
statement:
theorem continuous_baseFun (F : ofManifold K E M ⟶ ofManifold K E' N) :
    Continuous (baseFun F)

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.eval_stalkMap
statement:
theorem eval_stalkMap (F : ofManifold K E M ⟶ ofManifold K E' N) (y : M)
    (σ : (structureSheaf K E' N).presheaf.stalk (F.1.base y)) :
    Manifold.eval K E M y ((F.1.stalkMap y).hom σ) = Manifold.eval K E' N (F.1.base y) σ
proof:
:= by
  let α : (structureSheaf K E' N).presheaf.stalk (F.1.base y) →+*
      (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk y := (F.1.stalkMap y).hom
  have hloc : IsLocalHom α := F.1.prop y
  change Manifold.eval K E M y (α σ) = _
  set c := Manifold.eval K E' N (F.1.base y) σ with hc
  have h1 : σ - const K E' N (F.1.base y) c ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K E' N).presheaf.stalk (F.1.base y)) :=
    (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E' _).mpr (by rw [map_sub, eval_const, sub_self])
  have h2 : α (σ - const K E' N (F.1.base y) c) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk y) := by
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at h1 ⊢
    exact fun hu => h1 (hloc.map_nonunit _ hu)
  have h3 : α (const K E' N (F.1.base y) c) = const K E M y c := F.algebraMap_stalk y c
  rw [map_sub, h3] at h2
  have h4 := (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_eval E _).mp h2
  rw [map_sub, eval_const, sub_eq_zero] at h4
  exact h4

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.sheafHom_apply
statement:
theorem sheafHom_apply (F : ofManifold K E M ⟶ ofManifold K E' N) (U : Opens N)
    (s : (structureSheaf K E' N).presheaf.obj (op U)) (y : M) (hy : F.1.base y ∈ U) :
    ((F.1.c.app (op U)).hom s).1 ⟨y, hy⟩ = s.1 ⟨F.1.base y, hy⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h := eval_stalkMap F y ((structureSheaf K E' N).presheaf.germ U (F.1.base y) hy s)
  have hl : (F.1.stalkMap y).hom ((structureSheaf K E' N).presheaf.germ U (F.1.base y) hy s) =
      (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.germ ((Opens.map F.1.base).obj U) y hy
        ((F.1.c.app (op U)).hom s) :=
    PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply F.1.toShHom.hom U y hy s
  rw [hl] at h
  exact (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K) ω M K _ y hy _).symm.trans
    (h.trans (contMDiffSheafCommRing.eval_germ 𝓘(K, E') 𝓘(K) ω N K U (F.1.base y) hy s))

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.contMDiff_baseFun
statement:
theorem contMDiff_baseFun [IsManifold 𝓘(K, E') ω N] (ψ' : E' ≃L[K] (Fin n → K))
    (F : ofManifold K E M ⟶ ofManifold K E' N) : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, E') ω (baseFun F)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [contMDiffAt_iff_target]
  refine ⟨(continuous_baseFun F).continuousAt, ?_⟩
  set χ := chartAt E' (baseFun F x) with hχdef
  have hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E') ω N := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (baseFun F x)
  
  let W : Opens M := (Opens.map F.1.base).obj (chartSourceOpens χ)
  have hxW : x ∈ W := mem_chart_source E' (baseFun F x)
  let g : Fin n → M → K := fun i =>
    extendSection K E ((F.1.c.app (op (chartSourceOpens χ))).hom (chartSection E' ψ' χ hχ i))
  have hg : ∀ i, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K) ω (g i) W := fun i => contMDiffOn_extendSection _
  have hval : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ i, g i y = ψ' (χ (baseFun F y)) i := by
    intro y hy i
    have hy' : F.1.base y ∈ chartSourceOpens χ := hy
    exact (extendSection_of_mem K E _ hy).trans (sheafHom_apply F (chartSourceOpens χ) _ y hy')
  
  have hG : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, Fin n → K) ω (fun y i => g i y) W :=
    contMDiffOn_pi_module_iff.mpr hg
  have hχF : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, E') ω (χ ∘ baseFun F) W := by
    refine (((ψ'.symm : (Fin n → K) →L[K] E').contMDiff).comp_contMDiffOn hG).congr ?_
    intro y hy
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    have : (fun i => g i y) = ψ' (χ (baseFun F y)) := funext fun i => hval y hy i
    rw [this]
    exact (ψ'.symm_apply_apply _).symm
  have hext : (↑(extChartAt 𝓘(K, E') (baseFun F x)) ∘ baseFun F) = χ ∘ baseFun F := by
    rw [extChartAt_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe, Function.id_comp]
  rw [hext]
  exact hχF.contMDiffAt (W.isOpen.mem_nhds hxW)

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.ringHom_ext_of_coord'
statement:
theorem ringHom_ext_of_coord' {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (ψ : E ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) {φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E} (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M)
    {a : M} (ha : a ∈ φ.source) (α β : (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* R)
    (hα : IsLocalHom α) (hβ : IsLocalHom β)
    (hc : ∀ c : K, α (const K E M a c) = β (const K E M a c))
    (hz : ∀ i, α (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i) = β (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i)) : α = β
proof:
:= by
  set S := RingHom.eqLocus α β
  have hcS : ∀ c, const K E M a c ∈ S := hc
  have hzS : ∀ i, coord E ψ φ hφ ha i ∈ S := hz
  have approx : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ s : (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk a,
      ∃ P ∈ S,
        s - P ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk a)) ^ N := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero => intro s; exact ⟨0, S.zero_mem, by simp⟩
    | succ N ih =>
      intro s
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_eq_sum_coord_mul' E ψ φ ha hφ (s - const K E M a
          (Manifold.eval K E M a s))
        (by rw [map_sub, eval_const, sub_self])
      choose P hPS hP using fun i => ih (g i)
      refine ⟨const K E M a (Manifold.eval K E M a s) +
        ∑ i, (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i - const K E M a (Manifold.eval K E M a
            (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i))) * P i,
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact S.add_mem (hcS _)
          (S.sum_mem fun i _ => S.mul_mem (S.sub_mem (hzS i) (hcS _)) (hPS i))
      · have : s - (const K E M a (Manifold.eval K E M a s) +
            ∑ i, (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i - const K E M a (Manifold.eval K E M a
                (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i))) *
              P i) =
            ∑ i, (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i - const K E M a (Manifold.eval K E M a
                (coord E ψ φ hφ ha i))) *
              (g i - P i) := by
          rw [← sub_sub, hg, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (mul_sub _ _ _).symm
        rw [this, pow_succ']
        exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
          Ideal.mul_mem_mul (coord_sub_mem_maximalIdeal E ψ φ ha hφ i) (hP i)
  have hmap : ∀ (γ : (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk a →+* R) (_ : IsLocalHom γ) (N : ℕ)
      (t : (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk a),
      t ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk a)) ^ N →
        γ t ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ^ N := by
    intro γ hγ N t ht
    have := hγ
    have hle : Ideal.map γ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk a)) ≤
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
      intro b hb
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
      rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hb
      exact fun hu => hb ((isUnit_map_iff γ b).mp hu)
    have := Ideal.pow_right_mono hle N
    rw [← Ideal.map_pow] at this
    exact this (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem γ ht)
  ext s
  have hdiff : ∀ N, α s - β s ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ^ N := by
    intro N
    obtain ⟨P, hPS, hP⟩ := approx N s
    have h1 : α s - β s = α (s - P) - β (s - P) := by
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, (hPS : α P = β P)]
      ring
    rw [h1]
    exact Ideal.sub_mem _ (hmap α hα N _ hP) (hmap β hβ N _ hP)
  have hmem : α s - β s ∈ ⨅ N, (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ^ N := Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr hdiff
  rw [Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing _ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top,
    Ideal.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hmem

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.hom_ext_baseFun
statement:
theorem hom_ext_baseFun [IsManifold 𝓘(K, E) ω M] [IsManifold 𝓘(K, E') ω N]
    (ψ : E ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) {n' : ℕ} (ψ' : E' ≃L[K] (Fin n' → K))
    (F G : ofManifold K E M ⟶ ofManifold K E' N) (h : baseFun F = baseFun G) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  apply Hom.ext
  have hb : F.1.base = G.1.base := TopCat.ext fun x => congrFun h x
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨b₁, c₁⟩, p₁⟩, hF⟩ := F
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨b₂, c₂⟩, p₂⟩, hG⟩ := G
  change b₁ = b₂ at hb
  subst hb
  let f₁ : (ofManifold K E M).toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ (ofManifold K E' N).toLocallyRingedSpace :=
    ⟨⟨b₁, c₁⟩, p₁⟩
  let f₂ : (ofManifold K E M).toLocallyRingedSpace ⟶ (ofManifold K E' N).toLocallyRingedSpace :=
    ⟨⟨b₁, c₂⟩, p₂⟩
  let F₁ : ofManifold K E M ⟶ ofManifold K E' N := ⟨f₁, hF⟩
  let F₂ : ofManifold K E M ⟶ ofManifold K E' N := ⟨f₂, hG⟩
  have hc : c₁ = c₂ := by
    ext U s
    apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext (structureSheaf K E M)
    intro y hy
    
    have hN : IsNoetherianRing ((structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk y) :=
      isNoetherianRing_stalk_of_chart E ψ (chartAt E y) (mem_chart_source E y)
        (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas y)
    let α : (structureSheaf K E' N).presheaf.stalk (b₁ y) →+*
        (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk y := (f₁.stalkMap y).hom
    let β : (structureSheaf K E' N).presheaf.stalk (b₁ y) →+*
        (structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.stalk y := (f₂.stalkMap y).hom
    have i₁ : IsLocalHom α := p₁ y
    have i₂ : IsLocalHom β := p₂ y
    set χ := chartAt E' (baseFun F₁ y) with hχdef
    have hχ : χ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E') ω N := IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas (baseFun F₁ y)
    have hby : baseFun F₁ y ∈ χ.source := mem_chart_source E' (baseFun F₁ y)
    have key : α = β := by
      refine ringHom_ext_of_coord' ψ' hχ hby α β i₁ i₂
        (fun c => (F₁.algebraMap_stalk y c).trans (F₂.algebraMap_stalk y c).symm) fun i => ?_
      
      have hsec : (c₁.app (op (chartSourceOpens χ))).hom (chartSection E' ψ' χ hχ i) =
          (c₂.app (op (chartSourceOpens χ))).hom (chartSection E' ψ' χ hχ i) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        funext ⟨z, hz⟩
        exact (sheafHom_apply F₁ (chartSourceOpens χ) _ z hz).trans
          (sheafHom_apply F₂ (chartSourceOpens χ) _ z hz).symm
      exact (PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply f₁.toShHom.hom (chartSourceOpens χ) y hby
        (chartSection E' ψ' χ hχ i)).trans ((congrArg
          ((structureSheaf K E M).presheaf.germ ((Opens.map b₁).obj (chartSourceOpens χ)) y hby)
            hsec).trans
          (PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply f₂.toShHom.hom (chartSourceOpens χ) y hby
            (chartSection E' ψ' χ hχ i)).symm)
    refine (PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply f₁.toShHom.hom U y hy s).symm.trans ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_apply f₂.toShHom.hom U y hy s)
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun key _
  subst hc
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.toSpaceFun_toSpaceHom
statement:

name: AnalyticSpace.contMDiff_toSpaceFun
statement:

    ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, E) ω (toSpaceFun ψ F)

name: AnalyticSpace.toSpaceHom_injective
statement:
theorem toSpaceHom_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (toSpaceHom ψ : AnalyticMap M N → (toSpace ψ M ⟶ toSpace ψ N))
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  have h : toSpaceFun ψ (toSpaceHom ψ f) = toSpaceFun ψ (toSpaceHom ψ g) := by rw [hfg]
  rw [toSpaceFun_toSpaceHom, toSpaceFun_toSpaceHom] at h
  exact DFunLike.coe_injective h

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_toSpaceHom_eq
statement:
theorem exists_toSpaceHom_eq (F : toSpace ψ M ⟶ toSpace ψ N) :
    ∃ f : AnalyticMap M N, toSpaceHom ψ f = F
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨toSpaceFun ψ F, contMDiff_toSpaceFun ψ F⟩, hom_ext_toSpaceFun ψ _ _ rfl⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.toSpace_fullyFaithful
statement:
theorem toSpace_fullyFaithful :
    Function.Bijective
      (toSpaceHom ψ : AnalyticMap M N → (toSpace ψ M ⟶ toSpace ψ N))
proof:
:=
  ⟨toSpaceHom_injective ψ, exists_toSpaceHom_eq ψ⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.ofManifoldHom_congr
statement:
theorem ofManifoldHom_congr {f g : M → N} (h : f = g) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, E') ω f) :
    ofManifoldHom f hf = ofManifoldHom g (h ▸ hf)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.ofManifoldIso_hom
statement:
theorem ofManifoldIso_hom (f : M → N) (g : N → M) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, E') ω f)
    (hg : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E') 𝓘(K, E) ω g) (hgf : ∀ x, g (f x) = x) (hfg : ∀ y, f (g y) = y) :
    (ofManifoldIso f g hf hg hgf hfg).hom = ofManifoldHom f hf
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.mem_chartOpens
statement: theorem mem_chartOpens {y : Kn.{u} K n} : y ∈ chartOpens ψ φ ↔ ψ.symm y.down ∈ φ.target
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.chartFromOpens_chartToOpens
statement:
theorem chartFromOpens_chartToOpens (x : chartSourceOpens φ) :
    chartFromOpens ψ φ (chartToOpens ψ φ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change φ.symm (ψ.symm ((ULift.up (ψ (φ x)) : Kn.{u} K n).down)) = x
  rw [ULift.down_up, ψ.symm_apply_apply, φ.left_inv x.2]

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.chartToOpens_chartFromOpens
statement:
theorem chartToOpens_chartFromOpens (y : chartOpens ψ φ) :
    chartToOpens ψ φ (chartFromOpens ψ φ y) = y
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ULift.up (ψ (φ (φ.symm (ψ.symm y.1.down)))) = y.1
  rw [φ.right_inv ((mem_chartOpens ψ φ).mp y.2), ψ.apply_symm_apply, ULift.up_down]

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.contMDiff_ulift_coord
statement:
theorem contMDiff_ulift_coord :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) ω (fun e : E => (ULift.up (ψ e) : Kn.{u} K n))
proof:
:=
  ((ψ.trans ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift.symm : E ≃L[K] Kn.{u} K n) :
    E →L[K] Kn.{u} K n).contMDiff

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.contMDiff_coord_down
statement:
theorem contMDiff_coord_down :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) 𝓘(K, E) ω (fun y : Kn.{u} K n => ψ.symm y.down)
proof:
:=
  ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.ulift.trans ψ.symm : Kn.{u} K n ≃L[K] E) :
    Kn.{u} K n →L[K] E).contMDiff

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.contMDiff_chartToOpens
statement:
theorem contMDiff_chartToOpens (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) ω (chartToOpens ψ φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (contMDiff_subtypeVal_comp_iff' _).mp ?_
  have h1 : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, E) 𝓘(K, E) ω (φ ∘ (Subtype.val : chartSourceOpens φ → M)) :=
    (contMDiffOn_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ).comp_contMDiff contMDiff_subtype_val fun x => x.2
  exact (contMDiff_ulift_coord ψ).comp h1

name: AnalyticSpace.KLocallyRingedSpace.contMDiff_chartFromOpens
statement:
theorem contMDiff_chartFromOpens (hφ : φ ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(K, E) ω M) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) 𝓘(K, E) ω (chartFromOpens ψ φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (contMDiff_subtypeVal_comp_iff' _).mp ?_
  have h1 : ContMDiff 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) 𝓘(K, E) ω
      ((fun y : Kn.{u} K n => ψ.symm y.down) ∘ (Subtype.val : chartOpens ψ φ → Kn.{u} K n)) :=
    (contMDiff_coord_down ψ).comp contMDiff_subtype_val
  exact (contMDiffOn_symm_of_mem_maximalAtlas hφ).comp_contMDiff h1
    fun y => (mem_chartOpens ψ φ).mp y.2

name: AnalyticSpace.stalkIdeal_modelIdeal_noEquations
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_modelIdeal_noEquations (G : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)) (x : analyticSpaceOfOpen K n G) :
    (modelIdeal K n G (noEquations K n G)).stalkIdeal x = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine (IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofGlobal _ _ x).trans ?_
  rw [Set.range_eq_empty, Ideal.span_empty]

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_finset_inf_opens
statement:
theorem mem_finset_inf_opens {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Opens X) {x : X}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, x ∈ f i) : x ∈ s.inf f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.inf_insert, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf]
    exact ⟨h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s), ih fun i hi => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.finset_inf_opens_le
statement:
theorem finset_inf_opens_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Opens X) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    s.inf f ≤ f i
proof:
:=
  Finset.inf_le hi

name: AnalyticSpace.res_res_eq_res
statement:
theorem res_res_eq_res {U V W : Opens X} (hVU : V ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V) (s : F.presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op s) =
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).op s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_res_eq_of_germ_eq
statement:
theorem exists_res_eq_of_germ_eq {U : Opens X} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (s t : F.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (h : F.presheaf.germ U x hx s = F.presheaf.germ U x hx t) :
    ∃ (W : Opens X) (hWU : W ≤ U) (_ : x ∈ W),
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op s = F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iU, iV, hW⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq F.presheaf x hx hx s t h
  refine ⟨W, iU.le, hxW, ?_⟩
  have e1 : iU = homOfLE iU.le := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have e2 : iV = homOfLE iU.le := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rwa [e1, e2] at hW

name: AnalyticSpace.polyOfCoeff_weierstrassList
statement:
theorem polyOfCoeff_weierstrassList [Nontrivial R] {e d : ℕ} (he : e < d) (c : Fin e → R) :
    polyOfCoeff (weierstrassList e c d) = weierstrassPolynomial e c
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  rw [coeff_polyOfCoeff]
  by_cases hke : k < e
  · rw [dite_eq_left (by omega : k < d), weierstrassList, dite_eq_left hke,
      coeff_weierstrassPolynomial_of_lt _ _ hke]
  · by_cases hk : k = e
    · subst hk
      rw [dite_eq_left he, weierstrassList, dite_eq_right (lt_irrefl _), ite_eq_left rfl]
      have := (monic_weierstrassPolynomial (R := R) k c).coeff_natDegree
      rw [natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial] at this
      exact this.symm
    · have hgt : e < k := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hke) (Ne.symm hk)
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
        (by rw [natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial]; exact hgt)]
      by_cases hkd : k < d
      · rw [dite_eq_left hkd]
        simp only [weierstrassList, dite_eq_right hke, ite_eq_right hk]
      · rw [dite_eq_right hkd]

name: AnalyticSpace.map_weierstrassList
statement:
theorem map_weierstrassList {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (e : ℕ) (c : Fin e → R) (d : ℕ)
    (t : Fin d) :
    f (weierstrassList e c d t) = weierstrassList e (fun j => f (c j)) d t
proof:
:= by
  unfold weierstrassList
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_isRegularIn_of_prod
statement:
theorem exists_isRegularIn_of_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) {d : ℕ} (h : IsRegularIn (∏ i ∈ s, f i) d) {i : ι}
    (hi : i ∈ s) :
    ∃ d', IsRegularIn (f i) d'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing d with
  | empty => exact absurd hi (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha] at h
    obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, -, h₁, h₂⟩ := isRegularIn_of_mul h
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi'
    · exact ⟨d₁, h₁⟩
    · exact ih h₂ hi'

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_res
statement:
theorem hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_res {U W : Opens X} (hWU : W ≤ U) {p : ℕ}
    (g : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (h : HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p fun y hy => relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y hy) :
    HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 W p fun y hy =>
      relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (g j))
        y hy
proof:
:= by
  refine (h.mono hWU).congr fun y hy => ?_
  exact (relationSubmodule_res hWU (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) hy).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_of_res
statement:
theorem hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_of_res {U W : Opens X} (hWU : W ≤ U) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W) {p : ℕ}
    (g : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (h : HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 W p fun y hy =>
      relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (g j))
        y hy) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (hVU : V ≤ U) (_ : x ∈ V) (k : ℕ) (r : Fin k → Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op V)),
      ∀ y (hy : y ∈ V), relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y (hVU hy) =
        Submodule.span (𝒪.presheaf.stalk y)
          (Set.range fun l => fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ V y hy (r l j))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hVW, hxV, k, r, hr⟩ := h x hx
  refine ⟨V, hVW.trans hWU, hxV, k, r, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have := hr y hy
  dsimp only at this
  rw [relationSubmodule_res hWU (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) (hVW hy)] at this
  exact this

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_trans
statement:
theorem TKn_trans (L : (Fin n → K) ≃L[K] (Fin n → K)) (a : Kn.{u} K n)
    (s : (sheafKn K n).presheaf.stalk a) :
    TKn ((knCoord K n).trans L) a s =
      (substConv (L.symm : (Fin n → K) →L[K] (Fin n → K))
        ⟨TKn (knCoord K n) a s, TKn_mem_conv _ a s⟩ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, f, rfl⟩ := (sheafKn K n).presheaf.exists_germ_eq s
  have h1 := (isTaylorHom_TKn ((knCoord K n).trans L) a).2 U hU f
  have h2 := (isTaylorHom_TKn (knCoord K n) a).2 U hU f
  simp only [chartAt_self_eq, OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_symm, OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_apply]
    at h1 h2
  refine eq_of_evalSeries_sub_eventuallyEq ((knCoord K n).trans L) a (TKn_mem_conv _ _ _)
    (substConv _ _).2 ?_
  refine h1.symm.trans ?_
  have hLsymm : Tendsto L.symm (𝓝 (((knCoord K n).trans L) a)) (𝓝 ((knCoord K n) a)) := by
    have := L.symm.continuous.tendsto (((knCoord K n).trans L) a)
    rwa [ContinuousLinearEquiv.trans_apply, L.symm_apply_apply] at this
  have h3 := h2.comp_tendsto hLsymm
  have h4 : ∀ y, (extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) f ∘ id ∘ ((knCoord K n).trans L).symm) y =
      ((extendSection K (Kn.{u} K n) f ∘ id ∘ (knCoord K n).symm) ∘ L.symm) y := by
    intro y
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, id, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_trans_apply]
  refine (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (funext h4)).trans (h3.trans ?_)
  have hsub : Tendsto (fun y => y - ((knCoord K n).trans L) a) (𝓝 (((knCoord K n).trans L) a))
      (𝓝 0) := by
    have := (continuous_sub_right (((knCoord K n).trans L) a)).tendsto
      (((knCoord K n).trans L) a)
    rwa [sub_self] at this
  have h5 := (evalSeries_substConv (L.symm : (Fin n → K) →L[K] (Fin n → K))
    ⟨TKn (knCoord K n) a ((sheafKn K n).presheaf.germ U a hU f), TKn_mem_conv _ a _⟩).comp_tendsto
      hsub
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.trans (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_) h5.symm
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  congr 1
  simp only [id, map_sub, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ {U : Opens X} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (s : F.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hs : IsUnit (F.presheaf.germ U x hx s)) :
    ∃ (W : Opens X) (hWU : W ≤ U) (_ : x ∈ W), IsUnit (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hs.exists_right_inv
  obtain ⟨V, hV, t', rfl⟩ := F.presheaf.exists_germ_eq t
  have hxUV : x ∈ U ⊓ V := by
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf]; exact ⟨hx, hV⟩
  have h1 : F.presheaf.germ (U ⊓ V) x hxUV
      (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)).op s *
        F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)).op t') =
      F.presheaf.germ (U ⊓ V) x hxUV 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, map_one]
    exact ht
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iW, iW', hW⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq F.presheaf x hxUV hxUV _ _ h1
  have e1 : iW = homOfLE iW.le := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have e2 : iW' = homOfLE iW'.le := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [e1, e2, map_mul, map_one, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp, homOfLE_comp] at hW
  refine ⟨W, iW.le.trans inf_le_left, hxW, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨⟨_, F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (iW.le.trans inf_le_right)).op t', hW,
    by rw [mul_comm]; exact hW⟩, rfl⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_relationSubmodule_row_iff
statement:
theorem mem_relationSubmodule_row_iff (g : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ U)
    (a : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) :
    a ∈ relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y hy ↔
      ∑ j, 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y hy (g j) * a j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_relationSubmodule_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => h 0, fun h _ => h⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_zero
statement:
theorem hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_zero (g : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)) (hg : ∀ j, g j = 0) :
    HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p fun y hy => relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y hy
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨U, le_rfl, hx, p, fun l j => if l = j then 1 else 0, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  have htop : relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y hy = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro a _
    rw [mem_relationSubmodule_row_iff]
    simp [hg]
  rw [htop]
  have : (fun l => fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y hy
      (if l = j then (1 : 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U)) else 0)) =
      fun l : Fin p => (Pi.single l (1 : 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y) := by
    funext l j
    by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst hlj; simp
    · simp [hlj, Ne.symm hlj]
  rw [this, span_range_single_one_eq_top]

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_comp_perm
statement:
theorem hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_comp_perm (g : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin p))
    (h : HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p fun y hy => relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g ∘ σ) y hy) :
    HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p fun y hy => relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y hy
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k, r, hr⟩ := h x hx
  refine ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k, fun l => r l ∘ σ.symm, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ a : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y,
      a ∈ relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y (hVU hy) ↔
        a ∘ σ ∈ relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g ∘ σ) y (hVU hy) := by
    intro a
    rw [mem_relationSubmodule_row_iff, mem_relationSubmodule_row_iff]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp σ (fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hVU hy) (g j) * a j)]
  have hry := hr y hy
  dsimp only at hry ⊢
  ext a
  rw [key, hry, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    funext j
    have := congrFun hc (σ.symm j)
    simpa [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Function.comp_apply] using this
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    funext j
    have := congrFun hc (σ j)
    simpa [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Function.comp_apply] using this

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_mul_units
statement:
theorem hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_mul_units (g u : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.obj (op U))
    (hu : ∀ j, IsUnit (u j))
    (h : HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p fun y hy => relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y hy) :
    HasLocalGeneratorsOn 𝒪 U p fun y hy =>
      relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun j => u j * g j) y hy
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k, r, hr⟩ := h x hx
  choose v hv using fun j => (hu j).exists_right_inv
  refine ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k, fun l j => 𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (v j) * r l j,
    fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have hry := hr y hy
  dsimp only at hry ⊢
  
  have huv : ∀ j, 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hVU hy) (u j) * 𝒪.presheaf.germ V y hy
      (𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (v j)) = 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, ← map_mul, hv j, map_one]
  have key : ∀ a : Fin p → 𝒪.presheaf.stalk y,
      a ∈ relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun j => u j * g j) y (hVU hy) ↔
        (fun j => 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hVU hy) (u j) * a j) ∈
          relationSubmodule 𝒪 (fun _ : Fin 1 => g) y (hVU hy) := by
    intro a
    rw [mem_relationSubmodule_row_iff, mem_relationSubmodule_row_iff]
    refine Eq.congr_left (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [map_mul]; ring
  ext a
  rw [key, hry, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    funext j
    have h1 := congrFun hc j
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h1 ⊢
    calc ∑ l, c l * (𝒪.presheaf.germ V y hy (𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (v j) * r l j))
        = 𝒪.presheaf.germ V y hy (𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (v j)) *
          ∑ l, c l * 𝒪.presheaf.germ V y hy (r l j) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
          rw [map_mul]; ring
      _ = 𝒪.presheaf.germ V y hy (𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (v j)) *
          (𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hVU hy) (u j) * a j) := by rw [h1]
      _ = a j := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hVU hy) (u j)), huv, one_mul]
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    funext j
    have h1 := congrFun hc j
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h1 ⊢
    rw [← h1, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    rw [map_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (𝒪.presheaf.germ U y (hVU hy) (u j)) (c l),
      mul_assoc (c l), huv, mul_one]

name: AnalyticSpace.coeff_polyOfCoeff
statement:
theorem coeff_polyOfCoeff {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → R) (k : ℕ) :
    (polyOfCoeff c).coeff k = if h : k < N then c ⟨k, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold polyOfCoeff
  rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨k, h⟩
      (fun j _ hj => by rw [ite_eq_right (fun h' => hj (Fin.ext h'.symm))]) (by simp)]
    simp
  · exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => by
      rw [ite_eq_right]
      intro h'
      exact h (by rw [h']; exact j.isLt)

name: AnalyticSpace.natDegree_polyOfCoeff_lt
statement:
theorem natDegree_polyOfCoeff_lt {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → R) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (polyOfCoeff c).natDegree < N
proof:
:= by
  unfold polyOfCoeff
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ (n := N - 1) fun k _ => ?_)
    (Nat.sub_lt hN Nat.one_pos)
  have := k.isLt
  exact (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (by omega)

name: AnalyticSpace.polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → R) : polyOfCoeff c = 0 ↔ ∀ k, c k = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h k => ?_, fun h => by simp [polyOfCoeff, h]⟩
  simpa [coeff_polyOfCoeff] using congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · (k : ℕ)) h

name: AnalyticSpace.x0Sec_apply
statement:
theorem x0Sec_apply (W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)) (i : Fin n) (y : W) :
    x0Sec ψ W i y = ψ (y : Kn.{u} K n) i
proof: := rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.cSec_apply
statement: theorem cSec_apply (W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)) (t : K) (y : W) : cSec W t y = t
proof: := rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_x0Sec
statement:
theorem germ_x0Sec {W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)} {a : Kn.{u} K n} (ha : a ∈ W) (i : Fin n) :
    (sheafKn K n).presheaf.germ W a ha (x0Sec ψ W i) = coordKn ψ a i
proof:
:= by
  apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) ω (Kn.{u} K n) a
  unfold coordKn coord
  erw [stalkToGerm_germ, stalkToGerm_germ]
  apply Filter.Germ.coe_eq.mpr
  have h1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 a, y ∈ W := W.2.mem_nhds ha
  have h2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 a, y ∈ (chartAt (Kn.{u} K n) a).source :=
    (chartAt (Kn.{u} K n) a).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_chart_source _ a)
  filter_upwards [h1, h2] with y hy1 hy2
  rw [extendBy0_of_mem _ _ _ _ hy1, extendBy0_of_mem _ _ _ _ hy2]
  simp only [x0Sec, chartSection, chartAt_self_eq, OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_apply, id]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_cSec
statement:
theorem germ_cSec {W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)} {a : Kn.{u} K n} (ha : a ∈ W) (t : K) :
    (sheafKn K n).presheaf.germ W a ha (cSec W t) = const K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n) a t
proof:
:= by
  apply stalkToGerm_injective 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K n) ω (Kn.{u} K n) a
  erw [const_apply, stalkToGerm_germ, stalkToGerm_germ]
  apply Filter.Germ.coe_eq.mpr
  have h1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 a, y ∈ W := W.2.mem_nhds ha
  filter_upwards [h1] with y hy1
  rw [extendBy0_of_mem _ _ _ _ hy1, extendBy0_of_mem _ _ _ _ (Opens.mem_top y)]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_germ_x0Sec
statement:
theorem TKn_germ_x0Sec {W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)} {a : Kn.{u} K n} (ha : a ∈ W) (i : Fin n) :
    TKn ψ a ((sheafKn K n).presheaf.germ W a ha (x0Sec ψ W i)) =
      MvPowerSeries.X i + MvPowerSeries.C (ψ a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [germ_x0Sec]
  have := TKn_coord_sub_const ψ a i
  rw [map_sub, TKn_const, sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at this
  exact this

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_germ_cSec
statement:
theorem TKn_germ_cSec {W : Opens (Kn.{u} K n)} {a : Kn.{u} K n} (ha : a ∈ W) (t : K) :
    TKn ψ a ((sheafKn K n).presheaf.germ W a ha (cSec W t)) = MvPowerSeries.C t
proof:
:= by
  rw [germ_cSec, TKn_const]

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_baseOpens
statement:
theorem mem_baseOpens {V : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)} {a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)} :
    a ∈ baseOpens ψ V ↔ projKn ψ a ∈ V
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_germ_shiftSec
statement:
theorem TKn_germ_shiftSec (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V) (x0 : K) :
    TKn ψ a ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (shiftSec ψ V x0)) =
      MvPowerSeries.X 0 - MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftSec
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, TKn_germ_x0Sec, TKn_germ_cSec, map_sub]
  ring

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_germ_pullSec
statement:
theorem TKn_germ_pullSec (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V) (w : (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    TKn ψ a ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (pullSec ψ V w)) =
      liftTail (TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a) ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ a) ha w))
proof:
:=
  TKn_germ_comapSection ψ a ha w

name: AnalyticSpace.ofPoly_comp_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem ofPoly_comp_X_sub_C (P : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) (s : K) :
    ofPoly (P.comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C s))) =
      Polynomial.eval₂ (ofPolyHom.comp Polynomial.C) (MvPowerSeries.X 0 - MvPowerSeries.C s) P
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.comp, ofPoly, Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
  congr 1
  change ofPoly _ = _
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ofPoly_add, ofPoly_neg, ofPoly_X, ofPoly_C, liftTail, MvPowerSeries.rename_C,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

name: AnalyticSpace.ofPolyHom_comp_C
statement:
theorem ofPolyHom_comp_C (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) :
    (ofPolyHom.comp Polynomial.C) c = liftTail c
proof:
:=
  ofPoly_C c

name: AnalyticSpace.ofPoly_polyOfCoeff_comp
statement:
theorem ofPoly_polyOfCoeff_comp {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (s : K) :
    ofPoly ((polyOfCoeff c).comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C s))) =
      ∑ k, liftTail (c k) * (MvPowerSeries.X 0 - MvPowerSeries.C s) ^ (k : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPoly_comp_X_sub_C, polyOfCoeff, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_C, Polynomial.eval₂_X_pow, ofPolyHom_comp_C]

name: AnalyticSpace.ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial_comp
statement:
theorem ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial_comp {e : ℕ} (c : Fin e → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (s : K) :
    ofPoly ((weierstrassPolynomial e c).comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C s))) =
      (MvPowerSeries.X 0 - MvPowerSeries.C s) ^ e +
        ∑ j, liftTail (c j) * (MvPowerSeries.X 0 - MvPowerSeries.C s) ^ (e - 1 - (j : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPoly_comp_X_sub_C, weierstrassPolynomial, Polynomial.eval₂_add, Polynomial.eval₂_X_pow,
    Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_C, Polynomial.eval₂_X_pow, ofPolyHom_comp_C]

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_germ_polyComb
statement:
theorem TKn_germ_polyComb (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V) (x0 : K) {N : ℕ}
    (w : Fin N → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    TKn ψ a ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (polyComb ψ V x0 w)) =
      ofPoly ((polyOfCoeff fun k =>
          TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a) ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V _ ha (w k))).comp
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a 0))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPoly_polyOfCoeff_comp, polyComb, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, TKn_germ_pullSec ψ ha, TKn_germ_shiftSec ψ ha]

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_germ_polyMonic
statement:
theorem TKn_germ_polyMonic (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V) (x0 : K) (e : ℕ)
    (c : Fin e → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    TKn ψ a ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (polyMonic ψ V x0 e c)) =
      ofPoly ((weierstrassPolynomial e fun j => TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a)
          ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V _ ha (c j))).comp
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a 0))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial_comp, polyMonic, map_add, map_add, map_pow, map_pow, map_sum,
    map_sum, TKn_germ_shiftSec ψ ha]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, TKn_germ_pullSec ψ ha, TKn_germ_shiftSec ψ ha]

name: AnalyticSpace.monic_weierstrassPolynomial_comp
statement:
theorem monic_weierstrassPolynomial_comp {e : ℕ} (c : Fin e → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (s : K) :
    ((weierstrassPolynomial e c).comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C s))).Monic
proof:
:=
  (monic_weierstrassPolynomial e c).comp_X_sub_C _

name: AnalyticSpace.natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial_comp
statement:
theorem natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial_comp {e : ℕ} (c : Fin e → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K) (s : K) :
    ((weierstrassPolynomial e c).comp
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C s))).natDegree = e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_comp, natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial, Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C,
    mul_one]

name: AnalyticSpace.comp_X_sub_C_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem comp_X_sub_C_eq_zero_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (P : Polynomial R) (r : R) :
    P.comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r) = 0 ↔ P = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg (fun q => q.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C r)) h
    simp only [Polynomial.zero_comp] at this
    rwa [Polynomial.comp_assoc, Polynomial.sub_comp, Polynomial.X_comp, Polynomial.C_comp,
      add_sub_cancel_right, Polynomial.comp_X] at this
  · rintro rfl; exact Polynomial.zero_comp

name: AnalyticSpace.ofPoly_injective
statement: theorem ofPoly_injective : Function.Injective (ofPoly (K := K) (m := m))
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  have := congrArg (splitFirst K m) h
  rw [splitFirst_ofPoly, splitFirst_ofPoly] at this
  exact Polynomial.coe_inj.mp this

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_polyComb_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem germ_polyComb_eq_zero_iff (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V) (x0 : K) {N : ℕ}
    (w : Fin N → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (polyComb ψ V x0 w) = 0 ↔
      ∀ k, (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ a) ha (w k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (TKn_injective ψ a).eq_iff, map_zero, TKn_germ_polyComb ψ ha]
  rw [← ofPoly_zero, ofPoly_injective.eq_iff, comp_X_sub_C_eq_zero_iff, polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun k => ?_
  rw [← (TKn_injective (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a)).eq_iff, map_zero]

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_polyRow
statement:
theorem germ_polyRow {V : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)} {a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)} (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V)
    (x0 : K)
    {q d : ℕ} (pc : Fin q → Fin d → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V)) (j : Fin q) :
    (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (polyRow ψ V x0 pc j) =
      psi ψ a x0 (polyOfCoeff fun t => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ a) ha (pc j t))
proof:
:=
  germ_polyComb_eq_psi ψ ha x0 (pc j)

name: AnalyticSpace.baseOpens_mono
statement: theorem baseOpens_mono {V V' : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)} (h : V' ≤ V) : baseOpens ψ V' ≤ baseOpens ψ V
proof:
:=
  fun _ hy => h hy

name: AnalyticSpace.mem_rowKerR_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rowKerR_iff {p : ℕ} (G : Fin p → R) (P : Fin p → R) :
    P ∈ rowKerR G ↔ ∑ j, G j * P j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowKerR, mem_relKer_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => h 0, fun h _ => h⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.polyOfCoeff_sum_mul
statement:
theorem polyOfCoeff_sum_mul {N k : ℕ} (lam : Fin k → R) (c : Fin k → Fin N → R) :
    polyOfCoeff (fun t => ∑ l, lam l * c l t) = ∑ l, Polynomial.C (lam l) * polyOfCoeff (c l)
proof:
:= by
  unfold polyOfCoeff
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGeneratorsOn_polyRow
statement:
theorem hasLocalGeneratorsOn_polyRow {q d e : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (he : e < d) (V : Opens (Kn.{u} K m))
    (x0 : K)
    (pc : Fin (q + 1) → Fin d → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V))
    (hmonic : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ V),
      (polyOfCoeff fun t => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V b hb (pc 0 t)).Monic ∧
      (polyOfCoeff fun t => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V b hb (pc 0 t)).natDegree = e)
    (hIH : HasLocalGeneratorsOn (sheafKn K m) V ((q + 1) * (3 * d)) fun b hb =>
      relationSubmodule (sheafKn K m) (coeffMatSec pc (d + 3 * d) (3 * d)) b hb) :
    HasLocalGeneratorsOn (sheafKn K (m + 1)) (baseOpens ψ V) (q + 1) fun a ha =>
      relationSubmodule (sheafKn K (m + 1)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => polyRow ψ V x0 pc) a ha
proof:
:= by
  have h3d : 0 < 3 * d := by omega
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨V', hV'V, hbV', k, A, hA⟩ := hIH (projKn ψ a) ha
  refine ⟨baseOpens ψ V', baseOpens_mono ψ hV'V, hbV', k,
    fun l j => polyComb ψ V' x0 fun t => A l (finProdFinEquiv (j, t)), fun a' ha' => ?_⟩
  
  have hV : a' ∈ baseOpens ψ V := baseOpens_mono ψ hV'V ha'
  have hb' : projKn ψ a' ∈ V' := ha'
  have hbV : projKn ψ a' ∈ V := hV'V hb'
  set b0 := projKn ψ a' with hb0
  
  set Ph : Fin (q + 1) → Polynomial ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.stalk b0) :=
    fun j => polyOfCoeff fun t => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V b0 hbV (pc j t) with hPh
  have hPhdeg : ∀ j, (Ph j).natDegree < d := fun j => natDegree_polyOfCoeff_lt _ hd
  
  have hrow : relationSubmodule (sheafKn K (m + 1)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => polyRow ψ V x0 pc) a' hV =
      rowKerR fun j => psi ψ a' x0 (Ph j) := by
    rw [relationSubmodule]
    congr 1
    funext _ j
    exact germ_polyRow ψ hV x0 pc j
  
  have hbase : relKer (coeffMat' Ph (d + 3 * d) (3 * d)) =
      Submodule.span _
        (Set.range fun l => fun i => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V' b0 hb' (A l i)) := by
    rw [← hA b0 hb']
    dsimp only
    rw [relationSubmodule]
    congr 1
    funext l i
    exact (germ_coeffMatSec pc (d + 3 * d) (3 * d) hbV l i).symm
  
  have hR : ∀ l j, (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V') a' ha'
      (polyComb ψ V' x0 fun t => A l (finProdFinEquiv (j, t))) =
      psi ψ a' x0 (polyOfCoeff fun t =>
        (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V' b0 hb' (A l (finProdFinEquiv (j, t)))) :=
    fun l j => germ_polyComb_eq_psi ψ ha' x0 _
  have hflatA : ∀ l, flatCoeff (fun j t =>
      (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V' b0 hb' (A l (finProdFinEquiv (j, t)))) =
      fun i => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V' b0 hb' (A l i) := by
    intro l
    funext i
    simp only [flatCoeff, Prod.mk.eta, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change relationSubmodule (sheafKn K (m + 1)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => polyRow ψ V x0 pc) a' hV = _
  rw [hrow]
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    intro bb hbb
    
    set T := taylorKn ψ a' with hT
    have hTpsi : ∀ j, (T (psi ψ a' x0 (Ph j)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
        ofPoly (((Ph j).map (TKn (knCoord K m) b0)).comp
          (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a' 0)))) := fun j => by
      rw [hT, taylorKn_apply_coe, TKn_psi]
    obtain ⟨F0, hF0def⟩ : ∃ F0 : Analytic.Conv K (m + 1), F0 = T (psi ψ a' x0 (Ph 0)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Fin q → Analytic.Conv K (m + 1),
            ∀ j, F j = T (psi ψ a' x0 (Ph j.succ)) :=
      ⟨fun j => T (psi ψ a' x0 (Ph j.succ)), fun _ => rfl⟩
    have hcons : ∀ j,
        (Fin.cons F0 F : Fin (q + 1) → Analytic.Conv K (m + 1)) j = T (psi ψ a' x0 (Ph j)) := by
      intro j
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · simp [hF0def]
      · simp [hFdef]
    
    have hQmonic : (((Ph 0).map (TKn (knCoord K m) b0)).comp
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a' 0)))).Monic :=
      ((hmonic b0 hbV).1.map _).comp_X_sub_C _
    have hQdeg : (((Ph 0).map (TKn (knCoord K m) b0)).comp
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a' 0)))).natDegree = e := by
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_comp, Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one,
        Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective (TKn_injective (knCoord K m) b0)]
      exact (hmonic b0 hbV).2
    have hF0 : (F0 : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
        ofPoly (((Ph 0).map (TKn (knCoord K m) b0)).comp
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a' 0)))) := by
      rw [hF0def, hTpsi]
    have hF : ∀ j, DegLt d (F j : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
      intro j
      rw [hFdef, hTpsi]
      apply degLt_ofPoly_of_natDegree_lt
      calc (((Ph j.succ).map (TKn (knCoord K m) b0)).comp
            (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a' 0)))).natDegree
          ≤ ((Ph j.succ).map (TKn (knCoord K m) b0)).natDegree *
            (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a' 0))).natDegree :=
            Polynomial.natDegree_comp_le
        _ = ((Ph j.succ).map (TKn (knCoord K m) b0)).natDegree := by
            rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one]
        _ ≤ (Ph j.succ).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_map_le
        _ < d := hPhdeg _
    
    have hTb : (fun j => T (bb j)) ∈ rowKer (Fin.cons F0 F) := by
      rw [mem_rowKer_iff]
      have h1 := (mem_rowKerR_iff _ _).1 hbb
      have h2 := congrArg T h1
      rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h2
      rw [← h2]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [hcons, map_mul]
    have hOka := rowKer_le_span_degLt he hQmonic hQdeg F0 hF0 F hF hTb
    
    have key : ∀ y (_ : y ∈ Submodule.span (Analytic.Conv K (m + 1))
            (degLtRel (3 * d) (Fin.cons F0 F))),
        (fun j => T.symm (y j)) ∈ Submodule.span ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.stalk a')
          (Set.range fun l j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V') a' ha'
            (polyComb ψ V' x0 fun t => A l (finProdFinEquiv (j, t)))) := by
      intro y hy
      induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem y hy =>
        obtain ⟨hydeg, hyrel⟩ := hy
        
        have hdeg : ∀ j, DegLt (3 * d) (TKn ψ a' (T.symm (y j))) := fun j => by
          rw [← taylorKn_apply_coe, hT, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
          exact hydeg j
        choose Q hQdeg' hQ using fun j => exists_psi_eq_of_degLt ψ a' x0 h3d (T.symm (y j)) (hdeg j)
        
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Fin (q + 1) → Fin (3 * d) → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.stalk b0,
            ∀ j, polyOfCoeff (c j) = Q j :=
          ⟨fun j t => (Q j).coeff t, fun j => polyOfCoeff_coeff (Q j) (hQdeg' j)⟩
        have hrel : ∑ j, Ph j * polyOfCoeff (c j) = 0 := by
          apply psi_injective ψ a' x0
          rw [map_sum, map_zero]
          have h1 := (mem_rowKer_iff _ _).1 hyrel
          have h2 := congrArg T.symm h1
          rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h2
          rw [← h2]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
          rw [map_mul, hcons, map_mul, hT, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hc, hQ]
        rw [sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff_mem_relKer Ph hPhdeg c h3d, hbase,
          Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hrel
        obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := hrel
        
        have hy' : (fun j => T.symm (y j)) = ∑ l, germMapProj ψ a' (lam l) •
            (fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V') a' ha'
              (polyComb ψ V' x0 fun t => A l (finProdFinEquiv (j, t))) :
                Fin (q + 1) → (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.stalk a') := by
          funext j
          rw [← hQ j, ← hc j]
          have hcj : c j = fun t => ∑ l,
              lam l * (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V' b0 hb' (A l (finProdFinEquiv (j, t))) := by
            funext t
            have := congrFun hlam (finProdFinEquiv (j, t))
            rw [flatCoeff_apply] at this
            rw [← this]
            simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [hcj, polyOfCoeff_sum_mul, map_sum]
          simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hR]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
          rw [map_mul, psi_C]
        rw [hy']
        exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩)
      | zero =>
        have : (fun j => T.symm ((0 : Fin (q + 1) → Analytic.Conv K (m + 1)) j)) = 0 := by
          funext j; simp
        rw [this]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
        have : (fun j => T.symm ((y + z) j)) = (fun j => T.symm (y j)) + fun j => T.symm (z j) := by
          funext j; simp [map_add]
        rw [this]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
      | smul s y _ hy =>
        have : (fun j => T.symm ((s • y) j)) = T.symm s • fun j => T.symm (y j) := by
          funext j; simp [map_mul]
        rw [this]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
    have := key _ hOka
    simpa [hT, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using this
  · 
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_rowKerR_iff]
    simp only [hR]
    have h1 : ∑ j, Ph j * polyOfCoeff (fun t =>
        (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V' b0 hb' (A l (finProdFinEquiv (j, t)))) = 0 := by
      rw [sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff_mem_relKer Ph hPhdeg _ h3d, hflatA, hbase]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩
    have h2 := congrArg (psi ψ a' x0) h1
    rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h2
    rw [← h2]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_germMap
statement:
theorem TKn_germMap (a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (x : (sheafKn K m).presheaf.stalk (projKn ψ a)) :
    TKn ψ a (germMapProj ψ a x) = liftTail (TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, g, rfl⟩ := (sheafKn K m).presheaf.exists_germ_eq x
  rw [germMapProj, germMap_germ, TKn_germ_comapSection ψ a hU g]

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_shiftGerm
statement:
theorem TKn_shiftGerm (a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (x0 : K) :
    TKn ψ a (shiftGerm ψ a x0) = MvPowerSeries.X 0 - MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftGerm
  have := TKn_coord_sub_const ψ a 0
  rw [map_sub, TKn_const, sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at this
  rw [map_sub, this, TKn_const, map_sub]
  ring

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_shiftSec
statement:
theorem germ_shiftSec {V : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)} {a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)} (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V)
    (x0 : K) :
    (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (shiftSec ψ V x0) =
      shiftGerm ψ a x0
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftSec shiftGerm
  rw [map_sub, germ_x0Sec, germ_cSec]

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_pullSec
statement:
theorem germ_pullSec {V : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)} {a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)} (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V)
    (w : (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (pullSec ψ V w) =
      germMapProj ψ a ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ a) ha w)
proof:
:=
  (germMap_germ (projKn ψ) (contMDiff_projKn ψ) ha w).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.psi_C
statement:
theorem psi_C (a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (x0 : K)
    (x : (sheafKn K m).presheaf.stalk (projKn ψ a)) :
    psi ψ a x0 (Polynomial.C x) = germMapProj ψ a x
proof:
:= by
  simp [psi]

name: AnalyticSpace.psi_X
statement: theorem psi_X (a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (x0 : K) : psi ψ a x0 Polynomial.X = shiftGerm ψ a x0
proof:
:= by
  simp [psi]

name: AnalyticSpace.ofPoly_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem ofPoly_X_sub_C (s : K) :
    ofPoly (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C s) :
        Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K)) =
      MvPowerSeries.X 0 - MvPowerSeries.C s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ofPoly_add, ofPoly_neg, ofPoly_X, ofPoly_C, liftTail, MvPowerSeries.rename_C,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_psi
statement:
theorem TKn_psi (a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (x0 : K)
    (Q : Polynomial ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.stalk (projKn ψ a))) :
    TKn ψ a (psi ψ a x0 Q) = ofPoly ((Q.map (TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a))).comp
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a 0))))
proof:
:= by
  have key : (TKn ψ a).comp (psi ψ a x0) =
      (ofPolyHom.comp (Polynomial.compRingHom
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a 0))))).comp
        (Polynomial.mapRingHom (TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a))) := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun x => ?_) ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C,
        Polynomial.coe_compRingHom_apply, Polynomial.C_comp]
      rw [psi_C, TKn_germMap]
      exact (ofPoly_C _).symm
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X,
        Polynomial.coe_compRingHom_apply, Polynomial.X_comp]
      rw [psi_X, TKn_shiftGerm]
      exact (ofPoly_X_sub_C _).symm
  have := congrArg (fun f => f Q) key
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.coe_compRingHom_apply]
    at this
  exact this

name: AnalyticSpace.psi_injective
statement: theorem psi_injective (a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (x0 : K) : Function.Injective (psi ψ a x0)
proof:
:= by
  intro Q Q' h
  have h1 := congrArg (TKn ψ a) h
  rw [TKn_psi, TKn_psi, ofPoly_injective.eq_iff] at h1
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun P => P.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a 0)))) h1
  simp only [Polynomial.comp_assoc, Polynomial.sub_comp, Polynomial.X_comp, Polynomial.C_comp,
    add_sub_cancel_right, Polynomial.comp_X] at h2
  exact Polynomial.map_injective _ (TKn_injective (knCoord K m) _) h2

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_polyComb_eq_psi
statement:
theorem germ_polyComb_eq_psi {V : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)} {a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)}
    (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V) (x0 : K) {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (polyComb ψ V x0 w) =
      psi ψ a x0 (∑ k, Polynomial.C ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ a) ha (w k)) *
        Polynomial.X ^ (k : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyComb, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_mul, map_pow, psi_C, psi_X, germ_pullSec ψ ha, germ_shiftSec ψ ha]

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_polyMonic_eq_psi
statement:
theorem germ_polyMonic_eq_psi {V : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)} {a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)}
    (ha : a ∈ baseOpens ψ V) (x0 : K) (e : ℕ) (c : Fin e → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V)) :
    (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) a ha (polyMonic ψ V x0 e c) =
      psi ψ a x0 (weierstrassPolynomial e fun j =>
        (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ a) ha (c j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyMonic, weierstrassPolynomial, map_add, map_pow, map_sum, map_add, map_pow, map_sum,
    psi_X, germ_shiftSec ψ ha]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_mul, map_pow, psi_C, psi_X, germ_pullSec ψ ha, germ_shiftSec ψ ha]

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_psi_eq_of_degLt
statement:
theorem exists_psi_eq_of_degLt (a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (x0 : K) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (b : (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.stalk a) (hb : DegLt N (TKn ψ a b)) :
    ∃ Q : Polynomial ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.stalk (projKn ψ a)),
      Q.natDegree < N ∧ psi ψ a x0 Q = b
proof:
:= by
  set P := toPoly N (TKn ψ a b) with hP
  have hPdeg : P.natDegree < N := natDegree_toPoly_lt N _ hN
  have hPconv : ∀ k, P.coeff k ∈ Analytic.Conv K m := fun k => by
    rw [hP, toPoly, PowerSeries.coeff_trunc]
    split_ifs
    · exact coeff_splitFirst_mem_conv (TKn_mem_conv ψ a b) k
    · exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
  
  choose q hq using fun k => exists_TKn_eq (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a) (hPconv k)
  set Q0 : Polynomial ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.stalk (projKn ψ a)) :=
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P.natDegree + 1), Polynomial.C (q k) * Polynomial.X ^ k with hQ0
  have hQ0map : Q0.map (TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a)) = P := by
    rw [hQ0, Polynomial.map_sum]
    simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, hq]
    exact (Polynomial.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow P).symm
  have hQ0deg : Q0.natDegree ≤ P.natDegree := by
    rw [hQ0]
    refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun k hk => ?_
    exact (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans
      (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk))
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_TKn_eq (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a)
    (show MvPowerSeries.C (x0 - ψ a 0) ∈ Analytic.Conv K m from monomial_mem_conv 0 _)
  refine ⟨Q0.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C t), ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc (Q0.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C t)).natDegree
        ≤ Q0.natDegree * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C t).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_comp_le
      _ = Q0.natDegree := by rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_add_C, mul_one]
      _ < N := lt_of_le_of_lt hQ0deg hPdeg
  · apply TKn_injective ψ a
    rw [TKn_psi, Polynomial.map_comp, hQ0map, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.map_C, ht, Polynomial.comp_assoc, Polynomial.add_comp, Polynomial.X_comp,
      Polynomial.C_comp,
      sub_add_cancel, Polynomial.comp_X, hP, ofPoly_toPoly hb]

proof: := rfl

    TKn ψ a (const K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n) a c) = MvPowerSeries.C c
proof:
:=
  IsTaylorHom.map_const _ _ _ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a) (mem_chart_source _ a)

theorem eval_coordKn (a : Kn.{u} K n) (i : Fin n) :
    Manifold.eval K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n) a (coordKn ψ a i) = ψ a i
proof:

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_coord_sub_const
statement:
theorem TKn_coord_sub_const (a : Kn.{u} K n) (i : Fin n) :
    TKn ψ a (coordKn ψ a i - const K (Kn.{u} K n) (Kn.{u} K n) a (ψ a i)) =
      MvPowerSeries.X i
proof:

  rw [← eval_coordKn ψ a i]
  exact IsTaylorHom.map_coord_sub_const _ _ _ (IsManifold.chart_mem_maximalAtlas a)
    (mem_chart_source _ a) (isTaylorHom_TKn ψ a) i

statement: theorem tailProjCLM_apply (y : Fin (m + 1) → K) : tailProjCLM K m y = Fin.tail y
