name: AnalyticSpace.contMDiff_projKn
statement:
theorem contMDiff_projKn :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) 𝓘(K, Kn.{u} K m) ω (projKn ψ)
proof:
:=
  (projKn ψ).contMDiff

name: AnalyticSpace.extendSection_comapSection
statement:
theorem extendSection_comapSection {U : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)}
    (g : (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op U)) (x : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) :
    extendSection K (Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (comapSection (projKn ψ) (contMDiff_projKn ψ) g) x =
      extendSection K (Kn.{u} K m) g (projKn ψ x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : projKn ψ x ∈ U
  · rw [extendSection_of_mem _ _ g hx,
      extendSection_of_mem _ _ _ ((mem_preimageOpens _ _).mpr hx : x ∈ preimageOpens _ _ U),
      comapSection_apply]
  · simp only [extendSection, extendBy0, dite_eq_right hx]
    rw [dite_eq_right]
    exact fun h => hx ((mem_preimageOpens _ _).mp h)

name: AnalyticSpace.TKn_germ_comapSection
statement:
theorem TKn_germ_comapSection (a : Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) {U : Opens (Kn.{u} K m)}
    (hU : projKn ψ a ∈ U) (g : (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    TKn ψ a ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (preimageOpens (projKn ψ) (contMDiff_projKn ψ) U) a
        ((mem_preimageOpens _ _).mpr hU) (comapSection (projKn ψ) (contMDiff_projKn ψ) g)) =
      liftTail (TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a)
        ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ U (projKn ψ a) hU g))
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 := (isTaylorHom_TKn ψ a).2 (preimageOpens (projKn ψ) (contMDiff_projKn ψ) U)
    ((mem_preimageOpens _ _).mpr hU) (comapSection (projKn ψ) (contMDiff_projKn ψ) g)
  have h2 := (isTaylorHom_TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a)).2 U hU g
  simp only [chartAt_self_eq, OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_symm, OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_apply]
    at h1 h2
  refine eq_of_evalSeries_sub_eventuallyEq ψ a (TKn_mem_conv ψ a _)
    (liftTail_mem_conv (TKn_mem_conv _ _ _)) ?_
  refine h1.symm.trans ?_
  
  have hcomp : ∀ y : Fin (m + 1) → K,
      (extendSection K (Kn.{u} K (m + 1)) (comapSection (projKn ψ) (contMDiff_projKn ψ) g) ∘
        id ∘ ψ.symm) y =
      (extendSection K (Kn.{u} K m) g ∘ id ∘ (knCoord K m).symm) (Fin.tail y) := by
    intro y
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, id]
    rw [extendSection_comapSection, projKn_apply, ψ.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have htail :
      Tendsto Fin.tail (𝓝 (ψ a)) (𝓝 ((knCoord K m) (projKn ψ a))) := by
    have hfun : (⇑(tailProjCLM K m) : (Fin (m + 1) → K) → Fin m → K) = Fin.tail :=
      funext (tailProjCLM_apply K m)
    rw [← hfun]
    exact (tailProjCLM K m).continuous.tendsto (ψ a)
  have h3 := h2.comp_tendsto htail
  refine (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (funext hcomp)).trans (h3.trans ?_)
  refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, evalSeries_liftTail]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.polyOfCoeff_coeff
statement:
theorem polyOfCoeff_coeff {N : ℕ} (Q : Polynomial R) (hQ : Q.natDegree < N) :
    polyOfCoeff (fun k : Fin N => Q.coeff k) = Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold polyOfCoeff
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => Polynomial.C (Q.coeff k) * Polynomial.X ^ k) N]
  exact (Polynomial.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow' Q hQ).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.coeff_sum_mul_polyOfCoeff
statement:
theorem coeff_sum_mul_polyOfCoeff {q N : ℕ} (P : Fin q → Polynomial R) (c : Fin q → Fin N → R)
    (l : ℕ) :
    (∑ j, P j * polyOfCoeff (c j)).coeff l =
      ∑ jk : Fin q × Fin N,
        (if (jk.2 : ℕ) ≤ l then (P jk.1).coeff (l - jk.2) else 0) * c jk.1 jk.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  unfold polyOfCoeff
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [show P j * (Polynomial.C (c j k) * Polynomial.X ^ (k : ℕ)) =
      Polynomial.C (c j k) * (P j * Polynomial.X ^ (k : ℕ)) by ring,
    Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow']
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: AnalyticSpace.natDegree_sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_lt
statement:
theorem natDegree_sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_lt {q N d : ℕ} (P : Fin q → Polynomial R)
    (hP : ∀ j, (P j).natDegree < d) (c : Fin q → Fin N → R) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∑ j, P j * polyOfCoeff (c j)).natDegree < d + N
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ (n := d + N - 1) fun j _ => ?_) (by omega)
  refine Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans ?_
  have h1 := hP j
  have h2 := natDegree_polyOfCoeff_lt (c j) hN
  omega

name: AnalyticSpace.sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff {q N d : ℕ} (P : Fin q → Polynomial R)
    (hP : ∀ j, (P j).natDegree < d) (c : Fin q → Fin N → R) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∑ j, P j * polyOfCoeff (c j) = 0 ↔
      ∀ l : Fin (d + N),
        ∑ jk : Fin q × Fin N, coeffMat P (d + N) N l jk * c jk.1 jk.2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h l
    have := congrArg (fun Q => Polynomial.coeff Q l) h
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_zero] at this
    rw [coeff_sum_mul_polyOfCoeff] at this
    exact this
  · intro h
    ext l
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero]
    by_cases hl : l < d + N
    · rw [coeff_sum_mul_polyOfCoeff]
      exact h ⟨l, hl⟩
    · exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (natDegree_sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_lt P hP c hN) (not_lt.mp hl))

name: AnalyticSpace.flatCoeff_apply
statement:
theorem flatCoeff_apply {q N : ℕ} (c : Fin q → Fin N → R) (jk : Fin q × Fin N) :
    flatCoeff c (finProdFinEquiv jk) = c jk.1 jk.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [flatCoeff]

name: AnalyticSpace.sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff_mem_relKer
statement:
theorem sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff_mem_relKer {q N d : ℕ} (P : Fin q → Polynomial R)
    (hP : ∀ j, (P j).natDegree < d) (c : Fin q → Fin N → R) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∑ j, P j * polyOfCoeff (c j) = 0 ↔ flatCoeff c ∈ relKer (coeffMat' P (d + N) N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_mul_polyOfCoeff_eq_zero_iff P hP c hN, mem_relKer_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun l => ?_
  rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv finProdFinEquiv
    (fun jk => coeffMat P (d + N) N l jk * c jk.1 jk.2)
    (fun i => coeffMat' P (d + N) N l i * flatCoeff c i)
    (fun jk => by simp [coeffMat', flatCoeff])]

name: AnalyticSpace.germ_coeffMatSec
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : ((finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2 : ℕ) ≤ l
  · by_cases h2 : (l : ℕ) - (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2 < d
    · simp only [coeffMatSec, coeffMat', coeffMat, coeff_polyOfCoeff,
        dite_eq_left (And.intro h1 h2), ite_eq_left h1, dite_eq_left h2]
    · have hn : ¬ (((finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2 : ℕ) ≤ l ∧
          (l : ℕ) - (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2 < d) := fun h => h2 h.2
      simp only [coeffMatSec, coeffMat', coeffMat, coeff_polyOfCoeff, ite_eq_left h1,
        dite_eq_right h2]
      rw [dite_eq_right hn, map_zero]
  · have hn : ¬ (((finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2 : ℕ) ≤ l ∧
        (l : ℕ) - (finProdFinEquiv.symm i).2 < d) := fun h => h1 h.1
    simp only [coeffMatSec, coeffMat', coeffMat, coeff_polyOfCoeff, ite_eq_right h1]
    rw [dite_eq_right hn, map_zero]

name: AnalyticSpace.polyOfCoeff_zero
statement: theorem polyOfCoeff_zero (N : ℕ) : polyOfCoeff (0 : Fin N → R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [polyOfCoeff]

name: AnalyticSpace.weierstrassList_rev
statement:
theorem weierstrassList_rev {e d : ℕ} (he : e < d) (c : Fin e → R) (s : Fin e) :
    weierstrassList e c d ⟨e - 1 - s, by omega⟩ = c s
proof:
:= by
  unfold weierstrassList
  rw [dite_eq_left (by simp; omega)]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp
  omega

name: AnalyticSpace.isCoherent_sheafKn_zero
statement: theorem isCoherent_sheafKn_zero : IsCoherent (sheafKn.{u} K 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro U p q F x hx
  have hfg : (relationSubmodule (sheafKn K 0) F x hx).FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  obtain ⟨k, v, hv⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.mp hfg
  choose Uv hUv sv hsv using fun lj : Fin k × Fin p =>
    (sheafKn K 0).presheaf.exists_germ_eq (v lj.1 lj.2)
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Opens (Kn.{u} K 0), V = U ⊓ Finset.univ.inf Uv := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hxV : x ∈ V := by
    rw [hV, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf]
    exact ⟨hx, mem_finset_inf_opens _ _ fun lj _ => hUv lj⟩
  have hVU : V ≤ U := hV ▸ inf_le_left
  have hVlj : ∀ lj, V ≤ Uv lj := fun lj =>
    hV ▸ inf_le_right.trans (finset_inf_opens_le _ _ (Finset.mem_univ lj))
  refine ⟨V, hVU, hxV, k,
    fun l j => (sheafKn K 0).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVlj (l, j))).op (sv (l, j)), fun y hy => ?_⟩
  obtain rfl : x = y := Subsingleton.elim x y
  dsimp only
  have : (fun l => fun j => (sheafKn K 0).presheaf.germ V x hy
      ((sheafKn K 0).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVlj (l, j))).op (sv (l, j)))) = v := by
    funext l j
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    exact hsv (l, j)
  rw [this, hv]

name: AnalyticSpace.isCoherent_sheafKn_succ
statement:
theorem isCoherent_sheafKn_succ (m : ℕ) (ih : IsCoherent (sheafKn.{u} K m)) :
    IsCoherent (sheafKn.{u} K (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine isCoherent_of_isCoherent_top ?_
  intro U p g _ x hx
  classical
  by_cases hall : ∀ j, (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g j) = 0
  · 
    choose W hWU hxW hW using fun j =>
      exists_res_eq_of_germ_eq (sheafKn K (m + 1)) hx (g j) 0 (by rw [hall j, map_zero])
    obtain ⟨W', hW'⟩ : ∃ W' : Opens (Kn.{u} K (m + 1)), W' = U ⊓ Finset.univ.inf W := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hxW' : x ∈ W' := by
      rw [hW', ← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf]
      exact ⟨hx, mem_finset_inf_opens _ _ fun j _ => hxW j⟩
    have hW'U : W' ≤ U := hW' ▸ inf_le_left
    have hW'j : ∀ j, W' ≤ W j := fun j =>
      hW' ▸ inf_le_right.trans (finset_inf_opens_le _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j))
    refine hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_of_res hW'U hxW' g (hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_zero _ fun j => ?_)
    rw [← res_res_eq_res (sheafKn K (m + 1)) (hWU j) (hW'j j), hW j, map_zero, map_zero]
  · 
    obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := not_forall.mp hall
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q, p = q + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Fin.pos j0).ne'
    
    set σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q + 1)) := Equiv.swap 0 j0 with hσ
    set g' : Fin (q + 1) → (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.obj (op U) := g ∘ σ with hg'
    have hg'0 : (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g' 0) ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [hg', Function.comp_apply, hσ, Equiv.swap_apply_left]; exact hj0
    
    set S : Finset (Fin (q + 1)) :=
      Finset.univ.filter fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g' j) ≠ 0 with hS
    have h0S : (0 : Fin (q + 1)) ∈ S := by simp [hS, hg'0]
    have hSne : ∀ j ∈ S, (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g' j) ≠ 0 := fun j hj =>
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    have hSzero : ∀ j, j ∉ S → (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g' j) = 0 := fun j hj => by
      by_contra h; exact hj (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩)
    set fprod : Analytic.Conv K (m + 1) := ∏ j ∈ S,
      (⟨TKn (knCoord K (m + 1)) x ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g' j)),
        TKn_mem_conv _ x _⟩ : Analytic.Conv K (m + 1))
      with hfprod
    have hf0 : fprod ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hfprod, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
      intro j hj h
      apply hSne j hj
      apply TKn_injective (knCoord K (m + 1)) x
      rw [map_zero]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val h
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_substEquiv_isRegularIn hf0
    set ψ : Kn.{u} K (m + 1) ≃L[K] (Fin (m + 1) → K) := (knCoord K (m + 1)).trans L.symm with hψ
    have hTψ : ∀ s, TKn ψ x s = (substEquiv L ⟨TKn (knCoord K (m + 1)) x s, TKn_mem_conv _ x s⟩ :
        MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) := by
      intro s
      rw [hψ, TKn_trans, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_symm, substEquiv_apply]
    
    have hreg : ∀ j ∈ S,
        ∃ e, IsRegularIn (TKn ψ x ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g' j))) e := by
      intro j hj
      have hprodT : (substEquiv L fprod : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K) =
          ∏ i ∈ S, TKn ψ x ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g' i)) := by
        rw [hfprod, map_prod, ← Subalgebra.coe_val, map_prod]
        exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hTψ]; rfl
      rw [hprodT] at hL
      exact exists_isRegularIn_of_prod S _ hL hj
    choose e' hreg' using hreg
    
    have hprep : ∀ j (hj : j ∈ S), ∃ (u : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K)
        (c : Fin (e' j hj) → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K),
        u ∈ Analytic.Conv K (m + 1) ∧ constantCoeff u ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ k, c k ∈ Analytic.Conv K m ∧ constantCoeff (c k) = 0) ∧
        TKn ψ x ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ U x hx (g' j)) =
          u * weierstrassPoly (e' j hj) c := by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨u, c, hu, hu0, hc, heq, -⟩ :=
        exists_unique_weierstrassPreparation (TKn_mem_conv ψ x _) (hreg' j hj)
      exact ⟨u, c, hu, hu0, hc, heq⟩
    choose u' c' hu' hu'0 hc' heq' using hprep
    
    set d : ℕ := (∑ j ∈ S.attach, e' j.1 j.2) + 1 with hd
    have hd0 : 0 < d := by omega
    have hed : ∀ j (hj : j ∈ S), e' j hj < d := by
      intro j hj
      have : e' j hj ≤ ∑ i ∈ S.attach, e' i.1 i.2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i : S => e' i.1 i.2) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
          (Finset.mem_attach S ⟨j, hj⟩)
      omega
    
    set wl : Fin (q + 1) → Fin d → MvPowerSeries (Fin m) K :=
      fun j => if hj : j ∈ S then weierstrassList (e' j hj) (c' j hj) d else 0 with hwl
    have hwlconv : ∀ j t, wl j t ∈ Analytic.Conv K m := by
      intro j t
      simp only [hwl]
      split_ifs with hj
      · unfold weierstrassList
        split_ifs
        · exact (hc' j hj _).1
        · exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
        · exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
      · exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
    
    choose gc hgc using fun jt : Fin (q + 1) × Fin d =>
      exists_TKn_eq (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ x) (hwlconv jt.1 jt.2)
    choose Uc hUc sc hsc using fun jt : Fin (q + 1) × Fin d =>
      (sheafKn K m).presheaf.exists_germ_eq (gc jt)
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Opens (Kn.{u} K m), V = Finset.univ.inf Uc := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hx'V : projKn ψ x ∈ V := by rw [hV]; exact mem_finset_inf_opens _ _ fun jt _ => hUc jt
    have hVjt : ∀ jt, V ≤ Uc jt := fun jt => hV ▸ finset_inf_opens_le _ _ (Finset.mem_univ jt)
    set sec : Fin (q + 1) → Fin d → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V) :=
      fun j t => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVjt (j, t))).op (sc (j, t)) with hsec
    have hTsec : ∀ j t, TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ x)
        ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ x) hx'V (sec j t)) = wl j t := by
      intro j t
      rw [hsec]; dsimp only
      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, hsc, hgc]
    
    set pc : Fin (q + 1) → Fin d → (sheafKn K m).presheaf.obj (op V) :=
      fun j => if hj : j ∈ S then
        weierstrassList (e' j hj) (fun s => sec j ⟨e' j hj - 1 - s, by have := hed j hj; omega⟩) d
      else 0 with hpc
    
    have hpc_germ : ∀ j (hj : j ∈ S) (b : Kn.{u} K m) (hb : b ∈ V),
        (fun t => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V b hb (pc j t)) =
          weierstrassList (e' j hj) (fun s => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V b hb
            (sec j ⟨e' j hj - 1 - s, by have := hed j hj; omega⟩)) d := by
      intro j hj b hb
      funext t
      simp only [hpc, dite_eq_left hj]
      exact map_weierstrassList _ _ _ _ t
    have hmonic : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ V),
        (polyOfCoeff fun t => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V b hb (pc 0 t)).Monic ∧
        (polyOfCoeff fun t => (sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V b hb (pc 0 t)).natDegree =
          e' 0 h0S := by
      intro b hb
      rw [hpc_germ 0 h0S b hb, polyOfCoeff_weierstrassList (hed 0 h0S)]
      exact ⟨monic_weierstrassPolynomial _ _, natDegree_weierstrassPolynomial _ _⟩
    
    set x0 : K := ψ x 0 with hx0
    have hxbase : x ∈ baseOpens ψ V := hx'V
    have hTP : ∀ j (hj : j ∈ S), TKn ψ x ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) x hxbase
        (polyRow ψ V x0 pc j)) = weierstrassPoly (e' j hj) (c' j hj) := by
      intro j hj
      rw [polyRow, TKn_germ_polyComb ψ hxbase, hx0, sub_self, map_zero, map_zero, sub_zero,
        Polynomial.comp_X]
      have hlist : (fun t => TKn (knCoord K m) (projKn ψ x)
          ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ x) hxbase (pc j t))) =
          weierstrassList (e' j hj) (c' j hj) d := by
        funext t
        rw [congrFun (hpc_germ j hj _ hxbase) t, map_weierstrassList]
        congr 1
        funext s
        rw [hTsec j ⟨e' j hj - 1 - s, by have := hed j hj; omega⟩, hwl]
        simp only [dite_eq_left hj]
        exact weierstrassList_rev (hed j hj) (c' j hj) s
      rw [hlist, polyOfCoeff_weierstrassList (hed j hj),
        ofPoly_weierstrassPolynomial]
    have hTP0 : ∀ j, j ∉ S → (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ (baseOpens ψ V) x hxbase
        (polyRow ψ V x0 pc j) = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      rw [polyRow, germ_polyComb_eq_psi ψ hxbase]
      have : (∑ k : Fin d,
          Polynomial.C ((sheafKn K m).presheaf.germ V (projKn ψ x) hxbase (pc j k)) *
            Polynomial.X ^ (k : ℕ)) = 0 := by
        simp only [hpc, dite_eq_right hj, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      rw [this, map_zero]
    
    set uval : Fin (q + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) K :=
      fun j => if hj : j ∈ S then u' j hj else 1 with huval
    have huvalconv : ∀ j, uval j ∈ Analytic.Conv K (m + 1) := fun j => by
      simp only [huval]; split_ifs with hj
      · exact hu' j hj
      · exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
    have huval0 : ∀ j, constantCoeff (uval j) ≠ 0 := fun j => by
      simp only [huval]; split_ifs with hj
      · exact hu'0 j hj
      · rw [map_one]; exact one_ne_zero
    choose gu hgu using fun j => exists_TKn_eq ψ x (huvalconv j)
    choose Uu hUu su hsu using fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.exists_germ_eq (gu j)
    
    obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩ : ∃ W₀ : Opens (Kn.{u} K (m + 1)),
        W₀ = U ⊓ baseOpens ψ V ⊓ Finset.univ.inf Uu := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hxW₀ : x ∈ W₀ := by
      rw [hW₀, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf, Opens.coe_inf]
      exact ⟨⟨hx, hxbase⟩, mem_finset_inf_opens _ _ fun j _ => hUu j⟩
    have hW₀U : W₀ ≤ U := hW₀ ▸ inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
    have hW₀B : W₀ ≤ baseOpens ψ V := hW₀ ▸ inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
    have hW₀u : ∀ j, W₀ ≤ Uu j := fun j =>
      hW₀ ▸ inf_le_right.trans (finset_inf_opens_le _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j))
    set g₀ : Fin (q + 1) → (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.obj (op W₀) :=
      fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₀U).op (g' j) with hg₀
    set P₀ : Fin (q + 1) → (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.obj (op W₀) :=
      fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₀B).op (polyRow ψ V x0 pc j) with hP₀
    set u₀ : Fin (q + 1) → (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.obj (op W₀) :=
      fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hW₀u j)).op (su j) with hu₀
    have hgerm : ∀ j, (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ W₀ x hxW₀ (g₀ j) =
        (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ W₀ x hxW₀ (u₀ j * P₀ j) := by
      intro j
      apply TKn_injective ψ x
      rw [map_mul, hg₀, hP₀, hu₀]
      dsimp only
      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply,
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, map_mul, hsu, hgu]
      by_cases hj : j ∈ S
      · rw [heq' j hj, hTP j hj, huval]; simp only [dite_eq_left hj]
      · rw [hSzero j hj, hTP0 j hj, map_zero, mul_zero]
    choose W₁ hW₁ hxW₁ hW₁eq using fun j =>
      exists_res_eq_of_germ_eq (sheafKn K (m + 1)) hxW₀ (g₀ j) (u₀ j * P₀ j) (hgerm j)
    
    have hunit : ∀ j, IsUnit ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ W₀ x hxW₀ (u₀ j)) := by
      intro j
      rw [← MulEquiv.isUnit_map (taylorKn ψ x).toMulEquiv]
      have : taylorKn ψ x ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.germ W₀ x hxW₀ (u₀ j)) =
          ⟨uval j, huvalconv j⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rw [taylorKn_apply_coe, hu₀]
        dsimp only
        rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, hsu, hgu]
      rw [RingEquiv.toMulEquiv_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toMulEquiv, this]
      exact (isUnit_iff_constantCoeff_ne_zero (huvalconv j)).2 (huval0 j)
    choose W₂ hW₂ hxW₂ hW₂u using fun j =>
      exists_isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ (sheafKn K (m + 1)) hxW₀ (u₀ j) (hunit j)
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : Opens (Kn.{u} K (m + 1)),
        W = Finset.univ.inf W₁ ⊓ Finset.univ.inf W₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hxW : x ∈ W := by
      rw [hW, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf]
      exact ⟨mem_finset_inf_opens _ _ fun j _ => hxW₁ j, mem_finset_inf_opens _ _ fun j _ => hxW₂ j⟩
    have hWW₁ : ∀ j, W ≤ W₁ j := fun j =>
      hW ▸ inf_le_left.trans (finset_inf_opens_le _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j))
    have hWW₂ : ∀ j, W ≤ W₂ j := fun j =>
      hW ▸ inf_le_right.trans (finset_inf_opens_le _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j))
    have hWW₀ : W ≤ W₀ := (hWW₁ 0).trans (hW₁ 0)
    have hWU : W ≤ U := hWW₀.trans hW₀U
    
    have hrow : (fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (g' j)) =
        fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW₀).op (u₀ j) *
          (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW₀).op (P₀ j) := by
      funext j
      rw [← map_mul, ← res_res_eq_res (sheafKn K (m + 1)) (hW₁ j) (hWW₁ j), ← hW₁eq j,
        res_res_eq_res, hg₀]
      dsimp only
      rw [res_res_eq_res]
    have hunits : ∀ j, IsUnit ((sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW₀).op (u₀ j)) := by
      intro j
      rw [← res_res_eq_res (sheafKn K (m + 1)) (hW₂ j) (hWW₂ j)]
      exact (hW₂u j).map _
    
    have hIH := ih V ((q + 1) * (3 * d)) (d + 3 * d) (coeffMatSec pc (d + 3 * d) (3 * d))
    have hcore := hasLocalGeneratorsOn_polyRow ψ hd0 (hed 0 h0S) V x0 pc hmonic hIH
    have hP := hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_res (hWW₀.trans hW₀B) (polyRow ψ V x0 pc) hcore
    have hPW : HasLocalGeneratorsOn (sheafKn K (m + 1)) W (q + 1) fun y hy =>
        relationSubmodule (sheafKn K (m + 1))
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW₀).op (P₀ j))
          y hy := by
      refine hP.congr fun y hy => ?_
      congr 2
    have huP := hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_mul_units _ _ hunits hPW
    rw [← hrow] at huP
    
    have hg : HasLocalGeneratorsOn (sheafKn K (m + 1)) W (q + 1) fun y hy =>
        relationSubmodule (sheafKn K (m + 1))
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun j => (sheafKn K (m + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (g j))
          y hy :=
      hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_comp_perm _ σ huP
    exact hasLocalGeneratorsOn_row_of_res hWU hxW g hg

name: AnalyticSpace.isCoherent_sheafKn
statement:
theorem isCoherent_sheafKn : ∀ n : ℕ, IsCoherent (sheafKn.{u} K n)
  | 0 => isCoherent_sheafKn_zero
  | n + 1 => isCoherent_sheafKn_succ n (isCoherent_sheafKn n)

name: AnalyticSpace.oka_coherent
statement: theorem oka_coherent (n : ℕ) : IsCoherent (affine.{u} K n).toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪
proof:
:=
  isCoherent_sheafKn n

name: AnalyticSpace.colon_pow_succ
statement:
theorem colon_pow_succ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (J I : Ideal R) (k : ℕ) :
    Submodule.colon J (SetLike.coe (I ^ (k + 1))) =
      Submodule.colon (Submodule.colon J (SetLike.coe (I ^ k))) (SetLike.coe I)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [Submodule.mem_colon, SetLike.mem_coe, smul_eq_mul]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi p hp
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm i p]
    exact h _ (by rw [pow_succ]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hp hi)
  · intro h s hs
    rw [pow_succ] at hs
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hs (fun m hm n hn => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
    · rw [mul_comm m n, ← mul_assoc]
      exact h n hn m hm
    · rw [mul_add]
      exact J.add_mem hx hy

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_opens_stalkIdeal_eq_of_le_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, k, b, hbB, hb⟩ := B.exists_generators x
  have hmem : ∀ i, 𝒪.presheaf.germ U x hxU (b i) ∈ A.stalkIdeal x := fun i =>
    hx ▸ B.germ_mem_stalkIdeal hxU (hbB i)
  choose V hxV g hgA hg using fun i => A.mem_stalkIdeal_iff.mp (hmem i)
  choose W hxW iV iU hW using fun i =>
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq 𝒪.presheaf x (hxV i) hxU (g i) (b i) (hg i)
  have hmemInf : ∀ z : Y, z ∈ (U ⊓ ⨅ i, W i : Opens Y) ↔ z ∈ U ∧ ∀ i, z ∈ W i := by
    intro z
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf, Opens.coe_iInf, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter]
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
  refine ⟨U ⊓ ⨅ i, W i, ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · exact (hmemInf x).mpr ⟨hxU, hxW⟩
  · obtain ⟨hyU, hyW⟩ := (hmemInf y).mp hy
    refine le_antisymm (hAB y) ?_
    rw [hb y hyU]
    refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    dsimp only
    have h1 : 𝒪.presheaf.germ U y hyU (b i) =
        𝒪.presheaf.germ (W i) y (hyW i) (𝒪.presheaf.map (iU i).op (b i)) :=
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply 𝒪.presheaf (iU i) y (hyW i) (b i)).symm
    rw [h1, ← hW i, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    exact A.germ_mem_stalkIdeal _ (hgA i)

name: AnalyticSpace.exists_colon_pow_stationary_at
statement:
theorem exists_colon_pow_stationary_at (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K)
    (J I : IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪) (x : X) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N,
      Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal x ^ m)) =
        Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal x ^ N))
proof:
:= by
  have hN : IsNoetherianRing (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    AnalyticSpace.isNoetherianRing_stalk X x
  have hnoeth : _root_.IsNoetherian (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.stalk x)
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.stalk x) := isNoetherianRing_iff.mp hN
  let f : ℕ →o Ideal (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ⟨fun k => Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal x ^ k)),
      fun a b hab => Submodule.colon_mono le_rfl
        (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hab))⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr hnoeth f
  exact ⟨N, fun m hm => (hN m hm).symm⟩

name: AnalyticSpace.hasLocalGenerators_iSup_colon_pow_of_colonChain_locallyStationary
statement:
theorem hasLocalGenerators_iSup_colon_pow_of_colonChain_locallyStationary (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K)
    (J I : IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪)
    (hloc : ∀ x : X, ∃ (V : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ V) (N : ℕ), ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ y ∈ V,
      Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal y) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal y ^ m)) =
        Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal y) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal y ^ N))) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪)
      fun x : X => ⨆ k : ℕ,
        Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal x ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℕ → IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪, C = fun k =>
      IdealSheaf.ofStalks _ (fun x => Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x)
        (SetLike.coe ((I ^ k).stalkIdeal x)))
        (hasLocalGenerators_colon_idealSheaf X J (I ^ k)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCs : ∀ k (x : X), (C k).stalkIdeal x =
      Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal x ^ k)) := by
    intro k x
    rw [hC]
    dsimp only
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
  have hmono : ∀ k, C k ≤ C (k + 1) := by
    intro k x
    rw [hCs, hCs]
    exact Submodule.colon_mono le_rfl
      (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ k)))
  have hmono' : Monotone C := monotone_nat_of_le_succ hmono
  obtain ⟨V, haV, N, hN⟩ := hloc a
  obtain ⟨U', haU', l, g, -, hg⟩ := (C N).exists_generators a
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U, U = V ⊓ U' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUV : U ≤ V := hU ▸ inf_le_left
  have hUU' : U ≤ U' := hU ▸ inf_le_right
  have haU : a ∈ U := by
    rw [hU, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Opens.coe_inf]
    exact ⟨haV, haU'⟩
  refine ⟨U, haU, Fin l, inferInstance,
    fun i => X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUU').op (g i), fun b hb => ?_⟩
  have hsup : (⨆ k : ℕ, Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal b) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal b ^ k))) =
      (C N).stalkIdeal b := by
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun k => ?_) (le_iSup_of_le N (hCs N b).le)
    rw [← hCs]
    rcases le_total k N with hk | hk
    · exact IdealSheaf.le_def.mp (hmono' hk) b
    · rw [hCs, hCs, hN k hk b (hUV hb)]
  have hgi : ∀ i, X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U b hb
      (X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUU').op (g i)) =
        X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪.presheaf.germ U' b (hUU' hb) (g i) := fun i =>
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  dsimp only
  rw [hsup, hg b (hUU' hb)]
  congr 1
  ext s
  simp only [Set.mem_range, hgi]

name: AnalyticSpace.colonChain_locallyStationary
statement:
theorem colonChain_locallyStationary (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K)
    (J I : IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪) (x : X) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ V) (N : ℕ), ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ y ∈ V,
      Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal y) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal y ^ m)) =
        Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal y) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal y ^ N))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℕ → IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪, C = fun k =>
      IdealSheaf.ofStalks _ (fun x => Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x)
        (SetLike.coe ((I ^ k).stalkIdeal x)))
        (hasLocalGenerators_colon_idealSheaf X J (I ^ k)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCs : ∀ k (x : X), (C k).stalkIdeal x =
      Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal x ^ k)) := by
    intro k x
    rw [hC]
    dsimp only
    rw [IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_ofStalks, IdealSheaf.stalkIdeal_pow]
  have hmono : ∀ k, C k ≤ C (k + 1) := by
    intro k x
    rw [hCs, hCs]
    exact Submodule.colon_mono le_rfl
      (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ k)))
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_colon_pow_stationary_at X J I x
  have hxeq : (C N).stalkIdeal x = (C (N + 1)).stalkIdeal x := by
    rw [hCs, hCs]
    exact (hN (N + 1) (Nat.le_succ N)).symm
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hV⟩ := exists_opens_stalkIdeal_eq_of_le_of_eq (hmono N) hxeq
  refine ⟨V, hxV, N, fun m hm y hy => ?_⟩
  induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ m hm ih =>
    rw [colon_pow_succ, ih, ← colon_pow_succ, ← hCs (N + 1) y, ← hCs N y]
    exact (hV y hy).symm

name: AnalyticSpace.saturation_hasLocalGenerators
statement:
theorem saturation_hasLocalGenerators (X : AnalyticSpace.{u} K)
    (J I : IdealSheaf X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪) :
    IdealSheaf.HasLocalGenerators (𝒪 := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.𝒪)
      fun x : X => ⨆ k : ℕ,
        Submodule.colon (J.stalkIdeal x) (SetLike.coe (I.stalkIdeal x ^ k))
proof:
:=
  hasLocalGenerators_iSup_colon_pow_of_colonChain_locallyStationary X J I
    (colonChain_locallyStationary X J I)

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.mem_stalkIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_stalkIdeal_iff {z : X} {s : X.presheaf.stalk z} :
    s ∈ stalkIdeal X J z ↔ ∃ (V : Opens X) (hz : z ∈ V) (g : X.presheaf.obj (op V)),
      g ∈ J.carrier V ∧ X.presheaf.germ V z hz g = s
proof:
:=
  J.mem_stalkIdeal_iff

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.mem_preimage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_preimage {W : Opens X} {z : support X J} : z ∈ preimage X J W ↔ z.1 ∈ W
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.ι_evalHom
statement:
theorem ι_evalHom (z : support X J) (U : (OpenNhds z)ᵒᵖ) :
    Limits.colimit.ι ((OpenNhds.inclusion z).op ⋙ presheafCommRing X J) U ≫ evalHom X J z =
      evalAt X J z (unop U)
proof:
:=
  Limits.colimit.ι_desc _ _

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.germ_comp_evalHom
statement:
theorem germ_comp_evalHom (U : Opens (support X J)) (z : support X J) (hz : z ∈ U) :
    (presheafCommRing X J).germ U z hz ≫ evalHom X J z = evalAt X J z ⟨U, hz⟩
proof:
:=
  ι_evalHom X J z (op ⟨U, hz⟩)

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.evalHom_germ
statement:
theorem evalHom_germ (U : Opens (support X J)) (z : support X J) (hz : z ∈ U)
    (s : (presheafCommRing X J).obj (op U)) :
    evalHom X J z ((presheafCommRing X J).germ U z hz s) = s.1 ⟨z, hz⟩
proof:
:=
  congr_arg (fun a => a s) (germ_comp_evalHom X J U z hz)

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.evalHom_surjective
statement: theorem evalHom_surjective (z : support X J) : Function.Surjective (evalHom X J z).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
  obtain ⟨W, hzW, a, rfl⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq σ
  refine ⟨(presheafCommRing X J).germ (preimage X J W) z ((mem_preimage X J).mpr hzW)
    (classFamily X J W a), ?_⟩
  change evalHom X J z _ = _
  rw [evalHom_germ]
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.evalHom_injective
statement: theorem evalHom_injective (z : support X J) : Function.Injective (evalHom X J z).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (evalHom X J z).hom).mpr fun ξ hξ => ?_
  obtain ⟨V, hzV, s, rfl⟩ := (presheafCommRing X J).exists_germ_eq ξ
  change evalHom X J z _ = 0 at hξ
  rw [evalHom_germ] at hξ
  obtain ⟨U₁, hz₁, i₁, W, a, hWa⟩ := s.2 ⟨z, hzV⟩
  obtain ⟨hzW, e⟩ := hWa ⟨z, hz₁⟩
  have hmem : X.presheaf.germ W z.1 hzW a ∈ stalkIdeal X J z.1 := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← e]
    exact hξ
  obtain ⟨V', hzV', g, hg, hge⟩ := (mem_stalkIdeal_iff X J).mp hmem
  obtain ⟨W', hzW', iV', iW, hres⟩ := X.presheaf.germ_eq z.1 hzV' hzW g a hge
  have hzW'' : z ∈ preimage X J W' := (mem_preimage X J).mpr hzW'
  have hzero : (presheafCommRing X J).map (U₁.infLELeft (preimage X J W') ≫ i₁).op s = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext w
    obtain ⟨hwW, ew⟩ := hWa (U₁.infLELeft (preimage X J W') w)
    beta_reduce at ew
    change s.1 (i₁ (U₁.infLELeft (preimage X J W') w)) = 0
    rw [ew, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    have hw' : (U₁.infLELeft (preimage X J W') w).1.1 ∈ W' :=
      (mem_preimage X J).mp (U₁.infLERight (preimage X J W') w).2
    have hgerm : X.presheaf.germ W (U₁.infLELeft (preimage X J W') w).1.1 hwW a =
        X.presheaf.germ V' (U₁.infLELeft (preimage X J W') w).1.1 (iV'.le hw') g := by
      rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply X.presheaf iW _ hw', ← hres,
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    rw [hgerm]
    exact J.germ_mem_stalkIdeal _ hg
  have := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply (presheafCommRing X J)
    (U₁.infLELeft (preimage X J W') ≫ i₁) z (Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hz₁, hzW''⟩) s
  rw [hzero, map_zero] at this
  exact this.symm

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.stalkMap_comp_evalHom
statement:
theorem stalkMap_comp_evalHom (z : support X J) :
    (ιHom X J).stalkMap z ≫ evalHom X J z =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (stalkIdeal X J z.1))
proof:
:= by
  refine TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext _ fun U hzU => ?_
  rw [PresheafedSpace.stalkMap_germ_assoc]
  erw [germ_comp_evalHom]
  ext a
  rfl

name: AnalyticSpace.QuotientSpace.evalHom_stalkMap
statement:
theorem evalHom_stalkMap (z : support X J) (σ : X.presheaf.stalk z.1) :
    evalHom X J z ((ιHom X J).stalkMap z σ) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (stalkIdeal X J z.1) σ
proof:
:=
  congr_arg (fun f => f σ) (stalkMap_comp_evalHom X J z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BlowUpSequence.totalTransformSeq_concat_last
statement:
theorem totalTransformSeq_concat_last (S : BlowUpSequence X) (T : BlowUpSequence S.last)
    (E : DivisorFamily X) :
    (S.concat T).totalTransformSeq E (Fin.last _) =
      (T.totalTransformSeq (S.totalTransformSeq E (Fin.last _)) (Fin.last _)).comap
        (eqToHom (last_concat S T))
proof:
:= by
  induction S with
  | nil X =>
    have h0 : eqToHom (last_concat (nil X) T) = 𝟙 T.last := eqToHom_refl _ _
    change T.totalTransformSeq (E : DivisorFamily (nil X).last) (Fin.last _) =
      (T.totalTransformSeq (E : DivisorFamily (nil X).last) (Fin.last _)).comap
        (eqToHom (last_concat (nil X) T))
    erw [h0, DivisorFamily.comap_id]
  | cons X D rest ih =>
    change (rest.concat T).totalTransformSeq (E.totalTransform D) (Fin.last _) =
      (T.totalTransformSeq (rest.totalTransformSeq (E.totalTransform D) (Fin.last _))
        (Fin.last _)).comap (eqToHom _)
    exact ih T (E.totalTransform D)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BlowUpSequence.markedTransformSeq_concat_last
statement:
theorem markedTransformSeq_concat_last (S : BlowUpSequence X) (T : BlowUpSequence S.last)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (m : ℕ) :
    (S.concat T).markedTransformSeq I m (Fin.last _) =
      (T.markedTransformSeq (S.markedTransformSeq I m (Fin.last _)) m (Fin.last _)).comap
        (eqToHom (last_concat S T))
proof:
:= by
  induction S with
  | nil X =>
    have h0 : eqToHom (last_concat (nil X) T) = 𝟙 T.last := eqToHom_refl _ _
    change T.markedTransformSeq (I : (nil X).last.IdealSheafData) m (Fin.last _) =
      (T.markedTransformSeq (I : (nil X).last.IdealSheafData) m (Fin.last _)).comap
        (eqToHom (last_concat (nil X) T))
    erw [h0, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_id]
  | cons X D rest ih =>
    change (rest.concat T).markedTransformSeq (I.markedTransform D m) m (Fin.last _) =
      (T.markedTransformSeq (rest.markedTransformSeq (I.markedTransform D m) m (Fin.last _)) m
        (Fin.last _)).comap (eqToHom _)
    exact ih T (I.markedTransform D m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BlowUpSequence.comap_composite_concat
statement:
theorem comap_composite_concat (S : BlowUpSequence X) (T : BlowUpSequence S.last)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) :
    I.comap (S.concat T).composite =
      ((I.comap S.composite).comap T.composite).comap (eqToHom (last_concat S T))
proof:
:= by
  rw [composite_concat, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_support_comap_iff_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_support_comap_iff_apply (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (h : Y ⟶ X) (y : Y) :
    y ∈ (Z.comap h).support ↔ h y ∈ Z.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isSncAt_comap_of_smooth
statement:
theorem exists_isSncAt_comap_of_smooth (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (h : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth h]
    {E : DivisorFamily X} {y : Y} {n : ℕ} {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (h y)}
    (hE : E.IsSncAt (h y) z) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → Y.presheaf.stalk y), (E.comap h).IsSncAt y w ∧
      ∃ σ : Fin n → Fin m, Function.Injective σ ∧ ∀ i, w (σ i) = (h.stalkMap y).hom (z i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hz, c, hc, hcE⟩ := hE
  obtain ⟨m, w, hw, σ, hσ, hwσ⟩ := exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_stalkMap f h y z hz
  refine ⟨m, w, ⟨hw, ?_⟩, σ, hσ, hwσ⟩
  let τ : {i : (E.comap h).ι // y ∈ ((E.comap h).component i).support} →
      {i : E.ι // h y ∈ (E.component i).support} :=
    fun i => ⟨i.1, (mem_support_comap_iff_apply (E.component i.1) h y).mp i.2⟩
  have hτ : Function.Injective τ := fun i j hij =>
    Subtype.ext (show (τ i).1 = (τ j).1 from congrArg Subtype.val hij)
  refine ⟨fun i => σ (c (τ i)), hσ.comp (hc.comp hτ), fun i => ?_⟩
  change ((E.component i.1).comap h).stalkIdeal y = Ideal.span {w (σ (c (τ i)))}
  have hi := hcE (τ i)
  change (E.component i.1).stalkIdeal (h y) = Ideal.span {z (c (τ i))} at hi
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap, hwσ, hi, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSnc_comap_of_smooth
statement:
theorem isSnc_comap_of_smooth (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (h : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth h]
    {E : DivisorFamily X} (hE : E.IsSnc) : (E.comap h).IsSnc
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · refine isRegular_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_quotient _ fun y hy => ?_
    obtain ⟨n, z, hz⟩ := hE.2 (h y)
    obtain ⟨m, w, ⟨hw, c, -, hc⟩, -⟩ := exists_isSncAt_comap_of_smooth f h hz
    have : IsRegularLocalRing (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
      isRegularLocalRing_stalk (h ≫ f) y
    have hy' : y ∈ ((E.comap h).component i).support := hy
    have hZ : ((E.comap h).component i).stalkIdeal y =
        Ideal.span (w '' ↑({c ⟨i, hy'⟩} : Finset (Fin m))) := by
      rw [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton]
      exact hc ⟨i, hy'⟩
    exact isRegularLocalRing_quotient_stalkIdeal_of_eq_span hw hZ
  · obtain ⟨n, z, hz⟩ := hE.2 (h y)
    obtain ⟨m, w, hw, -⟩ := exists_isSncAt_comap_of_smooth f h hz
    exact ⟨m, w, hw⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasSncWith_comap_of_smooth
statement:
theorem hasSncWith_comap_of_smooth (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (h : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth h]
    {E : DivisorFamily X} {Z : X.IdealSheafData} (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) :
    (E.comap h).HasSncWith (Z.comap h)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨n, z, hsnc, s, hs⟩ := hZ (h y) ((mem_support_comap_iff_apply Z h y).mp hy)
  obtain ⟨m, w, hw, σ, -, hwσ⟩ := exists_isSncAt_comap_of_smooth f h hsnc
  refine ⟨m, w, hw, s.image σ, ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap, hs, Ideal.map_span, Finset.coe_image]
  simp only [Set.image_image]
  exact congrArg Ideal.span (Set.image_congr fun x _ => (hwσ x).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOrderSeq.pullback_of_equidim
statement:
theorem IsOrderSeq.pullback_of_equidim [CharZero k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (h : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth h] (n' : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n' (h ≫ f)]
    {S : BlowUpSequence X} {I : X.IdealSheafData} {E : DivisorFamily X} {m : ℕ}
    (hS : S.IsOrderSeq f I E m) : (S.pullback h).IsOrderSeq (h ≫ f) (I.comap h) (E.comap h) m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨IsSmooth.pullback f h hS.1, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hj' : j < S.length := by rwa [length_pullback] at hj
  have hsm : Smooth (S.stageMap ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩ ≫ f) :=
    IsSmooth.smooth_stageMap (n := n) hS.1 _
  have hsh : Smooth (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) :=
    smooth_pullbackStageHom S h _
  have hc : (S.pullback h).center ⟨j, hj⟩ =
      (S.center ⟨j, hj'⟩).comap (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) :=
    center_pullback_mk S h j hj'
  have hE : (S.pullback h).totalTransformSeq (E.comap h)
        (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin (S.pullback h).length).castSucc =
      (S.totalTransformSeq E ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩).comap
        (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) :=
    totalTransformSeq_pullback_mk S h E j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj')
  have hI : (S.pullback h).weakTransformSeq (I.comap h)
        (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin (S.pullback h).length).castSucc =
      (S.weakTransformSeq I ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩).comap
        (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) :=
    IsOrderSeq.weakTransformSeq_pullback_mk_of_equidim f n h n' hS j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj')
  obtain ⟨hsnc, hord⟩ := hS.2 ⟨j, hj'⟩
  rw [hc, hE, hI]
  exact ⟨hasSncWith_comap_of_smooth (S.stageMap ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩ ≫ f)
    (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) hsnc, ordAlongEq_comap_of_smooth _ hord⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOrderSeq.pullback
statement:
theorem IsOrderSeq.pullback [CharZero k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (h : Y ⟶ X) {d : ℕ} [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h]
    {S : BlowUpSequence X} {I : X.IdealSheafData} {E : DivisorFamily X} {m : ℕ}
    (hS : S.IsOrderSeq f I E m) : (S.pullback h).IsOrderSeq (h ≫ f) (I.comap h) (E.comap h) m
proof:
:= by
  have := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth d h
  have := smoothOfRelativeDimension_comp d n h f
  exact IsOrderSeq.pullback_of_equidim f n h (d + n) hS

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOrderGeSeq.pullback_of_smooth
statement:
theorem IsOrderGeSeq.pullback_of_smooth [CharZero k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (h : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth h]
    {S : BlowUpSequence X} {I : X.IdealSheafData} {m : ℕ} {E : DivisorFamily X}
    (hS : S.IsOrderGeSeq f I m E) :
    (S.pullback h).IsOrderGeSeq (h ≫ f) (I.comap h) m (E.comap h)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨IsSmooth.pullback f h hS.1, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hj' : j < S.length := by rwa [length_pullback] at hj
  have hsm : Smooth (S.stageMap ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩ ≫ f) :=
    IsSmooth.smooth_stageMap (n := n) hS.1 _
  have hsh : Smooth (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) :=
    smooth_pullbackStageHom S h _
  have hc : (S.pullback h).center ⟨j, hj⟩ =
      (S.center ⟨j, hj'⟩).comap (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) :=
    center_pullback_mk S h j hj'
  have hE : (S.pullback h).totalTransformSeq (E.comap h)
        (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin (S.pullback h).length).castSucc =
      (S.totalTransformSeq E ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩).comap
        (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) :=
    totalTransformSeq_pullback_mk S h E j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj')
  have hI : (S.pullback h).markedTransformSeq (I.comap h) m
        (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin (S.pullback h).length).castSucc =
      (S.markedTransformSeq I m ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩).comap
        (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) :=
    IsOrderGeSeq.markedTransformSeq_comap_pullbackStageHom_mk f n h hS j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj')
  obtain ⟨hsnc, hord⟩ := hS.2 ⟨j, hj'⟩
  rw [hc, hE, hI]
  exact ⟨hasSncWith_comap_of_smooth (S.stageMap ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩ ≫ f)
    (S.pullbackStageHom h ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj'⟩) hsnc, leOrdAlong_comap_of_smooth _ hord⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOrderGeSeq.pullback
statement:
theorem IsOrderGeSeq.pullback [CharZero k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (h : Y ⟶ X) {d : ℕ} [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h]
    {S : BlowUpSequence X} {I : X.IdealSheafData} {m : ℕ} {E : DivisorFamily X}
    (hS : S.IsOrderGeSeq f I m E) :
    (S.pullback h).IsOrderGeSeq (h ≫ f) (I.comap h) m (E.comap h)
proof:
:=
  have := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth d h
  IsOrderGeSeq.pullback_of_smooth f n h hS

name: AlgebraicGeometry.eq_nil_of_isOrderGeSeq_of_maxOrd_lt
proof:
:= by
  cases S with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ D rest =>
    exfalso
    rw [isOrderGeSeq_cons_iff] at hS
    rw [noEmptyCenters_cons_iff] at hne
    have hsup : (D.support : Set X) ≠ ∅ := fun h =>
      hne.1 ((IdealSheafData.support_eq_bot_iff D).mp (SetLike.coe_injective (by rw [h]; rfl)))
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hsup
    obtain ⟨η, hη, -⟩ := Closeds.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes D.support hz
    have h1 : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord η := hS.1.2.2 η hη
    exact absurd (h1.trans (IdealSheafData.le_maxOrd I η)) (not_le.mpr hI)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Remark33.ideal_fg_of_isLocallyNoetherian
statement:
theorem ideal_fg_of_isLocallyNoetherian [IsLocallyNoetherian M] (K : M.IdealSheafData)
    (U : M.affineOpens) : (K.ideal U).FG
proof:
:= by
  have : IsNoetherianRing Γ(M, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  exact IsNoetherian.noetherian _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Remark33.ideal_colon_of_isLocallyNoetherian
statement:
theorem ideal_colon_of_isLocallyNoetherian [IsLocallyNoetherian M] (I K : M.IdealSheafData)
    (U : M.affineOpens) :
    (I.colon K).ideal U = (I.ideal U).colon (K.ideal U : Set Γ(M, U))
proof:
:=
  Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_of_fg I K (fun U => ideal_fg_of_isLocallyNoetherian K U) U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Remark33.comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion_of_isAffine
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion c
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_isAffine ?_
  have hθ : Function.Surjective ⇑((c.appIso ⊤).inv.hom) :=
    (c.appIso ⊤).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective
  have h1 := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion (I.colon K) c ⟨⊤,
      isAffineOpen_top Y⟩
  have h2 := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion I c ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩
  have h3 := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion K c ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩
  rw [h1, ideal_colon_of_isLocallyNoetherian I K, Ideal.comap_colon_of_surjective _ hθ, ← h2,
    ← h3, ideal_colon_of_isLocallyNoetherian]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Remark33.comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion_of_isLocallyNoetherian
statement:
theorem comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion_of_isLocallyNoetherian [IsLocallyNoetherian M]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (c : Y ⟶ M) [IsOpenImmersion c] (I K : M.IdealSheafData) :
    (I.colon K).comap c = (I.comap c).colon (K.comap c)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion c
  have key : ∀ V : Y.affineOpens,
      ((I.colon K).comap c).comap V.1.ι = ((I.comap c).colon (K.comap c)).comap V.1.ι := by
    intro V
    have : IsAffine (V.1 : Scheme.{u}) := V.2
    rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion_of_isAffine
        (V.1.ι ≫ c) I K,
      comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion_of_isAffine V.1.ι (I.comap c) (K.comap c),
          Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
  have hcov : ∀ x : Y, ∃ (V : Y.affineOpens) (y : (V.1 : Scheme.{u})), V.1.ι y = x := by
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : Y.Opens) := trivial
    rw [← iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y] at hx
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
    exact ⟨V, ⟨x, hV⟩, rfl⟩
  exact le_antisymm
    (le_of_comap_le_of_forall_exists (fun V : Y.affineOpens => V.1.ι)
      hcov fun V => (key V).le)
    (le_of_comap_le_of_forall_exists (fun V : Y.affineOpens => V.1.ι)
      hcov fun V => (key V).ge)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.maxOrd_comap_eqToHom
statement:
theorem maxOrd_comap_eqToHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X = Y) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) :
    (J.comap (eqToHom h)).maxOrd = J.maxOrd
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [eqToHom_refl, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.maxOrd_weakTransformSeq_concat_last
statement:
theorem maxOrd_weakTransformSeq_concat_last {X : Scheme.{u}} (S : BlowUpSequence X)
    (T : BlowUpSequence S.last) (J : X.IdealSheafData) :
    ((S.concat T).weakTransformSeq J (Fin.last _)).maxOrd =
      (T.weakTransformSeq (S.weakTransformSeq J (Fin.last _)) (Fin.last _)).maxOrd
proof:
:= by
  rw [weakTransformSeq_concat_last]
  exact maxOrd_comap_eqToHom (last_concat S T) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_derivation_extend
statement:
theorem exists_derivation_extend [Algebra.FormallySmooth A B] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module k M] [Module A M] [Module B M] [IsScalarTower k A M] [IsScalarTower k B M]
    [IsScalarTower A B M] (δ : Derivation k A M) :
    ∃ Dx : Derivation k B M, ∀ a, Dx (algebraMap A B a) = δ a
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange k A B) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, (Algebra.H1Cotangent.exact_δ_mapBaseChange k A B).linearMap_ker_eq]
    exact LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mpr (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (KaehlerDifferential.map k A B B)
    LinearMap.id (KaehlerDifferential.map_surjective k A B)
  have h01 := (KaehlerDifferential.exact_mapBaseChange_map k A B).split_tfae'.out 1 2
  obtain ⟨-, l, hl⟩ := h01.mp ⟨hinj, s, hs⟩
  let L : Ω[B⁄k] →ₗ[B] M := (δ.liftKaehlerDifferential.liftBaseChange B) ∘ₗ l
  refine ⟨L.compDer (KaehlerDifferential.D k B), fun a => ?_⟩
  change L (KaehlerDifferential.D k B (algebraMap A B a)) = δ a
  have h1 : KaehlerDifferential.D k B (algebraMap A B a) =
      KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange k A B (1 ⊗ₜ KaehlerDifferential.D k A a) := by
    rw [KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange_tmul, one_smul, KaehlerDifferential.map_D]
  rw [h1]
  simp only [L, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply l, hl, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, one_smul,
    Derivation.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.smul_residueField_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem smul_residueField_eq_zero_of_mem {m : R} (hm : m ∈ maximalIdeal R) (x : ResidueField R) :
    m • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, (residue_eq_zero_iff m).mpr hm, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_sq
statement:
theorem derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_sq {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [Algebra k R]
    (D : Derivation k R (ResidueField R)) {a : R} (ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) : D a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two] at ha
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on ha (fun m hm n hn => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
  · rw [D.leibniz, smul_residueField_eq_zero_of_mem hm, smul_residueField_eq_zero_of_mem hn,
      add_zero]
  · rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_derivations_residueField
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_derivations_residueField {k : Type*} [CommRing k]
    [Algebra k R] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ι → R)
    (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ maximalIdeal R) (D : ι → Derivation k R (ResidueField R))
    (hD : ∀ i j, D i (w j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨w i, hw i⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg i
  choose a ha using fun j => residue_surjective (R := R) (g j)
  set W : ι → maximalIdeal R := fun j => ⟨w j, hw j⟩ with hW
  have hsum : (∑ j, g j • (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent (W j)) =
      (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent (∑ j, a j • W j) := by
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, ← ha j, ← ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul]
  have hmem : ((∑ j, a j • W j : maximalIdeal R) : R) ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 :=
    ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_eq_zero _).mp (hsum.symm.trans hg)
  have hcoe : ((∑ j, a j • W j : maximalIdeal R) : R) = ∑ j, a j * w j := by
    rw [Submodule.coe_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => rfl
  rw [hcoe] at hmem
  have hDi : D i (∑ j, a j * w j) = residue R (a i) := by
    rw [map_sum]
    have : ∀ j, D i (a j * w j) = if i = j then residue R (a j) else 0 := by
      intro j
      rw [(D i).leibniz, hD i j, smul_residueField_eq_zero_of_mem (hw j), add_zero, smul_ite,
        smul_zero, Algebra.smul_def, ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, mul_one]
    simp only [this, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  rw [← ha i, ← hDi]
  exact derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_sq (D i) hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_extend
statement:
theorem exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_extend [IsRegularLocalRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing B]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)] [Algebra.FormallySmooth A B]
    [Algebra.FormallySmooth k (ResidueField A)] {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → A)
    (hz : IsRegularSystemOfParameters z) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → B), IsRegularSystemOfParameters w ∧
      ∃ σ : Fin n → Fin m, Function.Injective σ ∧ ∀ i, w (σ i) = algebraMap A B (z i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hzm : ∀ i, z i ∈ maximalIdeal A := fun i => hz.1 ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  set Z : Fin n → maximalIdeal A := fun i => ⟨z i, hzm i⟩ with hZ
  
  have hspan : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span (ResidueField A)
      (Set.range fun i => (maximalIdeal A).toCotangent (Z i)) := by
    rw [top_le_iff, Set.range_comp' (maximalIdeal A).toCotangent Z,
      CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff]
    apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (maximalIdeal A).injective_subtype
    rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_subtype_top, ← Set.range_comp']
    exact hz.1
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin n) = Module.finrank (ResidueField A) (CotangentSpace A) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin]
    have h1 := (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace A).mp inferInstance
    rw [← hz.2] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1.symm
  have hli : LinearIndependent (ResidueField A) fun i => (maximalIdeal A).toCotangent (Z i) :=
    linearIndependent_of_top_le_span_of_card_eq_finrank hspan hcard
  
  set v : Fin n → ResidueField A ⊗[A] Ω[A⁄k] :=
    fun i => cotangentSpaceToTensor k A ((maximalIdeal A).toCotangent (Z i)) with hv
  have hli2 : LinearIndependent (ResidueField A) v :=
    hli.map' (cotangentSpaceToTensor k A)
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (injective_cotangentSpaceToTensor k A))
  have hvz : ∀ j, (1 : ResidueField A) ⊗ₜ[A] KaehlerDifferential.D k A (z j) = v j := fun j =>
    (cotangentSpaceToTensor_toCotangent k A (Z j)).symm
  
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ := LinearMap.exists_leftInverse_of_injective
    (Finsupp.linearCombination (ResidueField A) v) (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hli2)
  let δ : Fin n → Derivation k A (ResidueField A) := fun i =>
    ((Finsupp.lapply (R := ResidueField A) i ∘ₗ ℓ).restrictScalars A ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.mk A (ResidueField A) Ω[A⁄k] 1).compDer (KaehlerDifferential.D k A)
  have hδ : ∀ i j, δ i (z j) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i j
    have hvj : (1 : ResidueField A) ⊗ₜ[A] KaehlerDifferential.D k A (z j) =
        Finsupp.linearCombination (ResidueField A) v (Finsupp.single j 1) := by
      rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, hvz]
    have hℓv : ℓ (Finsupp.linearCombination (ResidueField A) v (Finsupp.single j 1)) =
        Finsupp.single j 1 := by
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hℓ (Finsupp.single j 1)
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] using this
    change ((Finsupp.lapply (R := ResidueField A) i ∘ₗ ℓ).restrictScalars A ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.mk A (ResidueField A) Ω[A⁄k] 1) (KaehlerDifferential.D k A (z j)) = _
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      TensorProduct.mk_apply, hvj, hℓv, Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp
    · rw [ite_eq_right hij, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hij)]
  
  let ρ : ResidueField A →ₗ[A] ResidueField B :=
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A (ResidueField A) (ResidueField B)).toLinearMap
  let δ' : Fin n → Derivation k A (ResidueField B) := fun i => ρ.compDer (δ i)
  have hδ' : ∀ i j, δ' i (z j) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i j
    change ρ (δ i (z j)) = _
    rw [hδ]
    split_ifs <;> simp [ρ]
  choose Dx hDx using fun i => exists_derivation_extend (k := k) (A := A) (B := B) (δ' i)
  have hwm : ∀ i, algebraMap A B (z i) ∈ maximalIdeal B := fun i =>
    (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr fun hu =>
      (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp (hzm i) (IsLocalHom.map_nonunit _ hu)
  have hliB : LinearIndependent (ResidueField B)
      fun i => (maximalIdeal B).toCotangent ⟨algebraMap A B (z i), hwm i⟩ :=
    linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_derivations_residueField _ hwm Dx fun i j => by
      rw [hDx, hδ']
  exact exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_linearIndependent _ hwm hliB

name: AlgebraicGeometry.essFiniteType_stalk_of_locallyOfFiniteType
statement:
theorem essFiniteType_stalk_of_locallyOfFiniteType (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (x : X) :
    let
proof:
:= f.stalkAlgebra x
    Algebra.EssFiniteType k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
  let := f.stalkAlgebra x
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpens_mem x
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra U.1
  let := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  have := f.isScalarTower_sectionsAlgebra_stalk U.1 hxU
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U.1) := by
    have h1 : (f.appLE ⊤ U.1 le_top).hom.FiniteType :=
      f.finiteType_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) U.2 le_top
    have h2 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom.FiniteType :=
      RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _ (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).2
    change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ U.1 le_top).hom.FiniteType
    rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp]
    exact h1.comp h2
  have : IsLocalization (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType Γ(X, U.1) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization _ (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
  exact Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k Γ(X, U.1) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_stalkMap
statement:
theorem exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_stalkMap [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f] (h : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth h] (y : Y) {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (h y))
    (hz : IsRegularSystemOfParameters z) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → Y.presheaf.stalk y), IsRegularSystemOfParameters w ∧
      ∃ σ : Fin n → Fin m, Function.Injective σ ∧ ∀ i, w (σ i) = (h.stalkMap y).hom (z i)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)) := f.stalkAlgebra (h y)
  let : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := (h.stalkMap y).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra k (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    ((h.stalkMap y).hom.comp (algebraMap k (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)))).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f (h y)
  have : IsRegularLocalRing (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk (h ≫ f) y
  have : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (h.stalkMap y).hom)
  have := h.formallySmooth_stalkMap y
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)) :=
    essFiniteType_stalk_of_locallyOfFiniteType f (h y)
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (h y))) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Algebra.EssFiniteType k (_ ⧸ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (h y))))
  exact exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_extend (k := k) z hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_isIso_stalkMap_of_stalkIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_isIso_stalkMap_of_stalkIdeal_eq {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion g] (g' : Y' ⟶ X') [IsClosedImmersion g'] (f : X' ⟶ X)
    {p : Y'} {y : Y} (hpt : f (g' p) = g y) [IsIso (f.stalkMap (g' p))]
    (h2 : g'.ker.stalkIdeal (g' p) = (g.ker.stalkIdeal (f (g' p))).map (f.stalkMap (g' p)).hom)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (Y'.presheaf.stalk p)] : IsRegularLocalRing (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
proof:
:= by
  let e1 : Y'.presheaf.stalk p ≃+* X'.presheaf.stalk (g' p) ⧸ g'.ker.stalkIdeal (g' p) :=
    (stalkEquivQuotient_of_isClosedImmersion g' p).symm
  let α : X.presheaf.stalk (f (g' p)) ≃+* X'.presheaf.stalk (g' p) :=
    (asIso (f.stalkMap (g' p))).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have h2' : g'.ker.stalkIdeal (g' p) =
      (g.ker.stalkIdeal (f (g' p))).map (α : X.presheaf.stalk (f (g' p)) →+* _) := h2
  let e2 : X'.presheaf.stalk (g' p) ⧸ g'.ker.stalkIdeal (g' p) ≃+*
      X.presheaf.stalk (f (g' p)) ⧸ g.ker.stalkIdeal (f (g' p)) :=
    (Ideal.quotientEquiv (g.ker.stalkIdeal (f (g' p))) (g'.ker.stalkIdeal (g' p)) α h2').symm
  let σ : X.presheaf.stalk (f (g' p)) ≃+* X.presheaf.stalk (g y) :=
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hpt)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let e3 : X.presheaf.stalk (f (g' p)) ⧸ g.ker.stalkIdeal (f (g' p)) ≃+*
      X.presheaf.stalk (g y) ⧸ g.ker.stalkIdeal (g y) :=
    Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ σ (stalkIdeal_map_stalkCongr g.ker hpt).symm
  let e4 : X.presheaf.stalk (g y) ⧸ g.ker.stalkIdeal (g y) ≃+* Y.presheaf.stalk y :=
    stalkEquivQuotient_of_isClosedImmersion g y
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (e1.trans (e2.trans (e3.trans e4)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Remark33.le_of_comap_le_of_forall_exists
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_iSup_eq_top
    (fun p : Σ i, (Y i).affineOpens =>
      ⟨c p.1 ''ᵁ p.2.1, p.2.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion (c p.1)⟩) ?_ fun p => ?_
  · refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => ?_
    obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := hc x
    obtain ⟨V, hyV⟩ : ∃ V : (Y i).affineOpens, y ∈ V.1 := by
      have hy : y ∈ (⊤ : (Y i).Opens) := trivial
      rw [← iSup_affineOpens_eq_top (Y i)] at hy
      exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨i, V⟩, ⟨y, hyV, rfl⟩⟩
  · have h1 := le_def.mp (h p.1) p.2
    rw [ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion, ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion] at h1
    exact (Ideal.comap_le_comap_iff_of_surjective _
      ((c p.1).appIso p.2.1).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective _ _).mp h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Remark33.comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion'
statement:
theorem comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion' {Y : Scheme.{u}} (c : Y ⟶ M) [IsOpenImmersion c]
    (I : M.IdealSheafData) {K : M.IdealSheafData} (hK : K.IsInvertible) :
    (I.colon K).comap c = (I.comap c).colon (K.comap c)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ V : Y.affineOpens,
      ((I.colon K).comap c).comap V.1.ι = ((I.comap c).colon (K.comap c)).comap V.1.ι := by
    intro V
    have : IsAffine (V.1 : Scheme.{u}) := V.2
    rw [← comap_comp, comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion (V.1.ι ≫ c) I hK,
      comap_colon_of_isOpenImmersion V.1.ι _ (hK.comap_of_isOpenImmersion c), comap_comp,
      comap_comp]
  have hcov : ∀ x : Y, ∃ (V : Y.affineOpens) (y : (V.1 : Scheme.{u})), V.1.ι y = x := by
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : Y.Opens) := trivial
    rw [← iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y] at hx
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
    exact ⟨V, ⟨x, hV⟩, rfl⟩
  exact le_antisymm
    (le_of_comap_le_of_forall_exists (fun V : Y.affineOpens => V.1.ι) hcov fun V => (key V).le)
    (le_of_comap_le_of_forall_exists (fun V : Y.affineOpens => V.1.ι) hcov fun V => (key V).ge)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Remark33.exists_blowUpMap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_blowUpMap_eq (h : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion h] (D : X.IdealSheafData)
    (x : blowUp D) (y : Y) (hxy : blowUpπ D x = h y) : ∃ z, blowUpMap h D z = x
proof:
:= by
  have sq := isPullback_blowUpMap h D
  obtain ⟨w, hw, -⟩ :=
    Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := blowUpπ D) (g := h) x y hxy
  have hb : sq.isoPullback.inv ≫ blowUpMap h D = Limits.pullback.fst (blowUpπ D) h :=
    (Iso.inv_comp_eq _).mpr sq.isoPullback_hom_fst.symm
  exact ⟨sq.isoPullback.inv w, by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hb, hw]⟩

name: Derivation.congrRingEquiv_apply

theorem congrRingEquiv_apply (D : Derivation k A A) (b : B) :

proof: := rfl

name: Ideal.derivative_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem derivative_map_ringEquiv (J : Ideal A) :
    (derivative k J).map e.toRingHom = derivative k (J.map e.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    refine derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨fun f hf => Ideal.mem_comap.mpr
      (le_derivative _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)), fun δ f hf => ?_⟩
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
    have : e.toRingHom (δ f) = Derivation.congrRingEquiv e hk δ (e.toRingHom f) := by
      change e (δ f) = e (δ (e.symm (e f)))
      rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [this]
    exact derivation_apply_mem_derivative _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf)
  · refine derivative_le_iff.mpr ⟨Ideal.map_mono (le_derivative J), fun δ' b hb => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective e.toRingHom e.surjective).mp hb
    have : δ' (e.toRingHom a) = e.toRingHom (Derivation.congrRingEquiv e.symm
        (fun c => by rw [Derivation.symm_algebraMap_of_forall e hk]) δ' a) := by
      change δ' (e a) = e (e.symm (δ' (e.symm.symm a)))
      rw [RingEquiv.symm_symm, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (derivation_apply_mem_derivative _ ha)

proof:

  conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective e.toRingHom e.bijective (I := J)]
  exact Iff.rfl

statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_markedTransform_of_notMem {q : Z.blowUp}
    (hq : q ∉ (Z.comap Z.blowUpπ).support) :
    (K.markedTransform Z c).stalkIdeal q =
      (K.stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ q)).map (Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap q).hom
proof:
:= by
  change ((K.comap Z.blowUpπ).colon (Z.comap Z.blowUpπ ^ c)).stalkIdeal q
      = _
  rw [stalkIdeal_colon_of_isInvertible _ (isInvertible_pow (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π Z) c),
