name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_comap_eq_of_comm
statement:
theorem comap_comap_eq_of_comm {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (j : Y ⟶ X)
    (h : X' ⟶ X) (j' : Y' ⟶ X') (hS : Y' ⟶ Y) (w : j' ≫ h = hS ≫ j) :
    (I.comap h).comap j' = (I.comap j).comap hS
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, w]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_subschemeι_comap
statement:
theorem isPullback_subschemeι_comap (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    IsPullback (Z.comap f).subschemeι
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap (Z.comap f) Z f (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap Z f))
      f Z.subschemeι
proof:
:=
  isPullback_of_isClosedImmersion _ _ _ _
    (Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap_subschemeι _ _ _ _).symm
    (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_map_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem comap_map_of_isPullback {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} {j : Y ⟶ X} [IsClosedImmersion j]
    {h : X' ⟶ X} {j' : Y' ⟶ X'} {hS : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback j' hS h j)
    (Z : Y.IdealSheafData) : (Z.map j).comap h = (Z.comap hS).map j'
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : IsPullback ((Z.comap hS).subschemeι ≫ j')
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap (Z.comap hS) Z hS
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap Z hS)) h (Z.subschemeι ≫ j) :=
    (isPullback_subschemeι_comap Z hS).paste_horiz sq
  calc (Z.map j).comap h = (Z.subschemeι ≫ j).ker.comap h := rfl
    _ = (pullback.fst h (Z.subschemeι ≫ j)).ker :=
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion _ h).symm
    _ = (hsq.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst h (Z.subschemeι ≫ j)).ker :=
        (Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso _ _).symm
    _ = ((Z.comap hS).subschemeι ≫ j').ker := by rw [hsq.isoPullback_hom_fst]
    _ = (Z.comap hS).map j' := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_blowUpMap_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem isPullback_blowUpMap_of_isPullback {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} {j : Y ⟶ X} {h : X' ⟶ X}
    [Flat h] {j' : Y' ⟶ X'} {hS : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback j' hS h j) (D : X.IdealSheafData) :
    IsPullback (blowUpMap j' (D.comap h))
      (eqToHom (congrArg (blowUp (X := Y')) (comap_comap_eq_of_comm D j h j' hS sq.w)) ≫
        blowUpMap hS (D.comap j))
      (blowUpMap h D) (blowUpMap j D)
proof:
:= by
  have : Flat hS :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback (P := @Flat) sq inferInstance
  have s₀ : IsPullback (blowUpπ ((D.comap h).comap j'))
      (eqToHom (congrArg (blowUp (X := Y')) (comap_comap_eq_of_comm D j h j' hS sq.w))) (𝟙 Y')
      (blowUpπ ((D.comap j).comap hS)) :=
    IsPullback.of_vert_isIso
      ⟨by rw [Category.comp_id,
        eqToHom_comp_blowUpπ (comap_comap_eq_of_comm D j h j' hS sq.w)]⟩
  have s₁ := s₀.paste_vert (isPullback_blowUpMap hS (D.comap j)).flip
  rw [Category.id_comp] at s₁
  have R := s₁.paste_horiz sq
  rw [← blowUpMap_π j' (D.comap h), ← blowUpMap_π j D] at R
  refine IsPullback.of_right R ?_ (isPullback_blowUpMap h D).flip
  refine blowUp.hom_ext D (blowUpπ ((D.comap h).comap j') ≫ j' ≫ h) ?_ _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
    exact blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π _
  · simp only [Category.assoc, blowUpMap_π, blowUpMap_π_assoc]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, blowUpMap_π, blowUpMap_π_assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc,
      eqToHom_comp_blowUpπ (comap_comap_eq_of_comm D j h j' hS sq.w), sq.w]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_mem_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_mem_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top {V : X.Opens} (s : Set Γ(X, V))
    (hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ V) : ∃ t ∈ s, x ∈ X.basicOpen t
proof:
:= by
  have h := iSup_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top V s hs
  rw [← h] at hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  obtain ⟨hts, hxt⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp ht
  exact ⟨t, hts, hxt⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.nontrivial_localizationAway_of_mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem nontrivial_localizationAway_of_mem_basicOpen {V : X.Opens} (t : Γ(X, V)) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ X.basicOpen t) : Nontrivial (Localization.Away t)
proof:
:= by
  have hxV : x ∈ V := X.basicOpen_le t hx
  have hunit : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV t) := (Scheme.mem_basicOpen X t x hxV).mp hx
  rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial,
    IsLocalization.subsingleton_iff (M := Submonoid.powers t) (S := Localization.Away t)]
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  have h0 : IsUnit ((X.presheaf.germ V x hxV) (0 : Γ(X, V))) := by
    rw [← hk, map_pow]
    exact hunit.pow k
  rw [map_zero] at h0
  exact zero_ne_one (isUnit_zero_iff.mp h0)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmoothOfRelativeDimension.eq_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem SmoothOfRelativeDimension.eq_of_nonempty (f : X ⟶ Y) [Nonempty X] {n m : ℕ}
    [hn : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] [hm : SmoothOfRelativeDimension m f] : n = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hxV, e, hP⟩ := hn.1 x
  have hloc : RingHom.Locally (RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension m)
      (f.appLE U V e).hom :=
    HasRingHomProperty.appLE (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension m) f hm ⟨U, hU⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩ e
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsP⟩ := hloc
  obtain ⟨t, hts, hxt⟩ := exists_mem_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top s hs hxV
  have hQm := hsP t hts
  have hQn : RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n
      ((algebraMap Γ(X, V) (Localization.Away t)).comp (f.appLE U V e).hom) :=
    (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_stableUnderCompositionWithLocalizationAway n).2
      (Localization.Away t) t _ hP
  have hnt : Nontrivial (Localization.Away t) := nontrivial_localizationAway_of_mem_basicOpen t hxt
  set ψ := (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (Localization.Away t)).comp (f.appLE U V e).hom with hψ
  algebraize [ψ]
  have h1 := Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential
    (R := Γ(Y, U)) (S := Localization.Away t) n
  have h2 := Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential
    (R := Γ(Y, U)) (S := Localization.Away t) m
  exact_mod_cast h1.symm.trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isOpenImmersion_subschemeMap_of_comap
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_subschemeMap_of_comap (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (hJ : J = I.comap f) (H : I ≤ J.map f) :
    IsOpenImmersion (subschemeMap J I f H)
proof:
:= by
  have sq : IsPullback J.subschemeι (subschemeMap J I f H) f I.subschemeι :=
    isPullback_of_isClosedImmersion J.subschemeι I.subschemeι (subschemeMap J I f H) f
      (subschemeMap_subschemeι J I f H).symm (by rw [ker_subschemeι, ker_subschemeι, hJ])
  exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback sq inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.exists_ι_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.exists_ι_eq_of_mem {Z : Scheme.{u}} {U : Z.Opens}
    {u : Z} (hu : u ∈ U) : ∃ y : U.toScheme, U.ι y = u
proof:
:= by
  have : u ∈ U.ι.opensRange := by rwa [Opens.opensRange_ι]
  exact Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.support_comap_subset_exceptionalSet
statement:
theorem support_comap_subset_exceptionalSet {B X : Scheme.{u}} (π : B ⟶ X)
    (Z : X.IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension m (Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap (Z.comap π) Z π
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap Z π))] :
    ((Z.comap π).support : Set B) ⊆ π.exceptionalSet
proof:
:= by
  intro x' hx'
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨U', hxU', hj⟩ := (Scheme.Hom.notMem_exceptionalSet_iff π).mp h
  
  have hcomp : Z.comap (U'.ι ≫ π) = (Z.comap π).comap U'.ι :=
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp Z U'.ι π
  have hle : Z.comap π ≤ (Z.comap (U'.ι ≫ π)).map U'.ι :=
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_iff_comap_le.mpr hcomp.ge
  set ι' : (Z.comap (U'.ι ≫ π)).subscheme ⟶ (Z.comap π).subscheme :=
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap (Z.comap (U'.ι ≫ π)) (Z.comap π) U'.ι hle with hι'_def
  have hι' : IsOpenImmersion ι' :=
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.isOpenImmersion_subschemeMap_of_comap U'.ι (Z.comap π) (Z.comap
        (U'.ι ≫ π)) hcomp hle
  set g := Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap (Z.comap π) Z π
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap Z π) with hg_def
  
  have hcomp2 : ι' ≫ g = Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap (Z.comap (U'.ι ≫ π)) Z (U'.ι ≫ π)
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap _ _) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono Z.subschemeι, Category.assoc, hg_def,
        Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap_subschemeι, hι'_def,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap_subschemeι_assoc,
          Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap_subschemeι]
  have hopen : IsOpenImmersion (ι' ≫ g) := by
    rw [hcomp2]
    exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.isOpenImmersion_subschemeMap_of_comap (U'.ι ≫ π) Z _ rfl _
  
  have hne : Nonempty (Z.comap (U'.ι ≫ π)).subscheme := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Scheme.Opens.exists_ι_eq_of_mem hxU'
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap] at hx'
    change π x' ∈ Z.support at hx'
    have hy' : y ∈ (Z.comap (U'.ι ≫ π)).support := by
      rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap]
      change (U'.ι ≫ π) y ∈ Z.support
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hy]
      exact hx'
    have hy'' : y ∈ Set.range (Z.comap (U'.ι ≫ π)).subschemeι := by
      rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι]
      exact hy'
    obtain ⟨p, -⟩ := hy''
    exact ⟨p⟩
  
  have h0 : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 (ι' ≫ g) := inferInstance
  have hm' : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (0 + m) (ι' ≫ g) := inferInstance
  have := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.eq_of_nonempty (ι' ≫ g) (n := 0) (m := 0 + m)
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.sub_mem_presentationIdeal
statement: theorem sub_mem_presentationIdeal (i : ι) : C a * X i - C (g i) ∈ presentationIdeal a g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.aeval_frac_mem_ker
statement:
theorem aeval_frac_mem_ker (p : MvPolynomial ι R) (hp : p ∈ presentationIdeal a g) :
    aeval (fun i => frac (a := a) (hg i)) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : presentationIdeal a g ≤
      RingHom.ker (aeval (fun i => frac (a := a) (hg i)) : MvPolynomial ι R →ₐ[R] _) := by
    refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker]
    change aeval (fun i => frac (a := a) (hg i)) (C a * X i - C (g i)) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X, aeval_C]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a *
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) (g i) * invSelf a) -
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) (g i) = 0
    rw [mul_left_comm, mul_invSelf, mul_one, sub_self]
  exact this hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.presentationHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem presentationHom_mk (p : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    presentationHom a g hg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) = aeval (fun i => frac (a := a) (hg i)) p
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_apply _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.presentationHom_mk_X

theorem presentationHom_mk_X (i : ι) :
    presentationHom a g hg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = frac (a := a) (hg i)
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.presentationHom_unique
statement:
theorem presentationHom_unique
    (φ : (MvPolynomial ι R ⧸ presentationIdeal a g) →ₐ[R] affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)
    (hφ : ∀ i, φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = frac (a := a) (hg i)) :
    φ = presentationHom a g hg
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext R (MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i => ?_)
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, hφ, presentationHom_mk_X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.presentationHom_surjective
statement:
theorem presentationHom_surjective (hI : I = Ideal.span (insert a (Set.range g))) :
    Function.Surjective (presentationHom a g hg)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  
  have key : ∀ x ∈ I, algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a ∈
      ((presentationHom a g hg).range.map (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a).val) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hI] at hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      rcases hy with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
      · rw [mul_invSelf]
        exact one_mem _
      · exact ⟨frac (a := a) (hg i), ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i), presentationHom_mk_X a g hg i⟩,
          rfl⟩
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, add_mul]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul r y _ hy =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_mem (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r) hy
  have hle : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a ≤
      (presentationHom a g hg).range.map (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a).val :=
    (affineBlowUpAlgebra_eq_adjoin I a).le.trans
      (Algebra.adjoin_le fun _ ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ => hxz ▸ key x hx)
  obtain ⟨w, ⟨q, hq⟩, hw⟩ := hle z.2
  exact ⟨q, Subtype.ext ((congrArg Subtype.val hq).trans hw)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.exists_pow_mul_sub_C_mem
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mul_sub_C_mem (p : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (c : R), C (a ^ d) * p - C c ∈ presentationIdeal a g
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => exact ⟨0, r, by rw [pow_zero, map_one, one_mul, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨d₁, c₁, h₁⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨d₂, c₂, h₂⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨d₁ + d₂, a ^ d₂ * c₁ + a ^ d₁ * c₂, ?_⟩
    have : C (a ^ (d₁ + d₂)) * (p + q) - C (a ^ d₂ * c₁ + a ^ d₁ * c₂) =
        C (a ^ d₂) * (C (a ^ d₁) * p - C c₁) + C (a ^ d₁) * (C (a ^ d₂) * q - C c₂) := by
      simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow, pow_add]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h₁) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h₂)
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    obtain ⟨d, c, h⟩ := hp
    refine ⟨d + 1, c * g i, ?_⟩
    have : C (a ^ (d + 1)) * (p * X i) - C (c * g i) =
        C (a ^ d) * p * (C a * X i - C (g i)) + C (g i) * (C (a ^ d) * p - C c) := by
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow, pow_succ]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (sub_mem_presentationIdeal a g i))
      (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algHom_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem algHom_apply_eq_zero_iff
    (φ : (MvPolynomial ι R ⧸ presentationIdeal a g) →ₐ[R] affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)
    (z : MvPolynomial ι R ⧸ presentationIdeal a g) :
    φ z = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, a ^ k • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    obtain ⟨d, c, hdc⟩ := exists_pow_mul_sub_C_mem a g p
    have h0 : φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C (a ^ d)) * Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p -
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C c)) = 0 := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_sub, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hdc, map_zero]
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, hz, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap, AlgHom.commutes] at h0
    have hc : algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) c = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val h0
    obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers a) _ c).mp hc
    have hk' : a ^ k * c = 0 := hk
    refine ⟨k + d, ?_⟩
    have hsplit : C (a ^ (k + d)) * p = C (a ^ k) * (C (a ^ d) * p - C c) + C (a ^ k * c) := by
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow, pow_add]; ring
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (a ^ (k + d) • p) = 0
    rw [← MvPolynomial.C_mul', hsplit, map_add,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hdc), zero_add, hk', map_zero,
      map_zero]
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have : algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a ^ k * φ z = 0 := by
      rw [← map_pow, ← Algebra.smul_def, ← map_smul, hk, map_zero]
    exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp (pow_mem (algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors (I := I) (a := a))
      k)).1 _ this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.presentationHom_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem presentationHom_apply_eq_zero_iff (z : MvPolynomial ι R ⧸ presentationIdeal a g) :
    presentationHom a g hg z = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, a ^ k • z = 0
proof:
:=
  algHom_apply_eq_zero_iff a g _ z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.appTop_Spec_map
statement:
theorem appTop_Spec_map (φ : R ⟶ S) :
    (Spec.map φ).appTop = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom ≫ φ ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.comp_id (Spec.map φ).appTop, ← (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).hom_inv_id, ← Category.assoc,
    Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality, Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.injective_ΓSpecIso_inv
statement: theorem injective_ΓSpecIso_inv : Function.Injective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).inv.hom
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_appTop_Spec_map
statement:
theorem ker_appTop_Spec_map (φ : R ⟶ S) :
    RingHom.ker (Spec.map φ).appTop.hom = (RingHom.ker φ.hom).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [appTop_Spec_map, CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← RingHom.comap_ker,
    RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ injective_ΓSpecIso_inv]
  ext x
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv.hom
    (fun y => ⟨(Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom.hom y,
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm_apply_apply y⟩)]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨(Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom x, hx,
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm_apply_apply x⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have h : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv.hom y) = y :=
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.apply_symm_apply y
    rw [h]
    exact hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_Spec_map_mk
statement:
theorem ker_Spec_map_mk (I : Ideal R) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker =
      ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv.hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.ker_of_isAffine, ker_appTop_Spec_map, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, Ideal.mk_ker]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_ofIdealTop_Spec_map
statement:
theorem comap_ofIdealTop_Spec_map (φ : R ⟶ S) (I : Ideal R) :
    (ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv.hom)).comap (Spec.map φ) =
      ofIdealTop ((I.map φ.hom).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).inv.hom)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := φ.hom.toAlgebra
  have hfst : (pullbackSpecIso R S (R ⧸ I)).inv ≫
      Limits.pullback.fst (Spec.map φ) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom :
        S →+* S ⊗[R] (R ⧸ I))) :=
    pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst R S (R ⧸ I)
  rw [← ker_Spec_map_mk, ← ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion,
    ← Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso (pullbackSpecIso R S (R ⧸ I)).inv, hfst,
    Scheme.ker_of_isAffine, ker_appTop_Spec_map, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
  have hincl : (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom : S →+* S ⊗[R] (R ⧸ I)) =
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot S I :
        S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R S) →ₐ[S] S ⊗[R] (R ⧸ I)) : _ →+* _).comp
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R S))) :=
    RingHom.ext fun s => (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot_mk S I s).symm
  rw [hincl, RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot S I).injective, Ideal.mk_ker]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPullback_fromSpec
statement:
theorem isPullback_fromSpec (J : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))))
      (J.subschemeCover.f U) U.2.fromSpec J.subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  have hopen : IsOpenImmersion (J.subschemeCover.f U) := J.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  change IsPullback _ _ hU.fromSpec _
  refine @IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))))
    (J.subschemeCover.f U) hU.fromSpec J.subschemeι hopen inferInstance ?_ ?_
  · exact (subschemeCover_map_subschemeι J U).trans (glueDataObjι_ι J U)
  · rw [IsAffineOpen.opensRange_fromSpec]
    exact (opensRange_subschemeCover_map J U).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_fromSpec
statement:
theorem comap_fromSpec (J : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    J.comap U.2.fromSpec = ofIdealTop ((J.ideal U).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := isPullback_fromSpec J U
  have hfst : Limits.pullback.fst U.2.fromSpec J.subschemeι =
      hP.isoPullback.inv ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) := by
    rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp, hP.isoPullback_hom_fst]
  rw [comap, hfst, Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso, ker_Spec_map_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_le
statement:
theorem ideal_comap_of_le (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (e : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) :
    (I.comap f).ideal V = (I.ideal U).map (f.appLE U.1 V.1 e).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (I.comap f).comap V.2.fromSpec =
      ofIdealTop (((I.comap f).ideal V).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, V)).inv.hom) :=
    comap_fromSpec _ V
  have h2 : (I.comap f).comap V.2.fromSpec =
      ofIdealTop (((I.ideal U).map (f.appLE U.1 V.1 e).hom).map
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, V)).inv.hom) := by
    rw [← comap_comp, ← IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f U.2 V.2 e, comap_comp,
      comap_fromSpec, comap_ofIdealTop_Spec_map]
  have h3 := h1.symm.trans h2
  have hinj : Function.Injective (ofIdealTop (X := Spec Γ(Y, V))) :=
    equivOfIsAffine.symm.injective
  have h4 := hinj h3
  
  set e : Γ(Y, V) ≃+* Γ(Spec Γ(Y, V), ⊤) :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, V)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he_def
  have he : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, V)).inv.hom = (e : Γ(Y, V) →+* Γ(Spec Γ(Y, V), ⊤)) := rfl
  rw [he, Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv, Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv] at h4
  exact Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _ e.symm.surjective h4

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_germ_ideal_comap
statement:
theorem map_germ_ideal_comap (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) (y : Y) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (hy : y ∈ V.1) (e : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) :
    ((I.comap f).ideal V).map (Y.presheaf.germ V.1 y hy).hom =
      ((I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (f y) (e hy)).hom).map (f.stalkMap y).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hfy : f y ∈ U.1 := e hy
  change _ = ((I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (f y) hfy).hom).map (f.stalkMap y).hom
  rw [ideal_comap_of_le I f U V e, Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  congr 2
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap, Scheme.Hom.appLE, Category.assoc, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.span_germ_appLE_eq_iff_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem span_germ_appLE_eq_iff_of_isOpenImmersion (I : X.IdealSheafData) (j : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (y : Y) (U : X.affineOpens) (V : Y.affineOpens) (hy : y ∈ V.1)
    (e : V.1 ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    Ideal.span {Y.presheaf.germ V.1 y hy (j.appLE U.1 V.1 e a)} =
        ((I.comap j).ideal V).map (Y.presheaf.germ V.1 y hy).hom ↔
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) (e hy) a} =
        (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) (e hy)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hfy : j y ∈ U.1 := e hy
  change _ ↔ Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) hfy a} =
    (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) hfy).hom
  rw [map_germ_ideal_comap I j y U V hy e]
  have hnat : Y.presheaf.germ V.1 y hy (j.appLE U.1 V.1 e a) =
      j.stalkMap y (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) hfy a) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE, CommRingCat.comp_apply,
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  rw [hnat]
  set σ : X.presheaf.stalk (j y) ≃+* Y.presheaf.stalk y :=
    (asIso (j.stalkMap y)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with hσ_def
  have hσ : (j.stalkMap y).hom = (σ : X.presheaf.stalk (j y) →+* Y.presheaf.stalk y) := rfl
  rw [hσ]
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (Ideal.map (σ : X.presheaf.stalk (j y) →+* Y.presheaf.stalk y)) := by
    intro A B h
    rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv, Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv] at h
    exact Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _ σ.symm.surjective h
  rw [show Ideal.span {j.stalkMap y (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) hfy a)} =
      (Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) hfy a}).map
        (σ : X.presheaf.stalk (j y) →+* Y.presheaf.stalk y) by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]; rfl]
  exact hinj.eq_iff

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpen_generator_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem exists_affineOpen_generator_of_isInvertible (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible) (U : X.affineOpens) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) :
    ∃ V : Y.affineOpens, y ∈ V.1 ∧ ∃ e : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, ∃ a ∈ I.ideal U,
      (I.comap f).ideal V = Ideal.span {f.appLE U.1 V.1 e a} ∧
        f.appLE U.1 V.1 e a ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(Y, V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V₁, hyV₁, h, hh, hJ₁⟩ := hf y
  obtain ⟨s, hs_le, hys⟩ := V₁.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⟨y, hy⟩ hyV₁
  set V₀ : Y.affineOpens := Y.affineBasicOpen s with hV₀
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀, hJ₀⟩ : ∃ g ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(Y, V₀), (I.comap f).ideal V₀ = Ideal.span {g} :=
    exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen (I.comap f) V₁ hh hJ₁ s
  have e₀ : V₀.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := hs_le
  have hyV₀ : y ∈ V₀.1 := hys
  
  have hmem : h₀ ∈ (I.ideal U).map (f.appLE U.1 V₀.1 e₀).hom := by
    rw [← ideal_comap_of_le I f U V₀ e₀, hJ₀]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self h₀
  have hmem' : h₀ ∈ Submodule.span Γ(Y, V₀)
      ((f.appLE U.1 V₀.1 e₀).hom '' (I.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U))) := hmem
  obtain ⟨T, hTs, hhT⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span hmem'
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finset.mp hhT
  
  have hTJ : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∈ (I.comap f).ideal V₀ := fun z hz => by
    rw [ideal_comap_of_le I f U V₀ e₀]
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hTs hz
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx
  have ht : ∀ z ∈ T, ∃ t : Γ(Y, V₀), t * h₀ = z := fun z hz =>
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hJ₀ ▸ hTJ z hz)
  choose! t ht using ht
  have hsum : (∑ z ∈ T, c z * t z) * h₀ = h₀ :=
    calc (∑ z ∈ T, c z * t z) * h₀ = ∑ z ∈ T, c z * (t z * h₀) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = ∑ z ∈ T, c z • z := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z hz => by rw [ht z hz, smul_eq_mul]
      _ = h₀ := hc
  have hsum' : ∑ z ∈ T, c z * t z = 1 :=
    (mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors hh₀).mp (by rw [one_mul]; exact hsum)
  
  set p := V₀.2.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyV₀⟩ with hp
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, htp⟩ : ∃ z ∈ T, t z ∉ p.asIdeal := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have h1 : (1 : Γ(Y, V₀)) ∈ p.asIdeal :=
      hsum' ▸ Submodule.sum_mem _ fun z hz => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hcon z hz)
    exact p.isPrime.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr h1)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ := hTs hz₀
  
  have hloc := V₀.2.isLocalization_basicOpen (t z₀)
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(Y, V₀) Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen (t z₀)) (t z₀)) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
  have hres : f.appLE U.1 (Y.basicOpen (t z₀)) ((Y.basicOpen_le _).trans e₀) =
      f.appLE U.1 V₀.1 e₀ ≫ Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le (t z₀))).op :=
    (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map f e₀ (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le (t z₀))).op).symm
  have hval : (f.appLE U.1 (Y.basicOpen (t z₀)) ((Y.basicOpen_le _).trans e₀)).hom x =
      algebraMap Γ(Y, V₀) Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen (t z₀)) (t z₀) *
        algebraMap Γ(Y, V₀) Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen (t z₀)) h₀ := by
    rw [hres, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, hxz]
    exact (congrArg (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le (t z₀))).op).hom
      (ht z₀ hz₀).symm).trans (map_mul _ _ _)
  refine ⟨Y.affineBasicOpen (t z₀), ?_, (Y.basicOpen_le _).trans e₀, x, hx, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := (fromSpec_mem_basicOpen_iff V₀.2 p (t z₀)).mpr htp
    rwa [hp, IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_primeIdealOf V₀.2 ⟨y, hyV₀⟩] at this
  · rw [ideal_affineBasicOpen_eq_map (I.comap f) V₀ (t z₀), hJ₀, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton]
    change _ = Ideal.span {(f.appLE U.1 (Y.basicOpen (t z₀)) ((Y.basicOpen_le _).trans e₀)).hom x}
    rw [hval, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hu]
  · change (f.appLE U.1 (Y.basicOpen (t z₀)) ((Y.basicOpen_le _).trans e₀)).hom x ∈
      nonZeroDivisors Γ(Y, Y.basicOpen (t z₀))
    rw [hval]
    exact mul_mem hu.mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap (Submonoid.powers (t z₀)) _ hh₀)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_colon_iff_mul_le
statement:
theorem le_colon_iff_mul_le {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {I J K : Ideal R} :
    J ≤ I.colon (K : Set R) ↔ J * K ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Ideal.mul_le]
    intro r hr s hs
    exact Submodule.mem_colon.mp (h hr) s hs
  · intro h r hr
    exact Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun s hs => Ideal.mul_le.mp h r hr s hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.map_colon_of_fg
statement:
theorem map_colon_of_fg {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] (I J : Ideal R) (hJ : J.FG) :
    (I.colon (J : Set R)).map (algebraMap R S) =
      (I.map (algebraMap R S)).colon (J.map (algebraMap R S) : Set S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro x hx
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
    have h1 : Ideal.span {x} * J ≤ I :=
      le_colon_iff_mul_le.mp (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx))
    have h2 : Ideal.span {algebraMap R S x} * J.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ I.map (algebraMap R S) := by
      rw [← Set.image_singleton, ← Ideal.map_span, ← Ideal.map_mul]
      exact Ideal.map_mono h1
    exact le_colon_iff_mul_le.mpr h2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hJ
    obtain ⟨⟨x, m⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective M z
    have key : ∀ j ∈ s, ∃ c ∈ M, c * (x * j) ∈ I := by
      intro j hj
      have hzj : IsLocalization.mk' S x m * algebraMap R S j ∈ I.map (algebraMap R S) :=
        Submodule.mem_colon.mp hz _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span hj))
      rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_one (M := M) S j, ← IsLocalization.mk'_mul, mul_one] at hzj
      exact (IsLocalization.mk'_mem_map_algebraMap_iff M S I (x * j) m).mp hzj
    choose! c hcM hcI using key
    refine (IsLocalization.mk'_mem_map_algebraMap_iff M S _ x m).mpr ⟨∏ j ∈ s, c j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Submonoid.prod_mem _ fun j hj => hcM j hj
    · rw [Ideal.colon_span]
      refine Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun j hj => ?_
      rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, ← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ hj, mul_assoc]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hcI j hj)

name: Ideal.IsInvertible.fg
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.IsInvertible.fg {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {J : Ideal A} (hJ : J.IsInvertible) :
    J.FG
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial A with hA | hA
  · have : Subsingleton (Ideal A) := (Submodule.subsingleton_iff A).mpr hA
    exact ⟨∅, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  
  choose s hs a ha hJa _ using hJ
  
  have htop : Ideal.span (Set.range s) = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hne
    exact hs ⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩ (hle (Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩))
  obtain ⟨T, hTs, hT⟩ := (Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_finite _).mp htop
  
  have hT' : ∀ t ∈ T, ∃ p, s p = t := fun t ht => hTs ht
  choose! p hp using hT'
  
  have hloc : ∀ x ∈ J, ∀ t ∈ T, ∃ n : ℕ, t ^ n * x ∈ Ideal.span {a (p t)} := by
    intro x hx t ht
    have hx' : algebraMap A (Localization.Away (s (p t))) x ∈
        Ideal.span {algebraMap A (Localization.Away (s (p t))) (a (p t))} := by
      rw [← hJa (p t)]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hx'
    obtain ⟨n, y', hy'⟩ :=
      IsLocalization.Away.surj (S := Localization.Away (s (p t))) (s (p t)) y
    have h3 : algebraMap A (Localization.Away (s (p t))) (x * s (p t) ^ n) =
        algebraMap A (Localization.Away (s (p t))) (a (p t) * y') := by
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, ← hy, ← hy']; ring
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (Submonoid.powers (s (p t))) _).mp h3
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff (c : A) (s (p t))).mp c.2
    rw [← hk] at hc
    refine ⟨k + n, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨s (p t) ^ k * y', ?_⟩⟩
    have ht' : t ^ (k + n) * x = s (p t) ^ (k + n) * x := by rw [hp t ht]
    rw [ht', pow_add]
    calc s (p t) ^ k * y' * a (p t) = s (p t) ^ k * (a (p t) * y') := by ring
      _ = s (p t) ^ k * (x * s (p t) ^ n) := hc.symm
      _ = s (p t) ^ k * s (p t) ^ n * x := by ring
  
  refine ⟨T.image fun t => a (p t), le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy)
    exact ha (p t)
  · intro x hx
    choose! n hn using hloc x hx
    set N := T.sup n with hN
    have hxN : ∀ t ∈ T, t ^ N * x ∈ Ideal.span (T.image fun t => a (p t) : Set A) := by
      intro t ht
      have hle : n t ≤ N := Finset.le_sup (f := n) ht
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
      rw [hd, pow_add, mul_comm (t ^ n t), mul_assoc]
      refine Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.span_mono ?_ (hn t ht))
      rintro _ rfl
      exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ht)
    have hpow : Ideal.span ((fun t => t ^ N) '' (T : Set A)) = ⊤ := Ideal.span_pow_eq_top _ hT N
    
    have hle : Ideal.span ((fun t => t ^ N) '' (T : Set A)) ≤
        (Ideal.span (T.image fun t => a (p t) : Set A)).colon {x} := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr (hxN t (Finset.mem_coe.mp ht))
    have h1 : (1 : A) ∈ (Ideal.span (T.image fun t => a (p t) : Set A)).colon {x} :=
      hle (hpow ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
    simpa using Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mp h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.iSup_colon_pow_eq
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_eq {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (I : Ideal R) (s : R) :
    ⨆ i : ℕ, (I.map f).colon {f s ^ i} =
      ((I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away s))).map
        (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away s) (Localization.Away (f s)) f s)).comap
          (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (f s)))
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away s) (Localization.Away (f s)) f s).comp
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away s)) = (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (f s))).comp f := by
    ext r
    simp [IsLocalization.Away.map]
  rw [Ideal.map_map, hφ, ← Ideal.map_map]
  have hmono : Monotone fun i : ℕ => (I.map f).colon ({f s ^ i} : Set S) := by
    intro i j hij z hz
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton] at hz ⊢
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hij
    rw [smul_eq_mul] at hz ⊢
    rw [pow_add, ← mul_assoc]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hz
  ext z
  rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ hmono.directed_le, Ideal.mem_comap,
    IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff (M := Submonoid.powers (f s))]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    refine ⟨f s ^ i, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers _) i, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mp hi
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, hmz⟩
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff m (f s)).mp hm
    refine ⟨i, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr ?_⟩
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    exact hmz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.dvd_of_dvd_mul_pow
statement:
theorem dvd_of_dvd_mul_pow {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {h g : R} (hh : Prime h)
    (hg : ¬ h ∣ g) {z : R} : ∀ i : ℕ, g ∣ z * h ^ i → g ∣ z
  | 0, hz => by simpa using hz
  | i + 1, hz => by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩
proof:
:= hz
    have hdvd : h ∣ g * w := ⟨z * h ^ i, by rw [← hw]; ring⟩
    obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := (hh.dvd_or_dvd hdvd).resolve_left hg
    refine dvd_of_dvd_mul_pow hh hg i ⟨w', mul_left_cancel₀ hh.ne_zero ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ] at hw
    linear_combination hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun i z hz => ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hz
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hz
    exact dvd_of_dvd_mul_pow hh hg i ⟨w * h ^ k, by rw [hw]; ring⟩
  · refine le_iSup_of_le k ?_
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨1, by rw [smul_eq_mul]; ring⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_le
statement:
theorem ideal_colon_le (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (I.colon K).ideal U ≤ (I.ideal U).colon (K.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U))
proof:
:=
  ideal_ofIdeals_le _ U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_colon_iff
statement:
theorem le_colon_iff :
    J ≤ I.colon K ↔ ∀ U, J.ideal U ≤ (I.ideal U).colon (K.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U))
proof:
:=
  le_ofIdeals_iff

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_colon_iff_mul_le
statement: theorem le_colon_iff_mul_le : J ≤ I.colon K ↔ J * K ≤ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_colon_iff, le_def]
  exact forall_congr' fun U => AlgebraicGeometry.le_colon_iff_mul_le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.mul_le_self_left
statement: theorem mul_le_self_left : I * K ≤ I
proof: := fun _ => Ideal.mul_le_left

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_colon_self
statement: theorem le_colon_self : I ≤ I.colon K
proof:
:=
  (le_colon_iff_mul_le I I K).mpr (mul_le_self_left I K)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_mul_le
statement: theorem colon_mul_le : I.colon K * K ≤ I
proof:
:=
  (le_colon_iff_mul_le I (I.colon K) K).mp le_rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_mono_left
statement: theorem colon_mono_left (h : I ≤ J) : I.colon K ≤ J.colon K
proof:
:=
  (le_colon_iff_mul_le J _ K).mpr ((colon_mul_le I K).trans h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_anti_right
statement: theorem colon_anti_right {K K' : X.IdealSheafData} (h : K ≤ K') : I.colon K' ≤ I.colon K
proof:
:=
  (le_colon_iff_mul_le I _ K).mpr <| by
    have h1 : I.colon K' * K ≤ I.colon K' * K' := le_def.mpr fun U => Ideal.mul_mono_right (h U)
    exact h1.trans (colon_mul_le I K')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_top
statement: theorem colon_top : I.colon ⊤ = I
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((mul_top _).symm.le.trans (colon_mul_le I ⊤)) (le_colon_self I ⊤)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_colon
statement: theorem colon_colon (L : X.IdealSheafData) : (I.colon K).colon L = I.colon (K * L)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [le_colon_iff_mul_le, mul_comm K L, ← mul_assoc]
    have h1 : (I.colon K).colon L * L * K ≤ I.colon K * K :=
      le_def.mpr fun U => Ideal.mul_mono_left (colon_mul_le (I.colon K) L U)
    exact h1.trans (colon_mul_le I K)
  · rw [le_colon_iff_mul_le, le_colon_iff_mul_le, mul_assoc, mul_comm L K]
    exact colon_mul_le I (K * L)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_of_fg
statement:
theorem ideal_colon_of_fg (hK : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, (K.ideal U).FG) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (I.colon K).ideal U = (I.ideal U).colon (K.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (ideal_colon_le I K U) ?_
  let G : X.IdealSheafData :=
    { ideal := fun U => (I.ideal U).colon (K.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U))
      map_ideal_basicOpen := fun U f => by
        let _ : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.affineBasicOpen f) :=
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom.toAlgebra
        have : IsLocalization.Away f Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) :=
          U.2.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen _ _ rfl
        have h1 := I.map_ideal_basicOpen U f
        have h2 := K.map_ideal_basicOpen U f
        exact (map_colon_of_fg (Submonoid.powers f) (S := Γ(X, X.basicOpen f))
          (I.ideal U) (K.ideal U) (hK U)).trans (by rw [← h1, ← h2]; rfl) }
  have hG : G ≤ I.colon K := (le_colon_iff I G K).mpr fun _ => le_rfl
  exact hG U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem ideal_colon_of_isInvertible (hK : K.IsInvertible) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (I.colon K).ideal U = (I.ideal U).colon (K.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U))
proof:
:=
  ideal_colon_of_fg I K (fun U => (hK.ideal K U).fg) U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_pow_le_saturate
statement: theorem colon_pow_le_saturate (i : ℕ) : I.colon (K ^ i) ≤ I.saturate K
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun i => I.colon (K ^ i)) i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_saturate
statement: theorem le_saturate : I ≤ I.saturate K
proof:
:=
  (le_colon_self I (K ^ 0)).trans (colon_pow_le_saturate I K 0)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_saturate
statement:
theorem ideal_saturate (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (I.saturate K).ideal U = ⨆ i : ℕ, (I.colon (K ^ i)).ideal U
proof:
:= by
  simp only [saturate, ideal_iSup, iSup_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.saturate_mono_left
statement: theorem saturate_mono_left (h : I ≤ J) : I.saturate K ≤ J.saturate K
proof:
:=
  iSup_mono fun i => colon_mono_left I J (K ^ i) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.saturate_eq_self_of_colon_eq
statement: theorem saturate_eq_self_of_colon_eq (h : I.colon K = I) : I.saturate K = I
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ i : ℕ, I.colon (K ^ i) = I := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact colon_top I
    | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, ← colon_colon, ih, h]
  rw [saturate]
  exact le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i => (hpow i).le) (le_saturate I K)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_pow
statement:
theorem isInvertible_pow {E : X.IdealSheafData} (hE : E.IsInvertible) (c : ℕ) :
    (E ^ c).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact isInvertible_top
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact ih.mul hE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_saturate_of_isInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [ideal_saturate]
  refine iSup_congr fun i => ?_
  rw [ideal_colon_of_isInvertible I (K ^ i) (isInvertible_pow hK i), ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply, he,
    Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.colon_span]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.pow_mul_colon_of_dvd
statement:
theorem pow_mul_colon_of_dvd (E : X.IdealSheafData) (c : ℕ) (h : E ^ c ∣ I) :
    E ^ c * I.colon (E ^ c) = I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ((mul_comm _ _).le.trans (colon_mul_le I (E ^ c))) ?_
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := h
  have hle : L ≤ I.colon (E ^ c) :=
    (le_colon_iff_mul_le I L (E ^ c)).mpr (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hL.ge)
  calc I = E ^ c * L := hL
    _ ≤ E ^ c * I.colon (E ^ c) := fun U => Ideal.mul_mono_right (hle U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_pow_eq_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem colon_pow_eq_of_mul_eq {E : X.IdealSheafData} (hE : E.IsInvertible) (c : ℕ)
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) (h : E ^ c * K = I) : I.colon (E ^ c) = K
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ((le_colon_iff_mul_le I K (E ^ c)).mpr (by rw [mul_comm]; exact h.le))
  have hEc := isInvertible_pow hE c
  choose U hxU e he hEe using hEc
  refine le_of_iSup_eq_top (I := I.colon (E ^ c)) (J := K) U ?_ fun x => ?_
  · refine top_le_iff.mp fun y _ => ?_
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨y, hxU y⟩
  · intro u hu
    have hu' := ideal_colon_le I (E ^ c) (U x) hu
    rw [hEe x] at hu'
    have hue : u * e x ∈ I.ideal (U x) := by
      simpa using Submodule.mem_colon.mp hu' (e x) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    have hI : I.ideal (U x) = Ideal.span {e x} * K.ideal (U x) := by
      rw [← h, ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply, hEe x]
    rw [hI] at hue
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hez⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.mp hue
    have hzu : e x * z = e x * u := by rw [hez, mul_comm]
    exact (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (he x)).mp hzu ▸ hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.fromSpec_mem_zeroLocus_iff
statement:
theorem fromSpec_mem_zeroLocus_iff {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U)) (s : Set Γ(X, U)) :
    hU.fromSpec q ∈ X.zeroLocus (U := U) s ↔ s ⊆ q.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_zeroLocus_iff]
  refine forall₂_congr fun f _ => ?_
  rw [fromSpec_mem_basicOpen_iff hU q f, not_not]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf
statement:
theorem mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf (U : X.affineOpens) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U.1)
    (s : Set Γ(X, U)) :
    x ∈ X.zeroLocus (U := U.1) s ↔ s ⊆ ((U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  have hx' : x ∈ X.zeroLocus (U := U.1) s ↔
      hU.fromSpec (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩) ∈ X.zeroLocus (U := U.1) s := by
    rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_primeIdealOf]
  rw [hx', fromSpec_mem_zeroLocus_iff hU]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_pow_mono
statement: theorem colon_pow_mono (I K : X.IdealSheafData) : Monotone fun i : ℕ => I.colon (K ^ i)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => colon_anti_right I fun _ => Ideal.pow_le_pow_right h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_support_saturate
statement:
theorem coe_support_saturate [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData) :
    ((I.saturate K).support : Set X) = closure ((I.support : Set X) \ (K.support : Set X))
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, (K.ideal U).FG := fun U =>
    (isNoetherianRing_iff_ideal_fg _).mp (IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U) _
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    
    
    intro x hx
    by_contra hcl
    simp only [mem_closure_iff, not_forall, Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hcl
    obtain ⟨W, hWo, hxW, hW⟩ := hcl
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hxU, hUW⟩ :=
      X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hxW hWo
    let V : X.affineOpens := ⟨U, hU⟩
    have hV : IsAffineOpen V.1 := hU
    have hxV : x ∈ V.1 := hxU
    
    have hVIK : ∀ y ∈ V.1, y ∈ I.support → y ∈ K.support := by
      intro y hyV hyI
      by_contra hyK
      have : y ∈ W ∩ ((I.support : Set X) \ (K.support : Set X)) := ⟨hUW hyV, hyI, hyK⟩
      rw [hW] at this
      exact (Set.mem_empty_iff_false y).mp this
    
    have hrad : K.ideal V ≤ (I.ideal V).radical := by
      rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf]
      refine le_sInf fun q ⟨hIq, hq⟩ => ?_
      let q' : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, V) := ⟨q, hq⟩
      have hyV : hV.fromSpec q' ∈ V.1 := by
        have : q' ∈ hV.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := by rw [hV.fromSpec_preimage_self]; trivial
        exact this
      have hyI : hV.fromSpec q' ∈ I.support := by
        rw [mem_support_iff_of_mem hyV, fromSpec_mem_zeroLocus_iff hV]
        exact hIq
      have hyK := hVIK _ hyV hyI
      rw [mem_support_iff_of_mem hyV, fromSpec_mem_zeroLocus_iff hV] at hyK
      exact hyK
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg hrad (hfg V)
    have hone : (1 : Γ(X, V)) ∈ (I.saturate K).ideal V := by
      refine colon_pow_le_saturate I K n V ?_
      rw [ideal_colon_of_fg I (K ^ n) (fun U => ?_) V]
      · exact Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun k hk => by simpa using hn hk
      · rw [ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply]
        exact (hfg U).pow
    have hx' := (mem_support_iff_of_mem hxV).mp hx
    rw [mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf V hxV] at hx'
    exact (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).isPrime.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr (hx' hone))
  · 
    
    refine closure_minimal ?_ (I.saturate K).support.isClosed'
    rintro x ⟨hxI, hxK⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe] at hxI hxK ⊢
    rw [mem_support_iff_of_mem hxU, mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf U hxU] at hxI hxK ⊢
    obtain ⟨k, hkK, hkp⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hxK
    intro z hz
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ideal_saturate] at hz
    have hdir : Directed (· ≤ ·) fun i : ℕ => (I.colon (K ^ i)).ideal U :=
      (show Monotone (fun i : ℕ => (I.colon (K ^ i)).ideal U) from
        fun _ _ h => colon_pow_mono I K h U).directed_le
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ hdir).mp hz
    have hi' := ideal_colon_le I (K ^ i) U hi
    have hk : k ^ i ∈ (K ^ i).ideal U := by
      rw [ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply]
      exact Ideal.pow_mem_pow hkK i
    have hzk : z * k ^ i ∈ I.ideal U := by simpa using Submodule.mem_colon.mp hi' _ hk
    rcases (U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩ |>.isPrime.mem_or_mem (hxI hzk) with
      hz' | hk'
    · exact hz'
    · exact absurd (((U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem i hk')
        hkp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.controlledTransformAlong_zero
statement: theorem controlledTransformAlong_zero : J.controlledTransformAlong π E 0 = J.comap π
proof:
:= by
  simp [controlledTransformAlong, Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_top]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_le_controlledTransformAlong
statement:
theorem comap_le_controlledTransformAlong (c : ℕ) :
    J.comap π ≤ J.controlledTransformAlong π E c
proof:
:=
  Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_colon_self _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.controlledTransformAlong_le_strictTransformAlong
statement:
theorem controlledTransformAlong_le_strictTransformAlong (c : ℕ) :
    J.controlledTransformAlong π E c ≤ J.strictTransformAlong π E
proof:
:=
  Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_pow_le_saturate _ _ c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.controlledTransformAlong_mono
statement:
theorem controlledTransformAlong_mono {c d : ℕ} (h : c ≤ d) :
    J.controlledTransformAlong π E c ≤ J.controlledTransformAlong π E d
proof:
:=
  Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_anti_right _ fun _ => Ideal.pow_le_pow_right h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ideal_controlledTransformAlong_of_appLE
statement:
theorem ideal_controlledTransformAlong_of_appLE (hE : E.IsInvertible) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (U' : B.affineOpens) (e : U'.1 ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (a : Γ(X, U))
    (ha : E.ideal U' = Ideal.span {π.appLE U.1 U'.1 e a}) (m : ℕ) :
    (J.controlledTransformAlong π E m).ideal U' =
      ((J.ideal U).map (π.appLE U.1 U'.1 e).hom).colon {π.appLE U.1 U'.1 e a ^ m}
proof:
:= by
  rw [controlledTransformAlong,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_of_isInvertible _ _
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_pow hE m),
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply, ha, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
    Ideal.colon_span, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_le J π U U' e]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayFrac_one_eq
statement:
theorem awayFrac_one_eq (x : R) :
    awayFrac a 1 x = algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayFrac_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem affineBlowUpAlgebra_eq_adjoin :
    affineBlowUpAlgebra I a = Algebra.adjoin R
      ((fun x : R => algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a) ''
        I)
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineBlowUpAlgebra
  congr 1
  exact Set.image_congr fun x _ => (awayFrac_one x).symm.trans (awayFrac_one_eq x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mul_invSelf_mem
statement:
theorem mul_invSelf_mem {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineBlowUpAlgebra_eq_adjoin]
  exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coe_frac
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_frac {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    (frac (a := a) hx : Localization.Away a) = algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coe_frac_eq_awayFrac
statement:
theorem coe_frac_eq_awayFrac {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    (frac (a := a) hx : Localization.Away a) = awayFrac a 1 x
proof:
:=
  (awayFrac_one_eq x).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {p : ∀ y : Localization.Away a, y ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a → Prop}
    (mem : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ I),
      p (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a) (mul_invSelf_mem hx))
    (algebraMap : ∀ r, p (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) r) (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r))
    (add : ∀ y z hy hz, p y hy → p z hz → p (y + z) (add_mem hy hz))
    (mul : ∀ y z hy hz, p y hy → p z hz → p (y * z) (mul_mem hy hz))
    {y : Localization.Away a} (hy : y ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) : p y hy
proof:
:= by
  have heq := affineBlowUpAlgebra_eq_adjoin I a
  have hmem := heq.ge
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun y _ => ∀ hy : y ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a, p y hy)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (heq.le hy) hy
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _
    exact mem x hx
  · intro r _
    exact algebraMap r
  · intro y z hy hz ihy ihz _
    exact add y z (hmem hy) (hmem hz) (ihy _) (ihz _)
  · intro y z hy hz ihy ihz _
    exact mul y z (hmem hy) (hmem hz) (ihy _) (ihz _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mul_invSelf_pow_mem
statement:
theorem mul_invSelf_pow_mem :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {x : R}, x ∈ I ^ n →
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a ^ n ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a
  | 0, x, _ => by simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]; exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ x
  | n + 1, x, hx => by
    rw [pow_succ'] at hx
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hx (fun m hm k hk => ?_) (fun y z hy hz => ?_)
    · have : algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) (m * k) * invSelf a ^ (n + 1) =
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) m * invSelf a) *
            (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) k * invSelf a ^ n)
proof:
:= by
        rw [map_mul, pow_succ']; ring
      rw [this]
      exact mul_mem (mul_invSelf_mem hm) (mul_invSelf_pow_mem n hk)
    · rw [map_add, add_mul]
      exact add_mem hy hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mem_iff
statement:
theorem mem_iff (ha : a ∈ I) (y : Localization.Away a) :
    y ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ x ∈ I ^ n, y * algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a ^ n =
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy
    induction hy using induction_on with
    | mem x hx =>
      exact ⟨1, x, by simpa using hx, by rw [pow_one, mul_assoc, mul_comm (invSelf a),
        mul_invSelf, mul_one]⟩
    | algebraMap r => exact ⟨0, r, by simp, by simp⟩
    | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
      obtain ⟨n, x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
      obtain ⟨m, x', hx', hx'z⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨n + m, x * a ^ m + x' * a ^ n, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine add_mem ?_ ?_
        · rw [pow_add]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha m)
        · rw [pow_add, mul_comm (I ^ n)]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx' (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha n)
      · rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, ← hxy, ← hx'z, pow_add]; ring
    | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
      obtain ⟨n, x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
      obtain ⟨m, x', hx', hx'z⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨n + m, x * x', by rw [pow_add]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx hx', ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, ← hxy, ← hx'z, pow_add]; ring
  · rintro ⟨n, x, hx, hxy⟩
    have : y = algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a ^ n := by
      calc y = y * (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a * invSelf a) ^ n := by
            rw [mul_invSelf, one_pow, mul_one]
        _ = algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a ^ n := by
            rw [mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, hxy]
    rw [this]
    exact mul_invSelf_pow_mem n hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_mul_pow_eq_iff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mul_pow_eq_iff (x y : R) (n m : ℕ) :
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a ^ m =
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) y * algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a ^ n ↔
      ∃ k : ℕ, a ^ k * (a ^ m * x - a ^ n * y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
    IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (Submonoid.powers a)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨c, k, rfl⟩, hc⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_sub, sub_eq_zero, mul_comm (a ^ m), mul_comm (a ^ n)]
    exact hc
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨⟨a ^ k, k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_sub, sub_eq_zero, mul_comm (a ^ m), mul_comm (a ^ n)] at hk
    exact hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors :
    algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a ∈ nonZeroDivisors (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a,
      z * algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a = 0 → z = 0 := fun z hz =>
    Subtype.ext ((algebraMap_isUnit (S := Localization.Away a) a).mul_left_eq_zero.mp
      (congrArg Subtype.val hz))
  exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mpr ⟨fun z hz => key z (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hz), key⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.map_algebraMap_eq_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro x hx
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨frac hx, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a * algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a
      = algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (invSelf a), mul_invSelf, mul_one]
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.isLocalization_away
statement:
theorem isLocalization_away :
    IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a) (Localization.Away a)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsLocalization.Away.mk _ (algebraMap_isUnit (S := Localization.Away a) a) ?_ ?_
  · intro s
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj (S := Localization.Away a) a s
    exact ⟨n, algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) p, hp⟩
  · intro x y h
    exact ⟨0, by rw [pow_zero, one_mul, one_mul]; exact Subtype.ext h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algHom_ext
statement:
theorem algHom_ext {A : Type v} [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] {φ ψ : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a →ₐ[R] A}
    (h : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ I), φ (frac hx) = ψ (frac hx)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext fun z => ?_
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := z
  induction hz using induction_on with
  | mem x hx => exact h x hx
  | algebraMap r =>
    exact (φ.commutes r).trans (ψ.commutes r).symm
  | add y z hy hz ihy ihz =>
    change φ (⟨y, hy⟩ + ⟨z, hz⟩) = ψ (⟨y, hy⟩ + ⟨z, hz⟩)
    rw [map_add, map_add, ihy, ihz]
  | mul y z hy hz ihy ihz =>
    change φ (⟨y, hy⟩ * ⟨z, hz⟩) = ψ (⟨y, hy⟩ * ⟨z, hz⟩)
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, ihy, ihz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.liftAux_algebraMap
statement:
theorem liftAux_algebraMap (r : R) :
    liftAux β (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) r) =
      algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)) (β r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftAux IsLocalization.Away.map
  exact IsLocalization.map_eq _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.liftAux_mem_range
statement:
theorem liftAux_mem_range (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I f) :
    liftAux β (z : Localization.Away f) ∈ (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f))).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x, hx, hz⟩ := (mem_iff hf z).mp z.2
  have hx' : β x ∈ Ideal.span {β f ^ n} := by
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_pow, ← hI, ← Ideal.map_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem β hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hx'
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)) (β f) ^ n) :=
    (algebraMap_isUnit (S := Localization.Away (β f)) (β f)).pow n
  apply hu.mul_left_injective
  calc algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)) s * algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)) (β f) ^ n
      = algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)) (β x) := by rw [← hs, map_mul, map_pow]
    _ = liftAux β (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) x) := (liftAux_algebraMap β x).symm
    _ = liftAux β ((z : Localization.Away f) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) f ^ n) := by
        rw [hz]
    _ = liftAux β z * algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)) (β f) ^ n := by
        rw [map_mul, map_pow, liftAux_algebraMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.injective_algebraMap_away
statement:
theorem injective_algebraMap_away :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)))
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.injective (M := Submonoid.powers (β f)) (Localization.Away (β f))
    (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hβf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_lift
statement:
theorem algebraMap_lift (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I f) :
    algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)) (lift β hf hβf hI z) = liftAux β z
proof:
:= by
  set e := RingEquiv.ofBijective (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f))).rangeRestrict
    ⟨fun _ _ h => injective_algebraMap_away β hβf (congrArg Subtype.val h),
      (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f))).rangeRestrict_surjective⟩
  have : algebraMap S (Localization.Away (β f)) (lift β hf hβf hI z) =
      (e (e.symm ⟨liftAux β z, liftAux_mem_range β hf hI z⟩) : Localization.Away (β f)) := rfl
  rw [this, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.lift_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem lift_comp_algebraMap :
    (lift β hf hβf hI).comp (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I f)) = β
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun r => injective_algebraMap_away β hβf ?_
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, algebraMap_lift]
  exact liftAux_algebraMap β r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mul_pow_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem mul_pow_of_comp_eq (δ : affineBlowUpAlgebra I f →+* S)
    (hδ : δ.comp (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I f)) = β) (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I f)
    (x : R) (n : ℕ)
    (hz : (z : Localization.Away f) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) f ^ n =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) x) :
    δ z * β f ^ n = β x
proof:
:= by
  have hz' : z * algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I f) f ^ n =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I f) x := Subtype.ext hz
  rw [← hδ, RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, hz']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique (δ : affineBlowUpAlgebra I f →+* S)
    (hδ : δ.comp (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I f)) = β) : δ = lift β hf hβf hI
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun z => ?_
  obtain ⟨n, x, hx, hz⟩ := (mem_iff hf z).mp z.2
  have h₁ := mul_pow_of_comp_eq β δ hδ z x n hz
  have h₂ := mul_pow_of_comp_eq β (lift β hf hβf hI) (lift_comp_algebraMap β hf hβf hI) z x n hz
  exact (mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors (pow_mem hβf n)).mp (h₁.trans h₂.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support (J : X.IdealSheafData) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∉ J.support) : J.stalkIdeal x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hxV⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  rw [mem_support_iff_of_mem hxV, mem_zeroLocus_iff] at hx
  push Not at hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hxs⟩ := hx
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ J V hxV]
  exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hs)
    ((Scheme.mem_basicOpen X s x hxV).mp hxs)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_mono {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : I ≤ J) (x : X) :
    I.stalkIdeal x ≤ J.stalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hxV⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ I V hxV, stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ J V hxV]
  exact Ideal.map_mono (ideal_mono h V)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_of_stalkIdeal_le
statement:
theorem le_of_stalkIdeal_le {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x ≤ J.stalkIdeal x) :
    I ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_iSup_eq_top (fun V : X.affineOpens => V) (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top X) fun V => ?_
  have hV : IsAffineOpen V.1 := V.2
  refine Ideal.le_of_localization_maximal fun P hP => ?_
  have hPp : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
  set y : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, V) := ⟨P, hPp⟩ with hy
  have hxV : hV.fromSpec y ∈ V.1 := by
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← hV.range_fromSpec]
    exact Set.mem_range_self y
  set x := hV.fromSpec y with hx
  let _ : Algebra Γ(X, V) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) P := hV.isLocalization_stalk' y hxV
  set e := IsLocalization.algEquiv P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
  set e' : Localization.AtPrime P →+* X.presheaf.stalk x := e.toAlgHom.toRingHom
  have key : ∀ K : Ideal Γ(X, V),
      K.map (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) =
        (K.map (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (Localization.AtPrime P))).map e' := fun K => by
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    congr 1
    exact RingHom.ext fun r => (e.commutes r).symm
  have hle := h x
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ I V hxV, stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ J V hxV,
    ← TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_open_algebraMap X.presheaf ⟨x, hxV⟩, key, key] at hle
  have := Ideal.comap_mono (f := e') hle
  rwa [Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective e' e.bijective,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective e' e.bijective] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem ext_stalkIdeal {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x = J.stalkIdeal x) :
    I = J
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun x => (h x).le) (le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun x => (h x).ge)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.comap_stalkMap_map_eq_self
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.comap_stalkMap_map_eq_self (u : U)
    (K : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (f u))) :
    (K.map (f.stalkMap u).hom).comap (f.stalkMap u).hom = K
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : (f.stalkMap u).hom.Flat := Flat.stalkMap f u
  set φ := (f.stalkMap u).hom with hφ_def
  algebraize [φ]
  have : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f u)) (U.presheaf.stalk u)) :=
    (inferInstance : IsLocalHom φ)
  have : Module.FaithfullyFlat (X.presheaf.stalk (f u)) (U.presheaf.stalk u) :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  exact Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat K

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_of_comap_le_of_flat
statement:
theorem le_of_comap_le_of_flat (Z Z' : X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : (Z.support : Set X) ⊆ Set.range f)
    (h : Z'.comap f ≤ Z.comap f) : Z' ≤ Z
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun x => ?_
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hst := stalkIdeal_mono h u
    rw [stalkIdeal_comap, stalkIdeal_comap] at hst
    calc Z'.stalkIdeal (f u)
        ≤ ((Z'.stalkIdeal (f u)).map (f.stalkMap u).hom).comap (f.stalkMap u).hom :=
          Ideal.le_comap_map
      _ ≤ ((Z.stalkIdeal (f u)).map (f.stalkMap u).hom).comap (f.stalkMap u).hom :=
          Ideal.comap_mono hst
      _ = Z.stalkIdeal (f u) := f.comap_stalkMap_map_eq_self u _
  · rw [stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support Z fun hm => hx (hZ hm)]
    exact le_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.eq_of_comap_eq_of_flat
statement:
theorem eq_of_comap_eq_of_flat (Z Z' : X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : (Z.support : Set X) ⊆ Set.range f)
    (hZ' : (Z'.support : Set X) ⊆ Set.range f) (h : Z.comap f = Z'.comap f) : Z = Z'
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_of_comap_le_of_flat f Z' Z hZ' h.le) (le_of_comap_le_of_flat f Z Z' hZ h.ge)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_subschemeι_comp_eq_bot
statement:
theorem comap_subschemeι_comp_eq_bot {Y : Scheme.{u}} (W : X.IdealSheafData) (g : Y ⟶ X) :
    W.comap ((W.comap g).subschemeι ≫ g) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [comap_comp]
  refine le_bot_iff.mp (le_map_iff_comap_le.mp ?_)
  rw [map_bot, ker_subschemeι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.eq_of_comap_eq_of_agreeOn
statement:
theorem eq_of_comap_eq_of_agreeOn (g : U ⟶ X) [Flat g] (Z Z' : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hZ : (Z.support : Set X) ⊆ Set.range f) (hZ' : (Z'.support : Set X) ⊆ Set.range g)
    (h : Z.comap f = Z'.comap g)
    (hfg : (Z.comap f).subschemeι ≫ f = (Z.comap f).subschemeι ≫ g) : Z = Z'
proof:
:= by
  
  have hC : Z'.comap ((Z.comap f).subschemeι ≫ g) = ⊥ := by
    have := comap_subschemeι_comp_eq_bot Z' g
    rw [h]
    exact this
  have h1 : Z'.comap f ≤ Z.comap f := by
    have hW : Z'.comap ((Z.comap f).subschemeι ≫ f) = ⊥ := by
      rw [hfg]
      exact hC
    rw [comap_comp] at hW
    have := le_map_iff_comap_le.mpr hW.le
    rwa [map_bot, ker_subschemeι] at this
  
  
  have h2 : Z.comap g ≤ Z'.comap g := by
    have hW : Z.comap ((Z'.comap g).subschemeι ≫ g) = ⊥ := by
      rw [← h, ← hfg]
      exact comap_subschemeι_comp_eq_bot Z f
    rw [comap_comp] at hW
    have := le_map_iff_comap_le.mpr hW.le
    rwa [map_bot, ker_subschemeι] at this
  exact le_antisymm (le_of_comap_le_of_flat g Z' Z hZ' h2) (le_of_comap_le_of_flat f Z Z' hZ h1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv {B : Type v} {C : Type w} [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    (e : B ≃+* C) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ nonZeroDivisors B) : e b ∈ nonZeroDivisors C
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff] at hb ⊢
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · have h1 : b * e.symm x = 0 :=
      e.injective (by rw [map_mul, e.apply_symm_apply, map_zero]; exact hx)
    rw [← e.apply_symm_apply x, hb.1 _ h1, map_zero]
  · have h1 : e.symm x * b = 0 :=
      e.injective (by rw [map_mul, e.apply_symm_apply, map_zero]; exact hx)
    rw [← e.apply_symm_apply x, hb.2 _ h1, map_zero]

name: Ideal.isInvertible_iff_forall_exists
statement:
theorem isInvertible_iff_forall_exists (J : Ideal A) :
    J.IsInvertible ↔ ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, ∃ s ∉ p.asIdeal, ∃ a ∈ J,
      J.IsRegularGeneratorIn (Localization.Away s) a
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Ideal.IsRegularGeneratorIn.of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem of_algEquiv {B : Type v} {C : Type w} [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra A C] (e : B ≃ₐ[A] C) (h : J.IsRegularGeneratorIn B a) :
    J.IsRegularGeneratorIn C a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  have he : algebraMap A C = (e : B →+* C).comp (algebraMap A B) := by
    ext x; simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he, ← Ideal.map_map, h₁, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, RingHom.comp_apply]
  · rw [he, RingHom.comp_apply]
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv h₂

name: Ideal.IsRegularGeneratorIn.of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem of_isLocalization {B : Type v} {C : Type w} [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C] (M : Submonoid B) [IsLocalization M C]
    (h : J.IsRegularGeneratorIn B a) : J.IsRegularGeneratorIn C a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B C, ← Ideal.map_map, h₁, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton, RingHom.comp_apply]
  · rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B C]
    exact IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap M C h₂

name: Ideal.IsRegularGeneratorIn.of_isLocalization_away_mul
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocalization.Away (t * s)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) t)) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.mul (Localization.Away s) _ s t
  have : IsLocalization.Away (t * s) C := by rw [mul_comm t s]; infer_instance
  have hC' : J.IsRegularGeneratorIn (Localization.Away (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) t)) a :=
    of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) t)) h
  exact of_algEquiv (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers (t * s)) _ C) hC'

name: Ideal.isInvertible_top
statement: theorem isInvertible_top : (⊤ : Ideal A).IsInvertible
proof:
:= fun p =>
  ⟨1, (Ideal.ne_top_iff_one _).mp p.isPrime.ne_top, 1, trivial, by
    rw [Ideal.map_top, map_one, Ideal.span_singleton_one], by rw [map_one]; exact one_mem _⟩

name: Ideal.IsInvertible.mul
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.mul {J₁ J₂ : Ideal A} (h₁ : J₁.IsInvertible) (h₂ : J₂.IsInvertible) :
    (J₁ * J₂).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, a₁, ha₁, hg₁⟩ := h₁ p
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂, a₂, ha₂, hg₂⟩ := h₂ p
  refine ⟨s₁ * s₂, fun h => (p.isPrime.mem_or_mem h).elim hs₁ hs₂, a₁ * a₂,
    Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha₁ ha₂, ?_⟩
  have : IsLocalization.Away (s₂ * s₁) (Localization.Away (s₁ * s₂)) := by
    rw [mul_comm s₂ s₁]; infer_instance
  have g₁ := IsRegularGeneratorIn.of_isLocalization_away_mul (t := s₂) hg₁
    (Localization.Away (s₁ * s₂))
  have g₂ := IsRegularGeneratorIn.of_isLocalization_away_mul (t := s₁) hg₂
    (Localization.Away (s₁ * s₂))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ideal.map_mul, g₁.1, g₂.1, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, map_mul]
  · rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem g₁.2 g₂.2

name: Ideal.IsInvertible.map_away
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.map_away {J : Ideal A} (hJ : J.IsInvertible) (s : A) :
    (J.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s))).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨s', hs', a, ha, hg⟩ := hJ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) q)
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap] at hs'
  refine ⟨algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) s', hs', algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) a,
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha, ?_⟩
  have : IsLocalization.Away (s' * s)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) s')) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.mul (Localization.Away s) _ s s'
  have hg' := IsRegularGeneratorIn.of_isLocalization_away_mul (t := s) hg
    (Localization.Away (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) s'))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ideal.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A (Localization.Away s), hg'.1,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (Localization.Away s)]
  · rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (Localization.Away s)]
    exact hg'.2

name: Ideal.IsInvertible.of_mul_left
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.of_mul_left {J₁ J₂ : Ideal A} (h : (J₁ * J₂).IsInvertible) :
    J₁.IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  obtain ⟨s, hs, g, hg, hspan, hnz⟩ := h p
  
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submonoid.powers s : Set A) (p.asIdeal : Set A) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ hk
    exact hs (p.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem k hk)
  have hq : (p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s))).IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers s) _ p.asIdeal p.isPrime hdisj
  
  have hg' : algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) g ∈
      J₁.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) *
        J₂.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_mul]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg
  rw [Submodule.mul_eq_span_mul_set] at hg'
  obtain ⟨T, hTs, hgT⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span hg'
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finset.mp hgT
  have hxy : ∀ z ∈ T, ∃ x ∈ J₁.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)),
      ∃ y ∈ J₂.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)), x * y = z :=
    fun z hz => Set.mem_mul.mp (hTs hz)
  choose! x hx y hy hxy using hxy
  
  have ht : ∀ z ∈ T, ∃ t : Localization.Away s,
      t * algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) g = c z * x z * y z := fun z hz => by
    have : c z * x z * y z ∈ J₁.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) *
        J₂.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) :=
      Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hx z hz)) (hy z hz)
    rw [← Ideal.map_mul, hspan] at this
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp this
  choose! t ht using ht
  
  have hsum : (∑ z ∈ T, t z) * algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) g =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) g :=
    calc (∑ z ∈ T, t z) * algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) g
        = ∑ z ∈ T, c z * x z * y z := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z hz => ht z hz
      _ = ∑ z ∈ T, c z • z :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z hz => by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, hxy z hz]
      _ = algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) g := hc
  have hsum' : ∑ z ∈ T, t z = 1 :=
    (mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors hnz).mp (by rw [one_mul]; exact hsum)
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, htq⟩ : ∃ z ∈ T, t z ∉ p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have h1 : (1 : Localization.Away s) ∈ p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) :=
      hsum' ▸ Submodule.sum_mem _ hcon
    exact hq.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr h1)
  
  obtain ⟨⟨t₀, ⟨_, k, rfl⟩⟩, ht₀⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers s) (t z₀)
  have ht₀' : t z₀ * algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) (s ^ k) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) t₀ := ht₀
  have hsk : IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) (s ^ k)) :=
    by rw [map_pow]; exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit s).pow k
  
  have hassoc : Associated (t z₀) (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) t₀) :=
    ht₀' ▸ associated_mul_unit_right (t z₀) _ hsk
  have : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) t₀) (Localization.Away (t z₀)) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.of_associated hassoc
  have hC : IsLocalization.Away (t₀ * s) (Localization.Away (t z₀)) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.mul (Localization.Away s) _ s t₀
  have ht₀p : t₀ ∉ p.asIdeal := fun h => htq (by
    have h1 : algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) t₀ ∈
        p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ h
    rw [← ht₀'] at h1
    exact (Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem _ hsk).mp h1)
  
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a₀, ha₀⟩, ⟨_, i, rfl⟩⟩, hxa⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers s) _).mp (hx z₀ hz₀)
  have hxa' : x z₀ * algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) (s ^ i) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) a₀ := hxa
  refine ⟨t₀ * s, fun h => (p.isPrime.mem_or_mem h).elim ht₀p hs, a₀, ha₀, ?_⟩
  suffices hgen : J₁.IsRegularGeneratorIn (Localization.Away (t z₀)) a₀ from
    hgen.of_algEquiv (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers (t₀ * s)) _ _)
  
  set C := Localization.Away (t z₀) with hCdef
  set φ := algebraMap (Localization.Away s) C with hφ
  have hτ : IsUnit (φ (t z₀)) := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (t z₀)
  have hG : φ (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) g) ∈ nonZeroDivisors C :=
    IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap (Submonoid.powers (t z₀)) C hnz
  have hcxy : φ (c z₀ * x z₀ * y z₀) ∈ nonZeroDivisors C := by
    rw [← ht z₀ hz₀, map_mul]; exact mul_mem hτ.mem_nonZeroDivisors hG
  have hX : φ (x z₀) ∈ nonZeroDivisors C := by
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, mul_mem_nonZeroDivisors, mul_mem_nonZeroDivisors] at hcxy
    exact hcxy.1.2
  have hY : φ (y z₀) ∈ nonZeroDivisors C := by
    rw [map_mul, mul_mem_nonZeroDivisors] at hcxy
    exact hcxy.2
  have htower : algebraMap A C = φ.comp (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) :=
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A (Localization.Away s) C
  
  have hspanC : J₁.map (algebraMap A C) = Ideal.span {φ (x z₀)} := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro w hw
      have hwY : w * φ (y z₀) ∈ Ideal.span {φ (c z₀ * x z₀ * y z₀)} := by
        have h1 : w * φ (y z₀) ∈ (J₁ * J₂).map (algebraMap A C) := by
          rw [Ideal.map_mul]
          refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul hw ?_
          rw [htower, ← Ideal.map_map]
          exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hy z₀ hz₀)
        rw [htower, ← Ideal.map_map, hspan, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
          ← Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hτ (φ (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) g)),
          ← map_mul, ht z₀ hz₀] at h1
        exact h1
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hwY
      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
      refine ⟨r * φ (c z₀), (mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors hY).mp ?_⟩
      rw [← hr, map_mul, map_mul]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, htower, ← Ideal.map_map]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hx z₀ hz₀)
  
  have hsi : IsUnit (φ (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) (s ^ i))) := by
    rw [map_pow, map_pow]
    exact ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit s).map φ).pow i
  have ha₀C : algebraMap A C a₀ = φ (x z₀) * φ (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) (s ^ i)) := by
    rw [htower, RingHom.comp_apply, ← hxa', map_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hspanC, ha₀C, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hsi]
  · rw [ha₀C]; exact mul_mem hX hsi.mem_nonZeroDivisors

name: Ideal.IsInvertible.of_mul
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.of_mul {J₁ J₂ : Ideal A} (h : (J₁ * J₂).IsInvertible) :
    J₁.IsInvertible ∧ J₂.IsInvertible
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsInvertible.of_mul_left h, IsInvertible.of_mul_left (mul_comm J₁ J₂ ▸ h)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.exists_lift
statement:
theorem exists_lift (h : IsBlowUp I π) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible) : ∃ g : Y ⟶ B, g ≫ π = f
proof:
:=
  (h.existsUnique_lift f hf).exists

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext (h : IsBlowUp I π) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible)
    (g g' : Y ⟶ B) (e : g ≫ π = f) (e' : g' ≫ π = f) : g = g'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₀, -, huniq⟩ := h.existsUnique_lift f hf
  exact (huniq g e).trans (huniq g' e').symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.comap_comp_isInvertible_iff
statement:
theorem comap_comp_isInvertible_iff {Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Z) (J : Z.IdealSheafData) :
    (J.comap (π ≫ g)).IsInvertible ↔ ((J.comap g).comap π).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayToAwayₐ_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayToAwayₐ_algebraMap (x c : R) (h : x ∣ c) (r : R) :
