    awayToAwayₐ x c h (algebraMap R (Localization.Away x) r) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayToAwayₐ, IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.toAway_algebraMap
statement:
theorem toAway_algebraMap (r : R) :
    toAway I hac (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) r) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [toAway, AlgHom.comp_apply, Subalgebra.coe_val, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
    awayToAwayₐ_algebraMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.toAway_frac_mul
statement:
theorem toAway_frac_mul {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    toAway I hac (frac hx) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) a =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [toAway, AlgHom.comp_apply, Subalgebra.coe_val, coe_frac, ← awayToAwayₐ_algebraMap a c hac a,
    ← map_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm (invSelf a), mul_invSelf, mul_one, awayToAwayₐ_algebraMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.isUnit_algebraMap_of_dvd
statement:
theorem isUnit_algebraMap_of_dvd {x : R} (hxc : x ∣ c) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) x)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd c hxc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.isUnit_toAway_frac
statement: theorem isUnit_toAway_frac {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) (hxc : x ∣ c) : IsUnit (toAway I hac (frac hx))
proof:
:=
  isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left ((toAway_frac_mul I hac hx).symm ▸ isUnit_algebraMap_of_dvd hxc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.embed_algebraMap
statement:
theorem embed_algebraMap (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    embed I hac s hs (algebraMap _ _ z) = toAway I hac z
proof:
:= by
  rw [embed, IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.embed_injective
statement:
theorem embed_injective {m : ℕ} (hcs : algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) c =
    s * algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a ^ m) : Function.Injective (embed I hac s hs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨k, w, hw⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj (S := Localization.Away s) s z
  
  have hw0 : toAway I hac w = 0 := by
    rw [← embed_algebraMap I hac s hs, ← hw, map_mul, hz, zero_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨n, r, hr⟩ :=
    IsLocalization.Away.surj (S := Localization.Away a) a (w : Localization.Away a)
  have hr' : algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) r =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (a ^ n) * w :=
    Subtype.ext (by
      rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, map_pow,
        mul_comm]
      exact hr.symm)
  have hr0 : algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) r = 0 := by
    rw [← toAway_algebraMap I hac, hr', map_mul, hw0, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨⟨_, j, rfl⟩, hj⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers c) _ r).mp hr0
  have hj' : c ^ j * r = 0 := hj
  
  have hcw : algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (c ^ j) * w = 0 := by
    have h1 : algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (a ^ n) *
        (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (c ^ j) * w) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_left_comm, ← hr', ← map_mul, hj', map_zero]
    rw [map_pow] at h1
    exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp
      (pow_mem (algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors (I := I) (a := a)) n)).1 _ h1
  
  have hz0 : algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (Localization.Away s) w = 0 := by
    have h2 := congrArg (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (Localization.Away s)) hcw
    rw [map_mul, map_zero, map_pow, hcs, mul_pow, map_mul, mul_assoc, map_pow, map_pow, map_pow,
      ← pow_mul] at h2
    have hsu : IsUnit (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (Localization.Away s) s ^ j) :=
      (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit s).pow j
    have h3 := hsu.mul_right_eq_zero.mp h2
    have hanz : algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (Localization.Away s)
        (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Localization.Away s) :=
      IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap (Submonoid.powers s) _
        (algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors (I := I) (a := a))
    exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp (pow_mem hanz (m * j))).1 _ h3
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (Localization.Away s) s ^ k) :=
    (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit s).pow k
  rw [← hu.mul_left_eq_zero, hw, hz0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac_mul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem frac_mul_algebraMap {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    frac (a := a) hx * algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_frac, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
    mul_assoc, mul_comm (invSelf a), mul_invSelf, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.toAway_mem_of_frac_mem
statement:
theorem toAway_mem_of_frac_mem (T : Subalgebra R (Localization.Away c))
    (hT : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ I), toAway I hac (frac hx) ∈ T) (w : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    toAway I hac w ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a).map (awayToAwayₐ a c hac) ≤ T := by
    rw [affineBlowUpAlgebra_eq_adjoin, AlgHom.map_adjoin, Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hT x hx
  exact hle ⟨w, w.2, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.range_embed_le_of
statement:
theorem range_embed_le_of (T : Subalgebra R (Localization.Away c))
    (hT : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ I), toAway I hac (frac hx) ∈ T)
    (hsT : ∃ t ∈ T, t * toAway I hac s = 1) : (embed I hac s hs).range ≤ T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htT, ht⟩ := hsT
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k, w, hw⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj (S := Localization.Away s) s z
  have h1 : embed I hac s hs z * toAway I hac s ^ k = toAway I hac w := by
    rw [← embed_algebraMap I hac s hs w, ← hw, map_mul, map_pow, embed_algebraMap]
  have h3 : (toAway I hac s * t) ^ k = 1 := by rw [mul_comm, ht, one_pow]
  have h2 : embed I hac s hs z = toAway I hac w * t ^ k := by
    calc embed I hac s hs z = embed I hac s hs z * (toAway I hac s * t) ^ k := by
          rw [h3, mul_one]
      _ = embed I hac s hs z * toAway I hac s ^ k * t ^ k := by rw [mul_pow, mul_assoc]
      _ = toAway I hac w * t ^ k := by rw [h1]
  change embed I hac s hs z ∈ T
  rw [h2]
  exact mul_mem (toAway_mem_of_frac_mem I hac T hT w) (pow_mem htT k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.range_embed_le
statement:
theorem range_embed_le :
    (embed I hac (frac (a := a) hb) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hac hb hbc)).range ≤
      (embed I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hbc ha hac)).range
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) a) := isUnit_algebraMap_of_dvd hac
  have hv : IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) b) := isUnit_algebraMap_of_dvd hbc
  have hWv : toAway I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) b =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) a := toAway_frac_mul I hbc ha
  have hQW : embed I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hbc ha hac)
      (invSelf (frac (a := b) ha)) * toAway I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) = 1 := by
    rw [← embed_algebraMap I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hbc ha hac), ← map_mul,
      mul_comm, mul_invSelf, map_one]
  refine range_embed_le_of I hac _ _ _ (fun x hx => ?_)
    ⟨toAway I hbc (frac (a := b) ha), ⟨algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := b) ha),
      embed_algebraMap I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hbc ha hac) _⟩, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine ⟨algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := b) hx) * invSelf (frac (a := b) ha), ?_⟩
    change embed I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hbc ha hac)
      (algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := b) hx) * invSelf (frac (a := b) ha)) = toAway I hac (frac hx)
    rw [map_mul, embed_algebraMap]
    apply hu.mul_left_injective
    change toAway I hbc (frac hx) * _ * algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) a =
      toAway I hac (frac hx) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) a
    rw [toAway_frac_mul I hac hx, ← hWv, mul_assoc,
      ← mul_assoc (embed I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hbc ha hac) _), hQW,
      one_mul, toAway_frac_mul]
  · 
    apply (hu.mul hv).mul_left_injective
    change toAway I hbc (frac ha) * toAway I hac (frac hb) * (algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) a *
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) b) = 1 * _
    rw [one_mul, mul_comm (algebraMap R (Localization.Away c) a), mul_mul_mul_comm, hWv,
      toAway_frac_mul, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.range_embed_eq
statement:
theorem range_embed_eq :
    (embed I hac (frac (a := a) hb) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hac hb hbc)).range =
      (embed I hbc (frac (a := b) ha) (isUnit_toAway_frac I hbc ha hac)).range
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (range_embed_le I hac ha hb hbc) (range_embed_le I hbc hb ha hac)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_mul_eq_frac_mul_sq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mul_eq_frac_mul_sq :
    algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (a * b) =
      frac (a := a) hb * algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two, ← mul_assoc, frac_mul_algebraMap, map_mul, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.embedAB_algebraMap
statement:
theorem embedAB_algebraMap (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    embedAB I hb a (algebraMap _ _ z) = toAway I (dvd_mul_right a b) z
proof:
:=
  embed_algebraMap _ _ _ _ z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.embedBA_algebraMap
statement:
theorem embedBA_algebraMap (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) :
    embedBA I ha b (algebraMap _ _ z) = toAway I (dvd_mul_left b a) z
proof:
:=
  embed_algebraMap _ _ _ _ z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.embedAB_injective
statement: theorem embedAB_injective : Function.Injective (embedAB I hb a)
proof:
:=
  embed_injective I (dvd_mul_right a b) _ _ (algebraMap_mul_eq_frac_mul_sq I hb)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.embedBA_injective
statement: theorem embedBA_injective : Function.Injective (embedBA I ha b)
proof:
:= by
  have h : algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) (a * b) =
      frac (a := b) ha * algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) b ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_comm a b]; exact algebraMap_mul_eq_frac_mul_sq I ha
  exact embed_injective I (dvd_mul_left b a) _ _ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.range_embedAB_eq
statement: theorem range_embedAB_eq : (embedAB I hb a).range = (embedBA I ha b).range
proof:
:=
  range_embed_eq I (dvd_mul_right a b) ha hb (dvd_mul_left b a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.embedBA_transitionEquiv
statement:
theorem embedBA_transitionEquiv (z : Localization.Away (frac (a := a) hb)) :
    embedBA I ha b (transitionEquiv I ha hb z) = embedAB I hb a z
proof:
:= by
  rw [transitionEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    ← AlgEquiv.ofInjective_apply (embedBA I ha b) (embedBA_injective I ha),
    AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Subalgebra.equivOfEq_apply, AlgEquiv.ofInjective_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.transitionEquiv_spec
statement:
theorem transitionEquiv_spec {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    transitionEquiv I ha hb (algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := a) hx)) *
        algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := b) ha) =
      algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := b) hx)
proof:
:= by
  apply embedBA_injective I ha
  have hv : IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a * b)) b) :=
    isUnit_algebraMap_of_dvd (dvd_mul_left b a)
  apply hv.mul_left_injective
  change embedBA I ha b (_ * _) * _ = embedBA I ha b _ * _
  rw [map_mul, embedBA_transitionEquiv, embedAB_algebraMap, embedBA_algebraMap,
    embedBA_algebraMap, mul_assoc, toAway_frac_mul I (dvd_mul_left b a) ha,
    toAway_frac_mul I (dvd_mul_right a b) hx, toAway_frac_mul I (dvd_mul_left b a) hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.transitionEquiv_unique
statement:
theorem transitionEquiv_unique
    (e : Localization.Away (frac (a := a) hb) ≃ₐ[R] Localization.Away (frac (a := b) ha))
    (he : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ I),
      e (algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := a) hx)) * algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := b) ha) =
        algebraMap _ _ (frac (a := b) hx)) : e = transitionEquiv I ha hb
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) (Localization.Away (frac (a := b) ha))
      (frac (a := b) ha)) := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
  have key : (e : Localization.Away (frac (a := a) hb) →ₐ[R] _).comp
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) _) =
      (transitionEquiv I ha hb : Localization.Away (frac (a := a) hb) →ₐ[R] _).comp
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) _) :=
    algHom_ext fun x hx => hu.mul_left_injective (by
      change e (algebraMap _ _ (frac hx)) * _ =
        transitionEquiv I ha hb (algebraMap _ _ (frac hx)) * _
      rw [he x hx, transitionEquiv_spec])
  have h2 : (e : Localization.Away (frac (a := a) hb) →ₐ[R] Localization.Away (frac (a := b) ha)) =
      (transitionEquiv I ha hb :
        Localization.Away (frac (a := a) hb) →ₐ[R] Localization.Away (frac (a := b) ha)) := by
    apply AlgHom.toRingHom_injective
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (frac (a := a) hb))
    ext w
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun key w
  exact AlgEquiv.ext fun z => AlgHom.congr_fun h2 z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algHom_ext_of_tower
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext fun z => ?_
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := z
  induction hz using induction_on with
  | mem x hx => exact h₂ x hx
  | algebraMap r => exact h₁ r
  | add y z hy hz ihy ihz =>
    change φ (⟨y, hy⟩ + ⟨z, hz⟩) = ψ (⟨y, hy⟩ + ⟨z, hz⟩)
    rw [map_add, map_add, ihy, ihz]
  | mul y z hy hz ihy ihz =>
    change φ (⟨y, hy⟩ * ⟨z, hz⟩) = ψ (⟨y, hy⟩ * ⟨z, hz⟩)
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, ihy, ihz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.X_mem_coordinateIdeal
statement:
theorem X_mem_coordinateIdeal {i : σ} (hi : i ∈ S) :
    (X i : MvPolynomial σ A) ∈ coordinateIdeal A S
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux_X_of_mem
statement:
theorem modelAux_X_of_mem {i : σ} (hi : i ∈ S) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    modelAux A S j (X (R := A) i) =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A)) (X (R := A) i) *
        invSelf (X j : MvPolynomial σ A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelAux, aeval_X, ite_eq_left ⟨hi, hij⟩]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux_X_of_not
statement:
theorem modelAux_X_of_not {i : σ} (h : ¬(i ∈ S ∧ i ≠ j)) :
    modelAux A S j (X (R := A) i) =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))
        (X (R := A) i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelAux, aeval_X, ite_eq_right h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux_X_self
statement:
theorem modelAux_X_self :
    modelAux A S j (X (R := A) j) =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A)) (X (R := A) j)
proof:
:=
  modelAux_X_of_not A S j fun h => h.2 rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst_X_of_mem
statement:
theorem chartSubst_X_of_mem {i : σ} (hi : i ∈ S) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    chartSubst A S j (X (R := A) i) = X (R := A) i * X j
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartSubst, aeval_X, ite_eq_left ⟨hi, hij⟩]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst_X_of_not
statement:
theorem chartSubst_X_of_not {i : σ} (h : ¬(i ∈ S ∧ i ≠ j)) :
    chartSubst A S j (X (R := A) i) = X i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartSubst, aeval_X, ite_eq_right h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst_X_self
statement: theorem chartSubst_X_self : chartSubst A S j (X (R := A) j) = X j
proof:
:=
  chartSubst_X_of_not A S j fun h => h.2 rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux_comp_chartSubst
statement:
theorem modelAux_comp_chartSubst :
    (modelAux A S j).comp (chartSubst A S j) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i => ?_
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom']
  by_cases h : i ∈ S ∧ i ≠ j
  · rw [chartSubst_X_of_mem A S j h.1 h.2, map_mul, modelAux_X_of_mem A S j h.1 h.2,
      modelAux_X_self, mul_assoc, mul_comm (invSelf _), mul_invSelf, mul_one]
  · rw [chartSubst_X_of_not A S j h, modelAux_X_of_not A S j h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux_chartSubst
statement:
theorem modelAux_chartSubst (p : MvPolynomial σ A) :
    modelAux A S j (chartSubst A S j p) = algebraMap _ _ p
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (modelAux_comp_chartSubst A S j) p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.isUnit_modelAux_X
statement: theorem isUnit_modelAux_X : IsUnit (modelAux A S j (X (R := A) j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelAux_X_self]; exact algebraMap_isUnit _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux'_algebraMap
statement:
theorem modelAux'_algebraMap (p : MvPolynomial σ A) :
    modelAux' A S j (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) p) =
      modelAux A S j p
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelAux', IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst'_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartSubst'_algebraMap (p : MvPolynomial σ A) :
    chartSubst' A S j (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) p) =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) (chartSubst A S j p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartSubst', IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst'_invSelf
statement:
theorem chartSubst'_invSelf :
    chartSubst' A S j (invSelf (X (R := A) j)) = invSelf (X (R := A) j)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j))
      (X (R := A) j)) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) (X (R := A) j)
  apply hu.mul_left_injective
  change chartSubst' A S j (invSelf (X (R := A) j)) *
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) (X (R := A) j) =
    invSelf (X (R := A) j) *
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) (X (R := A) j)
  have h := chartSubst'_algebraMap A S j (X (R := A) j)
  rw [chartSubst_X_self] at h
  rw [mul_comm (invSelf _), mul_invSelf, ← h, ← map_mul, mul_comm, mul_invSelf, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux'_chartSubst'
statement:
theorem modelAux'_chartSubst' (z : Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A)) :
    modelAux' A S j (chartSubst' A S j z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (((modelAux' A S j).comp (chartSubst' A S j) :
      Localization.Away (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) :
        Localization.Away (X (R := A) j) →+* Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)).comp
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))) =
      (RingHom.id _).comp
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))) :=
    RingHom.ext fun p => by
      change modelAux' A S j (chartSubst' A S j
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) p)) =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) p
      rw [chartSubst'_algebraMap, modelAux'_algebraMap, modelAux_chartSubst]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun
    (IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (X j : MvPolynomial σ A)) hcomp) z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst'_comp_modelAux
statement:
theorem chartSubst'_comp_modelAux :
    (chartSubst' A S j).comp (modelAux A S j) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i => ?_
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom']
  by_cases h : i ∈ S ∧ i ≠ j
  · rw [modelAux_X_of_mem A S j h.1 h.2, map_mul, chartSubst'_algebraMap,
      chartSubst_X_of_mem A S j h.1 h.2, chartSubst'_invSelf, map_mul, mul_assoc, mul_invSelf,
      mul_one]
  · rw [modelAux_X_of_not A S j h, chartSubst'_algebraMap, chartSubst_X_of_not A S j h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst'_modelAux'
statement:
theorem chartSubst'_modelAux' (z : Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A)) :
    chartSubst' A S j (modelAux' A S j z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (((chartSubst' A S j).comp (modelAux' A S j) :
      Localization.Away (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) :
        Localization.Away (X (R := A) j) →+* Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)).comp
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))) =
      (RingHom.id _).comp
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))) :=
    RingHom.ext fun p => by
      change chartSubst' A S j (modelAux' A S j
          (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) p)) =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (X (R := A) j)) p
      rw [modelAux'_algebraMap]
      exact AlgHom.congr_fun (chartSubst'_comp_modelAux A S j) p
  exact RingHom.congr_fun
    (IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (X j : MvPolynomial σ A)) hcomp) z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux'_injective
statement: theorem modelAux'_injective : Function.Injective (modelAux' A S j)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (chartSubst'_modelAux' A S j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux_injective
statement: theorem modelAux_injective : Function.Injective (modelAux A S j)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  apply IsLocalization.injective (M := Submonoid.powers (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))
    (Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A))
    (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (isRegular_iff_mem_nonZeroDivisors.mp isRegular_X))
  apply modelAux'_injective A S j
  rwa [modelAux'_algebraMap, modelAux'_algebraMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelAux_mem
statement:
theorem modelAux_mem (p : MvPolynomial σ A) :
    modelAux A S j p ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r =>
    rw [modelAux, aeval_C, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (MvPolynomial σ A)]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    rw [map_mul]
    refine mul_mem hp ?_
    by_cases h : i ∈ S ∧ i ≠ j
    · rw [modelAux_X_of_mem A S j h.1 h.2]
      exact mul_invSelf_mem (X_mem_coordinateIdeal A S h.1)
    · rw [modelAux_X_of_not A S j h]
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coe_modelHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_modelHom (p : MvPolynomial σ A) :
    (modelHom A S j p : Localization.Away (X j : MvPolynomial σ A)) = modelAux A S j p
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelHom_injective
statement: theorem modelHom_injective : Function.Injective (modelHom A S j)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  modelAux_injective A S j (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.exists_modelAux_eq_frac
statement:
theorem exists_modelAux_eq_frac {x : MvPolynomial σ A} (hx : x ∈ coordinateIdeal A S) :
    ∃ p, modelAux A S j p = algebraMap _ _ x * invSelf (X (R := A) j)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hy
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      exact ⟨1, by rw [map_one, mul_invSelf]⟩
    · exact ⟨X (R := A) i, modelAux_X_of_mem A S j hi hij⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, map_zero, zero_mul]⟩
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨p + q, by rw [map_add, hp, hq, map_add, add_mul]⟩
  | smul q y _ hy =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨chartSubst A S j q * p, by
      rw [map_mul, hp, modelAux_chartSubst, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.modelHom_surjective
statement: theorem modelHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (modelHom A S j)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  suffices h : ∃ p, modelAux A S j p = z from h.imp fun p hp => Subtype.ext hp
  induction hz using induction_on with
  | mem x hx => exact exists_modelAux_eq_frac A S j hx
  | algebraMap q => exact ⟨chartSubst A S j q, modelAux_chartSubst A S j q⟩
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨p + q, by rw [map_add, hp, hq]⟩
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨p * q, by rw [map_mul, hp, hq]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coordinateSubspaceEquiv_modelHom
statement:
theorem coordinateSubspaceEquiv_modelHom (p : MvPolynomial σ A) :
    coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j (modelHom A S j p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateSubspaceEquiv,
    ← AlgEquiv.ofBijective_apply (modelHom A S j)
      ⟨modelHom_injective A S j, modelHom_surjective A S j⟩,
    AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coordinateSubspaceEquiv_frac
statement:
theorem coordinateSubspaceEquiv_frac {i : σ} (hi : i ∈ S) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hi' : (X i : MvPolynomial σ A) ∈ coordinateIdeal A S) :
    coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j (frac (a := X (R := A) j) hi') = X i
proof:
:= by
  have : frac (a := X (R := A) j) hi' = modelHom A S j (X (R := A) i) :=
    Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_frac, coe_modelHom, modelAux_X_of_mem A S j hi hij])
  rw [this, coordinateSubspaceEquiv_modelHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coordinateSubspaceEquiv_algebraMap_X_of_mem
statement:
theorem coordinateSubspaceEquiv_algebraMap_X_of_mem {i : σ} (hi : i ∈ S) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ (X (R := A) i)) =
      X (R := A) i * X j
proof:
:= by
  have : algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j))
      (X (R := A) i) = modelHom A S j (X (R := A) i * X (R := A) j) := Subtype.ext (by
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, coe_modelHom, map_mul, modelAux_X_of_mem A S j hi hij,
      modelAux_X_self, mul_assoc, mul_comm (invSelf _), mul_invSelf, mul_one])
  rw [this, coordinateSubspaceEquiv_modelHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coordinateSubspaceEquiv_algebraMap_X_of_not
statement:
theorem coordinateSubspaceEquiv_algebraMap_X_of_not {i : σ} (h : ¬(i ∈ S ∧ i ≠ j)) :
    coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ (X (R := A) i)) = X i
proof:
:= by
  have : algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j))
      (X (R := A) i) = modelHom A S j (X (R := A) i) :=
    Subtype.ext (by rw [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, coe_modelHom, modelAux_X_of_not A S j h])
  rw [this, coordinateSubspaceEquiv_modelHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac_add'
statement:
theorem frac_add' {R : Type w} [CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {a x y : R} (hx : x ∈ I) (hy : y ∈ I) :
    frac (a := a) (I.add_mem hx hy) = frac hx + frac hy
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, coe_frac, coe_frac, coe_frac, map_add, add_mul])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac_mul_left'
statement:
theorem frac_mul_left' {R : Type w} [CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {a x : R} (r : R) (hx : x ∈ I) :
    frac (a := a) (I.mul_mem_left r hx) = algebraMap R _ r * frac hx
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, coe_frac, coe_frac, map_mul, mul_assoc])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac_zero'
statement:
theorem frac_zero' {R : Type w} [CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {a : R} :
    frac (a := a) I.zero_mem = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_frac, map_zero, zero_mul]; rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac_self'
statement:
theorem frac_self' {R : Type w} [CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {a : R} (ha : a ∈ I) :
    frac (a := a) ha = 1
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_frac, mul_invSelf]; rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coordinateSubspaceEquiv_unique
statement:
theorem coordinateSubspaceEquiv_unique
    (e : affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) ≃ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A)
    (h₁ : ∀ i ∈ S, i ≠ j → ∀ hi : (X i : MvPolynomial σ A) ∈ coordinateIdeal A S,
      e (frac hi) = X (R := A) i)
    (h₂ : ∀ i ∈ S, i ≠ j →
      e (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ (X (R := A) i)) = X (R := A) i * X (R := A) j)
    (h₃ : e (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ (X (R := A) j)) = X (R := A) j)
    (h₄ : ∀ i ∉ S, e (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ (X (R := A) i)) = X (R := A) i) :
    e = coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : (e : affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A]
      MvPolynomial σ A).comp
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A (MvPolynomial σ A) _) =
      (coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j :
        affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A).comp
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A (MvPolynomial σ A) _) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i => ?_
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
    by_cases h : i ∈ S ∧ i ≠ j
    · rw [h₂ i h.1 h.2, coordinateSubspaceEquiv_algebraMap_X_of_mem A S j h.1 h.2]
    · rw [coordinateSubspaceEquiv_algebraMap_X_of_not A S j h]
      by_cases hi : i ∈ S
      · have hij : i = j := by
          by_contra hne
          exact h ⟨hi, hne⟩
        subst hij
        exact h₃
      · exact h₄ i hi
  have key : (e : affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A) =
      (coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j :
        affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A) := by
    refine algHom_ext_of_tower A (fun r => AlgHom.congr_fun hgen r) fun x hx => ?_
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hy
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        have h1 : frac (a := X (R := A) i) (X_mem_coordinateIdeal A S hi) = 1 := frac_self' _
        rw [AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
        change e (frac (X_mem_coordinateIdeal A S hi)) =
          coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S i (frac (X_mem_coordinateIdeal A S hi))
        rw [h1, map_one, map_one]
      · rw [AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
        exact (h₁ i hi hij _).trans (coordinateSubspaceEquiv_frac A S j hi hij _).symm
    | zero => rw [frac_zero' (I := coordinateIdeal A S), map_zero, map_zero]
    | add y z hy hz ihy ihz =>
      rw [frac_add' (I := coordinateIdeal A S) hy hz, map_add, map_add, ihy, ihz]
    | smul q y hy ihy =>
      change (e : affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A)
          (frac (a := X (R := A) j) (Ideal.mul_mem_left (coordinateIdeal A S) q hy)) =
        (coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j :
          affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A)
          (frac (a := X (R := A) j) (Ideal.mul_mem_left (coordinateIdeal A S) q hy))
      rw [frac_mul_left' (I := coordinateIdeal A S) q hy, map_mul, map_mul, ihy,
        show (e : affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A)
            (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ q) =
          (coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j :
            affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) →ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A)
            (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ q) from AlgHom.congr_fun hgen q]
  exact AlgEquiv.ext fun z => AlgHom.congr_fun key z

name: Ideal.map_inf_of_flat
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.map_inf_of_flat (I J : Ideal R) :
    (I ⊓ J).map (algebraMap R S) = I.map (algebraMap R S) ⊓ J.map (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.map_inf_le _) fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨hxI, hxJ⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.mp hx
  obtain ⟨n, c, g, hg⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_set'.mp
    (show x ∈ Submodule.span S (algebraMap R S '' (I : Set R)) from hxI)
  obtain ⟨m, d, g', hg'⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_set'.mp
    (show x ∈ Submodule.span S (algebraMap R S '' (J : Set R)) from hxJ)
  have hgI : ∀ i, ∃ a ∈ I, algebraMap R S a = (g i : S) := fun i => (g i).2
  have hgJ : ∀ j, ∃ b ∈ J, algebraMap R S b = (g' j : S) := fun j => (g' j).2
  choose a haI ha using hgI
  choose b hbJ hb using hgJ
  
  let f : Fin n ⊕ Fin m → R := Sum.elim a fun j => -b j
  let z : Fin n ⊕ Fin m → S := Sum.elim c d
  have hrel : ∑ k, f k • z k = 0 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp only [f, z, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, Algebra.smul_def, map_neg, neg_mul,
      Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    have e1 : ∑ i, algebraMap R S (a i) * c i = x := by
      rw [← hg]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [ha, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    have e2 : ∑ j, algebraMap R S (b j) * d j = x := by
      rw [← hg']; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [hb, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    rw [e1, e2, add_neg_cancel]
  obtain ⟨p, α, y, hz, hα⟩ :=
    Module.Flat.isTrivialRelation_of_sum_smul_eq_zero (R := R) (M := S) hrel
  
  have hx' : x = ∑ l, algebraMap R S (∑ i, a i * α (Sum.inl i) l) * y l := by
    calc x = ∑ i, c i • (g i : S) := hg.symm
      _ = ∑ i, algebraMap R S (a i) * c i := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
        rw [ha, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      _ = ∑ i, algebraMap R S (a i) * ∑ l, α (Sum.inl i) l • y l := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [show c i = z (Sum.inl i) from rfl, hz (Sum.inl i)]
      _ = ∑ l, algebraMap R S (∑ i, a i * α (Sum.inl i) l) * y l := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum, map_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Algebra.smul_def]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
  have hcoef : ∀ l, ∑ i, a i * α (Sum.inl i) l = ∑ j, b j * α (Sum.inr j) l := by
    intro l
    have h := hα l
    rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type] at h
    simp only [f, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h)
  rw [hx']
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_)
  refine Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (haI i), ?_⟩
  rw [hcoef l]
  exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hbJ j)

name: Ideal.map_finset_inf_of_flat
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.map_finset_inf_of_flat {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (I : ι → Ideal R) :
    (s.inf I).map (algebraMap R S) = s.inf fun i => (I i).map (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [Ideal.map_top]
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.inf_insert, Finset.inf_insert, Ideal.map_inf_of_flat, ih]

name: Ideal.colon_span_finset
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.colon_span_finset {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (K : Ideal T) (t : Finset T) :
    K.colon (Ideal.span (t : Set T) : Set T) = t.inf fun x => K.colon {x}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Ideal.colon_span, show (t : Set T) = ⋃ x ∈ t, {x} from (Set.biUnion_of_singleton _).symm,
    Submodule.colon_iUnion, Finset.inf_eq_iInf]
  exact iInf_congr fun x => by rw [Submodule.colon_iUnion]

name: Ideal.map_colon_of_fg_of_flat
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.map_colon_of_fg_of_flat (I J : Ideal R) (hJ : J.FG) :
    (I.colon (J : Set R)).map (algebraMap R S) =
      (I.map (algebraMap R S)).colon (J.map (algebraMap R S) : Set S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hJ
  rw [Ideal.colon_span_finset, Ideal.map_finset_inf_of_flat, Ideal.map_span, ← Finset.coe_image,
    Ideal.colon_span_finset, Finset.inf_image]
  exact Finset.inf_congr rfl fun x _ => map_colon_singleton_of_flat I x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_colon_of_isLocallyNoetherian
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_colon_of_isLocallyNoetherian [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (x : X) :
    (I.colon K).stalkIdeal x =
      (I.stalkIdeal x).colon (K.stalkIdeal x : Set (X.presheaf.stalk x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hx⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  let _ := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  have := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hfg : ∀ V : X.affineOpens, (K.ideal V).FG := fun V => by
    have := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian (X := X) V
    exact IsNoetherian.noetherian (K.ideal V)
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ U hx, stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ I U hx, stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ K U hx,
    ideal_colon_of_fg I K hfg U]
  exact map_colon_of_fg (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl _ _ (hfg U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_comap_of_flat_of_isLocallyNoetherian
statement:
theorem colon_comap_of_flat_of_isLocallyNoetherian (h : Y ⟶ X) [Flat h] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (J K : X.IdealSheafData) :
    (J.colon K).comap h = (J.comap h).colon (K.comap h)
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_stalkIdeal
  intro y
  have hφ : (h.stalkMap y).hom.Flat := Flat.stalkMap h y
  let _ : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := (h.stalkMap y).hom.toAlgebra
  have : Module.Flat (X.presheaf.stalk (h y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := hφ
  obtain ⟨U, hx⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (h y)
  have hfg : (K.stalkIdeal (h y)).FG := by
    have := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian (X := X) U
    rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ K U hx]
    exact Ideal.FG.map (IsNoetherian.noetherian (K.ideal U)) _
  rw [stalkIdeal_comap, stalkIdeal_colon_of_isLocallyNoetherian,
    stalkIdeal_colon_of_isLocallyNoetherian, stalkIdeal_comap, stalkIdeal_comap]
  exact Ideal.map_colon_of_fg_of_flat (S := Y.presheaf.stalk y) _ _ hfg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_of_comap_eq
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_eq_of_comap_eq (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] {J K : X.IdealSheafData}
    (h : J.comap f = K.comap f) (y : Y) : J.stalkIdeal (f y) = K.stalkIdeal (f y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := stalkIdeal_comap J f y
  have h2 := stalkIdeal_comap K f y
  rw [h] at h1
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (f.stalkMap y).hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp inferInstance
  rw [← Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij (I := J.stalkIdeal (f y)), ← h1, h2,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_openCover
statement:
theorem ext_of_openCover {J K : X.IdealSheafData} (𝒱 : X.OpenCover.{u})
    (h : ∀ i, J.comap (𝒱.f i) = K.comap (𝒱.f i)) : J = K
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_stalkIdeal fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := 𝒱.exists_eq x
  exact stalkIdeal_eq_of_comap_eq (𝒱.f i) (h i) y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.ι_mem
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.ι_mem {Z : Scheme.{u}} {U : Z.Opens}
    (x : U.toScheme) : U.ι x ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  have : U.ι x ∈ U.ι.opensRange := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rwa [Opens.opensRange_ι] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.isAffineOpen
statement: theorem GlueIdx.isAffineOpen (p : GlueIdx 𝒰) : IsAffineOpen p.V.1

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.range_toX

  Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.le_def
statement: theorem GlueIdx.le_def {p q : GlueIdx 𝒰} : p ≤ q ↔ p.opens ≤ q.opens
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.range_toX_subset
statement:
theorem GlueIdx.range_toX_subset {p q : GlueIdx 𝒰} (h : p ≤ q) :
    Set.range p.toX ⊆ Set.range q.toX
proof:
:= by
  rw [GlueIdx.range_toX, GlueIdx.range_toX]
