name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.trans_toX
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem GlueIdx.trans_toX {p q : GlueIdx 𝒰} (h : p ≤ q) : GlueIdx.trans h ≫ q.toX = p.toX
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.isOpenImmersion_trans
statement:
theorem GlueIdx.isOpenImmersion_trans {p q : GlueIdx 𝒰} (h : p ≤ q) :
    IsOpenImmersion (GlueIdx.trans h)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsOpenImmersion (GlueIdx.trans h ≫ q.toX) := by
    rw [GlueIdx.trans_toX]
    infer_instance
  exact IsOpenImmersion.of_comp (GlueIdx.trans h) q.toX

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.trans_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem GlueIdx.trans_eq_of_comp_eq {p q : GlueIdx 𝒰} (h : p ≤ q) (g : p.scheme ⟶ q.scheme)
    (hg : g ≫ q.toX = p.toX) : g = GlueIdx.trans h
proof:
:=
  (cancel_mono q.toX).mp (by rw [hg, GlueIdx.trans_toX])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.trans_comp_trans
statement:
theorem GlueIdx.trans_comp_trans {p q r : GlueIdx 𝒰} (hpq : p ≤ q) (hqr : q ≤ r) :
    GlueIdx.trans hpq ≫ GlueIdx.trans hqr = GlueIdx.trans (hpq.trans hqr)
proof:
:=
  GlueIdx.trans_eq_of_comp_eq _ _ (by rw [Category.assoc, GlueIdx.trans_toX, GlueIdx.trans_toX])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.trans_self
statement: theorem GlueIdx.trans_self (p : GlueIdx 𝒰) : GlueIdx.trans (le_refl p) = 𝟙 p.scheme
proof:
:=
  (GlueIdx.trans_eq_of_comp_eq le_rfl (𝟙 _) (Category.id_comp _)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.exists_toX_eq
statement: theorem GlueIdx.exists_toX_eq (x : X) : ∃ (p : GlueIdx 𝒰) (y : p.scheme), p.toX y = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, u, rfl⟩ := 𝒰.exists_eq x
  obtain ⟨V, huV⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem u
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.exists_ι_eq_of_mem huV
  exact ⟨⟨i, V⟩, y, by rw [GlueIdx.toX_apply, hy]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.exists_common
statement:
theorem GlueIdx.exists_common {p q : GlueIdx 𝒰} (xp : p.scheme) (xq : q.scheme)
    (hx : p.toX xp = q.toX xq) :
    ∃ (k : GlueIdx 𝒰) (hkp : k ≤ p) (hkq : k ≤ q) (y : k.scheme),
      GlueIdx.trans hkp y = xp ∧ GlueIdx.trans hkq y = xq
proof:
:= by
  have huV : p.V.1.ι xp ∈ p.V.1 := Opens.ι_mem xp
  have hx' : 𝒰.f p.i (p.V.1.ι xp) = 𝒰.f q.i (q.V.1.ι xq) := by
    rw [GlueIdx.toX_apply, GlueIdx.toX_apply] at hx
    exact hx
  have huW : p.V.1.ι xp ∈ (𝒰.f p.i) ⁻¹ᵁ ((𝒰.f q.i) ''ᵁ q.V.1) := by
    change 𝒰.f p.i (p.V.1.ι xp) ∈ ((𝒰.f q.i) ''ᵁ q.V.1 : Set X)
    rw [hx', Scheme.Hom.coe_image]
    exact ⟨_, Opens.ι_mem xq, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs_le, hus⟩ := p.isAffineOpen.exists_basicOpen_le
    (V := p.V.1 ⊓ (𝒰.f p.i) ⁻¹ᵁ ((𝒰.f q.i) ''ᵁ q.V.1)) ⟨p.V.1.ι xp, ⟨huV, huW⟩⟩ huV
  have hkp : (⟨p.i, (𝒰.X p.i).affineBasicOpen s⟩ : GlueIdx 𝒰) ≤ p :=
    (Scheme.Hom.image_le_image_iff _ _ _).mpr (hs_le.trans inf_le_left)
  have hkq : (⟨p.i, (𝒰.X p.i).affineBasicOpen s⟩ : GlueIdx 𝒰) ≤ q :=
    ((Scheme.Hom.image_le_image_iff _ _ _).mpr (hs_le.trans inf_le_right)).trans
      ((𝒰.f p.i).image_preimage_le _)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.exists_ι_eq_of_mem (U := ((𝒰.X p.i).affineBasicOpen s).1) hus
  refine ⟨⟨p.i, (𝒰.X p.i).affineBasicOpen s⟩, hkp, hkq, y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply p.toX.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, GlueIdx.trans_toX, GlueIdx.toX_apply, GlueIdx.toX_apply]
    exact congrArg (𝒰.f p.i) hy
  · apply q.toX.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, GlueIdx.trans_toX, GlueIdx.toX_apply, GlueIdx.toX_apply, ← hx']
    exact congrArg (𝒰.f p.i) hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.comap_trans
statement:
theorem GlueIdx.comap_trans (compat : GlueCompat 𝒰 I) {p q : GlueIdx 𝒰} (h : p ≤ q) :
    (GlueIdx.ideal I q).comap (GlueIdx.trans h) = GlueIdx.ideal I p
proof:
:= by
  have hw : p.V.1.ι ≫ 𝒰.f p.i = (GlueIdx.trans h ≫ q.V.1.ι) ≫ 𝒰.f q.i := by
    rw [Category.assoc]
    exact (GlueIdx.trans_toX h).symm
  set φ : p.scheme ⟶ Limits.pullback (𝒰.f p.i) (𝒰.f q.i) :=
    Limits.pullback.lift p.V.1.ι (GlueIdx.trans h ≫ q.V.1.ι) hw
  have h1 : GlueIdx.ideal I p = ((I p.i).comap (Limits.pullback.fst _ _)).comap φ := by
    rw [← comap_comp, Limits.pullback.lift_fst]
  have h2 : (GlueIdx.ideal I q).comap (GlueIdx.trans h) =
      ((I q.i).comap (Limits.pullback.snd _ _)).comap φ := by
    rw [GlueIdx.ideal, ← comap_comp, ← comap_comp, Limits.pullback.lift_snd]
  rw [h1, h2, compat p.i q.i]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.GlueIdx.subschemeTrans_subschemeι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem GlueIdx.subschemeTrans_subschemeι {p q : GlueIdx 𝒰} (h : p ≤ q) :
    GlueIdx.subschemeTrans I compat h ≫ (GlueIdx.ideal I q).subschemeι =
      (GlueIdx.ideal I p).subschemeι ≫ GlueIdx.trans h
proof:
:=
  subschemeMap_subschemeι _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.glueNatTrans_equifibered
statement: theorem glueNatTrans_equifibered : (glueNatTrans I compat).Equifibered
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  refine (isPullback_of_isClosedImmersion (GlueIdx.ideal I p).subschemeι
    (GlueIdx.ideal I q).subschemeι (GlueIdx.subschemeTrans I compat h.le) (GlueIdx.trans h.le)
    (GlueIdx.subschemeTrans_subschemeι I compat h.le).symm ?_).flip
  rw [ker_subschemeι, ker_subschemeι]
  exact GlueIdx.comap_trans I compat h.le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_pullbackSnd
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_pullbackSnd (p : GlueIdx 𝒰) :
    IsClosedImmersion (Limits.pullback.snd (glueι I compat) p.toX)
proof:
:= by
  have H := ((glueRelData I compat).isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase p).flip
  have e : Arrow.mk ((glueRelData I compat).natTrans.app p) ≅
      Arrow.mk (Limits.pullback.snd (glueRelData I compat).toBase ((glueCover 𝒰).f p)) :=
    Arrow.isoMk H.isoPullback (Iso.refl _)
      (H.isoPullback_hom_snd.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
  exact (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff (P := @IsClosedImmersion) e).mp
    (inferInstanceAs (IsClosedImmersion (GlueIdx.ideal I p).subschemeι))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.glue_comap_toX
statement: theorem glue_comap_toX (p : GlueIdx 𝒰) : (glue I compat).comap p.toX = GlueIdx.ideal I p
proof:
:= by
  have H := (glueRelData I compat).isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase p
  have : IsClosedImmersion (glueRelData I compat).toBase := isClosedImmersion_glueι I compat
  have h1 := (ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion (glueRelData I compat).toBase ((glueCover 𝒰).f p)).symm
  have h2 := (Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso H.isoPullback.hom (Limits.pullback.fst _ _)).symm
  have h3 := congrArg Scheme.Hom.ker H.isoPullback_hom_fst
  have h4 := ker_subschemeι (GlueIdx.ideal I p)
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans (h3.trans h4))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.glue_comap
statement: theorem glue_comap (i : 𝒰.I₀) : (glue I compat).comap (𝒰.f i) = I i
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_stalkIdeal fun u => ?_
  obtain ⟨V, huV⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem u
  have h := glue_comap_toX I compat ⟨i, V⟩
  change (glue I compat).comap (V.1.ι ≫ 𝒰.f i) = (I i).comap V.1.ι at h
  rw [comap_comp] at h
  have := stalkIdeal_eq_of_comap_eq V.1.ι (J := (glue I compat).comap (𝒰.f i)) (K := I i) h
    ⟨u, huV⟩
  rwa [Opens.ι_apply] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.glue_unique
statement:
theorem glue_unique (J : X.IdealSheafData) (hJ : ∀ i, J.comap (𝒰.f i) = I i) :
    J = glue I compat
proof:
:=
  ext_of_openCover 𝒰 fun i => by rw [hJ, glue_comap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpNatTrans_equifibered
statement: theorem affineBlowUpNatTrans_equifibered : (affineBlowUpNatTrans I).Equifibered
proof:
:=
  equifibered_of_isPullback I affineBlowUp.isPullback_mapHom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specIdealSheaf_mul
statement:
theorem specIdealSheaf_mul {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I J : Ideal R) :
    specIdealSheaf (I * J) = specIdealSheaf I * specIdealSheaf J
proof:
:= by
  change Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((I * J).map _) = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map _) * Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (J.map _)
  rw [Ideal.map_mul]
  exact map_mul (Scheme.IdealSheafData.equivOfIsAffine (X := Spec (.of R))).symm _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_mul
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_mul
    {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : (I * J).IsInvertible) : I.IsInvertible ∧ J.IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  have h' := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_iff_forall_ideal _).mp h
  refine ⟨(Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_iff_forall_ideal I).mpr fun U => ?_,
    (Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_iff_forall_ideal J).mpr fun U => ?_⟩
  · have := h' U
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply] at this
    exact (Ideal.IsInvertible.of_mul this).1
  · have := h' U
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply] at this
    exact (Ideal.IsInvertible.of_mul this).2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_pow
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_pow {I : X.IdealSheafData}
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (h : (I ^ m).IsInvertible) : I.IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hm
  rw [pow_succ] at h
  exact (Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_mul h).2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective (f := (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a).val)
    (fun x y h => Subtype.ext h)
  rw [(affineBlowUpAlgebra I a).val.commutes r]
  exact IsLocalization.map_nonZeroDivisors_le (M := Submonoid.powers a)
    (S := Localization.Away a) (Submonoid.mem_map_of_mem _ hr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_ofIdealTop_map_algebraMap_of_eq_span
statement:
theorem isInvertible_ofIdealTop_map_algebraMap_of_eq_span {J : Ideal R} {k : R}
    (hJ : J = Ideal.span {k}) (hk : k ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) :
    (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((J.map (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))).map
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))).inv.hom)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  subst hJ
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  exact isInvertible_ofIdealTop_span_singleton (map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem I a hk))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_comap_eq_of_chart_π
statement:
theorem comap_comap_eq_of_chart_π {B : Scheme.{u}} (π : B ⟶ X) (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U)
    (chart : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)) ⟶ B)
    (hπ : chart ≫ π =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))) ≫
        (U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι)
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) :
    (K.comap π).comap chart =
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (((K.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra
          (I.ideal U) a))).map
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))).inv.hom)
proof:
:= by
  
  have s1 : (K.comap π).comap chart = K.comap (chart ≫ π) := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp K
      chart π).symm
  have s2 : K.comap (chart ≫ π) = K.comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))) ≫
      (U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι) := congrArg (K.comap ·) hπ
  have s3 : K.comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))) ≫
      (U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι) =
      (K.comap U.2.fromSpec).comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)))) :=
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp K _ U.2.fromSpec
  have s4 : (K.comap U.2.fromSpec).comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)))) =
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((K.ideal U).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom)).comap
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)))) :=
    congrArg (fun L : (Spec Γ(X, U)).IdealSheafData => L.comap _)
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_fromSpec K U)
  have s5 : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((K.ideal U).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,
      U)).inv.hom)).comap
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)))) =
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (((K.ideal U).map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))).hom).map
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))).inv.hom) :=
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_ofIdealTop_Spec_map _ (K.ideal U)
  exact s1.trans (s2.trans (s3.trans (s4.trans s5)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_mem_range_chart_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem exists_mem_range_chart_of_isInvertible {B : Scheme.{u}} (π : B ⟶ X)
    (chart : ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U),
      Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)) ⟶ B)
    (hcov : ∀ U : X.affineOpens,
      ⋃ a : I.ideal U, Set.range (chart U a) = (π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 : Set B))
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) (hK : K.IsInvertible) (y : B) :
    ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U), y ∈ Set.range (chart U a) ∧
      ∃ k ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, U), K.ideal U = Ideal.span {k}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hyU, k, hk, hKU⟩ := hK (π y)
  have hy : y ∈ ⋃ a : I.ideal U, Set.range (chart U a) := by rw [hcov U]; exact hyU
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
  exact ⟨U, a, ha, k, hk, hKU⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_comap_comap_chart
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_comap_chart {B : Scheme.{u}} (π : B ⟶ X) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (a : I.ideal U) (chart : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)) ⟶ B)
    (hπ : chart ≫ π =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))) ≫
        (U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι)
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) {k : Γ(X, U)} (hk : k ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, U))
    (hKU : K.ideal U = Ideal.span {k}) : ((K.comap π).comap chart).IsInvertible
proof:
:=
  (congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible (comap_comap_eq_of_chart_π I π U a chart hπ K)).mpr
    (isInvertible_ofIdealTop_map_algebraMap_of_eq_span (I.ideal U) a hKU hk)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_comap_of_charts
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_of_charts {B : Scheme.{u}} (π : B ⟶ X)
    (chart : ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U),
      Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)) ⟶ B)
    (hoi : ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U), IsOpenImmersion (chart U a))
    (hπ : ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U), chart U a ≫ π =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))) ≫
        (U.2 : IsAffineOpen U.1).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι)
    (hcov : ∀ U : X.affineOpens,
      ⋃ a : I.ideal U, Set.range (chart U a) = (π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 : Set B))
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) (hK : K.IsInvertible) : (K.comap π).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ p : ChartIndex I K, IsOpenImmersion (chart p.U p.a) := fun p => hoi _ _
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_forall_comap_isOpenImmersion (K.comap π) (ι :=
      ChartIndex I K)
    (fun p => chart p.U p.a) (fun y => ?_) (fun p => ?_)
  · obtain ⟨U, a, hy, k, hk, hKU⟩ := exists_mem_range_chart_of_isInvertible I π chart hcov K hK y
    exact ⟨⟨U, a, k, hk, hKU⟩, hy⟩
  · exact isInvertible_comap_comap_chart I π p.U p.a (chart p.U p.a) (hπ _ _) K p.hk p.hKU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_comap_mul_comp
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_mul_comp (hI : (I.comap (b' ≫ b)).IsInvertible)
    (hJ : ((J.comap b).comap b').IsInvertible) : ((I * J).comap (b' ≫ b)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_mul]
  exact hI.mul (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]; exact hJ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_lift_comp
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lift_comp
    (hub : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X), (I.comap f).IsInvertible →
      ∃! g : Y ⟶ X', g ≫ b = f)
    (hub' : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X'), ((J.comap b).comap f).IsInvertible →
      ∃! g : Y ⟶ X'', g ≫ b' = f)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : ((I * J).comap f).IsInvertible) :
    ∃! g : Y ⟶ X'', g ≫ (b' ≫ b) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_mul] at hf
  obtain ⟨hfI, hfJ⟩ := Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_mul hf
  obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, hg₁u⟩ := hub f hfI
  have hg₁J : ((J.comap b).comap g₁).IsInvertible :=
      by rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hg₁]; exact hfJ
  obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂, hg₂u⟩ := hub' g₁ hg₁J
  refine ⟨g₂, ?_, fun g hg => ?_⟩
  · change g₂ ≫ (b' ≫ b) = f
    rw [← Category.assoc, hg₂, hg₁]
  · exact hg₂u g (hg₁u (g ≫ b') (by change (g ≫ b') ≫ b = f; rw [Category.assoc]; exact hg))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_of_universal
statement:
theorem exists_iso_of_universal {B₁ B₂ : Scheme.{u}} (K : X.IdealSheafData) (π₁ : B₁ ⟶ X)
    (π₂ : B₂ ⟶ X) (h₁ : (K.comap π₁).IsInvertible)
    (hu₁ : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X), (K.comap f).IsInvertible →
      ∃! g : Y ⟶ B₁, g ≫ π₁ = f)
    (h₂ : (K.comap π₂).IsInvertible)
    (hu₂ : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X), (K.comap f).IsInvertible →
      ∃! g : Y ⟶ B₂, g ≫ π₂ = f) :
    ∃ e : B₁ ≅ B₂, e.hom ≫ π₂ = π₁ ∧ ∀ ψ : B₁ ⟶ B₂, ψ ≫ π₂ = π₁ → ψ = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huu⟩ := hu₂ π₁ h₁
  obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := hu₁ π₂ h₂
  obtain ⟨_, -, hid₁⟩ := hu₁ π₁ h₁
  obtain ⟨_, -, hid₂⟩ := hu₂ π₂ h₂
  refine ⟨⟨u, v, ?_, ?_⟩, hu, fun ψ hψ => huu ψ hψ⟩
  · exact (hid₁ (u ≫ v) (show (u ≫ v) ≫ π₁ = π₁ by rw [Category.assoc, hv, hu])).trans
      (hid₁ (𝟙 _) (Category.id_comp _)).symm
  · exact (hid₂ (v ≫ u) (show (v ≫ u) ≫ π₂ = π₂ by rw [Category.assoc, hu, hv])).trans
      (hid₂ (𝟙 _) (Category.id_comp _)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.hom_ext_of_universal
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_universal {B Y : Scheme.{u}} (K : X.IdealSheafData) (π : B ⟶ X)
    (hu : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X), (K.comap f).IsInvertible → ∃! g : Y ⟶ B, g ≫ π = f)
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : (K.comap f).IsInvertible) (g g' : Y ⟶ B) (e : g ≫ π = f)
    (e' : g' ≫ π = f) : g = g'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₀, -, hg₀⟩ := hu f hf
  exact (hg₀ g e).trans (hg₀ g' e').symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.comp
proof:
:=
  ⟨isInvertible_comap_mul_comp I J b b' hI hb'.admissible,
    fun f hf => existsUnique_lift_comp I J b b' hb.existsUnique_lift hb'.existsUnique_lift f hf⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.exists_iso
proof:
:=
  exists_iso_of_universal K π₁ π₂ h₁.admissible h₁.existsUnique_lift h₂.admissible
    h₂.existsUnique_lift

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.comp_iso
proof:
:= by
    rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, Category.assoc, e.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    exact h.admissible
  existsUnique_lift f hf := by
    rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp] at hf
    obtain ⟨g, hg, huniq⟩ := h.existsUnique_lift (f ≫ e.inv) hf
    refine ⟨g, ?_, fun g' hg' => huniq g' ?_⟩
    · change g ≫ π ≫ e.hom = f
      rw [← Category.assoc, hg, Category.assoc, e.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    · change g' ≫ π = f ≫ e.inv
      have hg'' : g' ≫ π ≫ e.hom = f := hg'
      rw [← hg'', Category.assoc, Category.assoc, e.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exceptionalSet_eq_support
statement:
theorem exceptionalSet_eq_support {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (n r : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (Z : X.IdealSheafData)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension (n - r) (Z.subschemeι ≫ f)] (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hrn : r ≤ n) :
    Z.blowUpπ.exceptionalSet =
        (Z.exceptionalDivisor.support : Set Z.blowUp)
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm
    (exceptionalSet_blowUpπ_subset_support Z) ?_
  have hsm := smoothOfRelativeDimension_exceptionalMap f n r Z
    (by omega) hrn
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (r - 1)
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap (Z.comap Z.blowUpπ) Z
          Z.blowUpπ
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap Z Z.blowUpπ)) := hsm
  exact support_comap_subset_exceptionalSet Z.blowUpπ Z (m := r - 1)
    (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.lift_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.lift_π (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible) :
    blowUp.lift I f hf ≫ blowUpπ I = f
proof:
:=
  (blowUp.exists_lift I f hf).choose_spec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.eq_lift
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.eq_lift (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible) (g : Y ⟶ blowUp I)
    (hg : g ≫ blowUpπ I = f) : g = blowUp.lift I f hf
proof:
:=
  blowUp.hom_ext I f hf g _ hg (blowUp.lift_π I f hf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpMap_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem blowUpMap_π : blowUpMap h D ≫ blowUpπ D = blowUpπ (D.comap h) ≫ h
proof:
:=
  blowUp.lift_π D _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.eqToHom_comp_blowUpπ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem eqToHom_comp_blowUpπ {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (e : I = J) :
    eqToHom (congrArg blowUp e) ≫ blowUpπ J = blowUpπ I
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rw [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_eqToHom_apply_eq
statement:
theorem exists_eqToHom_apply_eq {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (e : I = J) (t : blowUp J) :
    ∃ s, eqToHom (congrArg blowUp e) s = t
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  exact ⟨t, by simp⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.eq_blowUpMap
statement:
theorem eq_blowUpMap (g : blowUp (D.comap h) ⟶ blowUp D)
    (hg : g ≫ blowUpπ D = blowUpπ (D.comap h) ≫ h) : g = blowUpMap h D
proof:
:=
  blowUp.eq_lift D _ _ g hg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_blowUpMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_blowUpMap [Flat h] :
    IsPullback (blowUpMap h D) (blowUpπ (D.comap h)) (blowUpπ D) h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, H⟩ := (blowUp.isBlowUp D).exists_isPullback_of_flat h (blowUp.isBlowUp (D.comap h))
  rw [eq_blowUpMap h D φ H.w] at H
  exact H

name: AlgebraicGeometry.range_fst_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem range_fst_of_isPullback (H : IsPullback fst snd f g) :
    Set.range fst = f ⁻¹' Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective H.isoPullback.hom := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (Scheme.homeoOfIso H.isoPullback).surjective y
    exact ⟨p, by rw [← Scheme.homeoOfIso_apply]; exact hp⟩
  have hcomp : ⇑(H.isoPullback.hom ≫ Limits.pullback.fst f g) =
      ⇑(Limits.pullback.fst f g) ∘ ⇑H.isoPullback.hom :=
    funext fun p => Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ p
  rw [← H.isoPullback_hom_fst, hcomp, Set.range_comp, Set.range_eq_univ.mpr hsurj,
    Set.image_univ, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.property_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem property_of_isPullback (Q : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [Q.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    (H : IsPullback fst snd f g) (hg : Q g) : Q fst
proof:
:=
  MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback H.flip hg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.partialPresentationIdeal_zero
statement: theorem partialPresentationIdeal_zero : partialPresentationIdeal a g 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have : {i : Fin k | i.val < 0} = ∅ :=
    Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun i hi => Nat.not_lt_zero _ hi
  rw [partialPresentationIdeal, this, Set.image_empty, Ideal.span_empty]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.partialPresentationIdeal_succ
proof:
:= by
  have : {i : Fin k | i.val < j + 1} = insert ⟨j, hj⟩ {i : Fin k | i.val < j} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  rw [partialPresentationIdeal, partialPresentationIdeal, this, Set.image_insert_eq,
    Ideal.span_insert, sup_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.partialPresentationIdeal_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem partialPresentationIdeal_eq_of_le {j : ℕ} (hj : k ≤ j) :
    partialPresentationIdeal a g j = presentationIdeal a g
proof:
:= by
  have : {i : Fin k | i.val < j} = Set.univ :=
    Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun i => lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 hj
  rw [partialPresentationIdeal, this, Set.image_univ]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.a_mem_partialBase
statement: theorem a_mem_partialBase (j : ℕ) : a ∈ partialBase a g j
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.g_mem_partialBase
statement: theorem g_mem_partialBase {j : ℕ} {i : Fin k} (hi : i.val < j) : g i ∈ partialBase a g j
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.partialPresentationIdeal_sup_span_C
statement:
theorem partialPresentationIdeal_sup_span_C (j : ℕ) :
    partialPresentationIdeal a g j ⊔ Ideal.span {C a} =
      (partialBase a g j).map (C : A →+* MvPolynomial (Fin k) A)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine sup_le (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
    · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact Ideal.sub_mem _
        (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (a_mem_partialBase a g j)))
        (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (g_mem_partialBase a g hi))
    · rintro _ rfl
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (a_mem_partialBase a g j)
  · rw [partialBase, Ideal.map_span]
    refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rcases hy with rfl | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    · exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    · have : (C (g i) : MvPolynomial (Fin k) A) = C a * X i - (C a * X i - C (g i)) := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.sub_mem _
        (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)))
        (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.isSMulRegular_head
statement: theorem isSMulRegular_head (h : IsWeaklyRegular A (a :: List.ofFn g)) : IsSMulRegular A a
proof:
:=
  ((isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff A a _).mp h).1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.ofList_take_cons_ofFn
statement:
theorem ofList_take_cons_ofFn (j : ℕ) :
    Ideal.ofList ((a :: List.ofFn g).take (j + 1)) = partialBase a g j
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.take_succ_cons, Ideal.ofList_cons, partialBase, Ideal.span_insert]
  congr 1
  change Ideal.span {r | r ∈ (List.ofFn g).take j} = _
  congr 1
  ext r
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_image, List.mem_iff_getElem, List.length_take,
    List.length_ofFn, List.getElem_take, List.getElem_ofFn, lt_min_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi.2⟩, hi.1, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i.val, ⟨hi, i.2⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mem_partialBase_of_mul_mem
statement:
theorem mem_partialBase_of_mul_mem (h : IsWeaklyRegular A (a :: List.ofFn g)) (j : Fin k)
    {c : A} (hc : g j * c ∈ partialBase a g j) : c ∈ partialBase a g j
proof:
:= by
  have hreg := h.regular_mod_prev (j.val + 1) (by simp)
  rw [isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem] at hreg
  have hQ : (Ideal.ofList ((a :: List.ofFn g).take (j.val + 1)) • ⊤ : Submodule A A) =
      partialBase a g j := by
    rw [ofList_take_cons_ofFn a g j.val, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  rw [hQ] at hreg
  simp only [List.getElem_cons_succ, List.getElem_ofFn, Fin.eta] at hreg
  exact hreg c (by rw [smul_eq_mul]; exact hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mem_partialPresentationIdeal_of_C_mul_mem
statement:
theorem mem_partialPresentationIdeal_of_C_mul_mem (h : IsWeaklyRegular A (a :: List.ofFn g)) :
    ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin k) A,
      C a * p ∈ partialPresentationIdeal a g j → p ∈ partialPresentationIdeal a g j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro _ p hp
    rw [partialPresentationIdeal_zero, Ideal.mem_bot] at hp ⊢
    ext m
    have := congrArg (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff · m) hp
    rw [coeff_C_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] at this
    exact isSMulRegular_head a g h (by simpa using this)
  | succ j ih =>
    intro hj p hp
    have hjk : j < k := hj
    rw [partialPresentationIdeal_succ a g hjk] at hp ⊢
    obtain ⟨h₁, hh₁, q₀, hq₀, hsum⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hp
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hq₀
    have h₁eq : h₁ = C a * p - q * (C a * X ⟨j, hjk⟩ - C (g ⟨j, hjk⟩)) := eq_sub_of_add_eq hsum
    have hgq : C (g ⟨j, hjk⟩) * q ∈ partialPresentationIdeal a g j ⊔ Ideal.span {C a} := by
      have : C (g ⟨j, hjk⟩) * q = h₁ + C a * (X ⟨j, hjk⟩ * q - p) := by
        rw [h₁eq]; ring
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left hh₁)
        (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)))
    rw [partialPresentationIdeal_sup_span_C, MvPolynomial.mem_map_C_iff] at hgq
    have hq : q ∈ (partialBase a g j).map (C : A →+* MvPolynomial (Fin k) A) := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.mem_map_C_iff]
      intro m
      have := hgq m
      rw [coeff_C_mul] at this
      exact mem_partialBase_of_mul_mem a g h ⟨j, hjk⟩ this
    rw [← partialPresentationIdeal_sup_span_C] at hq
    obtain ⟨h', hh', q₁, hq₁, hq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hq
    obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hq₁
    have key : C a * (p - q' * (C a * X ⟨j, hjk⟩ - C (g ⟨j, hjk⟩))) ∈
        partialPresentationIdeal a g j := by
      have : C a * (p - q' * (C a * X ⟨j, hjk⟩ - C (g ⟨j, hjk⟩))) =
          h₁ + h' * (C a * X ⟨j, hjk⟩ - C (g ⟨j, hjk⟩)) := by
        rw [h₁eq, ← hq]; ring
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hh₁ (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hh')
    have hrest := ih hjk.le _ key
    have hp' : p = (p - q' * (C a * X ⟨j, hjk⟩ - C (g ⟨j, hjk⟩))) +
        q' * (C a * X ⟨j, hjk⟩ - C (g ⟨j, hjk⟩)) := by ring
    rw [hp']
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Ideal.mem_sup_left hrest)
      (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mem_presentationIdeal_of_C_mul_mem
statement:
theorem mem_presentationIdeal_of_C_mul_mem (h : IsWeaklyRegular A (a :: List.ofFn g))
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k) A) (hp : C a * p ∈ presentationIdeal a g) :
    p ∈ presentationIdeal a g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← partialPresentationIdeal_eq_of_le a g le_rfl] at hp ⊢
  exact mem_partialPresentationIdeal_of_C_mul_mem a g h k le_rfl p hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.isSMulRegular_quotient_presentationIdeal
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_quotient_presentationIdeal (h : IsWeaklyRegular A (a :: List.ofFn g)) :
    IsSMulRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin k) A ⧸ presentationIdeal a g) a
proof:
:= by
  intro z w hzw
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective w
  have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (presentationIdeal a g) (C a * p) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (presentationIdeal a g) (C a * q) := by
    have := hzw
    simp only at this
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk A, ← map_smul, ← map_smul, smul_eq_C_mul, smul_eq_C_mul] at this
    rwa [← Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk A]
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, ← mul_sub] at h1
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr (mem_presentationIdeal_of_C_mul_mem a g h _ h1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.isSMulRegular_pow_quotient_presentationIdeal
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_pow_quotient_presentationIdeal (h : IsWeaklyRegular A (a :: List.ofFn g))
    (d : ℕ) : IsSMulRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin k) A ⧸ presentationIdeal a g) (a ^ d)
proof:
:=
  (isSMulRegular_quotient_presentationIdeal a g h).pow d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exceptionalSet_blowUpπ_subset_support
statement:
theorem exceptionalSet_blowUpπ_subset_support
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) :
    I.blowUpπ.exceptionalSet ⊆
        (I.exceptionalDivisor.support : Set I.blowUp)
proof:
:= by
  have := blowUp.isIso_π_restrict_compl_support I
  exact Scheme.Hom.exceptionalSet_subset_support_comap I.blowUpπ I

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isEffectiveCartier_iff_isInvertible
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.isEffectiveCartier_iff_isInvertible {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (J : X.IdealSheafData) : J.IsEffectiveCartier ↔ J.IsInvertible
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isBlowUpAlong_iff_isBlowUp
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.isBlowUpAlong_iff_isBlowUp {X B : Scheme.{u}} (π : B ⟶ X)
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) : π.IsBlowUpAlong I ↔ IsBlowUp I π
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.admissible, h.existsUnique_lift⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayMapₐ_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayMapₐ_algebraMap (r : R) :
    awayMapₐ S a (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) r) =
      algebraMap S (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S a)) (algebraMap R S r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [awayMapₐ, IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom_apply, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S a))]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayMapₐ_invSelf
statement:
theorem awayMapₐ_invSelf :
    awayMapₐ S a (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a) =
      IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (algebraMap R S a)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit
    (S := Localization.Away (algebraMap R S a)) (algebraMap R S a)
  have h1 : awayMapₐ S a (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a) *
      algebraMap S (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S a)) (algebraMap R S a) = 1 := by
    rw [← awayMapₐ_algebraMap, ← map_mul, mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one]
  have h2 : IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (algebraMap R S a) *
      algebraMap S (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S a)) (algebraMap R S a) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf]
  exact hu.mul_left_injective (h1.trans h2.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.awayMapₐ_mem
statement:
theorem awayMapₐ_mem (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    awayMapₐ S a z ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := z
  induction hz using induction_on with
  | mem x hx =>
    change awayMapₐ S a (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a) ∈ _
    rw [map_mul, awayMapₐ_algebraMap, awayMapₐ_invSelf]
    exact mul_invSelf_mem (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx)
  | algebraMap r =>
    change awayMapₐ S a (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) r) ∈ _
    rw [awayMapₐ_algebraMap]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    change awayMapₐ S a (y + z) ∈ _
    rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
    change awayMapₐ S a (y * z) ∈ _
    rw [map_mul]; exact mul_mem hy hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coe_baseChangeHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_baseChangeHom (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    (baseChangeHom S a I z : Localization.Away (algebraMap R S a)) = awayMapₐ S a z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.baseChangeHom_frac
statement:
theorem baseChangeHom_frac {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    baseChangeHom S a I (frac hx) = frac (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R S) hx)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change awayMapₐ S a (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a) = _
  rw [map_mul, awayMapₐ_algebraMap, awayMapₐ_invSelf]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.baseChangeHom_unique
statement:
theorem baseChangeHom_unique
    (ψ : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a →ₐ[R]
      affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S a))
    (hψ : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ I), ψ (frac hx) = frac (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R S) hx)) :
    ψ = baseChangeHom S a I
proof:
:=
  algHom_ext fun x hx => by rw [hψ x hx, baseChangeHom_frac]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.tensorHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorHom_tmul (s : S) (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    tensorHom S a I (s ⊗ₜ z) = algebraMap S _ s * baseChangeHom S a I z
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHom, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.tensorHom_tmul_frac
statement:
theorem tensorHom_tmul_frac {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    tensorHom S a I (1 ⊗ₜ frac hx) = frac (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R S) hx)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorHom_tmul, map_one, one_mul, baseChangeHom_frac]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.tensorHom_unique
statement:
theorem tensorHom_unique
    (Ψ : S ⊗[R] affineBlowUpAlgebra I a →ₐ[S]
      affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S a))
    (hΨ : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ I),
      Ψ (1 ⊗ₜ frac hx) = frac (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R S) hx)) :
    Ψ = tensorHom S a I
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.TensorProduct.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (algHom_ext fun x hx => ?_)
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars',
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, hΨ x hx, tensorHom_tmul_frac]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.tensorHom_surjective
statement: theorem tensorHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (tensorHom S a I)
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  have key : ∀ y ∈ I.map (algebraMap R S),
      algebraMap S (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S a)) y *
        IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (algebraMap R S a) ∈
          (tensorHom S a I).range.map (affineBlowUpAlgebra _ _).val := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Ideal.map] at hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨_, ⟨1 ⊗ₜ frac hx, tensorHom_tmul_frac S a I hx⟩, rfl⟩
    | zero => simp only [map_zero, zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, add_mul]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul s y _ hy =>
      rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_mem ⟨_, ⟨algebraMap S _ s, AlgHom.commutes _ _⟩, rfl⟩ hy
  have hle : affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S a) ≤
      (tensorHom S a I).range.map (affineBlowUpAlgebra _ _).val :=
    (affineBlowUpAlgebra_eq_adjoin _ _).le.trans
      (Algebra.adjoin_le fun _ ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ => hyz ▸ key y hy)
  obtain ⟨v, ⟨q, hq⟩, hv⟩ := hle w.2
  exact ⟨q, Subtype.ext ((congrArg Subtype.val hq).trans hv)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.exists_pow_smul_eq_tmul_one
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_tmul_one (w : S ⊗[R] affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : S), algebraMap R S a ^ n • w = p ⊗ₜ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul s z =>
    obtain ⟨n, r, hr⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj (S := Localization.Away a) a
      (z : Localization.Away a)
    have hz : algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (a ^ n) * z =
        algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) r := Subtype.ext (by
      rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, map_pow,
        mul_comm]
      exact hr)
    refine ⟨n, algebraMap R S r * s, ?_⟩
    calc algebraMap R S a ^ n • (s ⊗ₜ z) = ((a ^ n) • s) ⊗ₜ[R] z := by
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, Algebra.smul_def, map_pow]
      _ = s ⊗ₜ ((a ^ n) • z) := TensorProduct.smul_tmul _ _ _
      _ = s ⊗ₜ algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) r := by rw [Algebra.smul_def, hz]
      _ = (algebraMap R S r * s) ⊗ₜ 1 := by
          rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, Algebra.smul_def]
  | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    obtain ⟨n₁, p₁, h₁⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨n₂, p₂, h₂⟩ := h₂
    refine ⟨n₁ + n₂, algebraMap R S a ^ n₂ * p₁ + algebraMap R S a ^ n₁ * p₂, ?_⟩
    have e₁ : algebraMap R S a ^ (n₁ + n₂) • w₁ = (algebraMap R S a ^ n₂ * p₁) ⊗ₜ 1 := by
      rw [pow_add, mul_comm (algebraMap R S a ^ n₁), mul_smul, h₁, TensorProduct.smul_tmul',
        smul_eq_mul]
    have e₂ : algebraMap R S a ^ (n₁ + n₂) • w₂ = (algebraMap R S a ^ n₁ * p₂) ⊗ₜ 1 := by
      rw [pow_add, mul_smul, h₂, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul]
    rw [smul_add, e₁, e₂, TensorProduct.add_tmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.tensorHom_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem tensorHom_apply_eq_zero_iff (w : S ⊗[R] affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    tensorHom S a I w = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, algebraMap R S a ^ k • w = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_tmul_one S a I w
    have h1 : algebraMap S (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S a)) p
        = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (tensorHom S a I) hp
      rw [← AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.map_smul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, hw,
        smul_zero, tensorHom_tmul, map_one, mul_one] at this
      exact this.symm
    have h2 : algebraMap S (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S a)) p = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val h1
    obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ :=
      (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R S a)) _ p).mp h2
    have hk' : algebraMap R S a ^ k * p = 0 := hk
    refine ⟨k + n, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_add, mul_smul, hp, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, hk',
      TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have : algebraMap S (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S a))
        (algebraMap R S a) ^ k * tensorHom S a I w = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (tensorHom S a I) hk
      rwa [← AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, LinearMap.map_smul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_zero,
        Algebra.smul_def, map_pow] at h
    exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp (pow_mem (algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (I := I.map (algebraMap R S)) (a := algebraMap R S a)) k)).1 _ this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.smul_eq_lTensor_mulLeft
statement:
theorem smul_eq_lTensor_mulLeft (w : S ⊗[R] affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    algebraMap R S a • w =
      LinearMap.lTensor S (LinearMap.mulLeft R (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a)) w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul s z =>
    rw [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul,
      ← Algebra.smul_def, TensorProduct.smul_tmul, Algebra.smul_def]
  | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [smul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.tensorHom_bijective_of_flat
statement: theorem tensorHom_bijective_of_flat [Module.Flat R S] : Function.Bijective (tensorHom S a I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, tensorHom_surjective S a I⟩
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (tensorHom_apply_eq_zero_iff S a I w).mp hw
  have hmul : Function.Injective
      (LinearMap.mulLeft R (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a)) := fun x y hxy =>
    (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors (I := I) (a := a))).mp
      hxy
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun v : S ⊗[R] affineBlowUpAlgebra I a =>
      algebraMap R S a • v := by
    have := Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := S) _ hmul
    convert this using 1
    funext v
    exact smul_eq_lTensor_mulLeft S a I v
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hk
  | succ k ih =>
    apply ih
    apply hinj
    change algebraMap R S a • (algebraMap R S a ^ k • w) = algebraMap R S a • (0 : S ⊗[R] _)
    rw [← mul_smul, ← pow_succ', hk, smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.comap_of_flat
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.comap_of_flat (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [Flat f] {J : X.IdealSheafData} (hJ : J.IsInvertible) : (J.comap f).IsInvertible
proof:
:= fun y => by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, a, ha, hJU⟩ := hJ (f y)
  obtain ⟨V₁, hyV₁⟩ := Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpens_mem y
  obtain ⟨s, hs_le, hys⟩ := V₁.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⟨y, hxU⟩ hyV₁
  have e : (Y.affineBasicOpen s).1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := hs_le
  have hφ : (f.appLE U.1 (Y.affineBasicOpen s).1 e).hom.Flat :=
    f.flat_appLE U.2 (Y.affineBasicOpen s).2 e
  set φ := (f.appLE U.1 (Y.affineBasicOpen s).1 e).hom with hφ_def
  have hnzd : φ a ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(Y, Y.affineBasicOpen s) := by
    algebraize [φ]
    have hreg : IsSMulRegular Γ(X, U) a :=
      isLeftRegular_iff.mp
        (isLeftRegular_iff_mem_nonZeroDivisorsLeft.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff'.mp ha).1)
    have hreg' : IsSMulRegular Γ(Y, Y.affineBasicOpen s) (algebraMap Γ(X, U) _ a) :=
      hreg.of_flat
    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] at hreg'
    refine mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mpr ⟨fun x hx => hreg' ?_, fun x hx => hreg' ?_⟩
    · change φ a • x = φ a • 0
      rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_zero]; exact hx
    · change φ a • x = φ a • 0
      rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_zero, mul_comm]; exact hx
  refine ⟨Y.affineBasicOpen s, hys, φ a, hnzd, ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_le J f U (Y.affineBasicOpen s) e, hJU, Ideal.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_restrictIso_of_isPullback
proof:
:=
  ⟨H.flip.isoIsPullback _ _ (isPullback_morphismRestrict π U),
    H.flip.isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ (isPullback_morphismRestrict π U)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.exists_isPullback_of_flat
statement:
theorem exists_isPullback_of_flat (g : X₁ ⟶ X₂) [Flat g] {π₂ : B₂ ⟶ X₂} (h₂ : IsBlowUp I π₂)
    {π₁ : B₁ ⟶ X₁} (h₁ : IsBlowUp (I.comap g) π₁) : ∃ φ : B₁ ⟶ B₂, IsPullback φ π₁ π₂ g
proof:
:= by
  have hcond : Limits.pullback.fst π₂ g ≫ π₂ = Limits.pullback.snd π₂ g ≫ g :=
      Limits.pullback.condition
  
  have hinv : ((I.comap g).comap (Limits.pullback.snd π₂ g)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, ← hcond, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
    exact h₂.admissible.comap_of_flat (Limits.pullback.fst π₂ g)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := h₁.exists_lift (Limits.pullback.snd π₂ g) hinv
  
  have hadm : (I.comap (π₁ ≫ g)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
    exact h₁.admissible
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := h₂.exists_lift (π₁ ≫ g) hadm
  let σ : B₁ ⟶ Limits.pullback π₂ g := Limits.pullback.lift φ π₁ hφ
  have hσ₁ : σ ≫ Limits.pullback.fst π₂ g = φ := Limits.pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hσ₂ : σ ≫ Limits.pullback.snd π₂ g = π₁ := Limits.pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  
  have hστ : σ ≫ τ = 𝟙 B₁ :=
    h₁.hom_ext π₁ h₁.admissible (σ ≫ τ) (𝟙 B₁)
      (by rw [Category.assoc, hτ, hσ₂]) (Category.id_comp π₁)
  have hτφ : τ ≫ φ = Limits.pullback.fst π₂ g :=
    h₂.hom_ext (Limits.pullback.snd π₂ g ≫ g)
      (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]; exact hinv) (τ ≫ φ) (Limits.pullback.fst π₂ g)
      (by rw [Category.assoc, hφ, ← Category.assoc, hτ]) hcond
  have hτσ : τ ≫ σ = 𝟙 (Limits.pullback π₂ g) := by
    apply Limits.pullback.hom_ext
    · rw [Category.assoc, hσ₁, Category.id_comp, hτφ]
    · rw [Category.assoc, hσ₂, Category.id_comp, hτ]
  exact ⟨φ, IsPullback.of_iso_pullback ⟨hφ⟩ ⟨σ, τ, hστ, hτσ⟩ hσ₁ hσ₂⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.exists_isPullback_of_etale
statement:
theorem exists_isPullback_of_etale (g : X₁ ⟶ X₂) [Etale g] {π₂ : B₂ ⟶ X₂} (h₂ : IsBlowUp I π₂)
    {π₁ : B₁ ⟶ X₁} (h₁ : IsBlowUp (I.comap g) π₁) : ∃ φ : B₁ ⟶ B₂, IsPullback φ π₁ π₂ g
proof:
:=
  h₂.exists_isPullback_of_flat g h₁

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsBlowUp.exists_isPullback_prod
statement:
theorem exists_isPullback_prod {S Z Y BY B' : Scheme.{u}} (fZ : Z ⟶ S) [Flat fZ] (fY : Y ⟶ S)
    {a : Y.IdealSheafData} {πY : BY ⟶ Y} (hY : IsBlowUp a πY) {π' : B' ⟶ Limits.pullback fZ fY}
    (h' : IsBlowUp (a.comap (Limits.pullback.snd fZ fY)) π') :
    ∃ φ : B' ⟶ BY, IsPullback φ π' πY (Limits.pullback.snd fZ fY) ∧
      IsPullback (π' ≫ Limits.pullback.fst fZ fY) φ fZ (πY ≫ fY)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, H⟩ := hY.exists_isPullback_of_flat (Limits.pullback.snd fZ fY) h'
  exact ⟨φ, H, H.flip.paste_horiz (IsPullback.of_hasPullback fZ fY)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.exceptionalSet_subset_support_comap

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_mul_isInvertible_iso
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_mul_isInvertible_iso (hL : L.IsInvertible) :
    ∃ e : blowUp (J * L) ≅ blowUp J, e.hom ≫ blowUpπ J = blowUpπ (J * L) ∧
      ∀ ψ : blowUp (J * L) ⟶ blowUp J, ψ ≫ blowUpπ J = blowUpπ (J * L) → ψ = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : (L.comap (blowUpπ J)).IsInvertible :=
    blowUp.isInvertible_comap_of_isInvertible J L hL
  have : IsIso (blowUpπ (L.comap (blowUpπ J))) := blowUp.isIso_π_of_isInvertible _ hinv
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁, -⟩ := blowUp.exists_mulIso J L
  set e : blowUp (J * L) ≅ blowUp J :=
    e₁.symm ≪≫ asIso (blowUpπ (L.comap (blowUpπ J))) with he_def
  have he : e.hom ≫ blowUpπ J = blowUpπ (J * L) := by
    simp only [he_def, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
    rw [← he₁, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  refine ⟨e, he, fun ψ hψ => ?_⟩
  have h := blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π (J * L)
  rw [comap_mul] at h
  exact blowUp.hom_ext J (blowUpπ (J * L)) (IsInvertible.of_mul h).1 ψ e.hom hψ he

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_ideal_map_iff_of_le_iSup
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_map_iff_of_le_iSup {ι : Type*} (U : Y.affineOpens) (V : ι → X.affineOpens)
    (hV : ∀ i, (V i).1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (hcov : f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ≤ ⨆ i, (V i).1) (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    x ∈ (L.map f).ideal U ↔ ∀ i, f.appLE U.1 (V i).1 (hV i) x ∈ L.ideal (V i)
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ i, L.subschemeι.app (V i).1 (f.appLE U.1 (V i).1 (hV i) x) =
      L.subscheme.presheaf.map ((Opens.map L.subschemeι.base).map (homOfLE (hV i))).op
        (L.subschemeι.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (f.app U.1 x)) := by
    intro i
    have h := congrArg (fun φ : Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⟶ Γ(L.subscheme, _) => φ.hom (f.app U.1 x))
      (L.subschemeι.naturality (homOfLE (hV i)).op)
    simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply] at h
    exact h
  have hker : ∀ i, (f.appLE U.1 (V i).1 (hV i) x ∈ L.ideal (V i) ↔
      L.subschemeι.app (V i).1 (f.appLE U.1 (V i).1 (hV i) x) = 0) := fun i => by
    rw [← ker_subschemeι_app L (V i), RingHom.mem_ker]
  change x ∈ (L.subschemeι ≫ f).ker.ideal U ↔ _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply, RingHom.mem_ker, Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
  change L.subschemeι.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (f.app U.1 x) = 0 ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h i
    rw [hker, key, h, map_zero]
  · intro h
    refine L.subscheme.sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun i => L.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ (V i).1)
      (L.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) (fun i => homOfLE fun z hz => hV i hz) ?_ _ 0 fun i => ?_
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (hcov hz)
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact ((key i).symm.trans ((hker i).mp (h i))).trans
        ((L.subscheme.sheaf.1.map (homOfLE fun z hz => hV i hz).op).hom.map_zero).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.existsUnique_preimage_of_notMem_support
proof:
:= by
  set W : X.Opens := I.support.compl with hW
  have hxW : x ∈ (W : Set X) := hx
  have := blowUp.isIso_π_restrict_compl_support I
  let e : (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W : Scheme.{u}) ≃ₜ (W : Scheme.{u}) :=
    Scheme.homeoOfIso (asIso (blowUpπ I ∣_ W))
  have hez : ∀ z : (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W : Scheme.{u}), (e z).1 = blowUpπ I z.1 := fun z =>
    morphismRestrict_base_coe (blowUpπ I) W z
  let p : (W : Scheme.{u}) := ⟨x, hxW⟩
  refine ⟨(e.symm p).1, ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · have h1 : (e (e.symm p)).1 = x := congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply p)
    exact (hez _).symm.trans h1
  · have hyW : y ∈ ((blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W : (blowUp I).Opens) : Set (blowUp I)) := by
      change blowUpπ I y ∈ W
      rw [hy]
      exact hxW
    let q : (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W : Scheme.{u}) := ⟨y, hyW⟩
    have h2 : e q = p := Subtype.ext ((hez q).trans hy)
    have h3 := congrArg (fun z => (e.symm z).1) h2
    simp only [Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply] at h3
    exact h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.support_mul_descendCenter
statement:
theorem support_mul_descendCenter (m : ℕ)
    (hm : (descendCenter I J' m).comap (blowUpπ I) = J' * I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m) :
    ((I * descendCenter I J' m).support : Set X) =
      (I.support : Set X) ∪ blowUpπ I '' (J'.support : Set (blowUp I))
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_mul, Closeds.coe_sup]
  have hpre : ((descendCenter I J' m).comap (blowUpπ I)).support =
      J'.support ⊔ (I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m).support := by
    rw [hm, support_mul]
  have hEm : ((I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m).support : Set (blowUp I)) ⊆
      blowUpπ I ⁻¹' (I.support : Set X) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hm0
    · subst hm0
      rw [pow_zero, one_eq_top, support_top]
      exact Set.empty_subset _
    · rw [support_pow _ _ hm0.ne', Scheme.IdealSheafData.exceptionalDivisor, support_comap]
      exact le_rfl
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro (hxI | hxK)
    · exact Or.inl hxI
    · by_cases hxI : x ∈ (I.support : Set X)
      · exact Or.inl hxI
      · right
        obtain ⟨x', hx', -⟩ := blowUp.existsUnique_preimage_of_notMem_support I hxI
        refine ⟨x', ?_, hx'⟩
        have h1 : x' ∈ ((descendCenter I J' m).comap (blowUpπ I)).support := by
          rw [support_comap]
          change blowUpπ I x' ∈ (descendCenter I J' m).support
          rw [hx']
          exact hxK
        rw [hpre] at h1
        have h1' : x' ∈ (J'.support : Set (blowUp I)) ∪
            ((I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m).support : Set (blowUp I)) := by
          rw [← Closeds.coe_sup]
          exact h1
        rcases h1' with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          apply hxI
          have h' : blowUpπ I x' ∈ (I.support : Set X) := hEm h
          rwa [hx'] at h'
  · rintro (hxI | ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl hxI
    · by_cases hxI : blowUpπ I x' ∈ (I.support : Set X)
      · exact Or.inl hxI
      · right
        have h1 : x' ∈ ((descendCenter I J' m).comap (blowUpπ I)).support := by
          rw [hpre]
          exact (le_sup_left : J'.support ≤ _) hx'
        rw [support_comap] at h1
        exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra_span_eq_adjoin
statement:
theorem affineBlowUpAlgebra_span_eq_adjoin (s : Set R) (a : R) :
    affineBlowUpAlgebra (Ideal.span s) a =
      Algebra.adjoin R ((fun x => Localization.mk x ⟨a, Submonoid.mem_powers a⟩) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ =>
      Localization.mk x ⟨a, Submonoid.mem_powers a⟩ ∈
        Algebra.adjoin R ((fun x => Localization.mk x ⟨a, Submonoid.mem_powers a⟩) '' s))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    · rw [Localization.mk_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · intro y z _ _ hy hz
      rw [← Localization.add_mk_self]
      exact add_mem hy hz
    · intro r y _ hy
      rw [← Localization.smul_mk]
      exact Subalgebra.smul_mem _ hy r
  · exact Algebra.adjoin_mono (Set.image_mono Ideal.subset_span)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra_fg
statement:
theorem affineBlowUpAlgebra_fg {I : Ideal R} (hI : I.FG) (a : R) :
    (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a).FG
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := hI
  rw [affineBlowUpAlgebra_span_eq_adjoin]
  exact Subalgebra.fg_def.mpr ⟨_, s.finite_toSet.image _, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianRing_affineBlowUpAlgebra
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_affineBlowUpAlgebra [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (a : R) :
    IsNoetherianRing (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)
proof:
:=
  isNoetherianRing_of_fg (affineBlowUpAlgebra_fg (IsNoetherian.noetherian I) a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isLocallyNoetherian
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isLocallyNoetherian [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    IsLocallyNoetherian (blowUp I)
proof:
:= by
  refine (isLocallyNoetherian_iff_of_iSup_eq_top
    (S := fun p : (U : X.affineOpens) × I.ideal U =>
      ⟨(blowUp.chart I p.1 p.2).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩) ?_).mpr fun p => ?_
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (blowUpπ I y)
    have hy : y ∈ ⋃ a : I.ideal U, Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a) := by
      rw [blowUp.iUnion_range_chart]
      exact hU
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨U, a⟩, ha⟩
  · have := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian p.1
    have h1 := isNoetherianRing_affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal p.1) p.2
    change IsNoetherianRing Γ(blowUp I, (blowUp.chart I p.1 p.2).opensRange)
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
    exact isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv _
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal p.1) p.2))).symm ≪≫
        ((blowUp.chart I p.1 p.2).appIso ⊤).symm).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isNoetherian
statement: theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isNoetherian [IsNoetherian X] : IsNoetherian (blowUp I)
proof:
:= by
  have := blowUp.isLocallyNoetherian I
  have := blowUp.isProper_π I
  have : CompactSpace (blowUp I) := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (blowUpπ I)
  exact { }

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isUnit_of_span_mul_eq_span
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_span_mul_eq_span {b c : S} (hb : b ∈ nonZeroDivisors S)
    (h : Ideal.span {b * c} = Ideal.span {b}) : IsUnit c
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : b ∈ Ideal.span {b * c} := h ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self b
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
  refine isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨r, ?_⟩
  rw [← mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb, one_mul]
  calc c * r * b = r * (b * c) := by ring
    _ = b := hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_unit_mul_of_span_eq_span
statement:
theorem exists_unit_mul_of_span_eq_span {b b' : S} (hb : b ∈ nonZeroDivisors S)
    (h : Ideal.span {b'} = Ideal.span {b}) : ∃ u : Sˣ, b' = u * b
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : b' ∈ Ideal.span {b} := h ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self b'
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
  have hu : IsUnit c := isUnit_of_span_mul_eq_span hb (by rw [mul_comm, hc]; exact h)
  exact ⟨hu.unit, by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec, hc]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_span_eq_span
statement:
theorem mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_span_eq_span {b b' : S} (hb : b ∈ nonZeroDivisors S)
    (h : Ideal.span {b'} = Ideal.span {b}) : b' ∈ nonZeroDivisors S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := exists_unit_mul_of_span_eq_span hb h
  exact mul_mem u.isUnit.mem_nonZeroDivisors hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_generator_of_isLocalRing
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : h ∈ I.map β := hI ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self h
  have hmem' : h ∈ Submodule.span S (β '' (I : Set R)) := hmem
  obtain ⟨t, hts, hht⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span hmem'
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finset.mp hht
  have hd : ∀ i ∈ t, ∃ d : S, d * h = i := fun i hi =>
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hI ▸ Ideal.subset_span (hts hi))
  choose! d hd using hd
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ t, c i * d i) * h = h :=
    calc (∑ i ∈ t, c i * d i) * h = ∑ i ∈ t, c i * (d i * h) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = ∑ i ∈ t, c i • i := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => by rw [hd i hi, smul_eq_mul]
      _ = h := hc
  have hsum' : ∑ i ∈ t, c i * d i = 1 :=
    (mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors hh).mp (by rw [one_mul]; exact hsum)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hu⟩ : ∃ i ∈ t, IsUnit (c i * d i) := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hmax : (∑ i ∈ t, c i * d i) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S :=
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi =>
        (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr (hcon i hi))
    rw [hsum'] at hmax
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal S).ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr hmax)
  have hdu : IsUnit (d i) := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hu
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfi⟩ := hts hi
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  rw [hI, hfi, ← hd i hi, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hdu]

name: Ideal.IsRegularGeneratorIn.map_ringEquiv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  have hpow : (Submonoid.powers s).map e.toMonoidHom = Submonoid.powers (e s) :=
    Submonoid.map_powers _ _
  let ρ : Localization.Away s ≃+* Localization.Away (e s) :=
    IsLocalization.ringEquivOfRingEquiv (Localization.Away s) (Localization.Away (e s)) e hpow
  have hρ : ∀ x, ρ (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s) x) =
      algebraMap B (Localization.Away (e s)) (e x) := fun x =>
    IsLocalization.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_eq hpow x
  have hcomp : (algebraMap B (Localization.Away (e s))).comp (e : A →+* B) =
      (ρ : Localization.Away s →+* Localization.Away (e s)).comp
        (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) :=
    RingHom.ext fun x => (hρ x).symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ideal.map_map, hcomp, ← Ideal.map_map, h₁, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
      RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, hρ]
  · rw [← hρ]
    exact map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv ρ h₂

name: Ideal.IsInvertible.map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.map_ringEquiv (e : A ≃+* B) {J : Ideal A} (hJ : J.IsInvertible) :
    (J.map (e : A →+* B)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨s, hs, a, ha, h⟩ := hJ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (e : A →+* B) q)
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap] at hs
  exact ⟨e s, hs, e a, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha, IsRegularGeneratorIn.map_ringEquiv e h⟩

name: Ideal.IsInvertible.map_of_isLocalization_away
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.map_of_isLocalization_away {J : Ideal A} (hJ : J.IsInvertible) (s : A)
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [IsLocalization.Away s C] :
    (J.map (algebraMap A C)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  have e := IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers s) (Localization.Away s) C
  have : algebraMap A C = (e.toRingEquiv : Localization.Away s →+* C).comp
      (algebraMap A (Localization.Away s)) := by
    ext x; simp
  rw [this, ← Ideal.map_map]
  exact (hJ.map_away s).map_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_affineBasicOpen_eq_map
statement:
theorem ideal_affineBasicOpen_eq_map (U : X.affineOpens) (s : Γ(X, U)) :
    J.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen s) =
      (J.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s))
proof:
:=
  (J.map_ideal_basicOpen U s).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen
proof:
:= by
  have := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen s
  refine ⟨algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) f,
    IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap (Submonoid.powers s) _ hf, ?_⟩
  rw [ideal_affineBasicOpen_eq_map, hJ, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_ideal_affineBasicOpen
statement:
theorem isInvertible_ideal_affineBasicOpen (U : X.affineOpens) (hU : (J.ideal U).IsInvertible)
    (s : Γ(X, U)) : (J.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen s)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  have := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen s
  rw [ideal_affineBasicOpen_eq_map]
  exact hU.map_of_isLocalization_away s Γ(X, X.basicOpen s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.fromSpec_mem_basicOpen_iff
statement:
theorem fromSpec_mem_basicOpen_iff {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(X, U)) :
    hU.fromSpec p ∈ X.basicOpen s ↔ s ∉ p.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : hU.fromSpec p ∈ X.basicOpen s ↔ p ∈ hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s := Iff.rfl
  rw [h1, hU.fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen]
  exact PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpens_mem
statement: theorem exists_affineOpens_mem (x : X) : ∃ U : X.affineOpens, x ∈ U.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hxU, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
  exact ⟨⟨U, hU⟩, hxU⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_of_forall_exists_affine
statement:
theorem isInvertible_of_forall_exists_affine
    (h : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.affineOpens, x ∈ U.1 ∧ (J.ideal U).IsInvertible) : J.IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, hinv⟩ := h x
  obtain ⟨s, hs, a, ha, hgen⟩ := hinv (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩)
  have hxs : x ∈ X.basicOpen s := by
    have := (fromSpec_mem_basicOpen_iff U.2 (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩) s).mpr hs
    rwa [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_primeIdealOf U.2 ⟨x, hxU⟩] at this
  have := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen s
  have hgen' : (J.ideal U).IsRegularGeneratorIn Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) a :=
    Ideal.IsRegularGeneratorIn.of_algEquiv (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers s) _ _) hgen
  refine ⟨X.affineBasicOpen s, hxs, algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) a, hgen'.2, ?_⟩
  rw [ideal_affineBasicOpen_eq_map, hgen'.1]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.ideal
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.ideal (hJ : J.IsInvertible) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (J.ideal U).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have hxU : U.2.fromSpec p ∈ U.1 := by
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← U.2.range_fromSpec]
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, g, hg, hJV⟩ := hJ (U.2.fromSpec p)
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hxs⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter U.2 V.2 _ ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
  have hs : s ∉ p.asIdeal := (fromSpec_mem_basicOpen_iff U.2 p s).mp hxs
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hJs⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, X.basicOpen s),
      J.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen s) = Ideal.span {g'} := by
    have key : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W), W = X.basicOpen t →
        ∃ g' ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, W), J.ideal ⟨W, hW⟩ = Ideal.span {g'} := by
      rintro W hW rfl
      exact exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen J V hg hJV t
    exact key _ (X.affineBasicOpen s).2 hst
  have := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen s
  
  have hmem : g' ∈ (J.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s)) := by
    rw [← ideal_affineBasicOpen_eq_map, hJs]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g'
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨_, k, rfl⟩⟩, hga⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers s) _).mp hmem
  have hga' : g' * algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) (s ^ k) =
      algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) a := hga
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) (s ^ k)) := by
    rw [map_pow]; exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit s).pow k
  have hgen : (J.ideal U).IsRegularGeneratorIn Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) a := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← ideal_affineBasicOpen_eq_map, hJs, ← hga', Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hu]
    · rw [← hga']; exact mul_mem hg' hu.mem_nonZeroDivisors
  exact ⟨s, hs, a, ha, Ideal.IsRegularGeneratorIn.of_algEquiv
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers s) _ _) hgen⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_iff_forall_ideal
statement:
theorem isInvertible_iff_forall_ideal :
    J.IsInvertible ↔ ∀ U : X.affineOpens, (J.ideal U).IsInvertible
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h U => IsInvertible.ideal J h U, fun h => isInvertible_of_forall_exists_affine J fun x =>
    let ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
    ⟨U, hxU, h U⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_iff_of_iSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem isInvertible_iff_of_iSup_eq_top {ι : Type*} (U : ι → X.affineOpens)
    (hU : ⨆ i, (U i).1 = ⊤) : J.IsInvertible ↔ ∀ i, (J.ideal (U i)).IsInvertible
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h i => IsInvertible.ideal J h (U i), fun h => isInvertible_of_forall_exists_affine J
    fun x => by
    have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, (U i).1 := by rw [hU]; exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
    exact ⟨U i, hi, h i⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_top
statement: theorem isInvertible_top : (⊤ : X.IdealSheafData).IsInvertible
proof:
:= fun x => by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  exact ⟨U, hxU, 1, one_mem _, Ideal.span_singleton_one.symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.mul
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.mul {J₁ J₂ : X.IdealSheafData} (h₁ : J₁.IsInvertible)
    (h₂ : J₂.IsInvertible) : (J₁ * J₂).IsInvertible
proof:
:= fun x => by
  obtain ⟨U₁, hx₁, f₁, hf₁, e₁⟩ := h₁ x
  obtain ⟨U₂, hx₂, f₂, hf₂, e₂⟩ := h₂ x
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hxs⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter U₁.2 U₂.2 x ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
  obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, hJ₁⟩ := exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen J₁ U₁ hf₁ e₁ s
  obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂, hJ₂⟩ : ∃ g ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, X.basicOpen s),
      J₂.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen s) = Ideal.span {g} := by
    have key : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W), W = X.basicOpen t →
        ∃ g ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, W), J₂.ideal ⟨W, hW⟩ = Ideal.span {g} := by
      rintro W hW rfl
      exact exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen J₂ U₂ hf₂ e₂ t
    exact key _ (X.affineBasicOpen s).2 hst
  refine ⟨X.affineBasicOpen s, hxs, g₁ * g₂, mul_mem hg₁ hg₂, ?_⟩
  rw [ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply, hJ₁, hJ₂]
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton g₁ g₂

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.comap_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.comap_of_isOpenImmersion {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    {J : X.IdealSheafData} (hJ : J.IsInvertible) : (J.comap f).IsInvertible
proof:
:= fun y => by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, g, hg, hJU⟩ := hJ (f y)
  obtain ⟨s, hs_le, hxs⟩ :=
    U.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := f.opensRange) ⟨f y, Set.mem_range_self y⟩ hxU
  have hWaff : IsAffineOpen (f ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s) :=
    (X.affineBasicOpen s).2.preimage_of_isOpenImmersion f hs_le
  have himg : f ''ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s) = X.basicOpen s := by
    rw [f.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, inf_eq_right.mpr hs_le]
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hJW⟩ := exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen J U hg hJU s
  refine ⟨⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s, hWaff⟩, hxs, ?_⟩
  rw [ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion]
  obtain ⟨g'', hg'', hJ''⟩ : ∃ g'' ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, f ''ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s)),
      J.ideal ⟨f ''ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s), hWaff.image_of_isOpenImmersion f⟩ =
        Ideal.span {g''} := by
    have key : ∀ (W' : X.Opens) (hW' : IsAffineOpen W'), W' = X.basicOpen s →
        ∃ g'' ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, W'), J.ideal ⟨W', hW'⟩ = Ideal.span {g''} := by
      rintro W' hW' rfl
      exact ⟨g', hg', hJW⟩
    exact key _ _ himg
  set e := (f.appIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  have hψ : (f.appIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s)).inv.hom = (e.symm : _ →+* _) :=
    RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl
  refine ⟨e g'', map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv e hg'', ?_⟩
  rw [hJ'', hψ]
  ext z
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  change g'' ∣ e.symm z ↔ e g'' ∣ z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨e c, by rw [← map_mul, ← hc, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨e.symm c, by rw [hc, map_mul, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayFrac_one
statement: theorem awayFrac_one (x : R) : awayFrac a 1 x = Localization.mk x ⟨a, Submonoid.mem_powers a⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold awayFrac
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (pow_one a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayFrac_zero
statement: theorem awayFrac_zero (x : R) : awayFrac a 0 x = algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
  unfold awayFrac
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (pow_zero a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayFrac_add
statement:
theorem awayFrac_add (n m : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    awayFrac a n x + awayFrac a m y = awayFrac a (n + m) (a ^ m * x + a ^ n * y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold awayFrac
  rw [Localization.add_mk]
  congr 1
  · ring
  · exact Subtype.ext (pow_add a n m).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayFrac_mul
statement:
theorem awayFrac_mul (n m : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    awayFrac a n x * awayFrac a m y = awayFrac a (n + m) (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold awayFrac
  rw [Localization.mk_mul]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (pow_add a n m).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayFrac_mem_affineBlowUpAlgebra
statement:
theorem awayFrac_mem_affineBlowUpAlgebra (n : ℕ) {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I ^ n) :
    awayFrac a n x ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero =>
    rw [awayFrac_zero]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ x
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ] at hx
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on'
      (C := fun x _ => awayFrac a (n + 1) x ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro d hd c hc
      rw [← awayFrac_mul, awayFrac_one]
      exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (ih hd) (Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩)
    · intro x _ y _ hx' hy'
      have : awayFrac a (n + 1) (x + y) = awayFrac a (n + 1) x + awayFrac a (n + 1) y := by
        unfold awayFrac
        rw [Localization.add_mk_self]
      rw [this]
      exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hx' hy'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_affineBlowUpAlgebra_iff
statement:
theorem mem_affineBlowUpAlgebra_iff (ha : a ∈ I) {y : Localization.Away a} :
    y ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a ↔ ∃ n, ∃ x ∈ I ^ n, y = awayFrac a n x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy
    refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun y _ => ∃ n, ∃ x ∈ I ^ n, y = awayFrac a n x)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hy
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨1, x, by simpa using hx, (awayFrac_one x).symm⟩
    · intro r
      exact ⟨0, r, by simp, (awayFrac_zero r).symm⟩
    · rintro _ _ _ _ ⟨n, x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨m, y, hy, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨n + m, a ^ m * x + a ^ n * y, Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ ?_, awayFrac_add n m x y⟩
      · rw [add_comm n m, pow_add]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha m) hx
      · rw [pow_add]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha n) hy
    · rintro _ _ _ _ ⟨n, x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨m, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨n + m, x * y, (pow_add I n m).symm ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx hy, awayFrac_mul n m x y⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact awayFrac_mem_affineBlowUpAlgebra n hx

proof:
