name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_of_notMem_support
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_of_notMem_support (D : X.IdealSheafData) {x' : blowUp Z}
    (hx' : x' ∉ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).support) :
    (D.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).stalkIdeal x' =
      (D.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z x')).map ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x').hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [strictTransformAlong, stalkIdeal_saturate_of_isInvertible _ (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π Z),
    stalkIdeal_comap, stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support _ hx']
  simp only [Ideal.top_pow, Ideal.colon_coe_top, iSup_const]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_support_strictTransformAlong_iff_of_notMem_support
statement:
theorem mem_support_strictTransformAlong_iff_of_notMem_support (D : X.IdealSheafData)
    {x' : blowUp Z} (hx' : x' ∉ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).support) :
    x' ∈ (D.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).support ↔
      blowUpπ Z x' ∈ D.support
proof:
:= by
  have := isIso_stalkMap_π_of_notMem_support Z hx'
  have hbij : Function.Bijective ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x').hom :=
    (stalkMapπEquiv Z hx').bijective
  rw [mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal, mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal,
    stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_of_notMem_support Z D hx',
    ← map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x').hom hbij.surjective,
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_snc_data_totalTransform_of_notMem_support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := isIso_stalkMap_π_of_notMem_support Z hx'
  set e := stalkMapπEquiv Z hx' with he
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x').hom e.surjective, hz,
      Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  · rw [hn]
    exact ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e
  · 
    have hmem : ∀ i, x' ∈ (totalTransformFamily Z E (Sum.inl i)).support →
        blowUpπ Z x' ∈ (E i).support := fun i hi =>
      (mem_support_strictTransformAlong_iff_of_notMem_support Z (E i) hx').mp hi
    have hF : ∀ u : PUnit.{u + 1}, x' ∉ (totalTransformFamily Z E (Sum.inr u)).support :=
      fun _ h => hx' h
    let c' : {k : ι ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1} // x' ∈ (totalTransformFamily Z E k).support} → Fin n :=
      fun k => match k with
        | ⟨Sum.inl i, hi⟩ => c ⟨i, hmem i hi⟩
        | ⟨Sum.inr u, h⟩ => (hF u h).elim
    refine ⟨c', ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ heq
      match k₁, h₁, k₂, h₂, heq with
      | Sum.inl i₁, h₁, Sum.inl i₂, h₂, heq =>
        have := hcinj (heq : c ⟨i₁, hmem i₁ h₁⟩ = c ⟨i₂, hmem i₂ h₂⟩)
        rw [Subtype.mk.injEq] at this
        exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Sum.inl this)
      | Sum.inl _, _, Sum.inr u, h₂, _ => exact (hF u h₂).elim
      | Sum.inr u, h₁, _, _, _ => exact (hF u h₁).elim
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      match k, hk with
      | Sum.inl i, hi =>
        change ((E i).strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).stalkIdeal x' =
          span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z (c ⟨i, hmem i hi⟩))}
        rw [stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_of_notMem_support Z (E i) hx', hc ⟨i, hmem i hi⟩,
          Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
      | Sum.inr u, h => exact (hF u h).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.kollarIdx_val
statement: theorem kollarIdx_val : (kollarIdx hk hkn).val = k - 1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.kollarReindex_apply_self
statement: theorem kollarReindex_apply_self : kollarReindex hk hkn j j = kollarIdx hk hkn
proof:
:= by
  change Equiv.swap (Fin.rev j) (kollarIdx hk hkn) (Fin.rev j) = _
  exact Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.lt_kollarReindex_iff
statement:
theorem lt_kollarReindex_iff (hj : n - k ≤ j.val) (i : Fin n) :
    (kollarReindex hk hkn j i).val < k ↔ n - k ≤ i.val
proof:
:= by
  have hi := i.2
  have hjn := j.2
  have hri : (Fin.rev i).val = n - (i.val + 1) := Fin.val_rev i
  have hrj : (Fin.rev j).val = n - (j.val + 1) := Fin.val_rev j
  have hρ : (kollarIdx hk hkn).val = k - 1 := rfl
  change (Equiv.swap (Fin.rev j) (kollarIdx hk hkn) (Fin.rev i)).val < k ↔ _
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · have := congrArg Fin.val h1
    omega
  · have := congrArg Fin.val h2
    omega
  · omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.image_kollarReindex
statement:
theorem image_kollarReindex (hj : n - k ≤ j.val) :
    kollarReindex hk hkn j '' {i : Fin n | n - k ≤ i.val} = {i : Fin n | i.val < k}
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩
    exact (lt_kollarReindex_iff hk hkn j hj i').mpr hi'
  · intro hi
    refine ⟨(kollarReindex hk hkn j).symm i, ?_, Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
    change n - k ≤ ((kollarReindex hk hkn j).symm i).val
    rw [← lt_kollarReindex_iff hk hkn j hj, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartYR_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem chartYR_of_not_lt {l : Fin n} (hl : ¬ l < ρ) :
    chartYR y ρ l = algebraMap R (chartRing y ρ) (y l)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_chartYROf, chartYOf_of_not_lt y ρ (y ρ) hl]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartYR_mul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartYR_mul_algebraMap {l : Fin n} (hl : l < ρ) :
    chartYR y ρ l * algebraMap R (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ) = algebraMap R (chartRing y ρ) (y l)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_chartYROf, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap]
  exact chartY_mul_algebraMap y ρ hl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringEquiv_apply_eq_of_const
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_apply_eq_of_const (e : S ≃+* L) (π : R →+* S) (g : R →+* R') (h : R' →+* L)
    (hcompat : ∀ c, e (π c) = h (g c)) {w : S} {c : R} (hw : w = π c) {u : R'} (hu : u = g c) :
    e w = h u
proof:
:= by
  subst hw hu
  exact hcompat c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringEquiv_apply_eq_of_mul
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_apply_eq_of_mul [IsDomain L] (e : S ≃+* L) (π : R →+* S) (g : R →+* R')
    (h : R' →+* L) (hcompat : ∀ c, e (π c) = h (g c)) {w : S} {ci cj : R} (hT : h (g cj) ≠ 0)
    (h1 : π ci = w * π cj) {u : R'} (h2 : u * g cj = g ci) : e w = h u
proof:
:= by
  have h1' := congrArg e h1
  rw [map_mul, hcompat, hcompat] at h1'
  have h2' := congrArg h h2
  rw [map_mul] at h2'
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hT (h1'.symm.trans h2'.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.image_eq_of_lt_iff
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩
    exact (hσ i').mpr hi'
  · intro hi
    refine ⟨σ.symm i, ?_, Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
    change n - kk ≤ (σ.symm i).val
    rw [← hσ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chartRing_model
statement:
theorem exists_chartRing_model (σ : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (hσ : ∀ i, (σ i).val < kk ↔ n - kk ≤ i.val)
    (ρ : Fin n) (hρ : ρ.val = kk - 1) (hσj : σ j = ρ)
    (w : Fin n → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j → w i = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i))
    (hw' : ∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → i ≠ j →
      (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i) = w i * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j)) :
    ∃ (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ)) (_ : 𝔮.IsPrime)
      (e : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a' ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮),
      𝔮.comap (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) (chartRing (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ)) =
        maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) ∧
      (∀ c : X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a'), e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' c) =
        algebraMap (chartRing (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (algebraMap _ _ c)) ∧
      ∀ i, e (w i) = algebraMap (chartRing (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (chartYR (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ (σ i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hyσ : ∀ i, (z ∘ σ.symm) (σ i) = z i :=
    fun i => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hyρ : (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ = z j := by rw [← hσj, hyσ]
  have hZ' : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z a') = span ((z ∘ σ.symm) '' {i | i.val < kk}) := by
    rw [hZa, ← image_eq_of_lt_iff σ hσ, Set.image_image]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hF' : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal a' =
      span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' ((z ∘ σ.symm) ρ)} := by
    rw [hyρ]
    exact hF
  have hρ' : ρ.val + 1 = kk := by omega
  obtain ⟨𝔮, h𝔮, e, hcomap, hcompat⟩ :=
    exists_stalk_equiv_localization_atPrime Z a' (z ∘ σ.symm) hZ' ρ hρ' hF'
  refine ⟨𝔮, h𝔮, e, hcomap, hcompat, fun i => ?_⟩
  by_cases hi : i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j
  · 
    have hlt : ¬ σ i < ρ := by
      rcases hi with hi | rfl
      · intro hlt
        have h1 := (hσ i).mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (by omega))
        omega
      · rw [hσj]
        exact lt_irrefl _
    refine ringEquiv_apply_eq_of_const e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a').hom _ _ hcompat (hw i hi) ?_
    rw [chartYR_of_not_lt _ _ hlt, hyσ]
  · push Not at hi
    have hlt : σ i < ρ := by
      have h1 := (hσ i).mpr hi.1
      have h2 : σ i ≠ ρ := fun h => hi.2 (σ.injective (h.trans hσj.symm))
      rw [Fin.lt_def]
      have h3 := Fin.val_ne_of_ne h2
      omega
    
    have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) := IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e
    have hT : e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j)) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h => hne (e.injective (by rw [h, map_zero]))
    rw [hcompat, ← hyρ] at hT
    have h1 := hw' i hi.1 hi.2
    rw [← hyσ i, ← hyρ] at h1
    exact ringEquiv_apply_eq_of_mul e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a').hom _ _ hcompat hT h1
      (chartYR_mul_algebraMap (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ hlt)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_induced
statement:
theorem exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_induced (w : Fin n → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j → w i = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i))
    (hw' : ∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → i ≠ j →
      (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i) = w i * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j)) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (z' : Fin m → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a'),
      (span (Set.range z') = maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a') ∧
        (m : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')) ∧
      ∃ σ : {i : Fin n // w i ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')} → Fin m,
        Function.Injective σ ∧ ∀ i, z' (σ i) = w i.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hσ1 := lt_kollarReindex_iff hk hkn j hj
  have hσ2 := kollarReindex_apply_self hk hkn j
  have hρ1 := kollarIdx_val hk hkn
  generalize kollarReindex hk hkn j = σ at hσ1 hσ2
  generalize kollarIdx hk hkn = ρ at hσ2 hρ1
  obtain ⟨𝔮, h𝔮, e, -, hcompat, hE⟩ :=
    exists_chartRing_model Z a' hk hZa hF hne σ hσ1 ρ hρ1 hσ2 w hw hw'
  have hyspan : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) =
      span (Set.range (z ∘ σ.symm)) := by
    rw [← hz.1, Set.range_comp, Equiv.range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ]
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) := IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e
  
  let _ := f.stalkAlgebra (blowUpπ Z a')
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_derivation_dual f (blowUpπ Z a') (z ∘ σ.symm) hyspan hz.2
  obtain ⟨m, z'', hz'', σ'', hσ''inj, hσ''⟩ :=
    exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_extend_chartYR (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ D hD 𝔮
  
  refine ⟨m, fun l => e.symm (z'' l), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Set.range_comp', ← Ideal.map_span, hz''.1, map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv e]
  · rw [hz''.2, ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e]
  · have hmem : ∀ i : {i : Fin n // w i ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')},
        algebraMap (chartRing (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
          (chartYR (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ (σ i.1)) ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) := by
      rintro ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩
      rw [← map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv e, Ideal.map_symm, Ideal.mem_comap, hE i₀] at hi₀
      exact hi₀
    refine ⟨fun i => σ'' ⟨σ i.1, hmem i⟩, fun i₁ i₂ h => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · have := hσ''inj h
      rw [Subtype.mk.injEq] at this
      exact Subtype.ext (σ.injective this)
    · change e.symm (z'' (σ'' ⟨σ i.1, hmem i⟩)) = w i.1
      rw [hσ'' ⟨σ i.1, hmem i⟩, ← hE i.1, e.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_basicOpen_ideal_eq_span
statement:
theorem exists_basicOpen_ideal_eq_span (D : X.IdealSheafData) {x : X} (V : X.affineOpens)
    (hxV : x ∈ V.1) [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1)] (S : Set Γ(X, V.1)) (hS : S.Finite)
    (hD : D.stalkIdeal x = span ((X.presheaf.germ V.1 x hxV).hom '' S)) :
    ∃ s : Γ(X, V.1), x ∈ X.basicOpen s ∧
      D.ideal ⟨X.basicOpen s, V.2.basicOpen s⟩ =
        span ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le s)).op).hom '' S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have hloc := V.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  set p := (V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal with hpdef
  have hI : (D.ideal V).map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) =
      (span S).map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
    change (D.ideal V).map (X.presheaf.germ V.1 x hxV).hom =
      (span S).map (X.presheaf.germ V.1 x hxV).hom
    rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ D V hxV, hD, Ideal.map_span]
  obtain ⟨s, hsp, hs⟩ := exists_mem_map_eq_map_of_localization p.primeCompl (D.ideal V) (span S)
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) (Submodule.fg_span hS) hI
  have hUV : X.basicOpen s ≤ V.1 := X.basicOpen_le s
  have hxU : x ∈ X.basicOpen s := (mem_basicOpen_iff_notMem_primeIdealOf V.2 hxV s).mpr hsp
  let _ := restrictAlgebra (X := X) hUV
  have hloc' : IsLocalization.Away s Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) :=
    V.2.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen s (homOfLE hUV) rfl
  refine ⟨s, hxU, ?_⟩
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_ideal D (U := ⟨X.basicOpen s, V.2.basicOpen s⟩) (V := V) hUV]
  change (D.ideal V).map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s)) = _
  rw [hs Γ(X, X.basicOpen s), Ideal.map_span]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_basicOpen_forall_ideal_eq_span
statement:
theorem exists_basicOpen_forall_ideal_eq_span {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (D : ι → X.IdealSheafData)
    {x : X} (V : X.affineOpens) (hxV : x ∈ V.1) [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1)]
    (S : ι → Set Γ(X, V.1)) (hS : ∀ i, (S i).Finite)
    (hD : ∀ i, (D i).stalkIdeal x = span ((X.presheaf.germ V.1 x hxV).hom '' S i)) :
    ∃ s : Γ(X, V.1), x ∈ X.basicOpen s ∧ ∀ i,
      (D i).ideal ⟨X.basicOpen s, V.2.basicOpen s⟩ =
        span ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le s)).op).hom '' S i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  choose t ht using fun i => exists_basicOpen_ideal_eq_span (D i) V hxV (S i) (hS i) (hD i)
  refine ⟨∏ i, t i, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · refine Finset.prod_induction t (fun a => x ∈ X.basicOpen a) (fun a b ha hb => ?_) ?_
      (fun i _ => (ht i).1)
    · rw [X.basicOpen_mul]
      exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
    · rw [X.basicOpen_one]
      exact hxV
  · have hle : X.basicOpen (∏ i, t i) ≤ X.basicOpen (t i) := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ t (Finset.mem_univ i), X.basicOpen_mul]
      exact inf_le_left
    rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_ideal (D i) (U := ⟨X.basicOpen (∏ i, t i), V.2.basicOpen _⟩)
      (V := ⟨X.basicOpen (t i), V.2.basicOpen _⟩) hle, (ht i).2, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_image]
    refine congrArg span (Set.image_congr fun a _ => ?_)
    change (X.presheaf.map _ ≫ X.presheaf.map _) a = X.presheaf.map _ a
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affineOpen_le_disjoint
statement:
theorem exists_affineOpen_le_disjoint {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (C : ι → Set X)
    (hC : ∀ i, IsClosed (C i)) {x : X} (hx : ∀ i, x ∉ C i) (V : X.affineOpens) (hxV : x ∈ V.1) :
    ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (_ : x ∈ U.1) (_ : U.1 ≤ V.1), ∀ i, Disjoint (U.1 : Set X) (C i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcl : IsClosed (⋃ i, C i) := isClosed_iUnion_of_finite hC
  let W : X.Opens := V.1 ⊓ ⟨(⋃ i, C i)ᶜ, hcl.isOpen_compl⟩
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxV, fun h => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
    exact hx i hi⟩
  obtain ⟨t, htW, hxt⟩ := V.2.exists_basicOpen_le (⟨x, hxW⟩ : W) hxV
  refine ⟨⟨X.basicOpen t, V.2.basicOpen t⟩, hxt, X.basicOpen_le t, fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro y hy hyC
  exact (htW hy).2 (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hyC⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_eq_top_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem comap_eq_top_of_disjoint (D : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.Opens)
    (h : Disjoint (U : Set X) (D.support : Set X)) : D.comap U.ι = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_eq_bot_iff]
  ext y
  simp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap, Closeds.coe_preimage, Set.mem_preimage,
    Closeds.coe_bot, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  intro hy
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h (Scheme.Opens.ι_apply U y ▸ y.2) hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.res_res
statement:
theorem res_res {U U' V : X.Opens} (h₁ : U' ≤ V) (h₂ : U ≤ U') (a : Γ(X, V)) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op a) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₂.trans h₁)).op a
proof:
:= by
  change (X.presheaf.map _ ≫ X.presheaf.map _) a = _
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ideal_eq_span_of_le
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_span_of_le (D : X.IdealSheafData) {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V)
    (S : Set Γ(X, V.1)) (hD : D.ideal V = span S) :
    D.ideal U = span ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom '' S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_ideal D h, hD, Ideal.map_span]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.sncReindex_mem_iff
statement:
theorem sncReindex_mem_iff (s : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    sncReindex s i ∈ s ↔ i.val < s.card
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hji⟩ : sncReindex s i ∈ finsetEquiv s '' {j | j.val < s.card} := by
      rw [finsetEquiv_image_lt]; exact h
    have : (sncReindex s).symm (finsetEquiv s j) = (sncReindex s).symm (sncReindex s i) :=
      congrArg _ hji
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
    have hval : ((sncReindex s).symm (finsetEquiv s j)).val = j.val := by
      simp [sncReindex]
    rw [← this, hval]
    exact hj
  · intro h
    have : sncReindex s i ∈ finsetEquiv s '' {j | j.val < s.card} :=
      ⟨finCongr (card_add_card_compl_eq s).symm i, by simpa using h, rfl⟩
    rwa [finsetEquiv_image_lt] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etaleCoordinatesAdapted_of_snc
statement:
theorem exists_etaleCoordinatesAdapted_of_snc {Z : X.IdealSheafData} {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (D : ι → X.IdealSheafData) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : IsClosed ({x₀} : Set X))
    {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk x₀}
    (hz : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x₀) = span (Set.range z)) (s : Finset (Fin n))
    (hZ : Z.stalkIdeal x₀ = span (z '' ↑s)) (c : {i : ι // x₀ ∈ (D i).support} → Fin n)
    (hcinj : Function.Injective c) (hc : ∀ i, (D i.1).stalkIdeal x₀ = span {z (c i)}) :
    ∃ (E : EtaleCoordinatesAdapted f n s.card Z x₀) (c' : {i : ι // x₀ ∈ (D i).support} → Fin n),
      Function.Injective c' ∧ (∀ i, (c' i).val < s.card ↔ c i ∈ s) ∧
      (∀ i, (D i.1).ideal E.U = span {E.v (c' i)}) ∧
      (∀ i, x₀ ∉ (D i).support → (D i).comap E.U.1.ι = ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := f.stalkAlgebra x₀
  have hs : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  
  set e := sncReindex s with hedef
  set z' : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk x₀ := z ∘ e with hz'def
  have hz' : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x₀) = span (Set.range z') := by
    rw [hz, hz'def, e.surjective.range_comp]
  have himg : z' '' {i : Fin n | i.val < s.card} = z '' ↑s := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e i, (sncReindex_mem_iff s i).mpr hi, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨e.symm j, ?_, by simp [hz'def]⟩
      have := (sncReindex_mem_iff s (e.symm j)).mp (by rwa [Equiv.apply_symm_apply])
      exact this
  have hZ' : Z.stalkIdeal x₀ = span (z' '' {i : Fin n | i.val < s.card}) := by rw [hZ, himg]
  set c' : {i : ι // x₀ ∈ (D i).support} → Fin n := fun i => e.symm (c i) with hc'def
  have hc'inj : Function.Injective c' := e.symm.injective.comp hcinj
  have hc'lt : ∀ i, (c' i).val < s.card ↔ c i ∈ s := fun i => by
    rw [← sncReindex_mem_iff s (c' i)]
    change e (e.symm (c i)) ∈ s ↔ c i ∈ s
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hc' : ∀ i, (D i.1).stalkIdeal x₀ = span {z' (c' i)} := fun i => by
    rw [hc i, hz'def, Function.comp_apply, hc'def, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V₀, hV₀, rfl⟩, hxV₀, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x₀) isOpen_univ
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, -, w, hw⟩ := exists_affineOpen_germ_eq ⟨V₀, hV₀⟩ hxV₀ z'
  
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_basis_tensor_kaehlerDifferential_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal f n hx₀ z' hz'
  have hb' : ∃ b' : Module.Basis (Fin n) (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x₀))
      (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x₀) ⊗[X.presheaf.stalk x₀] Ω[X.presheaf.stalk x₀⁄k]),
      ∀ i, b' i = 1 ⊗ₜ KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.presheaf.stalk x₀)
        (X.presheaf.germ V.1 x₀ hxV (w i)) :=
    ⟨b, fun i => by rw [hb i, hw i]⟩
  obtain ⟨U₁, hxU₁, hU₁V, hE₁⟩ := exists_etale_toAffineSpace_of_basis f n V hxV w hb'
  set w₁ : Fin n → Γ(X, U₁.1) := fun i => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₁V).op (w i) with hw₁def
  have hw₁ : ∀ i, X.presheaf.germ U₁.1 x₀ hxU₁ (w₁ i) = z' i := fun i => by
    rw [hw₁def]
    change X.presheaf.germ U₁.1 x₀ hxU₁ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₁V).op (w i)) = z' i
    rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply, hw i]
  
  obtain ⟨U₂, hxU₂, hU₂U₁, hdisj⟩ := exists_affineOpen_le_disjoint
    (fun i : {i : ι // x₀ ∉ (D i).support} => ((D i.1).support : Set X))
    (fun i => (D i.1).support.isClosed) (fun i => i.2) U₁ hxU₁
  set w₂ : Fin n → Γ(X, U₂.1) := fun i => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₂U₁).op (w₁ i) with hw₂def
  have hw₂ : ∀ i, X.presheaf.germ U₂.1 x₀ hxU₂ (w₂ i) = z' i := fun i => by
    rw [hw₂def]
    change X.presheaf.germ U₂.1 x₀ hxU₂ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₂U₁).op (w₁ i)) = z' i
    rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply, hw₁ i]
  
  have hnoeth : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U₂.1) := by
    let _ := f.sectionsAlgebra U₂.1
    have : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U₂.1) := f.finiteType_sectionsAlgebra U₂.2
    exact Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k Γ(X, U₂.1)
  let D' : {i : ι // x₀ ∈ (D i).support} ⊕ Unit → X.IdealSheafData :=
    Sum.elim (fun i => D i.1) fun _ => Z
  let S' : {i : ι // x₀ ∈ (D i).support} ⊕ Unit → Set Γ(X, U₂.1) :=
    Sum.elim (fun i => {w₂ (c' i)}) fun _ => w₂ '' {i : Fin n | i.val < s.card}
  have hS' : ∀ j, (S' j).Finite := by
    rintro (i | u)
    · exact Set.finite_singleton _
    · exact (Set.toFinite _).image w₂
  have hD' : ∀ j, (D' j).stalkIdeal x₀ = span ((X.presheaf.germ U₂.1 x₀ hxU₂).hom '' S' j) := by
    rintro (i | u)
    · change (D i.1).stalkIdeal x₀ = span ((X.presheaf.germ U₂.1 x₀ hxU₂).hom '' {w₂ (c' i)})
      rw [hc' i, Set.image_singleton]
      change span {z' (c' i)} = span {X.presheaf.germ U₂.1 x₀ hxU₂ (w₂ (c' i))}
      rw [hw₂]
    · change Z.stalkIdeal x₀ =
        span ((X.presheaf.germ U₂.1 x₀ hxU₂).hom '' (w₂ '' {i : Fin n | i.val < s.card}))
      rw [hZ', Set.image_image]
      refine congrArg span (Set.image_congr fun i _ => ?_)
      exact (hw₂ i).symm
  obtain ⟨t, hxt, ht⟩ := exists_basicOpen_forall_ideal_eq_span D' U₂ hxU₂ S' hS' hD'
  set U₃ : X.affineOpens := ⟨X.basicOpen t, U₂.2.basicOpen t⟩ with hU₃def
  have hU₃U₂ : U₃.1 ≤ U₂.1 := X.basicOpen_le t
  set w₃ : Fin n → Γ(X, U₃.1) := fun i => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₃U₂).op (w₂ i) with hw₃def
  have hw₃ : ∀ i, X.presheaf.germ U₃.1 x₀ hxt (w₃ i) = z' i := fun i => by
    rw [hw₃def]
    change X.presheaf.germ U₃.1 x₀ hxt (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₃U₂).op (w₂ i)) = z' i
    rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply, hw₂ i]
  
  have hZ₃ : Z.stalkIdeal x₀ =
      span ((fun i => X.presheaf.germ U₃.1 x₀ hxt (w₃ i)) '' {i : Fin n | i.val < s.card}) := by
    rw [hZ']
    exact congrArg span (Set.image_congr fun i _ => (hw₃ i).symm)
  obtain ⟨U₄, hxU₄, hU₄U₃, hAd⟩ :=
    exists_comap_eq_comap_coordinateSubspace f n s.card Z U₃ hxt w₃ hZ₃
  have hU₄U₁ : U₄.1 ≤ U₁.1 := hU₄U₃.trans (hU₃U₂.trans hU₂U₁)
  set w₄ : Fin n → Γ(X, U₄.1) := fun i => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₄U₁).op (w₁ i) with hw₄def
  have hw₄eq : (fun i => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₄U₃).op (w₃ i)) = w₄ := by
    funext i
    rw [hw₄def, hw₃def, hw₂def]
    change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₄U₃).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₃U₂).op
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₂U₁).op (w₁ i))) = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₄U₁).op (w₁ i)
    rw [res_res, res_res]
  have hE₄ : Etale (toAffineSpace f U₄.1 w₄) := by
    have : Etale (toAffineSpace f U₁.1 w₁) := hE₁
    exact etale_toAffineSpace_restrict f hU₄U₁ w₁
  rw [hw₄eq] at hAd
  refine ⟨⟨U₄, hxU₄, w₄, hE₄, hAd⟩, c', hc'inj, hc'lt, fun i => ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · 
    have h₃ := ht (Sum.inl i)
    change (D i.1).ideal U₃ = span ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₃U₂).op).hom '' {w₂ (c' i)}) at h₃
    rw [Set.image_singleton] at h₃
    have h₄ := ideal_eq_span_of_le (D i.1) hU₄U₃ _ h₃
    rw [Set.image_singleton] at h₄
    change (D i.1).ideal U₄ = span {w₄ (c' i)}
    rw [h₄, ← congrFun hw₄eq (c' i)]
    rfl
  · 
    exact comap_eq_top_of_disjoint (D i) U₄.1
      (Set.disjoint_of_subset_left (hU₄U₃.trans hU₃U₂) (hdisj ⟨i, hi⟩))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivisorFamily.subfamily_component
statement:
theorem subfamily_component (E : DivisorFamily X) (p : E.ι → Prop) (a : {a : E.ι // p a}) :
    (E.subfamily p).component a = E.component a.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivisorFamily.IsSnc.isSncOn
statement: theorem IsSnc.isSncOn {E : DivisorFamily X} (hE : E.IsSnc) (s : Set X) : E.IsSncOn s
proof:
:=
  fun x _ => hE.2 x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivisorFamily.isSnc_iff_isSncOn_univ
statement:
theorem isSnc_iff_isSncOn_univ (E : DivisorFamily X) :
    E.IsSnc ↔ (∀ i, IsRegular (E.component i).subscheme) ∧ E.IsSncOn Set.univ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, fun x _ => h.2 x⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, fun x => h.2 x trivial⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_span_singleton_eq_of_span_range_eq
statement:
theorem exists_span_singleton_eq_of_span_range_eq {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (g : ι → R) {e : R}
    (he : e ≠ 0) (h : span (Set.range g) = span {e}) : ∃ i, span {g i} = span {e}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  have hmem : e ∈ span (Set.range g) := h ▸ subset_span rfl
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp hmem
  have hg : ∀ i, ∃ d : R, d * e = g i := fun i =>
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (h ▸ subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  choose d hd using hg
  have hsum : (∑ i, c i * d i) = 1 := by
    have h1 : (∑ i, c i * d i) * e = 1 * e := by
      rw [one_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
      calc ∑ i, c i * d i * e = ∑ i, c i * g i :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [mul_assoc, hd i]
        _ = e := hc
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ he h1
  by_contra hno
  have hall : ∀ i, c i * d i ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro i
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
    intro hu
    exact hno ⟨i, by
      rw [← hd i, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hu)]⟩
  have h1 : (1 : R) ∈ maximalIdeal R := hsum ▸ Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => hall i
  exact (Ideal.ne_top_iff_one _).mp (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ne_of_mem_support_strictTransformAlong
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  exact notMem_support_strictTransformAlong_of_stalkIdeal_eq Z (E i) x' hc hF hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_comap_π_ne_bot
statement: theorem stalkIdeal_comap_π_ne_bot : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal x' ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hreg, m, z', hz', j, a, hF, -⟩ :=
    (exists_totalTransformData_of_mem_support f E Z hZ x' hx').1
  rw [hF]
  intro h0
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] at h0
  exact notMem_sq_of_span_eq z' hz'.1.symm hz'.2 j (h0 ▸ Ideal.zero_mem _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chart_index
statement:
theorem exists_chart_index :
    ∃ j ∈ s, (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal x' = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z j)} ∧
      ∀ l ∈ s, ∃ y : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk x',
        (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z l) = y * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z j)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk x') :=
    (exists_totalTransformData_of_mem_support f E Z hZ x' hx').1.1
  obtain ⟨-, m, z', hz', j', a, hF, -⟩ :=
    (exists_totalTransformData_of_mem_support f E Z hZ x' hx').1
  have hne : z' j' ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
    notMem_sq_of_span_eq z' hz'.1.symm hz'.2 j' (h0 ▸ Ideal.zero_mem _)
  
  have hgen : span (Set.range fun l : s => (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z l.1)) = span {z' j'} := by
    rw [← hF, stalkIdeal_comap, hs, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_image]
    congr 1
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨l, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨l.1, l.2, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, hjF⟩ := exists_span_singleton_eq_of_span_range_eq _ hne hgen
  refine ⟨j, hj, hF.trans hjF.symm, fun l hl => ?_⟩
  have hmem : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z l) ∈ span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z j)} := by
    rw [hjF, ← hgen]
    exact subset_span ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
  exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_of_eq_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk x') :=
    (exists_totalTransformData_of_mem_support f E Z hZ x' hx').1.1
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hstrict⟩ :=
    exists_stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_of_mem f E Z hZ i x' hx' hz hs hc hcs hF
  have hne : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply stalkIdeal_comap_π_ne_bot f E Z hZ x' hx'
    rw [hF, h0, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
  have huy : u = y := mul_right_cancel₀ hne (hu.symm.trans hy)
  rw [hstrict, huy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_maximalIdeal_iff_mem_support_strictTransformAlong
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal,
    stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_of_eq_mul f E Z hZ x' hx' hz hs hc hcs hF hy,
    Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ne_zero_of_parameters
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_parameters (c : Fin n) : z c ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h =>
  (mem_maximalIdeal_and_notMem_sq_of_span_eq ⟨hz.symm, hn⟩ c).2
    (h ▸ Ideal.zero_mem _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.prime_of_parameters
statement: theorem prime_of_parameters (c : Fin n) : Prime (z c)
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (ne_zero_of_parameters hz hn c)).mp
    (isPrime_span_singleton_of_parameters hz hn c)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.not_dvd_of_ne
statement: theorem not_dvd_of_ne {c d : Fin n} (h : c ≠ d) : ¬ z c ∣ z d
proof:
:= fun hdvd =>
  notMem_span_image_of_notMem hz hn (s := {c}) (j := d)
    (fun hmem => h (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hmem).symm)
    (by rw [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hdvd)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.not_dvd_prod_pow
statement:
theorem not_dvd_prod_pow {s : Finset (Fin n)} {d : Fin n} (hd : d ∉ s) (a : Fin n → ℕ) :
    ¬ z d ∣ ∏ c ∈ s, z c ^ a c
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hdc⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff (prime_of_parameters hz hn d) _).mp h
  exact not_dvd_of_ne hz hn (fun e => hd (by rw [e]; exact hc))
    ((prime_of_parameters hz hn d).dvd_of_dvd_pow hdc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.prod_pow_dvd_of_forall_dvd
statement:
theorem prod_pow_dvd_of_forall_dvd (s : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℕ) {f : R}
    (h : ∀ c ∈ s, z c ^ a c ∣ f) : (∏ c ∈ s, z c ^ a c) ∣ f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert d s hd ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hd]
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := ih fun c hc => h c (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hc)
    have h1 : z d ^ a d ∣ (∏ c ∈ s, z c ^ a c) * g := hg ▸ h d (Finset.mem_insert_self d s)
    have h2 : z d ^ a d ∣ g :=
      (prime_of_parameters hz hn d).pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (a d) (not_dvd_prod_pow hz hn hd a) h1
    rw [hg, mul_comm (z d ^ a d)]
    exact mul_dvd_mul_left _ h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isUnit_of_dvd_pow_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_dvd_pow_of_not_dvd {c : Fin n} {g : R} (hg : ¬ z c ∣ g) {N : ℕ}
    (h : g ∣ z c ^ N) : IsUnit g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, -, hassoc⟩ := (dvd_prime_pow (prime_of_parameters hz hn c) N).mp h
  cases i with
  | zero => exact associated_one_iff_isUnit.mp (by simpa using hassoc)
  | succ i => exact absurd ((dvd_pow_self (z c) (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)).trans hassoc.symm.dvd) hg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_pow_of_le_ordAlong_span_singleton
statement:
theorem le_pow_of_le_ordAlong_span_singleton {p : R} (hp : Prime p) (I : Ideal R) (m : ℕ)
    [hP : (Ideal.span {p}).IsPrime]
    (h : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ordAlong (Ideal.span {p}) I) : I ≤ Ideal.span {p} ^ m
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  rw [ordAlong, le_ord_iff,
    ← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, ← Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap] at h
  have hf' := h hf
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Ideal.span {p}).primeCompl] at hf'
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨s, hs⟩⟩, hfa⟩ := hf'
  rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (Ideal.span {p}).primeCompl] at hfa
  obtain ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ht'⟩ := hfa
  have hmem : t * s * f ∈ Ideal.span {p} ^ m := by
    have h1 : t * (f * s) = t * a := ht'
    rw [show t * s * f = t * (f * s) by ring, h1]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ha
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem ⊢
  have hts : ¬ p ∣ t * s := fun hd => by
    rcases hp.dvd_or_dvd hd with h | h
    · exact ht (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr h)
    · exact hs (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr h)
  exact hp.pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_left m hts hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_pow_of_le_ordAlong_of_eq_span
statement:
theorem le_pow_of_le_ordAlong_of_eq_span {P : Ideal R} [P.IsPrime] {p : R} (hp : Prime p)
    (hPp : P = Ideal.span {p}) (I : Ideal R) (m : ℕ)
    (h : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ ordAlong P I) : I ≤ P ^ m
proof:
:= by
  subst hPp
  exact le_pow_of_le_ordAlong_span_singleton hp I m h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.prod_dvd_of_forall_dvd_of_pairwise
statement:
theorem prod_dvd_of_forall_dvd_of_pairwise {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (q : ι → R)
    (hq : ∀ d ∈ S, IsUnit (q d) ∨
      ∃ p : R, Prime p ∧ (∃ a : ℕ, q d = p ^ a) ∧ ∀ i ∈ S, i ≠ d → ¬ p ∣ q i)
    {f : R} (h : ∀ i ∈ S, q i ∣ f) : (∏ i ∈ S, q i) ∣ f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert d S hd ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hd]
    have hS : ∀ d' ∈ S, IsUnit (q d') ∨
        ∃ p : R, Prime p ∧ (∃ a : ℕ, q d' = p ^ a) ∧ ∀ i ∈ S, i ≠ d' → ¬ p ∣ q i := by
      intro d' hd'
      rcases hq d' (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hd') with hu | ⟨p, hp, ha, hnot⟩
      · exact Or.inl hu
      · exact Or.inr ⟨p, hp, ha, fun i hi => hnot i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := ih hS fun i hi => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    rcases hq d (Finset.mem_insert_self d S) with hu | ⟨p, hp, ⟨a, hqa⟩, hnot⟩
    · exact hu.mul_left_dvd.mpr ⟨g, hg⟩
    · have h1 : q d ∣ (∏ i ∈ S, q i) * g := hg ▸ h d (Finset.mem_insert_self d S)
      have hnp : ¬ p ∣ ∏ i ∈ S, q i := fun hd' => by
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hpi⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff hp _).mp hd'
        exact hnot i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) (fun e => hd (e ▸ hi)) hpi
      rw [hqa] at h1 ⊢
      have h2 : p ^ a ∣ g := hp.pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_left a hnp h1
      rw [hg, mul_comm (p ^ a)]
      exact mul_dvd_mul_left _ h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ordElem_parameter
proof:
:=
  ordElem_eq_one_iff.mpr (mem_maximalIdeal_and_notMem_sq_of_span_eq hz c)

name: Derivation.map_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_sq
statement:
theorem _root_.Derivation.map_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_sq {k : Type v} [CommRing k] [Algebra k R]
    (D : Derivation k R R) {a : R} (ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) : D a ∈ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two] at ha
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on ha (fun m hm n hn => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
  · rw [D.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hm) (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hn)
  · rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem hx hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_derivations
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_derivations {k : Type v} [CommRing k] [Algebra k R]
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ι → R) (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (D : ι → Derivation k R R) (hD : ∀ i j, D i (w j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨w i, hw i⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg i
  choose a ha using fun j => residue_surjective (R := R) (g j)
  set W : ι → maximalIdeal R := fun j => ⟨w j, hw j⟩ with hW
  have hsum : (∑ j, g j • (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent (W j)) =
      (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent (∑ j, a j • W j) := by
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, ← ha j, ← ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul]
  have hmem : ((∑ j, a j • W j : maximalIdeal R) : R) ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 :=
    ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_eq_zero _).mp (hsum.symm.trans hg)
  have hcoe : ((∑ j, a j • W j : maximalIdeal R) : R) = ∑ j, a j * w j := by
    rw [Submodule.coe_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => rfl
  rw [hcoe] at hmem
  have hDi : D i (∑ j, a j * w j) = a i + ∑ j, w j * D i (a j) := by
    rw [map_sum]
    have : ∀ j, D i (a j * w j) = (if i = j then a j else 0) + w j * D i (a j) := by
      intro j
      rw [(D i).leibniz, hD i j, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    simp only [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  have hai : a i ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    have h1 : D i (∑ j, a j * w j) ∈ maximalIdeal R :=
      (D i).map_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_sq hmem
    have h2 : (∑ j, w j * D i (a j)) ∈ maximalIdeal R :=
      sum_mem fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hw j)
    rw [hDi] at h1
    simpa using sub_mem h1 h2
  rw [← ha i, residue_eq_zero_iff]
  exact hai

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_linearIndependent {ι : Type*} (w : ι → R)
    (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hli : LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨w i, hw i⟩) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (z : Fin m → R),
      (span (Set.range z) = maximalIdeal R ∧ (m : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) ∧
        ∃ σ : ι → Fin m, Function.Injective σ ∧ ∀ i, z (σ i) = w i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set v : ι → CotangentSpace R := fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨w i, hw i⟩ with hv
  have hs : LinearIndepOn (ResidueField R) id (Set.range v) := hli.linearIndepOn_id
  set B : Set (CotangentSpace R) := hs.extend (Set.subset_univ _) with hB
  let b : Basis B (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) := Basis.extend hs
  have : Fintype B := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex b
  choose ℓ₀ hℓ₀ using fun x : B => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_surjective (x : CotangentSpace R)
  let ℓ : B → R := fun x =>
    if h : (x : CotangentSpace R) ∈ Set.range v then w (Classical.choose h) else (ℓ₀ x : R)
  have hℓmem : ∀ x, ℓ x ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro x
    simp only [ℓ]
    split_ifs
    · exact hw _
    · exact (ℓ₀ x).2
  have hℓ : ∀ x : B, (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨ℓ x, hℓmem x⟩ = x := by
    intro x
    by_cases h : (x : CotangentSpace R) ∈ Set.range v
    · have h1 : ℓ x = w (Classical.choose h) := dite_eq_left h
      have h2 : v (Classical.choose h) = x := Classical.choose_spec h
      rw [← h2]
      exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext h1)
    · have h1 : ℓ x = (ℓ₀ x : R) := dite_eq_right h
      rw [← hℓ₀ x]
      exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext h1)
  obtain ⟨hspan, hcard⟩ :=
    (span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_card_eq_spanFinrank_iff ℓ hℓmem).mpr
      ⟨b, fun x => by rw [Basis.extend_apply_self, hℓ]⟩
  let e : B ≃ Fin (Fintype.card B) := Fintype.equivFin B
  have hvB : ∀ i, v i ∈ B := fun i => hs.subset_extend _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Fintype.card B, ℓ ∘ e.symm, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun i => e ⟨v i, hvB i⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e.symm.surjective.range_comp, hspan]
  · rw [hcard]
    exact_mod_cast IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
  · intro i j hij
    exact hli.injective (congrArg Subtype.val (e.injective hij))
  · intro i
    have h : (v i : CotangentSpace R) ∈ Set.range v := ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change ℓ (e.symm (e ⟨v i, hvB i⟩)) = w i
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change (if h : (v i : CotangentSpace R) ∈ Set.range v then w (Classical.choose h)
      else (ℓ₀ ⟨v i, hvB i⟩ : R)) = w i
    rw [dite_eq_left h]
    exact congrArg w (hli.injective (Classical.choose_spec h))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_etale_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_etale_coordinates
    (hy : (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) y).toRingHom.Etale) (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q) ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (z : Fin m → Localization.AtPrime q),
        (span (Set.range z) = maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q) ∧
          (m : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q)) ∧
        ∃ σ : {c : Fin n // y c ∈ q} → Fin m, Function.Injective σ ∧
          ∀ c, z (σ c) = algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q) (y c.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A := (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) y).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hEt : Algebra.Etale (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A := hy
  have halg : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k,
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A p = MvPolynomial.aeval y p := fun p => rfl
  have : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      rw [halg, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
  have : Algebra.FormallySmooth k A :=
    Algebra.FormallySmooth.comp k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k))
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A)
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    Algebra.IsSmoothAt.isRegularLocalRing (k := k) q
  refine ⟨hreg, ?_⟩
  
  have hD : ∀ c : Fin n, ∃ D : Derivation k A A, ∀ c', D (y c') = if c = c' then 1 else 0 := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := Derivation.exists_extension_of_formallySmooth (k := k)
      (A := MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (B := A) (MvPolynomial.pderiv c)
    refine ⟨D, fun c' => ?_⟩
    have h := hD (MvPolynomial.X c')
    rw [halg, halg, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.pderiv_X] at h
    rw [h]
    by_cases hcc : c = c'
    · subst hcc
      simp
    · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hcc), ite_eq_right hcc, map_zero]
  choose D hDy using hD
  
  let w : {c : Fin n // y c ∈ q} → Localization.AtPrime q := fun c => algebraMap A _ (y c.1)
  have hw : ∀ c, w c ∈ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q) := fun c =>
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime q) q (y c.1)).mpr c.2
  let Dl : {c : Fin n // y c ∈ q} →
      Derivation k (Localization.AtPrime q) (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    fun c => (D c.1).localization q.primeCompl
  have hDl : ∀ i j, Dl i (w j) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i j
    change (D i.1).localization q.primeCompl (algebraMap A (Localization q.primeCompl) (y j.1)) = _
    rw [Derivation.localization_algebraMap, hDy]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp
    · rw [ite_eq_right hij, ite_eq_right (fun h => hij (Subtype.ext h)), map_zero]
  exact exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_linearIndependent w hw
    (linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_derivations w hw Dl hDl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_residueFieldMap_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem isIso_residueFieldMap_of_isClosed [IsAlgClosed k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (a' : blowUp Z) (hcl : IsClosed ({a'} : Set (blowUp Z))) :
    IsIso ((blowUpπ Z).residueFieldMap a')
proof:
:= by
  have hN : IsLocallyNoetherian X := f.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
  have hπ : IsProper (blowUpπ Z) := blowUp.isProper_π Z
  
  have hcl' : IsClosed ({blowUpπ Z a'} : Set X) := by
    have := (blowUpπ Z).isClosedMap _ hcl
    rwa [Set.image_singleton] at this
  
  let i₁ := residueFieldIsoBase (blowUpπ Z ≫ f) a' hcl
  let i₀ := residueFieldIsoBase f (blowUpπ Z a') hcl'
  have key : i₀.inv ≫ (blowUpπ Z).residueFieldMap a' = i₁.inv := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    rw [Spec.map_comp, SpecMap_residueFieldIsoBase_inv, SpecMap_residueFieldIsoBase_inv,
      ← Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField,
      Category.assoc]
  have h2 : (blowUpπ Z).residueFieldMap a' = i₀.hom ≫ i₁.inv := by
    rw [← key, ← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [h2]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdeal_eq_map_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdeal_eq_map_of_isPullback (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    {φ : affineBlowUp (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟶ blowUp Z}
    (H : IsPullback φ (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal x)) (blowUpπ Z) (X.fromSpecStalk x))
    (t : affineBlowUp (Z.stalkIdeal x)) :
    (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (Z.stalkIdeal x)).stalkIdeal t =
      ((Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal (φ t)).map (φ.stalkMap t).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap, ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, H.w,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, comap_fromSpecStalk_eq_specIdealSheaf]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMap_stalkMap_germ_eq
statement:
theorem stalkMap_stalkMap_germ_eq (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (s : Γ(X, V)) :
    φ.stalkMap T (π.stalkMap (φ T) (X.presheaf.germ V (π (φ T)) (hx' ▸ hxV) s)) =
      ψ.stalkMap T ((Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (ψ T) trivial
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (X.presheaf.stalk x)).inv (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV s)))
proof:
:= by
  have hV : (φ ≫ π) T ∈ V := hx' ▸ hxV
  have h := stalkMap_germ_eq_of_eq_comp_fromSpecStalk x (φ ≫ π) hw T V hxV hV s
  have h1 : φ.stalkMap T (π.stalkMap (φ T) (X.presheaf.germ V (π (φ T)) (hx' ▸ hxV) s)) =
      (φ ≫ π).stalkMap T (X.presheaf.germ V ((φ ≫ π) T) hV s) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
    rfl
  exact h1.trans h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.map_stalkIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span
statement:
theorem map_stalkIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V)
    (s : Γ(X, V))
    (hF : (Z.comap π).stalkIdeal (φ T) =
      span {π.stalkMap (φ T) (X.presheaf.germ V (π (φ T)) (hx' ▸ hxV) s)}) :
    ((Z.comap π).stalkIdeal (φ T)).map (φ.stalkMap T).hom =
      span
        {ψ.stalkMap T ((Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (ψ T) trivial
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (X.presheaf.stalk x)).inv (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV s)))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [hF, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, stalkMap_stalkMap_germ_eq φ ψ π hw T hx']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringEquiv_trans_stalkMap_eq
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_trans_stalkMap_eq [IsIso (φ.stalkMap T)] {L : Type u} [CommRing L]
    (e₁ : Y.presheaf.stalk T ≃+* L) (g : X.presheaf.stalk x →+* L)
    (h4 : ∀ (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (s : Γ(X, V)),
      ψ.stalkMap T ((Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (ψ T) trivial
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (X.presheaf.stalk x)).inv (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV s))) =
      e₁.symm (g (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV s)))
    (c : X.presheaf.stalk (π (φ T))) :
    ((RingEquiv.ofBijective (φ.stalkMap T).hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _)).trans e₁)
      (π.stalkMap (φ T) c) = g (hx' ▸ c)
proof:
:= by
  subst hx'
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, s, rfl⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq c
  have hE : ∀ a, ((RingEquiv.ofBijective (φ.stalkMap T).hom
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _)).trans e₁) a = e₁ (φ.stalkMap T a) := fun a => rfl
  rw [hE, stalkMap_stalkMap_germ_eq φ ψ π hw T rfl V hxV s, h4, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chart_point_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem exists_chart_point_of_isPullback (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X) (x' : blowUp Z)
    (hx' : blowUpπ Z x' = x) {b : X.presheaf.stalk x} (hmem : b ∈ Z.stalkIdeal x)
    {φ : affineBlowUp (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟶ blowUp Z}
    (H : IsPullback φ (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal x)) (blowUpπ Z) (X.fromSpecStalk x))
    (V₀ : X.Opens) (hxV₀ : x ∈ V₀) (s₀ : Γ(X, V₀)) (hs₀ : X.presheaf.germ V₀ x hxV₀ s₀ = b)
    (hF : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal x' =
      span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (X.presheaf.germ V₀ (blowUpπ Z x') (hx' ▸ hxV₀) s₀)}) :
    ∃ q : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal x) b)),
      φ (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨b, hmem⟩ q) = x' ∧
      (PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal q).comap
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal x) b)) =
        maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxc : (blowUpπ Z).base x' =
      (X.fromSpecStalk x).base (closedPoint (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
    rw [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint, hx']
  obtain ⟨t, hφt, hπt⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback H x' _ hxc
  change φ t = x' at hφt
  subst hφt
  have hchart : t ∈ (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨b, hmem⟩).opensRange := by
    rw [affineBlowUp.mem_chart_iff, stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdeal_eq_map_of_isPullback Z x H t,
      map_stalkIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span φ (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal x)) (blowUpπ Z) H.w t
        hx' Z V₀ hxV₀ s₀ hF, hs₀]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hchart
  subst hq
  refine ⟨q, rfl, ?_⟩
  change (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨b, hmem⟩ ≫ affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal x)) q =
    closedPoint _ at hπt
  rw [affineBlowUp.chart_π, Spec.map_apply] at hπt
  exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hπt

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stalk_equiv_localization_atPrime_aux
statement:
theorem exists_stalk_equiv_localization_atPrime_aux (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (x' : blowUp Z) (hx' : blowUpπ Z x' = x) {n r : ℕ} (y : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (hZ : Z.stalkIdeal x = span (y '' {i | i.val < r})) (ρ : Fin n) (hρ : ρ.val + 1 = r)
    (V₀ : X.Opens) (hxV₀ : x ∈ V₀) (s₀ : Γ(X, V₀)) (hs₀ : X.presheaf.germ V₀ x hxV₀ s₀ = y ρ)
    (hF : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal x' =
      span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (X.presheaf.germ V₀ (blowUpπ Z x') (hx' ▸ hxV₀) s₀)}) :
    ∃ (𝔮 : Ideal (affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal x) (y ρ))) (_ : 𝔮.IsPrime)
      (e : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk x' ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮),
      𝔮.comap (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal x) (y ρ))) =
        maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
      ∀ c : X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z x'),
        e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' c) =
          algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal x) (y ρ)) _ (algebraMap _ _ (hx' ▸ c))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨φ, H⟩ := exists_isPullback_fromSpecStalk Z x
  have hmem : y ρ ∈ Z.stalkIdeal x :=
    hZ ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨ρ, show ρ.val < r by omega, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hφq, hqm⟩ :=
    exists_chart_point_of_isPullback Z x x' hx' hmem H V₀ hxV₀ s₀ hs₀ hF
  
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := exists_ringEquiv_stalk_chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩ q
  have hi := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    ((affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩).stalkMap q)).1
  have h2 := stalkMap_chart_stalkMap_π (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩ q
  let g : X.presheaf.stalk x →+*
      Localization.AtPrime (PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal q) (hp := PrimeSpectrum.isPrime q) :=
    (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal x) (y ρ)) _).comp
      (algebraMap _ (affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal x) (y ρ)))
  have h4 : ∀ (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (s : Γ(X, V)),
      (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal x)).stalkMap
          (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩ q)
          ((Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).presheaf.germ ⊤
            (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal x) (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩ q))
            trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (X.presheaf.stalk x)).inv (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV s))) =
        e₁.symm (g (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV s)) := fun V hxV s =>
    hi ((h2 (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV s)).trans (he₁ _).symm)
  have hiso := isIso_stalkMap_of_isPullback_fromSpecStalk H
    (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩ q)
  subst hφq
  have key := ringEquiv_trans_stalkMap_eq φ (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal x)) (blowUpπ Z) H.w
    (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal x) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩ q) hx' e₁ g h4
  exact ⟨PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal q, PrimeSpectrum.isPrime q, _, hqm, key⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stalk_equiv_localization_atPrime
statement:
theorem exists_stalk_equiv_localization_atPrime (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (x' : blowUp Z)
    {n r : ℕ} (y : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z x'))
    (hZ : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z x') = span (y '' {i | i.val < r})) (ρ : Fin n)
    (hρ : ρ.val + 1 = r)
    (hF : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal x' = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (y ρ)}) :
    ∃ (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing y ρ)) (_ : 𝔮.IsPrime)
      (e : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk x' ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮),
      𝔮.comap (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z x')) (chartRing y ρ)) =
        maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z x')) ∧
      ∀ c : X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z x'),
        e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' c) = algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) _ (algebraMap _ _ c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V₀, hxV₀, s₀, hs₀⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq (y ρ)
  have hF₀ : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal x' =
      span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (X.presheaf.germ V₀ (blowUpπ Z x') hxV₀ s₀)} := by
    rw [hs₀]
    exact hF
  have h := exists_stalk_equiv_localization_atPrime_aux Z (blowUpπ Z x') x' rfl y hZ ρ hρ V₀ hxV₀
    s₀ hs₀ hF₀
  have hC := affineBlowUpAlgebra_stalkIdeal_eq_chartRing Z _ hZ ρ hρ
  generalize affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z x')) (y ρ) = C at hC h
  subst hC
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.notMem_support_saturate_of_stalkIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem notMem_support_saturate_of_stalkIdeal_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} (D Z : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hZ : Z.IsInvertible) {x : X} (hD : D.stalkIdeal x = Z.stalkIdeal x) :
    x ∉ (D.saturate Z).support
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  have hle := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal _ _).mp hx
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_saturate_of_isInvertible D hZ x] at hle
  have htop : (⊤ : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ≤ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    refine le_trans ?_ hle
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup _ 1)
    rw [pow_one, hD, Ideal.colon_coe_self]
  exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top (top_le_iff.mp htop)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_snc_data_trivialTotalTransform
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hregx := hreg (π x')
  
  have hmemE : ∀ i, x' ∈ (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E (Sum.inl i)).support →
      π x' ∈ (E i).support := fun i hi =>
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_antitone (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_saturate (E i) Z)
      ((mem_support_strictTransformAlong_of_isIso_iff π Z (E i) x').mp hi)
  have hstalkE : ∀ i (hi : x' ∈ (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E (Sum.inl i)).support),
      (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E (Sum.inl i)).stalkIdeal x' =
        ((E i).stalkIdeal (π x')).map (π.stalkMap x').hom := fun i hi => by
    change ((E i).strictTransformAlong π (Z.comap π)).stalkIdeal x' = _
    rw [stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_of_isIso,
      stalkIdeal_saturate_eq_of_mem_support hreg (E i) Z hZ (hdata i)
        ((mem_support_strictTransformAlong_of_isIso_iff π Z (E i) x').mp hi)]
  
  have hmemF : ∀ k : PUnit.{u + 1}, x' ∈ (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E (Sum.inr k)).support →
      π x' ∈ Z.support := fun _ h => (mem_support_comap_of_isIso_iff π Z x').mp h
  let jF : ∀ k : PUnit.{u + 1}, x' ∈ (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E (Sum.inr k)).support → Fin n
      :=
    fun k h => Classical.choose (hj (hmemF k h))
  have hjF : ∀ k h, Z.stalkIdeal (π x') = span {z (jF k h)} :=
    fun k h => Classical.choose_spec (hj (hmemF k h))
  
  let c' : {k : ι ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1} // x' ∈ (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E k).support} → Fin n :=
    fun k => match k with
      | ⟨Sum.inl i, hi⟩ => c ⟨i, hmemE i hi⟩
      | ⟨Sum.inr u, h⟩ => jF u h
  
  have hne : ∀ (i : ι) (hi : x' ∈ (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E (Sum.inl i)).support)
      (u : PUnit.{u + 1}) (h : x' ∈ (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E (Sum.inr u)).support),
      c ⟨i, hmemE i hi⟩ ≠ jF u h := by
    intro i hi u h heq
    apply notMem_support_saturate_of_stalkIdeal_eq (E i) Z hZ
      (x := π x') (by rw [hc ⟨i, hmemE i hi⟩, hjF u h, heq])
    exact (mem_support_strictTransformAlong_of_isIso_iff π Z (E i) x').mp hi
  refine ⟨c', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨k₁, h₁⟩ ⟨k₂, h₂⟩ heq
    match k₁, h₁, k₂, h₂, heq with
    | Sum.inl i₁, h₁, Sum.inl i₂, h₂, heq =>
      have := hcinj (heq : c ⟨i₁, hmemE i₁ h₁⟩ = c ⟨i₂, hmemE i₂ h₂⟩)
      rw [Subtype.mk.injEq] at this
      exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Sum.inl this)
    | Sum.inl i, h₁, Sum.inr u, h₂, heq => exact (hne i h₁ u h₂ heq).elim
    | Sum.inr u, h₁, Sum.inl i, h₂, heq => exact (hne i h₂ u h₁ heq.symm).elim
    | Sum.inr u₁, h₁, Sum.inr u₂, h₂, _ => rfl
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    match k, hk with
    | Sum.inl i, hi =>
      change (trivialTotalTransformFamily π Z E (Sum.inl i)).stalkIdeal x' =
        span {π.stalkMap x' (z (c ⟨i, hmemE i hi⟩))}
      rw [hstalkE i hi, hc ⟨i, hmemE i hi⟩, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    | Sum.inr u, h =>
      change (Z.comap π).stalkIdeal x' = span {π.stalkMap x' (z (jF u h))}
      rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap, hjF u h, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGreatest_range_ord_iff
statement:
theorem isGreatest_range_ord_iff (J : X.IdealSheafData) (d : ℕ∞) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range J.ord) d ↔ J.maxOrd = d ∧ ∃ x, J.ord x = d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hub⟩
    refine ⟨le_antisymm (J.maxOrd_le_iff.mpr fun y => hub ⟨y, rfl⟩) ?_, x, hx⟩
    rw [← hx]
    exact J.le_maxOrd x
  · rintro ⟨hmax, x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact hmax ▸ J.le_maxOrd z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.support_componentFamily
statement:
theorem support_componentFamily [NoetherianSpace X] (E : X.IdealSheafData) :
    E.componentFamily.support = E.support
proof:
:= by
  change (⨆ η : E.support.genericPoints, (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure
      {(η : X)})).support) =
    E.support
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun η => ?_
    rw [← SetLike.coe_subset_coe]
    simp only [IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal]
    exact E.support.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr η.2.1)
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hspec⟩ := E.support.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes hx
    refine le_iSup (fun η : E.support.genericPoints =>
      (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure {(η : X)})).support) ⟨η, hη⟩ ?_
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe]
    simp only [IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hspec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.radical_eq_self_of_isReduced_subscheme
statement:
theorem radical_eq_self_of_isReduced_subscheme (E : X.IdealSheafData) [IsReduced E.subscheme] :
    E.radical = E
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext (funext fun U => ?_)
  change (E.ideal U).radical = E.ideal U
  rw [← E.ker_subschemeι_app U, Ideal.radical_eq_iff, Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (E.subschemeι.app U).hom := E.subschemeι_app_surjective U
  exact isReduced_of_injective (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj).toRingHom
    (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj).injective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsSmooth.stageMap_smoothOfRelativeDimension
proof:
:= by
  induction S with
  | nil Y =>
    change SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (𝟙 Y ≫ f)
    rw [Category.id_comp]
    infer_instance
  | cons Y D rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨hD, ht⟩ := (isSmooth_cons_iff f D rest).1 h
    have := hD
    have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (D.blowUpπ ≫ f) :=
      smoothOfRelativeDimension_blowUpπ_comp_of_smooth f n D
    rcases i with ⟨_ | j, hi⟩
    · change SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (𝟙 Y ≫ f)
      rw [Category.id_comp]
      infer_instance
    · change SmoothOfRelativeDimension n
        ((rest.stageMap ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩ ≫ D.blowUpπ) ≫ f)
      rw [Category.assoc]
      exact ih ht ⟨j, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOrderSeq.maxOrd_weakTransformSeq_le
statement:
theorem IsOrderSeq.maxOrd_weakTransformSeq_le (h : S.IsOrderSeq f J F d) (hmax : J.maxOrd = d)
    (i : Fin (S.length + 1)) : (S.weakTransformSeq J i).maxOrd ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  have h' : S.IsOrderGeSeq f J d F := (isOrderGeSeq_iff_isOrderSeq f n hmax).mpr h
  have := IsOrderGeSeq.maxOrd_le f n hmax h' i
  rwa [IsOrderSeq.markedTransformSeq_eq_weakTransformSeq f n h i] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOrderSeq.maxOrd_weakTransformSeq_eq
statement:
theorem IsOrderSeq.maxOrd_weakTransformSeq_eq (h : S.IsOrderSeq f J F d) (hmax : J.maxOrd = d)
    (i : Fin S.length) (hne : ((S.center i).support : Set (S.stage i.castSucc)).Nonempty) :
    (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).maxOrd = d
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (IsOrderSeq.maxOrd_weakTransformSeq_le f n h hmax i.castSucc) ?_
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨η, hη, -⟩ := (S.center i).support.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes hx
  have hord : (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).ord η = d := (h.2 i).2 η hη
  rw [← hord]
  exact (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).le_maxOrd η

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOrderSeq.le_ord_of_mem_center
statement:
theorem IsOrderSeq.le_ord_of_mem_center (h : S.IsOrderSeq f J F d) (i : Fin S.length)
    {x : S.stage i.castSucc} (hx : x ∈ (S.center i).support) :
    (d : ℕ∞) ≤ (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).ord x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hspec⟩ := (S.center i).support.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes hx
  have hord : (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).ord η = d := (h.2 i).2 η hη
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (S.stageMap i.castSucc ≫ f) :=
    IsSmooth.stageMap_smoothOfRelativeDimension h.1 i.castSucc
  have := (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).ord_le_ord_of_specializes
    (S.stageMap i.castSucc ≫ f) n hspec
  change (d : ℕ∞) ≤ (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).ord x
  rw [← hord]
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsOrderSeq.ord_eq_of_mem_center
statement:
theorem IsOrderSeq.ord_eq_of_mem_center (h : S.IsOrderSeq f J F d) (hmax : J.maxOrd = d)
    (i : Fin S.length) {x : S.stage i.castSucc} (hx : x ∈ (S.center i).support) :
    (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).ord x = d
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (IsOrderSeq.le_ord_of_mem_center f n h i hx)
  change (S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).ord x ≤ d
  exact ((S.weakTransformSeq J i.castSucc).le_maxOrd x).trans
    (IsOrderSeq.maxOrd_weakTransformSeq_le f n h hmax i.castSucc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.totalTransform_isSnc
statement:
theorem totalTransform_isSnc [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) :

      · exact exists_isSncAt_totalTransform_of_mem_support
