name: AlgebraicGeometry.sncDataAt_of_hasSncWith
statement:
theorem sncDataAt_of_hasSncWith (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (i : E.ι) :
    ∀ x ∈ (E.component i).support, x ∈ Z.support → SncDataAt (E.component i) Z x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxD hxZ
  obtain ⟨n, z, hsnc, s, hZs⟩ := hZ x hxZ
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := hsnc.2
  exact ⟨n, z, c ⟨i, hxD⟩, s, hsnc.1.1.symm, hsnc.1.2, hc ⟨i, hxD⟩, hZs⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.strictTransform_eq_comap_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem strictTransform_eq_comap_of_isInvertible (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z)
    (hZ' : Z.IsInvertible) (i : E.ι)
    (hi : ∀ x ∈ Z.support, x ∈ (E.component i).support →
      ¬ (E.component i).stalkIdeal x ≤ Z.stalkIdeal x) :
    (E.component i).strictTransform Z = (E.component i).comap Z.blowUpπ
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) := fun x =>
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f x
  have := blowUp.isIso_π_of_isInvertible Z hZ'
  have hsat : (E.component i).saturate Z = E.component i := by
    refine saturate_eq_self_of_snc_transversal hreg (E.component i) Z hZ' fun x hxD hxZ => ?_
    obtain ⟨n, z, hsnc, s, hZs⟩ := hZ x hxZ
    obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := hsnc.2
    exact ⟨n, z, c ⟨i, hxD⟩, s, hsnc.1.1.symm, hsnc.1.2, hc ⟨i, hxD⟩, hZs,
      notMem_of_not_stalkIdeal_le hsnc.1 hZs (hc ⟨i, hxD⟩) (hi x hxZ hxD)⟩
  exact strictTransformAlong_eq_comap_of_saturate_eq (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) Z
      (E.component i) hsat

name: AlgebraicGeometry.totalTransform_isSnc_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem totalTransform_isSnc_of_isInvertible (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z)
    (hZ' : Z.IsInvertible) : (E.totalTransform Z).IsSnc
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) := fun x =>
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f x
  have hiso := blowUp.isIso_π_of_isInvertible Z hZ'
  have hdata := sncDataAt_of_hasSncWith E Z hZ
  refine ⟨fun k => ?_, fun x' => ?_⟩
  · 
    rcases k with i | u
    · change IsRegular ((E.component i).strictTransform Z).subscheme
      rw [show (E.component i).strictTransform Z =
          ((E.component i).saturate Z).comap (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) from
        strictTransformAlong_of_isIso (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) Z (E.component i)]
      have := isIso_subschemeMap_comap_of_isIso (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)
          ((E.component i).saturate Z)
      exact IsRegular.of_isIso
        (inv (Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap _ _ (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap _ _)))
        (isRegular_subscheme_saturate hreg (E.component i) Z hZ' (hdata i) (hE.1 i))
    · change IsRegular (Z.comap (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)).subscheme
      have hZreg : IsRegular Z.subscheme :=
        isRegular_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_quotient Z fun w hw => by
          have := hreg w
          obtain ⟨n, z, hsnc, s, hZs⟩ := hZ w hw
          exact isRegularLocalRing_quotient_stalkIdeal_of_eq_span hsnc.1 hZs
      have := isIso_subschemeMap_comap_of_isIso (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) Z
      exact IsRegular.of_isIso
        (inv (Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap _ _ (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap _ _))) hZreg
  · 
    by_cases hxZ : IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z x' ∈ Z.support
    · obtain ⟨n, z, hsnc, s, hZs⟩ := hZ _ hxZ
      obtain ⟨c, hcinj, hc⟩ := hsnc.2
      have := hreg (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z x')
      obtain ⟨g, hg, hgZ⟩ := hZ'.exists_mem_nonZeroDivisors_stalkIdeal_eq_span
          (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z x')
      obtain ⟨j, hsj⟩ := exists_eq_singleton_of_span_image_eq_span_singleton hsnc.1.1.symm
        hsnc.1.2 hg (hZs.symm.trans hgZ)
      have hZj : Z.stalkIdeal (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z x') = span {z j} := by
        have h := hZs
        rw [hsj, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton] at h
        exact h
      obtain ⟨c', hc'inj, hc'⟩ := exists_snc_data_trivialTotalTransform
          (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) hreg Z hZ'
        E.component hdata x' c hcinj hc fun _ => ⟨j, hZj⟩
      refine ⟨n, fun l => (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z l),
        ⟨(maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_stalkMap (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) x' hsnc.1.1.symm).symm,
          natCast_eq_ringKrullDim_stalk_of_isIso (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) x' hsnc.1.2⟩,
        fun kk => c' ⟨ofLex kk.1, kk.2⟩, fun k₁ k₂ h => ?_, fun kk => hc' ⟨ofLex kk.1, kk.2⟩⟩
      exact Subtype.ext (ofLex.injective (Subtype.mk.inj (hc'inj h)))
    · obtain ⟨n, z, hsnc⟩ := hE.2 (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z x')
      obtain ⟨c, hcinj, hc⟩ := hsnc.2
      obtain ⟨c', hc'inj, hc'⟩ := exists_snc_data_trivialTotalTransform
          (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) hreg Z hZ'
        E.component hdata x' c hcinj hc fun h => absurd h hxZ
      refine ⟨n, fun l => (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z).stalkMap x' (z l),
        ⟨(maximalIdeal_eq_span_range_stalkMap (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) x' hsnc.1.1.symm).symm,
          natCast_eq_ringKrullDim_stalk_of_isIso (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) x' hsnc.1.2⟩,
        fun kk => c' ⟨ofLex kk.1, kk.2⟩, fun k₁ k₂ h => ?_, fun kk => hc' ⟨ofLex kk.1, kk.2⟩⟩
      exact Subtype.ext (ofLex.injective (Subtype.mk.inj (hc'inj h)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.bijective_quotientMap_of_residueField
statement:
theorem bijective_quotientMap_of_residueField (π : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom π]
    (hrat : Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map π)) (𝔮 : Ideal R') [𝔮.IsPrime]
    (e : S ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
    (hcompat : ∀ c, e (π c) = algebraMap R' (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (algebraMap R R' c))
    (h : maximalIdeal R ≤ 𝔮.comap (algebraMap R R')) :
    Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap 𝔮 (algebraMap R R') h)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hφbij : Function.Bijective (fun t => IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map π t)) :=
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e).bijective.comp hrat
  have hfac : ∀ t : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R,
      algebraMap (R' ⧸ 𝔮) 𝔮.ResidueField (Ideal.quotientMap 𝔮 (algebraMap R R') h t) =
        IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map π t) := by
    intro t
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective t
    change algebraMap (R' ⧸ 𝔮) 𝔮.ResidueField (Ideal.quotientMap 𝔮 (algebraMap R R') h
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x)) = IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map π (residue R x))
    rw [Ideal.quotientMap_mk, Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_residueField_mk,
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv_apply, IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, hcompat,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R' (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) 𝔮.ResidueField]
    rfl
  have hinj := Ideal.injective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField (I := 𝔮)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b hab
    apply hφbij.1
    exact (hfac a).symm.trans ((congrArg (algebraMap (R' ⧸ 𝔮) 𝔮.ResidueField) hab).trans (hfac b))
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hφbij.2 (algebraMap (R' ⧸ 𝔮) 𝔮.ResidueField y)
    refine ⟨x, hinj ?_⟩
    rw [hfac]
    exact hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartOriginAt_eq_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem chartOriginAt_eq_of_sub_mem (a b : Fin n → R) (hab : ∀ i, a i - b i ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
    chartOriginAt x r a = chartOriginAt x r b
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (a b : Fin n → R), (∀ i, a i - b i ∈ maximalIdeal R) →
      chartOriginAt x r a ≤ chartOriginAt x r b := by
    intro a b hab
    have hm : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (chartRing x r)) ≤ chartOriginAt x r b :=
      Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (comap_chartOriginAt x r b hx hn).ge
    refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    by_cases hi : i < r
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hi]
      have h1 : chartYR x r i - algebraMap R _ (b i) ∈ chartOriginAt x r b :=
        Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, by simp only [ite_eq_left hi]⟩
      have h2 : algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (a i - b i) ∈ chartOriginAt x r b :=
        hm (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hab i))
      have : chartYR x r i - algebraMap R (chartRing x r) (a i) =
          (chartYR x r i - algebraMap R _ (b i)) - algebraMap R _ (a i - b i) := by
        rw [map_sub]; ring
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.sub_mem _ h1 h2
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hi]
      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, by simp only [ite_eq_right hi]⟩
  exact le_antisymm (key a b hab) (key b a fun i => by
    have := (maximalIdeal R).neg_mem (hab i)
    rwa [neg_sub] at this)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringKrullDim_eq_of_span_eq_of_derivations
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_eq_of_span_eq_of_derivations {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → S)
    (hspan : span (Set.range g) = maximalIdeal S) (D : Fin n → Derivation k S S)
    (hD : ∀ i j, D i (g j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hg : ∀ i, g i ∈ maximalIdeal S := fun i => hspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hli := linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_derivations g hg D hD
  have htop : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
      (Set.range fun i => (maximalIdeal S).toCotangent ⟨g i, hg i⟩) :=
    ((span_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_span_toCotangent_eq_top g hg).mp hspan.symm).ge
  have hcard := ((span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_card_eq_spanFinrank_iff g hg).mpr
    ⟨Module.Basis.mk hli htop, fun i => by rw [Module.Basis.mk_apply]⟩).2
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  rw [hcard]
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringEquiv_symm_apply_eq_of_compat
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_symm_apply_eq_of_compat (E : S ≃+* L) (π : R →+* S) (g : R →+* R')
    (h : R' →+* L) (hc : ∀ c, E (π c) = h (g c)) {u : R'} {c : R} (hu : u = g c) :
    E.symm (h u) = π c
proof:
:= by
  subst hu
  rw [← hc, E.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_range_symm_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem span_range_symm_eq_maximalIdeal [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalRing L] (E : S ≃+* L)
    {ι : Type*} (g : ι → L) (hspan : span (Set.range g) = maximalIdeal L) :
    span (Set.range fun i => E.symm (g i)) = maximalIdeal S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.range_comp', ← Ideal.map_span, hspan]
  exact map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringEquiv_trans_symm_compat
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_trans_symm_compat {L' : Type*} [CommRing L'] (e : S ≃+* L) (Lq : L' ≃+* L)
    (π : R →+* S) (g : R →+* R') (h : R' →+* L) (h' : R →+* L') (hc : ∀ c, e (π c) = h (g c))
    (hL : ∀ c, Lq (h' c) = h (g c)) (c : R) : (e.trans Lq.symm) (π c) = h' c
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, hc, RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, hL]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringEquiv_symm_mul_eq_of_compat
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_symm_mul_eq_of_compat (E : S ≃+* L) (π : R →+* S) (g : R →+* R') (h : R' →+* L)
    (hc : ∀ c, E (π c) = h (g c)) (ci cj : R) {u v : R'} (hv : v = g cj) (huv : u * g cj = g ci) :
    E.symm (h u) * E.symm (h v) = π ci
proof:
:= by
  subst hv
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, huv, ← hc, E.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_induced_of_equiv_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem exists_induced_of_equiv_chartOrigin {n : ℕ} (y' : Fin n → R) (ρ : Fin n)
    (D' : Fin n → Derivation k R R) (hD' : ∀ i j, D' i (y' j) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    [(chartOrigin y' ρ).IsPrime] (E : S ≃+* Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ))
    (π : R →+* S) (hEc : ∀ c, E (π c) = algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ)) c)
    (σ : Fin n ≃ Fin n) :
    ∃ w' : Fin n → S,
      (span (Set.range w') = maximalIdeal S ∧ (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim S) ∧
      (∀ i, ¬ σ i < ρ → w' i = π (y' (σ i))) ∧
      (∀ i, σ i < ρ → π (y' (σ i)) = w' i * w' (σ.symm ρ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hEc' : ∀ c, E (π c) = algebraMap (chartRing y' ρ) (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ))
      (algebraMap R (chartRing y' ρ) c) :=
    fun c => (hEc c).trans (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply _ (chartRing y' ρ) _ c)
  have hregL : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ)) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv E
  have hspan' : span (Set.range fun l => algebraMap (chartRing y' ρ)
      (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ)) (chartYR y' ρ l)) =
      maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ)) :=
    (maximalIdeal_localization_chartOrigin y' ρ).symm
  refine ⟨fun i => E.symm (algebraMap (chartRing y' ρ) _ (chartYR y' ρ (σ i))), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine span_range_symm_eq_maximalIdeal E _ ?_
    have hr : (Set.range fun i => algebraMap (chartRing y' ρ)
        (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ)) (chartYR y' ρ (σ i))) =
        Set.range fun l => algebraMap (chartRing y' ρ)
          (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ)) (chartYR y' ρ l) := by
      rw [← σ.surjective.range_comp (fun l => algebraMap (chartRing y' ρ)
        (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ)) (chartYR y' ρ l))]
      rfl
    rw [hr]
    exact hspan'
  · rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv E]
    exact ringKrullDim_eq_of_span_eq_of_derivations _ hspan'
      (fun l => (chartRingDer y' ρ D' hD' l).localization (chartOrigin y' ρ).primeCompl)
      (fun i l => by
        change (chartRingDer y' ρ D' hD' i).localization (chartOrigin y' ρ).primeCompl
          (algebraMap (chartRing y' ρ) (Localization (chartOrigin y' ρ).primeCompl)
            (chartYR y' ρ l)) = _
        rw [Derivation.localization_algebraMap, chartRingDer_chartYR]
        split_ifs <;> simp)
  · intro i hi
    exact ringEquiv_symm_apply_eq_of_compat E π _ _ hEc' (chartYR_of_not_lt y' ρ hi)
  · intro i hi
    have hv : chartYR y' ρ (σ (σ.symm ρ)) = algebraMap R (chartRing y' ρ) (y' ρ) := by
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact chartYR_of_not_lt y' ρ (lt_irrefl ρ)
    exact (ringEquiv_symm_mul_eq_of_compat E π _ _ hEc' (y' (σ i)) (y' ρ) hv
      (chartYR_mul_algebraMap y' ρ hi)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_shiftCoords_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem exists_shiftCoords_chartOrigin {j : Fin n} (hj : n - kk ≤ j.val)
    (hF : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal a' = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j)})
    (hne : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j) ≠ 0) (p : Fin n) (hp : n - kk ≤ p.val) :
    ∃ z' : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a'),
      (span (Set.range z') = maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) ∧
        (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a'))) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j → z' i = z i) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → ∃ α : X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a'),
        z' i = z i - α * z j) ∧
      Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z a') = span (z' '' {i | n - kk ≤ i.val}) ∧
      ((p = j ∨ ∀ y : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a',
        (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z p) = y * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j) →
          y ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')) → z' p = z p) ∧
      ∃ w' : Fin n → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a',
        (span (Set.range w') = maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a') ∧
          (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j → w' i = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z' i)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → i ≠ j →
          (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z' i) = w' i * w' j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hex : ∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → ∃ y : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a',
      (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i) = y * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j) := by
    intro i hi
    have hmem : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i) ∈ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal a' := by
      rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap, hZa]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    rw [hF] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
    exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩
  choose! yy hyy using hex
  set w : Fin n → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a' := fun i =>
    if i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j then (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i) else yy i with hw_def
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j → w i = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i) :=
    fun i hi => ite_eq_left hi
  have hw' : ∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → i ≠ j →
      (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z i) = w i * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j) := by
    intro i h1 h2
    have : w i = yy i := ite_eq_right (by omega)
    rw [this]
    exact hyy i h1
  
  have hσ1 := lt_kollarReindex_iff hk hkn j hj
  have hσ2 := kollarReindex_apply_self hk hkn j
  have hρ1 := kollarIdx_val hk hkn
  generalize kollarReindex hk hkn j = σ at hσ1 hσ2
  generalize kollarIdx hk hkn = ρ at hσ2 hρ1
  have hyσ : ∀ i, (z ∘ σ.symm) (σ i) = z i :=
    fun i => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hyρ : (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ = z j := by rw [← hσ2, hyσ]
  have hyspan : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) =
      span (Set.range (z ∘ σ.symm)) := by
    rw [← hz.1, Set.range_comp, Equiv.range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ]
  have hZ' : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z a') = span ((z ∘ σ.symm) '' {i | i.val < kk}) := by
    rw [hZa, ← image_eq_of_lt_iff σ hσ1, Set.image_image]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hregR : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f _
  
  obtain ⟨𝔮, h𝔮, e, hcomap, hcompat, hE⟩ :=
    exists_chartRing_model Z a' hk hZa hF hne σ hσ1 ρ hρ1 hσ2 w hw hw'
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) := IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e
  
  have hle : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) ≤ 𝔮.comap (algebraMap _ _) :=
    hcomap.ge
  have hrat' := bijective_quotientMap_of_residueField ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a').hom hrat 𝔮 e
    hcompat hle
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ :=
    exists_eq_chartOriginAt (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ hyspan hz.2 𝔮 hle hrat'
  
  have hσp : n - kk ≤ p.val := hp
  have hlift : ∃ β : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a'),
      𝔮 = chartOriginAt (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ β ∧
        ((p = j ∨ ∀ y : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a',
          (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z p) = y * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j) →
            y ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')) → p ≠ j → β (σ p) = 0) := by
    by_cases hV : p = j ∨ ∀ y : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a',
        (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z p) = y * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j) →
          y ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')
    swap
    · exact ⟨α, hα, fun h => (hV h).elim⟩
    rcases hV with hpj | hpy
    · exact ⟨α, hα, fun _ h => (h hpj).elim⟩
    · by_cases hpj : p = j
      · exact ⟨α, hα, fun _ h => (h hpj).elim⟩
      · 
        have hwp : w p ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a') := hpy (w p) (hw' p hp hpj)
        have hlt : σ p < ρ := by
          have h1 := (hσ1 p).mpr hp
          have h2 : σ p ≠ ρ := fun h => hpj (σ.injective (h.trans hσ2.symm))
          rw [Fin.lt_def]
          have h3 := Fin.val_ne_of_ne h2
          omega
        have hmem : chartYR (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ (σ p) ∈ 𝔮 := by
          rw [← map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv e, Ideal.map_symm, Ideal.mem_comap, hE p] at hwp
          exact (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) 𝔮 _).mp
            hwp
        have hgen : chartYR (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ (σ p) -
            algebraMap _ (chartRing (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ) (α (σ p)) ∈ 𝔮 := by
          rw [hα]
          exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨σ p, by simp only [ite_eq_left hlt]⟩
        have hαp : α (σ p) ∈ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) := by
          rw [← hcomap, Ideal.mem_comap]
          have := 𝔮.sub_mem hmem hgen
          rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this
        refine ⟨Function.update α (σ p) 0, ?_, fun _ _ => Function.update_self _ _ _⟩
        rw [hα]
        refine chartOriginAt_eq_of_sub_mem (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ hyspan hz.2 α _ fun i => ?_
        by_cases hi : i = σ p
        · subst hi
          rw [Function.update_self, sub_zero]
          exact hαp
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi, sub_self]
          exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨β, hβ, hβp⟩ := hlift
  clear hα α
  subst hβ
  
  set y' : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a') := shiftCoords (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ β with hy'
  have hy'span : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) = span (Set.range y') :=
    span_range_shiftCoords (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ β hyspan
  have hy'lt : ∀ i, i < ρ → y' i = (z ∘ σ.symm) i - β i * (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ := fun i hi =>
    shiftCoords_of_lt _ _ _ hi
  have hy'ge : ∀ i, ¬ i < ρ → y' i = (z ∘ σ.symm) i := fun i hi => shiftCoords_of_not_lt _ _ _ hi
  have hprime : (chartOrigin y' ρ).IsPrime := (chartOrigin_isMaximal y' ρ hy'span hz.2).isPrime
  let L := localizationEquivShift (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ β
  let E : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a' ≃+* Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ) :=
    e.trans L.symm
  have hEc : ∀ c, E ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' c) =
      algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime (chartOrigin y' ρ)) c :=
    ringEquiv_trans_symm_compat e L ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a').hom _ _ _ hcompat
      (fun c => (localizationEquivShift_algebraMap_R (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ β c).trans
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply _ (chartRing (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ) _ c))
  
  have hlt_of : ∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → i ≠ j → σ i < ρ := by
    intro i h1 h2
    have h3 := (hσ1 i).mpr h1
    have h4 : σ i ≠ ρ := fun h => h2 (σ.injective (h.trans hσ2.symm))
    rw [Fin.lt_def]
    have h5 := Fin.val_ne_of_ne h4
    omega
  have hnlt_of : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j → ¬ σ i < ρ := by
    intro i hi
    rcases hi with hi | rfl
    · intro hlt
      have h1 := (hσ1 i).mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (by omega))
      omega
    · rw [hσ2]
      exact lt_irrefl _
  
  refine ⟨fun i => y' (σ i), ⟨?_, hz.2⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change span (Set.range (y' ∘ σ)) = _
    rw [Set.range_comp, Equiv.range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ, ← hy'span]
  · intro i hi
    change y' (σ i) = z i
    rw [hy'ge _ (hnlt_of i hi), hyσ]
  · intro i hi
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      change y' (σ i) = z i - 0 * z j
      rw [hy'ge _ (hnlt_of i (Or.inr hij)), hyσ, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    · refine ⟨β (σ i), ?_⟩
      change y' (σ i) = z i - β (σ i) * z j
      rw [hy'lt _ (hlt_of i hi hij), hyσ, hyρ]
  · 
    have hset : {i : Fin n | i ≤ ρ} = {i | i.val < kk} := by
      ext i
      change i.val ≤ ρ.val ↔ i.val < kk
      omega
    have h1 : (fun i => y' (σ i)) '' {i : Fin n | n - kk ≤ i.val} = y' '' {i | i.val < kk} := by
      rw [← image_eq_of_lt_iff σ hσ1, Set.image_image]
    have hcc := chartCenter_shiftCoords (z ∘ σ.symm) ρ β
    rw [chartCenter, chartCenter, hset] at hcc
    rw [h1, hZ']
    exact hcc.symm
  · 
    intro hV
    change y' (σ p) = z p
    by_cases hpj : p = j
    · rw [hy'ge _ (hnlt_of p (Or.inr hpj)), hyσ]
    · rw [hy'lt _ (hlt_of p hp hpj), hyσ, hyρ, hβp hV hpj, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  · 
    let _ := f.stalkAlgebra (blowUpπ Z a')
    obtain ⟨D', hD'⟩ := exists_derivation_dual f (blowUpπ Z a') y' hy'span hz.2
    obtain ⟨w', hw'r, hw'1, hw'2⟩ := exists_induced_of_equiv_chartOrigin y' ρ D' hD'
      E ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a').hom hEc σ
    have hσj' : σ.symm ρ = j := by rw [← hσ2, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    refine ⟨w', hw'r, fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi hij => ?_⟩
    · exact hw'1 i (hnlt_of i hi)
    · have := hw'2 i (hlt_of i hi hij)
      rwa [hσj'] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_coordinates_chartOrigin'
statement:
theorem exists_coordinates_chartOrigin' {j : Fin n} (hj : n - kk ≤ j.val)
    (hF : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal a' = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j)})
    (hne : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j) ≠ 0) {IV : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a'))}
    (p : Fin n) (hp : p.val = n - kk) (hV : IV = span {z p}) (P : Prop) (hP : P → j ≠ p)
    (hPy : ∀ y : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a',
      (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z p) = y * (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z j) →
        (y ∈ maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a') ↔ P)) :
    ∃ (z'' : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) (j' : Fin n),
      (span (Set.range z'') = maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a')) ∧
        (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z a'))) ∧
      IV = span {z'' p} ∧
      Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z a') = span (z'' '' {i | n - kk ≤ i.val}) ∧
      n - kk ≤ j'.val ∧ (P → j'.val = n - 1) ∧ (¬ P → j'.val = n - kk) ∧
      (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal a' = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z'' j')} ∧
      ∃ w'' : Fin n → (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a',
        (span (Set.range w'') = maximalIdeal ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a') ∧
          (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim ((blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk a')) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk ∨ i = j' → w'' i = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z'' i)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → i ≠ j' →
          (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z'' i) = w'' i * w'' j')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpk : n - kk ≤ p.val := hp.ge
  by_cases hPc : P
  · 
    have hjp : j ≠ p := hP hPc
    obtain ⟨z', hz', hz'1, -, hz'Z, hz'p', w', hw'r, hw'1, hw'2⟩ :=
      exists_shiftCoords_chartOrigin f Z a' hk hkn hz hZa hrat hj hF hne p hpk
    have hz'p : z' p = z p := hz'p' (Or.inr fun y hy => (hPy y hy).mpr hPc)
    have hn1 : n - 1 < n := by have := j.2; omega
    set τ : Fin n ≃ Fin n := Equiv.swap j ⟨n - 1, hn1⟩ with hτ
    have hpn : p ≠ ⟨n - 1, hn1⟩ := by
      intro h
      have h1 := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp only at h1
      have h2 := j.2
      have h3 : j.val = p.val := by omega
      exact hjp (Fin.ext h3)
    have hτp : τ p = p := Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hjp.symm hpn
    have hτj : τ j = ⟨n - 1, hn1⟩ := Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _
    have hτn : τ ⟨n - 1, hn1⟩ = j := Equiv.swap_apply_right _ _
    have hτlow : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - kk → τ i = i := by
      intro i hi
      refine Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne ?_ ?_
      · intro h; subst h; omega
      · intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp only at this; omega
    have hτge : ∀ i : Fin n, n - kk ≤ i.val → n - kk ≤ (τ i).val := by
      intro i hi
      rw [hτ, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
      split_ifs <;> first | exact hj | exact hi | (change n - kk ≤ n - 1; omega)
    have hτimage : τ '' {i : Fin n | n - kk ≤ i.val} = {i | n - kk ≤ i.val} := by
      ext i
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩
        exact hτge i' hi'
      · intro hi
        refine ⟨τ.symm i, ?_, Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
        have : τ.symm i = τ i := by rw [hτ, Equiv.symm_swap]
        change n - kk ≤ (τ.symm i).val
        rw [this]
        exact hτge i hi
    refine ⟨fun i => z' (τ i), ⟨n - 1, hn1⟩, ⟨?_, hz'.2⟩, ?_, ?_, show n - kk ≤ n - 1 by omega,
      fun _ => rfl, fun h => (h hPc).elim, ?_, fun i => w' (τ i), ⟨?_, hw'r.2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change span (Set.range (z' ∘ τ)) = _
      rw [Set.range_comp, Equiv.range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ, hz'.1]
    · change IV = span {z' (τ p)}
      rw [hτp, hz'p, hV]
    · rw [← Set.image_image, hτimage, hz'Z]
    · change _ = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z' (τ ⟨n - 1, hn1⟩))}
      rw [hτn, hz'1 j (Or.inr rfl)]
      exact hF
    · change span (Set.range (w' ∘ τ)) = _
      rw [Set.range_comp, Equiv.range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ, hw'r.1]
    · intro i hi
      change w' (τ i) = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z' (τ i))
      rcases hi with hi | rfl
      · rw [hτlow i hi]
        exact hw'1 i (Or.inl hi)
      · rw [hτn]
        exact hw'1 j (Or.inr rfl)
    · intro i hi hin
      change (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z' (τ i)) = w' (τ i) * w' (τ ⟨n - 1, hn1⟩)
      rw [hτn]
      refine hw'2 (τ i) (hτge i hi) fun h => hin ?_
      exact (Equiv.swap_apply_self _ _ i).symm.trans ((congrArg τ h).trans hτj)
  · 
    have hmem : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z p) ∈ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal a' := by
      rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap, hZa]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨p, hpk, rfl⟩)
    rw [hF] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
    have hyu : IsUnit y := by
      by_contra hu
      exact hPc ((hPy y hy.symm).mp ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal y).mpr hu))
    have hFp : (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal a' = span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z p)} := by
      rw [hF, ← hy, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hyu]
    have hnep : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap a' (z p) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hne
      have := hy
      rw [h0] at this
      exact hyu.mul_right_eq_zero.mp this
    obtain ⟨z', hz', hz'1, -, hz'Z, hz'p', w', hw'r, hw'1, hw'2⟩ :=
      exists_shiftCoords_chartOrigin f Z a' hk hkn hz hZa hrat hpk hFp hnep p hpk
    have hz'p : z' p = z p := hz'p' (Or.inl rfl)
    refine ⟨z', p, hz', ?_, hz'Z, hpk, fun h => (hPc h).elim, fun _ => hp, ?_, w', hw'r, hw'1,
      hw'2⟩
    · rw [hz'p, hV]
    · rw [hz'p]
      exact hFp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.coe_centreFinset
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.hs_finset
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_centreFinset]
  exact hZa

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem stalkMap_ne_zero [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (E : DivisorFamily X)
    (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (a' : Z.blowUp)
    (ha' : a' ∈ Z.exceptionalDivisor.support) {n : ℕ}
    {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a')} {j : Fin n}
    (hF : Z.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span
      {Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)}) :
    Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  apply stalkIdeal_comap_π_ne_bot f E.component Z (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ) a' ha'
  rw [show (Z.comap (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span
      {Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)}
    from hF, h0, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_coordinates_hypersurface_center
statement:
theorem exists_coordinates_hypersurface_center (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)
    (hv : E.component v ≤ Z) (a : X) (ha : a ∈ Z.support) :
    ∃ (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk a),
      IsRegularSystemOfParameters z ∧
      (E.component v).stalkIdeal a = Ideal.span {z ⟨n - k, by omega⟩} ∧
      Z.stalkIdeal a = Ideal.span (z '' {i | n - k ≤ i.val})
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk a) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f a
  obtain ⟨n, z, hrs, ⟨c, hcinj, hc⟩, s, hs⟩ := hasSncWith_data E Z hZ a ha
  obtain ⟨kk, hk, hkn, z', hrs', -, hV, hZ'⟩ :=
    exists_hauser_coordinates E.component Z v hv ha hrs c hcinj hc s hs
  exact ⟨n, kk, hk, hkn, z', hrs', hV, hZ'⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_prod_stalkIdeal_pow_eq_span_monomial'
statement:
theorem exists_prod_stalkIdeal_pow_eq_span_monomial' (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (_hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)
    (_hv : E.component v ≤ Z) (a : X) (_ha : a ∈ Z.support) {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk a} (hz : E.IsSncAt a z)

    ∃ q : Fin n → ℕ, q ⟨n - k, by omega⟩ = 0 ∧
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· ≠ v), (E.component i).stalkIdeal a ^ m i =
        Ideal.span {∏ j, z j ^ q j}
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk a) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f a
  obtain ⟨hrs, c, hcinj, hc⟩ := hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_map_prod_stalkIdeal_pow_eq_span_monomial'
statement:
theorem exists_map_prod_stalkIdeal_pow_eq_span_monomial' (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (_hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)

          (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((E.component v).stalkIdeal a)) =

proof:
