name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chart_index'
statement:
theorem exists_chart_index' [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f] (E : DivisorFamily X)
    (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)
    (_hv : E.component v ≤ Z) (a' : Z.blowUp) (ha' : a' ∈
        Z.exceptionalDivisor.support)
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a')}
    (_hz : E.IsSncAt (Z.blowUpπ a') z)
    (hV : (E.component v).stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span {z ⟨n - k, by omega⟩})
    (hZa : Z.stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span (z '' {i | n - k ≤ i.val})) :
    ∃ j : Fin n, n - k ≤ j.val ∧
      Z.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span
        {Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)} ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, n - k ≤ i.val → ∃ y : Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a',
        Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z i) = y * Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)) ∧
      (a' ∈ ((E.component v).strictTransform Z).support → j.val ≠ n - k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hF, hy⟩ := exists_chart_index f E.component Z
    (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ) a' ha' (hs_finset Z a' hZa)
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
  refine ⟨j, hj.2, hF, fun i hi => hy i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hi⟩),
    fun hmem hjv => ?_⟩
  exact ne_of_mem_support_strictTransformAlong E.component Z a' hV hF hmem (Fin.ext hjv)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_maximalIdeal_iff_mem_support_strictTransform
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_iff_mem_support_strictTransform [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)
    (_hv : E.component v ≤ Z) (a' : Z.blowUp)
        (ha' : a' ∈ Z.exceptionalDivisor.support)
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a')}
    (hz : E.IsSncAt (Z.blowUpπ a') z)
    (_hV : (E.component v).stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span {z ⟨n - k, by omega⟩})
    (hZa : Z.stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span (z '' {i | n - k ≤ i.val}))
        {j : Fin n}
    (_hj : n - k ≤ j.val)
    (hF : Z.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span
      {Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)})
    {i : E.ι} {c : Fin n}
    (hc : (E.component i).stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span {z c})
        (hcs : n - k ≤ c.val)
    (_hcj : c ≠ j) {y : Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a'}
    (hy : Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z c) = y * Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)) :
    y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a') ↔
      a' ∈ ((E.component i).strictTransform Z).support
proof:
:=
  mem_maximalIdeal_iff_mem_support_strictTransformAlong f E.component Z (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ)
    a' ha' hz.1 (hs_finset Z a' hZa) hc (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hcs⟩) hF hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_induced'
statement:
theorem exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_induced' [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)
    (_hv : E.component v ≤ Z) (a' : Z.blowUp)
        (ha' : a' ∈ Z.exceptionalDivisor.support)
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a')}
    (hz : E.IsSncAt (Z.blowUpπ a') z)
    (_hV : (E.component v).stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span {z ⟨n - k, by omega⟩})
    (hZa : Z.stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span (z '' {i | n - k ≤ i.val}))
        {j : Fin n}
    (hj : n - k ≤ j.val)
    (hF : Z.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span
      {Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)})
    (w : Fin n → Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a')
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - k ∨ i = j → w i = Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z i))
    (hw' : ∀ i : Fin n, n - k ≤ i.val → i ≠ j →
      Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z i) = w i * Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (z' : Fin m → Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a'), IsRegularSystemOfParameters
        z' ∧
      ∃ σ :
          {i : Fin n // w i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a')} →
              Fin m,
        Function.Injective σ ∧ ∀ i, z' (σ i) = w i.1
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a') :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk_blowUp' f E.component Z (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ) a'
  exact exists_isRegularSystemOfParameters_induced f Z a' hk hkn hz.1 hZa hj hF
    (stalkMap_ne_zero f E Z hZ a' ha' hF) w hw hw'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_strictTransform_hypersurface
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_strictTransform_hypersurface [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f]
    (E : DivisorFamily X) (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)
    (_hv : E.component v ≤ Z) (a' : Z.blowUp)
        (ha' : a' ∈ Z.exceptionalDivisor.support)
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a')}
    (hz : E.IsSncAt (Z.blowUpπ a') z)
    (hV : (E.component v).stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span {z ⟨n - k, by omega⟩})
    (hZa : Z.stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span (z '' {i | n - k ≤ i.val}))
        {j : Fin n}
    (_hj : n - k ≤ j.val)
    (hF : Z.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span
      {Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)})
    (_hjV : j.val ≠ n - k) {y : Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a'}
    (hy : Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z ⟨n - k,
        by omega⟩) = y * Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)) :
    ((E.component v).strictTransform Z).stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span {y}
proof:
:=
  stalkIdeal_strictTransformAlong_eq_span_of_eq_mul f E.component Z (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ) a'
    ha' hz.1 (hs_finset Z a' hZa) hV (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, le_rfl⟩) hF hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_shiftCoords_chartOrigin'
statement:
theorem exists_shiftCoords_chartOrigin' [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f] (E : DivisorFamily X)
    (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (_hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)
    (_hv : E.component v ≤ Z) (a' : Z.blowUp) (ha' : a' ∈
        Z.exceptionalDivisor.support)
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) {z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a')}
    (hz : E.IsSncAt (Z.blowUpπ a') z)
    (hV : (E.component v).stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span {z ⟨n - k, by omega⟩})
    (hZa : Z.stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span (z '' {i | n - k ≤ i.val}))
        {j : Fin n}
    (hj : n - k ≤ j.val)
    (hF : Z.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span
      {Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)})
    (hrat : IsIso (Z.blowUpπ.residueFieldMap a')) :
    ∃ z' : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a'),
      IsRegularSystemOfParameters z' ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - k ∨ i = j → z' i = z i) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, n - k ≤ i.val → ∃ α : X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a'),
        z' i = z i - α * z j) ∧
      Z.stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span (z' '' {i | n - k ≤ i.val}) ∧
      (a' ∈ ((E.component v).strictTransform Z).support →
        z' ⟨n - k, by omega⟩ = z ⟨n - k, by omega⟩) ∧
      ∃ w' : Fin n → Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a', IsRegularSystemOfParameters w' ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - k ∨ i = j → w' i = Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z' i)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, n - k ≤ i.val → i ≠ j →
          Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z' i) = w' i * w' j)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a') :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk_blowUp' f E.component Z (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ) a'
  obtain ⟨z', hz', h1, h2, h3, h4, w', hw'⟩ := exists_shiftCoords_chartOrigin f Z a'
    hk hkn hz.1 hZa (bijective_of_isIso_residueFieldMap Z a' hrat) hj hF
    (stalkMap_ne_zero f E Z hZ a' ha' hF) ⟨n - k, by omega⟩ le_rfl
  refine ⟨z', hz', h1, h2, h3, fun hmem => h4 ?_, w', hw'⟩
  by_cases hpj : (⟨n - k, by omega⟩ : Fin n) = j
  · exact Or.inl hpj
  · exact Or.inr fun y hy => (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_mem_support_strictTransformAlong f E.component
      Z (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ) a' ha' hz.1 (hs_finset Z a' hZa) hV
      (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, le_rfl⟩) hF hy).mpr hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_coordinates_chartOrigin
statement:
theorem exists_coordinates_chartOrigin [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [Smooth f] (E : DivisorFamily X)
    (Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hE : E.IsSnc) (hZ : E.HasSncWith Z) (v : E.ι)
    (hv : E.component v ≤ Z) (a' : Z.blowUp) (ha' : a' ∈
        Z.exceptionalDivisor.support)
    (hrat : IsIso (Z.blowUpπ.residueFieldMap a')) :
    ∃ (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk (Z.blowUpπ a'))
      (j : Fin n),
      IsRegularSystemOfParameters z ∧
      (E.component v).stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span {z ⟨n - k, by omega⟩} ∧
      Z.stalkIdeal (Z.blowUpπ a') = Ideal.span (z '' {i | n - k ≤ i.val}) ∧
      n - k ≤ j.val ∧
      (a' ∈ ((E.component v).strictTransform Z).support → j.val = n - 1) ∧
      (a' ∉ ((E.component v).strictTransform Z).support → j.val = n - k) ∧
      Z.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal a' = Ideal.span
        {Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j)} ∧
      ∃ w : Fin n → Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a', IsRegularSystemOfParameters w ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - k ∨ i = j → w i = Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z i)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, n - k ≤ i.val → i ≠ j →
          Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z i) = w i * w j)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : Z.blowUpπ a' ∈ Z.support := (mem_support_comap_iff' Z
      (IdealSheafData.blowUpπ Z) a').mp ha'
  obtain ⟨n, kk, hk, hkn, z, hz, hV, hZa⟩ :=
    exists_sncAt_coordinates_hypersurface_center f E Z hE hZ v hv (Z.blowUpπ a') ha
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hF, -, hjV⟩ := exists_chart_index' f E Z hE hZ v hv a' ha' hk hkn hz hV hZa
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a') :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk_blowUp' f E.component Z (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ) a'
  have hne := stalkMap_ne_zero f E Z hZ a' ha' hF
  have hPy : ∀ y : Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a',
      Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z ⟨n - kk,
          by omega⟩) = y * Z.blowUpπ.stalkMap a' (z j) →
        (y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.blowUp.presheaf.stalk a') ↔
          a' ∈ ((E.component v).strictTransform Z).support) := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hpj : (⟨n - kk, by omega⟩ : Fin n) = j
    · 
      have h1 : y = 1 := by
        rw [hpj] at hy
        exact mul_right_cancel₀ hne (hy.symm.trans (one_mul _).symm)
      subst h1
      have hnot : a' ∉ ((E.component v).strictTransform Z).support :=
        notMem_support_strictTransformAlong_of_stalkIdeal_eq Z (E.component v) a' hV (hpj ▸ hF)
      exact ⟨fun h => absurd isUnit_one ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp h),
        fun h => (hnot h).elim⟩
    · exact mem_maximalIdeal_iff_mem_support_strictTransformAlong f E.component Z
        (hasSncWith_data E Z hZ) a' ha' hz.1 (hs_finset Z a' hZa) hV
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, le_rfl⟩) hF hy
  obtain ⟨z'', j', hz'', hV'', hZ'', hj', hP1, hP2, hF'', w'', hw''⟩ :=
    exists_coordinates_chartOrigin' f Z a' hk hkn hz.1 hZa
      (bijective_of_isIso_residueFieldMap Z a' hrat) hj hF hne ⟨n - kk, by omega⟩ rfl hV
      (a' ∈ ((E.component v).strictTransform Z).support)
      (fun hmem h => hjV hmem (congrArg Fin.val h)) hPy
  exact ⟨n, kk, hk, hkn, z'', j', hz'', hV'', hZ'', hj', hP1, hP2, hF'', w'', hw''⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSmoothDivisor_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem isSmoothDivisor_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (hn : 1 ≤ n) (D : X.IdealSheafData)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension (n - 1) (D.subschemeι ≫ f)] : IsSmoothDivisor D
proof:
:= by
  have hsX : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  have hsD : Smooth (D.subschemeι ≫ f) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth (n - 1) _
  refine ⟨⟨fun z => isRegularLocalRing_stalk (D.subschemeι ≫ f) z⟩, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, y, hm, hspan, hI⟩ := exists_adaptedParameters D f n 1 hn hx
  have := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_stalkIdeal D f hx
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ D.stalkIdeal x)
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_quotient_stalkIdeal_add D f n 1 hn hx
  rw [hq, ← hm] at hdim
  have hqm : q + 1 = m := by exact_mod_cast hdim
  have h0 : 0 < m := by omega
  have himg : y '' {j : Fin m | j.val < 1} = {y ⟨0, h0⟩} := by
    ext a
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      congr 1
      exact Fin.ext (Nat.lt_one_iff.mp hj)
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨⟨0, h0⟩, Nat.zero_lt_one, rfl⟩
  rw [himg] at hI
  have := isRegularLocalRing_stalk f x
  exact ⟨y ⟨0, h0⟩, x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq y hspan _,
    notMem_sq_of_span_eq y hspan hm _, hI⟩

name: TopologicalSpace.Closeds.genericPoints_finite
statement:
theorem genericPoints_finite [T0Space Y] [QuasiSober Y] [NoetherianSpace Y] (Z : Closeds Y) :
    Z.genericPoints.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSf, hScl, hSirr, hZS⟩ :=
    NoetherianSpace.exists_finite_set_isClosed_irreducible Z.isClosed
  have hsub : Z.genericPoints ⊆ ⋃ t ∈ S, {η | IsGenericPoint η t} := by
    intro η hη
    have hηZ : η ∈ (Z : Set Y) := hη.1
    rw [hZS] at hηZ
    obtain ⟨t, htS, hηt⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hηZ
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨t, htS, ?_⟩
    have hmax := (Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff Z η).mp hη
    have h1 : closure {η} ⊆ t :=
      (hScl t htS).closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hηt)
    have htZ : t ⊆ (Z : Set Y) := by
      rw [hZS]
      exact Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem htS
    have h2 : t ⊆ closure {η} := hmax.2 ⟨htZ, hSirr t htS⟩ h1
    exact isGenericPoint_def.mpr (le_antisymm h1 h2)
  refine (hSf.biUnion fun t _ => ?_).subset hsub
  exact Set.Subsingleton.finite fun a ha b hb => ha.eq hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv {S' : Type w} [CommRing S'] [IsLocalRing S'] (e : S ≃+* S') :
    (maximalIdeal S').map e.symm = maximalIdeal S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_symm]
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal
    (Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective e e.surjective (K := maximalIdeal S'))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.TotalTransformData.of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem TotalTransformData.of_ringEquiv {S' : Type w} [CommRing S'] [IsLocalRing S']
    (e : S ≃+* S') {F : Ideal S} {T : ι → Ideal S} {F' : Ideal S'} {T' : ι → Ideal S'}
    (hF : F.map e = F') (hT : ∀ i, (T i).map e = T' i)
    (h : TotalTransformData F' T') : TotalTransformData F T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hreg, m, z', ⟨hspan, hdim⟩, j, a, hF', hinj, hshape⟩ := h
  have hback : ∀ (I : Ideal S) (I' : Ideal S'), I.map e = I' → I = I'.map e.symm := by
    intro I I' hI
    rw [Ideal.map_symm, ← hI, Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ e.bijective]
  have hspan' : ∀ b : S', (span {b}).map e.symm = span {e.symm b} := fun b => by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  refine ⟨IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e.symm, m, e.symm ∘ z', ⟨?_, ?_⟩, j, a, ?_, hinj, ?_⟩
  · rw [Set.range_comp, ← Ideal.map_span, hspan, map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv e]
  · rw [hdim]
    exact ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e.symm
  · rw [hback F F' hF, hF', hspan']
    rfl
  · intro i
    rw [hback (T i) (T' i) (hT i)]
    rcases hshape i with ⟨hne, hi | hi⟩ | hi | hi
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hne, Or.inl (by rw [hi, hspan', map_mul]; rfl)⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hne, Or.inr (by rw [hi, hspan']; rfl)⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by rw [hi, hspan']; rfl))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [hi, Ideal.map_top]))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.notMem_span_singleton_of_ne
statement: theorem notMem_span_singleton_of_ne {a j : Fin m} (haj : a ≠ j) : z j ∉ span {z a}
proof:
:= by
  have h := notMem_span_image_of_notMem hz.symm hn (s := {a}) (j := j)
    (by simpa using fun h => haj h.symm)
  rwa [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_mul
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_mul {a j : Fin m} (haj : a ≠ j) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, (span {z a * z j}).colon (↑(span {z j} ^ k) : Set R)) = span {z a}
proof:
:= by
  have hprime := isPrime_span_singleton_of_parameters hz.symm hn a
  have hnot := notMem_span_singleton_of_ne hz hn haj
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun k => fun r hr => ?_) (le_iSup_of_le 1 fun r hr => ?_)
  · rw [Submodule.mem_colon] at hr
    have h := hr (z j ^ k) (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (mem_span_singleton_self (z j)) k)
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mem_span_singleton] at h
    rw [mem_span_singleton]
    have h1 : z a ∣ r * z j ^ k := (dvd_mul_right (z a) (z j)).trans h
    rcases (hprime.mem_or_mem (mem_span_singleton.mpr h1)) with h2 | h2
    · exact mem_span_singleton.mp h2
    · exact absurd (hprime.mem_of_pow_mem k h2) hnot
  · rw [Submodule.mem_colon]
    intro s hs
    rw [pow_one, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_span_singleton] at hs
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hs
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mem_span_singleton]
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := mem_span_singleton.mp hr
    exact ⟨u * t, by ring⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_of_ne
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_of_ne {a j : Fin m} (haj : a ≠ j) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, (span {z a}).colon (↑(span {z j} ^ k) : Set R)) = span {z a}
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ k : ℕ, (span {z a}).colon (↑(span {z j} ^ k) : Set R) = span {z a} := fun k =>
    Ideal.colon_pow_eq_self_of_isPrime (isPrime_span_singleton_of_parameters hz.symm hn a)
      (fun h => notMem_span_singleton_of_ne hz hn haj (h (mem_span_singleton_self _))) k
  exact le_antisymm (iSup_le fun k => (h k).le) (le_iSup_of_le 0 (h 0).ge)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_self
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_self (g : R) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, (span {g} : Ideal R).colon (↑(span {g} ^ k) : Set R)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_le_iff.mp (le_iSup_of_le 1 (by rw [pow_one, Ideal.colon_coe_self]))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.iSup_colon_pow_top
statement:
theorem iSup_colon_pow_top (J : Ideal R) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, (⊤ : Ideal R).colon (↑(J ^ k) : Set R)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_le_iff.mp (le_iSup_of_le 0 fun _ _ => Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun _ _ => trivial)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.TotalTransformData.iSup_colon_eq
statement:
theorem TotalTransformData.iSup_colon_eq (h : TotalTransformData F T) :
    IsRegularLocalRing S ∧ ∃ (m : ℕ) (z : Fin m → S),
      (span (Set.range z) = maximalIdeal S ∧ (m : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim S) ∧
      ∃ (j : Fin m) (a : ι → Fin m), F = span {z j} ∧
        (∀ i i', a i ≠ j → a i' ≠ j → a i = a i' → i = i') ∧
        ∀ i, (a i ≠ j ∧ (⨆ k : ℕ, (T i).colon (↑(F ^ k) : Set S)) = span {z (a i)}) ∨
          (⨆ k : ℕ, (T i).colon (↑(F ^ k) : Set S)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hreg, m, z, ⟨hspan, hdim⟩, j, a, hF, hinj, hshape⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hreg, m, z, ⟨hspan, hdim⟩, j, a, hF, hinj, fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [hF]
  rcases hshape i with ⟨hne, hi | hi⟩ | hi | hi
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hne, by rw [hi]; exact iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_mul hspan hdim hne⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hne, by rw [hi]; exact iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_of_ne hspan hdim hne⟩
  · exact Or.inr (by rw [hi]; exact iSup_colon_pow_span_singleton_self (z j))
  · exact Or.inr (by rw [hi]; exact iSup_colon_pow_top _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasSncWith_comap_of_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem hasSncWith_comap_of_isClosedImmersion (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion g]
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) {E : DivisorFamily X}
    {Z : X.IdealSheafData} (hZ : (E.append g.ker).HasSncWith Z) (hle : g.ker ≤ Z) :
    (E.comap g).HasSncWith (Z.comap g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y hy
  have hx : g y ∈ Z.support := by rwa [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap] at hy
  have := hreg (g y)
  obtain ⟨n, z, ⟨⟨hzspan, hzdim⟩, c, hcinj, hc⟩, s, hs⟩ := hZ (g y) hx
  have hxH : g y ∈ ((E.append g.ker).component (toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))).support :=
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_antitone hle hx
  set h0 : Fin n := c ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), hxH⟩ with hh0
  have hker : g.ker.stalkIdeal (g y) = span {z h0} := hc ⟨toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), hxH⟩
  
  set φ : X.presheaf.stalk (g y) →+* Y.presheaf.stalk y := (g.stalkMap y).hom with hφdef
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := g.stalkMap_surjective y
  have hkerφ : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑({h0} : Finset (Fin n))) := by
    rw [hφdef, ker_stalkMap_of_isClosedImmersion, hker, Finset.coe_singleton,
      Set.image_singleton]
  
  set z' : Fin ({h0} : Finset (Fin n))ᶜ.card → Y.presheaf.stalk y :=
    φ ∘ z ∘ ({h0} : Finset (Fin n))ᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl with hz'
  have hz'span : span (Set.range z') = maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    span_range_comp_compl_eq_maximalIdeal hzspan.symm hφ hkerφ
  have hz'dim : ((({h0} : Finset (Fin n))ᶜ.card : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ringKrullDim (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := by
    rw [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact natCast_sub_card_eq_ringKrullDim_of_ker hzspan.symm hzdim hφ hkerφ
  
  have hEy : ∀ i : {i : E.ι // y ∈ ((E.comap g).component i).support},
      g y ∈ ((E.append g.ker).component (toLex (Sum.inl i.1))).support := fun i => by
    have hi := i.2
    rwa [show (E.comap g).component i.1 = (E.component i.1).comap g from rfl,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap] at hi
  have hno : ∀ i : {i : E.ι // y ∈ ((E.comap g).component i).support},
      c ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i.1), hEy i⟩ ∉ ({h0} : Finset (Fin n)) := fun i hmem => by
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton, hh0] at hmem
    exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (toLex.injective (congrArg Subtype.val (hcinj hmem)))
  refine ⟨_, z', ⟨⟨hz'span, hz'dim⟩, fun i => complIndex (hno i), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro i i' hii'
    have h' := congrArg (({h0} : Finset (Fin n))ᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl) hii'
    simp only [orderEmbOfFin_complIndex] at h'
    exact Subtype.ext (Sum.inl_injective (toLex.injective (congrArg Subtype.val (hcinj h'))))
  · change ((E.component i.1).comap g).stalkIdeal y = span {z' (complIndex (hno i))}
    have hci : (E.component i.1).stalkIdeal (g y) = span {z (c ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i.1), hEy i⟩)} :=
      hc ⟨toLex (Sum.inl i.1), hEy i⟩
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap, hci, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hz']
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, orderEmbOfFin_complIndex]
    rfl
  · 
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.filter fun j' => ({h0} : Finset (Fin n))ᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl j' ∈ s, ?_⟩
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap, hs, Ideal.map_span]
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine span_le.mpr ?_
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      by_cases hjh : j = h0
      · have hz0 : φ (z j) = 0 := by
          rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hkerφ]
          exact subset_span ⟨j, by simp [hjh], rfl⟩
        change φ (z j) ∈ _
        rw [hz0]
        exact zero_mem _
      · have hjc : j ∉ ({h0} : Finset (Fin n)) := by simpa using hjh
        refine subset_span ⟨complIndex hjc, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter]
          exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by rw [orderEmbOfFin_complIndex]; exact hj⟩
        · simp only [hz', Function.comp_apply, orderEmbOfFin_complIndex]
          rfl
    · refine span_le.mpr ?_
      rintro _ ⟨j', hj', rfl⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hj'
      exact subset_span ⟨z (({h0} : Finset (Fin n))ᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl j'), ⟨_, hj'.2, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSnc_append_empty_of_isSmoothDivisor
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hidx : ∀ (x : X) (i : {i : ((DivisorFamily.empty X).append H).ι //
      x ∈ (((DivisorFamily.empty X).append H).component i).support}),
      i.1 = toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) := by
    intro x i
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := toLex.surjective i.1
    rcases a with e | u
    · exact e.elim
    · cases u
      exact ha.symm
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toLex.surjective i
    rcases a with e | u
    · exact e.elim
    · exact hH.1
  · have := hreg x
    obtain ⟨d, w, hw, hd⟩ := exists_regularSystem (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    by_cases hx : x ∈ H.support
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, ha2, hHx⟩ := hH.2 x hx
      obtain ⟨z, ⟨i0, hi0⟩, hz⟩ :=
        exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_notMem_sq hd ha ha2
      refine ⟨d, z, ⟨hz.symm, hd⟩, fun _ => i0, fun i i' _ => Subtype.ext ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
      · rw [hidx x i, hidx x i']
      · rw [show i.1 = toLex (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) from hidx x i]
        change H.stalkIdeal x = span {z i0}
        rw [hHx, hi0]
    · refine ⟨d, w, ⟨hw.symm, hd⟩, fun i => (hx ?_).elim, fun i => (hx ?_).elim,
        fun i => (hx ?_).elim⟩
      all_goals
        have hi := i.2
        rw [hidx x i] at hi
        exact hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finsetPerm_injective
statement: theorem finsetPerm_injective (s : Finset (Fin n)) : Function.Injective (finsetPerm s)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply finSumFinEquiv.symm.injective
  rcases ha : finSumFinEquiv.symm a with a' | a' <;>
    rcases hb : finSumFinEquiv.symm b with b' | b' <;>
    simp only [finsetPerm, ha, hb, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hab
  · rw [(s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).injective hab]
  · exact absurd (hab ▸ s.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl a')
      (Finset.mem_compl.mp (sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl b'))
  · exact absurd (hab.symm ▸ s.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl b')
      (Finset.mem_compl.mp (sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl a'))
  · rw [(sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl).injective hab]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.card_add_card_compl_eq
statement: theorem card_add_card_compl_eq (s : Finset (Fin n)) : s.card + sᶜ.card = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_add_card_compl, Fintype.card_fin]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finsetEquiv_castAdd
statement:
theorem finsetEquiv_castAdd (s : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin s.card) :
    finsetEquiv s (Fin.castAdd sᶜ.card i) = s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i
proof:
:= by
  simp [finsetEquiv, finsetPerm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finsetEquiv_natAdd
statement:
theorem finsetEquiv_natAdd (s : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin sᶜ.card) :
    finsetEquiv s (Fin.natAdd s.card i) = sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl i
proof:
:= by
  simp [finsetEquiv, finsetPerm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finsetEquiv_image_lt
statement:
theorem finsetEquiv_image_lt (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    finsetEquiv s '' {j : Fin (s.card + sᶜ.card) | j.val < s.card} = ↑s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    have hj' : j.val < s.card := hj
    have : j = Fin.castAdd sᶜ.card ⟨j.val, hj'⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [this, finsetEquiv_castAdd]
    exact s.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl _
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : x ∈ Set.range (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl) := by
      rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]; exact hx
    exact ⟨Fin.castAdd sᶜ.card i, i.2, by rw [finsetEquiv_castAdd, hi]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finsetEquiv_natAdd_notMem
statement:
theorem finsetEquiv_natAdd_notMem (s : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin sᶜ.card) :
    finsetEquiv s (Fin.natAdd s.card i) ∉ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsetEquiv_natAdd]
  exact Finset.mem_compl.mp (sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.orderEmbOfFin_complIndex
statement:
theorem orderEmbOfFin_complIndex {s : Finset (Fin n)} {j : Fin n} (hj : j ∉ s) :
    sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl (complIndex hj) = j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.coe_orderIsoOfFin_apply, complIndex, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.image_finset_eq_image_lt
statement:
theorem image_finset_eq_image_lt {R : Type u} (z : Fin n → R) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    z '' ↑s = (z ∘ finsetEquiv s) '' {j : Fin (s.card + sᶜ.card) | j.val < s.card}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.image_comp, finsetEquiv_image_lt]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.natCast_card_add_card_compl
statement:
theorem natCast_card_add_card_compl (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (s : Finset (Fin n)) : ((s.card + sᶜ.card : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_add_card_compl_eq]; exact hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_image_insert
statement:
theorem span_image_insert (z : Fin n → R) (s : Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) :
    span (z '' ↑(insert j s)) = span (z '' ↑s) ⊔ span {z j}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.image_insert_eq, Ideal.span_insert, sup_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_range_comp_finsetEquiv
proof:
:= by
  rw [hz, (finsetEquiv s).surjective.range_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_finset
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_finset (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ span (z '' ↑s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_finset_eq_image_lt]
  exact isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_lt (z ∘ finsetEquiv s)
    (span_range_comp_finsetEquiv hz s) (natCast_card_add_card_compl hn s) s.card

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_finset
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_finset (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span (z '' ↑s)) + s.card = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_finset_eq_image_lt]
  exact ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_lt (z ∘ finsetEquiv s)
    (span_range_comp_finsetEquiv hz s) (natCast_card_add_card_compl hn s) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.natCast_sub_card_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient
statement:
theorem natCast_sub_card_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ((n - s.card : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span (z '' ↑s))
proof:
:= by
  have := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_finset hz hn s
  have h := ringKrullDim_quotient_span_image_finset hz hn s
  rw [← hn, ← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal] at h
  rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal]
  have h' : (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span (z '' ↑s))).spanFinrank + s.card : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ((n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_add]; exact h
  rw [← WithBot.coe_natCast, ← WithBot.coe_natCast, WithBot.coe_inj, Nat.cast_inj] at h'
  congr 1
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.notMem_sq_sup_span_image
statement:
theorem notMem_sq_sup_span_image (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {s : Finset (Fin n)} {j : Fin n} (hj : j ∉ s) :
    z j ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 ⊔ span (z '' ↑s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_basis_cotangentSpace_of_span_eq z hz hn
  have hzm : ∀ i, z i ∈ maximalIdeal R := x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq z hz
  rw [Submodule.mem_sup] at hmem
  obtain ⟨q, hq, w, hw, hqw⟩ := hmem
  rw [Set.image_eq_range] at hw
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp hw
  have hqm : q ∈ maximalIdeal R := Ideal.pow_le_self two_ne_zero hq
  
  have hid : (⟨z j, hzm j⟩ : maximalIdeal R) =
      ⟨q, hqm⟩ + ∑ l : (↑s : Set (Fin n)), c l • (⟨z l, hzm l⟩ : maximalIdeal R) := by
    ext
    simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hqw, hc]
  have h0 : (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨q, hqm⟩ = 0 := by
    rw [Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero]; exact hq
  
  have key : b j = ∑ l : (↑s : Set (Fin n)), residue R (c l) • b (l : Fin n) := by
    rw [hb j, hid, map_add, h0, zero_add, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.map_smul, hb (l : Fin n), ← ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul]
  have hmem' : b j ∈ Submodule.span (ResidueField R) (b '' ↑s) := by
    rw [key]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun l _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(l : Fin n), l.2, rfl⟩)
  exact b.linearIndependent.notMem_span_image hj hmem'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.notMem_span_image_of_notMem
statement:
theorem notMem_span_image_of_notMem (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) {s : Finset (Fin n)} {j : Fin n} (hj : j ∉ s) :
    z j ∉ span (z '' ↑s)
proof:
:= fun h =>
  notMem_sq_sup_span_image hz hn hj (Submodule.mem_sup_right h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_span_image_iff
statement:
theorem mem_span_image_iff (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (s : Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) :
    z j ∈ span (z '' ↑s) ↔ j ∈ s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by_contra fun hj => notMem_span_image_of_notMem hz hn hj h,
    fun h => subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem z (Finset.mem_coe.mpr h))⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_singleton_le_span_image_iff
statement:
theorem span_singleton_le_span_image_iff (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (s : Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) :
    span {z j} ≤ span (z '' ↑s) ↔ j ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, mem_span_image_iff hz hn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.apply_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem apply_eq_zero_of_mem (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑s)) {l : Fin n} (hl : l ∈ s) :
    φ (z l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hker]
  exact subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem z (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hl))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_range_comp_compl_eq_map
statement:
theorem span_range_comp_compl_eq_map (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑s)) :
    span (Set.range (φ ∘ z ∘ sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl)) = (span (Set.range z)).map φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  refine le_antisymm (span_mono ?_) (span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl l, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · rw [Function.comp_apply, apply_eq_zero_of_mem hker hi]
      exact zero_mem _
    · obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : i ∈ Set.range (sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl) := by
        rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]; exact Finset.mem_compl.mpr hi
      exact subset_span ⟨l, by simp [hl]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ker_mk_comp
statement:
theorem ker_mk_comp (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑s))
    (j : Fin n) :
    RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {φ (z j)})).comp φ) = span (z '' ↑(insert j s))
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : span {φ (z j)} = (span {z j}).map φ := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  rw [← RingHom.comap_ker, Ideal.mk_ker, span_image_insert, hmap,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective φ hφ, ← hker, sup_comm]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularLocalRing_of_ker_eq_span_image
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_of_ker_eq_span_image (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑s)) : IsRegularLocalRing S
proof:
:= by
  have := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_finset hz hn s
  rw [← hker] at this
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hφ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.natCast_sub_card_eq_ringKrullDim_of_ker
statement:
theorem natCast_sub_card_eq_ringKrullDim_of_ker (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑s)) :
    ((n - s.card : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hφ), hker]
  exact natCast_sub_card_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient hz hn s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_apply
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_apply
    (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑s)) (j : Fin n) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (S ⧸ span {φ (z j)})
proof:
:= by
  have := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_finset hz hn (insert j s)
  rw [← ker_mk_comp hφ hker j] at this
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective
    (f := (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {φ (z j)})).comp φ) (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp hφ))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.apply_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem apply_mem_maximalIdeal (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (j : Fin n) : φ (z j) ∈ maximalIdeal S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective φ hφ]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ (x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq z hz j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.apply_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq
statement:
theorem apply_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑s)) {j : Fin n} (hj : j ∉ s) :
    φ (z j) ∉ maximalIdeal S ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [← IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective φ hφ, ← Ideal.map_pow,
    Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective φ hφ] at h
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hEq⟩ := h
  have hsub : z j - a ∈ span (z '' ↑s) := by
    rw [← hker, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hEq, sub_self]
  apply notMem_sq_sup_span_image hz hn hj
  rw [show z j = a + (z j - a) by ring]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup ha hsub

name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_range_comp_compl_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem span_range_comp_compl_eq_maximalIdeal (hz : maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range z))
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (hker : RingHom.ker φ = span (z '' ↑s)) :
    span (Set.range (φ ∘ z ∘ sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl)) = maximalIdeal S
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_range_comp_compl_eq_map hker, ← hz, IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective φ hφ]

name: Derivation.coe_restrictSubalgebra_apply
statement:
theorem _root_.Derivation.coe_restrictSubalgebra_apply (D : Derivation k L L) (S : Subalgebra R L)
    (hS : ∀ a ∈ S, D a ∈ S) (a : S) : (D.restrictSubalgebra S hS a : L) = D a
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayDer_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayDer_algebraMap (i : Fin n) (a : R) :
    awayDer x r D i (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) a) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (D i a)
proof:
:=
  Derivation.localization_algebraMap _ _ a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartY_mul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartY_mul_algebraMap {j : Fin n} (hj : j < r) :
    chartY x r j * algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x j)
proof:
:= by
  change chartYOf x r (x r) j * _ = _
  rw [chartYOf_of_lt x r (x r) hj, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply]
  exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec _ (x j) ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers (x r)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isUnit_algebraMap_self
statement: theorem isUnit_algebraMap_self : IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r))
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away (x r)) ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers (x r)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.awayDer_chartY_mul
statement:
theorem awayDer_chartY_mul (i : Fin n) {j : Fin n} (hj : j < r) :
    awayDer x r D i (chartY x r j) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (D i (x j)) -
        chartY x r j * algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (D i (x r))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (awayDer x r D i) (chartY_mul_algebraMap x r hj)
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, awayDer_algebraMap, awayDer_algebraMap, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq' h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartDer_of_lt
statement:
theorem chartDer_of_lt {i : Fin n} (hi : i < r) :
    chartDer x r D i = algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x r) • awayDer x r D i
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartDer_self
statement:
theorem chartDer_self :
    chartDer x r D r = awayDer x r D r +
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < r), chartY x r l • awayDer x r D l
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartDer, ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl r), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartDer_of_gt
statement:
theorem chartDer_of_gt {i : Fin n} (hi : ¬ i < r) (hir : i ≠ r) :
    chartDer x r D i = awayDer x r D i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartDer, ite_eq_right hi, ite_eq_right hir]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartDer_chartY
statement:
theorem chartDer_chartY (i j : Fin n) :
    chartDer x r D i (chartY x r j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hu := isUnit_algebraMap_self x r
  by_cases hj : j < r
  · 
    have hL := awayDer_chartY_mul x r D i hj
    by_cases hi : i < r
    · rw [chartDer_of_lt x r D hi, Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, hL, hD, hD,
        ite_eq_right (ne_of_lt hi)]
      simp only [map_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    · by_cases hir : i = r
      · subst hir
        rw [chartDer_self, Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.finset_sum_apply,
          ite_eq_right (ne_of_gt hj)]
        refine hu.mul_left_cancel ?_
        rw [mul_zero, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm, hL, hD, hD, ite_eq_right (ne_of_gt hj),
          ite_eq_left rfl]
        have hsum : ∀ l ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < i),
            algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x i)) (x i) *
              (chartY x i l • awayDer x i D l) (chartY x i j) =
              if l = j then chartY x i j else 0 := by
          intro l hl
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hl
          rw [Derivation.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm,
            mul_comm (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x i)) (x i))
              (awayDer x i D l (chartY x i j)),
            awayDer_chartY_mul x i D l hj, hD, hD, ite_eq_right (ne_of_lt hl.2)]
          simp only [map_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero]
          split_ifs with h
          · subst h; simp
          · simp
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsum, Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ j, ite_eq_left (by simpa using hj)]
        simp
      · rw [chartDer_of_gt x r D hi hir, ite_eq_right (fun h : i = j => hi (h ▸ hj))]
        refine hu.mul_left_cancel ?_
        rw [mul_zero, mul_comm, hL, hD, hD, ite_eq_right hir,
          ite_eq_right (fun h : i = j => hi (h ▸ hj))]
        simp
  · 
    have hy : chartY x r j = algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) (x j) :=
      chartYOf_of_not_lt x r (x r) hj
    by_cases hi : i < r
    · rw [chartDer_of_lt x r D hi, Derivation.smul_apply, hy, awayDer_algebraMap, hD,
        ite_eq_right (fun h : i = j => hj (h ▸ hi)), ite_eq_right (fun h : i = j => hj (h ▸ hi))]
      simp
    · by_cases hir : i = r
      · subst hir
        rw [chartDer_self, Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.finset_sum_apply, hy,
          awayDer_algebraMap, hD]
        have hsum : ∀ l ∈ Finset.univ.filter (· < i),
            (chartY x i l • awayDer x i D l)
              (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x i)) (x j)) = 0 := by
          intro l hl
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hl
          rw [Derivation.smul_apply, awayDer_algebraMap, hD,
            ite_eq_right (fun h : l = j => hj (h ▸ hl.2))]
          simp
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsum, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      · rw [chartDer_of_gt x r D hi hir, hy, awayDer_algebraMap, hD]
        split_ifs <;> simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartDer_mem
statement: theorem chartDer_mem (i : Fin n) : ∀ a ∈ chartRing x r, chartDer x r D i a ∈ chartRing x r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a ha
  have hconst : ∀ c : R, chartDer x r D i (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (x r)) c) ∈
      chartRing x r := by
    intro c
    by_cases hi : i < r
    · rw [chartDer_of_lt x r D hi, Derivation.smul_apply, awayDer_algebraMap, smul_eq_mul,
        ← map_mul]
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
    · by_cases hir : i = r
      · subst hir
        rw [chartDer_self, Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.finset_sum_apply, awayDer_algebraMap]
        refine Subalgebra.add_mem _ (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _) (Subalgebra.sum_mem _ ?_)
        intro l _
        rw [Derivation.smul_apply, awayDer_algebraMap, smul_eq_mul]
        exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (chartY_mem x i l) (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _)
      · rw [chartDer_of_gt x r D hi hir, awayDer_algebraMap]
        exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun a _ => chartDer x r D i a ∈ chartRing x r) ?_ hconst
    ?_ ?_ ha
  · rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    have : chartDer x r D i (chartY x r j) ∈ chartRing x r := by
      rw [chartDer_chartY x r D hD]
      split_ifs
      · exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
      · exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
    rwa [show chartY x r j = Localization.mk (x j) ⟨x r, Submonoid.mem_powers (x r)⟩ from
      chartYOf_of_lt x r (x r) hj] at this
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    rw [map_add]
    exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ ha hb
  · intro a b hab hbb ha hb
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hab hb) (Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hbb ha)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartRingDer_chartYR
statement:
theorem chartRingDer_chartYR (i j : Fin n) :
    chartRingDer x r D hD i (chartYR x r j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change chartDer x r D i (chartY x r j) = _
  rw [chartDer_chartY x r D hD]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_extend_chartYR
statement:
theorem exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_extend_chartYR (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing x r)) [𝔮.IsPrime]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)] :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (z' : Fin m → Localization.AtPrime 𝔮),
      (span (Set.range z') = maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) ∧
        (m : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)) ∧
      ∃ σ : {i : Fin n // algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (chartYR x r i) ∈
          maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)} → Fin m,
        Function.Injective σ ∧
          ∀ i, z' (σ i) =
            algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (chartYR x r i.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set w : {i : Fin n // algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (chartYR x r i) ∈
      maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)} → Localization.AtPrime 𝔮 :=
    fun i => algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (chartYR x r i.1) with hw
  have hli := linearIndependent_toCotangent_of_derivations (k := k) w (fun i => i.2)
    (fun i => (chartRingDer x r D hD i.1).localization 𝔮.primeCompl) (fun i j => by
      change (chartRingDer x r D hD i.1).localization 𝔮.primeCompl
        (algebraMap (chartRing x r) (Localization 𝔮.primeCompl) (chartYR x r j.1)) = _
      rw [Derivation.localization_algebraMap, chartRingDer_chartYR]
      by_cases h : i = j
      · subst h; simp
      · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun h' => h (Subtype.ext h'))]
        simp)
  exact exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_linearIndependent w (fun i => i.2) hli

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_of_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_of_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension [PerfectField k]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (m : ℕ) {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) {x : X} (hxV : x ∈ V)
    (hstd : letI := f.sectionsAlgebra V
      Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension m k Γ(X, V)) :
    letI
proof:
:= f.stalkAlgebra x
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) +
      ((Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x))) : ℕ∞) :
        WithBot ℕ∞) = m := by
  let := f.stalkAlgebra x
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra V
  let := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  have := f.isScalarTower_sectionsAlgebra_stalk V hxV
  set 𝔮 := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal
  let e : Localization.AtPrime 𝔮 ≃ₐ[k] X.presheaf.stalk x :=
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv 𝔮.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
      (X.presheaf.stalk x)).restrictScalars k
  rw [← ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv,
    ← (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapAlgEquiv e).trdeg_eq]
  exact Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.ringKrullDim_localization_add_trdeg_residueField
    (k := k) m 𝔮

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension'
statement:
theorem exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension' (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (x : X) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen V) (_ : x ∈ V) (m : ℕ),
      letI
proof:
:= f.sectionsAlgebra V
      Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension m k Γ(X, V) := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hstd⟩ := exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmooth f x
  let := f.sectionsAlgebra V
  obtain ⟨ι, σ, _, _, ⟨P⟩⟩ := hstd.out
  exact ⟨V, hV, hxV, P.dimension, P.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyConstant_dimCount
statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_dimCount [PerfectField k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] :
    IsLocallyConstant (dimCount f)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open _).2 fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, m, hstd⟩ := exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension' f x
  refine ⟨V, V.isOpen, hxV, fun y hyV => ?_⟩
  show dimCount f y = dimCount f x
  unfold dimCount
  rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_of_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension f m hV hyV hstd,
    ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_of_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension f m hV hxV hstd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_preconnectedSpace
statement:
theorem exists_smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_preconnectedSpace [PerfectField k]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] [PreconnectedSpace X] [Nonempty X] :
    ∃ m : ℕ, SmoothOfRelativeDimension m f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀, hx₀, m₀, hstd₀⟩ := exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension' f x₀
  have hD₀ : dimCount f x₀ = m₀ :=
    ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_of_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension f m₀ hV₀ hx₀ hstd₀
  refine ⟨m₀, smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_forall_exists_affineOpen f m₀ fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, m, hstd⟩ := exists_affineOpen_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension' f x
  have hD : dimCount f x = m :=
    ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_of_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension f m hV hxV hstd
  have hconst := (isLocallyConstant_dimCount f).apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace x x₀
  rw [hD, hD₀] at hconst
  have hm : m = m₀ := by exact_mod_cast hconst
  subst hm
  exact ⟨V, hV, hxV, hstd⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartCoord_self
statement: theorem chartCoord_self : chartCoord E hj j = algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) _ (E.v j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartCoord]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartCoord_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem chartCoord_of_not_lt {i : Fin n} (hi : ¬ i.val < r) :
    chartCoord E hj i = algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) _ (E.v i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartCoord, hi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.algebraMap_v_eq_chartCoord_mul
statement:
theorem algebraMap_v_eq_chartCoord_mul {i : Fin n} (hi : i.val < r) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj)) (E.v i) =
      chartCoord E hj i * chartCoord E hj j
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartCoord_self, algebraMap_eq_ratio_mul E hj hi]
  simp [chartCoord, hi, hij]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.etale_aeval_chartCoord
statement:
theorem etale_aeval_chartCoord :
    letI
proof:
:= f.sectionsAlgebra E.U.1
    letI : Algebra k (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj)) :=
      ((algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) _).comp (algebraMap k Γ(X, E.U))).toAlgebra
    (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) (chartCoord E hj)).toRingHom.Etale :=
  etale_aeval_chartCoordinates E hj

name: AlgebraicGeometry.totalTransformData_chart
statement:
theorem totalTransformData_chart (hjq : chartCoord E hj j ∈ q) {ι : Type*}
    (D : ι → X.IdealSheafData) (c' : {i : ι // x₀ ∈ (D i).support} → Fin n)
    (hc'inj : Function.Injective c') (T : ι → Ideal (Localization.AtPrime q))
    (hT : ∀ i (h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support), T i = span
      {algebraMap
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj)) (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj))
          (E.v (c' ⟨i, h⟩)))})
    (hT' : ∀ i, x₀ ∉ (D i).support → T i = ⊤) :
    TotalTransformData (span
      {algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj))
        (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj)) (E.v j))}) T ∧
    ∀ i (h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support), T i ≤ span
      {algebraMap
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj)) (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj)) (E.v j))} →
      (c' ⟨i, h⟩).val < r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := f.sectionsAlgebra E.U.1
  let _ : Algebra k (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj)) :=
    ((algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) _).comp (algebraMap k Γ(X, E.U))).toAlgebra
  have hy : (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) (chartCoord E hj)).toRingHom.Etale :=
    etale_aeval_chartCoord E hj
  have hex := exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_of_etale_coordinates (chartCoord E hj) hy q
  obtain ⟨hreg, m, z, hz, σ, hσinj, hσ⟩ := hex
  let alg := algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra E.centerIdeal (E.coord j hj)) (Localization.AtPrime q)
  have hunit : ∀ c : Fin n, chartCoord E hj c ∉ q → IsUnit (alg (chartCoord E hj c)) := fun c hc =>
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (Localization.AtPrime q) q _).mpr hc
  let j' : Fin m := σ ⟨j, hjq⟩
  let a : ι → Fin m := fun i =>
    if h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support then
      if hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q then σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ else j'
    else j'
  have ha_of : ∀ i (h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support) (hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q),
      a i = σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ := fun i h hq => by
    change (if h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support then
      (if hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q then σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ else j') else j') = _
    rw [dite_eq_left h, dite_eq_left hq]
  have ha_of_not : ∀ i (h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support), chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∉ q → a i = j' :=
    fun i h hq => by
      change (if h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support then
        (if hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q then σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ else j') else j') = _
      rw [dite_eq_left h, dite_eq_right hq]
  have ha_notMem : ∀ i, x₀ ∉ (D i).support → a i = j' := fun i h => by
    change (if h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support then
      (if hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q then σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ else j') else j') = _
    rw [dite_eq_right h]
  have ha_not : ∀ i, a i ≠ j' → ∃ (h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support) (hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q),
      c' ⟨i, h⟩ ≠ j ∧ a i = σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support
    · by_cases hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q
      · refine ⟨h, hq, fun hcj => hi ?_, ha_of i h hq⟩
        rw [ha_of i h hq]
        exact congrArg σ (Subtype.ext hcj)
      · exact absurd (ha_of_not i h hq) hi
    · exact absurd (ha_notMem i h) hi
  have hzj' : z j' = alg (chartCoord E hj j) := hσ ⟨j, hjq⟩
  
  have hF : span {alg (algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) _ (E.v j))} = span {z j'} :=
    (congrArg (fun t => span {alg t}) (chartCoord_self E hj).symm).trans
      (congrArg (fun t => span {t}) hzj'.symm)
  
  have hle : ∀ i (h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support),
      T i ≤ span {alg (algebraMap Γ(X, E.U) _ (E.v j))} → (c' ⟨i, h⟩).val < r := by
    intro i h hTle
    by_contra hlt
    have hTi : T i = span {alg (chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩))} :=
      (hT i h).trans (congrArg (fun t => span {alg t}) (chartCoord_of_not_lt E hj hlt).symm)
    have hTle' : span {alg (chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩))} ≤ span {z j'} :=
      hTi.symm.le.trans (hTle.trans hF.le)
    by_cases hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q
    · have hcj : c' ⟨i, h⟩ ≠ j := fun hcj => hlt (hcj ▸ hj)
      have hne : σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ ≠ j' := fun heq =>
        hcj (congrArg Subtype.val (hσinj heq))
      have hmem : z (σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩) ∈ span {z j'} :=
        (hσ ⟨_, hq⟩).symm ▸ hTle' (mem_span_singleton_self _)
      exact notMem_span_singleton_of_ne hz.1 hz.2 hne.symm hmem
    · have hu := hunit _ hq
      have htop : span {alg (chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩))} = ⊤ := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hu
      have hle' : (⊤ : Ideal (Localization.AtPrime q)) ≤ span {z j'} := htop.symm.le.trans hTle'
      have hunit' : IsUnit (z j') := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp (top_le_iff.mp hle')
      exact mem_nonunits_iff.mp ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp
        (mem_maximalIdeal_and_notMem_sq_of_span_eq hz j').1) hunit'
  refine ⟨⟨hreg, m, z, hz, j', a, hF, ?_, ?_⟩, hle⟩
  · 
    intro i i' hi hi' heq
    have hi₁ := ha_not i hi
    have hi₂ := ha_not i' hi'
    obtain ⟨h, hq, -, ha⟩ := hi₁
    obtain ⟨h', hq', -, ha'⟩ := hi₂
    have heq' : σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ = σ ⟨c' ⟨i', h'⟩, hq'⟩ := ha.symm.trans (heq.trans ha')
    have := congrArg Subtype.val (hσinj heq')
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (hc'inj this)
  · 
    intro i
    by_cases h : x₀ ∈ (D i).support
    · have hTi := hT i h
      by_cases hcj : c' ⟨i, h⟩ = j
      · 
        rw [hcj] at hTi
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl (hTi.trans hF))
      · by_cases hq : chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩) ∈ q
        · have ha : a i = σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ := ha_of i h hq
          have hne : a i ≠ j' := fun heq => by
            have heq' : σ ⟨c' ⟨i, h⟩, hq⟩ = σ ⟨j, hjq⟩ := ha.symm.trans heq
            exact hcj (congrArg Subtype.val (hσinj heq'))
          have hz' : z (a i) = alg (chartCoord E hj (c' ⟨i, h⟩)) :=
            (congrArg z ha).trans (hσ ⟨_, hq⟩)
          by_cases hlt : (c' ⟨i, h⟩).val < r
          · refine Or.inl ⟨hne, Or.inl (hTi.trans ?_)⟩
            exact (congrArg (fun t => span {alg t})
              (algebraMap_v_eq_chartCoord_mul E hj hlt hcj)).trans
              ((congrArg (fun t => span {t}) (map_mul alg _ _)).trans
                (congrArg (fun t => span {t}) (congrArg₂ (· * ·) hz'.symm hzj'.symm)))
          · refine Or.inl ⟨hne, Or.inr (hTi.trans ?_)⟩
            exact (congrArg (fun t => span {alg t}) (chartCoord_of_not_lt E hj hlt).symm).trans
              (congrArg (fun t => span {t}) hz'.symm)
        · have hu := hunit _ hq
          by_cases hlt : (c' ⟨i, h⟩).val < r
          · refine Or.inr (Or.inl (hTi.trans ?_))
            exact (congrArg (fun t => span {alg t})
              (algebraMap_v_eq_chartCoord_mul E hj hlt hcj)).trans
              ((congrArg (fun t => span {t}) (map_mul alg _ _)).trans
                ((Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hu _).trans
                  (congrArg (fun t => span {t}) hzj'.symm)))
          · refine Or.inr (Or.inr (hTi.trans ?_))
            exact (congrArg (fun t => span {alg t}) (chartCoord_of_not_lt E hj hlt).symm).trans
              (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hu)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hT' i h))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_fin_span_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_fin_span_eq_maximalIdeal (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (z : Fin n → R),
      span (Set.range z) = maximalIdeal R ∧ (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hspan⟩ :=
    Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank (IsNoetherian.noetherian (maximalIdeal R))
  let e : ↥s ≃ Fin s.card := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (Fintype.card_coe s)
  refine ⟨s.card, fun i => ((e.symm i : ↥s) : R), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hrange : Set.range (fun i => ((e.symm i : ↥s) : R)) = (s : Set R) := by
      rw [show (fun i => ((e.symm i : ↥s) : R)) = Subtype.val ∘ e.symm from rfl, Set.range_comp,
        Equiv.range_eq_univ, Set.image_univ, Subtype.range_coe_subtype]
      rfl
    rw [hrange]
    exact hspan
  · rw [hcard]
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_maximalIdeal_and_notMem_sq_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_and_notMem_sq_of_span_eq
    (hz : span (Set.range z) = maximalIdeal R ∧ (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (i : Fin n) :
    z i ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ z i ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
proof:
:=
  ⟨x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq z hz.1.symm i,
    notMem_sq_of_span_eq z hz.1.symm hz.2 i⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_singleton_ne_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_basis_cotangentSpace_of_span_eq z hz.1.symm hz.2
  have hmem : z i ∈ span {z j} := heq ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (z i)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
  have hzi := x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq z hz.1.symm i
  have hzj := x_mem_maximalIdeal_of_span_eq z hz.1.symm j
  
  have hcot : b i = residue R u • b j := by
    rw [hb i, hb j, ← ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul (ResidueField R) u,
      ← LinearMap.map_smul]
    congr 1
    ext
    exact hu.symm
  have := congrArg (fun v => b.repr v i) hcot
  simp only [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply,
    ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hij), smul_zero] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_fin_span_eq_maximalIdeal_stalk
statement:
theorem exists_fin_span_eq_maximalIdeal_stalk (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth f] (x : X) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk x),
      span (Set.range z) = maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
        (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:=
  have := isRegularLocalRing_stalk f x
  exists_fin_span_eq_maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)

name: Ideal.colon_coe_self
statement: theorem Ideal.colon_coe_self {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) : I.colon (↑I : Set R) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_le_iff.mp fun r _ => Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun s hs => by
    rw [smul_eq_mul]; exact I.mul_mem_left r hs

name: Ideal.colon_pow_eq_self_of_isPrime
statement:
theorem Ideal.colon_pow_eq_self_of_isPrime {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {p J : Ideal R} (hp : p.IsPrime)
    (hJ : ¬ J ≤ p) (i : ℕ) : p.colon (↑(J ^ i) : Set R) = p
proof:
:= by
  have := hp
  refine le_antisymm (fun r hr => ?_) fun r hr =>
    Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun s _ => by rw [smul_eq_mul]; exact p.mul_mem_right s hr
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon] at hr
  have hJi : ¬ J ^ i ≤ p := fun h => hJ (Ideal.IsPrime.le_of_pow_le h)
  obtain ⟨y, hyJ, hyp⟩ := IsConcreteLE.not_le_iff_exists.mp hJi
  have h := hr y hyJ
  rw [smul_eq_mul] at h
  exact (hp.mem_or_mem h).resolve_right hyp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPrime_span_singleton_of_parameters
statement: theorem isPrime_span_singleton_of_parameters (c : Fin n) : (span {z c}).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  have h := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_image_finset hz hn {c}
  rw [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton] at h
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.colon_pow_span_image_eq_of_notMem
statement:
theorem colon_pow_span_image_eq_of_notMem {s : Finset (Fin n)} (hs : s.Nonempty) {c : Fin n}
    (hc : c ∉ s) (i : ℕ) : (span {z c}).colon (↑(span (z '' ↑s) ^ i) : Set R) = span {z c}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hs
  have hjc : j ∉ ({c} : Finset (Fin n)) := by
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
    rintro rfl
    exact hc hj
  have hnot : ¬ span (z '' ↑s) ≤ span {z c} := by
    intro hle
    have h1 : z j ∈ span (z '' ↑s) := subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem z (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hj))
    have h2 := notMem_span_image_of_notMem hz hn hjc
    rw [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton] at h2
    exact h2 (hle h1)
  exact Ideal.colon_pow_eq_self_of_isPrime (isPrime_span_singleton_of_parameters hz hn c) hnot i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_eq_singleton_of_span_image_eq_span_singleton
statement:
theorem exists_eq_singleton_of_span_image_eq_span_singleton {s : Finset (Fin n)} {g : R}
    (hg : g ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) (h : span (z '' ↑s) = span {g}) : ∃ j, s = {j}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : s.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hs
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hs
    rw [hs, Finset.coe_empty, Set.image_empty, span_empty] at h
    have hg0 : g = 0 := (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp (h ▸ mem_span_singleton_self g)
    exact nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hg hg0
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hs
  have hgm : g ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    have : g ∈ span (z '' ↑s) := h ▸ mem_span_singleton_self g
    rw [hz]
    exact span_mono (Set.image_subset_range z ↑s) this
  refine ⟨j, Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨hj, fun j' hj' => ?_⟩⟩
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
    mem_span_singleton.mp (h ▸ subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem z hj) : z j ∈ span {g})
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ :=
    mem_span_singleton.mp (h ▸ subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem z hj') : z j' ∈ span {g})
  by_cases hu : IsUnit b
  · have hgz : g = z j * ↑hu.unit⁻¹ := by
      rw [hb, mul_assoc, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, mul_one]
    have hmem : z j' ∈ span (z '' ↑({j} : Finset (Fin n))) := by
      rw [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton, mem_span_singleton]
      exact ⟨↑hu.unit⁻¹ * b', by rw [hb', hgz, mul_assoc]⟩
    have hj'j : j' ∉ ({j} : Finset (Fin n)) := by simpa using hne
    exact notMem_span_image_of_notMem hz hn hj'j hmem
  · have hbm : b ∈ maximalIdeal R :=
      (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal b).mpr (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr hu)
    have : z j ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 := by
      rw [hb, pow_two]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hgm hbm
    exact (mem_maximalIdeal_and_notMem_sq_of_span_eq ⟨hz.symm, hn⟩ j).2 this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.saturate_eq_self_of_forall_stalk
statement:
theorem saturate_eq_self_of_forall_stalk (D Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : Z.IsInvertible)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ D.support, x ∈ Z.support → ∀ i : ℕ,
      (D.stalkIdeal x).colon (↑(Z.stalkIdeal x ^ i) : Set (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ≤ D.stalkIdeal x) :
    D.saturate Z = D
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun x => ?_)
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_saturate D Z)
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_saturate_of_isInvertible D hZ x]
  refine iSup_le fun i => ?_
  by_cases hxD : x ∈ D.support
  · by_cases hxZ : x ∈ Z.support
    · exact h x hxD hxZ i
    · rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support Z hxZ, Ideal.top_pow]
      intro r hr
      have := Submodule.mem_colon.mp hr 1 Submodule.mem_top
      rwa [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
  · rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support D hxD]
    exact le_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_saturate_eq_of_mem_support
proof:
:= by
  have hwD : w ∈ D.support := Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_antitone
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_saturate D Z) hw
  have hne : (D.saturate Z).stalkIdeal w ≠ ⊤ := fun htop =>
    (maximalIdeal.isMaximal (X.presheaf.stalk w)).ne_top
      (top_le_iff.mp (htop ▸ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal _
          _).mp hw))
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_saturate_of_isInvertible D hZ w]
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i => ?_) ?_
  · by_cases hwZ : w ∈ Z.support
    · have := hreg w
      obtain ⟨n, z, c, s, hz, hn, hD, hZw⟩ := hdata w hwD hwZ
      obtain ⟨g, hg, hgZ⟩ := hZ.exists_mem_nonZeroDivisors_stalkIdeal_eq_span w
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ :=
        exists_eq_singleton_of_span_image_eq_span_singleton hz hn hg (hZw.symm.trans hgZ)
      by_cases hcj : c = j
      · exfalso
        apply hne
        rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_saturate_of_isInvertible D hZ w]
        refine top_le_iff.mp (le_iSup_of_le 1 ?_)
        rw [hD, hZw, pow_one, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.image_singleton, hcj]
        exact (Ideal.colon_coe_self _).ge
      · rw [hD, hZw, colon_pow_span_image_eq_of_notMem hz hn (Finset.singleton_nonempty j)
          (by simpa using hcj) i]
    · rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support Z hwZ, Ideal.top_pow]
      intro r hr
      have := Submodule.mem_colon.mp hr 1 Submodule.mem_top
      rwa [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
  · have h0 : D.stalkIdeal w ≤
        (D.stalkIdeal w).colon (↑(Z.stalkIdeal w ^ 0) : Set (X.presheaf.stalk w)) := by
      rw [pow_zero]
      intro r hr
      rw [Submodule.mem_colon]
      intro s _
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right s _ hr
    exact le_iSup_of_le 0 h0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.saturate_eq_self_of_snc_transversal
statement:
theorem saturate_eq_self_of_snc_transversal (D Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : Z.IsInvertible)
    (hdata : ∀ x ∈ D.support, x ∈ Z.support →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (z : Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk x) (c : Fin n) (s : Finset (Fin n)),
        maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) = span (Set.range z) ∧
        (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
        D.stalkIdeal x = span {z c} ∧ Z.stalkIdeal x = span (z '' ↑s) ∧ c ∉ s) :
    D.saturate Z = D
proof:
:= by
  refine saturate_eq_self_of_forall_stalk D Z hZ fun x hxD hxZ i => ?_
  have := hreg x
  obtain ⟨n, z, c, s, hz, hn, hD, hZx, hcs⟩ := hdata x hxD hxZ
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgZ⟩ := hZ.exists_mem_nonZeroDivisors_stalkIdeal_eq_span x
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ :=
    exists_eq_singleton_of_span_image_eq_span_singleton hz hn hg (hZx.symm.trans hgZ)
  rw [hD, hZx, colon_pow_span_image_eq_of_notMem hz hn (Finset.singleton_nonempty j) hcs i]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegular_subscheme_saturate
statement:
theorem isRegular_subscheme_saturate (D Z : X.IdealSheafData) (hZ : Z.IsInvertible)
    (hdata : ∀ x ∈ D.support, x ∈ Z.support → SncDataAt D Z x) (hD : IsRegular D.subscheme) :
    IsRegular (D.saturate Z).subscheme
proof:
:= by
  refine isRegular_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_quotient _ fun w hw => ?_
  rw [stalkIdeal_saturate_eq_of_mem_support hreg D Z hZ hdata hw]
  have hwD : w ∈ D.support := Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_antitone
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_saturate D Z) hw
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : w ∈ Set.range D.subschemeι := by rwa [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι]
  have : IsRegularLocalRing (D.subscheme.presheaf.stalk v) := hD.isRegularAt v
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (D.stalkQuotientEquiv v).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.strictTransformAlong_eq_comap_of_saturate_eq
statement:
theorem strictTransformAlong_eq_comap_of_saturate_eq {B X : Scheme.{u}} (π : B ⟶ X) [IsIso π]
    (Z D : X.IdealSheafData) (h : D.saturate Z = D) :
    D.strictTransformAlong π (Z.comap π) = D.comap π
