name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_toModulesSectionsEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem coe_toModulesSectionsEquiv_smul (U : X.affineOpens) (c : Γ(X, U))
    (s : Γ(I.toModules, U)) :
    ((I.toModulesSectionsEquiv U (c • s) : I.ideal U) : Γ(X, U)) =
      c * (I.toModulesSectionsEquiv U s : Γ(X, U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isLocalizedModule_toModules_resₗ
statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_toModules_resₗ (U : X.affineOpens) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    letI
proof:
:= Module.compHom Γ(I.toModules, X.basicOpen r)
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op).hom
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers r) (I.toModules.resₗ (X.basicOpen_le r)) := by
  letI := Module.compHom Γ(I.toModules, X.basicOpen r)
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op).hom
  have := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen r
  set ρ := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op
  set eU := I.toModulesSectionsEquiv U
  set eD := I.toModulesSectionsEquiv (X.affineBasicOpen r)
  
  let v : Γ(I.toModules, X.basicOpen r) → Γ(X, X.basicOpen r) := fun w => (eD w).1
  have hv : Function.Injective v := fun w w' h => eD.injective (Subtype.ext h)
  have hres (s : Γ(I.toModules, U)) :
      v (I.toModules.resₗ (X.basicOpen_le r) s) = ρ (eU s : Γ(X, U)) :=
    I.coe_toModulesSectionsEquiv_restrictionMap (U := X.affineBasicOpen r) (V := U)
      (X.basicOpen_le r) s
  have hsmul' (c : Γ(X, X.basicOpen r)) (y : Γ(I.toModules, X.basicOpen r)) :
      v (c • y) = c * v y :=
    I.coe_toModulesSectionsEquiv_smul (X.affineBasicOpen r) c y
  have hsmul (c : Γ(X, U)) (y : Γ(I.toModules, X.basicOpen r)) : v (c • y) = ρ c * v y :=
    hsmul' (ρ c) y
  have hunit (n : ℕ) : IsUnit (ρ (r ^ n)) := by
    rw [map_pow]
    exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := Γ(X, X.basicOpen r)) r).pow n
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun y => ?_, fun {a b} h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨_, n, rfl⟩ := x
    rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hunit n
    refine ⟨fun y z hyz => hv ?_, fun y => ⟨(u⁻¹ : (Γ(X, X.basicOpen r))ˣ) • y, hv ?_⟩⟩
    · have := congrArg v hyz
      simp only [Module.algebraMap_end_apply] at this
      rw [hsmul, hsmul, ← hu] at this
      exact u.isUnit.mul_left_cancel this
    · change v ((r ^ n) • ((u⁻¹ : (Γ(X, X.basicOpen r))ˣ) • y)) = v y
      rw [hsmul, ← hu, Units.smul_def, hsmul', ← mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, one_mul]
  · have hmap : ∀ w : Γ(X, X.basicOpen r), w ∈ I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen r) →
        w ∈ (I.ideal U).map ρ.hom := fun w hw => by rwa [← I.map_ideal_basicOpen] at hw
    have hy := hmap (v y) (eD y).2
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, ha⟩ := (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff
      (Submonoid.powers r) Γ(X, X.basicOpen r)).mp hy
    refine ⟨(eU.symm a, ⟨r ^ n, n, rfl⟩), hv ?_⟩
    change v ((r ^ n) • y) = _
    rw [hsmul, hres, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, mul_comm]
    exact ha
  · have h' := congrArg v h
    simp only [hres] at h'
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (Submonoid.powers r)
      Γ(X, X.basicOpen r)).mp h'
    refine ⟨c, eU.injective (Subtype.ext ?_)⟩
    rw [Submonoid.smul_def, Submonoid.smul_def, LinearEquiv.map_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul]
    exact hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isIso_fromTildeΓ_toModules
statement:
theorem isIso_fromTildeΓ_toModules {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    IsIso (I.toModules.restrict hU.fromSpec).fromTildeΓ
proof:
:=
  (isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing _).mpr fun r =>
    (I.toModules.isLocalizedModule_restrict_fromSpec_iff hU r).mpr
      (I.isLocalizedModule_toModules_resₗ ⟨U, hU⟩ r)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isFinitePresentation_toModules
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_toModules [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I.toModules
proof:
:= by
  refine I.toModules.isFinitePresentation_of_forall_affine fun U hU => ?_
  let U' : X.affineOpens := ⟨U, hU⟩
  have : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U'
  have : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, U) (I.ideal U') :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite _ _
  have : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, U) Γ(I.toModules, U) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv (I.toModulesSectionsEquiv U').symm
  have := I.isIso_fromTildeΓ_toModules hU
  exact I.toModules.exists_isFinite_presentation_restrict hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.symToRees_ι
statement:
theorem symToRees_ι (U : X.affineOpens) (s : Γ(I.toModules, U)) :
    I.symToRees U (ι _ _ s) = reesAlgebra.degreeOne (I.ideal U) (I.toModulesSectionsEquiv U s)
proof:
:=
  lift_ι_apply (I.toModulesToRees U) s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.symToRees_algebraMap
statement:
theorem symToRees_algebraMap (U : X.affineOpens) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    I.symToRees U (algebraMap _ _ r) = algebraMap Γ(X, U) (reesAlgebra (I.ideal U)) r
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.commutes (lift (I.toModulesToRees U)) r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.degreeOne_mem_range
statement:
theorem degreeOne_mem_range (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U) :
    reesAlgebra.degreeOne (I.ideal U) a ∈ (I.symToRees U).toRingHom.range
proof:
:=
  ⟨ι _ _ ((I.toModulesSectionsEquiv U).symm a), by
    rw [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, symToRees_ι, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.symToRees_surjective
statement: theorem symToRees_surjective (U : X.affineOpens) : Function.Surjective (I.symToRees U)
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Γ(X, U)) (hc : c ∈ I.ideal U ^ n),
      (⟨monomial n c, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hc⟩ : reesAlgebra (I.ideal U)) ∈
        (I.symToRees U).toRingHom.range := by
    intro n c hc
    induction hc using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r =>
      refine ⟨algebraMap _ _ r, ?_⟩
      rw [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, symToRees_algebraMap]
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      change Polynomial.C r = monomial 0 r
      exact (Polynomial.monomial_zero_left (R := Γ(X, U)) (a := r)).symm
    | add x y i hx hy ihx ihy =>
      have hx' : monomial i x ∈ reesAlgebra (I.ideal U) := reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hx
      have hy' : monomial i y ∈ reesAlgebra (I.ideal U) := reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hy
      have : (⟨monomial i (x + y), reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (add_mem hx hy)⟩ :
          reesAlgebra (I.ideal U)) = ⟨monomial i x, hx'⟩ + ⟨monomial i y, hy'⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext (map_add (monomial i) x y)
      rw [this]
      exact add_mem (ihx) (ihy)
    | mem_mul m hm i x hx ih =>
      have hx' : monomial i x ∈ reesAlgebra (I.ideal U) := reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hx
      have : (⟨monomial (i + 1) (m * x), reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (by
            rw [pow_succ']; exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul hm hx)⟩ : reesAlgebra (I.ideal U)) =
          reesAlgebra.degreeOne (I.ideal U) ⟨m, hm⟩ * ⟨monomial i x, hx'⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext (by
          change monomial (i + 1) (m * x) = monomial 1 m * monomial i x
          rw [monomial_mul_monomial, add_comm])
      rw [this]
      exact mul_mem (I.degreeOne_mem_range U ⟨m, hm⟩) ih
  intro p
  have hp : p = ∑ n ∈ (p : Γ(X, U)[X]).support,
      ⟨monomial n ((p : Γ(X, U)[X]).coeff n), reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr
        (reesAlgebra.coeff_mem_pow p n)⟩ := by
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
    exact (as_sum_support (p : Γ(X, U)[X]))
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : p ∈ (I.symToRees U).toRingHom.range := by
    rw [hp]
    exact Subring.sum_mem _ fun n _ => key n _ (reesAlgebra.coeff_mem_pow p n)
  exact ⟨q, hq⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.irrelevant_le_map_symToRees
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_symToRees (U : X.affineOpens) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (reesAlgebra.grading (I.ideal U)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading Γ(X, U) Γ(I.toModules, U))).map (I.symToRees U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toIdeal_le_toIdeal_iff, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map]
  refine (reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne _).trans (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  rw [← LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (I.toModulesSectionsEquiv U) a, ← symToRees_ι]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ one_pos (ι_mem_grading_one _))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_blowUpChart
statement: theorem isClosedImmersion_blowUpChart (U : X.affineOpens) : IsClosedImmersion (I.blowUpChart U)
proof:
:=
  Proj.isClosedImmersion_map_of_surjective _ _ (I.symToRees_surjective U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUpChart_π
statement:
theorem blowUpChart_π (U : X.affineOpens) :
    I.blowUpChart U ≫ affineProjectiveBundle.π Γ(X, U) Γ(I.toModules, U) =
      affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowUpChart, affineProjectiveBundle.π, affineBlowUp.π, Proj.map_toSpecZero_assoc,
    ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext ?_))
  change ((I.symToRees U (algebraMap _ _ r) : reesAlgebra (I.ideal U)) : Γ(X, U)[X]) = _
  rw [symToRees_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUpChart_naturality
statement:
theorem blowUpChart_naturality {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ⟶ V) :
    (affineBlowUpFunctor I).map h ≫ I.blowUpChart V =
      I.blowUpChart U ≫ (projectiveBundleFunctor I.toModules).map h
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (F : grading Γ(X, V) Γ(I.toModules, V) →+*ᵍ reesAlgebra.grading (I.ideal U))
      (hF) (F' : grading Γ(X, V) Γ(I.toModules, V) →+*ᵍ reesAlgebra.grading (I.ideal U)) (hF'),
      F = F' → Proj.map F hF = Proj.map F' hF' := by
    rintro F hF _ hF' rfl
    rfl
  rw [affineBlowUpFunctor_map]
  dsimp only [projectiveBundleFunctor, affineBlowUp.mapHom, affineBlowUp.mapOfEq,
    affineProjectiveBundle.mapHom, affineProjectiveBundle.map, blowUpChart]
  rw [← Proj.map_comp]
  refine (Proj.map_comp _ _ _ _).symm.trans (key _ _ _ _ (GradedRingHom.ext fun a =>
    RingHom.congr_fun (ringHom_ext
    (F := ((reesAlgebra.mapOfLe _ _).comp (I.symToRees V)).toRingHom)
    (G := ((I.symToRees U).comp (gradedMap _ (I.toModules.restrictionMap h.le))).toRingHom)
    (fun r => ?_) (fun x => ?_)) a))
  · simp only [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, GradedRingHom.comp_apply, symToRees_algebraMap,
      gradedMap_algebraMap]
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    change ((Polynomial.C r).map _ : Γ(X, U)[X]) = Polynomial.C _
    rw [Polynomial.map_C]
    rfl
  · simp only [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, GradedRingHom.comp_apply, symToRees_ι,
      gradedMap_ι, reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_degreeOne]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUpNatTrans_app_comp
statement:
theorem blowUpNatTrans_app_comp (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (I.blowUpNatTrans).app U ≫ (projectiveBundleNatTrans I.toModules).app U =
      (affineBlowUpNatTrans I).app U
proof:
:= by
  change I.blowUpChart U ≫ affineProjectiveBundle.π _ _ ≫ _ = _
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  rw [blowUpChart_π]
  exact (affineBlowUpNatTrans_app I U).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUpToProjectiveBundle_π
statement:
theorem blowUpToProjectiveBundle_π :
    I.blowUpToProjectiveBundle ≫ I.toModules.projectiveBundleπ = I.blowUpπ
proof:
:= by
  change colimMap I.blowUpNatTrans ≫ (projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).toBase =
    (relativeGluingDataOf I (affineBlowUpNatTrans_equifibered I)).toBase
  refine colimit.hom_ext fun U => ?_
  rw [ι_colimMap_assoc]
  erw [Scheme.Cover.RelativeGluingData.ι_toBase, Scheme.Cover.RelativeGluingData.ι_toBase]
  erw [← Category.assoc, I.blowUpNatTrans_app_comp U]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_blowUpToProjectiveBundle
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_blowUpToProjectiveBundle :
    IsClosedImmersion I.blowUpToProjectiveBundle
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover
    (projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).cover fun (U : X.affineOpens) => ?_
  have h₁ := (relativeGluingDataOf I
    (affineBlowUpNatTrans_equifibered I)).isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase U
  have h₂ := (projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase U
  have hsq : IsPullback (I.blowUpChart U)
      (colimit.ι (relativeGluingDataOf I (affineBlowUpNatTrans_equifibered I)).functor U)
      (colimit.ι (projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).functor U)
      I.blowUpToProjectiveBundle := by
    refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := (projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).natTrans.app U)
      (h₂₂ := (projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).toBase)
      (v₁₃ := X.directedAffineCover.f U) ?_ (by exact (ι_colimMap I.blowUpNatTrans U).symm) h₂
    have e₁ : I.blowUpChart U ≫ (projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).natTrans.app U =
        (relativeGluingDataOf I (affineBlowUpNatTrans_equifibered I)).natTrans.app U :=
      I.blowUpNatTrans_app_comp U
    have e₂ : I.blowUpToProjectiveBundle ≫ (projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).toBase =
        (relativeGluingDataOf I (affineBlowUpNatTrans_equifibered I)).toBase :=
      I.blowUpToProjectiveBundle_π
    exact h₁.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
      ((Category.comp_id _).trans (e₁.symm.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm))
      ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)
      ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)
      ((Category.comp_id _).trans (e₂.symm.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm))
  have := I.isClosedImmersion_blowUpChart U
  exact (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff @IsClosedImmersion
    (Arrow.isoMk (f := Arrow.mk (I.blowUpChart U))
      (g := Arrow.mk ((projectiveBundleGluingData I.toModules).cover.pullbackHom
        I.blowUpToProjectiveBundle U)) hsq.flip.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (by
      simp only [Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom, Iso.refl_hom]
      exact hsq.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd))).mp this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjective.isIso_comp
statement:
theorem IsProjective.isIso_comp {X X' Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X' ⟶ X) [IsIso e] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [hf : IsProjective f] : IsProjective (e ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hE', i, hi, hif⟩ := hf.exists_isClosedImmersion
  exact ⟨⟨E, hE, hE', e ≫ i, inferInstance, by rw [Category.assoc, hif]⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isProjective_blowUpπ
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.isProjective_blowUpπ [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    IsProjective I.blowUpπ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := I.isFinitePresentation_toModules.exists_quasicoherentData
  have : I.toModules.IsQuasicoherent := σ.isQuasicoherent
  have : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.{u} I.toModules := by
    constructor
    refine ⟨σ.localGeneratorsData, ?_⟩
    constructor
    intro i
    exact (hσ.isFinite_presentation i).isFiniteType_generators
  exact ⟨⟨I.toModules, inferInstance, inferInstance, I.blowUpToProjectiveBundle,
    I.isClosedImmersion_blowUpToProjectiveBundle, I.blowUpToProjectiveBundle_π⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.projectiveBundleNatTrans_equifibered
statement: theorem projectiveBundleNatTrans_equifibered : (projectiveBundleNatTrans F).Equifibered
proof:
:= by
  intro U V h
  have hle : U ≤ V := h.le
  have hle' : (U : X.Opens) ≤ V := hle
  obtain rfl : h = homOfLE hle := (homOfLE_leOfHom h).symm
  change IsPullback (affineProjectiveBundle.mapHom (R := Γ(X, V)) (S := Γ(X, U))
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X := X.Opens) hle).op) (F.restrictionMap hle)
      (Scheme.Modules.span_range_restrictionMap_eq_top F (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U)
        (affineOpens_isAffineOpen V) hle))
    (affineProjectiveBundle.π Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv)
    (affineProjectiveBundle.π Γ(X, V) Γ(F, V) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen V).isoSpec.inv)
    (X.homOfLE hle')
  exact (affineProjectiveBundle.isPullback_mapHom _ _ _
    (Scheme.Modules.exists_extend_restrictionMap F (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U)
      (affineOpens_isAffineOpen V) hle)).flip.paste_vert
    (IsPullback.of_vert_isIso ⟨specMap_presheaf_map_isoSpec_inv hle⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isProper_projectiveBundleπ
statement:
theorem Scheme.Modules.isProper_projectiveBundleπ {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.{u} F] : IsProper F.projectiveBundleπ
proof:
:= by
  choose U hU hxU hfin using F.exists_isAffineOpen_finite_sections
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_iSup_eq_top U
    (eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxU x⟩) fun x => ?_
  let V : X.affineOpens := ⟨U x, hU x⟩
  have h₁ : IsPullback ((projectiveBundleGluingData F).natTrans.app V)
      (colimit.ι (projectiveBundleGluingData F).functor V) (U x).ι F.projectiveBundleπ :=
    (projectiveBundleGluingData F).isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase V
  have h₂ := isPullback_morphismRestrict F.projectiveBundleπ (U x)
  have : Module.Finite Γ(X, U x) Γ(F, U x) := hfin x
  have : IsProper ((projectiveBundleGluingData F).natTrans.app V) := by
    change IsProper (affineProjectiveBundle.π Γ(X, U x) Γ(F, U x) ≫ (hU x).isoSpec.inv)
    have := affineProjectiveBundle.isProper_π (R := Γ(X, U x)) (M := Γ(F, U x))
    infer_instance
  exact (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff @IsProper
    (Arrow.isoMk (h₁.flip.isoIsPullback _ _ h₂.flip) (Iso.refl _)
      ((h₁.flip.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ h₂.flip).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm))).mp this

name: SymmetricAlgebra.gradedMap_eq_id
statement:
theorem gradedMap_eq_id (f : M →ₛₗ[RingHom.id R] M) (hf : ∀ x, f x = x) :
    gradedMap (RingHom.id R) f = GradedRingHom.id (grading R M)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedRingHom.ext fun a => RingHom.congr_fun (ringHom_ext
    (F := (gradedMap (RingHom.id R) f).toRingHom) (G := RingHom.id _) (fun r => ?_)
    (fun x => ?_)) a
  · rw [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, gradedMap_algebraMap]; rfl
  · rw [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, gradedMap_ι, hf]; rfl

name: SymmetricAlgebra.gradedMap_eq_comp
statement:
theorem gradedMap_eq_comp (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : S →+* T) (f : M →ₛₗ[φ] N) (g : N →ₛₗ[ψ] P)
    (k : M →ₛₗ[ψ.comp φ] P) (hk : ∀ x, k x = g (f x)) :
    gradedMap (ψ.comp φ) k = (gradedMap ψ g).comp (gradedMap φ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedRingHom.ext fun a => RingHom.congr_fun (ringHom_ext
    (F := (gradedMap (ψ.comp φ) k).toRingHom)
    (G := (gradedMap ψ g).toRingHom.comp (gradedMap φ f).toRingHom) (fun r => ?_)
    (fun x => ?_)) a
  · simp only [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, RingHom.comp_apply, gradedMap_algebraMap]
  · simp only [GradedRingHom.coe_toRingHom, RingHom.comp_apply, gradedMap_ι, hk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.map_eq_id
statement:
theorem map_eq_id {φ : R →+* R} (hφ : φ = RingHom.id R) (f : M →ₛₗ[φ] M) (hf : ∀ x, f x = x)
    (hspan : Submodule.span R (Set.range f) = ⊤) : map φ f hspan = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  subst hφ
  have key : ∀ (F : grading R M →+*ᵍ grading R M) (hF),
      F = GradedRingHom.id _ → Proj.map F hF = 𝟙 (Proj (grading R M)) := by
    rintro F hF rfl
    exact Proj.map_id
  exact key _ _ (gradedMap_eq_id f hf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.map_eq_comp
statement:
theorem map_eq_comp {φ : R →+* S} {ψ : S →+* T} {χ : R →+* T} (hχ : χ = ψ.comp φ)
    (f : M →ₛₗ[φ] N) (g : N →ₛₗ[ψ] P) (k : M →ₛₗ[χ] P) (hk : ∀ x, k x = g (f x))
    (hf : Submodule.span S (Set.range f) = ⊤) (hg : Submodule.span T (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hk' : Submodule.span T (Set.range k) = ⊤) :
    map χ k hk' = map ψ g hg ≫ map φ f hf
proof:
:= by
  subst hχ
  have key : ∀ (F : grading R M →+*ᵍ grading T P) (hF),
      F = (gradedMap ψ g).comp (gradedMap φ f) →
        Proj.map F hF = map ψ g hg ≫ map φ f hf := by
    rintro F hF rfl
    exact Proj.map_comp _ _ _ _
  exact key _ _ (gradedMap_eq_comp φ ψ f g k hk)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.map_π
statement:
theorem map_π (φ : R →+* S) (f : M →ₛₗ[φ] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range f) = ⊤) :
    map φ f hspan ≫ π R M = π S N ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map, π, π, Proj.map_toSpecZero_assoc, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r => Subtype.ext ?_)
  exact gradedMap_algebraMap φ f r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.mapHom_eq_id
statement:
theorem mapHom_eq_id {φ : R' ⟶ R'} (hφ : φ = 𝟙 R') (f : M' →ₛₗ[φ.hom] M') (hf : ∀ x, f x = x)
    (hspan : Submodule.span R' (Set.range f) = ⊤) : mapHom φ f hspan = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  subst hφ
  exact map_eq_id CommRingCat.hom_id f hf hspan

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.mapHom_eq_comp
statement:
theorem mapHom_eq_comp {φ : R' ⟶ S'} {ψ : S' ⟶ T'} {χ : R' ⟶ T'} (hχ : χ = φ ≫ ψ)
    (f : M' →ₛₗ[φ.hom] N') (g : N' →ₛₗ[ψ.hom] P') (k : M' →ₛₗ[χ.hom] P')
    (hk : ∀ x, k x = g (f x)) (hf : Submodule.span S' (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    (hg : Submodule.span T' (Set.range g) = ⊤) (hk' : Submodule.span T' (Set.range k) = ⊤) :
    mapHom χ k hk' = mapHom ψ g hg ≫ mapHom φ f hf
proof:
:= by
  subst hχ
  exact map_eq_comp (CommRingCat.hom_comp φ ψ) f g k hk hf hg hk'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.mapHom_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem mapHom_π (φ : R' ⟶ S') (f : M' →ₛₗ[φ.hom] N')
    (hspan : Submodule.span S' (Set.range f) = ⊤) :
    mapHom φ f hspan ≫ π R' M' = π S' N' ≫ Spec.map φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapHom, map_π, CommRingCat.ofHom_hom]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_ι
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_span_ι :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R M)).toIdeal ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range (ι R M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le]
  rintro (_ | i) hi x hx
  · exact absurd hi (lt_irrefl 0)
  change x ∈ LinearMap.range (ι R M) ^ (i + 1) at hx
  rw [pow_succ'] at hx
  change x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (ι R M))
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hx (fun a ha b _ => ?_) (fun a b ha hb => add_mem ha hb)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ha
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨y, rfl⟩)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap (φ : R →+* S) (f : M →ₛₗ[φ] N)
    (hf : Submodule.span S (Set.range f) = ⊤) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading S N) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R M)).map (gradedMap φ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toIdeal_le_toIdeal_iff, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map]
  refine irrelevant_le_span_ι.trans (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  have hn : n ∈ Submodule.span S (Set.range f) := hf ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  change ι S N n ∈ _
  induction hn using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem n hn =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hn
    have hι : gradedMap φ f (ι R M x) = ι S N (f x) := by
      let := algebraOfRingHom (N := N) φ
      exact lift_ι_apply (ιₛₗ φ f) x
    rw [← hι]
    refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ one_pos ?_)
    simpa only [grading, pow_one] using LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add n n' _ _ hn hn' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hn hn'
  | smul c n _ hn =>
    rw [LinearMap.map_smul, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.awayι_π
statement:
theorem awayι_π (e : SymmetricAlgebra R M) (he : e ∈ grading R M 1) :
    Proj.awayι (grading R M) e he one_pos ≫ π R M =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (toAway e))
proof:
:= by
  rw [π, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.isPullback_awayι_map
statement:
theorem isPullback_awayι_map (x : M) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x))))
      (Proj.awayι _ (gradedMap φ f (ι R M x)) ((gradedMap φ f).map_mem (ι_mem_grading_one x))
        one_pos)
      (Proj.awayι _ (ι R M x) (ι_mem_grading_one x) one_pos) (map φ f hspan)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _
    (Proj.awayι_comp_map (gradedMap φ f) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap φ f hspan) one_pos
      (ι R M x) (ι_mem_grading_one x))
    (by rw [Proj.opensRange_awayι, Proj.opensRange_awayι, map, Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.isPullback_map_aux
proof:
:= by
  have hchart := (isPullback_awayι_map φ f hspan x).flip
  let e := hab.isoIsPullback _ _ hchart
  have he₁ : e.hom ≫ Proj.awayι _ (gradedMap φ f (ι R M x))
      ((gradedMap φ f).map_mem (ι_mem_grading_one x)) one_pos = a :=
    hab.isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ hchart
  have he₂ : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map (gradedMap φ f) (ι R M x))) = b :=
    hab.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ hchart
  refine (isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (isPushout_away φ f x hspan hext)).of_iso' e (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, ← awayι_π (gradedMap φ f (ι R M x))
      ((gradedMap φ f).map_mem (ι_mem_grading_one x)), ← Category.assoc, he₁]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, he₂]
  · simp
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, awayι_π]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.isPullback_map
statement:
theorem isPullback_map :
    IsPullback (π S N) (map φ f hspan) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) (π R M)
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover (map φ f hspan) (π S N) (π R M)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) (chartCover (R := R) (M := M)).openCover fun x =>
      (isPullback_map_aux φ f hspan hext x (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _)).flip).flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.isPullback_mapHom
statement:
theorem isPullback_mapHom (φ : R ⟶ S) (f : M →ₛₗ[φ.hom] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    (hext : ∀ (T : Type u) [AddCommGroup T] [Module S T] (g : M →ₛₗ[φ.hom] T),
      ∃ g' : N →ₗ[S] T, ∀ x, g' (f x) = g x) :
    IsPullback (π S N) (mapHom φ f hspan) (Spec.map φ) (π R M)
proof:
:= by
  have := isPullback_map φ.hom f hspan hext
  rwa [CommRingCat.ofHom_hom] at this

name: HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_surjective
statement:
theorem _root_.HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_surjective {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {σ τ : Type*} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] (F : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hF : Function.Surjective F) {i : ℕ} {s : A} (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    Function.Surjective (Away.map F s)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective ℬ (F.map_mem hs) z
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hF b
  refine ⟨Away.mk 𝒜 hs n (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a (n • i)) (Subtype.prop _), ?_⟩
  rw [Away.map_mk]
  congr 1
  rw [GradedRingHom.map_directSumDecompose, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isPullback_awayι_map
statement:
theorem Proj.isPullback_awayι_map {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] (F : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hF : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map F)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) (s : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    IsPullback (Proj.awayι ℬ (F s) (F.map_mem hs) hi)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map F s))) (Proj.map F hF) (Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs hi)
proof:
:=
  (IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (Proj.awayι_comp_map F hF hi s hs)
    (by rw [Proj.opensRange_awayι, Proj.opensRange_awayι, Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen])).flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.isClosedImmersion_map_of_surjective
statement:
theorem Proj.isClosedImmersion_map_of_surjective {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] (F : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hF : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map F)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective F) : IsClosedImmersion (Proj.map F hF)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (Proj.affineOpenCover 𝒜).openCover fun j => ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, s, hs⟩ := j
  have hsq := Proj.isPullback_awayι_map F hF hi s hs
  have : IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map F s))) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (Away.map_surjective F hsurj hs)
  exact (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff @IsClosedImmersion
    (Arrow.isoMk (hsq.isoPullback) (Iso.refl _)
      (by simp only [Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
          exact hsq.isoPullback_hom_snd))).mp this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.finiteType_symmetricAlgebra
statement:
theorem finiteType_symmetricAlgebra [Module.Finite R M] :
    Algebra.FiniteType (SymmetricAlgebra.grading R M 0) (SymmetricAlgebra R M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.fg_top (R := R) (M := M)
  refine ⟨⟨s.image (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M), ?_⟩⟩
  rw [Finset.coe_image, eq_top_iff]
  have hι : ∀ x : M, SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x ∈ Algebra.adjoin (SymmetricAlgebra.grading R M 0)
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M '' (s : Set M)) := by
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span R (s : Set M) := hs ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx =>
      rw [LinearMap.map_smul, Algebra.smul_def]
      exact mul_mem (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _
        (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra.grading R M 0) c)) hx
  intro a ha
  clear ha
  induction a using SymmetricAlgebra.induction (R := R) (M := M) with
  | algebraMap r =>
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra.grading R M 0) r)
  | ι x => exact hι x
  | mul a b ha hb => exact mul_mem ha hb
  | add a b ha hb => exact add_mem ha hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineProjectiveBundle.isProper_π
statement: theorem isProper_π [Module.Finite R M] : IsProper (π R M)
proof:
:= by
  have := finiteType_symmetricAlgebra (R := R) (M := M)
  rw [π]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpOf.opensRange_ι
statement:
theorem blowUpOf.opensRange_ι (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (blowUpOf.ι I h U).opensRange = blowUpOf.π I h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= by
  have this : blowUpOf.π I h ⁻¹ᵁ (U.1.ι).opensRange = (blowUpOf.ι I h U).opensRange :=
    (relativeGluingDataOf I h).toBase_preimage_eq_opensRange_ι U
  rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι] at this
  exact this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpOf.chart_π
statement:
theorem blowUpOf.chart_π (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U) :
    blowUpOf.chart I h U a ≫ blowUpOf.π I h =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))) ≫
        (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  unfold blowUpOf.chart
  rw [Category.assoc, blowUpOf.ι_π]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (affineBlowUp.chart (I.ideal U) a), affineBlowUp.chart_π]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpOf.iSup_opensRange_chart
statement:
theorem blowUpOf.iSup_opensRange_chart (U : X.affineOpens) :
    ⨆ a : I.ideal U, (blowUpOf.chart I h U a).opensRange = blowUpOf.π I h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ a : I.ideal U, (blowUpOf.chart I h U a).opensRange =
      blowUpOf.ι I h U ''ᵁ (affineBlowUp.chart (I.ideal U) a).opensRange := fun a =>
    Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp _ _
  simp_rw [h1]
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.image_iSup, affineBlowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart,
    Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, blowUpOf.opensRange_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpOf.chart_preimage_chart
statement:
theorem blowUpOf.chart_preimage_chart (U : X.affineOpens) (a b : I.ideal U) :
    blowUpOf.chart I h U a ⁻¹ᵁ (blowUpOf.chart I h U b).opensRange =
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (I.ideal U) a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold blowUpOf.chart
  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq,
    affineBlowUp.chart_preimage_chart]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpOf.isProper_π
statement: theorem blowUpOf.isProper_π [IsLocallyNoetherian X] : IsProper (blowUpOf.π I h)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_iSup_eq_top (P := @IsProper)
    (fun U : X.affineOpens => (U : X.Opens)) (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top X) fun U => ?_
  have sq := blowUpOf.isPullback I h U
  have he := (isPullback_morphismRestrict (blowUpOf.π I h) U.1).isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ sq
  rw [← he]
  have := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  have h₁ : IsProper (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U)) :=
    affineBlowUp.isProper_π _ (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_forall_comap_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.of_forall_comap_isOpenImmersion
    {ι : Type*} (J : Y.IdealSheafData) {Z : ι → Scheme.{u}} (j : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ Y)
    [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)] (hcov : ∀ y : Y, ∃ i, y ∈ (j i).opensRange)
    (h : ∀ i, (J.comap (j i)).IsInvertible) : J.IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨i, hy⟩ := hcov y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hy
  obtain ⟨V, hzV, g, hg, hJV⟩ := h i z
  refine ⟨⟨j i ''ᵁ V.1, V.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion (j i)⟩, ⟨z, hzV, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  set e := ((j i).appIso V.1).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  let ψ : Γ(Z i, V) →+* Γ(Y, j i ''ᵁ V.1) := e.symm
  have hψ : ((j i).appIso V.1).inv.hom = ψ := RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl
  have hψs : Function.Surjective ψ := e.symm.surjective
  rw [ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion, hψ] at hJV
  refine ⟨ψ g, map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv e.symm hg, ?_⟩
  have h2 := congrArg (Ideal.map ψ) hJV
  rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective ψ hψs, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.comap_exceptionalDivisor_ι
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.comap_exceptionalDivisor_ι (U : X.affineOpens) :
    I.exceptionalDivisor.comap (blowUp.ι I U) =
      affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (I.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.exceptionalDivisor, ← comap_comp, blowUp.ι_π, Category.assoc,
    IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι, comap_comp]
  change (I.comap U.2.fromSpec).comap _ = _
  rw [comap_fromSpec]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_ι
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_ι (b : blowUp I) :
    ∃ U : X.affineOpens, b ∈ (blowUp.ι I U).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (blowUpπ I b)
  exact ⟨U, by rw [blowUp.opensRange_ι]; exact hU⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π
statement: theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π : (I.comap (blowUpπ I)).IsInvertible
proof:
:=
  IsInvertible.of_forall_comap_isOpenImmersion _ (blowUp.ι I) (blowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_ι I)
    fun U => by
      rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.exceptionalDivisor, blowUp.comap_exceptionalDivisor_ι]
      exact affineBlowUp.isInvertible_exceptionalIdeal _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrictToSpec_isoSpec_inv_ι
statement:
theorem restrictToSpec_isoSpec_inv_ι (U : X.affineOpens) :
    restrictToSpec f U ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι = (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictToSpec, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, morphismRestrict_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_specIdealSheaf_restrictToSpec
statement:
theorem comap_specIdealSheaf_restrictToSpec (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (specIdealSheaf (I.ideal U)).comap (restrictToSpec f U) =
      (I.comap f).comap (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [show specIdealSheaf (I.ideal U) = I.comap (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec from
    (comap_fromSpec I U).symm, ← comap_comp, ← comap_comp, ← IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι,
    restrictToSpec_isoSpec_inv_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_comap_restrictToSpec
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_restrictToSpec (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    ((specIdealSheaf (I.ideal U)).comap (restrictToSpec f U)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [comap_specIdealSheaf_restrictToSpec]
  exact hf.comap_of_isOpenImmersion _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.localLift_π
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.localLift_π (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible)
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    blowUp.localLift I f hf U ≫ blowUpπ I = (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowUp.localLift, Category.assoc, blowUp.ι_π, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc,
    affineBlowUp.lift_π, Category.assoc, restrictToSpec_isoSpec_inv_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.range_ι_comp_subset
statement:
theorem range_ι_comp_subset (h : Y ⟶ blowUp I) (hh : h ≫ blowUpπ I = f) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    Set.range ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ h) ⊆ Set.range (blowUp.ι I U)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  change h ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι w) ∈ (blowUp.ι I U).opensRange
  rw [blowUp.opensRange_ι, Scheme.Hom.mem_preimage, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hh]
  exact w.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.lift_comp_π_eq_restrictToSpec
statement:
theorem lift_comp_π_eq_restrictToSpec (h : Y ⟶ blowUp I) (hh : h ≫ blowUpπ I = f)
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsOpenImmersion.lift (blowUp.ι I U) ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ h) (range_ι_comp_subset I f h hh U) ≫
        affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) = restrictToSpec f U
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono ((affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι), Category.assoc,
    restrictToSpec_isoSpec_inv_ι, ← Category.assoc (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U)), ← blowUp.ι_π,
    ← Category.assoc, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac, Category.assoc, hh]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.hom_ext
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.hom_ext (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible) (g g' : Y ⟶ blowUp I)
    (e : g ≫ blowUpπ I = f) (e' : g' ≫ blowUpπ I = f) : g = g'
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.hom_ext_of_forall
  intro y
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (f y)
  refine ⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, hU, ?_⟩
  have key := affineBlowUp.hom_ext (I.ideal U) (restrictToSpec f U)
    (isInvertible_comap_restrictToSpec I f hf U) _ _
    (lift_comp_π_eq_restrictToSpec I f g e U) (lift_comp_π_eq_restrictToSpec I f g' e' U)
  calc (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ g
      = IsOpenImmersion.lift (blowUp.ι I U) ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ g) (range_ι_comp_subset I f g e U) ≫
          blowUp.ι I U := (IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _).symm
    _ = IsOpenImmersion.lift (blowUp.ι I U) ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ g')
          (range_ι_comp_subset I f g' e' U) ≫ blowUp.ι I U := by rw [key]
    _ = (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫ g' := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_lift
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_lift (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ g : Y ⟶ blowUp I, g ≫ blowUpπ I = f
proof:
:= by
  have hcov : IsOpenCover fun U : X.affineOpens => f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := by
    refine top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ?_
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (f z)
    exact ⟨U, hU⟩
  let 𝒰 : Y.OpenCover := Y.openCoverOfIsOpenCover (fun U : X.affineOpens => f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) hcov
  let lifts : ∀ U : 𝒰.I₀, 𝒰.X U ⟶ blowUp I := fun U => blowUp.localLift I f hf U
  have hlifts : ∀ U : 𝒰.I₀, lifts U ≫ blowUpπ I = 𝒰.f U ≫ f := fun U =>
    blowUp.localLift_π I f hf U
  have compat : ∀ U V, pullback.fst (𝒰.f U) (𝒰.f V) ≫ lifts U =
      pullback.snd (𝒰.f U) (𝒰.f V) ≫ lifts V := by
    intro U V
    refine blowUp.hom_ext I (pullback.fst (𝒰.f U) (𝒰.f V) ≫ 𝒰.f U ≫ f) ?_ _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [← Category.assoc, comap_comp]
      exact hf.comap_of_isOpenImmersion _
    · rw [Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun m => pullback.fst (𝒰.f U) (𝒰.f V) ≫ m) (hlifts U)
    · rw [Category.assoc]
      refine (congrArg (fun m => pullback.snd (𝒰.f U) (𝒰.f V) ≫ m) (hlifts V)).trans ?_
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨𝒰.glueMorphisms lifts compat, 𝒰.hom_ext _ _ fun U => ?_⟩
  rw [← Category.assoc, Scheme.Cover.ι_glueMorphisms]
  exact hlifts U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.existsUnique_lift
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.existsUnique_lift (hf : (I.comap f).IsInvertible) :
    ∃! g : Y ⟶ blowUp I, g ≫ blowUpπ I = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := blowUp.exists_lift I f hf
  exact ⟨g, hg, fun g' hg' => blowUp.hom_ext I f hf g' g hg' hg⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isBlowUp
statement: theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isBlowUp : IsBlowUp I (blowUpπ I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I, fun f hf => blowUp.existsUnique_lift I f hf⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.iUnion_range_chart
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.iUnion_range_chart :
    ⋃ a : I.ideal U, Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a) = (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 : Set (blowUp I))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← blowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart, Opens.coe_iSup]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.range_chart_subset
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.range_chart_subset (a : I.ideal U) :
    Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a) ⊆ (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 : Set (blowUp I))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← blowUp.iUnion_range_chart]
  exact Set.subset_iUnion (fun a : I.ideal U => Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a)) a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.iUnion_range_chart_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.iUnion_range_chart_of_span_eq (s : Set (I.ideal U))
    (hs : Ideal.span (Subtype.val '' s) = I.ideal U) :
    ⋃ a ∈ s, Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a) = (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 : Set (blowUp I))
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.iUnion₂_subset fun a _ => blowUp.range_chart_subset I U a) ?_
  intro x' hx'
  have hx'' : x' ∈ (blowUp.ι I U).opensRange := by
    rw [blowUp.opensRange_ι]
    exact hx'
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hx''
  obtain ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, hy⟩ :=
    affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq (I.ideal U) (Subtype.val '' s) hs y
  obtain ⟨a, has, rfl⟩ := hz
  have hsub : ∀ h : (a : Γ(X, U)) ∈ I.ideal U, (⟨(a : Γ(X, U)), h⟩ : I.ideal U) = a :=
    fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl
  rw [hsub] at hy
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hy
  refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a, has, w, ?_⟩
  rw [blowUp.chart_eq, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hw]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.preimage_range_chart
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.preimage_range_chart (a b : I.ideal U) :
    blowUp.chart I U a ⁻¹' Set.range (blowUp.chart I U b) =
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac (a := (a : Γ(X, U))) b.2) :
        Set (PrimeSpectrum (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg SetLike.coe (blowUp.chart_preimage_chart I U a b)
  have hfrac : affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (I.ideal U) a b =
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac (a := (a : Γ(X, U))) b.2 :=
    Subtype.ext (affineBlowUpAlgebra.coe_frac_eq_awayFrac _).symm
  rw [hfrac] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.fromSpec_stalkMap_germ
statement:
theorem fromSpec_stalkMap_germ (p : Spec Γ(X, U))
    (hp : (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec p ∈ U.1) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec.stalkMap p
        (X.presheaf.germ U.1 ((affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec p) hp a) =
      specGerm p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_app_self_apply, specGerm_apply]
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _
    (eqToHom (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec_preimage_self) p hp _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMap_ι_stalkMap_π
statement:
theorem stalkMap_ι_stalkMap_π (y : affineBlowUp (I.ideal U))
    (hy : blowUpπ I (blowUp.ι I U y) ∈ U.1) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    (blowUp.ι I U).stalkMap y ((blowUpπ I).stalkMap (blowUp.ι I U y)
        (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (blowUpπ I (blowUp.ι I U y)) hy a)) =
      (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U)).stalkMap y (specGerm (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) y) a)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : blowUp.ι I U ≫ blowUpπ I =
      affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec := by
    rw [blowUp.ι_π, Category.assoc, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]
  have key : ∀ f : affineBlowUp (I.ideal U) ⟶ X,
      f = affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec →
      ∀ hfy : f y ∈ U.1, f.stalkMap y (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (f y) hfy a) =
        (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U)).stalkMap y (specGerm (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) y) a) := by
    rintro f rfl hfy
    have h2 := congrArg (fun φ : X.presheaf.stalk
          ((affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec) y) ⟶
          (affineBlowUp (I.ideal U)).presheaf.stalk y =>
        φ (X.presheaf.germ U.1
          ((affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec) y) hfy a))
      (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U))
        (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).fromSpec y)
    refine h2.trans ?_
    exact congrArg (fun t => (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U)).stalkMap y t)
      (fromSpec_stalkMap_germ U _ hfy a)
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ : X.presheaf.stalk ((blowUp.ι I U ≫ blowUpπ I) y) ⟶
        (affineBlowUp (I.ideal U)).presheaf.stalk y =>
      φ (X.presheaf.germ U.1 ((blowUp.ι I U ≫ blowUpπ I) y) hy a))
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp (blowUp.ι I U) (blowUpπ I) y)
  exact h1.symm.trans (key _ hcomp hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.mem_range_chart_iff
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.mem_range_chart_iff (a : I.ideal U) (x' : blowUp I)
    (hx' : blowUpπ I x' ∈ U.1) :
    x' ∈ Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a) ↔
      I.exceptionalDivisor.stalkIdeal x' =
        Ideal.span {(blowUpπ I).stalkMap x' (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (blowUpπ I x') hx' a)}
proof:
:= by
  have hx'' : x' ∈ (blowUp.ι I U).opensRange := by
    rw [blowUp.opensRange_ι]
    exact hx'
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hx''
  set j := blowUp.ι I U
  have hL : j y ∈ Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a) ↔
      y ∈ (affineBlowUp.chart (I.ideal U) a).opensRange := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      rw [blowUp.chart_eq, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at hz
      exact ⟨z, j.injective hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      exact ⟨z, by rw [blowUp.chart_eq, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hz]⟩
  set σ : (blowUp I).presheaf.stalk (j y) ≃+* (affineBlowUp (I.ideal U)).presheaf.stalk y :=
    (asIso (j.stalkMap y)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with hσ_def
  have hσ : (j.stalkMap y).hom = (σ : (blowUp I).presheaf.stalk (j y) →+*
      (affineBlowUp (I.ideal U)).presheaf.stalk y) := rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Ideal.map (σ : (blowUp I).presheaf.stalk (j y) →+*
      (affineBlowUp (I.ideal U)).presheaf.stalk y)) := by
    intro A B h
    rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv, Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv] at h
    exact Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _ σ.symm.surjective h
  rw [hL, affineBlowUp.mem_chart_iff, ← hinj.eq_iff, ← hσ, ← stalkIdeal_comap,
    blowUp.comap_exceptionalDivisor_ι, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    stalkMap_ι_stalkMap_π I U y hx' a]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.chart_eq
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.chart_eq (U : X.affineOpens) (a : I.ideal U) :
    blowUp.chart I U a = affineBlowUp.chart (I.ideal U) a ≫ blowUp.ι I U
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.ι_π
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.ι_π (U : X.affineOpens) :
    blowUp.ι I U ≫ blowUpπ I =
      (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv) ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:=
  blowUpOf.ι_π I _ U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isPullback_ι
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isPullback_ι (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv)
      (blowUp.ι I U) U.1.ι (blowUpπ I)
proof:
:=
  blowUpOf.isPullback I _ U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.opensRange_ι
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.opensRange_ι (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (blowUp.ι I U).opensRange = blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.chart_π

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isInvertible_comap_of_isInvertible

theorem blowUp.isInvertible_comap_of_isInvertible (K : X.IdealSheafData) (hK : K.IsInvertible) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π_comp

proof:

  exact blowUp.isInvertible_comap_of_isInvertible _ _ (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.existsUnique_lift_comp
statement:
theorem blowUp.existsUnique_lift_comp {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : ((I * J).comap f).IsInvertible) :
    ∃! g : Y ⟶ blowUp (J.comap (blowUpπ I)),
      g ≫ (blowUpπ (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ≫ blowUpπ I) = f
proof:
:=
  AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_lift_comp I J (blowUpπ I) (blowUpπ (J.comap (blowUpπ I)))
    (fun f hf => blowUp.existsUnique_lift I f hf)
    (fun f hf => blowUp.existsUnique_lift (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) f hf) f hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isBlowUp_comp
statement: theorem blowUp.isBlowUp_comp : IsBlowUp (I * J) (blowUpπ (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ≫ blowUpπ I)
proof:
:=
  (blowUp.isBlowUp I).comp (blowUp.isBlowUp _) (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π_comp I J)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_mulIso
statement:
theorem blowUp.exists_mulIso :
    ∃ e : blowUp (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ≅ blowUp (I * J),
      e.hom ≫ blowUpπ (I * J) = blowUpπ (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ≫ blowUpπ I ∧
      ∀ ψ : blowUp (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ⟶ blowUp (I * J),
        ψ ≫ blowUpπ (I * J) = blowUpπ (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ≫ blowUpπ I → ψ = e.hom
proof:
:=
  exists_iso_of_universal (I * J) _ (blowUpπ (I * J)) (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_mul_π_comp I J)
    (fun f hf => blowUp.existsUnique_lift_comp I J f hf) (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π (I * J))
    (fun f hf => blowUp.existsUnique_lift (I * J) f hf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.mulIso_hom_π
statement:
theorem blowUp.mulIso_hom_π :
    (blowUp.mulIso I J).hom ≫ blowUpπ (I * J) = blowUpπ (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ≫ blowUpπ I
proof:
:=
  (blowUp.exists_mulIso I J).choose_spec.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.eq_mulIso_hom
statement:
theorem blowUp.eq_mulIso_hom (ψ : blowUp (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ⟶ blowUp (I * J))
    (hψ : ψ ≫ blowUpπ (I * J) = blowUpπ (J.comap (blowUpπ I)) ≫ blowUpπ I) :
    ψ = (blowUp.mulIso I J).hom
proof:
:=
  (blowUp.exists_mulIso I J).choose_spec.2 ψ hψ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_powIso
statement:
theorem blowUp.exists_powIso (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∃ e : blowUp (I ^ m) ≅ blowUp I, e.hom ≫ blowUpπ I = blowUpπ (I ^ m) ∧
      ∀ ψ : blowUp (I ^ m) ⟶ blowUp I, ψ ≫ blowUpπ I = blowUpπ (I ^ m) → ψ = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hm
  rw [pow_succ']
  have hinv : ((I ^ k).comap (blowUpπ I)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [comap_pow]; exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_pow (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I) k
  have : IsIso (blowUpπ ((I ^ k).comap (blowUpπ I))) := blowUp.isIso_π_of_isInvertible _ hinv
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁, -⟩ := blowUp.exists_mulIso I (I ^ k)
  set e : blowUp (I * I ^ k) ≅ blowUp I :=
    e₁.symm ≪≫ asIso (blowUpπ ((I ^ k).comap (blowUpπ I))) with he_def
  have he : e.hom ≫ blowUpπ I = blowUpπ (I * I ^ k) := by
    simp only [he_def, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
    rw [← he₁, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  refine ⟨e, he, fun ψ hψ => ?_⟩
  have h := blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π (I * I ^ k)
  rw [comap_mul] at h
  exact blowUp.hom_ext I (blowUpπ (I * I ^ k)) (IsInvertible.of_mul h).1 ψ e.hom hψ he

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_comap_of_isIso
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_comap_of_isIso (J : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (e : Y ⟶ Z) [IsIso e] : (J.comap e).map e = J
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_map_comap (f := e) J)
  calc (J.comap e).map e = (((J.comap e).map e).comap e).comap (inv e) := by
        rw [← comap_comp, IsIso.inv_hom_id, comap_id]
    _ ≤ (J.comap e).comap (inv e) := comap_mono (f := inv e) (comap_map_le (f := e) _)
    _ = J := by rw [← comap_comp, IsIso.inv_hom_id, comap_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isIso_π_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isIso_π_of_isInvertible (h : I.IsInvertible) : IsIso
    (blowUpπ I)
proof:
:= by
  have hid : (I.comap (𝟙 X)).IsInvertible := by rw [comap_id]; exact h
  refine ⟨⟨blowUp.lift I (𝟙 X) hid, ?_, blowUp.lift_π I (𝟙 X) hid⟩⟩
  exact blowUp.hom_ext I (blowUpπ I) (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I) _ _
    (by rw [Category.assoc, blowUp.lift_π, Category.comp_id]) (Category.id_comp _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.map_exceptionalDivisor_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.map_exceptionalDivisor_of_isInvertible (h : I.IsInvertible) :
    I.exceptionalDivisor.map (blowUpπ I) = I
proof:
:= by
  have := blowUp.isIso_π_of_isInvertible I h
  exact map_comap_of_isIso I (blowUpπ I)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isIso_π_top
statement: theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isIso_π_top : IsIso (blowUpπ (⊤ : X.IdealSheafData))
proof:
:=
  blowUp.isIso_π_of_isInvertible ⊤ isInvertible_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_ι_compl_support_eq_top
statement:
theorem comap_ι_compl_support_eq_top :
    I.comap (Scheme.Opens.ι (I.support.compl : X.Opens)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← support_eq_bot_iff, support_comap]
  refine SetLike.ext fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => (Set.notMem_empty x hx).elim⟩
  have hmem : Scheme.Opens.ι (I.support.compl : X.Opens) x ∈
      ((I.support.compl : X.Opens) : Set X) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact absurd (SetLike.mem_coe.mpr hx) hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isIso_π_restrict_compl_support
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isIso_π_restrict_compl_support : IsIso
    (blowUpπ I ∣_ I.support.compl)
proof:
:= by
  set W : X.Opens := I.support.compl with hW_def
  have hadm : (I.comap W.ι).IsInvertible := by
    rw [comap_ι_compl_support_eq_top]
    exact isInvertible_top
  set s := blowUp.lift I W.ι hadm with hs_def
  have hrange : Set.range s ⊆ Set.range (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι := by
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    change blowUpπ I (s w) ∈ W
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowUp.lift_π]
    have hw : W.ι w ∈ (W : Set X) := by
      rw [← Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
      exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact hw
  set s' := IsOpenImmersion.lift (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι s hrange with hs'_def
  have hs' : s' ≫ (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = s := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  have hadm' : (I.comap ((blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ blowUpπ I)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [comap_comp]
    exact (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I).comap_of_isOpenImmersion _
  refine ⟨⟨s', ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [← cancel_mono (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι, Category.assoc, hs', Category.id_comp]
    exact blowUp.hom_ext I _ hadm' _ _
      (by rw [Category.assoc, blowUp.lift_π, morphismRestrict_ι]) rfl
  · rw [← cancel_mono W.ι, Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, ← Category.assoc, hs',
      blowUp.lift_π, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isEmpty_of_forall
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isEmpty_of_forall (h : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, IsEmpty
    (affineBlowUp (I.ideal U))) :
    IsEmpty (blowUp I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun b => by
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := blowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_ι I b
    obtain ⟨b', -⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hU
    exact (h U).elim b'⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isEmpty_bot
statement: theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isEmpty_bot : IsEmpty (blowUp (⊥ : X.IdealSheafData))
proof:
:=
  blowUp.isEmpty_of_forall ⊥ fun U => affineBlowUp.isEmpty_bot (R := Γ(X, U))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_π_eq_of_notMem_support
proof:
:= by
  set W : X.Opens := Z.support.compl with hW
  have hxW : x ∈ (W : Set X) := hx
  have := blowUp.isIso_π_restrict_compl_support Z
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (Scheme.Opens.range_ι W).symm ▸ hxW
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (blowUpπ Z ∣_ W).homeomorph.surjective w
  refine ⟨(blowUpπ Z ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι v, ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.Hom.homeomorph_apply] at hv
  rw [← hw, ← hv, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, morphismRestrict_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_mapIso
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_mapIso (e : X ≅ Y) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (hIJ : I = J.comap e.hom) :
    ∃ φ : blowUp I ≅ blowUp J,
      φ.hom ≫ blowUpπ J = blowUpπ I ≫ e.hom ∧
      ∀ ψ : blowUp I ⟶ blowUp J, ψ ≫ blowUpπ J = blowUpπ I ≫ e.hom → ψ = φ.hom
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (J.comap (blowUpπ I ≫ e.hom)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [comap_comp, ← hIJ]
    exact blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I
  have hJI : J = I.comap e.inv := by
    rw [hIJ, ← comap_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, comap_id]
  have h2 : (I.comap (blowUpπ J ≫ e.inv)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [comap_comp, ← hJI]
    exact blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π J
  refine ⟨⟨blowUp.lift J _ h1, blowUp.lift I _ h2, ?_, ?_⟩, blowUp.lift_π J _ h1,
    fun ψ hψ => blowUp.eq_lift J _ h1 ψ hψ⟩
  · exact blowUp.hom_ext I (blowUpπ I) (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I) _ _
      (by rw [Category.assoc, blowUp.lift_π, ← Category.assoc, blowUp.lift_π, Category.assoc,
        Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]) (Category.id_comp _)
  · exact blowUp.hom_ext J (blowUpπ J) (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π J) _ _
      (by rw [Category.assoc, blowUp.lift_π, ← Category.assoc, blowUp.lift_π, Category.assoc,
        Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]) (Category.id_comp _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineBlowUpFunctor_obj (U : X.affineOpens) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpFunctor_map
statement:
theorem affineBlowUpFunctor_map {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ⟶ V) :
    (affineBlowUpFunctor I).map h =
      affineBlowUp.mapHom (R := Γ(X, V)) (S := Γ(X, U)) (I := I.ideal V) (J := I.ideal U)
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h.le).op) (I.map_ideal h.le)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpNatTrans_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineBlowUpNatTrans_app (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (affineBlowUpNatTrans I).app U =
      affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specMap_presheaf_map_isoSpec_inv
statement:
theorem specMap_presheaf_map_isoSpec_inv {U V : X.affineOpens} (hle : U ≤ V) :
    Spec.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X := X.Opens) hle).op) ≫
        (affineOpens_isAffineOpen V).isoSpec.inv =
      (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv ≫ X.homOfLE (show (U : X.Opens) ≤ V from hle)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp, ← Category.assoc, Iso.comp_inv_eq, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom,
    IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom]
  exact Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map _ _ hle

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specMap_presheaf_map_eq
statement:
theorem specMap_presheaf_map_eq {U V : X.affineOpens} (hle : U ≤ V) :
    Spec.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X := X.Opens) hle).op) =
      ((affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv ≫
        X.homOfLE (show (U : X.Opens) ≤ V from hle)) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen V).isoSpec.hom
proof:
:=
  (Iso.comp_inv_eq _).mp (specMap_presheaf_map_isoSpec_inv hle)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.equifibered_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem equifibered_of_isPullback
    (H : ∀ {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map φ)] {I : Ideal R}
      {J : Ideal S} (hJ : I.map φ.hom = J),
      IsPullback (affineBlowUp.mapHom φ hJ) (affineBlowUp.π J) (affineBlowUp.π I) (Spec.map φ)) :
    (affineBlowUpNatTrans I).Equifibered
proof:
:= by
  intro U V h
  have hle : U ≤ V := h.le
  have hle' : (U : X.Opens) ≤ V := hle
  obtain rfl : h = homOfLE hle := (homOfLE_leOfHom h).symm
  change IsPullback (affineBlowUp.mapHom (R := Γ(X, V)) (S := Γ(X, U)) (I := I.ideal V)
      (J := I.ideal U) (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X := X.Opens) hle).op) (I.map_ideal hle))
    (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv)
    (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal V) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen V).isoSpec.inv) (X.homOfLE hle')
  have hφ := isOpenImmersion_specMap_presheaf_map hle
  exact (@H _ _ _ hφ _ _ (I.map_ideal hle)).paste_vert
    (IsPullback.of_vert_isIso ⟨specMap_presheaf_map_isoSpec_inv hle⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpOf.ι_π
statement:
theorem blowUpOf.ι_π (U : X.affineOpens) :
    blowUpOf.ι I h U ≫ blowUpOf.π I h =
      (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv) ≫ U.1.ι
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.blowUpOf.isPullback
statement:
theorem blowUpOf.isPullback (U : X.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (affineBlowUp.π (I.ideal U) ≫ (affineOpens_isAffineOpen U).isoSpec.inv)
      (blowUpOf.ι I h U) U.1.ι (blowUpOf.π I h)
proof:

  (relativeGluingDataOf I h).isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.range_restrictHom_subset
statement:
theorem range_restrictHom_subset :
    Set.range (blowUpMap U.ι I) ⊆ Set.range (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
  change blowUpπ I (blowUpMap U.ι I x) ∈ U
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, blowUpMap_π, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have hw : U.ι (blowUpπ (I.comap U.ι) x) ∈ (U : Set X) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  exact hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrictHomToPreimage_ι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem restrictHomToPreimage_ι :
    restrictHomToPreimage I U ≫ (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = blowUpMap U.ι I
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_comap_morphismRestrict
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_morphismRestrict :
    ((I.comap U.ι).comap (blowUpπ I ∣_ U)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comap_comp, morphismRestrict_ι, comap_comp]
  exact (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I).comap_of_isOpenImmersion _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.preimageToRestrict_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem preimageToRestrict_π :
    preimageToRestrict I U ≫ blowUpπ (I.comap U.ι) = blowUpπ I ∣_ U
proof:
:=
  blowUp.lift_π _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.preimageToRestrict_restrictHom
statement:
theorem preimageToRestrict_restrictHom :
    preimageToRestrict I U ≫ blowUpMap U.ι I = (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
proof:
:= by
  refine blowUp.hom_ext I ((blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ blowUpπ I) ?_ _ _ ?_ rfl
  · rw [comap_comp]
    exact (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I).comap_of_isOpenImmersion _
  · rw [Category.assoc, blowUpMap_π, preimageToRestrict_π_assoc, morphismRestrict_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.preimageToRestrict_restrictHomToPreimage
statement:
theorem preimageToRestrict_restrictHomToPreimage :
    preimageToRestrict I U ≫ restrictHomToPreimage I U = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι, Category.assoc, restrictHomToPreimage_ι,
    preimageToRestrict_restrictHom, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrictHomToPreimage_morphismRestrict
statement:
theorem restrictHomToPreimage_morphismRestrict :
    restrictHomToPreimage I U ≫ (blowUpπ I ∣_ U) = blowUpπ (I.comap U.ι)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono U.ι, Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, restrictHomToPreimage_ι_assoc,
    blowUpMap_π]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrictHomToPreimage_preimageToRestrict
statement:
theorem restrictHomToPreimage_preimageToRestrict :
    restrictHomToPreimage I U ≫ preimageToRestrict I U = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine blowUp.hom_ext (I.comap U.ι) (blowUpπ (I.comap U.ι))
    (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π _) _ _ ?_ (Category.id_comp _)
  rw [Category.assoc, preimageToRestrict_π, restrictHomToPreimage_morphismRestrict]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isPullback_restrictHom
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isPullback_restrictHom :
    IsPullback (blowUpMap U.ι I) (blowUpπ (I.comap U.ι)) (blowUpπ I) U.ι
proof:
:= by
  refine (isPullback_morphismRestrict (blowUpπ I) U).flip.of_iso (blowUp.restrictIso I U).symm
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom]
    exact (preimageToRestrict_restrictHom I U).symm
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom]
    exact (preimageToRestrict_π I U).symm
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_isPullback_restrict
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_isPullback_restrict :
    ∃ φ : blowUp (I.comap U.ι) ⟶ blowUp I,

proof:
:=
  ⟨_, blowUp.isPullback_restrictHom I U⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_comap_π_comp
statement: theorem isInvertible_comap_π_comp : (D.comap (blowUpπ (D.comap h) ≫ h)).IsInvertible
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_map_of_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem comap_map_of_isClosedImmersion (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (Z : Y.IdealSheafData) :
    (Z.map j).comap j = Z
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hfac : (Z.subschemeι ≫ j).toImage ≫ (Z.map j).subschemeι = Z.subschemeι ≫ j :=
    (Z.subschemeι ≫ j).toImage_imageι
  
  have hpb : IsPullback Z.subschemeι (Z.subschemeι ≫ j).toImage j (Z.map j).subschemeι :=
    IsPullback.of_vert_isIso_mono ⟨hfac.symm⟩
  
  have hf : pullback.fst j (Z.map j).subschemeι = hpb.isoPullback.inv ≫ Z.subschemeι :=
    hpb.isoPullback_inv_fst.symm
  calc (Z.map j).comap j = (pullback.fst j (Z.map j).subschemeι).ker := rfl
    _ = (hpb.isoPullback.inv ≫ Z.subschemeι).ker := congrArg Scheme.Hom.ker hf
    _ = Z.subschemeι.ker := Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso _ _
    _ = Z := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι Z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.X_mem_centerIdeal
statement: theorem X_mem_centerIdeal {j : Fin n} (hj : j.val < r) : X j ∈ centerIdeal A n r
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem X hj)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.centerIdeal_le_comap_chartSubst
statement:
theorem centerIdeal_le_comap_chartSubst (j : Fin n) :
    centerIdeal A n r ≤
      (Ideal.span {(X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)}).comap
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst A (center n r) j).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [centerIdeal, affineBlowUpAlgebra.coordinateIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    rw [affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst_X_self]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  · rw [affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst_X_of_mem A (center n r) j hi hij]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.chartSubst_X
statement:
theorem chartSubst_X (j i : Fin n) :
    chartSubst A (center n r) j (X i) = if i.val < r ∧ i ≠ j then X i * X j else X i
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact chartSubst_X_of_mem A (center n r) j h.1 h.2
  · exact chartSubst_X_of_not A (center n r) j h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.chartRingIso_hom_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem chartRingIso_hom_comp_algebraMap (j : Fin n) :
    (chartRingIso A n r j).hom.hom.comp
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (centerIdeal A n r) (X j))) =
      (chartSubst A (center n r) j).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
  · simp only [chartRingIso, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
      RingHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toRingEquiv, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
    rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, AlgEquiv.commutes,
      AlgHom.commutes]
  · simp only [chartRingIso, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
      RingHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toRingEquiv, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
    by_cases h : i.val < r ∧ i ≠ j
    · rw [coordinateSubspaceEquiv_algebraMap_X_of_mem A (center n r) j h.1 h.2,
        chartSubst_X_of_mem A (center n r) j h.1 h.2]
    · rw [coordinateSubspaceEquiv_algebraMap_X_of_not A (center n r) j h,
        chartSubst_X_of_not A (center n r) j h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.modelChart_π
statement:
theorem modelChart_π (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r) :
    modelChart A n r j hj ≫ affineBlowUp.π (centerIdeal A n r) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartSubst A (center n r) j).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelChart, Category.assoc, affineBlowUp.chart_π, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext ?_
  rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
  exact chartRingIso_hom_comp_algebraMap A n r j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.opensRange_modelChart
statement:
theorem opensRange_modelChart (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r) :
    (modelChart A n r j hj).opensRange =
      (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) ⟨X j, X_mem_centerIdeal A n r hj⟩).opensRange
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp_of_isIso _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.iSup_opensRange_modelChart
statement:
theorem iSup_opensRange_modelChart :
    ⨆ (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r), (modelChart A n r j hj).opensRange = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hx⟩ := affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq
    (centerIdeal A n r) (X '' center n r) rfl x
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hy
  refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨j, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨hj, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [opensRange_modelChart]
  exact hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ratio_eq_frac
statement:
theorem ratio_eq_frac (j ℓ : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r) (hℓ : ℓ.val < r) :
    affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (centerIdeal A n r) ⟨X j, X_mem_centerIdeal A n r hj⟩
        ⟨X ℓ, X_mem_centerIdeal A n r hℓ⟩ =
      frac (a := X j) (X_mem_centerIdeal A n r hℓ)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (coe_frac_eq_awayFrac _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.chartRingIso_hom_ratio
statement:
theorem chartRingIso_hom_ratio (j ℓ : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r) (hℓ : ℓ.val < r) (hjℓ : j ≠ ℓ) :
    (chartRingIso A n r j).hom.hom
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio (centerIdeal A n r) ⟨X j, X_mem_centerIdeal A n r hj⟩
          ⟨X ℓ, X_mem_centerIdeal A n r hℓ⟩) = X ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [ratio_eq_frac A n r j ℓ hj hℓ]
  exact coordinateSubspaceEquiv_frac A (center n r) j hℓ (Ne.symm hjℓ) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.modelChart_preimage_modelChart
statement:
theorem modelChart_preimage_modelChart (j ℓ : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r) (hℓ : ℓ.val < r)
    (hjℓ : j ≠ ℓ) :
    modelChart A n r j hj ⁻¹ᵁ (modelChart A n r ℓ hℓ).opensRange =
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (X ℓ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [opensRange_modelChart, modelChart, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    affineBlowUp.chart_preimage_chart, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen,
    chartRingIso_hom_ratio A n r j ℓ hj hℓ hjℓ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.modelTransition_X
statement:
theorem modelTransition_X (j ℓ : Fin n) (i : Fin n) :
    modelTransition A n r j ℓ (X i) =
      if i = ℓ then
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (Localization.Away (X ℓ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))
          (X j * X ℓ)
      else if i = j then IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (X ℓ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
      else if i.val < r then
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (Localization.Away (X ℓ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))
            (X i) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (X ℓ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
      else algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (Localization.Away (X ℓ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))
        (X i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelTransition, aeval_X]

name: HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_eq_zero_iff_of_isRegular
statement:
theorem HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_eq_zero_iff_of_isRegular {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] {f : A} {d : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hreg : IsRegular f) (k : ℕ) (x : A) (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 (k • d)) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 hf k x hx = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val h
    rw [Away.val_mk, val_zero, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at h'
    obtain ⟨⟨_, m, rfl⟩, hm⟩ := h'
    exact (hreg.pow m).left (show f ^ m * x = f ^ m * 0 by rw [hm, mul_zero])
  · rintro rfl
    exact mk_eq_zero_of_num _ rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.chartInitialMap_surjective
statement: theorem chartInitialMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (chartInitialMap A n r hrn a)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨k, F, hF, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective _
    (map_mem (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn) (degreeOne_mem a)) z
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpF⟩ := exists_reesInitial_eq A n r hrn hF
  refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (degreeOne_mem a) k p hp, ?_⟩
  rw [chartInitialMap, Away.map_mk]
  subst hpF
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.chartQuotientMap_surjective
statement: theorem chartQuotientMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a)
proof:
:=
  (chartInitialMap_surjective A n r hrn a).comp (chartRingEquiv a).symm.surjective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.isRegular_reesInitialGraded_degreeOne
statement:
theorem isRegular_reesInitialGraded_degreeOne :
    IsRegular (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn (degreeOne (centerIdeal A n r) a))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, hamem⟩ := a
  subst ha
  rw [coe_reesInitialGraded, reesInitial_degreeOne_genX A n r hrn j hj]
  exact isRegular_X

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ker_chartInitialMap
statement:
theorem ker_chartInitialMap :
    RingHom.ker (chartInitialMap A n r hrn a) =
      Ideal.span
        {fromZeroRingHom (grading (centerIdeal A n r))
          (Submonoid.powers (degreeOne (centerIdeal A n r) a))
          ((gradingZeroEquiv (centerIdeal A n r)).symm (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))}
proof:
:= by
  have hreg := isRegular_reesInitialGraded_degreeOne A n r hrn a j hj ha
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨k, p, hp, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective _ (degreeOne_mem a) z
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, chartInitialMap, Away.map_mk,
      Away.mk_eq_zero_iff_of_isRegular _ _ hreg] at hz
    obtain ⟨hpc, hc⟩ := eq_monomial_of_mem_grading hp
    set c := ((p : reesAlgebra (centerIdeal A n r)) : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)).coeff
      (k • 1) with hc_def
    have hp_eq : p = ⟨Polynomial.monomial (k • 1) c, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hc⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext hpc
    have hc' : c ∈ centerIdeal A n r ^ (k • 1 + 1) := by
      rw [← reesInitial_mk_monomial_eq_zero_iff A n r hrn hc, ← hp_eq]
      exact hz
    have hk : (k + 1) • 1 = k • 1 + 1 := by simp
    refine Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr
      ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (degreeOne_mem a) (k + 1)
        ⟨Polynomial.monomial (k • 1 + 1) c, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hc'⟩
        (mem_grading_of_coe_eq_monomial (by rw [hk])), ?_⟩
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.ext_iff_val, val_mul, Away.val_mk, Away.val_mk,
      reesAlgebra.val_fromZeroRingHom, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, Localization.mk_mul,
      Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [Submonoid.coe_one, one_mul, mul_one, Subalgebra.coe_mul,
      Subalgebra.coe_pow, reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne, reesAlgebra.coe_gradingZeroEquiv_symm, hpc,
      Polynomial.monomial_pow, Polynomial.monomial_mul_C, Polynomial.monomial_mul_monomial]
    rw [Polynomial.monomial_eq_monomial_iff]
    left
    refine ⟨?_, by ring⟩
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, RingHom.mem_ker, chartInitialMap,
      Away.map_fromZeroRingHom]
    have h0 : GradedRingHom.zeroRingHom (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn)
        ((gradingZeroEquiv (centerIdeal A n r)).symm (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [GradedRingHom.coe_zeroRingHom_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
      change reesInitial A n r hrn (algebraMap _ _ (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) = 0
      rw [reesInitial_algebraMap, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr a.2, C_0]
    rw [h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ker_chartQuotientMap
statement:
theorem ker_chartQuotientMap :
    RingHom.ker (chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a) =
      Ideal.span
        {algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (centerIdeal A n r) a)
          (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, chartQuotientMap, RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, ← RingHom.mem_ker, ker_chartInitialMap A n r hrn a j hj ha,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton', Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨chartRingEquiv a c, ?_⟩
    rw [← chartRingEquiv_fromZeroRingHom, ← map_mul, hc, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(chartRingEquiv a).symm c, ?_⟩
    rw [← chartRingEquiv_fromZeroRingHom, map_mul, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.awayι_projInitial
statement:
theorem awayι_projInitial :
    Proj.awayι _ (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn (degreeOne (centerIdeal A n r) a))
        (map_mem (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn) (degreeOne_mem a)) one_pos ≫
      projInitial A n r hrn =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a)) ≫
      affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [projInitial, Proj.awayι_comp_map _ _ one_pos _ (degreeOne_mem a), affineBlowUp.chart,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun x => ?_)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.comp_apply, chartIso,
    chartQuotientMap, chartInitialMap, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.projInitial_preimage_opensRange_chart
statement:
theorem projInitial_preimage_opensRange_chart :
    projInitial A n r hrn ⁻¹ᵁ (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a).opensRange =
      (Proj.awayι _ (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn (degreeOne (centerIdeal A n r) a))
        (map_mem (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn) (degreeOne_mem a)) one_pos).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineBlowUp.opensRange_chart, Proj.opensRange_awayι]
  exact Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.isPullback_chart
statement:
theorem isPullback_chart :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a)))
      (Proj.awayι _ (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn (degreeOne (centerIdeal A n r) a))
        (map_mem (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn) (degreeOne_mem a)) one_pos)
      (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a) (projInitial A n r hrn)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (awayι_projInitial A n r hrn a)
    (projInitial_preimage_opensRange_chart A n r hrn a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.isClosedImmersion_pullback_snd_chart
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_pullback_snd_chart :
    IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (projInitial A n r hrn)
      (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a))
proof:
:= by
  have H := (isPullback_chart A n r hrn a).flip
  have hsnd : pullback.snd (projInitial A n r hrn) (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a) =
      H.isoPullback.inv ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a)) :=
    (Iso.eq_inv_comp _).mpr H.isoPullback_hom_snd
  have : IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a))) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (chartQuotientMap_surjective A n r hrn a)
  rw [hsnd]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ideal_comap_ker_projInitial_chart_top
statement:
theorem ideal_comap_ker_projInitial_chart_top :
    ((projInitial A n r hrn).ker.comap (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a)).ideal
        ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ =
      Ideal.span {affineBlowUp.chartGenerator (centerIdeal A n r) a}
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (projInitial A n r hrn).ker.comap (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a))).ker := by
    rw [← ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion (projInitial A n r hrn),
      ← (isPullback_chart A n r hrn a).isoPullback_inv_fst, Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso]
  rw [h1, Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
  change RingHom.ker (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a))).appTop.hom = _
  rw [ker_appTop_Spec_map, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, ker_chartQuotientMap A n r hrn a j hj ha,
    Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
