name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ker_projInitial_ideal_image_chart
statement:
theorem ker_projInitial_ideal_image_chart :
    (projInitial A n r hrn).ker.ideal
        ⟨affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a ''ᵁ ⊤,
          (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩ =
      (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)).ideal
        ⟨affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a ''ᵁ ⊤,
          (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hk := ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion (projInitial A n r hrn).ker
    (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a) ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  have he := ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r))
    (affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a) ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  have hk' := (ideal_comap_ker_projInitial_chart_top A n r hrn a j hj ha).symm.trans hk
  have he' :=
    (affineBlowUp.ideal_comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart_top (centerIdeal A n r) a).symm.trans he
  have hf : Function.Surjective ((affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) a).appIso ⊤).inv.hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).2
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hf x
  exact ((SetLike.ext_iff.mp hk' y).trans Ideal.mem_comap).symm.trans
    ((SetLike.ext_iff.mp he' y).trans Ideal.mem_comap)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ker_projInitial
statement:
theorem ker_projInitial :
    (projInitial A n r hrn).ker = affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)
proof:
:= by
  have hcover : ⨆ y : X '' center n r,
      ((⟨affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) ⟨y.1, Ideal.subset_span y.2⟩ ''ᵁ ⊤,
        (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩ : (modelBlowUp A n r).affineOpens) :
          (modelBlowUp A n r).Opens) = ⊤ := by
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
    exact affineBlowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq (centerIdeal A n r) (X '' center n r) rfl
  have key : ∀ y : X '' center n r,
      (projInitial A n r hrn).ker.ideal
          ⟨affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) ⟨y.1, Ideal.subset_span y.2⟩ ''ᵁ ⊤,
            (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩ =
        (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)).ideal
          ⟨affineBlowUp.chart (centerIdeal A n r) ⟨y.1, Ideal.subset_span y.2⟩ ''ᵁ ⊤,
            (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩ := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hy⟩ := y.2
    exact ker_projInitial_ideal_image_chart A n r hrn ⟨y.1, Ideal.subset_span y.2⟩ j hj hy.symm
  exact le_antisymm (le_of_iSup_eq_top _ hcover fun y => (key y).le)
    (le_of_iSup_eq_top _ hcover fun y => (key y).ge)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.projInitial_π
statement:
theorem projInitial_π :
    projInitial A n r hrn ≫ affineBlowUp.π (centerIdeal A n r) =
      Proj.toSpecZero _ ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)
          (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r) 0))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (centerIdeal A n r)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [projInitial, affineBlowUp.π, Proj.map_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun c => ?_)
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.comp_apply,
    RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
    GradedRingHom.coe_zeroRingHom_apply, SetLike.GradeZero.coe_algebraMap,
    MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  exact reesInitial_algebraMap A n r hrn c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.exists_iso_exceptional_proj
statement:
theorem exists_iso_exceptional_proj :
    ∃ e : (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)).subscheme ≅
        Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)),
      (∀ (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r),
        e.hom ''ᵁ ((affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)).subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ
            (modelChart A n r j hj).opensRange) =
          Proj.basicOpen _ (X (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin r))) ∧
      e.inv ≫ (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)).subschemeι ≫
          affineBlowUp.π (centerIdeal A n r) =
        Proj.toSpecZero _ ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)
            (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r) 0))) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (centerIdeal A n r)))
proof:
:= by
  have hker : (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)).subschemeι.ker =
      (projInitial A n r hrn).ker := by
    rw [ker_subschemeι, ker_projInitial]
  have : IsIso (IsClosedImmersion.lift
      (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)).subschemeι (projInitial A n r hrn)
      hker.le) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.isIso_lift _ _ hker
  refine ⟨(asIso (IsClosedImmersion.lift _ _ hker.le)).symm, fun j hj => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Scheme.Hom.inv_preimage, Iso.symm_inv, asIso_hom, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
      IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac, opensRange_modelChart, affineBlowUp.opensRange_chart, projInitial,
      Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen, coe_reesInitialGraded, reesInitial_degreeOne_genX]
  · rw [Iso.symm_inv, asIso_hom, IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac_assoc, projInitial_π]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.prod_pow_mem_pow
statement:
theorem prod_pow_mem_pow (J : Ideal S) (s : Finset σ) (e : σ → ℕ) (x : σ → S)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ J) : ∏ i ∈ s, x i ^ e i ∈ J ^ (∑ i ∈ s, e i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, pow_add]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (hx a) _) ih

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.mem_span_range_X_pow_of_forall
proof:
:= by
  rw [p.as_sum]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun d hd => ?_
  rw [monomial_eq]
  refine Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_
  have := prod_pow_mem_pow (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) d.support d X
    fun i => Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [← Finsupp.degree_apply] at this
  exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (h d hd) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.forall_degree_of_mem_span_range_X_pow
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k generalizing p with
  | zero => exact fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ] at hp
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hp ?_ ?_
    · intro a ha b hb d hd
      obtain ⟨da, hda, db, hdb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_add.mp (support_mul a b hd)
      have h1 := ih ha da hda
      have h2 : 1 ≤ db.degree := by
        rw [← Set.image_univ] at hb
        obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := mem_ideal_span_X_image.mp hb db hdb
        exact (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hi).trans (Finsupp.le_degree i db)
      rw [map_add]
      omega
    · intro a b ha hb d hd
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (support_add hd) with h | h
      · exact ha d h
      · exact hb d h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.mem_span_range_X_pow_iff
statement:
theorem mem_span_range_X_pow_iff {k : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial σ S} :
    p ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) ^ k ↔
      ∀ d ∈ p.support, k ≤ d.degree
proof:
:=
  ⟨forall_degree_of_mem_span_range_X_pow, mem_span_range_X_pow_of_forall⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.homogeneousComponent_mem_span_range_X_pow
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mem_span_range_X_pow (k : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial σ S) :
    homogeneousComponent k p ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) ^ k
proof:
:=
  mem_span_range_X_pow_of_forall fun d hd => by
    rw [support_homogeneousComponent, Finset.mem_filter] at hd
    exact hd.2.ge

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.sub_homogeneousComponent_mem
statement:
theorem sub_homogeneousComponent_mem {k : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial σ S}
    (hp : p ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) ^ k) :
    p - homogeneousComponent k p ∈
      (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_span_range_X_pow_of_forall fun d hd => ?_
  have hd' := mem_support_iff.mp hd
  rw [coeff_sub, coeff_homogeneousComponent] at hd'
  by_cases hdk : d.degree = k
  · rw [ite_eq_left hdk, sub_self] at hd'
    exact absurd rfl hd'
  · rw [ite_eq_right hdk, sub_zero] at hd'
    have := forall_degree_of_mem_span_range_X_pow hp d (mem_support_iff.mpr hd')
    omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_iff_mem_succ
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_iff_mem_succ {k : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial σ S}
    (hp : p ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) ^ k) :
    homogeneousComponent k p = 0 ↔
      p ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := sub_homogeneousComponent_mem hp
    rwa [h, sub_zero] at this
  · intro h
    refine homogeneousComponent_eq_zero' _ _ fun d hd hdk => ?_
    have := forall_degree_of_mem_span_range_X_pow h d hd
    omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.homogeneousComponent_mul_of_mem
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_mul_of_mem {k l : ℕ} {a b : MvPolynomial σ S}
    (ha : a ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) ^ k)
    (hb : b ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S))) ^ l) :
    homogeneousComponent (k + l) (a * b) =
      homogeneousComponent k a * homogeneousComponent l b
proof:
:= by
  set J := Ideal.span (Set.range (X : σ → MvPolynomial σ S)) with hJ
  have ha' := sub_homogeneousComponent_mem ha
  have hb' := sub_homogeneousComponent_mem hb
  have hak := homogeneousComponent_mem_span_range_X_pow k a
  have hbl := homogeneousComponent_mem_span_range_X_pow l b
  have hab : a * b = homogeneousComponent k a * homogeneousComponent l b +
      (homogeneousComponent k a * (b - homogeneousComponent l b) +
        (a - homogeneousComponent k a) * homogeneousComponent l b +
        (a - homogeneousComponent k a) * (b - homogeneousComponent l b)) := by ring
  have hrest : homogeneousComponent k a * (b - homogeneousComponent l b) +
      (a - homogeneousComponent k a) * homogeneousComponent l b +
      (a - homogeneousComponent k a) * (b - homogeneousComponent l b) ∈ J ^ (k + l + 1) := by
    refine Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.add_mem _ ?_ ?_) ?_
    · have := Ideal.mul_mem_mul hak hb'
      rwa [← pow_add, show k + (l + 1) = k + l + 1 by omega] at this
    · have := Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha' hbl
      rwa [← pow_add, show k + 1 + l = k + l + 1 by omega] at this
    · have := Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha' hb'
      rw [← pow_add] at this
      exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) this
  have hz : homogeneousComponent (k + l)
      (homogeneousComponent k a * (b - homogeneousComponent l b) +
        (a - homogeneousComponent k a) * homogeneousComponent l b +
        (a - homogeneousComponent k a) * (b - homogeneousComponent l b)) = 0 :=
    homogeneousComponent_eq_zero' _ _ fun d hd hdk => by
      have := forall_degree_of_mem_span_range_X_pow hrest d hd
      omega
  rw [hab, map_add, hz, add_zero, homogeneousComponent_eq_self
    ((homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous k a).mul (homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous l b))]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.splitFin_apply_of_lt
statement:
theorem splitFin_apply_of_lt {i : Fin n} (h : i.val < r) :
    splitFin n r hrn i = Sum.inl ⟨i.val, h⟩
proof: := dite_eq_left h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.splitFin_apply_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem splitFin_apply_of_not_lt {i : Fin n} (h : ¬ i.val < r) :
    splitFin n r hrn i = Sum.inr ⟨i, h⟩
proof: := dite_eq_right h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.centerSplitEquiv_X_of_lt
statement:
theorem centerSplitEquiv_X_of_lt {i : Fin n} (h : i.val < r) :
    centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn (X i) = X ⟨i.val, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [centerSplitEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  change mapAlgEquiv _ _ (sumAlgEquiv A _ _ (rename _ (X i))) = _
  rw [rename_X, splitFin_apply_of_lt n r hrn h, sumAlgEquiv_X_inl, mapAlgEquiv_apply, map_X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.centerSplitEquiv_X_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem centerSplitEquiv_X_of_not_lt {i : Fin n} (h : ¬ i.val < r) :
    centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn (X i) = C (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [centerSplitEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  change mapAlgEquiv _ _ (sumAlgEquiv A _ _ (rename _ (X i))) = _
  rw [rename_X, splitFin_apply_of_not_lt n r hrn h, sumAlgEquiv_X_inr, mapAlgEquiv_apply, map_C]
  congr 1
  rw [RingHom.coe_coe, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, quotientCenterAlgEquiv_mk_X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.constantCoeff_comp_centerSplitEquiv
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_comp_centerSplitEquiv :
    (constantCoeff (σ := Fin r)).comp
        (centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →+* _) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (centerIdeal A n r)
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.coe_coe, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, AlgEquiv.commutes,
      MvPolynomial.algebraMap_apply, constantCoeff_C]
    rfl
  · by_cases h : i.val < r
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.coe_coe, centerSplitEquiv_X_of_lt A n r hrn h,
        constantCoeff_X, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (X_mem_centerIdeal A n r h)]
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.coe_coe, centerSplitEquiv_X_of_not_lt A n r hrn h,
        constantCoeff_C]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.map_centerIdeal_centerSplitEquiv
statement:
theorem map_centerIdeal_centerSplitEquiv :
    (centerIdeal A n r).map (centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →+* _) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (X : Fin r →
        MvPolynomial (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)))
proof:
:= by
  change (Ideal.span (X '' center n r)).map _ = _
  rw [Ideal.map_span]
  congr 1
  ext F
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i.val, hi⟩, by rw [RingHom.coe_coe, centerSplitEquiv_X_of_lt A n r hrn hi]⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨X ⟨j.val, lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hrn⟩, ⟨⟨j.val, lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hrn⟩, j.2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [RingHom.coe_coe, centerSplitEquiv_X_of_lt A n r hrn j.2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.mem_pow_iff_centerSplitEquiv_mem
statement:
theorem mem_pow_iff_centerSplitEquiv_mem {k : ℕ} {c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A} :
    c ∈ centerIdeal A n r ^ k ↔
      centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn c ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : Fin r →
        MvPolynomial (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)))) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hbij : Function.Bijective ⇑(centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →+*
      MvPolynomial (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)) := by
    rw [RingHom.coe_coe]
    exact (centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn).bijective
  rw [← map_centerIdeal_centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn, ← Ideal.map_pow]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij (I := centerIdeal A n r ^ k)]
  exact Ideal.mem_comap

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.initialAux_monomial
statement:
theorem initialAux_monomial (k : ℕ) (c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) :
    initialAux A n r hrn (Polynomial.monomial k c) =
      homogeneousComponent k (centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn c)
proof:
:= by
  change (Polynomial.monomial k c).sum
    (fun k c => homogeneousComponent k (centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn c)) = _
  rw [Polynomial.sum_monomial_index]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.val_comp_reesPresentation
statement:
theorem val_comp_reesPresentation :
    (Subalgebra.val (reesAlgebra (centerIdeal A n r))).comp (reesPresentation A n r hrn) =
      ambientPresentation A n r hrn
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun j => ?_
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, reesPresentation, aeval_X, ambientPresentation, aeval_X,
    Subalgebra.coe_val, reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne, genMonomial,
    ← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, pow_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.coe_reesPresentation
statement:
theorem coe_reesPresentation (F : MvPolynomial (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) :
    ((reesPresentation A n r hrn F : reesAlgebra (centerIdeal A n r)) :
        Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) =
      ambientPresentation A n r hrn F
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (val_comp_reesPresentation A n r hrn) F

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.reesPresentation_surjective
statement: theorem reesPresentation_surjective : Function.Surjective (reesPresentation A n r hrn)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have hp : (p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) ∈ (ambientPresentation A n r hrn).range := by
    have hmem : (p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) ∈ Algebra.adjoin (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
        (Submodule.map (Polynomial.monomial 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin n) A]
          Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) (centerIdeal A n r) : Set _) :=
      (adjoin_monomial_eq_reesAlgebra (I := centerIdeal A n r)).ge p.2
    refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_ hmem
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    change Polynomial.monomial 1 a ∈ (ambientPresentation A n r hrn).range
    have hspan : Submodule.span (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (X '' center n r) ≤
        Submodule.comap (Polynomial.monomial 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin n) A]
          Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))
          (Subalgebra.toSubmodule (ambientPresentation A n r hrn).range) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      change Polynomial.monomial 1 (X i) ∈ (ambientPresentation A n r hrn).range
      refine (AlgHom.mem_range _).mpr ⟨X ⟨i.val, hi⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [ambientPresentation, aeval_X, genMonomial, ← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, pow_one]
    exact hspan ha
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨F, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [coe_reesPresentation]
  exact hF

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.centerSplitEquiv_prod_X_pow
statement:
theorem centerSplitEquiv_prod_X_pow (β : Fin r →₀ ℕ) :
    centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn (∏ j ∈ β.support, X ⟨j.val, lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hrn⟩ ^ β j) =
      monomial β 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_prod]
  have h : ∀ j ∈ β.support,
      centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn (X ⟨j.val, lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hrn⟩ ^ β j) = X j ^ β j :=
    fun j _ => by rw [map_pow, centerSplitEquiv_X_of_lt A n r hrn j.2]
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl h, monomial_eq, C_1, one_mul, Finsupp.prod]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.initialAux_coe_reesPresentation
statement:
theorem initialAux_coe_reesPresentation (F : MvPolynomial (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) :
    initialAux A n r hrn (reesPresentation A n r hrn F : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) =
      coeffQuotient A n r F
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_reesPresentation]
  induction F using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial β c =>
    rw [ambientPresentation, aeval_monomial, map_monomial]
    have hprod : (β.prod fun j e => genMonomial A n r hrn j ^ e) =
        Polynomial.C (∏ j ∈ β.support, X ⟨j.val, lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 hrn⟩ ^ β j) *
          Polynomial.X ^ β.degree := by
      rw [Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.degree_apply,
        _root_.map_prod (Polynomial.C (R := MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)),
        ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [genMonomial, mul_pow, map_pow]
    rw [hprod, Polynomial.algebraMap_eq, ← mul_assoc, ← Polynomial.C_mul,
      Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, initialAux_monomial, map_mul,
      centerSplitEquiv_prod_X_pow]
    have h0 : centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn c ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : Fin r →
        MvPolynomial (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)))) ^ 0 := by
      rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    have hβ : (monomial β (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)) ∈
        (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : Fin r →
          MvPolynomial (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)))) ^ β.degree := by
      rw [monomial_eq, C_1, one_mul, Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.degree_apply]
      exact prod_pow_mem_pow (Ideal.span (Set.range X)) β.support β X
        fun j => Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hcc := RingHom.congr_fun (constantCoeff_comp_centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn) c
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.coe_coe] at hcc
    rw [show β.degree = 0 + β.degree from (zero_add _).symm, homogeneousComponent_mul_of_mem h0 hβ,
      homogeneousComponent_eq_self (isHomogeneous_monomial _ rfl),
      homogeneousComponent_zero, ← constantCoeff_eq, hcc, C_mul_monomial, mul_one]
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, hp, hq, map_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.reesInitial_apply
statement:
theorem reesInitial_apply (p : reesAlgebra (centerIdeal A n r)) :
    reesInitial A n r hrn p = initialAux A n r hrn (p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := reesPresentation_surjective A n r hrn p
  rw [reesInitial, RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
    initialAux_coe_reesPresentation]
  have : (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (reesPresentation_surjective A n r hrn)).symm
      (reesPresentation A n r hrn F) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ F :=
    RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply _ F
  rw [this, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.reesInitial_mk_monomial
statement:
theorem reesInitial_mk_monomial {k : ℕ} {c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A}
    (hc : c ∈ centerIdeal A n r ^ k) :
    reesInitial A n r hrn ⟨Polynomial.monomial k c, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hc⟩ =
      homogeneousComponent k (centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesInitial_apply]
  exact initialAux_monomial A n r hrn k c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.reesInitial_mem
statement:
theorem reesInitial_mem {k : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra (centerIdeal A n r)}
    (hp : p ∈ grading (centerIdeal A n r) k) :
    reesInitial A n r hrn p ∈
      homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r) k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, -, hpc⟩ := reesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff_exists.mp hp
  rw [reesInitial_apply A n r hrn, hpc, initialAux_monomial]
  exact homogeneousComponent_mem _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.coe_reesInitialGraded
statement:
theorem coe_reesInitialGraded :
    ⇑(reesInitialGraded A n r hrn) = ⇑(reesInitial A n r hrn)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.reesInitial_degreeOne_genX
statement:
theorem reesInitial_degreeOne_genX (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r) :
    reesInitial A n r hrn (degreeOne (centerIdeal A n r) ⟨X j, X_mem_centerIdeal A n r hj⟩) =
      X ⟨j, hj⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesInitial_apply A n r hrn, reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne, initialAux_monomial]
  change homogeneousComponent 1 (centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn (X j)) = _
  rw [centerSplitEquiv_X_of_lt A n r hrn hj]
  exact homogeneousComponent_eq_self (isHomogeneous_X _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.reesInitial_algebraMap
statement:
theorem reesInitial_algebraMap (c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) :
    reesInitial A n r hrn
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) (reesAlgebra (centerIdeal A n r)) c) =
      C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (centerIdeal A n r) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesInitial_apply A n r hrn]
  change initialAux A n r hrn (Polynomial.C c) = _
  rw [← Polynomial.monomial_zero_left, initialAux_monomial, homogeneousComponent_zero]
  congr 1
  rw [← constantCoeff_eq]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (constantCoeff_comp_centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn) c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.exists_reesInitial_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hFhom : F.IsHomogeneous k := (mem_homogeneousSubmodule k F).mp hF
  have hFk : F ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (X : Fin r →
      MvPolynomial (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)))) ^ k :=
    mem_span_range_X_pow_of_forall fun d hd => by
      have h1 : d.degree = k := by
        have := hFhom (mem_support_iff.mp hd)
        rwa [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
      exact h1.ge
  have hc : (centerSplitEquiv A n r hrn).symm F ∈ centerIdeal A n r ^ k := by
    rw [mem_pow_iff_centerSplitEquiv_mem A n r hrn, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hFk
  refine ⟨⟨Polynomial.monomial k _, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hc⟩,
    reesAlgebra.mem_grading_of_coe_eq_monomial rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [reesInitial_mk_monomial A n r hrn hc, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact homogeneousComponent_eq_self hFhom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.irrelevant_le_map_reesInitialGraded
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_reesInitialGraded :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant
        (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading (centerIdeal A n r))).map
        (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toIdeal_le_toIdeal_iff, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map,
    HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le]
  intro i hi F hF
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := exists_reesInitial_eq A n r hrn hF
  have h := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (reesInitialGraded A n r hrn)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ hi hp)
  rw [coe_reesInitialGraded] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.reesInitial_mk_monomial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem reesInitial_mk_monomial_eq_zero_iff {k : ℕ} {c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A}
    (hc : c ∈ centerIdeal A n r ^ k) :
    reesInitial A n r hrn ⟨Polynomial.monomial k c, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hc⟩ = 0 ↔
      c ∈ centerIdeal A n r ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesInitial_mk_monomial A n r hrn hc,
    homogeneousComponent_eq_zero_iff_mem_succ ((mem_pow_iff_centerSplitEquiv_mem A n r hrn).mp hc),
    ← mem_pow_iff_centerSplitEquiv_mem]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap_of_algEquiv {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {S : Type v} {T : Type w} [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [Algebra A S] [Algebra A T] (e : S ≃ₐ[A] T)
    {m : ℕ} (h : RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension m (algebraMap A S)) :
    RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension m (algebraMap A T)
proof:
:= by
  have := (RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.equiv e.toRingEquiv).comp h
  rw [zero_add] at this
  have hcomp : (e.toRingEquiv : S →+* T).comp (algebraMap A S) = algebraMap A T :=
    RingHom.ext fun a => e.commutes a
  rwa [hcomp] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_mvPolynomial_quotient
statement:
theorem isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_mvPolynomial_quotient :
    IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (Nat.card σ) A
      (MvPolynomial σ A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (Empty.elim : Empty → MvPolynomial σ A)))
proof:
:=
  (mvPolynomialSubmersivePresentation A σ).isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (by
    simp [Presentation.dimension])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ringHom_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem ringHom_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap_mvPolynomial :
    RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (Nat.card σ) (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial σ A))
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : Ideal.span (Set.range (Empty.elim : Empty → MvPolynomial σ A)) = ⊥ := by
    rw [Set.range_eq_empty, Ideal.span_empty]
  have h : RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (Nat.card σ) (algebraMap A
      (MvPolynomial σ A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (Empty.elim : Empty → MvPolynomial σ A)))) :=
    (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap (n := Nat.card σ)).mpr
      (isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_mvPolynomial_quotient A σ)
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range (Empty.elim : Empty → MvPolynomial σ A)))) :=
    (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mpr (by rw [Ideal.mk_ker]; exact hJ)
  let e : MvPolynomial σ A ≃+*
      (MvPolynomial σ A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (Empty.elim : Empty → MvPolynomial σ A))) :=
    RingEquiv.ofBijective _ ⟨hinj, Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective⟩
  have := (RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.equiv e.symm).comp h
  rw [zero_add] at this
  convert this using 1
  refine RingHom.ext fun a => ?_
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
  change algebraMap A (MvPolynomial σ A) a = e.symm (e (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial σ A) a))
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.smoothOfRelativeDimension_Spec_map_algebraMap_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem smoothOfRelativeDimension_Spec_map_algebraMap_mvPolynomial (n : ℕ) :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension n
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension.{u} n), CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
  refine RingHom.locally_of RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_respectsIso _ ?_
  have := ringHom_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap_mvPolynomial A (Fin n)
  rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.smoothOfRelativeDimension_modelBlowUp
statement:
theorem smoothOfRelativeDimension_modelBlowUp :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (affineBlowUp.π (centerIdeal A n r) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  have hloc : IsZariskiLocalAtSource (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension.{u} n) :=
    @HasRingHomProperty.instIsZariskiLocalAtSource _ _ inferInstance
  have : MorphismProperty.RespectsIso (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension.{u} n) := hloc.toRespects
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_iSup_eq_top (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension.{u} n)
    (fun j : {j : Fin n // j.val < r} => (modelChart A n r j.1 j.2).opensRange) ?_ fun j => ?_
  · rw [← iSup_opensRange_modelChart A n r]
    symm
    exact iSup_subtype'
  · have e : Set.range (modelChart A n r j.1 j.2) =
        Set.range (modelChart A n r j.1 j.2).opensRange.ι := by
      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
      rfl
    rw [← IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_inv_fac (modelChart A n r j.1 j.2) _ e, Category.assoc,
      MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension.{u} n),
      ← Category.assoc, modelChart_π, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.comp_algebraMap]
    exact smoothOfRelativeDimension_Spec_map_algebraMap_mvPolynomial A n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.comap_exceptionalIdeal_modelChart
statement:
theorem comap_exceptionalIdeal_modelChart (j : Fin n) (hj : j.val < r) :
    (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal (centerIdeal A n r)).comap (modelChart A n r j hj) =
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((Ideal.span {(X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)}).map
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))).inv.hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelChart, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, affineBlowUp.comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_ofIdealTop_Spec_map,
    Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  congr 3
  have := congrArg (fun φ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) A => φ (X j))
    (chartRingIso_hom_comp_algebraMap A n r j)
  simpa [chartSubst_X_self] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.killPred_X_of
statement: theorem killPred_X_of {i : Fin n} (h : p i) : killPred A p (X i) = X ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [killPred, killCompl, aeval_X, dite_eq_left ⟨⟨i, h⟩, rfl⟩]
  congr 1
  exact Equiv.ofInjective_symm_apply Subtype.val_injective ⟨i, h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.killPred_X_of_not
statement: theorem killPred_X_of_not {i : Fin n} (h : ¬ p i) : killPred A p (X i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [killPred, killCompl, aeval_X, dite_eq_right]
  rintro ⟨⟨i', hi'⟩, h'⟩
  exact h (h' ▸ hi')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.killPred_surjective
statement: theorem killPred_surjective : Function.Surjective (killPred A p)
proof:
:= fun q =>
  ⟨rename Subtype.val q, killCompl_rename_app _ q⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.sub_rename_killPred_mem
statement:
theorem sub_rename_killPred_mem (q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) :
    q - rename Subtype.val (killPred A p q) ∈ coordinateIdeal A {i | ¬ p i}
proof:
:= by
  induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial v c =>
    by_cases hv :
        (↑v.support : Set (Fin n)) ⊆ Set.range (Subtype.val : {i : Fin n // p i} → Fin n)
    · rw [killPred, killCompl_monomial_eq_monomial_comapDomain_of_subset _ _ hv, rename_monomial,
        Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective _ hv, sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _
    · rw [killPred, killCompl_monomial_eq_zero_of_not_subset _ _ hv, map_zero, sub_zero]
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hnot⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hv
      have hpa : ¬ p a := fun h => hnot ⟨⟨a, h⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : (X a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A) ∣ monomial v c :=
        X_dvd_monomial.mpr (Or.inr (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp ha))
      rw [hq]
      exact (coordinateIdeal A {i | ¬ p i}).mul_mem_right q (Ideal.subset_span ⟨a, hpa, rfl⟩)
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ hp hq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ker_killPred
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro q hq
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.coe_coe] at hq
    have := sub_rename_killPred_mem A p q
    rwa [hq, map_zero, sub_zero] at this
  · rw [coordinateIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.coe_coe]
    exact killPred_X_of_not A p hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.quotientCoordinateIdealAlgEquiv_mk_X
statement:
theorem quotientCoordinateIdealAlgEquiv_mk_X {i : Fin n} (h : p i) :
    quotientCoordinateIdealAlgEquiv A p (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = X ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (killPred_surjective A p)
    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq A (ker_killPred A p).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i))) = X ⟨i, h⟩
  rw [Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]
  exact (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk (killPred_surjective A p) (X i)).trans
    (killPred_X_of A p h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.killX_X_of_ne
statement: theorem killX_X_of_ne {i : Fin n} (h : i ≠ j) : killX A j (X i) = X ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:=
  killPred_X_of A (· ≠ j) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.killX_X_self
statement: theorem killX_X_self : killX A j (X j) = 0
proof:
:=
  killPred_X_of_not A (· ≠ j) fun h => h rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.killX_surjective
statement: theorem killX_surjective : Function.Surjective (killX A j)
proof: := killPred_surjective A (· ≠ j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.ker_killX
proof:
:= by
  rw [killX, ker_killPred, show {i : Fin n | ¬ i ≠ j} = {j} from Set.ext fun _ => not_not,
    coordinateIdeal, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.quotientSpanXAlgEquiv_mk_X
statement:
theorem quotientSpanXAlgEquiv_mk_X {i : Fin n} (h : i ≠ j) :
    quotientSpanXAlgEquiv A j (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = X ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (killX_surjective A j)
    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq A (ker_killX A j).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i))) = X ⟨i, h⟩
  rw [Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]
  exact (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk (killX_surjective A j) (X i)).trans
    (killX_X_of_ne A j h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.exists_algEquiv_quotient_span_X
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_quotient_span_X :
    ∃ e : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ Ideal.span {(X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)}) ≃ₐ[A]
        MvPolynomial {i : Fin n // i ≠ j} A,
      ∀ i (h : i ≠ j), e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = X ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:=
  ⟨quotientSpanXAlgEquiv A j, fun _ h => quotientSpanXAlgEquiv_mk_X A j h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.card_ne
statement: theorem card_ne : Nat.card {i : Fin n // i ≠ j} = n - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.filter_ne',
    Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ j), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.smoothOfRelativeDimension_quotient_span_X
statement:
theorem smoothOfRelativeDimension_quotient_span_X :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension (n - 1) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ Ideal.span {(X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)}))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension.{u} (n - 1)),
    CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
  refine RingHom.locally_of RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_respectsIso _ ?_
  have h := ringHom_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap_mvPolynomial A
    {i : Fin n // i ≠ j}
  rw [card_ne] at h
  exact isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap_of_algEquiv
    (quotientSpanXAlgEquiv A j).symm h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.centerIdeal_eq_coordinateIdeal_not_not
statement:
theorem centerIdeal_eq_coordinateIdeal_not_not :
    centerIdeal A n r = coordinateIdeal A {i : Fin n | ¬ ¬ i.val < r}
proof:
:=
  congrArg (coordinateIdeal A) (Set.ext fun _ => ⟨not_not_intro, not_not.mp⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.quotientCenterAlgEquiv_mk_X
statement:
theorem quotientCenterAlgEquiv_mk_X {i : Fin n} (h : ¬ i.val < r) :
    quotientCenterAlgEquiv A n r (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = X ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientCenterAlgEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]
  exact quotientCoordinateIdealAlgEquiv_mk_X A _ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.splitVars_symm_of_lt
statement:
theorem splitVars_symm_of_lt {i : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (h : i.val < r) :
    (splitVars n r j hj).symm ⟨i, hij⟩ = Sum.inl ⟨i, h, hij⟩
proof: := dite_eq_left h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.splitVars_symm_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem splitVars_symm_of_not_lt {i : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (h : ¬ i.val < r) :
    (splitVars n r j hj).symm ⟨i, hij⟩ = Sum.inr ⟨i, h⟩
proof: := dite_eq_right h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.fibreAlgEquiv_mk_X_of
statement:
theorem fibreAlgEquiv_mk_X_of {i : Fin n} (h : i.val < r ∧ i ≠ j) :
    fibreAlgEquiv A n r j hj (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = X ⟨i, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [fibreAlgEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    quotientSpanXAlgEquiv_mk_X A j h.2]
  change mapAlgEquiv _ _ (sumAlgEquiv A _ _ (rename _ (X _))) = _
  rw [rename_X, splitVars_symm_of_lt n r j hj h.2 h.1, sumAlgEquiv_X_inl, mapAlgEquiv_apply, map_X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.fibreAlgEquiv_mk_X_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem fibreAlgEquiv_mk_X_of_not_lt {i : Fin n} (h : ¬ i.val < r) :
    fibreAlgEquiv A n r j hj (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = C (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i))
proof:
:= by
  have hij : i ≠ j := fun e => h (by rw [e]; exact hj)
  rw [fibreAlgEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    quotientSpanXAlgEquiv_mk_X A j hij]
  change mapAlgEquiv _ _ (sumAlgEquiv A _ _ (rename _ (X _))) = _
  rw [rename_X, splitVars_symm_of_not_lt n r j hj hij h, sumAlgEquiv_X_inr, mapAlgEquiv_apply,
    map_C]
  congr 1
  rw [RingHom.coe_coe, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, quotientCenterAlgEquiv_mk_X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.fibreAlgEquiv_comp_mk_comp_chartSubst
statement:
theorem fibreAlgEquiv_comp_mk_comp_chartSubst :
    ((fibreAlgEquiv A n r j hj).toAlgHom.comp
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ A _).comp (chartSubst A (center n r) j))) =
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r) _).comp
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ A (centerIdeal A n r))
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i => ?_
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom',
    AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, chartSubst_X]
  by_cases hi : i.val < r
  · rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (X_mem_centerIdeal A n r hi), map_zero]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
        (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)), map_zero]
    · have hij : i = j := by
        by_contra hne
        exact h ⟨hi, hne⟩
      rw [hij, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _), map_zero]
  · rw [ite_eq_right fun h => hi h.1, fibreAlgEquiv_mk_X_of_not_lt A n r j hj hi, algebraMap_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.CoordinateSubspace.exists_algEquiv_quotient_span_X_over_center
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_quotient_span_X_over_center :
    letI : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r)
        (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ Ideal.span {(X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)})
proof:
:=
      (Ideal.quotientMap (Ideal.span {(X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)})
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra.chartSubst A (center n r) j).toRingHom
        (centerIdeal_le_comap_chartSubst A n r j)).toAlgebra
    ∃ e : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ Ideal.span {(X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)})
        ≃ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r]
          MvPolynomial {i : Fin n // i.val < r ∧ i ≠ j}
            (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ centerIdeal A n r),
      ∀ i (h : i.val < r ∧ i ≠ j), e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X i)) = X ⟨i, h⟩ :=
  ⟨fibreAlgEquivOverCenter A n r j hj, fun _ h => fibreAlgEquiv_mk_X_of A n r j hj h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.coe_fracPow
statement:
theorem coe_fracPow (n : ℕ) {y : R} (hy : y ∈ I ^ n) :
    ((fracPow I n hy : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) : Localization.Away a) = awayFrac a n y
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.awayFrac_mul_algebraMap_pow
statement:
theorem awayFrac_mul_algebraMap_pow (n : ℕ) (y : R) :
    awayFrac a n y * algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) (a ^ n) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold awayFrac
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply]
  exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.toAway_fracPow_mul
statement:
theorem toAway_fracPow_mul {c' : R} (hac : a ∣ c') (n : ℕ) {y : R} (hy : y ∈ I ^ n) :
    toAway I hac (fracPow I n hy) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away c') a ^ n =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away c') y
proof:
:= by
  rw [toAway, AlgHom.comp_apply, Subalgebra.coe_val]
  change awayToAwayₐ a c' hac (awayFrac a n y) * _ = _
  rw [← map_pow, ← awayToAwayₐ_algebraMap a c' hac, ← map_mul, awayFrac_mul_algebraMap_pow,
    awayToAwayₐ_algebraMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.transitionHom_apply
statement:
theorem transitionHom_apply (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) :
    transitionHom I ha hc z = (transitionEquiv I hc ha).symm
      (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (Localization.Away (frac (a := a) hc)) z)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.transitionHom_fracPow
statement:
theorem transitionHom_fracPow (n : ℕ) {y : R} (hy : y ∈ I ^ n) :
    transitionHom I ha hc (fracPow I n hy) *
      algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) (Localization.Away (frac (a := c) ha))
        (frac (a := c) ha) ^ n =
    algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) (Localization.Away (frac (a := c) ha))
      (fracPow I n hy)
proof:
:= by
  apply embedAB_injective I ha
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c * a)) c ^ n) :=
    (isUnit_algebraMap_of_dvd (dvd_mul_right c a)).pow n
  apply hu.mul_left_injective
  have h1 : embedAB I ha c (transitionHom I ha hc (fracPow I n hy)) =
      embedBA I hc a (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (Localization.Away (frac (a := a) hc))
        (fracPow I n hy)) := by
    rw [transitionHom_apply, ← embedBA_transitionEquiv I hc ha, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change embedAB I ha c (_ * _) * _ = embedAB I ha c _ * _
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, h1, embedBA_algebraMap, embedAB_algebraMap, embedAB_algebraMap,
    mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, toAway_frac_mul I (dvd_mul_right c a) ha,
    toAway_fracPow_mul I (dvd_mul_left a c), toAway_fracPow_mul I (dvd_mul_right c a)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.exists_pow_frac_mul_mem
proof:
:= by
  set r := frac (a := c) ha with hr
  have h1 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (transitionHom I ha hc) hz
  rw [hPQ] at h1
  have h2 : algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) (Localization.Away r) (fracPow I n hy) ∈
      Q.map (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) (Localization.Away r)) := by
    rw [← transitionHom_fracPow I ha hc n hy]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ h1
  obtain ⟨⟨j, s⟩, hjk⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers r) (Localization.Away r)).mp h2
  have h3 : algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) (Localization.Away r)
      (fracPow I n hy * (s : affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) - (j : affineBlowUpAlgebra I c)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hjk
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers r) (Localization.Away r) _).mp h3
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff _ _).mp s.2
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff _ _).mp m.2
  refine ⟨l + k, ?_⟩
  have h4 : r ^ (l + k) * fracPow I n hy = r ^ l * (j : affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) := by
    rw [← hl, ← hk] at hm
    linear_combination hm
  rw [h4]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ j.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.map_algebraMap_away_frac
statement:
theorem map_algebraMap_away_frac :
    I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (frac (a := c) ha))) =
      Ideal.span
        {algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) (Localization.Away (frac (a := c) ha))
          (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) c)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c)
    (Localization.Away (frac (a := c) ha)), ← Ideal.map_map, map_algebraMap_eq_span_singleton hc,
    Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors_away_frac
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors_away_frac :
    algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) (Localization.Away (frac (a := c) ha))
        (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I c) c) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors (Localization.Away (frac (a := c) ha))
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.map_nonZeroDivisors_le (M := Submonoid.powers (frac (a := c) ha))
    (S := Localization.Away (frac (a := c) ha))
    (Submonoid.mem_map_of_mem _ algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_specMap_fromSpec
statement:
theorem comap_specMap_fromSpec (K : X.IdealSheafData) {S : Type u} [CommRing S]
    (ψ : Γ(X, U) →+* S) :
    K.comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ U.2.fromSpec) = specIdealSheaf ((K.ideal U).map ψ)
proof:
:=
  (comap_comp K _ _).trans
    ((congrArg (fun L : (Spec Γ(X, U)).IdealSheafData => L.comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ)))
      (comap_fromSpec K U)).trans (comap_ofIdealTop_Spec_map _ _))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_specIdealSheaf_Spec_map
statement:
theorem comap_specIdealSheaf_Spec_map {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (P : Ideal R) :
    (specIdealSheaf P).comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) = specIdealSheaf (P.map f)
proof:
:=
  comap_ofIdealTop_Spec_map (CommRingCat.ofHom f) P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specMap_chart_π
statement:
theorem specMap_chart_π {T : Type u} [CommRing T] (χ : Γ(X, U) →+* T) (b : I.ideal U)
    (ψ : affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) b →+* T)
    (hψ : ψ.comp (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) b)) = χ) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ blowUp.chart I U b) ≫ blowUpπ I =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom χ) ≫ U.2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, blowUp.chart_π, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    hψ]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_comap_overlap
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_overlap :
    (I.comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (overlapRing I U a c))) ≫
      U.2.fromSpec)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [comap_specMap_fromSpec, affineBlowUpAlgebra.map_algebraMap_away_frac (I.ideal U) a.2 c.2]
  exact isInvertible_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton
    (affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors_away_frac (I.ideal U) a.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specMap_algebraMap_chart_eq
statement:
theorem specMap_algebraMap_chart_eq :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) (overlapRing I U a c))) ≫
      blowUp.chart I U c =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra.transitionHom (I.ideal U) a.2 c.2).toRingHom) ≫
      blowUp.chart I U a
proof:
:=
  blowUp.hom_ext I _ (isInvertible_comap_overlap I U a c) _ _
    (specMap_chart_π I U _ c _
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq Γ(X, U) _ (overlapRing I U a c)).symm)
    (specMap_chart_π I U _ a _ (AlgHom.comp_algebraMap _))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartIdeal_map_transition
statement:
theorem chartIdeal_map_transition :
    (chartIdeal I J' U a).map (affineBlowUpAlgebra.transitionHom (I.ideal U) a.2 c.2) =
      (chartIdeal I J' U c).map
        (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) (overlapRing I U a c))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => J'.comap φ) (specMap_algebraMap_chart_eq I U a c)
  have h1 : J'.comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) (overlapRing I U a c))) ≫
        blowUp.chart I U c) =
      specIdealSheaf ((chartIdeal I J' U c).map
        (algebraMap (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) (overlapRing I U a c))) :=
    (comap_comp J' _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun L : (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))).IdealSheafData =>
        L.comap _) (comap_chart_eq_specIdealSheaf I J' U c)).trans
          (comap_specIdealSheaf_Spec_map _ _))
  have h2 : J'.comap (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (affineBlowUpAlgebra.transitionHom (I.ideal U) a.2 c.2).toRingHom) ≫
        blowUp.chart I U a) =
      specIdealSheaf ((chartIdeal I J' U a).map
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra.transitionHom (I.ideal U) a.2 c.2).toRingHom) :=
    (comap_comp J' _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun L : (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))).IdealSheafData =>
        L.comap _) (comap_chart_eq_specIdealSheaf I J' U a)).trans
          (comap_specIdealSheaf_Spec_map _ _))
  exact (specIdealSheaf_inj (h2.symm.trans (h.symm.trans h1)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specIdealSheaf_le_iff
statement: theorem specIdealSheaf_le_iff (P Q : Ideal R) : specIdealSheaf P ≤ specIdealSheaf Q ↔ P ≤ Q
proof:
:= by
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.bijective
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 := le_def.mp h ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
    rw [specIdealSheaf, specIdealSheaf, ofIdealTop_ideal_top, ofIdealTop_ideal_top] at h1
    intro p hp
    have h2 := h1 (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hp)
    rwa [← Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij] at h2
  · intro h
    refine le_of_isAffine ?_
    rw [specIdealSheaf, specIdealSheaf, ofIdealTop_ideal_top, ofIdealTop_ideal_top]
    exact Ideal.map_mono h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specIdealSheaf_inj
statement: theorem specIdealSheaf_inj {P Q : Ideal R} (h : specIdealSheaf P = specIdealSheaf Q) : P = Q
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((specIdealSheaf_le_iff P Q).mp h.le) ((specIdealSheaf_le_iff Q P).mp h.ge)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specIdealSheaf_pow
statement:
theorem specIdealSheaf_pow (P : Ideal R) (m : ℕ) :
    specIdealSheaf (P ^ m) = specIdealSheaf P ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
    change ofIdealTop ((1 : Ideal R).map _) = _
    rw [Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.map_top, one_eq_top]
    exact le_antisymm le_top (le_of_isAffine (by rw [ofIdealTop_ideal_top]; exact le_top))
  | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ, specIdealSheaf_mul, ih, pow_succ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton
statement:
theorem isInvertible_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton {g : R} (hg : g ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {g})).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  change (ofIdealTop ((Ideal.span {g}).map _)).IsInvertible
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  exact isInvertible_ofIdealTop_span_singleton (map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv hg)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.eq_specIdealSheaf
statement:
theorem eq_specIdealSheaf (L : (Spec (.of R)).IdealSheafData) :
    L = specIdealSheaf ((L.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩).comap
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom)
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective
  change L = ofIdealTop _
  rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ hsurj]
  exact ((equivOfIsAffine (X := Spec (.of R))).left_inv L).symm

name: Ideal.map_span_pair
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_chart_eq_specIdealSheaf
statement:
theorem comap_chart_eq_specIdealSheaf :
    J'.comap (blowUp.chart I U a) = specIdealSheaf (chartIdeal I J' U a)
proof:
:=
  eq_specIdealSheaf _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.comap_exceptionalDivisor_chart
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.comap_exceptionalDivisor_chart :
    I.exceptionalDivisor.comap (blowUp.chart I U a) =
      specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a) a})
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowUp.chart_eq, comap_comp, blowUp.comap_exceptionalDivisor_ι,
    affineBlowUp.comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_mul_pow_chart
statement:
theorem comap_mul_pow_chart (m : ℕ) :
    (J' * I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m).comap (blowUp.chart I U a) =
      specIdealSheaf (chartIdeal I J' U a *
        Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a) a} ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comap_mul, comap_pow, comap_chart_eq_specIdealSheaf, blowUp.comap_exceptionalDivisor_chart,
    specIdealSheaf_mul, specIdealSheaf_pow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_comap_chart
statement:
theorem comap_comap_chart (K : X.IdealSheafData) :
    (K.comap (blowUpπ I)).comap (blowUp.chart I U a) =
      specIdealSheaf ((K.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a)))
proof:
:=
  comap_comap_eq_of_chart_π I (blowUpπ I) U a (blowUp.chart I U a) (blowUp.chart_π I U a) K

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow
statement:
theorem fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow (n : ℕ) {y : R} (hy : y ∈ I ^ n) :
    (fracPow I n hy : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) * algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a ^ n =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) y
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change awayFrac a n y * algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a ^ n =
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) y
  rw [← map_pow, awayFrac_mul_algebraMap_pow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow_add
statement:
theorem fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow_add (n j : ℕ) {y : R} (hy : y ∈ I ^ n) :
    (fracPow I n hy : affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) *
        algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a ^ (n + j) =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (a ^ j * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_add, ← mul_assoc, fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow, map_mul, map_pow, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_eq_mul_frac
statement:
theorem algebraMap_eq_mul_frac :
    algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) c =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a * frac (a := a) hc
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) c = algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a *
    (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) c * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a)
  rw [mul_left_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_pow_mul
statement:
theorem algebraMap_pow_mul (n k : ℕ) {y : R} (hy : y ∈ I ^ n) :
    algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) (c ^ k * y) =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a ^ (n + k) *
        (frac (a := a) hc ^ k * fracPow I n hy)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, algebraMap_eq_mul_frac I hc, ← fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow I n hy]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.pow_frac_mul_mem_of_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hk
  rw [pow_add, mul_comm (frac hc ^ N), mul_assoc]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartIdeal_mul_pow
statement:
theorem chartIdeal_mul_pow (a : I.ideal U) (m : ℕ) :
    chartIdeal I (J' * I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m) U a =
      chartIdeal I J' U a *
        Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a) a} ^ m
proof:
:=
  specIdealSheaf_inj
    ((comap_chart_eq_specIdealSheaf I _ U a).symm.trans (comap_mul_pow_chart I J' U a m))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_bound_of_mem_chartIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_bound_of_mem_chartIdeal (s : Finset (I.ideal U)) (c : I.ideal U) (n : ℕ)
    {y : Γ(X, U)} (hy : y ∈ (I.ideal U) ^ n)
    (hz : affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy ∈ chartIdeal I J' U c) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ k, N ≤ k →
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac (a := (a : Γ(X, U))) c.2 ^ k *
        affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy ∈ chartIdeal I J' U a
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ a : I.ideal U, ∃ N : ℕ, affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac (a := (a : Γ(X, U))) c.2 ^ N *
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy ∈ chartIdeal I J' U a := fun a =>
    affineBlowUpAlgebra.exists_pow_frac_mul_mem (I.ideal U) c.2 a.2
      (chartIdeal_map_transition I J' U c a) n hy hz
  choose N hN using h
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Finite.exists_le (fun a : s => N a)
  exact ⟨M, fun a ha k hk => affineBlowUpAlgebra.pow_frac_mul_mem_of_le (I.ideal U) c.2 n hy (hN a)
    ((hM ⟨a, ha⟩).trans hk)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_descendCenter_ideal
statement:
theorem mem_descendCenter_ideal [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (s : Finset (I.ideal U))
    (hs : Ideal.span (Subtype.val '' (s : Set (I.ideal U))) = I.ideal U) (c : I.ideal U) (n : ℕ)
    {y : Γ(X, U)} (hy : y ∈ (I.ideal U) ^ n) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ k, N ≤ k → affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac (a := (a : Γ(X, U))) c.2 ^ k *
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy ∈ chartIdeal I J' U a)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : N ≤ k) :
    (c : Γ(X, U)) ^ k * y ∈ (descendCenter I J' (n + k)).ideal U
proof:
:= by
  rw [descendCenter, ideal_inf, Pi.inf_apply, Submodule.mem_inf, ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply,
    mem_ideal_map_iff_chart I _ U (s : Set (I.ideal U)) hs]
  refine ⟨?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  · rw [add_comm, pow_add]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow c.2 k) hy
  · rw [chartIdeal_mul_pow, affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_pow_mul (I.ideal U) c.2 n k hy,
      mul_comm (chartIdeal I J' U a)]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) (n + k))
      (hN a ha k hk)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow_mem_map
statement:
theorem fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow_mem_map [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (s : Finset (I.ideal U))
    (hs : Ideal.span (Subtype.val '' (s : Set (I.ideal U))) = I.ideal U) (c : I.ideal U) (n : ℕ)
    {y : Γ(X, U)} (hy : y ∈ (I.ideal U) ^ n) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ k, N ≤ k → affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac (a := (a : Γ(X, U))) c.2 ^ k *
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy ∈ chartIdeal I J' U a) (k : ℕ) :
    affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy *
        algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) c ^ (n + (N + k)) ∈
      ((descendCenter I J' (n + (N + k))).ideal U).map
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow_add]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
    (mem_descendCenter_ideal I J' U s hs c n hy hN (N + k) (Nat.le_add_right _ _))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mul_mem_of_mem_span
statement:
theorem mul_mem_of_mem_span {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {G : Set A} {t : A} {Q : Ideal A}
    (h : ∀ g ∈ G, g * t ∈ Q) : ∀ r ∈ Ideal.span G, r * t ∈ Q
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun r _ => r * t ∈ Q) h ?_ ?_ ?_ hr
  · rw [zero_mul]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro r₁ r₂ _ _ h₁ h₂
    rw [add_mul]
    exact add_mem h₁ h₂
  · intro v r _ h
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ v h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.gen_mul_pow_mem_map
statement:
theorem gen_mul_pow_mem_map [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (s : Finset (I.ideal U))
    (hs : Ideal.span (Subtype.val '' (s : Set (I.ideal U))) = I.ideal U) (c : I.ideal U)
    (g : affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) (n : ℕ) {y : Γ(X, U)} (hy : y ∈ (I.ideal U) ^ n)
    (hg : g = affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ k, N ≤ k → affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac (a := (a : Γ(X, U))) c.2 ^ k *
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy ∈ chartIdeal I J' U a)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : n + N ≤ m) :
    g * algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) c ^ m ∈
      ((descendCenter I J' m).ideal U).map
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
  have hm' : m = n + (N + k) := by omega
  subst hg
  rw [hm']
  exact fracPow_mul_algebraMap_pow_mem_map I J' U s hs c n hy hN k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chartIdeal_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem exists_chartIdeal_mul_pow_le [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (s : Finset (I.ideal U))
    (hs : Ideal.span (Subtype.val '' (s : Set (I.ideal U))) = I.ideal U) (c : I.ideal U) :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m, m₀ ≤ m →
      chartIdeal I J' U c *
          Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) c} ^ m ≤
        ((descendCenter I J' m).ideal U).map
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))
proof:
:= by
  have := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  have hnoeth := isNoetherianRing_affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) (c : Γ(X, U))
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := IsNoetherian.noetherian (chartIdeal I J' U c)
  have hrep : ∀ g : G, ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ y : Γ(X, U), ∃ hy : y ∈ (I.ideal U) ^ n,
      (g : affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) = affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) n hy := by
    intro g
    obtain ⟨n, y, hy, hgy⟩ :=
      (mem_affineBlowUpAlgebra_iff c.2).mp (g : affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c).2
    exact ⟨n, y, hy, Subtype.ext hgy⟩
  choose n y hy hg using hrep
  have hbound : ∀ g : G, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ k, N ≤ k →
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.frac (a := (a : Γ(X, U))) c.2 ^ k *
        affineBlowUpAlgebra.fracPow (I.ideal U) (n g) (hy g) ∈ chartIdeal I J' U a := fun g =>
    exists_bound_of_mem_chartIdeal I J' U s c (n g) (hy g)
      (by rw [← hg g, ← hG]; exact Ideal.subset_span g.2)
  choose N hN using hbound
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Finite.exists_le (fun g : G => n g + N g)
  refine ⟨M, fun m hm => ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mul_le]
  intro r hr t ht
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp ht
  rw [mul_left_comm]
  refine Ideal.mul_mem_left _ u ?_
  rw [← hG] at hr
  exact mul_mem_of_mem_span (fun g hgG => gen_mul_pow_mem_map I J' U s hs c g (n ⟨g, hgG⟩)
    (hy ⟨g, hgG⟩) (hg ⟨g, hgG⟩) (hN ⟨g, hgG⟩) m ((hM ⟨g, hgG⟩).trans hm)) r hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.appLE_specMap_fromSpec
statement:
theorem appLE_specMap_fromSpec (ψ : Γ(X, V) →+* S)
    (e : (⊤ : (Spec (.of S)).Opens) ≤ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ hV.fromSpec) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (x : Γ(X, V)) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ hV.fromSpec).appLE V ⊤ e x =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv (ψ x)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ hV.fromSpec)
    hV (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of S))) e
  rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top, Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp] at h1
  have h2 : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ hV.fromSpec).appLE V ⊤ e =
      CommRingCat.ofHom ψ ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv :=
    Spec.map_injective ((cancel_mono hV.fromSpec).mp h1)
  exact congrArg (fun φ : Γ(X, V) ⟶ Γ(Spec (.of S), ⊤) => φ x) h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.appLE_eq_of_eq_specMap_fromSpec
statement:
theorem appLE_eq_of_eq_specMap_fromSpec (g : Spec (.of S) ⟶ X) (ψ : Γ(X, V) →+* S)
    (hg : g = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ hV.fromSpec)
    (e : (⊤ : (Spec (.of S)).Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (x : Γ(X, V)) :
    g.appLE V ⊤ e x = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv (ψ x)
proof:
:= by
  subst hg
  exact appLE_specMap_fromSpec hV ψ e x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chart_image_top_le
statement: theorem chart_image_top_le : blowUp.chart I U c ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
  intro y hy
  exact blowUp.range_chart_subset I U c (Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chart_comp_π_eq
statement:
theorem chart_comp_π_eq :
    blowUp.chart I U c ≫ blowUpπ I =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))) ≫
        U.2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  rw [blowUp.chart_π]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chart_comp_le
statement:
theorem chart_comp_le : (⊤ : (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))).Opens) ≤
    (blowUp.chart I U c ≫ blowUpπ I) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= fun z _ =>
  chart_image_top_le I U c (by rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]; exact ⟨z, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.appIso_hom_appLE_chart
statement:
theorem appIso_hom_appLE_chart (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    ((blowUp.chart I U c).appIso ⊤).hom
        ((blowUpπ I).appLE U.1 (blowUp.chart I U c ''ᵁ ⊤) (chart_image_top_le I U c) x) =
      (blowUp.chart I U c ≫ blowUpπ I).appLE U.1 ⊤ (chart_comp_le I U c) x
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun φ : Γ(blowUp I, blowUp.chart I U c ''ᵁ ⊤) ⟶
      Γ(Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c)), ⊤) =>
        φ ((blowUpπ I).appLE U.1 (blowUp.chart I U c ''ᵁ ⊤) (chart_image_top_le I U c) x))
    (Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom' (blowUp.chart I U c) ⊤)).trans
  (congrArg (fun φ : Γ(X, U) ⟶ Γ(Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c)), ⊤) => φ x)
    (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE (blowUp.chart I U c) (blowUpπ I) U.1 _ ⊤
      (chart_image_top_le I U c) (Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq _ ⊤).ge))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.appLE_chart_comp_π
statement:
theorem appLE_chart_comp_π (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    (blowUp.chart I U c ≫ blowUpπ I).appLE U.1 ⊤ (chart_comp_le I U c) x =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))).inv
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) x)
proof:
:=
  appLE_eq_of_eq_specMap_fromSpec U.2 _ _ (chart_comp_π_eq I U c) _ x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.appLE_chart_eq
statement:
theorem appLE_chart_eq (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    (blowUpπ I).appLE U.1 (blowUp.chart I U c ''ᵁ ⊤) (chart_image_top_le I U c) x =
      ((blowUp.chart I U c).appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))).inv
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) x))
proof:
:=
  (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply ((blowUp.chart I U c).appIso ⊤) _).symm.trans
    (congrArg ((blowUp.chart I U c).appIso ⊤).inv
      ((appIso_hom_appLE_chart I U c x).trans (appLE_chart_comp_π I U c x)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_chartIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_chartIdeal_iff (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) :
    z ∈ chartIdeal I L U c ↔
      ((blowUp.chart I U c).appIso ⊤).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))).inv z) ∈
          L.ideal (chartOpen I U c)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.ext_iff.mp
    (ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion L (blowUp.chart I U c) ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩)
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))).inv z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.appLE_chart_mem_ideal_iff
statement:
theorem appLE_chart_mem_ideal_iff (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    (blowUpπ I).appLE U.1 (chartOpen I U c).1 (chart_image_top_le I U c) x ∈
        L.ideal (chartOpen I U c) ↔
      algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) x ∈ chartIdeal I L U c
proof:
:=
  (Eq.to_iff (congrArg (fun w => w ∈ L.ideal (chartOpen I U c)) (appLE_chart_eq I U c x))).trans
    (mem_chartIdeal_iff I L U c _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_ideal_map_iff_chart
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_map_iff_chart [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (s : Set (I.ideal U))
    (hs : Ideal.span (Subtype.val '' s) = I.ideal U) (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    x ∈ (L.map (blowUpπ I)).ideal U ↔
      ∀ c ∈ s, algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) x ∈ chartIdeal I L U c
proof:
:= by
  have := blowUp.isProper_π I
  have hcov : blowUpπ I ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ≤ ⨆ c : s, (chartOpen I U c.1).1 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : y ∈ ⋃ a ∈ s, Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a) := by
      rw [blowUp.iUnion_range_chart_of_span_eq I U s hs]
      exact hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, z, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hy'
    refine Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
    change blowUp.chart I U a z ∈ blowUp.chart I U a ''ᵁ ⊤
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
    exact Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩
  refine (mem_ideal_map_iff_of_le_iSup (blowUpπ I) L U (fun c : s => chartOpen I U c.1)
    (fun c => chart_image_top_le I U c.1) hcov x).trans ⟨fun h c hc => ?_, fun h c => ?_⟩
  · exact (appLE_chart_mem_ideal_iff I L U c x).mp (h ⟨c, hc⟩)
  · exact (appLE_chart_mem_ideal_iff I L U c.1 x).mpr (h c.1 c.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_unique_iso_over_of_iso
statement:
theorem exists_unique_iso_over_of_iso {f : A ⟶ X} {g : B ⟶ X} {h : C ⟶ X}
    (e₁ : A ≅ B) (he₁ : e₁.hom ≫ g = f)
    (h₂ : ∃ e : B ≅ C, e.hom ≫ h = g ∧ ∀ ψ : B ⟶ C, ψ ≫ h = g → ψ = e.hom) :
    ∃ e : A ≅ C, e.hom ≫ h = f ∧ ∀ ψ : A ⟶ C, ψ ≫ h = f → ψ = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₂, he₂, hu₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨e₁ ≪≫ e₂, by rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, he₂, he₁], fun ψ hψ => ?_⟩
  have key : e₁.inv ≫ ψ = e₂.hom :=
    hu₂ _ (by rw [Category.assoc, hψ, ← he₁, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc])
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, ← key, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_iso_of_eq
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_iso_of_eq {L L' : X.IdealSheafData} (h : L = L') :
    ∃ e : blowUp L ≅ blowUp L', e.hom ≫ blowUpπ L' = blowUpπ L
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact ⟨Iso.refl _, Category.id_comp _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_iso_mul_isInvertible
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_iso_mul_isInvertible (J L : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hL : L.IsInvertible) :
    ∃ e : blowUp J ≅ blowUp (J * L), e.hom ≫ blowUpπ (J * L) = blowUpπ J ∧
      ∀ ψ : blowUp J ⟶ blowUp (J * L), ψ ≫ blowUpπ (J * L) = blowUpπ J → ψ = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, -⟩ := blowUp.exists_mul_isInvertible_iso J L hL
  have hinv : ((J * L).comap (blowUpπ J)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [comap_mul]
    exact (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π J).mul (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_of_isInvertible J L hL)
  refine ⟨e.symm, by rw [Iso.symm_hom, ← he, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc], fun ψ hψ => ?_⟩
  exact blowUp.hom_ext (J * L) (blowUpπ J) hinv ψ e.symm.hom hψ
    (by rw [Iso.symm_hom, ← he, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_iso_of_comap_descendCenter_eq
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_iso_of_comap_descendCenter_eq (m : ℕ)
    (hm : (descendCenter I J' m).comap (blowUpπ I) = J' * I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m) :
    ∃ e : blowUp J' ≅ blowUp (I * descendCenter I J' m),
      e.hom ≫ blowUpπ (I * descendCenter I J' m) = blowUpπ J' ≫ blowUpπ I ∧
      ∀ ψ : blowUp J' ⟶ blowUp (I * descendCenter I J' m),
        ψ ≫ blowUpπ (I * descendCenter I J' m) = blowUpπ J' ≫ blowUpπ I → ψ = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁, -⟩ := blowUp.exists_iso_mul_isInvertible J' (I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m)
    (Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_pow (blowUp.isInvertible_comap_π I) m)
  obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := blowUp.exists_iso_of_eq hm.symm
  refine exists_unique_iso_over_of_iso
    (g := blowUpπ (J' * I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m) ≫ blowUpπ I) e₁
    (by rw [← Category.assoc, he₁]) ?_
  exact exists_unique_iso_over_of_iso e₂ (by rw [← Category.assoc, he₂])
    (blowUp.exists_mulIso I (descendCenter I J' m))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_comp_iso
statement:
theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.exists_comp_iso [IsNoetherian X] :
    ∃ K : X.IdealSheafData,
      (K.support : Set X) = (I.support : Set X) ∪ blowUpπ I '' (J'.support : Set (blowUp I)) ∧
      ∃ e : blowUp J' ≅ blowUp K,
        e.hom ≫ blowUpπ K = blowUpπ J' ≫ blowUpπ I ∧
        ∀ ψ : blowUp J' ⟶ blowUp K, ψ ≫ blowUpπ K = blowUpπ J' ≫ blowUpπ I → ψ = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := exists_comap_descendCenter_eq I J'
  exact ⟨I * descendCenter I J' m₀, support_mul_descendCenter I J' m₀ (hm₀ m₀ le_rfl),
    blowUp.exists_iso_of_comap_descendCenter_eq I J' m₀ (hm₀ m₀ le_rfl)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finset_affineOpens_iSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_finset_affineOpens_iSup_eq_top [CompactSpace X] :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Finset X.affineOpens, ⨆ U ∈ 𝒰, (U : X.Opens) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover (fun U : X.affineOpens => (U.1 : Set X))
    (fun U => U.1.2) (fun x _ => by
      obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨U, hU⟩)
  refine ⟨t, eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (Set.mem_univ x))
  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨U, Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨hU, hx⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finset_span_eq
statement:
theorem exists_finset_span_eq [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    ∃ s : Finset (I.ideal U), Ideal.span (Subtype.val '' (s : Set (I.ideal U))) = I.ideal U
proof:
:= by
  have := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsNoetherian.noetherian (I.ideal U)
  have hsub : (t : Set Γ(X, U)) ⊆ I.ideal U := fun x hx => ht ▸ Ideal.subset_span hx
  have hfin : (Subtype.val ⁻¹' (t : Set Γ(X, U)) : Set (I.ideal U)).Finite :=
    t.finite_toSet.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn
  refine ⟨hfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, Set.image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  · exact ht
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨⟨x, hsub hx⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_ideal_chartOpen_iff
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_chartOpen_iff (L : (blowUp I).IdealSheafData)
    (w : Γ(blowUp I, chartOpen I U c)) :
    w ∈ L.ideal (chartOpen I U c) ↔
      ((blowUp.chart I U c).appIso ⊤).hom w ∈
        (L.comap (blowUp.chart I U c)).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
proof:
:=
  (Eq.to_iff (congrArg (fun v => v ∈ L.ideal (chartOpen I U c))
    (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply ((blowUp.chart I U c).appIso ⊤) w).symm)).trans
    (SetLike.ext_iff.mp
      (ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion L (blowUp.chart I U c) ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩) _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ideal_chartOpen_le_of_comap_le
proof:
:= fun w hw =>
  (mem_ideal_chartOpen_iff I U c L' w).mpr
    (le_def.mp h ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ((mem_ideal_chartOpen_iff I U c L w).mp hw))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_chart_le_of_ideal_le
statement:
theorem comap_chart_le_of_ideal_le (m : ℕ)
    (h : chartIdeal I J' U c *
        Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c) c} ^ m ≤
      ((descendCenter I J' m).ideal U).map
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) c))) :
    (J' * I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m).comap (blowUp.chart I U c) ≤
      ((descendCenter I J' m).comap (blowUpπ I)).comap (blowUp.chart I U c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comap_mul_pow_chart, comap_comap_chart, specIdealSheaf_le_iff]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_comap_descendCenter_eq
statement:
theorem exists_comap_descendCenter_eq [IsNoetherian X] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m, m₀ ≤ m →
      (descendCenter I J' m).comap (blowUpπ I) = J' * I.exceptionalDivisor ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨𝒰, h𝒰⟩ := exists_finset_affineOpens_iSup_eq_top (X := X)
  choose s hs using exists_finset_span_eq I
  choose m₀ hm₀ using fun p : Σ V : 𝒰, s V.1 =>
    exists_chartIdeal_mul_pow_le I J' p.1.1 (s p.1.1) (hs p.1.1) p.2.1
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Finite.exists_le m₀
  refine ⟨M, fun m hm => le_antisymm (comap_descendCenter_le I J' m) ?_⟩
  have hcov : ⨆ p : Σ V : 𝒰, s V.1, (chartOpen I p.1.1 p.2.1).1 = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    have hy : blowUpπ I y ∈ ⨆ V ∈ 𝒰, (V : X.Opens) := by rw [h𝒰]; exact Opens.mem_top _
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy
    obtain ⟨hV𝒰, hyV⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hV
    have hy' : y ∈ ⋃ a ∈ (s V : Set (I.ideal V)), Set.range (blowUp.chart I V a) := by
      rw [blowUp.iUnion_range_chart_of_span_eq I V _ (hs V)]
      exact hyV
    obtain ⟨a, ha, z, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hy'
    refine Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨⟨V, hV𝒰⟩, ⟨a, ha⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    change blowUp.chart I V a z ∈ blowUp.chart I V a ''ᵁ ⊤
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
    exact Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩
  exact le_of_iSup_eq_top (fun p : Σ V : 𝒰, s V.1 => chartOpen I p.1.1 p.2.1) hcov fun p =>
    ideal_chartOpen_le_of_comap_le I p.1.1 p.2.1
      (comap_chart_le_of_ideal_le I J' p.1.1 p.2.1 m (hm₀ p m ((hM p).trans hm)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.isProper_π
statement: theorem affineBlowUp.isProper_π (hI : I.FG) : IsProper (affineBlowUp.π I)
proof:
:= by
  have := reesAlgebra.finiteType_of_fg I hI
  have h₁ : IsProper (Proj.toSpecZero (reesAlgebra.grading I)) := inferInstance
  have h₂ : IsProper (Spec.map (reesAlgebra.gradingZeroEquiv I).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom) :=
    inferInstance
  unfold affineBlowUp.π
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_id
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_id (I : Ideal R) (hJ : I.map (RingHom.id R) = I) :
    affineBlowUp.mapOfEq (RingHom.id R) hJ = 𝟙 (affineBlowUp I)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (f : reesAlgebra.grading I →+*ᵍ reesAlgebra.grading I) (hf),
      f = GradedRingHom.id _ → Proj.map f hf = 𝟙 (Proj (reesAlgebra.grading I)) := by
    rintro f hf rfl
    exact Proj.map_id
  exact key _ _ (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_id hJ.le)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_eq_id
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_eq_id {φ : R →+* R} (hφ : φ = RingHom.id R) (I : Ideal R)
    (hJ : I.map φ = I) : affineBlowUp.mapOfEq φ hJ = 𝟙 (affineBlowUp I)
proof:
:= by
  subst hφ
  exact affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_id I hJ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_comp
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_comp (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : S →+* T) (hJ : I.map φ = J)
    (hK : J.map ψ = K) (hK' : I.map (ψ.comp φ) = K) :
    affineBlowUp.mapOfEq (ψ.comp φ) hK' =
      affineBlowUp.mapOfEq ψ hK ≫ affineBlowUp.mapOfEq φ hJ
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (g : reesAlgebra.grading I →+*ᵍ reesAlgebra.grading K) (hg),
      g = (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe ψ hK.le).comp (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hJ.le) →
        Proj.map g hg = Proj.map (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe ψ hK.le)
          (reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_mapOfEq ψ hK) ≫ Proj.map (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hJ.le)
          (reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_mapOfEq φ hJ) := by
    rintro g hg rfl
    exact Proj.map_comp _ _ _ _
  exact key _ _ (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_comp φ ψ hJ.le hK.le hK'.le)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_eq_comp
proof:
:= by
  subst hχ
  exact affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_comp φ ψ hJ hK hK'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_π
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_π (φ : R →+* S) (hJ : I.map φ = J) :
    affineBlowUp.mapOfEq φ hJ ≫ affineBlowUp.π I =
      affineBlowUp.π J ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineBlowUp.mapOfEq affineBlowUp.π
  rw [Category.assoc, Proj.map_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r => ?_)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
    RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
  exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (reesAlgebra.coe_mapOfLe_gradingZeroEquiv_symm φ hJ.le r))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mapHom_eq_id
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.mapHom_eq_id {φ : R ⟶ R} (hφ : φ = 𝟙 R) (I : Ideal R)
    (hJ : I.map φ.hom = I) : affineBlowUp.mapHom φ hJ = 𝟙 (affineBlowUp I)
proof:
:= by
  subst hφ
  exact affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_eq_id CommRingCat.hom_id I hJ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mapHom_eq_comp
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.mapHom_eq_comp {φ : R ⟶ S} {ψ : S ⟶ T} {χ : R ⟶ T} (hχ : χ = φ ≫ ψ)
    (hJ : I.map φ.hom = J) (hK : J.map ψ.hom = K) (hK' : I.map χ.hom = K) :
    affineBlowUp.mapHom χ hK' = affineBlowUp.mapHom ψ hK ≫ affineBlowUp.mapHom φ hJ
proof:
:= by
  subst hχ
  exact affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_eq_comp (CommRingCat.hom_comp φ ψ) hJ hK hK'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mapHom_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineBlowUp.mapHom_π (φ : R ⟶ S) (hJ : I.map φ.hom = J) :
    affineBlowUp.mapHom φ hJ ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = affineBlowUp.π J ≫ Spec.map φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineBlowUp.mapHom
  rw [affineBlowUp.mapOfEq_π, CommRingCat.ofHom_hom]
