name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineOpens_isAffineOpen
statement: theorem affineOpens_isAffineOpen (U : X.affineOpens) : IsAffineOpen U.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart (a : I) :
    (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).comap (affineBlowUp.chart I a) =
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((Ideal.span {algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) a}).map
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))).inv.hom)
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, affineBlowUp.chart_π,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_ofIdealTop_Spec_map, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
    affineBlowUpAlgebra.map_algebraMap_eq_span_singleton a.2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.ideal_comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart_top
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.ideal_comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart_top (a : I) :
    ((affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).comap (affineBlowUp.chart I a)).ideal
        ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ =
      Ideal.span {affineBlowUp.chartGenerator I a}
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineBlowUp.comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop_ideal,
    show homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))).Opens) ≤ ⊤) = 𝟙 _ from rfl,
    op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, CommRingCat.hom_id, Ideal.map_id, Ideal.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.chartGenerator_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.chartGenerator_mem_nonZeroDivisors (a : I) :
    affineBlowUp.chartGenerator I a ∈
      nonZeroDivisors Γ(Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)), ⊤)
proof:
:=
  map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    affineBlowUpAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.exists_generator_exceptionalIdeal_image_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.exists_generator_exceptionalIdeal_image_chart (a : I)
    (W : (affineBlowUp I).Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (hWeq : W = affineBlowUp.chart I a ''ᵁ ⊤) :
    ∃ f ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(affineBlowUp I, W),
      (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).ideal ⟨W, hW⟩ = Ideal.span {f}
proof:
:= by
  subst hWeq
  set j := affineBlowUp.chart I a
  set e := (j.appIso ⊤).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  let ψ : Γ(Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)), ⊤) →+* Γ(affineBlowUp I, j ''ᵁ ⊤) := e.symm
  have hψ : (j.appIso ⊤).inv.hom = ψ := RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl
  have hψs : Function.Surjective ψ := e.symm.surjective
  have h1 : ((affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).comap j).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ =
      ((affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).ideal ⟨j ''ᵁ ⊤, hW⟩).comap (j.appIso ⊤).inv.hom :=
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I) j ⟨⊤,
        isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  rw [affineBlowUp.ideal_comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart_top, hψ] at h1
  refine ⟨ψ (affineBlowUp.chartGenerator I a),
    map_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ringEquiv e.symm
      (affineBlowUp.chartGenerator_mem_nonZeroDivisors I a), ?_⟩
  have h2 := congrArg (Ideal.map ψ) h1
  rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective ψ hψs, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at h2
  exact h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.exists_generator_exceptionalIdeal_opensRange_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.exists_generator_exceptionalIdeal_opensRange_chart (a : I) :
    ∃ f ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(affineBlowUp I, (affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange),
      (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).ideal
        ⟨(affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩ = Ideal.span {f}
proof:
:=
  affineBlowUp.exists_generator_exceptionalIdeal_image_chart I a _ _
    (Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.isInvertible_exceptionalIdeal
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.isInvertible_exceptionalIdeal :
    (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).IsInvertible
proof:
:= fun x => by
  obtain ⟨a, hx⟩ := affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart I x
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hJ⟩ := affineBlowUp.exists_generator_exceptionalIdeal_opensRange_chart I a
  exact ⟨⟨(affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩, hx, f, hf, hJ⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.opensRange_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.opensRange_chart (a : I) :
    (affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange =
      Proj.basicOpen (reesAlgebra.grading I) (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineBlowUp.chart
  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp_of_isIso, Proj.opensRange_awayι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart (x : affineBlowUp I) :
    ∃ a : I, x ∈ (affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  have h := Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top (reesAlgebra.grading I) (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I)
    (reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne I)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp (h ▸ TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top x)
  exact ⟨a, (affineBlowUp.opensRange_chart I a).symm ▸ ha⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart :
    ⨆ a : I, (affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ =>
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr (affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart I x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq (x : affineBlowUp I) :
    ∃ y : s, x ∈ (affineBlowUp.chart I ⟨y, hs ▸ Ideal.subset_span y.2⟩).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  have h := Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top (reesAlgebra.grading I)
    (fun y : s => reesAlgebra.degreeOne I ⟨y, hs ▸ Ideal.subset_span y.2⟩)
    (reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne_of_span_eq I s hs)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp (h ▸ TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top x)
  exact ⟨y, (affineBlowUp.opensRange_chart I _).symm ▸ hy⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.iSup_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq :
    ⨆ y : s, (affineBlowUp.chart I ⟨y, hs ▸ Ideal.subset_span y.2⟩).opensRange = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ =>
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
      (affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq I s hs x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.isEmpty_bot
statement: theorem affineBlowUp.isEmpty_bot : IsEmpty (affineBlowUp (⊥ : Ideal R))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => (affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart_of_span_eq (⊥ : Ideal R) ∅
    Ideal.span_empty x).choose.2.elim⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.chart_π
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.chart_π (a : I) :
    affineBlowUp.chart I a ≫ affineBlowUp.π I =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineBlowUp.chart affineBlowUp.π
  rw [Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r => ?_)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
    RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom, reesAlgebra.chartIso, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
  exact reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv_fromZeroRingHom a r

name: reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv_isLocalizationElem
statement:
theorem _root_.reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv_isLocalizationElem (a b : I) :
    reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv a
        (Away.isLocalizationElem (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a) (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem b)) =
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I a b
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  change (reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv a (Away.mk _ (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a) 1
    (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I b ^ 1) _) : Localization.Away (a : R)) = awayFrac (a : R) 1 (b : R)
  rw [reesAlgebra.coe_chartRingEquiv_mk]
  congr 1
  rw [pow_one, reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne, coeff_monomial_same]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.chart_preimage_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.chart_preimage_chart (a b : I) :
    affineBlowUp.chart I a ⁻¹ᵁ (affineBlowUp.chart I b).opensRange =
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineBlowUp.opensRange_chart]
  unfold affineBlowUp.chart
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen _ (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a) one_pos
      (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem b) one_pos,
    SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen, ← reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv_isLocalizationElem]
  rfl

name: reesAlgebra.gradingZeroEquiv_apply

@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebra.gradingZeroEquiv_apply (p : reesAlgebra.grading I 0) :

name: reesAlgebra.coe_gradingZeroEquiv_symm

@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebra.coe_gradingZeroEquiv_symm (r : R) :

theorem reesAlgebra.algebraMap_gradingZeroEquiv_symm (r : R) :

name: reesAlgebra.coe_mapOfLe_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebra.coe_mapOfLe_apply (φ : R →+* S) (hIJ : I.map φ ≤ J) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hIJ p : reesAlgebra J) : S[X]) = (p : R[X]).map φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_degreeOne
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_degreeOne (φ : R →+* S) (hIJ : I.map φ ≤ J) (a : I) :
    reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hIJ (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a) =
      reesAlgebra.degreeOne J ⟨φ a, hIJ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ a.2)⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by simp [map_monomial])

name: reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_id
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_id (h : I.map (RingHom.id R) ≤ I) :
    reesAlgebra.mapOfLe (RingHom.id R) h = GradedRingHom.id (reesAlgebra.grading I)
proof:
:=
  GradedRingHom.ext fun p => Subtype.ext (Polynomial.map_id (p := (p : R[X])))

name: reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_comp
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_comp (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : S →+* T) (hIJ : I.map φ ≤ J)
    (hJK : J.map ψ ≤ K) (hIK : I.map (ψ.comp φ) ≤ K) :
    reesAlgebra.mapOfLe (ψ.comp φ) hIK =
      (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe ψ hJK).comp (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hIJ)
proof:
:=
  GradedRingHom.ext fun p => Subtype.ext (Polynomial.map_map φ ψ (p : R[X])).symm

name: reesAlgebra.coe_mapOfLe_gradingZeroEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.coe_mapOfLe_gradingZeroEquiv_symm (φ : R →+* S) (hIJ : I.map φ ≤ J) (r : R) :
    ((reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hIJ ((reesAlgebra.gradingZeroEquiv I).symm r) : reesAlgebra J) : S[X]) =
      (((reesAlgebra.gradingZeroEquiv J).symm (φ r) : reesAlgebra J) : S[X])
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesAlgebra.coe_mapOfLe_apply, reesAlgebra.coe_gradingZeroEquiv_symm,
    reesAlgebra.coe_gradingZeroEquiv_symm, map_C]

name: reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_mapOfEq
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_mapOfEq (φ : R →+* S) (hJ : I.map φ = J) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (reesAlgebra.grading J) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (reesAlgebra.grading I)).map (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hJ.le)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toIdeal_le_toIdeal_iff, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map]
  refine (reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne J).trans (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
  set M := (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (reesAlgebra.grading I)).toIdeal.map
    (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hJ.le) with hM
  have hb : (b : S) ∈ Ideal.map φ I := hJ ▸ b.2
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun b _ => ∀ hb : b ∈ J, reesAlgebra.degreeOne J ⟨b, hb⟩ ∈ M) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hb b.2
  · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ hb
    rw [show reesAlgebra.degreeOne J ⟨φ a, hb⟩ =
        reesAlgebra.mapOfLe φ hJ.le (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I ⟨a, ha⟩) from
      (reesAlgebra.mapOfLe_degreeOne φ hJ.le ⟨a, ha⟩).symm]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
      (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ one_pos (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem _))
  · intro _
    exact (map_zero (reesAlgebra.degreeOne J)).symm ▸ Ideal.zero_mem _
  · intro x y hx hy ihx ihy _
    have hx' : x ∈ J := hJ ▸ hx
    have hy' : y ∈ J := hJ ▸ hy
    exact (map_add (reesAlgebra.degreeOne J) ⟨x, hx'⟩ ⟨y, hy'⟩).symm ▸
      Ideal.add_mem _ (ihx hx') (ihy hy')
  · intro s x hx ih _
    have hx' : x ∈ J := hJ ▸ hx
    exact (map_smul (reesAlgebra.degreeOne J) s ⟨x, hx'⟩).symm ▸
      Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ s (ih hx')

name: GradedRingHom.coe_zeroRingHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem GradedRingHom.coe_zeroRingHom_apply (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (x : 𝒜 0) :
    (GradedRingHom.zeroRingHom f x : B) = f x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Away.map_fromZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Away.map_fromZeroRingHom (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (s : A) (x : 𝒜 0) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map f s (fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 (Submonoid.powers s) x) =
      fromZeroRingHom ℬ (Submonoid.powers (f s)) (GradedRingHom.zeroRingHom f x)
proof:
:= by
  change HomogeneousLocalization.map f _ (HomogeneousLocalization.mk ⟨0, x, 1, one_mem _⟩) =
    HomogeneousLocalization.mk ⟨0, GradedRingHom.zeroRingHom f x, 1, one_mem _⟩
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.ext_iff_val, val_mk, val_mk]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (map_one f)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι_map_toSpecZero
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι_map_toSpecZero (i : ℕ+) (x : 𝒜 i) :
    Proj.awayι ℬ (f x) (f.2 x.2) i.pos ≫ Proj.map f hf ≫ Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 =
      Proj.awayι ℬ (f x) (f.2 x.2) i.pos ≫ Proj.toSpecZero ℬ ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (GradedRingHom.zeroRingHom f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proj.awayι_comp_map_assoc _ _ i.pos _ x.2, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero,
    Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun y => ?_)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
  exact Away.map_fromZeroRingHom f _ y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_toSpecZero
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_toSpecZero :
    Proj.map f hf ≫ Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 =
      Proj.toSpecZero ℬ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (GradedRingHom.zeroRingHom f))
proof:
:=
  (Proj.mapAffineOpenCover f hf).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun s =>
    Proj.awayι_map_toSpecZero f hf s.1 s.2

name: reesAlgebra.evalInv_apply
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.evalInv_apply (a : R) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    reesAlgebra.evalInv I a p =
      Polynomial.aeval (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a : Localization.Away a) (p : R[X])
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reesAlgebra.evalInv_of_coe_eq_monomial
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.evalInv_of_coe_eq_monomial {a : R} {n : ℕ} {c : R} {p : reesAlgebra I}
    (hp : (p : R[X]) = monomial n c) : reesAlgebra.evalInv I a p = awayFrac a n c
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesAlgebra.evalInv_apply, hp, aeval_monomial]
  unfold awayFrac
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq]
  change algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) c * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a ^ n *
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) (a ^ n) = algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) c
  rw [map_pow, mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_comm (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf a),
    IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, one_pow, mul_one]

name: reesAlgebra.evalInv_degreeOne
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.evalInv_degreeOne (a : I) :
    reesAlgebra.evalInv I a (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesAlgebra.evalInv_of_coe_eq_monomial (reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne a), awayFrac_one]
  exact Localization.mk_self ⟨(a : R), Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩

name: reesAlgebra.awayLift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.awayLift_algebraMap (a : I) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    reesAlgebra.awayLift a
        (algebraMap (reesAlgebra I) (Localization.Away (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a)) p) =
      reesAlgebra.evalInv I a p
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq _ _ p

name: reesAlgebra.mem_grading_smul_one_iff
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mem_grading_smul_one_iff {n : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra I} :
    p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I (n • 1) ↔ p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I n
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: reesAlgebra.chartHom_mk
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.chartHom_mk (a : I) (n : ℕ) (x : reesAlgebra I)
    (hx : x ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I (n • 1)) :
    reesAlgebra.chartHom a (Away.mk _ (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a) n x hx) =
      reesAlgebra.evalInv I a x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reesAlgebra.chartHom, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    Away.val_mk]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply]
  unfold reesAlgebra.awayLift IsLocalization.Away.lift
  rw [IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec]
  simp [map_pow, reesAlgebra.evalInv_degreeOne]

name: reesAlgebra.chartHom_mk_eq_awayFrac
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.chartHom_mk_eq_awayFrac (a : I) (n : ℕ) (x : reesAlgebra I)
    (hx : x ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I (n • 1)) :
    reesAlgebra.chartHom a (Away.mk _ (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a) n x hx) =
      awayFrac (a : R) n ((x : R[X]).coeff n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesAlgebra.chartHom_mk]
  exact reesAlgebra.evalInv_of_coe_eq_monomial
    (reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading (reesAlgebra.mem_grading_smul_one_iff.mp hx)).1

name: reesAlgebra.chartHom_mem
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.chartHom_mem (a : I)
    (z : Away (reesAlgebra.grading I) (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a)) :
    reesAlgebra.chartHom a z ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x, hx, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective _ (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a) z
  rw [reesAlgebra.chartHom_mk_eq_awayFrac]
  exact awayFrac_mem_affineBlowUpAlgebra n
    (reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading (reesAlgebra.mem_grading_smul_one_iff.mp hx)).2

name: reesAlgebra.chartHom_injective
statement: theorem reesAlgebra.chartHom_injective (a : I) : Function.Injective (reesAlgebra.chartHom a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, x, hx, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective _ (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a) z
  have hx' := reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading (reesAlgebra.mem_grading_smul_one_iff.mp hx)
  rw [reesAlgebra.chartHom_mk_eq_awayFrac] at hz
  unfold awayFrac at hz
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hz
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := hz
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [Away.val_mk, val_zero, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨⟨reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a ^ k, k, rfl⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  change ((reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a ^ k * x : reesAlgebra I) : R[X]) = 0
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne, monomial_pow, hx'.1,
    monomial_mul_monomial, hk, monomial_zero_right]

name: reesAlgebra.coe_chartRingEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebra.coe_chartRingEquiv_mk (a : I) (n : ℕ) (x : reesAlgebra I)
    (hx : x ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I (n • 1)) :
    (reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv a (Away.mk _ (reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a) n x hx) :
      Localization.Away (a : R)) = awayFrac (a : R) n ((x : R[X]).coeff n)
proof:
:=
  reesAlgebra.chartHom_mk_eq_awayFrac a n x hx

name: reesAlgebra.coe_chartRingEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.coe_chartRingEquiv_apply (a : I)
    (z : Away (reesAlgebra.grading I) (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a)) :
    (reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv a z : Localization.Away (a : R)) = reesAlgebra.chartHom a z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reesAlgebra.val_fromZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.val_fromZeroRingHom (x : Submonoid (reesAlgebra I))
    (f : reesAlgebra.grading I 0) :
    (fromZeroRingHom (reesAlgebra.grading I) x f).val =
      algebraMap (reesAlgebra I) (Localization x) (f : reesAlgebra I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: reesAlgebra.chartHom_fromZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.chartHom_fromZeroRingHom (a : I) (r : R) :
    reesAlgebra.chartHom a
        (fromZeroRingHom (reesAlgebra.grading I) _ ((reesAlgebra.gradingZeroEquiv I).symm r)) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a : R)) r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reesAlgebra.chartHom, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    reesAlgebra.val_fromZeroRingHom, reesAlgebra.awayLift_algebraMap]
  change reesAlgebra.evalInv I a (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) r) = _
  exact (reesAlgebra.evalInv I a).commutes r

name: reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv_fromZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv_fromZeroRingHom (a : I) (r : R) :
    reesAlgebra.chartRingEquiv a
        (fromZeroRingHom (reesAlgebra.grading I) _ ((reesAlgebra.gradingZeroEquiv I).symm r)) =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) r
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext
    ((reesAlgebra.chartHom_fromZeroRingHom a r).trans (Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap _ r).symm)

name: reesAlgebra.coe_component
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebra.coe_component (n : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((reesAlgebra.component I n p : reesAlgebra I) : R[X]) = monomial n ((p : R[X]).coeff n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne (a : I) :
    (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a : R[X]) = monomial 1 (a : R)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem (a : I) :
    reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I 1
proof:
:=
  reesAlgebra.mem_grading_of_coe_eq_monomial rfl

name: reesAlgebra.mem_grading_one_iff
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mem_grading_one_iff {p : reesAlgebra I} :
    p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I 1 ↔ ∃ a : I, reesAlgebra.degreeOne I a = p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hp => ?_, fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => ha ▸ reesAlgebra.degreeOne_mem a⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hpc⟩ := reesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff_exists.mp hp
  exact ⟨⟨c, by simpa using hc⟩, Subtype.ext hpc.symm⟩

name: reesAlgebra.grading_one_eq_range
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.grading_one_eq_range :
    reesAlgebra.grading I 1 = LinearMap.range (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.ext fun _ => reesAlgebra.mem_grading_one_iff.trans LinearMap.mem_range.symm

name: reesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff {n : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra I} :
    p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I n ↔ ∀ j ≠ n, (p : R[X]).coeff j = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: reesAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_grading {n : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra I}
    (hp : p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I n) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ n) : (p : R[X]).coeff j = 0
proof:
:=
  reesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff.mp hp j hj

name: reesAlgebra.coeff_mem_pow
statement: theorem reesAlgebra.coeff_mem_pow (p : reesAlgebra I) (n : ℕ) : (p : R[X]).coeff n ∈ I ^ n
proof:
:=
  (mem_reesAlgebra_iff I p).mp p.2 n

name: reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Polynomial.ext fun j => ?_, reesAlgebra.coeff_mem_pow p n⟩
  rw [coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]
  · exact reesAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_grading hp (Ne.symm h)

name: reesAlgebra.mem_grading_of_coe_eq_monomial
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mem_grading_of_coe_eq_monomial {i : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra I} {c : R}
    (hp : (p : R[X]) = monomial i c) : p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I i
proof:
:=
  fun j hj => by rw [hp, coeff_monomial, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hj)]

name: reesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff_exists
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff_exists {n : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra I} :
    p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I n ↔ ∃ c ∈ I ^ n, (p : R[X]) = monomial n c
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hp => ⟨_, (reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading hp).2,
      (reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading hp).1⟩,
    fun ⟨_, _, hp⟩ => reesAlgebra.mem_grading_of_coe_eq_monomial hp⟩

name: reesAlgebra.component_of_mem
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.component_of_mem {n : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra I}
    (hp : p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I n) : reesAlgebra.component I n p = ⟨p, hp⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext <| Subtype.ext (reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading hp).1.symm

name: reesAlgebra.component_of_mem_of_ne
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.component_of_mem_of_ne {m n : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra I}
    (hp : p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I m) (h : m ≠ n) : reesAlgebra.component I n p = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext <| Subtype.ext <| by
    change monomial n ((p : R[X]).coeff n) = 0
    simp [reesAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem_grading hp (Ne.symm h)]

name: reesAlgebra.component_coeAddMonoidHom
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.component_coeAddMonoidHom (x : ⨁ i, reesAlgebra.grading I i) (n : ℕ) :
    reesAlgebra.component I n (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (reesAlgebra.grading I) x) = x n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x, map_sum, map_sum]
  simp_rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single n (fun i _ hi => reesAlgebra.component_of_mem_of_ne (x i).2 hi)
    fun hn => by rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hn, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, map_zero]]
  exact reesAlgebra.component_of_mem (x n).2

name: reesAlgebra.isInternal_grading
statement: theorem reesAlgebra.isInternal_grading : DirectSum.IsInternal (reesAlgebra.grading I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun x y hxy => DirectSum.ext fun n => ?_, fun p => ?_⟩
  · rw [← reesAlgebra.component_coeAddMonoidHom x n,
      ← reesAlgebra.component_coeAddMonoidHom y n, hxy]
  · refine ⟨∑ n ∈ (p : R[X]).support, DirectSum.of (fun i => reesAlgebra.grading I i) n
      (reesAlgebra.component I n p), ?_⟩
    rw [map_sum]
    simp_rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
    exact (Polynomial.as_sum_support (p : R[X])).symm

name: reesAlgebra.mem_grading_zero_iff
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.mem_grading_zero_iff {p : reesAlgebra I} :
    p ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I 0 ↔ ∃ r : R, (p : R[X]) = C r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    exact ⟨_, (reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading hp).1.trans (monomial_zero_left (a := _))⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact reesAlgebra.mem_grading_of_coe_eq_monomial (hr.trans (monomial_zero_left (a := r)).symm)

name: reesAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_grading_zero
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_grading_zero (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) r ∈ reesAlgebra.grading I 0
proof:
:=
  reesAlgebra.mem_grading_zero_iff.mpr ⟨r, by rw [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, algebraMap_eq]⟩

name: reesAlgebra.mem_span_degreeOne_of_coe_eq_monomial
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [pow_succ] at hc
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on' (C := fun c _ => ∀ q : reesAlgebra I,
    (q : R[X]) = monomial (m + 1) c → q ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I)))
    ?_ ?_ hc p hp
  · intro d hd a ha q hq
    have : q = ⟨monomial m d, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hd⟩ * reesAlgebra.degreeOne I ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (by rw [hq, Subalgebra.coe_mul, reesAlgebra.coe_degreeOne, monomial_mul_monomial])
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  · intro x hx y hy ihx ihy q hq
    have hx' : monomial (m + 1) x ∈ reesAlgebra I :=
      reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (by rw [pow_succ]; exact hx)
    have hy' : monomial (m + 1) y ∈ reesAlgebra I :=
      reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (by rw [pow_succ]; exact hy)
    have : q = ⟨monomial (m + 1) x, hx'⟩ + ⟨monomial (m + 1) y, hy'⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (by rw [hq, Subalgebra.coe_add, map_add])
    rw [this]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (ihx _ rfl) (ihy _ rfl)

name: reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (reesAlgebra.grading I)).toIdeal ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant, RingHom.mem_ker, GradedRing.projZeroRingHom_apply] at hx
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (reesAlgebra.grading I) x]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi
  · rw [hx]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  · obtain ⟨heq, hmem⟩ :=
      reesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem_grading (DirectSum.decompose (reesAlgebra.grading I) x i).2
    exact reesAlgebra.mem_span_degreeOne_of_coe_eq_monomial I hi hmem heq

name: reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne_of_span_eq (s : Set R) (hs : Ideal.span s = I) :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (reesAlgebra.grading I)).toIdeal ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun x : s =>
        reesAlgebra.degreeOne I ⟨x, hs ▸ Ideal.subset_span x.2⟩)
proof:
:= by
  refine (reesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_span_degreeOne I).trans (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  set J := Ideal.span (Set.range fun x : s =>
    reesAlgebra.degreeOne I ⟨x, hs ▸ Ideal.subset_span x.2⟩) with hJ
  have key : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ Ideal.span s), ∀ hx' : x ∈ I,
      reesAlgebra.degreeOne I ⟨x, hx'⟩ ∈ J := by
    intro x hx
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun x _ => ∀ hx' : x ∈ I, reesAlgebra.degreeOne I ⟨x, hx'⟩ ∈ J) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro x hxs _
      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨x, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro _
      exact (map_zero (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I)).symm ▸ Ideal.zero_mem _
    · intro x y hxs hys ihx ihy _
      have hx' : x ∈ I := hs ▸ hxs
      have hy' : y ∈ I := hs ▸ hys
      exact (map_add (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I) ⟨x, hx'⟩ ⟨y, hy'⟩).symm ▸
        Ideal.add_mem _ (ihx hx') (ihy hy')
    · intro r x hxs ih _
      have hx' : x ∈ I := hs ▸ hxs
      exact (map_smul (reesAlgebra.degreeOne I) r ⟨x, hx'⟩).symm ▸
        Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ r (ih hx')
  exact key a (hs ▸ a.2) a.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.injective_of_flat_of_surjective
statement:
theorem injective_of_flat_of_surjective {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Nontrivial S] (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.Flat) (hs : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  have hflat : Module.Flat R S := hf
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (Algebra.ofId R S) := hs
  have hpure : Module.Flat R (R ⧸ RingHom.ker f) :=
    Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hsurj).toLinearEquiv
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  have hxk : x ∈ RingHom.ker f := hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Ideal.exists_eq_mul_of_pure hxk
  have hym : y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (RingHom.ker_ne_top f) hy
  have hu : IsUnit (1 - y) := IsLocalRing.isUnit_one_sub_self_of_mem_nonunits y hym
  have hx0 : x * (1 - y) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← hxy, sub_self]
  exact hu.mul_left_eq_zero.mp hx0

name: Ideal.mem_of_forall_exists_mul_mem
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.mem_of_forall_exists_mul_mem {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {u : R}
    (h : ∀ Q : Ideal R, Q.IsMaximal → ∃ t ∉ Q, t * u ∈ I) : u ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hu
  have hne : I.colon ({u} : Set R) ≠ ⊤ := fun htop =>
    hu (by simpa using Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mp ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mp htop))
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hne
  obtain ⟨t, htQ, htu⟩ := h Q hQ
  exact htQ (hle (Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr (by simpa using htu)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.germ_eq_zero_of_flat_stalkMap
statement:
theorem germ_eq_zero_of_flat_stalkMap (J : X.IdealSheafData) (y : J.subscheme)
    (hflat : (J.subschemeι.stalkMap y).hom.Flat) (U : X.affineOpens) {x : X}
    (hxy : J.subschemeι y = x) (hx : x ∈ U.1) {j : Γ(X, U)} (hj : j ∈ J.ideal U) :
    X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hx j = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst hxy
  have hinj : Function.Injective (J.subschemeι.stalkMap y).hom :=
    injective_of_flat_of_surjective _ hflat (J.subschemeι.stalkMap_surjective y)
  apply hinj
  rw [map_zero]
  have h1 := Scheme.Hom.germ_appLE_apply J.subschemeι U.1 (J.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) le_rfl
    (z := y) hx hx j
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] at h1
  have h2 : (J.subschemeι.app U.1) j = 0 := by
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, J.ker_subschemeι_app U]
    exact hj
  rw [← h1, h2, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_mul_eq_zero_of_flat_stalkMap
statement:
theorem exists_mul_eq_zero_of_flat_stalkMap (J : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U)) (y : J.subscheme) (hy : J.subschemeι y = U.2.fromSpec q)
    (hflat : (J.subschemeι.stalkMap y).hom.Flat) {j : Γ(X, U)} (hj : j ∈ J.ideal U) :
    ∃ s ∉ q.asIdeal, s * j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  have hq : hU.fromSpec q ∈ U.1 := by
    have : q ∈ hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := by rw [hU.fromSpec_preimage_self]; trivial
    exact this
  have hgerm' : X.presheaf.germ U.1 (hU.fromSpec q) hq j = 0 :=
    germ_eq_zero_of_flat_stalkMap J y hflat U hy hq hj
  have hloc := hU.isLocalization_stalk' q hq
  have := (@IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff Γ(X, U) _ q.asIdeal.primeCompl
    (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec q)) _
    (TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨hU.fromSpec q, hq⟩) hloc j).mp hgerm'
  obtain ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, hsj⟩ := this
  exact ⟨s, hs, hsj⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.colon_comap_le_comap_of_flat
statement:
theorem colon_comap_le_comap_of_flat (π : B ⟶ X) (D J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hE : (D.comap π).IsInvertible)
    (hflat : ∀ y : J.subscheme, J.subschemeι y ∈ D.support →
      (J.subschemeι.stalkMap y).hom.Flat) :
    (J.comap π).colon (D.comap π) ≤ J.comap π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  
  have hcov : ∀ b : B, ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : B.affineOpens), b ∈ U'.1 ∧
      U'.1 ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ∧ ∃ e ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(B, U'), (D.comap π).ideal U' = Ideal.span {e} := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨W, hbW, e₀, he₀, hEW⟩ := hE b
    obtain ⟨U, V, hbV, hVU⟩ := IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpens_le_preimage π b
    have hW : IsAffineOpen W.1 := W.2
    obtain ⟨f, hfle, hbf⟩ := hW.exists_basicOpen_le (V := W.1 ⊓ V.1) ⟨b, ⟨hbW, hbV⟩⟩ hbW
    obtain ⟨e, he, hEe⟩ :=
      IdealSheafData.exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen (D.comap π) W he₀ hEW f
    exact ⟨U, B.affineBasicOpen f, hbf, (hfle.trans inf_le_right).trans hVU, e, he, hEe⟩
  choose U U' hbU' hle e he hEe using hcov
  refine IdealSheafData.le_of_iSup_eq_top U' ?_ fun b => ?_
  · exact top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨z, hbU' z⟩
  
  set φ := π.appLE (U b).1 (U' b).1 (hle b) with hφ
  rw [IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_of_isInvertible _ _ hE (U' b), hEe b, Ideal.colon_span,
    IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_le J π (U b) (U' b) (hle b)]
  intro u hu
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul] at hu
  refine Ideal.mem_of_forall_exists_mul_mem fun Q hQ => ?_
  by_cases heQ : e b ∈ Q
  · by_cases hJQ : (J.ideal (U b)).map φ.hom ≤ Q
    · 
      have hU : IsAffineOpen (U b).1 := (U b).2
      have hU' : IsAffineOpen (U' b).1 := (U' b).2
      let q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(B, U' b) := ⟨Q, hQ.isPrime⟩
      let p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U b) := PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom q
      have hp : p.asIdeal = Q.comap φ.hom := rfl
      
      have hπ : π (hU'.fromSpec q) = hU.fromSpec p := by
        have := congrArg (fun g => g q) (IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec π hU hU' (hle b))
        exact this.symm
      have hxU : hU.fromSpec p ∈ (U b).1 := by
        have : p ∈ hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (U b).1 := by rw [hU.fromSpec_preimage_self]; trivial
        exact this
      have hJp : J.ideal (U b) ≤ p.asIdeal := Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hJQ
      have hDp : D.ideal (U b) ≤ p.asIdeal := by
        refine Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp ?_
        rw [← IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_le D π (U b) (U' b) (hle b), hEe b, Ideal.span_le,
          Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        exact heQ
      have hxJ : hU.fromSpec p ∈ J.support := by
        rw [IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem hxU, IdealSheafData.fromSpec_mem_zeroLocus_iff]
        exact hJp
      have hxD : hU.fromSpec p ∈ D.support := by
        rw [IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem hxU, IdealSheafData.fromSpec_mem_zeroLocus_iff]
        exact hDp
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, J.subschemeι y = hU.fromSpec p := by
        have : hU.fromSpec p ∈ Set.range J.subschemeι := by
          rw [IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι]; exact hxJ
        exact this
      have hfl := hflat y (hy ▸ hxD)
      
      obtain ⟨T, hT, huT⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finite_of_mem_span hu
      have hTJ : ∀ t ∈ T, ∃ j ∈ J.ideal (U b), φ.hom j = t := fun t ht => hT ht
      choose! jT hjT hφj using hTJ
      have hann : ∀ t ∈ T, ∃ s ∉ p.asIdeal, s * jT t = 0 := fun t ht =>
        IdealSheafData.exists_mul_eq_zero_of_flat_stalkMap J (U b) p y hy hfl (hjT t ht)
      choose! sT hsT hsj using hann
      set s := ∏ t ∈ T, sT t with hs
      have hsp : s ∉ p.asIdeal :=
        Submonoid.prod_mem (p.asIdeal.primeCompl)
          (fun t ht => hsT t ht : ∀ t ∈ T, sT t ∈ p.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      
      have hzero : φ.hom s * (u * e b) = 0 := by
        obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_finset.mp huT
        rw [← hc, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t ht => ?_
        rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm, ← hφj t ht, ← map_mul, hs, ← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ ht,
          mul_assoc, hsj t ht, mul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
      have hsu : φ.hom s * u = 0 :=
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp (he b)).2 _ (by rw [mul_assoc]; exact hzero)
      refine ⟨φ.hom s, fun hsQ => hsp ?_, by rw [hsu]; exact zero_mem _⟩
      rw [hp, Ideal.mem_comap]
      exact hsQ
    · 
      obtain ⟨t, htI, htQ⟩ := IsConcreteLE.not_le_iff_exists.mp hJQ
      exact ⟨t, htQ, Ideal.mul_mem_right u _ htI⟩
  · 
    exact ⟨e b, heQ, by rw [mul_comm]; exact hu⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.strictTransformAlong_eq_comap_of_flat
statement:
theorem strictTransformAlong_eq_comap_of_flat (π : B ⟶ X) (D J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hE : (D.comap π).IsInvertible)
    (hflat : ∀ y : J.subscheme, J.subschemeι y ∈ D.support →
      (J.subschemeι.stalkMap y).hom.Flat) :
    J.strictTransformAlong π (D.comap π) = J.comap π
proof:
:=
  IdealSheafData.saturate_eq_self_of_colon_eq _ _
    (le_antisymm (colon_comap_le_comap_of_flat π D J hE hflat)
      (IdealSheafData.le_colon_self _ _))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpens_le_preimage
statement:
theorem exists_affineOpens_le_preimage (f : Y ⟶ X) (y : Y) :
    ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (V : Y.affineOpens), y ∈ V.1 ∧ V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (f y)
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hyV, hVU⟩ :=
    Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (show y ∈ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 : Set Y) from hU)
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).2
  exact ⟨U, ⟨V, hV⟩, hyV, hVU⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_mul
statement:
theorem comap_mul (I K : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    (I * K).comap f = I.comap f * K.comap f
proof:
:= by
  choose U V hyV hVU using exists_affineOpens_le_preimage f
  refine ext_of_iSup_eq_top V ?_ fun y => ?_
  · exact top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨z, hyV z⟩
  · rw [ideal_comap_of_le _ f (U y) (V y) (hVU y), ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply, ideal_mul,
      Pi.mul_apply, ideal_comap_of_le I f (U y) (V y) (hVU y),
      ideal_comap_of_le K f (U y) (V y) (hVU y), Ideal.map_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_pow
statement:
theorem comap_pow (K : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) (n : ℕ) :
    (K ^ n).comap f = K.comap f ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, comap_mul, ih, pow_succ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_iSup
statement:
theorem comap_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    (⨆ i, I i).comap f = ⨆ i, (I i).comap f
proof:
:=
  (map_gc f).l_iSup

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_colon_le
statement:
theorem comap_colon_le (I K : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    (I.colon K).comap f ≤ (I.comap f).colon (K.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_colon_iff_mul_le, ← comap_mul]
  exact comap_mono f (colon_mul_le I K)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_saturate_le
statement:
theorem comap_saturate_le (I K : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    (I.saturate K).comap f ≤ (I.comap f).saturate (K.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [saturate, comap_iSup]
  refine iSup_mono fun i => ?_
  rw [← comap_pow]
  exact comap_colon_le I (K ^ i) f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_pow_bot_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem colon_pow_bot_of_isInvertible {E : X.IdealSheafData} (hE : E.IsInvertible) (i : ℕ) :
    (⊥ : X.IdealSheafData).colon (E ^ i) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  have hEi := isInvertible_pow hE i
  choose U hxU e he hEe using hEi
  refine le_of_iSup_eq_top U ?_ fun x => ?_
  · exact top_le_iff.mp fun y _ => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨y, hxU y⟩
  · intro u hu
    have hu' := ideal_colon_le ⊥ (E ^ i) (U x) hu
    rw [hEe x] at hu'
    have hue : u * e x ∈ (⊥ : X.IdealSheafData).ideal (U x) := by
      simpa using Submodule.mem_colon.mp hu' (e x) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rw [ideal_bot, Pi.bot_apply, Ideal.mem_bot] at hue
    rw [ideal_bot, Pi.bot_apply, Ideal.mem_bot]
    exact (he x).2 u hue

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.saturate_bot_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem saturate_bot_of_isInvertible {E : X.IdealSheafData} (hE : E.IsInvertible) :
    (⊥ : X.IdealSheafData).saturate E = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [saturate]
  exact iSup_eq_bot.mpr fun i => colon_pow_bot_of_isInvertible hE i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.colon_saturate_of_fg
statement:
theorem colon_saturate_of_fg (I K : X.IdealSheafData) (hK : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, (K.ideal U).FG) :
    (I.saturate K).colon K = I.saturate K
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_colon_self _ K)
  refine le_def.mpr fun U => ?_
  rw [ideal_colon_of_fg _ K hK U, ideal_saturate]
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hK U
  have hdir : Directed (· ≤ ·) fun i : ℕ => (I.colon (K ^ i)).ideal U :=
    (show Monotone (fun i : ℕ => (I.colon (K ^ i)).ideal U) from
      fun _ _ h => colon_pow_mono I K h U).directed_le
  
  have key : ∀ k ∈ s, ∃ i : ℕ, u * k ∈ (I.colon (K ^ i)).ideal U := by
    intro k hk
    have : u * k ∈ ⨆ i : ℕ, (I.colon (K ^ i)).ideal U := by
      simpa using Submodule.mem_colon.mp hu k (hs ▸ Ideal.subset_span hk)
    exact (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ hdir).mp this
  choose! n hn using key
  classical
  set N := s.sup n with hN
  
  have hspan : ∀ b ∈ K.ideal U,
      u * b ∈ (I.ideal U).colon ((K.ideal U ^ N : Ideal Γ(X, U)) : Set Γ(X, U)) := by
    have hle : K.ideal U ≤
        ((I.ideal U).colon ((K.ideal U ^ N : Ideal Γ(X, U)) : Set Γ(X, U))).colon {u} := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hs]
      rw [Ideal.span_le]
      intro k hk
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      have h1 := ideal_colon_le I (K ^ (n k)) U (hn k hk)
      rw [ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply] at h1
      exact Submodule.colon_mono le_rfl
        (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Finset.le_sup (f := n) hk))) h1
    intro b hb
    have := hle hb
    rwa [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at this
  refine (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _ hdir).mpr ⟨N + 1, ?_⟩
  rw [ideal_colon_of_fg _ (K ^ (N + 1)) (fun V => (hK V).pow) U, ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply, pow_succ]
  refine Submodule.mem_colon.mpr fun v hv => ?_
  rw [smul_eq_mul]
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hv (fun a ha b hb => ?_)
    (fun x y hx hy => by rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy)
  rw [show u * (a * b) = (u * b) * a by ring]
  simpa using Submodule.mem_colon.mp (hspan b hb) a ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_subschemeι_eq_bot
statement: theorem comap_subschemeι_eq_bot (I : X.IdealSheafData) : I.comap I.subschemeι = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have h : I ≤ (⊥ : I.subscheme.IdealSheafData).map I.subschemeι := by
    rw [map_bot, ker_subschemeι]
  exact le_bot_iff.mp (le_map_iff_comap_le.mp h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isInvertible_comap_subschemeι_of_colon_eq
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_subschemeι_of_colon_eq {E S : X.IdealSheafData} (hE : E.IsInvertible)
    (hS : S.colon E = S) : (E.comap S.subschemeι).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, e, he, hEe⟩ := hE (S.subschemeι z)
  let ι := S.subschemeι
  let V : S.subscheme.affineOpens := ⟨ι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage ι⟩
  have hzV : z ∈ V.1 := hxU
  refine ⟨V, hzV, ι.app U.1 e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hker : ∀ u : Γ(X, U), ι.app U.1 u = 0 ↔ u ∈ S.ideal U := fun u => by
      rw [← S.ker_subschemeι_app U, RingHom.mem_ker]
    have hcol : (S.ideal U).colon ({e} : Set Γ(X, U)) = S.ideal U := by
      have this : (S.colon E).ideal U = S.ideal U := by rw [hS]
      rw [ideal_colon_of_isInvertible S E hE U, hEe, Ideal.colon_span] at this
      exact this
    have key : ∀ w : Γ(S.subscheme, V), w * ι.app U.1 e = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := S.subschemeι_app_surjective U w
      rw [← map_mul, hker] at hw
      have hu : u ∈ (S.ideal U).colon ({e} : Set Γ(X, U)) :=
        Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr (by simpa using hw)
      rw [hcol] at hu
      exact (hker u).mpr hu
    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mpr ⟨fun w hw => key w (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hw), key⟩
  · 
    rw [ideal_comap_of_le E ι U V le_rfl, hEe, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_strictTransform_subscheme
statement:
theorem exists_iso_strictTransform_subscheme {π : B ⟶ X} {π' : B' ⟶ J.subscheme}
    (hπ : IsBlowUp D π) (hπ' : IsBlowUp (D.comap J.subschemeι) π') :
    ∃ e : B' ≅ (J.strictTransformAlong π (D.comap π)).subscheme,
      e.hom ≫ (J.strictTransformAlong π (D.comap π)).subschemeι ≫ π = π' ≫ J.subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  set ι := J.subschemeι with hι
  set E := D.comap π with hE
  set S := J.strictTransformAlong π E with hSdef
  set ιs := S.subschemeι with hιs
  have hEfg : ∀ U : B.affineOpens, (E.ideal U).FG := fun U =>
    (IdealSheafData.IsInvertible.ideal E hπ.admissible U).fg
  have hSsat : S.colon E = S := IdealSheafData.colon_saturate_of_fg (J.comap π) E hEfg
  
  have hadm₁ : (D.comap (π' ≫ ι)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [IdealSheafData.comap_comp]; exact hπ'.admissible
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hπ.exists_lift (π' ≫ ι) hadm₁
  
  have hJφ : (J.comap π).comap φ = ⊥ := by
    rw [← IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hφ, IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hι,
      IdealSheafData.comap_subschemeι_eq_bot, IdealSheafData.comap_bot]
  have hEφ : E.comap φ = D.comap (π' ≫ ι) := by
    rw [hE, ← IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hφ]
  have hSφ : S.comap φ = ⊥ := by
    refine le_bot_iff.mp ((IdealSheafData.comap_saturate_le _ _ φ).trans ?_)
    rw [hJφ, hEφ, IdealSheafData.saturate_bot_of_isInvertible hadm₁]
  have hker₁ : ιs.ker ≤ φ.ker := by
    rw [hιs, IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι, ← IdealSheafData.map_bot,
      IdealSheafData.le_map_iff_comap_le, hSφ]
  let φ' : B' ⟶ S.subscheme := IsClosedImmersion.lift ιs φ hker₁
  have hφ' : φ' ≫ ιs = φ := IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac ιs φ hker₁
  
  have hker₂ : ι.ker ≤ (ιs ≫ π).ker := by
    rw [hι, IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι, ← IdealSheafData.map_bot,
      IdealSheafData.le_map_iff_comap_le, IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
    exact (IdealSheafData.comap_mono ιs (IdealSheafData.le_saturate (J.comap π) E)).trans
      (IdealSheafData.comap_subschemeι_eq_bot S).le
  let g : S.subscheme ⟶ J.subscheme := IsClosedImmersion.lift ι (ιs ≫ π) hker₂
  have hg : g ≫ ι = ιs ≫ π := IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac ι (ιs ≫ π) hker₂
  have hEιs : (E.comap ιs).IsInvertible :=
    IdealSheafData.isInvertible_comap_subschemeι_of_colon_eq hπ.admissible hSsat
  have hadm₂ : ((D.comap ι).comap g).IsInvertible := by
    rw [← IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hg, IdealSheafData.comap_comp]; exact hEιs
  have hadm₃ : (D.comap (ιs ≫ π)).IsInvertible := by
    rw [IdealSheafData.comap_comp]; exact hEιs
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hπ'.exists_lift g hadm₂
  
  have hφ'g : φ' ≫ g = π' := by
    rw [← cancel_mono ι, Category.assoc, hg, ← Category.assoc, hφ', hφ]
  have h₁ : φ' ≫ ψ = 𝟙 B' :=
    hπ'.hom_ext π' hπ'.admissible (φ' ≫ ψ) (𝟙 B')
      (by rw [Category.assoc, hψ, hφ'g]) (Category.id_comp _)
  have hψφ : ψ ≫ φ = ιs :=
    hπ.hom_ext (ιs ≫ π) hadm₃ (ψ ≫ φ) ιs
      (by rw [Category.assoc, hφ, ← Category.assoc, hψ, hg]) rfl
  have h₂ : ψ ≫ φ' = 𝟙 S.subscheme := by
    rw [← cancel_mono ιs, Category.assoc, hφ', hψφ, Category.id_comp]
  refine ⟨⟨φ', ψ, h₁, h₂⟩, ?_⟩
  change φ' ≫ ιs ≫ π = π' ≫ ι
  rw [← Category.assoc, hφ', hφ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_colon_of_isIso
statement: theorem comap_colon_of_isIso : (I.colon K).comap e = (I.comap e).colon (K.comap e)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (comap_colon_le I K e) ?_
  have h := comap_colon_le (I.comap e) (K.comap e) (inv e)
  have h1 : (I.comap e).comap (inv e) = I :=
    (comap_comp I (inv e) e).symm.trans (by rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id, comap_id])
  have h2 : (K.comap e).comap (inv e) = K :=
    (comap_comp K (inv e) e).symm.trans (by rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id, comap_id])
  rw [h1, h2] at h
  have h3 : (((I.comap e).colon (K.comap e)).comap (inv e)).comap e ≤ (I.colon K).comap e :=
    comap_mono (f := e) h
  have h4 : (((I.comap e).colon (K.comap e)).comap (inv e)).comap e =
      (I.comap e).colon (K.comap e) :=
    (comap_comp _ e (inv e)).symm.trans (by rw [IsIso.hom_inv_id, comap_id])
  rwa [h4] at h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_saturate_of_isIso
statement: theorem comap_saturate_of_isIso : (I.saturate K).comap e = (I.comap e).saturate (K.comap e)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [saturate, comap_iSup, comap_colon_of_isIso, comap_pow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.strictTransformAlong_of_isIso
statement:
theorem strictTransformAlong_of_isIso {B X : Scheme.{u}} (π : B ⟶ X) [IsIso π]
    (Z J : X.IdealSheafData) :
    J.strictTransformAlong π (Z.comap π) = (J.saturate Z).comap π
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_saturate_of_isIso π J Z).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_span_singleton_eq
statement:
theorem mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_span_singleton_eq {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors A)
    (h : Ideal.span {a} = Ideal.span {b}) : b ∈ nonZeroDivisors A
proof:
:= by
  have hab : b ∣ a := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (h ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a)
  have hba : a ∣ b := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (h.symm ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self b)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hab
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hba
  have h1 : a * (v * u - 1) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, ← hv, ← hu, sub_self]
  have hvu : v * u = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp ((mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp ha).1 _ h1)
  have hvunit : IsUnit v := ⟨Units.mkOfMulEqOne v u hvu, rfl⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact mul_mem ha hvunit.mem_nonZeroDivisors

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mul_pow_mem_span_of_mul_pow_succ_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hN
  have hg : ¬ e ∣ g := fun ⟨w, hw⟩ => hN' ⟨w, by rw [hw, pow_succ, mul_assoc]⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hu
  have h1 : e ^ N * (u * e) = e ^ N * (g * v) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← hv, pow_succ]; ring
  have h2 : u * e = g * v := (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (pow_mem he N)).mp h1
  have hv' : e ∣ v := (hp.dvd_or_dvd ⟨u, by rw [← h2, mul_comm]⟩).resolve_left hg
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hv'
  have h3 : u = g * w := (mul_cancel_right_mem_nonZeroDivisors he).mp (by rw [h2]; ring)
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact ⟨w, by rw [h3]; ring⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_span_of_mul_mem_of_forall_pow_dvd
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ →o Ideal A :=
    ⟨fun i => (Ideal.span {f}).colon {e ^ i}, fun i j hij x hx => by
      rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul] at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hij
      rw [pow_add, ← mul_assoc]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hx⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr inferInstance c
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hf (k + 1)
  have hgk : g ∈ c k := by
    rw [hk (k + 1) (Nat.le_succ k)]
    change g ∈ (Ideal.span {f}).colon {e ^ (k + 1)}
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, hg, mul_comm]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  change g ∈ (Ideal.span {f}).colon {e ^ k} at hgk
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hgk
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hgk
  have h1 : e ^ k * g = e ^ k * (e * g * b) := by
    rw [hg] at hb
    calc e ^ k * g = g * e ^ k := mul_comm _ _
      _ = e ^ (k + 1) * g * b := hb
      _ = e ^ k * (e * g * b) := by ring
  have h2 : g = e * g * b := (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (pow_mem he k)).mp h1
  have hf0 : (1 - e * b) * f = 0 := by
    rw [hg]
    calc (1 - e * b) * (e ^ (k + 1) * g) = e ^ (k + 1) * (g - e * g * b) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [← h2, sub_self, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hu
  have h3 : (u - u * (e * b)) * e = 0 := by
    calc (u - u * (e * b)) * e = (1 - e * b) * (u * e) := by ring
      _ = (1 - e * b) * f * v := by rw [hv, mul_assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hf0, zero_mul]
  have h4 : u = u * (e * b) := sub_eq_zero.mp ((mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp he).2 _ h3)
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  refine ⟨v * b, ?_⟩
  calc u = u * (e * b) := h4
    _ = u * e * b := by ring
    _ = f * v * b := by rw [hv]
    _ = f * (v * b) := by ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isIntegral_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_stalk
statement:
theorem isIntegral_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_stalk [IrreducibleSpace E.subscheme]
    (h : ∀ z : E.subscheme, IsRegularLocalRing (E.subscheme.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    IsIntegral E.subscheme
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ z : E.subscheme, _root_.IsReduced (E.subscheme.presheaf.stalk z) := fun z => by
    have := h z
    infer_instance
  have : IsReduced E.subscheme := isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk E.subscheme
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced E.subscheme

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_eq_top_of_forall_notMem
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_top_of_forall_notMem (U : X.affineOpens)
    (h : ∀ z : E.subscheme, E.subschemeι z ∉ U.1) : E.ideal U = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hne
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  let q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) := ⟨Q, hQ.isPrime⟩
  have hmem : hU.fromSpec q ∈ U.1 := by
    have : q ∈ hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := by rw [hU.fromSpec_preimage_self]; trivial
    exact this
  have hsupp' : hU.fromSpec q ∈ E.support := by
    rw [mem_support_iff_of_mem hmem, fromSpec_mem_zeroLocus_iff]
    exact hle
  have hsupp : hU.fromSpec q ∈ Set.range E.subschemeι := by
    rw [range_subschemeι]; exact hsupp'
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hsupp
  exact h z (hz ▸ hmem)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPrime_ideal_of_isIntegral_subscheme
statement:
theorem isPrime_ideal_of_isIntegral_subscheme (U : X.affineOpens) {z : E.subscheme}
    (hz : E.subschemeι z ∈ U.1) : (E.ideal U).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (E.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := ⟨⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  rw [← E.ker_subschemeι_app U]
  exact RingHom.ker_isPrime _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_ideal_of_map_mem_of_isIntegral_subscheme
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (E.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) := ⟨⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  have h' : E.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ≤ E.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := fun _ hx => h hx
  rw [← E.ker_subschemeι_app U, RingHom.mem_ker]
  rw [← E.ker_subschemeι_app V, RingHom.mem_ker] at hg
  have hres : (E.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op).hom ((E.subschemeι.app U.1).hom g) =
      (E.subschemeι.app V.1).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom g) := by
    change (E.subschemeι.app U.1 ≫ E.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op) g =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op ≫ E.subschemeι.app V.1) g
    rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE,
      Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  apply map_injective_of_isIntegral E.subscheme (homOfLE h')
  change (E.subscheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op).hom _ = _
  rw [hres, hg, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_pow_of_pow_dvd
statement: theorem le_pow_of_pow_dvd {I E : B.IdealSheafData} {c : ℕ} (h : E ^ c ∣ I) : I ≤ E ^ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, rfl⟩ := h
  exact IdealSheafData.mul_le_self_left _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pow_dvd_of_le_pow_of_isInvertible
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_of_le_pow_of_isInvertible {I E : B.IdealSheafData} (hE : E.IsInvertible) {c : ℕ}
    (h : I ≤ E ^ c) : E ^ c ∣ I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨I.colon (E ^ c), le_antisymm ?_ (by rw [mul_comm]; exact IdealSheafData.colon_mul_le _ _)⟩
  have hE' := hE
  choose U hxU e he hEe using hE'
  refine IdealSheafData.le_of_iSup_eq_top U
    (top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxU x⟩) fun x => ?_
  rw [IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply,
    IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_of_isInvertible _ _ (IdealSheafData.isInvertible_pow hE c) (U x),
    IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply, hEe x, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.colon_span]
  intro s hs
  have hs' : s ∈ Ideal.span {e x ^ c} := by
    have := h (U x) hs
    rwa [IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply, hEe x, Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at this
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hs'
  refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) ?_
  rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  exact hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ideal_le_pow_of_le
statement:
theorem ideal_le_pow_of_le {I K : B.IdealSheafData} {U V : B.affineOpens} (h : V ≤ U) {c : ℕ}
    (hU : I.ideal U ≤ K.ideal U ^ c) : I.ideal V ≤ K.ideal V ^ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← I.map_ideal h, ← K.map_ideal h, ← Ideal.map_pow]
  exact Ideal.map_mono hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chart_of_locally_principal
statement:
theorem exists_chart_of_locally_principal (hE : E.IsInvertible)
    (hJ : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.affineOpens, x ∈ U.1 ∧ ∃ f : Γ(X, U), J.ideal U = Ideal.span {f})
    (b : B) : ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : B.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U)),
      J.ideal U = Ideal.span {f} ∧ b ∈ U'.1 ∧ U'.1 ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ∧
        ∃ e ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(B, U'), E.ideal U' = Ideal.span {e}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, f, hf⟩ := hJ (π b)
  obtain ⟨W, hbW, e₀, he₀, hEW⟩ := hE b
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hbV, hVU⟩ := B.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
    (show b ∈ (π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 : Set B) from hxU) (π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).2
  have hVU' : V ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := hVU
  have hW : IsAffineOpen W.1 := W.2
  obtain ⟨s, hsle, hbs⟩ := hW.exists_basicOpen_le (V := W.1 ⊓ V) ⟨b, ⟨hbW, hbV⟩⟩ hbW
  obtain ⟨e, he, hEe⟩ := IdealSheafData.exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen E W he₀ hEW s
  exact ⟨U, B.affineBasicOpen s, f, hf, hbs, (hsle.trans inf_le_right).trans hVU', e, he, hEe⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.locally_principal_of_forall_principal
proof:
:=
  let ⟨U, hxU⟩ := IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpens_mem x
  ⟨U, hxU, hJ U⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ideal_comap_le_pow_succ_of_le
statement:
theorem ideal_comap_le_pow_succ_of_le (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : B.affineOpens)
    (hle : U'.1 ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) {e : Γ(B, U')}
    (hEe : E.ideal U' = Ideal.span {e}) {f : Γ(X, U)} (hf : J.ideal U = Ideal.span {f}) {N : ℕ}
    (hN : (J.comap π).ideal U' ≤ E.ideal U' ^ N) (V : B.affineOpens) (hV : V ≤ U')
    {z : E.subscheme} (hz : E.subschemeι z ∈ V.1)
    (heV : ∃ e' ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(B, V), E.ideal V = Ideal.span {e'})
    (h : (J.comap π).ideal V ≤ E.ideal V ^ (N + 1)) :
    (J.comap π).ideal U' ≤ E.ideal U' ^ (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  set φ := π.appLE U.1 U'.1 hle with hφ
  have hJ' : (J.comap π).ideal U' = Ideal.span {φ.hom f} := by
    rw [IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_le J π U U' hle, hf, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  rw [hJ', hEe, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton] at hN ⊢
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hN
  set res : Γ(B, U') →+* Γ(B, V) := (B.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom with hres
  have hEV : E.ideal V = Ideal.span {res e} := by
    rw [← E.map_ideal hV, hEe, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  have hresE : res e ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(B, V) := by
    obtain ⟨e', he', hEe'⟩ := heV
    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_span_singleton_eq he' (hEe'.symm.trans hEV)
  have hmem : res (φ.hom f) ∈ (J.comap π).ideal V := by
    rw [← (J.comap π).map_ideal hV]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hJ' ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  have h1 := h hmem
  rw [hEV, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h1
  obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := h1
  rw [hg, map_mul, map_pow] at hh'
  have h2 : res g = res e * h' := by
    refine (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors (pow_mem hresE N)).mp ?_
    rw [hh', pow_succ]; ring
  have h3 : g ∈ E.ideal U' :=
    E.mem_ideal_of_map_mem_of_isIntegral_subscheme hV hz
      (by rw [hEV, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, h2]; exact dvd_mul_right _ _)
  rw [hEe, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h3
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h3
  exact ⟨w, by rw [hg, hw, pow_succ]; ring⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_le_pow_succ_of_chart
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose U U' f hf hbU' hle e he hEe using
    exists_chart_of_locally_principal π E J hE hJ
  refine IdealSheafData.le_of_iSup_eq_top U'
    (top_le_iff.mp fun b _ => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨b, hbU' b⟩) fun b => ?_
  rw [IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply]
  by_cases hz : ∃ z : E.subscheme, E.subschemeι z ∈ (U' b).1
  · obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ := hz
    
    obtain ⟨z, hz₀', hz₁'⟩ := nonempty_preirreducible_inter
      (E.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U₀.1).isOpen (E.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ (U' b).1).isOpen
      ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩
    
    obtain ⟨W, hzW, e₀, he₀, hEW⟩ := hE (E.subschemeι z)
    have hW : IsAffineOpen W.1 := W.2
    obtain ⟨s, hsle, hzs⟩ :=
      hW.exists_basicOpen_le (V := W.1 ⊓ (U₀.1 ⊓ (U' b).1)) ⟨E.subschemeι z, ⟨hzW, hz₀', hz₁'⟩⟩ hzW
    have hV₀ : B.affineBasicOpen s ≤ U₀ := (hsle.trans inf_le_right).trans inf_le_left
    have hV₁ : B.affineBasicOpen s ≤ U' b := (hsle.trans inf_le_right).trans inf_le_right
    have hNb : (J.comap π).ideal (U' b) ≤ E.ideal (U' b) ^ N := by
      have := hN (U' b)
      rwa [IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply] at this
    exact ideal_comap_le_pow_succ_of_le π E J (U b) (U' b) (hle b) (hEe b) (hf b) hNb
      (B.affineBasicOpen s) hV₁ hzs
      (IdealSheafData.exists_regular_generator_affineBasicOpen E W he₀ hEW s)
      (ideal_le_pow_of_le hV₀ h₀)
  · rw [E.ideal_eq_top_of_forall_notMem (U' b) fun z hz' => hz ⟨z, hz'⟩, Ideal.top_pow]
    exact le_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.weakTransformAlong_eq_strictTransformAlong_of_locally_principal
statement:
theorem weakTransformAlong_eq_strictTransformAlong_of_locally_principal [IsLocallyNoetherian B]
    (hE : E.IsInvertible)
    (hJ : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.affineOpens, x ∈ U.1 ∧ ∃ f : Γ(X, U), J.ideal U = Ideal.span {f}) :
    J.weakTransformAlong π E = J.strictTransformAlong π E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set N := exceptionalOrderAlong π E J with hNdef
  
  have key : (J.comap π).colon (E ^ (N + 1)) ≤ (J.comap π).colon (E ^ N) := by
    choose U U' f hf hbU' hle e he hEe using
      exists_chart_of_locally_principal π E J hE hJ
    refine IdealSheafData.le_of_iSup_eq_top U'
      (top_le_iff.mp fun b _ => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨b, hbU' b⟩) fun b => ?_
    set φ := π.appLE (U b).1 (U' b).1 (hle b) with hφ
    have hJ' : (J.comap π).ideal (U' b) = Ideal.span {φ.hom (f b)} := by
      rw [IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_le J π (U b) (U' b) (hle b), hf b, Ideal.map_span,
        Set.image_singleton]
    
    have hdvd : ∀ c, E ^ c ∣ J.comap π → e b ^ c ∣ φ.hom (f b) := fun c hc => by
      have := le_pow_of_pow_dvd hc (U' b)
      rw [hJ', IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply, hEe b, Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at this
      exact Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mp this
    have hEpow := IdealSheafData.isInvertible_pow hE
    rw [IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_of_isInvertible _ _ (hEpow _) (U' b),
      IdealSheafData.ideal_colon_of_isInvertible _ _ (hEpow _) (U' b), hJ']
    simp only [IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply, hEe b, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
      Ideal.colon_span]
    intro u hu
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, smul_eq_mul] at hu ⊢
    by_cases hbdd : BddAbove {c : ℕ | E ^ c ∣ J.comap π}
    · 
      have hmem : E ^ N ∣ J.comap π :=
        Nat.sSup_mem ⟨0, show E ^ 0 ∣ J.comap π by rw [pow_zero]; exact one_dvd _⟩ hbdd
      have hmax : ¬ E ^ (N + 1) ∣ J.comap π := fun h =>
        Nat.not_succ_le_self N (le_csSup hbdd h)
      by_cases hz : ∃ z : E.subscheme, E.subschemeι z ∈ (U' b).1
      · 
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hz
        have : Nonempty (U' b).1 := ⟨⟨_, hz⟩⟩
        have hne : e b ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
          one_ne_zero ((mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp (he b)).1 1 (by rw [h0, zero_mul]))
        have hprime : Prime (e b) := (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hne).mp
          (by rw [← hEe b]; exact E.isPrime_ideal_of_isIntegral_subscheme (U' b) hz)
        refine mul_pow_mem_span_of_mul_pow_succ_mem (he b) hprime (hdvd N hmem)
          (fun hd => hmax ?_) hu
        refine pow_dvd_of_le_pow_of_isInvertible hE ?_
        refine comap_le_pow_succ_of_chart π E J hE hJ (le_pow_of_pow_dvd hmem) (U' b) hz ?_
        rw [hJ', hEe b, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
        exact Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr hd
      · 
        have htop := E.ideal_eq_top_of_forall_notMem (U' b) fun z hz' => hz ⟨z, hz'⟩
        rw [hEe b, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top] at htop
        rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc] at hu
        exact (Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem _ htop).mp hu
    · 
      have hN0 : N = 0 := Nat.sSup_of_not_bddAbove hbdd
      have hall : ∀ c, e b ^ c ∣ φ.hom (f b) := fun c => by
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hcy⟩ := not_bddAbove_iff.mp hbdd c
        exact hdvd c ((pow_dvd_pow E hcy.le).trans hy)
      rw [hN0, pow_zero, mul_one]
      rw [hN0, zero_add, pow_one] at hu
      have := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian (U' b)
      exact mem_span_of_mul_mem_of_forall_pow_dvd (he b) hall hu
  
  have hall : ∀ i, (J.comap π).colon (E ^ i) ≤ (J.comap π).colon (E ^ N) := by
    have hstep : ∀ m, (J.comap π).colon (E ^ (N + m)) ≤ (J.comap π).colon (E ^ N) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => exact le_rfl
      | succ m ih =>
        calc (J.comap π).colon (E ^ (N + (m + 1)))
            = ((J.comap π).colon (E ^ (N + m))).colon E := by
              rw [IdealSheafData.colon_colon, ← Nat.add_assoc, pow_succ]
          _ ≤ ((J.comap π).colon (E ^ N)).colon E := IdealSheafData.colon_mono_left _ _ E ih
          _ = (J.comap π).colon (E ^ (N + 1)) := by rw [IdealSheafData.colon_colon, pow_succ]
          _ ≤ (J.comap π).colon (E ^ N) := key
    intro i
    rcases le_or_gt i N with h | h
    · exact IdealSheafData.colon_pow_mono _ _ h
    · have := hstep (i - N)
      rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h.le] at this
  change (J.comap π).colon (E ^ N) = (J.comap π).saturate E
  exact le_antisymm (IdealSheafData.colon_pow_le_saturate _ _ N) (iSup_le hall)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.weakTransformAlong_eq_strictTransformAlong_of_locally_principal'
statement:
theorem weakTransformAlong_eq_strictTransformAlong_of_locally_principal' [IsLocallyNoetherian B]
    (hE : E.IsInvertible)
    (hF : ∀ z : E.subscheme, IsRegularLocalRing (E.subscheme.presheaf.stalk z))
    [IrreducibleSpace E.subscheme]
    (hJ : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.affineOpens, x ∈ U.1 ∧ ∃ f : Γ(X, U), J.ideal U = Ideal.span {f}) :
    J.weakTransformAlong π E = J.strictTransformAlong π E
proof:
:=
  have := E.isIntegral_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_stalk hF
  weakTransformAlong_eq_strictTransformAlong_of_locally_principal π E J hE hJ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isReduced
statement: theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.blowUp.isReduced [IsReduced X] : IsReduced (blowUp I)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ y : blowUp I, _root_.IsReduced ((blowUp I).presheaf.stalk y) := fun y => by
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpens_mem (blowUpπ I y)
    have hy : y ∈ ⋃ a : I.ideal U, Set.range (blowUp.chart I U a) := by
      rw [blowUp.iUnion_range_chart]
      exact hU
    obtain ⟨a, x, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    have : _root_.IsReduced Γ(X, U) := (inferInstance : IsReduced X).component_reduced U
    have : IsReduced (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra (I.ideal U) a))) := inferInstance
    exact isReduced_of_injective _
      (asIso ((blowUp.chart I U a).stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  exact isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isReduced_strictTransformAlong_subscheme
statement:
theorem isReduced_strictTransformAlong_subscheme (D J : X.IdealSheafData)
    [IsReduced J.subscheme] :
    IsReduced (J.strictTransformAlong (blowUpπ D) (D.comap (blowUpπ D))).subscheme
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, -⟩ := exists_iso_strictTransform_subscheme (blowUp.isBlowUp D)
    (blowUp.isBlowUp (D.comap J.subschemeι))
  have : IsReduced (blowUp (D.comap J.subschemeι)) := blowUp.isReduced _
  exact isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion e.inv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affineOpen_generator
statement:
theorem exists_affineOpen_generator (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hf : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).IsInvertible) (y : Y) :
    ∃ V : Y.affineOpens, y ∈ V.1 ∧ ∃ a : I,
      sectionsHom f V.1 a ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(Y, V) ∧
        I.map (sectionsHom f V.1) = Ideal.span {sectionsHom f V.1 a}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, e, a', ha', hJ, hnz⟩ :=
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_affineOpen_generator_of_isInvertible
    (specIdealSheaf I) f hf ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ y (Opens.mem_top y)
  rw [specIdealSheaf_ideal_top] at ha'
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective).mp ha'
  refine ⟨V, hyV, ⟨a, ha⟩, hnz, ?_⟩
  rw [← ideal_comap_specIdealSheaf]
  exact hJ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_comap_specIdealSheaf_eq_span
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_comap_specIdealSheaf_eq_span (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (a : I) (hI : I.map (sectionsHom f V.1) = Ideal.span {sectionsHom f V.1 a}) {z : Y}
    (hz : z ∈ V.1) :
    ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).stalkIdeal z =
      Ideal.span
        {f.stalkMap z ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (f z) (Opens.mem_top _)
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom a))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ V hz, ideal_comap_specIdealSheaf, hI,
      Ideal.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]
  congr 2
  exact f.germ_appLE_apply ⊤ V.1 le_top hz (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.hom_ext_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.hom_ext_chart (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (V : Y.affineOpens) (a : I)
    (hβa : sectionsHom f V.1 a ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(Y, V))
    (hI : I.map (sectionsHom f V.1) = Ideal.span {sectionsHom f V.1 a})
    (u u' : (V.1 : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)))
    (hu : u ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))) = V.1.ι ≫ f)
    (hu' : u' ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))) =
      V.1.ι ≫ f) :
    u = u'
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ v : (V.1 : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)),
      v ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))) = V.1.ι ≫ f →
      v = V.2.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (affineBlowUpAlgebra.lift (sectionsHom f V.1) a.2 hβa hI)) := by
    intro v hv
    set δ := Spec.preimage (V.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ v) with hδ_def
    have hδ : Spec.map δ = V.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ v := Spec.map_preimage _
    have hv' : v = V.2.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map δ := by rw [hδ, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    have hcomp : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a)) ≫ δ =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (sectionsHom f V.1) := by
      apply Spec.map_injective
      rw [Spec.map_comp, ← Iso.cancel_iso_hom_left V.2.isoSpec, ← Category.assoc, ← hv', hv,
        isoSpec_hom_specMap_sectionsHom f V]
    have hlift : δ.hom = affineBlowUpAlgebra.lift (sectionsHom f V.1) a.2 hβa hI :=
      affineBlowUpAlgebra.lift_unique _ a.2 hβa hI δ.hom (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hcomp)
    have hδ' : δ = CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBlowUpAlgebra.lift (sectionsHom f V.1) a.2 hβa hI) :=
      CommRingCat.hom_ext hlift
    rw [hv', hδ']
  rw [key u hu, key u' hu']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.hom_ext
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.hom_ext (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hf : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).IsInvertible) (g g' : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I)
    (e : g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f) (e' : g' ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f) : g = g'
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.hom_ext_of_forall
  intro y
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, a, hβa, hI⟩ := exists_affineOpen_generator I f hf y
  refine ⟨V.1, hyV, ?_⟩
  have hrange : ∀ h : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I, h ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f →
      Set.range (V.1.ι ≫ h) ⊆ Set.range (affineBlowUp.chart I a) := by
    intro h hh
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact affineBlowUp.mem_chart_of_generates I f hf h hh (V.1.ι z) a
      (stalkIdeal_comap_specIdealSheaf_eq_span I f V a hI z.2)
  have hu : ∀ (h : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I) (hh : h ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f),
      IsOpenImmersion.lift (affineBlowUp.chart I a) (V.1.ι ≫ h) (hrange h hh) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I a))) = V.1.ι ≫ f := by
    intro h hh
    rw [← affineBlowUp.chart_π, ← Category.assoc, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac, Category.assoc, hh]
  calc V.1.ι ≫ g
      = IsOpenImmersion.lift (affineBlowUp.chart I a) (V.1.ι ≫ g) (hrange g e) ≫
          affineBlowUp.chart I a := (IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _).symm
    _ = IsOpenImmersion.lift (affineBlowUp.chart I a) (V.1.ι ≫ g') (hrange g' e') ≫
          affineBlowUp.chart I a := by
        rw [affineBlowUp.hom_ext_chart I f V a hβa hI _ _ (hu g e) (hu g' e')]
    _ = V.1.ι ≫ g' := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.isPullback_mapHom
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.isPullback_mapHom :
    IsPullback (affineBlowUp.mapHom φ hJ) (affineBlowUp.π J) (affineBlowUp.π I) (Spec.map φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (isPullback_morphismRestrict (affineBlowUp.π I) (Spec.map φ).opensRange).flip.of_iso
    (blowUpIsoPreimage φ hJ).symm (Iso.refl _) (specMapIsoOpensRange φ).symm (Iso.refl _)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom]
    exact (preimageToBlowUp_mapHom φ hJ).symm
  · rw [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
    exact (preimageToBlowUp_π φ hJ).symm
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom, specMapIsoOpensRange_inv_specMap]

statement:
theorem specIdealSheaf_ideal_top (I : Ideal R) :

proof:
:= by

    show homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) ≤ ⊤) = 𝟙 _ from rfl, op_id,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, CommRingCat.hom_id, Ideal.map_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ideal_comap_specIdealSheaf

theorem ideal_comap_specIdealSheaf (I : Ideal R) (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (V : Y.affineOpens) :
    ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).ideal V = I.map (sectionsHom f V.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_le (specIdealSheaf I) f ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ V le_top,
    specIdealSheaf_ideal_top, Ideal.map_map]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.liftOn_eq

    liftOn I f V a hβa hI = V.2.isoSpec.hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineBlowUpAlgebra.lift (sectionsHom f V.1) a.2 hβa hI)) ≫
        affineBlowUp.chart I a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isoSpec_hom_specMap_sectionsHom
statement:
theorem isoSpec_hom_specMap_sectionsHom :
    V.2.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (sectionsHom f V.1)) = V.1.ι ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  have hV : IsAffineOpen V.1 := V.2
  have h := IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of R))) hV
    (le_top : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)
  rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top, Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv] at h
  have hι : V.1.ι = hV.isoSpec.hom ≫ hV.fromSpec :=
    (Iso.inv_comp_eq _).mp (IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι hV)
  calc hV.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (sectionsHom f V.1))
      = hV.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (f.appLE ⊤ V.1 le_top) ≫
          Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv := by
        rw [← Spec.map_comp]
        rfl
    _ = hV.isoSpec.hom ≫ hV.fromSpec ≫ f := by rw [h]
    _ = V.1.ι ≫ f := by rw [hι, Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.liftOn_π
statement: theorem liftOn_π : liftOn I f V a hβa hI ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = V.1.ι ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftOn_eq, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, affineBlowUp.chart_π, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← isoSpec_hom_specMap_sectionsHom f V]
  congr 2
  exact CommRingCat.hom_ext (affineBlowUpAlgebra.lift_comp_algebraMap _ a.2 hβa hI)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isUnit_specGerm_iff

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specGerm_mem_nonZeroDivisors
proof:
:= by
  have hloc := (isAffineOpen_top (Spec S)).isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, Opens.mem_top x⟩
  have hle := @IsLocalization.map_nonZeroDivisors_le Γ(Spec S, ⊤) _
    ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec S)).primeIdealOf ⟨x, Opens.mem_top x⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
    ((Spec S).presheaf.stalk x) _
    (TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk (Spec S).presheaf ⟨x, Opens.mem_top x⟩) hloc
  exact hle ⟨_, hs, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.appTop_Spec_map_apply

    (Spec.map φ).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r) = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).inv (φ r)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMap_Spec_map_specGerm

    (Spec.map φ).stalkMap x (specGerm (Spec.map φ x) r) = specGerm x (φ r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [specGerm_apply, Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  change (Spec S).presheaf.germ ⊤ x (Opens.mem_top x) ((Spec.map φ).appTop _) = _
  rw [appTop_Spec_map_apply]
