name: AlgebraicGeometry.algebraMap_eq_mul_ratio
statement:
theorem algebraMap_eq_mul_ratio (a : I) :
    algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) a =
      algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) b * affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I b a
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h1 : awayFrac (b : R) 1 b = 1 := by
    rw [awayFrac_one]
    exact Localization.mk_self (a := ⟨(b : R), Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩)
  have h2 := awayFrac_mul (a := (b : R)) 1 0 b a
  rw [add_zero, h1, one_mul] at h2
  change algebraMap R (Localization.Away (b : R)) a =
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away (b : R)) b * awayFrac (b : R) 1 a
  rw [← awayFrac_zero, ← awayFrac_zero, awayFrac_mul, zero_add, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineBlowUp.comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart, stalkIdeal_ofIdealTop, Ideal.map_span,
    Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Set.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMap_chart_stalkMap_π
statement:
theorem stalkMap_chart_stalkMap_π (x' : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))) (r : R) :
    (affineBlowUp.chart I b).stalkMap x'
        ((affineBlowUp.π I).stalkMap (affineBlowUp.chart I b x')
          ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (affineBlowUp.π I (affineBlowUp.chart I b x'))
            (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom r))) =
      specGerm x' (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) r)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ f : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b)) ⟶ Spec (.of R),
      f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))) →
      f.stalkMap x' ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (f x') (Opens.mem_top _)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom r)) =
      specGerm x' (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) r) := by
    rintro f rfl
    exact stalkMap_Spec_map_specGerm (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b)))
      x' r
  have h := key _ (affineBlowUp.chart_π I b)
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ : (Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalk
        ((affineBlowUp.chart I b ≫ affineBlowUp.π I) x') ⟶
        (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).presheaf.stalk x' =>
      φ ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ ((affineBlowUp.chart I b ≫ affineBlowUp.π I) x')
        (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom r)))
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp (affineBlowUp.chart I b) (affineBlowUp.π I) x')
  exact h2.symm.trans h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdeal_chart_map
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdeal_chart_map (x' : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))) :
    ((affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).stalkIdeal (affineBlowUp.chart I b x')).map
        ((affineBlowUp.chart I b).stalkMap x').hom =
      Ideal.span {specGerm x' (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) b)}
proof:
:= by
  have h := (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).stalkIdeal_comap (affineBlowUp.chart I b) x'
  rw [stalkIdeal_comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_ringEquiv_stalk_chart
statement:
theorem exists_ringEquiv_stalk_chart (x' : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))) :
    ∃ e : (affineBlowUp I).presheaf.stalk (affineBlowUp.chart I b x') ≃+*
        Localization.AtPrime (PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal x') (hp := PrimeSpectrum.isPrime x'),
      ∀ c : affineBlowUpAlgebra I b,
        (affineBlowUp.chart I b).stalkMap x' (e.symm (algebraMap _ _ c)) = specGerm x' c
proof:
:= by
  let e : (affineBlowUp I).presheaf.stalk (affineBlowUp.chart I b x') ≅
      .of (Localization.AtPrime (PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal x') (hp := PrimeSpectrum.isPrime x')) :=
    asIso ((affineBlowUp.chart I b).stalkMap x') ≪≫ Spec.stalkIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b)) x'
  refine ⟨e.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv, fun c => ?_⟩
  have h1 : e.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm (algebraMap _ _ c) = e.inv (algebraMap _ _ c) := rfl
  rw [h1]
  change ((asIso ((affineBlowUp.chart I b).stalkMap x') ≪≫
    Spec.stalkIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b)) x').inv ≫ (affineBlowUp.chart I b).stalkMap x')
      (algebraMap _ _ c) = _
  rw [Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc, asIso_inv, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  have h := Spec.algebraMap_stalkIso_inv (R := CommRingCat.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b)) x'
  exact congrArg (fun φ : CommRingCat.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) ⟶
    (Spec (CommRingCat.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).presheaf.stalk x' => φ c) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdeal_chart_eq_span_iff
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdeal_chart_eq_span_iff (x' : Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b)))
    (a : I) :
    (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).stalkIdeal (affineBlowUp.chart I b x') =
        Ideal.span
          {(affineBlowUp.π I).stalkMap (affineBlowUp.chart I b x')
            ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (affineBlowUp.π I (affineBlowUp.chart I b x'))
              (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom a))} ↔
      Ideal.span {specGerm x' (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) b)} =
        Ideal.span {specGerm x' (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) a)}
proof:
:= by
  set j := affineBlowUp.chart I b
  set σ : (affineBlowUp I).presheaf.stalk (j x') ≃+*
      (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).presheaf.stalk x' :=
    (asIso (j.stalkMap x')).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with hσ_def
  have hσ : (j.stalkMap x').hom = (σ : (affineBlowUp I).presheaf.stalk (j x') →+*
      (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).presheaf.stalk x') := rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Ideal.map (σ : (affineBlowUp I).presheaf.stalk (j x') →+*
      (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).presheaf.stalk x')) := by
    intro A B h
    rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv, Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv] at h
    exact Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _ σ.symm.surjective h
  rw [← hinj.eq_iff, ← hσ, ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap,
      stalkIdeal_comap_exceptionalIdeal_chart,
    Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, stalkMap_chart_stalkMap_π]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.chart_preimage_chart_eq_basicOpen
statement:
theorem chart_preimage_chart_eq_basicOpen (a : I) :
    affineBlowUp.chart I b ⁻¹ᵁ (affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange =
      (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).basicOpen
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).inv (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I b a))
proof:
:=
  (affineBlowUp.chart_preimage_chart I b a).trans
    (basicOpen_eq_of_affine (R := .of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))
      (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I b a)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mem_chart_iff
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.mem_chart_iff (a : I) (x : affineBlowUp I) :
    x ∈ (affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange ↔
      (affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).stalkIdeal x =
        Ideal.span
          {(affineBlowUp.π I).stalkMap x ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤
            (affineBlowUp.π I x) (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom a))}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart I x
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hb
  rw [stalkIdeal_exceptionalIdeal_chart_eq_span_iff, ← Scheme.Hom.mem_preimage,
    chart_preimage_chart_eq_basicOpen, ← isUnit_specGerm_iff]
  have hmul : specGerm x' (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) a) =
      specGerm x' (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) b) *
        specGerm x' (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I b a) := by
    rw [algebraMap_eq_mul_ratio, map_mul]
  have hnz : specGerm x' (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b) b) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors ((Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).presheaf.stalk x') :=
    specGerm_mem_nonZeroDivisors x' (affineBlowUp.chartGenerator_mem_nonZeroDivisors I b)
  constructor
  · intro hu
    rw [hmul, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit hu]
  · intro h
    exact isUnit_of_span_mul_eq_span hnz (by rw [← hmul]; exact h.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.exists_factor_of_mem_chart
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.exists_factor_of_mem_chart (a : I) (x : affineBlowUp I)
    (hxb : x ∈ (affineBlowUp.chart I b).opensRange) :
    ∃ u : (affineBlowUp I).presheaf.stalk x,
      (affineBlowUp.π I).stalkMap x ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (affineBlowUp.π I x)
          (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom a)) =
        (affineBlowUp.π I).stalkMap x ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (affineBlowUp.π I x)
          (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom b)) * u ∧
      (IsUnit u → x ∈ (affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hxb
  set j := affineBlowUp.chart I b
  set σ : (affineBlowUp I).presheaf.stalk (j x') ≃+*
      (Spec (.of (affineBlowUpAlgebra I b))).presheaf.stalk x' :=
    (asIso (j.stalkMap x')).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with hσ_def
  refine ⟨σ.symm (specGerm x' (affineBlowUpAlgebra.ratio I b a)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply σ.injective
    rw [map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change (j.stalkMap x') _ = (j.stalkMap x') _ * _
    rw [stalkMap_chart_stalkMap_π, stalkMap_chart_stalkMap_π, ← map_mul, ← algebraMap_eq_mul_ratio]
  · intro hu
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.mem_preimage, chart_preimage_chart_eq_basicOpen, ← isUnit_specGerm_iff]
    have := hu.map σ
    rwa [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isInvertible_comap_comp_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem isInvertible_comap_comp_of_isOpenImmersion (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hf : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).IsInvertible) {Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap (j ≫ f)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
  exact hf.comap_of_isOpenImmersion j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.exists_lift
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.exists_lift (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hf : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).IsInvertible) :
    ∃ g : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I, g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f
proof:
:= by
  choose V hyV a hβa hI using exists_affineOpen_generator I f hf
  have hcov : IsOpenCover fun y : Y => (V y).1 :=
    top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨z, hyV z⟩
  let 𝒰 : Y.OpenCover := Y.openCoverOfIsOpenCover (fun y => (V y).1) hcov
  let lifts : ∀ y : 𝒰.I₀, 𝒰.X y ⟶ affineBlowUp I := fun y =>
    liftOn I f (V y) (a y) (hβa y) (hI y)
  have hlifts : ∀ y : 𝒰.I₀, lifts y ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = 𝒰.f y ≫ f := fun y =>
    liftOn_π I f (V y) (a y) (hβa y) (hI y)
  have compat : ∀ y y', pullback.fst (𝒰.f y) (𝒰.f y') ≫ lifts y =
      pullback.snd (𝒰.f y) (𝒰.f y') ≫ lifts y' := by
    intro y y'
    refine affineBlowUp.hom_ext I (pullback.fst (𝒰.f y) (𝒰.f y') ≫ 𝒰.f y ≫ f) ?_ _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact isInvertible_comap_comp_of_isOpenImmersion I f hf _
    · rw [Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun m => pullback.fst (𝒰.f y) (𝒰.f y') ≫ m) (hlifts y)
    · rw [Category.assoc]
      refine (congrArg (fun m => pullback.snd (𝒰.f y) (𝒰.f y') ≫ m) (hlifts y')).trans ?_
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨𝒰.glueMorphisms lifts compat, 𝒰.hom_ext _ _ fun y => ?_⟩
  rw [← Category.assoc, Scheme.Cover.ι_glueMorphisms]
  exact hlifts y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.existsUnique_lift
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.existsUnique_lift (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hf : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).IsInvertible) :
    ∃! g : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I, g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := affineBlowUp.exists_lift I f hf
  exact ⟨g, hg, fun g' hg' => affineBlowUp.hom_ext I f hf g' g hg' hg⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.lift_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineBlowUp.lift_π (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hf : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).IsInvertible) :
    affineBlowUp.lift I f hf ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f
proof:
:=
  (affineBlowUp.exists_lift I f hf).choose_spec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.eq_lift
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.eq_lift (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hf : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).IsInvertible) (g : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I)
    (hg : g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f) : g = affineBlowUp.lift I f hf
proof:
:=
  affineBlowUp.hom_ext I f hf g _ hg (affineBlowUp.lift_π I f hf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_comap_of_comp_π
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_comap_of_comp_π (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (g : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I)
    (hg : g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f) (y : Y) :
    ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).stalkIdeal y =
      ((affineBlowUp.exceptionalIdeal I).stalkIdeal (g y)).map (g.stalkMap y).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst hg
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
  exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_comap _ g y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMap_comp_π_germ
statement:
theorem stalkMap_comp_π_germ (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (g : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I)
    (hg : g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f) (y : Y) (r : R) :
    g.stalkMap y ((affineBlowUp.π I).stalkMap (g y) ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤
        (affineBlowUp.π I (g y)) (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom r))) =
      f.stalkMap y ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (f y) (Opens.mem_top _)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom r))
proof:
:= by
  subst hg
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ : (Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalk ((g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I) y) ⟶
        Y.presheaf.stalk y =>
      φ ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ ((g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I) y) (Opens.mem_top _)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom r)))
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp g (affineBlowUp.π I) y)
  exact h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUp.mem_chart_of_generates
statement:
theorem affineBlowUp.mem_chart_of_generates (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hf : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).IsInvertible) (g : Y ⟶ affineBlowUp I)
    (hg : g ≫ affineBlowUp.π I = f) (y : Y) (a : I)
    (ha : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).stalkIdeal y =
      Ideal.span
        {f.stalkMap y ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (f y)
          (Opens.mem_top _) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom a))}) :
    g y ∈ (affineBlowUp.chart I a).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := affineBlowUp.exists_mem_opensRange_chart I (g y)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hmem⟩ := affineBlowUp.exists_factor_of_mem_chart I b a (g y) hb
  apply hmem
  
  have hstalk := (affineBlowUp.mem_chart_iff I b (g y)).mp hb
  
  have hJb : ((specIdealSheaf I).comap f).stalkIdeal y =
      Ideal.span
        {f.stalkMap y ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (f y) (Opens.mem_top _)
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom b))} := by
    rw [stalkIdeal_comap_of_comp_π I f g hg y, hstalk, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
      stalkMap_comp_π_germ I f g hg y b]
  
  have hfa : f.stalkMap y ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (f y) (Opens.mem_top _)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom a)) =
      f.stalkMap y ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (f y) (Opens.mem_top _)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom b)) * g.stalkMap y u := by
    rw [← stalkMap_comp_π_germ I f g hg y a, ← stalkMap_comp_π_germ I f g hg y b, hu, map_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hJh⟩ := hf.exists_mem_nonZeroDivisors_stalkIdeal_eq_span y
  have hnz : f.stalkMap y ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (f y) (Opens.mem_top _)
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom b)) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_span_eq_span hh (hJb.symm.trans hJh)
  
  have hunit : IsUnit (g.stalkMap y u) :=
    isUnit_of_span_mul_eq_span hnz (by rw [← hfa, ← ha, hJb])
  exact (isUnit_map_iff (g.stalkMap y).hom u).mp hunit

name: TopologicalSpace.Closeds.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes
statement:
theorem Closeds.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes [T0Space X] [QuasiSober X] (Z : Closeds X)
    {z : X} (hz : z ∈ Z) : ∃ η ∈ Z.genericPoints, η ⤳ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, -, hT⟩ := zorn_subset_nonempty {T : Set X | T ⊆ Z ∧ IsIrreducible T ∧ z ∈ T}
    (fun c hc hcc hne => by
      obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀⟩ := hne
      refine ⟨⋃₀ c, ⟨Set.sUnion_subset fun T hT => (hc hT).1,
        ⟨⟨z, Set.mem_sUnion_of_mem (hc hT₀).2.2 hT₀⟩, ?_⟩,
        Set.mem_sUnion_of_mem (hc hT₀).2.2 hT₀⟩, fun s hs => Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem hs⟩
      intro u v hu hv ⟨y, hy, hyu⟩ ⟨x, hx, hxv⟩
      obtain ⟨p, hpc, hyp⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.1 hy
      obtain ⟨q, hqc, hxq⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.1 hx
      rcases hcc.total hpc hqc with hpq | hqp
      · obtain ⟨w, hwq, hwuv⟩ := (hc hqc).2.1.2 u v hu hv ⟨y, hpq hyp, hyu⟩ ⟨x, hxq, hxv⟩
        exact ⟨w, Set.mem_sUnion_of_mem hwq hqc, hwuv⟩
      · obtain ⟨w, hwp, hwuv⟩ := (hc hpc).2.1.2 u v hu hv ⟨y, hyp, hyu⟩ ⟨x, hqp hxq, hxv⟩
        exact ⟨w, Set.mem_sUnion_of_mem hwp hpc, hwuv⟩)
    (closure {z}) ⟨Z.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hz),
      isIrreducible_singleton.closure, subset_closure rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hTZ, hTirr, hzT⟩ := hT.prop
  have hTc : closure T = T :=
    (hT.eq_of_subset ⟨Z.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr hTZ, hTirr.closure, subset_closure hzT⟩
      subset_closure).symm
  have hη : IsGenericPoint hTirr.genericPoint T :=
    hTirr.isGenericPoint_genericPoint (isClosed_of_closure_subset hTc.le)
  refine ⟨hTirr.genericPoint, ?_, hη.specializes hzT⟩
  rw [Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff, hη.def]
  exact ⟨⟨hTZ, hTirr⟩, fun T' hT' hle => (hT.eq_of_subset ⟨hT'.1, hT'.2, hle hzT⟩ hle).symm.le⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_le_ord_of_specializes_of_upperSemicontinuous
statement:
theorem ord_le_ord_of_specializes_of_upperSemicontinuous {η x : X} (h : η ⤳ x) :
    I.ord η ≤ I.ord x
proof:
:=
  h.mem_closed (upperSemicontinuous_iff_isClosed_preimage.mp hI (I.ord η))
    (show I.ord η ≤ I.ord η from le_rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ordAlong_le_ord_of_upperSemicontinuous
statement:
theorem ordAlong_le_ord_of_upperSemicontinuous (Z : IrreducibleCloseds X) {z : X} (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    I.ordAlong Z ≤ I.ord z
proof:
:=
  ord_le_ord_of_specializes_of_upperSemicontinuous I hI
    (Z.isGenericPoint_genericPoint.specializes hz)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ordAlong_eq_iInf_of_upperSemicontinuous
statement:
theorem ordAlong_eq_iInf_of_upperSemicontinuous (Z : IrreducibleCloseds X) :
    I.ordAlong Z = ⨅ z ∈ (Z : Set X), I.ord z
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun _ hz => ordAlong_le_ord_of_upperSemicontinuous I hI Z hz)
    (iInf₂_le Z.genericPoint Z.isGenericPoint_genericPoint.mem)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ordAlong_eq_iInf_closedPoints_of_upperSemicontinuous
statement:
theorem ordAlong_eq_iInf_closedPoints_of_upperSemicontinuous [JacobsonSpace X]
    (Z : IrreducibleCloseds X) :
    I.ordAlong Z = ⨅ z ∈ (Z : Set X) ∩ closedPoints X, I.ord z
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm
    (le_iInf₂ fun _ hz => ordAlong_le_ord_of_upperSemicontinuous I hI Z hz.1) ?_
  rcases eq_or_ne (I.ordAlong Z) ⊤ with htop | hne
  · rw [htop]
    exact le_top
  have hclosed : IsClosed {x | I.ordAlong Z + 1 ≤ I.ord x} :=
    upperSemicontinuous_iff_isClosed_preimage.mp hI (I.ordAlong Z + 1)
  have hne' : ((Z : Set X) ∩ {x | I.ordAlong Z + 1 ≤ I.ord x}ᶜ).Nonempty :=
    ⟨Z.genericPoint, Z.isGenericPoint_genericPoint.mem, fun h =>
      (not_le.mpr ((ENat.lt_add_one_iff hne).mpr le_rfl)) h⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨haZ, ha⟩, hac⟩ := nonempty_inter_closedPoints hne'
    (Z.isClosed.isLocallyClosed.inter hclosed.isOpen_compl.isLocallyClosed)
  exact (iInf₂_le a ⟨haZ, hac⟩).trans ((ENat.lt_add_one_iff hne).mp (not_le.mp ha))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.leOrdAlong_iff_forall_mem_of_upperSemicontinuous
statement:
theorem leOrdAlong_iff_forall_mem_of_upperSemicontinuous (Z : Closeds X) (m : ℕ∞) :
    I.LeOrdAlong Z m ↔ ∀ z ∈ Z, m ≤ I.ord z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h z hz
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hspec⟩ := Z.exists_mem_genericPoints_specializes hz
    exact (h η hη).trans (ord_le_ord_of_specializes_of_upperSemicontinuous I hI hspec)
  · intro h η hη
    exact h η hη.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_le_ord_of_specializes
statement: theorem ord_le_ord_of_specializes {η x : X} (h : η ⤳ x) : I.ord η ≤ I.ord x
proof:
:=
  ord_le_ord_of_specializes_of_upperSemicontinuous I (upperSemicontinuous_ord f n I) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_le_ord_of_mem_closure
statement: theorem ord_le_ord_of_mem_closure {η x : X} (h : x ∈ closure {η}) : I.ord η ≤ I.ord x
proof:
:=
  ord_le_ord_of_specializes I f n (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ordAlong_le_ord
statement:
theorem ordAlong_le_ord (Z : IrreducibleCloseds X) {z : X} (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    I.ordAlong Z ≤ I.ord z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ordAlong_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem ordAlong_eq_iInf (Z : IrreducibleCloseds X) :
    I.ordAlong Z = ⨅ z ∈ (Z : Set X), I.ord z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ordAlong_eq_iInf_closedPoints
statement:
theorem ordAlong_eq_iInf_closedPoints (Z : IrreducibleCloseds X) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.leOrdAlong_iff_forall_mem
statement:
theorem leOrdAlong_iff_forall_mem (Z : Closeds X) (m : ℕ∞) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal
statement: theorem ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal : I.ord x = IsLocalRing.ord (I.stalkIdeal x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ord IsLocalRing.ord
  rw [iSup_subtype', ← sSup_range]
  congr 1
  ext n
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_range, Subtype.exists, exists_prop]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl, hm⟩
    exact ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨m, rfl, hm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_ord_iff
statement:
theorem le_ord_iff {r : ℕ} :
    (r : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x ↔ I.stalkIdeal x ≤ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, IsLocalRing.le_ord_iff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_anti
statement: theorem ord_anti {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : I ≤ J) (x : X) : J.ord x ≤ I.ord x
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal]
  exact IsLocalRing.ord_anti (stalkIdeal_mono h x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal :
    x ∈ I.support ↔ I.stalkIdeal x ≤ maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  rw [mem_support_iff_of_mem hxU, mem_zeroLocus_iff, stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ I U hxU,
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  constructor
  · intro h f hf
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
    exact fun hu => h f hf ((Scheme.mem_basicOpen X f x hxU).mpr hu)
  · intro h f hf hxf
    have := h hf
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at this
    exact this ((Scheme.mem_basicOpen X f x hxU).mp hxf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_zero_iff : I.ord x = 0 ↔ x ∉ I.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, IsLocalRing.ord_eq_zero_iff,
    mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal]
  constructor
  · intro h hle
    rw [h] at hle
    exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hle)
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    exact h ((le_maximalIdeal hne))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_le_ord_iff
statement: theorem one_le_ord_iff : 1 ≤ I.ord x ↔ x ∈ I.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal, ← pow_one (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)),
    ← le_ord_iff, Nat.cast_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_top_iff [IsLocallyNoetherian X] : I.ord x = ⊤ ↔ I.stalkIdeal x = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, IsLocalRing.ord_eq_top_iff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_top : (⊤ : X.IdealSheafData).ord x = 0
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_bot
statement: theorem ord_bot : (⊥ : X.IdealSheafData).ord x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal]
  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem x
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ U hxU, ideal_bot, Pi.bot_apply, Ideal.map_bot,
    IsLocalRing.ord_bot]

name: TopologicalSpace.Closeds.genericPoints_bot
statement: theorem Closeds.genericPoints_bot : (⊥ : Closeds X).genericPoints = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun η hη => ?_
  have h : η ∈ ((⊥ : Closeds X) : Set X) := hη.1
  rw [Closeds.coe_bot] at h
  exact Set.notMem_empty η h

name: TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds.isGenericPoint_genericPoint
statement:
theorem IrreducibleCloseds.isGenericPoint_genericPoint [QuasiSober X] (Z : IrreducibleCloseds X) :
    IsGenericPoint Z.genericPoint (Z : Set X)
proof:
:=
  Z.isIrreducible.isGenericPoint_genericPoint Z.isClosed

name: TopologicalSpace.Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff
statement:
theorem Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff [T0Space X] [QuasiSober X] (Z : Closeds X) (η : X) :
    η ∈ Z.genericPoints ↔ Maximal (fun T : Set X => T ⊆ Z ∧ IsIrreducible T) (closure {η})
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hηZ, hmax⟩
    refine ⟨⟨Z.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hηZ),
      isIrreducible_singleton.closure⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro T ⟨hTZ, hT⟩ hle
    have hη' : IsGenericPoint hT.genericPoint (closure T) := hT.isGenericPoint_genericPoint_closure
    have hη'Z : hT.genericPoint ∈ Z :=
      Z.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr hTZ hη'.mem
    have hηT : η ∈ closure T := subset_closure (hle (subset_closure rfl))
    have heq : hT.genericPoint = η := hmax hη'Z (hη'.specializes hηT)
    calc T ⊆ closure T := subset_closure
      _ = closure {hT.genericPoint} := hη'.def.symm
      _ = closure {η} := by rw [heq]
  · rintro ⟨⟨hsub, -⟩, hmax⟩
    refine ⟨hsub (subset_closure rfl), fun η' hη'Z hspec => ?_⟩
    have h1 : closure ({η} : Set X) ⊆ closure {η'} := specializes_iff_closure_subset.mp hspec
    have h2 : closure ({η'} : Set X) ⊆ closure {η} :=
      hmax ⟨Z.isClosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hη'Z),
        isIrreducible_singleton.closure⟩ h1
    exact (hspec.antisymm (specializes_iff_closure_subset.mpr h2)).eq

name: TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds.genericPoints_eq
statement:
theorem IrreducibleCloseds.genericPoints_eq [T0Space X] [QuasiSober X] (Z : IrreducibleCloseds X) :
    (⟨Z, Z.isClosed⟩ : Closeds X).genericPoints = {Z.genericPoint}
proof:
:= by
  ext η
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hηZ, hmax⟩
    exact (hmax Z.isGenericPoint_genericPoint.mem
      (Z.isGenericPoint_genericPoint.specializes hηZ)).symm
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨Z.isGenericPoint_genericPoint.mem, fun η' hη' hspec =>
      (hspec.antisymm (Z.isGenericPoint_genericPoint.specializes hη')).eq⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ordAlong_eq_of_isGenericPoint

name: Hironaka.Monomial.PieceFamily.mem_finset_sup_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.Hironaka.Monomial.PieceFamily.mem_finset_sup_iff {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (g : ι → Closeds X) (x : X) :
    x ∈ s.sup g ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, x ∈ g i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Closeds.coe_finset_sup, Finset.sup_eq_iSup]
