name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affineOpens_of_not_mem_sup
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hxU, hUV⟩ := X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
    (show x ∈ ((s.sup C).compl : Opens X) from hx) (s.sup C).compl.isOpen
  exact ⟨⟨U, hU⟩, hxU, fun y hy => hUV hy⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_controlledTransform_le_of_notMem
statement:
theorem ord_controlledTransform_le_of_notMem (Z I : X.IdealSheafData) (m : ℕ) (q : blowUp Z)
    (hq : blowUpπ Z q ∉ Z.support) :
    (I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) m).ord q ≤
      I.ord (blowUpπ Z q)
proof:
:= by
  refine
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_anti
          (comap_le_controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) I m)
    q).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  have hqU : q ∈ blowUpπ Z ⁻¹ᵁ Z.support.compl := (blowUpπ Z).mem_preimage.mpr hq
  have := blowUp.isIso_π_restrict_compl_support Z
  have hcomp : (I.comap (blowUpπ Z)).comap (Scheme.Opens.ι (blowUpπ Z ⁻¹ᵁ Z.support.compl)) =
      (I.comap (Scheme.Opens.ι Z.support.compl)).comap (blowUpπ Z ∣_ Z.support.compl) := by
    rw [← comap_comp, ← comap_comp, morphismRestrict_ι]
  
  have h1 := ord_comap_ι (I.comap (blowUpπ Z)) (blowUpπ Z ⁻¹ᵁ Z.support.compl) ⟨q, hqU⟩
  have h2 := ord_comap_of_isIso (I.comap (Scheme.Opens.ι Z.support.compl))
    (blowUpπ Z ∣_ Z.support.compl) ⟨q, hqU⟩
  have h3 := ord_comap_ι I Z.support.compl ((blowUpπ Z ∣_ Z.support.compl) ⟨q, hqU⟩)
  have h4 : Scheme.Opens.ι Z.support.compl ((blowUpπ Z ∣_ Z.support.compl) ⟨q, hqU⟩) =
      blowUpπ Z q :=
    morphismRestrict_base_coe (blowUpπ Z) Z.support.compl ⟨q, hqU⟩
  rw [hcomp] at h1
  rw [h4] at h3
  exact h1.symm.trans (h2.trans h3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_comap_eq_span_of_chart
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_comap_eq_span_of_chart {Z : X.IdealSheafData} (q : blowUp Z) {n' : ℕ}
    (y : Fin n' → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (ρ : Fin n')
    (hZ' : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = chartCenter y ρ) (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing y ρ))
    [𝔮.IsPrime] (e : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
    (he : ∀ c, e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q c) =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (chartRing y ρ) c)) :
    (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)).stalkIdeal q = Ideal.span {(blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y ρ)}
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : e.toRingHom.comp ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom =
      (algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)).comp
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (chartRing y ρ)) := RingHom.ext he
  have hψ : ∀ c, e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q c) =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (chartRing y ρ) c) :=
    fun c => RingHom.congr_fun hcomp c
  have hinj : Function.Injective e.toRingHom := e.injective
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective e.toRingHom := e.surjective
  rw [stalkIdeal_comap, hZ', chartCenter, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    change i ≤ ρ at hi
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hi with heq | hlt
    · rw [heq]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurj (algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (chartYR y ρ i))
      
      
      have h1 : e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y i)) =
          e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y ρ) * u) :=
        calc e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y i))
            = algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
                (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y i)) := hψ (y i)
          _ = algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
                (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ) * chartYR y ρ i) := by
              rw [algebraMap_x_eq_mul_chartYR y ρ hlt]
          _ = algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
                (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ)) *
              algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (chartYR y ρ i) :=
              map_mul _ _ _
          _ = e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y ρ)) * e.toRingHom u :=
              congrArg₂ (· * ·) (hψ (y ρ)).symm hu.symm
          _ = e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y ρ) * u) := (map_mul _ _ _).symm
      change (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y i) ∈ _
      rw [hinj h1]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  · rintro _ rfl
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨ρ, show ρ ≤ ρ from le_rfl, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_mem_stalkIdeal_pow_mul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mem_stalkIdeal_pow_mul_eq {Z : X.IdealSheafData} (q : blowUp Z) {n' : ℕ}
    (y : Fin n' → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (ρ : Fin n')
    (hZ' : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = chartCenter y ρ) (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing y ρ))
    [𝔮.IsPrime] (e : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
    (he : ∀ c, e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q c) =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (chartRing y ρ) c))
    (T : (blowUp Z).IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ} {f₀ : X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)}
    (hmem0 : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q f₀ ∈ ((Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ m * T).stalkIdeal q) :
    ∃ t ∈ T.stalkIdeal q, (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y ρ) ^ m * t = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q f₀
proof:
:= by
  have hFq := stalkIdeal_comap_eq_span_of_chart q y ρ hZ' 𝔮 e he
  rw [stalkIdeal_mul, stalkIdeal_pow, hFq, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul] at hmem0
  exact hmem0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.toRingHom_pow_mul_eq_of_pow_mul_eq
statement:
theorem toRingHom_pow_mul_eq_of_pow_mul_eq {Z : X.IdealSheafData} (q : blowUp Z) {n' : ℕ}
    (y : Fin n' → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (ρ : Fin n') (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing y ρ))
    [𝔮.IsPrime] (e : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
    (he : ∀ c, e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q c) =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (chartRing y ρ) c))
    {m : ℕ} {f₀ : X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)} {t : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q}
    (hteq : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y ρ) ^ m * t = (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q f₀) :
    algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ)) ^ m * e.toRingHom t =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) f₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : e.toRingHom.comp ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q).hom =
      (algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)).comp
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (chartRing y ρ)) := RingHom.ext he
  have hψ : ∀ c, e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q c) =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (chartRing y ρ) c) :=
    fun c => RingHom.congr_fun hcomp c
  
  have hteq2 : e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y ρ)) ^ m * e.toRingHom t =
      e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q f₀) :=
    ((congrArg₂ (· * ·) (map_pow e.toRingHom ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q (y ρ)) m).symm rfl).trans
      (map_mul e.toRingHom _ _).symm).trans (congrArg e.toRingHom hteq)
  exact ((congrArg₂ (· * ·) (congrArg (· ^ m) (hψ (y ρ)).symm) rfl).trans hteq2).trans (hψ f₀)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.toRingHom_eq_algebraMap_transformElem
statement:
theorem toRingHom_eq_algebraMap_transformElem {Z : X.IdealSheafData} (q : blowUp Z) {n' : ℕ}
    (y : Fin n' → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q))
    [IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q))]
    (hy : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) = Ideal.span (Set.range y))
    (hn' : (n' : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q))) (ρ : Fin n')
    (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing y ρ)) [𝔮.IsPrime]
    (e : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
    {m : ℕ} {f₀ : X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)} (hf₀P : f₀ ∈ chartCenter y ρ ^ m)
    {t : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q}
    (hteq3 : algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ)) ^ m * e.toRingHom t =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) f₀)) :
    e.toRingHom t = algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (transformElem y ρ f₀ hf₀P)
proof:
:= by
  have hdom : IsDomain (chartRing y ρ) := isDomain_chartRing y ρ hy hn'
  have hdom' : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) :=
    IsLocalization.isDomain_localization 𝔮.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  have hne : algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
      (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hinj' : Function.Injective (algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)) :=
      IsLocalization.injective (M := 𝔮.primeCompl) (S := Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        𝔮.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
    have h1' := hinj' (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    exact x_ne_zero_of_span_eq y hy hn' ρ
      (algebraMap_chartRing_injective y ρ hy hn' (h1'.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hteq' : algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ)) ^ m * e.toRingHom t =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ)) ^ m *
        algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (transformElem y ρ f₀ hf₀P) :=
    hteq3.trans (by
      rw [← map_pow (algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮))
        (algebraMap _ (chartRing y ρ) (y ρ)) m,
        ← map_mul (algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)),
        algebraMap_pow_mul_transformElem])
  have _ : IsLeftCancelMulZero (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) :=
    hdom'.toIsCancelMulZero.toIsLeftCancelMulZero
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero m hne) hteq'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.algebraMap_transformElem_mem_map_of_mem
statement:
theorem algebraMap_transformElem_mem_map_of_mem {Z : X.IdealSheafData} (q : blowUp Z) {n' : ℕ}
    (y : Fin n' → X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q))
    [IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q))]
    (hy : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) = Ideal.span (Set.range y))
    (hn' : (n' : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q))) (ρ : Fin n')
    (hZ' : Z.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q) = chartCenter y ρ) (𝔮 : Ideal (chartRing y ρ))
    [𝔮.IsPrime] (e : (blowUp Z).presheaf.stalk q ≃+* Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
    (he : ∀ c, e ((blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q c) =
      algebraMap (chartRing y ρ) (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮)
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) (chartRing y ρ) c))
    (T : (blowUp Z).IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ} {f₀ : X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)}
    (hf₀P : f₀ ∈ chartCenter y ρ ^ m)
    (hmem0 : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q f₀ ∈ ((Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ m * T).stalkIdeal q) :
    algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) (transformElem y ρ f₀ hf₀P) ∈
      (T.stalkIdeal q).map e.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hteq⟩ := exists_mem_stalkIdeal_pow_mul_eq q y ρ hZ' 𝔮 e he T hmem0
  have h3 := toRingHom_pow_mul_eq_of_pow_mul_eq q y ρ 𝔮 e he hteq
  have hc := toRingHom_eq_algebraMap_transformElem q y hy hn' ρ 𝔮 e hf₀P h3
  have hmem := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem e.toRingHom ht
  rw [hc] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_controlledTransform_le_of_mem
statement:
theorem ord_controlledTransform_le_of_mem (m : ℕ) (hm : I.ord η = m) (hmax : I.maxOrd = m)
    (q : blowUp Z) (hq : blowUpπ Z q ∈ Z.support) :
    (I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) m).ord q ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsm : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  
  have hordz : I.ord (blowUpπ Z q) = m := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← hmax]
      exact I.le_maxOrd _
    · rw [← hm]
      exact ord_le_ord_of_specializes I f n (hη.specializes hq)
  have hIZ : I ≤ Z ^ m := le_pow_of_le_ord f n r Z hr hrn I hη m (le_of_eq hm.symm)
  have hFT := pow_mul_controlledTransformAlong f n r Z hr hrn I hη m (le_of_eq hm.symm)
  
  obtain ⟨n', y, ρ, hn', hy, hZ', 𝔮, hprime, hle, e, he⟩ :=
    exists_stalk_equiv_localization_chart f n r Z hrn q hq
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (blowUpπ Z q)) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk f _
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, ← ord_map_ringEquiv (B := Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) e,
    ← RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe]
  
  have hordIz : IsLocalRing.ord (I.stalkIdeal (blowUpπ Z q)) = m := by
    rw [← ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal]
    exact hordz
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀I, hf₀⟩ := exists_mem_ordElem_eq_of_ord_eq hordIz
  have hf₀P : f₀ ∈ chartCenter y ρ ^ m := by
    have := stalkIdeal_mono hIZ (blowUpπ Z q) hf₀I
    rwa [stalkIdeal_pow, hZ'] at this
  
  have hmem0 : (blowUpπ Z).stalkMap q f₀ ∈
      ((Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ m *
        I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) m).stalkIdeal q := by
    rw [hFT, stalkIdeal_comap]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf₀I
  have hkey := algebraMap_transformElem_mem_map_of_mem q y hy hn' ρ hZ' 𝔮 e he _ hf₀P hmem0
  
  have hbound := ordElem_algebraMap_transformElem_le y hy hn' ρ 𝔮 hle hf₀P hf₀
  refine le_trans (IsLocalRing.ord_anti (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hkey))) ?_
  rw [ord_span_singleton]
  exact hbound

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_controlledTransform_le
statement:
theorem ord_controlledTransform_le (m : ℕ) (hm : I.ord η = m) (hmax : I.maxOrd = m)
    (q : blowUp Z) :
    (I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) m).ord q ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : blowUpπ Z q ∈ Z.support
  · exact ord_controlledTransform_le_of_mem f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm hmax q hq
  · refine (ord_controlledTransform_le_of_notMem Z I m q hq).trans ?_
    rw [← hmax]
    exact I.le_maxOrd _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.maxOrd_controlledTransform_le
statement:
theorem maxOrd_controlledTransform_le (m : ℕ) (hm : I.ord η = m) (hmax : I.maxOrd = m) :
    (I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) m).maxOrd ≤ I.maxOrd
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxOrd_le_iff, hmax]
  exact fun q => ord_controlledTransform_le f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm hmax q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.maxOrd_weakTransform_le
statement:
theorem maxOrd_weakTransform_le (m : ℕ) (hm : I.ord η = m) (hmax : I.maxOrd = m) :
    (I.weakTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z))).maxOrd ≤ I.maxOrd
proof:
:= by
  rw [weakTransformAlong_eq f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm]
  exact maxOrd_controlledTransform_le f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm hmax

name: IsLocalRing.OrdFaithful.of_arrow_iso
statement:
theorem OrdFaithful.of_arrow_iso {A B A' B' : CommRingCat} [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    [IsLocalRing A'] [IsLocalRing B'] {φ : A ⟶ B} {ψ : A' ⟶ B'} (i : Arrow.mk φ ≅ Arrow.mk ψ)
    (h : OrdFaithful φ.hom) : OrdFaithful ψ.hom
proof:
:= by
  have hw : i.hom.left ≫ ψ = φ ≫ i.hom.right := Arrow.w i.hom
  have hl : i.inv.left ≫ i.hom.left = 𝟙 A' := by
    rw [← Arrow.comp_left, i.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  have hψ : ψ = i.inv.left ≫ φ ≫ i.hom.right := by
    rw [← hw, ← Category.assoc, hl]
    exact (Category.id_comp ψ).symm
  have hr : i.hom.right ≫ i.inv.right = 𝟙 B := by
    rw [← Arrow.comp_right, i.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have hr' : i.inv.right ≫ i.hom.right = 𝟙 B' := by
    rw [← Arrow.comp_right, i.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  have hl' : i.hom.left ≫ i.inv.left = 𝟙 A := by
    rw [← Arrow.comp_left, i.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  let eL : A' ≃+* A := (Iso.mk i.inv.left i.hom.left hl hl').commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let eR : B ≃+* B' := (Iso.mk i.hom.right i.inv.right hr hr').commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hψ' : ψ.hom = (eR : B →+* B').comp (φ.hom.comp (eL : A' →+* A)) := by
    rw [hψ]
    rfl
  rw [hψ']
  exact (h.ringEquiv_comp eL).comp_ringEquiv eR

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_map_stalkMap_of_smooth
statement:
theorem ord_map_stalkMap_of_smooth {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth f] (y : Y)
    (J : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))) :
    IsLocalRing.ord (J.map (f.stalkMap y).hom) = IsLocalRing.ord J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hyU, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ (f y)) isOpen_univ
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hyV, hVU⟩ :=
    Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hyU (U.2.preimage f.continuous)
  have hsm : (f.appLE U V hVU).hom.Smooth :=
    HasRingHomProperty.appLE @Smooth f inferInstance ⟨U, hU⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩ hVU
  algebraize [(f.appLE U V hVU).hom]
  have hOF : OrdFaithful (Localization.localRingHom _ _ (f.appLE U V hVU).hom
      congr($(IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE U hU V hV hVU hyV).1).symm) :=
    ordFaithful_localRingHom_of_isSmoothAt _ _
  exact ord_map_eq_of_ordFaithful (OrdFaithful.of_arrow_iso
    (IsAffineOpen.arrowStalkMapIso f U hU V hV hVU hyV).symm hOF) J

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_comap_of_smooth
statement:
theorem ord_comap_of_smooth {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [Smooth f] (y : Y) :
    (I.comap f).ord y = I.ord (f y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, stalkIdeal_comap]
  exact ord_map_stalkMap_of_smooth f y _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_comap_of_etale
statement:
theorem ord_comap_of_etale {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y) :
    (I.comap f).ord y = I.ord (f y)
proof:
:=
  ord_comap_of_smooth I f y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_maximalIdeal_eq_one
statement: theorem ord_maximalIdeal_eq_one (h : maximalIdeal R ≠ ⊥) : ord (maximalIdeal R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun r => iSup_le fun hr => ?_) ?_
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge r 2 with hr2 | hr2
    · exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hr2
    · exfalso
      have hsq : maximalIdeal R ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 := hr.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hr2)
      refine h (Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (maximalIdeal R) (maximalIdeal R)
        (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) ?_ ?_)
      · rw [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← pow_two]
        exact hsq
      · rw [jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal (⊥ : Ideal R) bot_ne_top]
  · have := le_ord_of_le (I := maximalIdeal R) (r := 1) (by rw [pow_one])
    simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_eq_one_of_stalkIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem ord_eq_one_of_stalkIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) {x : X} (h : I.stalkIdeal x = maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hne : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ≠ ⊥) : I.ord x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, h]
  exact ord_maximalIdeal_eq_one hne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_genericPoints_iff
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_iff (Z : Closeds X) (η : X) :
    η ∈ Z.genericPoints ↔ Maximal (fun T : Set X => T ⊆ Z ∧ IsIrreducible T) (closure {η})
proof:
:=
  Closeds.mem_genericPoints_iff Z η

name: AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_subscheme_of_isGenericPoint
statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_subscheme_of_isGenericPoint (Z : X.IdealSheafData) {η : X}
    (hη : IsGenericPoint η (Z.support : Set X)) : IrreducibleSpace Z.subscheme
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Z.exists_subschemeι_eq hη.mem
  rw [irreducibleSpace_def]
  have hcl : closure ({p} : Set Z.subscheme) = Set.univ := by
    refine Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr fun q => ?_
    rw [← specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← Z.subschemeι.isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff, hp]
    exact hη.specializes (Z.range_subschemeι ▸ ⟨q, rfl⟩)
  rw [Set.top_eq_univ, ← hcl]
  exact isIrreducible_singleton.closure

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIntegral_subscheme_of_smooth
proof:
:= by
  have := irreducibleSpace_subscheme_of_isGenericPoint Z hη
  exact isIntegral_subscheme_of_isRegularLocalRing_stalk Z fun z =>
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk (Z.subschemeι ≫ f) z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPrime_stalkIdeal_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem isPrime_stalkIdeal_of_mem_support {z : X} (hz : z ∈ Z.support) :
    (Z.stalkIdeal z).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hzU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem z
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := Z.exists_subschemeι_eq hz
  have hprime : (Z.ideal U).IsPrime := isPrime_ideal_of_isIntegral_subscheme Z U (hz' ▸ hzU)
  have hle : Z.ideal U ≤ (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzU⟩).asIdeal :=
    (mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf U hzU _).mp ((mem_support_iff_of_mem hzU).mp hz)
  let := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨z, hzU⟩ : U.1)
  have := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨z, hzU⟩
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ _ U hzU]
  exact IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
    (X.presheaf.stalk z) _ hprime (Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun a ha haI => ha (hle haI))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ordAlong_stalkIdeal_eq_ord_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem ordAlong_stalkIdeal_eq_ord_stalkIdeal {η z : X}
    (hη : IsGenericPoint η (Z.support : Set X)) (hz : z ∈ Z.support)
    [hP : (Z.stalkIdeal z).IsPrime] :
    IsLocalRing.ordAlong (Z.stalkIdeal z) (I.stalkIdeal z) =
      IsLocalRing.ord (I.stalkIdeal η)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hzU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem z
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U.1 := U.2
  have hηz : η ⤳ z := hη.specializes hz
  have hηU : η ∈ U.1 := hηz.mem_open U.1.2 hzU
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := Z.exists_subschemeι_eq hz
  have hprime : (Z.ideal U).IsPrime := isPrime_ideal_of_isIntegral_subscheme Z U (hz' ▸ hzU)
  have hle : Z.ideal U ≤ (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzU⟩).asIdeal :=
    (mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf U hzU _).mp ((mem_support_iff_of_mem hzU).mp hz)
  have hdisj : Disjoint ((hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl : Set Γ(X, U))
      (Z.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U)) :=
    Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun a ha haI => ha (hle haI)
  
  let y : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) := ⟨Z.ideal U, hprime⟩
  have hyU : hU.fromSpec y ∈ (U.1 : Set X) := by
    rw [← hU.range_fromSpec]
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hyη : hU.fromSpec y = η := by
    have hpid : hU.primeIdealOf ⟨hU.fromSpec y, hyU⟩ = y :=
      hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective (hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨hU.fromSpec y, hyU⟩)
    have hmem : hU.fromSpec y ∈ Z.support :=
      (mem_support_iff_of_mem hyU).mpr ((mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf U hyU _).mpr
        (by rw [hpid]))
    have h1 : hU.fromSpec y ⤳ η := by
      have hηy : Z.ideal U ≤ (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨η, hηU⟩).asIdeal :=
        (mem_zeroLocus_iff_le_primeIdealOf U hηU _).mp ((mem_support_iff_of_mem hηU).mp hη.mem)
      have h2 : y ⤳ hU.primeIdealOf ⟨η, hηU⟩ := (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hηy
      have h3 := h2.map hU.fromSpec.continuous
      rwa [hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf] at h3
    have hgen : IsGenericPoint (hU.fromSpec y) (Z.support : Set X) := by
      rw [isGenericPoint_iff_specializes]
      intro q
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact h.mem_closed Z.support.isClosed hmem
      · intro hq
        exact h1.trans (hη.specializes hq)
    exact hgen.eq hη
  subst hyη
  
  let := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨z, hzU⟩ : U.1)
  have hloc_z := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨z, hzU⟩
  let := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨hU.fromSpec y, hyU⟩ : U.1)
  have hloc_η := hU.isLocalization_stalk' y hyU
  set P := Z.stalkIdeal z with hPdef
  have hPmap : P = (Z.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk z)) :=
    stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ Z U hzU
  have hcomap : P.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk z)) = Z.ideal U := by
    rw [hPmap]
    exact IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk z) hprime hdisj
  have hT : IsLocalization (Z.ideal U).primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P) := by
    have h1 := IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P) P
    have hsub : (Z.ideal U).primeCompl =
        (P.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk z))).primeCompl := by
      ext a
      change a ∉ Z.ideal U ↔ a ∉ P.comap (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk z))
      rw [hcomap]
    rw [hsub]
    exact h1
  have hloc_η' : IsLocalization (Z.ideal U).primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec y)) :=
    hloc_η
  let e := IsLocalization.algEquiv (Z.ideal U).primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P)
    (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec y))
  unfold IsLocalRing.ordAlong
  have hI : I.stalkIdeal z = (I.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk z)) :=
    stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ I U hzU
  have hIη : I.stalkIdeal (hU.fromSpec y) =
      (I.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec y))) :=
    stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ I U hyU
  rw [hI, Ideal.map_map, hIη, ← ord_map_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv, Ideal.map_map]
  congr 2
  refine RingHom.ext fun a => ?_
  change e ((algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) (Localization.AtPrime P))
    ((algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk z)) a)) = _
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  exact e.commutes a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_pow_of_le_ordAlong_of_eq_chartCenter
statement:
theorem le_pow_of_le_ordAlong_of_eq_chartCenter {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    [Algebra ℚ R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → R) (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (r : Fin n) (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : P = chartCenter x r) (I : Ideal R) (m : ℕ) (h : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.ordAlong P I) :
    I ≤ P ^ m
proof:
:= by
  subst hP
  exact (le_ordAlong_chartCenter_iff x hx hn r I m).mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_pow_of_le_ord
statement: theorem le_pow_of_le_ord (m : ℕ) (hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord η) : I ≤ Z ^ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  have : Smooth (Z.subschemeι ≫ f) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth (n - r) _
  have hint : IsIntegral Z.subscheme := isIntegral_subscheme_of_smooth f Z hη
  refine le_of_stalkIdeal_le fun z => ?_
  rw [stalkIdeal_pow]
  by_cases hz : z ∈ Z.support
  · have hP := isPrime_stalkIdeal_of_mem_support Z hz
    have hord : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.ordAlong (Z.stalkIdeal z) (I.stalkIdeal z) := by
      rw [ordAlong_stalkIdeal_eq_ord_stalkIdeal Z I hη hz, ← ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal]
      exact hm
    have := isRegularLocalRing_stalk f z
    let := f.stalkAlgebraRat z
    obtain ⟨m', y, hm', hy, hZ⟩ := exists_adaptedParameters Z f n r hrn hz
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m' with hm0 | hm0
    · 
      subst hm0
      have hZ0 : Z.stalkIdeal z = ⊥ := by
        rw [hZ, Set.eq_empty_of_isEmpty ({j : Fin 0 | j.val < r}), Set.image_empty,
          Ideal.span_empty]
      have hmax : maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk z) = ⊥ := by
        rw [hy, Set.range_eq_empty, Ideal.span_empty]
      rw [hZ0]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h0 | h0
      · subst h0
        rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
        exact le_top
      · rw [Ideal.bot_pow (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h0), ← hmax, ← pow_one (maximalIdeal _)]
        refine (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_ord_iff I z).mp ?_
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h0) (hm.trans (ord_le_ord_of_specializes I f n
          (hη.specializes hz)))
    · 
      let ρ : Fin m' := ⟨min (r - 1) (m' - 1), by omega⟩
      have hset : {j : Fin m' | j.val < r} = {j | j ≤ ρ} := by
        ext j
        change j.val < r ↔ j ≤ ρ
        rw [Fin.le_def]
        change j.val < r ↔ j.val ≤ min (r - 1) (m' - 1)
        have := j.2
        omega
      have hZ' : Z.stalkIdeal z = chartCenter y ρ := by
        rw [hZ, hset]
        rfl
      exact le_pow_of_le_ordAlong_of_eq_chartCenter y hy hm' ρ (Z.stalkIdeal z) hZ'
        (I.stalkIdeal z) m hord
  · rw [stalkIdeal_eq_top_of_notMem_support Z hz, Ideal.top_pow]
    exact le_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exceptionalDivisor_pow_dvd_comap_of_le_ord
statement:
theorem exceptionalDivisor_pow_dvd_comap_of_le_ord (m : ℕ) (hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord η) :
    (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ m ∣ I.comap (blowUpπ Z)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : I.comap (blowUpπ Z) ≤ (Z ^ m).comap (blowUpπ Z) :=
    comap_mono (blowUpπ Z) (le_pow_of_le_ord f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm)
  rw [comap_pow] at h1
  exact pow_dvd_of_le_pow_of_isInvertible (blowUp.isBlowUp Z).admissible h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field [LocallyOfFiniteType f] :
    IsLocallyNoetherian X
proof:
:= by
  refine isLocallyNoetherian_of_affine_cover (S := fun U : X.affineOpens => U)
    (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top X) fun U => ?_
  let _ := f.sectionsAlgebra U.1
  have := f.finiteType_sectionsAlgebra U.2
  exact Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k Γ(X, U.1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.setOf_ord_eq_top_eq_iInter
statement:
theorem setOf_ord_eq_top_eq_iInter (I : X.IdealSheafData) :
    {x | I.ord x = ⊤} = ⋂ m : ℕ, {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_iInter]
  exact ENat.eq_top_iff_forall_ge

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.setOf_ord_eq_top_eq_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot
statement:
theorem setOf_ord_eq_top_eq_setOf_stalkIdeal_eq_bot [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (I : X.IdealSheafData) :
    {x | I.ord x = ⊤} = {x | I.stalkIdeal x = ⊥}
proof:
:= by
  have := f.isLocallyNoetherian_of_field
  ext x
  exact ord_eq_top_iff I x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.setOf_le_ord_eq_support_derivativeIter
statement:
theorem setOf_le_ord_eq_support_derivativeIter (I : X.IdealSheafData) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} = ((I.derivativeIter f (m - 1)).support : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact le_ord_iff_mem_support_derivativeIter f n I x hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosed_setOf_le_ord
statement:
theorem isClosed_setOf_le_ord (I : X.IdealSheafData) (m : ℕ) :
    IsClosed {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x}
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · have : {x | ((0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun x => by simp
    rw [this]
    exact isClosed_univ
  · rw [setOf_le_ord_eq_support_derivativeIter f n I hm]
    exact (I.derivativeIter f (m - 1)).support.isClosed

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosed_setOf_ord_eq_top
statement: theorem isClosed_setOf_ord_eq_top (I : X.IdealSheafData) : IsClosed {x | I.ord x = ⊤}
proof:
:= by
  rw [setOf_ord_eq_top_eq_iInter]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun m => isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.upperSemicontinuous_ord
statement: theorem upperSemicontinuous_ord (I : X.IdealSheafData) : UpperSemicontinuous fun x => I.ord x
proof:
:= by
  rw [upperSemicontinuous_iff_isClosed_preimage]
  intro y
  induction y using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top =>
    have : (fun x => I.ord x) ⁻¹' Set.Ici ⊤ = {x | I.ord x = ⊤} := by
      ext x
      change ⊤ ≤ I.ord x ↔ I.ord x = ⊤
      exact top_le_iff
    rw [this]
    exact isClosed_setOf_ord_eq_top f n I
  | coe m => exact isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivation_eq_sum_smul_pderiv
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_sum_smul_pderiv
    (δ : Derivation K (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) :
    δ = ∑ i, δ (X i) • pderiv i
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.derivation_ext fun j => ?_
  have hc : (⇑(∑ i, δ (X i) • pderiv i : Derivation K (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
      (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) =
      ∑ i, ⇑(δ (X i) • (pderiv i : Derivation K (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
        (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) :=
    map_sum Derivation.coeFnAddMonoidHom _ _
  rw [hc, Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [Derivation.smul_apply, pderiv_X_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  · intro i _ hij
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, pderiv_X_of_ne hij.symm, smul_zero]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivation_mem_span_range_pderiv
statement:
theorem derivation_mem_span_range_pderiv
    (δ : Derivation K (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) :
    δ ∈ Submodule.span (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
      (Set.range fun i : Fin n =>
        (pderiv i : Derivation K (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivation_eq_sum_smul_pderiv δ]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivative_span_eq
statement:
theorem derivative_span_eq (S : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) :
    Ideal.derivative K (Ideal.span S) = Ideal.span (S ∪ ⋃ i, pderiv i '' S)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.derivative_span_eq_of_span (fun i : Fin n => pderiv i) derivation_mem_span_range_pderiv S

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pderivList_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem pderivList_nil (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) :
    pderivList ([] : List (Fin n)) f = f
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pderivList_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem pderivList_cons (i : Fin n) (l : List (Fin n))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) : pderivList (i :: l) f = pderiv i (pderivList l f)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivativeIter_span_singleton
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    rw [Ideal.derivativeIter_zero]
    congr 1
    ext g
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Nat.le_zero, List.length_eq_zero_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨[], rfl, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨l, rfl, rfl⟩
      rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Ideal.derivativeIter_succ, ih, derivative_span_eq]
    congr 1
    ext g
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, g', ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨l, by omega, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨i :: l, by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
      cases l with
      | nil => exact Or.inl ⟨[], by simp, rfl⟩
      | cons i l =>
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
        exact Or.inr ⟨i, pderivList l f, ⟨l, by omega, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.derivativeIter_span_singleton_le_iff
statement:
theorem derivativeIter_span_singleton_le_iff (r : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
    (p : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) :
    Ideal.derivativeIter K r (Ideal.span {f}) ≤ p ↔
      ∀ l : List (Fin n), l.length ≤ r → pderivList l f ∈ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivativeIter_span_singleton, Ideal.span_le]
  exact ⟨fun h l hl => h ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩, fun h g ⟨l, hl, hg⟩ => hg ▸ h l hl⟩

name: Ideal.derivativeIter_map
statement:
theorem _root_.Ideal.derivativeIter_map {k A B : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k A] [Algebra A B] [Algebra k B] [IsScalarTower k A B] (M : Submonoid A)
    [IsLocalization M B] [Module.FinitePresentation A (Ω[A⁄k])] (r : ℕ) (J : Ideal A) :
    Ideal.derivativeIter k r (J.map (algebraMap A B)) =
      (Ideal.derivativeIter k r J).map (algebraMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [Ideal.derivativeIter_succ, Ideal.derivativeIter_succ, ih, Ideal.derivative_map M]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_specIdealSheaf
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_specIdealSheaf {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (J : Ideal R) (p : Spec (.of R)) :
    (specIdealSheaf J).stalkIdeal p = J.map (StructureSheaf.toStalk R p).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkIdeal_ofIdealTop, Ideal.map_map]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton
statement:
theorem ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (f : R) (p : Spec (.of R)) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {f})).ord p =
      IsLocalRing.ordElem (R := (Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalk p)
        ((StructureSheaf.toStalk R p).hom f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, stalkIdeal_specIdealSheaf, Ideal.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_one
statement:
theorem ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_one (p : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {(1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)})).ord p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton, map_one]
  exact IsLocalRing.ordElem_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.algebraMap_stalkAlgebra_affineSpaceToSpec
statement:
theorem algebraMap_stalkAlgebra_affineSpaceToSpec (p : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) :
    letI
proof:
:= (affineSpaceToSpec K n).stalkAlgebra p
    letI : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
        ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p) :=
      (StructureSheaf.toStalk (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) p).hom.toAlgebra
    algebraMap K ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p) =
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
        ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p)).comp
        (algebraMap K (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) := by
  refine RingHom.ext fun c => ?_
  have h := congrArg (fun g => g.hom c)
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))))
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at h
  exact congrArg ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial) h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isScalarTower_affineSpace_stalk
statement:
theorem isScalarTower_affineSpace_stalk (p : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) :
    letI
proof:
:= (affineSpaceToSpec K n).stalkAlgebra p
    letI : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
        ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p) :=
      (StructureSheaf.toStalk (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) p).hom.toAlgebra
    IsScalarTower K (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
      ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p) :=
  letI := (affineSpaceToSpec K n).stalkAlgebra p
  letI : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
      ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p) :=
    (StructureSheaf.toStalk (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) p).hom.toAlgebra
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (algebraMap_stalkAlgebra_affineSpaceToSpec p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_ord_specIdealSheaf_iff
statement:
theorem le_ord_specIdealSheaf_iff (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))
    (p : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    (c : ℕ∞) ≤ (specIdealSheaf J).ord p ↔ Ideal.derivativeIter K (c - 1) J ≤ p.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (affineSpaceToSpec K n) :=
    CoordinateSubspace.smoothOfRelativeDimension_Spec_map_algebraMap_mvPolynomial K n
  have : Smooth (affineSpaceToSpec K n) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n _
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_ord_iff_mem_support_derivativeIter (affineSpaceToSpec K n) n _ p hc,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_derivativeIter (affineSpaceToSpec K n) (c - 1) _ p,
    stalkIdeal_specIdealSheaf]
  let _ := (affineSpaceToSpec K n).stalkAlgebra p
  let _ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
      ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p) :=
    (StructureSheaf.toStalk (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) p).hom.toAlgebra
  have := isScalarTower_affineSpace_stalk (K := K) p
  have hp : p.asIdeal.IsPrime := p.isPrime
  have hloc : IsLocalization.AtPrime ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p)
      p.asIdeal :=
    StructureSheaf.IsLocalization.to_stalk (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) p
  have hmap := Ideal.derivativeIter_map (k := K)
    (B := (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p) p.asIdeal.primeCompl (c - 1) J
  change Ideal.derivativeIter K (c - 1) (J.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
    ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p))) ≤ _ ↔ _
  rw [hmap, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  exact ⟨fun h x hx => (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff _ p.asIdeal x).mp (h hx),
    fun h x hx => (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff _ p.asIdeal x).mpr (h hx)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.le_ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem le_ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_iff (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (a : Fin n → K)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) :
    (c : ℕ∞) ≤ (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {f})).ord (ratPoint a) ↔
      ∀ l : List (Fin n), l.length ≤ c - 1 → aeval a (pderivList l f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_ord_specIdealSheaf_iff _ _ hc, derivativeIter_span_singleton_le_iff]
  exact forall_congr' fun l => forall_congr' fun _ => mem_ratPoint_asIdeal_iff a _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_mul
statement:
theorem ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_mul (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
    (p : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {f * g})).ord p =
      (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {f})).ord p + (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {g})).ord p
proof:
:= by
  have : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (affineSpaceToSpec K n) :=
    CoordinateSubspace.smoothOfRelativeDimension_Spec_map_algebraMap_mvPolynomial K n
  have : Smooth (affineSpaceToSpec K n) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n _
  have : IsRegularLocalRing ((Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))).presheaf.stalk p) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_stalk (affineSpaceToSpec K n) p
  let _ := (affineSpaceToSpec K n).stalkAlgebra p
  let _ := (affineSpaceToSpec K n).stalkAlgebraRat p
  rw [ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton, ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton,
    ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton, map_mul]
  exact IsLocalRing.ordElem_mul_of_algebraRat _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_prod
statement:
theorem ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (g : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (p : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {∏ i ∈ s, g i})).ord p =
      ∑ i ∈ s, (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {g i})).ord p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    rw [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    exact ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_one p
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_mul, ih]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_pow
statement:
theorem ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_pow (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (e : ℕ)
    (p : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {f ^ e})).ord p = e * (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {f})).ord p
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
    exact ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_one p
  | succ e ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_mul, ih, Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_X
statement:
theorem ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_X (i : Fin n) (a : Fin n → K) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {(X i : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)})).ord (ratPoint a) =
      if a i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {(X i : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)})).ord
      (ratPoint a) ↔ a i = 0 := by
    have key := le_ord_specIdealSheaf_iff (K := K) (Ideal.span {(X i : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)})
      (ratPoint a) (c := 1) le_rfl
    rw [Nat.cast_one, Nat.sub_self, Ideal.derivativeIter_zero, Ideal.span_le,
      Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe] at key
    exact key.trans ((mem_ratPoint_asIdeal_iff a _).trans (by rw [aeval_X]))
  have h2 : ¬ (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {(X i : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)})).ord
      (ratPoint a) := by
    have key := le_ord_specIdealSheaf_iff (K := K) (Ideal.span {(X i : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)})
      (ratPoint a) (c := 2) (by norm_num)
    rw [Nat.cast_ofNat] at key
    rw [key]
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) ∈
        Ideal.derivativeIter K (2 - 1) (Ideal.span {(X i : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)}) := by
      rw [show 2 - 1 = 0 + 1 from rfl, Ideal.derivativeIter_succ, Ideal.derivativeIter_zero,
        ← pderiv_X_self i]
      exact Ideal.derivation_apply_mem_derivative (pderiv i) (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    exact (ratPoint a).isPrime.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr (h hone))
  by_cases ha : a i = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left ha]
    refine le_antisymm ?_ (h1.mpr ha)
    rw [← not_lt]
    intro hlt
    exact h2 (by rw [← one_add_one_eq_two]; exact (ENat.add_one_le_iff ENat.one_ne_top).mpr hlt)
  · rw [ite_eq_right ha]
    exact Order.lt_one_iff.mp (not_le.mp fun h => ha (h1.mp h))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_prod_pow_X
statement:
theorem ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_prod_pow_X (e : Fin n → ℕ) (a : Fin n → K) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {∏ i, (X i : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) ^ e i})).ord (ratPoint a) =
      ∑ i, if a i = 0 then (e i : ℕ∞) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_prod]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_pow, ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_X]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_prod_X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_prod_pow_X (K := K) (fun _ : Fin n => 1) a
  simp only [pow_one, Nat.cast_one] at h
  rw [h, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pderiv_ofNat
statement:
@[simp] theorem pderiv_ofNat {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (i : σ) (c : ℕ) [c.AtLeastTwo] :
    pderiv i (ofNat(c) : MvPolynomial σ R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_ofNat]
  exact Derivation.map_natCast _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pderiv_zero_hauserEx3Poly
statement: theorem pderiv_zero_hauserEx3Poly : pderiv 0 (hauserEx3Poly K k m) = 3 * X 0 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hauserEx3Poly, map_add, pderiv_pow, pderiv_X_self, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul,
    pderiv_X_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide),
    pderiv_X_of_ne (show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide)]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pderiv_one_hauserEx3Poly
statement:
theorem pderiv_one_hauserEx3Poly :
    pderiv 1 (hauserEx3Poly K k m) = (k : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K) * X 1 ^ (k - 1) * X 2 ^ m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hauserEx3Poly, map_add, pderiv_pow, pderiv_X_self, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul,
    pderiv_X_of_ne (show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide),
    pderiv_X_of_ne (show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide)]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pderiv_two_hauserEx3Poly
statement:
theorem pderiv_two_hauserEx3Poly :
    pderiv 2 (hauserEx3Poly K k m) = (m : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K) * X 1 ^ k * X 2 ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hauserEx3Poly, map_add, pderiv_pow, pderiv_X_self, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul,
    pderiv_X_of_ne (show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide),
    pderiv_X_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide)]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.fin3_cases
statement: theorem fin3_cases (i : Fin 3) : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2
proof: := by decide +revert

name: AlgebraicGeometry.two_le_ord_hauserEx3_iff
statement:
theorem two_le_ord_hauserEx3_iff (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (a : Fin 3 → K) :
    (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {hauserEx3Poly K k m})).ord (ratPoint a) ↔
      a 0 = 0 ∧ ((a 1 = 0 ∧ (2 ≤ k ∨ a 2 = 0)) ∨ (a 2 = 0 ∧ (2 ≤ m ∨ a 1 = 0)))
proof:
:= by
  have key := le_ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_iff (hauserEx3Poly K k m) a (c := 2)
    (by norm_num)
  rw [Nat.cast_ofNat] at key
  rw [key]
  have E0 : aeval a (hauserEx3Poly K k m) = a 0 ^ 3 + a 1 ^ k * a 2 ^ m := by
    simp [hauserEx3Poly]
  have E1 : aeval a (pderiv 0 (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = 3 * a 0 ^ 2 := by
    rw [pderiv_zero_hauserEx3Poly]; simp
  have E2 : aeval a (pderiv 1 (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = k * a 1 ^ (k - 1) * a 2 ^ m := by
    rw [pderiv_one_hauserEx3Poly]; simp
  have E3 : aeval a (pderiv 2 (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = m * a 1 ^ k * a 2 ^ (m - 1) := by
    rw [pderiv_two_hauserEx3Poly]; simp
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  constructor
  · intro h
    have e0 := h [] (by simp)
    have e1 := h [0] (by simp)
    have e2 := h [1] (by simp)
    have e3 := h [2] (by simp)
    rw [pderivList_nil, E0] at e0
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, E1] at e1
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, E2] at e2
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, E3] at e3
    have ha0 : a 0 = 0 :=
      (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp e1).resolve_left (by norm_num))
    refine ⟨ha0, ?_⟩
    rw [ha0, zero_pow (by norm_num), zero_add, mul_eq_zero, pow_eq_zero_iff hk0,
      pow_eq_zero_iff hm0] at e0
    rcases e0 with ha1 | ha2
    · refine Or.inl ⟨ha1, ?_⟩
      by_cases hk2 : 2 ≤ k
      · exact Or.inl hk2
      · obtain rfl : k = 1 := by omega
        rw [ha1, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at e2
        exact Or.inr ((pow_eq_zero_iff hm0).mp e2)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨ha2, ?_⟩
      by_cases hm2 : 2 ≤ m
      · exact Or.inl hm2
      · obtain rfl : m = 1 := by omega
        rw [ha2, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at e3
        exact Or.inr ((pow_eq_zero_iff hk0).mp e3)
  · rintro ⟨ha0, h⟩ l hl
    rcases l with _ | ⟨i, _ | ⟨j, l⟩⟩
    · rw [pderivList_nil, E0, ha0, zero_pow (by norm_num), zero_add]
      rcases h with ⟨ha1, _⟩ | ⟨ha2, _⟩
      · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0, zero_mul]
      · rw [ha2, zero_pow hm0, mul_zero]
    · rcases fin3_cases i with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, E1, ha0]; ring
      · rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, E2]
        rcases h with ⟨ha1, hk2 | ha2⟩ | ⟨ha2, _⟩
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow hm0]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow hm0]; ring
      · rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, E3]
        rcases h with ⟨ha1, _⟩ | ⟨ha2, hm2 | ha1⟩
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0]; ring
    · simp at hl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_hauserEx3_le_three
statement:
theorem ord_hauserEx3_le_three (a : Fin 3 → K) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {hauserEx3Poly K k m})).ord (ratPoint a) ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_lt]
  intro hlt
  have h4 : (4 : ℕ∞) ≤ (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {hauserEx3Poly K k m})).ord (ratPoint a) := by
    rw [show (4 : ℕ∞) = 3 + 1 by norm_num]
    exact (ENat.add_one_le_iff (by simp)).mpr hlt
  have key := le_ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_iff (hauserEx3Poly K k m) a (c := 4)
    (by norm_num)
  rw [Nat.cast_ofNat] at key
  have e := key.mp h4 [0, 0, 0] (by simp)
  rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil,
    pderiv_zero_hauserEx3Poly] at e
  simp [Derivation.leibniz] at e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ord_hauserEx3_eq_three_iff
statement:
theorem ord_hauserEx3_eq_three_iff (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (a : Fin 3 → K) :
    (specIdealSheaf (Ideal.span {hauserEx3Poly K k m})).ord (ratPoint a) = 3 ↔
      a 0 = 0 ∧ ((a 1 = 0 ∧ 3 ≤ k) ∨ (a 2 = 0 ∧ 3 ≤ m) ∨ (a 1 = 0 ∧ a 2 = 0 ∧ 3 ≤ k + m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, and_iff_right (ord_hauserEx3_le_three k m a)]
  have key := le_ord_specIdealSheaf_span_singleton_iff (hauserEx3Poly K k m) a (c := 3)
    (by norm_num)
  rw [Nat.cast_ofNat] at key
  rw [key]
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have E0 : aeval a (hauserEx3Poly K k m) = a 0 ^ 3 + a 1 ^ k * a 2 ^ m := by
    simp [hauserEx3Poly]
  have E1 : aeval a (pderivList [0] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = 3 * a 0 ^ 2 := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_zero_hauserEx3Poly]; simp
  have E2 : aeval a (pderivList [1] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = k * a 1 ^ (k - 1) * a 2 ^ m := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_one_hauserEx3Poly]; simp
  have E3 : aeval a (pderivList [2] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = m * a 1 ^ k * a 2 ^ (m - 1) := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_two_hauserEx3Poly]; simp
  have E00 : aeval a (pderivList [0, 0] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = 6 * a 0 := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_zero_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz]; ring
  have E11 : aeval a (pderivList [1, 1] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) =
      k * ((k - 1 : ℕ) : K) * a 1 ^ (k - 1 - 1) * a 2 ^ m := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_one_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X_of_ne (show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide)]; ring
  have E22 : aeval a (pderivList [2, 2] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) =
      m * ((m - 1 : ℕ) : K) * a 1 ^ k * a 2 ^ (m - 1 - 1) := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_two_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide)]; ring
  have E12 : aeval a (pderivList [1, 2] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) =
      k * m * a 1 ^ (k - 1) * a 2 ^ (m - 1) := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_two_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X_of_ne (show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide)]; ring
  have E21 : aeval a (pderivList [2, 1] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) =
      k * m * a 1 ^ (k - 1) * a 2 ^ (m - 1) := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_one_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide)]; ring
  have E01 : aeval a (pderivList [0, 1] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = 0 := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_one_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide),
      pderiv_X_of_ne (show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide)]
  have E02 : aeval a (pderivList [0, 2] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = 0 := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_two_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X_of_ne (show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide),
      pderiv_X_of_ne (show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide)]
  have E10 : aeval a (pderivList [1, 0] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = 0 := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_zero_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X_of_ne (show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide)]
  have E20 : aeval a (pderivList [2, 0] (hauserEx3Poly K k m)) = 0 := by
    rw [pderivList_cons, pderivList_cons, pderivList_nil, pderiv_zero_hauserEx3Poly]
    simp [Derivation.leibniz, pderiv_X_of_ne (show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have e0 := h [] (by simp)
    have e1 := h [0] (by simp)
    have e2 := h [1] (by simp)
    have e3 := h [2] (by simp)
    have e11 := h [1, 1] (by simp)
    have e22 := h [2, 2] (by simp)
    have e12 := h [1, 2] (by simp)
    rw [pderivList_nil, E0] at e0
    rw [E1] at e1
    rw [E2] at e2
    rw [E3] at e3
    rw [E11] at e11
    rw [E22] at e22
    rw [E12] at e12
    have ha0 : a 0 = 0 :=
      (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp e1).resolve_left (by norm_num))
    refine ⟨ha0, ?_⟩
    rw [ha0, zero_pow (by norm_num), zero_add, mul_eq_zero, pow_eq_zero_iff hk0,
      pow_eq_zero_iff hm0] at e0
    by_cases ha1 : a 1 = 0
    · by_cases ha2 : a 2 = 0
      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨ha1, ha2, ?_⟩)
        by_contra hlt
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ : k = 1 ∧ m = 1 := by omega
        rw [ha1, ha2] at e12
        simp at e12
      · refine Or.inl ⟨ha1, ?_⟩
        have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by
          by_contra hlt
          obtain rfl : k = 1 := by omega
          rw [ha1, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at e2
          exact ha2 ((pow_eq_zero_iff hm0).mp e2)
        by_contra hlt
        obtain rfl : k = 2 := by omega
        rw [ha1] at e11
        have h2 : a 2 ^ m = 0 := by simpa using e11
        exact ha2 ((pow_eq_zero_iff hm0).mp h2)
    · have ha2 : a 2 = 0 := e0.resolve_left ha1
      refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨ha2, ?_⟩)
      have hm2 : 2 ≤ m := by
        by_contra hlt
        obtain rfl : m = 1 := by omega
        rw [ha2, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at e3
        exact ha1 ((pow_eq_zero_iff hk0).mp e3)
      by_contra hlt
      obtain rfl : m = 2 := by omega
      rw [ha2] at e22
      have h1 : a 1 ^ k = 0 := by simpa using e22
      exact ha1 ((pow_eq_zero_iff hk0).mp h1)
  · rintro ⟨ha0, h⟩ l hl
    have hz : a 1 ^ k * a 2 ^ m = 0 := by
      rcases h with ⟨ha1, _⟩ | ⟨ha2, _⟩ | ⟨ha1, _, _⟩
      · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0, zero_mul]
      · rw [ha2, zero_pow hm0, mul_zero]
      · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0, zero_mul]
    rcases l with _ | ⟨i, _ | ⟨j, _ | ⟨l, tl⟩⟩⟩
    · rw [pderivList_nil, E0, ha0, zero_pow (by norm_num), zero_add, hz]
    · rcases fin3_cases i with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [E1, ha0]; ring
      · rw [E2]
        rcases h with ⟨ha1, hk3⟩ | ⟨ha2, _⟩ | ⟨ha1, ha2, _⟩
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow hm0]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow hm0]; ring
      · rw [E3]
        rcases h with ⟨ha1, _⟩ | ⟨ha2, hm3⟩ | ⟨ha1, ha2, _⟩
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0]; ring
    · rcases fin3_cases i with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases fin3_cases j with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [E00, ha0]; ring
      · exact E01
      · exact E02
      · exact E10
      · rw [E11]
        rcases h with ⟨ha1, hk3⟩ | ⟨ha2, _⟩ | ⟨ha1, ha2, _⟩
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow hm0]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow hm0]; ring
      · rw [E12]
        rcases h with ⟨ha1, hk3⟩ | ⟨ha2, hm3⟩ | ⟨ha1, ha2, hkm⟩
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 k with hk2 | hk2
          · rw [ha1, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
          · rw [ha2, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
      · exact E20
      · rw [E21]
        rcases h with ⟨ha1, hk3⟩ | ⟨ha2, hm3⟩ | ⟨ha1, ha2, hkm⟩
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 k with hk2 | hk2
          · rw [ha1, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
          · rw [ha2, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
      · rw [E22]
        rcases h with ⟨ha1, _⟩ | ⟨ha2, hm3⟩ | ⟨ha1, ha2, _⟩
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0]; ring
        · rw [ha2, zero_pow (by omega)]; ring
        · rw [ha1, zero_pow hk0]; ring
    · simp at hl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_comap_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem ord_comap_of_isOpenImmersion {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (y : Y) :
    (I.comap f).ord y = I.ord (f y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, stalkIdeal_comap]
  exact ord_map_ringEquiv (asIso (f.stalkMap y)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_comap_of_isIso
statement:
theorem ord_comap_of_isIso {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsIso f] (y : Y) :
    (I.comap f).ord y = I.ord (f y)
proof:
:=
  ord_comap_of_isOpenImmersion I f y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_comap_ι
statement: theorem ord_comap_ι (U : X.Opens) (u : U) : (I.comap U.ι).ord u = I.ord (U.ι u)
proof:
:=
  ord_comap_of_isOpenImmersion I U.ι u

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_eq_ord_map_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem ord_eq_ord_map_adicCompletion [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : X) :
    I.ord x = IsLocalRing.ord ((I.stalkIdeal x).map
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal, ord_map_adicCompletion]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.maxOrd_comap_of_isIso
statement:
theorem maxOrd_comap_of_isIso (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsIso f] :
    (I.comap f).maxOrd = I.maxOrd
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ((I.comap f).maxOrd_le_iff.mpr fun y => ?_)
    (I.maxOrd_le_iff.mpr fun x => ?_)
  · rw [I.ord_comap_of_isIso f y]
    exact I.le_maxOrd _
  · have hI : I = (I.comap f).comap (inv f) := by
      rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_id]
    calc I.ord x = ((I.comap f).comap (inv f)).ord x := by rw [← hI]
      _ = (I.comap f).ord (inv f x) := (I.comap f).ord_comap_of_isIso (inv f) x
      _ ≤ (I.comap f).maxOrd := (I.comap f).le_maxOrd _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.maxOrdAlong_anti
statement:
theorem maxOrdAlong_anti {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : I ≤ J) (Z : Set X) :
    J.maxOrdAlong Z ≤ I.maxOrdAlong Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxOrdAlong_eq_sSup_image, maxOrdAlong_eq_sSup_image]
  refine sSup_le ?_
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact (ord_anti h x).trans (le_sSup ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.maxOrd_anti
statement: theorem maxOrd_anti {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : I ≤ J) : J.maxOrd ≤ I.maxOrd
proof:
:=
  (maxOrd_le_iff J).mpr fun x => (ord_anti h x).trans (le_maxOrd I x)

name: IsClosed.isConstructible
statement:
theorem _root_.IsClosed.isConstructible {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [NoetherianSpace Y]
    {s : Set Y} (hs : IsClosed s) : IsConstructible s
proof:
:=
  isConstructible_compl.mp ((NoetherianSpace.isCompact sᶜ).isConstructible hs.isOpen_compl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.setOf_ord_eq_eq_sdiff
statement:
theorem setOf_ord_eq_eq_sdiff (m : ℕ) :
    {x | I.ord x = m} = {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} \ {x | ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change I.ord x = m ↔ (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x ∧ ¬ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x
  rw [not_le]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self m⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (ne_top_of_lt h2)
    rw [← hr] at h1 h2 ⊢
    norm_cast at h1 h2 ⊢
    omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_specializes
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_specializes {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y) :
    I.stalkIdeal x = (I.stalkIdeal y).map (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hyU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem y
  rw [I.stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ U hyU, I.stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ U (h.mem_open U.1.2 hyU),
    Ideal.map_map, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_bot_of_specializes
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_eq_bot_of_specializes {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y) (hy : I.stalkIdeal y = ⊥) :
    I.stalkIdeal x = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.stalkIdeal_specializes h, hy, Ideal.map_bot]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_ne_bot_of_irreducibleComponents
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_ne_bot_of_irreducibleComponents
    (h : ∀ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X, ∀ η, IsGenericPoint η Z → I.stalkIdeal η ≠ ⊥) (x : X) :
    I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  have hgen := (isIrreducible_irreducibleComponent (x := x)).isGenericPoint_genericPoint
    isClosed_irreducibleComponent
  exact h _ (irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents x) _ hgen
    (I.stalkIdeal_eq_bot_of_specializes (hgen.specializes mem_irreducibleComponent) hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_ne_top_of_irreducibleComponents
statement:
theorem ord_ne_top_of_irreducibleComponents [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (h : ∀ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X, ∀ η, IsGenericPoint η Z → I.stalkIdeal η ≠ ⊥) (x : X) :
    I.ord x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  fun hx => I.stalkIdeal_ne_bot_of_irreducibleComponents h x ((I.ord_eq_top_iff x).mp hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.maxOrdAlong_eq_sSup_image

theorem maxOrdAlong_eq_sSup_image (Z : Set X) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.maxOrd_eq_iSup
statement: theorem maxOrd_eq_iSup : I.maxOrd = ⨆ x, I.ord x
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_maxOrd
statement: theorem le_maxOrd (x : X) : I.ord x ≤ I.maxOrd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.maxOrd_le_iff
statement: theorem maxOrd_le_iff {m : ℕ∞} : I.maxOrd ≤ m ↔ ∀ x, I.ord x ≤ m
proof:
:= by

  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.topLocus_eq_setOf_le
statement: theorem topLocus_eq_setOf_le : I.topLocus = {x | I.maxOrd ≤ I.ord x}
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isNoetherian_of_field
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isNoetherian_of_field [LocallyOfFiniteType f]

statement: theorem isLocallyNoetherian_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension : IsLocallyNoetherian X

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isLocallyClosed_setOf_ord_eq
statement: theorem isLocallyClosed_setOf_ord_eq (m : ℕ) : IsLocallyClosed {x | I.ord x = m}
proof:
:= by
  rw [setOf_ord_eq_eq_sdiff, Set.sdiff_eq]
  exact (isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I m).isLocallyClosed.inter
    (isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I (m + 1)).isOpen_compl.isLocallyClosed

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isConstructible_setOf_ord_eq
statement:
theorem isConstructible_setOf_ord_eq [NoetherianSpace X] (m : ℕ) :
    IsConstructible {x | I.ord x = m}
proof:
:= by
  rw [setOf_ord_eq_eq_sdiff]
  exact (isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I m).isConstructible.sdiff
    (isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I (m + 1)).isConstructible

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_setOf_le_ord_eq_setOf_ord_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_setOf_le_ord_eq_setOf_ord_eq_top [NoetherianSpace X] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m, m₀ ≤ m → {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} = {x | I.ord x = ⊤}
proof:
:= by
  let C : ℕ → Closeds X := fun m => ⟨{x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x}, isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I m⟩
  have hC : Antitone C := fun a b hab x hx => by
    change (a : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x
    exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hab) hx
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := WellFoundedLT.antitone_chain_condition hC
  refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm => ?_⟩
  have heq : {x | (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} = {x | (m₀ : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} :=
    congrArg SetLike.coe (hm₀ m hm).symm
  rw [heq, setOf_ord_eq_top_eq_iInter]
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm (fun x hx => Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun m' => ?_) (Set.iInter_subset _ m₀)
  rcases le_or_gt m' m₀ with h' | h'
  · exact le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr h' : (m' : ℕ∞) ≤ m₀) hx
  · have : {x | (m' : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} = {x | (m₀ : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x} :=
      congrArg SetLike.coe (hm₀ m' h'.le).symm
    rw [this]
    exact hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_ord_le_of_stalkIdeal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_ord_le_of_stalkIdeal_ne_bot [NoetherianSpace X] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥ → I.ord x ≤ m₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := exists_setOf_le_ord_eq_setOf_ord_eq_top I f n
  refine ⟨m₀, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  by_contra hlt
  rw [not_le] at hlt
  have h1 : ((m₀ + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord x := by
    rw [Nat.cast_succ]
    exact Order.add_one_le_of_lt hlt
  have h2 : x ∈ {x | I.ord x = ⊤} := hm₀ (m₀ + 1) (Nat.le_succ m₀) ▸ h1
  have := isLocallyNoetherian_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension f n
  exact hx ((I.ord_eq_top_iff x).mp h2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.finite_image_ord_setOf_stalkIdeal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem finite_image_ord_setOf_stalkIdeal_ne_bot [NoetherianSpace X] :
    ((fun x => I.ord x) '' {x | I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥}).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := exists_ord_le_of_stalkIdeal_ne_bot I f n
  refine ((Set.finite_le_nat m₀).image (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℕ∞)).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hle : I.ord x ≤ m₀ := hm₀ x hx
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (hle.trans_lt (ENat.natCast_lt_top m₀)).ne
  refine ⟨r, ?_, hr⟩
  rw [← hr] at hle
  exact_mod_cast hle

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.finite_range_ord
statement: theorem finite_range_ord [NoetherianSpace X] : (Set.range fun x => I.ord x).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((finite_image_ord_setOf_stalkIdeal_ne_bot I f n).insert ⊤).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [Set.mem_insert_iff]
  by_cases hx : I.stalkIdeal x = ⊥
  · have := isLocallyNoetherian_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension f n
    exact Or.inl ((I.ord_eq_top_iff x).mpr hx)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_ord_eq_maxOrdAlong
statement:
theorem exists_ord_eq_maxOrdAlong [NoetherianSpace X] {Z : Set X} (hZ : Z.Nonempty)
    (hI : ∀ x ∈ Z, I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥) : ∃ z ∈ Z, I.ord z = I.maxOrdAlong Z
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : ((fun x => I.ord x) '' Z).Finite :=
    (finite_image_ord_setOf_stalkIdeal_ne_bot I f n).subset (Set.image_mono hI)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := (hZ.image fun x => I.ord x).csSup_mem hfin
  exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [maxOrdAlong_eq_sSup_image]; exact hz'⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.maxOrdAlong_ne_top
statement:
theorem maxOrdAlong_ne_top [NoetherianSpace X] {Z : Set X} (hI : ∀ x ∈ Z, I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥) :
    I.maxOrdAlong Z ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := exists_ord_le_of_stalkIdeal_ne_bot I f n
  exact ((I.maxOrdAlong_le_iff.mpr fun z hz => hm₀ z (hI z hz)).trans_lt
    (ENat.natCast_lt_top m₀)).ne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_ord_eq_maxOrd
statement:
theorem exists_ord_eq_maxOrd [NoetherianSpace X] [Nonempty X] (hI : ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ x, I.ord x = I.maxOrd
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := exists_ord_eq_maxOrdAlong I f n Set.univ_nonempty fun x _ => hI x
  exact ⟨z, hz⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.maxOrd_ne_top
statement: theorem maxOrd_ne_top [NoetherianSpace X] (hI : ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥) : I.maxOrd ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  maxOrdAlong_ne_top I f n fun x _ => hI x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isGreatest_range_ord
statement:
theorem isGreatest_range_ord [NoetherianSpace X] [Nonempty X] (hI : ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range fun x => I.ord x) I.maxOrd
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ord_eq_maxOrd I f n hI
  refine ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact I.le_maxOrd y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosed_topLocus
statement: theorem isClosed_topLocus : IsClosed I.topLocus
proof:
:= by
  rw [topLocus_eq_setOf_le]
  by_cases h : I.maxOrd = ⊤
  · rw [h]
    simp_rw [top_le_iff]
    exact isClosed_setOf_ord_eq_top f n I
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp h
    rw [← hm]
    exact isClosed_setOf_le_ord f n I m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.topLocus_nonempty
statement:
theorem topLocus_nonempty [NoetherianSpace X] [Nonempty X] (hI : ∀ x, I.stalkIdeal x ≠ ⊥) :
    I.topLocus.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  exists_ord_eq_maxOrd I f n hI

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isConstructible_setOf_ord_eq_top
statement: theorem isConstructible_setOf_ord_eq_top [NoetherianSpace X] : IsConstructible {x | I.ord x = ⊤}
proof:
:=
  (isClosed_setOf_ord_eq_top f n I).isConstructible

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isConstructible_preimage_ord
statement:
theorem isConstructible_preimage_ord [NoetherianSpace X] (v : ℕ∞) :
    IsConstructible ((fun x => I.ord x) ⁻¹' {v})
proof:
:= by
  cases v using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => exact isConstructible_setOf_ord_eq_top I f n
  | coe m => exact isConstructible_setOf_ord_eq I f n m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.finite_range_ord_and_isConstructible_preimage_ord
statement:
theorem finite_range_ord_and_isConstructible_preimage_ord [NoetherianSpace X] :
    (Set.range fun x => I.ord x).Finite ∧
      ∀ v : ℕ∞, IsConstructible ((fun x => I.ord x) ⁻¹' {v})
proof:
:=
  ⟨finite_range_ord I f n, isConstructible_preimage_ord I f n⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.maxOrd_top
statement: theorem maxOrd_top {X : Scheme.{u}} : (⊤ : X.IdealSheafData).maxOrd = 0
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.maxOrd_le_iff _).mpr fun x =>
      by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ord_top]) zero_le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.subschemeι_genericPoint_eq
statement: theorem subschemeι_genericPoint_eq : Z.subschemeι (genericPoint Z.subscheme) = η
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (genericPoint_spec Z.subscheme).image Z.subschemeι.continuous
  rw [Set.image_univ, Z.range_subschemeι, Z.support.isClosed.closure_eq] at h1
  exact h1.eq hη

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal_of_isGenericPoint
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal_of_isGenericPoint :
    Z.stalkIdeal η = maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk η)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := subschemeι_genericPoint_eq Z hη
  have hfield : IsField (Z.subscheme.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Z.subscheme)) :=
    Field.toIsField Z.subscheme.functionField
  have hq := (stalkQuotientEquiv Z (genericPoint Z.subscheme)).toMulEquiv.isField hfield
  have hmax := Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField _ hq
  rw [← hp]
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax

name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringKrullDim_stalk_ne_zero
statement: theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_ne_zero : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk η) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsm : Smooth (Z.subschemeι ≫ f) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth (n - r) _
  have hint : IsIntegral Z.subscheme := isIntegral_subscheme_of_smooth f Z hη
  have hp := subschemeι_genericPoint_eq Z hη
  set p := genericPoint Z.subscheme with hpdef
  subst hp
  let := f.stalkAlgebra (Z.subschemeι p)
  let := (Z.subschemeι ≫ f).stalkAlgebra p
  have hX := Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_residueField_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension f n
    (Z.subschemeι p)
  have hZ := Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_add_trdeg_residueField_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
    (Z.subschemeι ≫ f) (n - r) p
  have h0 : ringKrullDim (Z.subscheme.presheaf.stalk p) = 0 :=
    ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField (Field.toIsField Z.subscheme.functionField)
  
  let e : ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (Z.subschemeι p)) ≃ₐ[k]
      ResidueField (Z.subscheme.presheaf.stalk p) :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := residueFieldStalkEquiv Z p) fun c => by
      change ResidueField.map (Z.subschemeι.stalkMap p).hom
        (residue _ (algebraMap k (X.presheaf.stalk (Z.subschemeι p)) c)) =
        residue _ (algebraMap k (Z.subscheme.presheaf.stalk p) c)
      rw [ResidueField.map_residue, stalkMap_subschemeι_algebraMap Z f p c]
  have htr := e.trdeg_eq
  intro hdim
  rw [hdim, zero_add, htr] at hX
  rw [h0, zero_add] at hZ
  rw [hZ] at hX
  have : n = n - r := by exact_mod_cast hX.symm
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.not_pow_succ_dvd_comap
statement:
theorem not_pow_succ_dvd_comap (m : ℕ) (hm : I.ord η = m) :
    ¬ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ (m + 1) ∣ I.comap (blowUpπ Z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hdvd
  have hsmX : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
  have hsm : Smooth (Z.subschemeι ≫ f) := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth (n - r) _
  have hint : IsIntegral Z.subscheme := isIntegral_subscheme_of_smooth f Z hη
  have hle : I.comap (blowUpπ Z) ≤ (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ (m + 1) := le_pow_of_pow_dvd hdvd
  obtain ⟨φ, H⟩ := exists_isPullback_fromSpecStalk Z η
  
  have h1 : (specIdealSheaf (I.stalkIdeal η)).comap (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal η)) ≤
      ((specIdealSheaf (Z.stalkIdeal η)).comap (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal η))) ^ (m + 1) := by
    have h : (I.comap (blowUpπ Z)).comap φ ≤ ((Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ (m + 1)).comap φ :=
      comap_mono φ hle
    rwa [comap_pow, ← comap_comp, ← comap_comp, H.w, comap_comp, comap_comp,
      comap_fromSpecStalk_eq_specIdealSheaf,
      comap_fromSpecStalk_eq_specIdealSheaf] at h
  
  obtain ⟨m', y, hm', hy, -⟩ := exists_adaptedParameters Z f n r hrn hη.mem
  have hZmax : Z.stalkIdeal η = maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk η) :=
    stalkIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal_of_isGenericPoint Z hη
  have hm'pos : 0 < m' := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m' with h0 | h0
    · exfalso
      apply ringKrullDim_stalk_ne_zero f n r Z hr hrn hη
      rw [← hm', h0]
      rfl
    · exact h0
  let ρ : Fin m' := ⟨m' - 1, by omega⟩
  have hρ : ρ.val + 1 = m' := by
    change m' - 1 + 1 = m'
    omega
  have hcenter : Z.stalkIdeal η = chartCenter y ρ := by
    rw [hZmax, hy, chartCenter]
    congr 1
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨i, ?_, rfl⟩
      change i.val ≤ m' - 1
      have := i.2
      omega
    · rintro ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hmem : y ρ ∈ Z.stalkIdeal η :=
    hcenter ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨ρ, show ρ ≤ ρ from le_rfl, rfl⟩
  
  have h2 : ((specIdealSheaf (I.stalkIdeal η)).comap (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal η))).comap
        (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal η) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩) ≤
      (((specIdealSheaf (Z.stalkIdeal η)).comap (affineBlowUp.π (Z.stalkIdeal η))) ^ (m + 1)).comap
        (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal η) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩) :=
    comap_mono (affineBlowUp.chart (Z.stalkIdeal η) ⟨y ρ, hmem⟩) h1
  rw [comap_pow, ← comap_comp, ← comap_comp, affineBlowUp.chart_π, comap_specIdealSheaf_Spec_map,
    comap_specIdealSheaf_Spec_map, ← specIdealSheaf_pow, specIdealSheaf_le_iff] at h2
  
  have hreg := isRegularLocalRing_stalk f η
  have hordI : IsLocalRing.ord (I.stalkIdeal η) = m := by
    rw [← ord_eq_ord_stalkIdeal]
    exact hm
  obtain ⟨g, hgI, hgm⟩ := exists_mem_ordElem_eq_of_ord_eq hordI
  have h3 := h2 (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hgI)
  
  have hC : affineBlowUpAlgebra (Z.stalkIdeal η) (y ρ) = chartRing y ρ := by
    rw [hcenter]
    exact affineBlowUpAlgebra_span_eq_chartRing y ρ
  have key : ∀ C : Subalgebra (X.presheaf.stalk η) (Localization.Away (y ρ)), C = chartRing y ρ →
      algebraMap _ C g ∉ ((Z.stalkIdeal η).map (algebraMap _ C)) ^ (m + 1) := by
    rintro C rfl h
    rw [hcenter, map_chartCenter] at h
    exact algebraMap_notMem_span_pow_succ y hy hm' ρ hρ g m hgm h
  exact key _ hC h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exceptionalOrderAlong_eq_ord
statement:
theorem exceptionalOrderAlong_eq_ord (hI : I.ord η ≠ ⊤) :
    (exceptionalOrderAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) I : ℕ∞) = I.ord η
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hI
  rw [ENat.some_eq_natCast] at hm
  rw [← hm]
  congr 1
  unfold exceptionalOrderAlong
  refine IsGreatest.csSup_eq ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact exceptionalDivisor_pow_dvd_comap_of_le_ord f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm.le
  · intro c hc
    by_contra hlt
    exact not_pow_succ_dvd_comap f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm.symm
      (dvd_trans (pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (not_le.mp hlt))) hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pow_mul_controlledTransformAlong
statement:
theorem pow_mul_controlledTransformAlong (m : ℕ) (hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord η) :
    (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ m *
        I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) m =
      I.comap (blowUpπ Z)
proof:
:=
  pow_mul_colon_of_dvd _ _ _
    (exceptionalDivisor_pow_dvd_comap_of_le_ord f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.weakTransformAlong_eq
statement:
theorem weakTransformAlong_eq (m : ℕ) (hm : I.ord η = m) :
    I.weakTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) =
      I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) m
proof:
:= by
  unfold weakTransformAlong
  congr 1
  have h := exceptionalOrderAlong_eq_ord f n r Z hr hrn I hη
    (by rw [hm]; exact ENat.natCast_ne_top m)
  rw [hm] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pow_dvd_controlledTransformAlong_iff
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_controlledTransformAlong_iff (m : ℕ) (hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord η) (c : ℕ) :
    (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ c ∣
        I.controlledTransformAlong (blowUpπ Z) (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) m ↔
      ((c + m : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ I.ord η
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := (blowUp.isBlowUp Z).admissible
  have hFm := pow_mul_controlledTransformAlong f n r Z hr hrn I hη m hm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, hK⟩
    have h1 : I.comap (blowUpπ Z) = (Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ (c + m) * K := by
      rw [← hFm, hK, pow_add, mul_comm ((Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ c) ((Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ m),
        mul_assoc]
    by_contra hlt
    rw [not_le] at hlt
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hlt.ne_top
    rw [ENat.some_eq_natCast] at hm₀
    have hlt' : m₀ < c + m := by
      rw [← hm₀] at hlt
      exact Nat.cast_lt.mp hlt
    exact not_pow_succ_dvd_comap f n r Z hr hrn I hη m₀ hm₀.symm
      (dvd_trans (pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt')) ⟨K, h1⟩)
  · intro hle
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exceptionalDivisor_pow_dvd_comap_of_le_ord f n r Z hr hrn I hη (c + m) hle
    refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
    exact colon_pow_eq_of_mul_eq _ hinv m ((Z.comap (blowUpπ Z)) ^ c * K)
      (by rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.add_comm m c, ← hK])

name: Derivation.preservesIdeal_span_iff
statement:
theorem preservesIdeal_span_iff (δ : Derivation k A A) (s : Set A) :
    δ.PreservesIdeal (Ideal.span s) ↔ ∀ g ∈ s, δ g ∈ Ideal.span s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h g hg => h g (Ideal.subset_span hg), fun h a ha => ?_⟩
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem g hg => exact h g hg
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ ha hb
  | smul c a ha' ha =>
    rw [smul_eq_mul, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ha) (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ ha')

name: Derivation.PreservesIdeal.map_of_forall
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : J.map φ = Ideal.span (φ '' (J : Set A)) := rfl
  rw [hJ, preservesIdeal_span_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  rw [h a]
  exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨δ a, hδ a ha, rfl⟩

name: Ideal.map_logDerivative_le
statement:
theorem map_logDerivative_le (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M B] (J I : Ideal A) :
    (logDerivative k J I).map (algebraMap A B) ≤
      logDerivative k (J.map (algebraMap A B)) (I.map (algebraMap A B))
proof:
:= by
